items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G /\ (finite (group_carrier A G) /\ gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1) -> group_monomorphism A A (G,G) (fun x:set => group_pow A G x n)

items.name: ABELIAN_GROUP_MONOMORPHISM_POWERING_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G /\ finite (group_carrier A G) -> (group_monomorphism A A (G,G) (fun x:set => group_pow A G x n) <-> gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1)

items.name: ABELIAN_GROUP_MUL_AC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G <-> (forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ z :e group_carrier A G) -> group_mul A G (group_mul A G x y) z = group_mul A G x (group_mul A G y z)) /\ forall x y z :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ z :e group_carrier A G) -> group_mul A G x (group_mul A G y z) = group_mul A G y (group_mul A G x z))

items.name: ABELIAN_GROUP_MUL_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, forall n :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> group_pow A G (group_mul A G x y) n = group_mul A G (group_pow A G x n) (group_pow A G y n)

items.name: ABELIAN_GROUP_MUL_ZPOW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, forall n :e int, abelian_group_hl A G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> group_zpow A G (group_mul A G x y) n = group_mul A G (group_zpow A G x n) (group_zpow A G y n)

items.name: ABELIAN_GROUP_NORMAL_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, abelian_group_hl A G -> (normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G)

items.name: ABELIAN_GROUP_ORDER_DIVIDES_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G /\ finite (group_carrier A G) -> exists x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ forall y :e A, y :e group_carrier A G -> divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G y) (group_element_order_hl A G x)

items.name: ABELIAN_GROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e s)) -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) -> abelian_group_hl A (subgroup_generated A G s)

items.name: ABELIAN_GROUP_TORSION_STRUCTURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G -> isomorphic_group A (A :^: omega) (subgroup_generated A G {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0}) (sum_group A omega {p :e omega | prime_nat p} (fun p:set => subgroup_generated A G {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k}))

items.name: ABELIAN_HOMOLOGY_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, abelian_group_hl (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top))

items.name: ABELIAN_IMP_SOLVABLE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G -> solvable_group A G

items.name: ABELIAN_INTEGER_GROUP
items.statement: abelian_group_hl int integer_group

items.name: ABELIAN_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e omega, abelian_group_hl int (integer_mod_group n)

items.name: ABELIAN_OPPOSITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A (opposite_group A G) <-> abelian_group_hl A G

items.name: ABELIAN_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> (abelian_group_hl (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> abelian_group_hl A (G i))

items.name: ABELIAN_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, abelian_group_hl (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G H) <-> abelian_group_hl A G /\ abelian_group_hl B H

items.name: ABELIAN_QUOTIENT_COMMUTATOR
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall x y :e A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (abelian_group_hl (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G)) -> group_mul A G (group_inv A G x) (group_mul A G (group_inv A G y) (group_mul A G x y)) :e n

items.name: ABELIAN_QUOTIENT_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall n c= A, group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ (normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ abelian_group_hl (Power A) (quotient_group A G n)) -> normal_subgroup_of B {f x | x :e n} H /\ abelian_group_hl (Power B) (quotient_group B H {f x | x :e n})

items.name: ABELIAN_QUOTIENT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, abelian_group_hl A G /\ subgroup_of A n G -> abelian_group_hl (Power A) (quotient_group A G n)

items.name: ABELIAN_QUOTIENT_GROUP_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> group_div A G (group_mul A G x y) (group_mul A G y x) :e n) -> abelian_group_hl (Power A) (quotient_group A G n)

items.name: ABELIAN_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, abelian_group_hl (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)))

items.name: ABELIAN_RELCYCLE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, abelian_group_hl (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (relcycle_group A (p,(top,s)))

items.name: ABELIAN_SIMPLE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G -> ((forall h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G -> h = {group_id A G} \/ h = group_carrier A G) <-> finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G) = 1 \/ prime_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))))

items.name: ABELIAN_SINGLETON_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, abelian_group_hl A (singleton_group A a)

items.name: ABELIAN_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, abelian_group_hl A G -> abelian_group_hl A (subgroup_generated A G h)

items.name: ABELIAN_SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> (abelian_group_hl (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> abelian_group_hl A (G i))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on M f s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x < drop y) -> distance N (g x,g y) <= distance M (f x,f y)) -> absolutely_continuous_on N g s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_DIFFERENTIABLE_BV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, differentiable_on_hl N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_DIFFERENTIABLE_BV_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (bounded_hl 1 s /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f s /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ (countable t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s :\: t -> differentiable N 1 f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)))))) -> absolutely_continuous_on N f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_EXTENDS_TO_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ is_interval 1 s -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (absolutely_continuous_on N g (closure 1 s) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_IMP_BANACH_SPROPERTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall e0 :e R, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx 1, t c= s /\ (measurable 1 t /\ measure 1 t < d) -> measurable N {f x | x :e t} /\ measure N {f x | x :e t} < e0

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_IMP_PATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> absolutely_continuous_on N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> path N g

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_IMP_RECTIFIABLE_PATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> absolutely_continuous_on N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> rectifiable_path N g

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_integral 1 N f' (vector_sub N (f x) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (x,b) seq_nil)) f) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < d) -> vector_norm N (integral N M t f) < e0

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ISOMETRIC
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, distance A (f x,f y) = distance N (g x,g y)) -> (absolutely_continuous_on A f s <-> absolutely_continuous_on N g s)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ISOMETRIC_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) -> (absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => f (g x)) s <-> absolutely_continuous_on M g s)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_JOINPATHS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 /\ (absolutely_continuous_on N g1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) /\ absolutely_continuous_on N g2 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil))) -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_LIPSCHITZ_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall B :e R, absolutely_continuous_on M g s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e {g x | x :e s} /\ y :e {g x | x :e s} -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => f (g x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_MEASURE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ differentiable_on_hl N N f s -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (measurable N t /\ measure N t < d) -> measurable N {f x | x :e t} /\ measure N {f x | x :e t} < e0

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_MEASURE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ negligible N {f x | x :e {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable N N f (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)}}) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (measurable N t /\ measure N t < d) -> measurable N {f x | x :e t} /\ measure N {f x | x :e t} < e0

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_MEASURE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= u /\ (measurable N u /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) /\ negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | infinite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}}))) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < d) -> measurable N {f x | x :e t} /\ measure N {f x | x :e t} < e0

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ absolutely_continuous_on N g s -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_BILINEAR
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, bilinear N P M bop /\ (absolutely_continuous_on M f s /\ (absolutely_continuous_on N g s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ bounded_hl 1 s))) -> absolutely_continuous_on P (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closure 1 s) /\ absolutely_continuous_on N f (interior 1 s)) -> absolutely_continuous_on N f (closure 1 s)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSURE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closure 1 s) -> (absolutely_continuous_on N f (closure 1 s) <-> absolutely_continuous_on N f s)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_CMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_CMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s <-> c = 0 \/ absolutely_continuous_on N f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop c /\ drop c <= drop b -> (absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) /\ absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (bounded_hl 1 s /\ (is_interval 1 t /\ (bounded_hl 1 t /\ (absolutely_continuous_on N f t /\ (absolutely_continuous_on 1 g s /\ {g x | x :e s} c= t))))) -> (absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => f (g x)) s <-> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => f (g x)) s)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPOSE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on M f s /\ linear M N g -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => g (f x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_CONST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall c :e R :^: idx N, absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => c) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_DIVISION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx 1), division_of 1 d (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx 1, k :e d -> absolutely_continuous_on N f k) <-> absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> absolutely_continuous_on N f Empty

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ absolutely_continuous_on N f s -> absolutely_continuous_on N g s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_ID
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => x) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_IMP_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on A f s /\ is_interval 1 s -> continuous_on_hl 1 A f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_IMP_HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ bounded_hl 1 s -> has_bounded_variation_on N f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_IMP_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ is_interval 1 s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl 1 N f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f (interior 1 s) /\ continuous_on_hl 1 N f s -> absolutely_continuous_on N f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_INTERIOR_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl 1 N f s -> (absolutely_continuous_on N f (interior 1 s) <-> absolutely_continuous_on N f s)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_ABS
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (f x))) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_MAX
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on 1 f s /\ absolutely_continuous_on 1 g s -> absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (if drop (f x) <= drop (g x) then drop (g x) else drop (f x))) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_MIN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on 1 f s /\ absolutely_continuous_on 1 g s -> absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (if drop (f x) <= drop (g x) then drop (f x) else drop (g x))) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on 1 f s /\ (absolutely_continuous_on N g s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ bounded_hl 1 s)) -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop (f x)) (g x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s -> absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x))) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_NULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, content 1 s = 0 /\ bounded_hl 1 s -> absolutely_continuous_on N f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on A f {a}

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ absolutely_continuous_on N g s -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ t c= s -> absolutely_continuous_on N f t

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx N, absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vector_add N a (f x)) s <-> absolutely_continuous_on N f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_VMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall v :e R :^: idx N, absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (f x) v) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_VMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall v :e R :^: idx N, absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (f x) v) s <-> v = vec N 0 \/ absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_ON_VSUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx 1, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall k c= A, finite k /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> absolutely_continuous_on N (f i) s) -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => vsum A N k (fun i:set => f i x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> absolutely_continuous_on N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> absolutely_continuous_on N (fun x:set => reversepath N g x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_VECTOR_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ absolutely_continuous_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, absolutely_integrable_on B A (fun x:set => vec B 0) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s -> absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => abs_SNo (f x i)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))))) -> absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_DERIVATIVE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_DERIVATIVE_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (at 1 x))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= vector_norm P (g x)) /\ (integrable_on N M f s /\ absolutely_integrable_on P M g s) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_COMPONENT_LBOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, x :e s /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> f x i <= g x i) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f s /\ integrable_on N M g s) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M g s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_COMPONENT_UBOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, x :e s /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> f x i <= g x i) /\ (integrable_on N M f s /\ absolutely_integrable_on N M g s) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_DROP_LBOUND
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> drop (f x) <= drop (g x)) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on 1 M f s /\ integrable_on 1 M g s) -> absolutely_integrable_on 1 M g s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_DROP_UBOUND
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> drop (f x) <= drop (g x)) /\ (integrable_on 1 M f s /\ absolutely_integrable_on 1 M g s) -> absolutely_integrable_on 1 M f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABS_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, absolutely_integrable_on 1 A f s -> absolutely_integrable_on 1 A (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (drop (f x)))) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ABS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s <-> integrable_on N M f s /\ integrable_on N M (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => abs_SNo (f x i)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s /\ absolutely_integrable_on N M g s -> absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s /\ ~ m = 0 -> absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => f (vector_add M (vector_mul M m x) c)) {vector_add M (vector_mul M (recip_SNo m) x) (vector_neg M (vector_mul M (recip_SNo m) c)) | x :e s}

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_APPROXIMATE_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M g s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (R :^: idx M) /\ (bounded_hl N {g x | x :e R :^: idx M} /\ vector_norm 1 (integral 1 M s (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (g x))))) < e0)))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_MEASURABLE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, op x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, bilinear P Q N op /\ (measurable_on M N f s /\ (bounded_hl N {f x | x :e s} /\ absolutely_integrable_on P M g s)) -> absolutely_integrable_on Q M (fun x:set => op (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_MEASURABLE_PRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s <-> measurable_on M N f s /\ forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> measurable_on M 1 g s /\ bounded_hl 1 {g x | x :e s} -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop (g x)) (f x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_MEASURABLE_PRODUCT_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (absolutely_integrable_on N M f s <-> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> measurable_on M 1 g s /\ bounded_hl 1 {g x | x :e s} -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop (g x)) (f x)) s)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (fun k:set => integral N M k f) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (fun k:set => integral N M k f) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_UNIV_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) <-> integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) /\ has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (fun k:set => integral N M k f) (R :^: idx M))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_VARIATION_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists s c= R :^: idx 1, negligible 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (at 1 x)) /\ absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_VARIATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N (fun t:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,t) seq_nil)) f) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CHANGE_OF_VARIABLES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, g' x y :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative M M g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ g x = g y) -> x = y)) -> (absolutely_integrable_on N M f {g x | x :e s} <-> absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M (g' x)))) (f (g x))) s)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CHANGE_OF_VARIABLES_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R, g' x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, lebesgue_measurable 1 s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ g x = g y) -> x = y) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> has_vector_derivative 1 g (lift (g' (drop x))) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s))) -> (absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f {g x | x :e s} <-> absolutely_integrable_on N 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (g' (drop x))) (f (g x))) s)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CHANGE_OF_VARIABLES_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M M g -> (absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M g))) (f (g x))) s <-> absolutely_integrable_on N M f {g x | x :e s})

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CMUL

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s <-> c = 0 \/ absolutely_integrable_on N M f s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_COMBINE

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_COMPONENTWISE

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CONST

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CONTINUOUS

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CONVOLUTION_AE
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear P Q N bop /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) /\ absolutely_integrable_on P M g (R :^: idx M)) -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x :e t -> absolutely_integrable_on Q M (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CONVOLUTION_L1_LINF
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, bilinear P Q N bop /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) /\ (measurable_on M P g (R :^: idx M) /\ bounded_hl P {g x | x :e R :^: idx M})) -> absolutely_integrable_on Q M (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CONVOLUTION_L2
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, bilinear P Q N bop /\ (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ (measurable_on M P g (R :^: idx M) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on 1 M (fun x0:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x0) ^ 2)) (R :^: idx M) /\ absolutely_integrable_on 1 M (fun x0:set => lift (vector_norm P (g x0) ^ 2)) (R :^: idx M)))) -> absolutely_integrable_on Q M (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CONVOLUTION_LINF_L1
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, bilinear P Q N bop /\ (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ (bounded_hl N {f x | x :e R :^: idx M} /\ absolutely_integrable_on P M g (R :^: idx M))) -> absolutely_integrable_on Q M (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_CONVOLUTION_SYM
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on Q M (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y)) (R :^: idx M) <-> absolutely_integrable_on Q M (fun y:set => bop (f y) (g (vector_sub M x y))) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_DIFF

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_EQ_INTEGRABLE_POS

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_IMPROPER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, (forall c d :e R :^: idx M, closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= open_interval M (a,b) -> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))) /\ (bounded_hl N (\/_ c :e R :^: idx M, {integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) f | d :e R :^: idx M, closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= open_interval M (a,b)}) /\ (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on 1 M g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> f x i <= drop (g x)) \/ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> drop (g x) <= f x i)))) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_IMPROPER_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, (forall c d :e R :^: idx M, closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= open_interval M (a,b) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))) /\ bounded_hl 1 (\/_ c :e R :^: idx M, {integral 1 M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x))) | d :e R :^: idx M, closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= open_interval M (a,b)}) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_INCREASING_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> exists s c= R :^: idx 1, exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative 1 f (f' x) (at 1 x)) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on 1 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> drop (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f') <= drop (f x) + - drop (f a))))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_INCREASING_DERIVATIVE_ALT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative 1 f (f' x) (at 1 x))) -> absolutely_integrable_on 1 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> drop (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f') <= drop (f x) + - drop (f a)

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_INF_1
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall fs:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e A, fs x y :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= A, finite k /\ (~ k = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> absolutely_integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => lift (fs x i)) s)) -> absolutely_integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => lift (inf {fs x x0 | x0 :e k})) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_INTEGRABLE_BOUND

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_LE

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_LEBESGUE_POINTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, negligible M k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, ~ x :e k /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall h :e R, 0 < h /\ h < d -> vector_norm 1 (vector_mul 1 (recip_SNo (content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (vector_sub M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1)),vector_add M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1))) seq_nil)))) (integral 1 M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (vector_sub M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1)),vector_add M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1))) seq_nil)) (fun t:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f t) (f x)))))) < e0

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_MAX_1
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ absolutely_integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (g x)) s -> absolutely_integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (if f x <= g x then g x else f x)) s

items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, g' x y :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative M M g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) /\ absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M (g' x)))) (f (g x))) s -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f {g x | x :e s}

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ON_LINEAR_IMAGE

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_ON_NEGLIGIBLE

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_PASTECART_SYM
items.statement: forall A M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall y :e A, absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) (fun z:set => f (pastecart M N (sndcart N M z) (fstcart N z))) {pastecart N M (sndcart M N z) (fstcart M z) | z :e s} <-> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f s

items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> set_variation M N (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun k:set => integral N M k f) = drop (integral 1 M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x))))

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_SQUARE_INTEGRABLE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, bilinear P Q N bop /\ (measurable_on M N f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x) ^ 2)) s /\ (measurable_on M P g s /\ integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm P (g x) ^ 2)) s))) -> absolutely_integrable_on Q M (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_SETCONTINUOUS_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, absolutely_setcontinuous_on M N f s /\ (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> vector_norm P (g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) <= vector_norm N (f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> absolutely_setcontinuous_on M P g s

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_SETCONTINUOUS_ON_CMUL

items.name: ABSOLUTELY_SETCONTINUOUS_ON_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), operative (R :^: idx N) M (fun x:set => fun x0:set => vector_add N x x0) f /\ division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e d -> absolutely_setcontinuous_on M N f k) <-> absolutely_setcontinuous_on M N f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ absolutely_setcontinuous_on M N f s -> absolutely_setcontinuous_on M N g s

items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s /\ content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0) -> f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = vec N 0) /\ (content M s = 0 /\ bounded_hl M s) -> absolutely_setcontinuous_on M N f s

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u t c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) N f t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex N + 1))) u) t) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) N g u /\ ({g x | x :e u} c= s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), x :e t -> g x = f x))) -> AR N s

items.name: ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_DERIVATIVE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_integral 1 N f' (vector_sub N (f x) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil))) <-> absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ exists s c= R :^: idx 1, negligible 1 s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_DERIVATIVE_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_integral 1 N f' (vector_sub N (f x) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil))) <-> absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ exists s c= R :^: idx 1, negligible 1 s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (at 1 x)

items.name: ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_NORM_DERIVATIVE_LE_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists s c= R :^: idx 1, exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (at 1 x)) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall c :e R :^: idx 1, c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> drop (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f' x)))) <= vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f)))

items.name: ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_NORM_DERIVATIVE_LE_VARIATION_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))))) -> absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall c :e R :^: idx 1, c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> drop (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f' x)))) <= vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f

items.name: ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_SUBSTITUTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (g a,g b) seq_nil)) /\ (absolutely_continuous_on 1 g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative 1 g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (g x) <= drop (g y)))))) -> absolutely_integrable_on N 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop (g' x)) (f (g x))) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop (g' x)) (f (g x))) = integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (g a,g b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: ABSOLUTE_INTEGRATION_BY_PARTS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, bilinear N P M bop /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ (absolutely_integrable_on M 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N 1 g' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_integral 1 M f' (f x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil))) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_integral 1 N g' (g x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil))))))) -> absolutely_integrable_on P 1 (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g' x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on P 1 (fun x:set => bop (f' x) (g x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ vector_add P (integral P 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g' x))) (integral P 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => bop (f' x) (g x))) = vector_sub P (bop (f b) (g b)) (bop (f a) (g a)))

items.name: ABSOLUTE_INTEGRATION_BY_PARTS_SUM
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, bilinear N P M bop /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ (absolutely_integrable_on M 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_integral 1 M f' (vector_sub M (f x) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil))) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N 1 g' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_integral 1 N g' (vector_sub N (g x) (g a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)))))) -> absolutely_integrable_on P 1 (fun x:set => vector_add P (bop (f x) (g' x)) (bop (f' x) (g x))) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_integral 1 P (fun x0:set => vector_add P (bop (f x0) (g' x0)) (bop (f' x0) (g x0))) (vector_sub P (bop (f x) (g x)) (bop (f a) (g a))) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil))

items.name: ABSOLUTE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_EXTENSOR_IMP_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u t c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) N f t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex N + 1))) u) t) -> exists v c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (t c= v /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex N + 1))) u /\ (continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) N g v /\ ({g x | x :e v} c= s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), x :e t -> g x = f x))))) -> ANR N s

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACTION_CONVEX_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= t)) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (retraction N (t,s) r /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x :e s -> r x :e frontier N s)

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACTION_CONVEX_CLOSED_RELATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= t)) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (retraction N (t,s) r /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s :\: relative_interior N s -> r x :e relative_frontier N s)

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_CONTRACTIBLE_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (contractible N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ANR N s)) -> retract_of N s u

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s) -> retract_of N s u

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_CONVEX_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= t)) -> retract_of N s t

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_FROM_UNION_AND_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N (s :\/: t) (R :^: idx N) /\ (retract_of N (s :/\: t) (R :^: idx N) /\ (closed N s /\ closed N t)) -> retract_of N s (R :^: idx N)

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_COMPACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, homeomorphic M N s u /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (s c= t /\ (convex M u /\ compact M u))) -> retract_of N s t

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_IMP_AR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall s' c= R :^: idx N, retract_of M s (R :^: idx M) /\ (homeomorphic N M s s' /\ closed N s') -> retract_of N s' (R :^: idx N)

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_IMP_AR_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall s' c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, retract_of M s t /\ (convex M t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (homeomorphic N M s s' /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s'))) -> retract_of N s' u

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_PATH_IMAGE_ARC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, arc N g /\ path_image N g c= s -> retract_of N (path_image N g) s

items.name: ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N s (R :^: idx N) /\ (retract_of N t (R :^: idx N) /\ retract_of N (s :/\: t) (R :^: idx N)) -> retract_of N (s :\/: t) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: ABSORPTION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, x :e s <-> SetAdjoin s x = s

items.name: ABS_DROP
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, abs_SNo (drop x) = vector_norm 1 x

items.name: ABS_SIMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall t1 :e A, forall t2 :e B, t1 = t1

items.name: ABS_SQUARE_EQ_1
items.statement: forall x :e R, x ^ 2 = 1 <-> abs_SNo x = 1

items.name: ABS_SQUARE_LE_1
items.statement: forall x :e R, x ^ 2 <= 1 <-> abs_SNo x <= 1

items.name: ABS_SQUARE_LT_1
items.statement: forall x :e R, x ^ 2 < 1 <-> abs_SNo x < 1

items.name: ACCESSIBLE_FRONTIER_ANR_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (ANR N s /\ (c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ (x :e c /\ y :e frontier N c))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx 1, g x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N g /\ (pathstart N g = x /\ (pathfinish N g = y /\ forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) :\: {vec 1 1} -> g t :e c)))

items.name: ACCESSIBLE_FRONTIER_ANR_INTER_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, forall p :e R :^: idx N, forall b c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (ANR N s /\ (c :e components N (b :\: s) /\ (p :e frontier N c /\ p :e interior N b))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N g /\ (pathfinish N g = p /\ forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) :\: {vec 1 1} -> g t :e c))

items.name: ADD
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, 0 + n = n) /\ forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m + n = ordsucc (m + n)

items.name: ADD1
items.statement: forall m :e omega, ordsucc m = m + 1

items.name: ADDITIVE_CONTENT_DIVISION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, division_of N d (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> finsum d (fun x:set => content N x) = content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ADDITIVE_CONTENT_TAGGED_DIVISION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, tagged_division_of N d (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> finsum d (fun p:set => content N (p 1)) = content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ADDITIVE_DIVISION_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx 1), forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b /\ division_of 1 d (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> vsum (Power (R :^: idx 1)) N d (fun k:set => vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 k)) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 k))) = vector_sub N (f b) (f a)

items.name: ADDITIVE_TAGGED_DIVISION_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p c= R :^: idx 1 :*: Power (R :^: idx 1), forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b /\ tagged_division_of 1 p (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> vsum (R :^: idx 1 :*: Power (R :^: idx 1)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 (p0 1))) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 (p0 1)))) = vector_sub N (f b) (f a)

items.name: ADD_0
items.statement: forall m :e omega, m + 0 = m

items.name: ADD_AC
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m + n = n + m /\ ((m + n) + p = m + n + p /\ m + n + p = n + m + p)

items.name: ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m + n + p = (m + n) + p

items.name: ADD_CLAUSES
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, 0 + n = n) /\ ((forall m :e omega, m + 0 = m) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m + n = ordsucc (m + n)) /\ forall m n :e omega, m + ordsucc n = ordsucc (m + n)))

items.name: ADD_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m + n = 0 <-> m = 0 /\ n = 0

items.name: ADD_SUB
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, minus_nat (m + n) n = m

items.name: ADD_SUB2
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, minus_nat (m + n) m = n

items.name: ADD_SUBR
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, minus_nat n (m + n) = 0

items.name: ADD_SUBR2
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, minus_nat m (m + n) = 0

items.name: ADD_SUC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m + ordsucc n = ordsucc (m + n)

items.name: ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m + n = n + m

items.name: ADJOINT_ADJOINT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, adjoint N M (adjoint M N f) x = f x

items.name: ADJOINT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, dot M x (adjoint M N f y) = dot N (f x) y) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, dot M (adjoint M N f y) x = dot N y (f x)

items.name: ADJOINT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N A f /\ linear N N g -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, adjoint N A (fun x:set => f (g x)) x = adjoint N N g (adjoint N A f x)

items.name: ADJOINT_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, adjoint M N f x = adjoint M N f y -> x = y) <-> forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)

items.name: ADJOINT_INJECTIVE_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = adjoint N N f y -> x = y) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: ADJOINT_INJECTIVE_INJECTIVE_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = vec N 0 -> x = vec N 0) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = vec N 0 -> x = vec N 0)

items.name: ADJOINT_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> linear N M (adjoint M N f)

items.name: ADJOINT_MATRIX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, adjoint N M (fun x0:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x0) x = matrix_vector_mul N M (transp M N A) x

items.name: ADJOINT_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> ((forall y :e R :^: idx M, exists x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint M N f x = y) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: ADJOINT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f' x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear B A f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, dot B (f' x) y = dot A x (f y)) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, f' x = adjoint B A f x

items.name: ADJOINT_WORKS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, dot N (f x) y = dot M x (adjoint M N f y)
