items.name: AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall V c= R :^: idx N, affine N V <-> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) -> finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (s c= V /\ finsum s u = 1)) -> vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) :e V

items.name: AFFINE_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, affine A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s)

items.name: AFFINE_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, affine N s -> affine N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, affine N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ affine N s

items.name: AFFINE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, affine A s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall u :e R, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_add A (vector_mul A (1 + - u) x) (vector_mul A u y) :e s

items.name: AFFINE_BASIS_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, exists b c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N b /\ (b c= s /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} b = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s)

items.name: AFFINE_BOUNDED_EQ_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s -> (bounded_hl N s <-> aff_dim N s <= 0)

items.name: AFFINE_BOUNDED_EQ_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s -> (bounded_hl N s <-> s = Empty \/ exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a})

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_BIGGERSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (finite s -> dimindex N + 2 <= finite_cardinality s) -> affine_dependent N s

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_BIGGERSET_GENERAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (finite s -> dim N s + 2 <= finite_cardinality s) -> affine_dependent N s

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_CHOOSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> (affine_dependent N (SetAdjoin s a) <-> ~ a :e s /\ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s)

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, affine_dependent N p <-> exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (s c= p /\ (finsum s u = 0 /\ ((exists v :e R :^: idx N, v :e s /\ ~ u v = 0) /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = vec N 0))))

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_EXPLICIT_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> (affine_dependent N s <-> exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finsum s u = 0 /\ ((exists v :e R :^: idx N, v :e s /\ ~ u v = 0) /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = vec N 0)))

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_IMP_COLLINEAR_3
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, affine_dependent N {a,b,c} -> collinear N {a,b,c}

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_IMP_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, affine_dependent A s -> dependent A s

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ affine_dependent M s) -> affine_dependent N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (affine_dependent N {f x | x :e s} <-> affine_dependent M s)

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_MONO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, affine_dependent N s /\ s c= t -> affine_dependent N t

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, affine_dependent A s -> affine_dependent A {vector_add A a x | x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_DEPENDENT_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, affine_dependent A {vector_add A a x | x :e s} <-> affine_dependent A s

items.name: AFFINE_DIFFERENCES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, affine A s /\ affine A t -> affine A (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {vector_sub A x y | y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: AFFINE_DIFFS_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ a :e s -> subspace N {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> affine A Empty

items.name: AFFINE_EQ_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e s -> (affine N s <-> subspace N s)

items.name: AFFINE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, - 1 <= n /\ n <= dimindex N -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ aff_dim N s = n

items.name: AFFINE_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) -> finite t /\ (t c= s /\ finsum t u = 1) -> vsum (R :^: idx N) N t (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) :e s

items.name: AFFINE_HULLS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} t /\ t c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} t

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_0_2_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} {x,y} <-> exists a b :e R, vector_add N (vector_mul N a x) (vector_mul N b y) = vec N 0 /\ ~ a + b = 0

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_0_3_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} {x,y,z} <-> exists a b c :e R, vector_add N (vector_mul N a x) (vector_add N (vector_mul N b y) (vector_mul N c z)) = vec N 0 /\ ~ a + b + c = 0

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_0_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (t c= s /\ (~ finsum t u = 0 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N t (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = vec N 0))))

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} {a,b} = \/_ u :e R, {vector_add A (vector_mul A u a) (vector_mul A v b) | v :e R, u + v = 1}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_2_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} {a,b} = {vector_add A a (vector_mul A u (vector_sub A b a)) | u :e R, u :e R}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_3
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} {a,b,c} = \/_ u :e R, \/_ v :e R, {vector_add A (vector_mul A u a) (vector_add A (vector_mul A v b) (vector_mul A w c)) | w :e R, u + v + w = 1}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_3_IMP_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx A, c :e hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} {a,b} -> collinear A {a,b,c}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_AFFINE_INTER_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ ~ s :/\: interior N t = Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (s :/\: t) = s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_AFFINE_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (open N t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (s :/\: t) = s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_AFFINE_INTER_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (s :/\: t) = s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {vector_add N (vector_mul N c x) a | x :e s} = {vector_add N (vector_mul N c x) a | x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (closure N s) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) = if s = Empty then Empty else hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (SetAdjoin s (vec N 0))

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s) = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_CONVEX_INTER_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ s :/\: interior N t = Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (s :/\: t) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_CONVEX_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (open N t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (s :/\: t) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_CONVEX_INTER_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (s :/\: t) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} Empty = Empty

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s = s <-> affine A s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s = Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = {a} <-> s = {a}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_EQ_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = span N s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_EQ_SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = span N s <-> vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} p = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (s c= p /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y))))}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_EXPLICIT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} p = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (s c= p /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y)))}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_EXPLICIT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) -> forall u':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u' x :e R) -> ~ affine_dependent N s /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ (finsum s u' = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u' x) x))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> u x = u' x

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_FACE_OF_DISJOINT_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (face_of N f s /\ ~ f = s) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} f :/\: relative_interior N s = Empty

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y)}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_FINITE_INTERSECTION_HYPERPLANES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (finite_cardinality f + aff_dim N s = dimindex N /\ (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}))

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_FINITE_STEP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall w :e R, forall y :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, ((exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finsum Empty u = w /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N Empty (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y)) <-> w = 0 /\ y = vec N 0) /\ (finite s -> ((exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finsum (SetAdjoin s a) u = w /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N (SetAdjoin s a) (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y)) <-> exists v :e R, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finsum s u = w + - v /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = vector_sub N y (vector_mul N v a))))

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_FINITE_STEP_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall w :e R, forall y :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall P:set -> set -> prop, ((exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e Empty -> P x (u x)) /\ (finsum Empty u = w /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N Empty (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))) <-> w = 0 /\ y = vec N 0) /\ (finite s /\ ((forall y0 :e R, a :e s /\ P a y0 -> P a (y0 :/: 2)) /\ (forall x y0 :e R, a :e s /\ (P a x /\ P a y0) -> P a (x + y0))) -> ((exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e SetAdjoin s a -> P x (u x)) /\ (finsum (SetAdjoin s a) u = w /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N (SetAdjoin s a) (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))) <-> exists v :e R, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (P a v /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> P x (u x)) /\ (finsum s u = w + - v /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = vector_sub N y (vector_mul N v a))))))

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x} = if a = vec N 0 /\ 0 < b then Empty else R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {x :e R :^: idx N | b < dot N a x} = if a = vec N 0 /\ 0 <= b then Empty else R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} = if a = vec N 0 /\ b < 0 then Empty else R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x < b} = if a = vec N 0 /\ b <= 0 then Empty else R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_INDEXED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists k :e omega, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, u x :e R) /\ exists x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= k -> x i :e s) /\ (finsum (idx_n k) u = 1 /\ vsum omega N (idx_n k) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i)) = y))}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_INSERT_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ a :e s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (SetAdjoin s a) = {vector_add N a v | v :e R :^: idx N, v :e span N {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_INSERT_SUBSET_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (SetAdjoin s a) c= {vector_add N a v | v :e R :^: idx N, v :e span N {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N (s :\/: t) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (s :/\: t)

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx N), ~ affine_dependent N (Union s) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t | t :e Power (R :^: idx N), t :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e hull (R :^: idx B) {x :e Power (R :^: idx B) | affine B x} s}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ interior N s = Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t) /\ ~ s = Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_OPEN_IN_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, affine N u /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ ~ s = Empty) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = u

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_OPEN_IN_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ ~ t = Empty) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) | affine (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x} (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e hull (R :^: idx M) {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | affine M x} s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a}) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (relative_frontier N s) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} (relative_interior A s) = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} = {vector_mul N c x | x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b}) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (open_segment N (a,b)) = if a = b then Empty else hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} {a} = {a}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, a :e s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = {vector_add N a v | v :e R :^: idx N, v :e span N {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: {a}}}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_SUBSET_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s c= span A s

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} t}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} {vector_add A a x | x :e s} = {vector_add A a x | x :e hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s}

items.name: AFFINE_HULL_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (R :^: idx N) = R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, affine A {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x = b}

items.name: AFFINE_HYPERPLANE_SUMS_EQ_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (~ s :/\: {v :e R :^: idx N | dot N a v = b} = Empty /\ ~ s :\: {v :e R :^: idx N | dot N a v = b} = Empty) -> (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e {v :e R :^: idx N | dot N a v = b}}) = R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_IMP_CONVEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, affine A s -> convex A s

items.name: AFFINE_IMP_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s -> polyhedron N s

items.name: AFFINE_IMP_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, affine A s /\ vec A 0 :e s -> subspace A s

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N {a}

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N {a,b}

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_CARD_DIM_DIFFS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ a :e s -> finite_cardinality s = dim N {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} + 1

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_CARD_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N + 1

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_CONVEX_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ t c= s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, ~ affine_dependent A s -> ~ affine_dependent A (s :\: {a})

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ~ affine_dependent A Empty

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_IFF_CARD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s <-> finite s /\ aff_dim N s = finite_cardinality s + - 1

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_IMP_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> finite s

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ ~ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> ~ affine_dependent N (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ finite_cardinality s = dimindex N + 1 -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_SPAN_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ dimindex N < finite_cardinality s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> ~ affine_dependent N (SetAdjoin {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} (vec N 0))

items.name: AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, ~ affine_dependent A t /\ s c= t -> ~ affine_dependent A s

items.name: AFFINE_INDEXED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s <-> forall k :e omega, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, u x :e R) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= k -> x i :e s) /\ finsum (idx_n k) u = 1 -> vsum omega N (idx_n k) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i)) :e s

items.name: AFFINE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, affine A s /\ affine A t -> affine A (s :/\: t)

items.name: AFFINE_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), (forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e f -> affine A s) -> affine A {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: AFFINE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, affine A s /\ linear A B f -> affine B {f x | x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (affine A {f x | x :e s} <-> affine B s)

items.name: AFFINE_LINEAR_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear M N f /\ affine N s -> affine M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, affine A s -> affine A {vector_neg A x | x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_PARALLEL_SLICE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, affine N s -> s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} = Empty \/ (s c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} \/ exists a' :e R :^: idx N, exists b' :e R, ~ a' = vec N 0 /\ (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a' x <= b'} = s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} /\ (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a' x = b'} = s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} /\ forall w :e R :^: idx N, w :e s -> vector_add N w a' :e s)))

items.name: AFFINE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, affine M s /\ affine N t -> affine (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: AFFINE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, affine (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ affine M s /\ affine N t)

items.name: AFFINE_SCALING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, affine A s -> affine A {vector_mul A c x | x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, affine N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ affine N s

items.name: AFFINE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, affine A {x}

items.name: AFFINE_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, affine A (span A s)

items.name: AFFINE_STANDARD_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b :e R, forall k :e omega, affine N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = b}

items.name: AFFINE_SUMS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, affine A s /\ affine A t -> affine A (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {vector_add A x y | y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: AFFINE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, affine N s -> affine N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> affine N s

items.name: AFFINE_TRANSLATION_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, affine N t /\ ~ t = Empty <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ t = {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: AFFINE_TRANSLATION_SUBSPACE_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, affine N t /\ a :e t -> subspace N {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t} /\ t = {vector_add N a x | x :e {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t}}

items.name: AFFINE_TRANSLATION_UNIQUE_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, affine N t /\ ~ t = Empty <-> exists s c= R :^: idx N, (exists a :e R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ t = {vector_add N a x | x :e s}) /\ forall y c= R :^: idx N, (exists a :e R :^: idx N, subspace N y /\ t = {vector_add N a x | x :e y}) -> y = s

items.name: AFFINE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> affine N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: AFFINE_VSUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= A, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite k /\ (affine N s /\ (finsum k u = 1 /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> x i :e s))) -> vsum A N k (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i)) :e s

items.name: AFFINE_VSUM_STRONG
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= A, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> affine N s /\ (finsum k u = 1 /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> u i = 0 \/ x i :e s)) -> vsum A N k (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i)) :e s

items.name: AFFINITY_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx A, ~ m = 0 -> (forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A (vector_mul A m (vector_add A (vector_mul A (recip_SNo m) x) (vector_neg A (vector_mul A (recip_SNo m) c)))) c = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A (vector_mul A (recip_SNo m) (vector_add A (vector_mul A m x) c)) (vector_neg A (vector_mul A (recip_SNo m) c)) = x

items.name: AFFINITY_SCALING_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall c x :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c = vector_add N c (vector_mul N m x)

items.name: AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, exists b c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} b = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s /\ (~ affine_dependent A b /\ aff_dim A s = finite_cardinality b + - 1)

items.name: AFF_DIM_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, aff_dim N {a,b} = if a = b then 0 else 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, aff_dim A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s) = aff_dim A s

items.name: AFF_DIM_AFFINE_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N b -> aff_dim N b = finite_cardinality b + - 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_AFFINE_INTER_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s -> aff_dim N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}) = if s :/\: {v :e R :^: idx N | dot N a v = b} = Empty then - 1 else if s c= {v :e R :^: idx N | dot N a v = b} then aff_dim N s else aff_dim N s + - 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, aff_dim N (ball N (a,r)) = if 0 < r then dimindex N else - 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, aff_dim N (cball N (a,r)) = if 0 < r then dimindex N else if r = 0 then 0 else - 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N (closure N s) = aff_dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) = if s = Empty \/ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s then aff_dim N s else aff_dim N s + 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_CONIC_HULL_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) = if s = Empty then - 1 else dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = aff_dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_CONVEX_INTER_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ s :/\: interior N t = Empty -> aff_dim N (s :/\: t) = aff_dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_CONVEX_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (open N t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> aff_dim N (s :/\: t) = aff_dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s = if vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s then dim N s else dim N s + - 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s = dimension N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s)

items.name: AFF_DIM_DIMENSION_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s = dimension N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: AFF_DIM_DIM_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> aff_dim N s = dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_DIM_AFFINE_DIFFS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, a :e s -> aff_dim N s = dim N {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}

items.name: AFF_DIM_DIM_AFFINE_DIFFS_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> aff_dim N s = dim N {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}

items.name: AFF_DIM_DIM_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> aff_dim N s = dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> aff_dim A Empty = - 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s = 0 <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a}

items.name: AFF_DIM_EQ_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ aff_dim N t <= aff_dim N s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t

items.name: AFF_DIM_EQ_FULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s = dimindex N <-> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N

items.name: AFF_DIM_EQ_FULL_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t -> (aff_dim N s = aff_dim N t <-> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t)

items.name: AFF_DIM_EQ_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s = dimindex N + - 1 <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: AFF_DIM_EQ_INTER_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (affine N t /\ (t c= s /\ aff_dim N t + 1 = aff_dim N s)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} :/\: s = t

items.name: AFF_DIM_EQ_MINUS1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s = - 1 <-> s = Empty

items.name: AFF_DIM_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, - 1 <= aff_dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, aff_dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x} = if a = vec N 0 /\ 0 < b then - 1 else dimindex N

items.name: AFF_DIM_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, aff_dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | b < dot N a x} = if a = vec N 0 /\ 0 <= b then - 1 else dimindex N

items.name: AFF_DIM_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, aff_dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} = if a = vec N 0 /\ b < 0 then - 1 else dimindex N

items.name: AFF_DIM_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, aff_dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x < b} = if a = vec N 0 /\ b <= 0 then - 1 else dimindex N

items.name: AFF_DIM_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 -> aff_dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} = dimindex N + - 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> aff_dim N {f x | x :e s} = aff_dim M s

items.name: AFF_DIM_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N (SetAdjoin s a) = if a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s then aff_dim N s else aff_dim N s + 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, aff_dim N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty then - 1 else finite_cardinality {i :e omega | 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ a i < b i)}) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, aff_dim N (open_interval N (a,b)) = if open_interval N (a,b) = Empty then - 1 else dimindex N

items.name: AFF_DIM_LE_CARD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> aff_dim N s <= finite_cardinality s + - 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_LE_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s <= dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_LE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s <= dimindex N

items.name: AFF_DIM_LINEAR_IMAGE_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> aff_dim N {f x | x :e s} <= aff_dim M s

items.name: AFF_DIM_LT_FULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s < dimindex N <-> ~ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N

items.name: AFF_DIM_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ interior N s = Empty -> aff_dim N s = dimindex N

items.name: AFF_DIM_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (aff_dim N s = dimindex N <-> ~ interior N s = Empty)

items.name: AFF_DIM_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, s c= u /\ (affine N u /\ ~ interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s = Empty) -> aff_dim N s = aff_dim N u

items.name: AFF_DIM_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (affine N u /\ s c= u) -> (aff_dim N s = aff_dim N u <-> s = Empty /\ u = Empty \/ ~ interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s = Empty)

items.name: AFF_DIM_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> aff_dim N s = dimindex N

items.name: AFF_DIM_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ affine N t) -> aff_dim N s = aff_dim N t

items.name: AFF_DIM_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty -> aff_dim (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = aff_dim M s + aff_dim N t

items.name: AFF_DIM_POS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 0 <= aff_dim N s <-> ~ s = Empty

items.name: AFF_DIM_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} t /\ hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s <> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} t -> aff_dim A s < aff_dim A t

items.name: AFF_DIM_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> aff_dim N (relative_interior N s) = aff_dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, aff_dim N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if a = b then 0 else 1) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, aff_dim N (open_segment N (a,b)) = if a = b then - 1 else 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall n :e int, simplex A n s -> aff_dim A s = n

items.name: AFF_DIM_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, aff_dim N {a} = 0

items.name: AFF_DIM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t -> aff_dim N s <= aff_dim N t

items.name: AFF_DIM_SUMS_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (affine N t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> aff_dim N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = (aff_dim N s + aff_dim N t) + - aff_dim N (s :/\: t)

items.name: AFF_DIM_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = aff_dim N s

items.name: AFF_DIM_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (affine N t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> aff_dim N (s :\/: t) = (aff_dim N s + aff_dim N t) + - aff_dim N (s :/\: t)

items.name: AFF_DIM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s b c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} b = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ ~ affine_dependent N b -> aff_dim N s = finite_cardinality b + - 1

items.name: AFF_DIM_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> aff_dim N (R :^: idx N) = dimindex N

items.name: AFF_LOWDIM_SUBSET_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s < dimindex N -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ s c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: ALEXANDER_SUBBASE_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall B c= Power A, {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e relative_to A {x01 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e B) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} (Union B)) /\ Union u = x} = top /\ (forall C c= Power A, C c= B /\ Union C = topspace A top -> exists C' c= Power A, finite C' /\ (C' c= C /\ Union C' = topspace A top)) -> compact_space A top

items.name: ALEXANDER_SUBBASE_THEOREM_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall B c= Power A, forall u c= A, u c= Union B /\ ({x :e Power A | exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A {x01 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e B) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} u) /\ Union u0 = x} = top /\ (forall C c= Power A, C c= B /\ u c= Union C -> exists C' c= Power A, finite C' /\ (C' c= C /\ u c= Union C'))) -> compact_space A top

items.name: ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION_DENSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, ~ compact_space A top -> closure_of (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) {Inj0 x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top)

items.name: ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, kc_space A top /\ (compact_space A top /\ a :e topspace A top) -> homeomorphic_space (A :+: 1) A (alexandroff_compactification A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a}))) top

items.name: ALEXANDROFF_HAUSDORFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top /\ (metrizable_space A top /\ ~ topspace A top = Empty) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power omega, f x :e A) /\ (continuous_map (Power omega) A (cantor_space,top) f /\ {f x | x :e topspace (Power omega) cantor_space} = topspace A top)

items.name: ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_all P seq_nil <-> True) /\ (seq_all P (seq_cons h t) <-> P h /\ seq_all P t)

items.name: ALL2
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, forall h2 :e B, forall t2 :e finseq B, (seq_all2 P seq_nil seq_nil <-> True) /\ ((seq_all2 P (seq_cons h1 t1) seq_nil <-> False) /\ ((seq_all2 P seq_nil (seq_cons h2 t2) <-> False) /\ (seq_all2 P (seq_cons h1 t1) (seq_cons h2 t2) <-> P h1 h2 /\ seq_all2 P t1 t2)))

items.name: ALL2_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, seq_all2 P l l <-> seq_all (fun x:set => P x x) l

items.name: ALL2_AND_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall m :e finseq B, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:set -> set -> prop, seq_all2 (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ Q x y) l m <-> seq_all P l /\ seq_all2 Q l m

items.name: ALL2_DEF
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall l2 :e finseq B, forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, (seq_all2 P seq_nil l2 <-> l2 = seq_nil) /\ (seq_all2 P (seq_cons h1 t1) l2 <-> (l2 = seq_nil -> False) /\ (~ l2 = seq_nil -> P h1 (seq_hd l2) /\ seq_all2 P t1 (seq_tl l2)))

items.name: ALL2_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_all2 P (seq_map f l) l <-> seq_all (fun a:set => P (f a) a) l

items.name: ALL2_MAP2
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e C, g x :e D) -> forall l :e finseq A, forall m :e finseq C, seq_all2 P (seq_map f l) (seq_map g m) <-> seq_all2 (fun x:set => fun y:set => P (f x) (g y)) l m

items.name: ALLPAIRS
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq B, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, ((forall i :e seq_len seq_nil, forall j :e seq_len l, f (seq_nth seq_nil i) (seq_nth l j)) <-> True) /\ ((forall i :e seq_len (seq_cons h t), forall j :e seq_len l, f (seq_nth (seq_cons h t) i) (seq_nth l j)) <-> seq_all (f h) l /\ forall i :e seq_len t, forall j :e seq_len l, f (seq_nth t i) (seq_nth l j))

items.name: ALLPAIRS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0 R':set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, forall m :e finseq B, forall P Q:set -> prop, seq_all P l /\ (seq_all Q m /\ (forall p :e A, forall q :e B, P p /\ Q q -> (R0 p q <-> R' p q))) -> ((forall i :e seq_len l, forall j :e seq_len m, R0 (seq_nth l i) (seq_nth m j)) <-> forall i :e seq_len l, forall j :e seq_len m, R' (seq_nth l i) (seq_nth m j))

items.name: ALLPAIRS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e C, g x :e D) -> forall l :e finseq A, forall m :e finseq C, (forall i :e seq_len (seq_map f l), forall j :e seq_len (seq_map g m), P (seq_nth (seq_map f l) i) (seq_nth (seq_map g m) j)) <-> forall i :e seq_len l, forall j :e seq_len m, P (f (seq_nth l i)) (g (seq_nth m j))

items.name: ALLPAIRS_MEM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, forall m :e finseq B, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, seq_mem x l /\ seq_mem y m -> P x y) <-> forall i :e seq_len l, forall j :e seq_len m, P (seq_nth l i) (seq_nth m j)

items.name: ALLPAIRS_SYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, forall m :e finseq B, (forall i :e seq_len l, forall j :e seq_len m, P (seq_nth l i) (seq_nth m j)) <-> forall i :e seq_len m, forall j :e seq_len l, P (seq_nth l j) (seq_nth m i)

items.name: ALL_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_all P (seq_append l1 l2) <-> seq_all P l1 /\ seq_all P l2

items.name: ALL_EL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (forall i :e omega, i < seq_len l -> P (seq_nth l i)) <-> seq_all P l

items.name: ALL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0 P Q:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, seq_all R0 l /\ (forall x :e A, R0 x -> (P x <-> Q x)) -> (seq_all P l <-> seq_all Q l)

items.name: ALL_FILTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, seq_all P (seq_filter Q l) <-> seq_all (fun x:set => Q x -> P x) l

items.name: ALL_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x :e A, seq_mem x l /\ P x -> Q x) /\ seq_all P l -> seq_all Q l

items.name: ALL_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_all P (seq_map f l) <-> seq_all (fun x:set => P (f x)) l

items.name: ALL_MEM

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ANR N s <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u t c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) N f t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex N + 1))) u) t) -> exists v c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (t c= v /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex N + 1))) u /\ (continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) N g v /\ ({g x | x :e v} c= s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), x :e t -> g x = f x))))

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, antichain_on A l s <-> s c= fld_on A l /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> ~ l x y

items.name: ANTICHAIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, antichain_on A l s /\ t c= s -> antichain_on A l t

items.name: ANTIDERIVATIVE_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_vector_derivative N g (f x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: ANTIDERIVATIVE_INTEGRAL_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (v :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop u <= drop v) -> has_integral 1 N f (vector_sub N (g v) (g u)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil))

items.name: ANY_CLOSEST_POINT_AFFINE_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (b :e s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> distance N (a,b) <= distance N (a,x))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> orthogonal N (vector_sub N x b) (vector_sub N a b)

items.name: ANY_CLOSEST_POINT_DOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x y :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (forall z :e R :^: idx N, z :e s -> distance N (a,x) <= distance N (a,z))))) -> dot N (vector_sub N a x) (vector_sub N y x) <= 0

items.name: ANY_CLOSEST_POINT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x y :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ((forall z :e R :^: idx N, z :e s -> distance N (a,x) <= distance N (a,z)) /\ (forall z :e R :^: idx N, z :e s -> distance N (a,y) <= distance N (a,z)))))) -> x = y

items.name: APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall l :e finseq A, seq_append seq_nil l = l) /\ forall h :e A, forall t l :e finseq A, seq_append (seq_cons h t) l = seq_cons h (seq_append t l)

items.name: APPEND_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m n :e finseq A, seq_append l (seq_append m n) = seq_append (seq_append l m) n

items.name: APPEND_BUTLAST_LAST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> seq_append (seq_butlast l) (seq_cons (seq_last l) seq_nil) = l

items.name: APPEND_EQ_NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_append l m = seq_nil <-> l = seq_nil /\ m = seq_nil

items.name: APPEND_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l1 l2 l3 :e finseq A, seq_append l1 l2 = seq_append l1 l3 <-> l2 = l3

items.name: APPEND_NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_append l seq_nil = l

items.name: APPEND_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l1 l2 l3 :e finseq A, seq_append l1 l3 = seq_append l2 l3 <-> l1 = l2

items.name: APPEND_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_append (seq_cons h seq_nil) t = seq_cons h t

items.name: APPROACHABLE_LT_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> ((exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e A, f x < d -> P x) <-> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e A, f x <= d -> P x)

items.name: APPROXIMABLE_ON_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, 0 <= e0 /\ (division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall i c= R :^: idx M, i :e d -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e i -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) <= e0) /\ integrable_on N M g i))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) <= e0) /\ integrable_on N M g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: ARB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> choose_in A (fun x:set => True) = choose_in A (fun x:set => False)

items.name: ARBITRARILY_SMALL_CONTINUUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (open N u /\ ({a} c= s /\ {a} <> s /\ a :e u))) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, {a} c= c /\ {a} <> c /\ (c c= s /\ (c c= u /\ (compact N c /\ connected N c)))

items.name: ARBITRARY
items.statement: forall A:set, True <-> True

items.name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ Union u = A :\: s

items.name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A

items.name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x0) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x

items.name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :/\: t

items.name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u c= A, relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e P) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} u = relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A P u) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u0, x0 :e Y} = x} u

items.name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall B c= Power A, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x :e u, x :e B) /\ Union u = s) <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists u c= A, u :e B /\ (x :e u /\ u c= s)

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A :\: s

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = Empty

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x0) /\ Union u = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_INTER_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_NONEMPTY_FINITE_INTERSECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, forall x c= A, (exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, exists u0 c= Power A, finite u0 /\ ~ u0 = Empty /\ (forall x1 :e u0, x1 :e u) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = x0) /\ Union u0 = x) <-> exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A {x01 :e Power A | exists u0 c= Power A, finite u0 /\ (forall x1 :e u0, x1 :e u) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = x01} (Union u)) /\ Union u0 = x

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u x c= A, x :e relative_to A {x0 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e P) /\ Union u = x0} u <-> exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A P u) /\ Union u0 = x

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :\/: t

items.name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ Union u0 = Union u

items.name: ARCH_EVENTUALLY_ABS_INV_OFFSET
items.statement: forall a e0 :e R, eventually omega {n :e omega | abs_SNo (recip_SNo (n + a)) < e0} sequentially <-> 0 < e0

items.name: ARCH_EVENTUALLY_INV
items.statement: forall e0 :e R, eventually omega {n :e omega | recip_SNo n < e0} sequentially <-> 0 < e0

items.name: ARCH_EVENTUALLY_INV1
items.statement: forall e0 :e R, eventually omega {n :e omega | recip_SNo (n + 1) < e0} sequentially <-> 0 < e0

items.name: ARCH_EVENTUALLY_INV_OFFSET
items.statement: forall a e0 :e R, eventually omega {n :e omega | recip_SNo (n + a) < e0} sequentially <-> 0 < e0

items.name: ARCH_EVENTUALLY_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, eventually omega {n :e omega | x <= n} sequentially

items.name: ARCH_EVENTUALLY_LT
items.statement: forall x :e R, eventually omega {n :e omega | x < n} sequentially

items.name: ARCH_EVENTUALLY_POW
items.statement: forall x b :e R, 1 < x -> eventually omega {n :e omega | b < x ^ n} sequentially

items.name: ARCH_EVENTUALLY_POW_INV
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ abs_SNo x < 1 -> eventually omega {n :e omega | abs_SNo (x ^ n) < e0} sequentially

items.name: ARC_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N p = pathstart N q /\ pathfinish N q = pathstart N r -> (arc N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) q r x0) x) <-> arc N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p q x0) r x))

items.name: ARC_CONNECTED_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc N g /\ (arc N h /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N h /\ ~ pathstart N g = pathfinish N h)) -> exists i:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, i x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N i /\ (path_image N i c= path_image N g :\/: path_image N h /\ (pathstart N i = pathstart N g /\ pathfinish N i = pathfinish N h)))

items.name: ARC_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc N g /\ (continuous_on_hl N A f (path_image N g) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e path_image N g /\ (y :e path_image N g /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> arc A (fun x:set => f (g x))

items.name: ARC_DISTINCT_ENDS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc N g -> ~ pathfinish N g = pathstart N g

items.name: ARC_ENDS_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc N g /\ (simple_path N h /\ path_image N g = path_image N h) -> {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g} = {pathstart N h,pathfinish N h}

items.name: ARC_HOMEOMORPHISM_ENDS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f f' :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism N N (path_image N g,path_image N h) (f,f') /\ (arc N g /\ arc N h) -> f (pathstart N g) = pathstart N h /\ (f (pathfinish N g) = pathfinish N h /\ (f' (pathstart N h) = pathstart N g /\ f' (pathfinish N h) = pathfinish N g)) \/ f (pathstart N g) = pathfinish N h /\ (f (pathfinish N g) = pathstart N h /\ (f' (pathstart N h) = pathfinish N g /\ f' (pathfinish N h) = pathstart N g))

items.name: ARC_IMAGE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N g /\ (arc N h /\ (path_image N g c= path_image N h /\ {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g} = {pathstart N h,pathfinish N h})) -> path_image N g = path_image N h

items.name: ARC_IMP_PATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> arc A g -> path A g

items.name: ARC_IMP_SIMPLE_PATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> arc A g -> simple_path A g

items.name: ARC_JOIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc N g1 /\ (arc N g2 /\ (pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 /\ path_image N g1 :/\: path_image N g2 c= {pathstart N g2})) -> arc N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x)

items.name: ARC_JOIN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 -> (arc N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) <-> arc N g1 /\ (arc N g2 /\ path_image N g1 :/\: path_image N g2 c= {pathstart N g2}))

items.name: ARC_JOIN_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 -> (arc N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) <-> arc N g1 /\ (arc N g2 /\ path_image N g1 :/\: path_image N g2 = {pathstart N g2}))

items.name: ARC_LENGTH_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g /\ (arc N g /\ (rectifiable_path N h /\ path_image N g = path_image N h)) -> path_length N g <= path_length N h

items.name: ARC_LENGTH_REPARAMETRIZATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g -> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (rectifiable_path N h /\ (path_image N h = path_image N g /\ (pathstart N h = pathstart N g /\ (pathfinish N h = pathfinish N g /\ (path_length N h = path_length N g /\ ((arc N g -> arc N h) /\ ((simple_path N g -> simple_path N h) /\ ((forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> path_length N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) t h x) = path_length N g * drop t) /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> distance N (h x,h y) <= path_length N g * distance 1 (x,y)))))))))

items.name: ARC_LENGTH_UNIQUE

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ (AR N (s :\/: t) /\ AR N (s :/\: t))) -> AR N s /\ AR N t

items.name: AR_FROM_UNION_AND_INTER_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) t /\ (AR N (s :\/: t) /\ AR N (s :/\: t))) -> AR N s /\ AR N t

items.name: AR_IMP_ABSOLUTE_EXTENSOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u t c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) t)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ ({g x | x :e u} c= s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> g x = f x))

items.name: AR_IMP_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall u s' c= R :^: idx M, AR N s /\ (homeomorphic M N s s' /\ closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s') -> retract_of M s' u

items.name: AR_IMP_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall s' c= R :^: idx M, AR N s /\ (homeomorphic M N s s' /\ closed M s') -> retract_of M s' (R :^: idx M)

items.name: AR_IMP_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N s -> ANR N s

items.name: AR_IMP_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N s -> connected N s

items.name: AR_IMP_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N s -> contractible N s

items.name: AR_IMP_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: AR_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: AR_IMP_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N s -> ~ s = Empty

items.name: AR_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N s -> path_connected N s

items.name: AR_IMP_RETRACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, AR N s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s -> retract_of N s u

items.name: AR_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, AR N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, AR N (open_interval N (a,b)) <-> ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty

items.name: AR_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (AR N {f x | x :e s} <-> AR M s)

items.name: AR_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, AR M s /\ AR N t -> AR (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: AR_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, AR (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> AR M s /\ (AR N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty))

items.name: AR_RETRACT_OF_AR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, AR N t /\ retract_of N s t -> AR N s

items.name: AR_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, AR N {a}

items.name: AR_STRONG_DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_AR
