items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, AR N s /\ (AR N t /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> h x = x} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (fun x:set => x) r /\ retraction N (s,t) r)

items.name: AR_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> AR N s

items.name: AR_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> AR N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: AR_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, AR N s <-> forall u s' c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1), homeomorphic (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) N s s' /\ closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex N + 1))) u) s' -> retract_of (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) s' u

items.name: ASSOC
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall a :e A, forall h :e A :*: B, forall t :e finseq (A :*: B), seq_assoc a (seq_cons h t) = if h 0 = a then h 1 else seq_assoc a t

items.name: AT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, netfilter (R :^: idx N) (at N a) = {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | open N u /\ a :e u}

items.name: ATPOINTOF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, netfilter A (atpointof A top a) = {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ a :e u}

items.name: ATPOINTOF_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, a :e s -> atpointof A (subtopology A top s) a = within A (atpointof A top a) s

items.name: ATPOINTOF_WITHIN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, within A (atpointof A top a) (topspace A top) = atpointof A top a

items.name: ATPOINTOF_WITHIN_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, forall a :e A, topspace A top c= u -> within A (atpointof A top a) u = atpointof A top a

items.name: AT_INFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> netfilter (R :^: idx N) (at_infinity N) = {{x :e R :^: idx N | b <= vector_norm N x} | b :e R, b :e R}

items.name: AT_NEGINFINITY
items.statement: netfilter R at_neginfinity = {{x :e R | x <= a} | a :e R, a :e R}

items.name: AT_POSINFINITY
items.statement: netfilter R at_posinfinity = {{x :e R | a <= x} | a :e R, a :e R}

items.name: AUSTIN_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall D c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite D /\ (forall d c= R :^: idx N, d :e D -> exists k :e R, exists a b :e R :^: idx N, d = closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> b i + - a i = k) -> exists D' c= Power (R :^: idx N), D' c= D /\ ((forall x y :e D', x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ measure N (Union D) :/: 3 ^ dimindex N <= measure N (Union D'))

items.name: BABY_SARD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ rank M N (matrix M N (f' x)) < dimindex N) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: BABY_SARD_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists f':set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f' x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ rank M N (matrix M N f') < dimindex N)) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: BACK_AND_FORTH
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t -> R0 x x y y) /\ ((forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall x' :e A, forall y' :e B, x :e s /\ (x' :e s /\ (y :e t /\ (y' :e t /\ (~ x = x' /\ (~ y = y' /\ R0 x x' y y'))))) -> R0 x' x y' y) /\ (countable s /\ (countable t /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ (finite t' /\ (t' c= t /\ ({f x | x :e s'} = t' /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s' /\ y :e s' -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s' /\ y :e s' -> R0 x y (f x) (f y))))))) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s :\: s' -> exists y :e B, y :e t :\: t' /\ forall z :e A, z :e s' -> R0 x z y (f z)) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t :\: t' -> exists x :e A, x :e s :\: s' /\ forall z :e A, z :e s' -> R0 x z y (f z))))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> R0 x y (f x) (f y)))

items.name: BACK_AND_FORTH_2
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t -> R0 x x y y) /\ ((forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall x' :e A, forall y' :e B, x :e s /\ (x' :e s /\ (y :e t /\ (y' :e t /\ (~ x = x' /\ (~ y = y' /\ R0 x x' y y'))))) -> R0 x' x y' y) /\ (countable s /\ (countable t /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, forall x :e A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ (finite t' /\ (t' c= t /\ ({f x | x :e s'} = t' /\ ((forall x0 y :e A, x0 :e s' /\ y :e s' -> (f x0 = f y <-> x0 = y)) /\ ((forall x0 y :e A, x0 :e s' /\ y :e s' -> R0 x0 y (f x0) (f y)) /\ x :e s :\: s')))))) -> exists y :e B, y :e t :\: t' /\ forall z :e A, z :e s' -> R0 x z y (f z)) /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall t' c= B, forall s' c= A, forall x :e B, finite t' /\ (t' c= t /\ (finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ ({f x | x :e t'} = s' /\ ((forall x0 y :e B, x0 :e t' /\ y :e t' -> (f x0 = f y <-> x0 = y)) /\ ((forall x0 y :e B, x0 :e t' /\ y :e t' -> R0 (f x0) (f y) x0 y) /\ x :e t :\: t')))))) -> exists y :e A, y :e s :\: s' /\ forall z :e B, z :e t' -> R0 y (f z) x z))))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> R0 x y (f x) (f y)))

items.name: BACK_AND_FORTH_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable s /\ (countable t /\ (forall R0 c= A :*: B, finite R0 /\ (R0 c= s :*: t /\ (forall x y :e R0, x <> y -> P x y)) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ forall x0 y0 :e SetAdjoin R0 (x,y), x0 <> y0 -> P x0 y0) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall x0 y0 :e SetAdjoin R0 (x,y), x0 <> y0 -> P x0 y0)) -> exists R0 c= A :*: B, R0 c= s :*: t /\ ((forall x y :e R0, x <> y -> P x y) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ (x,y) :e R0) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ (x,y) :e R0))

items.name: BAIRE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (countable g /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e g -> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ s c= closure N t)) -> s c= closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}

items.name: BAIRE0_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 0 (R :^: idx N) <-> s = Empty \/ s = R :^: idx N

items.name: BAIRE1_DET_JACOBIAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (at N x)) /\ open N s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => lift (det N (matrix N N (f' x)))) :e baire N 1 1 s

items.name: BAIRE1_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 1 (R :^: idx N) <-> fsigma N s /\ gdelta N s

items.name: BAIRE1_PARTIAL_DERIVATIVES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i j :e omega, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M f (f' x) (at M x)) /\ (open M s /\ (1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex M)))) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => lift (matrix M N (f' x) i j)) :e baire M 1 1 s

items.name: BAIRE1_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx 1), forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (at 1 x)) /\ open 1 s -> f' :e baire 1 N 1 s

items.name: BAIRE_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, f :e baire M N n s /\ g :e baire M N n s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) :e baire M N n s

items.name: BAIRE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (countable g /\ Union g = s)) -> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, t :e g /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (~ u = Empty /\ u c= closure N t))

items.name: BAIRE_BILINEAR
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, bilinear P Q N bop /\ (f :e baire M N n s /\ g :e baire M P n s) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => bop (f x) (g x)) :e baire M Q n s

items.name: BAIRE_CASES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, f :e baire M N k s /\ (g :e baire M N k (t :\: s) /\ (fun x :e R :^: idx M => indicator M s x) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => if x :e s then f x else g x) :e baire M N k t

items.name: BAIRE_CATEGORY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall g c= Power A, (completely_metrizable_space A top \/ locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top)) /\ (countable g /\ (forall t c= A, t :e g -> t :e top /\ closure_of A top t = topspace A top)) -> closure_of A top {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y} = topspace A top

items.name: BAIRE_CATEGORY_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall g c= Power A, (completely_metrizable_space A top \/ locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top)) /\ (countable g /\ (forall t c= A, t :e g -> closed_in A top t /\ interior_of A top t = Empty)) -> interior_of A top (Union g) = Empty

items.name: BAIRE_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, forall n :e omega, f :e baire M N n s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => vector_mul N c (f x)) :e baire M N n s

items.name: BAIRE_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, f :e baire M N n s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => lift (f x i)) :e baire M 1 n s

items.name: BAIRE_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall m n :e omega, forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx M, f :e baire M N m s /\ g :e baire N P n {f x | x :e s} -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => g (f x)) :e baire M P (m + n) s

items.name: BAIRE_COMPOSE_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ g :e baire N P k {f x | x :e s} -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => g (f x)) :e baire M P k s

items.name: BAIRE_CONST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, forall a :e R :^: idx N, (fun x :e R :^: idx M => a) :e baire M N n s

items.name: BAIRE_CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, f :e baire M N k s /\ continuous_on_hl N P g {f x | x :e s} -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => g (f x)) :e baire M P k s

items.name: BAIRE_CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl N P f (R :^: idx N) /\ g :e baire M N n s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => f (g x)) :e baire M P n s

items.name: BAIRE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ f :e baire M N n s -> g :e baire M N n s

items.name: BAIRE_EQ_FSIGMA_PREIMAGE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u = s) /\ f :e baire M N k s <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, open N u -> exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u0 = {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u})

items.name: BAIRE_EQ_FSIGMA_PREIMAGE_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u = s) -> (f :e baire M N k s <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, open N u -> exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u0 = {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u})

items.name: BAIRE_EQ_FSIGMA_PREIMAGE_OPEN_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k -> (f :e baire M N k s <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, open N u -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u = t) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} = s :/\: t)

items.name: BAIRE_EQ_GDELTA_PREIMAGE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ f :e baire M N k s <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed N u -> exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u})

items.name: BAIRE_EQ_GDELTA_PREIMAGE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) -> (f :e baire M N k s <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed N u -> exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u})

items.name: BAIRE_EQ_GDELTA_PREIMAGE_CLOSED_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k -> (f :e baire M N k s <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed N u -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} = s :/\: t)

items.name: BAIRE_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, f :e baire M N k s /\ (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) -> exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), g :e baire M N k (R :^: idx M) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x

items.name: BAIRE_FSIGMA_PREIMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall m n :e omega, f :e baire M N m s /\ (exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 n (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u0 = u) -> exists c c= R :^: idx M, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 (m + n) (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u = c) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} = s :/\: c

items.name: BAIRE_IMP_BOREL_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, f :e baire M N n s -> borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => f x) s

items.name: BAIRE_IMP_MEASURABLE_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, f :e baire M N n s /\ lebesgue_measurable M s -> measurable_on M N (fun x:set => f x) s

items.name: BAIRE_IMP_MEASURABLE_ON_UNIV
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s :e A, f :e baire M N n (R :^: idx M) -> measurable_on M N (fun x:set => f x) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_BIJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> ((fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N {f x | x :e s} x) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N) <-> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => indicator M s x) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M))

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N (u :\: s) x) :e baire N 1 n u <-> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_COMPLEMENT_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x) :e baire N 1 n u <-> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t u c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N t x) :e baire N 1 k u /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= u) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => indicator M {x0 :e R :^: idx M | x0 :e s /\ f x0 :e t} x) :e baire M 1 k s

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS_PREIMAGE_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N) /\ continuous_on_hl M N f (R :^: idx M) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => indicator M {x0 :e R :^: idx M | f x0 :e s} x) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_DELTA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 n (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 n (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 n (R :^: idx N)

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 n u /\ (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N t x) :e baire N 1 n u -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N (s :\: t) x) :e baire N 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx A, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx A => indicator A Empty x) :e baire A 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y)) -> ((fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N {f x | x :e s} x) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N) <-> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => indicator M s x) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M))

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 n u /\ (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N t x) :e baire N 1 n u -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N (s :/\: t) x) :e baire N 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx A, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall n :e omega, finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e f -> (fun x :e R :^: idx A => indicator A s x) :e baire A 1 n u) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx A => indicator A {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} x) :e baire A 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_LOCALLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ ((fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 k u /\ (exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = u)) -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N t x) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N) /\ u :/\: t = u :/\: s

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N u x) :e baire N 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_SUC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x1 :e u, (fun x10 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x1 x10) :e baire N 1 n (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x00 :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x00 :e Y} = x) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x1 :e u, (fun x10 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x1 x10) :e baire N 1 n (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = x) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 (n + 1) (R :^: idx N))

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N {vector_add N a x0 | x0 :e s} x) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N) <-> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 n u /\ (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N t x) :e baire N 1 n u -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N (s :\/: t) x) :e baire N 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx A, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall n :e omega, finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e f -> (fun x :e R :^: idx A => indicator A s x) :e baire A 1 n u) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx A => indicator A (Union f) x) :e baire A 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_INDICATOR_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N (R :^: idx N) x) :e baire N 1 n u

items.name: BAIRE_LAVRENTIEV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, f :e baire M N k s -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), (exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 (k + 1) (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = u) /\ (s c= u /\ (u c= closure M s /\ (g :e baire M N k u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)))

items.name: BAIRE_MAX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => lift (f x)) :e baire N 1 n s /\ (fun x :e R :^: idx N => lift (g x)) :e baire N 1 n s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => lift (if f x <= g x then g x else f x)) :e baire N 1 n s

items.name: BAIRE_MIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => lift (f x)) :e baire N 1 n s /\ (fun x :e R :^: idx N => lift (g x)) :e baire N 1 n s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => lift (if f x <= g x then f x else g x)) :e baire N 1 n s

items.name: BAIRE_MONO
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall m n :e omega, f :e baire M N m s /\ m <= n -> f :e baire M N n s

items.name: BAIRE_MUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx M => lift (f x)) :e baire M 1 n s /\ g :e baire M N n s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => vector_mul N (f x) (g x)) :e baire M N n s

items.name: BAIRE_NORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, f :e baire M N n s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => lift (vector_norm N (f x))) :e baire M 1 n s

items.name: BAIRE_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, f :e baire M N n s /\ g :e baire M P n s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) :e baire M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) n s

items.name: BAIRE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= A, forall n :e omega, finite t /\ (forall i :e A, i :e t -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => lift (f i x)) :e baire N 1 n s) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => lift (finprod t (fun i:set => f i x))) :e baire N 1 n s

items.name: BAIRE_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, f :e baire M N k s /\ (fun x :e R :^: idx M => indicator M s x) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) :e baire M N k (R :^: idx M)

items.name: BAIRE_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, f :e baire M N n s /\ g :e baire M N n s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) :e baire M N n s

items.name: BAIRE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, f :e baire M N n s /\ t c= s -> f :e baire M N n t

items.name: BAIRE_UNIFORM_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, f :e baire M N k s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), g :e baire M N k s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g x) (f x)) < e0

items.name: BAIRE_UNIFORM_LIMIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, forall g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, eventually omega {n :e omega | f n :e baire M N k s} sequentially /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually omega {n :e omega | forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f n x) (g x)) < e0} sequentially) -> g :e baire M N k s

items.name: BAIRE_VSUM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) :^: A, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= A, forall n :e omega, finite t /\ (forall i :e A, i :e t -> f i :e baire M N n s) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => vsum A N t (fun i:set => f i x)) :e baire M N n s

items.name: BALL_1
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall r :e R, cball 1 (x,r) = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_sub 1 x (lift r),vector_add 1 x (lift r)) seq_nil) /\ ball 1 (x,r) = open_interval 1 (vector_sub 1 x (lift r),vector_add 1 x (lift r))

items.name: BALL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, e0 <= 0 -> ball A (x,e0) = Empty

items.name: BALL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, ball A (x,e0) = Empty <-> e0 <= 0

items.name: BALL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall e0 :e R, ball 1 (x,e0) = open_interval 1 (vector_sub 1 x (lift e0),vector_add 1 x (lift e0))

items.name: BALL_INTERVAL_0
items.statement: forall e0 :e R, ball 1 (vec 1 0,e0) = open_interval 1 (vector_neg 1 (lift e0),lift e0)

items.name: BALL_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall r :e R, linear M N f /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x0 :e R :^: idx M, f x0 = y) /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm M x0)) -> ball N (f x,r) = {f x0 | x0 :e ball M (x,r)}

items.name: BALL_MAX_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r s :e R, ball A (a,if r <= s then s else r) = ball A (a,r) :\/: ball A (a,s)

items.name: BALL_MIN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r s :e R, ball A (a,if r <= s then r else s) = ball A (a,r) :/\: ball A (a,s)

items.name: BALL_SCALING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, 0 < c -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, ball A (vector_mul A c x,c * r) = {vector_mul A c x0 | x0 :e ball A (x,r)}

items.name: BALL_SUBSET_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, ball A (x,e0) c= cball A (x,e0)

items.name: BALL_SUBSET_OPEN_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall r :e R, bounded_hl M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) /\ (open N {f x | x :e interior M s} /\ (a :e s /\ (0 < r /\ (forall z :e R :^: idx M, z :e frontier M s -> r <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f z) (f a))))))) -> ball N (f a,r) c= {f x | x :e s}

items.name: BALL_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, ball A (vector_add A a x,r) = {vector_add A a y | y :e ball A (x,r)}

items.name: BALL_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, ball A (x,0) = Empty

items.name: BALL_UNION_SPHERE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, ball A (a,r) :\/: sphere A (a,r) = cball A (a,r)

items.name: BANACH_FIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, complete N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (0 <= c /\ (c < 1 /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (f x,f y) <= c * distance N (x,y)))))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ f y = y -> y = x

items.name: BANACH_FIXPOINT_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall k :e R, ~ mspace A m = Empty /\ (mcomplete A m /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m -> f x :e mspace A m) /\ (k < 1 /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> mdist A m (f x,f y) <= k * mdist A m (x,y))))) -> exists x :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ f x = x /\ forall y :e A, y :e mspace A m /\ f y = y -> y = x

items.name: BANACH_FIX_ITER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall n :e omega, complete N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (0 <= c /\ (c < 1 /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (iter_fun n f x,iter_fun n f y) <= c * distance N (x,y)))))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ f y = y -> y = x

items.name: BANACH_SPROPERTY_IMP_FINITE_PREIMAGES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (measurable M s /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < d) -> measurable N {f x | x :e t} /\ measure N {f x | x :e t} < e0)) -> negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | infinite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: BANACH_SPROPERTY_IMP_LUZIN_NPROPERTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < d) -> measurable N {f x | x :e t} /\ measure N {f x | x :e t} < e0) -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: BANACH_SPROPERTY_IMP_LUZIN_NPROPERTY_OUTER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < d) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e t} c= u /\ (measurable N u /\ measure N u < e0)) -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: BANACH_SPROPERTY_IMP_PRESERVES_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < d) -> measurable N {f x | x :e t} /\ measure N {f x | x :e t} < e0) -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ measurable M t -> measurable N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: BANACH_SPROPERTY_OUTER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < d) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e t} c= u /\ (measurable N u /\ measure N u < e0)) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < d) -> measurable N {f x | x :e t} /\ measure N {f x | x :e t} < e0

items.name: BANACH_ZARECKI
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> continuous_on_hl 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (has_bounded_variation_on 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall t c= R :^: idx 1, t c= closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ negligible 1 t -> negligible 1 {f x | x :e t})

items.name: BANACH_ZARECKI_GEN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ bounded_hl 1 s -> (absolutely_continuous_on 1 f s <-> continuous_on_hl 1 1 f s /\ (has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s /\ forall t c= R :^: idx 1, t c= s /\ negligible 1 t -> negligible 1 {f x | x :e t}))

items.name: BARYCENTRE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> barycentre A Empty = vec A 0

items.name: BARYCENTRE_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, barycentre N {a} = a

items.name: BARYCENTRE_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, barycentre N {a,b} = midpoint N (a,b)

items.name: BARYCENTRE_IN_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> barycentre N s :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: BARYCENTRE_IN_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> barycentre N s :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s

items.name: BARYCENTRE_IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> barycentre N s :e relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: BARYCENTRE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> barycentre N {f x | x :e s} = f (barycentre M s)

items.name: BARYCENTRE_NOT_IN_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a}) -> ~ barycentre N s :e s

items.name: BARYCENTRE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, barycentre N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = vector_add N (if finite s /\ ~ s = Empty then a else vec N 0) (barycentre N s)

items.name: BASIS_CARD_EQ_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx A, b c= v /\ (v c= span A b /\ independent A b) -> finite b /\ finite_cardinality b = dim A v

items.name: BASIS_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> basis N k i = if i = k then 1 else 0

items.name: BASIS_COORDINATES_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, independent N b /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> vector_norm N (vsum (R :^: idx N) N b (fun v:set => vector_mul N (c v) v)) < d -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> abs_SNo (c v) < e0

items.name: BASIS_COORDINATES_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, independent N b -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> abs_SNo (c v) <= B * vector_norm N (vsum (R :^: idx N) N b (fun v0:set => vector_mul N (c v0) v0))

items.name: BASIS_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, basis N i = vec N 0 <-> ~ i :e idx N

items.name: BASIS_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx A, exists b c= R :^: idx A, b c= v /\ (independent A b /\ (v c= span A b /\ equip b (dim A v)))

items.name: BASIS_EXISTS_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx A, exists b c= R :^: idx A, finite b /\ (b c= v /\ (independent A b /\ (v c= span A b /\ equip b (dim A v))))

items.name: BASIS_EXPANSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vsum omega N (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (x i) (basis N i)) = x

items.name: BASIS_EXPANSION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vsum omega N (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (f i) (basis N i)) = x <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> f i = x i

items.name: BASIS_HAS_SIZE_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx A, independent A b /\ span A b = v -> equip b (dim A v)

items.name: BASIS_HAS_SIZE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, independent N b /\ span N b = R :^: idx N -> equip b (dimindex N)

items.name: BASIS_INJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ basis N i = basis N j))) -> i = j

items.name: BASIS_INJ_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> (basis N i = basis N j <-> i = j)

items.name: BASIS_IN_STANDARD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p i :e omega, (fun j :e omega => if j = i then 1 else 0) :e standard_simplex p <-> i <= p

items.name: BASIS_NE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ i = j))) -> ~ basis N i = basis N j

items.name: BASIS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> ~ basis N k = vec N 0

items.name: BASIS_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, finite b -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, finite c /\ (finite_cardinality c <= finite_cardinality b /\ (span N c = span N b /\ forall x y :e c, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y))

items.name: BASIS_SUBSPACE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, finite b /\ (b c= s /\ (independent N b /\ (span N b = s /\ equip b (dim N s))))

items.name: BEPPO_LEVI_DECREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> drop (f (ordsucc k) x) <= drop (f k x)) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega}) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: k -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => f k0 x) (g x) sequentially

items.name: BEPPO_LEVI_INCREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> drop (f k x) <= drop (f (ordsucc k) x)) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega}) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: k -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => f k0 x) (g x) sequentially

items.name: BEPPO_LEVI_MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_DECREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> drop (f (ordsucc k) x) <= drop (f k x)) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega}) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: k -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => f k0 x) (g x) sequentially) /\ (integrable_on 1 N g s /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => integral 1 N s (f k0)) (integral 1 N s g) sequentially))

items.name: BEPPO_LEVI_MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_DECREASING_AE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ ((forall k :e omega, exists t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: t -> drop (f (ordsucc k) x) <= drop (f k x)) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega}) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: k -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => f k0 x) (g x) sequentially) /\ (integrable_on 1 N g s /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => integral 1 N s (f k0)) (integral 1 N s g) sequentially))

items.name: BEPPO_LEVI_MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_INCREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> drop (f k x) <= drop (f (ordsucc k) x)) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega}) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: k -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => f k0 x) (g x) sequentially) /\ (integrable_on 1 N g s /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => integral 1 N s (f k0)) (integral 1 N s g) sequentially))

items.name: BEPPO_LEVI_MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_INCREASING_AE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ ((forall k :e omega, exists t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: t -> drop (f k x) <= drop (f (ordsucc k) x)) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega}) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: k -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => f k0 x) (g x) sequentially) /\ (integrable_on 1 N g s /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun k0:set => integral 1 N s (f k0)) (integral 1 N s g) sequentially))

items.name: BESSEL_INEQUALITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, x0 :e s -> vector_norm N x0 = 1) -> finsum s (fun e0:set => dot N e0 x ^ 2) <= vector_norm N x ^ 2

items.name: BETA_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall y :e A, f y = f y

items.name: BETWEEN_1
items.statement: forall a b x :e R :^: idx 1, between 1 x (a,b) <-> drop a <= drop x /\ drop x <= drop b \/ drop b <= drop x /\ drop x <= drop a

items.name: BETWEEN_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx A, between A a (b,c) /\ between A b (a,c) -> a = b

items.name: BETWEEN_CMUL_LIFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, between N (vector_mul N c v) (vector_mul N a v,vector_mul N b v) <-> v = vec N 0 \/ between 1 (lift c) (lift a,lift b)

items.name: BETWEEN_COLLINEAR_DIST_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) <-> collinear N {a,x,b} /\ (distance N (x,a) <= distance N (a,b) /\ distance N (x,b) <= distance N (a,b))

items.name: BETWEEN_DIST_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, distance N (c,a) <= r /\ (distance N (c,b) <= r /\ between N x (a,b)) -> distance N (c,x) <= r

items.name: BETWEEN_DIST_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, distance N (c,a) < r /\ (distance N (c,b) < r /\ between N x (a,b)) -> distance N (c,x) < r

items.name: BETWEEN_DOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) <-> dot N (vector_sub N x a) (vector_sub N b x) = vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) * vector_norm N (vector_sub N b x)

items.name: BETWEEN_EXISTS_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N b (a,x) /\ ~ b = a -> exists d :e R, 0 <= d /\ x = vector_add N b (vector_mul N d (vector_sub N b a))

items.name: BETWEEN_IMP_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) -> collinear N {a,x,b}

items.name: BETWEEN_IN_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x a b :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) <-> x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} {a,b}

items.name: BETWEEN_IN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x a b :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) <-> x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: BETWEEN_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, linear A B f /\ (forall x0 y0 :e R :^: idx A, f x0 = f y0 -> x0 = y0) -> (between B (f x) (f y,f z) <-> between A x (y,z))

items.name: BETWEEN_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, between A (midpoint A (a,b)) (a,b) /\ between A (midpoint A (a,b)) (b,a)

items.name: BETWEEN_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) <-> vector_mul N (vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a)) (vector_sub N b x) = vector_mul N (vector_norm N (vector_sub N b x)) (vector_sub N x a)

items.name: BETWEEN_NORM_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N a <= r /\ (vector_norm N b <= r /\ between N x (a,b)) -> vector_norm N x <= r

items.name: BETWEEN_NORM_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N a < r /\ (vector_norm N b < r /\ between N x (a,b)) -> vector_norm N x < r

items.name: BETWEEN_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, between A a (a,b) /\ (between A b (a,b) /\ between A a (a,a))

items.name: BETWEEN_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx A, between A x (a,a) <-> x = a

items.name: BETWEEN_RESTRICTED_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c x :e R :^: idx N, between N x (a,b) /\ (between N x (a,c) /\ ~ x = a) -> between N b (a,c) \/ between N c (a,b)

items.name: BETWEEN_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx A, between A x (a,b) <-> between A x (b,a)

items.name: BETWEEN_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx A, between A a (b,c) /\ between A d (a,c) -> between A d (b,c)

items.name: BETWEEN_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall z a x y :e R :^: idx A, between A (vector_add A a x) (vector_add A a y,vector_add A a z) <-> between A x (y,z)

items.name: BETWEEN_TRANS_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx A, between A a (b,c) /\ between A d (a,b) -> between A a (c,d)

items.name: BEZOUT
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, exists d x y :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b /\ (minus_nat (a * x) (b * y) = d \/ minus_nat (b * x) (a * y) = d)

items.name: BEZOUT_ADD
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, exists d x y :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b /\ (a * x = b * y + d \/ b * x = a * y + d)

items.name: BEZOUT_ADD_STRONG
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, ~ a = 0 -> exists d x y :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ (divides_nat d b /\ a * x = b * y + d)

items.name: BEZOUT_GCD
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, exists x y :e omega, minus_nat (a * x) (b * y) = gcd_int a b \/ minus_nat (b * x) (a * y) = gcd_int a b

items.name: BEZOUT_GCD_STRONG
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, ~ a = 0 -> exists x y :e omega, a * x = b * y + gcd_int a b

items.name: BEZOUT_PRIME
items.statement: forall a p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ ~ divides_nat p a -> exists x y :e omega, a * x = p * y + 1

items.name: BICONNECTED_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, finite (components N t) /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} t /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} t /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ connected M c -> connected N {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c c= t /\ connected N c -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e c}))))) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: BIJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, bij s t f <-> inj s t f /\ ((forall x :e s, f x :e t) /\ forall y :e t, exists x :e s, f x = y)

items.name: BIJECTIONS_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (finite s \/ finite t) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)) -> finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t

items.name: BIJECTIONS_HAS_SIZE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ equip s n) -> equip t n

items.name: BIJECTIONS_HAS_SIZE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) -> forall n :e omega, equip s n <-> equip t n

items.name: BIJECTIVE_CLOSED_IMP_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)))) -> homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: BIJECTIVE_CLOSED_IMP_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> open_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: BIJECTIVE_INJECTIVE_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall t c= A, (forall x :e B, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e t -> exists x :e B, x :e s /\ f x = y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e s /\ f y0 = y -> y0 = x) <-> (forall x :e B, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ ((forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ forall y :e A, y :e t -> exists x :e B, x :e s /\ f x = y)

items.name: BIJECTIVE_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall t c= A, (forall x :e B, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e t -> exists x :e B, x :e s /\ f x = y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e s /\ f y0 = y -> y0 = x) <-> (forall x :e B, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ ((forall y :e A, y :e t -> g y :e s) /\ ((forall y :e A, y :e t -> f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e B, x :e s -> g (f x) = x))

items.name: BIJECTIVE_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall y :e B, f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e A, g (f x) = x))

items.name: BIJECTIVE_ON_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) -> ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> f (g y) = y) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g (f x) = x)))

items.name: BIJECTIVE_OPEN_IMP_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> open_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: BIJECTIVE_OPEN_IMP_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (open_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)))) -> homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: BILINEAR_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear N P M h -> exists B :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm P (h x y) <= B * vector_norm M x * vector_norm N y

items.name: BILINEAR_BOUNDED_POS
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> bilinear B C A h -> exists B0 :e R, 0 < B0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm C (h x y) <= B0 * vector_norm A x * vector_norm B y

items.name: BILINEAR_CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A M N P:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> continuous M A f net0 /\ (continuous N A g net0 /\ bilinear N P M h) -> continuous P A (fun x:set => h (f x) (g x)) net0

items.name: BILINEAR_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear N P M bop -> continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) P (fun z:set => bop (fstcart M z) (sndcart M N z)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))

items.name: BILINEAR_CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx D, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx D, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= R :^: idx D, continuous_on_hl D A f s /\ (continuous_on_hl D B g s /\ bilinear B C A h) -> continuous_on_hl D C (fun x:set => h (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: BILINEAR_DIFFERENTIABLE_AT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, h x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, differentiable N M f (at M a) /\ (differentiable P M g (at M a) /\ bilinear P Q N h) -> differentiable Q M (fun x:set => h (f x) (g x)) (at M a)

items.name: BILINEAR_DIFFERENTIABLE_ON_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, h x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, differentiable_on_hl N M f s /\ (differentiable_on_hl P M g s /\ bilinear P Q N h) -> differentiable_on_hl Q M (fun x:set => h (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: BILINEAR_DIFFERENTIABLE_WITHIN_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, h x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, differentiable N M f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ (differentiable P M g (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ bilinear P Q N h) -> differentiable Q M (fun x0:set => h (f x0) (g x0)) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: BILINEAR_DOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> bilinear N 1 N (fun x:set => fun y:set => lift (dot N x y))

items.name: BILINEAR_DROP_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> bilinear N N 1 (fun x:set => fun y:set => vector_mul N (drop x) y)

items.name: BILINEAR_EPSILON_DELTA
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bilinear N P M bop /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm M (vector_sub M x a) < d /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N y b) < d -> vector_norm P (vector_sub P (bop x y) (bop a b)) < e0

items.name: BILINEAR_EQ
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, g x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall b c= R :^: idx M, forall c c= R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, bilinear N P M f /\ (bilinear N P M g /\ (s c= span M b /\ (t c= span N c /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, x :e b /\ y :e c -> f x y = g x y)))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> f x y = g x y

items.name: BILINEAR_EQ_MBASIS
items.statement: forall A M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector M), forall y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), f x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector M), forall y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), g x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s :e A, bilinear (multivector N) P (multivector M) f /\ (bilinear (multivector N) P (multivector M) g /\ (forall s0 t c= omega, s0 c= idx M /\ t c= idx N -> f (mbasis M s0) (mbasis N t) = g (mbasis M s0) (mbasis N t))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector M), forall x0 :e R :^: idx (multivector N), f x x0 = g x x0

items.name: BILINEAR_EQ_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, g x y :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear N P M f /\ (bilinear N P M g /\ (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> f (basis M i) (basis N j) = g (basis M i) (basis N j))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f x x0 = g x x0

items.name: BILINEAR_GEOM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> bilinear (multivector A) (multivector A) (multivector A) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => geom_mul A x x0)

items.name: BILINEAR_INNER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> bilinear (multivector A) (multivector A) (multivector A) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => inner A x x0)

items.name: BILINEAR_IN_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bilinear N P M f /\ (x :e hull (R :^: idx M) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx M) | affine M x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} t) -> f x y :e hull (R :^: idx P) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx P) | affine P x0} (\/_ a :e R :^: idx M, {f a b | b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e t})

items.name: BILINEAR_IN_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bilinear N P M f /\ (x :e hull (R :^: idx M) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx M) | convex M x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} t) -> f x y :e hull (R :^: idx P) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx P) | convex P x0} (\/_ a :e R :^: idx M, {f a b | b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e t})

items.name: BILINEAR_LADD
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx B, forall z :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vector_add B x y) z = vector_add C (h x z) (h y z)

items.name: BILINEAR_LIFT_MUL
items.statement: bilinear 1 1 1 (fun x:set => fun y:set => lift (drop x * drop y))

items.name: BILINEAR_LMUL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vector_mul B c x) y = vector_mul C c (h x y)

items.name: BILINEAR_LNEG
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vector_neg B x) y = vector_neg C (h x y)

items.name: BILINEAR_LSUB
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx B, forall z :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vector_sub B x y) z = vector_sub C (h x z) (h y z)

items.name: BILINEAR_LSUM
items.statement: forall A M N P:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bilinear N P M bop /\ finite s -> bop (vsum A M s f) y = vsum A P s (fun i:set => bop (f i) y)

items.name: BILINEAR_LZERO
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall y :e R :^: idx A, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, bilinear A C B h -> h (vec B 0) x = vec C 0

items.name: BILINEAR_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> bilinear (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex P)) (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex P)) (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (fun m1:set => fun m2:set => vectorize R M P (matrix_mul M N P (matrify R M N m1) (matrify R N P m2)))

items.name: BILINEAR_MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> bilinear N M (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (fun m:set => fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N (matrify R M N m) x)

items.name: BILINEAR_MUL_DROP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> bilinear 1 N N (fun y:set => fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop x) y)

items.name: BILINEAR_OUTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> bilinear (multivector A) (multivector A) (multivector A) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => outer A x x0)

items.name: BILINEAR_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op:set -> set -> set -> prop, bilinear (multivector A) (multivector A) (multivector A) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => Product A mult op x x0)

items.name: BILINEAR_RADD
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y z :e R :^: idx B, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vector_add B y z) = vector_add C (h x y) (h x z)

items.name: BILINEAR_RMUL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vector_mul B c y) = vector_mul C c (h x y)

items.name: BILINEAR_RNEG
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vector_neg B y) = vector_neg C (h x y)

items.name: BILINEAR_RSUB
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y z :e R :^: idx B, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vector_sub B y z) = vector_sub C (h x y) (h x z)

items.name: BILINEAR_RSUM
items.statement: forall A M N P:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e R :^: idx M, bilinear N P M bop /\ finite s -> bop x (vsum A N s f) = vsum A P s (fun i:set => bop x (f i))

items.name: BILINEAR_RZERO
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, h x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, bilinear B C A h -> h x (vec B 0) = vec C 0

items.name: BILINEAR_SWAP
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, op x y :e R :^: idx P) -> (bilinear M P N (fun x:set => fun y:set => op y x) <-> bilinear N P M op)

items.name: BILINEAR_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, h x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (uniformly_continuous_on_hl M P g s /\ (bilinear P Q N h /\ (bounded_hl N {f x | x :e s} /\ bounded_hl P {g x | x :e s}))) -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl M Q (fun x:set => h (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B M N P:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear N P M h /\ (finite s /\ finite t) -> h (vsum A M s f) (vsum B N t g) = vsum (A :*: B) P (s :*: t) (fun p:set => h (f (p 0)) (g (p 1)))

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM_CONVOLUTION_1
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, b x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, bilinear N P M bop -> vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun m:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m} (fun i:set => bop (a i) (b (minus_nat m i)))) = vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun m:set => bop (a m) (vsum omega N {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} b))

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM_CONVOLUTION_2
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, b x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, bilinear N P M bop -> vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun m:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m} (fun k:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= k} (fun i:set => bop (a i) (b (minus_nat k i))))) = vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun m:set => bop (vsum omega M {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m} a) (vsum omega N {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} b))

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM_PARTIAL_PRE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall m n :e omega, bilinear N P M h -> vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => h (f k) (vector_sub N (g k) (g (minus_nat k 1)))) = if m <= n then vector_sub P (vector_sub P (h (f (n + 1)) (g n)) (h (f m) (g (minus_nat m 1)))) (vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => h (vector_sub M (f (k + 1)) (f k)) (g k))) else vec P 0

items.name: BILINEAR_VSUM_PARTIAL_SUC
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall m n :e omega, bilinear N P M h -> vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => h (f k) (vector_sub N (g (k + 1)) (g k))) = if m <= n then vector_sub P (vector_sub P (h (f (n + 1)) (g (n + 1))) (h (f m) (g m))) (vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => h (vector_sub M (f (k + 1)) (f k)) (g (k + 1)))) else vec P 0

items.name: BILIPSCHITZ_HOMEOMORPHISM_RELATIVE_FRONTIERS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex M s /\ (bounded_hl M s /\ (convex N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t))) -> exists f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (relative_frontier M s,relative_frontier N t) (f,g) /\ ((exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e relative_frontier M s /\ y :e relative_frontier M s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) /\ exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e relative_frontier N t /\ y :e relative_frontier N t -> vector_norm M (vector_sub M (g x) (g y)) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y))

items.name: BILIPSCHITZ_HOMEOMORPHISM_SPHERICAL_PROJECTION
