items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s) -> exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism N N (relative_frontier N s,sphere N (vec N 0,1) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) (fun x :e R :^: idx N => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N x)) x,g) /\ ((exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e relative_frontier N s /\ y :e relative_frontier N s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N x)) x) (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N y)) y)) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)) /\ exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e sphere N (vec N 0,1) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s /\ y :e sphere N (vec N 0,1) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g x) (g y)) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y))

items.name: BINARYSUM_BITSET
items.statement: forall n :e omega, binarysum (bitset n) = n

items.name: BINARYSUM_BOUND
items.statement: forall k :e omega, forall s c= omega, (forall i :e omega, i :e s -> i < k) -> binarysum s < 2 ^ k

items.name: BINARYSUM_BOUND_EQ
items.statement: forall s c= omega, forall k :e omega, finite s -> (binarysum s < 2 ^ k <-> forall i :e omega, i :e s -> i < k)

items.name: BINARYSUM_BOUND_LEMMA
items.statement: forall k :e omega, forall s c= omega, (forall i :e omega, i :e s -> i < k) -> finsum s (fun i:set => 2 ^ i) < 2 ^ k

items.name: BINARYSUM_DIV
items.statement: forall k :e omega, forall s c= omega, finite s -> div_nat (finsum s (fun j:set => 2 ^ j)) (2 ^ k) = finsum s (fun j:set => if j < k then 0 else 2 ^ minus_nat j k)

items.name: BINARYSUM_DIV_DIVISIBLE
items.statement: forall s c= omega, forall k :e omega, finite s /\ (forall i :e omega, i :e s -> k <= i) -> finsum s (fun i:set => 2 ^ i) = 2 ^ k * finsum s (fun i:set => 2 ^ minus_nat i k)

items.name: BINARY_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ (forall n :e omega, P n -> P (2 * n) /\ P (2 * n + 1)) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: BIT0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n = n + n

items.name: BIT0_DEF
items.statement: 0 = 0 /\ forall n :e omega, 2 * ordsucc n = ordsucc (ordsucc (2 * n))

items.name: BIT0_THM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n = n + n

items.name: BIT1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = ordsucc (n + n)

items.name: BIT1_DEF
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = ordsucc (2 * n)

items.name: BIT1_THM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n + 1 = ordsucc (n + n)

items.name: BITSET_0
items.statement: bitset 0 = Empty

items.name: BITSET_BINARYSUM
items.statement: forall s c= omega, finite s -> bitset (binarysum s) = s

items.name: BITSET_BOUND
items.statement: forall n i k :e omega, n < 2 ^ k /\ i :e bitset n -> i < k

items.name: BITSET_BOUND_EQ
items.statement: forall n k :e omega, n < 2 ^ k <-> forall i :e omega, i :e bitset n -> i < k

items.name: BITSET_BOUND_LEMMA
items.statement: forall n i :e omega, i :e bitset n -> 2 ^ i <= n

items.name: BITSET_BOUND_WEAK
items.statement: forall n i :e omega, i :e bitset n -> i < n

items.name: BITSET_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, bitset m = bitset n <-> m = n

items.name: BITSET_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall n :e omega, bitset n = Empty <-> n = 0

items.name: BITSET_STEP
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, bitset (2 * n) = {ordsucc x | x :e bitset n}) /\ forall n :e omega, bitset (2 * n + 1) = SetAdjoin {ordsucc x | x :e bitset n} 0

items.name: BLASCHKE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall c c= R :^: idx N, compact N c /\ (forall n :e omega, convex N (f n) /\ (~ f n = Empty /\ f n c= c)) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ exists s c= R :^: idx N, (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ (compact N s /\ (convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (s c= c /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (hausdist N (f (r n),s))) (vec 1 0) sequentially))))

items.name: BLASCHKE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall c c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N c /\ (forall n :e omega, convex N (f n) /\ (~ f n = Empty /\ f n c= c)) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ exists s c= R :^: idx N, (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ (compact N s /\ (convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (hausdist N (f (r n),s))) (vec 1 0) sequentially)))

items.name: BOHL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ (convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ a :e interior N s)) -> (exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x) \/ exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e frontier N s /\ x :e open_segment N (a,f x)

items.name: BOHL_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ (convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ (a :e interior N s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= (R :^: idx N) :\: {a}))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e frontier N s /\ a :e open_segment N (x,f x)

items.name: BOHL_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (a :e s /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= (R :^: idx N) :\: {a})) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e frontier N s /\ ~ f x = x

items.name: BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ infinite s -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x s

items.name: BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS_CONTRAPOS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (t c= s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> ~ limit_point_of N x t)) -> finite t

items.name: BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS_IMP_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall t c= R :^: idx N, infinite t /\ t c= s -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x t) -> bounded_hl N s

items.name: BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall t c= R :^: idx N, infinite t /\ t c= s -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ limit_point_of N x t) -> closed N s

items.name: BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS_PROPERTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall u s c= A, s c= u /\ s c= mspace A m -> ((forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> exists l :e A, exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ (l :e u /\ ((forall m0 n :e omega, m0 < n -> r m0 < r n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m) (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) l sequentially))) <-> forall t c= A, t c= s /\ infinite t -> ~ u :/\: derived_set_of A (mtopology A m) t = Empty)

items.name: BOOL_CASES_AX
items.statement: forall t:prop, (t <-> True) \/ (t <-> False)

items.name: BOREL_BOREL_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ (borel M s /\ borel N t) -> borel M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: BOREL_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, borel N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) <-> borel N s

items.name: BOREL_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, borel N s /\ borel N t -> borel N (s :\: t)

items.name: BOREL_DOMAIN_OF_INJECTIVITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (forall n c= R :^: idx M, n c= s /\ negligible M n -> negligible N {f x | x :e n})) -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, borel M t /\ (t c= s /\ (negligible N ({f x | x :e s} :\: {f x | x :e t}) /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))

items.name: BOREL_DOMAIN_OF_INJECTIVITY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ fsigma M s -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, borel M t /\ (t c= s /\ ({f x | x :e t} = {f x | x :e s} /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))

items.name: BOREL_DOMAIN_OF_INJECTIVITY_CONTINUOUS_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e u -> compact M k /\ continuous_on_hl M N f k) -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, borel M t /\ (t c= Union u /\ ({f x | x :e t} = {f x | x :e Union u} /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))

items.name: BOREL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> borel A Empty

items.name: BOREL_FROM_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, borel_in A (subtopology A top u) s /\ borel_in A top u -> borel_in A top s

items.name: BOREL_IMP_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, borel N s -> analytic N s

items.name: BOREL_IMP_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, borel N s -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: BOREL_INDUCT_CLOSED_UNIONS_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> P s) /\ ((forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> P s) -> P (Union u)) /\ (forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> P s) -> P {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y})) -> forall a c= R :^: idx N, borel N a -> P a

items.name: BOREL_INDUCT_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> P s) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, P s -> P ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) /\ (forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> P s) -> P (Union u))) -> forall a c= R :^: idx N, borel N a -> P a

items.name: BOREL_INDUCT_COMPACT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> P s) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, P s -> P ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) /\ (forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> P s)) -> P {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y})) -> forall a c= R :^: idx N, borel N a -> P a

items.name: BOREL_INDUCT_COMPACT_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> P s) /\ ((forall s t c= R :^: idx N, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\: t)) /\ (forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> P s) -> P (Union u))) -> forall a c= R :^: idx N, borel N a -> P a

items.name: BOREL_INDUCT_COMPACT_UNIONS_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> P s) /\ ((forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> P s) -> P (Union u)) /\ (forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> P s) -> P {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y})) -> forall a c= R :^: idx N, borel N a -> P a

items.name: BOREL_INDUCT_UNIONS_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> P s) /\ ((forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> P s) -> P (Union u)) /\ (forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> P s) -> P {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y})) -> forall a c= R :^: idx N, borel N a -> P a

items.name: BOREL_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, borel N s /\ borel N t -> borel N (s :/\: t)

items.name: BOREL_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> borel N s) -> borel N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: BOREL_IN_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, borel_in A top s -> borel_in A top (topspace A top :\: s)

items.name: BOREL_IN_COMPLEMENT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (borel_in A top (topspace A top :\: s) <-> borel_in A top s)

items.name: BOREL_IN_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall t c= B, continuous_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ borel_in B top2 t -> borel_in A top1 {x :e A | x :e topspace A top1 /\ f x :e t}

items.name: BOREL_IN_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, borel_in A top s /\ borel_in A top t -> borel_in A top (s :\: t)

items.name: BOREL_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, borel_in A top Empty

items.name: BOREL_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, borel_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) x <-> borel N x

items.name: BOREL_IN_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAPS_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e A :^: B, forall s c= A, homeomorphic_maps A B (top,top') (f,g) /\ s c= topspace A top -> (borel_in B top' {f x | x :e s} <-> borel_in A top s)

items.name: BOREL_IN_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ borel_in A top s -> borel_in B top' {f x | x :e s}

items.name: BOREL_IN_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ s c= topspace A top -> (borel_in B top' {f x | x :e s} <-> borel_in A top s)

items.name: BOREL_IN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, borel_in A top s /\ borel_in A top t -> borel_in A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: BOREL_IN_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, countable u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> borel_in A top s)) -> borel_in A top {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: BOREL_IN_INTER_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, borel_in A top t -> borel_in A (subtopology A top s) (t :/\: s)

items.name: BOREL_IN_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, borel_in A top s -> s c= topspace A top

items.name: BOREL_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, borel_in A (subtopology A top u) s <-> exists t c= A, borel_in A top t /\ s = t :/\: u

items.name: BOREL_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, borel_in A top u -> (borel_in A (subtopology A top u) s <-> borel_in A top s /\ s c= u)

items.name: BOREL_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, borel_in A top (topspace A top)

items.name: BOREL_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, borel_in A top s /\ borel_in A top t -> borel_in A top (s :\/: t)

items.name: BOREL_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> borel_in A top s) -> borel_in A top (Union u)

items.name: BOREL_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (borel N {f x | x :e s} <-> borel N s)

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ borel_measurable_on M N g s -> borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_BILINEAR
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, bilinear P Q N bop /\ (borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ borel_measurable_on M P g s) -> borel_measurable_on M Q (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_CASES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ (borel_measurable_on M N g (t :\: s) /\ borel M s) -> borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else g x) t

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, borel_measurable_on M N f s -> borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> borel_measurable_on M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ borel_measurable_on N P g {f x | x :e s} -> borel_measurable_on M P (fun x:set => g (f x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_CONST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx N, borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => c) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl N P f (R :^: idx N) /\ borel_measurable_on M N g s -> borel_measurable_on M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ borel_measurable_on M N f s -> borel_measurable_on M N g s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ borel N t) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (borel_measurable_on M N g (R :^: idx M) /\ ((~ t = Empty -> {g x | x :e R :^: idx M} c= t) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x))

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_IMP_MEASURABLE_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ lebesgue_measurable M s -> measurable_on M N f s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => indicator N s x) (R :^: idx N) <-> borel N s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top1 -> f x :e topspace B top2) /\ forall c c= B, closed_in B top2 c -> borel_in A top1 {x :e A | x :e topspace A top1 /\ f x :e c})

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top3 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ borel_measurable_map B C (top2,top3) g -> borel_measurable_map A C (top1,top3) (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall c :e B, borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) (fun x:set => c) <-> topspace A top1 = Empty \/ c :e topspace B top2

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top1 -> f x = g x) /\ borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) f -> borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) g

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (borel_measurable_map (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) (euclidean M,euclidean N) f <-> borel_measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M))

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_EUCLIDEAN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel M s -> (borel_measurable_map (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,euclidean N) f <-> borel_measurable_on M N f s)

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_FROM_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) f -> borel_measurable_map A B (subtopology A top1 s,top2) f

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, borel_measurable_map A A (top,top) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_IMAGE_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) f -> {f x | x :e topspace A top1} c= topspace B top2

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_INTO_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= B, borel_measurable_map A B (top1,subtopology B top2 s) f <-> borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top1} c= s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> metrizable_space B top2 /\ ((forall n :e omega, borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) (f n)) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top1 -> limit omega B top2 (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially)) -> borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) g

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top1 -> f x :e topspace B top2) /\ forall c c= B, c :e top2 -> borel_in A top1 {x :e A | x :e topspace A top1 /\ f x :e c})

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) s -> borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (if f x <= g x then g x else f x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) s -> borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (if f x <= g x then f x else g x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_MUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ borel_measurable_on M N g s -> borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_NORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s -> borel_measurable_on M 1 (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x))) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_ON_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, borel N s -> (borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => indicator N t x) s <-> borel N (s :/\: t))

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_ON_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ t c= s -> borel_measurable_on M N f t

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ borel_measurable_on M P g s -> borel_measurable_on M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_BOREL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel M s /\ borel_measurable_on M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, borel N t -> borel M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= A, finite t /\ (forall i :e A, i :e t -> borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f i x)) s) -> borel_measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (finprod t (fun i:set => f i x))) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ borel M s -> borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N f s /\ borel_measurable_on M N g s -> borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_VSUM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= A, finite t /\ (forall i :e A, i :e t -> borel_measurable_on M N (f i) s) -> borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vsum A N t (fun i:set => f i x)) s

items.name: BOREL_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, borel M s /\ borel N t -> borel (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: BOREL_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, borel (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ borel M s /\ borel N t)

items.name: BOREL_POINTS_OF_DIFFERENTIABILITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> borel M {x :e R :^: idx M | differentiable N M f (at M x)}

items.name: BOREL_PREIMAGE_FINITE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ fsigma M s -> borel N {y :e R :^: idx N | finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: BOREL_PREIMAGE_HAS_SIZE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ fsigma M s -> borel N {y :e R :^: idx N | equip {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} n}

items.name: BOREL_PREIMAGE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ fsigma M s -> borel N {y :e R :^: idx N | infinite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: BOREL_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, borel N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> borel N s

items.name: BOREL_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, borel N s /\ borel N t -> borel N (s :\/: t)

items.name: BOREL_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> borel N s) -> borel N (Union u)

items.name: BOREL_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> borel N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: BORSUK_HOMOTOPY_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) t) s /\ ((ANR M s /\ ANR M t \/ ANR N u) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= u /\ homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) f g))) -> exists g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g' x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g' t /\ ({g' x | x :e t} c= u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g' x = g x))

items.name: BORSUK_HOMOTOPY_EXTENSION_HOMOTOPIC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) t) s /\ ((ANR M s /\ ANR M t \/ ANR N u) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= u /\ homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) f g))) -> exists g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g' x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) t,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) f g' /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g' t /\ ({g' x | x :e t} c= u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g' x = g x)))

items.name: BORSUK_ODD_MAPPING_DEGREE_STEP
items.statement: forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), forall n :e omega, continuous_map (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) (nsphere n,nsphere n) (fun x:set => f x) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: omega, x :e topspace (R :^: omega) (nsphere n) -> forall x0 :e omega, f (fun x2 :e omega => - x x2) x0 = (fun x2 :e omega => - f x x2) x0) /\ {f x | x :e topspace (R :^: omega) (nsphere (minus_nat n 1))} c= topspace (R :^: omega) (nsphere (minus_nat n 1))) -> divides_int 2 (brouwer_degree2 n (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0) + - brouwer_degree2 (minus_nat n 1) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0))

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c c= A, connected_space A top /\ (compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ s <> topspace A top /\ c :e connected_components_of A (subtopology A top s)))) -> ~ frontier_of A top c :/\: frontier_of A top s = Empty

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c c= A, connected_space A top /\ (compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (~ s = topspace A top /\ c :e connected_components_of A (subtopology A top s))))) -> ~ c :/\: frontier_of A top s = Empty

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_CLOSED_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c c= A, connected_space A top /\ (locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (~ s = topspace A top /\ (compact_in A top c /\ c :e connected_components_of A (subtopology A top s)))))) -> ~ c :/\: frontier_of A top s = Empty

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s /\ c :e components N t)) -> ~ closure N c :/\: (closure N t :/\: closure N (s :\: t)) = Empty

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_EUCLIDEAN_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s /\ c :e components N (closure N t)))) -> ~ c :/\: (s :\: t) = Empty

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_EUCLIDEAN_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ (closed N t /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s /\ c :e components N t))) -> ~ c :/\: (closure N t :/\: closure N (s :\: t)) = Empty

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_EUCLIDEAN_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (open N u /\ (~ s c= u /\ (compact N (s :/\: closure N u) /\ c :e components N (s :/\: closure N u))))) -> ~ c :/\: frontier N u = Empty

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_EUCLIDEAN_INTER_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (open N u /\ (~ s :/\: u = Empty /\ (~ s c= u /\ (compact N (s :/\: closure N u) /\ c :e components N (s :/\: u)))))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e frontier N u /\ limit_point_of N x c

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_EUCLIDEAN_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, (compact N s \/ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) /\ (connected N s /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s /\ c :e components N t))) -> ~ closure N c :/\: (s :\: t) = Empty

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_EUCLIDEAN_OPEN_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, (compact N s \/ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) /\ (connected N s /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s /\ c :e components N t))) -> ~ closure N c :/\: (closure N t :\: t) = Empty

items.name: BOUNDARY_BUMPING_THEOREM_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c c= A, connected_space A top /\ (locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ s <> topspace A top /\ (c :e connected_components_of A (subtopology A top s) /\ compact_in A top (closure_of A top c))))) -> ~ frontier_of A top c :/\: frontier_of A top s = Empty

items.name: BOUNDED_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: BOUNDED_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ bounded_hl N s

items.name: BOUNDED_AND_DIAMETER_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ diameter N s <= r <-> 0 <= r /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (x,y) <= r

items.name: BOUNDED_ARC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> arc A g -> bounded_hl A (path_image A g)

items.name: BOUNDED_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl A (ball A (x,e0))

items.name: BOUNDED_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N (cball N (x,e0))

items.name: BOUNDED_CLOSED_CHAIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall b c= R :^: idx N, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty) /\ ((forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) /\ (b :e f /\ bounded_hl N b)) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: BOUNDED_CLOSED_IMP_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ closed N s -> compact N s

items.name: BOUNDED_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: BOUNDED_CLOSED_NEST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, closed N (s n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ s n = Empty) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n c= s m) /\ bounded_hl N (s 0))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, a :e s n

items.name: BOUNDED_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N (closure N s)

items.name: BOUNDED_CLOSURE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N (closure N s) <-> bounded_hl N s

items.name: BOUNDED_COMMON_FRONTIER_DOMAINS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (bounded_hl N c /\ (open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (open N t /\ (connected N t /\ (~ s = t /\ (frontier N s = c /\ frontier N t = c))))))) -> bounded_hl N s \/ bounded_hl N t

items.name: BOUNDED_COMPONENTS_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N (inside N s) -> bounded_hl N c

items.name: BOUNDED_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> bounded_hl 1 {lift (x i) | x :e s}

items.name: BOUNDED_COMPONENT_RETRACT_COMPLEMENT_MEETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (retract_of N s t /\ (c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ bounded_hl N c)) -> ~ c c= t

items.name: BOUNDED_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: BOUNDED_CONVEX_HULL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s) <-> bounded_hl A s

items.name: BOUNDED_DECREASING_CONVERGENT
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx 1) -> bounded_hl 1 {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega} /\ (forall n :e omega, drop (s (ordsucc n)) <= drop (s n)) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 omega s l sequentially

items.name: BOUNDED_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N (s :\: {x}) <-> bounded_hl N s

items.name: BOUNDED_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s -> bounded_hl A (s :\: t)

items.name: BOUNDED_DIFFS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t -> bounded_hl N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_sub N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: BOUNDED_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> bounded_hl A Empty

items.name: BOUNDED_EQUIINTEGRAL_OVER_THIN_TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (f :e fs /\ ((forall h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall x :e R :^: idx M, h :e fs /\ x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (h x) <= vector_norm N (f x)) /\ 0 < e0)) -> exists d:set -> set -> prop, gauge M d /\ forall c :e R :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), forall h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), c :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (tagged_partial_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p /\ (h :e fs /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall k c= R :^: idx M, (x,k) :e p -> ~ k :/\: {x0 :e R :^: idx M | x0 i = c i} = Empty)))))) -> finsum p (fun p0:set => vector_norm N (integral N M (p0 1) (fun x:set => h x))) < e0

items.name: BOUNDED_EQUIVALENT_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall d :e R, 0 < d -> exists m' :e metric A, mspace A m' = mspace A m /\ (mtopology A m' = mtopology A m /\ forall x y :e A, mdist A m' (x,y) < d)

items.name: BOUNDED_EQ_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ infinite t -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x t

items.name: BOUNDED_EQ_TOTALLY_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, finite k /\ (k c= s /\ s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e ball N (x,e0)} | x :e k})

items.name: BOUNDED_FINITE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall s c= omega, (forall x :e omega, x :e s -> x <= n) -> finite s

items.name: BOUNDED_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N (frontier N s)

items.name: BOUNDED_FRONTIER_BOUNDED_OR_COBOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ bounded_hl N (frontier N s) -> bounded_hl N s \/ bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: BOUNDED_FUNCTIONS_BIJECTIONS_1
items.statement: forall s c= omega, forall k :e omega, forall p :e omega :*: omega :^: omega, p :e (\/_ y :e omega, {(y,g) | g :e omega :^: omega, y :e s /\ g :e {f :e omega :^: omega | (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= k -> f i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, ~ (1 <= i /\ i <= k) -> f i = i}}) -> (fun i :e omega => if i = ordsucc k then p 0 else p 1 i) :e {f :e omega :^: omega | (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= ordsucc k -> f i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, ~ (1 <= i /\ i <= ordsucc k) -> f i = i} /\ (if ordsucc k = ordsucc k then p 0 else p 1 (ordsucc k),fun i :e omega => if i = ordsucc k then i else if i = ordsucc k then p 0 else p 1 i) = p

items.name: BOUNDED_FUNCTIONS_BIJECTIONS_2
items.statement: forall k :e omega, forall s c= omega, forall h :e omega :^: omega, h :e {f :e omega :^: omega | (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= ordsucc k -> f i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, ~ (1 <= i /\ i <= ordsucc k) -> f i = i} -> (h (ordsucc k),fun i :e omega => if i = ordsucc k then i else h i) :e (\/_ y :e omega, {(y,g) | g :e omega :^: omega, y :e s /\ g :e {f :e omega :^: omega | (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= k -> f i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, ~ (1 <= i /\ i <= k) -> f i = i}}) /\ (fun i :e omega => if i = ordsucc k then h (ordsucc k) else (fun i0 :e omega => if i0 = ordsucc k then i0 else h i0) i) = h

items.name: BOUNDED_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x} <-> a = vec N 0 /\ 0 < b

items.name: BOUNDED_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | b < dot N a x} <-> a = vec N 0 /\ 0 <= b

items.name: BOUNDED_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} <-> a = vec N 0 /\ b < 0

items.name: BOUNDED_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x < b} <-> a = vec N 0 /\ b <= 0

items.name: BOUNDED_HAS_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, bounded_hl 1 {lift x | x :e s} /\ ~ s = Empty -> (forall x :e R, x :e s -> inf s <= x) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) -> b <= inf s

items.name: BOUNDED_HAS_SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, bounded_hl 1 {lift x | x :e s} /\ ~ s = Empty -> (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= sup s) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> sup s <= b

items.name: BOUNDED_HYPERPLANE_EQ_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} <-> (a = vec N 0 -> ~ b = 0) /\ (~ a = vec N 0 -> dimindex N = 1)

items.name: BOUNDED_IMAGE_IN_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), forall u c= R :^: idx M, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= R :^: idx M, homeomorphism M N (u,s :\: t) (f,g) /\ (compact N s /\ (closed M u /\ c c= u)) -> (bounded_hl M c <-> closure N {f x | x :e c} :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: BOUNDED_INCREASING_CONVERGENT
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx 1) -> bounded_hl 1 {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega} /\ (forall n :e omega, drop (s n) <= drop (s (ordsucc n))) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 omega s l sequentially

items.name: BOUNDED_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A (SetAdjoin s x) <-> bounded_hl A s

items.name: BOUNDED_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N (inside N s)

items.name: BOUNDED_INTEGRALS_OVER_SUBINTERVALS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> bounded_hl N (\/_ c :e R :^: idx M, {integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) f | d :e R :^: idx M, closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)})

items.name: BOUNDED_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s \/ bounded_hl A t -> bounded_hl A (s :/\: t)

items.name: BOUNDED_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N (interior N s)

items.name: BOUNDED_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (exists s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ bounded_hl N s) -> bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: BOUNDED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx B, bounded_hl B (open_interval B (a,b))

items.name: BOUNDED_LIFT
items.statement: forall s c= R, bounded_hl 1 {lift x | x :e s} <-> exists a :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= a

items.name: BOUNDED_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, bounded_hl M s /\ linear M N f -> bounded_hl N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: BOUNDED_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (bounded_hl A {f x | x :e s} <-> bounded_hl B s)

items.name: BOUNDED_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) /\ bounded_hl M s -> bounded_hl N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: BOUNDED_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s -> bounded_hl A {vector_neg A x | x :e s}

items.name: BOUNDED_NORM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s <-> bounded_hl 1 {lift (vector_norm N x) | x :e s}

items.name: BOUNDED_PAIRS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s <-> exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (x,y) <= B

items.name: BOUNDED_PAIRS_POS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s <-> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (x,y) <= B

items.name: BOUNDED_PARTIAL_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, bounded_hl N {vsum omega N {i :e omega | k <= i /\ i <= n} f | n :e omega, n :e omega} -> bounded_hl N (\/_ m :e omega, {vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f | n :e omega, m :e omega /\ n :e omega})

items.name: BOUNDED_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> path A g -> bounded_hl A (path_image A g)

items.name: BOUNDED_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl M s /\ bounded_hl N t -> bounded_hl (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: BOUNDED_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ bounded_hl M s /\ bounded_hl N t)

items.name: BOUNDED_POS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s <-> exists b :e R, 0 < b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> vector_norm A x <= b

items.name: BOUNDED_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s <-> exists b :e R, 0 < b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> vector_norm A x < b

items.name: BOUNDED_RECTIFIABLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g -> bounded_hl N (path_image N g)

items.name: BOUNDED_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: BOUNDED_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N (relative_interior N s)

items.name: BOUNDED_SCALING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s -> bounded_hl A {vector_mul A c x | x :e s}

items.name: BOUNDED_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, bounded_hl N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ bounded_hl N s

items.name: BOUNDED_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N (open_segment N (a,b))

items.name: BOUNDED_SEPARATION_1D
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 /\ bounded_hl N s -> (connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) <-> s = Empty)

items.name: BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) /\ has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (fun k:set => integral N M k f) (R :^: idx M) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M)

items.name: BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (fun k:set => integral N M k f) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: BOUNDED_SET_VARIATION_FROM_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) s -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ set_variation M N s f <= set_variation M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) s (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) /\ (has_bounded_setvariation_on M P g s /\ set_variation M P s g <= set_variation M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) s (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)))

items.name: BOUNDED_SET_VARIATION_ON_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ has_bounded_setvariation_on M P g s -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) s /\ set_variation M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) s (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) <= set_variation M N s f + set_variation M P s g

items.name: BOUNDED_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> simple_path A g -> bounded_hl A (path_image A g)

items.name: BOUNDED_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A {a}

items.name: BOUNDED_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, bounded_hl N (sphere N (a,r))

items.name: BOUNDED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A t /\ s c= t -> bounded_hl A s

items.name: BOUNDED_SUBSET_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> exists r :e R, 0 < r /\ s c= ball N (x,r)

items.name: BOUNDED_SUBSET_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> exists r :e R, 0 < r /\ s c= cball N (x,r)

items.name: BOUNDED_SUBSET_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, s c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: BOUNDED_SUBSET_CLOSED_INTERVAL_SYMMETRIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, s c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (vector_neg N a,a) seq_nil)

items.name: BOUNDED_SUBSET_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, s c= open_interval N (a,b)

items.name: BOUNDED_SUBSET_OPEN_INTERVAL_SYMMETRIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, s c= open_interval N (vector_neg N a,a)

items.name: BOUNDED_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t -> bounded_hl N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: BOUNDED_SUMS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall t c= A, bounded_hl B {f x | x :e A, x :e t} /\ bounded_hl B {g x | x :e A, x :e t} -> bounded_hl B {vector_add B (f x) (g x) | x :e A, x :e t}

items.name: BOUNDED_SUMS_IMAGES
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t c= A, forall s c= B, finite s /\ (forall a :e B, a :e s -> bounded_hl N {f x a | x :e A, x :e t}) -> bounded_hl N {vsum B N s (f x) | x :e A, x :e t}

items.name: BOUNDED_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: BOUNDED_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> bounded_hl N s

items.name: BOUNDED_ULC_IMP_FCCOVERABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ distance N (x,y) < d) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ (y :e c /\ (c c= s /\ (connected N c /\ (bounded_hl N c /\ diameter N c <= e0))))) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite c /\ (Union c = s /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e c -> connected N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ diameter N t <= e0))

items.name: BOUNDED_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ bounded_hl M s -> bounded_hl N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: BOUNDED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A (s :\/: t) <-> bounded_hl A s /\ bounded_hl A t

items.name: BOUNDED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e f -> bounded_hl A s) -> bounded_hl A (Union f)

items.name: BOUNDED_UNIQUE_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ bounded_hl N s -> (c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ ~ bounded_hl N c <-> c = outside N s)

items.name: BOUNDED_VARIATION_FROM_PASTECART
items.statement: forall N P:set, N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) s -> has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ vector_variation N s f <= vector_variation (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) s (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) /\ (has_bounded_variation_on P g s /\ vector_variation P s g <= vector_variation (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) s (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)))

items.name: BOUNDED_VECTOR_VARIATION_ON_PASTECART
items.statement: forall N P:set, N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on P g s -> has_bounded_variation_on (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) s /\ vector_variation (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) s (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) <= vector_variation N s f + vector_variation P s g

items.name: BOUNDED_WITH_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N (s :\/: inside N s)

items.name: BOUNDS_DIVIDED
items.statement: forall P:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, P x :e omega) -> ((exists B :e omega, forall n :e omega, P n <= B) <-> exists A B :e omega, forall n :e omega, n * P n <= A * n + B)

items.name: BOUNDS_IGNORE
items.statement: forall P:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, P x :e omega) -> forall Q:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, Q x :e omega) -> ((exists B :e omega, forall i :e omega, P i <= Q i + B) <-> exists B N :e omega, forall i :e omega, N <= i -> P i <= Q i + B)

items.name: BOUNDS_LINEAR
items.statement: forall A B C :e omega, (forall n :e omega, A * n <= B * n + C) <-> A <= B

items.name: BOUNDS_LINEAR_0
items.statement: forall A B :e omega, (forall n :e omega, A * n <= B) <-> A = 0

items.name: BOUNDS_NOTZERO
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, P x y :e omega) -> forall A B :e omega, P 0 0 = 0 /\ (forall m n :e omega, P m n <= A * (m + n) + B) -> exists B0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, P m n <= B0 * (m + n)

items.name: BROUWER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= s))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x

items.name: BROUWER_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (retract_of N s (R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= s)) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x

items.name: BROUWER_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N s (R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= s /\ bounded_hl N {f x | x :e s})) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x

items.name: BROUWER_AR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (AR N s /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= s)) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x

items.name: BROUWER_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f (cball N (a,e0)) /\ {f x | x :e cball N (a,e0)} c= cball N (a,e0)) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e cball N (a,e0) /\ f x = x

items.name: BROUWER_CONTRACTIBLE_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (contractible N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (ANR N s /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= s)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x

items.name: BROUWER_CUBE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl N N f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (vec N 0,vec N 1) seq_nil)) /\ {f x | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (vec N 0,vec N 1) seq_nil)} c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (vec N 0,vec N 1) seq_nil) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (vec N 0,vec N 1) seq_nil) /\ f x = x

items.name: BROUWER_DEGREE1_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl N N f (sphere N (vec N 0,1) :/\: span N {basis N x | x :e idx_n n}) /\ (continuous_on_hl N N g (sphere N (vec N 0,1) :/\: span N {basis N x | x :e idx_n n}) /\ ({f x | x :e sphere N (vec N 0,1) :/\: span N {basis N x | x :e idx_n n}} c= sphere N (vec N 0,1) :/\: span N {basis N x | x :e idx_n n} /\ {g x | x :e sphere N (vec N 0,1) :/\: span N {basis N x | x :e idx_n n}} c= sphere N (vec N 0,1) :/\: span N {basis N x | x :e idx_n n})) -> brouwer_degree1 N n (fun x:set => g (f x)) = brouwer_degree1 N n g * brouwer_degree1 N n f

items.name: BROUWER_DEGREE1_CONST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall a :e R :^: idx N, 1 <= n /\ n <= dimindex N -> brouwer_degree1 N n (fun x:set => a) = 0

items.name: BROUWER_DEGREE1_EQ

items.name: BROUWER_DEGREE_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl N N f (sphere N (vec N 0,1)) /\ (continuous_on_hl N N g (sphere N (vec N 0,1)) /\ ({f x | x :e sphere N (vec N 0,1)} c= sphere N (vec N 0,1) /\ {g x | x :e sphere N (vec N 0,1)} c= sphere N (vec N 0,1))) -> brouwer_degree N (fun x:set => g (f x)) = brouwer_degree N g * brouwer_degree N f

items.name: BROUWER_FACTOR_THROUGH_AR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= s /\ (compact M s /\ AR N t)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ g (f x) = x

items.name: BROUWER_INESSENTIAL_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (ANR N s /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= s /\ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) f (fun x:set => a)))))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x

items.name: BROUWER_REDUCTION_THEOREM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact N (f n) /\ (~ f n = Empty /\ P (f n))) /\ (forall n :e omega, f (ordsucc n) c= f n) -> P {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {f n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}) /\ (compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ P s)) -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (compact N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (P t /\ forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= s /\ (closed N u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ P u)) -> ~ (u c= t /\ u <> t))))

items.name: BROUWER_REDUCTION_THEOREM_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, closed N (f n) /\ P (f n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, f (ordsucc n) c= f n) -> P {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {f n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}) /\ (closed N s /\ P s) -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (closed N t /\ (P t /\ forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= s /\ (closed N u /\ P u) -> ~ (u c= t /\ u <> t)))

items.name: BROUWER_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N t /\ (convex N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f t /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> vector_add N x (vector_sub N y (f y)) :e t)))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ f y = x

items.name: BROUWER_SURJECTIVE_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f (cball N (a,e0)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e cball N (a,e0) -> vector_add N x (vector_sub N y (f y)) :e cball N (a,e0))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e cball N (a,e0) /\ f y = x

items.name: BROUWER_WEAK

items.name: BUTLAST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_butlast seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_butlast (seq_cons h t) = if t = seq_nil then seq_nil else seq_cons h (seq_butlast t)

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_butlast (seq_append l m) = if m = seq_nil then seq_butlast l else seq_append l (seq_butlast m)

items.name: BUTLAST_CLAUSES

items.name: CANTOR_BAIRE_STATIONARY_PRINCIPLE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall w:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A w /\ (~ countable (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e A, w x y}) /\ ((forall v0:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A v0 w /\ ~ (forall x x0 :e A, v0 x x0 <-> w x x0) -> countable (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e A, v0 x y})) /\ ((forall i :e A, i :e fld_on A w -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) v) (f i) \/ f i :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) v) /\ (forall i j :e A, w i j -> f j c= f i)))) -> exists k :e A, k :e fld_on A w /\ forall i :e A, w k i -> f i = f k

items.statement: forall a c= omega, real_sums (fun x:set => cantor_term a x) (cantor_map a) (from 0)

items.name: CANTOR_PARTIAL_SUM_DIFF_AT_K
items.statement: forall a b c= omega, forall k :e omega, (forall j :e omega, j < k -> (j :e a <-> j :e b)) /\ (k :e a /\ ~ k :e b) -> finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= k} (fun x:set => cantor_term a x) = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= k} (fun x:set => cantor_term b x) + 2 :/: 3 ^ (k + 1)

items.name: CANTOR_PARTIAL_SUM_MONO
items.statement: forall a c= omega, forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m} (fun x:set => cantor_term a x) <= finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => cantor_term a x)

items.name: CANTOR_SET_SUBSET_INTERVAL
items.statement: cantor_set c= closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)

items.name: CANTOR_SPACE_HOMEOMORPHIC_CANTOR_SET
items.statement: homeomorphic_space (Power omega) R cantor_space (subtopology R euclideanreal cantor_set)

items.name: CANTOR_TERM_BOUND
items.statement: forall a c= omega, forall k :e omega, cantor_term a k <= 2 :/: 3 ^ (k + 1)

items.name: CANTOR_TERM_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall k :e omega, continuous_map (Power omega) R (cantor_space,euclideanreal) (fun a:set => cantor_term a k)

items.name: CANTOR_TERM_POS
items.statement: forall a c= omega, forall k :e omega, 0 <= cantor_term a k

items.name: CANTOR_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, atleastp s {t :e Power A | t c= s} /\ ~ equip s {t :e Power A | t c= s}

items.name: CANTOR_THM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> atleastp A (Power A) /\ ~ equip A (Power A)

items.name: CAPPED_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e R, forall m :e metric A, mspace A (capped_metric A d m) = mspace A m /\ forall x :e A :*: A, mdist A (capped_metric A d m) x = if d <= 0 then mdist A m (x 0,x 1) else if d <= mdist A m (x 0,x 1) then d else mdist A m (x 0,x 1)

items.name: CARATHEODORY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} p = {x :e R :^: idx N | exists s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (s c= p /\ (finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N + 1 /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s))}

items.name: CARATHEODORY_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} p = {x :e R :^: idx N | exists s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (s c= p /\ (finite_cardinality s <= aff_dim N p + 1 /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s))}

items.name: CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite_cardinality s = set_foldr (fun x:set => fun n:set => ordsucc n) s 0

items.name: CARD_ADD2_ABSORB_LE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, infinite u /\ (atleastp s u /\ atleastp t u) -> atleastp (s :+: t) u

items.name: CARD_ADD2_ABSORB_LT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, infinite u /\ (atleastp s u /\ ~ equip s u /\ (atleastp t u /\ ~ equip t u)) -> atleastp (s :+: t) u /\ ~ equip (s :+: t) u

items.name: CARD_ADD_ABSORB_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ atleastp s t -> atleastp (s :+: t) t

items.name: CARD_ADD_ABSORB_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ atleastp s t -> equip (s :+: t) t

items.name: CARD_ADD_ABSORB_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite s /\ atleastp t s -> equip (s :+: t) s

items.name: CARD_ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip (s :+: (t :+: u)) (s :+: t :+: u)

items.name: CARD_ADD_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :+: t) = finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_ADD_CONG
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, equip s s' /\ equip t t' -> equip (s :+: t) (s' :+: t')

items.name: CARD_ADD_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (s :+: t)

items.name: CARD_ADD_FINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite (s :+: t) <-> finite s /\ finite t

items.name: CARD_ADD_LE_MUL_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> atleastp (s :+: s) (s :*: s)

items.name: CARD_ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip (s :+: t) (t :+: s)

items.name: CARD_ADD_SYMDIFF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t = finite_cardinality ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) + 2 * finite_cardinality (s :/\: t)

items.name: CARD_BOOL
items.statement: finite_cardinality 2 = 2

items.name: CARD_CART
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> finite {x :e A | P i x}) -> finite_cardinality {v :e A :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (v i)} = finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {x :e A | P i x})

items.name: CARD_CART_UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> finite A -> finite_cardinality (A :^: idx N) = finite_cardinality A ^ dimindex N

items.name: CARD_CIRCLE_INTERSECTION_LE
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, forall r s :e R, ~ (a = b /\ (r = s /\ (0 < r /\ 0 < s))) -> finite_cardinality (sphere (idx_n 2) (a,r) :/\: sphere (idx_n 2) (b,s)) <= 2

items.name: CARD_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite_cardinality Empty = 0 /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality (SetAdjoin s x) = if x :e s then finite_cardinality s else ordsucc (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: CARD_COLUMNS_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, finite_cardinality (columns N M A) <= dimindex M

items.name: CARD_COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENT_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> finite_cardinality (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) <= 2

items.name: CARD_CONJUGATE_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ s c= group_carrier A G -> finite_cardinality {t :e Power A | group_conjugate A G s t} = div_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) (finite_cardinality (group_normalizer A G s))

items.name: CARD_CONJUGATE_SUBSETS_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ s c= group_carrier A G -> finite_cardinality {t :e Power A | group_conjugate A G s t} * finite_cardinality (group_normalizer A G s) = finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)

items.name: CARD_CONJUGATE_SUBSETS_MUL_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= group_carrier A G -> equip ({t :e Power A | group_conjugate A G s t} :*: group_normalizer A G s) (group_carrier A G)
