items.name: CARD_COUNTABLE_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t -> (countable s <-> countable t)

items.name: CARD_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :*: t) = finite_cardinality s * finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_CYCLIC_SUBGROUP_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, finite (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x})) /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> finite_cardinality (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x})) = group_element_order_hl A G x

items.name: CARD_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality (s :\: {x}) = if x :e s then minus_nat (finite_cardinality s) 1 else finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> finite_cardinality (s :\: t) = minus_nat (finite_cardinality s) (finite_cardinality t)

items.name: CARD_DIFF_ABSORB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ (atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s) -> equip (s :\: t) s

items.name: CARD_DIFF_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s' c= s /\ (t' c= t /\ (equip s t /\ (equip s' t' /\ (infinite s -> atleastp s' s /\ ~ equip s' s)))) -> equip (s :\: s') (t :\: t')

items.name: CARD_DIFF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality (s :\: t) + finite_cardinality (s :/\: t)

items.name: CARD_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty -> equip (s :\/: t) (s :+: t)

items.name: CARD_DIVIDES_GROUP_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ finite (group_carrier A G) -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier B H)) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: CARD_DIVIDES_GROUP_MONOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_monomorphism A B (G,H) f /\ finite (group_carrier B H) -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier B H))

items.name: CARD_EMPTY_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, atleastp Empty s

items.name: CARD_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finite_cardinality s = 0 <-> s = Empty)

items.name: CARD_EQ_ADD_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, (finite s \/ atleastp s t /\ atleastp s u) /\ equip (s :+: t) (s :+: u) -> equip t u

items.name: CARD_EQ_ADD_LCANCEL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, finite s \/ atleastp s t /\ atleastp s u -> (equip (s :+: t) (s :+: u) <-> equip t u)

items.name: CARD_EQ_ADD_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, (finite u \/ atleastp u s /\ atleastp u t) /\ equip (s :+: u) (t :+: u) -> equip s t

items.name: CARD_EQ_ADD_RCANCEL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, finite u \/ atleastp u s /\ atleastp u t -> (equip (s :+: u) (t :+: u) <-> equip s t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_ANALYTIC_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip {s :e Power (R :^: idx N) | analytic N s} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_ARC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> arc A g -> equip (path_image A g) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_BAIRE_FUNCTIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, equip {f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | f :e baire M N k (R :^: idx M)} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 0 < r -> equip (ball N (a,r)) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))

items.name: CARD_EQ_BIJECTIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)

items.name: CARD_EQ_BIJECTIONS_SPECIAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t /\ (a :e s /\ b :e t))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ (f a = b /\ (g b = a /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)))

items.name: CARD_EQ_BOREL_MEASURABLE_FUNCTIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip {f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => f x) (R :^: idx M)} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_BOREL_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip {s :e Power (R :^: idx N) | borel N s} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_CARD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> (equip s t <-> finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_CARD_IMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ equip s t -> finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_EQ_CART
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> infinite A -> equip (A :^: idx N) A

items.name: CARD_EQ_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall t :e Power B :^: K, forall k c= K, (forall i :e K, i :e k -> equip (s i) (t i)) -> equip {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} {f :e B :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: CARD_EQ_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall f :e Power A :^: K, forall k l c= K, k :/\: l = Empty -> equip {f0 :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k :\/: l, f0 i :e f i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k :\/: l -> f0 i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} ({f0 :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f0 i :e f i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f0 i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} :*: {f0 :e A :^: K | (forall i :e l, f0 i :e f i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e l -> f0 i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)})

items.name: CARD_EQ_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 0 < r -> equip (cball N (a,r)) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> atleastp s omega \/ equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_CLOSED_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip {s :e Power (R :^: idx N) | closed N s} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_COMPACT_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip {s :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N s} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ homeomorphic N N s t) -> equip (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t))

items.name: CARD_EQ_COMPONENTS_IN_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), forall g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx N, homeomorphism N M (sphere N (a,r) :\: {z},R :^: idx M) (f,g) /\ (s c= sphere N (a,r) /\ (z :e sphere N (a,r) /\ ~ z :e closure N s)) -> equip (components N (sphere N (a,r) :\: s)) ({1} :+: {c :e Power (R :^: idx M) | c :e components M ((R :^: idx M) :\: {f x | x :e s}) /\ bounded_hl M c})

items.name: CARD_EQ_CONDENSATION_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, equip {x :e R :^: idx N | condensation_point_of N x s} R <-> ~ countable s

items.name: CARD_EQ_CONDENSATION_POINTS_IN_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ countable s -> equip {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ condensation_point_of N x s} s

items.name: CARD_EQ_CONG
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, equip s s' /\ equip t t' -> (equip s t <-> equip s' t')

items.name: CARD_EQ_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ ~ a = b)) -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_EUCLIDEAN_COMPLEMENTS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall s t c= R :^: omega, closed_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) t /\ homeomorphic_space (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) s) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) t)) -> equip (connected_components_of (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) (topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) :\: s))) (connected_components_of (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) (topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) :\: t)))

items.name: CARD_EQ_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ ~ a = b)) -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, countable t /\ equip s t -> countable s

items.name: CARD_EQ_COUNTABLE_SUBSETS_REAL
items.statement: equip {s :e Power R | countable s} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_COUNTABLE_SUBSETS_SUBREAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s /\ atleastp s R -> equip {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ countable t} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_COVERING_MAP_FIBRES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (path_connected N s /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s)) -> equip {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = a} {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b}

items.name: CARD_EQ_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx A, b c= v /\ equip b (dim A v) -> (independent A b <-> v c= span A b)

items.name: CARD_EQ_DISJOINT_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, forall t c= B, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ (forall u c= A, u :e s -> equip u t) -> equip (Union s) (s :*: t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, equip s Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: CARD_EQ_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip (R :^: idx N) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_EXP_INFINITE_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite s /\ (finite t /\ ~ t = Empty) -> equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} s

items.name: CARD_EQ_FINITE
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, finite t /\ equip s t -> finite s

items.name: CARD_EQ_FINITE_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> equip {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ finite t} s

items.name: CARD_EQ_FREE_ABELIAN_GROUP_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> equip (group_carrier (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s)) s

items.name: CARD_EQ_FSIGMA_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip {s :e Power (R :^: idx N) | fsigma N s} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_FULLSIZE_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> equip {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ equip t s} {t :e Power A | t c= s}

items.name: CARD_EQ_FUNDAMENTAL_GROUPS_BASEPOINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N s /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s) -> equip (fundamental_group N (s,a)) (fundamental_group N (s,b))

items.name: CARD_EQ_FUNDAMENTAL_GROUP_COVERING_SPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (path_connected M c /\ a :e c) -> equip (fundamental_group N (s,p a)) (fundamental_group M (c,a) :*: {a' :e R :^: idx M | a' :e c /\ p a' = p a})

items.name: CARD_EQ_FUNDAMENTAL_GROUP_COVERING_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (path_connected M c /\ a :e c) -> equip (fundamental_group N (s,p a)) {{x :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx 1) | homotopic_paths M c (fun x0:set => g x0) (fun x0:set => x x0)} | g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx 1), path M (fun x:set => g x) /\ (path_image M (fun x:set => g x) c= c /\ (pathstart M (fun x:set => g x) = a /\ p (pathfinish M (fun x:set => g x)) = p a))}

items.name: CARD_EQ_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> equip {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ {x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s} {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EQ_GDELTA_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip {s :e Power (R :^: idx N) | gdelta N s} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_GROUP_IMAGE_KERNEL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f -> equip (group_image A B (G,H) f :*: group_kernel A B (G,H) f) (group_carrier A G)

items.name: CARD_EQ_GROUP_ISOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_isomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f -> equip (group_carrier A G) (group_carrier B H)

items.name: CARD_EQ_GROUP_MONOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_monomorphism A B (G,H) f -> equip {f x | x :e group_carrier A G} (group_carrier A G)

items.name: CARD_EQ_GROUP_ORBIT_STABILIZERS
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ group_orbit A X G s a x y -> equip (group_stabilizer A X G a x) (group_stabilizer A X G a y)

items.name: CARD_EQ_HOMOMORPHISMS_FROM_FREE_ABELIAN_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall G :e group_hl B, abelian_group_hl B G -> equip {f :e B :^: frag A | (forall x :e frag A, ~ x :e group_carrier (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) /\ group_homomorphism_hl (frag A) B (free_abelian_group A s,G) (fun x:set => f x)} {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e group_carrier B G) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EQ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> equip {f x | x :e s} s

items.name: CARD_EQ_IMAGES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (f x = f y <-> g x = g y)) -> equip {f x | x :e s} {g x | x :e s}

items.name: CARD_EQ_IMAGE_MUL_FIBRES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= C, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> equip {z :e A | z :e s /\ f z = f x} t) -> equip ({f x | x :e s} :*: t) s

items.name: CARD_EQ_IMP_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t -> atleastp s t

items.name: CARD_EQ_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ equip s t -> infinite s

items.name: CARD_EQ_INTEGER
items.statement: equip {x :e R | x :e int} omega

items.name: CARD_EQ_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty -> equip (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) R) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty -> equip (open_interval N (a,b)) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_INT_NUM
items.statement: equip int omega

items.name: CARD_EQ_LEFT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> equip (left_coset_hl A G x h) (left_coset_hl A G y h)

items.name: CARD_EQ_LEFT_COSET_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> equip (left_coset_hl A G x h) h

items.name: CARD_EQ_LEFT_RIGHT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> equip {left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} {right_coset_hl A G h x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}

items.name: CARD_EQ_LIMITED_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite s -> (atleastp t s -> equip {k :e Power A | k c= s /\ atleastp k t} {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}) /\ (~ atleastp t s -> equip {k :e Power A | k c= s /\ atleastp k t} {f :e 2 :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)})

items.name: CARD_EQ_LIST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> infinite A -> equip (finseq A) A

items.name: CARD_EQ_LIST_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> equip {l :e finseq A | forall x :e A, seq_mem x l -> x :e s} s

items.name: CARD_EQ_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ interior N s = Empty -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_NSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality s = finsum s (fun x:set => 1)

items.name: CARD_EQ_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_OPEN_CLOSED_IN_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, equip {s :e Power A | s :e top} {s :e Power A | closed_in A top s}

items.name: CARD_EQ_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} u /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ limit_point_of N x u)) -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_OPEN_IN_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, affine N u /\ (~ aff_dim N u = 0 /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ ~ s = Empty)) -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_OPEN_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip {s :e Power (R :^: idx N) | open N s} R

items.name: CARD_EQ_ORDINAL_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, exists l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ equip (fld_on A l) s

items.name: CARD_EQ_PATH_COMPONENTS_EUCLIDEAN_COMPLEMENTS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall s t c= R :^: omega, closed_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) t /\ homeomorphic_space (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) s) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) t)) -> equip (path_components_of (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) (topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) :\: s))) (path_components_of (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) (topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) :\: t)))

items.name: CARD_EQ_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ ~ a = b)) -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, equip (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (s :*: t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_PERFECT_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> limit_point_of N x s) /\ ~ s = Empty) -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (f x :e t /\ (f y :e t /\ f x = f y))) -> x = y) /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} -> equip {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t} t

items.name: CARD_EQ_RATIONAL
items.statement: equip {x :e R | x :e rational} omega

items.name: CARD_EQ_REAL
items.statement: equip R (Power omega)

items.name: CARD_EQ_REAL_IMP_UNCOUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, equip s R -> ~ countable s

items.name: CARD_EQ_REAL_SEQUENCES
items.statement: equip (R :^: omega) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_REAL_SUBSET
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a b :e R, a < b /\ (forall x :e R, a < x /\ x < b -> x :e s) -> equip s R

items.name: CARD_EQ_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, equip s s

items.name: CARD_EQ_REFL_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s = t -> equip s t

items.name: CARD_EQ_RESTRICTED_FUNSPACE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> infinite s /\ (~ (exists a :e B, t c= {a}) /\ {k x | x :e s} c= t) -> equip {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ({x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s /\ finite {x :e A | ~ f x = k x})} (s :*: t)

items.name: CARD_EQ_RESTRICTED_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite s -> equip {k :e Power A | k c= s /\ equip k t} (if atleastp t s then {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} else Empty)

items.name: CARD_EQ_RIGHT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> equip (right_coset_hl A G h x) (right_coset_hl A G h y)

items.name: CARD_EQ_RIGHT_COSET_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> equip (right_coset_hl A G h x) h

items.name: CARD_EQ_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> equip (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) R) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> equip (open_segment N (a,b)) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> simple_path A g -> equip (path_image A g) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N /\ 0 < r -> equip (sphere N (a,r)) R

items.name: CARD_EQ_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality s = finsum s (fun x:set => 1)

items.name: CARD_EQ_SYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t <-> equip t s

items.name: CARD_EQ_TRANS
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip s t /\ equip t u -> equip s u

items.name: CARD_EVEN_PERMUTATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ 2 <= finite_cardinality s -> 2 * finite_cardinality {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s /\ evenperm A (fun x:set => p x)} = factorial (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: CARD_EXP_0
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall c :e C, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e Empty, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e Empty -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {c}

items.name: CARD_EXP_ABSORB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ (atleastp 2 s /\ atleastp s {f :e 2 :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)}) -> equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {f :e 2 :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_ADD
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip {f :e A :^: (B :+: C) | (forall x :e t :+: u, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B :+: C, ~ x :e t :+: u -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} ({f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} :*: {f :e A :^: C | (forall x :e u, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e u -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)})

items.name: CARD_EXP_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} = finite_cardinality s ^ finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_EXP_CANTOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, atleastp s {f :e 2 :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)} /\ ~ equip s {f :e 2 :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_CONG
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, equip s s' /\ equip t t' -> equip {f :e A :^: C | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {f :e B :^: D | (forall x :e t', f x :e s') /\ forall x :e D, ~ x :e t' -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_EQ_REAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, countable s /\ ~ s = Empty -> equip {f :e R :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e R) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in R (fun y:set => False)} R

items.name: CARD_EXP_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_FINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} <-> (exists a :e A, s c= {a}) \/ (t = Empty \/ finite s /\ finite t)

items.name: CARD_EXP_GRAPH
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {R0 :e Power A :^: B | (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, y :e R0 x -> x :e t /\ y :e s) /\ forall x :e B, x :e t -> exists y :e A, y :e R0 x /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e R0 x -> y0 = y}

items.name: CARD_EXP_GRAPH_PAIRED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {R0 :e Power (B :*: A) | (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, (x,y) :e R0 -> x :e t /\ y :e s) /\ forall x :e B, x :e t -> exists y :e A, (x,y) :e R0 /\ forall y0 :e A, (x,y0) :e R0 -> y0 = y}

items.name: CARD_EXP_LE_REAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s R /\ countable t -> atleastp {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} R

items.name: CARD_EXP_MUL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip {f :e A :^: (B :*: C) | (forall x :e t :*: u, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B :*: C, ~ x :e t :*: u -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {f :e A :^: B :^: C | (forall x :e u, f x :e {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e u -> f x = choose_in (A :^: B) (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_EXP_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, equip {f :e 2 :^: A | (forall x :e s, f x :e 2) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in 2 (fun y:set => False)} {t :e Power A | t c= s}

items.name: CARD_EXP_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall b :e B, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e {b}, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e {b} -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} s

items.name: CARD_EXP_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e B, f x :e A) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e B -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} = A :^: B

items.name: CARD_EXP_ZERO
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall c :e C, equip {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e s, f x :e Empty) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} (if s = Empty then {c} else Empty)

items.name: CARD_FACES_OF_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx A, simplex A n s -> finite_cardinality {f :e Power (R :^: idx A) | face_of A f s} = 2 ^ if n + 1 :e omega then n + 1 else 0

items.name: CARD_FINITE_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t -> (finite s <-> finite t)

items.name: CARD_FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite_cardinality (idx A) = dimindex A

items.name: CARD_FRONTIER_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s -> finite (frontier 1 s) /\ finite_cardinality (frontier 1 s) <= 2

items.name: CARD_FRONTIER_OF_REALINTERVAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, is_realinterval s -> finite (frontier_of R euclideanreal s) /\ finite_cardinality (frontier_of R euclideanreal s) <= 2

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = d} = finite_cardinality t ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE_CONG
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> equip A A_ /\ equip B B_ -> equip (B :^: A) (B_ :^: A_)

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE_CURRY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> equip (C :^: B :^: A) (C :^: (A :*: B))

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> atleastp A A_ /\ atleastp B B_ -> atleastp (B :^: A) (B_ :^: A_)

items.name: CARD_FUNSPACE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> finite A /\ finite B -> finite_cardinality (B :^: A) = finite_cardinality B ^ finite_cardinality A

items.name: CARD_GE_DIM_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx N, b c= v /\ (independent N b /\ dim N v <= finite_cardinality b) -> v c= span N b

items.name: CARD_GE_PERFECT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, (completely_metrizable_space A top \/ locally_compact_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top) /\ (derived_set_of A top s = s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> atleastp R s

items.name: CARD_GE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> atleastp t {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CARD_GROUP_ORBIT_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s) -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0}) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: CARD_GROUP_SETMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, finite g /\ (finite h /\ (subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G)) -> finite_cardinality (group_setmul A G g h) = div_nat (finite_cardinality g * finite_cardinality h) (finite_cardinality (g :/\: h))

items.name: CARD_GROUP_SETMUL_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, finite g /\ (finite h /\ (subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G)) -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality (group_setmul A G g h)) (finite_cardinality g * finite_cardinality h)

items.name: CARD_GROUP_SETMUL_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> equip (group_setmul A G g h :*: g :/\: h) (g :*: h)

items.name: CARD_GROUP_SETMUL_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, finite g /\ (finite h /\ (subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G)) -> finite_cardinality (group_setmul A G g h) * finite_cardinality (g :/\: h) = finite_cardinality g * finite_cardinality h

items.name: CARD_GROUP_STABILIZER_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s) -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality (group_stabilizer A X G a x)) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: CARD_HAS_SIZE_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall n :e omega, equip s t -> (equip s n <-> equip t n)

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_EQ_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} = finite_cardinality s <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ finite s -> finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} = finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_INJ_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ f y0 = y -> y0 = x)) -> finite_cardinality t = finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} <= finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_LE2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ g x = g y) -> f x = f y) -> finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} <= finite_cardinality {g x | x :e s}

items.name: CARD_IMAGE_LT2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ g x = g y) -> f x = f y) /\ ~ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> g x = g y)) -> finite_cardinality {f x | x :e s} < finite_cardinality {g x | x :e s}

items.name: CARD_INFINITE_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t -> (infinite s <-> infinite t)

items.name: CARD_INTSEG_INT
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a :e int /\ b :e int -> finite_cardinality {x :e R | x :e int /\ (a <= x /\ x <= b)} = if b < a then 0 else if (if (b + - a) + 1 :e int then (b + - a) + 1 else 0) :e omega then if (b + - a) + 1 :e int then (b + - a) + 1 else 0 else 0

items.name: CARD_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip (s :*: (t :+: u)) (s :*: t :+: s :*: u)

items.name: CARD_LEFT_COSETS_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ subgroup_of A h G -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality {left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: CARD_LET_TOTAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t \/ atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s

items.name: CARD_LET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, atleastp s t /\ (atleastp t u /\ ~ equip t u) -> atleastp s u /\ ~ equip s u

items.name: CARD_LE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= 1 <-> exists a :e A, s c= {a}

items.name: CARD_LE_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, finite_cardinality {a,b} <= 2

items.name: CARD_LE_3
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c :e A, finite_cardinality {a,b,c} <= 3

items.name: CARD_LE_4
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c d :e A, finite_cardinality {a,b,c,d} <= 4

items.name: CARD_LE_ADD
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, atleastp s s' /\ atleastp t t' -> atleastp (s :+: t) (s' :+: t')

items.name: CARD_LE_ADDL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp t (s :+: t)

items.name: CARD_LE_ADDR
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s (s :+: t)

items.name: CARD_LE_ADD_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, (finite s \/ atleastp s u) /\ atleastp (s :+: t) (s :+: u) -> atleastp t u

items.name: CARD_LE_ADD_LCANCEL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, finite s \/ atleastp s u -> (atleastp (s :+: t) (s :+: u) <-> atleastp t u)

items.name: CARD_LE_ADD_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, (finite u \/ atleastp u t) /\ atleastp (s :+: u) (t :+: u) -> atleastp s t

items.name: CARD_LE_ADD_RCANCEL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, finite u \/ atleastp u t -> (atleastp (s :+: u) (t :+: u) <-> atleastp s t)

items.name: CARD_LE_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t /\ atleastp t s <-> equip s t

items.name: CARD_LE_CARD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> (atleastp s t <-> finite_cardinality s <= finite_cardinality t)

items.name: CARD_LE_CARD_IMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ atleastp s t -> finite_cardinality s <= finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_LE_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall t :e Power B :^: K, forall k c= K, (forall i :e K, i :e k -> atleastp (s i) (t i)) -> atleastp {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} {f :e B :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: CARD_LE_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_SUBINDEX
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k l c= K, k c= l /\ ~ {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e l, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e l -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty -> atleastp {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e l, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e l -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: CARD_LE_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> atleastp (components N {f x | x :e s}) (components M s)

items.name: CARD_LE_COMPONENTS_CLOSURE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> atleastp (components N (closure N s)) (components N (frontier N s))

items.name: CARD_LE_COMPONENTS_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> atleastp (components N s) (components N (frontier N s))

items.name: CARD_LE_COMPONENTS_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, atleastp (components N (s :\/: t)) (components N s :+: components N t)

items.name: CARD_LE_CONG
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, equip s s' /\ equip t t' -> (atleastp s t <-> atleastp s' t')

items.name: CARD_LE_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> atleastp {{x :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N {f x | x :e s} y x} | y :e R :^: idx N, y :e {f x | x :e s}} {{x0 :e R :^: idx M | connected_component M s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s}

items.name: CARD_LE_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall n :e omega, atleastp (idx_n n) (connected_components_of A top) <-> n = 0 \/ exists u c= Power A, equip u n /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> separated_in A top x y) /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e u -> ~ t = Empty) /\ Union u = topspace A top))

items.name: CARD_LE_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, atleastp (connected_components_of A top) (topspace A top)

items.name: CARD_LE_CONNNECTED_COMPONENTS_CONNECTED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, (forall c c= A, c :e u -> connected_in A top c) /\ Union u = topspace A top -> atleastp (connected_components_of A top) u

items.name: CARD_LE_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, countable t /\ atleastp s t -> countable s

items.name: CARD_LE_COUNTABLE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable s /\ infinite t -> atleastp s t

items.name: CARD_LE_COUNTABLE_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t -> atleastp {u :e Power A | u c= s /\ countable u} {v :e Power B | v c= t /\ countable v}

items.name: CARD_LE_DIM_SPANNING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx N, v c= span N b /\ (finite b /\ finite_cardinality b <= dim N v) -> independent N b

items.name: CARD_LE_DISJOINT_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, forall t c= B, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ (forall u c= A, u :e s -> atleastp t u) -> atleastp (s :*: t) (Union s)

items.name: CARD_LE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, atleastp s Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: CARD_LE_EQ_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t <-> exists u c= B, u c= t /\ equip s u

items.name: CARD_LE_EQ_SUBSET_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, equip t s) <-> atleastp s B

items.name: CARD_LE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t <-> exists u c= B, equip t (s :+: u)

items.name: CARD_LE_EXP
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, ~ s = Empty /\ (atleastp s s' /\ atleastp t t') -> atleastp {f :e A :^: C | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {f :e B :^: D | (forall x :e t', f x :e s') /\ forall x :e D, ~ x :e t' -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_LE_EXP_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, atleastp s s' -> atleastp {f :e A :^: C | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {f :e B :^: C | (forall x :e t, f x :e s') /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_LE_EXP_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall t' c= C, ~ s = Empty /\ atleastp t t' -> atleastp {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} {f :e A :^: C | (forall x :e t', f x :e s) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e t' -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARD_LE_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ atleastp s t -> finite s

items.name: CARD_LE_FINITE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ infinite t -> atleastp s t

items.name: CARD_LE_FINITE_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t -> atleastp {u :e Power A | u c= s /\ finite u} {v :e Power B | v c= t /\ finite v}

items.name: CARD_LE_GROUP_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f -> atleastp (group_carrier B H) (group_carrier A G)

items.name: CARD_LE_GROUP_MONOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_monomorphism A B (G,H) f -> atleastp (group_carrier A G) (group_carrier B H)

items.name: CARD_LE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, atleastp {f x | x :e s} s

items.name: CARD_LE_IMAGES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ g x = g y) -> f x = f y) -> atleastp {f x | x :e s} {g x | x :e s}

items.name: CARD_LE_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> atleastp t s

items.name: CARD_LE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite s /\ atleastp s t -> infinite t

items.name: CARD_LE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality s <= finite_cardinality t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: CARD_LE_LIST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t -> atleastp {l :e finseq A | forall x :e A, seq_mem x l -> x :e s} {l :e finseq B | forall x :e B, seq_mem x l -> x :e t}

items.name: CARD_LE_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t <-> atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t \/ equip s t

items.name: CARD_LE_MUL
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, atleastp s s' /\ atleastp t t' -> atleastp (s :*: t) (s' :*: t')

items.name: CARD_LE_PAIRWISE_SEPARATED_CONNECTED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u v c= Power A, finite u /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> separated_in A top x y) /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e u -> ~ c = Empty) /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e v -> connected_in A top c) /\ Union u = Union v))) -> atleastp u v

items.name: CARD_LE_PATH_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> atleastp {{x :e R :^: idx N | path_component N {f x | x :e s} y x} | y :e R :^: idx N, y :e {f x | x :e s}} {{x0 :e R :^: idx M | path_component M s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s}

items.name: CARD_LE_PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, atleastp (path_components_of A top) (topspace A top)

items.name: CARD_LE_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t -> atleastp {u :e Power A | u c= s} {v :e Power B | v c= t}

items.name: CARD_LE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (f x :e t /\ (f y :e t /\ f x = f y))) -> x = y) -> atleastp {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t} t

items.name: CARD_LE_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, atleastp (quasi_components_of A top) (topspace A top)

items.name: CARD_LE_QUOTIENT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> atleastp (group_carrier (Power A) (quotient_group A G n)) (group_carrier A G)

items.name: CARD_LE_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, atleastp s s

items.name: CARD_LE_RELATIONAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, forall y y' :e B, x :e s /\ (R0 x y /\ R0 x y') -> y = y') -> atleastp {y :e B | exists x :e A, x :e s /\ R0 x y} s

items.name: CARD_LE_RELATIONAL_FULL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ R0 x y) /\ (forall x :e A, forall y y' :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ (y' :e t /\ (R0 x y /\ R0 x y'))) -> y = y') -> atleastp t s

items.name: CARD_LE_RESTRICTED_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> atleastp {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ({x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s /\ finite {x :e A | ~ f x = k x})} {u :e Power (A :*: B) | u c= s :*: t /\ finite u}

items.name: CARD_LE_RESTRICTED_FUNSPACE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> infinite s /\ ~ t = Empty -> atleastp {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ({x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s /\ finite {x :e A | ~ f x = k x})} (s :*: t)

items.name: CARD_LE_RETRACT_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (retract_of N s t /\ bounded_hl N t) -> atleastp (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t))

items.name: CARD_LE_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e B, forall s c= A, atleastp s {c} <-> exists a :e A, s c= {a}

items.name: CARD_LE_SQUARE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, atleastp s (s :*: s)

items.name: CARD_LE_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall k c= K, infinite k /\ atleastp s k -> atleastp (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)) k

items.name: CARD_LE_SUBPOWERSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s0 c= A, P s0 -> Q {f x | x :e s0}) -> atleastp {u :e Power A | u c= s /\ P u} {v :e Power B | v c= t /\ Q v}

items.name: CARD_LE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t -> atleastp s t

items.name: CARD_LE_TOPSPACE_CLOSED_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top -> atleastp (topspace A top) {s :e Power A | closed_in A top s}

items.name: CARD_LE_TOPSPACE_OPEN_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top -> atleastp (topspace A top) {s :e Power A | s :e top}

items.name: CARD_LE_TOTAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t \/ atleastp t s

items.name: CARD_LE_TRANS
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, atleastp s t /\ atleastp t u -> atleastp s u

items.name: CARD_LE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall k c= B, forall u c= Power A, infinite k /\ (atleastp u k /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> atleastp s k)) -> atleastp (Union u) k

items.name: CARD_LE_UNIONS2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, forall k c= B, forall l c= C, atleastp u k /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> atleastp s l) -> atleastp (Union u) (k :*: l)

items.name: CARD_LE_UNIONS_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall n :e omega, (forall t u c= A, t :e f /\ u :e f -> t c= u \/ u c= t) /\ (forall t c= A, t :e f -> finite t /\ finite_cardinality t <= n) -> finite (Union f) /\ finite_cardinality (Union f) <= n

items.name: CARD_LE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, atleastp s A

items.name: CARD_LTE_TOTAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t \/ atleastp t s

items.name: CARD_LTE_TRANS
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t /\ atleastp t u -> atleastp s u /\ ~ equip s u

items.name: CARD_LT_ADD
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, atleastp s s' /\ ~ equip s s' /\ (atleastp t t' /\ ~ equip t t') -> atleastp (s :+: t) (s' :+: t') /\ ~ equip (s :+: t) (s' :+: t')

items.name: CARD_LT_CARD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> (atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t <-> finite_cardinality s < finite_cardinality t)

items.name: CARD_LT_CONG
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, equip s s' /\ equip t t' -> (atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t <-> atleastp s' t' /\ ~ equip s' t')

items.name: CARD_LT_COUNTABLE_UNCOUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, countable s /\ ~ countable t -> atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t

items.name: CARD_LT_FINITE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ infinite t -> atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t

items.name: CARD_LT_IMP_DISCONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, atleastp s R /\ ~ equip s R /\ x :e s -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x0 <-> x0 :e SetAdjoin Empty x

items.name: CARD_LT_IMP_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t -> atleastp s t

items.name: CARD_LT_IMP_SUC_LE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall a :e C, atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t -> atleastp (s :+: {a}) t

items.name: CARD_LT_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t <-> atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t

items.name: CARD_LT_NUM_REAL
items.statement: atleastp omega R /\ ~ equip omega R

items.name: CARD_LT_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, ~ (atleastp s s /\ ~ equip s s)

items.name: CARD_LT_TOTAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t \/ (atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t \/ atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s)

items.name: CARD_LT_TRANS
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t /\ (atleastp t u /\ ~ equip t u) -> atleastp s u /\ ~ equip s u

items.name: CARD_MUL2_ABSORB_LE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, infinite u /\ (atleastp s u /\ atleastp t u) -> atleastp (s :*: t) u

items.name: CARD_MUL2_ABSORB_LE_ALT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, (infinite s \/ infinite t) /\ (atleastp s u /\ atleastp t u) -> atleastp (s :*: t) u

items.name: CARD_MUL_ABSORB
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ atleastp s t) -> equip (s :*: t) t

items.name: CARD_MUL_ABSORB_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite t /\ atleastp s t -> atleastp (s :*: t) t

items.name: CARD_MUL_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip (s :*: (t :*: u)) (s :*: t :*: u)

items.name: CARD_MUL_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :*: t) = finite_cardinality s * finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_MUL_CONG
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall s' c= B, forall t c= C, forall t' c= D, equip s s' /\ equip t t' -> equip (s :*: t) (s' :*: t')

items.name: CARD_MUL_EXP
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip {f :e (A :*: B) :^: C | (forall x :e u, f x :e s :*: t) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e u -> f x = choose_in (A :*: B) (fun y:set => False)} ({f :e A :^: C | (forall x :e u, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e u -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} :*: {f :e B :^: C | (forall x :e u, f x :e t) /\ forall x :e C, ~ x :e u -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => False)})

items.name: CARD_MUL_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (s :*: t)

items.name: CARD_MUL_FINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ finite s /\ finite t)

items.name: CARD_MUL_LID
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall a :e A, forall t c= B, equip ({a} :*: t) t

items.name: CARD_MUL_LT_INFINITE
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, atleastp s u /\ ~ equip s u /\ (atleastp t u /\ ~ equip t u /\ infinite u) -> atleastp (s :*: t) u /\ ~ equip (s :*: t) u

items.name: CARD_MUL_LT_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A C B:set, A <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, atleastp s t /\ (atleastp t u /\ ~ equip t u /\ infinite u) -> atleastp (s :*: t) u /\ ~ equip (s :*: t) u

items.name: CARD_MUL_RID
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall b :e B, equip (s :*: {b}) s

items.name: CARD_MUL_SYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip (s :*: t) (t :*: s)

items.name: CARD_NOT_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, ~ atleastp s t <-> atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s

items.name: CARD_NOT_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, ~ (atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t) <-> atleastp t s

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, finite_cardinality {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = minus_nat (n + 1) m

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite_cardinality (idx_n n) = n

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite_cardinality {m :e omega | m <= n} = n + 1

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG_LEMMA
items.statement: forall m d :e omega, finite_cardinality {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= m + d} = d + 1

items.name: CARD_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite_cardinality {m :e omega | m < n} = n

items.name: CARD_PERMUTATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s} = factorial (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: CARD_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite_cardinality {t :e Power A | t c= s} = 2 ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: CARD_POWERSET_CONG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t -> equip {u :e Power A | u c= s} {v :e Power B | v c= t}

items.name: CARD_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = finite_cardinality s * finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c= A, a c= b /\ a <> b /\ finite b -> finite_cardinality a < finite_cardinality b

items.name: CARD_PSUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c= A, finite b /\ a c= b -> (a c= b /\ a <> b <-> finite_cardinality a < finite_cardinality b)

items.name: CARD_PSUBSET_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c= A, a c= b /\ ~ finite_cardinality a = finite_cardinality b -> a c= b /\ a <> b

items.name: CARD_QUOTIENT_GROUP_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ normal_subgroup_of A n G -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier (Power A) (quotient_group A G n))) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: CARD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall u c= C, equip ((s :+: t) :*: u) (s :*: u :+: t :*: u)

items.name: CARD_RIGHT_COSETS_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ subgroup_of A h G -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality {right_coset_hl A G h x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: CARD_ROWS_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, finite_cardinality (rows N M A) <= dimindex N

items.name: CARD_SET_OF_LIST_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, finite_cardinality (seq_set l) <= seq_len l

items.name: CARD_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, finite_cardinality {a} = 1

items.name: CARD_SING_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall a :e A, forall s c= B, atleastp {a} s <-> ~ s = Empty

items.name: CARD_SQUARE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= A, infinite k -> equip (k :*: k) k

items.name: CARD_SQUARE_NUM
items.statement: equip (omega :*: omega) omega

items.name: CARD_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> finite_cardinality {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} = dimindex N

items.name: CARD_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c= A, a c= b /\ finite b -> finite_cardinality a <= finite_cardinality b

items.name: CARD_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c= A, finite b /\ (a c= b /\ finite_cardinality a = finite_cardinality b) -> a = b

items.name: CARD_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, finite t /\ s c= {f x | x :e t} -> finite_cardinality s <= finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_SUBSET_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c= A, finite b /\ (a c= b /\ finite_cardinality b <= finite_cardinality a) -> a = b

items.name: CARD_SUSLIN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, equip C R -> equip (suslin A C) R

items.name: CARD_SUSLIN_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, atleastp C R -> atleastp (suslin A C) R

items.name: CARD_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) = finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t) /\ (forall t u c= A, t :e s /\ (u :e s /\ ~ t = u) -> t :/\: u = Empty)) -> finite_cardinality (Union s) = finsum s (fun x:set => finite_cardinality x)

items.name: CARD_UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall f :e Power A :^: K, forall s c= K, finite s /\ ((forall t :e K, t :e s -> finite (f t)) /\ (forall t u :e K, t :e s /\ (u :e s /\ ~ t = u) -> f t :/\: f u = Empty)) -> finite_cardinality (Union {f x | x :e s}) = finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality (f i))

items.name: CARD_UNIONS_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> finite (t x) /\ finite_cardinality (t x) <= n) -> finite_cardinality (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) <= m * n

items.name: CARD_UNION_ABSORB_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite t /\ atleastp s t -> equip (s :\/: t) t

items.name: CARD_UNION_ABSORB_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ atleastp t s -> equip (s :\/: t) s

items.name: CARD_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= A, finite u /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ s :\/: t = u) -> finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t = finite_cardinality u

items.name: CARD_UNION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) = minus_nat (finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t) (finite_cardinality (s :/\: t))

items.name: CARD_UNION_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) <= finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t

items.name: CARD_UNION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u v c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (finite u /\ (finite v /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ (u :/\: v = Empty /\ s :\/: t = u :\/: v))))) -> finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t = finite_cardinality u + finite_cardinality v

items.name: CARD_UNION_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) < finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t) -> ~ s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: CARD_UNION_OVERLAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> (finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) = finite_cardinality s + finite_cardinality t <-> s :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: CARRIER_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, normal_subgroup_of A (group_carrier A G) G

items.name: CARRIER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_BY_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x}) = {group_zpow A G x n | n :e int, n :e int}

items.name: CARRIER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G h) = h

items.name: CARRIER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ group_setmul A G g h = group_setmul A G h g) -> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G (g :\/: h)) = group_setmul A G g h

items.name: CARRIER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_UNION_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G (g :\/: h)) = group_setmul A G g h

items.name: CARRIER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_UNION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ normal_subgroup_of A h G -> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G (g :\/: h)) = group_setmul A G g h

items.name: CARRIER_SUBGROUP_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, subgroup_of A (group_carrier A G) G

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | forall i :e K, f i :e if i :e k then s i else {choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_AS_RESTRICTIONS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {(fun x :e K => if x :e k then f x else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) | f :e A :^: K, forall i :e K, i :e k -> f i :e s i}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f :e A :^: B | (forall i :e t, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e s}) /\ forall i :e B, ~ i :e t -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e Empty, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e Empty -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {fun i :e K => choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty /\ {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i = t i

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty <-> exists i :e K, i :e k /\ s i = Empty

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EQ_MEMBERS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall x y :e A :^: K, x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ (y :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> x i = y i)) -> x = y

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EQ_MEMBERS_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall x y :e A :^: K, x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ y :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} -> (x = y <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> x i = y i)

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall h :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, normal_subgroup_of (A :^: K) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e h i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} (product_group A K k G) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> normal_subgroup_of A (h i) (G i)

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_SINGS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall x :e A :^: K, (forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e k -> x x0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) -> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | x1 :e {x i}}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {x}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_SINGS_GEN
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e K, x x :e A) -> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | x1 :e {x i}}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {fun x0 :e K => if x0 :e k then x x0 else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_SUBGROUP_OF_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall h :e Power A :^: K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> (subgroup_of (A :^: K) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e h i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} (product_group A K k G) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> subgroup_of A (h i) (G i))

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_SUBGROUP_OF_SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall h :e Power A :^: K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> (subgroup_of (A :^: K) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e h i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} (sum_group A K k G) <-> (forall i :e K, i :e k -> subgroup_of A (h i) (G i)) /\ forall z :e A :^: K, z :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e h i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} -> finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ z i = group_id A (G i)})

items.name: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e K, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e A}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e K -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = A :^: K

items.name: CART_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall x y :e A :^: idx B, x = y <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex B -> x i = y i

items.name: CART_EQ_FULL
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e A :^: idx N, x = y <-> forall i :e omega, x i = y i
