items.name: CAUCHY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx N) -> (cauchy N s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, N0 <= n -> distance N (s n,s N0) < e0)

items.name: CAUCHY_ABSOLUTELY_SUMMABLE_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> cauchy N x -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ summable 1 (from 0) (fun n:set => lift (distance N (x (r (n + 1)),x (r n)))))

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_EQ_EXTENDS_TO_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> cauchy M x /\ (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => f (x x0))) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (closure M s) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_EXTENDS_TO_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> cauchy M x /\ (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => f (x x0))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> cauchy M x /\ (forall n :e omega, x n :e closure M s) -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => g (x x0))) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_EXTENDS_TO_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> cauchy M x /\ (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => f (x x0))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (closure M s) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_IMP_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> cauchy M x /\ (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => f (x x0))) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_IMP_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f -> continuous_map A B (mtopology A m1,mtopology B m2) f

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m3 :e metric C, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f /\ cauchy_continuous_map B C (m2,m3) g -> cauchy_continuous_map A C (m1,m3) (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall c :e B, cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) (fun x:set => c) <-> mspace A m1 = Empty \/ c :e mspace B m2

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e B, x :e mspace B m1 -> f x = g x) /\ cauchy_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f -> cauchy_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) g

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENDS_TO_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, mcomplete B m2 /\ cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 s,m2) f -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 (closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s),m2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENDS_TO_CONTINUOUS_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, mcomplete B m2 /\ cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 s,m2) f -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A (mtopology A m1) (closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s),mtopology B m2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENDS_TO_CONTINUOUS_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, mcomplete B m2 /\ (cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 s,m2) f /\ t c= closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A (mtopology A m1) t,mtopology B m2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENDS_TO_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, mcomplete B m2 /\ (cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 s,m2) f /\ t c= closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 t,m2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 s,m2) f

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_SUBMETRIC_MONO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall s t c= B, cauchy_continuous_map B A (submetric B m1 t,m2) f /\ s c= t -> cauchy_continuous_map B A (submetric B m1 s,m2) f

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> cauchy_continuous_map A (B :*: C) (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m,m1) (fun x:set => f x 0)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, cauchy_continuous_map A A (m1,m1) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f -> {f x | x :e mspace A m1} c= mspace B m2

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,submetric B m2 s) f <-> {f x | x :e mspace A m1} c= s /\ cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_MDIST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m' :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m,m') f /\ cauchy_continuous_map A B (m,m') g -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => mdist B m' (f x,g x))

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ (t c= closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A (mtopology A m1) t,mtopology B m2) f /\ cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 s,m2) f)) -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 t,m2) f

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PAIRED
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> (cauchy_continuous_map A (B :*: C) (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) (fun x:set => (f x,g x)) <-> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m,m1) f /\ cauchy_continuous_map A C (m,m2) g)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> (cauchy_continuous_map A (B :*: C) (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) f <-> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m,m1) (fun x:set => f x 0) /\ cauchy_continuous_map A C (m,m2) (fun x:set => f x 1))

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PASTED
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (cauchy_continuous_map A (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (m,euclidean_metric (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (fun x:set => pastecart M N (f x) (g x)) <-> cauchy_continuous_map A (R :^: idx M) (m,euclidean_metric M) f /\ cauchy_continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (m,euclidean_metric N) g)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PASTEWISE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> (cauchy_continuous_map A (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (m,euclidean_metric (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) f <-> cauchy_continuous_map A (R :^: idx M) (m,euclidean_metric M) (fun x:set => fstcart M (f x)) /\ cauchy_continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (m,euclidean_metric N) (fun x:set => sndcart M N (f x)))

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x))

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x + g x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall m :e metric A, cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => c)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ (cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) g /\ ~ 0 :e closure_of R euclideanreal {g x | x :e mspace A m}) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x :/: g x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ ~ 0 :e closure_of R euclideanreal {f x | x :e mspace A m} -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => recip_SNo (f x))

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => c * f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => if f x <= g x then g x else f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => if f x <= g x then f x else g x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x * g x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MULTIPLICATION
items.statement: cauchy_continuous_map (R :*: R) R (prod_metric R R real_euclidean_metric real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun p:set => p 0 * p 1)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => - f x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x ^ n)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x * c)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x + - g x)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SND
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> cauchy_continuous_map A (B :*: C) (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A C (m,m2) (fun x:set => f x 1)

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SQRT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => if 0 <= f x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (f x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- f x))

items.name: CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SUM
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall m :e metric K, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e R) -> forall k c= A, finite k /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> cauchy_continuous_map K R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x i)) -> cauchy_continuous_map K R (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => finsum k (f x))

items.name: CAUCHY_CONVERGENT_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) -> cauchy N x /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) l sequentially) -> tendsto N omega x l sequentially

items.name: CAUCHY_EQ_SUMMABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> (cauchy N x <-> summable N (from 0) (fun n:set => vector_sub N (x (n + 1)) (x n)))

items.name: CAUCHY_EQ_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> totally_bounded_in A m1 (mspace A m1) -> (cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f <-> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f)

items.name: CAUCHY_GROUP_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))) -> exists x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ group_element_order_hl A G x = p

items.name: CAUCHY_IMP_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx N) -> cauchy N s -> bounded_hl N {y :e R :^: idx N | exists n :e omega, y = s n}

items.name: CAUCHY_IMP_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> totally_bounded_in A m1 (mspace A m1) /\ cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_CAPPED_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e R, forall m :e metric A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (cauchy_in A (capped_metric A d m) x <-> cauchy_in A m x)

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall a :e A, cauchy_in A m (fun n:set => a) <-> a :e mspace A m

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_CONVERGENT_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) -> forall a :e A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> cauchy_in A m x /\ ((forall m0 n :e omega, m0 < n -> r m0 < r n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m) (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) a sequentially) -> limit omega A (mtopology A m) x a sequentially

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx N) -> (cauchy_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s <-> cauchy N s)

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_IMP_MBOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> cauchy_in A m x -> mbounded A m {x i | i :e omega, i :e omega}

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_INTERLEAVING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> forall a :e A, cauchy_in A m (fun n:set => if even_nat n then x (div_nat n 2) else a) <-> (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A m) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m) x a sequentially

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_INTERLEAVING_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e A) -> (cauchy_in A m (fun n:set => if even_nat n then x (div_nat n 2) else y (div_nat n 2)) <-> cauchy_in A m x /\ (cauchy_in A m y /\ limit omega R euclideanreal (fun n:set => mdist A m (x n,y n)) 0 sequentially))

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_OFFSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall a :e omega, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, n < a -> x n :e mspace A m) /\ cauchy_in A m (fun n:set => x (a + n)) -> cauchy_in A m x

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A :*: B) -> (cauchy_in (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) x <-> cauchy_in A m1 (fun x0:set => x x0 0) /\ cauchy_in B m2 (fun x0:set => x x0 1))

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (cauchy_in A (submetric A m s) x <-> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ cauchy_in A m x)

items.name: CAUCHY_IN_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) -> (forall m0 n :e omega, m0 < n -> r m0 < r n) /\ cauchy_in A m x -> cauchy_in A m (fun x0:set => x (r x0))

items.name: CAUCHY_ISOMETRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall e0 :e R, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx B) -> 0 < e0 /\ (subspace B s /\ (linear B A f /\ ((forall x0 :e R :^: idx B, x0 :e s -> e0 * vector_norm B x0 <= vector_norm A (f x0)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ cauchy A (fun x0:set => f (x x0)))))) -> cauchy B x

items.name: CAUCHY_OFFSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> (cauchy N (fun i:set => x (i + k)) <-> cauchy N x)

items.name: CAUCHY_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) -> (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ cauchy N x -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => x (r x0))

items.name: CBALL_DIFF_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, cball A (a,r) :\: ball A (a,r) = sphere A (a,r)

items.name: CBALL_DIFF_SPHERE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, cball A (a,r) :\: sphere A (a,r) = ball A (a,r)

items.name: CBALL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, e0 < 0 -> cball A (x,e0) = Empty

items.name: CBALL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, cball A (x,e0) = Empty <-> e0 < 0

items.name: CBALL_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, cball N (x,e0) = {x} <-> e0 = 0

items.name: CBALL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall e0 :e R, cball 1 (x,e0) = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_sub 1 x (lift e0),vector_add 1 x (lift e0)) seq_nil)

items.name: CBALL_INTERVAL_0
items.statement: forall e0 :e R, cball 1 (vec 1 0,e0) = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_neg 1 (lift e0),lift e0) seq_nil)

items.name: CBALL_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall r :e R, linear M N f /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x0 :e R :^: idx M, f x0 = y) /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm M x0)) -> cball N (f x,r) = {f x0 | x0 :e cball M (x,r)}

items.name: CBALL_MAX_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r s :e R, cball A (a,if r <= s then s else r) = cball A (a,r) :\/: cball A (a,s)

items.name: CBALL_MIN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall d e0 :e R, cball A (x,if d <= e0 then d else e0) = cball A (x,d) :/\: cball A (x,e0)

items.name: CBALL_SCALING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, 0 < c -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, cball A (vector_mul A c x,c * r) = {vector_mul A c x0 | x0 :e cball A (x,r)}

items.name: CBALL_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, e0 = 0 -> cball A (x,e0) = {x}

items.name: CBALL_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, cball A (vector_add A a x,r) = {vector_add A a y | y :e cball A (x,r)}

items.name: CBALL_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, cball A (x,0) = {x}

items.name: CELL_COMPLEX_DISJOINT_RELATIVE_INTERIORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c d c= R :^: idx N, face_of N (c :/\: d) c /\ (face_of N (c :/\: d) d /\ ~ c = d) -> relative_interior N c :/\: relative_interior N d = Empty

items.name: CELL_COMPLEX_SUBDIVISION_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall d :e int, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (finite m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> polytope N c) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> aff_dim N c <= d) /\ (forall c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, c1 :e m /\ c2 :e m -> face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c1 /\ face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c2)))) -> exists m' c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m' -> diameter N c < e0) /\ (Union m' = Union m /\ (finite m' /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m' -> exists d0 c= R :^: idx N, d0 :e m /\ c c= d0) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, c :e m /\ x :e c -> exists d0 c= R :^: idx N, d0 :e m' /\ (x :e d0 /\ d0 c= c)) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m' -> polytope N c) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m' -> aff_dim N c <= d) /\ forall c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, c1 :e m' /\ c2 :e m' -> face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c1 /\ face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c2))))))

items.name: CENTRE_IN_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, x :e ball A (x,e0) <-> 0 < e0

items.name: CENTRE_IN_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, x :e cball A (x,e0) <-> 0 <= e0

items.name: CENTRE_IN_MBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, 0 < r /\ x :e mspace A m -> x :e mball A m (x,r)

items.name: CENTRE_IN_MBALL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, x :e mball A m (x,r) <-> x :e mspace A m /\ 0 < r

items.name: CENTRE_IN_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, 0 <= r /\ x :e mspace A m -> x :e mcball A m (x,r)

items.name: CENTRE_IN_MCBALL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, x :e mcball A m (x,r) <-> x :e mspace A m /\ 0 <= r

items.name: CFUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, (forall top0 :e topology A, forall m0 :e metric B, mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top0 m0) = {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top0 -> f x :e mspace B m0) /\ (f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e topspace A top0 -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ (mbounded B m0 {f x | x :e topspace A top0} /\ continuous_map A B (top0,mtopology B m0) (fun x:set => f x)))}) /\ forall f g :e B :^: A, mdist (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) (f,g) = if topspace A top = Empty then 0 else sup {mdist B m (f x,g x) | x :e A, x :e topspace A top}

items.name: CFUNSPACE_IMP_BOUNDED2
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall f g :e B :^: A, f :e mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) /\ g :e mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) -> exists b :e R, forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> mdist B m (f x,g x) <= b

items.name: CFUNSPACE_MDIST_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall f g :e B :^: A, forall a :e R, ~ topspace A top = Empty /\ (f :e mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) /\ g :e mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m)) -> (mdist (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) (f,g) <= a <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> mdist B m (f x,g x) <= a)

items.name: CFUNSPACE_MDIST_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall f g :e B :^: A, forall a :e R, forall x :e A, compact_in A top (topspace A top) /\ (f :e mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) /\ (g :e mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) /\ (mdist (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) (f,g) < a /\ x :e topspace A top))) -> mdist B m (f x,g x) < a

items.name: CFUNSPACE_SUBSET_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) c= mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B (topspace A top) m)

items.name: CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, chain_on A l s <-> s c= fld_on A l /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> l x y \/ l y x

items.name: CHAIN_BOUNDARY_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, chain_boundary A p (frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega))) = frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega))

items.name: CHAIN_BOUNDARY_ADD

items.name: CHAIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, chain_on A l s /\ t c= s -> chain_on A l t

items.name: CHARACTERISTIC_POLYNOMIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, exists a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R) /\ (a (dimindex N) = 1 /\ forall x :e R, det N (matrix_sub N N (matrix_cmul N N x (mat N N 1)) A) = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} (fun i:set => a i * x ^ i))

items.name: CHINESE_REMAINDER
items.statement: forall a b u v :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 /\ (~ a = 0 /\ ~ b = 0) -> exists x q1 q2 :e omega, x = u + q1 * a /\ x = v + q2 * b

items.name: CHOICE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s) = choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)

items.name: CHOICE_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, ~ s = Empty -> choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s) :e s

items.name: CHOICE_PAIRED_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y) /\ (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y -> Q (x,y)) -> Q (choose_in (A :*: B) (fun x:set => P (x 0) (x 1)))

items.name: CHOICE_UNPAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, choose_in (A :*: B) (fun x:set => P (x 0) (x 1)) = choose_in (A :*: B) (fun p:set => P (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: CHOOSE_AFFINE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall d :e int, affine N s /\ (- 1 <= d /\ d <= aff_dim N s) -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, affine N t /\ (t c= s /\ aff_dim N t = d)

items.name: CHOOSE_LARGE_COMPACT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ~ measurable N s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (compact N t /\ B <= measure N t)

items.name: CHOOSE_LARGE_COMPACT_SUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ B < measure N s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, compact N t /\ (t c= s /\ B < measure N t)

items.name: CHOOSE_LARGE_MEASURABLE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ~ measurable N s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (measurable N t /\ B <= measure N t)

items.name: CHOOSE_POLYTOPE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, - 1 <= n /\ n <= dimindex N -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s /\ aff_dim N s = n

items.name: CHOOSE_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, - 1 <= n /\ n <= dimindex N -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, simplex N n s

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> forall n :e omega, n <= finite_cardinality s -> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ equip t n

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSET_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s u c= A, s c= u /\ (finite s /\ (finite_cardinality s <= n /\ (finite u -> n <= finite_cardinality u))) -> exists t c= A, s c= t /\ (t c= u /\ equip t n)

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> n <= finite_cardinality s <-> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ equip t n

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSET_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, (finite s -> n <= finite_cardinality s) -> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ equip t n

items.name: CHOOSE_SUBSPACE_OF_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, n <= dim N s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N t /\ (t c= span N s /\ dim N t = n)

items.name: CHOOSE_SURROUNDING_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, 0 <= n /\ n <= dimindex N -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, simplex N n s /\ a :e relative_interior N s

items.name: CHOOSE_SURROUNDING_SIMPLEX_FULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, exists s c= R :^: idx N, simplex N (dimindex N) s /\ a :e interior N s

items.name: CLOPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ open N s <-> s = Empty \/ s = R :^: idx N

items.name: CLOPEN_IN_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s /\ s :e top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ (closed_in A top (topspace A top :\: s) /\ topspace A top :\: s :e top)

items.name: CLOPEN_IN_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (connected N s /\ ~ s = Empty)) -> s :e components N u

items.name: CLOPEN_IN_EQ_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s /\ s :e top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ frontier_of A top s = Empty

items.name: CLOPEN_UNIONS_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u -> exists k c= Power (R :^: idx N), k c= components N u /\ s = Union k

items.name: CLOSED_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s -> closed N s

items.name: CLOSED_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s)

items.name: CLOSED_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, closed N s -> closed N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSED_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, closed N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ closed N s

items.name: CLOSED_APPROACHABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s -> ((forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists y :e R :^: idx A, y :e s /\ distance A (y,x) < e0) <-> x :e s)

items.name: CLOSED_ARC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> arc A g -> closed A (path_image A g)

items.name: CLOSED_AS_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, s = frontier N t

items.name: CLOSED_AS_FRONTIER_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ s = frontier N t

items.name: CLOSED_BOUNDEDPREIM_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, closed M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ vector_norm N (f x) <= e0})) -> closed N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSED_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, closed N (cball N (x,e0))

items.name: CLOSED_CLOSED_PREIMAGES_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, compact N t /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e c})) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CLOSED_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A (closure A s)

items.name: CLOSED_COMPACT_DIFFERENCES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ compact N t -> closed N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_sub N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: CLOSED_COMPACT_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k c c= A, compact_in A top k /\ (c c= k /\ closed_in A top c) -> compact_in A top c

items.name: CLOSED_COMPACT_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), compact M s /\ closed (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) t -> closed N {y :e R :^: idx N | exists x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ pastecart M N x y :e t}

items.name: CLOSED_COMPACT_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ compact N t -> closed N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: CLOSED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ c :e components A s -> closed A c

items.name: CLOSED_CONDENSATION_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | condensation_point_of N x s}

items.name: CLOSED_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s \/ compact N s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e s -> closed N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)

items.name: CLOSED_CONIC_HULL_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s \/ (polytope N s \/ compact N s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e s) -> closed N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)

items.name: CLOSED_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, closed N s -> closed N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0}

items.name: CLOSED_CONNECTED_PREIMAGES_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, compact N t /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ connected M c -> connected N {f x | x :e c}))) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CLOSED_CONTAINS_SEQUENTIAL_LIMIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ tendsto N omega x l sequentially) -> l :e s

items.name: CLOSED_CONVEX_CONE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> closed N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} s)

items.name: CLOSED_CONVEX_CONE_HULL_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s \/ (polytope N s \/ (vec N 0 :e relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) \/ compact N s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)) -> closed N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} s)

items.name: CLOSED_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ open A t -> closed A (s :\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_DIFF_OPEN_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: open_interval 1 (a,b) = if closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty then Empty else {a,b}

items.name: CLOSED_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> closed A Empty

items.name: CLOSED_EQ_CONTINUOUS_INVERSE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e topspace B top' /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> g y :e topspace A top /\ f (g y) = y) -> (closed_map A B (top,top') f <-> continuous_map B A (top',top) g)

items.name: CLOSED_EQ_CONTINUOUS_LEVELSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed M s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | f x = a} = s)

items.name: CLOSED_EXTREME_POINTS_2D
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (convex N s /\ aff_dim N s <= 2) -> closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s}

items.name: CLOSED_FIP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> closed N t) /\ ((exists t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f /\ bounded_hl N t) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f' /\ f' c= f -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = Empty)) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: CLOSED_FORALL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall Q:set -> set -> prop, (forall a :e A, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | Q a x}) -> closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall a :e A, Q a x}

items.name: CLOSED_FORALL_IN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:set -> set -> prop, (forall a :e A, P a -> closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | Q a x}) -> closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall a :e A, P a -> Q a x}

items.name: CLOSED_GROUP_ORBIT
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, forall g :e A, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ g :e group_carrier A G -> {a g x0 | x0 :e {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0}} c= {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0}

items.name: CLOSED_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | a <= x k}

items.name: CLOSED_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= a}

items.name: CLOSED_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x}

items.name: CLOSED_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b}

items.name: CLOSED_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, closed A {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x = b}

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> analytic N s

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_BAIRE1_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 1 (R :^: idx N)

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> borel N s

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_BOREL_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> borel_in A top s

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_FIP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), closed N s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> closed N t) /\ ((exists t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f /\ bounded_hl N t) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f' /\ f' c= f -> ~ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = Empty))) -> ~ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_FIP_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), closed N s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> compact N t) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f' /\ f' c= f -> ~ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = Empty)) -> ~ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_FSIGMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> fsigma N s

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_FSIGMA_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> s :e fsigma_in A top

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_GDELTA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> gdelta N s

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_GDELTA_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, metrizable_space A top /\ closed_in A top s -> s :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: CLOSED_IMP_LOCALLY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s

items.name: CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s <-> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: CLOSED_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_SUBSET_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, closed M s /\ (s c= t /\ (subspace M t /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t /\ f x = vec N 0 -> x = vec M 0)))) -> closed N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSED_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, subspace B s /\ (linear B A f /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s /\ f x = vec A 0 -> x = vec B 0) /\ closed B s)) -> closed A {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSED_INJECTIVE_IMP_PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CLOSED_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, closed M s -> closed N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSED_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (closed N {f x | x :e s} <-> closed M s)

items.name: CLOSED_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s -> closed A (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: CLOSED_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ closed A t -> closed A (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed N s) -> closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: CLOSED_INTERS_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s <-> forall e0 :e R, compact N (cball N (vec N 0,e0) :/\: s)

items.name: CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: CLOSED_INTERVAL_AS_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, exists s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s

items.name: CLOSED_INTERVAL_DROPOUT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ a k <= b k)) -> closed_interval M (seq_cons (dropout N M k a,dropout N M k b) seq_nil) = {dropout N M k x | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: CLOSED_INTERVAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed N (open_interval N (a,b)) <-> open_interval N (a,b) = Empty

items.name: CLOSED_INTERVAL_IMAGE_UNIT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty -> closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {vector_add N a x | x :e {(fun i :e idx N => (b i + - a i) * x i) | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (vec N 0,vec N 1) seq_nil)}}

items.name: CLOSED_INTERVAL_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b :e R :^: idx N, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i <= b i}

items.name: CLOSED_INTERVAL_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= x i}

items.name: CLOSED_INTER_CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s -> closed_in A (subtopology A top t) (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_INTER_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ compact A t -> compact A (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_INTER_COMPACT_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ compact_in A top t -> compact_in A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A :+: 1, closed_in (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) c <-> (exists k c= A, compact_in A top k /\ (closed_in A top k /\ c = {Inj0 x | x :e k})) \/ exists u c= A, u :e top /\ c = topspace (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) :\: {Inj0 x | x :e u}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION_IMAGE_INL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k c= A, closed_in (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) {Inj0 x | x :e k} <-> compact_in A top k /\ closed_in A top k

items.name: CLOSED_IN_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) s /\ analytic N t -> analytic N s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) s /\ borel N t -> borel N s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CANTOR_SET
items.statement: closed_in R euclideanreal cantor_set

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CANTOR_SET_INTERVAL
items.statement: closed_in R (subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil))) cantor_set

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, closed_in (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_in A (tops i) (s i)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, closed N t /\ s = u :/\: t

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CLOSED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed A s -> (closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) t <-> closed A t /\ t c= s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CLOSED_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s -> closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) u) (u :/\: s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CLOSED_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s -> (closed_in A (subtopology A top s) t <-> closed_in A top t /\ t c= s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CLOSED_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) t) s /\ closed A t -> closed A s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top (closure_of A top s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t -> compact N t

items.name: CLOSED_IN_COMPACT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, compact A s -> (closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) t <-> compact A t /\ t c= s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_COMPACT_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), compact M s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {y :e R :^: idx N | exists x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ pastecart M N x y :e u}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_COMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, compact_space A top /\ closed_in A top s -> compact_in A top s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_COMPACT_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k s c= A, compact_in A top k /\ closed_in A (subtopology A top k) s -> compact_in A top s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) c

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N t /\ (~ vec N 0 :e t /\ t c= s) -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top -> closed_in A top c

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, closed_in A top {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e connected_components_of A (subtopology A top s) /\ closure_of A top c c= s -> closed_in A top c

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CONTAINS_DERIVED_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s <-> derived_set_of A top s c= s /\ s c= topspace A top

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CONTINUOUS_MAPS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, hausdorff_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ continuous_map A B (top,top') g) -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = g x}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall c c= B, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ closed_in B top' c -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e c}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PREIMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall u c= A, forall v c= B, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_in A top u /\ closed_in B top' v) -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e u /\ f x :e v}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, closed_in (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ closed_in A top1 s /\ closed_in B top2 t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_DERIVED_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top t) s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ (s c= t /\ forall x :e A, x :e derived_set_of A top s /\ x :e t -> x :e s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_DERIVED_SET_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top -> closed_in A top (derived_set_of A top s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_DERIVED_SET_OF_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, t1_space A top -> closed_in A top (derived_set_of A top s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ t :e top -> closed_in A top (s :\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_DIFF_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, open A t -> closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) (s :\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_DISCRETE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, discrete_space A top -> (closed_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, closed_in A (discrete_topology A u) s <-> s c= u

items.name: CLOSED_IN_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall u :e Power A :^: K, closed_in (K :*: A) (sum_topology A K k top) {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e u (p 0)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_in A (top i) (u i)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, closed_in A top Empty

items.name: CLOSED_IN_EQ_CONTINUOUS_LEVELSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f u /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e u /\ f x = a} = s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_EQ_MCOMPLETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mcomplete A m -> (closed_in A (mtopology A m) s <-> s c= mspace A m /\ mcomplete A (submetric A m s))

items.name: CLOSED_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) x <-> closed N x

items.name: CLOSED_IN_EUCLIDEAN_METRIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (mtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N)) x <-> closed N x

items.name: CLOSED_IN_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, closed_in (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) (topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n))

items.name: CLOSED_IN_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top (frontier_of A top s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_FSIGMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) s /\ fsigma N t -> fsigma N s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_GDELTA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) s /\ gdelta N t -> gdelta N s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_HAUSDORFF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ finite s) -> closed_in A top s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_HAUSDORFF_FINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ finite s -> (closed_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_HAUSDORFF_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, hausdorff_space A top /\ x :e topspace A top -> closed_in A top {x}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_HAUSDORFF_SING_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, hausdorff_space A top -> (closed_in A top {x} <-> x :e topspace A top)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top s) t -> t c= s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e t}) {f x | x :e s} <-> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) t) s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ a :e u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ closed_in A top t -> closed_in A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k c= Power A, ~ k = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e k -> closed_in A top s) -> closed_in A top {x :e A | forall Y :e k, x :e Y}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_INTER_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ closed N t -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_INTER_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t <-> s :/\: closure N t = t

items.name: CLOSED_IN_INTER_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top s) t <-> s :/\: closure_of A top t = t

items.name: CLOSED_IN_KIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, closed_in A (kification A top) u <-> u c= topspace A top /\ forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> closed_in A (subtopology A top k) (k :/\: u)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_KIFICATION_FINER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> closed_in A (kification A top) s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_LIMPT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) s <-> s c= t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x s /\ x :e t -> x :e s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_LOCALLY_FINITE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e f -> closed_in A top s) /\ locally_finite_in A top f -> closed_in A top (Union f)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, closed_in A (mtopology A m) (mcball A m (x,r))

items.name: CLOSED_IN_MCOMPLETE_IMP_MCOMPLETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, closed_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ mcomplete A m -> mcomplete A (submetric A m s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall c c= A, closed_in A (mtopology A m) c <-> c c= mspace A m /\ forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m :\: c -> exists r :e R, 0 < r /\ c :/\: mball A m (x,r) = Empty

items.name: CLOSED_IN_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, closed_in A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, locally_path_connected_space A top /\ c :e path_components_of A top -> closed_in A top c

items.name: CLOSED_IN_PATH_COMPONENT_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x0} s -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_PATH_COMPONENT_OF_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, locally_path_connected_space A top -> closed_in A top {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) s' /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) t' -> closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})) (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'})

items.name: CLOSED_IN_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})) (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) <-> s' = Empty \/ (t' = Empty \/ closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) s' /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) t')

items.name: CLOSED_IN_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> closed_in A top c

items.name: CLOSED_IN_QUASI_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, closed_in A top {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s x c= A, x :e relative_to A {x0 :e Power A | closed_in A top x0} s <-> closed_in A (subtopology A top s) x

items.name: CLOSED_IN_RETRACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N s t -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, 0 < setdist N (s,t) -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) t

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SEQUENTIAL_LIMITS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s <-> s c= u /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ (l :e u /\ tendsto N omega x l sequentially) -> l :e s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) {x} <-> x :e u

items.name: CLOSED_IN_STANDARD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, closed_in (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) (standard_simplex p)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> s c= topspace A top

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ s c= t -> closed_in A (subtopology A top t) s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top u) s /\ (s c= t /\ t c= u) -> closed_in A (subtopology A top t) s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top u) s <-> exists t c= A, closed_in A top t /\ s = t :/\: u

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top u) s <-> s :e {u :/\: t | t :e Power A, closed_in A top t}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_BOREL_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall t s c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top t) s /\ borel_in A top t -> borel_in A top s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_DIFF_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ t :e top -> closed_in A (subtopology A top s) (s :\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top Empty) s <-> s = Empty

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_INTER_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top t -> closed_in A (subtopology A top s) (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_INTER_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top u) s /\ closed_in A top t -> closed_in A (subtopology A top u) (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s u v c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top u) (u :/\: s) /\ v c= u -> closed_in A (subtopology A top v) (v :/\: s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top u) u <-> u c= topspace A top

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top t) s /\ closed_in A (subtopology A top u) s -> closed_in A (subtopology A top (t :\/: u)) s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUM_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall u c= K :*: A, closed_in (K :*: A) (sum_topology A K k top) u <-> u c= {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e {x0 :e A | {x0 :e A | x0 :e topspace A (top (p 0))} x0}} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_in A (top i) {x :e A | (i,x) :e u}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_SUM_TOPOLOGY_ALT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall u c= K :*: A, closed_in (K :*: A) (sum_topology A K k top) u <-> exists t :e Power A :^: K, u = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_in A (top i) (t i)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_T1_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, t1_space A top /\ a :e topspace A top -> closed_in A top {a}

items.name: CLOSED_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, closed_in A top (topspace A top)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_TOPSPACE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, topspace A top = Empty -> (closed_in A top s <-> s = Empty)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top t) s /\ closed_in A (subtopology A top u) t -> closed_in A (subtopology A top u) s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) {vector_add A a x | x :e t}) {vector_add A a x | x :e s} <-> closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) t) s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_TRANS_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t) <-> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t

items.name: CLOSED_IN_TRANS_FULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s u c= A, closed_in A (subtopology A top u) s /\ closed_in A top u -> closed_in A top s

items.name: CLOSED_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ closed_in A top t -> closed_in A top (s :\/: t)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ (forall t c= A, t :e s -> closed_in A top t) -> closed_in A top (Union s)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_UNIONS_LOCALLY_FINITE_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, locally_finite_in A top f -> closed_in A top (Union {closure_of A top s | s :e Power A, s :e f})

items.name: CLOSED_IN_UNION_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} u /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ c :e components N (u :\: s)) -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) (s :\/: c)

items.name: CLOSED_IN_UNION_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= Power (R :^: idx N), locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} u /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ c c= components N (u :\: s)) -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) (s :\/: Union c)

items.name: CLOSED_IRREDUCIBLE_SEPARATOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) a b -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (closed N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (~ connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t) a b /\ forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t /\ u <> t -> connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: u) a b)))

items.name: CLOSED_LIFT
items.statement: forall s c= R, closed 1 {lift x | x :e s} <-> forall x :e R, (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists x' :e R, x' :e s /\ (~ x' = x /\ abs_SNo (x' + - x) < e0)) -> x :e s

items.name: CLOSED_LIMPT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, limit_point_of A x s -> x :e s

items.name: CLOSED_LIMPTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N x s}

items.name: CLOSED_LOCALLY_FINITE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed N s) /\ locally_finite_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) f -> closed N (Union f)

items.name: CLOSED_LOCAL_HOMEOMORPHISM_GLOBAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, path_connected M s /\ (simply_connected N t /\ ((s = Empty -> t = Empty) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, exists v c= R :^: idx N, exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ homeomorphism M N (u,v) (f,g))))))) -> exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g)

items.name: CLOSED_LOCAL_HOMEOMORPHISM_IMP_COVERING_MAP
