items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, connected_component M c x x0 <-> x0 :e SetAdjoin Empty x) -> c = {x}) /\ ({p x | x :e c} = s /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) {p x | x :e k}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e c -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, exists u c= R :^: idx N, exists q :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), x :e t /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ homeomorphism M N (t,u) (p,q)))))) -> covering_space M N (c,p) s

items.name: CLOSED_LOCAL_HOMEOMORPHISM_IMP_PROPER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, connected_component M s x x0 <-> x0 :e SetAdjoin Empty x) -> s = {x}) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, exists v c= R :^: idx N, exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ homeomorphism M N (u,v) (f,g))))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: CLOSED_LOCAL_HOMEOMORPHISM_IMP_PROPER_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, (forall c c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall w c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, w :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ x :e w -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ ({x} c= u /\ {x} <> u /\ (u c= w /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f u /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx M, x' :e u /\ ~ x' = x -> ~ f x' = f x)))) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> ((forall s c= R :^: idx M, closed M s -> closed N {f x | x :e s}) <-> forall s c= R :^: idx M, closure N {f x | x :e s} c= {f x | x :e closure M s})

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_CLOSURE_OF_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (closed_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> closure_of B top' {f x | x :e s} c= {f x | x :e closure_of A top s})

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_COMPONENT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_map A (K :*: A) (top i,sum_topology A K k top) (fun x:set => (i,x))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ closed_map B C (top',top'') g -> closed_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall c :e B, closed_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => c) <-> topspace A top = Empty \/ closed_in B top' {c}

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_DIAG_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, closed_map A (A :*: A) (top,prod_topology A A top top) (fun x:set => (x,x)) <-> hausdorff_space A top

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) /\ closed_map A B (top,top') f -> closed_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_FIBRE_NEIGHBOURHOOD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (closed_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall u c= A, forall y :e B, u :e top /\ (y :e topspace B top' /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y} c= u) -> exists v c= B, v :e top' /\ (y :e v /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e v} c= u))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_FROM_CLOSED_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_in B top' s /\ closed_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g t /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ g x = g y) -> x = y) /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx P) (subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u) {g (f x) | x :e k})))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e k}

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> closed_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> closed_map B C (top',top'') g

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> closed_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ (continuous_map B C (top',top'') g /\ (forall x y :e B, x :e topspace B top' /\ (y :e topspace B top' /\ g x = g y) -> x = y))) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx P) (subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u) {g (f x) | x :e k}))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx P) (subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u) {g x | x :e k}

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_FROM_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ closed_in A top u -> closed_map A B (subtopology A top u,top') f

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, compact_space B top' -> closed_map (A :*: B) A (prod_topology A B top top',top) (fun x:set => x 0)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_FSTCART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), compact N t /\ closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {fstcart M x | x :e c}

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, closed_map A A (top,top) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_IFF_UPPER_HEMICONTINUOUS_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e u}) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {y :e R :^: idx N | y :e t /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} c= u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_IMP_CLOSED_GRAPH
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y}) /\ regular_space A top) -> closed_in (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top') {(x,f x) | x :e A, x :e topspace A top}

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_IMP_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e u}) /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e {f x | x :e u}} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s)) -> forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) t -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s}) {f x | x :e t}) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s})

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, closed_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ s c= topspace A top1 -> {f x | x :e s} c= topspace B top2

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_IMP_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_map A B (top1,top2) f -> {f x | x :e topspace A top1} c= topspace B top2

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_INCLUSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> closed_map A A (subtopology A top s,top) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_INCLUSION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_map A A (subtopology A top s,top) (fun x:set => x) <-> closed_in A top (topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_INTO_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= B, closed_map A B (top,discrete_topology B u) f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= u

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_INTO_K_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ (forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> closed_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k},subtopology B top' k) f)) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_INTO_K_SPACE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' -> (closed_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> closed_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k},subtopology B top' k) f)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_INTO_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= B, closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= s -> closed_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_in B top' s -> (closed_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f <-> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= s)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, closed_map A A (top,subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e topspace A top}) (fun x:set => kolmogorov_quotient A top x)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, closed_in A top u -> {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e u} = {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e topspace A top} :/\: u

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_map A A (subtopology A top s,subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e s}) (fun x:set => kolmogorov_quotient A top x)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> closed 1 {lift (vector_norm N x) | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> topspace A top = Empty -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_OPEN_SUPERSET_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, forall w c= R :^: idx N, (forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e k}) /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (w c= t /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e w} c= u)) -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ (w c= v /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} c= u)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_OPEN_SUPERSET_PREIMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e k}) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx M, forall w c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (w c= t /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e w} c= u) -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ (w c= v /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} c= u))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_OPEN_SUPERSET_PREIMAGE_POINT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e k}) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (y :e t /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} c= u) -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ (y :e v /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} c= u))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PAIRED
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top1 :e topology B, forall top2 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> closed_map A B (top,top1) f /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top1) f /\ (closed_map A C (top,top2) g /\ (continuous_map A C (top,top2) g /\ (t1_space B top1 /\ regular_space C top2 \/ regular_space B top1 /\ t1_space C top2)))) -> closed_map A (B :*: C) (top,prod_topology B C top1 top2) (fun x:set => (f x,g x))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PAIRED_CLOSED_MAP_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y}) /\ regular_space A top) -> closed_map A (B :*: A) (top,prod_topology B A top' top) (fun x:set => (f x,x))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PAIRED_CLOSED_MAP_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y}) /\ regular_space A top) -> closed_map A (A :*: B) (top,prod_topology A B top top') (fun x:set => (x,f x))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PAIRED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ hausdorff_space B top' -> closed_map A (B :*: A) (top,prod_topology B A top' top) (fun x:set => (f x,x))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PAIRED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ hausdorff_space B top' -> closed_map A (A :*: B) (top,prod_topology A B top top') (fun x:set => (x,f x))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PAIRED_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top1 :e topology B, forall top2 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> closed_map A B (top,top1) f /\ (closed_map A C (top,top2) g /\ (regular_space B top1 /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top1) f /\ (forall z :e C, z :e topspace C top2 -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ g x = z})) \/ regular_space C top2 /\ (continuous_map A C (top,top2) g /\ (forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top1 -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y})))) -> closed_map A (B :*: C) (top,prod_topology B C top1 top2) (fun x:set => (f x,g x))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top1 :e topology B, forall top2 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> closed_map A B (top,top1) (fun x:set => f x 0) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top1) (fun x:set => f x 0) /\ (closed_map A C (top,top2) (fun x:set => f x 1) /\ (continuous_map A C (top,top2) (fun x:set => f x 1) /\ (t1_space B top1 /\ regular_space C top2 \/ regular_space B top1 /\ t1_space C top2)))) -> closed_map A (B :*: C) (top,prod_topology B C top1 top2) f

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PREIMAGE_NEIGHBOURHOOD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (closed_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall u c= A, forall t c= B, u :e top /\ (t c= topspace B top' /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e t} c= u) -> exists v c= B, v :e top' /\ (t c= v /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e v} c= u))

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PROD
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top1' :e topology C, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top2' :e topology D, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e D) -> closed_map (A :*: B) (C :*: D) (prod_topology A B top1 top2,prod_topology C D top1' top2') (fun p:set => (f (p 0),g (p 1))) -> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ closed_map A C (top1,top1') f /\ closed_map B D (top2,top2') g

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall top':set -> set, (forall x :e K, top' x :e topology B) -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> closed_map (A :^: K) (B :^: K) (product_topology A K k top,product_topology B K k top') (fun x:set => fun x0 :e K => if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) -> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k top) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_map A B (top i,top' i) (f i)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, (forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e u}) /\ t' c= t -> forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t'}) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t') {f x | x :e u}

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, forall v c= B, closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e v} = u -> closed_map A B (subtopology A top u,subtopology B top' v) f

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_SND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, compact_space A top -> closed_map (A :*: B) B (prod_topology A B top top',top') (fun x:set => x 1)

items.name: CLOSED_MAP_SNDCART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), compact M s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {sndcart M N x | x :e c}

items.name: CLOSED_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> closed N {vector_neg N x | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSED_OPEN_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b -> closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = open_interval 1 (a,b) :\/: {a,b}

items.name: CLOSED_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> path A g -> closed A (path_image A g)

items.name: CLOSED_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed M s /\ closed N t -> closed (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: CLOSED_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ closed M s /\ closed N t)

items.name: CLOSED_POLAR_DUAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N (polar_dual N s)

items.name: CLOSED_POSITIVE_ORTHANT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 <= x i}

items.name: CLOSED_RELATIVE_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s -> closed A (s :\: relative_interior A s)

items.name: CLOSED_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: CLOSED_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | closed N x} s <-> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t

items.name: CLOSED_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, closed N s -> closed N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSED_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, closed N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ closed N s

items.name: CLOSED_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed N (open_segment N (a,b)) <-> a = b

items.name: CLOSED_SEGMENT_DESCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R, forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, 0 < a /\ (0 <= b /\ (0 < c /\ (vector_mul N b y :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (vector_mul N a x,vector_mul N c z) seq_nil) /\ ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} {x,y,z}))) -> y :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (x,z) seq_nil)

items.name: CLOSED_SEGMENT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx B, linear B A f -> closed_segment A (seq_cons (f a,f b) seq_nil) = {f x | x :e closed_segment B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: CLOSED_SEQUENTIAL_LIMITS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ tendsto A omega x l sequentially -> l :e s

items.name: CLOSED_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A g = pathstart A g /\ a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> pathfinish A (fun x:set => shiftpath A a g x) = pathstart A (fun x:set => shiftpath A a g x)

items.name: CLOSED_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> simple_path A g -> closed A (path_image A g)

items.name: CLOSED_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N {a}

items.name: CLOSED_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A (span A s)

items.name: CLOSED_SPHERE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, closed A (sphere A (a,r))

items.name: CLOSED_STANDARD_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a :e R, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = a}

items.name: CLOSED_STRIP_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) <= a}

items.name: CLOSED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ closed N s -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) s

items.name: CLOSED_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s <-> s c= u)

items.name: CLOSED_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> closed N s

items.name: CLOSED_SUBSTANDARD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d :e omega, closed N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, d < i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i = 0}

items.name: CLOSED_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N s -> closed N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSED_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> closed N s

items.name: CLOSED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ closed A t -> closed A (s :\/: t)

items.name: CLOSED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx A), finite s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx A, t :e s -> closed A t) -> closed A (Union s)

items.name: CLOSED_UNIONS_COMPONENTS_MEETING_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ closed N t -> closed N (Union {c :e Power (R :^: idx N) | c :e components N s /\ ~ c :/\: t = Empty})

items.name: CLOSED_UNION_COMPACT_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> exists f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact N (f n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n c= s) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n c= f (n + 1)) /\ (Union {f n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = s /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, compact N k /\ k c= s -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, N0 <= n -> k c= f n)))

items.name: CLOSED_UNION_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> closed N (s :\/: c)

items.name: CLOSED_UNION_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= Power (R :^: idx N), closed N s /\ c c= components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> closed N (s :\/: Union c)

items.name: CLOSED_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> closed N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: CLOSED_WITH_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> closed N (s :\/: inside N s)

items.name: CLOSER_POINTS_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall y z :e R :^: idx N, 0 < dot N y z -> exists u :e R, 0 < u /\ forall v :e R, 0 < v /\ v <= u -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N v z) y) < vector_norm N y

items.name: CLOSER_POINT_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, 0 < dot A (vector_sub A y x) (vector_sub A z x) -> exists u :e R, 0 < u /\ (u <= 1 /\ distance A (vector_add A x (vector_mul A u (vector_sub A z x)),y) < distance A (x,y))

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_AFFINE_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ x :e s) -> orthogonal N (vector_sub N x (closest_point N s a)) (vector_sub N a (closest_point N s a))

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_AFFINE_ORTHOGONAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ b :e s -> (closest_point N s a = b <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> orthogonal N (vector_sub N x b) (vector_sub N a b))

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_DOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ x :e s) -> dot N (vector_sub N a (closest_point N s a)) (vector_sub N x (closest_point N s a)) <= 0

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ ~ s = Empty -> closest_point A s a :e s /\ forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e s -> distance A (a,closest_point A s a) <= distance A (a,y)

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x :e interior N s -> closest_point N (frontier N s) x = closest_point N (closure N s) x

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_IDEMPOTENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, closest_point N s (closest_point N s x) = closest_point N s x

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_IN_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ x :e interior N s) -> closest_point N s x :e frontier N s

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_IN_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (closest_point N s x :e interior N s <-> x :e interior N s)

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_IN_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s :\: relative_interior N s) -> closest_point N s x :e relative_frontier N s

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s) -> (closest_point N s x :e relative_interior N s <-> x :e relative_interior N s)

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_IN_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ ~ s = Empty -> closest_point A s a :e s

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a x :e R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ x :e s -> distance A (a,closest_point A s a) <= distance A (a,x)

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> distance N (closest_point N s x,closest_point N s y) <= distance N (x,y)

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a x :e R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ (closed A s /\ (x :e s /\ ~ x = closest_point A s a)) -> distance A (a,closest_point A s a) < distance A (a,x)

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (closest_point N s x = x <-> x :e s)

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_SELF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> closest_point N s x = x

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_SUBSPACE_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ b :e s -> orthogonal N (vector_sub N a (closest_point N s a)) b

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_SUBSPACE_ORTHOGONAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> (closest_point N s a = b <-> b :e s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> orthogonal N (vector_sub N a b) x)

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> closest_point N {vector_add N a x0 | x0 :e s} (vector_add N a x) = vector_add N a (closest_point N s x)

items.name: CLOSEST_POINT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (x :e s /\ (forall z :e R :^: idx N, z :e s -> distance N (a,x) <= distance N (a,z)))) -> x = closest_point N s a

items.name: CLOSURE_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, closure N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} = {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e closure N s}

items.name: CLOSURE_APPROACHABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e closure A s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists y :e R :^: idx A, y :e s /\ distance A (y,x) < e0

items.name: CLOSURE_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> closure N (ball N (x,e0)) = cball N (x,e0)

items.name: CLOSURE_BOUNDED_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ bounded_hl M s -> closure N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e closure M s}

items.name: CLOSURE_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, closure N (cball N (a,r)) = cball N (a,r)

items.name: CLOSURE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s -> closure A s = s

items.name: CLOSURE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closure A (closure A s) = closure A s

items.name: CLOSURE_COCOUNTABLE_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> countable (R :\: {x :e R | P i x})) -> closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (x i)} = R :^: idx N

items.name: CLOSURE_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) = (R :^: idx N) :\: interior N s

items.name: CLOSURE_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s \/ bounded_hl N s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e closure N s -> closure N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (closure N s)

items.name: CLOSURE_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, compact A s -> closure A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s) = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s

items.name: CLOSURE_CONVEX_INTER_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (affine N t /\ ~ relative_interior N s :/\: t = Empty) -> closure N (s :/\: t) = closure N s :/\: t

items.name: CLOSURE_CONVEX_INTER_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ interior N s = Empty /\ interior N s c= closure N t) -> closure N (s :/\: t) = closure N s

items.name: CLOSURE_COSMALL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> atleastp (R :\: {x :e R | P i x}) R /\ ~ equip (R :\: {x :e R | P i x}) R) -> closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (x i)} = R :^: idx N

items.name: CLOSURE_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closure N (s :\: {a}) = if limit_point_of N a s then closure N s else closure N s :\: {a}

items.name: CLOSURE_DYADIC_RATIONALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> closure N (\/_ n :e omega, {vector_mul N (recip_SNo (2 ^ n)) x | x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e int}) = R :^: idx N

items.name: CLOSURE_DYADIC_RATIONALS_IN_CONVEX_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ interior N s = Empty -> closure N (s :/\: \/_ n :e omega, {vector_mul N (recip_SNo (2 ^ n)) x | x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e int}) = closure N s

items.name: CLOSURE_DYADIC_RATIONALS_IN_OPEN_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> closure N (s :/\: \/_ n :e omega, {vector_mul N (recip_SNo (2 ^ n)) x | x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e int}) = closure N s

items.name: CLOSURE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> closure A Empty = Empty

items.name: CLOSURE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closure A s = s <-> closed A s

items.name: CLOSURE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closure A s = Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: CLOSURE_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | a < x k} = {x :e R :^: idx N | a <= x k}

items.name: CLOSURE_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k < a} = {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= a}

items.name: CLOSURE_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 -> closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | b < dot N a x} = {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x}

items.name: CLOSURE_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 -> closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x < b} = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b}

items.name: CLOSURE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closure A s = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | closed A x} s

items.name: CLOSURE_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, closure A {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x = b} = {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x = b}

items.name: CLOSURE_IMAGE_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) /\ bounded_hl M s -> closure N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e closure M s}

items.name: CLOSURE_IMAGE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) -> closure N {f x | x :e closure M s} = closure N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSURE_INC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> x :e closure N s

items.name: CLOSURE_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> closure N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e closure M s}

items.name: CLOSURE_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closure N (SetAdjoin s a) = SetAdjoin (closure N s) a

items.name: CLOSURE_INSIDE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> closure N (inside N s) c= s :\/: inside N s

items.name: CLOSURE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure N s = (R :^: idx N) :\: interior N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: CLOSURE_INTERIOR_IDEMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure N (interior N (closure N (interior N s))) = closure N (interior N s)

items.name: CLOSURE_INTERIOR_UNION_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ closed N t -> closure N (interior N (s :\/: t)) = closure N (interior N s) :\/: closure N (interior N t)

items.name: CLOSURE_INTERS_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex N s) /\ ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e relative_interior N x} | x :e f}, x :e Y} = Empty -> closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e closure N x} | x :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: CLOSURE_INTERS_CONVEX_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex N s /\ open N s) -> closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = if {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty then Empty else {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e closure N x} | x :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: CLOSURE_INTERS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), closure A {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} c= {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e closure A x} | x :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: CLOSURE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, closure A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx B, closure B (open_interval B (a,b)) = if open_interval B (a,b) = Empty then Empty else closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: CLOSURE_INTER_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ ~ relative_interior N s :/\: relative_interior N t = Empty) -> closure N (s :/\: t) = closure N s :/\: closure N t

items.name: CLOSURE_INTER_CONVEX_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ (open A s /\ (convex A t /\ open A t)) -> closure A (s :/\: t) = if s :/\: t = Empty then Empty else closure A s :/\: closure A t

items.name: CLOSURE_INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closure A (s :/\: t) c= closure A s :/\: closure A t

items.name: CLOSURE_IRRATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> ~ x i :e rational} = R :^: idx N

items.name: CLOSURE_LINEAR_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> {f x | x :e closure M s} c= closure N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CLOSURE_LOCALLY_FINITE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), locally_finite_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) f -> closure N (Union f) = Union {closure N s | s :e Power (R :^: idx N), s :e f}

items.name: CLOSURE_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s c= t /\ closed A t -> closure A s c= t

items.name: CLOSURE_MINIMAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N t -> (closure N s c= t <-> s c= t)

items.name: CLOSURE_MINIMAL_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) u /\ t c= u -> s :/\: closure N t c= u

items.name: CLOSURE_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closure A {vector_neg A x | x :e s} = {vector_neg A x | x :e closure A s}

items.name: CLOSURE_NONEMPTY_OPEN_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closure N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ open N t -> ~ s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s = topspace A top :/\: (s :\/: derived_set_of A top s)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s = topspace A top :/\: s :\/: derived_set_of A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, closure_of (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e closure_of A (tops i) (s i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> closure_of A top s = s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top (closure_of A top s) = closure_of A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top (topspace A top :\: s) = topspace A top :\: interior_of A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, closure_of (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (s :*: t) = closure_of A top1 s :*: closure_of B top2 t

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_DYADIC_RATIONALS_IN_UNIT_INTERVAL
items.statement: closure_of R euclideanreal (\/_ k :e omega, {k :/: 2 ^ n | n :e omega, k <= 2 ^ n}) = closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, closure_of A top Empty = Empty

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s = s <-> closed_in A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (closure_of A top s = Empty <-> s = Empty)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_EQ_EMPTY_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s = Empty <-> topspace A top :/\: s = Empty

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_EQ_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s = topspace A top <-> interior_of A top (topspace A top :\: s) = Empty

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> closure_of A top s = hull A {x :e Power A | closed_in A top x} s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> closure_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e u}) {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e closure_of (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s}

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s = topspace A top :\: interior_of A top (topspace A top :\: s)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_INTERIOR_OF_IDEMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top (interior_of A top (closure_of A top (interior_of A top s))) = closure_of A top (interior_of A top s)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_INTERIOR_OF_REALINTERVAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, is_realinterval s /\ ~ interior_of R euclideanreal s = Empty -> closure_of R euclideanreal (interior_of R euclideanreal s) = closure_of R euclideanreal s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_LOCALLY_FINITE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, locally_finite_in A top f -> closure_of A top (Union f) = Union {closure_of A top s | s :e Power A, s :e f}

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ closed_in A top t -> closure_of A top s c= t

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_MINIMAL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ closed_in A top t -> (closure_of A top s c= t <-> s c= t)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= t -> closure_of A top s c= closure_of A top t

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_OPEN_IN_INTER_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top -> closure_of A top (s :/\: closure_of A top t) = closure_of A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_OPEN_IN_INTER_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top /\ s c= closure_of A top t -> closure_of A top (s :/\: t) = closure_of A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_INTER_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, s :e subtopology A top u /\ t c= u -> closure_of A top (s :/\: closure_of A top t) = closure_of A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b :e R, closure_of R euclideanreal (open_real_interval (a,b)) = if open_real_interval (a,b) = Empty then Empty else closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s = closure_of A top (topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall met :e metric A, forall s c= A, closure_of A (mtopology A met) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A met /\ exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e A) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :/\: mspace A met) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) f x sequentially)}

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, t1_space A top -> closure_of A top {a} = if a :e topspace A top then {a} else Empty

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> s c= closure_of A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ closure_of A top s c= s <-> closed_in A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SUBSET_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, topspace A top :/\: s c= closure_of A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SUBSET_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closure_of A (subtopology A top s) t c= s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s c= topspace A top

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, closure_of A (subtopology A top u) s = u :/\: closure_of A top (u :/\: s)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, t c= u -> closure_of A (subtopology A top t) s c= closure_of A (subtopology A top u) s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, u :e top \/ s c= u -> closure_of A (subtopology A top u) s = u :/\: closure_of A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s u c= A, closure_of A (subtopology A top u) s c= closure_of A top s

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, closure_of A top (topspace A top) = topspace A top

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall u s c= R :^: idx N, closure_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {vector_add N a x | x :e u}) {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e closure_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s}

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closure_of A top (s :\/: t) = closure_of A top s :\/: closure_of A top t

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, finite f -> closure_of A top (Union f) = Union {closure_of A top s | s :e Power A, s :e f}

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_UNIONS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, Union {closure_of A top s | s :e Power A, s :e f} c= closure_of A top (Union f)

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ (closed_in A top t /\ (forall t' c= A, s c= t' /\ closed_in A top t' -> t c= t')) -> closure_of A top s = t

items.name: CLOSURE_OF_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, closure_of A top A = topspace A top

items.name: CLOSURE_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty -> closure N (open_interval N (a,b)) = closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: CLOSURE_OPEN_INTER_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> closure N (s :/\: closure N t) = closure N (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSURE_OPEN_INTER_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ s c= closure N t -> closure N (s :/\: t) = closure N s

items.name: CLOSURE_OPEN_IN_INTER_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ t c= u -> closure N (s :/\: closure N t) = closure N (s :/\: t)

items.name: CLOSURE_OUTSIDE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> closure N (outside N s) c= s :\/: outside N s

items.name: CLOSURE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, closure (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e closure M s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e closure N t}

items.name: CLOSURE_RATIONALS_IN_CONVEX_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ interior N s = Empty -> closure N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e rational}) = closure N s

items.name: CLOSURE_RATIONALS_IN_OPEN_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> closure N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e rational}) = closure N s

items.name: CLOSURE_RATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e rational} = R :^: idx N

items.name: CLOSURE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, closure N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} = {vector_mul N c x | x :e closure N s}

items.name: CLOSURE_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closure N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closure N (open_segment N (a,b)) = if a = b then Empty else closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: CLOSURE_SEQUENTIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall l :e R :^: idx N, l :e closure N s <-> exists x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ tendsto N omega x l sequentially)

items.name: CLOSURE_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, closure N {x} = {x}

items.name: CLOSURE_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, closure N (sphere N (a,r)) = sphere N (a,r)

items.name: CLOSURE_STRIP_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) < a} = if a = 0 then Empty else {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) <= a}

items.name: CLOSURE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, s c= closure A s

items.name: CLOSURE_SUBSET_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closure A s c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s

items.name: CLOSURE_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure N s c= s <-> closed N s

items.name: CLOSURE_SUBSET_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure N s c= span N s

items.name: CLOSURE_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s \/ bounded_hl N t -> closure N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e closure N s /\ y :e closure N t}

items.name: CLOSURE_SURJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = y) -> closure N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e closure N s}

items.name: CLOSURE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e closure N s}

items.name: CLOSURE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closure N (s :\/: t) = closure N s :\/: closure N t

items.name: CLOSURE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), finite f -> closure A (Union f) = Union {closure A s | s :e Power (R :^: idx A), s :e f}

items.name: CLOSURE_UNIONS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), Union {closure N s | s :e Power (R :^: idx N), s :e f} c= closure N (Union f)

items.name: CLOSURE_UNION_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure N s = s :\/: frontier N s

items.name: CLOSURE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s c= t /\ (closed A t /\ (forall t' c= R :^: idx A, s c= t' /\ closed A t' -> t c= t')) -> closure A s = t

items.name: CLOSURE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> closure N (R :^: idx N) = R :^: idx N

items.name: COBOUNDED_HAS_BOUNDED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ ~ connected N s) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s /\ bounded_hl N c

items.name: COBOUNDED_IMP_UNBOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> ~ bounded_hl N s

items.name: COBOUNDED_INTER_UNBOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ ~ bounded_hl N t -> ~ s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: COBOUNDED_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: outside N s)

items.name: COBOUNDED_UNBOUNDED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ ~ bounded_hl N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0}

items.name: COBOUNDED_UNBOUNDED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s /\ ~ bounded_hl N c

items.name: COBOUNDED_UNIQUE_UNBOUNDED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ (~ bounded_hl N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0} /\ ~ bounded_hl N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s y x0})) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x0 <-> connected_component N s y x0

items.name: COBOUNDED_UNIQUE_UNBOUNDED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c' c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ (c :e components N s /\ (~ bounded_hl N c /\ (c' :e components N s /\ ~ bounded_hl N c')))) -> c' = c

items.name: COCOUNTABLE_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall s c= R, countable (R :\: s) -> forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists y :e R, y :e s /\ abs_SNo (y + - x) < e0

items.name: CODESET_SETCODE_BIJECTIONS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, i :e idx_n (2 ^ n) -> codeset i c= idx_n n /\ setcode (codeset i) = i) /\ forall s c= omega, s c= idx_n n -> setcode s :e idx_n (2 ^ n) /\ codeset (setcode s) = s

items.name: COFACTOR_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> cofactor N (mat N N 0) = if dimindex N = 1 then mat N N 1 else mat N N 0

items.name: COFACTOR_1
items.statement: forall A :e R :^: idx 1 :^: idx 1, cofactor 1 A = mat 1 1 1

items.name: COFACTOR_1_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 -> cofactor N A = mat N N 1

items.name: COFACTOR_CMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall c :e R, cofactor N (matrix_cmul N N c A) = matrix_cmul N N (c ^ minus_nat (dimindex N) 1) (cofactor N A)

items.name: COFACTOR_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N -> cofactor N (cofactor N A) = matrix_cmul N N (det N A ^ minus_nat (dimindex N) 2) A

items.name: COFACTOR_COLUMN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, cofactor N A = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => det N (fun k :e idx N => fun l :e idx N => if l = j then if k = i then 1 else 0 else A k l)

items.name: COFACTOR_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, cofactor N A = mat N N 0 <-> rank N N A < minus_nat (dimindex N) 1

items.name: COFACTOR_I
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> cofactor N (mat N N 1) = mat N N 1

items.name: COFACTOR_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, ~ det N A = 0 -> cofactor N A = matrix_cmul N N (det N A) (transp N N (matrix_inv N N A))

items.name: COFACTOR_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, cofactor N (matrix_mul N N N A B) = matrix_mul N N N (cofactor N A) (cofactor N B)

items.name: COFACTOR_ROW
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, cofactor N A = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => det N (fun k :e idx N => fun l :e idx N => if k = i then if l = j then 1 else 0 else A k l)

items.name: COFACTOR_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, cofactor N (transp N N A) = transp N N (cofactor N A)

items.name: COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_1D
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (ANR N t /\ (connected N t /\ (dimindex M = 1 \/ (exists r c= R :^: idx 1, homeomorphic 1 M s r))))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => a)

items.name: COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_ON_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s \/ compact M s /\ ANR N t -> ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ {g x | x :e s} c= t)) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f g) <-> forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e components M s -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f c /\ ({f x | x :e c} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g c /\ {g x | x :e c} c= t)) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f g)

items.name: COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_ON_COMPONENTS_NULL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, (locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s \/ compact M s /\ ANR N t) /\ path_connected N t -> ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => a)) <-> forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e components M s -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f c /\ {f x | x :e c} c= t -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => a))

items.name: COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_RETRACTION_GEN
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall P0 c= R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M), forall Q c= R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, k x :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl M N h s /\ ({h x | x :e s} = t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M k t /\ ({k x | x :e t} c= s /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> h (k y) = y) /\ ((forall f :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), continuous_on_hl N P (fun x:set => f x) t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= u /\ f :e Q) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => f (h x)) :e P0) /\ ((forall f :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M), continuous_on_hl M P (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= u /\ f :e P0) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => f (k x)) :e Q) /\ (forall h0 k0 :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> h0 x = k0 x) -> (h0 :e Q <-> k0 :e Q)))))))) /\ (forall f g :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M), continuous_on_hl M P (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= u /\ (f :e P0 /\ (continuous_on_hl M P (fun x:set => g x) s /\ ({g x | x :e s} c= u /\ g :e P0)))) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx P) (R :^: idx M) P0 (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u) (fun x:set => f x) (fun x:set => g x)) -> forall f g :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), continuous_on_hl N P (fun x:set => f x) t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= u /\ (f :e Q /\ (continuous_on_hl N P (fun x:set => g x) t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ g :e Q)))) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx P) (R :^: idx N) Q (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u) (fun x:set => f x) (fun x:set => g x)

items.name: COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_RETRACTION_NULL_GEN
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall P0 c= R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M), forall Q c= R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, k x :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl M N h s /\ ({h x | x :e s} = t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M k t /\ ({k x | x :e t} c= s /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> h (k y) = y) /\ ((forall f :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), continuous_on_hl N P (fun x:set => f x) t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= u /\ f :e Q) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx M => f (h x)) :e P0) /\ ((forall f :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M), continuous_on_hl M P (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= u /\ f :e P0) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => f (k x)) :e Q) /\ (forall h0 k0 :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> h0 x = k0 x) -> (h0 :e Q <-> k0 :e Q)))))))) /\ (forall f :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M), continuous_on_hl M P (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= u /\ f :e P0) -> exists c :e R :^: idx P, homotopic_with (R :^: idx P) (R :^: idx M) P0 (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u) (fun x:set => f x) (fun x:set => c)) -> forall f :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), continuous_on_hl N P (fun x:set => f x) t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= u /\ f :e Q) -> exists c :e R :^: idx P, homotopic_with (R :^: idx P) (R :^: idx N) Q (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u) (fun x:set => f x) (fun x:set => c)

items.name: COLLINEAR_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, collinear 1 s

items.name: COLLINEAR_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {x,y}

items.name: COLLINEAR_3
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {x,y,z} <-> collinear A {vec A 0,vector_sub A x y,vector_sub A z y}

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_2D
items.statement: forall x y z :e R :^: idx_n 2, collinear (idx_n 2) {x,y,z} <-> (z 1 + - x 1) * (y 2 + - x 2) = (y 1 + - x 1) * (z 2 + - x 2)

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> (collinear N {a,b,c} <-> c :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b})

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_DOT_MULTIPLES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} <-> vector_mul N (dot N (vector_sub N b a) (vector_sub N b a)) (vector_sub N c a) = vector_mul N (dot N (vector_sub N c a) (vector_sub N b a)) (vector_sub N b a)

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_EQ_AFFINE_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} <-> a = b \/ (a = c \/ (b = c \/ affine_dependent N {a,b,c}))

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_EXPAND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} <-> a = c \/ exists u :e R, b = vector_add N (vector_mul N u a) (vector_mul N (1 + - u) c)

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {x,y,z} <-> exists a b c :e R, vector_add N (vector_mul N a x) (vector_add N (vector_mul N b y) (vector_mul N c z)) = vec N 0 /\ (a + b + c = 0 /\ ~ (a = 0 /\ (b = 0 /\ c = 0)))

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_IN_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v0 v1 x :e R :^: idx N, ~ v1 = v0 -> (collinear N {v0,v1,x} <-> x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} {v0,v1})

items.name: COLLINEAR_3_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} /\ (collinear N {b,c,d} /\ ~ b = c) -> collinear N {a,b,d}

items.name: COLLINEAR_4_3
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> (collinear N {a,b,c,d} <-> collinear N {a,b,c} /\ collinear N {a,b,d})

items.name: COLLINEAR_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, collinear N s <-> exists u v :e R :^: idx N, s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {u,v}

items.name: COLLINEAR_AFFINE_HULL_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, collinear A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s) <-> collinear A s

items.name: COLLINEAR_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, collinear N s <-> aff_dim N s <= 1

items.name: COLLINEAR_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, collinear N s <-> exists u v :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists c :e R, x = vector_add N u (vector_mul N c v)

items.name: COLLINEAR_ALT2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, collinear N s <-> exists u v :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists c :e R, vector_sub N x u = vector_mul N c v

items.name: COLLINEAR_BETWEEN_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} <-> between N a (b,c) \/ (between N b (c,a) \/ between N c (a,b))

items.name: COLLINEAR_BETWEEN_CASES_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, between N c (a,b) /\ between N d (a,b) -> between N d (a,c) \/ between N d (c,b)

items.name: COLLINEAR_CONVEX_HULL_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, collinear N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) <-> collinear N s

items.name: COLLINEAR_DESCALE
