items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R, forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = 0 /\ (~ c = 0 /\ (collinear N {vector_mul N a x,vector_mul N b y,vector_mul N c z} /\ ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} {x,y,z})) -> collinear N {x,y,z}

items.name: COLLINEAR_DIST_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {x,a,b} /\ (distance A (x,a) <= distance A (a,b) /\ distance A (x,b) <= distance A (a,b)) -> between A x (a,b)

items.name: COLLINEAR_DIST_IN_CLOSED_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {x,a,b} /\ (distance A (x,a) <= distance A (a,b) /\ distance A (x,b) <= distance A (a,b)) -> x :e closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: COLLINEAR_DIST_IN_OPEN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {x,a,b} /\ (distance A (x,a) < distance A (a,b) /\ distance A (x,b) < distance A (a,b)) -> x :e open_segment A (a,b)

items.name: COLLINEAR_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> collinear A Empty

items.name: COLLINEAR_EXTREME_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, collinear N s -> finite {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s} /\ finite_cardinality {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s} <= 2

items.name: COLLINEAR_HYPERPLANE_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, dimindex N <= 2 /\ ~ a = vec N 0 -> collinear N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: COLLINEAR_IMP_COPLANAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, collinear A s -> coplanar A s

items.name: COLLINEAR_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {vec N 0,x,y} <-> x = vec N 0 \/ (y = vec N 0 \/ exists c :e R, y = vector_mul N c x)

items.name: COLLINEAR_LEMMA_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {vec A 0,x,y} <-> x = vec A 0 \/ exists c :e R, y = vector_mul A c x

items.name: COLLINEAR_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, collinear A s /\ linear A B f -> collinear B {f x | x :e s}

items.name: COLLINEAR_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (collinear A {f x | x :e s} <-> collinear B s)

items.name: COLLINEAR_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {a,midpoint A (a,b),b}

items.name: COLLINEAR_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, collinear N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, collinear N (open_segment N (a,b))

items.name: COLLINEAR_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N g /\ collinear N (path_image N g) -> path_image N g = closed_segment N (seq_cons (pathstart N g,pathfinish N g) seq_nil)

items.name: COLLINEAR_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, collinear A {x}

items.name: COLLINEAR_SMALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= 2 -> collinear A s

items.name: COLLINEAR_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {vec N 0,a,b} <-> a = vec N 0 \/ b :e span N {a}

items.name: COLLINEAR_STANDARD_HYPERPLANE_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall b :e R, dimindex N <= 2 -> collinear N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = b}

items.name: COLLINEAR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, collinear A t /\ s c= t -> collinear A s

items.name: COLLINEAR_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, collinear A s -> collinear A {vector_add A a x | x :e s}

items.name: COLLINEAR_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, collinear A {vector_add A a x | x :e s} <-> collinear A s

items.name: COLLINEAR_TRIPLES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> (collinear N (SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s b) a) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> collinear N {a,b,x})

items.name: COLUMNS_IMAGE_BASIS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, columns N M A = {matrix_vector_mul N M A x | x :e {basis M i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M}}

items.name: COLUMNS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, ~ columns M N A = Empty

items.name: COLUMNS_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, columns N M (transp M N A) = rows M N A

items.name: COLUMN_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, column N N i (mat N N 0) = vec N 0

items.name: COLUMN_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex P -> column M P i (matrix_mul M N P A B) = matrix_vector_mul M N A (column N P i B)

items.name: COLUMN_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> column N M i (transp M N A) = row M N i A

items.name: COMMA_DEF
items.error: internal constant ABS_prod (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: COMMON_FRONTIER_DOMAINS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (open N t /\ (connected N s /\ (connected N t /\ frontier N s = frontier N t))) -> s = t \/ s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: COMMUTATOR_IMP_ABELIAN_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> group_mul A G (group_inv A G x) (group_mul A G (group_inv A G y) (group_mul A G x y)) :e n) -> abelian_group_hl (Power A) (quotient_group A G n)

items.name: COMMUTING_MATRIX_INV_COVARIANCE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M M M (matrix_inv M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A)) (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) = matrix_mul M M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) (matrix_inv M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A))

items.name: COMMUTING_MATRIX_INV_NORMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A -> matrix_mul N N N (matrix_inv N N A) A = matrix_mul N N N A (matrix_inv N N A)

items.name: COMMUTING_WITH_DIAGONAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A D :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N D -> (matrix_mul N N N A D = matrix_mul N N N D A <-> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> A i j = 0 \/ D i i = D j j)

items.name: COMMUTING_WITH_SQUARE_ROOT_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A S B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N S /\ (matrix_mul N N N S S = A /\ matrix_mul N N N A B = matrix_mul N N N B A) -> matrix_mul N N N S B = matrix_mul N N N B S

items.name: COMPACT_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, compact N s -> compact N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: COMPACT_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, compact N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ compact N s

items.name: COMPACT_AR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ AR N s <-> compact N s /\ retract_of N s (R :^: idx N)

items.name: COMPACT_ARC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> arc A g -> compact A (path_image A g)

items.name: COMPACT_ATTAINS_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, compact 1 {lift x | x :e s} /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ forall y :e R, y :e s -> x <= y

items.name: COMPACT_ATTAINS_SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, compact 1 {lift x | x :e s} /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ forall y :e R, y :e s -> y <= x

items.name: COMPACT_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, compact A (cball A (x,e0))

items.name: COMPACT_CHAIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> compact N s /\ ~ s = Empty) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_CLOSED_DIFFERENCES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ closed N t -> closed N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_sub N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: COMPACT_CLOSED_POINTIMAGES_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ compact M c -> compact N {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: COMPACT_CLOSED_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ closed N t -> closed N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: COMPACT_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, compact A (closure A s) <-> bounded_hl A s

items.name: COMPACT_CLOSURE_OF_EQ_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (closure_of A (mtopology A m) s) <-> forall t c= A, infinite t /\ (t c= s /\ t c= mspace A m) -> ~ derived_set_of A (mtopology A m) t = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_CLOSURE_OF_IMP_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, compact_in A top (closure_of A top s) /\ (infinite t /\ (t c= s /\ t c= topspace A top)) -> ~ derived_set_of A top t = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_CLOSURE_OF_IMP_TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, s c= mspace A m /\ compact_in A (mtopology A m) (closure_of A (mtopology A m) s) -> totally_bounded_in A m s

items.name: COMPACT_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ c :e components N s -> compact N c

items.name: COMPACT_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, compact N s -> compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s a x}

items.name: COMPACT_CONNECTED_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ (connected_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s)) -> path_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s)

items.name: COMPACT_CONNECTED_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) -> path_connected N s

items.name: COMPACT_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ compact M s -> compact N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: COMPACT_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> (continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx M, compact M t /\ t c= s -> compact N {f x | x :e t})

items.name: COMPACT_CONVEX_COLLINEAR_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (compact N s /\ (convex N s /\ collinear N s)) -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, s = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: COMPACT_CONVEX_COLLINEAR_SEGMENT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ collinear N s)) -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, s = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: COMPACT_CONVEX_COMBINATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ compact N t -> compact N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, \/_ u :e R, {vector_add N (vector_mul N (1 + - u) x) (vector_mul N u y) | y :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= u /\ (u <= 1 /\ (x :e s /\ y :e t))})

items.name: COMPACT_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> compact N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: COMPACT_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, compact A s /\ open A t -> compact A (s :\: t)

items.name: COMPACT_DIFFERENCES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ compact N t -> compact N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_sub N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: COMPACT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> compact A Empty

items.name: COMPACT_EQ_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, infinite t /\ t c= s -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ limit_point_of N x t

items.name: COMPACT_EQ_BOUNDED_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s <-> bounded_hl N s /\ closed N s

items.name: COMPACT_EQ_HEINE_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s <-> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> open N t) /\ s c= Union f -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ (finite f' /\ s c= Union f')

items.name: COMPACT_EQ_HEINE_BOREL_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, compact N c <-> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) /\ c c= Union f -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ (finite f' /\ c c= Union f')

items.name: COMPACT_EQ_HEINE_BOREL_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s <-> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) /\ s c= Union f -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ (finite f' /\ s c= Union f')

items.name: COMPACT_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, compact_space (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) <-> n = 0

items.name: COMPACT_FIP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> compact N t) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f' /\ f' c= f -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = Empty) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, compact A s -> compact A (frontier A s)

items.name: COMPACT_FRONTIER_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s -> compact A (frontier A s)

items.name: COMPACT_FRONTIER_LINE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (vec N 0 :e s /\ ~ x = vec N 0) -> exists u :e R, 0 <= u /\ (vector_mul N u x :e frontier N s /\ forall v :e R, u < v -> ~ vector_mul N v x :e s)

items.name: COMPACT_HAUSDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall c c= R :^: idx N, compact N c /\ (forall n :e omega, ~ f n = Empty /\ f n c= c) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ exists s c= R :^: idx N, (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ (compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (s c= c /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (hausdist N (f (r n),s))) (vec 1 0) sequentially)))

items.name: COMPACT_HAUSDORFF_IMP_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top -> regular_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_HAUSDORFF_OR_REGULAR_IMP_NORMAL_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) -> normal_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_HAUSDORFF_SPACE_OPTIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, topspace A top' = topspace A top /\ ((forall u c= A, u :e top -> u :e top') /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ compact_space A top')) -> top' = top

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, compact A s -> analytic A s

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> borel N s

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, compact A s -> bounded_hl A s

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, compact A s -> closed A s

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_COMPACT_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k s c= A, compact_in A top k /\ k c= s -> compact_in A (subtopology A top s) k

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_COMPLETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> complete N s

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_FIP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), compact N s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> closed N t) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f' /\ f' c= f -> ~ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = Empty)) -> ~ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_HEINE_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> open N t) /\ s c= Union f -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ (finite f' /\ s c= Union f')

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_K_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top -> k_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_LINDELOF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top -> lindelof_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top -> locally_compact_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_PARACOMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top -> paracompact_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_PERFECT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' /\ (kc_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ (forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> compact_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k})))) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' /\ (kc_space B top' /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ ((continuous_map A B (top,top') f \/ kc_space A top) /\ (forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> compact_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k})))) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_PROPER_MAP_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top' :e topology B, (forall s c= B, s c= topspace B top' /\ (forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> compact_in B top' (s :/\: k)) -> closed_in B top' s) -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ ((continuous_map A B (top,top') f \/ kc_space A top) /\ (forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> compact_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k})) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: COMPACT_IMP_TOTALLY_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, finite k /\ (k c= s /\ s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e ball N (x,e0)} | x :e k})

items.name: COMPACT_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, compact A s -> compact A (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: COMPACT_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, compact A s /\ compact A t -> compact A (s :/\: t)

items.name: COMPACT_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> compact N s) /\ ~ f = Empty -> compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: COMPACT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, compact N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: COMPACT_INTERVAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, compact N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, compact N (open_interval N (a,b)) <-> open_interval N (a,b) = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_INTER_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, compact A s /\ closed A t -> compact A (s :/\: t)

items.name: COMPACT_INTER_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, compact_in A top s /\ closed_in A top t -> compact_in A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: COMPACT_IN_ABSOLUTE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (subtopology A top s) s <-> compact_in A top s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, compact_in (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> compact_in A (tops i) (s i)

items.name: COMPACT_IN_CONTRACTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, topspace A top' = topspace A top /\ (forall u c= A, u :e top -> u :e top') -> forall s c= A, compact_in A top' s -> compact_in A top s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, compact_in (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ compact_in A top1 s /\ compact_in B top2 t)

items.name: COMPACT_IN_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, compact_in A (discrete_topology A u) s <-> s c= u /\ finite s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_in A top Empty

items.name: COMPACT_IN_EQ_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s <-> s c= mspace A m /\ forall t c= A, t c= s /\ infinite t -> ~ s :/\: derived_set_of A (mtopology A m) t = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s <-> compact N s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, compact_in R euclideanreal s <-> mbounded R real_euclidean_metric s /\ closed_in R euclideanreal s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_EUCLIDEANREAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b :e R, compact_in R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: COMPACT_IN_FIP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, compact_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ forall f c= Power A, (forall c c= A, c :e f -> closed_in A top c) /\ (forall f' c= Power A, finite f' /\ f' c= f -> ~ s :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = Empty) -> ~ s :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_IN_IMP_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, compact_in A top s /\ (infinite t /\ t c= s) -> ~ s :/\: derived_set_of A top t = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_IN_IMP_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ compact_in A top s -> closed_in A top s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_IMP_CLOSED_IN_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, kc_space A top /\ compact_in A top s -> closed_in A top s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_IMP_MBOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s -> mbounded A m s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_IMP_MCOMPLETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s -> mcomplete A (submetric A m s)

items.name: COMPACT_IN_IMP_TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s -> totally_bounded_in A m s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_IMP_TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall e0 :e R, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists k c= A, finite k /\ (k c= s /\ s c= Union {mball A m (x,e0) | x :e A, x :e k})

items.name: COMPACT_IN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (compact_in A top s /\ compact_in A top t) -> compact_in A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: COMPACT_IN_KIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k c= A, compact_in A (kification A top) k <-> compact_in A top k

items.name: COMPACT_IN_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_EQ_FCCOVERABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power A, finite c /\ (Union c = mspace A m /\ forall t c= A, t :e c -> connected_in A (mtopology A m) t /\ (compact_in A (mtopology A m) t /\ mdiameter A m t <= e0))

items.name: COMPACT_IN_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_EQ_FCCOVERABLE_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power A, finite c /\ (Union c = mspace A m /\ forall t c= A, t :e c -> connected_in A (mtopology A m) t /\ (compact_in A (mtopology A m) t /\ (locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) t) /\ mdiameter A m t <= e0)))

items.name: COMPACT_IN_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_FCCOVERABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) -> fccoverable_space A m

items.name: COMPACT_IN_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_ULC_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) -> ulc_space A m

items.name: COMPACT_IN_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_ULC_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ (d < e0 /\ forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) < d) -> exists c c= A, connected_in A (mtopology A m) c /\ (x :e c /\ (y :e c /\ c c= mspace A m :/\: (mball A m (x,e0) :/\: mball A m (y,e0)))))

items.name: COMPACT_IN_MSPACE_CFUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, compact_in A top (topspace A top) -> mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) = {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e mspace B m) /\ (f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e topspace A top -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ continuous_map A B (top,mtopology B m) (fun x:set => f x))}

items.name: COMPACT_IN_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e A) -> path_in A top g -> compact_in A top {g x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)}

items.name: COMPACT_IN_PROPER_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall k c= B, proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ compact_in B top' k -> compact_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k}

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N (s :\/: t) /\ 0 < setdist N (s,t) -> compact N s /\ compact N t

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SEQUENCE_WITH_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e A) -> forall l :e A, limit omega A top a l sequentially /\ (s c= {a x | x :e omega} /\ s c= topspace A top) -> compact_in A top (SetAdjoin s l)

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s <-> s c= mspace A m /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> exists l :e A, exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ (l :e s /\ ((forall m0 n :e omega, m0 < n -> r m0 < r n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m) (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) l sequentially))

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, compact_in A top {a} <-> a :e topspace A top

items.name: COMPACT_IN_STANDARD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, compact_in (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) (standard_simplex p)

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN_MSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact_in (R :^: idx N) (mtopology (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s)) s <-> compact N s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, compact_in A top s -> s c= topspace A top

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, compact_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ compact_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, compact_in A (subtopology A top s) t <-> compact_in A top t /\ t c= s

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t <-> t c= s /\ compact N t

items.name: COMPACT_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_IMP_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k s c= A, compact_in A (subtopology A top s) k -> compact_in A top k

items.name: COMPACT_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, compact_in A top s /\ compact_in A top t -> compact_in A top (s :\/: t)

items.name: COMPACT_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, finite f /\ (forall s c= A, s :e f -> compact_in A top s) -> compact_in A top (Union f)

items.name: COMPACT_KC_EQ_MAXIMAL_COMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top -> (kc_space A top <-> forall top' :e topology A, topspace A top' = topspace A top /\ ((forall s c= A, s :e top -> s :e top') /\ compact_space A top') -> top' = top)

items.name: COMPACT_LF_OPEN_NEIGHBORHOOD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall K c= A, forall V c= Power A, compact_in A top K /\ locally_finite_in A top V -> exists N c= A, N :e top /\ (K c= N /\ finite {v :e Power A | v :e V /\ ~ v :/\: N = Empty})

items.name: COMPACT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, compact M s /\ linear M N f -> compact N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: COMPACT_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (compact A {f x | x :e s} <-> compact B s)

items.name: COMPACT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_EQ_FCCCOVERABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite c /\ (Union c = s /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e c -> connected N t /\ (compact N t /\ diameter N t <= e0))

items.name: COMPACT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_EQ_FCCCOVERABLE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite c /\ (Union c = s /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e c -> connected N t /\ (compact N t /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} t /\ diameter N t <= e0)))

items.name: COMPACT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_FCCOVERABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite c /\ (Union c = s /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e c -> connected N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ diameter N t <= e0))

items.name: COMPACT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_ULC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ distance N (x,y) < d) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ (y :e c /\ (c c= s /\ (connected N c /\ (bounded_hl N c /\ diameter N c <= e0))))

items.name: COMPACT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_ULC_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ (d < e0 /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ distance N (x,y) < d) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, connected N c /\ (x :e c /\ (y :e c /\ c c= s :/\: (ball N (x,e0) :/\: ball N (y,e0)))))

items.name: COMPACT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_NEARBY_PATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_space A (mtopology A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) < d) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R, g x0 :e A) /\ (path_in A (mtopology A m) g /\ (g 0 = x /\ (g 1 = y /\ ({g x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)} c= mspace A m /\ mdiameter A m {g x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)} < e0))))

items.name: COMPACT_METRIZABLE_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top /\ (metrizable_space A top /\ locally_connected_space A top) -> locally_path_connected_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_METRIZABLE_PEANO_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top /\ (metrizable_space A top /\ (connected_space A top /\ locally_connected_space A top)) -> path_connected_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> compact N {vector_neg N x | x :e s}

items.name: COMPACT_NEST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx A) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact A (s n) /\ ~ s n = Empty) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n c= s m) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_NESTED_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall c :e Power A :^: omega :^: omega, forall N:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, N x :e omega) -> mcomplete A m /\ ((forall n i :e omega, i <= N n -> c n i c= mspace A m) /\ (forall n i :e omega, i <= N n -> forall x y :e A, x :e c n i /\ y :e c n i -> mdist A m (x,y) < recip_SNo (n + 1))) -> compact_in A (mtopology A m) {x :e A | forall Y :e {Union {closure_of A (mtopology A m) (c n i) | i :e omega, i <= N n} | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}

items.name: COMPACT_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ open N s <-> s = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_PARTITION_CONTAINING_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t t' c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (closed N t /\ (closed N t' /\ (t c= s /\ (t' c= s /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s -> c :/\: t = Empty \/ c :/\: t' = Empty))))) -> exists k k' c= R :^: idx N, compact N k /\ (compact N k' /\ (t c= k /\ (t' c= k' /\ (k :/\: k' = Empty /\ k :\/: k' = s))))

items.name: COMPACT_PARTITION_CONTAINING_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ ~ connected_component N s a b)) -> exists k k' c= R :^: idx N, compact N k /\ (compact N k' /\ (a :e k /\ (b :e k' /\ (k :/\: k' = Empty /\ k :\/: k' = s))))

items.name: COMPACT_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> path A g -> compact A (path_image A g)

items.name: COMPACT_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, compact M s /\ compact N t -> compact (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: COMPACT_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, compact (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ compact M s /\ compact N t)

items.name: COMPACT_QUASI_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ compact_in A top c) -> (c :e quasi_components_of A top <-> c :e connected_components_of A top)

items.name: COMPACT_RELATIVE_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, compact A s -> compact A (s :\: relative_interior A s)

items.name: COMPACT_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> compact N (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: COMPACT_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> compact N (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: COMPACT_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, compact N s -> compact N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s}

items.name: COMPACT_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, compact N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ compact N s

items.name: COMPACT_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, compact N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, compact N (open_segment N (a,b)) <-> a = b

items.name: COMPACT_SEQUENCE_WITH_LIMIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega f l sequentially -> compact N (SetAdjoin {f x | x :e omega} l)

items.name: COMPACT_SEQUENCE_WITH_LIMIT_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega f l sequentially /\ s c= {f x | x :e omega} -> compact N (SetAdjoin s l)

items.name: COMPACT_SHRINK_ENCLOSING_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 0 < r /\ (compact N s /\ s c= ball N (x,r)) -> exists r' :e R, 0 < r' /\ (r' < r /\ s c= ball N (x,r'))

items.name: COMPACT_SHRINK_ENCLOSING_BALL_INFTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, compact N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b * vector_norm N x < 1) -> exists r :e R, 0 < r /\ (b * r < 1 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_norm N x < r)

items.name: COMPACT_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> simple_path A g -> compact A (path_image A g)

items.name: COMPACT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, compact A {a}

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top <-> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top -> exists V c= Power A, finite V /\ (V c= U /\ Union V = topspace A top)

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top)

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top <-> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ topspace A top c= Union U -> exists V c= Power A, finite V /\ (V c= U /\ topspace A top c= Union V)

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_CANTOR_SPACE
items.statement: compact_space (Power omega) cantor_space

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_CONTRACTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, topspace A top' = topspace A top /\ (forall u c= A, u :e top -> u :e top') -> compact_space A top' -> compact_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, compact_space A (discrete_topology A u) <-> finite u

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_EQ_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_space A (mtopology A m) <-> forall s c= A, s c= mspace A m /\ infinite s -> ~ derived_set_of A (mtopology A m) s = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_EQ_MCOMPLETE_TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_space A (mtopology A m) <-> mcomplete A m /\ totally_bounded_in A m (mspace A m)

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact_space (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> compact N s

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_FIP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top <-> forall f c= Power A, (forall c c= A, c :e f -> closed_in A top c) /\ (forall f' c= Power A, finite f' /\ f' c= f -> ~ {x :e A | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = Empty) -> ~ {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_IMP_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, compact_space A top /\ (infinite s /\ s c= topspace A top) -> ~ derived_set_of A top s = Empty

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_IMP_MCOMPLETE

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_IMP_NEST

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_NEST

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_PROPER_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ compact_space B top') -> compact_space A top

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_QUOTIENT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') q /\ compact_space A top -> compact_space B top'

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ compact_space A top -> compact_space B top'

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_space A (mtopology A m) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A m) -> exists l :e A, exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ (l :e mspace A m /\ ((forall m0 n :e omega, m0 < n -> r m0 < r n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m) (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) l sequentially))

items.name: COMPACT_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY

items.name: COMPACT_TUBE_COVER
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall x :e A, forall U c= Power (A :*: B), compact_space B top' /\ (x :e topspace A top /\ ((forall u c= A :*: B, u :e U -> u :e prod_topology A B top top') /\ {x} :*: topspace B top' c= Union U)) -> exists v c= A, exists Ux c= Power (A :*: B), v :e top /\ (x :e v /\ (finite Ux /\ (Ux c= U /\ v :*: topspace B top' c= Union Ux)))

items.name: COMPACT_UNIFORMLY_EQUICONTINUOUS

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, bounded_hl N (f n) /\ (convex N (f n) /\ ~ f n = Empty)) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, N0 <= m /\ N0 <= n -> hausdist N (f m,f n) < e0) -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (hausdist N (f n,s))) (vec 1 0) sequentially))

items.name: COMPLETE_HAUSDIST_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, bounded_hl N (f n) /\ ~ f n = Empty) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, N0 <= m /\ N0 <= n -> hausdist N (f m,f n) < e0) -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (hausdist N (f n,s))) (vec 1 0) sequentially)

items.name: COMPLETE_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, complete M s -> complete N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: COMPLETE_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (complete N {f x | x :e s} <-> complete M s)

items.name: COMPLETE_ISOMETRIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (subspace M s /\ (linear M N f /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> e0 * vector_norm M x <= vector_norm N (f x)) /\ complete M s))) -> complete N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: COMPLETE_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> complete N s

items.name: COMPLETE_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, complete N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> complete N s

items.name: COMPLETE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> complete N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: COMPL_COMPL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, A :\: (A :\: s) = s

items.name: COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, x :e SetAdjoin s x

items.name: COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENT_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: frontier N s) = components N (interior N s) :\/: components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: closure N s)

items.name: COMPONENTS_CONVEX_COMPLEMENT_CONTAINS_HALFSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} c= c

items.name: COMPONENTS_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> components A Empty = Empty

items.name: COMPONENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c c' c= R :^: idx A, c :e components A s /\ c' :e components A s -> (c = c' <-> ~ c :/\: c' = Empty)

items.name: COMPONENTS_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, components A s = Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: COMPONENTS_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, components N s = {s} <-> connected N s /\ ~ s = Empty

items.name: COMPONENTS_EQ_SING_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (exists a c= R :^: idx N, components N s = {a}) <-> connected N s /\ ~ s = Empty

items.name: COMPONENTS_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> components N s = {{x} | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}

items.name: COMPONENTS_INTERMEDIATE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, s :e components N u /\ (s c= t /\ t c= u) -> s :e components N t

items.name: COMPONENTS_INTER_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c d c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s /\ d :e components N (t :/\: c) -> d :e components N (t :/\: s)

items.name: COMPONENTS_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx A, exists x :e R :^: idx B, f x = y)) -> components A {f x | x :e s} = {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e components B s}

items.name: COMPONENTS_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s /\ (connected N t /\ (t c= s /\ ~ c :/\: t = Empty)) -> t c= c

items.name: COMPONENTS_NONOVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c c' c= R :^: idx A, c :e components A s /\ c' :e components A s -> (c :/\: c' = Empty <-> ~ c = c')

items.name: COMPONENTS_OPEN_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e f -> open N c /\ (connected N c /\ ~ c = Empty)) /\ ((forall x y :e f, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ Union f = s) -> components N s = f

items.name: COMPONENTS_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, components (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ c :e Power (R :^: idx M), {(\/_ x :e c, {pastecart M N x y | y :e d}) | d :e Power (R :^: idx N), c :e components M s /\ d :e components N t}

items.name: COMPONENTS_SEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :/\: closure N t = Empty /\ t :/\: closure N s = Empty -> components N (s :\/: t) = components N s :\/: components N t

items.name: COMPONENTS_SUBSETS_CLOPEN_PARTITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (finite u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (u c= components N s /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e u -> compact N c)))) -> exists f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: Power (R :^: idx N), (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e u -> f c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (f c) /\ c c= f c)) /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> ~ f x = f y) /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> f x :/\: f y = Empty) /\ Union {f x | x :e u} = s))

items.name: COMPONENTS_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, components A {vector_add A a x | x :e s} = {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e {vector_add A a x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e components A s}

items.name: COMPONENTS_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= Power (R :^: idx N), Union k = s /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e k -> connected N c /\ (~ c = Empty /\ forall c' c= R :^: idx N, connected N c' /\ (c c= c' /\ c' c= s) -> c' = c)) -> components N s = k

items.name: COMPONENTS_UNIQUE_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, connected N c1 /\ (connected N c2 /\ (c1 :\/: c2 = s /\ ~ connected N s)) -> components N s = {c1,c2}

items.name: COMPONENTS_UNIQUE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= Power (R :^: idx N), components N s = k <-> Union k = s /\ forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e k -> connected N c /\ (~ c = Empty /\ forall c' c= R :^: idx N, connected N c' /\ (c c= c' /\ c' c= s) -> c' = c)

items.name: COMPONENTS_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> components N (R :^: idx N) = {R :^: idx N}

items.name: COMPONENT_CLOPEN_HAUSDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (c :e components N s /\ compact N c)) -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (compact N k /\ (c c= k /\ hausdist N (c,k) < e0))

items.name: COMPONENT_CLOPEN_HAUSDIST_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (c :e components N s /\ compact N c)) -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (compact N k /\ (c c= k /\ k c= \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x d | d :e R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ d :e ball N (vec N 0,e0)}))

items.name: COMPONENT_COMPLEMENT_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (connected N u /\ (s c= u /\ c :e components N (u :\: s))) -> connected N (u :\: c)

items.name: COMPONENT_INTERMEDIATE_CLOPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, t :e components N s /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (t c= u /\ (dimindex N = 1 \/ ((exists r c= R :^: idx 1, homeomorphic 1 N s r) \/ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s \/ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ compact N t))))) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) c /\ (c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (t c= c /\ c c= u))

items.name: COMPONENT_LE_INFNORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) <= infnorm N x

items.name: COMPONENT_LE_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, abs_SNo (x i) <= vector_norm N x

items.name: COMPONENT_LE_ONORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i j :e omega, linear M N f -> abs_SNo (matrix M N f i j) <= onorm M N f

items.name: COMPONENT_LE_PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall x1 :e A, forall y1 :e B, forall x2 :e A, forall y2 :e B, mdist A m1 (x1,x2) <= mdist (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) ((x1,y1),(x2,y2)) /\ mdist B m2 (y1,y2) <= mdist (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) ((x1,y1),(x2,y2))

items.name: COMPONENT_RETRACT_COMPLEMENT_MEETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (retract_of N s t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s))) -> ~ c c= t

items.name: CONDENSATION_POINTS_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | condensation_point_of N x s} = Empty <-> countable s

items.name: CONDENSATION_POINT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, condensation_point_of N x s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, countable t -> limit_point_of N x (s :\: t)

items.name: CONDENSATION_POINT_IMP_LIMPT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, condensation_point_of A x s -> limit_point_of A x s

items.name: CONDENSATION_POINT_INFINITE_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, condensation_point_of N x s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> ~ countable (s :/\: ball N (x,e0))

items.name: CONDENSATION_POINT_INFINITE_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, condensation_point_of N x s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> ~ countable (s :/\: cball N (x,e0))

items.name: CONDENSATION_POINT_OF_CONDENSATION_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, condensation_point_of N x {y :e R :^: idx N | condensation_point_of N y s} <-> condensation_point_of N x s

items.name: CONDENSATION_POINT_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, condensation_point_of N x s /\ s c= t -> condensation_point_of N x t

items.name: COND_ABS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall b:prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if b then f x else g x) = if b then f x else g x

items.name: COND_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall t1 t2 :e A, (if True then t1 else t2) = t1 /\ (if False then t1 else t2) = t2

items.name: COND_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall b:prop, forall x y :e A :^: idx B, forall i :e omega, (if b then x else y) i = if b then x i else y i

items.name: COND_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall t:prop, forall t1 t2 :e A, (if t then t1 else t2) = choose_in A (fun x:set => ((t <-> True) -> x = t1) /\ ((t <-> False) -> x = t2))

items.name: COND_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall c:prop, forall x y :e A, P (if c then x else y) <-> (c -> P x) /\ (~ c -> P y)

items.name: COND_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b:prop, forall t :e A, (if b then t else t) = t

items.name: COND_RAND
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall b:prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x y :e A, f (if b then x else y) = if b then f x else f y

items.name: COND_RATOR
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall b:prop, forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (if b then f x else g x) = if b then f x else g x

items.name: COND_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:prop, forall x y :e A, (if ~ p then x else y) = if p then y else x

items.name: CONG
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> mod_nat x n = mod_nat y n

items.name: CONGRUENT_IMAGE_STD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> permutes omega p (idx N) -> {x :e R :^: idx N | 0 <= x (p 1) /\ (x (p (dimindex N)) <= 1 /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i < dimindex N -> x (p i) <= x (p (i + 1)))} = {(fun i :e idx N => finsum (idx_n (inverse omega omega p i)) (fun j:set => x j)) | x :e {x :e R :^: idx N | (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 <= x i) /\ finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => x i) <= 1}}

items.name: CONG_DIV2
items.statement: forall a b m n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + (m * n) * q1 = b + (m * n) * q2) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, div_nat a m + n * q1 = div_nat b m + n * q2

items.name: CONG_LMOD
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, mod_nat x n + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2

items.name: CONG_MULT_LCANCEL_IFF
items.statement: forall a n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> ((forall x y :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, a * x + n * q1 = a * y + n * q2) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> gcd_int a n = 1)

items.name: CONG_MULT_RCANCEL_IFF
items.statement: forall a n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> ((forall x y :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x * a + n * q1 = y * a + n * q2) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> gcd_int a n = 1)

items.name: CONG_NPRODUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, f x + n * q1 = g x + n * q2) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, finprod s f + n * q1 = finprod s g + n * q2

items.name: CONG_NSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, f x + n * q1 = g x + n * q2) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, finsum s f + n * q1 = finsum s g + n * q2

items.name: CONG_RMOD
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = mod_nat y n + n * q2) <-> exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2

items.name: CONIC_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s -> conic N (closure N s)

items.name: CONIC_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, conic A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | conic A x} s)

items.name: CONIC_CONTAINS_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s -> (vec N 0 :e s <-> ~ s = Empty)

items.name: CONIC_CONVEX_CONE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, conic A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex_cone A x} s)

items.name: CONIC_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s -> conic N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: CONIC_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> conic A Empty

items.name: CONIC_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, conic A {x :e R :^: idx A | 0 <= dot A a x}

items.name: CONIC_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, conic A {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x <= 0}

items.name: CONIC_HULLS_EQ_IMP_SPANS_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} t -> span N s = span N t

items.name: CONIC_HULL_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | conic A x} {vec A 0} = {vec A 0}

items.name: CONIC_HULL_AS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s = {vector_mul N (drop (fstcart 1 z)) (sndcart 1 N z) | z :e \/_ x :e {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 <= drop t}, {pastecart 1 N x y | y :e s}}

items.name: CONIC_HULL_CONTAINS_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s <-> ~ s = Empty

items.name: CONIC_HULL_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)

items.name: CONIC_HULL_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ t c= s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (s :\: t) = if t = s then Empty else hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s :\: (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} t :\: {vec N 0})

items.name: CONIC_HULL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | conic A x} Empty = Empty

items.name: CONIC_HULL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | conic A x} s = s <-> conic A s

items.name: CONIC_HULL_EQ_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: CONIC_HULL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | conic A x} s = Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: CONIC_HULL_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x0} s = {x} <-> s = {vec N 0} /\ x = vec N 0

items.name: CONIC_HULL_EQ_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s = span N s

items.name: CONIC_HULL_EQ_SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) <-> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s = span N s

items.name: CONIC_HULL_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s = \/_ c :e R, {vector_mul N c x | x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= c /\ x :e s}

items.name: CONIC_HULL_IMAGE_SCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 < c x) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} {vector_mul N (c x) x | x :e s} = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s

items.name: CONIC_HULL_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (s :\/: t) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (s :/\: t) = if s :/\: t = Empty then Empty else hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} t

items.name: CONIC_HULL_INTER_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, f c= s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} f :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = f

items.name: CONIC_HULL_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | conic A x} {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e hull (R :^: idx B) {x :e Power (R :^: idx B) | conic B x} s}

items.name: CONIC_HULL_POINTLESS_AS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s :\: {vec N 0} = {vector_mul N (drop (fstcart 1 z)) (sndcart 1 N z) | z :e \/_ x :e {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 < drop t}, {pastecart 1 N x y | y :e s :\: {vec N 0}}}

items.name: CONIC_HULL_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (relative_frontier N s) = if exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a} then Empty else relative_frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)

items.name: CONIC_HULL_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (relative_interior N s) = if relative_interior N s = Empty then Empty else SetAdjoin (relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)) (vec N 0)

items.name: CONIC_HULL_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (relative_interior N s) :\: {vec N 0} c= relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)

items.name: CONIC_HULL_SUBSET_CONVEX_CONE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | conic A x} s c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex_cone A x} s

items.name: CONIC_HULL_SUBSET_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s c= span N s

items.name: CONIC_HULL_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (R :^: idx N) = R :^: idx N

items.name: CONIC_IMAGE_MULTIPLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, conic N s /\ 0 < a -> {vector_mul N a x | x :e s} = s

items.name: CONIC_IMAGE_MULTIPLE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s <-> forall a :e R, 0 <= a -> {vector_mul N a x | x :e s} c= s

items.name: CONIC_IMP_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s -> connected N s

items.name: CONIC_IMP_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s -> contractible N s

items.name: CONIC_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s -> path_connected N s

items.name: CONIC_IMP_SIMPLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s -> simply_connected N s

items.name: CONIC_IMP_STARLIKE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> starlike N s

items.name: CONIC_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s /\ vec N 0 :e interior N s -> conic N (interior N s)

items.name: CONIC_INTERIOR_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s -> conic N (SetAdjoin (interior N s) (vec N 0))

items.name: CONIC_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), (forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e f -> conic A s) -> conic A {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: CONIC_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, conic A s /\ linear A B f -> conic B {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONIC_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (conic A {f x | x :e s} <-> conic B s)

items.name: CONIC_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, conic N s /\ (x :e s /\ 0 <= c) -> vector_mul N c x :e s

items.name: CONIC_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, conic A s -> conic A {vector_neg A x | x :e s}

items.name: CONIC_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, conic M s /\ conic N t -> conic (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: CONIC_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, conic (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ conic M s /\ conic N t)

items.name: CONIC_POSITIVE_ORTHANT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> conic N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 <= x i}

items.name: CONIC_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s /\ vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s -> conic N (relative_interior N s)

items.name: CONIC_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, conic N s -> conic N (SetAdjoin (relative_interior N s) (vec N 0))

items.name: CONIC_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, conic A (span A s)

items.name: CONIC_SUBSET_AS_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, conic N c /\ (~ c = {vec N 0} /\ c c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (s :/\: c) = c

items.name: CONIC_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, conic N s /\ conic N t -> conic N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: CONIC_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> conic N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: CONJ_ASSOC
items.statement: forall t1 t2 t3:prop, t1 /\ (t2 /\ t3) <-> t1 /\ t2 /\ t3

items.name: CONJ_SYM
items.statement: forall t1 t2:prop, t1 /\ t2 <-> t2 /\ t1

items.name: CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= R :^: idx N, open N e1 /\ (open N e2 /\ (s c= e1 :\/: e2 /\ (e1 :/\: e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 :/\: s = Empty /\ ~ e2 :/\: s = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N {a,b} <-> a = b

items.name: CONNECTED_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, connected N s -> connected N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: CONNECTED_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, connected N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ connected N s

items.name: CONNECTED_ANNULUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r1 r2 :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | r1 < vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) < r2}) /\ ((forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r1 r2 :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | r1 < vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) <= r2}) /\ ((forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r1 r2 :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | r1 <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) < r2}) /\ forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r1 r2 :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | r1 <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) < r2}))

items.name: CONNECTED_ARC_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> 2 <= dimindex N /\ arc N p -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: path_image N p)

items.name: CONNECTED_ARC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> arc A g -> connected A (path_image A g)

items.name: CONNECTED_ARC_IMAGE_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, arc N g /\ a :e path_image N g -> (connected N (path_image N g :\: {a}) <-> a :e {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g})

items.name: CONNECTED_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, connected N (ball N (x,e0))

items.name: CONNECTED_CARD_EQ_IFF_NONTRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> (equip s R <-> ~ exists a :e R :^: idx N, s c= {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_CARD_LT_IFF_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> (atleastp s R /\ ~ equip s R <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, s c= {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, connected N (cball N (x,e0))

items.name: CONNECTED_CHAIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> compact N s /\ connected N s) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: CONNECTED_CHAIN_GEN
