items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed N s /\ connected N s) /\ ((exists s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ compact N s) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s)) -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: CONNECTED_CLOPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, connected A s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx A, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) t -> t = Empty \/ t = s

items.name: CONNECTED_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= R :^: idx N, closed N e1 /\ (closed N e2 /\ (s c= e1 :\/: e2 /\ (e1 :/\: (e2 :/\: s) = Empty /\ (~ e1 :/\: s = Empty /\ ~ e2 :/\: s = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, connected A s <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= R :^: idx A, closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) e1 /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) e2 /\ (s c= e1 :\/: e2 /\ (e1 :/\: e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ ~ e2 = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_CLOSED_IN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, connected A s <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= R :^: idx A, closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) e1 /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) e2 /\ (e1 :\/: e2 = s /\ (e1 :/\: e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ ~ e2 = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_CLOSED_MONOTONE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}))) -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, connected N c /\ c c= t -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e c}

items.name: CONNECTED_CLOSED_POINTIMAGES_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx 1, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c c= s /\ connected N c -> connected 1 {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx 1, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}))) -> continuous_on_hl N 1 f s

items.name: CONNECTED_CLOSED_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> (connected N s <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= R :^: idx N, closed N e1 /\ (closed N e2 /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ (~ e2 = Empty /\ (e1 :\/: e2 = s /\ e1 :/\: e2 = Empty)))))

items.name: CONNECTED_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> connected N (closure N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_CLOSURE_FROM_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N (frontier N s) -> connected N (closure N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPACT_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, connected 1 s /\ compact 1 s <-> exists a b :e R :^: idx 1, s = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (compact N s /\ AR N s) -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_BOUNDED_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ convex N s) -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_COMPACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (homeomorphic M N s t /\ (convex M t /\ compact M t)) -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_SUBSET_CIRCLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, dimindex N = 2 /\ s c= sphere N (a,r) -> (connected N (sphere N (a,r) :\: s) <-> connected N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_SUBSET_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simple_path N g /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N g /\ s c= path_image N g) -> (connected N (path_image N g :\: s) <-> connected N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s a b <-> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s /\ (a :e c /\ b :e c)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top -> connected_components_of A top = if topspace A top = Empty then Empty else {topspace A top}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, connected_components_of A (discrete_topology A u) = {{x} | x :e A, x :e u}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c' c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top /\ c' :e connected_components_of A top -> (c :/\: c' = Empty <-> ~ c = c')

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_EMPTY_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> connected_components_of A top = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_components_of A top = Empty <-> topspace A top = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_components_of A top = {s} <-> connected_space A top /\ (~ topspace A top = Empty /\ s = topspace A top)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top /\ (connected_in A top s /\ ~ c :/\: s = Empty) -> s c= c

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c' c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top /\ c' :e connected_components_of A top -> (~ c :/\: c' = Empty <-> c = c')

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> connected_components_of (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = {{f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e c i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} | c :e Power A :^: K, forall i :e K, i :e k -> c i :e connected_components_of A (tops i)}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, connected_components_of (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = \/_ c1 :e Power A, {c1 :*: c2 | c2 :e Power B, c1 :e connected_components_of A top1 /\ c2 :e connected_components_of B top2}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top -> c c= topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_SUBSET_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_components_of A top c= {s} <-> connected_space A top /\ (topspace A top = Empty \/ topspace A top = s)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top /\ c c= u -> c :e connected_components_of A (subtopology A top u)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, connected_component 1 s a b <-> closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_1_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 -> (connected_component N s a b <-> closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_DIFF_CLOSED_NONSEPARATED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ (closed N t /\ (t c= s /\ (~ t = Empty /\ c :e components N (s :\: t))))) -> ~ closure N c :/\: t = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_DIFF_NONSEPARATED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ (t c= s /\ (~ t = Empty /\ c :e components N (s :\: t)))) -> ~ closure N c :/\: closure N t = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_DIFF_NONSEPARATED_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s /\ c :e components N t)) -> ~ closure N c :/\: closure N (s :\: t) = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a b :e R :^: idx A, {x :e R :^: idx A | connected_component A s a x} :/\: {x :e R :^: idx A | connected_component A s b x} = Empty <-> ~ a :e {x :e R :^: idx A | connected_component A s b x}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x x0 :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A Empty x x0 <-> x0 :e Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, y :e {x0 :e R :^: idx A | connected_component A s x x0} -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A s y x0 <-> connected_component A s x x0

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EQUIVALENCE_RELATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, R0 x y -> R0 y x) /\ ((forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ (forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (a :e t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> R0 a x))) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s a b -> R0 a b

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x0 <-> x0 :e Empty) <-> ~ x :e s

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EQ_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x0 <-> connected_component N s y x0) <-> ~ x :e s /\ ~ y :e s \/ x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ connected_component N s x y)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, connected A s /\ x :e s -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A s x x0 <-> x0 :e s

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EQ_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x0 <-> x0 :e R :^: idx N) <-> s = R :^: idx N

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EQ_WELLCHAINED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, compact N s -> (connected_component N s a b <-> a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> distance N (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))))

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, finite s -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x0 <-> (x :e s -> x0 :e SetAdjoin Empty x) /\ (~ x :e s -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_IDEMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N {x1 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x1} x x0 <-> connected_component N s x x0

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_IMP_WELLCHAINED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ connected_component N s a b -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> distance N (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A s x y -> x :e s /\ y :e s

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N (inside N s) a x <-> (a :e inside N s -> connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) a x) /\ (~ a :e inside N s -> x :e Empty)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_INTERMEDIATE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t u c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N u a x} c= t /\ t c= u -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N t a x <-> connected_component N u a x

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_IN_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0} :e components N s <-> x :e s

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, {x :e A | connected_component_of A top a x} :e connected_components_of A top <-> a :e topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, connected_component_of A top x y -> x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_LIMIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (tendsto N omega x a sequentially /\ (tendsto N omega y b sequentially /\ eventually omega {n :e omega | connected_component N s (x n) (y n)} sequentially)) -> connected_component N s a b

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall x :e R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ ((forall x0 y :e R :^: idx B, f x0 = f y -> x0 = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx A, exists x0 :e R :^: idx B, f x0 = y)) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A {f x | x :e s} (f x) x0 <-> x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e {x1 :e R :^: idx B | connected_component B s x x1}}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ (connected N t /\ t c= s) -> t c= {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, s c= t -> {x0 :e R :^: idx A | connected_component A s x x0} c= {x0 :e R :^: idx A | connected_component A t x x0}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_NONOVERLAP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s a x} :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s b x} = Empty <-> ~ a :e s \/ (~ b :e s \/ ~ forall x :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s a x <-> connected_component N s b x)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x y :e A, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ connected_component_of A top x y -> connected_component_of B top' (f x) (f y)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= A, forall x x0 :e A, connected_component_of A (discrete_topology A u) x x0 <-> (x :e u -> x0 :e SetAdjoin Empty x) /\ (~ x :e u -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top y x0} = Empty <-> ~ connected_component_of A top x y

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, (forall x0 :e A, connected_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top y x0) <-> ~ x :e topspace A top /\ ~ y :e topspace A top \/ x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ connected_component_of A top x y)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_EQUIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, connected_component_of A top x y <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ forall x0 :e A, connected_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top y x0)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, (forall x0 :e A, connected_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e Empty) <-> ~ x :e topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_EQ_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, (forall x0 :e A, connected_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top y x0) <-> ~ x :e topspace A top /\ ~ y :e topspace A top \/ ~ {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top y x0} = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_EQ_WELLCHAINED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall K c= A, forall a b :e A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) K -> (connected_component_of A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) K) a b <-> a :e K /\ (b :e K /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e A) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e K) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> mdist A m (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))))

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) x x0 <-> connected_component N s x x0

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_IMP_WELLCHAINED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall a b :e A, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ connected_component_of A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) a b -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e A) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> mdist A m (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, connected_in A top s /\ x :e s -> s c= {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall x y :e A, connected_component_of A (subtopology A top s) x y /\ s c= t -> connected_component_of A (subtopology A top t) x y

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_NONOVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top y x0} = Empty <-> ~ x :e topspace A top \/ (~ y :e topspace A top \/ ~ forall x0 :e A, connected_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top y x0)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, ~ {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top y x0} = Empty <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ forall x0 :e A, connected_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top y x0)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_PAIR
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall x0 :e A :*: B, connected_component_of (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (x,y) x0 <-> x0 :e {x1 :e A | connected_component_of A top1 x x1} :*: {x1 :e B | connected_component_of B top2 y x1}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall x x0 :e A :^: K, connected_component_of (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) x x0 <-> ((forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e k -> x x0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) -> x0 :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x2 :e A | connected_component_of A (tops i) (x i) x2}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}) /\ (~ (forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e k -> x x0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, connected_component_of A top x x <-> x :e topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x x0 :e A, connected_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e {y :e A | exists t c= A, connected_in A top t /\ (x :e t /\ y :e t)}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall y :e R :^: idx A, forall s t c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, s c= t /\ connected_component A s x y -> connected_component A t x y

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0} c= topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, connected_component_of A (subtopology A top s) x y -> connected_component_of A top x y

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, forall x :e A, (forall x0 :e A, connected_component_of A (subtopology A top u) x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top x x0) <-> {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0} c= u

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, connected_component_of A top x y <-> connected_component_of A top y x

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y z :e A, connected_component_of A top x y /\ connected_component_of A top y z -> connected_component_of A top x z

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, forall x :e A, x :e c /\ (connected_in A top c /\ (forall c' c= A, x :e c' /\ connected_in A top c' -> c' c= c)) -> forall x0 :e A, connected_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e c

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N (outside N s) a x <-> (a :e outside N s -> connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) a x) /\ (~ a :e outside N s -> x :e Empty)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s a x} :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s b x} = Empty <-> a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s a x <-> connected_component N s b x)

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), connected_component (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (pastecart M N a b) x <-> x :e \/_ x :e {x0 :e R :^: idx M | connected_component M s a x0}, {pastecart M N x y | y :e {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N t b x0}}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> connected_component N s x x

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x <-> x :e s

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, s :/\: closure N t = Empty /\ t :/\: closure N s = Empty -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N (s :\/: t) x x0 <-> (x :e s -> connected_component N s x x0) /\ (~ x :e s -> (x :e t -> connected_component N t x x0) /\ (~ x :e t -> x0 :e Empty))

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x x0 :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A s x x0 <-> x0 :e {y :e R :^: idx A | exists t c= R :^: idx A, connected A t /\ (t c= s /\ (x :e t /\ y :e t))}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, {x0 :e R :^: idx A | connected_component A s x x0} c= s

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SUBSET_QUASI_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0} c= {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x y -> connected_component N s y x

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SYM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A s x y <-> connected_component A s y x

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall z :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x y /\ connected_component N s y z -> connected_component N s x z

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x x0 :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A {vector_add A a x1 | x1 :e s} (vector_add A a x) x0 <-> x0 :e {vector_add A a x1 | x1 :e {x1 :e R :^: idx A | connected_component A s x x1}}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x x0 :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A s x x0 <-> x0 :e Union {t :e Power (R :^: idx A) | connected A t /\ (x :e t /\ t c= s)}

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ (c c= s /\ (connected N c /\ (forall c' c= R :^: idx N, x :e c' /\ (c' c= s /\ connected N c') -> c' c= c))) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x0 <-> x0 :e c

items.name: CONNECTED_COMPONENT_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N (R :^: idx N) x x0 <-> x0 :e R :^: idx N

items.name: CONNECTED_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, connected A {x0 :e R :^: idx A | connected_component A s x x0}

items.name: CONNECTED_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x0 <-> x0 :e s

items.name: CONNECTED_CONNECTED_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s c= closure N (s :\: t) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ connected N (u :\: t)))) -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_CONNECTED_IMP_CLOSED_POINTIMAGES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ connected M c -> connected N {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}

items.name: CONNECTED_CONNECTED_POINTIMAGES_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx 1, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c c= s /\ connected N c -> connected 1 {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx 1, connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}))) -> continuous_on_hl N 1 f s

items.name: CONNECTED_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ connected M s -> connected N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONNECTED_CONVEX_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, connected 1 s <-> convex 1 s

items.name: CONNECTED_CONVEX_1_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 -> (connected N s <-> convex N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_CONVEX_DIFF_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx A, convex A u /\ (~ collinear A u /\ (atleastp s R /\ ~ equip s R)) -> connected A (u :\: s)

items.name: CONNECTED_CONVEX_DIFF_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx A, convex A u /\ (~ collinear A u /\ countable s) -> connected A (u :\: s)

items.name: CONNECTED_CONVEX_DIFF_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ dimension N t <= aff_dim N s + - 2 -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_DELETE_INTERIOR_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (connected N s /\ a :e interior N s) -> connected N (s :\: {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_DELETE_INTERIOR_POINT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ a :e interior N s -> (connected N (s :\: {a}) <-> connected N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_DIFF_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (connected N s /\ cball N (a,r) c= s) -> connected N (s :\: ball N (a,r))

items.name: CONNECTED_DIFF_OPEN_FROM_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (t c= u /\ (open N s /\ (closed N t /\ (connected N u /\ connected N (t :\: s))))) -> connected N (u :\: s)

items.name: CONNECTED_DIMENSION_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> (dimension N s = 0 <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_DISJOINT_UNIONS_OPEN_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall x y :e f, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ ((forall x y :e f', x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> open N s /\ (connected N s /\ ~ s = Empty)) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f' -> open N s /\ (connected N s /\ ~ s = Empty)) /\ Union f = Union f'))) -> f = f'

items.name: CONNECTED_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> connected A Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_EQUIVALENCE_RELATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, R0 x y -> R0 y x) /\ ((forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ (forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (a :e t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> R0 a x)))) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e s -> R0 a b

items.name: CONNECTED_EQUIVALENCE_RELATION_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, R0 x y -> R0 y x) /\ ((forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ a :e t -> exists z :e R :^: idx N, z :e t /\ P z) /\ (forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (a :e t /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ (P x /\ P y)) -> R0 x y))))) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (P a /\ P b)) -> R0 a b

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_CARD_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> finite (components N s) /\ finite_cardinality (components N s) <= 1

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_COMPONENTS_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> s = Empty \/ components N s = {s}

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_COMPONENTS_SING_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> s = Empty \/ exists a c= R :^: idx N, components N s = {a}

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_COMPONENTS_SUBSET_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> components N s c= {s}

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_COMPONENTS_SUBSET_SING_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> exists a c= R :^: idx N, components N s c= {a}

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_COMPONENT_DELETE_NONSEPARATED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, (compact N s \/ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s \/ finite (components N (s :\: {a})))) /\ a :e s -> (connected N s <-> forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N (s :\: {a}) -> a :e closure N c)

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_COMPONENT_DIFF_CLOSED_NONSEPARATED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (closed N t /\ (connected N t /\ (t c= s /\ ~ t = Empty))) -> (connected N s <-> forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N (s :\: t) -> ~ closure N c :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, connected A s <-> forall c c' c= R :^: idx A, c :e components A s /\ c' :e components A s -> c = c'

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, connected A s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A s x x0 <-> connected_component A s y x0

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_NONSEPARATED_CLOSED_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, (compact N u \/ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} u) /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (connected N s /\ ~ s = Empty)) -> (connected N u <-> forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N (u :\: s) -> ~ s :/\: closure N c = Empty)

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_WELLCHAINED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> (connected N s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e s -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> distance N (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0)))

items.name: CONNECTED_EQ_WELLCHAINED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s -> (connected_in A (mtopology A m) s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> forall a b :e A, a :e s /\ b :e s -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e A) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> mdist A m (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0)))

items.name: CONNECTED_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, connected_space (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n)

items.name: CONNECTED_FINITE_EQ_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> (finite s <-> aff_dim N s <= 0)

items.name: CONNECTED_FINITE_IFF_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> (finite s <-> countable s)

items.name: CONNECTED_FINITE_IFF_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> (finite s <-> s = Empty \/ exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_FROM_CLOSED_UNION_AND_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ (connected N (s :\/: t) /\ connected N (s :/\: t))) -> connected N s /\ connected N t

items.name: CONNECTED_FROM_CLOSED_UNION_AND_INTER_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ (connected N (s :\/: t) /\ connected N (s :/\: t))) -> connected N s /\ connected N t

items.name: CONNECTED_FROM_OPEN_UNION_AND_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (open N t /\ (connected N (s :\/: t) /\ connected N (s :/\: t))) -> connected N s /\ connected N t

items.name: CONNECTED_FROM_OPEN_UNION_AND_INTER_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (connected N (s :\/: t) /\ connected N (s :/\: t))) -> connected N s /\ connected N t

items.name: CONNECTED_FULL_CONVEX_DIFF_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ interior N s = Empty /\ dimension N t <= dimindex N + - 2) -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_FULL_REGULAR_DIFF_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= closure N (interior N s) /\ (connected N (interior N s) /\ dimension N t <= dimindex N + - 2) -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_HAUSDIST_LIMIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall k c= R :^: idx N, (forall n :e omega, bounded_hl N (s n) /\ (connected N (s n) /\ ~ s n = Empty)) /\ (compact N k /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (hausdist N (s n,k))) (vec 1 0) sequentially) -> connected N k

items.name: CONNECTED_IFF_CONNECTABLE_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, connected N t /\ (t c= s /\ (a :e t /\ b :e t))

items.name: CONNECTED_IFF_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, connected A s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> connected_component A s x y

items.name: CONNECTED_IMP_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s) -> connected_component N s a b

items.name: CONNECTED_IMP_NONSEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N (s :\/: t) -> setdist N (s,t) = 0

items.name: CONNECTED_IMP_PERFECT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a}) /\ x :e s) -> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: CONNECTED_IMP_PERFECT_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (~ aff_dim N s = 0 /\ x :e s) -> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: CONNECTED_IMP_PERFECT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, connected A s /\ (closed A s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx A, s = {a})) -> (limit_point_of A x s <-> x :e s)

items.name: CONNECTED_IMP_QUASI_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, connected_component_of A top x y -> quasi_component_of A top x y

items.name: CONNECTED_IMP_WELLCHAINED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (0 < e0 /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s)) -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> distance N (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))

items.name: CONNECTED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ ~ exists e1 e2 c= A, e1 :e top /\ (e2 :e top /\ (s c= e1 :\/: e2 /\ (e1 :/\: (e2 :/\: s) = Empty /\ (~ e1 :/\: s = Empty /\ ~ e2 :/\: s = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_INDUCTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ a :e t -> exists z :e R :^: idx N, z :e t /\ P z) /\ (forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (a :e t /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ (P x /\ (P y /\ Q x))) -> Q y))) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (P a /\ (P b /\ Q a))) -> Q b

items.name: CONNECTED_INDUCTION_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (a :e t /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ P x) -> P y)) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ P a) -> P b

items.name: CONNECTED_INFINITE_IFF_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> (infinite s <-> equip s R)

items.name: CONNECTED_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, connected N s -> (connected N (SetAdjoin s a) <-> s = Empty \/ a :e closure N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_INSERT_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, compact N (SetAdjoin s a) -> (connected N (SetAdjoin s a) <-> forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s -> a :e closure N c)

items.name: CONNECTED_INSERT_LIMPT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ limit_point_of N a s -> connected N (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: CONNECTED_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s c= t /\ t c= closure N s) -> connected N t

items.name: CONNECTED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N (open_interval N (a,b))

items.name: CONNECTED_INTER_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (~ s :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ s :\: t = Empty) -> ~ s :/\: frontier N t = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_INTER_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t /\ (~ s :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ s :\: t = Empty)) -> ~ s :/\: relative_frontier N t = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_ABSOLUTE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A (subtopology A top s) s <-> connected_in A top s

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, connected_in (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> connected_in A (tops i) (s i)

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (~ f = Empty /\ ((forall s c= A, s :e f -> compact_in A top s /\ connected_in A top s) /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s))) -> connected_in A top {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CHAIN_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, hausdorff_space A top /\ ((forall s c= A, s :e f -> closed_in A top s /\ connected_in A top s) /\ ((exists s c= A, s :e f /\ compact_in A top s) /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s))) -> connected_in A top {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CHAIN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c :e Power A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, i <= n -> connected_in A top (c i)) /\ (forall i :e omega, i < n -> ~ c i :/\: c (ordsucc i) = Empty) -> connected_in A top (Union {c i | i :e omega, i <= n})

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CLOPEN_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c t c= A, connected_in A top c /\ (closed_in A top t /\ t :e top) -> c c= t \/ c :/\: t = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ ~ exists e1 e2 c= A, closed_in A top e1 /\ (closed_in A top e2 /\ (s c= e1 :\/: e2 /\ (e1 :/\: (e2 :/\: s) = Empty /\ (~ e1 :/\: s = Empty /\ ~ e2 :/\: s = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s -> connected_in A top (closure_of A top s)

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top -> connected_in A top c

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, connected_in A top {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ connected_in A top s -> connected_in B top' {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, connected_in (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ connected_in A top1 s /\ connected_in B top2 t)

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, connected_in A (discrete_topology A u) s <-> s c= u /\ exists a :e A, s c= {a}

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_in A top Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_EQ_NOT_SEPARATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ ~ exists c1 c2 c= A, c1 :\/: c2 = s /\ (~ c1 = Empty /\ (~ c2 = Empty /\ separated_in A top c1 c2))

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_EQ_NOT_SEPARATED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ ~ exists c1 c2 c= A, s c= c1 :\/: c2 /\ (~ s :/\: c1 = Empty /\ (~ s :/\: c2 = Empty /\ separated_in A top c1 c2))

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_EQ_SUBSET_SEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, connected_in A top c <-> c c= topspace A top /\ forall s t c= A, separated_in A top s t /\ c c= s :\/: t -> c c= s \/ c c= t

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s <-> connected N s

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, connected_in R euclideanreal s <-> is_realinterval s

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_EUCLIDEANREAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, connected_in R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R, connected_in R euclideanreal (open_real_interval (a,b))

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_EUCLIDEAN_COMPLEMENTS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall s t c= R :^: omega, closed_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) t /\ homeomorphic_space (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) s) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) t)) -> (connected_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) (topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) :\: s) <-> connected_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) (topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) :\: t))

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_IFF_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> connected_component_of A (subtopology A top s) x y

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_IMP_PERFECT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (connected_in A top s /\ ~ (exists a :e A, s = {a})) -> s c= derived_set_of A top s

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_IMP_PERFECT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, t1_space A top /\ (connected_in A top s /\ ~ (exists a :e A, s = {a})) -> s c= derived_set_of A top s

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_IMP_WELLCHAINED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall e0 :e R, forall a b :e A, connected_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ (0 < e0 /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s)) -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e A) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> mdist A m (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, connected_in A top s /\ (s c= t /\ t c= closure_of A top s) -> connected_in A top t

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_INTER_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, connected_in A top s /\ (~ s :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ s :\: t = Empty) -> ~ s :/\: frontier_of A top t = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_MONOTONE_QUOTIENT_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall c c= B, monotone_map A B (top,top') f /\ (quotient_map A B (top,top') f /\ (connected_in B top' c /\ (c :e top' \/ closed_in B top' c))) -> connected_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e c}

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_NEST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s :e Power A :^: omega, hausdorff_space A top /\ ((forall n :e omega, compact_in A top (s n) /\ connected_in A top (s n)) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n c= s m)) -> connected_in A top {x :e A | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_NEST_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s :e Power A :^: omega, hausdorff_space A top /\ ((forall n :e omega, closed_in A top (s n) /\ connected_in A top (s n)) /\ ((exists n :e omega, compact_in A top (s n)) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n c= s m))) -> connected_in A top {x :e A | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_NONSEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, connected_in A top s /\ (connected_in A top t /\ ~ separated_in A top s t) -> connected_in A top (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e A) -> path_in A top g -> connected_in A top {g x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)}

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ ~ exists c1 c2 c= A, c1 :\/: c2 = s /\ (~ c1 = Empty /\ (~ c2 = Empty /\ (c1 :/\: closure_of A top c2 = Empty /\ c2 :/\: closure_of A top c1 = Empty)))

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SEPARATION_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ ~ exists c1 c2 c= A, s c= c1 :\/: c2 /\ (~ c1 :/\: s = Empty /\ (~ c2 :/\: s = Empty /\ (c1 :/\: closure_of A top c2 = Empty /\ c2 :/\: closure_of A top c1 = Empty)))

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, connected_in A top {a} <-> a :e topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SPHERE_DELETE_INTERIOR_POINT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall u s c= R :^: idx N, 3 <= dimindex N /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (a,r)) /\ (b :e u /\ (u c= s /\ s c= sphere N (a,r)))) -> (connected N (s :\: {b}) <-> connected N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_STANDARD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, connected_in (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) (standard_simplex p)

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected_in (R :^: idx N) (mtopology (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s)) t <-> t c= s /\ connected N t

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN_MSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected_in (R :^: idx N) (mtopology (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s)) s <-> connected N s

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SUBSET_SEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c c= A, connected_in A top c /\ (separated_in A top s t /\ c c= s :\/: t) -> c c= s \/ c c= t

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s -> s c= topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, connected_in A (subtopology A top s) t <-> connected_in A top t /\ t c= s

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t <-> t c= s /\ connected N t

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_in A top (topspace A top) <-> connected_space A top

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, connected_in A top s /\ (connected_in A top t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> connected_in A top (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e u -> connected_in A top s) /\ ~ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = Empty -> connected_in A top (Union u)

items.name: CONNECTED_IN_UNIONS_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e f -> connected_in A top s) /\ ~ Union f :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e {closure_of A top s | s :e Power A, s :e f}, x :e Y} = Empty -> connected_in A top (Union f)

items.name: CONNECTED_IVT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, connected N s /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (x k <= a /\ a <= y k))))) -> exists z :e R :^: idx N, z :e s /\ z k = a

items.name: CONNECTED_IVT_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, connected N s /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (dot N a x <= b /\ b <= dot N a y))) -> exists z :e R :^: idx N, z :e s /\ dot N a z = b

items.name: CONNECTED_JACOBIAN_GRAPH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (at N x) /\ ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0)) -> connected (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) {pastecart N 1 x (lift (det N (matrix N N (f' x)))) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}

items.name: CONNECTED_JACOBIAN_RANGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (at N x) /\ ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0)) -> connected 1 {lift (det N (matrix N N (f' x))) | x :e s}

items.name: CONNECTED_JACOBIAN_RANGE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (convex N t /\ (t c= s /\ (~ interior N t = Empty /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (at N x) /\ ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0) /\ (a :e t /\ b :e t)))))) -> open_segment 1 (lift (det N (matrix N N (f' a))),lift (det N (matrix N N (f' b)))) c= {lift (det N (matrix N N (f' x))) | x :e interior N t}

items.name: CONNECTED_JACOBIAN_RANGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (convex N t /\ (t c= s /\ (~ interior N t = Empty /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (at N x) /\ ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0))))) -> connected 1 {lift (det N (matrix N N (f' x))) | x :e t}

items.name: CONNECTED_LIMIT_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N x s}

items.name: CONNECTED_LIMIT_POINTS_EQ_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a}) -> {x :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N x s} = closure N s

items.name: CONNECTED_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s /\ linear M N f -> connected N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONNECTED_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (connected A {f x | x :e s} <-> connected B s)

items.name: CONNECTED_MONOTONE_QUOTIENT_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) /\ connected N t))) -> connected M s

items.name: CONNECTED_MONOTONE_QUOTIENT_PREIMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) /\ ((c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t \/ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) c) /\ connected N c))) -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e c}

items.name: CONNECTED_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> connected N {vector_neg N x | x :e s}

items.name: CONNECTED_NEST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact N (s n) /\ connected N (s n)) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n c= s m) -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}

items.name: CONNECTED_NEST_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, closed N (s n) /\ connected N (s n)) /\ ((exists n :e omega, compact N (s n)) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n c= s m)) -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_ARC_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ connected N s -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> x = y \/ exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx 1, g x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N g /\ (path_image N g c= s /\ (pathstart N g = x /\ pathfinish N g = y)))

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (open N s /\ connected N s) -> connected N (s :\: {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_DELETE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ open N s -> (connected N (s :\: {a}) <-> connected N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_DIFF_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (atleastp t R /\ ~ equip t R))) -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_DIFF_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (open N s /\ (connected N s /\ cball N (a,r) c= s)) -> connected N (s :\: cball N (a,r))

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_DIFF_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (open N s /\ (connected N s /\ countable t)) -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_DIFF_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ dimension N t <= dimindex N + - 2) -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, connected A s <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= R :^: idx A, e1 :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s /\ (e2 :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s /\ (s c= e1 :\/: e2 /\ (e1 :/\: e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ ~ e2 = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_IN_CONVEX_DIFF_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N c /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) c /\ (connected N s /\ dimension N t <= aff_dim N c + - 2)) -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_IN_DIFF_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ (~ collinear N s /\ (atleastp t R /\ ~ equip t R))) -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_IN_DIFF_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ (connected N s /\ dimension N t <= aff_dim N s + - 2) -> connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_IN_DIFF_UNIONS_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ (finite f /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> aff_dim N t + 2 <= aff_dim N s))) -> connected N (s :\: Union f)

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_IN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, connected A s <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= R :^: idx A, e1 :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s /\ (e2 :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s /\ (e1 :\/: e2 = s /\ (e1 :/\: e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ ~ e2 = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_IN_SPHERE_DELETE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, 3 <= dimindex N /\ s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (a,r)) -> (connected N (s :\: {b}) <-> connected N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_MONOTONE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e c} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}))) -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, connected N c /\ c c= t -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e c}

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ connected N s -> path_connected N s

items.name: CONNECTED_OPEN_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> (connected N s <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= R :^: idx N, open N e1 /\ (open N e2 /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ (~ e2 = Empty /\ (e1 :\/: e2 = s /\ e1 :/\: e2 = Empty)))))

items.name: CONNECTED_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ bounded_hl N s -> connected N (outside N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> path A g -> connected A (path_image A g)

items.name: CONNECTED_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, connected M s /\ connected N t -> connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: CONNECTED_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ connected M s /\ connected N t)

items.name: CONNECTED_PUNCTURED_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> connected N (ball N (a,r) :\: {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_PUNCTURED_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> connected N (cball N (a,r) :\: {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_PUNCTURED_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ aff_dim N s = 1 -> connected N (s :\: {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_PUNCTURED_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall b :e R :^: idx N, connected N (sphere N (a,r) :\: {b}) <-> dimindex N = 1 /\ 0 < r -> b :e sphere N (a,r)

items.name: CONNECTED_PUNCTURED_UNIVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_QUASI_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> (c :e connected_components_of A top <-> connected_in A top c)

items.name: CONNECTED_RETRACT_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (retract_of N s t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t))) -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: CONNECTED_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, connected N s -> connected N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s}

items.name: CONNECTED_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, connected N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ connected N s

items.name: CONNECTED_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N (open_segment N (a,b))

items.name: CONNECTED_SEMIOPEN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: {a})) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: {b})

items.name: CONNECTED_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> ~ exists c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, c1 :\/: c2 = s /\ (~ c1 = Empty /\ (~ c2 = Empty /\ (c1 :/\: closure N c2 = Empty /\ c2 :/\: closure N c1 = Empty)))

items.name: CONNECTED_SEPARATION_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s <-> ~ exists c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, s c= c1 :\/: c2 /\ (~ c1 :/\: s = Empty /\ (~ c2 :/\: s = Empty /\ (c1 :/\: closure N c2 = Empty /\ c2 :/\: closure N c1 = Empty)))

items.name: CONNECTED_SIMPLE_PATH_ENDLESS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, c x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N c -> connected N (path_image N c :\: {pathstart N c,pathfinish N c})

items.name: CONNECTED_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> simple_path A g -> connected A (path_image A g)

items.name: CONNECTED_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, simple_path N g /\ pathfinish N g = pathstart N g -> connected N (path_image N g :\: {a})

items.name: CONNECTED_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, connected A {a}

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_CLOPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall t c= A, t :e top /\ closed_in A top t -> t = Empty \/ t = topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= A, closed_in A top e1 /\ (closed_in A top e2 /\ (topspace A top c= e1 :\/: e2 /\ (e1 :/\: e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ ~ e2 = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_CLOSED_IN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= A, closed_in A top e1 /\ (closed_in A top e2 /\ (e1 :\/: e2 = topspace A top /\ (e1 :/\: e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ ~ e2 = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= A, e1 :\/: e2 = topspace A top /\ (closure_of A top e1 :/\: closure_of A top e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ ~ e2 = Empty))

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> forall x0 :e A, connected_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, connected_space A (discrete_topology A u) <-> exists a :e A, u c= {a}

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= A, e1 :e top /\ (e2 :e top /\ (e1 :\/: e2 = topspace A top /\ (e1 :/\: e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ ~ e2 = Empty))))

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_EQ_FRONTIER_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ frontier_of A top s = Empty -> s = Empty \/ s = topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_EQ_NOT_SEPARATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> ~ exists c1 c2 c= A, c1 :\/: c2 = topspace A top /\ (~ c1 = Empty /\ (~ c2 = Empty /\ separated_in A top c1 c2))

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_EQ_NOT_SEPARATED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> ~ exists c1 c2 c= A, topspace A top c= c1 :\/: c2 /\ (~ c1 = Empty /\ (~ c2 = Empty /\ separated_in A top c1 c2))

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected_space (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> connected N s

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_FRONTIER_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_space A top /\ s c= topspace A top -> (frontier_of A top s = Empty <-> s = Empty \/ s = topspace A top)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IFF_COMPONENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall c c' c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top /\ c' :e connected_components_of A top -> c = c'

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IFF_COMPONENTS_SUBSET_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> exists a c= A, connected_components_of A top c= {a}

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IFF_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> connected_component_of A top x y

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IFF_QUASI_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> quasi_component_of A top x y

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IFF_QUASI_COMPONENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall c c' c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top /\ c' :e quasi_components_of A top -> c = c'

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IFF_QUASI_COMPONENTS_SUBSET_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> exists a c= A, quasi_components_of A top c= {a}

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_CARD_GE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top /\ (normal_space A top /\ ((t1_space A top \/ hausdorff_space A top) /\ ~ (exists a :e A, topspace A top c= {a}))) -> atleastp R (topspace A top)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_CARD_GE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_space A top /\ (completely_regular_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ s = topspace A top))) -> atleastp R (topspace A top)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_CARD_GE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, connected_space A top /\ (normal_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ s :/\: t = Empty))))) -> atleastp R (topspace A top)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a b :e A, connected_space A top /\ (a :e topspace A top /\ b :e topspace A top) -> connected_component_of A top a b

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ ~ (exists a :e A, topspace A top c= {a})) -> infinite (topspace A top)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_INFINITE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_space A top /\ (regular_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ s = topspace A top))) -> infinite (topspace A top)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_INFINITE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top /\ (t1_space A top /\ ~ (exists a :e A, topspace A top c= {a})) -> infinite (topspace A top)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_QUASI_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a b :e A, connected_space A top /\ (a :e topspace A top /\ b :e topspace A top) -> quasi_component_of A top a b

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_SEPARATED_BETWEEN_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, connected_space A top -> (separated_between A top s t <-> s = Empty /\ t c= topspace A top \/ s c= topspace A top /\ t = Empty)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_UNCOUNTABLE
