items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top /\ (regular_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ ~ (exists a :e A, topspace A top c= {a}))) -> ~ countable (topspace A top)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_MONOTONE_QUOTIENT_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> monotone_map A B (top,top') f /\ (quotient_map A B (top,top') f /\ connected_space B top') -> connected_space A top

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, connected_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> connected_space A (tops i)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, connected_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ connected_space A top1 /\ connected_space B top2

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_QUASI_COMPONENT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e topspace A top

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_QUOTIENT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') q /\ connected_space A top -> connected_space B top'

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ connected_space A top -> connected_space B top'

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_SEPARATED_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t -> s = Empty \/ t = Empty

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_SUBCONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> exists s c= A, connected_in A top s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s -> connected_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: CONNECTED_SPACE_TOPSPACE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> connected_space A top

items.name: CONNECTED_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> connected N (sphere N (a,r))

items.name: CONNECTED_SPHERE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, connected N (sphere N (a,r)) <-> 2 <= dimindex N \/ r <= 0

items.name: CONNECTED_SPHERE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ ~ aff_dim N s = 1) -> connected N (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_SUBSET_ARC_PAIR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, arc N g /\ (arc N h /\ (pathstart N g = pathstart N h /\ (pathfinish N g = pathfinish N h /\ (path_image N g :/\: path_image N h = {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g} /\ (connected N s /\ (s c= path_image N g :\/: path_image N h /\ (pathstart N g :e s /\ pathfinish N g :e s))))))) -> path_image N g c= s \/ path_image N h c= s

items.name: CONNECTED_SUBSET_CLOPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (connected N c /\ (c c= u /\ ~ c :/\: s = Empty))) -> c c= s

items.name: CONNECTED_SUBSET_PATH_IMAGE_ARC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc N g /\ (connected N s /\ (s c= path_image N g /\ (pathstart N g :e s /\ pathfinish N g :e s))) -> s = path_image N g

items.name: CONNECTED_SUBSET_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_components_of A top c= quasi_components_of A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top x x0

items.name: CONNECTED_SUBSET_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s c= closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s)) -> s = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: CONNECTED_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ connected N t -> connected N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: CONNECTED_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> connected N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: CONNECTED_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> connected N s

items.name: CONNECTED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (connected N t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> connected N (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e P -> connected N s) /\ ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e P, x :e Y} = Empty -> connected N (Union P)

items.name: CONNECTED_UNIONS_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> connected N s) /\ (forall x y :e f, x <> y -> ~ x = Empty /\ ~ y = Empty -> ~ x :/\: y = Empty) -> connected N (Union f)

items.name: CONNECTED_UNIONS_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> connected N s) /\ ~ Union f :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {closure N s | s :e Power (R :^: idx N), s :e f}, x :e Y} = Empty -> connected N (Union f)

items.name: CONNECTED_UNION_CLOPEN_IN_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (connected N u /\ (s c= u /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (u :\: s) /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (u :\: s)) t))) -> connected N (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_UNION_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (connected N t /\ ~ closure N s :/\: t = Empty) -> connected N (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONNECTED_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> connected N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: CONNECTED_UNIV_DIFF_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s <= dimindex N + - 2 -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: CONNECTED_WITH_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ connected N s -> connected N (s :\/: inside N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_WITH_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ connected N s -> connected N (s :\/: outside N s)

items.name: CONNECTED_WITH_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_OPEN_IN_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c s c= R :^: idx N, convex N c /\ (connected N s /\ s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) c) -> connected N (relative_interior N c :/\: s)

items.name: CONS_11
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h1 h2 :e A, forall t1 t2 :e finseq A, seq_cons h1 t1 = seq_cons h2 t2 <-> h1 = h2 /\ t1 = t2

items.name: CONS_HD_TL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> l = seq_cons (seq_hd l) (seq_tl l)

items.name: CONTAINS_COMPONENT_OF_CLOSURE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ c :e components N (closure N s) -> exists d c= R :^: idx N, d :e components N (frontier N s) /\ d c= c

items.name: CONTAINS_COMPONENT_OF_COMPACT_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ c :e components N s -> exists d c= R :^: idx N, d :e components N (frontier N s) /\ d c= c

items.name: CONTENT_0_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, s c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> content N s = 0

items.name: CONTENT_0_SUBSET_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ content N t = 0) -> content N s = 0

items.name: CONTENT_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b -> content 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = drop b + - drop a

items.name: CONTENT_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= b i) -> content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => b i + - a i)

items.name: CONTENT_CLOSED_INTERVAL_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= b i then finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => b i + - a i) else 0

items.name: CONTENT_DOUBLESPLIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, forall c e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k + - c) <= d}) < e0

items.name: CONTENT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> content A Empty = 0

items.name: CONTENT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 <-> exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ b i <= a i)

items.name: CONTENT_EQ_0_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, content 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 <-> drop b <= drop a

items.name: CONTENT_EQ_0_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> (content N s = 0 <-> exists i :e omega, exists a :e R, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> x i = a))

items.name: CONTENT_EQ_0_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 <-> interior N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = Empty

items.name: CONTENT_IMAGE_AFFINITY_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, content N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = abs_SNo m ^ dimindex N * content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTENT_IMAGE_STRETCH_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, m x :e R) -> content N {(fun k :e idx N => m k * x k) | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = abs_SNo (finprod (idx N) m) * content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTENT_LT_NZ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, 0 < content A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> ~ content A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0

items.name: CONTENT_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, content (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)) = content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) * content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTENT_POS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTENT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < b i) -> 0 < content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTENT_POS_LT_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a < drop b -> 0 < content 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTENT_POS_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, 0 < content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < b i

items.name: CONTENT_SPLIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}) + content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k})

items.name: CONTENT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) -> content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <= content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTENT_UNIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (vec N 0,vec N 1) seq_nil)) = 1

items.name: CONTENT_UNIT_1
items.statement: content 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) = 1

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ABS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall net0 :e net A, continuous N A f net0 -> continuous N A (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => abs_SNo (f x i)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall net0 :e net A, continuous B A f net0 /\ continuous B A g net0 -> continuous B A (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ADDITIVE_IMP_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f (vector_add M x y) = vector_add N (f x) (f y)) -> linear M N f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AE_IMP_MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s m c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f (s :\: m) /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ negligible M m) -> measurable_on M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AGREE_ON_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N g (closure M s) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N h (closure M s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = h x)) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closure M s -> g x = h x

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AGREE_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N g s' /\ (continuous_on_hl M N h s' /\ (s c= s' /\ (s' c= closure M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = h x)))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s' -> g x = h x

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, continuous A (R :^: idx N) f (at N x) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx N) f (f x) (at N x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ATTAINS_INF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> f x <= f y

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ATTAINS_SUP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> f y <= f x

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_AVOID
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x) /\ ~ f x = a -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, distance M (x,y) < e0 -> ~ f y = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_BALL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, continuous B (R :^: idx A) f (at A x) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ {f x0 | x0 :e ball A (x,d)} c= ball B (f x,e0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ (closed A s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> continuous A (R :^: idx A) (fun x0:set => closest_point A s x0) (at A x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx C, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall x :e R :^: idx C, continuous A (R :^: idx C) f (at C x) /\ continuous B (R :^: idx A) g (at A (f x)) -> continuous B (R :^: idx C) (fun x:set => g (f x)) (at C x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_COMPOSE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, g x0 :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, h x0 :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous M (R :^: idx M) g (at M x) /\ (continuous M (R :^: idx M) h (at M (g x)) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx M, g (h y) = y) /\ h (g x) = x)) -> (continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M (g x)) <-> continuous N (R :^: idx M) (fun x0:set => f (g x0)) (at M x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_DIST_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x0:set => lift (distance N (x0,closest_point N s x0))) (at N x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, continuous A (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => x) (at A a)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> continuous A (R :^: idx B) f (at B x)) -> continuous_on_hl B A f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, continuous 1 (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (at A a) /\ ~ f a = 0 -> continuous 1 (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => lift (recip_SNo (f x))) (at A a)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_LIFT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall a :e R :^: idx N, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (x i)) (at N a)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_LIFT_DIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx N, continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (distance N (a,x))) (at N x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_LIFT_DOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx N, continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (dot N a x)) (at N x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_LIFT_INFNORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (infnorm N x)) (at N x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_LIFT_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, continuous 1 (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm A x)) (at A x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_LIFT_RANGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, continuous 1 (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (at A x) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (vector_sub A x' x) < d -> abs_SNo (f x' + - f x) < e0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_LIFT_SETDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => lift (setdist N ({y},s))) (at N x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall z :e R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M M h /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm M (h x) = vector_norm M x) -> (continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M (h z)) <-> continuous N (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (h x)) (at M z))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x) <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ f x :e t -> exists s c= R :^: idx M, open M s /\ (x :e s /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx M, x' :e s -> f x' :e t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous A (R :^: idx N) f (at N a) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> tendsto N omega x a sequentially -> tendsto A omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) (f a) sequentially

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_SEQUENTIALLY_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M a) <-> forall e0 :e R, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> 0 < e0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ x n = a) /\ (tendsto M omega x a sequentially /\ (forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n))) -> exists n :e omega, distance N (f (x n),f a) < e0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_SEQUENTIALLY_INJ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M a) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> (forall n :e omega, ~ x n = a) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ tendsto M omega x a sequentially) -> tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) (f a) sequentially

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_SQRT
items.statement: forall a :e R :^: idx 1, continuous 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun x:set => lift (if 0 <= drop x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (drop x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- drop x))) (at 1 a)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_SQRT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (at N a) -> continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (if 0 <= f x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (f x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- f x))) (at N a)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a z :e R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M (vector_add M a z)) <-> continuous N (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x)) (at M z))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x) -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_AT_WITHIN_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s) /\ ~ f a = 0 -> continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (recip_SNo (f x))) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_BOREL_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (borel M s /\ borel N t) -> borel M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_BV_IMP_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f s) -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl 1 N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CARD_LT_RANGE_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (atleastp {f x | x :e s} R /\ ~ equip {f x | x :e s} R)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CARD_LT_RANGE_CONSTANT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (atleastp {f x | x :e s} R /\ ~ equip {f x | x :e s} R) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_GRAPH
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, closed M s /\ continuous_on_hl M N f s -> closed (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {pastecart M N x (f x) | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_GRAPH_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, compact N t /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> (continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})) {pastecart M N x (f x) | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_GRAPH_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> closed_in (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})) {pastecart M N x (f x) | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_IMP_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ closed M s -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> cauchy M x /\ (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => f (x x0))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_IMP_PERFECT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (t1_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top'))) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_IMP_PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (t1_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ closed_map A B (top,top') f)) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_IN_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx B, continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ closed B t -> closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) {x :e R :^: idx A | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_IN_PREIMAGE_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = a}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_IN_PREIMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed N t -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_IN_PREIMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t u c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u) -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_IN_PREIMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, forall v c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) v)) -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e u /\ f x :e v}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (closed M s /\ closed N t) -> closed M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_PREIMAGE_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ closed M s -> closed M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = a}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_PREIMAGE_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x)) /\ closed N s -> closed M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ closed_map A B (top,top') f -> (quotient_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c :e R, forall net0 :e net B, continuous A B f net0 -> continuous A B (fun x:set => vector_mul A c (f x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_COMPONENTWISE_LIFT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (continuous N A f net0 <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) net0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f /\ continuous_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) -> continuous_map B C (top',top'') g

items.name: CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE_QUOTIENT_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f -> (continuous_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) <-> continuous_map B C (top',top'') g)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net B, forall c :e R :^: idx A, continuous A B (fun x:set => c) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CONSTANT_ON_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closure M s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_CONSTANT_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s' /\ (s c= s' /\ (s' c= closure M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s' -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_COUNTABLE_RANGE_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ countable {f x | x :e s}) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_COUNTABLE_RANGE_CONSTANT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ countable {f x | x :e s} -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_DECREASING_IMAGE_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x))) -> {f x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (f b,f a) seq_nil)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_DET_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall A' :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> abs_SNo (A' i j + - A i j) < d) -> abs_SNo (det N A' + - det N A) < e0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_DET_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N) -> continuous (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex N)) A (fun a:set => vectorize R N N (A0 a)) net0 -> continuous 1 A (fun a:set => lift (det N (A0 a))) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_DIAMETER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ 0 < e0) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,t) < d) -> abs_SNo (diameter N s + - diameter N t) < e0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_DISCONNECTED_RANGE_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N t y x <-> x :e SetAdjoin Empty y))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_DISCONNECTED_RANGE_CONSTANT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N t y x <-> x :e SetAdjoin Empty y)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_DISCRETE_RANGE_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s /\ ~ f y = f x -> e0 <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_DISCRETE_RANGE_CONSTANT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s /\ ~ f y = f x -> e0 <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_EQ_CAUCHY_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M a) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x x' :e R :^: idx M, distance M (x,a) < d /\ distance M (x',a) < d -> distance N (f x,f x') < e0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_EQ_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, closed M s -> (continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> cauchy M x /\ (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => f (x x0)))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_EQ_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> mcomplete A m1 -> (continuous_map A B (mtopology A m1,mtopology B m2) f <-> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_EQ_CAUCHY_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x x' :e R :^: idx M, x :e SetAdjoin s a /\ (distance M (x,a) < d /\ (x' :e SetAdjoin s a /\ distance M (x',a) < d)) -> distance N (f x,f x') < e0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_EQ_COMPACT_CONNECTED_PRESERVING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s -> (continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ compact M c -> compact N {f x | x :e c}) /\ forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ connected M c -> connected N {f x | x :e c})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_EQ_COMPACT_CONNECTED_PRESERVING_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, locally M P s /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e P -> connected M c) -> (continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ compact M c -> compact N {f x | x :e c}) /\ forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ c :e P -> connected N {f x | x :e c})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_EQ_COMPACT_PATH_CONNECTED_PRESERVING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | path_connected M x} s -> (continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ compact M c -> compact N {f x | x :e c}) /\ forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ path_connected M c -> path_connected N {f x | x :e c})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_EQ_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A (mtopology A m1) -> (continuous_map A B (mtopology A m1,mtopology B m2) f <-> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_EXTENSION_OF_PROPER_MAP_FROM_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> hausdorff_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ proper_map A B (subtopology A top s,top') f)) -> closed_in A top s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_FINITE_RANGE_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ finite {f x | x :e s}) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_FINITE_RANGE_CONSTANT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, connected M s <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ finite {f x | x :e s} -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_FROM_CLOSED_GRAPH
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, compact N t /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ closed (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {pastecart M N x (f x) | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s}) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_FSIGMA_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (fsigma M s /\ fsigma N t) -> fsigma M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_FSTCART
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> continuous (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) A f net0 -> continuous M A (fun x:set => fstcart M (f x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_FUNCTION_HAS_EIGENVALUES_ODD_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> odd_nat (dimindex N) /\ continuous_on_hl N N f (sphere N (vec N 0,1)) -> exists v :e R :^: idx N, exists c :e R, v :e sphere N (vec N 0,1) /\ f v = vector_mul N c v

items.name: CONTINUOUS_GDELTA_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (gdelta M s /\ gdelta N t) -> gdelta M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_GE_ON_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R, continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (closure M s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> a <= f x) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closure M s -> a <= f x

items.name: CONTINUOUS_GE_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R, continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s' /\ (s c= s' /\ (s' c= closure M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> a <= f x))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s' -> a <= f x

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMAGE_NESTED_INTERS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, continuous_on_hl M N f (s 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, compact M (s n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, s (ordsucc n) c= s n)) -> {f x | x :e {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {{f x | x :e s n} | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMAGE_NESTED_INTERS_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, forall m :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N f (s m) /\ ((forall n :e omega, m <= n -> compact M (s n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, m <= n -> s (ordsucc n) c= s n)) -> {f x | x :e {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, m <= n}, x :e Y}} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {{f x | x :e s n} | n :e omega, m <= n}, x :e Y}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMAGE_SUBSET_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (dimindex N <= dimindex M /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> {f x | x :e interior M s} c= interior N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMAGE_SUBSET_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (aff_dim N t <= aff_dim M s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))) -> {f x | x :e relative_interior M s} c= relative_interior N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_BOREL_MEASURABLE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top1,top2) f -> borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_BOREL_MEASURABLE_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> borel_measurable_on M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> mcomplete A m1 /\ continuous_map A B (mtopology A m1,mtopology B m2) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space B top' /\ continuous_map A B (top,top') f) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_CLOSED_MAP_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ compact M s) -> forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e u}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_CLOSED_MAP_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (kc_space B top' /\ continuous_map A B (top,top') f) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_EMBEDDING_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)))) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))))) -> homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_MEASURABLE_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f (R :^: idx M) -> measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_MEASURABLE_ON_CLOSED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ closed M s -> measurable_on M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ lebesgue_measurable M s -> measurable_on M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_PEFECT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (kc_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (kc_space B top' /\ continuous_map A B (top,top') f) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ compact M s) -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IMP_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A (mtopology A m1) /\ continuous_map A B (mtopology A m1,mtopology B m2) f -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INCREASING_IMAGE_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y))) -> {f x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (f a,f b) seq_nil)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INJECTIVE_IFF_MONOTONIC
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl 1 1 f s /\ is_interval 1 s -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x < drop y) -> drop (f x) < drop (f y)) \/ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x < drop y) -> drop (f y) < drop (f x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_OPEN_SEGMENT_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 f (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> {f x | x :e open_segment N (a,b)} = open_segment 1 (f a,f b)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_SEGMENT_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 f (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> {f x | x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (f a,f b) seq_nil)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_SUBSPACE_DIM_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace M s /\ (subspace N t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)))) -> dim M s <= dim N t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INJECTIVE_IMP_MONOTONIC
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl 1 1 f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (drop (f x) < drop (f y) <-> drop x < drop y)) \/ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (drop (f x) < drop (f y) <-> drop y < drop x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INTERVAL_BIJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b u v x :e R :^: idx N, continuous N (R :^: idx N) (fun x0:set => interval_bij N (a,b) (u,v) x0) (at N x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x)) net0 /\ ~ f (netlimit A net0) = 0 -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (recip_SNo (f x))) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INVERSE_INJECTIVE_PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}))) -> continuous_on_hl N M g t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_INVERSE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> forall s c= B, compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> g (f x) = x) /\ s c= {f x | x :e topspace A top}))) -> continuous_map B A (subtopology B top' s,top) g

items.name: CONTINUOUS_IVT_LOCAL_EXTREMUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 f (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (~ a = b /\ f a = f b) -> exists z :e R :^: idx N, z :e open_segment N (a,b) /\ ((forall w :e R :^: idx N, w :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> drop (f w) <= drop (f z)) \/ forall w :e R :^: idx N, w :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> drop (f z) <= drop (f w))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LEFT_INVERSE_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g {f x | x :e s} /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x)) -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= {f x | x :e s} -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LEVELSET_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, connected M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (open M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = a} /\ (exists x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ f x = a))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LEVELSET_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, connected M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = a} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (exists x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ f x = a))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LEVELSET_OPEN_IN_CASES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, connected M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = a} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) -> (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> ~ f x = a) \/ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LE_ON_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R, continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (closure M s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x <= a) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closure M s -> f x <= a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LE_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R, continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s' /\ (s c= s' /\ (s' c= closure M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x <= a))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s' -> f x <= a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LIFT_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x)) net0 -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (f x))) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LIFT_ABS_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, continuous N A f net0 -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (f x k))) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LIFT_COMPONENT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e omega, continuous N A f net0 -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LIFT_DET
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N) -> forall net0 :e net A, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (A0 x i j)) net0) -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (det N (A0 x))) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LIFT_DOT2
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous N A f net0 /\ continuous N A g net0 -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (dot N (f x) (g x))) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LIFT_NORM_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous N A f net0 -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x))) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LIFT_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x)) net0 -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x ^ n)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LIFT_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e R) -> forall t c= B, finite t /\ (forall i :e B, i :e t -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) net0) -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (finprod t (f x))) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_LINEPATH_AT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, continuous A (R :^: idx 1) (fun x0:set => linepath A (a,b) x0) (at 1 x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology B, forall top' :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> (continuous_map B A (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace B top} c= topspace A top' /\ forall u c= A, u :e top' -> {x :e B | x :e topspace B top /\ f x :e u} :e top)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_ATPOINTOF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> limit A B top' f (f x) (atpointof A top x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CASES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (closure_of A top {x :e A | P x}),top') f /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (closure_of A top {x :e A | ~ P x}),top') g /\ (forall x :e A, x :e frontier_of A top {x0 :e A | P x0} -> f x = g x)) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CASES_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (closure_of A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ P x}),top') f /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (closure_of A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ ~ P x}),top') g /\ (forall x :e A, x :e frontier_of A top {x0 :e A | x0 :e topspace A top /\ P x0} -> f x = g x)) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CASES_FUNCTION
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e C) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall u c= C, continuous_map A C (top,top'') p /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ p x :e closure_of C top'' u},top') f /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ p x :e closure_of C top'' (topspace C top'' :\: u)},top') g /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ p x :e frontier_of C top'' u -> f x = g x))) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => if p x :e u then f x else g x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CASES_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) p /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) q /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ p x <= q x},top') f /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ q x <= p x},top') g /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ p x = q x -> f x = g x)))) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => if p x <= q x then f x else g x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CASES_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) p /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) q /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ p x <= q x},top') f /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ q x <= p x},top') g /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ p x = q x -> f x = g x)))) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => if p x < q x then f x else g x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e topspace B top') /\ forall c c= B, closed_in B top' c -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e c})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (continuous_on_hl M N f (R :^: idx M) <-> forall s c= R :^: idx M, {f x | x :e closure M s} c= closure N {f x | x :e s})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CLOSURES_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s -> {f x | x :e s :/\: closure M t} c= closure N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CLOSURE_PREIMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall t c= B, continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> closure_of A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e t} c= {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e closure_of B top' t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology B) -> forall t c= K, forall f :e B :^: K :^: A, continuous_map A (B :^: K) (top,product_topology B K t tops) (fun x:set => f x) <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= {x :e B :^: K | forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e t -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ forall k :e K, k :e t -> continuous_map A B (top,tops k) (fun x:set => f x k)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_COMPONENTWISE_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e omega, f x y :e R) -> forall n :e omega, continuous_map A (R :^: omega) (top,euclidean_space n) (fun x:set => fun x0 :e omega => if 1 <= x0 /\ x0 <= n then f x x0 else 0) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= n -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => f x i)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_COMPONENTWISE_REAL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) f <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => f x i))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_COMPONENTWISE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology B) -> forall f :e B :^: K :^: A, continuous_map A (B :^: K) (top,product_topology B K K tops) (fun x:set => f x) <-> forall k :e K, continuous_map A B (top,tops k) (fun x:set => f x k)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_COMPONENT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> continuous_map A (K :*: A) (top i,sum_topology A K k top) (fun x:set => (i,x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ continuous_map B C (top',top'') g -> continuous_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall c :e B, continuous_map A B (top1,top2) (fun x:set => c) <-> topspace A top1 = Empty \/ c :e topspace B top2

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_DOT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) f /\ continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) g -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => dot N (f x) (g x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_DROP
items.statement: continuous_map (R :^: idx 1) R (euclidean 1,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => drop x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_DROP_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e A) -> (continuous_map R A (euclideanreal,top) f <-> continuous_map (R :^: idx 1) A (euclidean 1,top) (fun x:set => f (drop x)))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_DROP_EQ_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e A) -> (continuous_map R A (subtopology R euclideanreal s,top) f <-> continuous_map (R :^: idx 1) A (subtopology (R :^: idx 1) (euclidean 1) {lift x | x :e s},top) (fun x:set => f (drop x)))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) /\ continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> continuous_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_CLOSURE_PREIMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall t c= B, closure_of A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e t} c= {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e closure_of B top' t})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_CLOSURE_PREIMAGE_SUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall t c= B, t c= topspace B top' -> closure_of A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e t} c= {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e closure_of B top' t})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_DROP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (continuous_map A (R :^: idx 1) (top,euclidean 1) f <-> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => drop (f x)))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_IMAGE_CLOSURE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> forall s c= A, {f x | x :e closure_of A top s} c= closure_of B top' {f x | x :e s})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_IMAGE_CLOSURE_SUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> {f x | x :e closure_of A top s} c= closure_of B top' {f x | x :e s})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_IMAGE_CLOSURE_SUBSET_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall s c= A, {f x | x :e closure_of A top s} c= closure_of B top' {f x | x :e s})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_INTERIOR_PREIMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall t c= B, {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e interior_of B top' t} c= interior_of A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e t})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_INTERIOR_PREIMAGE_SUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall t c= B, t c= topspace B top' -> {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e interior_of B top' t} c= interior_of A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e t})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_LIFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f <-> continuous_map A (R :^: idx 1) (top,euclidean 1) (fun x:set => lift (f x)))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_TOPCONTINUOUS_AT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> topcontinuous_at A B top top' f x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_map (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,euclidean M) f <-> continuous_on_hl N M f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EUCLIDEAN2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_map (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f <-> continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EUCLIDEAN_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e omega, continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) f -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => f x i)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EUCLIDEAN_EUCLIDEAN
