items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (continuous_map (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) (euclidean M,euclidean N) f <-> continuous_on_hl M N f (R :^: idx M))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall n :e omega, forall f g :e R :^: omega :^: A, continuous_map A (R :^: omega) (top,euclidean_space n) (fun x:set => f x) /\ continuous_map A (R :^: omega) (top,euclidean_space n) (fun x:set => g x) -> continuous_map A (R :^: omega) (top,euclidean_space n) (fun x:set => fun x0 :e omega => f x x0 + g x x0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall n :e omega, forall f g :e R :^: omega :^: A, continuous_map A (R :^: omega) (top,euclidean_space n) (fun x:set => f x) /\ continuous_map A (R :^: omega) (top,euclidean_space n) (fun x:set => g x) -> continuous_map A (R :^: omega) (top,euclidean_space n) (fun x:set => fun x0 :e omega => f x x0 + - g x x0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENSION_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, regular_space B top2 /\ (s c= t /\ (t c= closure_of A top1 s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e t -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, g x0 :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top1 (SetAdjoin s x),top2) g /\ forall x0 :e A, x0 :e s -> g x0 = f x0)))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top1 t,top2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENSION_POINTWISE_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, regular_space B top2 /\ (s c= t /\ (t c= closure_of A top1 s /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top1 s,top2) f /\ (forall x :e A, x :e t :\: s -> exists l :e B, limit A B top2 f l (within A (atpointof A top1 x) s))))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top1 t,top2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology B, forall u c= A, continuous_map A B (discrete_topology A u,top) f <-> {f x | x :e u} c= topspace B top

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_KIFICATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> continuous_map A B (kification A top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_K_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space A top /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> continuous_map A B (subtopology A top k,top') f) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall top :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (mtopology A m,top) f <-> {f x | x :e mspace A m} c= topspace B top /\ forall a :e A, a :e mspace A m -> forall u c= B, u :e top /\ f a :e u -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (a,x) < d -> f x :e u)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> continuous_map A B (subtopology A top s,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_SUBTOPOLOGY_MONO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology B, forall top' :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall s t c= B, continuous_map B A (subtopology B top t,top') f /\ s c= t -> continuous_map B A (subtopology B top s,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_FRONTIER_FRONTIER_PREIMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall t c= B, continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> frontier_of A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e t} c= {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e frontier_of B top' t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, continuous_map (A :*: B) A (prod_topology A B top1 top2,top1) (fun x:set => x 0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_FST_OF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top1 :e topology B, forall top2 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> continuous_map A (B :*: C) (top,prod_topology B C top1 top2) f -> continuous_map A B (top,top1) (fun x:set => f x 0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, continuous_map A A (top,top) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE_CLOSURE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> {f x | x :e closure_of A top s} c= closure_of B top' {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top'

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMP_CLOSED_GRAPH
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ hausdorff_space B top' -> closed_in (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top') {(x,f x) | x :e A, x :e topspace A top}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INF

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INL

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTERIOR_PREIMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall t c= B, continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e interior_of B top' t} c= interior_of A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_EMPTY

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_FULLTOPOLOGY

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_KIFICATION

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_SUBTOPOLOGY

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_TOPOLOGY_BASE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall b c= Power B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall x c= B, x :e top' <-> exists u c= Power B, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e b) /\ Union u = x) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e topspace B top') /\ (forall u c= B, u :e b -> {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e u} :e top)) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_TOPOLOGY_BASE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall b c= Power B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall x c= B, x :e top' <-> exists u c= Power B, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e b) /\ Union u = x) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e topspace B top') /\ forall u c= B, u :e b -> {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e u} :e top)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_TOPOLOGY_SUBBASE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall b c= Power B, forall u c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> {x :e Power B | exists u0 c= Power B, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to B {x01 :e Power B | exists u c= Power B, finite u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e b) /\ {x :e B | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} u) /\ Union u0 = x} = top' /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e topspace B top') /\ (forall u0 c= B, u0 :e b -> {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e u0} :e top)) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_TOPOLOGY_SUBBASE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall b c= Power B, forall u c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> {x :e Power B | exists u0 c= Power B, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to B {x01 :e Power B | exists u c= Power B, finite u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e b) /\ {x :e B | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} u) /\ Union u0 = x} = top' -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e topspace B top') /\ forall u0 c= B, u0 :e b -> {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e u0} :e top)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_MDIST

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_OF_FST
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology C, forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> (continuous_map (A :*: B) C (prod_topology A B top1 top2,top) (fun x:set => f (x 0)) <-> topspace B top2 = Empty \/ continuous_map A C (top1,top) f)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_PROD

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall top':set -> set, (forall x :e K, top' x :e topology B) -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> (continuous_map (A :^: K) (B :^: K) (product_topology A K k top,product_topology B K k top') (fun x:set => fun x0 :e K => if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k top) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> continuous_map A B (top i,top' i) (f i))

items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top1 :e topology B, forall top2 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> continuous_map A (B :*: C) (top,prod_topology B C top1 top2) f -> continuous_map A C (top,top2) (fun x:set => f x 1)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_SQRT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => if 0 <= f x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (f x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- f x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_SQUARE_ROOT
items.statement: continuous_map R R (euclideanreal,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_SUM
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e K, f x y :e R) -> forall k c= K, finite k /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => f x i)) -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => finsum k (f x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_SUM_LOCALLY_FINITE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e R) -> forall v :e Power A :^: K, forall U c= K, (forall u :e K, u :e U -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (f u)) /\ ((forall u :e K, u :e U -> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ ~ x :e v u -> f u x = 0) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists N c= A, N :e top /\ (x :e N /\ finite {u :e K | u :e U /\ ~ v u :/\: N = Empty}))) -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => finsum U (fun u:set => f u x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_SUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e K, f x y :e R) -> forall k c= K, finite k /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => f x i)) -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => sup {f x i | i :e K, i :e k})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_TO_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (t,mtopology B m) f <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A t -> forall r :e R, 0 < r -> exists u c= A, u :e t /\ (x :e u /\ forall y :e A, y :e u -> f y :e mball B m (f x,r)))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_UNIFORMLY_CAUCHY_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall ms :e metric B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> ~ trivial_limit omega sequentially /\ (mcomplete B ms /\ (eventually omega {n :e omega | continuous_map A B (top,mtopology B ms) (f n)} sequentially /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall m n :e omega, forall x :e A, N <= m /\ (N <= n /\ x :e topspace A top) -> mdist B ms (f m x,f n x) < e0))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,mtopology B ms) g /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually omega {n :e omega | forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> mdist B ms (f n x,g x) < e0} sequentially)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_UNIFORM_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net K, forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ~ trivial_limit K net0 /\ (eventually K {n :e K | continuous_map A B (top,mtopology B m) (f n)} net0 /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually K {n :e K | forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> g x :e mspace B m /\ mdist B m (f n x,g x) < e0} net0)) -> continuous_map A B (top,mtopology B m) g

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_UNIFORM_LIMIT_ALT
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net K, forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ~ trivial_limit K net0 /\ ({g x | x :e topspace A top} c= mspace B m /\ (eventually K {n :e K | continuous_map A B (top,mtopology B m) (f n)} net0 /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually K {n :e K | forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> mdist B m (f n x,g x) < e0} net0))) -> continuous_map A B (top,mtopology B m) g

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_UPPER_LOWER_SEMICONTINUOUS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f <-> (forall a :e R, closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ a <= f x}) /\ forall a :e R, closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x <= a})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_UPPER_LOWER_SEMICONTINUOUS_LE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (continuous_map A R (top,subtopology R euclideanreal u) f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e u) /\ ((forall a :e R, closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ a <= f x}) /\ forall a :e R, closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x <= a}))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_UPPER_LOWER_SEMICONTINUOUS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f <-> (forall a :e R, {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ a < f x} :e top) /\ forall a :e R, {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x < a} :e top)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_UPPER_LOWER_SEMICONTINUOUS_LTE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f <-> (forall a :e R, {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x < a} :e top) /\ forall a :e R, closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x <= a})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_UPPER_LOWER_SEMICONTINUOUS_LTE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (continuous_map A R (top,subtopology R euclideanreal u) f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e u) /\ ((forall a :e R, {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x < a} :e top) /\ forall a :e R, closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x <= a}))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_UPPER_LOWER_SEMICONTINUOUS_LT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (continuous_map A R (top,subtopology R euclideanreal u) f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e u) /\ ((forall a :e R, {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ a < f x} :e top) /\ forall a :e R, {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x < a} :e top))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_VECTOR_ADD
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) f /\ continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) g -> continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_VECTOR_CONST
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall b :e R :^: idx N, continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) (fun x:set => b)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_VECTOR_MUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e A, c x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) c /\ continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) f -> continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) (fun x:set => vector_mul N (c x) (f x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_VECTOR_SUB
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) f /\ continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) g -> continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAP_VSUM
items.statement: forall A K N:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e K, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> finite k /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) (fun x:set => f x i)) -> continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,euclidean N) (fun x:set => vsum K N k (f x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MATRIX_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N) -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous N A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N M (A0 a) x) net0) <-> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex M)) -> continuous 1 A (fun a:set => lift (A0 a i j)) net0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall A M N P:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M) -> forall B:set -> set, (forall x :e A, B x :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N) -> continuous (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) A (fun x:set => vectorize R M N (A0 x)) net0 /\ continuous (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex P)) A (fun x:set => vectorize R N P (B x)) net0 -> continuous (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex P)) A (fun x:set => vectorize R M P (matrix_mul M N P (A0 x) (B x))) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MATRIX_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M) -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, continuous M A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul M N (A0 a) x) net0) <-> continuous (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) A (fun a:set => vectorize R M N (A0 a)) net0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M) -> forall v:set -> set, (forall x :e A, v x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) A (fun x:set => vectorize R M N (A0 x)) net0 /\ continuous N A v net0 -> continuous M A (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N (A0 x) (v x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAX
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall net0 :e net A, continuous N A f net0 /\ continuous N A g net0 -> continuous N A (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => if f x i <= g x i then g x i else f x i) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MAX_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x)) net0 /\ continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (g x)) net0 -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (if f x <= g x then g x else f x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MEASURE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s k c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (differentiable_on_hl N N f s /\ compact N k) -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun a:set => lift (measure N {f x | x :e {vector_add N a x | x :e k}})) {a :e R :^: idx N | {vector_add N a x | x :e k} c= s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MEASURE_TRANSLATION_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s -> tendsto 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun a:set => lift (measure N ({vector_add N a x | x :e s} :\: s))) (vec 1 0) (at N (vec N 0))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MEASURE_TRANSLATION_SYMDIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s -> tendsto 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun a:set => lift (measure N (({vector_add N a x | x :e s} :\: s) :\/: (s :\: {vector_add N a x | x :e s})))) (vec 1 0) (at N (vec N 0))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MIDPOINT_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ (convex N s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f (midpoint N (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2)) -> convex_on N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MIN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall net0 :e net A, continuous N A f net0 /\ continuous N A g net0 -> continuous N A (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => if f x i <= g x i then f x i else g x i) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MIN_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x)) net0 /\ continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (g x)) net0 -> continuous 1 A (fun x:set => lift (if f x <= g x then f x else g x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_MUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e B, c x :e R) -> continuous 1 B (fun x:set => lift (c x)) net0 /\ continuous A B f net0 -> continuous A B (fun x:set => vector_mul A (c x) (f x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_NEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall net0 :e net A, continuous B A f net0 -> continuous B A (fun x:set => vector_neg B (f x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N A f s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> tendsto A (R :^: idx N) f (f x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_ABS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => abs_SNo (f x i)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun a:set => integral N M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x))) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_TRANSLATION_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s /\ lebesgue_measurable M t -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun a:set => integral N M t (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x))) {a :e R :^: idx M | {vector_add M a x | x :e t} c= s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_TRANSLATION_NORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) -> tendsto 1 (R :^: idx M) (fun a:set => integral 1 M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f (vector_add M a x)) (f x))))) (vec 1 0) (at M (vec M 0))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_TRANSLATION_NORM_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M t /\ t c= s) -> tendsto 1 (R :^: idx M) (fun a:set => integral 1 M t (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f (vector_add M a x)) (f x))))) (vec 1 0) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M (vec M 0)) {a :e R :^: idx M | {vector_add M a x | x :e t} c= s})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ continuous_on_hl A B g s -> continuous_on_hl A B (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_AVOID
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (x :e s /\ ~ f x = a) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s /\ distance M (x,y) < e0 -> ~ f y = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CASES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, closed M s /\ (closed M t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ ~ P x \/ x :e t /\ P x -> f x = g x)))) -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CASES_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R, continuous_on_hl 1 N f {t :e R :^: idx 1 | t :e s /\ drop t <= a} /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N g {t :e R :^: idx 1 | t :e s /\ a <= drop t} /\ (lift a :e s -> f (lift a) = g (lift a))) -> continuous_on_hl 1 N (fun t:set => if drop t <= a then f t else g t) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CASES_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R, continuous_on_hl M N f {t :e R :^: idx M | t :e s /\ h t <= a} /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g {t :e R :^: idx M | t :e s /\ a <= h t} /\ (continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (h x)) s /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx M, t :e s /\ h t = a -> f t = g t))) -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun t:set => if h t <= a then f t else g t) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CASES_LOCAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (s :\/: t)) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (s :\/: t)) t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ ~ P x \/ x :e t /\ P x -> f x = g x)))) -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CASES_LOCAL_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (s :\/: t) /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (s :\/: t) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ ~ P x \/ x :e t /\ P x -> f x = g x)))) -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CASES_OPEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx B, open B s /\ (open B t /\ (continuous_on_hl B A f s /\ (continuous_on_hl B A g t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s /\ ~ P x \/ x :e t /\ P x -> f x = g x)))) -> continuous_on_hl B A (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOPEN_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => if x :e t then a else b) s <-> a = b \/ s :/\: t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) (s :/\: t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s}) t -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSED_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> (continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ (closed A s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> continuous_on_hl A A (fun x:set => closest_point A s x) t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, x :e closure M s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s /\ distance M (y,x) < d -> distance N (f y,f x) < e0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSURE_COMPONENT_GE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, forall k :e omega, continuous_on_hl N M f (closure N s) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> b <= f y k) /\ x :e closure N s) -> b <= f x k

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSURE_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, forall k :e omega, continuous_on_hl N M f (closure N s) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> f y k <= b) /\ x :e closure N s) -> f x k <= b

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSURE_NORM_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, continuous_on_hl N M f (closure N s) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> vector_norm M (f y) <= b) /\ x :e closure N s) -> vector_norm M (f x) <= b

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSURE_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, a :e closure M s /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ tendsto M omega x a sequentially) -> tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) (f a) sequentially

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx B, continuous_on_hl B A f s -> continuous_on_hl B A (fun x:set => vector_mul A c (f x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPACT_SURFACE_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s v c= R :^: idx N, forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, d x :e R) -> compact N s /\ (s c= v :\: {vec N 0} /\ (conic N v /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e R, x :e v :\: {vec N 0} -> (0 < k /\ vector_mul N k x :e s <-> d x = k)))) -> continuous_on_hl N N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (d x) x) (v :\: {vec N 0})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M P g s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (f x,f y) <= distance P (g x,g y)) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e components M s -> continuous_on_hl M N f c) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPONENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, locally A {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | connected A x} s -> (continuous_on_hl A B f s <-> forall c c= R :^: idx A, c :e components A s -> continuous_on_hl A B f c)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPONENTS_FINITE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, finite (components M s) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e components M s -> continuous_on_hl M N f c) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPONENTS_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e components M s -> c :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ continuous_on_hl M N f c) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPONENTS_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, open M s /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e components M s -> continuous_on_hl M N f c) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPONENTS_OPEN_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s -> (continuous_on_hl A B f s <-> forall c c= R :^: idx A, c :e components A s -> continuous_on_hl A B f c)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPONENTWISE_LIFT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, continuous_on_hl B A f s /\ continuous_on_hl A C g {f x | x :e s} -> continuous_on_hl B C (fun x:set => g (f x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPOSE_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ ((forall v c= R :^: idx N, v c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) /\ continuous_on_hl M P (fun x:set => g (f x)) s)) -> continuous_on_hl N P g t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall c :e R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl B A (fun x:set => c) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CONVOLUTION_L1_LINF
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear P Q N bop /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) /\ (measurable_on M P g (R :^: idx M) /\ bounded_hl P {g x | x :e R :^: idx M})) -> continuous_on_hl M Q (fun x:set => integral Q M (R :^: idx M) (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y))) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_CONVOLUTION_LINF_L1
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear P Q N bop /\ (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ (bounded_hl N {f x | x :e R :^: idx M} /\ absolutely_integrable_on P M g (R :^: idx M))) -> continuous_on_hl M Q (fun x:set => integral Q M (R :^: idx M) (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y))) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_DET_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall A:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, A x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex N)) (fun a:set => vectorize R N N (A a)) s -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun a:set => lift (det N (A a))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_DIST_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ ~ s = Empty -> continuous_on_hl A 1 (fun x:set => lift (distance A (x,closest_point A s x))) t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f Empty

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ continuous_on_hl B A f s -> continuous_on_hl B A g s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_EQ_CONTINUOUS_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, open M s -> (continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_EQ_CONTINUOUS_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, continuous_on_hl B A f s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> continuous A (R :^: idx B) f (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_FINITE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, finite s -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_FSTCART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) -> continuous_on_hl M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) f s -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => fstcart N (f x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A A (fun x:set => x) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_IMP_BAIRE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => f x) s -> f :e baire M N n s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_IMP_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s}) t -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_IMP_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s} -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ x :e interior M s -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, t c= closure M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f (f x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) -> continuous_on_hl M N f t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, s c= t /\ t c= closure M s -> (continuous_on_hl M N f t <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f (f x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, s c= t /\ (t c= closure M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> continuous_on_hl M N f (SetAdjoin s x))) -> continuous_on_hl M N f t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INTERVAL_BIJ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b u v :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A A (fun x:set => interval_bij A (a,b) (u,v) x) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> ~ f x = 0) -> continuous_on_hl A 1 (fun x:set => lift (recip_SNo (f x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INVERSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (compact M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x)) -> continuous_on_hl N M g {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INVERSE_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e u}))) -> continuous_on_hl N M g t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INVERSE_INTO_1D
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl N 1 f s /\ ((path_connected N s \/ (connected N s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s \/ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) \/ (compact N s \/ open N s))) /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> g (f x) = x))) -> continuous_on_hl 1 N g t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INVERSE_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex N <= dimindex M /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (open M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x))) -> continuous_on_hl N M g {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_INVERSE_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t))) -> continuous_on_hl N M g t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_ABS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (f x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_ABS_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (f x k))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall s c= R :^: idx N, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (x i)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_COMPONENT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_DET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, A x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (A x i j)) s) -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (det N (A x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_DIST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A 1 (fun x:set => lift (distance A (a,x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_DOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A 1 (fun x:set => lift (dot A a x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_DOT2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ continuous_on_hl M N g s -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (dot N (f x) (g x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A 1 (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm A x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_NORM_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_POW
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x ^ n)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e A, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= A, finite t /\ (forall i :e A, i :e t -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s) -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (finprod t (f x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_RANGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx A, x' :e s /\ vector_norm A (vector_sub A x' x) < d -> abs_SNo (f x' + - f x) < e0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_SETDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun y:set => lift (setdist N ({y},s))) t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_SQRT
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl 1 1 (fun x:set => lift (if 0 <= drop x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (drop x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- drop x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_SQRT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (if 0 <= f x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (f x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- f x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl 1 A (fun x:set => linepath A (a,b) x) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MATRIX_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, A x :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx P, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl P N (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N M (A a) x) s) <-> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex M)) -> continuous_on_hl P 1 (fun a:set => lift (A a i j)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall A:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx Q, A x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M) -> forall B:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx Q, B x :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx Q, continuous_on_hl Q (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (fun x:set => vectorize R M N (A x)) s /\ continuous_on_hl Q (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex P)) (fun x:set => vectorize R N P (B x)) s -> continuous_on_hl Q (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex P)) (fun x:set => vectorize R M P (matrix_mul M N P (A x) (B x))) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MATRIX_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, A x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx P, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl P M (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul M N (A a) x) s) <-> continuous_on_hl P (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (fun a:set => vectorize R M N (A a)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, A x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M) -> forall v:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, v x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl P (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (fun x:set => vectorize R M N (A x)) s /\ continuous_on_hl P N v s -> continuous_on_hl P M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N (A x) (v x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MAX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ continuous_on_hl M N g s -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => if f x i <= g x i then g x i else f x i) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MAX_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) s -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (if f x <= g x then g x else f x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MDIST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall a :e A, a :e mspace A m -> continuous_map A R (mtopology A m,euclideanreal) (fun x:set => mdist A m (a,x))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MEASURE_IN_HALFSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, measurable N s -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun a:set => lift (measure N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ dot N a x <= b})) ((R :^: idx N) :\: {vec N 0})

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MEASURE_IN_PORTION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, measurable N s /\ ((forall a :e R :^: idx M, a :e t -> lebesgue_measurable N {x :e R :^: idx N | f a x <= 0}) /\ ((forall a :e R :^: idx M, a :e t -> negligible N {x :e R :^: idx N | f a x = 0}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun a:set => lift (f a x)) t))) -> continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun a:set => lift (measure N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f a x <= 0})) t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ continuous_on_hl M N g s -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => if f x i <= g x i then f x i else g x i) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MIN_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) s -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (if f x <= g x then f x else g x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_MUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, c x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> continuous_on_hl B 1 (fun x:set => lift (c x)) s /\ continuous_on_hl B A f s -> continuous_on_hl B A (fun x:set => vector_mul A (c x) (f x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_NEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A B f s -> continuous_on_hl A B (fun x:set => vector_neg B (f x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_NO_LIMPT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, ~ (exists x :e R :^: idx M, limit_point_of M x s) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s} -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_OPEN_AVOID
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (open M s /\ (x :e s /\ ~ f x = a)) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, distance M (x,y) < e0 -> ~ f y = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_OPEN_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> (continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ continuous_on_hl M P g s -> continuous_on_hl M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_PATH_LENGTH_SUBPATH_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, rectifiable_path N g /\ a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> continuous_on_hl 1 1 (fun x:set => lift (path_length N (fun x0:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) x a g x0))) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_PATH_LENGTH_SUBPATH_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, rectifiable_path N g /\ a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> continuous_on_hl 1 1 (fun x:set => lift (path_length N (fun x0:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) a x g x0))) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_REFLECT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => f (vector_neg M x)) {vector_neg M x | x :e s} <-> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> P x) -> (continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) s <-> continuous_on_hl M N f s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N A f s <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ tendsto N omega x a sequentially) -> tendsto A omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) (f a) sequentially

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_SING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f {a}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_SNDCART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) -> continuous_on_hl M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) f s -> continuous_on_hl M P (fun x:set => sndcart N P (f x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_SUB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ continuous_on_hl A B g s -> continuous_on_hl A B (fun x:set => vector_sub B (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx B, continuous_on_hl B A f s /\ t c= s -> continuous_on_hl B A f t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ (closed A t /\ (continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ continuous_on_hl A B f t)) -> continuous_on_hl A B f (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_UNION_LOCAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (s :\/: t)) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (s :\/: t)) t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ continuous_on_hl M N f t)) -> continuous_on_hl M N f (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_UNION_LOCAL_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (s :\/: t) /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (s :\/: t) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ continuous_on_hl M N f t)) -> continuous_on_hl M N f (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_UNION_OPEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, open A s /\ (open A t /\ (continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ continuous_on_hl A B f t)) -> continuous_on_hl A B f (s :\/: t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_VECTORIZE_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, A x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl P (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (fun a:set => vectorize R M N (A a)) s <-> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> continuous_on_hl P 1 (fun a:set => lift (A a i j)) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_VECTOR_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> continuous_on_hl 1 1 (fun x:set => lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_VMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, c x :e R) -> forall v :e R :^: idx B, continuous_on_hl A 1 (fun x:set => lift (c x)) s -> continuous_on_hl A B (fun x:set => vector_mul B (c x) v) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_ON_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e C, forall y :e R :^: idx B, f x y :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= C, finite s /\ (forall a :e C, a :e s -> continuous_on_hl B A (f a) t) -> continuous_on_hl B A (fun x:set => vsum C A s (fun a:set => f a x)) t

items.name: CONTINUOUS_OPEN_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (open_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: CONTINUOUS_OPEN_IN_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx B, continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ open B t -> {x :e R :^: idx A | x :e s /\ f x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_OPEN_IN_PREIMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, open N t -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_OPEN_IN_PREIMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t u c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_OPEN_IN_PREIMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, forall v c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e u /\ f x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_OPEN_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (open M s /\ open N t) -> open M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_OPEN_PREIMAGE_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x)) /\ open N s -> open M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e s}

items.name: CONTINUOUS_OPEN_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ open_map A B (top,top') f -> (quotient_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')

items.name: CONTINUOUS_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous M A f net0 /\ continuous N A g net0 -> continuous (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) A (fun x:set => pastecart M N (f x) (g x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_RIGHT_INVERSE_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= s /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> f (g y) = y)))) -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_SNDCART
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> continuous (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) A f net0 -> continuous N A (fun x:set => sndcart M N (f x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_SUB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall net0 :e net A, continuous B A f net0 /\ continuous B A g net0 -> continuous B A (fun x:set => vector_sub B (f x) (g x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_TRANSFORM_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall d :e R, 0 < d /\ ((forall x' :e R :^: idx M, distance M (x',x) < d -> f x' = g x') /\ continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x)) -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) g (at M x)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_TRANSFORM_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall d :e R, 0 < d /\ (x :e s /\ ((forall x' :e R :^: idx M, x' :e s /\ distance M (x',x) < d -> f x' = g x') /\ continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s))) -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) g (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_TRANSFORM_WITHIN_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, open M s /\ (a :e s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M a))) -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) g (at M a)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_TRANSFORM_WITHIN_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) t /\ (a :e s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) t))) -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) g (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_TRANSFORM_WITHIN_SET_IMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall s t c= R :^: idx B, eventually (R :^: idx B) {x :e R :^: idx B | x :e t -> x :e s} (at B a) /\ continuous A (R :^: idx B) f (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) s) -> continuous A (R :^: idx B) f (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_TRIVIAL_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall net0 :e net A, trivial_limit A net0 -> continuous B A f net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_UNIFORMLY_CAUCHY_LIMIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, eventually omega {n :e omega | continuous_on_hl M N (f n) s} sequentially /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx M, N0 <= m /\ (N0 <= n /\ x :e s) -> distance N (f m x,f n x) < e0) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_UNIFORM_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (eventually A {n :e A | continuous_on_hl M N (f n) s} net0 /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {n :e A | forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f n x) (g x)) < e0} net0)) -> continuous_on_hl M N g s

items.name: CONTINUOUS_VECTORIZE_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M) -> (continuous (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) A (fun a:set => vectorize R M N (A0 a)) net0 <-> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> continuous 1 A (fun a:set => lift (A0 a i j)) net0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_VMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net B, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e B, c x :e R) -> forall v :e R :^: idx A, continuous 1 B (fun x:set => lift (c x)) net0 -> continuous A B (fun x:set => vector_mul A (c x) v) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e C, forall y :e B, f x y :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= C, finite s /\ (forall a :e C, a :e s -> continuous A B (f a) net0) -> continuous A B (fun x:set => vsum C A s (fun a:set => f a x)) net0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A M:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous A (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx M) f (f x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_AVOID
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ (x :e s /\ ~ f x = a) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s /\ distance M (x,y) < e0 -> ~ f y = a

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_BALL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, continuous B (R :^: idx A) f (within (R :^: idx A) (at A x) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ {f x0 | x0 :e ball A (x,d) :/\: s} c= ball B (f x,e0)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_CLOSED_NONTRIVIAL

var_views.f: metafun(R :^: idx A -> R :^: idx B)

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ ~ a :e s -> continuous B (R :^: idx A) f (within (R :^: idx A) (at A a) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, continuous P (R :^: idx M) g (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> distance N (f a,f x) <= distance P (g a,g x)) -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_COMPOSE
