items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx C, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall x :e R :^: idx C, forall s c= R :^: idx C, continuous A (R :^: idx C) f (within (R :^: idx C) (at C x) s) /\ continuous B (R :^: idx A) g (within (R :^: idx A) (at A (f x)) {f x | x :e s}) -> continuous B (R :^: idx C) (fun x:set => g (f x)) (within (R :^: idx C) (at C x) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, continuous A (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => x) (within (R :^: idx A) (at A a) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_LIFT_SQRT
items.statement: forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, continuous 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun x:set => lift (if 0 <= drop x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (drop x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- drop x))) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) u) <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ f x :e t -> exists s c= R :^: idx M, open M s /\ (x :e s /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx M, x' :e s /\ x' :e u -> f x' :e t)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall s t c= R :^: idx M, a :e t /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> (continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) t) <-> continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s))

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous A (R :^: idx N) f (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ tendsto N omega x a sequentially -> tendsto A omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) (f a) sequentially

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> 0 < e0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s :\: {a}) /\ (tendsto M omega x a sequentially /\ (forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n))) -> exists n :e omega, distance N (f (x n),f a) < e0

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY_COMPACT_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ compact M c -> compact N {f x | x :e c}) /\ x :e s -> (continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) <-> forall p:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, p x0 :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, (forall n :e omega, p n :e s) /\ (tendsto M omega p x sequentially /\ (forall n :e omega, f (p n) = y)) -> f x = y)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY_INJ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ tendsto M omega x a sequentially) -> tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) (f a) sequentially

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_SQRT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s) -> continuous 1 (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => lift (if 0 <= f x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (f x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- f x))) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s)

items.name: CONTINUOUS_WITHIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx B, forall x :e R :^: idx B, continuous A (R :^: idx B) f (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s) /\ t c= s -> continuous A (R :^: idx B) f (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) t)

items.name: CONTINUUM_UNION_COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ (compact N u /\ (connected N u /\ (s c= u /\ (c :e components N (u :\: s) /\ closure N c :\: c c= s))))) -> compact N (c :\/: s) /\ connected N (c :\/: s)

items.name: CONTINUUM_UNION_COMPONENTS_INTERMEDIATE_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (connected N s /\ (compact N t /\ (s c= t /\ (compact N u /\ (connected N u /\ (t c= u /\ (c :e components N (u :\: t) /\ closure N c :\: c c= s))))))) -> compact N (c :\/: s) /\ connected N (c :\/: s)

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_CONVEX_TWEAK_BOUNDARY_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (relative_interior N s c= t /\ t c= closure N s) -> contractible N t

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> contractible A Empty

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_EQ_HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SINGLETON_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, contractible_space A top <-> topspace A top = Empty \/ exists a :e A, a :e topspace A top /\ homotopy_equivalent_space A A top (subtopology A top {a})

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, contractible_space (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n)

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_IMP_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, contractible N s -> connected N s

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_IMP_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, contractible_space A top -> connected_space A top

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, contractible N s -> path_connected N s

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, contractible_space A top -> path_connected_space A top

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_IMP_SIMPLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, contractible N s -> simply_connected N s

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (contractible N {f x | x :e s} <-> contractible M s)

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, contractible M s /\ contractible N t -> contractible (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, contractible (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ contractible M s /\ contractible N t)

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_PUNCTURED_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall b :e R :^: idx N, 0 < r /\ b :e sphere N (a,r) -> contractible N (sphere N (a,r) :\: {b})

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_PUNCTURED_SPHERE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ a :e relative_frontier N s) -> contractible N (relative_frontier N s :\: {a})

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, contractible N {a}

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, contractible_space A top <-> topspace A top = Empty \/ exists a :e A, a :e topspace A top /\ homotopic_with A A {x :e A :^: A | True} (top,top) (fun x:set => x) (fun x:set => a)

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, contractible_space A top <-> forall a :e A, a :e topspace A top -> homotopic_with A A {x :e A :^: A | True} (top,top) (fun x:set => x) (fun x:set => a)

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> contractible_space A top

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, contractible_space (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> contractible N s

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: contractible_space R euclideanreal

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_LOWER_HEMISPHERE
items.statement: forall n k :e omega, k :e idx_n (n + 1) -> contractible_space (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (nsphere n) {x :e R :^: omega | x k <= 0})

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> (contractible_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> contractible_space A (tops i))

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, contractible_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace A top1 = Empty \/ (topspace B top2 = Empty \/ contractible_space A top1 /\ contractible_space B top2)

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') f /\ contractible_space A top -> contractible_space B top'

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, topspace A top = {a} -> contractible_space A top

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_SUBSET_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, topspace A top c= {a} -> contractible_space A top

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, contractible_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal s) <-> is_realinterval s

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, contractible_space A (subtopology A top {a})

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_UPPER_HEMISPHERE
items.statement: forall n k :e omega, k :e idx_n (n + 1) -> contractible_space (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (nsphere n) {x :e R :^: omega | 0 <= x k})

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, contractible N (sphere N (a,r)) <-> r <= 0

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, contractible N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> contractible N s

items.name: CONTRACTIBLE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> contractible N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: CONTRACTION_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (f x,f y) <= distance M (x,y)) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: CONTRACTION_IMP_UNIQUE_FIXPOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall k :e R, forall x y :e A, k < 1 /\ ((forall x0 :e A, x0 :e mspace A m -> f x0 :e mspace A m) /\ ((forall x0 y0 :e A, x0 :e mspace A m /\ y0 :e mspace A m -> mdist A m (f x0,f y0) <= k * mdist A m (x0,y0)) /\ (x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ (f x = x /\ f y = y))))) -> x = y

items.name: CONTRAPOS_THM
items.statement: forall t1 t2:prop, ~ t1 -> ~ t2 <-> t2 -> t1

items.name: CONVERGENCE_IN_MEASURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall n :e omega, measurable_on M N (f n) s) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually omega {n :e omega | exists t c= R :^: idx M, {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ e0 <= distance N (f n x,g x)} c= t /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < e0)} sequentially) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ exists t c= R :^: idx M, (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ (negligible M t /\ (t c= s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f (r n) x) (g x) sequentially))

items.name: CONVERGENCE_IN_MEASURE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall n :e omega, measurable_on M N (f n) s) /\ ((forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually omega {n :e omega | exists t c= R :^: idx M, {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ e0 <= distance N (f n x,g x)} c= t /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < e0)} sequentially) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually omega {n :e omega | exists t c= R :^: idx M, {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ e0 <= distance N (f n x,h x)} c= t /\ (measurable M t /\ measure M t < e0)} sequentially)) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ~ g x = h x}

items.name: CONVERGENT_BOUNDED_DECREASING_1
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall b :e R, (forall n :e omega, drop (s (ordsucc n)) <= drop (s n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, b <= drop (s n)) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 omega s l sequentially

items.name: CONVERGENT_BOUNDED_INCREASING
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R) -> forall b :e R, (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s m <= s n) /\ (forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (s n) <= b) -> exists l :e R, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n -> abs_SNo (s n + - l) < e0

items.name: CONVERGENT_BOUNDED_INCREASING_1
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall b :e R, (forall n :e omega, drop (s n) <= drop (s (ordsucc n))) /\ (forall n :e omega, drop (s n) <= b) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 omega s l sequentially

items.name: CONVERGENT_BOUNDED_MONOTONE
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R) -> forall b :e R, (forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (s n) <= b) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s m <= s n) \/ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n <= s m)) -> exists l :e R, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n -> abs_SNo (s n + - l) < e0

items.name: CONVERGENT_BOUNDED_MONOTONE_1
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx 1) -> bounded_hl 1 {s x | x :e omega} /\ ((forall n :e omega, drop (s n) <= drop (s (ordsucc n))) \/ (forall n :e omega, drop (s (ordsucc n)) <= drop (s n))) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 omega s l sequentially

items.name: CONVERGENT_BOUNDED_MONOTONE_EQ
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (forall n :e omega, drop (s n) <= drop (s (ordsucc n))) \/ (forall n :e omega, drop (s (ordsucc n)) <= drop (s n)) -> ((exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 omega s l sequentially) <-> bounded_hl 1 {s x | x :e omega})

items.name: CONVERGENT_EQ_CAUCHY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx A) -> ((exists l :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A omega s l sequentially) <-> cauchy A s)

items.name: CONVERGENT_EQ_CAUCHY_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (at M a)) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x x' :e R :^: idx M, 0 < distance M (x,a) /\ (distance M (x,a) < d /\ (0 < distance M (x',a) /\ distance M (x',a) < d)) -> distance N (f x,f x') < e0

items.name: CONVERGENT_EQ_CAUCHY_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s)) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x x' :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (0 < distance M (x,a) /\ (distance M (x,a) < d /\ (x' :e s /\ (0 < distance M (x',a) /\ distance M (x',a) < d)))) -> distance N (f x,f x') < e0

items.name: CONVERGENT_EQ_ZERO_OSCILLATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s)) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, open M u /\ (a :e u /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :/\: u :\: {a} /\ y :e s :/\: u :\: {a} -> distance N (f x,f y) < e0)

items.name: CONVERGENT_EQ_ZERO_OSCILLATION_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, mcomplete B m /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top :/\: s} c= mspace B m -> ((exists l :e B, limit A B (mtopology B m) f l (within A (atpointof A top a) s)) <-> ~ mspace B m = Empty /\ (a :e topspace A top -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (a :e u /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s :/\: u :\: {a} /\ y :e s :/\: u :\: {a} -> mdist B m (f x,f y) < e0)))

items.name: CONVERGENT_IMP_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A omega s l sequentially -> bounded_hl A {s x | x :e omega}

items.name: CONVERGENT_IMP_CAUCHY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A omega s l sequentially -> cauchy A s

items.name: CONVERGENT_IMP_CAUCHY_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> forall l :e A, (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A m) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m) x l sequentially -> cauchy_in A m x

items.name: CONVERGENT_OFFSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega f l sequentially) -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega (fun i:set => f (i + k)) l sequentially

items.name: CONVERGENT_OFFSET_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega (fun i:set => f (i + k)) l sequentially) <-> exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega f l sequentially

items.name: CONVERGENT_OFFSET_REV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega (fun i:set => f (i + k)) l sequentially) -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega f l sequentially

items.name: CONVERGENT_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> ((exists y :e R :^: idx N, exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ (y :e s /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) y sequentially))) <-> exists k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ (compact N k /\ infinite {n :e omega | x n :e k}))

items.name: CONVERSE_SARD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M = dimindex N /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) /\ negligible N {f x | x :e s}) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ rank M N (matrix M N (f' x)) = dimindex N}

items.name: CONVERSE_SARD_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> has_vector_derivative 1 f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)) /\ negligible 1 {f x | x :e s} -> negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ f' x = vec 1 0}

items.name: CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall V c= R :^: idx N, convex N V <-> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) -> finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (s c= V /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ finsum s u = 1))) -> vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) :e V

items.name: CONVEXITY_PRESERVING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ convex M c -> convex N {f x | x :e c}) <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> convex N {f x | x :e closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: CONVEXITY_PRESERVING_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ convex M c -> convex N {f x | x :e c}) <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> closed_segment N (seq_cons (f a,f b) seq_nil) c= {f x | x :e closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: CONVEXITY_PRESERVING_SHRINK_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> exists f g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism N N (R :^: idx N,ball N (vec N 0,1)) (f,g) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} {f x | x :e s} = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e s -> vec N 0 :e {f x | x :e s}) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ vec N 0 :e s -> convex N {f x | x :e s}) /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s -> vec N 0 :e relative_interior N {f x | x :e s})))

items.name: CONVEX_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R) -> convex_on A f s /\ convex_on A g s -> convex_on A (fun x:set => f x + g x) s

items.name: CONVEX_ADD_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N (fun x:set => a + f x) s <-> convex_on N f s

items.name: CONVEX_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, convex N s -> convex N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, convex N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ convex N s

items.name: CONVEX_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall u :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (0 <= u /\ u <= 1)) -> vector_add A (vector_mul A (1 + - u) x) (vector_mul A u y) :e s

items.name: CONVEX_AND_AFFINE_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (affine N t /\ (open N u /\ (s :/\: u = t :/\: u /\ ~ s :/\: u = Empty))) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = t

items.name: CONVEX_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, convex N (ball N (x,e0))

items.name: CONVEX_BOUNDS_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, convex_on N f (cball N (x,e0)) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e cball N (x,e0) -> f y <= b) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e cball N (x,e0) -> abs_SNo (f y) <= b + 2 * abs_SNo (f x)

items.name: CONVEX_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, convex N (cball N (x,e0))

items.name: CONVEX_CLOSED_CONTAINS_SAME_RAY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b l :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (b :e s /\ (forall t :e R, 0 <= t -> vector_add N a (vector_mul N t l) :e s))) -> forall t :e R, 0 <= t -> vector_add N b (vector_mul N t l) :e s

items.name: CONVEX_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> convex N (closure N s)

items.name: CONVEX_CLOSURE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ interior N s = Empty -> closure N (interior N s) = closure N s

items.name: CONVEX_CLOSURE_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> closure N (relative_interior N s) = closure N s

items.name: CONVEX_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> 0 <= c /\ convex_on A f s -> convex_on A (fun x:set => c * f x) s

items.name: CONVEX_CONCAVE_EQ_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> (convex_on N f (R :^: idx N) /\ convex_on N (fun x:set => - f x) (R :^: idx N) <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = dot N a x + b)

items.name: CONVEX_CONE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_cone N s <-> vec N 0 :e s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_add N x y :e s) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, x :e s /\ 0 <= c -> vector_mul N c x :e s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, convex_cone A s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> vector_add A x y :e s

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_CONTAINS_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_cone N s -> vec N 0 :e s

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_CONVEX_CONE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex_cone A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex_cone A x} s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, convex_cone A {x :e R :^: idx A | 0 <= dot A a x}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, convex_cone A {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x <= 0}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x0} s -> vector_add N x y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x0} s

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_CONTAINS_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, vec A 0 :e hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex_cone A x} s

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} s = SetAdjoin (\/_ c :e R, {vector_mul N c x | x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= c /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s}) (vec N 0)

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_CONVEX_HULL_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} s = \/_ c :e R, {vector_mul N c x | x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= c /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex_cone A x} Empty = {vec A 0}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e hull (R :^: idx M) {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | convex_cone M x} s}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= c /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x0} s -> vector_mul N c x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x0} s

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ~ hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex_cone A x} s = Empty

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_SEPARATE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} s = SetAdjoin (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)) (vec N 0)

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_SEPARATE_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_HULL_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} (s :\/: t) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x0} t}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex_cone N s) -> convex_cone N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, convex_cone M s /\ linear M N f -> convex_cone N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (convex_cone N {f x | x :e s} <-> convex_cone M s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, convex_cone A s /\ (0 <= c /\ x :e s) -> vector_mul A c x :e s

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex_cone A s -> convex_cone A {vector_neg A x | x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex_cone A s -> ~ s = Empty

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex_cone M s /\ convex_cone N t -> convex_cone (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex_cone (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> convex_cone M s /\ convex_cone N t

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> convex_cone A {vec A 0}

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex_cone A (span A s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONE_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex_cone N s /\ convex_cone N t -> convex_cone N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: CONVEX_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> convex N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> connected N s

items.name: CONVEX_CONNECTED_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, convex 1 s <-> connected 1 s

items.name: CONVEX_CONNECTED_1_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 -> (convex N s <-> connected N s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONNECTED_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, collinear N s -> (convex N s <-> connected N s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONTAINS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> x :e s

items.name: CONVEX_CONTAINS_OPEN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, a :e s /\ b :e s -> open_segment A (a,b) c= s

items.name: CONVEX_CONTAINS_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, a :e s /\ b :e s -> closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s

items.name: CONVEX_CONTAINS_SEGMENT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s <-> a :e s /\ b :e s

items.name: CONVEX_CONTAINS_SEGMENT_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a b :e R :^: idx A, convex A s -> (closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s <-> a :e s /\ b :e s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONVEX_CONE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex_cone A x} s)

items.name: CONVEX_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s)

items.name: CONVEX_DIFFERENCES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ convex A t -> convex A (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {vector_sub A x y | y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: CONVEX_DISTANCE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, convex_on A (fun x:set => distance A (a,x)) s

items.name: CONVEX_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> convex A Empty

items.name: CONVEX_EPIGRAPH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex_on A f s /\ convex A s <-> convex (idx_n (dimindex A + 1)) (epigraph A s f)

items.name: CONVEX_EPIGRAPH_CONVEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s -> (convex_on A f s <-> convex (idx_n (dimindex A + 1)) (epigraph A s f))

items.name: CONVEX_EQ_CONNECTED_LINE_INTERSECTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N (s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b})

items.name: CONVEX_EQ_CONVEX_LINE_INTERSECTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N (s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b})

items.name: CONVEX_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) -> finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> 0 <= u x) /\ finsum t u = 1)) -> vsum (R :^: idx N) N t (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) :e s

items.name: CONVEX_FACIAL_PARTITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> Union {relative_interior N f | f :e Power (R :^: idx N), face_of N f s} = s

items.name: CONVEX_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> (convex N s <-> forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) -> (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ finsum s u = 1 -> vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) :e s)

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | a <= x k}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | a < x k}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= a}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k < a}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_SGN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | (if 0 < x k then 1 else if x k < 0 then - 1 else 0) = a}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, convex A {x :e R :^: idx A | b < dot A a x}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_INTERSECTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ convex N s -> s = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {h :e Power (R :^: idx N) | s c= h /\ exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b}}, x :e Y}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, convex A {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x <= b}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, convex A {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x < b}

items.name: CONVEX_HALFSPACE_SGN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | (if 0 < dot N a x then 1 else if dot N a x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = b}

items.name: CONVEX_HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: CONVEX_HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_EQ
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 (fun x:set => drop (f x)) s /\ is_interval 1 s -> (has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s <-> bounded_hl 1 {f x | x :e s})

items.name: CONVEX_HAUSDIST_LIMIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall t c= R :^: idx N, eventually omega {n :e omega | bounded_hl N (s n) /\ (convex N (s n) /\ ~ s n = Empty)} sequentially /\ (compact N t /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (hausdist N (s n,t))) (vec 1 0) sequentially) -> convex N t

items.name: CONVEX_HULLS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} t /\ t c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} t

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} {a,b} = \/_ u :e R, {vector_add A (vector_mul A u a) (vector_mul A v b) | v :e R, 0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1)}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_2_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} {a,b} = {vector_add A a (vector_mul A u (vector_sub A b a)) | u :e R, 0 <= u /\ u <= 1}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_3
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} {a,b,c} = \/_ u :e R, \/_ v :e R, {vector_add A (vector_mul A u a) (vector_add A (vector_mul A v b) (vector_mul A w c)) | w :e R, 0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ (0 <= w /\ u + v + w = 1))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_3_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} {a,b,c} = \/_ u :e R, {vector_add A a (vector_add A (vector_mul A u (vector_sub A b a)) (vector_mul A v (vector_sub A c a))) | v :e R, 0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v <= 1)}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {vector_add N (vector_mul N c x) a | x :e s} = {vector_add N (vector_mul N c x) a | x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_CARATHEODORY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} p = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (s c= p /\ (finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N + 1 /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y)))))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_CARATHEODORY_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} p = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (s c= p /\ (finite_cardinality s <= aff_dim N p + 1 /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y)))))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} (closure A s) = closure A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s)

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_CLOSURE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (closure N s) c= closure N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_CONTAINS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ (b :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} Empty = Empty

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s = s <-> convex A s

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s = Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s = {a} <-> s = {a}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_EXCHANGE_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ (a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s /\ (t c= s /\ t' c= s)) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin t a) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin t' a) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin (t :/\: t') a)

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_EXCHANGE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s = Union {hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin (s :\: {b}) a) | b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} p = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (s c= p /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y))))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_FINITE_IMAGE_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= A, finite k -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {f x | x :e k} = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) /\ ((forall a :e A, a :e k -> 0 <= u a) /\ (finsum k u = 1 /\ vsum A N k (fun a:set => vector_mul N (u a) (f a)) = y))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_FINITE_STEP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall w :e R, forall y :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, ((exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e Empty -> 0 <= u x) /\ (finsum Empty u = w /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N Empty (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))) <-> w = 0 /\ y = vec N 0) /\ (finite s -> ((exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e SetAdjoin s a -> 0 <= u x) /\ (finsum (SetAdjoin s a) u = w /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N (SetAdjoin s a) (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))) <-> exists v :e R, 0 <= v /\ exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ (finsum s u = w + - v /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = vector_sub N y (vector_mul N v a)))))

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= A, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {f x | x :e k} = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists c c= A, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) /\ (finite c /\ (c c= k /\ ((forall a :e A, a :e c -> 0 <= u a) /\ (finsum c u = 1 /\ vsum A N c (fun a:set => vector_mul N (u a) (f a)) = y))))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_IMAGE_LT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= A, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {f x | x :e k} = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists c c= A, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) /\ (finite c /\ (c c= k /\ ((forall a :e A, a :e c -> 0 < u a) /\ (finsum c u = 1 /\ vsum A N c (fun a:set => vector_mul N (u a) (f a)) = y))))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_INDEXED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists k :e omega, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, u x :e R) /\ exists x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= k -> 0 <= u i /\ x i :e s) /\ (finsum (idx_n k) u = 1 /\ vsum omega N (idx_n k) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i)) = y))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s a) = {x :e R :^: idx N | exists u v :e R, exists b :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ (u + v = 1 /\ (b :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ x = vector_add N (vector_mul N u a) (vector_mul N v b))))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_INSERT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s a) = if s = Empty then {a} else \/_ u :e R, {vector_add N (vector_mul N (1 + - u) a) (vector_mul N u x) | x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= u /\ (u <= 1 /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s)}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_INSERT_REDUNDANT_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s c) /\ (b :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s c) /\ c :e open_segment N (a,b)) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s c) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_INSERT_SEGMENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s a) = if s = Empty then {a} else Union {closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N (s :\/: t) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :/\: t)

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_INTERIOR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (interior N s) c= interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx N), ~ affine_dependent N (Union s) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t | t :e Power (R :^: idx N), t :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e hull (R :^: idx B) {x :e Power (R :^: idx B) | convex B x} s}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) | convex (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x} (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e hull (R :^: idx M) {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | convex M x} s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_REDUNDANT_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\: {a}) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s <-> ~ extreme_point_of N a (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_REDUNDANT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (t c= s /\ s :\: t c= interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_REDUNDANT_SUBSET_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (t c= s /\ (s :\: t) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s)} = Empty) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_REDUNDANT_SUBSET_REV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t -> (s :\: t) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s)} = Empty

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} = {vector_mul N c x | x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} {a} = {a}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (sphere N (a,r)) = cball N (a,r)

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_SUBSET_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_SUBSET_CONVEX_CONE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex_cone A x} s

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_SUBSET_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s c= span A s

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} t}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_UNION_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ convex N t -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\/: t) = s :\/: (t :\/: \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, \/_ u :e R, {vector_add N (vector_mul N (1 + - u) x) (vector_mul N u y) | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ (0 <= u /\ u <= 1))})

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_UNION_NONEMPTY_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (convex N t /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\/: t) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, \/_ u :e R, {vector_add N (vector_mul N (1 + - u) x) (vector_mul N u y) | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ (0 <= u /\ u <= 1))}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_UNION_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N (Union f) /\ ~ f = Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\/: Union f) = Union {hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\/: t) | t :e Power (R :^: idx N), t :e f}

items.name: CONVEX_HULL_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (R :^: idx N) = R :^: idx N

items.name: CONVEX_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> ANR N s

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_AR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> AR N s

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_BOUNDED_ON_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> abs_SNo (f x) <= B

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> contractible N s

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N f t /\ (compact N s /\ s c= relative_interior N t) -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> abs_SNo (f x + - f y) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_LOCALLY_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ a :e relative_interior N s -> exists e0 B :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (0 < B /\ (cball N (a,e0) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s c= s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e cball N (a,e0) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s -> abs_SNo (f x) <= B))

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ a :e relative_interior N s -> exists e0 B :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (0 < B /\ (cball N (a,e0) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s c= s /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e cball N (a,e0) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s /\ y :e cball N (a,e0) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s -> abs_SNo (f x + - f y) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)))

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> path_connected N s

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_PIECEWISE_MONOTONE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 f s /\ is_interval 1 s -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e interior 1 s /\ (y :e interior 1 s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> f x <= f y) \/ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e interior 1 s /\ (y :e interior 1 s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> f y <= f x) \/ exists a :e R :^: idx 1, a :e interior 1 s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (drop x <= drop y /\ drop y <= drop a)) -> f y <= f x) /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (drop a <= drop x /\ drop x <= drop y)) -> f x <= f y))

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_SIMPLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> simply_connected N s

items.name: CONVEX_IMP_STARLIKE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ ~ s = Empty -> starlike A s

items.name: CONVEX_INDEXED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s <-> forall k :e omega, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, u x :e R) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= k -> 0 <= u i /\ x i :e s) /\ finsum (idx_n k) u = 1 -> vsum omega N (idx_n k) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i)) :e s

items.name: CONVEX_INNER_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, finite k /\ (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} k c= s /\ (hausdist N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} k,s) < e0 /\ (k = Empty -> s = Empty)))

items.name: CONVEX_INNER_POLYTOPE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists p c= R :^: idx N, polytope N p /\ (p c= s /\ (hausdist N (p,s) < e0 /\ (p = Empty -> s = Empty)))

items.name: CONVEX_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ convex A t -> convex A (s :/\: t)

items.name: CONVEX_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> convex N (interior N s)

items.name: CONVEX_INTERIOR_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> interior N (closure N s) = interior N s

items.name: CONVEX_INTERMEDIATE_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall t c= R :^: idx N, ball N (a,r) c= t /\ t c= cball N (a,r) -> convex N t

items.name: CONVEX_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), (forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e f -> convex A s) -> convex A {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: CONVEX_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ convex N (open_interval N (a,b))

items.name: CONVEX_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ linear A B f -> convex B {f x | x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (convex A {f x | x :e s} <-> convex B s)

items.name: CONVEX_LINEAR_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ convex N s -> convex M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_LINE_INTERSECTIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e relative_frontier N s /\ (b :e relative_frontier N s /\ ~ open_segment N (a,b) :/\: relative_interior N s = Empty)) -> ~ a = b /\ (closure N s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (relative_interior N s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} = open_segment N (a,b) /\ relative_frontier N s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} = {a,b}))

items.name: CONVEX_LINE_INTERSECTIONS_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e relative_frontier N s /\ (b :e relative_frontier N s /\ ~ open_segment N (a,b) c= relative_frontier N s)) -> ~ a = b /\ (closure N s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (relative_interior N s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} = open_segment N (a,b) /\ relative_frontier N s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} = {a,b}))

items.name: CONVEX_LINE_INTERSECTION_UNIQUE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (a :e relative_frontier N s /\ (b :e relative_frontier N s /\ ~ open_segment N (a,b) :/\: relative_interior N s = Empty))) -> s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: CONVEX_LINE_INTERSECTION_UNIQUE_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (open N s /\ (a :e relative_frontier N s /\ (b :e relative_frontier N s /\ ~ open_segment N (a,b) :/\: s = Empty))) -> s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} = open_segment N (a,b)

items.name: CONVEX_LINE_INTERSECTION_UNIQUE_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ (a :e relative_frontier N s /\ (b :e relative_frontier N s /\ ~ open_segment N (a,b) :/\: s = Empty))) -> s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} = open_segment N (a,b)

items.name: CONVEX_LOCAL_GLOBAL_MINIMUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ (x :e t /\ (open N t /\ (t c= s /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> f x <= f y)))) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> f x <= f y

items.name: CONVEX_LOCAL_GLOBAL_MINIMUM_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ (x :e t /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s) /\ (t c= s /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> f x <= f y)))) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> f x <= f y

items.name: CONVEX_LOCAL_GLOBAL_MINIMUM_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ (x :e s /\ (forall z :e R :^: idx N, z :e s /\ ~ z = x -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (x,z) seq_nil) /\ (y :e s /\ (~ y = x /\ f x <= f y)))) -> forall z :e R :^: idx N, z :e s -> f x <= f z

items.name: CONVEX_LOWER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall u v :e R, convex_on N f s /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1)))) -> f (vector_add N (vector_mul N u x) (vector_mul N v y)) <= if f x <= f y then f y else f x

items.name: CONVEX_LOWER_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> f x <= if f a <= f b then f b else f a

items.name: CONVEX_LOWER_SEGMENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (~ x = b /\ f a < f b)))) -> f x < f b

items.name: CONVEX_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex_on A f s /\ convex_on A g s -> convex_on A (fun x:set => if f x <= g x then g x else f x) s

items.name: CONVEX_NEARBY_IN_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, convex N s /\ (vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s /\ 1 < r) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s /\ distance N (x,y) <= d) -> y :e {vector_mul N r x0 | x0 :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_NEARBY_IN_SCALING_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, convex N s /\ (vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s /\ 1 < r) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s /\ distance N (x,y) <= d) -> y :e {vector_mul N r x0 | x0 :e relative_interior N s}

items.name: CONVEX_NEARBY_NOT_IN_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, convex N s /\ (vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s /\ (0 < r /\ r < 1)) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e relative_frontier N s /\ distance N (x,y) <= d -> ~ y :e {vector_mul N r x0 | x0 :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s -> convex A {vector_neg A x | x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N (fun x:set => vector_norm N x) s

items.name: CONVEX_ON_COMPOSE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, convex_on N f {g x | x :e s} /\ linear M N g -> convex_on M (fun x:set => f (g x)) s

items.name: CONVEX_ON_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R, convex_on A (fun x:set => a) s

items.name: CONVEX_ON_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ convex_on N f s -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s

items.name: CONVEX_ON_CONTINUOUS_ON_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (relative_interior N s)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_CONVEX_HULL_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex_on N f (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x <= b) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s -> f x <= b

items.name: CONVEX_ON_CONVEX_HULL_BOUND_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex_on N f (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s -> f x <= b) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x <= b)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_COUNTABLE_NONDIFFERENTIABLE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 f s /\ countable (components 1 s) -> countable {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable 1 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (at 1 x)}

items.name: CONVEX_ON_DERIVATIVES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative 1 N (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (fun x0:set => lift (f' x x0)) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) -> (convex_on N f s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f' x (vector_sub N y x) <= f' y (vector_sub N y x))

items.name: CONVEX_ON_DERIVATIVES_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall f'x:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f'x x :e R) -> forall f'y:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f'y x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ (closed_segment N (seq_cons (x,y) seq_nil) c= s /\ (has_derivative 1 N (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (fun x:set => lift (f'x x)) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s) /\ has_derivative 1 N (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (fun x:set => lift (f'y x)) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N y) s))) -> f'x (vector_sub N y x) <= f'y (vector_sub N y x)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_DERIVATIVE_SECANT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative 1 N (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (fun x0:set => lift (f' x x0)) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) -> (convex_on N f s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f' x (vector_sub N y x) <= f y + - f x)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_DERIVATIVE_SECANT_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ (closed_segment N (seq_cons (x,y) seq_nil) c= s /\ has_derivative 1 N (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (fun x:set => lift (f' x)) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) -> f' (vector_sub N y x) <= f y + - f x

items.name: CONVEX_ON_DIRECTIONAL_DERIVATIVES
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 f s /\ a :e interior 1 s -> exists l r :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x <= drop a}) /\ (has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) r (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop a <= drop x}) /\ drop l <= drop r)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_DIRECTIONAL_DERIVATIVE_FUNCTIONS
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ open 1 s) -> exists l:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, l x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (l x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | drop t <= drop x})) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (r x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x <= drop t})) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> drop (l x) <= drop (r x)) /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x < drop y) -> drop (r x) <= drop (l y))))

items.name: CONVEX_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> convex_on N f Empty

items.name: CONVEX_ON_EPIGRAPH_SLICE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, convex_on N f s /\ convex N s -> convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x <= a}

items.name: CONVEX_ON_EPIGRAPH_SLICE_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, convex_on N f s /\ convex N s -> convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x < a}

items.name: CONVEX_ON_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ convex_on A f s) -> convex_on A g s

items.name: CONVEX_ON_IMP_JENSEN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= A, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> convex_on N f s /\ (convex N s /\ (finite k /\ ((forall i :e A, i :e k -> 0 <= u i /\ x i :e s) /\ finsum k u = 1))) -> f (vsum A N k (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i))) <= finsum k (fun i:set => u i * f (x i))

items.name: CONVEX_ON_IMP_MIDPOINT_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> f (midpoint N (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2

items.name: CONVEX_ON_INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_INCREASING
