items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> convex_on 1 (fun x:set => drop (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: CONVEX_ON_IS_INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 (fun x:set => drop (f x)) s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ open 1 s) -> exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f' x) <= drop (f' y)) /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> has_integral 1 1 f' (vector_sub 1 (f y) (f x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (x,y) seq_nil)))

items.name: CONVEX_ON_JENSEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (convex_on N f s <-> forall k :e omega, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, u x :e R) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= k -> 0 <= u i /\ x i :e s) /\ finsum (idx_n k) u = 1 -> f (vsum omega N (idx_n k) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i))) <= finsum (idx_n k) (fun i:set => u i * f (x i)))

items.name: CONVEX_ON_LEFT_DIFFERENTIABLE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 f s /\ a :e interior 1 s -> differentiable 1 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x <= drop a})

items.name: CONVEX_ON_LEFT_SECANT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s <-> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e open_segment N (a,b)) -> (f x + - f a) :/: vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) <= (f b + - f a) :/: vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_LEFT_SECANT_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s <-> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> (f x + - f a) * vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a) <= (f b + - f a) * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_MID_SECANT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s <-> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e open_segment N (a,b)) -> (f x + - f a) :/: vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) <= (f b + - f x) :/: vector_norm N (vector_sub N b x)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_MID_SECANT_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s <-> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> (f x + - f a) * vector_norm N (vector_sub N b x) <= (f b + - f x) * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_RIGHT_DIFFERENTIABLE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 f s /\ a :e interior 1 s -> differentiable 1 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop a <= drop x})

items.name: CONVEX_ON_RIGHT_SECANT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s <-> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e open_segment N (a,b)) -> (f b + - f a) :/: vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a) <= (f b + - f x) :/: vector_norm N (vector_sub N b x)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_RIGHT_SECANT_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s <-> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> (f b + - f a) * vector_norm N (vector_sub N b x) <= (f b + - f x) * vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_SECANTS_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s -> (convex_on 1 f s <-> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx 1, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (c :e s /\ (d :e s /\ (drop a < drop b /\ (drop b <= drop c /\ drop c < drop d))))) -> (f b + - f a) :/: (drop b + - drop a) <= (f d + - f c) :/: (drop d + - drop c))

items.name: CONVEX_ON_SECANTS_1_IMP
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b c d :e R :^: idx 1, convex_on 1 f s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (c :e s /\ (d :e s /\ (drop a < drop b /\ (drop b <= drop c /\ drop c < drop d)))))) -> (f b + - f a) :/: (drop b + - drop a) <= (f d + - f c) :/: (drop d + - drop c)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_SECANT_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative 1 N (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (fun x0:set => lift (f' x x0)) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) -> (convex_on N f s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f y + - f x <= f' y (vector_sub N y x))

items.name: CONVEX_ON_SECANT_DERIVATIVE_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f s /\ (closed_segment N (seq_cons (x,y) seq_nil) c= s /\ has_derivative 1 N (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (fun x:set => lift (f' x)) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N y) s)) -> f y + - f x <= f' (vector_sub N y x)

items.name: CONVEX_ON_SETDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N t -> convex_on N (fun x:set => setdist N ({x},t)) s

items.name: CONVEX_ON_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f {a}

items.name: CONVEX_ON_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex_on A f t /\ s c= t -> convex_on A f s

items.name: CONVEX_ON_SUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> convex_on N (f a) t) -> convex_on N (fun x:set => finsum s (fun a:set => f a x)) t

items.name: CONVEX_ON_SUP
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R) -> forall t c= A, forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ((forall i :e A, i :e t -> convex_on N (f i) s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists B :e R, forall i :e A, i :e t -> f i x <= B)) -> convex_on N (fun x:set => sup {f i x | i :e A, i :e t}) s

items.name: CONVEX_ON_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex_on N f {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> convex_on N (fun x:set => f (vector_add N a x)) s

items.name: CONVEX_OPEN_SEGMENT_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e closure N s /\ b :e closure N s) -> open_segment N (a,b) c= relative_frontier N s \/ open_segment N (a,b) c= relative_interior N s

items.name: CONVEX_OPEN_SEGMENT_CASES_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e closure N s /\ b :e closure N s) -> open_segment N (a,b) c= frontier N s \/ open_segment N (a,b) c= interior N s

items.name: CONVEX_OUTER_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, finite k /\ (s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} k /\ hausdist N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} k,s) < e0)

items.name: CONVEX_OUTER_POLYTOPE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists p c= R :^: idx N, polytope N p /\ (s c= p /\ hausdist N (p,s) < e0)

items.name: CONVEX_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex M s /\ convex N t -> convex (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: CONVEX_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ convex M s /\ convex N t)

items.name: CONVEX_POLAR_DUAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N (polar_dual N s)

items.name: CONVEX_POSITIVE_ORTHANT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 <= x i}

items.name: CONVEX_PREIMAGE_CONCAVE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (vec N 0 :e s /\ (convex_on N (fun x:set => - f x) t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> 0 < f x)))) -> convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e t /\ vector_mul N (recip_SNo (f x)) x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_RELATIVE_BOUNDARY_SUBSET_OF_PROPER_FACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (convex N t /\ t c= s :\: relative_interior N s)) -> exists f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ (~ f = s /\ t c= f)

items.name: CONVEX_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> convex N (relative_interior N s)

items.name: CONVEX_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> relative_interior N (closure N s) = relative_interior N s

items.name: CONVEX_SAME_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ convex A t -> (relative_interior A s = relative_interior A t <-> closure A s = closure A t)

items.name: CONVEX_SAME_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CLOSURE_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ convex A t -> (relative_interior A s = relative_interior A t <-> relative_interior A s c= t /\ t c= closure A s)

items.name: CONVEX_SCALING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, convex A s -> convex A {vector_mul A c x | x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, convex N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ convex N s

items.name: CONVEX_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, convex A (closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx B, convex B (open_segment B (a,b))

items.name: CONVEX_SEMIOPEN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: {a})) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: {b})

items.name: CONVEX_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, convex A {a}

items.name: CONVEX_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A (span A s)

items.name: CONVEX_STANDARD_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a :e R, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = a}

items.name: CONVEX_STANDARD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: omega, forall u :e R, x :e standard_simplex p /\ (y :e standard_simplex p /\ (0 <= u /\ u <= 1)) -> (fun i :e omega => (1 + - u) * x i + u * y i) :e standard_simplex p

items.name: CONVEX_STARCENTRES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N {a :e R :^: idx N | a :e s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil) c= s}

items.name: CONVEX_STRIP_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) <= a}

items.name: CONVEX_STRIP_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, convex N {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) < a}

items.name: CONVEX_SUMS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ convex A t -> convex A (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {vector_add A x y | y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: CONVEX_SUMS_MULTIPLES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c d :e R, convex N s /\ (0 <= c /\ 0 <= d) -> (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N (vector_mul N c x) (vector_mul N d y) | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s}) = {vector_mul N (c + d) x | x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_SYMDIFF_CLOSE_TO_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (convex N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,t) < e0))))) -> (s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s) c= \/_ u :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N u v | v :e R :^: idx N, u :e frontier N s /\ v :e ball N (vec N 0,e0)}

items.name: CONVEX_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s -> convex N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: CONVEX_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> convex N s

items.name: CONVEX_TRANSLATION_SUBSET_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N t -> convex N {a :e R :^: idx N | {vector_add N a x | x :e s} c= t}

items.name: CONVEX_TRANSLATION_SUPERSET_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N t -> convex N {a :e R :^: idx N | s c= {vector_add N a x | x :e t}}

items.name: CONVEX_TRIPLE_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx_n 2, forall a b c d :e R :^: idx_n 2, forall e0 :e R, convex (idx_n 2) s /\ ({a,b,c} c= relative_frontier (idx_n 2) s /\ (~ a = b /\ (~ a = c /\ (~ b = c /\ (dot (idx_n 2) d a = e0 /\ (dot (idx_n 2) d b = e0 /\ dot (idx_n 2) d c = e0)))))) -> s c= {x :e R :^: idx_n 2 | dot (idx_n 2) d x <= e0} \/ s c= {x :e R :^: idx_n 2 | e0 <= dot (idx_n 2) d x}

items.name: CONVEX_UNIONS_FULLDIM_CELLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall u c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e s -> closed N c /\ convex N c) /\ (Union s = u /\ convex N u)) -> Union {c :e Power (R :^: idx N) | c :e s /\ aff_dim N c = aff_dim N u} = u

items.name: CONVEX_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> convex N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: CONVEX_VSUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= A, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite k /\ (convex N s /\ (finsum k u = 1 /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> 0 <= u i /\ x i :e s))) -> vsum A N k (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i)) :e s

items.name: CONVEX_VSUM_STRONG
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= A, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> convex N s /\ (finsum k u = 1 /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> 0 <= u i /\ (u i = 0 \/ x i :e s))) -> vsum A N k (fun i:set => vector_mul N (u i) (x i)) :e s

items.name: COPLANAR_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, coplanar A {a,b}

items.name: COPLANAR_3
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx A, coplanar A {a,b,c}

items.name: COPLANAR_AFFINE_HULL_COPLANAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, coplanar A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s) <-> coplanar A s

items.name: COPLANAR_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, coplanar N s <-> aff_dim N s <= 2

items.name: COPLANAR_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> coplanar A Empty

items.name: COPLANAR_INTERSECTING_LINES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d z :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,z,b} /\ collinear N {c,z,d} -> coplanar N {z,a,b,c,d}

items.name: COPLANAR_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, coplanar M s /\ linear M N f -> coplanar N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: COPLANAR_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (coplanar A {f x | x :e s} <-> coplanar B s)

items.name: COPLANAR_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, coplanar A {a}

items.name: COPLANAR_SMALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= 3 -> coplanar A s

items.name: COPLANAR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, coplanar A t /\ s c= t -> coplanar A s

items.name: COPLANAR_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, coplanar N s -> coplanar N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: COPLANAR_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, coplanar N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> coplanar N s

items.name: COPRIME
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 <-> forall d :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b <-> d = 1

items.name: COPRIME_0
items.statement: (forall d :e omega, gcd_int d 0 = 1 <-> d = 1) /\ forall d :e omega, gcd_int 0 d = 1 <-> d = 1

items.name: COPRIME_1
items.statement: (forall a :e omega, gcd_int a 1 = 1) /\ forall a :e omega, gcd_int 1 a = 1

items.name: COPRIME_2
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, gcd_int 2 n = 1 <-> odd_nat n) /\ forall n :e omega, gcd_int n 2 = 1 <-> odd_nat n

items.name: COPRIME_BEZOUT
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 <-> exists x y :e omega, minus_nat (a * x) (b * y) = 1 \/ minus_nat (b * x) (a * y) = 1

items.name: COPRIME_BEZOUT_ALT
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 /\ ~ a = 0 -> exists x y :e omega, a * x = b * y + 1

items.name: COPRIME_BEZOUT_STRONG
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 /\ ~ b = 1 -> exists x y :e omega, a * x = b * y + 1

items.name: COPRIME_DIVISORS
items.statement: forall a b d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ (divides_nat e0 b /\ gcd_int a b = 1) -> gcd_int d e0 = 1

items.name: COPRIME_DIVPROD
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d (a * b) /\ gcd_int d a = 1 -> divides_nat d b

items.name: COPRIME_DIVPROD_IFF
items.statement: forall d a :e omega, ~ d = 0 -> ((forall b :e omega, divides_nat d (a * b) -> divides_nat d b) <-> gcd_int d a = 1)

items.name: COPRIME_EXP
items.statement: forall n a d :e omega, gcd_int d a = 1 -> gcd_int d (a ^ n) = 1

items.name: COPRIME_EXP2
items.statement: forall m n k :e omega, gcd_int (m ^ k) (n ^ k) = 1 <-> gcd_int m n = 1 \/ k = 0

items.name: COPRIME_EXP2_SUC
items.statement: forall n a b :e omega, gcd_int (a ^ ordsucc n) (b ^ ordsucc n) = 1 <-> gcd_int a b = 1

items.name: COPRIME_EXP_DIVPROD
items.statement: forall d n a b :e omega, divides_nat (d ^ n) (a * b) /\ gcd_int d a = 1 -> divides_nat (d ^ n) b

items.name: COPRIME_EXP_IMP
items.statement: forall n a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int (a ^ n) (b ^ n) = 1

items.name: COPRIME_GCD
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 <-> gcd_int a b = 1

items.name: COPRIME_GROUP_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) -> ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> gcd_int (group_element_order_hl A G x) n = 1) <-> gcd_int (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) n = 1)

items.name: COPRIME_INDEX
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n = 1 <-> (m = 0 -> n = 1) /\ ((n = 0 -> m = 1) /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p m = 0 \/ prime_index p n = 0)

items.name: COPRIME_LEXP

items.name: COPRIME_LMOD

items.name: COPRIME_LMUL

items.name: COPRIME_LMUL2

items.name: COPRIME_MINUS1

items.name: COPRIME_MUL

items.name: COPRIME_NPRODUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> gcd_int n (a x) = 1) -> gcd_int n (finprod s a) = 1

items.name: COPRIME_NPRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall a :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> (gcd_int a (finprod s f) = 1 <-> forall i :e A, i :e s -> gcd_int a (f i) = 1)) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> (gcd_int (finprod s f) b = 1 <-> forall i :e A, i :e s -> gcd_int (f i) b = 1)

items.name: COPRIME_PAIR_DECOMP

items.name: COPRIME_PLUS1

items.name: COPRIME_POW

items.name: COPRIME_PRIME

items.name: COPRIME_PRIMEPOW

items.name: COPRIME_PRIME_EQ

items.name: COPRIME_PRIME_PRIME

items.name: COPRIME_REFL

items.name: COPRIME_REXP

items.name: COPRIME_RMOD

items.name: COPRIME_RMUL

items.name: COPRIME_RMUL2
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, gcd_int d (a * b) = 1 -> gcd_int d a = 1

items.name: COPRIME_SOS

items.name: COUNTABLE_ASCENDING_CLOPEN_IN_CHAIN

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 (k + 1) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_BAIRE_INDICATOR_BIJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = {f x | x :e s}) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s)

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_BAIRE_INDICATOR_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = {vector_add N a x | x :e s}) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_BIJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall P P':set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) /\ (forall s c= A, P' {f x | x :e s} <-> P s)) -> forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power B, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P' c) /\ {x :e B | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = {f x | x :e s}) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ Union u = A :\: s

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x0) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :/\: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u c= A, relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e P) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} u = relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A P u) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u0, x0 :e Y} = x} u

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u s c= A, P u -> (s :e relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} u <-> (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ s c= u)

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = Empty) /\ ((forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) /\ (finite u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s))) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = Union u

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNIONS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) /\ (finite u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s))) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = Union u

items.name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_ISOLATED_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> ~ limit_point_of N a s) -> countable s

items.name: COUNTABLE_LIST

items.name: COUNTABLE_LIST_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, countable s -> countable {l :e finseq A | forall x :e A, seq_mem x l -> x :e s}

items.name: COUNTABLE_LOCAL_MAXIMA
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> countable {f x | x :e R, exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R, abs_SNo (x' + - x) < d -> f x' <= f x}

items.name: COUNTABLE_LOCAL_MINIMA
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> countable {f x | x :e R, exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R, abs_SNo (x' + - x) < d -> f x <= f x'}

items.name: COUNTABLE_NEITHER_SIDED_LIMITS_IMP_BAIRE1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx 1), forall s c= R :^: idx 1, countable {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ (~ (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun x0:set => f x0) l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | drop t <= drop x})) /\ ~ exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun x0:set => f x0) l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x <= drop t}))} -> f :e baire 1 N 1 s

items.name: COUNTABLE_NEITHER_SIDED_LIMITS_IMP_BAIRE1_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx 1), forall s c= R :^: idx 1, countable {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ (~ (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun x0:set => f x0) l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | t :e s /\ drop t <= drop x})) /\ ~ exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun x0:set => f x0) l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | t :e s /\ drop x <= drop t}))} -> f :e baire 1 N 1 s

items.name: COUNTABLE_NONCONTINUOUS_LEFT_LIMITS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, countable {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ((exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | t :e s /\ drop t <= drop x})) /\ ~ continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s))}

items.name: COUNTABLE_NONCONTINUOUS_ONE_SIDED_LIMITS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, countable {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ (((exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | t :e s /\ drop t <= drop x})) \/ (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | t :e s /\ drop x <= drop t}))) /\ ~ continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s))}

items.name: COUNTABLE_NONCONTINUOUS_RIGHT_LIMITS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, countable {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ((exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | t :e s /\ drop x <= drop t})) /\ ~ continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s))}

items.name: COUNTABLE_NON_CONDENSATION_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, countable (s :\: {x :e R :^: idx N | condensation_point_of N x s})

items.name: COUNTABLE_NON_LIMIT_POINTS

items.name: COUNTABLE_OPEN_COMPONENTS

items.name: COUNTABLE_OPEN_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS

items.name: COUNTABLE_OPEN_INTERVAL

items.name: COUNTABLE_PATH_COMPONENTS

items.name: COUNTABLE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, countable s /\ countable t -> countable (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: COUNTABLE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, countable (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ countable s /\ countable t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_PRODUCT_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, countable s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> countable (t x)) -> countable (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t x})

items.name: COUNTABLE_RATIONAL

items.name: COUNTABLE_RATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> countable {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e rational}

items.name: COUNTABLE_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, countable s -> countable {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x}

items.name: COUNTABLE_RESTRICTED_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> countable s /\ countable t -> countable {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ({x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s /\ finite {x :e A | ~ f x = k x})}

items.name: COUNTABLE_SING

items.name: COUNTABLE_STRICT_LOCAL_MAXIMA

items.name: COUNTABLE_STRICT_LOCAL_MINIMA

items.name: COUNTABLE_SUBGROUP_GENERATED

items.name: COUNTABLE_SUBSET

items.name: COUNTABLE_SUBSET_IMAGE

items.name: COUNTABLE_SUBSET_NUM

items.name: COUNTABLE_TRIVIAL_LEFT_LIMITS

items.name: COUNTABLE_TRIVIAL_RIGHT_LIMITS

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall A0 c= Power A, countable A0 /\ (forall s c= A, s :e A0 -> countable s) -> countable (Union A0)

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, countable s /\ countable t -> countable (s :\/: t)

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_ASCENDING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P Empty /\ (forall t u c= A, P t /\ P u -> P (t :\/: u)) -> ((exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists t :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, P (t n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, t n c= t (ordsucc n)) /\ Union {t n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = s))

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_BAIRE0_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 0 (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s) <-> s = Empty \/ s = R :^: idx N

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_BAIRE_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N s x) :e baire N 1 (k + 1) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_BAIRE_INDICATOR_BIJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = {f x | x :e s}) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u = s)

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_BAIRE_INDICATOR_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = {vector_add N a x | x :e s}) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_BIJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall P P':set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) /\ (forall s c= A, P' {f x | x :e s} <-> P s)) -> forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power B, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P' c) /\ Union u = {f x | x :e s}) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A :\: s

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = Empty

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P Empty -> ((exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists t :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, P (t n)) /\ Union {t n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = s)

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x0) /\ Union u = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = A) /\ ((forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) /\ (finite u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s))) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ Union u0 = {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTERS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) /\ (finite u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s))) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ Union u0 = {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTER_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u x c= A, x :e relative_to A {x0 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e P) /\ Union u = x0} u <-> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A P u) /\ Union u0 = x

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :\/: t

items.name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, countable u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ Union u0 = Union u

items.name: COUNT_FINITE_CYCLIC_GROUP_SUBGROUPS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall d :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ cyclic_group_hl A G -> finite_cardinality {h :e Power A | subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = d} = if divides_nat d (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) then 1 else 0

items.name: COUNT_FINITE_CYCLIC_GROUP_SUBGROUPS_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ cyclic_group_hl A G -> finite_cardinality {h :e Power A | subgroup_of A h G} = finite_cardinality {d :e omega | divides_nat d (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))}

items.name: COVARIANCE_MATRIX_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul N M N (transp M N A) A = mat N N 0 <-> A = mat M N 0

items.name: COVARIANCE_MATRIX_EQ_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) A = matrix_mul N N N A A <-> symmetric_matrix_hl N A

items.name: COVARIANCE_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M N (transp M N (matrix_inv M N A)) (matrix_inv M N A) = matrix_inv N N (matrix_mul N M N A (transp N M A))

items.name: COVARIANCE_UNIQUE_UP_TO_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) A = matrix_mul N N N (transp N N B) B <-> exists U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ matrix_mul N N N U A = B

items.name: COVARIANCE_UNIQUE_UP_TO_ORTHOGONAL_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A (transp N N A) = matrix_mul N N N B (transp N N B) <-> exists U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ matrix_mul N N N A U = B

items.name: COVERING_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall g :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: (R :^: idx N), s c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty /\ gauge N (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e g x)) -> exists d c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable d /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e d -> k c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (~ interior N k = Empty /\ exists c d0 :e R :^: idx N, k = closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d0) seq_nil))) /\ ((forall k1 k2 c= R :^: idx N, k1 :e d /\ (k2 :e d /\ ~ k1 = k2) -> interior N k1 :/\: interior N k2 = Empty) /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e d -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :/\: k /\ k c= g x) /\ ((forall u v :e R :^: idx N, closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) :e d -> exists n :e omega, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> v i + - u i = (b i + - a i) :/: 2 ^ n) /\ s c= Union d))))

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ ((forall b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s -> finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b}) /\ closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c) t) -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) {p x | x :e t}

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_COMPACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s -> (compact M c <-> compact N s /\ forall b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s -> finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b})

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_COUNTABLE_SHEETS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s -> countable {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b}

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_FIBRE_NO_LIMPT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ a :e c -> ~ limit_point_of M a {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b}

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_FINITE_EQ_COMPACT_FIBRE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s -> (finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b} <-> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b})

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_FINITE_SHEETS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ compact M c -> finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b}

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_FINITE_SHEETS_EQ_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (connected N s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a})) -> ((forall b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s -> finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b}) <-> forall t c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c) t -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) {p x | x :e t})

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_FINITE_SHEETS_EQ_CLOSED_MAP_STRONG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (forall b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s -> limit_point_of N b s) -> ((forall b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s -> finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b}) <-> forall t c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c) t -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) {p x | x :e t})

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_FINITE_SHEETS_EQ_PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s -> ((forall b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s -> finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x = b}) <-> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x :e k})

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_HOMEOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (path_connected M c /\ simply_connected N s) -> exists q :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (c,s) (p,q)

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_CANCEL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx M) -> covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (path M g /\ (path_image M g c= c /\ (path M h /\ (path_image M h c= c /\ (pathstart M g = pathstart M h /\ homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => p (g x)) (fun x:set => p (h x))))))) -> homotopic_paths M c g h

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_CANCEL_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx M) -> covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (path M g /\ (path_image M g c= c /\ (path M h /\ (path_image M h c= c /\ pathstart M g = pathstart M h)))) -> (homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => p (g x)) (fun x:set => p (h x)) <-> homotopic_paths M c g h)

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_IMP_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => p x) c

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_IMP_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s -> {p x | x :e c} = s

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_INESSENTIAL_LOOP_LIFT_IS_LOOP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (path N g /\ (path_image N g c= s /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N g /\ (homotopic_paths N s g (fun x:set => linepath N (a,a) x) /\ (path M h /\ (path_image M h c= c /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> p (h t) = g t))))))) -> pathfinish M h = pathstart M h

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (path_connected M c /\ simply_connected N s) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e c /\ (y :e c /\ p x = p y) -> x = y

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_LIFT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u c= R :^: idx P, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (simply_connected P u /\ (locally P {x :e Power (R :^: idx P) | path_connected P x} u /\ (continuous_on_hl P N f u /\ {f x | x :e u} c= s))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (continuous_on_hl P M g u /\ ({g x | x :e u} c= c /\ forall y :e R :^: idx P, y :e u -> p (g y) = f y))

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_LIFT_GENERAL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u c= R :^: idx P, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall z :e R :^: idx P, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (a :e c /\ (z :e u /\ (path_connected P u /\ (locally P {x :e Power (R :^: idx P) | path_connected P x} u /\ (continuous_on_hl P N f u /\ ({f x | x :e u} c= s /\ (f z = p a /\ (forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx P) -> path P r /\ (path_image P r c= u /\ (pathstart P r = z /\ pathfinish P r = z)) -> exists q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (path M q /\ (path_image M q c= c /\ (pathstart M q = a /\ (pathfinish M q = a /\ homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => f (r x)) (fun x:set => p (q x)))))))))))))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (continuous_on_hl P M g u /\ ({g x | x :e u} c= c /\ (g z = a /\ forall y :e R :^: idx P, y :e u -> p (g y) = f y)))

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_LIFT_HOMOTOPIC_FUNCTION
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall u c= R :^: idx P, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (continuous_on_hl P M g u /\ ({g x | x :e u} c= c /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx P, y :e u -> p (g y) = f y) /\ homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx P) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx P) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) f f'))) -> exists g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, g' x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (continuous_on_hl P M g' u /\ ({g' x | x :e u} c= c /\ forall y :e R :^: idx P, y :e u -> p (g' y) = f' y))

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_LIFT_HOMOTOPIC_PATH
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (homotopic_paths N s f f' /\ (path M g /\ (path_image M g c= c /\ (pathstart M g = a /\ (pathfinish M g = b /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> p (g t) = f t)))))) -> exists g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (path M g' /\ (path_image M g' c= c /\ (pathstart M g' = a /\ (pathfinish M g' = b /\ forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> p (g' t) = f' t))))

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_LIFT_HOMOTOPIC_PATHS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h1 x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h2 x :e R :^: idx M) -> covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ (path N g1 /\ (path_image N g1 c= s /\ (path N g2 /\ (path_image N g2 c= s /\ (homotopic_paths N s g1 g2 /\ (path M h1 /\ (path_image M h1 c= c /\ ((forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> p (h1 t) = g1 t) /\ (path M h2 /\ (path_image M h2 c= c /\ ((forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> p (h2 t) = g2 t) /\ pathstart M h1 = pathstart M h2))))))))))) -> homotopic_paths M c h1 h2

items.name: COVERING_SPACE_LIFT_HOMOTOPY

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> det N (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then vsum omega N (idx N) (fun i0:set => vector_mul N (x i0) (row N N i0 A)) else row N N i A) = x k * det N A

items.name: CRAMER_MATRIX_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A X B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, ~ det N A = 0 -> (matrix_mul N N N X A = B <-> X = fun k :e idx N => fun l :e idx N => det N (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => if j = l then B k i else A j i) :/: det N A)

items.name: CRAMER_MATRIX_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A A' :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A' A = mat N N 1 <-> ~ det N A = 0 /\ A' = fun k :e idx N => fun l :e idx N => det N (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => if j = l then if i = k then 1 else 0 else A j i) :/: det N A

items.name: CRAMER_MATRIX_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A X B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, ~ det N A = 0 -> (matrix_mul N N N A X = B <-> X = fun k :e idx N => fun l :e idx N => det N (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => if j = k then B i l else A i j) :/: det N A)

items.name: CRAMER_MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A A' :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A A' = mat N N 1 <-> ~ det N A = 0 /\ A' = fun k :e idx N => fun l :e idx N => det N (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => if j = k then if i = l then 1 else 0 else A i j) :/: det N A

items.name: CREATE_ISOMORPHIC_COPY_OF_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e A :^: B, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= B, forall z :e B, forall i :e B :^: B, forall m :e B :^: B :^: B, z :e s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> f x :e s /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e s -> g y :e group_carrier A G /\ f (g y) = y) /\ (g z = group_id A G /\ ((forall x :e B, x :e s -> i x = f (group_inv A G (g x))) /\ (forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e s -> m x y = f (group_mul A G (g x) (g y))))))) -> group_isomorphisms A B (G,(s,(z,(i,m)))) (f,g) /\ (group_carrier B (s,(z,(i,m))) = s /\ (group_id B (s,(z,(i,m))) = z /\ ((forall x :e B, group_inv B (s,(z,(i,m))) x = i x) /\ forall x x0 :e B, group_mul B (s,(z,(i,m))) x x0 = m x x0)))

items.name: CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, s :*: t = \/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t}

items.name: CROSS_DIFF
items.statement: forall A B:set, (forall s c= A, forall t u c= B, s :*: t :\: u = (s :*: t) :\: (s :*: u)) /\ forall s t c= A, forall u c= B, s :\: t :*: u = (s :*: u) :\: (t :*: u)

items.name: CROSS_EMPTY
items.statement: forall C D A B:set, (forall s c= A, s :*: Empty = Empty) /\ forall t c= B, Empty :*: t = Empty

items.name: CROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s :*: t = s' :*: t' <-> (s = Empty \/ t = Empty) /\ (s' = Empty \/ t' = Empty) \/ s = s' /\ t = t'

items.name: CROSS_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, s :*: t = Empty <-> s = Empty \/ t = Empty

items.name: CROSS_INTER
items.statement: forall A B:set, (forall s c= A, forall t u c= B, s :*: t :/\: u = (s :*: t) :/\: (s :*: u)) /\ forall s t c= A, forall u c= B, s :/\: t :*: u = (s :*: u) :/\: (t :*: u)

items.name: CROSS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall s c= A, forall f c= Power A, s :*: {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = if f = Empty then s :*: A else {x :e A :*: A | forall Y :e {s :*: t | t :e Power A, t :e f}, x :e Y}) /\ forall f c= Power A, forall t c= B, {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :*: t = if f = Empty then A :*: t else {x :e A :*: B | forall Y :e {s :*: t | s :e Power A, s :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: CROSS_INTERS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall g c= Power B, {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :*: {x :e B | forall Y :e g, x :e Y} = if f = Empty then {x :e A :*: B | forall Y :e {A :*: t | t :e Power B, t :e g}, x :e Y} else if g = Empty then {x :e A :*: B | forall Y :e {s :*: B | s :e Power A, s :e f}, x :e Y} else {x :e A :*: B | forall Y :e (\/_ s :e Power A, {s :*: t | t :e Power B, s :e f /\ t :e g}), x :e Y}

items.name: CROSS_MONO
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, s c= s' /\ t c= t' -> s :*: t c= s' :*: t'

items.name: CROSS_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G1 :e group_hl A, forall G2 :e group_hl B, forall h1 c= A, forall h2 c= B, normal_subgroup_of (A :*: B) (h1 :*: h2) (prod_group A B G1 G2) <-> normal_subgroup_of A h1 G1 /\ normal_subgroup_of B h2 G2

items.name: CROSS_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, {x} :*: {y} = {(x,y)}

items.name: CROSS_SUBGROUP_OF_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G1 :e group_hl A, forall G2 :e group_hl B, forall h1 c= A, forall h2 c= B, subgroup_of (A :*: B) (h1 :*: h2) (prod_group A B G1 G2) <-> subgroup_of A h1 G1 /\ subgroup_of B h2 G2

items.name: CROSS_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, (forall s c= A, forall t u c= B, s :*: t :\/: u = (s :*: t) :\/: (s :*: u)) /\ forall s t c= A, forall u c= B, s :\/: t :*: u = (s :*: u) :\/: (t :*: u)

items.name: CROSS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall s c= A, forall f c= Power A, s :*: Union f = Union {s :*: t | t :e Power A, t :e f}) /\ forall f c= Power A, forall t c= B, Union f :*: t = Union {s :*: t | s :e Power A, s :e f}

items.name: CROSS_UNIONS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall g c= Power B, Union f :*: Union g = Union (\/_ s :e Power A, {s :*: t | t :e Power B, s :e f /\ t :e g})

items.name: CROSS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A :*: B = A :*: B

items.name: CURRY_DEF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f (x,y) = f (x,y)

items.name: CUT_WIRE_FENCE_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ (forall c c= A, connected_in A top c -> c :/\: s = Empty \/ c :/\: t = Empty)))) -> separated_between A top s t

items.name: CUT_WIRE_FENCE_THEOREM_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, compact_space A top /\ ((hausdorff_space A top \/ (regular_space A top \/ normal_space A top)) /\ (compact_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ (forall c c= A, connected_in A top c -> c :/\: s = Empty \/ c :/\: t = Empty)))) -> separated_between A top s t

items.name: CYCLIC_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, cyclic_group_hl A G <-> exists x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ group_carrier A G = {group_zpow A G x n | n :e int, n :e int}

items.name: CYCLIC_GROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, cyclic_group_hl A G <-> exists x :e A, subgroup_generated A G {x} = G

items.name: CYCLIC_GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finite (group_carrier A G) -> (cyclic_group_hl A G <-> exists a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ group_element_order_hl A G a = finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: CYCLIC_GROUP_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ cyclic_group_hl A G -> cyclic_group_hl B H

items.name: CYCLIC_GROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, cyclic_group_hl A (subgroup_generated A G {x})

items.name: CYCLIC_GROUP_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e omega, cyclic_group_hl int (integer_mod_group n)

items.name: CYCLIC_GROUP_PRIME_ORDER_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, (forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ a = group_id A G -> subgroup_generated A G {a} = G) <-> finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G) = 1 \/ prime_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)))

items.name: CYCLIC_GROUP_QUOTIENT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, cyclic_group_hl A G /\ subgroup_of A n G -> cyclic_group_hl (Power A) (quotient_group A G n)

items.name: CYCLIC_IMP_ABELIAN_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, cyclic_group_hl A G -> abelian_group_hl A G

items.name: CYCLIC_IMP_COUNTABLE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, cyclic_group_hl A G -> countable (group_carrier A G)

items.name: CYCLIC_IMP_FINITELY_GENERATED_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, cyclic_group_hl A G -> finitely_generated_group_hl A G

items.name: CYCLIC_INTEGER_GROUP
items.statement: cyclic_group_hl int integer_group

items.name: CYCLIC_PRIME_ORDER_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ ((finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G) = 1 \/ prime_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))) /\ (a :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ a = group_id A G)) -> subgroup_generated A G {a} = G

items.name: CYCLIC_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, cyclic_group_hl (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G H) <-> cyclic_group_hl A G /\ (cyclic_group_hl B H /\ (trivial_group A G \/ (trivial_group B H \/ finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (finite (group_carrier B H) /\ gcd_int (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier B H)) = 1))))

items.name: CYCLIC_PROD_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, cyclic_group_hl (int :*: int) (prod_group int int (integer_mod_group m) (integer_mod_group n)) <-> gcd_int m n = 1

items.name: CYCLIC_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_NSPHERE
items.statement: forall p :e int, forall n :e omega, cyclic_group_hl (Power (frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group (R :^: omega) (p,nsphere n))

items.name: DARBOUX_AND_REGULATED_IMP_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx 1, c c= s /\ connected 1 c -> connected N {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall a :e R :^: idx 1, a :e s -> (exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x <= drop a}))) /\ exists r :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f r (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop a <= drop x})))) -> continuous_on_hl 1 N f s

items.name: DECIMAL
items.statement: forall x y :e omega, x :/: y = x :/: y

items.name: DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s <-> exists t c= A, s = SetAdjoin t x /\ ~ x :e t

items.name: DECREASING_BOUNDED_VARIATION
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: DECREASING_BOUNDED_VARIATION_GEN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, bounded_hl 1 {f x | x :e s} /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s

items.name: DECREASING_CLOSED_NEST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, closed N (s n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ s n = Empty) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n c= s m) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists n :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s n /\ y :e s n -> distance N (x,y) < e0))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, a :e s n

items.name: DECREASING_CLOSED_NEST_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, closed N (s n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ s n = Empty) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s n c= s m) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists n :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s n /\ y :e s n -> distance N (x,y) < e0))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {t :e Power (R :^: idx N) | exists n :e omega, t = s n}, x :e Y} = {a}

items.name: DECREASING_COUNTABLE_DISCONTINUITIES
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) -> countable {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ continuous 1 (R :^: idx 1) f (at 1 x)}

items.name: DECREASING_IMP_BAIRE1
items.statement: forall f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx 1), forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) -> f :e baire 1 1 1 s

items.name: DECREASING_LEFT_LIMIT_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) /\ c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)))

items.name: DECREASING_LEFT_LIMIT_1_GEN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall B :e R, is_interval 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> B <= drop (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x))) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= drop a})

items.name: DECREASING_RIGHT_LIMIT_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) /\ c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: DECREASING_RIGHT_LIMIT_1_GEN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall B :e R, is_interval 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> drop (f x) <= B) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x))) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop a <= drop x})

items.name: DECREASING_VECTOR_VARIATION
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) -> vector_variation 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = drop (f a) + - drop (f b)

items.name: DEFORMATION_RETRACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (fun x:set => x) r /\ retraction N (s,t) r)) <-> retract_of N t s /\ exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (fun x:set => x) f /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t)

items.name: DEFORMATION_RETRACTION_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, forall r1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (fun x:set => x) r1 /\ (retraction N (s,t) r1 /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) (fun x:set => x) r2 /\ retraction N (t,u) r2)) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (fun x:set => x) (fun x:set => r2 (r1 x)) /\ retraction N (s,u) (fun x:set => r2 (r1 x))

items.name: DEFORMATION_RETRACTION_IMP_HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r :e B :^: A, forall s :e A :^: B, homotopic_with A A {x :e A :^: A | True} (top,top) (fun x:set => s (r x)) (fun x:set => x) /\ retraction_maps A B (top,top') (r,s) -> homotopy_equivalent_space A B top top'

items.name: DEFORMATION_RETRACTION_IMP_ISOMORPHIC_HOMOLOGY_GROUPS
