items.name: DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s :\: {x} = {y :e A | y :e s /\ ~ y = x}

items.name: DELETE_COMM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, (s :\: {x}) :\: {y} = (s :\: {y}) :\: {x}

items.name: DELETE_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (s :\: {x}) :\: {x} = s :\: {x}

items.name: DELETE_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin s x :\: {y} = if x = y then s :\: {y} else SetAdjoin (s :\: {y}) x

items.name: DELETE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, (s :\: {x}) :/\: t = s :/\: t :\: {x}

items.name: DELETE_NON_ELEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ x :e s <-> s :\: {x} = s

items.name: DELETE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, s :\: {x} c= s

items.name: DENSE_ACCESSIBLE_FRONTIER_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s v c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (frontier N s) /\ ~ v = Empty) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N g /\ ({g x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) :\: {vec 1 1}} c= s /\ (pathstart N g :e s /\ pathfinish N g :e v)))

items.name: DENSE_ACCESSIBLE_FRONTIER_POINTS_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s v c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (x :e s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (frontier N s) /\ ~ v = Empty))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx 1, g x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N g /\ ({g x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) :\: {vec 1 1}} c= s /\ (pathstart N g = x /\ pathfinish N g :e v)))

items.name: DENSE_ACCESSIBLE_FRONTIER_POINT_PAIRS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u v c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (frontier N s) /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (frontier N s) /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (~ v = Empty /\ ~ u = v))))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N g /\ (pathstart N g :e u /\ (pathfinish N g :e v /\ {g x | x :e open_interval 1 (vec 1 0,vec 1 1)} c= s)))

items.name: DENSE_COMPLEMENT_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N t < aff_dim N s /\ affine N s -> closure N (s :\: t) = s

items.name: DENSE_COMPLEMENT_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N t < aff_dim N s /\ convex N s -> closure N (s :\: t) = closure N s

items.name: DENSE_COMPLEMENT_CONVEX_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N t < aff_dim N s /\ (convex N s /\ closed N s) -> closure N (s :\: t) = s

items.name: DENSE_COMPLEMENT_OPEN_IN_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N t < aff_dim N s /\ s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) -> closure N (s :\: t) = closure N s

items.name: DENSE_COMPLEMENT_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, dim N t < dim N s /\ subspace N s -> closure N (s :\: t) = s

items.name: DENSE_FUNCTION_ON_DYADIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall e0 :e R, mcomplete A m /\ (0 < e0 /\ (forall eps :e R, 0 < eps -> exists del :e R, 0 < del /\ forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) < del) -> exists c c= A, connected_in A (mtopology A m) c /\ (x :e c /\ (y :e c /\ (mbounded A m c /\ mdiameter A m c < eps))))) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) < d) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R, f x0 :e A) /\ exists s c= R, s c= closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil) /\ (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil) c= closure_of R euclideanreal s /\ (0 :e s /\ (1 :e s /\ (f 0 = x /\ (f 1 = y /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= mspace A m /\ ((forall a :e R, a :e s -> mdist A m (x,f a) <= e0 :/: 4) /\ uniformly_continuous_map A R (submetric R real_euclidean_metric s,m) f)))))))

items.name: DENSE_GDELTA_IMP_LARGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s /\ R :^: idx N c= closure N s -> equip s R

items.name: DENSE_IMP_PERFECT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure N s = R :^: idx N -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: DENSE_INTERSECTS_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s = topspace A top <-> forall t c= A, t :e top /\ ~ t = Empty -> ~ s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: DENSE_LIMIT_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N x s} = R :^: idx N <-> closure N s = R :^: idx N

items.name: DENSE_LOCALLY_COMPACT_OPEN_IN_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ (closure_of A top s = topspace A top /\ locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top s))) -> s :e top

items.name: DENSE_OPEN_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ t c= u \/ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ s c= u -> (u c= closure N (s :/\: t) <-> u c= closure N s /\ u c= closure N t)

items.name: DENSE_OPEN_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite g /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e g -> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ s c= closure N t) -> s c= closure N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}

items.name: DEPENDENT_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, dependent N {a,b} <-> (a = b -> a = vec N 0) /\ (~ a = b -> exists x y :e R, vector_add N (vector_mul N x a) (vector_mul N y b) = vec N 0 /\ ~ (x = 0 /\ y = 0))

items.name: DEPENDENT_3
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b /\ (~ a = c /\ ~ b = c) -> (dependent N {a,b,c} <-> exists x y z :e R, vector_add N (vector_mul N x a) (vector_add N (vector_mul N y b) (vector_mul N z c)) = vec N 0 /\ ~ (x = 0 /\ (y = 0 /\ z = 0)))

items.name: DEPENDENT_AFFINE_DEPENDENT_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dependent N s <-> affine_dependent N s \/ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s

items.name: DEPENDENT_BIGGERSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (finite s -> dimindex N < finite_cardinality s) -> dependent N s

items.name: DEPENDENT_BIGGERSET_GENERAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (finite s -> dim N s < finite_cardinality s) -> dependent N s

items.name: DEPENDENT_CHOICE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall R0:set -> set -> set -> prop, (exists a :e A, P 0 a) /\ (forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, P n x -> exists y :e A, P (ordsucc n) y /\ R0 n x y) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall n :e omega, P n (f n)) /\ forall n :e omega, R0 n (f n) (f (ordsucc n)))

items.name: DEPENDENT_CHOICE_FIXED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall R0:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, P 0 a /\ (forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, P n x -> exists y :e A, P (ordsucc n) y /\ R0 n x y) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ (f 0 = a /\ ((forall n :e omega, P n (f n)) /\ forall n :e omega, R0 n (f n) (f (ordsucc n))))

items.name: DEPENDENT_EQ_DIM_LT_CARD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dependent N s <-> finite s -> dim N s < finite_cardinality s

items.name: DEPENDENT_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, dependent N p <-> exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (s c= p /\ ((exists v :e R :^: idx N, v :e s /\ ~ u v = 0) /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = vec N 0)))

items.name: DEPENDENT_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> (dependent N s <-> exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((exists v :e R :^: idx N, v :e s /\ ~ u v = 0) /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = vec N 0))

items.name: DEPENDENT_IMP_AFFINE_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, dependent N {vector_sub N x a | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} /\ ~ a :e s -> affine_dependent N (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: DEPENDENT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ dependent M s) -> dependent N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: DEPENDENT_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (dependent N {f x | x :e s} <-> dependent M s)

items.name: DEPENDENT_MONO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, dependent N s /\ s c= t -> dependent N t

items.name: DEPENDENT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dependent A {x} <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_DERIVED_SET_SUBSET

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_INFINITE_MBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A m) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> infinite (s :/\: mball A m (x,e0))}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_INFINITE_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A m) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> infinite (s :/\: mcball A m (x,e0))}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_INFINITE_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top -> derived_set_of A top s = {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ forall u c= A, x :e u /\ u :e top -> infinite (s :/\: u)}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_INFINITE_OPEN_IN_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A m) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ forall u c= A, x :e u /\ u :e mtopology A m -> infinite (s :/\: u)}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> derived_set_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e u}) {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e derived_set_of (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= t -> derived_set_of A top s c= derived_set_of A top t

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A top s = derived_set_of A top (topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall met :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A met) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A met /\ exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e A) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :/\: mspace A met :\: {x}) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) f x sequentially)}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SEQUENTIALLY_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall met :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A met) s = {x :e A | exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e A) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :\: {x}) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) f x sequentially)}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SEQUENTIALLY_DECREASING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall met :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A met) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A met /\ exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e A) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :/\: mspace A met :\: {x}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> mdist A met (f n,x) < mdist A met (f m,x)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, f m = f n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) f x sequentially)))}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SEQUENTIALLY_DECREASING_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall met :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A met) s = {x :e A | exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e A) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :\: {x}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> mdist A met (f n,x) < mdist A met (f m,x)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, f m = f n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) f x sequentially)))}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SEQUENTIALLY_INJ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall met :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A met) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A met /\ exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e A) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :/\: mspace A met :\: {x}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, f m = f n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) f x sequentially))}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SEQUENTIALLY_INJ_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall met :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A met) s = {x :e A | exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e A) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :\: {x}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, f m = f n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) f x sequentially))}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, hausdorff_space A top -> derived_set_of A top {x} = Empty

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SUBSET_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A top s c= closure_of A top s

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SUBSET_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, derived_set_of A (subtopology A top s) t c= s

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A top s c= topspace A top

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, derived_set_of A (subtopology A top u) s = u :/\: derived_set_of A top (u :/\: s)

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, derived_set_of A top (topspace A top) = {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ ~ {x} :e top}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall u s c= R :^: idx N, derived_set_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {vector_add N a x | x :e u}) {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e derived_set_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_TRIVIAL_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, a :e derived_set_of A top s <-> ~ trivial_limit A (within A (atpointof A top a) s)

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, derived_set_of A top (s :\/: t) = derived_set_of A top s :\/: derived_set_of A top t

items.name: DERIVED_SET_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, finite f -> derived_set_of A top (Union f) = Union {derived_set_of A top s | s :e Power A, s :e f}

items.name: DERIVED_SET_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (derived_set_of A top s c= s <-> closed_in A top s)

items.name: DERIVED_SET_SUBSET_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A top s c= s <-> closed_in A top (topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: DEST_FRAG_0
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, frag_0 A x = 0

items.name: DEST_FRAG_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e frag A, forall a :e A, frag_add A x y a = x a + y a

items.name: DEST_FRAG_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall c :e int, forall x :e frag A, forall a :e A, frag_cmul A c x a = c * x a

items.name: DEST_FRAG_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e frag A, forall a :e A, frag_neg A x a = - x a

items.name: DEST_FRAG_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall c a :e A, frag_of A c a = if a = c then 1 else 0

items.name: DEST_FRAG_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e frag A, forall a :e A, frag_sub A x y a = x a + - y a

items.name: DEST_MK_MULTIVECTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> s = s

items.name: DET_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> det N (mat N N 0) = 0

items.name: DET_1
items.statement: forall A :e R :^: idx 1 :^: idx 1, det 1 A = A 1 1

items.name: DET_1_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 -> det N A = A 1 1

items.name: DET_2
items.statement: forall A :e R :^: idx_n 2 :^: idx_n 2, det (idx_n 2) A = A 1 1 * A 2 2 + - A 1 2 * A 2 1

items.name: DET_CMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall c :e R, det N (matrix_cmul N N c A) = c ^ dimindex N * det N A

items.name: DET_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, det N (cofactor N A) = det N A ^ minus_nat (dimindex N) 1

items.name: DET_COFACTOR_EXPANSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> det N A = finsum (idx N) (fun j:set => A i j * cofactor N A i j)

items.name: DET_DEPENDENT_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, dependent N (columns N N A) -> det N A = 0

items.name: DET_DEPENDENT_ROWS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, dependent N (rows N N A) -> det N A = 0

items.name: DET_DIAGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A -> det N A = finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => A i i)

items.name: DET_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, det N A = 0 <-> ~ invertible N N A

items.name: DET_EQ_0_RANK
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, det N A = 0 <-> rank N N A < dimindex N

items.name: DET_I
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> det N (mat N N 1) = 1

items.name: DET_IDENTICAL_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ (~ i = j /\ column N N i A = column N N j A)))) -> det N A = 0

items.name: DET_IDENTICAL_ROWS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ (~ i = j /\ row N N i A = row N N j A)))) -> det N A = 0

items.name: DET_LE_ONORM_POW
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, abs_SNo (det N A) <= onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) ^ dimindex N

items.name: DET_LINEAR_ROWS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, linear N N f -> det N (fun i :e idx N => f (A i)) = det N (matrix N N f) * det N A

items.name: DET_LINEAR_ROWS_VSUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, a x y :e R :^: idx N) -> finite s -> det N (fun i :e idx N => vsum omega N s (a i)) = finsum {f :e omega :^: omega | (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> f i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, ~ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> f i = i} (fun f:set => det N (fun i :e idx N => a i (f i)))

items.name: DET_LINEAR_ROWS_VSUM_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, forall k :e omega, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, a x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite s /\ k <= dimindex N -> det N (fun i :e idx N => if i <= k then vsum omega N s (a i) else c i) = finsum {f :e omega :^: omega | (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= k -> f i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, ~ (1 <= i /\ i <= k) -> f i = i} (fun f:set => det N (fun i :e idx N => if i <= k then a i (f i) else c i))

items.name: DET_LINEAR_ROW_VSUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, forall k :e omega, finite s /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> det N (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then vsum A N s a else c i) = finsum s (fun j:set => det N (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then a j else c i))

items.name: DET_LOWERTRIANGULAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ i < j))) -> A i j = 0) -> det N A = finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => A i i)

items.name: DET_MATRIX_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> (det N (matrix N N f) = 0 <-> ~ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear N N g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (f x) = x)))

items.name: DET_MATRIX_EQ_0_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> (det N (matrix N N f) = 0 <-> ~ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear N N g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (f x) = x))

items.name: DET_MATRIX_EQ_0_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> (det N (matrix N N f) = 0 <-> ~ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear N N g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x))

items.name: DET_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, det N (matrix_inv N N A) = recip_SNo (det N A)

items.name: DET_MATRIX_REFLECT_ALONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, det N (matrix N N (fun x:set => reflect_along N v x)) = if v = vec N 0 then 1 else - 1

items.name: DET_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, det N (matrix_mul N N N A B) = det N A * det N B

items.name: DET_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, det N (matrix_neg N N A) = (- 1) ^ dimindex N * det N A

items.name: DET_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> (exists B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, abs_SNo (B i j + - A i j) < e0) /\ det N B < det N A) /\ exists C :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, abs_SNo (C i j + - A i j) < e0) /\ det N A < det N C

items.name: DET_ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall Q :e R :^: idx A :^: idx A, orthogonal_matrix_hl A Q -> det A Q = 1 \/ det A Q = - 1

items.name: DET_PERMUTE_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> permutes omega p (idx N) -> det N (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => A i (p j)) = sign omega p * det N A

items.name: DET_PERMUTE_ROWS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> permutes omega p (idx N) -> det N (fun i :e idx N => A (p i)) = sign omega p * det N A

items.name: DET_POSITIVE_DEFINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_definite N A -> 0 < det N A

items.name: DET_POSITIVE_SEMIDEFINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A -> 0 <= det N A

items.name: DET_ROWS_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R) -> det N (fun i :e idx N => vector_mul N (c i) (a i)) = finprod (idx N) c * det N (fun i :e idx N => a i)

items.name: DET_ROW_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> det N (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then vector_add N a b else c i) = det N (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then a else c i) + det N (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then b else c i)

items.name: DET_ROW_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, b x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> det N (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then vector_mul N c a else b i) = c * det N (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then a else b i)

items.name: DET_ROW_OPERATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall j :e omega, forall c :e R, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ i = j))) -> det N (fun k :e idx N => if k = i then vector_add N (row N N i A) (vector_mul N c (row N N j A)) else row N N k A) = det N A

items.name: DET_ROW_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ x :e span N {row N N j A | j :e omega, 1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ j = i)}) -> det N (fun k :e idx N => if k = i then vector_add N (row N N i A) x else row N N k A) = det N A

items.name: DET_SIMILAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall S A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N S -> det N (matrix_mul N N N (matrix_inv N N S) (matrix_mul N N N A S)) = det N A

items.name: DET_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, det N (transp N N A) = det N A

items.name: DET_UPPERTRIANGULAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ j < i))) -> A i j = 0) -> det N A = finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => A i i)

items.name: DET_ZERO_COLUMN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ column N N i A = vec N 0) -> det N A = 0

items.name: DET_ZERO_ROW
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ row N N i A = vec N 0) -> det N A = 0

items.name: DIAGONAL_IMP_SYMMETRIC_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A -> symmetric_matrix_hl N A

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A <-> A = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => if i = j then A i j else 0

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, diagonal_matrix_hl M N A /\ diagonal_matrix_hl M N B -> diagonal_matrix_hl M N (matrix_add M N A B)

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall c :e R, diagonal_matrix_hl M N A -> diagonal_matrix_hl M N (matrix_cmul M N c A)

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N (matrix_inv N N A) <-> diagonal_matrix_hl N N A

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX_INV_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i j :e omega, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A /\ (1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N))) -> matrix_inv N N A i j = recip_SNo (A i j)

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX_INV_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A -> matrix_inv N N A = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => recip_SNo (A i j)

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX_MAT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e omega, diagonal_matrix_hl N N (mat N N m)

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A /\ diagonal_matrix_hl N N B -> diagonal_matrix_hl N N (matrix_mul N N N A B)

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX_MUL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i j :e omega, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A /\ (diagonal_matrix_hl N N B /\ (1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)))) -> matrix_mul N N N A B i j = A i j * B i j

items.name: DIAGONAL_MATRIX_MUL_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, diagonal_matrix_hl N N (matrix_mul N M N A B) <-> forall x y :e idx N, x <> y -> orthogonal M (row N M x A) (column M N y B)

items.name: DIAGONAL_POSITIVE_DEFINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, positive_definite N A /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> 0 < A i i

items.name: DIAGONAL_POSITIVE_SEMIDEFINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, positive_semidefinite N A /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> 0 <= A i i

items.name: DIAMETERS_HAUSDIST_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> abs_SNo (diameter N s + - diameter N t) <= 2 * hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: DIAMETER_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> diameter N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} = abs_SNo m * diameter N s

items.name: DIAMETER_ATTAINED_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ ~ diameter N s = 0 -> exists x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e frontier N s /\ (y :e frontier N s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y) = diameter N s)

items.name: DIAMETER_ATTAINED_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ ~ diameter N s = 0 -> exists x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e relative_frontier N s /\ (y :e relative_frontier N s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y) = diameter N s)

items.name: DIAMETER_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, diameter N (ball N (a,r)) = if r < 0 then 0 else 2 * r

items.name: DIAMETER_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y) <= diameter N s) /\ forall d :e R, 0 <= d /\ d < diameter N s -> exists x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ d < vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y))

items.name: DIAMETER_BOUNDED_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y) <= diameter A s

items.name: DIAMETER_BOUNDED_BOUND_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (x :e relative_interior N s /\ (y :e closure N s /\ ~ diameter N s = 0)) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y) < diameter N s

items.name: DIAMETER_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, diameter N (cball N (a,r)) = if r < 0 then 0 else 2 * r

items.name: DIAMETER_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, diameter N (closure N s) = diameter N s

items.name: DIAMETER_COMPACT_ATTAINED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y) = diameter N s)

items.name: DIAMETER_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, diameter N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = diameter N s

items.name: DIAMETER_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> diameter A Empty = 0

items.name: DIAMETER_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> (diameter N s = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a})

items.name: DIAMETER_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> diameter N (frontier N s) = diameter N s

items.name: DIAMETER_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, diameter N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty then 0 else vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, diameter N (open_interval N (a,b)) = if open_interval N (a,b) = Empty then 0 else vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a)

items.name: DIAMETER_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, (~ s = Empty \/ 0 <= d) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y) <= d) -> diameter N s <= d

items.name: DIAMETER_LE_SUMS_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t) -> diameter N t <= diameter N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: DIAMETER_LE_SUMS_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ t = Empty /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t) -> diameter N s <= diameter N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: DIAMETER_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x) -> diameter N {f x | x :e s} = diameter M s

items.name: DIAMETER_LT_SUMS_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s c= {a}) /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t)) -> diameter N t < diameter N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: DIAMETER_LT_SUMS_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, t c= {a}) /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t)) -> diameter N s < diameter N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: DIAMETER_POS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> 0 <= diameter N s

items.name: DIAMETER_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a}) -> diameter N (relative_frontier N s) = diameter N s

items.name: DIAMETER_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> diameter N {vector_mul N a x | x :e s} = abs_SNo a * diameter N s

items.name: DIAMETER_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, diameter N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = distance N (a,b)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, diameter N (open_segment N (a,b)) = distance N (a,b)

items.name: DIAMETER_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty -> diameter N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = sup (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {distance N (x,y) | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s})

items.name: DIAMETER_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, diameter N {a} = 0

items.name: DIAMETER_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, diameter N (sphere N (a,r)) = if r < 0 then 0 else 2 * r

items.name: DIAMETER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ bounded_hl N t -> diameter N s <= diameter N t

items.name: DIAMETER_SUBSET_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> exists z :e R :^: idx N, s c= cball N (z,diameter N s)

items.name: DIAMETER_SUBSET_CBALL_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists z :e R :^: idx N, z :e s /\ s c= cball N (z,diameter N s)

items.name: DIAMETER_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t -> diameter N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) <= diameter N s + diameter N t

items.name: DIAMETER_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, diameter A {vector_add A a x | x :e s} = diameter A s

items.name: DIAMETER_UNION_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> diameter N (s :\/: t) <= diameter N s + diameter N t

items.name: DICKSON
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, x x y :e omega) -> exists i j :e omega, i < j /\ forall k :e omega, k < n -> x i k <= x j k

items.name: DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\: t = {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ x :e t}

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx A), differentiable B A f net0 /\ differentiable B A g net0 -> differentiable B A (fun z:set => vector_add B (f z) (g z)) net0

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_AT_IMP_DIFFERENTIABLE_ON
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> differentiable A B f (at B x)) -> differentiable_on_hl A B f s

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_AT_LIFT_DOT2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, differentiable N M f (at M x) /\ differentiable N M g (at M x) -> differentiable 1 M (fun x0:set => lift (dot N (f x0) (g x0))) (at M x)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_AT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall x :e R :^: idx B, differentiable A B f (at B x) -> differentiable A B f (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, convex M s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> onorm M N (f' x) <= B)) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_CHAIN_AT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx C, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall x :e R :^: idx C, differentiable A C f (at C x) /\ differentiable B A g (at A (f x)) -> differentiable B C (fun x:set => g (f x)) (at C x)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_CHAIN_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx C, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall x :e R :^: idx C, forall s c= R :^: idx C, differentiable A C f (within (R :^: idx C) (at C x) s) /\ differentiable B A g (within (R :^: idx A) (at A (f x)) {f x | x :e s}) -> differentiable B C (fun x:set => g (f x)) (within (R :^: idx C) (at C x) s)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx B), forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c :e R, differentiable A B f net0 -> differentiable A B (fun x:set => vector_mul A c (f x)) net0

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_COMPONENTWISE_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, differentiable N M f (at M a) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> differentiable 1 M (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) (at M a)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_COMPONENTWISE_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, differentiable N M f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> differentiable 1 M (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall c :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx B), differentiable A B (fun z:set => c) net0

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_COUNTABLE_PREIMAGES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = y -> ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0) -> countable {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_DISCRETE_PREIMAGES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = y -> ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0) -> {l :e R :^: idx N | l :e s /\ limit_point_of N l {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}} = Empty

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_DISCRETE_PREIMAGES_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = y -> ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0)) -> {l :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N l {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}} = Empty

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_FINITE_PREIMAGES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = y -> ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0)) -> finite {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_FINITE_PREIMAGES_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx N, compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y} /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = y -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = y -> ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0)) -> finite {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx A), differentiable A A (fun z:set => z) net0

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_IMP_CONTINUOUS_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, differentiable N M f (at M x) -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, differentiable_on_hl N M f s -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_IMP_CONTINUOUS_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, differentiable N M f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_IMP_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (at N x) /\ ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0) -> open N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_IMP_OPEN_MAP_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s) /\ ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0) /\ (open N t /\ t c= s) -> open N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_IMP_OPEN_MAP_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g':set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, g' x y :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, open M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M f (f' x) (at M x) /\ (linear N M (g' x) /\ forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f' x (g' x x0) = x0)) -> open N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_LIFT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx N), differentiable 1 N (fun x:set => lift (x i)) net0

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx M), forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> differentiable N M f net0

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_MUL_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, differentiable 1 M (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (at M a) /\ differentiable N M g (at M a) -> differentiable N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (f x) (g x)) (at M a)

items.name: DIFFERENTIABLE_MUL_WITHIN

items.name: DIFFERENTIAL_COMPONENT_NEG_AT_MAXIMUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, forall e0 :e R, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (x :e s /\ (convex M s /\ (has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ (0 < e0 /\ (forall w :e R :^: idx M, w :e s :/\: ball M (x,e0) -> f w k <= f x k)))))) -> forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s -> f' (vector_sub M y x) k <= 0

items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, forall e0 :e R, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (x :e s /\ (convex M s /\ (has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ (0 < e0 /\ (forall w :e R :^: idx M, w :e s :/\: ball M (x,e0) -> f x k <= f w k)))))) -> forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s -> 0 <= f' (vector_sub M y x) k

items.name: DIFFERENTIAL_COMPONENT_ZERO_AT_MAXMIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (x :e s /\ (open M s /\ (has_derivative N M f f' (at M x) /\ ((forall w :e R :^: idx M, w :e s -> f w k <= f x k) \/ (forall w :e R :^: idx M, w :e s -> f x k <= f w k)))))) -> forall h :e R :^: idx M, f' h k = 0

items.name: DIFFERENTIAL_ZERO_LEVELSET_DENSITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx N, has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) /\ (eventually (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx M | f x = c} (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun e0:set => lift (measure M (s :/\: ball M (a,drop e0)) :/: measure M (ball M (a,drop e0)))) (vec 1 1) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (vec 1 0)) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 < drop t}))) -> forall h :e R :^: idx M, f' h = vec N 0

items.name: DIFFERENTIAL_ZERO_MAXMIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (open N s /\ (has_derivative 1 N f f' (at N x) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) \/ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y))))) -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, f' v = vec 1 0

items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (0 < e0 /\ (((forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e ball M (x,e0) -> f y k <= f x k) \/ (forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e ball M (x,e0) -> f x k <= f y k)) /\ differentiable N M f (at M x)))) -> jacobian M N f (at M x) k = vec M 0

items.name: DIFFERENTIAL_ZERO_MAXMIN_DENSITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, has_derivative 1 N f f' (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s) /\ ((eventually (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N | drop (f a) <= drop (f x)} (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s) \/ eventually (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N | drop (f x) <= drop (f a)} (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s)) /\ (lebesgue_measurable N s /\ tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun e0:set => lift (measure N (s :/\: ball N (a,drop e0)) :/: measure N (ball N (a,drop e0)))) (vec 1 1) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (vec 1 0)) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 < drop t}))) -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, f' v = vec 1 0

items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g' x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (at M x) /\ has_derivative P N g g' (at N (f x)) -> has_derivative P M (fun x:set => g (f x)) (fun x:set => g' (f' x)) (at M x)

items.name: DIFF_CHAIN_AT_EQUAL_AE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall h':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t u v w c= R :^: idx 1, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (negligible 1 u /\ (negligible 1 v /\ (negligible 1 w /\ ((forall n c= R :^: idx 1, n c= t /\ negligible 1 n -> negligible 1 {g x | x :e n}) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s :\: u -> has_vector_derivative 1 f (f' x) (at 1 x)) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx 1, y :e t :\: v -> has_vector_derivative 1 g (g' y) (at 1 y)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s :\: w -> has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => g (f x)) (h' x) (at 1 x)))))))) -> negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ h' x = vector_mul 1 (drop (f' x)) (g' (f x))}

items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g' x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ has_derivative P N g g' (within (R :^: idx N) (at N (f x)) {f x | x :e s}) -> has_derivative P M (fun x:set => g (f x)) (fun x:set => g' (f' x)) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: DIFF_CHAIN_WITHIN_AE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t u v c= R :^: idx 1, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (negligible 1 u /\ (negligible 1 v /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s :\: u -> has_vector_derivative 1 f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx 1, y :e t :\: v -> has_vector_derivative 1 g (g' y) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 y) t)) /\ negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ f' x = vec 1 0})))) -> negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => g (f x)) (vector_mul 1 (drop (f' x)) (g' (f x))) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)}

items.name: DIFF_CHAIN_WITHIN_EQUAL_AE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall h':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t u v w c= R :^: idx 1, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (negligible 1 u /\ (negligible 1 v /\ (negligible 1 w /\ ((forall n c= R :^: idx 1, n c= t /\ negligible 1 n -> negligible 1 {g x | x :e n}) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s :\: u -> has_vector_derivative 1 f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx 1, y :e t :\: v -> has_vector_derivative 1 g (g' y) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 y) t)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s :\: w -> has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => g (f x)) (h' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)))))))) -> negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ h' x = vector_mul 1 (drop (f' x)) (g' (f x))}
