items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, forall s c= Power A, u :\: {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = Union {u :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}

items.name: DIFF_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, {x :e A | x :e s :\: t /\ P x} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} :\: {x :e A | x :e t /\ P x}

items.name: DIFF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= A, forall s c= Power A, u :\: Union s = u :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e {u :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: DIFF_UNIONS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= A, forall s c= Power A, ~ s = Empty -> u :\: Union s = {x :e A | forall Y :e {u :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: DIFF_UNIONS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= Power A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ t c= s -> Union s :\: Union t = Union (s :\: t)

items.name: DIFF_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: A = Empty

items.name: DIMENSION_ATMOST_RATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, n <= dimindex N -> dimension N {x :e R :^: idx N | finite_cardinality {i :e omega | i :e idx N /\ x i :e rational} <= n} = n

items.name: DIMENSION_COMPLEMENT_RATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> dimension N ((R :^: idx N) :\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e rational}) = dimindex N + - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, 0 <= n -> (dimension N s <= n <-> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, t :\/: u = s /\ (t :/\: u = Empty /\ (t :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | fsigma N x} s /\ (dimension N t <= n + - 1 /\ dimension N u <= 0))))

items.name: DIMENSION_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, dimension N (s :\: {a}) = if s :\: {a} = Empty then - 1 else dimension N s

items.name: DIMENSION_DIMENSION_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> dimension_le (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) n

items.name: DIMENSION_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> dimension A Empty = - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> dimension N s = aff_dim N s

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_DISCRETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N x s} = Empty -> dimension N s = if s = Empty then - 1 else 0

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_FULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s = dimindex N <-> ~ interior N s = Empty

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_FULL_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, convex N u /\ s c= u -> (dimension N s = aff_dim N u <-> s = Empty /\ u = Empty \/ ~ interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s = Empty)

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_FULL_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s = aff_dim N s <-> s = Empty \/ ~ relative_interior N s = Empty

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_LOCALLY_CLOPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s <= 0 <-> locally N {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) u /\ u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s} s

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_MINUS1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s = - 1 <-> s = Empty

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_ON_NBDS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (u c= v /\ (v c= s /\ dimension N v = n)))) -> dimension N s = n

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_ON_OPEN_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ dimension N u = n)) -> dimension N s = n

items.name: DIMENSION_EQ_ZERO_DISCRETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N x s} = Empty -> dimension N s = 0

items.name: DIMENSION_EXACTLY_RATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, 1 <= n /\ n <= dimindex N -> dimension N {x :e R :^: idx N | equip {i :e omega | i :e idx N /\ x i :e rational} n} = 0

items.name: DIMENSION_FRONTIER_BOUNDED_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ bounded_hl N u -> dimension N (frontier N u) = if u = Empty then - 1 else dimindex N + - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_FRONTIER_NONDENSE_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ ~ closure N u = R :^: idx N) -> dimension N (frontier N u) = dimindex N + - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, - 1 <= dimension N s

items.name: DIMENSION_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, dimension N (SetAdjoin s a) = if s = Empty then 0 else dimension N s

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_0_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_CLOPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, dimension_le A top 0 <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {u :e Power A | closed_in A top u /\ u :e top} top

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s <= aff_dim N s

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall n :e int, dimension_le A top n -> - 1 <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a0 :e topology A, forall a1 :e int, dimension_le A a0 a1 <-> - 1 <= a1 /\ forall v c= A, forall a :e A, v :e a0 /\ a :e v -> exists u c= A, a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (u :e a0 /\ dimension_le A (subtopology A a0 (frontier_of A a0 u)) (a1 + - 1)))

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_CLOSED_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall n :e int, - 1 <= n /\ (countable c /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ dimension N s <= n)) -> dimension N (Union c) <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_DIMINDEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s <= dimindex N

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_DISCRETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N x s} = Empty -> dimension N s <= 0

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, dimension_le A (discrete_topology A u) 0

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> - 1 <= n /\ forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, open N v /\ (a :e v /\ a :e s) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (open N u /\ dimension N (s :/\: frontier N u) <= n + - 1))

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> - 1 <= n /\ forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, open N v /\ (a :e v /\ a :e s) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (open N u /\ dimension N (frontier_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (s :/\: u)) <= n + - 1))

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, dimension_le A top (- 1) <-> topspace A top = Empty

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_EQ_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> (s = Empty -> - 1 <= n) /\ (~ s = Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, open N v /\ a :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (open N u /\ dimension N (s :/\: frontier N u) <= n + - 1)))

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_EQ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, s c= t -> (dimension N s <= n <-> - 1 <= n /\ forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ (a :e v /\ a :e s) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ dimension N (s :/\: frontier_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u) <= n + - 1)))

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_EQ_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> - 1 <= n /\ forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ a :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ dimension N (frontier_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) u) <= n + - 1))

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_EQ_LOCALLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> - 1 <= n /\ locally N {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ dimension N (frontier_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) u) <= n + - 1} s

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_EQ_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall n :e int, dimension_le A (subtopology A top s) n <-> - 1 <= n /\ forall v c= A, forall a :e A, v :e top /\ (a :e v /\ a :e s) -> exists u c= A, a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (u :e top /\ dimension_le A (subtopology A top (frontier_of A (subtopology A top s) (s :/\: u))) (n + - 1)))

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_IMP_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n -> - 1 <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall dimension_le':set -> set -> prop, (forall top :e topology A, forall n :e int, - 1 <= n /\ (forall v c= A, forall a :e A, v :e top /\ a :e v -> exists u c= A, a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (u :e top /\ dimension_le' (subtopology A top (frontier_of A top u)) (n + - 1)))) -> dimension_le' top n) -> forall a0 :e topology A, forall a1 :e int, dimension_le A a0 a1 -> dimension_le' a0 a1

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_MINUS1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s <= - 1 <-> s = Empty

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m n :e int, dimension_le A top m /\ m <= n -> dimension_le A top n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall n :e int, dimension_le A top n <-> - 1 <= n /\ neighbourhood_base_of A {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ dimension_le A (subtopology A top (frontier_of A top u)) (n + - 1)} top

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_RATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, dimension N {x :e R :^: idx N | equip {i :e omega | i :e idx N /\ x i :e rational} n} <= 0

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall n :e int, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ dimension_le A top n -> dimension_le B top' n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_RULES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall n :e int, - 1 <= n /\ (forall v c= A, forall a :e A, v :e top /\ a :e v -> exists u c= A, a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (u :e top /\ dimension_le A (subtopology A top (frontier_of A top u)) (n + - 1)))) -> dimension_le A top n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_SUBTOPOLOGIES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall n :e int, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ dimension_le A (subtopology A top t) n -> dimension_le A (subtopology A top s) n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall n :e int, forall s c= A, dimension_le A top n -> dimension_le A (subtopology A top s) n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, fsigma N s /\ (fsigma N t /\ (dimension N s <= n /\ dimension N t <= n)) -> dimension N (s :\/: t) <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall n :e int, - 1 <= n /\ (countable c /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e c -> fsigma N s /\ dimension N s <= n)) -> dimension N (Union c) <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_UNIONS_RELATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall n :e int, - 1 <= n /\ (countable c /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e c -> s :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | fsigma N x} u /\ dimension N s <= n)) -> dimension N (Union c) <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_UNIONS_ZERODIMENSIONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> dimension N s <= 0) -> dimension N (Union f) <= finite_cardinality f + - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_UNIONS_ZERODIMENSIONAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (finite_cardinality f <= n + 1 /\ ((forall d c= R :^: idx N, d :e f -> dimension N d <= 0) /\ Union f = s))

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_UNION_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ t c= u \/ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ s c= u) /\ (dimension N s <= n /\ dimension N t <= n) -> dimension N (s :\/: t) <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_UNION_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (fsigma N s /\ gdelta N s \/ fsigma N t /\ gdelta N t) /\ (dimension N s <= n /\ dimension N t <= n) -> dimension N (s :\/: t) <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_UNION_RELATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, s :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | fsigma N x} u /\ (t :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | fsigma N x} u /\ (dimension N s <= n /\ dimension N t <= n)) -> dimension N (s :\/: t) <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LE_UNION_RELATIVE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, (s :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | fsigma N x} u /\ (s :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | gdelta N x} u /\ t c= u) \/ t :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | fsigma N x} u /\ (t :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | gdelta N x} u /\ s c= u)) /\ (dimension N s <= n /\ dimension N t <= n) -> dimension N (s :\/: t) <= n

items.name: DIMENSION_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> dimension N {f x | x :e s} = dimension M s

items.name: DIMENSION_LT_FULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s < dimindex N <-> interior N s = Empty

items.name: DIMENSION_LT_FULL_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, convex N u /\ s c= u -> (dimension N s < aff_dim N u <-> ~ u = Empty /\ interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s = Empty)

items.name: DIMENSION_LT_FULL_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s < aff_dim N s <-> ~ s = Empty /\ relative_interior N s = Empty

items.name: DIMENSION_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ interior N s = Empty -> dimension N s = dimindex N

items.name: DIMENSION_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> dimension N s = if s = Empty then - 1 else dimindex N

items.name: DIMENSION_OPEN_IN_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, convex N u /\ s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u -> dimension N s = if s = Empty then - 1 else aff_dim N u

items.name: DIMENSION_PCROSS_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, dimension (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = 0 <-> dimension M s = 0 /\ dimension N t = 0

items.name: DIMENSION_PCROSS_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, ~ (s = Empty /\ t = Empty) -> dimension (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <= dimension M s + dimension N t

items.name: DIMENSION_POS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 0 <= dimension N s <-> ~ s = Empty

items.name: DIMENSION_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_BOUNDED_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, affine N u /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ bounded_hl N s) -> dimension N (relative_frontier N s) = if s = Empty then - 1 else aff_dim N u + - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> dimension N (relative_frontier N s) = aff_dim N s + - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_NONDENSE_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, affine N u /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ closure_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s = u)) -> dimension N (relative_frontier N s) = aff_dim N u + - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_SEPARATION_THEOREM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, forall c d c= R :^: idx N, 0 <= n /\ (s c= t /\ (dimension N s <= n /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) c /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) d /\ c :/\: d = Empty)))) -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) b /\ (dimension N (b :/\: s) <= n + - 1 /\ exists u v c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ (u :/\: v = Empty /\ (u :\/: v = t :\: b /\ (c c= u /\ d c= v)))))

items.name: DIMENSION_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, dimension N {a} = 0

items.name: DIMENSION_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, dimension N (sphere N (a,r)) = if 0 < r then dimindex N + - 1 else if r = 0 then 0 else - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_SPHERE_INTER_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall t c= R :^: idx N, 0 < r /\ (affine N t /\ a :e t) -> dimension N (sphere N (a,r) :/\: t) = aff_dim N t + - 1

items.name: DIMENSION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t -> dimension N s <= dimension N t

items.name: DIMENSION_SUBSET_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, - 1 <= n /\ n <= dimension N s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t /\ (t c= s /\ dimension N t = n)

items.name: DIMENSION_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> dimension N s = dim N s

items.name: DIMENSION_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = dimension N s

items.name: DIMENSION_UNION_LE_BASIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, dimension N (s :\/: t) <= dimension N s + dimension N t + 1

items.name: DIMENSION_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> dimension N (R :^: idx N) = dimindex N

items.name: DIMENSION_ZERO_REDUCTION_THEOREM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall v :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, dimension N s <= 0 /\ (forall n :e omega, v n :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) -> exists u :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, u n :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) /\ ((forall n :e omega, u n c= v n) /\ ((forall x y :e omega, x <> y -> u x :/\: u y = Empty) /\ Union {u n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = Union {v n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))

items.name: DIMENSION_ZERO_REDUCTION_THEOREM_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, dimension N u <= 0 /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) -> exists s' t' c= R :^: idx N, s' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (t' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (s' c= s /\ (t' c= t /\ (s' :/\: t' = Empty /\ s' :\/: t' = s :\/: t))))

items.name: DIMENSION_ZERO_SEPARATION_THEOREM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, dimension N u <= 0 /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ s :/\: t = Empty)) -> exists s' t' c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s' /\ (s' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t' /\ (t' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (s c= s' /\ (t c= t' /\ (s' :/\: t' = Empty /\ s' :\/: t' = u))))))

items.name: DIMINDEX_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, 1 = 1 /\ (2 * dimindex A = 2 * dimindex A /\ 2 * dimindex A + 1 = 2 * dimindex A + 1)

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_DIFF
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> dimindex (idx_n (if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1)) = if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> dimindex (idx A) = dimindex A

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_PROD
items.statement: forall M N:set, dimindex M * dimindex N = dimindex M * dimindex N

items.name: DIMINDEX_FINITE_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, dimindex M + dimindex N = dimindex M + dimindex N

items.name: DIMINDEX_GE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> 1 <= dimindex A

items.name: DIMINDEX_HAS_SIZE_FINITE_DIFF
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1)) (if dimindex N < dimindex M then minus_nat (dimindex M) (dimindex N) else 1)

items.name: DIMINDEX_HAS_SIZE_FINITE_PROD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (dimindex M * dimindex N)

items.name: DIMINDEX_HAS_SIZE_FINITE_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (dimindex M + dimindex N)

items.name: DIMINDEX_MULTIVECTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> dimindex (multivector N) = 2 ^ dimindex N

items.name: DIMINDEX_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ~ dimindex A = 0

items.name: DIMINDEX_TYBIT0
items.statement: forall A:set, 2 * dimindex A = 2 * dimindex A

items.name: DIMINDEX_TYBIT1
items.statement: forall A:set, 2 * dimindex A + 1 = 2 * dimindex A + 1

items.name: DIMINDEX_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, equip A n -> dimindex A = n

items.name: DIMINDEX_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, dimindex A = dimindex A

items.name: DIM_BASIS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k c= omega, dim N {basis N x | x :e k} = finite_cardinality (idx N :/\: k)

items.name: DIM_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N (closure N s) = dim N s

items.name: DIM_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) = dim N s

items.name: DIM_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = dim N s

items.name: DIM_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s = dimension N (span N s)

items.name: DIM_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> dim N Empty = 0

items.name: DIM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s = 0 <-> s c= {vec N 0}

items.name: DIM_EQ_CARD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, independent N s -> dim N s = finite_cardinality s

items.name: DIM_EQ_FULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s = dimindex N <-> span N s = R :^: idx N

items.name: DIM_EQ_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s = minus_nat (dimindex N) 1 <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ span N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = 0}

items.name: DIM_EQ_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ dim N t <= dim N s -> span N s = span N t

items.name: DIM_EQ_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ s c= t) -> (dim N s = dim N t <-> s = t)

items.name: DIM_EQ_SUBSPACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ (s c= t /\ dim N t <= dim N s)) -> s = t

items.name: DIM_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 -> dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = 0} = minus_nat (dimindex N) 1

items.name: DIM_IMAGE_KERNEL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> dim N {f x | x :e R :^: idx M} + dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x = vec N 0} = dimindex M

items.name: DIM_IMAGE_KERNEL_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ subspace M s -> dim N {f x | x :e s} + dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = vec N 0} = dim M s

items.name: DIM_IMAGE_SCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> ~ c x = 0) -> dim N {vector_mul N (c x) x | x :e s} = dim N s

items.name: DIM_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> dim N {f x | x :e s} = dim M s

items.name: DIM_INJECTIVE_ON_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (subspace M s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> dim N {f x | x :e s} = dim M s

items.name: DIM_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N (SetAdjoin s x) = if x :e span N s then dim N s else dim N s + 1

items.name: DIM_INSERT_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N (SetAdjoin s (vec N 0)) = dim N s

items.name: DIM_KERNEL_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> linear M N f /\ linear N P g -> dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | g (f x) = vec P 0} <= dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x = vec N 0} + dim N {y :e R :^: idx N | g y = vec P 0}

items.name: DIM_LE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s -> dim A s <= finite_cardinality s

items.name: DIM_LINEAR_IMAGE_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> dim N {f x | x :e s} <= dim M s

items.name: DIM_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ interior N s = Empty -> dim N s = dimindex N

items.name: DIM_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> dim N s = dimindex N

items.name: DIM_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ subspace N t) -> dim N s = dim N t

items.name: DIM_ORTHOGONAL_SUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> dot N x y = 0) -> dim N (s :\/: t) = dim N s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace M s /\ subspace N t -> dim (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = dim M s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_PCROSS_STRONG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (vec M 0 :e s \/ vec N 0 :e t)) -> dim (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = dim M s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, span N s c= span N t /\ span N s <> span N t -> dim N s < dim N t

items.name: DIM_ROWS_LE_DIM_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, dim M (rows N M A) <= dim N (columns N M A)

items.name: DIM_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dim A {x} = if x = vec A 0 then 0 else 1

items.name: DIM_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N (span N s) = dim N s

items.name: DIM_SPECIAL_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = 0} = minus_nat (dimindex N) 1

items.name: DIM_SPECIAL_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k c= omega, dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ i :e k) -> x i = 0} = finite_cardinality (idx N :\: k)

items.name: DIM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t -> dim N s <= dim N t

items.name: DIM_SUBSET_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s <= dimindex N

items.name: DIM_SUBSPACE_ORTHOGONAL_TO_VECTORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ s c= t) -> dim N {y :e R :^: idx N | y :e t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> orthogonal N x y} + dim N s = dim N t

items.name: DIM_SUBSTANDARD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d :e omega, d <= dimindex N -> dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, d < i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i = 0} = d

items.name: DIM_SUMS_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ subspace N t -> dim N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) + dim N (s :/\: t) = dim N s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_UNION_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ subspace N t -> dim N (s :\/: t) + dim N (s :/\: t) = dim N s + dim N t

items.name: DIM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall v b c= R :^: idx A, b c= v /\ (v c= span A b /\ (independent A b /\ equip b n)) -> dim A v = n

items.name: DIM_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> dim N (R :^: idx N) = dimindex N

items.name: DINI
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ ((forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl N 1 (f n) s) /\ (continuous_on_hl N 1 g s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially) /\ (forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> drop (f n x) <= drop (f (n + 1) x))))) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually omega {n :e omega | forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 (f n x) (g x)) < e0} sequentially

items.name: DISCRETE_BOUNDED_IMP_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N y x) < e0) -> y = x) /\ bounded_hl N s) -> finite s

items.name: DISCRETE_COMPACT_IN_EQ_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :/\: derived_set_of A top s = Empty -> (compact_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ finite s)

items.name: DISCRETE_COMPACT_SPACE_EQ_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, derived_set_of A top (topspace A top) = Empty -> (compact_space A top <-> finite (topspace A top))

items.name: DISCRETE_EQ_FINITE_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> ({x :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N x s} = Empty <-> finite s)

items.name: DISCRETE_EQ_FINITE_BOUNDED_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ t c= s) -> ({x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ limit_point_of N x t} = Empty <-> finite t)

items.name: DISCRETE_EQ_FINITE_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ t c= s -> ({x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ limit_point_of N x t} = Empty <-> finite t)

items.name: DISCRETE_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N y x) < e0) -> y = x) -> closed N s

items.name: DISCRETE_IMP_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> e0 <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N y x)) -> countable s

items.name: DISCRETE_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall s c= A, mspace A (discrete_metric A s) = s) /\ forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, mdist A (discrete_metric A s) (x,y) = if x = y then 0 else 1

items.name: DISCRETE_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e t /\ limit_point_of N x s} = Empty <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> e0 <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N y x)

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, discrete_space A top <-> exists u c= A, discrete_topology A u = top

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, discrete_space A top <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> closed_in A top s

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_CLOSED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, discrete_space A top <-> forall s c= A, closed_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_CLOSED_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ discrete_space A top) -> discrete_space B top'

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, discrete_space A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, discrete_space A top <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> s :e top

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_OPEN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, discrete_space A top <-> forall s c= A, s :e top <-> s c= topspace A top

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_OPEN_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> open_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ discrete_space A top) -> discrete_space B top'

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> discrete_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> discrete_space B top'

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, discrete_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ exists a :e A, topspace A (tops i) c= {a}} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> discrete_space A (tops i)

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, discrete_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ discrete_space A top1 /\ discrete_space B top2

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_QUOTIENT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') q /\ discrete_space A top -> discrete_space B top'

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ discrete_space A top -> discrete_space B top'

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, discrete_space A top -> discrete_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_TOPSPACE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> discrete_space A top

items.name: DISCRETE_SPACE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, discrete_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> {x} :e top

items.name: DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ exists a :e A, s i c= {a}} -> discrete_topology (A :^: K) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = product_topology A K k (fun x:set => discrete_topology A (s x))

items.name: DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, discrete_topology (A :^: K) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = product_topology A K k (fun x:set => discrete_topology A (s x)) <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ exists a :e A, s i c= {a}}

items.name: DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, closure_of A (discrete_topology A u) s = u :/\: s

items.name: DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, frontier_of A (discrete_topology A u) s = Empty

items.name: DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, interior_of A (discrete_topology A u) s = u :/\: s

items.name: DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, discrete_topology A u = top <-> topspace A top = u /\ forall x :e A, x :e u -> {x} :e top

items.name: DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, discrete_topology A u = top <-> topspace A top c= u /\ forall x :e A, x :e u -> {x} :e top

items.name: DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_UNIQUE_DERIVED_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, discrete_topology A u = top <-> topspace A top = u /\ derived_set_of A top u = Empty

items.name: DISCRETE_ULTRAMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x y z :e A, mdist A (discrete_metric A s) (x,z) <= if mdist A (discrete_metric A s) (x,y) <= mdist A (discrete_metric A s) (y,z) then mdist A (discrete_metric A s) (y,z) else mdist A (discrete_metric A s) (x,y)

items.name: DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ (t c= s /\ (u c= s /\ t :/\: u = Empty)) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} u = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, (s :*: t) :/\: (s' :*: t') = Empty <-> s :/\: s' = Empty \/ t :/\: t' = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_DELETE_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, (s :\: {x}) :/\: t = Empty <-> (t :\: {x}) :/\: s = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} :/\: {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} = Empty <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i :/\: t i = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, Empty :/\: s = Empty /\ s :/\: Empty = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_EMPTY_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s = Empty <-> s :/\: s = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_GROUP_ORBITS
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> ({x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} :/\: {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a y x0} = Empty <-> ~ forall x0 :e X, group_orbit A X G s a x x0 <-> group_orbit A X G s a y x0)

items.name: DISJOINT_HYPERPLANES_IMP_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall c d :e R, {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = c} :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N b x = d} = Empty -> collinear N {vec N 0,a,b}

items.name: DISJOINT_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x :/\: t = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ x :e t

items.name: DISJOINT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty <-> (exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (b i < a i \/ (d i < c i \/ (b i < c i \/ d i < a i)))))) /\ ((closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: open_interval N (c,d) = Empty <-> (exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (b i < a i \/ (d i <= c i \/ (b i <= c i \/ d i <= a i)))))) /\ ((open_interval N (a,b) :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty <-> (exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (b i <= a i \/ (d i < c i \/ (b i <= c i \/ d i <= a i)))))) /\ (open_interval N (a,b) :/\: open_interval N (c,d) = Empty <-> exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (b i <= a i \/ (d i <= c i \/ (b i <= c i \/ d i <= a i)))))))

items.name: DISJOINT_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall a b c d :e R :^: idx 1, (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty <-> drop b < drop a \/ (drop d < drop c \/ (drop b < drop c \/ drop d < drop a))) /\ ((closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: open_interval 1 (c,d) = Empty <-> drop b < drop a \/ (drop d <= drop c \/ (drop b <= drop c \/ drop d <= drop a))) /\ ((open_interval 1 (a,b) :/\: closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty <-> drop b <= drop a \/ (drop d < drop c \/ (drop b <= drop c \/ drop d <= drop a))) /\ (open_interval 1 (a,b) :/\: open_interval 1 (c,d) = Empty <-> drop b <= drop a \/ (drop d <= drop c \/ (drop b <= drop c \/ drop d <= drop a)))))

items.name: DISJOINT_LEFT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> (left_coset_hl A G x h :/\: left_coset_hl A G y h = Empty <-> ~ left_coset_hl A G x h = left_coset_hl A G y h)

items.name: DISJOINT_MBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x x' :e A, forall r r' :e R, r + r' <= mdist A m (x,x') -> mball A m (x,r) :/\: mball A m (x',r') = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} :/\: {i :e omega | p <= i /\ i <= q} = Empty <-> n < p \/ (q < m \/ (n < m \/ q < p))

items.name: DISJOINT_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t' c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :/\: (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) = Empty <-> s :/\: s' = Empty \/ t :/\: t' = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a}) -> relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) :/\: s = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_RIGHT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> (right_coset_hl A G h x :/\: right_coset_hl A G h y = Empty <-> ~ right_coset_hl A G h x = right_coset_hl A G h y)

items.name: DISJOINT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, forall a :e A, s :/\: {a} = Empty <-> ~ a :e s) /\ forall s c= A, forall a :e A, {a} :/\: s = Empty <-> ~ a :e s

items.name: DISJOINT_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty <-> t :/\: s = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, (s :\/: t) :/\: u = Empty <-> s :/\: u = Empty /\ t :/\: u = Empty

items.name: DISJOINT_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i = t i

items.name: DISJOINT_UNION_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} = Empty <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i = Empty

items.name: DISJ_ASSOC
items.statement: forall t1 t2 t3:prop, t1 \/ (t2 \/ t3) <-> t1 \/ t2 \/ t3

items.name: DISJ_SYM
items.statement: forall t1 t2:prop, t1 \/ t2 <-> t2 \/ t1

items.name: DISTANCE_ATTAINS_INF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> distance N (a,x) <= distance N (a,y)

items.name: DISTANCE_ATTAINS_SUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, compact A s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e s -> distance A (a,y) <= distance A (a,x)

items.name: DISTINCT_PRIME_COPRIME
items.statement: forall p q :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (prime_nat q /\ ~ p = q) -> gcd_int p q = 1

items.name: DIST_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,vec A 0) = vector_norm A x /\ distance A (vec A 0,x) = vector_norm A x

items.name: DIST_1
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, distance 1 (x,y) = abs_SNo (drop x + - drop y)

items.name: DIST_ADD2
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, abs_SNo ((m + n) + - (p + q)) <= abs_SNo (m + - p) + abs_SNo (n + - q)

items.name: DIST_ADD2_REV
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - p) <= abs_SNo ((m + n) + - (p + q)) + abs_SNo (n + - q)

items.name: DIST_ADDBOUND
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) <= m + n

items.name: DIST_CLOSEST_POINT_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> abs_SNo (distance N (x,closest_point N s x) + - distance N (y,closest_point N s y)) <= distance N (x,y)

items.name: DIST_CONVEX_HULL_BOUND_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s -> distance N (x,y) <= d) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (x,y) <= d

items.name: DIST_CONVEX_HULL_BOUND_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s -> distance N (a,x) <= d) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> distance N (a,x) <= d

items.name: DIST_DECREASES_CLOSED_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> distance N (c,x) <= distance N (c,a) \/ distance N (c,x) <= distance N (c,b)

items.name: DIST_DECREASES_OPEN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c x :e R :^: idx N, x :e open_segment N (a,b) -> distance N (c,x) < distance N (c,a) \/ distance N (c,x) < distance N (c,b)

items.name: DIST_DESCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= a /\ (0 <= b /\ vector_norm N x = vector_norm N y) -> (if a <= b then a else b) * distance N (x,y) <= distance N (vector_mul N a x,vector_mul N b y)

items.name: DIST_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall x y :e omega, P (abs_SNo (x + - y)) <-> forall d :e omega, (x = y + d -> P d) /\ (y = x + d -> P d)

items.name: DIST_ENDPOINTS_LE_PATH_LENGTH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g -> distance N (pathstart N g,pathfinish N g) <= path_length N g

items.name: DIST_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall w x :e R :^: idx A, forall y z :e R :^: idx B, distance A (w,x) = distance B (y,z) <-> distance A (w,x) ^ 2 = distance B (y,z) ^ 2

items.name: DIST_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,y) = 0 <-> x = y

items.name: DIST_FSTCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A), distance B (fstcart B x,fstcart B y) <= distance (idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A)) (x,y)

items.name: DIST_INCREASES_ONLINE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b d :e R :^: idx A, ~ d = vec A 0 -> distance A (a,b) < distance A (a,vector_add A b d) \/ distance A (a,b) < distance A (a,vector_sub A b d)

items.name: DIST_IN_CLOSED_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> distance N (x,a) <= distance N (a,b) /\ distance N (x,b) <= distance N (a,b)

items.name: DIST_IN_CLOSED_SEGMENT_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> distance N (x,y) <= distance N (a,b)

items.name: DIST_IN_OPEN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, x :e open_segment N (a,b) -> distance N (x,a) < distance N (a,b) /\ distance N (x,b) < distance N (a,b)

items.name: DIST_LADD
items.statement: forall m p n :e omega, abs_SNo ((m + n) + - (m + p)) = abs_SNo (n + - p)

items.name: DIST_LADD_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, abs_SNo ((m + n) + - m) = n

items.name: DIST_LE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,y) <= 0 <-> x = y

items.name: DIST_LE_CASES
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) <= p <-> m <= n + p /\ n <= m + p

items.name: DIST_LE_DIAMETER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s) -> distance N (a,b) <= diameter N s

items.name: DIST_LE_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall y1 :e R :^: idx B, forall x2 :e R :^: idx A, forall y2 :e R :^: idx B, distance A (x1,x2) <= distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x1 y1,pastecart A B x2 y2) /\ distance B (y1,y2) <= distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x1 y1,pastecart A B x2 y2)

items.name: DIST_LIFT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, distance 1 (lift x,lift y) = abs_SNo (x + - y)

items.name: DIST_LMUL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * abs_SNo (n + - p) = abs_SNo (m * n + - m * p)

items.name: DIST_LZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (0 + - n) = n

items.name: DIST_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, distance A (a,midpoint A (a,b)) = distance A (a,b) :/: 2 /\ (distance A (b,midpoint A (a,b)) = distance A (a,b) :/: 2 /\ (distance A (midpoint A (a,b),a) = distance A (a,b) :/: 2 /\ distance A (midpoint A (a,b),b) = distance A (a,b) :/: 2))

items.name: DIST_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, distance A (vector_mul A c x,vector_mul A c y) = abs_SNo c * distance A (x,y)

items.name: DIST_NZ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, ~ x = y <-> 0 < distance A (x,y)

items.name: DIST_PASTECART_CANCEL
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall x x' :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x y,pastecart A B x' y) = distance A (x,x')) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx C, forall y y' :e R :^: idx D, distance (idx_n (dimindex C + dimindex D)) (pastecart C D x y,pastecart C D x y') = distance D (y,y')

items.name: DIST_PASTECART_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall y1 :e R :^: idx B, forall x2 :e R :^: idx A, forall y2 :e R :^: idx B, distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x1 y1,pastecart A B x2 y2) <= distance A (x1,x2) + distance B (y1,y2)

items.name: DIST_POINTS_LE_PATH_LENGTH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, rectifiable_path N g /\ (a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ b :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> distance N (g a,g b) <= path_length N g

items.name: DIST_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, 0 <= distance A (x,y)

items.name: DIST_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, ~ x = y -> 0 < distance A (x,y)

items.name: DIST_RADD
items.statement: forall m p n :e omega, abs_SNo ((m + p) + - (n + p)) = abs_SNo (m + - n)

items.name: DIST_RADD_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - (m + n)) = n

items.name: DIST_REAL
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, distance 1 (x,y) = abs_SNo (x 1 + - y 1)

items.name: DIST_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,x) = 0

items.name: DIST_RESCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x = vector_norm N y -> distance N (vector_mul N a x,y) = distance N (x,vector_mul N a y)

items.name: DIST_RMUL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) * p = abs_SNo (m * p + - n * p)

items.name: DIST_RZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (n + - 0) = n

items.name: DIST_SNDCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B), distance B (sndcart A B x,sndcart A B y) <= distance (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (x,y)

items.name: DIST_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,y) = distance A (y,x)

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, distance N (x,z) <= distance N (x,y) + distance N (y,z)

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLES_LE
items.statement: forall m n p q r s :e omega, abs_SNo (m + - n) <= r /\ abs_SNo (p + - q) <= s -> abs_SNo (m + - p) <= abs_SNo (n + - q) + r + s

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x x' y y' :e R :^: idx A, distance A (vector_add A x y,vector_add A x' y') <= distance A (x,x') + distance A (y,y')

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_ADD_HALF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x x' y y' :e R :^: idx N, distance N (x,x') < e0 :/: 2 /\ distance N (y,y') < e0 :/: 2 -> distance N (vector_add N x y,vector_add N x' y') < e0

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, distance A (y,z) <= distance A (x,y) + distance A (x,z)

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,z) = distance A (x,y) + distance A (y,z) <-> vector_mul A (vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y)) (vector_sub A y z) = vector_mul A (vector_norm A (vector_sub A y z)) (vector_sub A x y)

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_HALF_L
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x1 x2 y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x1,y) < e0 :/: 2 /\ distance A (x2,y) < e0 :/: 2 -> distance A (x1,x2) < e0

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_HALF_R
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x1 x2 y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (y,x1) < e0 :/: 2 /\ distance A (y,x2) < e0 :/: 2 -> distance A (x1,x2) < e0

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, distance A (x,z) + distance A (y,z) <= e0 -> distance A (x,y) <= e0

items.name: DIST_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, distance A (x,z) + distance A (y,z) < e0 -> distance A (x,y) < e0

items.name: DIVIDES_0
items.statement: forall x :e omega, divides_nat x 0

items.name: DIVIDES_1
items.statement: forall x :e omega, divides_nat 1 x

items.name: DIVIDES_2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, divides_nat 2 n <-> even_nat n

items.name: DIVIDES_ADD
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b -> divides_nat d (a + b)

items.name: DIVIDES_ADD_REVL
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d b /\ divides_nat d (a + b) -> divides_nat d a

items.name: DIVIDES_ADD_REVR
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d (a + b) -> divides_nat d b

items.name: DIVIDES_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n /\ divides_nat n m <-> m = n

items.name: DIVIDES_CASES
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat n m -> m = 0 \/ (m = n \/ 2 * n <= m)

items.name: DIVIDES_CMUL2
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, divides_nat (c * a) (c * b) /\ ~ c = 0 -> divides_nat a b

items.name: DIVIDES_DIVIDES_DIV
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d n -> (divides_nat e0 (div_nat n d) <-> divides_nat (d * e0) n)

items.name: DIVIDES_DIVIDES_DIV_EQ
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d n /\ divides_nat e0 (div_nat n d) <-> divides_nat (d * e0) n

items.name: DIVIDES_DIVIDES_DIV_IMP
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat (d * e0) n -> divides_nat e0 (div_nat n d)

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall n d e0 :e omega, divides_nat d n /\ (n = 0 -> e0 = 0) -> (divides_nat (div_nat n d) e0 <-> divides_nat n (d * e0))

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> div_nat n m * m = n

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_NOT
items.statement: forall n x q r :e omega, x = q * n + r /\ (0 < r /\ r < n) -> ~ divides_nat n x

items.name: DIVIDES_DIV_SELF
items.statement: forall n d :e omega, divides_nat d n -> divides_nat (div_nat n d) n

items.name: DIVIDES_EQ_ZERO
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, n < p -> (divides_nat p n <-> n = 0)

items.name: DIVIDES_EXP
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, divides_nat x y -> divides_nat (x ^ n) (y ^ n)

items.name: DIVIDES_EXP2
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ divides_nat (x ^ n) y -> divides_nat x y

items.name: DIVIDES_EXP2_EQ
items.statement: forall n a b :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> (divides_nat (a ^ n) (b ^ n) <-> divides_nat a b)

items.name: DIVIDES_EXP2_REV
items.statement: forall n a b :e omega, divides_nat (a ^ n) (b ^ n) /\ ~ n = 0 -> divides_nat a b

items.name: DIVIDES_EXP_LE
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, 2 <= p -> (divides_nat (p ^ m) (p ^ n) <-> m <= n)

items.name: DIVIDES_EXP_LE_IMP
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, m <= n -> divides_nat (p ^ m) (p ^ n)

items.name: DIVIDES_EXP_MINUS1
items.statement: forall k n :e omega, divides_nat (minus_nat n 1) (minus_nat (n ^ k) 1)

items.name: DIVIDES_EXP_PLUS1
items.statement: forall n k :e omega, odd_nat k -> divides_nat (n + 1) (n ^ k + 1)

items.name: DIVIDES_FACT
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, 1 <= p /\ p <= n -> divides_nat p (factorial n)

items.name: DIVIDES_FACT_PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> forall n :e omega, divides_nat p (factorial n) <-> p <= n

items.name: DIVIDES_GCD
items.statement: forall a b d :e omega, divides_nat d (gcd_int a b) <-> divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b

items.name: DIVIDES_GCD_LEFT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> gcd_int m n = m

items.name: DIVIDES_GCD_RIGHT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat n m <-> gcd_int m n = n

items.name: DIVIDES_INDEX
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> n = 0 \/ ~ m = 0 /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p m <= prime_index p n

items.name: DIVIDES_ITERATE_GCD
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall d :e omega, finite k -> (divides_nat d (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> divides_nat d (f i))

items.name: DIVIDES_ITERATE_GCD_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall d :e omega, divides_nat d (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f) <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 0} -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> divides_nat d (f i)

items.name: DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM
items.statement: forall K:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall i :e K, finite k /\ i :e k -> divides_nat (f i) (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f)

items.name: DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall i :e K, i :e k -> (divides_nat (f i) (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} \/ f i = 1)

items.name: DIVIDES_LCM
items.statement: forall m n r :e omega, divides_nat r m \/ divides_nat r n -> divides_nat r (lcm_int m n)

items.name: DIVIDES_LCM_GCD
items.statement: forall m n d :e omega, divides_nat d (lcm_int m n) <-> divides_nat (d * gcd_int m n) (m * n)

items.name: DIVIDES_LCM_LEFT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat n m <-> lcm_int m n = m

items.name: DIVIDES_LCM_RIGHT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> lcm_int m n = n

items.name: DIVIDES_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n -> m <= n \/ n = 0

items.name: DIVIDES_LE_IMP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n /\ (n = 0 -> m = 0) -> m <= n

items.name: DIVIDES_LE_STRONG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n -> 1 <= m /\ m <= n \/ n = 0

items.name: DIVIDES_LMUL
items.statement: forall d a x :e omega, divides_nat d a -> divides_nat d (x * a)

items.name: DIVIDES_LMUL2
items.statement: forall d a x :e omega, divides_nat (x * d) a -> divides_nat d a

items.name: DIVIDES_LMUL2_EQ
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, ~ c = 0 -> (divides_nat (c * a) (c * b) <-> divides_nat a b)

items.name: DIVIDES_LMUL_GCD
items.statement: (forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d (gcd_int d a * b) <-> divides_nat d (a * b)) /\ forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d (gcd_int a d * b) <-> divides_nat d (a * b)

items.name: DIVIDES_MOD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> mod_nat n m = 0

items.name: DIVIDES_MUL
items.statement: forall m n r :e omega, divides_nat m r /\ (divides_nat n r /\ gcd_int m n = 1) -> divides_nat (m * n) r

items.name: DIVIDES_MUL2
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, divides_nat a b /\ divides_nat c d -> divides_nat (a * c) (b * d)

items.name: DIVIDES_MUL_L
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, divides_nat a b -> divides_nat (c * a) (c * b)

items.name: DIVIDES_MUL_R
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, divides_nat a b -> divides_nat (a * c) (b * c)

items.name: DIVIDES_NSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> divides_nat n (f i)) -> divides_nat n (finsum s f)

items.name: DIVIDES_ONE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, divides_nat n 1 <-> n = 1

items.name: DIVIDES_PRIMEPOW
items.statement: forall k p :e omega, prime_nat p -> forall d :e omega, divides_nat d (p ^ k) <-> exists i :e omega, i <= k /\ d = p ^ i

items.name: DIVIDES_PRIME_EXP_LE
items.statement: forall p q m n :e omega, prime_nat p /\ prime_nat q -> (divides_nat (p ^ m) (q ^ n) <-> m = 0 \/ p = q /\ m <= n)

items.name: DIVIDES_PRIME_PRIME
items.statement: forall p q :e omega, prime_nat p /\ prime_nat q -> (divides_nat p q <-> p = q)

items.name: DIVIDES_REFL
items.statement: forall x :e omega, divides_nat x x

items.name: DIVIDES_REXP
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, divides_nat x y /\ ~ n = 0 -> divides_nat x (y ^ n)

items.name: DIVIDES_REXP_SUC
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, divides_nat x y -> divides_nat x (y ^ ordsucc n)

items.name: DIVIDES_RMUL
items.statement: forall d a x :e omega, divides_nat d a -> divides_nat d (a * x)

items.name: DIVIDES_RMUL2
items.statement: forall d a x :e omega, divides_nat (d * x) a -> divides_nat d a

items.name: DIVIDES_RMUL2_EQ
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, ~ c = 0 -> (divides_nat (a * c) (b * c) <-> divides_nat a b)

items.name: DIVIDES_RMUL_GCD
items.statement: (forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d (a * gcd_int d b) <-> divides_nat d (a * b)) /\ forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d (a * gcd_int b d) <-> divides_nat d (a * b)

items.name: DIVIDES_SUB
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b -> divides_nat d (minus_nat a b)

items.name: DIVIDES_SUB_1
items.statement: forall d n :e omega, divides_nat d (minus_nat n 1) <-> n = 0 \/ exists q1 q2 :e omega, n + d * q1 = 1 + d * q2

items.name: DIVIDES_SUB_EQ
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d (minus_nat a b) <-> a < b \/ exists q1 q2 :e omega, a + d * q1 = b + d * q2

items.name: DIVIDES_TRANS
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, divides_nat a b /\ divides_nat b c -> divides_nat a c

items.name: DIVIDES_TRIVIAL_UPPERBOUND
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ 2 <= p -> ~ divides_nat (p ^ n) n

items.name: DIVIDES_ZERO
items.statement: forall x :e omega, divides_nat 0 x <-> x = 0

items.name: DIVISION
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> m = div_nat m n * n + mod_nat m n /\ mod_nat m n < n

items.name: DIVISION_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (n = 0 -> div_nat m n = 0 /\ mod_nat m n = m) /\ (~ n = 0 -> m = div_nat m n * n + mod_nat m n /\ mod_nat m n < n)

items.name: DIVISION_1_SORT
items.statement: forall d c= Power (R :^: idx 1), forall s c= R :^: idx 1, division_of 1 d s /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx 1, k :e d -> ~ interior 1 k = Empty) -> exists n :e omega, exists t :e Power (R :^: idx 1) :^: omega, {t x | x :e idx_n n} = d /\ forall i j :e omega, i :e idx_n n /\ (j :e idx_n n /\ i < j) -> ~ t i = t j /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e t i /\ y :e t j -> drop x <= drop y

items.name: DIVISION_COMMON_POINT_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, division_of N d s -> finite_cardinality {k :e Power (R :^: idx N) | k :e d /\ (~ content N k = 0 /\ x :e k)} <= 2 ^ dimindex N

items.name: DIVISION_CONTAINS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, division_of A s i -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e i -> exists k c= R :^: idx A, x :e k /\ k :e s

items.name: DIVISION_DECOMP
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, divides_nat a (b * c) -> exists b' c' :e omega, a = b' * c' /\ (divides_nat b' b /\ divides_nat c' c)

items.name: DIVISION_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s1 s2 c= R :^: idx N, forall p1 p2 c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p1 s1 /\ (division_of N p2 s2 /\ interior N s1 :/\: interior N s2 = Empty) -> division_of N (p1 :\/: p2) (s1 :\/: s2)

items.name: DIVISION_DOUBLESPLIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, forall c e0 :e R, division_of N p (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> division_of N {l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k + - c) <= e0} | l :e Power (R :^: idx N), l :e p /\ ~ l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k + - c) <= e0} = Empty} (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k + - c) <= e0})

items.name: DIVISION_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s1 s2 c= R :^: idx N, forall p1 p2 c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p1 s1 /\ division_of N p2 s2 -> division_of N (\/_ k1 :e Power (R :^: idx N), {k1 :/\: k2 | k2 :e Power (R :^: idx N), k1 :e p1 /\ (k2 :e p2 /\ ~ k1 :/\: k2 = Empty)}) (s1 :/\: s2)

items.name: DIVISION_INTER_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall i c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, division_of N d i /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= i -> division_of N {closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: k | k :e Power (R :^: idx N), k :e d /\ ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: k = Empty} (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: DIVISION_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, division_of A s i <-> finite s /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx A, k :e s -> ~ k = Empty /\ exists a b :e R :^: idx A, k = closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall k1 k2 c= R :^: idx A, k1 :e s /\ (k2 :e s /\ ~ k1 = k2) -> interior A k1 :/\: interior A k2 = Empty) /\ Union s = i))

items.name: DIVISION_OF_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, division_of N {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x0) c | x0 :e x}} | x :e d} {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> (m = 0 -> (s = Empty -> d = Empty) /\ (~ s = Empty -> ~ d = Empty /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e d -> ~ k = Empty))) /\ (~ m = 0 -> division_of N d s)

items.name: DIVISION_OF_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, division_of A s i -> closed A i

items.name: DIVISION_OF_CONTENT_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx A), content A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 /\ division_of A d (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> forall k c= R :^: idx A, k :e d -> content A k = 0

items.name: DIVISION_OF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, division_of A s i -> finite s

items.name: DIVISION_OF_NONTRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, division_of N s (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ~ content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> division_of N {k :e Power (R :^: idx N) | k :e s /\ ~ content N k = 0} (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: DIVISION_OF_REFLECT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, division_of N {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {vector_neg N x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e d} {vector_neg N x | x :e s} <-> division_of N d s

items.name: DIVISION_OF_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, ~ closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty -> division_of A {closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: DIVISION_OF_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall a :e R :^: idx A, division_of A s (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,a) seq_nil)) <-> s = {closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,a) seq_nil)}

items.name: DIVISION_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p q c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p (Union p) /\ q c= p -> division_of N q (Union q)

items.name: DIVISION_OF_TAGGED_DIVISION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, tagged_division_of A s i -> division_of A {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e x 1} | x :e s} i

items.name: DIVISION_OF_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, division_of N {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {vector_add N a x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e d} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> division_of N d s

items.name: DIVISION_OF_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx A), division_of A s Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: DIVISION_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (Power (R :^: idx A)), finite f /\ ((forall p c= Power (R :^: idx A), p :e f -> division_of A p (Union p)) /\ (forall k1 k2 c= R :^: idx A, k1 :e Union f /\ (k2 :e Union f /\ ~ k1 = k2) -> interior A k1 :/\: interior A k2 = Empty)) -> division_of A (Union f) (Union (Union f))

items.name: DIVISION_OF_UNION_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, division_of A p s -> division_of A p (Union p)

items.name: DIVISION_POINTS_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall i c= R :^: idx N, division_of N d i -> finite (division_points N i d)

items.name: DIVISION_POINTS_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall k :e omega, division_of N d (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < b i) /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (a k < c /\ (c < b k /\ (exists l c= R :^: idx N, l :e d /\ (interval_lowerbound N l k = c \/ interval_upperbound N l k = c))))))) -> division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}) {l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} | l :e Power (R :^: idx N), l :e d /\ ~ l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} = Empty} c= division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) d /\ division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}) {l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} | l :e Power (R :^: idx N), l :e d /\ ~ l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} = Empty} <> division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) d /\ (division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k}) {l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} | l :e Power (R :^: idx N), l :e d /\ ~ l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} = Empty} c= division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) d /\ division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k}) {l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} | l :e Power (R :^: idx N), l :e d /\ ~ l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} = Empty} <> division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) d)

items.name: DIVISION_POINTS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall k :e omega, division_of N d (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < b i) /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (a k < c /\ c < b k)))) -> division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}) {l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} | l :e Power (R :^: idx N), l :e d /\ ~ l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} = Empty} c= division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) d /\ division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k}) {l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} | l :e Power (R :^: idx N), l :e d /\ ~ l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} = Empty} c= division_points N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) d

items.name: DIVISION_SIMP
