items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, div_nat m n * n + mod_nat m n = m) /\ forall m n :e omega, n * div_nat m n + mod_nat m n = m

items.name: DIVISION_SPLIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, forall c :e R, division_of N p s /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> division_of N {l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} | l :e Power (R :^: idx N), l :e p /\ ~ l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} = Empty} (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}) /\ division_of N {l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} | l :e Power (R :^: idx N), l :e p /\ ~ l :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} = Empty} (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k})

items.name: DIVISION_SPLIT_LEFT_INJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall i k1 k2 c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, forall c :e R, division_of N d i /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (k1 :e d /\ (k2 :e d /\ (~ k1 = k2 /\ k1 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} = k2 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}))))) -> content N (k1 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}) = 0

items.name: DIVISION_SPLIT_RIGHT_INJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall i k1 k2 c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, forall c :e R, division_of N d i /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (k1 :e d /\ (k2 :e d /\ (~ k1 = k2 /\ k1 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} = k2 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k}))))) -> content N (k1 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k}) = 0

items.name: DIVISION_UNION_INTERVALS_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty -> exists p c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N (SetAdjoin p (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))

items.name: DIVISORS_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m = n <-> forall d :e omega, divides_nat d m <-> divides_nat d n

items.name: DIVMOD_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m n :e omega, P (div_nat m n) (mod_nat m n) <-> forall q r :e omega, n = 0 /\ (q = 0 /\ r = m) \/ m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> P q r

items.name: DIVMOD_ELIM_THM'
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m n :e omega, P (div_nat m n) (mod_nat m n) <-> exists q r :e omega, (n = 0 /\ (q = 0 /\ r = m) \/ m = q * n + r /\ r < n) /\ P q r

items.name: DIVMOD_EXIST
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> exists q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n

items.name: DIVMOD_EXIST_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, exists q r :e omega, (n = 0 -> q = 0 /\ r = m) /\ (~ n = 0 -> m = q * n + r /\ r < n)

items.name: DIVMOD_UNIQ
items.statement: forall m n q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> div_nat m n = q /\ mod_nat m n = r

items.name: DIVMOD_UNIQ_LEMMA
items.statement: forall m n q1 r1 q2 r2 :e omega, m = q1 * n + r1 /\ r1 < n /\ (m = q2 * n + r2 /\ r2 < n) -> q1 = q2 /\ r1 = r2

items.name: DIV_0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, div_nat 0 n = 0

items.name: DIV_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, div_nat n 1 = n

items.name: DIV_ADD
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d a \/ divides_nat d b -> div_nat (a + b) d = div_nat a d + div_nat b d

items.name: DIV_ADD_EQ
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n -> div_nat (x + y) n = div_nat x n + div_nat y n

items.name: DIV_ADD_EQ_EQ
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, div_nat (x + y) n = div_nat x n + div_nat y n <-> n = 0 \/ mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n

items.name: DIV_ADD_MOD
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> (mod_nat (a + b) n = mod_nat a n + mod_nat b n <-> div_nat (a + b) n = div_nat a n + div_nat b n)

items.name: DIV_BY_DIV
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ divides_nat m n -> div_nat n (div_nat n m) = m

items.name: DIV_DIV
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, div_nat (div_nat m n) p = div_nat m (n * p)

items.name: DIV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> (div_nat m n = 0 <-> m < n)

items.name: DIV_EQ_EXCLUSION
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, b * c < (a + 1) * d /\ a * d < (c + 1) * b -> div_nat a b = div_nat c d

items.name: DIV_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, div_nat m n = m <-> m = 0 \/ n = 1

items.name: DIV_EXP
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> div_nat (m ^ n) (m ^ p) = if p <= n then m ^ minus_nat n p else if m = 1 then 1 else 0

items.name: DIV_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, div_nat m n <= m

items.name: DIV_LE_EXCLUSION
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, ~ b = 0 /\ b * c < (a + 1) * d -> div_nat c d <= div_nat a b

items.name: DIV_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n -> div_nat m n = 0

items.name: DIV_MOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (div_nat m n) p = div_nat (mod_nat m (n * p)) n

items.name: DIV_MONO
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m <= n -> div_nat m p <= div_nat n p

items.name: DIV_MONO2
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ p = 0 /\ p <= m -> div_nat n m <= div_nat n p

items.name: DIV_MONO_LT
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ p = 0 /\ m + p <= n -> div_nat m p < div_nat n p

items.name: DIV_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> div_nat (m * n) m = n

items.name: DIV_MULT2
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> div_nat (m * n) (m * p) = div_nat n p

items.name: DIV_MULT_ADD
items.statement: (forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (a * n + b) n = a + div_nat b n) /\ ((forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (n * a + b) n = a + div_nat b n) /\ ((forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (b + a * n) n = div_nat b n + a) /\ forall a b n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (b + n * a) n = div_nat b n + a))

items.name: DIV_MUL_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, n * div_nat m n <= m

items.name: DIV_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat n n = 1

items.name: DIV_UNIQ
items.statement: forall m n q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> div_nat m n = q

items.name: DIV_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, div_nat n 0 = 0

items.name: DOMINATED_CONVERGENCE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on N M (f k) s) /\ (integrable_on 1 M h s /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f k x) <= drop (h x)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially))) -> integrable_on N M g s /\ tendsto N omega (fun k:set => integral N M s (f k)) (integral N M s g) sequentially

items.name: DOMINATED_CONVERGENCE_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall k :e omega, absolutely_integrable_on N M (f k) s) /\ (integrable_on 1 M h s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (g x) <= drop (h x)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially))) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M g s

items.name: DOMINATED_CONVERGENCE_AE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on N M (f k) s) /\ (integrable_on 1 M h s /\ (negligible M t /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> vector_norm N (f k x) <= drop (h x)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> tendsto N omega (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially)))) -> integrable_on N M g s /\ tendsto N omega (fun k:set => integral N M s (f k)) (integral N M s g) sequentially

items.name: DOMINATED_CONVERGENCE_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall k :e omega, absolutely_integrable_on N M (f k) s) /\ (integrable_on 1 M h s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (g x) <= drop (h x)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially))) -> integrable_on N M g s

items.name: DOT_1
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, dot 1 x y = x 1 * y 1

items.name: DOT_2
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx_n 2, dot (idx_n 2) x y = x 1 * y 1 + x 2 * y 2

items.name: DOT_3
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx_n 3, dot (idx_n 3) x y = x 1 * y 1 + x 2 * y 2 + x 3 * y 3

items.name: DOT_4
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx_n 4, dot (idx_n 4) x y = x 1 * y 1 + x 2 * y 2 + x 3 * y 3 + x 4 * y 4

items.name: DOT_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> dot N (basis N i) x = x i /\ dot N x (basis N i) = x i

items.name: DOT_BASIS_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> dot N (basis N i) (basis N j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

items.name: DOT_BASIS_BASIS_UNEQUAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, ~ i = j -> dot A (basis A i) (basis A j) = 0

items.name: DOT_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_EQUAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y ^ 2 = dot N x x * dot N y y <-> collinear N {vec N 0,x,y}

items.name: DOT_DROPOUT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> dot M (dropout N M k x) (dropout N M k y) = dot N x y + - x k * y k

items.name: DOT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, dot N x x = 0 <-> x = vec N 0

items.name: DOT_LADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vector_add A x y) z = dot A x z + dot A y z

items.name: DOT_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vector_mul A c x) y = c * dot A x y

items.name: DOT_LMUL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, dot N (vector_matrix_mul M N x A) y = dot M x (matrix_vector_mul M N A y)

items.name: DOT_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vector_neg A x) y = - dot A x y

items.name: DOT_LSUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vector_sub A x y) z = dot A x z + - dot A y z

items.name: DOT_LSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y :e R :^: idx A, finite s -> dot A (vsum B A s f) y = finsum s (fun x:set => dot A (f x) y)

items.name: DOT_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dot A (vec A 0) x = 0

items.name: DOT_MATRIX_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y = matrix_mul 1 N 1 (rowvector N x) (columnvector N y) 1 1

items.name: DOT_MATRIX_TRANSP_LMUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx N :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, dot N (matrix_vector_mul N A (transp A N A0) x) y = dot A x (matrix_vector_mul A N A0 y)

items.name: DOT_MATRIX_TRANSP_RMUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, dot A x (matrix_vector_mul A N (transp N A A0) y) = dot N (matrix_vector_mul N A A0 x) y

items.name: DOT_MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N (matrix_vector_mul N N A x) (matrix_vector_mul N N B y) = matrix_mul 1 N 1 (rowvector N x) (matrix_mul N N 1 (matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) B) (columnvector N y)) 1 1

items.name: DOT_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x y = ((vector_norm A (vector_add A x y) ^ 2 + - vector_norm A x ^ 2) + - vector_norm A y ^ 2) :/: 2

items.name: DOT_NORM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x y = ((vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm A y ^ 2) + - vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y) ^ 2) :/: 2

items.name: DOT_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall x2 :e R :^: idx B, forall y1 :e R :^: idx A, forall y2 :e R :^: idx B, dot (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x1 x2) (pastecart A B y1 y2) = dot A x1 y1 + dot B x2 y2

items.name: DOT_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 <= dot A x x

items.name: DOT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 < dot A x x <-> ~ x = vec A 0

items.name: DOT_PUSHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a b :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> dot N (pushin N R M k a x) (pushin N R M k b y) = dot M x y + a * b

items.name: DOT_RADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vector_add A y z) = dot A x y + dot A x z

items.name: DOT_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vector_mul A c y) = c * dot A x y

items.name: DOT_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vector_neg A y) = - dot A x y

items.name: DOT_ROWVECTOR_COLUMNVECTOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall v :e R :^: idx N, columnvector M (matrix_vector_mul M N A v) = matrix_mul M N 1 A (columnvector N v)

items.name: DOT_RSUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vector_sub A y z) = dot A x y + - dot A x z

items.name: DOT_RSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, finite s -> dot A x (vsum B A s f) = finsum s (fun y:set => dot A x (f y))

items.name: DOT_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dot A x (vec A 0) = 0

items.name: DOT_SQUARE_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, dot A x x = vector_norm A x ^ 2

items.name: DOT_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, dot A x y = dot A y x

items.name: DOT_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, dot (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N A) (vectorize R M N B) = trace N (matrix_mul N M N (transp M N A) B)

items.name: DOUBLE_HALF
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, even_nat n -> 2 * div_nat n 2 = n) /\ forall n :e omega, even_nat n -> div_nat n 2 * 2 = n

items.name: DOUBLE_INTEGRABLE_CONVOLUTION
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear P Q N bop /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) /\ absolutely_integrable_on P M g (R :^: idx M)) -> integrable_on Q M (fun x:set => integral Q M (R :^: idx M) (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y))) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: DOUBLE_INTEGRAL_CONVOLUTION
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear P Q N bop /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) /\ absolutely_integrable_on P M g (R :^: idx M)) -> integral Q M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => integral Q M (R :^: idx M) (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y))) = bop (integral N M (R :^: idx M) f) (integral P M (R :^: idx M) g)

items.name: DOUBLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e t}) <-> measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e t})

items.name: DOUBLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_INVERSE_FUNCTION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x)) -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M t -> lebesgue_measurable N {y :e R :^: idx N | y :e {f x | x :e s} /\ g y :e t}

items.name: DOUBLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_INVERSE_FUNCTION_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M t -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e s :/\: t}

items.name: DOUBLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M t -> lebesgue_measurable N {y :e R :^: idx N | y :e {f x | x :e s} /\ g y :e t})

items.name: DOUBLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (lebesgue_measurable N t /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t) -> ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N u /\ u c= t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u}) <-> measurable_on M N f s /\ forall u c= R :^: idx N, negligible N u /\ u c= t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u})

items.name: DOUBLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e {f x | x :e s} -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ forall t c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M t -> lebesgue_measurable N {y :e R :^: idx N | y :e {f x | x :e s} /\ g y :e t})

items.name: DROPOUT_0
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, dropout N A k (vec N 0) = vec A 0

items.name: DROPOUT_ADD
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dropout N A k (vector_add N x y) = vector_add A (dropout N A k x) (dropout N A k y)

items.name: DROPOUT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (x k = y k /\ dropout N M k x = dropout N M k y))) -> x = y

items.name: DROPOUT_GALOIS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx M, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> (y = dropout N M k x <-> exists t :e R, x = pushin N R M k t y)

items.name: DROPOUT_MUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, dropout N A k (vector_mul N c x) = vector_mul A c (dropout N A k x)

items.name: DROPOUT_PUSHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall t :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N -> dropout N M k (pushin N R M k t x) = x

items.name: DROPOUT_SUB
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dropout N A k (vector_sub N x y) = vector_sub A (dropout N A k x) (dropout N A k y)

items.name: DROP_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop (vector_add 1 x y) = drop x + drop y

items.name: DROP_BASIS
items.statement: forall i :e omega, drop (basis 1 i) = if i = 1 then 1 else 0

items.name: DROP_CMUL
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall c :e R, drop (vector_mul 1 c x) = c * drop x

items.name: DROP_DIFFERENTIAL_NEG_AT_MAXIMUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, x :e s /\ (convex N s /\ (has_derivative 1 N f f' (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s) /\ (0 < e0 /\ (forall w :e R :^: idx N, w :e s :/\: ball N (x,e0) -> drop (f w) <= drop (f x))))) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> drop (f' (vector_sub N y x)) <= 0

items.name: DROP_DIFFERENTIAL_POS_AT_MINIMUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, x :e s /\ (convex N s /\ (has_derivative 1 N f f' (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s) /\ (0 < e0 /\ (forall w :e R :^: idx N, w :e s :/\: ball N (x,e0) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f w))))) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> 0 <= drop (f' (vector_sub N y x))

items.name: DROP_EQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop x = drop y <-> x = y

items.name: DROP_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, drop x = 0 <-> x = vec 1 0

items.name: DROP_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, drop (indicator A s x) = if x :e s then 1 else 0

items.name: DROP_INDICATOR_ABS_LE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (drop (indicator A s x)) <= 1

items.name: DROP_INDICATOR_LE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, drop (indicator A s x) <= 1

items.name: DROP_INDICATOR_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 <= drop (indicator A s x)

items.name: DROP_IN_IMAGE_DROP
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, drop x :e {drop x0 | x0 :e s} <-> x :e s

items.name: DROP_IN_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, drop x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (lift a,lift b) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, drop x :e open_real_interval (a,b) <-> x :e open_interval 1 (lift a,lift b)

items.name: DROP_LAMBDA
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R) -> drop (fun i :e idx 1 => x i) = x 1

items.name: DROP_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop (midpoint 1 (x,y)) = (drop x + drop y) :/: 2

items.name: DROP_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, drop (vector_neg 1 x) = - drop x

items.name: DROP_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop (vector_sub 1 x y) = drop x + - drop y

items.name: DROP_VEC
items.statement: forall n :e omega, drop (vec 1 n) = n

items.name: DROP_VSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R :^: idx 1) -> drop (vsum A 1 k x) = finsum k (fun x0:set => drop (x x0))

items.name: DROP_WLOG_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, P x y <-> P y x) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop x <= drop y -> P x y) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, P x y

items.name: DSUM_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ vector_norm N c <= e0 -> vector_norm N (vsum (Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun l:set => vector_mul N (content M l) c)) <= e0 * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: DUGUNDJI
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, forall u s c= R :^: idx M, convex N c /\ (~ c = Empty /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= c))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ ({g x | x :e u} c= c /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x))

items.name: EDELSTEIN_FIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> distance N (f x,f y) < distance N (x,y)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ f y = y -> y = x

items.name: EDELSTEIN_FIX_ITER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> distance N (iter_fun n f x,iter_fun n f y) < distance N (x,y)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ f y = y -> y = x

items.name: EDGE_OF_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, edge_of A s t -> s c= t

items.name: EDGE_OF_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (edge_of N {f x | x :e c} {f x | x :e s} <-> edge_of M c s)

items.name: EDGE_OF_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall f s c= R :^: idx N, edge_of N {vector_add N a x | x :e f} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> edge_of N f s

items.name: EFFECTIVELY_COUNTABLE_CLOPEN_CHAIN_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed N s \/ open N s) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable f' /\ (f' c= f /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y})

items.name: EFFECTIVELY_COUNTABLE_CLOPEN_CHAIN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed N s \/ open N s) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable f' /\ (f' c= f /\ Union f' = Union f)

items.name: EFFECTIVELY_COUNTABLE_CLOPEN_IN_CHAIN_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall v c= R :^: idx N, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) v) s \/ s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) v) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable f' /\ (f' c= f /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y})

items.name: EFFECTIVELY_COUNTABLE_CLOPEN_IN_CHAIN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall v c= R :^: idx N, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) v) s \/ s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) v) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable f' /\ (f' c= f /\ Union f' = Union f)

items.name: EGOROV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, measurable M s /\ (negligible M t /\ ((forall n :e omega, measurable_on M N (f n) s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially))) -> forall d :e R, 0 < d -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, k c= s /\ (measurable M k /\ (measure M k < d /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx M, N0 <= n /\ x :e s :\: k -> distance N (f n x,g x) < e0))

items.name: EIGENVALUES_CHARACTERISTIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall c :e R, (exists v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v) <-> det N (matrix_sub N N (matrix_cmul N N c (mat N N 1)) A) = 0

items.name: EIGENVALUES_CHARACTERISTIC_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall c :e R, (exists v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v) <-> det N (matrix_sub N N A (matrix_cmul N N c (mat N N 1))) = 0

items.name: EIGENVALUE_LOWERBOUND_DOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall a :e R, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ (forall c :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v /\ ~ v = vec N 0 -> a <= c) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, a * vector_norm N x ^ 2 <= dot N x (matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: EIGENVALUE_LOWERBOUND_DOT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall a :e R, symmetric_matrix_hl N A -> ((forall c :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v /\ ~ v = vec N 0 -> a <= c) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, a * vector_norm N x ^ 2 <= dot N x (matrix_vector_mul N N A x))

items.name: EL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, seq_nth l 0 = seq_hd l /\ seq_nth l (ordsucc n) = seq_nth (seq_tl l) n

items.name: ELEMENTARY_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, (exists p c= Power (R :^: idx A), division_of A p s) -> bounded_hl A s

items.name: ELEMENTARY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, (exists d c= Power (R :^: idx A), division_of A d s) -> compact A s

items.name: ELEMENTARY_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> exists p c= Power (R :^: idx A), division_of A p Empty

items.name: ELEMENTARY_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, (exists p c= Power (R :^: idx A), division_of A p s) /\ (exists p c= Power (R :^: idx A), division_of A p t) -> exists p c= Power (R :^: idx A), division_of A p (s :/\: t)

items.name: ELEMENTARY_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> exists p c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p s)) -> exists p c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: ELEMENTARY_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, exists p c= Power (R :^: idx A), division_of A p (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: ELEMENTARY_SUBSET_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, (exists p c= Power (R :^: idx A), division_of A p s) -> exists a b :e R :^: idx A, s c= closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: ELEMENTARY_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (exists p c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p s) /\ (exists p c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p t) -> exists p c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p (s :\/: t)

items.name: ELEMENTARY_UNIONS_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, s = closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists p c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p (Union f)

items.name: ELEMENTARY_UNION_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, division_of N p (Union p) -> exists q c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N q (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: Union p)

items.name: ELEMENTARY_UNION_INTERVAL_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, division_of N p (Union p) -> exists q c= Power (R :^: idx N), p c= q /\ division_of N q (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: Union p)

items.name: ELEMENT_LE_SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ a :e s -> a <= sup s

items.name: EL_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall l m :e finseq A, seq_nth (seq_append l m) k = if k < seq_len l then seq_nth l k else seq_nth m (minus_nat k (seq_len l))

items.name: EL_CONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e omega, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_nth (seq_cons h t) n = if n = 0 then h else seq_nth t (minus_nat n 1)

items.name: EL_LIST_OF_SEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> forall m n :e omega, m < n -> seq_nth (seq_mk n s) m = s m

items.name: EL_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall n :e omega, forall l :e finseq A, n < seq_len l -> seq_nth (seq_map f l) n = f (seq_nth l n)

items.name: EL_MAP2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall l :e finseq A, forall m :e finseq B, forall k :e omega, k < seq_len l /\ k < seq_len m -> seq_nth (seq_map2 f l m) k = f (seq_nth l k) (seq_nth m k)

items.name: EL_TL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, seq_nth (seq_tl l) n = seq_nth l (n + 1)

items.name: EMBEDDING_EQ_SECTION_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (embedding_map A B (top,top') f <-> section_map A B (top,subtopology B top' {f x | x :e topspace A top}) f)

items.name: EMBEDDING_IMP_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f /\ closed_in B top' {f x | x :e topspace A top} -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: EMBEDDING_IMP_CLOSED_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f -> (closed_map A B (top,top') f <-> closed_in B top' {f x | x :e topspace A top})

items.name: EMBEDDING_IMP_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: EMBEDDING_IMP_INJECTIVE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f -> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)

items.name: EMBEDDING_IMP_MONOTONE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f -> monotone_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: EMBEDDING_IMP_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} :e top' -> open_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: EMBEDDING_IMP_OPEN_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f -> (open_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} :e top')

items.name: EMBEDDING_INTO_METRIZABLE_IMP_METRIZABLE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f /\ metrizable_space B top' -> metrizable_space A top

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_COMPONENT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> embedding_map A (K :*: A) (top i,sum_topology A K k top) (fun x:set => (i,x))

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f /\ embedding_map B C (top',top'') g -> embedding_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) /\ embedding_map A B (top,top') f -> embedding_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_GRAPH
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (embedding_map A (A :*: B) (top,prod_topology A B top top') (fun x:set => (x,f x)) <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') f)

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_IMP_HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f -> homeomorphic_space A B top (subtopology B top' {f x | x :e topspace A top})

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_INL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, embedding_map A (A :+: 1) (top,alexandroff_compactification A top) (fun x:set => Inj0 x)

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_INTO_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> path_connected_space A top -> (embedding_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f <-> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f /\ forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (embedding_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f <-> embedding_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= s)

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_ON_DENSE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ (closure_of A top s = topspace A top /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ embedding_map A B (subtopology A top s,top') f))) -> {f x | x :e s} :/\: {f x | x :e topspace A top :\: s} = Empty

items.name: EMBEDDING_MAP_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> topspace A top = Empty -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x :e Empty <-> False

items.name: EMPTY_AS_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> Empty = closed_interval A (seq_cons (vec A 1,vec A 0) seq_nil)

items.name: EMPTY_AS_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: Empty = closed_real_interval (seq_cons (1,0) seq_nil)

items.name: EMPTY_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, Empty :\: {x} = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, Empty :\: s = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_DIVISION_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, division_of A Empty s <-> s = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_EXPOSED_FACE_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, exposed_face_of N Empty s

items.name: EMPTY_FACE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, face_of A Empty s

items.name: EMPTY_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A:set, {x :e A | False} = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INSIDE_PSUBSET_CONVEX_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (t c= frontier N s /\ t <> frontier N s) -> inside N t = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INTERIOR_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N -> interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INTERIOR_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim N s < dimindex N -> interior N s = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N -> interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INTERIOR_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> interior N s = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INTERIOR_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s < dimindex N -> interior N s = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INTERIOR_LOWDIM_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M < dimindex N /\ homeomorphic M N s t -> interior N s = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INTERIOR_LOWDIM_GEN_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (interior M t = Empty /\ homeomorphic M N s t) -> interior N s = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INTERIOR_OF_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, affine N u /\ aff_dim N s < aff_dim N u -> interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_INTERIOR_SUBSET_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ interior N s = Empty -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ s c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: EMPTY_NOT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ~ Empty = A

items.name: EMPTY_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, n < m -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, Empty c= s

items.name: EMPTY_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t = Empty <-> s = Empty /\ t = Empty

items.name: EMPTY_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union s = Empty <-> forall t c= A, t :e s -> t = Empty

items.name: ENDPOINTS_NOT_IN_INTERIOR_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N g -> {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g} :/\: interior N (path_image N g) = Empty

items.name: ENDPOINTS_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A g = pathstart A g /\ a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> pathfinish A (fun x:set => shiftpath A a g x) = g a /\ pathstart A (fun x:set => shiftpath A a g x) = g a

items.name: ENDS_IN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, a :e closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> ~ closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx B, b :e closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> ~ closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx C, ~ a :e open_interval C (a,b)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx D, ~ b :e open_interval D (a,b)))

items.name: ENDS_IN_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, a :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> ~ closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b :e R, b :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> ~ closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b :e R, ~ a :e open_real_interval (a,b)) /\ forall a b :e R, ~ b :e open_real_interval (a,b)))

items.name: ENDS_IN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, a :e closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ b :e closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: ENDS_IN_UNIT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> vec A 0 :e closed_interval A (seq_cons (vec A 0,vec A 1) seq_nil) /\ (vec B 1 :e closed_interval B (seq_cons (vec B 0,vec B 1) seq_nil) /\ (~ vec C 0 :e open_interval C (vec C 0,vec C 1) /\ ~ vec D 1 :e open_interval D (vec D 0,vec D 1)))

items.name: ENDS_IN_UNIT_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: 0 :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil) /\ 1 :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)

items.name: ENDS_NOT_IN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, ~ a :e open_segment A (a,b) /\ ~ b :e open_segment A (a,b)

items.name: ENR_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s <-> ANR N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s

items.name: ENR_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, ENR N (ball N (a,r))

items.name: ENR_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> (ENR N s <-> exists u c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ (bounded_hl N u /\ retract_of N s u))

items.name: ENR_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, ENR N (cball N (a,r))

items.name: ENR_CLOSED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ (ENR N s /\ (ENR N t /\ ENR N (s :/\: t)))) -> ENR N (s :\/: t)

items.name: ENR_CLOSED_UNION_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ (ENR N s /\ (ENR N t /\ ENR N (s :/\: t)))) -> ENR N (s :\/: t)

items.name: ENR_CLOSURE_FROM_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N (frontier N s) -> ENR N (closure N s)

items.name: ENR_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s <-> countable (components N s) /\ forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s -> c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ ENR N c

items.name: ENR_COMPONENT_ENR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s /\ c :e components N s -> ENR N c

items.name: ENR_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_ENR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> ENR N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0}

items.name: ENR_CONVEX_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ convex N s -> ENR N s

items.name: ENR_COVERING_SPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= R :^: idx M, covering_space M N (c,p) s /\ ENR M c -> ENR N s

items.name: ENR_COVERING_SPACE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= R :^: idx M, covering_space M N (c,p) s -> (ENR N s <-> ENR M c)

items.name: ENR_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> ENR N (s :\: {a})

items.name: ENR_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ENR A Empty

items.name: ENR_FINITE_UNIONS_CONVEX_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite t /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e t -> closed N c /\ convex N c) -> ENR N (Union t)

items.name: ENR_FROM_UNION_AND_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ (ENR N (s :\/: t) /\ ENR N (s :/\: t))) -> ENR N s

items.name: ENR_FROM_UNION_AND_INTER_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) t /\ (ENR N (s :\/: t) /\ ENR N (s :/\: t))) -> ENR N s

items.name: ENR_IMP_ABSOLUTE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_RETRACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall s' u c= R :^: idx N, ENR M s /\ (homeomorphic N M s s' /\ s' c= u) -> exists t' c= R :^: idx N, t' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ retract_of N s' t'

items.name: ENR_IMP_ABSOLUTE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_RETRACT_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall s' c= R :^: idx N, ENR M s /\ homeomorphic N M s s' -> exists t' c= R :^: idx N, open N t' /\ retract_of N s' t'

items.name: ENR_IMP_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> ANR N s

items.name: ENR_IMP_FSGIMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> fsigma N s

items.name: ENR_IMP_GDELTA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> gdelta N s

items.name: ENR_IMP_LOCALLY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s

items.name: ENR_IMP_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: ENR_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: ENR_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ENR N s -> ENR N (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: ENR_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ENR A (interior A s)

items.name: ENR_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ENR N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ENR N (open_interval N (a,b))

items.name: ENR_INTER_CLOSED_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, closed N t /\ (open N u /\ s = t :/\: u)

items.name: ENR_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (ENR N {f x | x :e s} <-> ENR M s)

items.name: ENR_LOCALLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | ENR N x} s <-> ENR N s

items.name: ENR_NEIGHBORHOOD_RETRACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N s t /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ ENR N u) -> ENR N s

items.name: ENR_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ ENR N t -> ENR N s

items.name: ENR_OPEN_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (ENR N s /\ ENR N t)) -> ENR N (s :\/: t)

items.name: ENR_OPEN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall u c= R :^: idx N, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> ENR N s) /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) -> ENR N (Union f)

items.name: ENR_PATH_COMPONENT_ENR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, ENR N s -> ENR N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0}

items.name: ENR_PATH_IMAGE_SIMPLE_PATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N g -> ENR N (path_image N g)

items.name: ENR_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, ENR M s /\ ENR N t -> ENR (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: ENR_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, ENR (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ ENR M s /\ ENR N t)

items.name: ENR_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ convex N s -> ENR N (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: ENR_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ENR A s -> ENR A (relative_interior A s)

items.name: ENR_RETRACT_OF_ENR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ENR N t /\ retract_of N s t -> ENR N s

items.name: ENR_SIMPLICIAL_COMPLEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c c= Power (R :^: idx A), simplicial_complex A c -> ENR A (Union c)

items.name: ENR_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, ENR N {a}

items.name: ENR_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, ENR N (sphere N (a,r))

items.name: ENR_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> ENR N s

items.name: ENR_TRIANGULATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall tr c= Power (R :^: idx A), triangulation A tr -> ENR A (Union tr)

items.name: ENR_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> ENR N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: ENR_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ENR A s <-> exists u c= R :^: idx A, open A u /\ retract_of A s u

items.name: EPSILON_ABSORBING_IMP_CLOPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c c= A, forall e0 :e R, s c= mspace A m /\ (c c= s /\ (0 < e0 /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e c /\ (y :e s /\ mdist A m (x,y) < e0) -> y :e c))) -> c :e subtopology A (mtopology A m) s /\ closed_in A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) c

items.name: EPSILON_DELTA_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, finite {x :e A | Q x} /\ ((forall d e0 :e R, forall x :e A, Q x /\ (0 < e0 /\ e0 < d) -> P d x -> P e0 x) /\ (forall x :e A, Q x -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ P d x)) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e A, Q x -> P d x

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs gs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs s /\ equiintegrable_on M N gs s -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) | g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), f :e fs /\ g :e gs}) s

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_CLOSED_INTERVAL_RESTRICTIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ c :e R :^: idx M, {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => if x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) then f x else vec N 0) | d :e R :^: idx M, c :e R :^: idx M /\ d :e R :^: idx M}) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e R, equiintegrable_on M N fs s -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ c :e R, {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => vector_mul N c (f x)) | f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), abs_SNo c <= k /\ f :e fs}) s

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> (equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> forall i c= R :^: idx M, i :e d -> equiintegrable_on M N fs i)

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs gs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs s /\ (forall g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), g :e gs -> exists f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), f :e fs /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> equiintegrable_on M N gs s

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_HALFSPACE_RESTRICTIONS_GE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (f :e fs /\ (forall h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall x :e R :^: idx M, h :e fs /\ x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (h x) <= vector_norm N (f x))) -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ i :e omega, \/_ c :e R, {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => if c <= x i then h x else vec N 0) | h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), i :e idx M /\ (c :e R /\ h :e fs)}) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_HALFSPACE_RESTRICTIONS_GT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (f :e fs /\ (forall h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall x :e R :^: idx M, h :e fs /\ x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (h x) <= vector_norm N (f x))) -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ i :e omega, \/_ c :e R, {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => if c < x i then h x else vec N 0) | h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), i :e idx M /\ (c :e R /\ h :e fs)}) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_HALFSPACE_RESTRICTIONS_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (f :e fs /\ (forall h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall x :e R :^: idx M, h :e fs /\ x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (h x) <= vector_norm N (f x))) -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ i :e omega, \/_ c :e R, {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => if x i <= c then h x else vec N 0) | h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), i :e idx M /\ (c :e R /\ h :e fs)}) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_HALFSPACE_RESTRICTIONS_LT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (f :e fs /\ (forall h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall x :e R :^: idx M, h :e fs /\ x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (h x) <= vector_norm N (f x))) -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ i :e omega, \/_ c :e R, {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => if x i < c then h x else vec N 0) | h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), i :e idx M /\ (c :e R /\ h :e fs)}) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_LIMIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N {f n | n :e omega, n :e omega} (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially) -> integrable_on N M g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ tendsto N omega (fun n:set => integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => f n x)) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) g) sequentially

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs s -> equiintegrable_on M N {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => vector_neg N (f x)) | f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), f :e fs} s

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_ON_NULL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_ON_SING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N {f} (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => f x) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_ON_SPLIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall k :e omega, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx M | x k <= c}) /\ (equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx M | c <= x k}) /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex M)) -> equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_OPEN_INTERVAL_RESTRICTIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ c :e R :^: idx M, {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => if x :e open_interval M (c,d) then f x else vec N 0) | d :e R :^: idx M, c :e R :^: idx M /\ d :e R :^: idx M}) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_REFLECT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> equiintegrable_on M N {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => f (vector_neg M x)) | f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), f :e fs} (closed_interval M (seq_cons (vector_neg M b,vector_neg M a) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs gs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs s /\ equiintegrable_on M N gs s -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) | g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), f :e fs /\ g :e gs}) s

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall fs gs c= R :^: idx A :^: (R :^: idx B), forall s c= R :^: idx B, equiintegrable_on B A fs s /\ gs c= fs -> equiintegrable_on B A gs s

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_SUM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> equiintegrable_on M N (\/_ t :e Power A, \/_ c :e R :^: A, {(fun x :e R :^: idx M => vsum A N t (fun i:set => vector_mul N (c i) (f i x))) | f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) :^: A, finite t /\ ((forall i :e A, i :e t -> 0 <= c i /\ f i :e fs) /\ finsum t (fun x:set => c x) = 1)}) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_UNIFORM_LIMIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> equiintegrable_on M N {g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), f :e fs /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g x) (f x)) < e0} (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_UNION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs gs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs s /\ equiintegrable_on M N gs s -> equiintegrable_on M N (fs :\/: gs) s

items.name: EQ_ADD_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m + n = m + p <-> n = p

items.name: EQ_ADD_LCANCEL_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m + n = m <-> n = 0

items.name: EQ_ADD_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m + p = n + p <-> m = n

items.name: EQ_ADD_RCANCEL_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m + n = n <-> m = 0

items.name: EQ_BALLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a a' :e R :^: idx N, forall r r' :e R, ball N (a,r) = ball N (a',r') <-> a = a' /\ r = r' \/ r <= 0 /\ r' <= 0) /\ ((forall a a' :e R :^: idx N, forall r r' :e R, ball N (a,r) = cball N (a',r') <-> r <= 0 /\ r' < 0) /\ ((forall a a' :e R :^: idx N, forall r r' :e R, cball N (a,r) = ball N (a',r') <-> r < 0 /\ r' <= 0) /\ forall a a' :e R :^: idx N, forall r r' :e R, cball N (a,r) = cball N (a',r') <-> a = a' /\ r = r' \/ r < 0 /\ r' < 0))

items.name: EQ_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t <-> exists R0:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, R0 (x,y) -> x :e s /\ y :e t) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 (x,y) /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 (x,y0) -> y0 = y) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ R0 (x,y) /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ R0 (y0,y) -> y0 = x)

items.name: EQ_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall t:prop, ((True <-> t) <-> t) /\ (((t <-> True) <-> t) /\ (((False <-> t) <-> ~ t) /\ ((t <-> False) <-> ~ t)))

items.name: EQ_C_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t <-> exists R0:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 (x,y) /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 (x,y0) -> y0 = y) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ R0 (x,y) /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ R0 (y0,y) -> y0 = x

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, equip s t <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s :/\: s' = Empty /\ t :/\: t' = Empty -> (equip s t /\ equip s' t' <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s' -> f x :e t' /\ g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t' -> g y :e s' /\ f (g y) = y))))

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_EXTEND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s c= s' /\ (t c= t' /\ (equip (s' :\: s) (t' :\: t) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y)))) -> exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e A, f' x :e B) /\ exists g':set -> set, (forall x :e B, g' x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s' -> f' x :e t' /\ g' (f' x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t' -> g' y :e s' /\ f' (g' y) = y) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f' x = f x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g' y = g y)))

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s' c= s /\ t' c= t -> (equip s' t' /\ equip (s :\: s') (t :\: t') <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ ({f x | x :e s'} = t' /\ {g x | x :e t'} = s'))))

items.name: EQ_C_BIJECTIONS_SUBSETS_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, s' c= s /\ (t' c= t /\ (infinite s -> atleastp s' s /\ ~ equip s' s)) -> (equip s t /\ equip s' t' <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ ({f x | x :e s'} = t' /\ {g x | x :e t'} = s'))))

items.name: EQ_C_INVOLUTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall s t c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x :e s) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s \/ x :e t -> f (f x) = x)) -> equip s t

items.name: EQ_DIVMOD
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, div_nat m p = div_nat n p /\ mod_nat m p = mod_nat n p <-> m = n

items.name: EQ_EXP
items.statement: forall x m n :e omega, x ^ m = x ^ n <-> (x = 0 -> (m = 0 <-> n = 0)) /\ (~ x = 0 -> x = 1 \/ m = n)

items.name: EQ_EXT
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, f x = g x) -> forall x :e A, f x = g x

items.name: EQ_IMP
items.statement: forall a b:prop, (a <-> b) -> a -> b

items.name: EQ_IMP_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m = n -> m <= n

items.name: EQ_INDEX
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m = n <-> (m = 0 <-> n = 0) /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p m = prime_index p n

items.name: EQ_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) <-> closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty \/ a = c /\ b = d) /\ ((forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = open_interval N (c,d) <-> closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ open_interval N (c,d) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, open_interval N (a,b) = closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) <-> open_interval N (a,b) = Empty /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, open_interval N (a,b) = open_interval N (c,d) <-> open_interval N (a,b) = Empty /\ open_interval N (c,d) = Empty \/ a = c /\ b = d))

items.name: EQ_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall a b c d :e R :^: idx 1, closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) <-> drop b < drop a /\ drop d < drop c \/ drop a = drop c /\ drop b = drop d

items.name: EQ_MULT_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * n = m * p <-> m = 0 \/ n = p

items.name: EQ_MULT_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * p = n * p <-> m = n \/ p = 0

items.name: EQ_PRIMEPOW
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, prime_nat p -> (p ^ m = p ^ n <-> m = n)

items.name: EQ_PRIME_EXP
items.statement: forall p q m n :e omega, prime_nat p /\ prime_nat q -> (p ^ m = q ^ n <-> m = 0 /\ n = 0 \/ p = q /\ m = n)

items.name: EQ_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x = x

items.name: EQ_SPAN_INSERT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub N x y :e span N s -> span N (SetAdjoin s x) = span N (SetAdjoin s y)

items.name: EQ_SUMS_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx A, ~ s = Empty /\ (bounded_hl A s /\ (closed A t /\ (convex A t /\ (closed A u /\ (convex A u /\ (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {vector_add A x y | y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {vector_add A x z | z :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ z :e u})))))) -> t = u

items.name: EQ_SUMS_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ (convex A s /\ (closed A t /\ (convex A t /\ (bounded_hl A u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {vector_add A x z | z :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ z :e u}) = (\/_ y :e R :^: idx A, {vector_add A y z | z :e R :^: idx A, y :e t /\ z :e u})))))) -> s = t

items.name: EQ_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, x = y -> y = x

items.name: EQ_SYM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, x = y <-> y = x

items.name: EQ_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y z :e A, x = y /\ y = z -> x = z

items.name: EQ_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s) <-> s = A

items.name: ETA_AX
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e A, t x :e B) -> forall x :e A, t x = t x

items.name: ETA_ONE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e 1, f x :e A) -> forall x :e 1, f 0 = f x

items.name: EUCLID
items.statement: forall n :e omega, exists p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ n < p

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_CLOSURE_OF_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall a :e R, closure_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | a <= x} = {x :e R | a <= x}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_CLOSURE_OF_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall a :e R, closure_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | a < x} = {x :e R | a <= x}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_CLOSURE_OF_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall a :e R, closure_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | x <= a} = {x :e R | x <= a}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_CLOSURE_OF_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall a :e R, closure_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | x < a} = {x :e R | x <= a}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_CLOSURE_OF_IRRATIONAL
items.statement: closure_of R euclideanreal {z :e R | ~ z :e rational} = R

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_CLOSURE_OF_RATIONAL
items.statement: closure_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | x :e rational} = R

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_FRONTIER_OF_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall a :e R, frontier_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | a <= x} = {x :e R | x = a}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_FRONTIER_OF_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall a :e R, frontier_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | a < x} = {x :e R | x = a}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_FRONTIER_OF_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall a :e R, frontier_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | x <= a} = {x :e R | x = a}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_FRONTIER_OF_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall a :e R, frontier_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | x < a} = {x :e R | x = a}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_INTERIOR_OF_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall a :e R, interior_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | a <= x} = {x :e R | a < x}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_INTERIOR_OF_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall a :e R, interior_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | a < x} = {x :e R | a < x}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_INTERIOR_OF_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall a :e R, interior_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | x <= a} = {x :e R | x < a}

items.name: EUCLIDEANREAL_INTERIOR_OF_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall a :e R, interior_of R euclideanreal {x :e R | x < a} = {x :e R | x < a}

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure_of (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s = closure N s

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected_components_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) = components N s

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_DERIVED_SET_OF_IFF_LIMIT_POINT_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, derived_set_of (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s = {x :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N x s}

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier_of (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s = frontier N s
