items.name: EUCLIDEAN_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior_of (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s = interior N s

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_MATROID
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> matroid_set (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N) = R :^: idx N /\ forall x c= R :^: idx N, forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, matroid_span (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N) x x0 <-> x0 :e span N x

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_MATROID_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, matroid_dim (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N) x = dim N x

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_MATROID_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> matroid_dimension (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N) = dimindex N

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_MATROID_FINITE_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e matroid_finite_dim (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N)

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_MATROID_FINITE_DIMENSIONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> euclidean_matroid N :e matroid_finite_dimensional (R :^: idx N)

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_MATROID_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, matroid_independent (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N) x <-> independent N x

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_MATROID_SPANNING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, matroid_spanning (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N) s <-> span N s = R :^: idx N

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_MATROID_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, matroid_subspace (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N) x <-> subspace N x

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_METRIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall x :e R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N, mdist (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) x = distance N x) /\ mspace (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) = R :^: idx N

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_SPACE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> infinite (R :^: idx N)

items.name: EUCLIDEAN_SUBMATROID
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall s c= R :^: idx N, matroid_set (R :^: idx N) (submatroid (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N) s) = span N s) /\ forall s x c= R :^: idx N, forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, matroid_span (R :^: idx N) (submatroid (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_matroid N) s) x x0 <-> x0 :e span N x

items.name: EUCLID_BOUND
items.statement: forall n :e omega, exists p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (n < p /\ p <= ordsucc (factorial n))

items.name: EULER_ROTATION_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A :e R :^: idx_n 3 :^: idx_n 3, rotation_matrix (idx_n 3) A -> exists v :e R :^: idx_n 3, ~ v = vec (idx_n 3) 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul (idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) A v = v

items.name: EULER_ROTATION_THEOREM_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, odd_nat (dimindex N) /\ rotation_matrix N A -> exists v :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N v = 1 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N A v = v

items.name: EULER_ROTOINVERSION_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A :e R :^: idx_n 3 :^: idx_n 3, rotoinversion_matrix (idx_n 3) A -> exists v :e R :^: idx_n 3, ~ v = vec (idx_n 3) 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul (idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) A v = vector_neg (idx_n 3) v

items.name: EVEN
items.statement: (even_nat 0 <-> True) /\ forall n :e omega, even_nat (ordsucc n) <-> ~ even_nat n

items.name: EVENPERM_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> permutation A p /\ permutation A q -> (evenperm A (fun x:set => p (q x)) <-> (evenperm A p <-> evenperm A q))

items.name: EVENPERM_CYCLIC
items.statement: forall n :e omega, evenperm omega (fun i:set => if i < n then mod_nat (i + 1) n else i) <-> n = 0 \/ odd_nat n

items.name: EVENPERM_CYCLIC_N
items.statement: forall n k :e omega, evenperm omega (fun i:set => if i < n then mod_nat (i + k) n else i) <-> n = 0 \/ (odd_nat n \/ even_nat k)

items.name: EVENPERM_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (evenperm A (fun x:set => x) <-> True)

items.name: EVENPERM_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> evenperm A (fun x:set => x)

items.name: EVENPERM_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> permutation A p -> (evenperm A (fun x:set => inverse A A p x) <-> evenperm A p)

items.name: EVENPERM_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, evenperm A (fun x:set => swap A (a,b) x) <-> a = b

items.name: EVENPERM_TRANSFER
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e B, q x :e B) -> finite s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ (permutes A p s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> q (f x) = f (p x)) /\ (forall y :e B, ~ y :e {f x | x :e s} -> q y = y)))) -> (evenperm B q <-> evenperm A p)

items.name: EVENPERM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall b:prop, swapseq A n p /\ (even_nat n <-> b) -> (evenperm A p <-> b)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall p q c= A, eventually A {x :e A | x :e p /\ x :e q} net0 <-> eventually A p net0 /\ eventually A q net0

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall p c= R :^: idx A, eventually (R :^: idx A) p (at A a) <-> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 < distance A (x,a) /\ distance A (x,a) < d -> x :e p

items.name: EVENTUALLY_ATPOINTOF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= A, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, eventually A P (atpointof A top a) <-> ~ a :e topspace A top \/ exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (a :e u /\ forall x :e A, x :e u :\: {a} -> x :e P)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_ATPOINTOF_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= A, forall m :e metric A, forall a :e A, eventually A P (atpointof A (mtopology A m) a) <-> a :e mspace A m -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (0 < mdist A m (x,a) /\ mdist A m (x,a) < d) -> x :e P

items.name: EVENTUALLY_ATPOINTOF_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall met :e metric A, forall P c= A, forall a :e A, eventually A P (atpointof A (mtopology A met) a) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A met :\: {a}) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) x a sequentially -> eventually omega {n :e omega | x n :e P} sequentially

items.name: EVENTUALLY_ATPOINTOF_SEQUENTIALLY_DECREASING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall met :e metric A, forall P c= A, forall a :e A, eventually A P (atpointof A (mtopology A met) a) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A met :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> mdist A met (x n,a) < mdist A met (x m,a)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) x a sequentially)) -> eventually omega {n :e omega | x n :e P} sequentially

items.name: EVENTUALLY_ATPOINTOF_SEQUENTIALLY_INJ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall met :e metric A, forall P c= A, forall a :e A, eventually A P (atpointof A (mtopology A met) a) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A met :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) x a sequentially) -> eventually omega {n :e omega | x n :e P} sequentially

items.name: EVENTUALLY_ATPOINTOF_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall met :e metric A, forall P s c= A, forall a :e A, eventually A P (within A (atpointof A (mtopology A met) a) s) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :/\: mspace A met :\: {a}) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) x a sequentially -> eventually omega {n :e omega | x n :e P} sequentially

items.name: EVENTUALLY_ATPOINTOF_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY_DECREASING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall met :e metric A, forall P s c= A, forall a :e A, eventually A P (within A (atpointof A (mtopology A met) a) s) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :/\: mspace A met :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> mdist A met (x n,a) < mdist A met (x m,a)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) x a sequentially)) -> eventually omega {n :e omega | x n :e P} sequentially

items.name: EVENTUALLY_ATPOINTOF_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY_INJ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall met :e metric A, forall P s c= A, forall a :e A, eventually A P (within A (atpointof A (mtopology A met) a) s) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :/\: mspace A met :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A met) x a sequentially) -> eventually omega {n :e omega | x n :e P} sequentially

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT_INFINITY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A, eventually (R :^: idx A) p (at_infinity A) <-> exists b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, b <= vector_norm A x -> x :e p

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT_INFINITY_POS

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT_INFINITY_WITHIN

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT_NEGINFINITY

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT_POSINFINITY

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT_REFLECT

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT_TOPOLOGICAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, eventually (R :^: idx N) P (at N a) <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ (a :e t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t :\: {a} -> x :e P)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, eventually (R :^: idx N) P (at N a) -> eventually (R :^: idx N) P (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_AT_ZERO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, eventually (R :^: idx N) P (at N a) <-> eventually (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N | vector_add N a x :e P} (at N (vec N 0))

items.name: EVENTUALLY_EQ_MP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall P Q c= A, eventually A {x :e A | x :e P <-> x :e Q} net0 /\ eventually A P net0 -> eventually A Q net0

items.name: EVENTUALLY_FALSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, eventually A {x :e A | False} net0 <-> trivial_limit A net0

items.name: EVENTUALLY_FORALL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall p :e Power A :^: B, forall s c= B, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (eventually A {x :e A | forall a :e B, a :e s -> x :e p a} net0 <-> forall a :e B, a :e s -> eventually A (p a) net0)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_HAPPENS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall p c= A, eventually A p net0 -> trivial_limit A net0 \/ exists x :e A, x :e p

items.name: EVENTUALLY_HAPPENS_AT

items.name: EVENTUALLY_HAPPENS_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall P c= omega, eventually omega P sequentially -> exists n :e omega, n :e P

items.name: EVENTUALLY_IFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall net0 :e net A, forall P Q c= A, eventually A {x :e A | x :e P <-> x :e Q} net0 -> (eventually A P net0 <-> eventually A Q net0)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_IMP_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall P s c= A, eventually A P net0 -> eventually A P (within A net0 s)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_IN_OPEN

items.name: EVENTUALLY_IN_SEQUENTIALLY

items.name: EVENTUALLY_LBOUND_LE_SEQUENTIALLY

items.name: EVENTUALLY_MONO

items.name: EVENTUALLY_MP

items.name: EVENTUALLY_NO_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall P c= omega, eventually omega P sequentially <-> ~ exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ forall n :e omega, ~ r n :e P)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_SCALABLE_PROPERTY

items.name: EVENTUALLY_SCALABLE_PROPERTY_EQ

items.name: EVENTUALLY_SEQUENTIALLY

items.name: EVENTUALLY_SEQUENTIALLY_WITHIN

items.name: EVENTUALLY_SUBSEQUENCE

items.name: EVENTUALLY_TRIVIAL

items.name: EVENTUALLY_TRUE

items.name: EVENTUALLY_UBOUND_LE_SEQUENTIALLY

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall p c= R :^: idx M, eventually (R :^: idx M) p (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (0 < distance M (x,a) /\ distance M (x,a) < d) -> x :e p

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_DELETE

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall P s c= A, eventually A P (within A net0 s) <-> eventually A {x :e A | x :e s -> x :e P} net0

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e interior N s -> (eventually (R :^: idx N) p (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s) <-> eventually (R :^: idx N) p (at N x))

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_INTERIOR_INTER

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_INTERIOR_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, a :e u /\ (u c= t /\ (t c= s /\ u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s)) -> (eventually (R :^: idx N) P (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) t) <-> eventually (R :^: idx N) P (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s))

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_INTER_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall net0 :e net A, forall P s t c= A, eventually A P (within A net0 (s :/\: t)) <-> eventually A {x :e A | x :e t -> x :e P} (within A net0 s)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_LE

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_LEFT_ALT

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_LEFT_ALT_GEN
items.statement: forall P s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, eventually (R :^: idx 1) P (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= drop a}) <-> eventually (R :^: idx 1) P (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x < drop a})

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_OPEN

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, a :e t /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s -> (eventually (R :^: idx N) P (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) t) <-> eventually (R :^: idx N) P (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s))

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_REFLECT

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_RIGHT_ALT

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_RIGHT_ALT_GEN
items.statement: forall P s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, eventually (R :^: idx 1) P (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop a <= drop x}) <-> eventually (R :^: idx 1) P (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop a < drop x})

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= A, forall net0 :e net A, forall s t c= A, eventually A P (within A net0 s) /\ t c= s -> eventually A P (within A net0 t)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_TOPOLOGICAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, eventually (R :^: idx N) P (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s) <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ (a :e t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :/\: (t :\: {a}) -> x :e P)

items.name: EVENTUALLY_WITHIN_ZERO

items.name: EVEN_ADD

items.name: EVEN_OR_ODD

items.name: EXACT_SEQUENCE_SUM_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A B C D X:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall f :e C :^: X, forall g :e D :^: X, forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e C) -> forall i :e X :^: A, forall j :e X :^: B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e D) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall D0 :e group_hl D, forall X0 :e group_hl X, abelian_group_hl X X0 /\ (group_isomorphism_hl A C (A0,C0) h /\ (group_isomorphism_hl B D (B0,D0) k /\ (group_exactness A X D (A0,(X0,D0)) (i,g) /\ (group_exactness B X C (B0,(X0,C0)) (j,f) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A A0 -> f (i x) = h x) /\ (forall x :e B, x :e group_carrier B B0 -> g (j x) = k x)))))) -> group_isomorphism_hl (A :*: B) X (prod_group A B A0 B0,X0) (fun p:set => group_mul X X0 (i (p 0)) (j (p 1))) /\ group_isomorphism_hl X (C :*: D) (X0,prod_group C D C0 D0) (fun z:set => (f z,g z))

items.name: EXCISED_CHAIN_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), closure_of A top u c= interior_of A top t /\ (t c= s /\ singular_chain A (p,subtopology A top s) c) -> exists n :e omega, exists d e0 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,subtopology A top (s :\: u)) d /\ (singular_chain A (p,subtopology A top t) e0 /\ iter_fun n (singular_subdivision A p) c = frag_add (A :^: (R :^: omega)) d e0)

items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, (exists z :e A :^: K, z :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> P i (z i)) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> exists x :e A, x :e s i /\ P i x
