items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> ((exists u c= K :*: A, closed_in (K :*: A) (sum_topology A K k top) u /\ P u) <-> exists t :e Power A :^: K, (forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_in A (top i) (t i)) /\ P {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)})

items.name: EXISTS_COMPLETELY_METRIZABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (exists top :e topology A, completely_metrizable_space A top /\ P top (topspace A top)) <-> exists m :e metric A, mcomplete A m /\ P (mtopology A m) (mspace A m)

items.name: EXISTS_COMPONENT_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ connected N t) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s /\ t c= c

items.name: EXISTS_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s /\ ~ topspace A top = Empty -> exists c c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top /\ s c= c

items.name: EXISTS_COUNTABLE_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, countable t /\ (t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t)) <-> exists t c= A, countable t /\ (t c= s /\ P {f x | x :e t})

items.name: EXISTS_COUNTABLE_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, countable t /\ (t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t)) <-> exists t c= A, countable t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ P {f x | x :e t}))

items.name: EXISTS_CURRY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e C :^: (A :*: B), P f) <-> exists f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) /\ P (fun p :e A :*: B => f (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: EXISTS_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) <-> forall q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> q) -> q

items.name: EXISTS_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists s c= A, P (A :\: s)) <-> exists s c= A, P s

items.name: EXISTS_DOUBLE_ARC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, simple_path N g /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N g /\ (a :e path_image N g /\ (b :e path_image N g /\ ~ a = b))) -> exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, u x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists d:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, d x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N u /\ (arc N d /\ (pathstart N u = a /\ (pathfinish N u = b /\ (pathstart N d = b /\ (pathfinish N d = a /\ (path_image N u :/\: path_image N d = {a,b} /\ path_image N u :\/: path_image N d = path_image N g)))))))

items.name: EXISTS_DOUBLE_ARC_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, simple_path N g /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N g /\ (a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (b :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ ~ g a = g b)))) -> exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, u x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists d:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, d x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N u /\ (arc N d /\ (pathstart N u = g a /\ (pathfinish N u = g b /\ (pathstart N d = g b /\ (pathfinish N d = g a /\ (path_image N u = {g x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} /\ (path_image N d = {g x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) :\: open_interval 1 (a,b)} /\ (path_image N u :/\: path_image N d = {g a,g b} /\ path_image N u :\/: path_image N d = path_image N g)))))))))

items.name: EXISTS_DROP
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e R, P x) <-> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, P (drop x)

items.name: EXISTS_DROP_FUN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e R :^: A, P f) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ P (fun x :e A => drop (f x))

items.name: EXISTS_DROP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists s c= R, P s) <-> exists s c= R :^: idx 1, P {drop x | x :e s}

items.name: EXISTS_EX
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq B, (exists x :e A, seq_ex (P x) l) <-> seq_ex (fun s:set => exists x :e A, P x s) l

items.name: EXISTS_FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, finite t /\ (t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t)) <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ P {f x | x :e t})

items.name: EXISTS_FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, finite t /\ (t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t)) <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ P {f x | x :e t}))

items.name: EXISTS_FUN_DROP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e A :^: (R :^: idx 1), P f) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e A) /\ P (fun x :e R :^: idx 1 => f (drop x))

items.name: EXISTS_FUN_LIFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e A :^: R, P f) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e A) /\ P (fun x :e R => f (lift x))

items.name: EXISTS_INT_CASES
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e int, P x) <-> (exists n :e omega, P n) \/ exists n :e omega, P (- n)

items.name: EXISTS_IN_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, x :e Empty /\ P x) <-> False) /\ forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, (exists x :e A, x :e SetAdjoin s a /\ P x) <-> P a \/ exists x :e A, x :e s /\ P x

items.name: EXISTS_IN_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (exists z :e A :*: B, z :e s :*: t /\ P z) <-> exists x :e A, exists y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ P (x,y))

items.name: EXISTS_IN_GROUP_CARRIER_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall G :e group_hl A, (exists x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ P (group_inv A G x)) <-> exists x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ P x

items.name: EXISTS_IN_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A B C D E:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> (forall P Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((exists z :e B, z :e {f x | x :e A, P x} /\ Q z) <-> exists x :e A, P x /\ Q (f x))) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> ((exists z :e C, z :e (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, P x y}) /\ Q z) <-> exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y /\ Q (f x y))) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, f x y z :e D) -> ((exists z :e D, z :e (\/_ w :e A, \/_ x :e B, {f w x y | y :e C, P w x y}) /\ Q z) <-> exists w :e A, exists x :e B, exists y :e C, P w x y /\ Q (f w x y))) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall Q:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, forall w :e D, f x y z w :e E) -> ((exists z :e E, z :e (\/_ v :e A, \/_ w :e B, \/_ x :e C, {f v w x y | y :e D, P v w x y}) /\ Q z) <-> exists v :e A, exists w :e B, exists x :e C, exists y :e D, P v w x y /\ Q (f v w x y))))

items.name: EXISTS_IN_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists y :e B, y :e {f x | x :e s} /\ P y) <-> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ P (f x)

items.name: EXISTS_IN_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, (exists x :e A, x :e SetAdjoin s a /\ P x) <-> P a \/ exists x :e A, x :e s /\ P x

items.name: EXISTS_IN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall P:set -> prop, (exists z :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), z :e (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) /\ P z) <-> exists x :e A :^: idx M, exists y :e A :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ P (pastecart M N x y))

items.name: EXISTS_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists x :e A, x :e s :\/: t /\ P x) <-> (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ P x) \/ exists x :e A, x :e t /\ P x

items.name: EXISTS_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= Power A, (exists x :e A, x :e Union s /\ P x) <-> exists t c= A, exists x :e A, t :e s /\ (x :e t /\ P x)

items.name: EXISTS_LIFT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e R :^: idx 1, P x) <-> exists x :e R, P (lift x)

items.name: EXISTS_LIFT_FUN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: A, P f) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ P (fun x :e A => lift (f x))

items.name: EXISTS_LIFT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists s c= R :^: idx 1, P s) <-> exists s c= R, P {lift x | x :e s}

items.name: EXISTS_LT_MOD_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, (exists a :e omega, a < n /\ P a) <-> ~ n = 0 /\ exists a :e omega, P (mod_nat a n)

items.name: EXISTS_MATRIFY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A :^: idx B :^: idx C, P x) <-> exists x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex C * dimindex B), P (matrify A C B x)

items.name: EXISTS_METRIZABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (exists top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top /\ P top (topspace A top)) <-> exists m :e metric A, P (mtopology A m) (mspace A m)

items.name: EXISTS_MOD_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> ((exists a :e omega, P (mod_nat a n)) <-> exists a :e omega, a < n /\ P a)

items.name: EXISTS_NOT_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, ~ P x) <-> ~ forall x :e A, P x

items.name: EXISTS_ONE_REP
items.statement: exists b:prop, b

items.name: EXISTS_ONE_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e 1, P x) <-> P 0

items.name: EXISTS_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall top :e topology A, (exists s c= A, s :e top /\ P s) <-> exists s c= A, closed_in A top s /\ P (topspace A top :\: s)

items.name: EXISTS_OPEN_IN_SUM_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> ((exists u c= K :*: A, u :e sum_topology A K k top /\ P u) <-> exists t :e Power A :^: K, (forall i :e K, i :e k -> t i :e top i) /\ P {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)})

items.name: EXISTS_OPTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e 1 :+: A, P x) <-> P (Inj0 0) \/ exists x :e A, P (Inj1 x)

items.name: EXISTS_OPTION_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e 1 :+: A, P x) <-> P (Inj0 0) \/ exists a :e A, P (Inj1 a)

items.name: EXISTS_OR_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x \/ Q x) <-> (exists x :e A, P x) \/ exists x :e A, Q x

items.name: EXISTS_PAIRED_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (exists x :e A :*: B, P (x 0) (x 1)) <-> exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y

items.name: EXISTS_PAIR_FUN_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e (B :*: C) :^: A, P f) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e C) /\ P (fun a :e A => (g a,h a))

items.name: EXISTS_PAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists p :e A :*: B, P p) <-> exists p1 :e A, exists p2 :e B, P (p1,p2)

items.name: EXISTS_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists p :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), P p) <-> exists x :e A :^: idx M, exists y :e A :^: idx N, P (pastecart M N x y)

items.name: EXISTS_PATH_COMPONENT_OF_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, path_connected_in A top s /\ ~ topspace A top = Empty -> exists c c= A, c :e path_components_of A top /\ s c= c

items.name: EXISTS_PATH_SUBPATH_TO_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path N g /\ (pathstart N g :e s /\ ~ pathfinish N g :e s) -> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (path N h /\ (pathstart N h = pathstart N g /\ (path_image N h c= path_image N g /\ (path_image N h :\: {pathfinish N h} c= interior N s /\ pathfinish N h :e frontier N s))))

items.name: EXISTS_PATH_SUBPATH_TO_FRONTIER_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (path N g /\ (pathstart N g :e s /\ ~ pathfinish N g :e s)) -> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (path N h /\ (pathstart N h = pathstart N g /\ (path_image N h c= path_image N g :/\: s /\ pathfinish N h :e frontier N s)))

items.name: EXISTS_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, exists x :e A, x = a

items.name: EXISTS_SIMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t:prop, (exists x :e A, t) <-> t

items.name: EXISTS_SMALL_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (exists t c= B, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ (t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t))) <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ (t c= s /\ P {f x | x :e t}))

items.name: EXISTS_SMALL_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (exists t c= B, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ (t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t))) <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ P {f x | x :e t})))

items.name: EXISTS_SUBARC_OF_ARC_NOENDS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, arc N g /\ (a :e path_image N g /\ (b :e path_image N g /\ (~ a = b /\ {a,b} :/\: {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g} = Empty))) -> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N h /\ (pathstart N h = a /\ (pathfinish N h = b /\ path_image N h c= path_image N g :\: {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g})))

items.name: EXISTS_SUBPATH_OF_ARC_NOENDS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, arc N g /\ (a :e path_image N g /\ (b :e path_image N g /\ {a,b} :/\: {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g} = Empty)) -> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (path N h /\ (pathstart N h = a /\ (pathfinish N h = b /\ path_image N h c= path_image N g :\: {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g})))

items.name: EXISTS_SUBPATH_OF_PATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path N g /\ (a :e path_image N g /\ b :e path_image N g) -> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (path N h /\ (pathstart N h = a /\ (pathfinish N h = b /\ path_image N h c= path_image N g)))

items.name: EXISTS_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t) <-> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: EXISTS_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (exists t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} /\ P t) <-> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) /\ P {f x | x :e t})

items.name: EXISTS_SUBSET_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall t c= A, (exists s c= A, s c= SetAdjoin t a /\ P s) <-> exists s c= A, s c= t /\ (P s \/ P (SetAdjoin s a))

items.name: EXISTS_SUBSET_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall t u c= A, (exists s c= A, s c= t :\/: u /\ P s) <-> exists t' u' c= A, t' c= t /\ (u' c= u /\ P (t' :\/: u'))

items.name: EXISTS_SUM_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists z :e B :+: A, P z) <-> (exists x :e B, P (Inj0 x)) \/ exists x :e A, P (Inj1 x)

items.name: EXISTS_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e C :^: A :^: B, P f) <-> exists f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) /\ P (fun b :e B => fun a :e A => f a b)

items.name: EXISTS_SWAP_FUN_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e C :^: B :^: A, P f) <-> exists f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, f x y :e C) /\ P (fun a :e A => fun b :e B => f b a)

items.name: EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) <-> P (choose_in A P)

items.name: EXISTS_TRIPLED_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (exists x :e A :*: (B :*: C), P (x 0) (x 1 0) (x 1 1)) <-> exists x :e A, exists y :e B, exists z :e C, P x y z

items.name: EXISTS_UNCURRY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists f :e C :^: B :^: A, P f) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) /\ P (fun a :e A => fun b :e B => f (a,b))

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x) <-> exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x) <-> exists x :e A, forall y :e A, P y <-> x = y

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x) <-> (exists x :e A, P x) /\ forall x y :e A, P x /\ P y -> x = y

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, exists x :e A, x = a /\ forall y :e A, y = a -> y = x

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, P y -> y = x) <-> (exists x :e A, P x) /\ forall x x' :e A, P x /\ P x' -> x = x'

items.name: EXISTS_UNIQUE_UNIONS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists s c= A, P s /\ forall y c= A, P y -> y = s) <-> Union {s :e Power A | P s} = {x :e A | forall Y :e {s :e Power A | P s}, x :e Y}

items.name: EXISTS_UNPAIR_FUN_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (exists f :e B :^: A, exists g :e C :^: A, P f g) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B :*: C) /\ P (fun x :e A => h x 0) (fun x :e A => h x 1)

items.name: EXISTS_UNPAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y) <-> exists z :e A :*: B, P (z 0) (z 1)

items.name: EXISTS_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex B * dimindex C), P x) <-> exists x :e A :^: idx C :^: idx B, P (vectorize A B C x)

items.name: EXISTS_VECTOR_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists v :e A :^: idx 1, P v) <-> exists x :e A, P (vector A 1 (seq_cons x seq_nil))

items.name: EXISTS_VECTOR_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists v :e A :^: idx_n 2, P v) <-> exists x y :e A, P (vector A (idx_n 2) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y seq_nil)))

items.name: EXISTS_VECTOR_3
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists v :e A :^: idx_n 3, P v) <-> exists x y z :e A, P (vector A (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil))))

items.name: EXISTS_VECTOR_4
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (exists v :e A :^: idx_n 4, P v) <-> exists w x y z :e A, P (vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))))

items.name: EXP
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, m ^ 0 = 1) /\ forall m n :e omega, m ^ ordsucc n = m * m ^ n

items.name: EXPAND_CLOSED_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c d :e R :^: idx N, closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= open_interval N (c,d) /\ measure N (open_interval N (c,d)) <= measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) + e0

items.name: EXPANSION_SET_CONTAINS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall C c= Power A, forall b c= A, Union C = topspace A top /\ b c= topspace A top -> b c= topspace A top :\: Union {c :e Power A | c :e C /\ c :/\: b = Empty}

items.name: EXPANSION_SET_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall C c= Power A, forall b c= A, locally_finite_in A top C /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e C -> closed_in A top c) /\ b c= topspace A top) -> topspace A top :\: Union {c :e Power A | c :e C /\ c :/\: b = Empty} :e top

items.name: EXPLICIT_SUBSET_INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N -> {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 < u x /\ u x < 1) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))} c= interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: EXPLICIT_SUBSET_INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N -> {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 < u x) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))} c= interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: EXPLICIT_SUBSET_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 < u x /\ u x < 1) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))} c= relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: EXPLICIT_SUBSET_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 < u x) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))} c= relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: EXPOSED_FACET_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ facet_of N t s -> exposed_face_of N t s

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, exposed_face_of N t s <-> face_of N t s /\ (t = Empty \/ (t = s \/ exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ (s c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} /\ t = s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b})))

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_IMP_FACE_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, exposed_face_of N t s -> face_of N t s

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, exposed_face_of N t s /\ exposed_face_of N u s -> exposed_face_of N (t :/\: u) s

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ P = Empty /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e P -> exposed_face_of N t s) -> exposed_face_of N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e P, x :e Y} s

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b <= dot N a x) -> exposed_face_of N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}) s

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x <= b) -> exposed_face_of N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}) s

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> (exposed_face_of N {f x | x :e c} {f x | x :e s} <-> exposed_face_of M c s)

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_PARALLEL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t s c= R :^: idx N, exposed_face_of N t s <-> face_of N t s /\ exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, s c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} /\ (t = s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} /\ ((~ t = Empty /\ ~ t = s -> ~ a = vec N 0) /\ forall w :e R :^: idx N, w :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ ~ t = s -> vector_add N w a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s))

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> (exposed_face_of N f s <-> face_of N f s)

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> exposed_face_of N s s

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, exposed_face_of N s s <-> convex N s

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t f c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ exposed_face_of N f (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})) -> exists k l c= R :^: idx N, exposed_face_of N k s /\ (exposed_face_of N l t /\ f = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e k /\ y :e l})

items.name: EXPOSED_FACE_OF_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall f s c= R :^: idx N, exposed_face_of N {vector_add N a x | x :e f} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> exposed_face_of N f s

items.name: EXPOSED_POINT_OF_FURTHEST_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> distance N (a,x) <= distance N (a,b)) -> exposed_face_of N {b} s

items.name: EXPOSED_POINT_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b <= dot N a x) /\ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} = {c} -> exposed_face_of N {c} s

items.name: EXPOSED_POINT_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x <= b) /\ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} = {c} -> exposed_face_of N {c} s

items.name: EXP_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n ^ 1 = n

items.name: EXP_2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n ^ 2 = n * n

items.name: EXP_2_NE_0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ 2 ^ n = 0

items.name: EXP_ADD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m ^ (n + p) = m ^ n * m ^ p

items.name: EXP_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} = {f :e A :^: B | {f x | x :e t} c= s /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: EXP_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m ^ n = 0 <-> m = 0 /\ ~ n = 0

items.name: EXP_EQ_1
items.statement: forall x n :e omega, x ^ n = 1 <-> x = 1 \/ n = 0

items.name: EXP_EXP
items.statement: forall x m n :e omega, (x ^ m) ^ n = x ^ (m * n)

items.name: EXP_INDEX_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ prime_index p n) n

items.name: EXP_LT_0
items.statement: forall n x :e omega, 0 < x ^ n <-> ~ x = 0 \/ n = 0

items.name: EXP_MONO_EQ
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x ^ n = y ^ n <-> x = y \/ n = 0

items.name: EXP_MONO_LE
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x ^ n <= y ^ n <-> x <= y \/ n = 0

items.name: EXP_MONO_LE_IMP
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x <= y -> x ^ n <= y ^ n

items.name: EXP_MONO_LT
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x ^ n < y ^ n <-> x < y /\ ~ n = 0

items.name: EXP_MONO_LT_IMP
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, x < y /\ ~ n = 0 -> x ^ n < y ^ n

items.name: EXP_MULT
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m ^ (n * p) = (m ^ n) ^ p

items.name: EXP_MULT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall m n p k :e omega, ~ m = 0 /\ m ^ k * n = p ^ k -> exists q :e omega, n = q ^ k

items.name: EXP_NSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e omega, forall n:set -> set, (forall x :e A, n x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> m ^ finsum s n = finprod s (fun i:set => m ^ n i)

items.name: EXP_ONE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 1 ^ n = 1

items.name: EXP_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 ^ n = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

items.name: EXTEND_CONVEX_FRONTIER_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e closure N s /\ (b :e closure N s /\ (x :e open_segment N (a,b) /\ x :e frontier N s))) -> closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= frontier N s

items.name: EXTEND_CONVEX_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e closure N s /\ (b :e closure N s /\ (x :e open_segment N (a,b) /\ x :e relative_frontier N s))) -> closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= relative_frontier N s

items.name: EXTEND_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, woset_on A l -> (x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun y:set => l x0 y /\ l y a) <-> l x a)

items.name: EXTEND_INSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, woset_on A l /\ a :e fld_on A l -> inseg_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => l x y /\ l y a) l

items.name: EXTEND_LINSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, woset_on A l /\ a :e fld_on A l -> inseg_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => linseg_rel l a x y \/ y = a /\ (x :e fld_on A (linseg_rel l a) \/ x = a)) l

items.name: EXTEND_TO_AFFINE_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ s c= u -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N t /\ (s c= t /\ (t c= u /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} u))

items.name: EXTENSION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s = t <-> forall x :e A, x :e s <-> x :e t

items.name: EXTENSIONAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall x :e B :^: A, (forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> x :e {f :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> f x0 = choose_in B (fun x:set => True)}

items.name: EXTENSIONAL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e B :^: A, (forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e Empty -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> x :e SetAdjoin Empty (fun x0 :e A => choose_in B (fun x:set => True))

items.name: EXTENSIONAL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f g :e B :^: A, f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ (g :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)) -> f = g

items.name: EXTENSIONAL_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, ~ x :e A -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: EXTENSION_FROM_CLOPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= u /\ (u = Empty -> s = Empty)))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ ({g x | x :e s} c= u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> g x = f x))

items.name: EXTENSION_FROM_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, (locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s \/ compact M s /\ ANR N u) /\ (c :e components M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f c /\ {f x | x :e c} c= u)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ ({g x | x :e s} c= u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e c -> g x = f x))

items.name: EXTENSION_INTO_AR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (retract_of N t (R :^: idx N) /\ closed M s)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (R :^: idx M) /\ ({g x | x :e R :^: idx M} c= t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x))

items.name: EXTENSION_INTO_AR_LOCAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f c /\ ({f x | x :e c} c= t /\ (retract_of N t (R :^: idx N) /\ closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) c)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ ({g x | x :e R :^: idx M} c= t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e c -> g x = f x))

items.name: EXTREMELY_SHORT_EXACT_SEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, group_exactness A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (trivial_group A A0 /\ trivial_group C C0) -> trivial_group B B0

items.name: EXTREME_POINTS_OF_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, {x :e R :^: idx A | extreme_point_of A x (hull (R :^: idx A) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x0} s)} c= s

items.name: EXTREME_POINTS_OF_CONVEX_HULL_AFFINE_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s)} = s

items.name: EXTREME_POINTS_OF_CONVEX_HULL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ t <> s -> ~ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) -> {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s)} = s

items.name: EXTREME_POINTS_OF_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> {y :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N y {f x | x :e s}} = {f x | x :e {x :e R :^: idx M | extreme_point_of M x s}}

items.name: EXTREME_POINTS_OF_STILLCONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ t c= {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s} -> convex N (s :\: t)

items.name: EXTREME_POINTS_OF_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x {vector_add N a x0 | x0 :e s}} = {vector_add N a x | x :e {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s}}

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_EXISTS_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (convex N s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N x s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_IN_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N x s -> x :e frontier N s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_IN_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N x s /\ ~ s = {x} -> x :e relative_frontier N s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_NOT_IN_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N x s -> ~ x :e interior N s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_NOT_IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N x s /\ ~ s = {x} -> ~ x :e relative_interior N s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N x (cball N (a,r)) <-> x :e sphere N (a,r)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CONIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, conic N s /\ extreme_point_of N x s -> x = vec N 0

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s -> (extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x0} s) <-> x = vec N 0 /\ ~ s = Empty)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s) -> x :e s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CONVEX_HULL_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx A, extreme_point_of A x (hull (R :^: idx A) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x0} {a,b}) <-> x = a \/ x = b

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CONVEX_HULL_AFFINE_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, ~ affine_dependent A s -> (extreme_point_of A x (hull (R :^: idx A) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x0} s) <-> x :e s)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CONVEX_HULL_CONVEX_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> ~ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} (s :\: {a})) -> (extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s) <-> x :e s)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CONVEX_HULL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ t <> s -> ~ hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s) -> (extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s) <-> x :e s)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CONVEX_HULL_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s -> extreme_point_of N a (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s a))

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_CONVEX_HULL_INSERT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s -> (extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} (SetAdjoin s a)) <-> x = a \/ extreme_point_of N x (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s))

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, ~ extreme_point_of A x Empty

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_FACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx A, forall v :e R :^: idx A, face_of A f s -> (extreme_point_of A v f <-> extreme_point_of A v s /\ v :e f)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s t c= R :^: idx A, extreme_point_of A x s /\ extreme_point_of A x t -> extreme_point_of A x (s :/\: t)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_INTER_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s t c= R :^: idx A, (extreme_point_of A x s \/ extreme_point_of A x t) /\ x :e s :/\: t -> extreme_point_of A x (s :/\: t)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_GE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> b <= dot A a x) /\ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x = b} = {c} -> extreme_point_of A c s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> dot A a x <= b) /\ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x = b} = {c} -> extreme_point_of A c s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x0 y :e R :^: idx M, f x0 = f y -> x0 = y) -> (extreme_point_of N (f x) {f x | x :e s} <-> extreme_point_of M x s)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (extreme_point_of N x s <-> x :e s /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x = midpoint N (a,b)) -> x = a /\ x = b)

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N x (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> x = a \/ x = b

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx A, extreme_point_of A x {a} <-> x = a

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_STILLCONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (extreme_point_of N x s <-> x :e s /\ convex N (s :\: {x}))

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_STILLCONVEX_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ convex N (s :\: {x}) -> extreme_point_of N x s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_OF_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N (vector_add N a x) {vector_add N a x0 | x0 :e s} <-> extreme_point_of N x s

items.name: EXTREME_POINT_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (x :e s :\: relative_interior N s /\ (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, {a,b} c= s :\: relative_interior N s -> ~ x :e open_segment N (a,b))) -> extreme_point_of N x s

items.name: EX_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x :e A, seq_mem x l /\ P x -> Q x) /\ seq_ex P l -> seq_ex Q l

items.name: EX_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_ex P (seq_map f l) <-> seq_ex (fun x:set => P (f x)) l

items.name: EX_MEM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (exists x :e A, P x /\ seq_mem x l) <-> seq_ex P l

items.name: FACES_OF_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> {t :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N t {f x | x :e s}} = {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e {t :e Power (R :^: idx M) | face_of M t s}}

items.name: FACES_OF_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx A, simplex A n s -> {f :e Power (R :^: idx A) | face_of A f s} = {hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} c | c :e Power (R :^: idx A), c c= {v :e R :^: idx A | extreme_point_of A v s}}

items.name: FACES_OF_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N f {vector_add N a x | x :e s}} = {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {vector_add N a x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N f s}}

items.name: FACETS_OF_POLYHEDRON_EXPLICIT_DISTINCT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), b x :e R) -> finite f /\ (s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ ((forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> ~ a h = vec N 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h) x <= b h}) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ f' <> f -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} /\ s <> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y}))) -> forall h1 h2 c= R :^: idx N, h1 :e f /\ (h2 :e f /\ s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h1) x = b h1} = s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h2) x = b h2}) -> h1 = h2

items.name: FACET_OF_CONVEX_HULL_AFFINE_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> (facet_of N t (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) <-> ~ t = Empty /\ exists u :e R :^: idx N, u :e s /\ t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\: {u}))

items.name: FACET_OF_CONVEX_HULL_AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> (facet_of N t (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) <-> 2 <= finite_cardinality s /\ exists u :e R :^: idx N, u :e s /\ t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\: {u}))

items.name: FACET_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ~ facet_of A s Empty

items.name: FACET_OF_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, facet_of N f {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x} <-> ~ a = vec N 0 /\ f = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: FACET_OF_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, facet_of N f {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} <-> ~ a = vec N 0 /\ f = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: FACET_OF_IMP_FACE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx A, facet_of A f s -> face_of A f s

items.name: FACET_OF_IMP_PROPER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx A, facet_of A f s -> ~ f = Empty /\ ~ f = s

items.name: FACET_OF_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx A, facet_of A f s -> f c= s

items.name: FACET_OF_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (facet_of N {f x | x :e c} {f x | x :e s} <-> facet_of M c s)

items.name: FACET_OF_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ facet_of N c s -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ (s c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} /\ c = s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b})

items.name: FACET_OF_POLYHEDRON_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), b x :e R) -> finite f /\ (s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ ((forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> ~ a h = vec N 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h) x <= b h}) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ f' <> f -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} /\ s <> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y}))) -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, facet_of N c s <-> exists h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f /\ c = s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h) x = b h}

items.name: FACET_OF_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ~ facet_of A s s

items.name: FACET_OF_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall f s c= R :^: idx N, facet_of N {vector_add N a x | x :e f} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> facet_of N f s

items.name: FACE_OF_AFFINE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, affine N s -> (face_of N f s <-> f = Empty \/ f = s)

items.name: FACE_OF_AFFINE_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ face_of N f s -> f = Empty \/ f = s

items.name: FACE_OF_AFF_DIM_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ aff_dim N f = 0 <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, extreme_point_of N a s /\ f = {a}

items.name: FACE_OF_AFF_DIM_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (face_of N f s /\ ~ f = s) -> aff_dim N f < aff_dim N s

items.name: FACE_OF_CONIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, conic N s /\ face_of N f s -> conic N f

items.name: FACE_OF_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> face_of N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} f) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)

items.name: FACE_OF_CONIC_HULL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> (face_of N f (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) <-> f = {vec N 0} /\ ~ s = Empty \/ exists f' c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f' s /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} f' = f)

items.name: FACE_OF_CONIC_HULL_REV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) /\ ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> f = {vec N 0} \/ exists f' c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f' s /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} f' = f

items.name: FACE_OF_CONVEX_HULLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (f c= s /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} f :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\: f) = Empty) -> face_of N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} f) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: FACE_OF_CONVEX_HULL_AFFINE_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> (face_of N t (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) <-> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c c= s /\ t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} c)

items.name: FACE_OF_CONVEX_HULL_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (~ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ face_of N f (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)) -> face_of N f (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s a))

items.name: FACE_OF_CONVEX_HULL_INSERT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> (face_of N f (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s a)) <-> face_of N f (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) \/ exists f' c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f' (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) /\ f = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin f' a))

items.name: FACE_OF_CONVEX_HULL_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ face_of N t (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) -> exists s' c= R :^: idx N, s' c= s /\ t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s'

items.name: FACE_OF_DISJOINT_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ ~ f = s -> f :/\: interior N s = Empty

items.name: FACE_OF_DISJOINT_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ ~ f = s -> f :/\: relative_interior N s = Empty

items.name: FACE_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, face_of A s Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: FACE_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, face_of N t s /\ (face_of N u s /\ ~ relative_interior N t :/\: relative_interior N u = Empty) -> t = u

items.name: FACE_OF_FACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f s t c= R :^: idx A, face_of A t s -> (face_of A f t <-> face_of A f s /\ f c= t)

items.name: FACE_OF_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, face_of N f {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x} <-> f = Empty \/ (f = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} \/ f = {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x})

items.name: FACE_OF_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, face_of N f {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} <-> f = Empty \/ (f = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} \/ f = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b})

items.name: FACE_OF_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ (closed A s /\ face_of A t s) -> closed A t

items.name: FACE_OF_IMP_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s /\ (compact A s /\ face_of A t s) -> compact A t

items.name: FACE_OF_IMP_CONVEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, face_of A t s -> convex A t

items.name: FACE_OF_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, face_of A t s -> t c= s

items.name: FACE_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t1 t2 c= R :^: idx A, face_of A t1 s /\ face_of A t2 s -> face_of A (t1 :/\: t2) s

items.name: FACE_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, ~ P = Empty /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx A, t :e P -> face_of A t s) -> face_of A {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e P, x :e Y} s

items.name: FACE_OF_INTER_AS_INTER_OF_FACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t f c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ face_of N f (s :/\: t)) -> exists k l c= R :^: idx N, face_of N k s /\ (face_of N l t /\ k :/\: l = f)

items.name: FACE_OF_INTER_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f t f' t' c= R :^: idx A, face_of A f t /\ face_of A f' t' -> face_of A (f :/\: f') (t :/\: t')

items.name: FACE_OF_INTER_SUBFACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c1 c2 d1 d2 c= R :^: idx N, face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c1 /\ (face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c2 /\ (face_of N d1 c1 /\ face_of N d2 c2)) -> face_of N (d1 :/\: d2) d1 /\ face_of N (d1 :/\: d2) d2

items.name: FACE_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b <= dot N a x) -> face_of N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}) s

items.name: FACE_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_GE_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b <= dot N a x) -> face_of N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}) s

items.name: FACE_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x <= b) -> face_of N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}) s

items.name: FACE_OF_INTER_SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_LE_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, convex N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x <= b) -> face_of N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}) s

items.name: FACE_OF_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (face_of N {f x | x :e c} {f x | x :e s} <-> face_of M c s)

items.name: FACE_OF_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx M, forall f' s' c= R :^: idx N, face_of M f s /\ face_of N f' s' -> face_of (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e f, {pastecart M N x y | y :e f'}) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e s'})

items.name: FACE_OF_PCROSS_DECOMP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall s' c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), face_of (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) c (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e s'}) <-> exists f c= R :^: idx M, exists f' c= R :^: idx N, face_of M f s /\ (face_of N f' s' /\ c = \/_ x :e f, {pastecart M N x y | y :e f'})

items.name: FACE_OF_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx M, forall f' s' c= R :^: idx N, face_of (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e f, {pastecart M N x y | y :e f'}) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e s'}) <-> f = Empty \/ (f' = Empty \/ face_of M f s /\ face_of N f' s')

items.name: FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ (face_of N c s /\ (~ c = Empty /\ ~ c = s)) -> c = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | facet_of N f s /\ c c= f}, x :e Y}

items.name: FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), b x :e R) -> finite f /\ (s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ ((forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> ~ a h = vec N 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h) x <= b h}) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ f' <> f -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} /\ s <> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y}))) -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, face_of N c s /\ (~ c = Empty /\ ~ c = s) -> c = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h) x = b h} | h :e Power (R :^: idx N), h :e f /\ c c= s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h) x = b h}}, x :e Y}

items.name: FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON_FACE_OF_FACET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ (face_of N c s /\ (~ c = Empty /\ ~ c = s)) -> exists f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N c f /\ facet_of N f s

items.name: FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ face_of N c s -> polyhedron N c

items.name: FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON_SUBSET_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), b x :e R) -> finite f /\ (s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ ((forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> ~ a h = vec N 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h) x <= b h}) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ f' <> f -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} /\ s <> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y}))) -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, face_of N c s /\ (~ c = Empty /\ ~ c = s) -> exists h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f /\ c c= s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h) x = b h}

items.name: FACE_OF_POLYHEDRON_SUBSET_FACET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ (face_of N c s /\ (~ c = Empty /\ ~ c = s)) -> exists f c= R :^: idx N, facet_of N f s /\ c c= f

items.name: FACE_OF_POLYTOPE_INSERT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, polytope N s /\ ~ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> (face_of N f (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s a)) <-> face_of N f s \/ exists f' c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f' s /\ f = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin f' a))

items.name: FACE_OF_POLYTOPE_POLYTOPE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s /\ face_of N f s -> polytope N f

items.name: FACE_OF_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s -> face_of A s s

items.name: FACE_OF_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, face_of A s s <-> convex A s

items.name: FACE_OF_SIMPLEX_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s f c= R :^: idx N, simplex N n s /\ face_of N f s -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c c= {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s} /\ f = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} c

items.name: FACE_OF_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, face_of A {x} s <-> extreme_point_of A x s

items.name: FACE_OF_SLICE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f s t c= R :^: idx A, face_of A f s /\ convex A t -> face_of A (f :/\: t) (s :/\: t)

items.name: FACE_OF_STILLCONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (face_of N t s <-> t c= s /\ (convex N (s :\: t) /\ t = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t :/\: s))

items.name: FACE_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f s t c= R :^: idx A, face_of A f s /\ (f c= t /\ t c= s) -> face_of A f t

items.name: FACE_OF_SUBSET_FRONTIER_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ aff_dim N f < dimindex N -> f c= frontier N s

items.name: FACE_OF_SUBSET_RELATIVE_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ ~ f = s -> f c= s :\: relative_interior N s

items.name: FACE_OF_SUBSET_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ ~ f = s -> f c= relative_frontier N s

items.name: FACE_OF_SUBSET_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_AFF_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ aff_dim N f < aff_dim N s -> f c= relative_frontier N s

items.name: FACE_OF_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx A, face_of A s t /\ face_of A t u -> face_of A s u

items.name: FACE_OF_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall f s c= R :^: idx N, face_of N {vector_add N a x | x :e f} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> face_of N f s

items.name: FACT
items.statement: factorial 0 = 1 /\ forall n :e omega, factorial (ordsucc n) = ordsucc n * factorial n

items.name: FACTORIZATION_INDEX
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ 2 <= p -> exists k :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ k) n /\ forall l :e omega, k < l -> ~ divides_nat (p ^ l) n

items.name: FACTOR_CONTINUOUS_THROUGH_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b l :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = drop l)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> f x = g (lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f))) /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,l) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,l) seq_nil) /\ v :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,l) seq_nil) -> distance N (g u,g v) <= distance 1 (u,v)) /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,l) seq_nil)) /\ ({lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f) | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,l) seq_nil) /\ ({g x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,l) seq_nil)} = {f x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,l) seq_nil) -> vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,x) seq_nil)) g = drop x))))))

items.name: FACTOR_THROUGH_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> f x = g (lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f))) /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N g {lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,u) seq_nil)) f) | u :e R :^: idx 1, u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e {lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,u) seq_nil)) f) | u :e R :^: idx 1, u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} /\ y :e {lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,u) seq_nil)) f) | u :e R :^: idx 1, u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} -> distance N (g x,g y) <= distance 1 (x,y)))

items.name: FACT_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 1 <= factorial n

items.name: FACT_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 < factorial n

items.name: FACT_MONO
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> factorial m <= factorial n

items.name: FACT_NZ
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ factorial n = 0

items.name: FARKAS_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx M, (exists x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = b /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 <= x i) <-> ~ exists y :e R :^: idx M, dot M b y < 0 /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 <= matrix_vector_mul N M (transp M N A) y i

items.name: FARKAS_LEMMA_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx M, (exists x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> matrix_vector_mul M N A x i <= b i) <-> ~ exists y :e R :^: idx M, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> 0 <= y i) /\ (vector_matrix_mul M N y A = vec N 0 /\ dot M b y < 0)

items.name: FASHODA
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, path (idx_n 2) f /\ (path (idx_n 2) g /\ (path_image (idx_n 2) f c= closed_interval (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (path_image (idx_n 2) g c= closed_interval (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (pathstart (idx_n 2) f 1 = a 1 /\ (pathfinish (idx_n 2) f 1 = b 1 /\ (pathstart (idx_n 2) g 2 = a 2 /\ pathfinish (idx_n 2) g 2 = b 2)))))) -> exists z :e R :^: idx_n 2, z :e path_image (idx_n 2) f /\ z :e path_image (idx_n 2) g

items.name: FASHODA_INTERLACE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, path (idx_n 2) f /\ (path (idx_n 2) g /\ (path_image (idx_n 2) f c= closed_interval (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (path_image (idx_n 2) g c= closed_interval (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (pathstart (idx_n 2) f 2 = a 2 /\ (pathfinish (idx_n 2) f 2 = a 2 /\ (pathstart (idx_n 2) g 2 = a 2 /\ (pathfinish (idx_n 2) g 2 = a 2 /\ (pathstart (idx_n 2) f 1 < pathstart (idx_n 2) g 1 /\ (pathstart (idx_n 2) g 1 < pathfinish (idx_n 2) f 1 /\ pathfinish (idx_n 2) f 1 < pathfinish (idx_n 2) g 1))))))))) -> exists z :e R :^: idx_n 2, z :e path_image (idx_n 2) f /\ z :e path_image (idx_n 2) g

items.name: FASHODA_UNIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> {f x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_neg 1 (vec 1 1),vec 1 1) seq_nil)} c= closed_interval (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (vector_neg (idx_n 2) (vec (idx_n 2) 1),vec (idx_n 2) 1) seq_nil) /\ ({g x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_neg 1 (vec 1 1),vec 1 1) seq_nil)} c= closed_interval (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (vector_neg (idx_n 2) (vec (idx_n 2) 1),vec (idx_n 2) 1) seq_nil) /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 (idx_n 2) f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_neg 1 (vec 1 1),vec 1 1) seq_nil)) /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 (idx_n 2) g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_neg 1 (vec 1 1),vec 1 1) seq_nil)) /\ (f (vector_neg 1 (vec 1 1)) 1 = - 1 /\ (f (vec 1 1) 1 = 1 /\ (g (vector_neg 1 (vec 1 1)) 2 = - 1 /\ g (vec 1 1) 2 = 1)))))) -> exists s t :e R :^: idx 1, s :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_neg 1 (vec 1 1),vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_neg 1 (vec 1 1),vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ f s = g t)

items.name: FASHODA_UNIT_PATH

items.name: FATOU
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, negligible N t /\ ((forall n :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f n) s) /\ ((forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: t -> 0 <= drop (f n x)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: t -> tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially) /\ (forall n :e omega, drop (integral 1 N s (f n)) <= B)))) -> integrable_on 1 N g s /\ (0 <= drop (integral 1 N s g) /\ drop (integral 1 N s g) <= B)

items.name: FILTER

items.name: FINE_SIMPLICIAL_SUBDIVISION_OF_CELL_COMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (finite m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> polytope N c) /\ (forall c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, c1 :e m /\ c2 :e m -> face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c1 /\ face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c2))) -> exists t c= Power (R :^: idx N), simplicial_complex N t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> diameter N k < e0) /\ (Union t = Union m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (f c= t /\ c = Union f)) /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m /\ k c= c)))

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall d :e int, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (finite m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> polytope N c) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> aff_dim N c = d) /\ (forall c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, c1 :e m /\ c2 :e m -> face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c1 /\ face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c2)))) -> exists t c= Power (R :^: idx N), triangulation N t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> diameter N k < e0) /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> aff_dim N k = d) /\ (Union t = Union m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (f c= t /\ c = Union f)) /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m /\ k c= c))))
