items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall n :e omega, s c= t /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t <= n) -> finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= n

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall m n :e omega, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= m /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t <= n) -> finite (s :\/: t) /\ finite_cardinality (s :\/: t) <= m + n

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> finite (t x) /\ finite_cardinality (t x) <= n) /\ (finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= m) -> finite (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) /\ finite_cardinality (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) <= m * n

items.name: FINITE_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s <-> atleastp s omega /\ ~ equip s omega

items.name: FINITE_CART
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> finite {x :e A | P i x}) -> finite {v :e A :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (v i)}

items.name: FINITE_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, finite {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ exists a :e A, s i c= {a}} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> finite (s i)

items.name: FINITE_CART_SUBSET_LEMMA
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m n :e omega, finite (\/_ i :e omega, {(i,j) | j :e omega, i :e idx_n m /\ (j :e idx_n n /\ P i j)})

items.name: FINITE_CART_UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> finite A -> finite (A :^: idx N)

items.name: FINITE_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a c= A, finite a <-> a = Empty \/ exists x :e A, exists s c= A, a = SetAdjoin s x /\ finite s

items.name: FINITE_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, finite (cball N (a,r)) <-> r <= 0

items.name: FINITE_CIRCLE_INTERSECTION
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, forall r s :e R, finite (sphere (idx_n 2) (a,r) :/\: sphere (idx_n 2) (b,s)) <-> ~ (a = b /\ (r = s /\ (0 < r /\ 0 < s)))

items.name: FINITE_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite 1 /\ (finite (idx_n (2 * dimindex A)) /\ finite (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1)))

items.name: FINITE_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, finite (columns M N A)

items.name: FINITE_COMPLEMENT_ANR_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ ANR N s -> finite (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s))

items.name: FINITE_COMPLEMENT_ENR_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ ENR N s -> finite (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s))

items.name: FINITE_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> finite (components N s)

items.name: FINITE_COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENT_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> finite (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s))

items.name: FINITE_COMPONENTS_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> finite (components N s)

items.name: FINITE_COMPONENTS_MEETING_COMPACT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k s c= R :^: idx N, compact N k /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s /\ k c= s) -> finite {c :e Power (R :^: idx N) | c :e components N s /\ ~ c :/\: k = Empty}

items.name: FINITE_COMPONENTS_PUNCTURED_CONNECTED_SUBSET_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s c= sphere N (a,r) /\ b :e interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (a,r))) s) -> finite (components N (s :\: {b}))

items.name: FINITE_COMPONENTS_PUNCTURED_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s -> finite (components N (s :\: {a}))

items.name: FINITE_COMPONENTS_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, finite (components N s) /\ finite (components N t) -> finite (components N (s :\/: t))

items.name: FINITE_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_CLOPEN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall C s c= A, locally_connected_space A top /\ (C :e top /\ (closed_in A top C /\ (C c= topspace A top /\ (s c= C /\ (finite (connected_components_of A top) /\ finite (connected_components_of A (subtopology A top (C :\: s)))))))) -> finite (connected_components_of A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: s)))

items.name: FINITE_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_COMPACT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) -> finite (connected_components_of A (mtopology A m))

items.name: FINITE_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, finite (topspace A top) -> finite (connected_components_of A top)

items.name: FINITE_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (s :*: t)

items.name: FINITE_CROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ finite s /\ finite t)

items.name: FINITE_CROSS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (finite (A :*: B) <-> finite A /\ finite B)

items.name: FINITE_CYCLIC_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (finite (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x})) <-> exists n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ group_pow A G x n = group_id A G)

items.name: FINITE_CYCLIC_SUBGROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (finite (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x})) <-> exists n :e int, ~ n = 0 /\ group_zpow A G x n = group_id A G)

items.name: FINITE_CYCLIC_SUBGROUP_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, finite (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x})) /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x}) = {group_pow A G x n | n :e omega, n < group_element_order_hl A G x}

items.name: FINITE_CYCLIC_SUBGROUP_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (finite (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x})) <-> ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0)

items.name: FINITE_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, finite (s :\: {x}) <-> finite s

items.name: FINITE_DELETE_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, finite s -> finite (s :\: {x})

items.name: FINITE_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, finite s -> finite (s :\: t)

items.name: FINITE_DIFF_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, idx_n (if dimindex B < dimindex A then minus_nat (dimindex A) (dimindex B) else 1) = idx_n (if dimindex B < dimindex A then minus_nat (dimindex A) (dimindex B) else 1)

items.name: FINITE_DIVISORS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> finite {d :e omega | divides_nat d n}

items.name: FINITE_EIGENVALUES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, finite {c :e R | exists v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v}

items.name: FINITE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite Empty

items.name: FINITE_ENR_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ENR N s /\ compact N s -> finite (components N s)

items.name: FINITE_EQ_BOUNDED_DISCRETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s <-> bounded_hl N s /\ exists r :e R, 0 < r /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N y x) < r) -> x = y

items.name: FINITE_EXP_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall p n :e omega, 2 <= p -> finite {j :e omega | P j /\ p ^ j <= n}

items.name: FINITE_FACES_OF_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx A, simplex A n s -> finite {f :e Power (R :^: idx A) | face_of A f s}

items.name: FINITE_FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite (idx A)

items.name: FINITE_FINITE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall t c= B, finite t /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> finite {x :e A | f x = y}) -> finite {x :e A | f x :e t}

items.name: FINITE_FINITE_PREIMAGE_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y}) -> finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: FINITE_FINITE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, finite s -> (finite (Union s) <-> forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t)

items.name: FINITE_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, finite (fld_on A l) <-> finite (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e A, l x y})

items.name: FINITE_FRAG_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e frag A, finite (frag_support A x)

items.name: FINITE_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = d}

items.name: FINITE_FUNSPACE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> finite A /\ finite B -> finite (B :^: A)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_ACTIONS
items.statement: forall A B X:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e X :^: X :^: A, f x :e B) -> finitely_generated_group_hl A G /\ (finite s /\ (forall a a' :e X :^: X :^: A, (forall g :e A, forall x :e X, g :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s -> a g x = a' g x) -> f a = f a')) -> finite {f a | a :e X :^: X :^: A, group_action_hl A X G s (fun x:set => fun x0:set => a x x0)}

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_CENTRALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) -> finite (group_centralizer A G s)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ finite (group_carrier A G) -> finite (group_carrier B H)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_MONOMORPHIC_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_monomorphism A B (G,H) f /\ finite (group_carrier B H) -> finite (group_carrier A G)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_NORMALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) -> finite (group_normalizer A G s)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_ORBIT
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, finite (group_carrier A G) \/ finite s -> finite {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0}

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_POW_INJECTIVE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) -> ((forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_pow A G x n = group_pow A G y n) -> x = y) <-> gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_POW_SURJECTIVE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) -> ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> exists y :e A, y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_pow A G y n = x) <-> gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_ROOT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1 /\ x :e group_carrier A G) -> exists y :e A, y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_pow A G y n = x

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_SETMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (group_setmul A G s t)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_STABILIZER
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, finite (group_carrier A G) -> finite (group_stabilizer A X G a x)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_ZPOW_INJECTIVE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e int, finite (group_carrier A G) -> ((forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_zpow A G x n = group_zpow A G y n) -> x = y) <-> gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_ZPOW_SURJECTIVE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e int, finite (group_carrier A G) -> ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> exists y :e A, y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_zpow A G y n = x) <-> gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1)

items.name: FINITE_GROUP_ZROOT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e int, forall x :e A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1 /\ x :e group_carrier A G) -> exists y :e A, y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_zpow A G y n = x

items.name: FINITE_HAS_SIZE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s <-> equip s (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {f x | x :e s}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite {f x | x :e s} <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t})

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_EQ_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite {f x | x :e s} <-> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t} /\ forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)))

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_EXPAND
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {y :e B | exists x :e A, x :e s /\ y = f x}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (finite t /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> g x = g y)) -> finite {g x | x :e s}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, idx A = idx A

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, infinite s /\ finite {f x | x :e s} -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ infinite {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = f a}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall A0 c= B, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ finite A0 -> finite {x :e A | f x :e A0}

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_INJ_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> (finite {f x | x :e s} <-> finite s)

items.name: FINITE_IMAGE_INJ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall A0 c= B, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ finite A0 -> finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e A0}

items.name: FINITE_IMP_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> ANR N s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> bounded_hl N s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_BOUNDED_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s -> bounded_hl A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s)

items.name: FINITE_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s -> closed A s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, finite s /\ s c= t -> closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) t) s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s -> compact A s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_COMPACT_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> compact N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: FINITE_IMP_COMPACT_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ finite s -> compact_in A top s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_COMPACT_IN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, finite s -> (compact_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top)

items.name: FINITE_IMP_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> countable s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_DIMENSION_LE_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> dimension N s <= 0

items.name: FINITE_IMP_ENR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> ENR N s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_FINITELY_GENERATED_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finite (group_carrier A G) -> finitely_generated_group_hl A G

items.name: FINITE_IMP_LOCALLY_FINITE_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, finite u /\ Union u c= topspace A top -> locally_finite_in A top u

items.name: FINITE_IMP_MATROID_FINITE_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ s c= matroid_set A m -> s :e matroid_finite_dim A m

items.name: FINITE_IMP_MATROID_FINITE_DIM_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ s c= matroid_set A m -> {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} :e matroid_finite_dim A m

items.name: FINITE_IMP_NOT_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> ~ open N s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ s c= mspace A m -> totally_bounded_in A m s

items.name: FINITE_IMP_TOTALLY_DISCONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> components N s = {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {x}} | x :e s}

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_INJ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex A /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex A)) -> (i = j <-> i = j)

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_INRANGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, exists k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ forall x :e A :^: idx N, x i = x k)

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_INRANGE_2
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, exists k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ ((forall x :e A :^: idx N, x i = x k) /\ forall y :e B :^: idx N, y i = y k))

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_NUMBERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s <-> exists k c= omega, exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall i j :e omega, i :e k /\ (j :e k /\ f i = f j) -> i = j) /\ (finite k /\ s = {f x | x :e k}))

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall i j :e omega, i :e idx_n (finite_cardinality s) /\ (j :e idx_n (finite_cardinality s) /\ f i = f j) -> i = j) /\ s = {f x | x :e idx_n (finite_cardinality s)})

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_NUMSEG_SPECIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall i j :e omega, i :e idx_n (finite_cardinality s) /\ (j :e idx_n (finite_cardinality s) /\ f i = f j) -> i = j) /\ (s = {f x | x :e idx_n (finite_cardinality s)} /\ f 1 = a))

items.name: FINITE_INDEX_WORKS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall i :e idx A, exists n :e omega, 1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex A /\ n = i) /\ forall y :e omega, 1 <= y /\ (y <= dimindex A /\ y = i) -> y = n

items.name: FINITE_INDICES
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall p n :e omega, 2 <= p /\ ~ n = 0 -> finite {j :e omega | P j /\ divides_nat (p ^ j) n}

items.name: FINITE_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall FINITE':set -> prop, FINITE' Empty /\ (forall x :e A, forall s c= A, FINITE' s -> FINITE' (SetAdjoin s x)) -> forall a c= A, finite a -> FINITE' a

items.name: FINITE_INDUCT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ (forall s c= A, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ (P (s :\: {x}) -> P s)) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> P s

items.name: FINITE_INDUCT_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ (forall x :e A, forall s c= A, P s /\ (~ x :e s /\ finite s) -> P (SetAdjoin s x)) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> P s

items.name: FINITE_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, finite (SetAdjoin s x) <-> finite s

items.name: FINITE_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite (group_carrier int (integer_mod_group n)) <-> ~ n = 0

items.name: FINITE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s \/ finite t -> finite (s :/\: t)

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ Union u = A :\: s

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x0) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :/\: t

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, finite u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u c= A, relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e P) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} u = relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u0 c= Power A, finite u0 /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A P u) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u0, x0 :e Y} = x} u

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u s c= A, P u -> (s :e relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} u <-> (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ s c= u)

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s :\/: t

items.name: FINITE_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, finite (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> drop b <= drop a) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, finite (open_interval 1 (a,b)) <-> drop b <= drop a

items.name: FINITE_INTER_COLLINEAR_OPEN_SEGMENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, collinear N {a,b,c} -> (finite (open_segment N (a,b) :/\: open_segment N (c,d)) <-> open_segment N (a,b) :/\: open_segment N (c,d) = Empty)

items.name: FINITE_INTER_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall s c= omega, forall m n :e omega, finite (s :/\: {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n})

items.name: FINITE_INTSEG
items.statement: forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | x :e int /\ (a <= x /\ x <= b)}

items.name: FINITE_INT_SEG
items.statement: (forall l r :e int, finite {x :e int | l <= x /\ x <= r}) /\ ((forall l r :e int, finite {x :e int | l <= x /\ x < r}) /\ ((forall l r :e int, finite {x :e int | l < x /\ x <= r}) /\ forall l r :e int, finite {x :e int | l < x /\ x < r}))

items.name: FINITE_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> finite {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}

items.name: FINITE_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_PATH_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s -> finite {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}

items.name: FINITE_MULTIVECTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> finite (multivector N)

items.name: FINITE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, finite {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: FINITE_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite {m :e omega | m <= n}

items.name: FINITE_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finite {m :e omega | m < n}

items.name: FINITE_OPPOSITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finite (group_carrier A (opposite_group A G)) <-> finite (group_carrier A G)

items.name: FINITE_PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, finite (topspace A top) -> finite (path_components_of A top)

items.name: FINITE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: FINITE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, finite (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ finite s /\ finite t)

items.name: FINITE_PERMUTATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s}

items.name: FINITE_PGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, forall G :e group_hl A, finite (group_carrier A G) -> (pgroup A s G <-> forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) -> p :e s)

items.name: FINITE_PGROUP_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ prime_nat p -> (pgroup A {p} G <-> exists k :e omega, finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G) = p ^ k)

items.name: FINITE_POLYHEDRON_EXPOSED_FACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> finite {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | exposed_face_of N f s}

items.name: FINITE_POLYHEDRON_EXTREME_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> finite {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s}

items.name: FINITE_POLYHEDRON_FACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> finite {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N f s}

items.name: FINITE_POLYHEDRON_FACETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> finite {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | facet_of N f s}

items.name: FINITE_POLYTOPE_FACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s -> finite {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N f s}

items.name: FINITE_POLYTOPE_FACETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s -> finite {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | facet_of N f s}

items.name: FINITE_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {t :e Power A | t c= s}

items.name: FINITE_POWERSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite {t :e Power A | t c= s} <-> finite s

items.name: FINITE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: FINITE_PRODUCT_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> finite (t x)) -> finite (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t x})

items.name: FINITE_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> (finite (group_carrier (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G)) <-> finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ trivial_group A (G i)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> finite (group_carrier A (G i)))

items.name: FINITE_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, finite (group_carrier (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G H)) <-> finite (group_carrier A G) /\ finite (group_carrier B H)

items.name: FINITE_PROD_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, idx_n (dimindex A * dimindex B) = idx_n (dimindex A * dimindex B)

items.name: FINITE_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, finite (topspace A top) -> finite (quasi_components_of A top)

items.name: FINITE_QUOTIENT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ normal_subgroup_of A n G -> finite (group_carrier (Power A) (quotient_group A G n))

items.name: FINITE_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a :e R, ~ finite {x :e R | a < x}) /\ ((forall a :e R, ~ finite {x :e R | a <= x}) /\ ((forall b :e R, ~ finite {x :e R | x < b}) /\ ((forall b :e R, ~ finite {x :e R | x <= b}) /\ ((forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | a < x /\ x < b} <-> b <= a) /\ ((forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | a <= x /\ x < b} <-> b <= a) /\ ((forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | a < x /\ x <= b} <-> b <= a) /\ forall a b :e R, finite {x :e R | a <= x /\ x <= b} <-> b <= a))))))

items.name: FINITE_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, (forall x y :e A, forall s :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s)) -> set_foldr f Empty b = b /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> set_foldr f (SetAdjoin s x) b = if x :e s then set_foldr f s b else f x (set_foldr f s b)

items.name: FINITE_RECURSION_DELETE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, (forall x y :e A, forall s :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s)) -> set_foldr f Empty b = b /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> set_foldr f s b = if x :e s then f x (set_foldr f (s :\: {x}) b) else set_foldr f (s :\: {x}) b

items.name: FINITE_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, finite s -> finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x}

items.name: FINITE_RESTRICTED_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e A, k x :e B) -> finite s /\ finite t -> finite {f :e B :^: A | {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ {x :e A | ~ f x = k x} c= s}

items.name: FINITE_RESTRICTED_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, finite {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ equip t n} <-> finite s \/ n = 0

items.name: FINITE_RESTRICTED_SUBGROUPS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall G :e group_hl A, finite (group_carrier A G) -> finite {h :e Power A | subgroup_of A h G /\ P h}

items.name: FINITE_RESTRICTED_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {t :e Power A | t c= s /\ P t}

items.name: FINITE_ROWS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, finite (rows M N A)

items.name: FINITE_RULES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite Empty /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> finite (SetAdjoin s x)

items.name: FINITE_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, finite (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> a = b) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, finite (open_segment N (a,b)) <-> a = b

items.name: FINITE_SET_AVOID
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ ~ x = a -> d <= distance N (a,x)

items.name: FINITE_SET_OF_LIST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, finite (seq_set l)

items.name: FINITE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, finite {a}

items.name: FINITE_SINGLETON_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, finite (group_carrier A (singleton_group A a))

items.name: FINITE_SPECIAL_DIVISORS
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> finite {d :e omega | P d /\ divides_nat d n}

items.name: FINITE_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, finite (sphere N (a,r)) <-> r <= 0 \/ dimindex N = 1

items.name: FINITE_SPHERE_1
items.statement: forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall r :e R, finite (sphere 1 (a,r))

items.name: FINITE_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> finite {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N}

items.name: FINITE_SUBGROUPS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finite (group_carrier A G) -> finite {h :e Power A | subgroup_of A h G}

items.name: FINITE_SUBGROUPS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finite {h :e Power A | subgroup_of A h G} <-> finite (group_carrier A G)

items.name: FINITE_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) -> finite (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s))

items.name: FINITE_SUBGROUP_OF_SETWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, finite s -> (subgroup_of A s G <-> s c= group_carrier A G /\ (~ s = Empty /\ group_setmul A G s s c= s))

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, finite t /\ s c= t -> finite s

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} <-> exists s' c= A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ t = {f x | x :e s'})

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_IMAGE_IMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite t /\ t c= {f x | x :e s} -> exists s' c= A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ t c= {f x | x :e s'})

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall s c= omega, finite s <-> exists n :e omega, s c= {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ s c= Union f -> exists f' c= Power A, finite f' /\ (f' c= f /\ s c= Union f')

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ (s c= Union f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall t u c= A, t :e f /\ u :e f -> t c= u \/ u c= t))) -> exists t c= A, t :e f /\ s c= t

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_CHAIN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, ~ f = Empty /\ ((forall t u c= A, t :e f /\ u :e f -> t c= u \/ u c= t) /\ finite s) -> (s c= Union f <-> exists t c= A, t :e f /\ s c= t)

items.name: FINITE_SUBSET_UNIONS_DIRECTED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, ~ f = Empty /\ ((forall t u c= A, t :e f /\ u :e f -> exists v c= A, v :e f /\ (t c= v /\ u c= v)) /\ finite s) -> (s c= Union f <-> exists t c= A, t :e f /\ s c= t)

items.name: FINITE_SUM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B) = idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)

items.name: FINITE_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op}

items.name: FINITE_SUPPORT_DELTA
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, finite {x :e s | (if x = a then f x else neutral_of B op) <> neutral_of B op}

items.name: FINITE_T1_SPACE_IMP_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, topspace A top = u /\ (finite u /\ t1_space A top) -> top = discrete_topology A u

items.name: FINITE_TOPSPACE_IMP_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = u /\ (finite u /\ hausdorff_space A top) -> top = discrete_topology A u

items.name: FINITE_TRANSITIVITY_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, ~ R0 x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e A, y :e s /\ R0 x y))) -> s = Empty

items.name: FINITE_TYBIT0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite (idx_n (2 * dimindex A))

items.name: FINITE_TYBIT1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> finite (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1))

items.name: FINITE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite (s :\/: t) <-> finite s /\ finite t

items.name: FINITE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, finite (Union s) <-> finite s /\ forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t

items.name: FINITE_UNION_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ finite t -> finite (s :\/: t)

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall s0 :e u, P (A :\: s0)) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A :\: s

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = Empty

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall x0 :e u, exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x0) /\ Union u = x) <-> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P s -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INTER_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t) <-> forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :/\: t

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u x c= A, x :e relative_to A {x0 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e P) /\ Union u = x0} u <-> exists u0 c= Power A, finite u0 /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A P u) /\ Union u0 = x

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s :\/: t

items.name: FINITE_UNION_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) -> exists u0 c= Power A, finite u0 /\ (forall c :e u0, P c) /\ Union u0 = Union u

items.name: FINITE_UNIV_PAIR
items.statement: forall A:set, finite (A :*: A) <-> finite A

items.name: FINREC_FUN_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall R0:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall s :e A, P s -> exists a :e B, exists n :e C, R0 s a n) /\ (forall n1 n2 :e C, forall s :e A, forall a1 a2 :e B, R0 s a1 n1 /\ R0 s a2 n2 -> a1 = a2 /\ n1 = n2) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ forall s :e A, forall a :e B, P s -> ((exists n :e C, R0 s a n) <-> f s = a)

items.name: FIRST_COUNTABLE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, first_countable A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: FIRST_COUNTABLE_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, first_countable A (mtopology A m)

items.name: FIRST_COUNTABLE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, first_countable A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists b c= Power A, countable b /\ neighbourhood_base_at A x b top

items.name: FIRST_COUNTABLE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, first_countable A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists b c= Power A, countable b /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e b -> v :e top) /\ neighbourhood_base_at A x b top)

items.name: FIRST_COUNTABLE_OPEN_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (open_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ first_countable A top)) -> first_countable B top'

items.name: FIRST_COUNTABLE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ first_countable A top -> first_countable B top'

items.name: FIRST_COUNTABLE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, first_countable A top -> first_countable A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: FIRST_GROUP_EPIMORPHISM_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,G') f -> isomorphic_group (Power A) B (quotient_group A G (group_kernel A B (G,G') f)) G'

items.name: FIRST_GROUP_ISOMORPHISM_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f -> isomorphic_group (Power A) B (quotient_group A G (group_kernel A B (G,G') f)) (subgroup_generated B G' (group_image A B (G,G') f))

items.name: FIRST_GROUP_ISOMORPHISM_THEOREM_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall j c= A, forall k c= B, group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ (normal_subgroup_of B k H /\ {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ f x :e k} = j) -> isomorphic_group (Power A) (Power B) (quotient_group A G j) (quotient_group B H k)

items.name: FIRST_GROUP_ISOMORPHISM_THEOREM_GEN_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall j c= A, forall k c= B, group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ (normal_subgroup_of A j G /\ (group_kernel A B (G,H) f c= j /\ {f x | x :e j} = k)) -> isomorphic_group (Power A) (Power B) (quotient_group A G j) (quotient_group B H k)

items.name: FIVE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_ C C_ D D_ E E_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> C_ <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> D_ <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> E_ <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall h :e D :^: C, forall k :e E :^: D, forall f' :e B_ :^: A_, forall g' :e C_ :^: B_, forall h' :e D_ :^: C_, forall k' :e E_ :^: D_, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e A_) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e B, b x :e B_) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e C, c x :e C_) -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e D, d x :e D_) -> forall e0:set -> set, (forall x :e E, e0 x :e E_) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall D0 :e group_hl D, forall E0 :e group_hl E, forall A' :e group_hl A_, forall B' :e group_hl B_, forall C' :e group_hl C_, forall D' :e group_hl D_, forall E' :e group_hl E_, group_epimorphism A A_ (A0,A') a /\ (group_isomorphism_hl B B_ (B0,B') b /\ (group_homomorphism_hl C C_ (C0,C') c /\ (group_isomorphism_hl D D_ (D0,D') d /\ (group_monomorphism E E_ (E0,E') e0 /\ (group_exactness A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_exactness B C D (B0,(C0,D0)) (g,h) /\ (group_exactness C D E (C0,(D0,E0)) (h,k) /\ (group_exactness A_ B_ C_ (A',(B',C')) (f',g') /\ (group_exactness B_ C_ D_ (B',(C',D')) (g',h') /\ (group_exactness C_ D_ E_ (C',(D',E')) (h',k') /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A A0 -> f' (a x) = b (f x)) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e group_carrier B B0 -> g' (b y) = c (g y)) /\ ((forall z :e C, z :e group_carrier C C0 -> h' (c z) = d (h z)) /\ (forall w :e D, w :e group_carrier D D0 -> k' (d w) = e0 (k w))))))))))))))) -> group_isomorphism_hl C C_ (C0,C') c

items.name: FIXED_POINT_INESSENTIAL_SPHERE_MAP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, 0 < r /\ homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (a,r)),subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (a,r))) f (fun x:set => c) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e sphere N (a,r) /\ f x = x

items.name: FIXING_SWAPSEQ_DECREASE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall a b :e A, swapseq A n p /\ (~ a = b /\ swap A (a,b) (p a) = a) -> ~ n = 0 /\ swapseq A (minus_nat n 1) (fun x:set => swap A (a,b) (p x))

items.name: FIXPOINT_HOMOTOPIC_IDENTITY_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> odd_nat (dimindex N) /\ homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (vec N 0,1)),subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (vec N 0,1))) (fun x:set => x) f -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e sphere N (vec N 0,1) /\ f x = x

items.name: FIXPOINT_OR_NEG_MAPPING_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> odd_nat (dimindex N) /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f (sphere N (vec N 0,1)) /\ {f x | x :e sphere N (vec N 0,1)} c= sphere N (vec N 0,1)) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e sphere N (vec N 0,1) /\ (f x = vector_neg N x \/ f x = x)

items.name: FLATTEN_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) <-> forall y :e B, forall x :e A, x :e s /\ y = f x -> g y = x)

items.name: FLD_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, fld_on A R0 = Empty <-> forall x y :e A, R0 x y <-> False

items.name: FLD_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= K, qoset_on A l -> fld_on (A :^: K) (fun x:set => fun y:set => forall i :e K, i :e s -> l (x i) (y i)) = {x :e A :^: K | forall i :e K, i :e s -> x i :e fld_on A l}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> forall P:set -> prop, x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun y:set => P x0 /\ (P y /\ l x0 y)) <-> P x /\ x :e fld_on A l

items.name: FLD_RESTRICTED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall x c= A, x :e fld_on (Power A) (fun x0:set => fun y:set => P x0 /\ (P y /\ x0 c= y)) <-> P x

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_POSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, poset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_TOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, toset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, woset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_RESTRICT_WQOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, wqoset_on A l -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y)) = {x :e A | x :e fld_on A l /\ P x}

items.name: FLD_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l r:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, l x y -> r x y) -> fld_on A l c= fld_on A r

items.name: FLD_SUC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun y:set => l x0 y \/ y = a /\ (x0 :e fld_on A l \/ x0 = a)) <-> x :e fld_on A l \/ x = a

items.name: FLD_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> fld_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False) = Empty

items.name: FLD_num
items.statement: fld_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0) = omega

items.name: FLOOR
items.statement: forall x :e R, floor_R x :e int /\ (floor_R x <= x /\ x < floor_R x + 1)

items.name: FLOOR_DIV_DIV
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> floor_R (n :/: m) = div_nat n m

items.name: FLOOR_DOUBLE
items.statement: forall u :e R, 2 * floor_R u <= floor_R (2 * u) /\ floor_R (2 * u) <= 2 * floor_R u + 1

items.name: FLOOR_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, floor_R x = 0 <-> 0 <= x /\ x < 1

items.name: FLOOR_FRAC
items.statement: forall x :e R, floor_R x :e int /\ (0 <= x + - floor_R x /\ (x + - floor_R x < 1 /\ x = floor_R x + x + - floor_R x))

items.name: FLOOR_MONO
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x <= y -> floor_R x <= floor_R y

items.name: FLOOR_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, floor_R n = n

items.name: FLOOR_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> exists n :e omega, floor_R x = n

items.name: FLOOR_POS_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= floor_R x <-> 0 <= x

items.name: FLOOR_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall x a :e R, a :e int /\ (a <= x /\ x < a + 1) <-> floor_R x = a

items.name: FORALL_1
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= 1 -> P i) <-> P 1

items.name: FORALL_2
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= 2 -> P i) <-> P 1 /\ P 2

items.name: FORALL_3
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= 3 -> P i) <-> P 1 /\ (P 2 /\ P 3)

items.name: FORALL_4

items.name: FORALL_ALL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq B, (forall x :e A, seq_all (P x) l) <-> seq_all (fun s:set => forall x :e A, P x s) l

items.name: FORALL_AND_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x /\ Q x) <-> (forall x :e A, P x) /\ forall x :e A, Q x

items.name: FORALL_BOOL_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall b:prop, P (if b then 1 else 0)) <-> P (if True then 1 else 0) /\ P (if False then 1 else 0)

items.name: FORALL_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, (forall z :e A :^: K, forall i :e K, z :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ i :e k -> P i (z i)) <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ x :e s i -> P i x

items.name: FORALL_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_ELEMENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, ~ {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty -> ((forall i :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ x :e s i -> P i x) <-> forall z :e A :^: K, forall i :e K, z :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ i :e k -> P i (z i))

items.name: FORALL_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall top :e topology A, (forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> P s) <-> forall s c= A, s :e top -> P (topspace A top :\: s)

items.name: FORALL_CLOSED_IN_HOMEOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall P:set -> prop, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f -> ((forall v c= B, closed_in B top' v -> P v) <-> forall u c= A, closed_in A top u -> P {f x | x :e u})
