items.statement: (forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e omega, P (prime_index p x)) <-> forall k :e omega, P k) /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e omega, ~ x = 0 -> P (prime_index p x)) <-> forall k :e omega, P k

items.name: FORALL_REAL_ONE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, P x) <-> forall x :e R, P (fun i :e idx 1 => x)

items.name: FORALL_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u c= A, forall Q:set -> prop, (forall s c= A, s :e relative_to A P u -> Q s) <-> forall s c= A, s :e P -> Q (u :/\: s)

items.name: FORALL_SETCODE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= omega, s c= idx_n n -> P (setcode s)) <-> forall i :e omega, i :e idx_n (2 ^ n) -> P i

items.name: FORALL_SIMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t:prop, (forall x :e A, t) <-> t

items.name: FORALL_SMALL_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (forall t c= B, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ t c= {f x | x :e s}) -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ t c= s) -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_SMALL_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (forall t c= B, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ t c= {f x | x :e s}) -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, finite t /\ (finite_cardinality t < n /\ (t c= s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)))) -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_SUBSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, t c= s -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_SUBSET_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall t c= B, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> P t) <-> forall t c= A, t c= s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) -> P {f x | x :e t}

items.name: FORALL_SUBSET_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall t c= A, (forall s c= A, s c= SetAdjoin t a -> P s) <-> forall s c= A, s c= t -> P s /\ P (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: FORALL_SUBSET_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall t u c= A, (forall s c= A, s c= t :\/: u -> P s) <-> forall t' u' c= A, t' c= t /\ u' c= u -> P (t' :\/: u')

items.name: FORALL_SUC
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> P n) <-> forall n :e omega, P (ordsucc n)

items.name: FORALL_SUM_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall z :e B :+: A, P z) <-> (forall x :e B, P (Inj0 x)) /\ forall x :e A, P (Inj1 x)

items.name: FORALL_TRIPLED_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), P (x 0) (x 1 0) (x 1 1)) <-> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, P x y z

items.name: FORALL_UNCURRY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall f :e C :^: B :^: A, P f) <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) -> P (fun a :e A => fun b :e B => f (a,b))

items.name: FORALL_UNION_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q R0:set -> prop, (forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s) -> R0 s) <-> forall t c= Power A, P t /\ (forall c c= A, c :e t -> Q c) -> R0 (Union t)

items.name: FORALL_UNPAIR_FUN_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: A, P f g) <-> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B :*: C) -> P (fun x :e A => h x 0) (fun x :e A => h x 1)

items.name: FORALL_UNPAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y) <-> forall z :e A :*: B, P (z 0) (z 1)

items.name: FORALL_UNWIND_THM1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, (forall x :e A, a = x -> P x) <-> P a

items.name: FORALL_UNWIND_THM2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, (forall x :e A, x = a -> P x) <-> P a

items.name: FORALL_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex B * dimindex C), P x) <-> forall x :e A :^: idx C :^: idx B, P (vectorize A B C x)

items.name: FORALL_VECTOR_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (forall v :e A :^: idx 1, P v) <-> forall x :e A, P (vector A 1 (seq_cons x seq_nil))

items.name: FORALL_VECTOR_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (forall v :e A :^: idx_n 2, P v) <-> forall x y :e A, P (vector A (idx_n 2) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y seq_nil)))

items.name: FORALL_VECTOR_3
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (forall v :e A :^: idx_n 3, P v) <-> forall x y z :e A, P (vector A (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil))))

items.name: FORALL_VECTOR_4
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, (forall v :e A :^: idx_n 4, P v) <-> forall w x y z :e A, P (vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))))

items.name: FOUR_LEMMA_EPI
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_ C C_ D D_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> C_ <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> D_ <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall h :e D :^: C, forall f' :e B_ :^: A_, forall g' :e C_ :^: B_, forall h' :e D_ :^: C_, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e A_) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e B, b x :e B_) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e C, c x :e C_) -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e D, d x :e D_) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall D0 :e group_hl D, forall A' :e group_hl A_, forall B' :e group_hl B_, forall C' :e group_hl C_, forall D' :e group_hl D_, group_epimorphism A A_ (A0,A') a /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B B_ (B0,B') b /\ (group_epimorphism C C_ (C0,C') c /\ (group_monomorphism D D_ (D0,D') d /\ (group_exactness A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_exactness B C D (B0,(C0,D0)) (g,h) /\ (group_exactness A_ B_ C_ (A',(B',C')) (f',g') /\ (group_exactness B_ C_ D_ (B',(C',D')) (g',h') /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A A0 -> f' (a x) = b (f x)) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e group_carrier B B0 -> g' (b y) = c (g y)) /\ (forall z :e C, z :e group_carrier C C0 -> h' (c z) = d (h z))))))))))) -> group_epimorphism B B_ (B0,B') b

items.name: FOUR_LEMMA_MONO
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_ C C_ D D_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> C_ <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> D_ <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall h :e D :^: C, forall f' :e B_ :^: A_, forall g' :e C_ :^: B_, forall h' :e D_ :^: C_, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e A_) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e B, b x :e B_) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e C, c x :e C_) -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e D, d x :e D_) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall D0 :e group_hl D, forall A' :e group_hl A_, forall B' :e group_hl B_, forall C' :e group_hl C_, forall D' :e group_hl D_, group_epimorphism A A_ (A0,A') a /\ (group_monomorphism B B_ (B0,B') b /\ (group_homomorphism_hl C C_ (C0,C') c /\ (group_monomorphism D D_ (D0,D') d /\ (group_exactness A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_exactness B C D (B0,(C0,D0)) (g,h) /\ (group_exactness A_ B_ C_ (A',(B',C')) (f',g') /\ (group_exactness B_ C_ D_ (B',(C',D')) (g',h') /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A A0 -> f' (a x) = b (f x)) /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e group_carrier B B0 -> g' (b y) = c (g y)) /\ (forall z :e C, z :e group_carrier C C0 -> h' (c z) = d (h z))))))))))) -> group_monomorphism C C_ (C0,C') c

items.name: FRAC_DIV_MOD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> m :/: n + - floor_R (m :/: n) = mod_nat m n :/: n

items.name: FRAC_FLOOR
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - floor_R x = x + - floor_R x

items.name: FRAC_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, - x + - floor_R (- x) = if x :e int then 0 else 1 + - (x + - floor_R x)

items.name: FRAC_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n + - floor_R n = 0

items.name: FRAC_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall x a :e R, x + - a :e int /\ (0 <= a /\ a < 1) <-> x + - floor_R x = a

items.name: FRAG_ADD_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c1 c2 :e frag A, frag_support A c1 :/\: frag_support A c2 = Empty /\ frag_add A c1 c2 = frag_0 A -> c1 = frag_0 A /\ c2 = frag_0 A

items.name: FRAG_CLOSURE_SUB_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P (frag_0 A) /\ (forall c1 c2 :e frag A, P c1 /\ P c2 -> P (frag_sub A c1 c2)) -> forall a :e int, forall c :e frag A, P c -> P (frag_cmul A a c)

items.name: FRAG_CMUL_SUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e frag A) -> forall k c= B, forall a :e int, frag_cmul A a (iterate_op (frag A) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add A a b) k f) = iterate_op (frag A) (fun a0:set => fun b:set => frag_add A a0 b) k (fun b:set => frag_cmul A a (f b))

items.name: FRAG_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall c1 c2 :e frag A, c1 = c2 <-> c1 = c2

items.name: FRAG_EXPANSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e frag A, x = frag_extend A A (fun x0:set => frag_of A x0) x

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> forall x :e frag A, frag_extend A B f x = iterate_op (frag B) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add B a b) A (fun a:set => frag_cmul B (x a) (f a))

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> frag_extend A B f (frag_0 A) = frag_0 B

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> forall x y :e frag A, frag_extend A B f (frag_add A x y) = frag_add B (frag_extend A B f x) (frag_extend A B f y)

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> forall c :e int, forall x :e frag A, frag_extend A B f (frag_cmul A c x) = frag_cmul B c (frag_extend A B f x)

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e frag C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall c :e frag A, frag_extend B C f (frag_extend A B (fun x:set => frag_of B (g x)) c) = frag_extend A C (fun x:set => f (g x)) c

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e frag B) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e frag B) -> forall c :e frag A, (forall f :e A, f :e frag_support A c -> g f = h f) -> frag_extend A B g c = frag_extend A B h c

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> forall c :e frag A, (forall a :e A, a :e frag_support A c -> f a = frag_0 B) -> frag_extend A B f c = frag_0 B

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_NEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> forall x :e frag A, frag_extend A B f (frag_neg A x) = frag_neg B (frag_extend A B f x)

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> forall a :e A, frag_extend A B f (frag_of A a) = f a

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_SUB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> forall x y :e frag A, frag_extend A B f (frag_sub A x y) = frag_sub B (frag_extend A B f x) (frag_extend A B f y)

items.name: FRAG_EXTEND_SUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e C, g x :e frag A) -> forall k c= C, finite k -> frag_extend A B f (iterate_op (frag A) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add A a b) k g) = iterate_op (frag B) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add B a b) k (fun x:set => frag_extend A B f (g x))

items.name: FRAG_INDUCTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P (frag_0 A) /\ ((forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (frag_of A a)) /\ (forall c1 c2 :e frag A, P c1 /\ P c2 -> P (frag_sub A c1 c2))) -> forall c :e frag A, frag_support A c c= s -> P c

items.name: FRAG_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, frag_of A x = frag_of A y <-> x = y

items.name: FRAG_OF_IN_FREE_ABELIAN_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, frag_of A x :e group_carrier (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) <-> x :e s

items.name: FRAG_OF_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, ~ frag_of A a = frag_0 A

items.name: FRAG_SPLIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e frag A, forall s t c= A, frag_support A c c= s :\/: t -> exists d e0 :e frag A, frag_support A d c= s /\ (frag_support A e0 c= t /\ frag_add A d e0 = c)

items.name: FRAG_SUPPORT_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> frag_support A (frag_0 A) = Empty

items.name: FRAG_SUPPORT_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e frag A, frag_support A (frag_add A x y) c= frag_support A x :\/: frag_support A y

items.name: FRAG_SUPPORT_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e int, forall x :e frag A, frag_support A (frag_cmul A a x) c= frag_support A x

items.name: FRAG_SUPPORT_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e frag A, frag_support A c = Empty <-> c = frag_0 A

items.name: FRAG_SUPPORT_FRAG_EXTEND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag B) -> forall c :e frag A, frag_support B (frag_extend A B f c) c= Union {frag_support B (f a) | a :e A, a :e frag_support A c}

items.name: FRAG_SUPPORT_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e frag A, frag_support A (frag_neg A x) = frag_support A x

items.name: FRAG_SUPPORT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, frag_support A (frag_of A a) = {a}

items.name: FRAG_SUPPORT_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e frag A, frag_support A (frag_sub A x y) c= frag_support A x :\/: frag_support A y

items.name: FRAG_SUPPORT_SUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e frag A) -> forall k c= B, frag_support A (iterate_op (frag A) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add A a b) k f) c= Union {frag_support A (f i) | i :e B, i :e k}

items.name: FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (at M x) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f' x0 = frechet_derivative N M f (at M x) x0

items.name: FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_CONST_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R :^: idx N, forall a h :e R :^: idx M, frechet_derivative N M (fun x:set => c) (at M a) h = vec N 0

items.name: FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_UNIQUE_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f'':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f'' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (at M x) /\ has_derivative N M f f'' (at M x) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f' x0 = f'' x0

items.name: FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_UNIQUE_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f'':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f'' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ (has_derivative N M f f'' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ (forall i :e omega, forall e0 :e R, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ 0 < e0) -> exists d :e R, 0 < abs_SNo d /\ (abs_SNo d < e0 /\ vector_add M x (vector_mul M d (basis M i)) :e s))) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f' x0 = f'' x0

items.name: FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_UNIQUE_WITHIN_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f'':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f'' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x a b :e R :^: idx M, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> a i < b i) /\ (x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ has_derivative N M f f'' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))))) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f' x0 = f'' x0

items.name: FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_UNIQUE_WITHIN_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f'':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f'' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x a b :e R :^: idx M, x :e open_interval M (a,b) /\ (has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) (open_interval M (a,b))) /\ has_derivative N M f f'' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) (open_interval M (a,b)))) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f' x0 = f'' x0

items.name: FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_WITHIN_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x a b :e R :^: idx M, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> a i < b i) /\ (x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, frechet_derivative N M f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) x0 = f' x0

items.name: FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_WORKS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx A), differentiable B A f net0 <-> has_derivative B A f (frechet_derivative B A f net0) net0

items.name: FREE_ABELIAN_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall s c= A, group_carrier (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) = {c :e frag A | frag_support A c c= s}) /\ ((forall s c= A, group_id (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) = frag_0 A) /\ ((forall s c= A, forall x :e frag A, group_inv (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) x = frag_neg A x) /\ forall s c= A, forall x x0 :e frag A, group_mul (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) x x0 = frag_add A x x0))

items.name: FREE_ABELIAN_GROUP_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P (frag_0 A) /\ ((forall x y :e frag A, x :e group_carrier (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) /\ (y :e group_carrier (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) /\ (P x /\ P y)) -> P (frag_sub A x y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (frag_of A a))) -> forall x :e frag A, x :e group_carrier (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) -> P x

items.name: FREE_ABELIAN_GROUP_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall x :e frag A, forall n :e omega, group_pow (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) x n = frag_cmul A n x

items.name: FREE_ABELIAN_GROUP_UNIVERSAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall G :e group_hl B, {f x | x :e s} c= group_carrier B G /\ abelian_group_hl B G -> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e frag A, h x :e B) /\ (group_homomorphism_hl (frag A) B (free_abelian_group A s,G) h /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> h (frag_of A x) = f x)

items.name: FREE_ABELIAN_GROUP_ZPOW
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall x :e frag A, forall n :e int, group_zpow (frag A) (free_abelian_group A s) x n = frag_cmul A n x

items.name: FROM_0
items.statement: from 0 = omega

items.name: FROM_INTER_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall k n :e omega, from k :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} = {i :e omega | k <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: FROM_INTER_NUMSEG_GEN
items.statement: forall k m n :e omega, from k :/\: {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = if m < k then {i :e omega | k <= i /\ i <= n} else {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: FROM_INTER_NUMSEG_MAX
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, from p :/\: {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = {i :e omega | (if p <= m then m else p) <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: FROM_MONO
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, from m c= from n <-> n <= m

items.name: FROM_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ from n = Empty

items.name: FRONTIER_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, frontier N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} = if m = 0 /\ s = R :^: idx N then {c} else {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e frontier N s}

items.name: FRONTIER_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> frontier A (ball A (a,e0)) = sphere A (a,e0)

items.name: FRONTIER_BIJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> frontier N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e frontier M s}

items.name: FRONTIER_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, frontier A (cball A (a,e0)) = sphere A (a,e0)

items.name: FRONTIER_CLOPEN_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, open M s /\ (open N {f x | x :e s} /\ (closed N {f x | x :e closure M s} /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e c}))))) -> {f x | x :e frontier M s} = frontier N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: FRONTIER_CLOPEN_MAP_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, closed N {f x | x :e closure M s} /\ open N {f x | x :e interior M s} -> frontier N {f x | x :e s} c= {f x | x :e frontier M s}

items.name: FRONTIER_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A (frontier A s)

items.name: FRONTIER_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, frontier A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: open_interval A (a,b)

items.name: FRONTIER_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N s = closure N s :/\: closure N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: FRONTIER_CLOSURE_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> frontier N (closure N s) = frontier N s

items.name: FRONTIER_CLOSURE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N (closure N s) c= frontier N s

items.name: FRONTIER_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) = frontier N s

items.name: FRONTIER_CONVEX_HULL_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = if finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N then hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s else Union {hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\: {a}) | a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s}

items.name: FRONTIER_CONVEX_HULL_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ ((dimindex N < finite_cardinality s -> (exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ u x = 0)) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y)))}

items.name: FRONTIER_DISJOINT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, frontier A s :/\: s = Empty <-> open A s

items.name: FRONTIER_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> frontier A Empty = Empty

items.name: FRONTIER_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N s = Empty <-> s = Empty \/ s = R :^: idx N

items.name: FRONTIER_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s \/ closed N s -> frontier N (frontier N s) = frontier N s

items.name: FRONTIER_FRONTIER_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N (frontier N (frontier N s)) = frontier N (frontier N s)

items.name: FRONTIER_FRONTIER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N (frontier N s) c= frontier N s

items.name: FRONTIER_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | a <= x k} = {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = a}

items.name: FRONTIER_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | a < x k} = {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = a}

items.name: FRONTIER_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= a} = {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = a}

items.name: FRONTIER_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k < a} = {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = a}

items.name: FRONTIER_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ (a = vec N 0 /\ b = 0) -> frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x} = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: FRONTIER_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ (a = vec N 0 /\ b = 0) -> frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | b < dot N a x} = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: FRONTIER_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ (a = vec N 0 /\ b = 0) -> frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: FRONTIER_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ (a = vec N 0 /\ b = 0) -> frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x < b} = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: FRONTIER_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> frontier N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e frontier N s}

items.name: FRONTIER_INSIDE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> frontier N (inside N s) c= s

items.name: FRONTIER_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, frontier N (s :/\: t) = closure N (s :/\: t) :/\: (frontier N s :\/: frontier N t)

items.name: FRONTIER_INTERIORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N s = ((R :^: idx N) :\: interior N s) :\: interior N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: FRONTIER_INTERIOR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N (interior N s) c= frontier N s

items.name: FRONTIER_INTER_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ closed N t -> frontier N (s :/\: t) = frontier N s :/\: t :\/: s :/\: frontier N t

items.name: FRONTIER_INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, frontier A (s :/\: t) c= frontier A s :\/: frontier A t

items.name: FRONTIER_INTER_SUBSET_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, frontier N (s :/\: t) c= closure N s :/\: frontier N t :\/: frontier N s :/\: closure N t

items.name: FRONTIER_MINIMAL_SEPARATING_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (~ connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed N t /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s) -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t)) /\ c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s))) -> frontier N c = s

items.name: FRONTIER_MINIMAL_SEPARATING_CLOSED_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (~ a :e s /\ (~ connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) a b /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed N t /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s) -> connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t) a b))) -> frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) a x} = s

items.name: FRONTIER_NOT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ ~ s = R :^: idx N -> ~ frontier N s = Empty

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, frontier_of A top s = closure_of A top s :/\: closure_of A top (topspace A top :\: s)

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, frontier_of A top (topspace A top :\: s) = frontier_of A top s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_COMPONENTS_CLOSED_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> frontier N c c= s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_COMPONENTS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s -> frontier N c c= frontier N s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, frontier N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0} c= frontier N s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_CONVEX_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ closed N s -> frontier N s = Union {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N f s /\ aff_dim N f < dimindex N}

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, equip s (dimindex N + 1) -> frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = Union {hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\: {a}) | a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s}

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_DISJOINT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (frontier_of A top s :/\: s = Empty <-> s :e top)

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_DISJOINT_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top :\: frontier_of A top s <-> s :e top

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, frontier_of A top Empty = Empty

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (frontier_of A top s = Empty <-> closed_in A top s /\ s :e top)

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top \/ closed_in A top s -> frontier_of A top (frontier_of A top s) = frontier_of A top s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_FRONTIER_OF_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, frontier_of A top (frontier_of A top (frontier_of A top s)) = frontier_of A top (frontier_of A top s)

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_FRONTIER_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, frontier_of A top (frontier_of A top s) c= frontier_of A top s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> frontier_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e u}) {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e frontier_of (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s}

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, frontier_of A top (s :/\: t) = closure_of A top (s :/\: t) :/\: (frontier_of A top s :\/: frontier_of A top t)

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_INTER_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ closed_in A top t -> frontier_of A top (s :/\: t) = frontier_of A top s :/\: t :\/: s :/\: frontier_of A top t

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, frontier_of A top (s :/\: t) c= frontier_of A top s :\/: frontier_of A top t

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SUBSPACE_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c c= A, locally_connected_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ c :e connected_components_of A (subtopology A top s)) -> frontier_of A top c = c :/\: frontier_of A top s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top -> frontier_of A top s = closure_of A top s :\: s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_OPEN_IN_STRADDLE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s u c= A, u :e top /\ ~ u :/\: frontier_of A top s = Empty -> ~ u :/\: s = Empty /\ ~ u :\: s = Empty

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, frontier_of A top s = frontier_of A top (topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_SUBSET_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> frontier_of A top s c= s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (frontier_of A top s c= s <-> closed_in A top s)

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_SUBSET_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, frontier_of A (subtopology A top s) t c= s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, frontier_of A top s c= topspace A top

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ t c= u -> frontier_of A (subtopology A top t) s c= frontier_of A (subtopology A top u) s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, u :e top -> frontier_of A (subtopology A top u) s = u :/\: frontier_of A top s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s u c= A, u :/\: frontier_of A (subtopology A top u) s c= frontier_of A top s

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, frontier_of A top (topspace A top) = Empty

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall u s c= R :^: idx N, frontier_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {vector_add N a x | x :e u}) {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e frontier_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s}

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx_n 2, frontier (idx_n 2) (hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | convex (idx_n 2) x} {a,b,c}) = closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: (closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil) :\/: closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (c,a) seq_nil))

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_UNIONS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, finite f -> frontier_of A top (Union f) c= Union {frontier_of A top t | t :e Power A, t :e f}

items.name: FRONTIER_OF_UNION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, frontier_of A top (s :\/: t) c= frontier_of A top s :\/: frontier_of A top t

items.name: FRONTIER_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, frontier A (open_interval A (a,b)) = if open_interval A (a,b) = Empty then Empty else closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: open_interval A (a,b)

items.name: FRONTIER_OPEN_MAP_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, bounded_hl M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) /\ open N {f x | x :e interior M s}) -> frontier N {f x | x :e s} c= {f x | x :e frontier M s}

items.name: FRONTIER_OPEN_STRADDLE_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ ~ u :/\: frontier N s = Empty -> ~ u :/\: s = Empty /\ ~ u :\: s = Empty

items.name: FRONTIER_OPEN_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (open N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> frontier N (s :\/: t) = frontier N s :\/: frontier N t

items.name: FRONTIER_OPEN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> open N s) /\ (forall x y :e f, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty)) -> frontier N (Union f) = Union {frontier N s | s :e Power (R :^: idx N), s :e f}

items.name: FRONTIER_OUTSIDE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> frontier N (outside N s) c= s

items.name: FRONTIER_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, frontier (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = (\/_ x :e frontier M s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e closure N t}) :\/: \/_ x :e closure M s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e frontier N t}

items.name: FRONTIER_PROPER_CLOPEN_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, open M s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) /\ (open N {f x | x :e s} /\ (closed N {f x | x :e closure M s} /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}))))) -> {f x | x :e frontier M s} = frontier N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: FRONTIER_PROPER_MAP_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (open M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}))) -> {f x | x :e frontier M s} c= frontier N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: FRONTIER_PROPER_MAP_IMAGE_SUBSET_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k})) -> {f x | x :e closure M s :\: s} c= closure N {f x | x :e s} :\: {f x | x :e s}

items.name: FRONTIER_PROPER_OPEN_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl M s /\ (open M s /\ (open N {f x | x :e s} /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}))))) -> {f x | x :e frontier M s} = frontier N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: FRONTIER_RETRACT_OF_PUNCTURED_UNIVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ a :e interior N s) -> retract_of N (frontier N s) ((R :^: idx N) :\: {a})

items.name: FRONTIER_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, frontier N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} = if c = 0 /\ s = R :^: idx N then {vec N 0} else {vector_mul N c x | x :e frontier N s}

items.name: FRONTIER_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, frontier N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if 2 <= dimindex N then closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) else {a,b}) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, frontier N (open_segment N (a,b)) = if a = b then Empty else if 2 <= dimindex N then closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) else {a,b}

items.name: FRONTIER_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, frontier N {a} = {a}

items.name: FRONTIER_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, frontier N (sphere N (a,r)) = sphere N (a,r)

items.name: FRONTIER_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, a :e frontier N s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> (exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ distance N (a,x) < e0) /\ exists x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x :e s /\ distance N (a,x) < e0

items.name: FRONTIER_STRIP_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) <= a} = {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) = a}

items.name: FRONTIER_STRIP_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, frontier N {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) < a} = if a = 0 then Empty else {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) = a}

items.name: FRONTIER_SUBSET_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s -> frontier A s c= s

items.name: FRONTIER_SUBSET_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, compact A s -> frontier A s c= s

items.name: FRONTIER_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N s c= s <-> closed N s

items.name: FRONTIER_SUBSET_RETRACTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> bounded_hl N s /\ (frontier N s c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N N r (closure N s) /\ ({r x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> r x = x)))) -> s c= t

items.name: FRONTIER_SURJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = y) -> frontier N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e frontier N s}

items.name: FRONTIER_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e frontier N s}

items.name: FRONTIER_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closure N s :/\: closure N t = Empty -> frontier N (s :\/: t) = frontier N s :\/: frontier N t

items.name: FRONTIER_UNIONS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f -> frontier N (Union f) c= Union {frontier N t | t :e Power (R :^: idx N), t :e f}

items.name: FRONTIER_UNIONS_SUBSET_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), frontier N (Union f) c= closure N (Union {frontier N t | t :e Power (R :^: idx N), t :e f})

items.name: FRONTIER_UNION_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, frontier N s :\/: interior N s = closure N s

items.name: FRONTIER_UNION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, frontier N (s :\/: t) c= frontier N s :\/: frontier N t

items.name: FRONTIER_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> frontier N (R :^: idx N) = Empty

items.name: FRONTIER_WITH_INSIDE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> frontier N (s :\/: inside N s) c= s

items.name: FRONTIER_WITH_OUTSIDE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> frontier N (s :\/: outside N s) c= s

items.name: FSIGMA_ASCENDING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s <-> exists c :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact N (c n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, c n c= c (ordsucc n)) /\ Union {c n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = s)

items.name: FSIGMA_BAIRE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 1 (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s

items.name: FSIGMA_BAIRE1_PREIMAGE_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, fsigma M s /\ (open N u /\ f :e baire M N 1 s) -> fsigma M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u}

items.name: FSIGMA_BAIRE1_PREIMAGE_OPEN_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, g x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t u c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ ((forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N (g n) s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => g n x) (f x) sequentially))) -> exists c c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable c /\ ((forall t0 c= R :^: idx M, t0 :e c -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) t0) /\ Union c = {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u})

items.name: FSIGMA_BAIRE_PREIMAGE_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (f :e baire M N k s /\ ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u = s) /\ open N u)) -> exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u0 = {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u}

items.name: FSIGMA_BAIRE_PREIMAGE_OPEN_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (f :e baire M N k s /\ open N u) -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u = t) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} = s :/\: t

items.name: FSIGMA_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) <-> gdelta N s

items.name: FSIGMA_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ fsigma M s -> fsigma N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: FSIGMA_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s /\ gdelta N t -> fsigma N (s :\: t)

items.name: FSIGMA_DISJOINT_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall s c= R :^: idx N, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), u :e {x :e Power (Power (R :^: idx N)) | countable x} :/\: {x :e Power (Power (R :^: idx N)) | forall x0 y :e x, x0 <> y -> x0 :/\: y = Empty} /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s

items.name: FSIGMA_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> fsigma A Empty

items.name: FSIGMA_FSIGMA_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), {fstcart M x | x :e t} c= s /\ fsigma (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) t -> fsigma N {y :e R :^: idx N | exists x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ pastecart M N x y :e t}

items.name: FSIGMA_GDELTA_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall s c= R :^: idx N, 1 <= k -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 (k + 1) (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), u :e {x :e Power (Power (R :^: idx N)) | countable x} :/\: {x :e Power (Power (R :^: idx N)) | forall x0 y :e x, x0 <> y -> x0 :/\: y = Empty} /\ (forall x :e u, exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x1 :e u, (fun x10 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x1 x10) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x00 :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x00 :e Y} = x) /\ Union u = s)

items.name: FSIGMA_GDELTA_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall s c= R :^: idx N, 1 <= k -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 (k + 1) (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x1 :e u, (fun x10 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x1 x10) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x00 :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x00 :e Y} = x) /\ Union u = s)

items.name: FSIGMA_IMP_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s -> analytic N s

items.name: FSIGMA_IMP_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s -> borel N s

items.name: FSIGMA_IMP_BOREL_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e fsigma_in A top -> borel_in A top s

items.name: FSIGMA_IMP_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: FSIGMA_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s /\ fsigma N t -> fsigma N (s :/\: t)

items.name: FSIGMA_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite g /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e g -> fsigma N u) -> fsigma N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_ASCENDING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e fsigma_in A top <-> exists c :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, closed_in A top (c n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, c n c= c (n + 1)) /\ Union {c n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = s)

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e fsigma_in A top /\ t :e gdelta_in A top -> s :\: t :e fsigma_in A top

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, Empty :e fsigma_in A top

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx A, x :e fsigma_in (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) <-> fsigma A x

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_FSIGMA_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e fsigma_in A top -> (t :e fsigma_in A (subtopology A top s) <-> t :e fsigma_in A top /\ t c= s)

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_GDELTA_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e fsigma_in A top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ topspace A top :\: s :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e fsigma_in A top /\ t :e fsigma_in A top -> s :/\: t :e fsigma_in A top

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, relative_to A (fsigma_in A top) s = fsigma_in A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e fsigma_in A top -> s c= topspace A top

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, s :e fsigma_in A (subtopology A top u) <-> exists t c= A, t :e fsigma_in A top /\ s = t :/\: u

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top :e fsigma_in A top

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e fsigma_in A top /\ t :e fsigma_in A top -> s :\/: t :e fsigma_in A top

items.name: FSIGMA_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall t c= Power A, countable t /\ (forall s c= A, s :e t -> s :e fsigma_in A top) -> Union t :e fsigma_in A top

items.name: FSIGMA_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (fsigma N {f x | x :e s} <-> fsigma N s)

items.name: FSIGMA_LOCALLY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> fsigma N s

items.name: FSIGMA_LOCALLY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k -> (s c= u /\ (exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k u) /\ Union u0 = s) <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = t) /\ u :/\: t = s)

items.name: FSIGMA_LOCALLY_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k u) /\ Union u0 = s) -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = t) /\ u :/\: t = u :/\: s

items.name: FSIGMA_LOCALLY_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (s c= t /\ (t c= u /\ ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k t) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k u) /\ Union u0 = t)))) -> exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k u) /\ Union u0 = s

items.name: FSIGMA_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, fsigma M s /\ fsigma N t -> fsigma (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: FSIGMA_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, fsigma (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ fsigma M s /\ fsigma N t)

items.name: FSIGMA_PREIMAGE_CARD_GE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ fsigma M s -> fsigma N {y :e R :^: idx N | finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} -> n <= finite_cardinality {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: FSIGMA_PROPER_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ fsigma N k -> fsigma M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: FSIGMA_REDUCTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, fsigma N (s n)) -> exists t :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, fsigma N (t n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, t n c= s n) /\ ((forall x y :e omega, x <> y -> t x :/\: t y = Empty) /\ Union {t n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))

items.name: FSIGMA_REDUCTION_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall k :e omega, (forall n :e omega, exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s n) /\ Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = R :^: idx N -> exists t :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N (t n) x) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, t n c= s n) /\ ((forall x y :e omega, x <> y -> t x :/\: t y = Empty) /\ Union {t n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = R :^: idx N))

items.name: FSIGMA_REDUCTION_GEN_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = t) -> exists s' t' c= R :^: idx N, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s') /\ ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = t') /\ (s' c= s /\ (t' c= t /\ (s' :/\: t' = Empty /\ s' :\/: t' = s :\/: t))))

items.name: FSIGMA_REDUCTION_GEN_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall k :e omega, (forall n :e omega, exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = s n) -> exists t :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = t n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, t n c= s n) /\ ((forall x y :e omega, x <> y -> t x :/\: t y = Empty) /\ Union {t n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))

items.name: FSIGMA_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, fsigma N {x}

items.name: FSIGMA_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> fsigma N s

items.name: FSIGMA_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s /\ fsigma N t -> fsigma N (s :\/: t)

items.name: FSIGMA_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable g /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e g -> fsigma N u) -> fsigma N (Union g)

items.name: FSIGMA_UNIONS_CLOPEN_CHAIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed N s \/ open N s) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> fsigma N (Union f)

items.name: FSIGMA_UNIONS_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, compact N x) /\ Union u = s

items.name: FSIGMA_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> fsigma N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: FST
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x = x

items.name: FSTCART_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), fstcart M (vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x y) = vector_add M (fstcart M x) (fstcart M y)

items.name: FSTCART_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall c :e R, fstcart M (vector_mul (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) c x) = vector_mul M c (fstcart M x)

items.name: FSTCART_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> fstcart M x i = x i

items.name: FSTCART_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), vector_neg M (fstcart M x) = fstcart M (vector_neg (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x)

items.name: FSTCART_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, fstcart M (pastecart M N x y) = x

items.name: FSTCART_SNDCART_MATRIX_ADD
items.statement: forall K M N:set, K <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx K :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), fstcart M (matrix_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) K x y) = matrix_add M K (fstcart M x) (fstcart M y) /\ sndcart M N (matrix_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) K x y) = matrix_add N K (sndcart M N x) (sndcart M N y)

items.name: FSTCART_SNDCART_MAT_ZERO
items.statement: forall A B M:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> fstcart A (mat (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) M 0) = mat A M 0 /\ sndcart A B (mat (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) M 0) = mat B M 0

items.name: FSTCART_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), fstcart M (vector_sub (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x y) = vector_sub M (fstcart M x) (fstcart M y)

items.name: FSTCART_VEC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, fstcart B (vec (idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A)) n) = vec B n

items.name: FSTCART_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall k c= C, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e C, x x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A)) -> finite k -> fstcart B (vsum C (idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A)) k x) = vsum C B k (fun i:set => fstcart B (x i))

items.name: FST_DEF
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall p :e A :*: B, p 0 = choose_in A (fun x:set => exists y :e B, p = (x,y))

items.name: FUBINI_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | ~ absolutely_integrable_on P N (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y)) (R :^: idx N)} /\ has_integral M P (fun x:set => integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y))) (integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f) (R :^: idx M)

items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | ~ absolutely_integrable_on P M (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y)) (R :^: idx M)} /\ has_integral N P (fun y:set => integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y))) (integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: FUBINI_HAS_ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | ~ absolutely_integrable_on P N (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y)) (R :^: idx N)} /\ (absolutely_integrable_on P M (fun x:set => integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y))) (R :^: idx M) /\ integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y))) = integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f)

items.name: FUBINI_HAS_ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_ALT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | ~ absolutely_integrable_on P M (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y)) (R :^: idx M)} /\ (absolutely_integrable_on P N (fun y:set => integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y))) (R :^: idx N) /\ integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y))) = integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f)

items.name: FUBINI_HAS_INTEGRAL_SWAP
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> has_integral M P (fun x:set => integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y))) (integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y)))) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: FUBINI_HAS_INTEGRAL_SWAP_ALT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> has_integral N P (fun y:set => integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y))) (integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y)))) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: FUBINI_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f = integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y)))

items.name: FUBINI_INTEGRAL_ALT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f = integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y)))

items.name: FUBINI_INTEGRAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)) -> integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)) f = integral P M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => integral P N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y)))

items.name: FUBINI_INTEGRAL_INTERVAL_ALT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)) -> integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)) f = integral P N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) (fun y:set => integral P M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y)))

items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y))) = integral P N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => integral P M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (pastecart M N x y)))

items.name: FUBINI_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE

items.name: FUBINI_MEASURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | ~ measurable N {y :e R :^: idx N | pastecart M N x y :e s}} /\ has_integral M 1 (fun x:set => lift (measure N {y :e R :^: idx N | pastecart M N x y :e s})) (lift (measure (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: FUBINI_TONELLI
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> measurable_on (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) P f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> (absolutely_integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) <-> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | ~ absolutely_integrable_on P N (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y)) (R :^: idx N)} /\ integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => integral 1 N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => lift (vector_norm P (f (pastecart M N x y))))) (R :^: idx M))
