items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s -> (measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s <-> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | ~ measurable N {y :e R :^: idx N | pastecart M N x y :e s}} /\ integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (measure N {y :e R :^: idx N | pastecart M N x y :e s})) (R :^: idx M))

items.name: FUBINI_TONELLI_MEASURE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s -> (measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s <-> negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | ~ measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | pastecart M N x y :e s}} /\ integrable_on 1 N (fun y:set => lift (measure M {x :e R :^: idx M | pastecart M N x y :e s})) (R :^: idx N))

items.name: FUBINI_TONELLI_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s -> (negligible (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s <-> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | ~ negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | pastecart M N x y :e s}})

items.name: FUBINI_TONELLI_NEGLIGIBLE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s -> (negligible (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s <-> negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | ~ negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | pastecart M N x y :e s}})

items.name: FULL_RANK_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = dimindex M <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x = matrix_vector_mul N M A y -> x = y

items.name: FULL_RANK_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = dimindex N <-> forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x = y

items.name: FUNCTION_CONVERGENT_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall M0 :e R, countable s /\ (forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f n x) <= M0) -> exists k:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> k m < k n) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f (k n) x) l sequentially)

items.name: FUNCTION_EXTENSION_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (t c= closure M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, g x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (SetAdjoin s x) /\ ({g x0 | x0 :e SetAdjoin s x} c= u /\ forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, x0 :e s -> g x0 = f x0)))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x))

items.name: FUNCTION_EXTENSION_POINTWISE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (t c= closure M s /\ (closed N u /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= u /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t :\: s -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)))))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x))

items.name: FUNCTION_FACTORS_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> ((forall x y :e A, g x = g y -> f x = f y) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e C, h x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, f x = h (g x))

items.name: FUNCTION_FACTORS_LEFT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> ((forall x y :e A, P x /\ (P y /\ g x = g y) -> f x = f y) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e C, h x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, P x -> f x = h (g x))

items.name: FUNCTION_FACTORS_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> ((forall x :e A, exists y :e B, g y = f x) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, f x = g (h x))

items.name: FUNCTION_FACTORS_RIGHT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> ((forall x :e A, P x -> exists y :e B, g y = f x) <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, P x -> f x = g (h x))

items.name: FUNDAMENTAL_GROUP_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, fundamental_group N (s,a) = Empty <-> ~ a :e s

items.name: FUNDAMENTAL_GROUP_SIMPLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s /\ a :e s -> fundamental_group N (s,a) = {{x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx 1) | homotopic_paths N s (fun x0:set => linepath N (a,a) x0) (fun x0:set => x x0)}}

items.name: FUNDAMENTAL_THEOREM_OF_CALCULUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> has_integral 1 N f' (vector_sub N (f b) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: FUNDAMENTAL_THEOREM_OF_CALCULUS_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, negligible 1 s /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ (absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))))) -> has_integral 1 N f' (vector_sub N (f b) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: FUNDAMENTAL_THEOREM_OF_CALCULUS_BARTLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, negligible 1 s /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists g:set -> set -> prop, gauge 1 g /\ forall p c= R :^: idx 1 :*: Power (R :^: idx 1), tagged_partial_division_of 1 p (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (fine (R :^: idx 1) (R :^: idx 1) g p /\ {x 0 | x :e p} c= s) -> vector_norm N (vsum (R :^: idx 1 :*: Power (R :^: idx 1)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 (p0 1))) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 (p0 1))))) < e0))) -> has_integral 1 N f' (vector_sub N (f b) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: FUNDAMENTAL_THEOREM_OF_CALCULUS_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (at 1 x))) -> has_integral 1 N f' (vector_sub N (f b) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: FUNDAMENTAL_THEOREM_OF_CALCULUS_INTERIOR_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, countable s /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (at 1 x)))) -> has_integral 1 N f' (vector_sub N (f b) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: FUNDAMENTAL_THEOREM_OF_CALCULUS_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, countable s /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))))) -> has_integral 1 N f' (vector_sub N (f b) (f a)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric B, mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) = {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e mspace B m) /\ (f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ mbounded B m {f x | x :e s})} /\ forall f g :e B :^: A, mdist (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) (f,g) = if s = Empty then 0 else sup {mdist B m (f x,g x) | x :e A, x :e s}

items.name: FUNSPACE_IMP_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric B, forall f :e B :^: A, f :e mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) -> s = Empty \/ exists c :e B, exists b :e R, forall x :e A, x :e s -> mdist B m (c,f x) <= b

items.name: FUNSPACE_IMP_BOUNDED2
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric B, forall f g :e B :^: A, f :e mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) /\ g :e mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) -> exists b :e R, forall x :e A, x :e s -> mdist B m (f x,g x) <= b

items.name: FUNSPACE_IMP_BOUNDED_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric B, forall f :e B :^: A, f :e mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) -> mbounded B m {f x | x :e s}

items.name: FUNSPACE_IMP_EXTENSIONAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric B, forall f :e B :^: A, f :e mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) -> f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: FUNSPACE_IMP_WELLDEFINED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, f :e mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) /\ x :e s -> f x :e mspace B m

items.name: FUNSPACE_MDIST_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric B, forall f g :e B :^: A, forall a :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (f :e mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) /\ g :e mspace (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m)) -> (mdist (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m) (f,g) <= a <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> mdist B m (f x,g x) <= a)

items.name: FUN_EQ_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, f x = g x) <-> forall x :e A, f x = g x)

items.name: FUN_IN_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e {f x | x :e s}

items.name: F_DEF
items.statement: False <-> forall p:prop, p

items.name: GATEAUX_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (at M x) -> tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun t:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (drop t)) (vector_sub N (f (vector_add M x (vector_mul M (drop t) y))) (f x))) (f' y) (at 1 (vec 1 0))

items.name: GATEAUX_DERIVATIVE_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (open M s /\ ((exists B :e R, forall u v :e R :^: idx M, u :e s /\ v :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f u) (f v)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M u v)) /\ (linear M N f' /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun t:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (drop t)) (vector_sub N (f (vector_add M x (vector_mul M (drop t) y))) (f x))) (f' y) (at 1 (vec 1 0)))))) -> has_derivative N M f f' (at M x)

items.name: GATEAUX_DERIVATIVE_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) -> tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun t:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (drop t)) (vector_sub N (f (vector_add M x (vector_mul M (drop t) y))) (f x))) (f' y) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (vec 1 0)) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | vector_add M x (vector_mul M (drop t) y) :e s})

items.name: GAUGE_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> gauge A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e ball A (x,e0))

items.name: GAUGE_BALL_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, e0 x :e R) -> (forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 < e0 x) -> gauge A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e ball A (x,e0 x))

items.name: GAUGE_EXISTENCE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> prop, forall q:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, exists d :e R, p x -> 0 < d /\ q d x) <-> forall x :e A, exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ (p x -> q d x)

items.name: GAUGE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d1 d2 :e Power (R :^: idx A) :^: (R :^: idx A), gauge A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e d1 x) /\ gauge A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e d2 x) -> gauge A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e d1 x :/\: d2 x)

items.name: GAUGE_INTERS

var_views.f: set(Power (R :^: idx A) :^: (R :^: idx A) :^: B)

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx A) :^: (R :^: idx A) :^: B, forall s c= B, finite s /\ (forall d :e B, d :e s -> gauge A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e f d x)) -> gauge A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e {x0 :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e {f d x | d :e B, d :e s}, x0 :e Y})

items.name: GAUGE_MODIFY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> open M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e s}) -> forall d:set -> set -> prop, gauge N d -> gauge M (fun x:set => fun y:set => d (f x) (f y))

items.name: GAUGE_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> gauge A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e ball A (x,1))

items.name: GCD
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, divides_nat (gcd_int a b) a /\ divides_nat (gcd_int a b) b /\ forall e0 :e omega, divides_nat e0 a /\ divides_nat e0 b -> divides_nat e0 (gcd_int a b)

items.name: GCD_0
items.statement: (forall a :e omega, gcd_int 0 a = a) /\ forall a :e omega, gcd_int a 0 = a

items.name: GCD_1
items.statement: (forall a :e omega, gcd_int 1 a = 1) /\ forall a :e omega, gcd_int a 1 = 1

items.name: GCD_2_CASES
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, gcd_int 2 n = if even_nat n then 2 else 1) /\ forall n :e omega, gcd_int n 2 = if even_nat n then 2 else 1

items.name: GCD_ADD
items.statement: (forall a b :e omega, gcd_int (a + b) b = gcd_int a b) /\ ((forall a b :e omega, gcd_int (b + a) b = gcd_int a b) /\ ((forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a (a + b) = gcd_int a b) /\ forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a (b + a) = gcd_int a b))

items.name: GCD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a (gcd_int b c) = gcd_int (gcd_int a b) c

items.name: GCD_BEZOUT
items.statement: forall a b d :e omega, (exists x y :e omega, minus_nat (a * x) (b * y) = d \/ minus_nat (b * x) (a * y) = d) <-> divides_nat (gcd_int a b) d

items.name: GCD_BEZOUT_SUM
items.statement: forall a b d x y :e omega, a * x + b * y = d -> divides_nat (gcd_int a b) d

items.name: GCD_COPRIME
items.statement: forall a b a' b' :e omega, ~ gcd_int a b = 0 /\ (a = a' * gcd_int a b /\ b = b' * gcd_int a b) -> gcd_int a' b' = 1

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_DIVIDES_LMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 /\ divides_nat a c -> gcd_int (a * b) c = a * gcd_int b c

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_DIVIDES_RMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int b c = 1 /\ divides_nat b a -> gcd_int a (b * c) = b * gcd_int a c

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_EXISTS
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, exists a' b' :e omega, a = a' * gcd_int a b /\ (b = b' * gcd_int a b /\ gcd_int a' b' = 1)

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_LMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int (a * b) c = gcd_int a c * gcd_int b c

items.name: GCD_COPRIME_RMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int c (a * b) = gcd_int c a * gcd_int c b

items.name: GCD_EQ
items.statement: forall x y u v :e omega, (forall d :e omega, divides_nat d x /\ divides_nat d y <-> divides_nat d u /\ divides_nat d v) -> gcd_int x y = gcd_int u v

items.name: GCD_EXP
items.statement: forall n a b :e omega, gcd_int (a ^ n) (b ^ n) = gcd_int a b ^ n

items.name: GCD_LCM_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a (lcm_int b c) = lcm_int (gcd_int a b) (gcd_int a c)

items.name: GCD_LE
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n <= m <-> m = 0 -> n = 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n <= n <-> n = 0 -> m = 0

items.name: GCD_LE_MAX
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n <= if m <= n then n else m

items.name: GCD_LE_MIN
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (m = 0 <-> n = 0) -> gcd_int m n <= if m <= n then m else n

items.name: GCD_LE_MIN_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n <= (if m <= n then m else n) <-> (m = 0 <-> n = 0)

items.name: GCD_LMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int (c * a) (c * b) = c * gcd_int a b

items.name: GCD_MULTIPLE
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int b (a * b) = b

items.name: GCD_MUL_COPRIME
items.statement: (forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int a (b * c) = gcd_int a c) /\ ((forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a c = 1 -> gcd_int a (b * c) = gcd_int a b) /\ ((forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int b c = 1 -> gcd_int a (b * c) = gcd_int a b * gcd_int a c) /\ ((forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a c = 1 -> gcd_int (a * b) c = gcd_int b c) /\ ((forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int b c = 1 -> gcd_int (a * b) c = gcd_int a c) /\ forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int (a * b) c = gcd_int a c * gcd_int b c))))

items.name: GCD_ONE
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int a b = 1

items.name: GCD_PRIME_CASES
items.statement: (forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> gcd_int p n = if divides_nat p n then p else 1) /\ forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> gcd_int n p = if divides_nat p n then p else 1

items.name: GCD_REFL
items.statement: forall a :e omega, gcd_int a a = a

items.name: GCD_RMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, gcd_int (a * c) (b * c) = c * gcd_int a b

items.name: GCD_SUB
items.statement: (forall a b :e omega, b <= a -> gcd_int (minus_nat a b) b = gcd_int a b) /\ forall a b :e omega, a <= b -> gcd_int a (minus_nat b a) = gcd_int a b

items.name: GCD_SYM
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = gcd_int b a

items.name: GCD_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall d a b :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b /\ (forall e0 :e omega, divides_nat e0 a /\ divides_nat e0 b -> divides_nat e0 d) <-> d = gcd_int a b

items.name: GCD_ZERO
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 0 <-> a = 0 /\ b = 0

items.name: GDELTA_BAIRE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 1 (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: GDELTA_BAIRE1_PREIMAGE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c c= R :^: idx N, gdelta M s /\ (closed N c /\ f :e baire M N 1 s) -> gdelta M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e c}

items.name: GDELTA_BAIRE_PREIMAGE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (f :e baire M N k s /\ ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ closed N u)) -> exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u}

items.name: GDELTA_BAIRE_PREIMAGE_CLOSED_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (f :e baire M N k s /\ closed N u) -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} = s :/\: t

items.name: GDELTA_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) <-> fsigma N s

items.name: GDELTA_CONNECTED_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s /\ (connected N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) -> path_connected N s

items.name: GDELTA_CONTINUOUS_FUNCTION_MINIMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ compact M s -> gdelta M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s /\ f x = f y -> x = y \/ exists k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex M /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i < k -> x i <= y i) /\ x k < y k))}

items.name: GDELTA_DESCENDING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s <-> exists u :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, open N (u n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, u (ordsucc n) c= u n) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {u n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} = s)

items.name: GDELTA_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s /\ fsigma N t -> gdelta N (s :\: t)

items.name: GDELTA_DOMAIN_OF_INJECTIVITY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ compact M s -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, gdelta M t /\ (t c= s /\ ({f x | x :e t} = {f x | x :e s} /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))

items.name: GDELTA_DOMAIN_OF_INJECTIVITY_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (0 < e0 /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= u /\ (measurable N u /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}))))) -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (gdelta M t /\ (bounded_hl M t /\ (measurable M t /\ (measurable N {f x | x :e t} /\ (measure N ({f x | x :e s} :\: {f x | x :e t}) < e0 /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)))))

items.name: GDELTA_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> gdelta A Empty

items.name: GDELTA_FSIGMA_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall s c= R :^: idx N, 1 <= k -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 (k + 1) (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x1 :e u, (fun x10 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x1 x10) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = x) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s)

items.name: GDELTA_HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_CLOSED_IN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, metrizable_space A top /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i :e top) -> exists t c= A :*: R :^: K, closed_in (A :*: R :^: K) (prod_topology A (R :^: K) top (product_topology R K k (fun i:set => euclideanreal))) t /\ homeomorphic_space A (A :*: R :^: K) (subtopology A top {x :e A | forall Y :e {s i | i :e K, i :e k}, x :e Y}) (subtopology (A :*: R :^: K) (prod_topology A (R :^: K) top (product_topology R K k (fun i:set => euclideanreal))) t)

items.name: GDELTA_IMP_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s -> analytic N s

items.name: GDELTA_IMP_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s -> borel N s

items.name: GDELTA_IMP_BOREL_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e gdelta_in A top -> borel_in A top s

items.name: GDELTA_IMP_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: GDELTA_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s /\ gdelta N t -> gdelta N (s :/\: t)

items.name: GDELTA_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable g /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e g -> gdelta N u) -> gdelta N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}

items.name: GDELTA_INTERS_CLOPEN_CHAIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed N s \/ open N s) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> gdelta N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: GDELTA_IN_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e gdelta_in A top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x :e u, x :e top) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: GDELTA_IN_DESCENDING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e gdelta_in A top <-> exists c :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, c n :e top) /\ ((forall n :e omega, c (n + 1) c= c n) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e {c n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} = s)

items.name: GDELTA_IN_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e gdelta_in A top /\ t :e fsigma_in A top -> s :\: t :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: GDELTA_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, Empty :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: GDELTA_IN_EQ_COMPLETELY_METRIZABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, completely_metrizable_space A top -> (s :e gdelta_in A top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ completely_metrizable_space A (subtopology A top s))

items.name: GDELTA_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx A, x :e gdelta_in (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) <-> gdelta A x

items.name: GDELTA_IN_FSIGMA_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e gdelta_in A top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ topspace A top :\: s :e fsigma_in A top

items.name: GDELTA_IN_GDELTA_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e gdelta_in A top -> (t :e gdelta_in A (subtopology A top s) <-> t :e gdelta_in A top /\ t c= s)

items.name: GDELTA_IN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e gdelta_in A top /\ t :e gdelta_in A top -> s :/\: t :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: GDELTA_IN_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall t c= Power A, countable t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e t -> s :e gdelta_in A top)) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e t, x :e Y} :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: GDELTA_IN_POINTS_OF_CONVERGENCE_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, completely_metrizable_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top s,top') f \/ t1_space A top /\ {f x | x :e s} c= topspace B top') -> {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ exists l :e B, limit A B top' f l (within A (atpointof A top x) s)} :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: GDELTA_IN_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, relative_to A (gdelta_in A top) s = gdelta_in A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: GDELTA_IN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e gdelta_in A top -> s c= topspace A top

items.name: GDELTA_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, s :e gdelta_in A (subtopology A top u) <-> exists t c= A, t :e gdelta_in A top /\ s = t :/\: u

items.name: GDELTA_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: GDELTA_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e gdelta_in A top /\ t :e gdelta_in A top -> s :\/: t :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: GDELTA_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (gdelta N {f x | x :e s} <-> gdelta N s)

items.name: GDELTA_LOCALLY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> gdelta N s

items.name: GDELTA_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: GDELTA_LOCALLY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k -> (s c= u /\ (exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k u) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) /\ u :/\: t = s)

items.name: GDELTA_LOCALLY_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k u) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = s) -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) /\ u :/\: t = u :/\: s

items.name: GDELTA_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s -> (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s)

items.name: GDELTA_LOCALLY_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (s c= t /\ (t c= u /\ ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k t) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k u) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = t)))) -> exists u0 c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u0 /\ (forall x :e u0, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k u) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u0, x :e Y} = s

items.name: GDELTA_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, gdelta M s /\ gdelta N t -> gdelta (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: GDELTA_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, gdelta (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ gdelta M s /\ gdelta N t)

items.name: GDELTA_POINTS_OF_CONTINUITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> gdelta M {x :e R :^: idx M | continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x)}

items.name: GDELTA_POINTS_OF_CONTINUITY_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, exists t c= R :^: idx M, gdelta M t /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)} = s :/\: t

items.name: GDELTA_POINTS_OF_CONVERGENCE_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> gdelta M {x :e R :^: idx M | exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (at M x)}

items.name: GDELTA_POINTS_OF_CONVERGENCE_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, gdelta M {x :e R :^: idx M | exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)}

items.name: GDELTA_PREIMAGE_CARD_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ fsigma M s -> gdelta N {y :e R :^: idx N | finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} /\ finite_cardinality {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} <= n}

items.name: GDELTA_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s /\ (gdelta N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N u /\ (gdelta N u /\ (s c= u /\ u :/\: t = Empty))

items.name: GDELTA_SEPARATION_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, (exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t) /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N u x) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N) /\ (s c= u /\ u :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: GDELTA_SING

items.name: GDELTA_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> gdelta N s

items.name: GDELTA_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s /\ gdelta N t -> gdelta N (s :\/: t)

items.name: GDELTA_UNIONS

items.name: GDELTA_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> gdelta N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: GE
items.statement: forall n m :e omega, n <= m <-> n <= m

items.name: GENERAL_CONNECTED_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, c s x y -> x :e s /\ y :e s) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, c s x y -> c s y x) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, c s x y /\ c s y z -> c s x z) /\ ((forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ c s x y -> c t x y) /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, y :e ball N (x,e0) /\ ball N (x,e0) c= s -> c (ball N (x,e0)) x y)))) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s)) -> c s x y

items.name: GENERAL_REDUCTION_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ ((forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) /\ (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\: t))) -> forall s :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s n) -> exists t :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, t n c= s n) /\ ((forall x y :e omega, x <> y -> t x :/\: t y = Empty) /\ Union {t n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))

items.name: GENERAL_REDUCTION_THEOREM_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ ((forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\/: t)) /\ (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :\: t))) -> forall s t c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t) -> exists s' t' c= A, (exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = s') /\ ((exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = t') /\ (s' c= s /\ (t' c= t /\ (s' :/\: t' = Empty /\ s' :\/: t' = s :\/: t))))

items.name: GENERATOR_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall a :e int, subgroup_generated int (integer_mod_group n) {a} = integer_mod_group n <-> (n <= 1 \/ 0 <= a /\ a < n) /\ gcd_int n a = 1

items.name: GEOM_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector N), geom_mul N x (geom_mul N y z) = geom_mul N (geom_mul N x y) z

items.name: GEOM_LADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector A), geom_mul A (vector_add (multivector A) x y) z = vector_add (multivector A) (geom_mul A x z) (geom_mul A y z)

items.name: GEOM_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), geom_mul A (vector_mul (multivector A) c x) y = vector_mul (multivector A) c (geom_mul A x y)

items.name: GEOM_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), geom_mul A (vector_neg (multivector A) x) y = vector_neg (multivector A) (geom_mul A x y)

items.name: GEOM_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), geom_mul A (vec (multivector A) 0) x = vec (multivector A) 0

items.name: GEOM_MBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= omega, geom_mul N (mbasis N s) (mbasis N t) = if s c= idx N /\ t c= idx N then vector_mul (multivector N) ((- 1) ^ finite_cardinality (\/_ i :e omega, {(i,j) | j :e omega, i :e s /\ (j :e t /\ j < i)})) (mbasis N ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s))) else vec (multivector N) 0

items.name: GEOM_MBASIS_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, geom_mul N (mbasis N {i}) (mbasis N {j}) = if i :e idx N /\ j :e idx N then if i = j then mbasis N Empty else if i < j then mbasis N {i,j} else vector_neg (multivector N) (mbasis N {i,j}) else vec (multivector N) 0

items.name: GEOM_RADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector A), geom_mul A x (vector_add (multivector A) y z) = vector_add (multivector A) (geom_mul A x y) (geom_mul A x z)

items.name: GEOM_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), geom_mul A x (vector_mul (multivector A) c y) = vector_mul (multivector A) c (geom_mul A x y)

items.name: GEOM_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), geom_mul A x (vector_neg (multivector A) y) = vector_neg (multivector A) (geom_mul A x y)

items.name: GEOM_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), geom_mul A x (vec (multivector A) 0) = vec (multivector A) 0

items.name: GRADE_ADD

items.name: GRADE_CMUL
