items.name: GRAM_SCHMIDT_STEP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ x :e span N s -> orthogonal N x (vector_sub N a (vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun b:set => vector_mul N (dot N b a :/: dot N b b) b)))

items.name: GRAPH_EMBEDS_IN_R3
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, atleastp s R -> exists v:set -> set, (forall x :e A, v x :e R :^: idx_n 3) /\ ((forall a b :e A, a :e s /\ b :e s -> (v a = v b <-> a = b)) /\ forall a b c d :e A, ~ {v a,v b} = {v c,v d} -> closed_segment (idx_n 3) (seq_cons (v a,v b) seq_nil) :/\: closed_segment (idx_n 3) (seq_cons (v c,v d) seq_nil) c= {v a,v b} :/\: {v c,v d})

items.name: GRASSMANN_PLUCKER_2
items.statement: forall x1 x2 y1 y2 :e R :^: idx_n 2, det (idx_n 2) (vector (R :^: idx_n 2) (idx_n 2) (seq_cons x1 (seq_cons x2 seq_nil))) * det (idx_n 2) (vector (R :^: idx_n 2) (idx_n 2) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons y2 seq_nil))) = det (idx_n 2) (vector (R :^: idx_n 2) (idx_n 2) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons x2 seq_nil))) * det (idx_n 2) (vector (R :^: idx_n 2) (idx_n 2) (seq_cons x1 (seq_cons y2 seq_nil))) + det (idx_n 2) (vector (R :^: idx_n 2) (idx_n 2) (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons x2 seq_nil))) * det (idx_n 2) (vector (R :^: idx_n 2) (idx_n 2) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons x1 seq_nil)))

items.name: GRASSMANN_PLUCKER_3
items.statement: forall x1 x2 x3 y1 y2 y3 :e R :^: idx_n 3, det (idx_n 3) (vector (R :^: idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x1 (seq_cons x2 (seq_cons x3 seq_nil)))) * det (idx_n 3) (vector (R :^: idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons y3 seq_nil)))) = det (idx_n 3) (vector (R :^: idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons x2 (seq_cons x3 seq_nil)))) * det (idx_n 3) (vector (R :^: idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x1 (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons y3 seq_nil)))) + det (idx_n 3) (vector (R :^: idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons x2 (seq_cons x3 seq_nil)))) * det (idx_n 3) (vector (R :^: idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons x1 (seq_cons y3 seq_nil)))) + det (idx_n 3) (vector (R :^: idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) (seq_cons y3 (seq_cons x2 (seq_cons x3 seq_nil)))) * det (idx_n 3) (vector (R :^: idx_n 3) (idx_n 3) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons x1 seq_nil))))

items.name: GRASSMANN_PLUCKER_4
items.statement: forall x1 x2 x3 x4 y1 y2 y3 y4 :e R :^: idx_n 4, det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons x1 (seq_cons x2 (seq_cons x3 (seq_cons x4 seq_nil))))) * det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons y3 (seq_cons y4 seq_nil))))) = det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons x2 (seq_cons x3 (seq_cons x4 seq_nil))))) * det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons x1 (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons y3 (seq_cons y4 seq_nil))))) + det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons x2 (seq_cons x3 (seq_cons x4 seq_nil))))) * det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons x1 (seq_cons y3 (seq_cons y4 seq_nil))))) + det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons y3 (seq_cons x2 (seq_cons x3 (seq_cons x4 seq_nil))))) * det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons x1 (seq_cons y4 seq_nil))))) + det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons y4 (seq_cons x2 (seq_cons x3 (seq_cons x4 seq_nil))))) * det (idx_n 4) (vector (R :^: idx_n 4) (idx_n 4) (seq_cons y1 (seq_cons y2 (seq_cons y3 (seq_cons x1 seq_nil)))))

items.name: GROUPS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G H :e group_hl A, G = H <-> group_carrier A G = group_carrier A H /\ (group_id A G = group_id A H /\ ((forall x :e A, group_inv A G x = group_inv A H x) /\ forall x x0 :e A, group_mul A G x x0 = group_mul A H x x0))

items.name: GROUP_ACTIONS_EQ_ON_GENERATORS
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall t c= A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall a':set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a' x y :e X) -> group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (group_action_hl A X G s a' /\ (forall g :e A, forall x :e X, g :e group_carrier A G /\ (g :e t /\ x :e s) -> a g x = a' g x)) -> forall g :e A, forall x :e X, g :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t) /\ x :e s -> a g x = a' g x

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_ALT
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> (group_action_hl A X G s a <-> (forall g :e A, forall x :e X, g :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s -> a g x :e s) /\ ((forall x :e X, x :e s -> a (group_id A G) x = x) /\ forall g h :e A, forall x :e X, g :e group_carrier A G /\ (h :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s) -> a g (a h x) = a (group_mul A G g h) x))

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_BIJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall g :e A, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ g :e group_carrier A G -> forall y :e X, y :e s -> exists x :e X, x :e s /\ a g x = y /\ forall y0 :e X, y0 :e s /\ a g y0 = y -> y0 = x

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall g :e A, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ g :e group_carrier A G -> {a g x | x :e s} c= s

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, group_action_hl A A G (group_carrier A G) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => group_conjugation A G x x0)

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_CONJUGATION_NORMAL_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> group_action_hl A A G n (fun x:set => fun x0:set => group_conjugation A G x x0)

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_EQ
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall g h :e A, forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (g :e group_carrier A G /\ (h :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s)) -> (a g x = a h x <-> group_mul A G (group_inv A G g) h :e group_stabilizer A X G a x)

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_FIBRES
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall h :e A, forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (h :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s) -> {g :e A | g :e group_carrier A G /\ a g x = a h x} = {group_mul A G h x0 | x0 :e group_stabilizer A X G a x}

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_FROM_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall h c= A, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> group_action_hl A X G s a -> group_action_hl A X (subgroup_generated A G h) s a

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_GROUP_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, group_action_hl A A G (group_carrier A G) (group_mul A G)

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall u c= Power X, forall s c= X, forall a :e X :^: X :^: A, group_action_hl A X G s (fun x:set => fun x0:set => a x x0) /\ ((forall t c= X, t :e u -> t c= s) /\ (forall g :e A, forall t c= X, g :e group_carrier A G /\ t :e u -> {a g x | x :e t} :e u)) -> group_action_hl A (Power X) G u (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e X | (fun x0 :e Power X => {x1 :e X | x1 :e {a x x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1})

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_IMAGE_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall u c= Power A, (forall t c= A, t :e u -> t c= group_carrier A G) /\ (forall g :e A, forall t c= A, g :e group_carrier A G /\ t :e u -> {group_conjugation A G g x | x :e t} :e u) -> group_action_hl A (Power A) G u (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e A | (fun x0 :e Power A => {x1 :e A | x1 :e {(fun x0 :e A => group_conjugation A G x x0) x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1})

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_IMAGE_CONJUGATION_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, group_action_hl A (Power A) G {s :e Power A | s c= group_carrier A G} (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e A | (fun x0 :e Power A => {x1 :e A | x1 :e {(fun x0 :e A => group_conjugation A G x x0) x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1})

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_IMAGE_CONJUGATION_SUBGROUPS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, group_action_hl A (Power A) G {n :e Power A | subgroup_of A n G} (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e A | (fun x0 :e Power A => {x1 :e A | x1 :e {(fun x0 :e A => group_conjugation A G x x0) x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1})

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_IMAGE_SIZED
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall k :e omega, forall a :e X :^: X :^: A, group_action_hl A X G s (fun x:set => fun x0:set => a x x0) -> group_action_hl A (Power X) G {t :e Power X | t c= s /\ equip t k} (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e X | (fun x0 :e Power X => {x1 :e X | x1 :e {a x x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1})

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall g :e A, forall x y :e X, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, forall y0 :e X, a x0 y0 :e X) -> group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (g :e group_carrier A G /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s)) -> (a g x = a g y <-> x = y)

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_INVARIANT
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall g :e A, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ g :e group_carrier A G -> {a g x | x :e s} = s

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_INVARIANT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall t c= X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ t c= s -> ((forall g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G -> {a g x | x :e t} c= t) <-> forall g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G -> {a g x | x :e t} = t)

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_KERNEL_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> {g :e A | g :e group_carrier A G /\ forall x :e X, x :e s -> a g x = x} = if s = Empty then group_carrier A G else {x :e A | forall Y :e {group_stabilizer A X G a x | x :e X, x :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_LEFT_COSET_MULTIPLICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, h c= group_carrier A G -> group_action_hl A (Power A) G {left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e A | (fun x0 :e Power A => {x1 :e A | x1 :e {(fun x0 :e A => group_mul A G x x0) x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1})

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_LINV
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall g :e A, forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (g :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s) -> a (group_inv A G g) (a g x) = x

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_MUL
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall g h :e A, forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (g :e group_carrier A G /\ (h :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s)) -> a g (a h x) = a (group_mul A G g h) x

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_ON_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (t c= s /\ (forall g :e A, forall x :e X, g :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e t -> a g x :e t)) -> group_action_hl A X G t a

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_RINV
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall g :e A, forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (g :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s) -> a g (a (group_inv A G g) x) = x

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_SUBGROUP_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, group_action_hl A A (subgroup_generated A G h) (group_carrier A G) (group_mul A G)

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_SUBSET_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall u c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e u -> s c= group_carrier A G) /\ (forall a :e A, forall s c= A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ s :e u -> {group_mul A G a x | x :e s} :e u) -> group_action_hl A (Power A) G u (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e A | (fun x0 :e Power A => {x1 :e A | x1 :e {(fun x0 :e A => group_mul A G x x0) x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1})

items.name: GROUP_ACTION_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall g :e A, forall y :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (g :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e s) -> exists x :e X, a g x = y

items.name: GROUP_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, group_add A G x y :e group_carrier A G <-> x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y z :e A, group_add A G x (group_add A G y z) = group_add A G (group_add A G x y) z

items.name: GROUP_ADD_EQ_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, group_add A G x y = group_id A G <-> group_add A G y x = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_ADD_EQ_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> group_add A G x y = group_mul A G x y

items.name: GROUP_ADD_LID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, group_add A G (group_id A G) x = x

items.name: GROUP_ADD_NMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, forall n :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G -> group_nmul A G n (group_add A G x y) = group_add A G (group_nmul A G n x) (group_nmul A G n y)

items.name: GROUP_ADD_RID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, group_add A G x (group_id A G) = x

items.name: GROUP_ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, abelian_group_hl A G -> group_add A G x y = group_add A G y x

items.name: GROUP_ADD_SYM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, (forall x y :e A, group_add A G x y = group_add A G y x) <-> abelian_group_hl A G

items.name: GROUP_AUTOMORPHISM_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G -> group_automorphism_hl A G (fun x:set => group_conjugation A G a x)

items.name: GROUP_AUTOMORPHISM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e A, f' x :e A) -> group_automorphism_hl A G f /\ (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> f' x = f x) -> group_automorphism_hl A G f'

items.name: GROUP_AUTOMORPHISM_IMP_ENDOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> group_automorphism_hl A G f -> group_endomorphism A G f

items.name: GROUP_CARRIER_HAS_SIZE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, equip (group_carrier A G) 1 <-> trivial_group A G

items.name: GROUP_CARRIER_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e omega, group_carrier int (integer_mod_group n) = {rem_int x n | x :e int}

items.name: GROUP_CARRIER_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, ~ group_carrier A G = Empty

items.name: GROUP_CARRIER_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group A (p,top)) = group_kernel (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (1 :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top),homology_group 1 (p,discrete_topology 1 {0})) (fun x:set => hom_induced A 1 p (top,Empty) (discrete_topology 1 {0},Empty) (fun x :e A => 0) x)

items.name: GROUP_CARRIER_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group A (p,top)) c= group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top))

items.name: GROUP_CARRIER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A (subgroup_generated A G s) t) c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t)

items.name: GROUP_CARRIER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G h) c= group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= group_carrier A G -> group_centralizer A G s = {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x}

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_centralizer A G s = {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ forall y :e A, y :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e s -> group_conjugation A G x y = y}

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_CENTRALIZER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= group_centralizer A G (group_centralizer A G s) <-> s c= group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_GALOIS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= group_carrier A G /\ t c= group_centralizer A G s -> s c= group_centralizer A G t

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_GALOIS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= group_carrier A G /\ t c= group_carrier A G -> (s c= group_centralizer A G t <-> t c= group_centralizer A G s)

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= t -> group_centralizer A G t c= group_centralizer A G s

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, ~ group_centralizer A G s = Empty

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_centralizer A G s = if s = Empty then group_carrier A G else {x :e A | forall Y :e {group_centralizer A G {x} | x :e A, x :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_centralizer A G s = group_centralizer A G (group_carrier A G :/\: s)

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h s c= A, s c= h /\ subgroup_of A h G -> group_centralizer A (subgroup_generated A G h) s = h :/\: group_centralizer A G s

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= group_centralizer A G s <-> s c= group_carrier A G /\ forall a b :e A, a :e s /\ b :e s -> group_mul A G a b = group_mul A G b a

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_SUBSET_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_centralizer A G s c= group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> (h c= group_centralizer A G h <-> abelian_group_hl A (subgroup_generated A G h))

items.name: GROUP_CENTRALIZER_SUBSET_NORMALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_centralizer A G s c= group_normalizer A G s

items.name: GROUP_CENTRE_EQ_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, group_centralizer A G (group_carrier A G) = group_carrier A G <-> abelian_group_hl A G

items.name: GROUP_COMMUTES_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) -> group_mul A G (group_inv A G x) y = group_mul A G y (group_inv A G x)

items.name: GROUP_COMMUTES_INV_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> (group_mul A G (group_inv A G x) y = group_mul A G y (group_inv A G x) <-> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x)

items.name: GROUP_COMMUTES_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y z :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ (z :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_mul A G x z = group_mul A G z x /\ group_mul A G y z = group_mul A G z y))) -> group_mul A G (group_mul A G x y) z = group_mul A G z (group_mul A G x y)

items.name: GROUP_COMMUTES_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) -> group_mul A G (group_pow A G x n) y = group_mul A G y (group_pow A G x n)

items.name: GROUP_COMMUTES_SUBGROUPS_GENERATED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) /\ y :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t) -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e t)) -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x

items.name: GROUP_COMMUTES_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall z :e A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> group_mul A G x z = group_mul A G z x) /\ z :e group_carrier A G -> forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) -> group_mul A G x z = group_mul A G z x

items.name: GROUP_COMMUTES_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall z :e A, z :e group_carrier A G -> ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) -> group_mul A G x z = group_mul A G z x) <-> forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s -> group_mul A G x z = group_mul A G z x)

items.name: GROUP_COMMUTES_ZPOW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, forall n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) -> group_mul A G (group_zpow A G x n) y = group_mul A G y (group_zpow A G x n)

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATE_IMP_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_conjugate A G s t -> equip s t

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATE_IMP_ISOMORPHIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_conjugate A G s t -> isomorphic_group A A (subgroup_generated A G s) (subgroup_generated A G t)

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATE_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_conjugate A G s t -> (normal_subgroup_of A s G <-> normal_subgroup_of A t G)

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATE_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_conjugate A G s s <-> s c= group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATE_SUBGROUPS_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_conjugate A G s t -> group_conjugate A G (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)) (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t))

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATE_SUBGROUP_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_conjugate A G s t -> (subgroup_of A s G <-> subgroup_of A t G)

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATE_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_conjugate A G s t <-> group_conjugate A G t s

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATE_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t u c= A, group_conjugate A G s t /\ group_conjugate A G t u -> group_conjugate A G s u

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> group_conjugation A G x y :e group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION_BY_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_conjugation A G (group_id A G) x = x

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a b x :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ (b :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e group_carrier A G) -> group_conjugation A G a (group_conjugation A G b x) = group_conjugation A G (group_mul A G a b) x

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a x y :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> (group_conjugation A G a x = group_conjugation A G a y <-> x = y)

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION_EQ_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a x :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_conjugation A G a x = group_id A G <-> x = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> (group_conjugation A G x y = y <-> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x)

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION_LINV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a x :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> group_conjugation A G (group_inv A G a) (group_conjugation A G a x) = x

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION_RIGHT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ h c= group_carrier A G -> {group_conjugation A G x x0 | x0 :e right_coset_hl A G h x} = left_coset_hl A G x h

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION_RINV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a x :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> group_conjugation A G a (group_conjugation A G (group_inv A G a) x) = x

items.name: GROUP_CONJUGATION_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall x x0 :e A, group_conjugation A (subgroup_generated A G s) x x0 = group_conjugation A G x x0

items.name: GROUP_DIRECT_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c c= group_hl A, ~ c = Empty /\ (forall g g' :e group_hl A, g :e c /\ g' :e c -> exists G :e group_hl A, G :e c /\ (group_monomorphism A A (g,G) (fun x:set => x) /\ group_monomorphism A A (g',G) (fun x:set => x))) -> exists G :e group_hl A, group_carrier A G = Union {group_carrier A g | g :e group_hl A, g :e c} /\ forall g :e group_hl A, g :e c -> group_monomorphism A A (g,G) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: GROUP_DISJOINT_SUM_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> (g :/\: h c= {group_id A G} <-> g :/\: h = {group_id A G})

items.name: GROUP_DISJOINT_SUM_CANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> (g :/\: h c= {group_id A G} <-> forall x x' y y' :e A, x :e g /\ (x' :e g /\ (y :e h /\ (y' :e h /\ group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G x' y'))) -> x = x' /\ y = y')

items.name: GROUP_DISJOINT_SUM_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> (g :/\: h c= {group_id A G} <-> forall x y :e A, x :e g /\ (y :e h /\ group_mul A G x y = group_id A G) -> x = group_id A G /\ y = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> group_div A G x y :e group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_DIV_EQ_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> (group_div A G x y = group_id A G <-> x = y)

items.name: GROUP_DIV_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_div A G x x = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_DIV_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall x x0 :e A, group_div A (subgroup_generated A G s) x x0 = group_div A G x x0

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> group_element_order_hl A G (group_conjugation A G x y) = group_element_order_hl A G y

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_COPRIME_DECOMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall z :e A, forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n = 1 /\ (z :e group_carrier A G /\ group_element_order_hl A G z = m * n) -> exists x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_mul A G x y = z /\ (group_mul A G y x = z /\ (group_element_order_hl A G x = m /\ group_element_order_hl A G y = n))))

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_COPRIME_DECOMP_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall z :e A, forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n = 1 /\ (z :e group_carrier A G /\ divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G z) (m * n)) -> exists x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_mul A G x y = z /\ (group_mul A G y x = z /\ (divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G x) m /\ divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G y) n))))

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_COPRIME_DECOMP_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n = 1 /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ group_element_order_hl A G x = m * n) -> exists r s :e int, group_element_order_hl A G (group_zpow A G x r) = m /\ (group_element_order_hl A G (group_zpow A G x s) = n /\ group_mul A G (group_zpow A G x r) (group_zpow A G x s) = x)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_COPRIME_DECOMP_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall z :e A, forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n = 1 /\ (z :e group_carrier A G /\ group_element_order_hl A G z = m * n) -> exists x :e A :*: A, x 0 :e group_carrier A G /\ (x 1 :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_mul A G (x 0) (x 1) = z /\ (group_mul A G (x 1) (x 0) = z /\ (group_element_order_hl A G (x 0) = m /\ group_element_order_hl A G (x 1) = n)))) /\ forall y :e A :*: A, y 0 :e group_carrier A G /\ (y 1 :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_mul A G (y 0) (y 1) = z /\ (group_mul A G (y 1) (y 0) = z /\ (group_element_order_hl A G (y 0) = m /\ group_element_order_hl A G (y 1) = n)))) -> y = x

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_DIVIDES_GROUP_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ finite (group_carrier A G) -> divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G x) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_element_order_hl A G x = 0 <-> forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> ~ group_pow A G x n = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_EQ_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_element_order_hl A G x = 1 <-> x = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_EQ_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_element_order_hl A G x = 2 <-> ~ x = group_id A G /\ group_pow A G x 2 = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_EQ_2_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_element_order_hl A G x = 2 <-> ~ x = group_id A G /\ group_inv A G x = x)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_EQ_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall k n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (~ k = 0 /\ divides_nat k n) -> (group_element_order_hl A G x = k * n <-> group_element_order_hl A G (group_pow A G x k) = n)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_EQ_MUL_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall k n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ k = 0 -> (group_element_order_hl A G x = k * n <-> divides_nat k (group_element_order_hl A G x) /\ group_element_order_hl A G (group_pow A G x k) = n)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_HOMOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> divides_nat (group_element_order_hl B H (f x)) (group_element_order_hl A G x)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, group_element_order_hl A G (group_id A G) = 1

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_INTEGER_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e int, group_element_order_hl int integer_group n = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n m :e omega, group_element_order_hl int (integer_mod_group n) m = if m = 0 /\ n = 0 then 1 else div_nat n (gcd_int n m)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, group_element_order_hl int (integer_mod_group n) 1 = n

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP_1R
items.statement: forall n :e omega, group_element_order_hl int (integer_mod_group n) (rem_int 1 n) = n

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_element_order_hl A G (group_inv A G x) = group_element_order_hl A G x

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_LCM_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) -> exists z :e A, z :e group_carrier A G /\ group_element_order_hl A G z = lcm_int (group_element_order_hl A G x) (group_element_order_hl A G y)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_MONOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall x :e A, group_monomorphism A B (G,H) f /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> group_element_order_hl B H (f x) = group_element_order_hl A G x

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_MUL_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) -> divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G (group_mul A G x y)) (group_element_order_hl A G x * group_element_order_hl A G y)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_MUL_DIVIDES_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x /\ (divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G x) n /\ divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G y) n))) -> divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G (group_mul A G x y)) n

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_MUL_DIVIDES_LCM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) -> divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G (group_mul A G x y)) (lcm_int (group_element_order_hl A G x) (group_element_order_hl A G y))

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_MUL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x /\ gcd_int (group_element_order_hl A G x) (group_element_order_hl A G y) = 1)) -> group_element_order_hl A G (group_mul A G x y) = group_element_order_hl A G x * group_element_order_hl A G y

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_MUL_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> group_element_order_hl A G (group_mul A G x y) = group_element_order_hl A G (group_mul A G y x)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall k :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (~ k = 0 /\ divides_nat k (group_element_order_hl A G x)) -> group_element_order_hl A G (group_pow A G x k) = div_nat (group_element_order_hl A G x) k

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_POW_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G (group_pow A G x n)) (group_element_order_hl A G x)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_POW_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall k :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_element_order_hl A G (group_pow A G x k) = if k = 0 then 1 else div_nat (group_element_order_hl A G x) (gcd_int (group_element_order_hl A G x) k)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_PRIME
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, prime_nat p /\ (equip (group_carrier A G) p /\ a :e group_carrier A G) -> group_element_order_hl A G a = if a = group_id A G then 1 else finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_PRIMEPOW_DECOMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall z :e A, forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (z :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ group_element_order_hl A G z = 0) -> exists x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_mul A G x y = z /\ (group_mul A G y x = z /\ ((exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k) /\ gcd_int p (group_element_order_hl A G y) = 1))))

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier B H -> group_element_order_hl (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G H) (x,y) = lcm_int (group_element_order_hl A G x) (group_element_order_hl B H y)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_PROD_GROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall z :e A :*: B, z :e group_carrier (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G H) -> group_element_order_hl (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G H) z = lcm_int (group_element_order_hl A G (z 0)) (group_element_order_hl B H (z 1))

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, group_element_order_hl A (subgroup_generated A G h) x = group_element_order_hl A G x

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall k c= K, forall x :e A :^: K, x :e group_carrier (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) -> group_element_order_hl (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) x = iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k (fun i:set => group_element_order_hl A (G i) (x i))

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_SUM_GROUP_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall k c= K, forall x :e A :^: K, x :e group_carrier (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) -> (group_element_order_hl (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) x = 0 <-> exists i :e K, i :e k /\ group_element_order_hl A (G i) (x i) = 0)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall d :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_element_order_hl A G x = d <-> forall n :e omega, group_pow A G x n = group_id A G <-> divides_nat d n)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ n = 0 -> (group_element_order_hl A G x = n <-> group_pow A G x n = group_id A G /\ forall m :e omega, 0 < m /\ m < n -> ~ group_pow A G x m = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_ELEMENT_ORDER_UNIQUE_PRIME
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall p :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ prime_nat p -> (group_element_order_hl A G x = p <-> ~ x = group_id A G /\ group_pow A G x p = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_ENDOMORPHISM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e A, f' x :e A) -> group_endomorphism A G f /\ (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> f' x = f x) -> group_endomorphism A G f'

items.name: GROUP_ENDOMORPHISM_INTEGER_GROUP_EQ
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e int, f x :e int) -> (group_endomorphism int integer_group f <-> exists c :e int, forall x :e int, f x = c * x)

items.name: GROUP_ENDOMORPHISM_INTEGER_GROUP_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e int, f x :e int) -> (group_endomorphism int integer_group f <-> exists c :e int, (forall x :e int, f x = c * x) /\ forall y :e int, (forall x :e int, f x = y * x) -> y = c)

items.name: GROUP_ENDOMORPHISM_INTEGER_GROUP_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e int, f x :e int) -> group_endomorphism int integer_group f -> forall x :e int, f x = f 1 * x

items.name: GROUP_ENDOMORPHISM_INTEGER_GROUP_MUL
items.statement: forall c :e int, group_endomorphism int integer_group (fun x:set => c * x)

items.name: GROUP_EPIMORPHISM_BETWEEN_SUBGROUPS

items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, group_homomorphism_hl A B (A0,B0) f /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B C (B0,C0) g /\ group_epimorphism A C (A0,C0) (fun x:set => g (f x))) -> group_epimorphism B C (B0,C0) g

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e A, f' x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> f' x = f x) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f'

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> (group_epimorphism (A :*: A) A (prod_group A A (subgroup_generated A G g) (subgroup_generated A G h),G) (fun p:set => group_mul A G (p 0) (p 1)) <-> group_setmul A G g h = group_carrier A G /\ forall x y :e A, x :e g /\ y :e h -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x)

items.name: GROUP_MUL_RINV

items.name: GROUP_MUL_SUBGROUP

items.name: GROUP_MUL_ZPOW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, forall n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x) -> group_zpow A G (group_mul A G x y) n = group_mul A G (group_zpow A G x n) (group_zpow A G y n)

items.name: GROUP_NEG

items.name: GROUP_NEG_ADD

items.name: GROUP_NEG_EQ_ID

items.name: GROUP_NEG_EQ_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_neg A G x = group_inv A G x

items.name: GROUP_NEG_ID

items.name: GROUP_NEG_NEG

items.name: GROUP_NEG_NMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, group_neg A G (group_nmul A G n x) = group_nmul A G n (group_neg A G x)

items.name: GROUP_NMUL_1

items.name: GROUP_NMUL_ADD

items.name: GROUP_NMUL_EQ_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_nmul A G n x = group_pow A G x n

items.name: GROUP_NMUL_MUL

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= group_carrier A G -> group_normalizer A G s = {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ {group_conjugation A G x x0 | x0 :e s} = s}

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_normalizer A G s = {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ {group_conjugation A G x x0 | x0 :e group_carrier A G :/\: s} = group_carrier A G :/\: s}

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= group_carrier A G /\ finite s -> group_normalizer A G s = {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ {group_conjugation A G x x0 | x0 :e s} c= s}

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h n c= A, subgroup_of A n G -> (normal_subgroup_of A h (subgroup_generated A G n) <-> subgroup_of A h G /\ (h c= n /\ n c= group_normalizer A G h))

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_MAXIMAL_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h (subgroup_generated A G n) <-> subgroup_of A h (subgroup_generated A G n) /\ group_carrier A G :/\: n c= group_normalizer A G h

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, ~ group_normalizer A G s = Empty

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_normalizer A G s = group_normalizer A G (group_carrier A G :/\: s)

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_SING

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h s c= A, s c= h /\ subgroup_of A h G -> group_normalizer A (subgroup_generated A G h) s = h :/\: group_normalizer A G s

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> h c= group_normalizer A G h

items.name: GROUP_NORMALIZER_SUBSET_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_normalizer A G s c= group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_NPOW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, group_zpow A G x n = group_pow A G x n

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a -> forall x0 :e X, group_orbit A X G s a x x0 <-> (x :e s -> x0 :e {a g x | g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G}) /\ (~ x :e s -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: GROUP_ORBITS_EQ
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> ((forall x0 :e X, group_orbit A X G s a x x0 <-> group_orbit A X G s a y x0) <-> ~ {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} :/\: {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a y x0} = Empty)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_COMMON_DIVISOR
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall n :e omega, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (finite s /\ (forall x :e X, x :e s -> divides_nat n (finite_cardinality {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0}))) -> divides_nat n (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_COMMON_INDEX
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall p k :e omega, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (finite s /\ ((s = Empty -> k = 0) /\ (forall x :e X, x :e s -> k <= prime_index p (finite_cardinality {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0})))) -> k <= prime_index p (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_CONJUGATE_STABILIZERS
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ group_orbit A X G s a x y -> group_conjugate A G (group_stabilizer A X G a x) (group_stabilizer A X G a y)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x x0 :e A, group_orbit A A G (group_carrier A G) (fun x1:set => fun x2:set => group_conjugation A G x1 x2) x x0 <-> (x :e group_carrier A G -> x0 :e {y :e A | y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_conjugate A G {x} {y}}) /\ (~ x :e group_carrier A G -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_CONJUGATION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s c= group_carrier A G -> forall x0 :e A, group_orbit A A G s (fun x1:set => fun x2:set => group_conjugation A G x1 x2) x x0 <-> (x :e s -> x0 :e {y :e A | y :e s /\ group_conjugate A G {x} {y}}) /\ (~ x :e s -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, ~ x :e s -> forall x0 :e X, group_orbit A X G s a x x0 <-> x0 :e Empty

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_EQ
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> ((forall x0 :e X, group_orbit A X G s a x x0 <-> group_orbit A X G s a y x0) <-> group_orbit A X G s a x y)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a -> ((forall x0 :e X, group_orbit A X G s a x x0 <-> x0 :e Empty) <-> ~ x :e s)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a -> ((forall x0 :e X, group_orbit A X G s a y x0 <-> x0 :e SetAdjoin Empty x) <-> x :e s /\ (y = x /\ forall g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G -> a g x = x))

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_EQ_SING_SELF
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a -> ((forall x0 :e X, group_orbit A X G s a x x0 <-> x0 :e SetAdjoin Empty x) <-> x :e s /\ forall g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G -> a g x = x)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_GROUP_TRANSLATION

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_HAS_SIZE_1
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a -> (equip {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} 1 <-> x :e s /\ forall g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G -> a g x = x)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_IMAGE_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall x x0 c= A, group_orbit A (Power A) G {s :e Power A | s c= group_carrier A G} (fun x1:set => fun x2:set => {x3 :e A | (fun x2 :e Power A => {x3 :e A | x3 :e {(fun x2 :e A => group_conjugation A G x1 x2) x3 | x3 :e x2}}) x2 x3}) x x0 <-> group_conjugate A G x x0

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_IMAGE_CONJUGATION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall u c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall t c= A, t :e u -> t c= group_carrier A G) /\ s :e u -> forall t c= A, group_orbit A (Power A) G u (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e A | (fun x0 :e Power A => {x1 :e A | x1 :e {(fun x0 :e A => group_conjugation A G x x0) x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1}) s t <-> t :e u /\ group_conjugate A G s t

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_LEFT_COSET_MULTIPLICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> forall x c= A, group_orbit A (Power A) G {left_coset_hl A G x0 h | x0 :e A, x0 :e group_carrier A G} (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => {x2 :e A | (fun x1 :e Power A => {x2 :e A | x2 :e {(fun x1 :e A => group_mul A G x0 x1) x2 | x2 :e x1}}) x1 x2}) (left_coset_hl A G a h) x <-> x :e {left_coset_hl A G x0 h | x0 :e A, x0 :e group_carrier A G}

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_LEFT_COSET_MULTIPLICATION_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> forall x c= A, group_orbit A (Power A) G {left_coset_hl A G x0 h | x0 :e A, x0 :e group_carrier A G} (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => {x2 :e A | (fun x1 :e Power A => {x2 :e A | x2 :e {(fun x1 :e A => group_mul A G x0 x1) x2 | x2 :e x1}}) x1 x2}) h x <-> x :e {left_coset_hl A G x0 h | x0 :e A, x0 :e group_carrier A G}

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_ON_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e X, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, forall y :e X, a x0 y :e X) -> t c= s /\ x :e t -> forall x0 :e X, group_orbit A X G t a x x0 <-> x0 :e t :/\: {x1 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x1}

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_REFL
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s -> group_orbit A X G s a x x

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a -> (group_orbit A X G s a x x <-> x :e s)

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_SUBGROUP_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> forall x :e A, group_orbit A A (subgroup_generated A G h) (group_carrier A G) (group_mul A G) a x <-> x :e right_coset_hl A G h a

items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} c= s

items.name: GROUP_ORBIT_SYM
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ group_orbit A X G s a x y -> group_orbit A X G s a y x

items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a -> (group_orbit A X G s a x y <-> group_orbit A X G s a y x)
