items.name: GROUP_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow A G x n :e group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_POW_0
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, group_pow A G x 0 = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_POW_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow A G x 1 = x

items.name: GROUP_POW_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow A G x 2 = group_mul A G x x

items.name: GROUP_POW_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow A G x (m + n) = group_mul A G (group_pow A G x m) (group_pow A G x n)

items.name: GROUP_POW_CANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, forall x y :e A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1 /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_pow A G x n = group_pow A G y n))) -> x = y

items.name: GROUP_POW_COPRIME_EQ_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ gcd_int m n = 1 -> (group_pow A G x m = group_id A G /\ group_pow A G x n = group_id A G <-> x = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_POW_ELEMENT_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow A G x (group_element_order_hl A G x) = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_POW_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_pow A G x m = group_pow A G x n <-> exists q1 q2 :e omega, m + group_element_order_hl A G x * q1 = n + group_element_order_hl A G x * q2)

items.name: GROUP_POW_EQ_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_pow A G x n = group_id A G <-> divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G x) n)

items.name: GROUP_POW_EQ_ID_DECOMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall z :e A, forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n = 1 /\ (z :e group_carrier A G /\ group_pow A G z (m * n) = group_id A G) -> exists x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_mul A G x y = z /\ (group_mul A G y x = z /\ (group_pow A G x m = group_id A G /\ group_pow A G y n = group_id A G))))

items.name: GROUP_POW_EQ_ID_DIVISOR
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_pow A G x m = group_id A G /\ divides_nat m n) -> group_pow A G x n = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_POW_GCD_EQ_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_pow A G x (gcd_int m n) = group_id A G <-> group_pow A G x m = group_id A G /\ group_pow A G x n = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_POW_GROUP_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ finite (group_carrier A G) -> group_pow A G x (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_POW_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, group_pow A G (group_id A G) n = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_POW_INTEGER_GROUP
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, group_pow int integer_group x n = n * x

items.name: GROUP_POW_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x :e int, forall m :e omega, group_pow int (integer_mod_group n) x m = rem_int (m * x) n

items.name: GROUP_POW_MOD_ELEMENT_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow A G x (mod_nat n (group_element_order_hl A G x)) = group_pow A G x n

items.name: GROUP_POW_MOD_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow A G x (mod_nat n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))) = group_pow A G x n

items.name: GROUP_POW_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow A G x (m * n) = group_pow A G (group_pow A G x m) n

items.name: GROUP_POW_MUL_EQ_ID_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> (group_pow A G (group_mul A G x y) n = group_id A G <-> group_pow A G (group_mul A G y x) n = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_POW_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow A G (group_pow A G x m) n = group_pow A G x (m * n)

items.name: GROUP_POW_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall k c= K, forall x :e A :^: K, forall n :e omega, forall x0 :e K, group_pow (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) x n x0 = if x0 :e k then group_pow A (G x0) (x x0) n else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)

items.name: GROUP_POW_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier B H -> group_pow (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G H) (x,y) n = (group_pow A G x n,group_pow B H y n)

items.name: GROUP_POW_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ n <= m -> group_pow A G x (minus_nat m n) = group_div A G (group_pow A G x m) (group_pow A G x n)

items.name: GROUP_POW_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_pow A (subgroup_generated A G s) = group_pow A G

items.name: GROUP_POW_SUB_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ n <= m -> group_pow A G x (minus_nat m n) = group_mul A G (group_inv A G (group_pow A G x n)) (group_pow A G x m)

items.name: GROUP_POW_SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall k c= K, forall x :e A :^: K, forall n :e omega, forall x0 :e K, group_pow (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) x n x0 = if x0 :e k then group_pow A (G x0) (x x0) n else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)

items.name: GROUP_PRODUCT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A K:set, forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall a :e A, forall i :e K, (fun x :e K => if x :e k then if x = i then a else group_id A (G x) else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) :e group_carrier (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) <-> i :e k -> a :e group_carrier A (G i)

items.name: GROUP_RID_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> (group_mul A G x y = x <-> y = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_RID_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x y = x) -> y = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_RINV_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> (group_inv A G x = y <-> group_mul A G y x = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_RINV_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x y = group_id A G) -> group_inv A G y = x

items.name: GROUP_SEMIDIRECT_SUM_IM_KER
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall K :e group_hl C, group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B C (H,K) g /\ group_isomorphism_hl A C (G,K) (fun x:set => g (f x))) -> group_image A B (G,H) f :/\: group_kernel B C (H,K) g = {group_id B H} /\ group_setmul B H (group_image A B (G,H) f) (group_kernel B C (H,K) g) = group_carrier B H

items.name: GROUP_SEMIDIRECT_SUM_KER_IM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall K :e group_hl C, group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B C (H,K) g /\ group_isomorphism_hl A C (G,K) (fun x:set => g (f x))) -> group_kernel B C (H,K) g :/\: group_image A B (G,H) f = {group_id B H} /\ group_setmul B H (group_kernel B C (H,K) g) (group_image A B (G,H) f) = group_carrier B H

items.name: GROUP_SETINV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g c= A, g c= group_carrier A G -> group_setinv A G g c= group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_AS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall x c= A, group_setinv A G x = {group_inv A G x0 | x0 :e x}

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g c= A, group_setinv A G g = Empty <-> g = Empty

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_LEFT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall a :e A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> group_setinv A G (left_coset_hl A G a n) = left_coset_hl A G (group_inv A G a) n

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_LEFT_COSET_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> group_setinv A G (left_coset_hl A G a h) = right_coset_hl A G h (group_inv A G a)

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s s' c= A, s c= s' -> group_setinv A G s c= group_setinv A G s'

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_RIGHT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall a :e A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> group_setinv A G (right_coset_hl A G n a) = right_coset_hl A G n (group_inv A G a)

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_RIGHT_COSET_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> group_setinv A G (right_coset_hl A G h a) = left_coset_hl A G (group_inv A G a) h

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, group_setinv A G {x} = {group_inv A G x}

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> group_setinv A G h = h

items.name: GROUP_SETINV_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h x c= A, group_setinv A (subgroup_generated A G h) x = group_setinv A G x

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, g c= group_carrier A G /\ h c= group_carrier A G -> group_setmul A G g h c= group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h i c= A, g c= group_carrier A G /\ (h c= group_carrier A G /\ i c= group_carrier A G) -> group_setmul A G g (group_setmul A G h i) = group_setmul A G (group_setmul A G g h) i

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_setmul A G s Empty = Empty) /\ forall G :e group_hl A, forall t c= A, group_setmul A G Empty t = Empty

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, group_setmul A G g h = Empty <-> g = Empty \/ h = Empty

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, subgroup_of A s G /\ subgroup_of A t G -> t c= group_setmul A G s t) /\ forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, subgroup_of A s G /\ subgroup_of A t G -> s c= group_setmul A G s t

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_INC_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_id A G :e s /\ t c= group_carrier A G -> t c= group_setmul A G s t) /\ forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= group_carrier A G /\ group_id A G :e t -> s c= group_setmul A G s t

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (g c= group_carrier A G /\ h c= group_carrier A G) -> (group_setmul A G {x} g = group_setmul A G {x} h <-> g = h)

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_LCANCEL_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ subgroup_of A h G) -> (group_setmul A G h {x} = group_setmul A G h {y} <-> group_div A G x y :e h)

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_LEFT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall a b :e A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (a :e group_carrier A G /\ b :e group_carrier A G) -> group_setmul A G (left_coset_hl A G a n) (left_coset_hl A G b n) = left_coset_hl A G (group_mul A G a b) n

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_LID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g c= A, g c= group_carrier A G -> group_setmul A G {group_id A G} g = g

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_LSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h s c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (s c= h /\ ~ s = Empty) -> group_setmul A G s h = h

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_LSUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h s c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ s c= group_carrier A G -> (group_setmul A G s h = h <-> s c= h /\ ~ s = Empty)

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t s' t' c= A, s c= s' /\ t c= t' -> group_setmul A G s t c= group_setmul A G s' t'

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_NORMAL_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h k c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G /\ normal_subgroup_of A k G -> normal_subgroup_of A (group_setmul A G h k) G

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> subgroup_of A (group_setmul A G n h) G

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h n c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ normal_subgroup_of A n G -> subgroup_of A (group_setmul A G h n) G

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, group_setmul (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e group_setmul A (G i) (s i) (t i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G1 :e group_hl A, forall G2 :e group_hl B, forall s1 c= A, forall s2 c= B, forall t1 c= A, forall t2 c= B, group_setmul (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G1 G2) (s1 :*: s2) (t1 :*: t2) = group_setmul A G1 s1 t1 :*: group_setmul B G2 s2 t2

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (g c= group_carrier A G /\ h c= group_carrier A G) -> (group_setmul A G g {x} = group_setmul A G h {x} <-> g = h)

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_RCANCEL_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ subgroup_of A h G) -> (group_setmul A G {x} h = group_setmul A G {y} h <-> group_mul A G (group_inv A G x) y :e h)

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_RID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g c= A, g c= group_carrier A G -> group_setmul A G g {group_id A G} = g

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_RIGHT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall a b :e A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (a :e group_carrier A G /\ b :e group_carrier A G) -> group_setmul A G (right_coset_hl A G n a) (right_coset_hl A G n b) = right_coset_hl A G n (group_mul A G a b)

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_RSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h s c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (s c= h /\ ~ s = Empty) -> group_setmul A G h s = h

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_RSUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h s c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ s c= group_carrier A G -> (group_setmul A G h s = h <-> s c= h /\ ~ s = Empty)

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, group_setmul A G {x} {y} = {group_mul A G x y}

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> group_setmul A G h h = h

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h x x0 c= A, group_setmul A (subgroup_generated A G h) x x0 = group_setmul A G x x0

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, abelian_group_hl A G /\ (g c= group_carrier A G /\ h c= group_carrier A G) -> group_setmul A G g h = group_setmul A G h g

items.name: GROUP_SETMUL_SYM_ELEMENTWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t u c= A, (forall a :e A, a :e s -> group_setmul A G {a} t = group_setmul A G u {a}) -> group_setmul A G s t = group_setmul A G u s

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G -> group_stabilizer A A G (fun x:set => fun x0:set => group_conjugation A G x x0) a = group_centralizer A G {a}

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_GROUP_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G -> group_stabilizer A A G (group_mul A G) a = {group_id A G}

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_IMAGE_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= group_carrier A G -> group_stabilizer A (Power A) G (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e A | (fun x0 :e Power A => {x1 :e A | x1 :e {(fun x0 :e A => group_conjugation A G x x0) x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1}) s = group_normalizer A G s

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_LEFT_COSET_MULTIPLICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> group_stabilizer A (Power A) G (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e A | (fun x0 :e Power A => {x1 :e A | x1 :e {(fun x0 :e A => group_mul A G x x0) x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1}) (left_coset_hl A G a h) = {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e h}

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_LEFT_COSET_MULTIPLICATION_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> group_stabilizer A (Power A) G (fun x:set => fun x0:set => {x1 :e A | (fun x0 :e Power A => {x1 :e A | x1 :e {(fun x0 :e A => group_mul A G x x0) x1 | x1 :e x0}}) x0 x1}) h = h

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall s c= X, forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s -> ~ group_stabilizer A X G a x = Empty

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_OF_ACTION
items.statement: forall A X:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall g :e A, forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (g :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s) -> group_stabilizer A X G a (a g x) = {group_conjugation A G g x0 | x0 :e group_stabilizer A X G a x}

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_ON_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, subgroup_of A h G -> group_stabilizer A X (subgroup_generated A G h) a x = h :/\: group_stabilizer A X G a x

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_stabilizer A X (subgroup_generated A G h) a x = group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G h) :/\: group_stabilizer A X G a x

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_SUBGROUP_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> group_stabilizer A A (subgroup_generated A G h) (group_mul A G) a = {group_id A G}

items.name: GROUP_STABILIZER_SUBSET_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl B, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, a x y :e A) -> forall x :e A, group_stabilizer B A G a x c= group_carrier B G

items.name: GROUP_SUM_COMMUTING_IMP_NORMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ (group_carrier A G c= group_setmul A G g h /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e g /\ y :e h -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x))) -> normal_subgroup_of A g G /\ normal_subgroup_of A h G

items.name: GROUP_SUM_IM_KER
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall K :e group_hl C, group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B C (H,K) g /\ group_epimorphism A C (G,K) (fun x:set => g (f x))) -> group_setmul B H (group_image A B (G,H) f) (group_kernel B C (H,K) g) = group_carrier B H

items.name: GROUP_SUM_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A K:set, forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall a :e A, forall i :e K, (fun x :e K => if x :e k then if x = i then a else group_id A (G x) else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) :e group_carrier (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) <-> i :e k -> a :e group_carrier A (G i)

items.name: GROUP_SUM_KER_IM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall K :e group_hl C, group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B C (H,K) g /\ group_epimorphism A C (G,K) (fun x:set => g (f x))) -> group_setmul B H (group_kernel B C (H,K) g) (group_image A B (G,H) f) = group_carrier B H

items.name: GROUP_SUM_NORMAL_EQ_COMMUTING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ (group_carrier A G c= group_setmul A G g h /\ g :/\: h c= {group_id A G})) -> (normal_subgroup_of A g G /\ normal_subgroup_of A h G <-> forall x y :e A, x :e g /\ y :e h -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x)

items.name: GROUP_SUM_NORMAL_IMP_COMMUTING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A g G /\ (normal_subgroup_of A h G /\ g :/\: h c= {group_id A G}) -> forall x y :e A, x :e g /\ y :e h -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x n :e group_carrier A G

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_0
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, group_zpow A G x 0 = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x 1 = x

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x 2 = group_mul A G x x

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_ABS_EQ_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_zpow A G x (abs_SNo n) = group_id A G <-> group_zpow A G x n = group_id A G)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x (m + n) = group_mul A G (group_zpow A G x m) (group_zpow A G x n)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_CANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e int, forall x y :e A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (gcd_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = 1 /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ group_zpow A G x n = group_zpow A G y n))) -> x = y

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_zpow A G x m = group_zpow A G x n <-> divides_int (group_element_order_hl A G x) (m + - n))

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_zpow A G x m = group_zpow A G x n <-> divides_int (group_element_order_hl A G x) (n + - m))

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_EQ_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_zpow A G x n = group_id A G <-> divides_int (group_element_order_hl A G x) n)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_EQ_ID_DIVISOR
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (group_zpow A G x m = group_id A G /\ divides_int m n) -> group_zpow A G x n = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e int, group_zpow A G (group_id A G) n = group_id A G

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_INTEGER_GROUP
items.statement: forall x n :e int, group_zpow int integer_group x n = n * x

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x m :e int, group_zpow int (integer_mod_group n) x m = rem_int (m * x) n

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G (group_inv A G x) n = group_zpow A G x (- n)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_MINUS1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x (- 1) = group_inv A G x

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x (m * n) = group_zpow A G (group_zpow A G x m) n

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x (- n) = group_inv A G (group_zpow A G x n)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, group_zpow A G x n = group_pow A G x n) /\ forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, group_zpow A G x (- n) = group_inv A G (group_pow A G x n)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall k c= K, forall x :e A :^: K, forall n :e int, forall x0 :e K, group_zpow (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) x n x0 = if x0 :e k then group_zpow A (G x0) (x x0) n else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier B H -> group_zpow (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G H) (x,y) n = (group_zpow A G x n,group_zpow B H y n)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_REM_ELEMENT_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x (rem_int n (group_element_order_hl A G x)) = group_zpow A G x n

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_REM_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e int, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x (rem_int n (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))) = group_zpow A G x n

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x (m + - n) = group_div A G (group_zpow A G x m) (group_zpow A G x n)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, forall x0 :e int, group_zpow A (subgroup_generated A G s) x x0 = group_zpow A G x x0

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_SUB_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall m n :e int, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow A G x (m + - n) = group_mul A G (group_inv A G (group_zpow A G x n)) (group_zpow A G x m)

items.name: GROUP_ZPOW_SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall k c= K, forall x :e A :^: K, forall n :e int, forall x0 :e K, group_zpow (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) x n x0 = if x0 :e k then group_zpow A (G x0) (x x0) n else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)

items.name: GT
items.statement: forall n m :e omega, n < m <-> n < m

items.name: HADAMARD_INEQUALITY_COLUMN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, abs_SNo (det N A) <= finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_norm N (column N N i A))

items.name: HADAMARD_INEQUALITY_PSD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A -> det N A <= finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => A i i)

items.name: HADAMARD_INEQUALITY_ROW
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, abs_SNo (det N A) <= finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_norm N (row N N i A))

items.name: HAHN_MAZURKIEWICZ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top -> ((exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e A) /\ (continuous_map R A (subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)),top) f /\ {f x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)} = topspace A top)) <-> compact_space A top /\ (connected_space A top /\ (locally_connected_space A top /\ (metrizable_space A top /\ ~ topspace A top = Empty))))

items.name: HAHN_MAZURKIEWICZ_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top /\ (connected_space A top /\ (locally_connected_space A top /\ (metrizable_space A top /\ ~ topspace A top = Empty))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e A) /\ (continuous_map R A (subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)),top) f /\ {f x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)} = topspace A top)

items.name: HAIRY_BALL_THEOREM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, (exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f (sphere N (vec N 0,r)) /\ ({f x | x :e sphere N (vec N 0,r)} c= sphere N (vec N 0,r) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e sphere N (vec N 0,r) -> ~ f x = vec N 0 /\ orthogonal N x (f x)))) <-> r < 0 \/ 0 < r /\ even_nat (dimindex N)

items.name: HAIRY_BALL_THEOREM_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, (exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f (sphere N (vec N 0,r)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e sphere N (vec N 0,r) -> ~ f x = vec N 0 /\ orthogonal N x (f x))) <-> r <= 0 \/ even_nat (dimindex N)

items.name: HALFSPACE_EQ_EMPTY_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x} = Empty <-> a = vec N 0 /\ 0 < b

items.name: HALFSPACE_EQ_EMPTY_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, {x :e R :^: idx N | b < dot N a x} = Empty <-> a = vec N 0 /\ 0 <= b

items.name: HALFSPACE_EQ_EMPTY_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} = Empty <-> a = vec N 0 /\ b < 0

items.name: HALFSPACE_EQ_EMPTY_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x < b} = Empty <-> a = vec N 0 /\ b <= 0

items.name: HALF_DOUBLE
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, div_nat (2 * n) 2 = n) /\ forall n :e omega, div_nat (n * 2) 2 = n

items.name: HALF_MEASURES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s -> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, t :/\: u = Empty /\ (t :\/: u = s /\ (measurable N t /\ (measure N t = measure N s :/: 2 /\ (measurable N u /\ measure N u = measure N s :/: 2))))

items.name: HAS_ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, absolutely_integrable_on N M f s /\ integral N M s f = y <-> absolutely_integrable_on N M f s /\ has_integral M N f y s

items.name: HAS_ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_CHANGE_OF_VARIABLES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, g' x y :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative M M g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ g x = g y) -> x = y)) -> (absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M (g' x)))) (f (g x))) s /\ integral N M s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M (g' x)))) (f (g x))) = b <-> absolutely_integrable_on N M f {g x | x :e s} /\ integral N M {g x | x :e s} f = b)

items.name: HAS_ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_CHANGE_OF_VARIABLES_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R, g' x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall b :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable 1 s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ g x = g y) -> x = y) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> has_vector_derivative 1 g (lift (g' (drop x))) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s))) -> (absolutely_integrable_on N 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (g' (drop x))) (f (g x))) s /\ integral N 1 s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (g' (drop x))) (f (g x))) = b <-> absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f {g x | x :e s} /\ integral N 1 {g x | x :e s} f = b)

items.name: HAS_ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_CHANGE_OF_VARIABLES_INVERTIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, g' x y :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative M M g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> h (g x) = x) /\ continuous_on_hl M M h {g x | x :e s}) -> (absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M (g' x)))) (f (g x))) s /\ integral N M s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M (g' x)))) (f (g x))) = b <-> absolutely_integrable_on N M f {g x | x :e s} /\ integral N M {g x | x :e s} f = b)

items.name: HAS_ABSOLUTE_INTEGRAL_CHANGE_OF_VARIABLES_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, linear M M g -> (absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M g))) (f (g x))) s /\ integral N M s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M g))) (f (g x))) = b <-> absolutely_integrable_on N M f {g x | x :e s} /\ integral N M {g x | x :e s} f = b)

items.name: HAS_ANTIDERIVATIVE_LIMIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, g' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> convex M s /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ forall h :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f' x h) (g' x h)) <= e0 * vector_norm M h) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: HAS_ANTIDERIVATIVE_SEQUENCE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y z :e R :^: idx M, f' x y z :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, g' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> convex M s /\ ((forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M (f n) (f' n x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, forall x h :e R :^: idx M, N0 <= n /\ x :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f' n x h) (g' x h)) <= e0 * vector_norm M h)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> vector_norm P (g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) <= vector_norm N (f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M P g s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s <-> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d t /\ t c= s -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= B

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_0
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, has_bounded_setvariation_on N A (fun x:set => vec A 0) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ has_bounded_setvariation_on M N g s -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M 1 (fun k:set => lift (f k i)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_COMPOSE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ linear N P g -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M P (fun x:set => g (f x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), operative (R :^: idx N) M (fun x:set => fun x0:set => vector_add N x x0) f /\ division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e d -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f k) <-> has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_ELEMENTARY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists d c= Power (R :^: idx M), division_of M d s) -> (has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s <-> exists B :e R, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), division_of M d s -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= B)

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_EQ

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_INTEGRABLE_NORM_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, countable s /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> differentiable N 1 f (at 1 x))) -> (has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> integrable_on 1 1 (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_derivative N f (at 1 x)))) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ISOMETRIC
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, distance A (f x,f y) = distance N (g x,g y)) -> (has_bounded_variation_on A f s <-> has_bounded_variation_on N g s)

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ISOMETRIC_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) -> (has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => f (g x)) s <-> has_bounded_variation_on M g s)

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_LEFT_LIMIT_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ is_interval 1 s -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= drop a})

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_LIPSCHITZ_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall B :e R, has_bounded_variation_on M g s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e {g x | x :e s} /\ y :e {g x | x :e s} -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => f (g x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_NONTRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s <-> exists B :e R, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx 1), forall t c= R :^: idx 1, division_of 1 d t /\ (t c= s /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx 1, k :e d -> ~ interior 1 k = Empty)) -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 k)) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 k)))) <= B

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g s -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_BILINEAR
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, bilinear N P M bop /\ (has_bounded_variation_on M f s /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N g s /\ is_interval 1 s)) -> has_bounded_variation_on P (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> has_bounded_variation_on N f (closure 1 s)

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_CLOSURE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s -> (has_bounded_variation_on N f (closure 1 s) <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f s)

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_CMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_CMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s <-> c = 0 \/ has_bounded_variation_on N f s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop c /\ drop c <= drop b -> (has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_COMBINE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R, is_interval 1 s -> (has_bounded_variation_on N f s <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= a} /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ a <= drop x})

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_COMPOSE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on M f s /\ linear M N g -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => g (f x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_CONST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall c :e R :^: idx N, has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => c) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_DARBOUX_IMP_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx 1, c c= s /\ connected 1 c -> connected N {f x | x :e c})) -> continuous_on_hl 1 N f s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_DIVISION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx 1), division_of 1 d (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx 1, k :e d -> has_bounded_variation_on N f k) <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> has_bounded_variation_on N f Empty

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> has_bounded_variation_on N g s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_ID
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, bounded_hl 1 s -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => x) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_IMP_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ is_interval 1 s -> bounded_hl N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_IMP_BOUNDED_ON_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> bounded_hl N {f x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_IMP_BOUNDED_ON_SUBINTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> bounded_hl N (\/_ d :e R :^: idx 1, {vector_sub N (f d) (f c) | c :e R :^: idx 1, closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= s /\ ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty})

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun c:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun c:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (interior 1 s) /\ (is_interval 1 s \/ continuous_on_hl 1 N f s) -> has_bounded_variation_on N f s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_INTERIOR_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s \/ continuous_on_hl 1 N f s -> (has_bounded_variation_on N f (interior 1 s) <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f s)

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> exists B :e R, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx 1), division_of 1 d (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 k)) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 k)))) <= B

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_LIFT_ABS
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (f x))) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, linear 1 1 f /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g {f x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => g (f x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_MAX
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on 1 g s -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (if drop (f x) <= drop (g x) then drop (g x) else drop (f x))) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_MIN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on 1 g s -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (if drop (f x) <= drop (g x) then drop (f x) else drop (g x))) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N g s /\ is_interval 1 s) -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop (f x)) (g x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x))) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_NULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, content 1 s = 0 /\ bounded_hl 1 s -> has_bounded_variation_on N f s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_PASTECART
items.statement: forall N P:set, N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) s <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on P g s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_REFLECT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f {vector_neg 1 x | x :e s} -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => f (vector_neg 1 x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_REFLECT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_neg 1 b,vector_neg 1 a) seq_nil)) -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => f (vector_neg 1 x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on A f {a}

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_SPLIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R, is_interval 1 s -> (has_bounded_variation_on N f s <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= a} /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ a <= drop x})

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g s -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ t c= s -> has_bounded_variation_on N f t

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx N, has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vector_add N a (f x)) s <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (is_interval 1 t /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f t)) -> has_bounded_variation_on N f (s :\/: t)

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_VECTOR_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_VMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall v :e R :^: idx N, has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (f x) v) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_VMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall v :e R :^: idx N, has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (f x) v) s <-> v = vec N 0 \/ has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_VSUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx 1, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall k c= A, finite k /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> has_bounded_variation_on N (f i) s) -> has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => vsum A N k (fun i:set => f i x)) s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_REFLECT2_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => f (vector_neg 1 x)) {vector_neg 1 x | x :e s} <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f s

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_REFLECT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => f (vector_neg 1 x)) s <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f {vector_neg 1 x | x :e s}

items.name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_REFLECT_EQ_INTERVAL
