items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall s u c= R :^: idx M, a :e s /\ s :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u -> (has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) u))

items.name: HAS_DERIVATIVE_WITHIN_REFLECT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M (fun x:set => f (vector_neg M x)) (fun x:set => f' (vector_neg M x)) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M (vector_neg M a)) {vector_neg M x | x :e s}) <-> has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s)

items.name: HAS_DERIVATIVE_WITHIN_SUBSET

var_views.f': metafun(R :^: idx B -> R :^: idx A)

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f' x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx B, forall x :e R :^: idx B, has_derivative A B f f' (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s) /\ t c= s -> has_derivative A B f f' (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) t)

items.name: HAS_DERIVATIVE_ZERO_CONNECTED_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, open M s /\ (connected M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M f (fun h:set => vec N 0) (at M x))) -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = c

items.name: HAS_DERIVATIVE_ZERO_CONNECTED_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall c :e R :^: idx A, open B s /\ (connected B s /\ (a :e s /\ (f a = c /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> has_derivative A B f (fun h:set => vec A 0) (at B x))))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> f x = c

items.name: HAS_DERIVATIVE_ZERO_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, convex M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M f (fun h:set => vec N 0) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = c

items.name: HAS_DERIVATIVE_ZERO_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall c :e R :^: idx A, convex B s /\ (a :e s /\ (f a = c /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> has_derivative A B f (fun h:set => vec A 0) (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s)))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> f x = c

items.name: HAS_DERIVATIVE_ZERO_UNIQUE_STRONG_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s k c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, connected M s /\ (open M s /\ (countable k /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (c :e s /\ (f c = y /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: k -> has_derivative N M f (fun h:set => vec N 0) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s))))))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = y

items.name: HAS_DERIVATIVE_ZERO_UNIQUE_STRONG_CONVEX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s k c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, convex M s /\ (countable k /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (c :e s /\ (f c = y /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: k -> has_derivative N M f (fun h:set => vec N 0) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)))))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = y

items.name: HAS_DERIVATIVE_ZERO_UNIQUE_STRONG_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall k c= R :^: idx 1, forall y :e R :^: idx N, countable k /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (f a = y /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: k -> has_derivative N 1 f (fun h:set => vec N 0) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> f x = y

items.name: HAS_DOUBLE_INTEGRAL_CONVOLUTION
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> bilinear P Q N bop /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f (R :^: idx M) /\ absolutely_integrable_on P M g (R :^: idx M)) -> has_integral M Q (fun x:set => integral Q M (R :^: idx M) (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y))) (bop (integral N M (R :^: idx M) f) (integral P M (R :^: idx M) g)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: HAS_DOUBLE_INTEGRAL_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N P Q R:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> R <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, forall y :e R :^: idx Q, bop x y :e R :^: idx R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, bilinear Q R P bop /\ (absolutely_integrable_on P M f s /\ absolutely_integrable_on Q N g t) -> has_integral (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) R (fun z:set => bop (f (fstcart M z)) (g (sndcart M N z))) (bop (integral P M s f) (integral Q N t g)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: HAS_FRECHET_DERIVATIVE_UNIQUE_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (at M x) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, frechet_derivative N M f (at M x) x0 = f' x0

items.name: HAS_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l :e R, is_glb s l <-> ~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e s -> l <= x) /\ forall c :e R, l < c -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ x < c)

items.name: HAS_INF_APPROACH
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l c :e R, is_glb s l /\ l < c -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ x < c

items.name: HAS_INF_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l :e R, is_glb s l <-> ~ s = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ inf s = l)

items.name: HAS_INF_LBOUND
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b x :e R, is_glb s b /\ x :e s -> b <= x

items.name: HAS_INF_LE
items.statement: forall s t c= R, forall l m :e R, is_glb s l /\ (is_glb t m /\ (forall y :e R, y :e t -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ x <= y)) -> l <= m

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f i s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ball M (vec M 0,B) c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> exists z :e R :^: idx N, has_integral M N (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) z (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N z i) < e0

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, has_integral A B (fun x:set => vec B 0) (vec B 0) s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_0_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall i :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= R :^: idx A, has_integral A B (fun x:set => vec B 0) i s <-> i = vec B 0

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k l :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f k s /\ has_integral M N g l s -> has_integral M N (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) (vector_add N k l) s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f i s /\ ~ m = 0 -> has_integral M N (fun x:set => f (vector_add M (vector_mul M m x) c)) (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (abs_SNo m ^ dimindex M)) i) {vector_add M (vector_mul M (recip_SNo m) x) (vector_neg M (vector_mul M (recip_SNo m) c)) | x :e s}

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx N, has_integral M N f i s <-> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ball M (vec M 0,B) c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0)) i) < e0

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, 0 <= B /\ (has_integral M N f i (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (f x) <= B)) -> vector_norm N i <= B * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, negligible M (frontier M s) -> (has_integral M N f y (closure M s) <-> has_integral M N f y s)

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, has_integral M N f k s -> has_integral M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) (vector_mul N c k) s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i j :e R :^: idx N, forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop c /\ (drop c <= drop b /\ (has_integral 1 N f i (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) /\ has_integral 1 N f j (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)))) -> has_integral 1 N f (vector_add N i j) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMBINE_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), i x :e R :^: idx N) -> division_of M d s /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e d -> has_integral M N f (i k) k) -> has_integral M N f (vsum (Power (R :^: idx M)) N d i) s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMBINE_DIVISION_TOPDOWN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall k c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ (division_of M d k /\ k c= s) -> has_integral M N f (vsum (Power (R :^: idx M)) N d (fun i:set => integral N M i f)) k

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMBINE_TAGGED_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), i x :e R :^: idx N) -> tagged_division_of M p s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall k c= R :^: idx M, (x,k) :e p -> has_integral M N f (i k) k) -> has_integral M N f (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => i (p0 1))) s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMBINE_TAGGED_DIVISION_TOPDOWN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> has_integral M N f (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => integral N M (p0 1) f)) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, has_integral M N f y s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> has_integral M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) (lift (y i)) s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_LBOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall B :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, has_integral M N f i (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> B <= f x k))) -> B * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <= i k

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i j :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (has_integral M N f i s /\ (has_integral M N g j s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x k <= g x k)))) -> i k <= j k

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_LE_AE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i j :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, forall t c= R :^: idx M, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (negligible M t /\ (has_integral M N f i s /\ (has_integral M N g j s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> f x k <= g x k))))) -> i k <= j k

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (has_integral M N f i s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x k <= 0))) -> i k <= 0

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_POS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (has_integral M N f i s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> 0 <= f x k))) -> 0 <= i k

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_UBOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall B :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, has_integral M N f i (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> f x k <= B))) -> i k <= B * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_CONST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx N, has_integral M N (fun x:set => c) (vector_mul N (content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) c) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_CONST_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx N, measurable M s -> has_integral M N (fun x:set => c) (vector_mul N (measure M s) c) s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_CONVOLUTION_SYM
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall i :e R :^: idx Q, forall x :e R :^: idx M, has_integral M Q (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y)) i (R :^: idx M) <-> has_integral M Q (fun y:set => bop (f y) (g (vector_sub M x y))) i (R :^: idx M)

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_DIFF
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i j :e R :^: idx N, forall s t c= R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f i s /\ (has_integral M N f j t /\ negligible M (t :\: s)) -> has_integral M N f (vector_sub N i j) (s :\: t)

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_DROP_LE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i j :e R :^: idx 1, has_integral M 1 f i s /\ (has_integral M 1 g j s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> drop (f x) <= drop (g x))) -> drop i <= drop j

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_DROP_LE_AE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i j :e R :^: idx 1, forall t c= R :^: idx M, has_integral M 1 f i s /\ (has_integral M 1 g j s /\ (negligible M t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> drop (f x) <= drop (g x)))) -> drop i <= drop j

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_DROP_NEG
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx 1, has_integral M 1 f i s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> drop (f x) <= 0) -> drop i <= 0

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_DROP_POS
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx 1, has_integral M 1 f i s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> 0 <= drop (f x)) -> 0 <= drop i

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_DROP_POS_AE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx 1, has_integral M 1 f i s /\ (negligible M t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> 0 <= drop (f x))) -> 0 <= drop i

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_EMPTY

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_EMPTY_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall i :e R :^: idx B, has_integral A B f i Empty <-> i = vec B 0

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ has_integral M N f k s -> has_integral M N g k s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_EQ_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> (has_integral M N f k s <-> has_integral M N g k s)

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_FACTOR_CONTENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f i (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d:set -> set -> prop, gauge M d /\ forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0)))) i) <= e0 * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall i :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx B, has_integral B A f i s -> integrable_on A B f s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_INTEGRABLE_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f i s <-> integrable_on N M f s /\ integral N M s f = i

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_INTEGRAL

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_INTERIOR

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_LIM_AT_POSINFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, has_integral 1 N f l {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 <= drop t} <-> (forall a :e R :^: idx 1, integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,a) seq_nil))) /\ tendsto N R (fun a:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,lift a) seq_nil)) f) l at_posinfinity

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_LIM_AT_POSINFINITY_GEN

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_LIM_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N R (fun x:set => f (lift x)) (vec N 0) at_posinfinity /\ ((forall n :e omega, integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 n) seq_nil))) /\ tendsto N omega (fun n:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 n) seq_nil)) f) l sequentially) -> has_integral 1 N f l {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 <= drop t}

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_LINEAR

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_MEASURE_UNDER_CURVE

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_NEGLIGIBLE

items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, x :e s /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> 0 <= f x i) -> (has_integral M N f (vec N 0) s <-> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ~ f x = vec N 0})

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_NORM_BOUND_INTEGRAL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall j :e R :^: idx P, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex P /\ (has_integral M N f i s /\ (has_integral M P g j s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= g x k)))) -> vector_norm N i <= j k

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_PASTECART_SYM
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall y :e R :^: idx P, has_integral (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) P (fun z:set => f (pastecart M N (sndcart N M z) (fstcart N z))) y {pastecart N M (sndcart M N z) (fstcart M z) | z :e s} <-> has_integral (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) P f y s

items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M), forall y :e R :^: idx P, has_integral (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) P (fun z:set => f (pastecart M N (sndcart N M z) (fstcart N z))) y s <-> has_integral (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) P f y {pastecart M N (sndcart N M z) (fstcart N z) | z :e s}

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SEPARATE_SIDES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, has_integral M N f i (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex M) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d:set -> set -> prop, gauge M d /\ forall p1 p2 c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_division_of M p1 (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx M | x k <= c}) /\ (fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p1 /\ (tagged_division_of M p2 (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx M | c <= x k}) /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p2)) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vector_add N (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p1 (fun p:set => vector_mul N (content M (p 1)) (f (p 0)))) (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p2 (fun p:set => vector_mul N (content M (p 1)) (f (p 0))))) i) < e0

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SPIKE
