items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SPIKE_FINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t :\: s -> g x = f x) -> (has_integral M N f y t <-> has_integral M N g y t)

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SPIKE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e open_interval M (a,b) -> g x = f x) /\ has_integral M N f y (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> has_integral M N g y (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SPIKE_INTERIOR_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e open_interval M (a,b) -> g x = f x) -> (has_integral M N f y (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> has_integral M N g y (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SPIKE_SET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, negligible M ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) /\ has_integral M N f y s -> has_integral M N f y t

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SPIKE_SET_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, negligible M ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> (has_integral M N f y s <-> has_integral M N f y t)

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SPLIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i j :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, has_integral M N f i (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx M | x k <= c}) /\ (has_integral M N f j (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx M | c <= x k}) /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex M)) -> has_integral M N f (vector_add N i j) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_STRADDLE_NULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= drop (f x) /\ drop (f x) <= drop (g x)) /\ has_integral N 1 g (vec 1 0) s -> has_integral N 1 f (vec 1 0) s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_STRETCH
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, m x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f i (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex M -> ~ m k = 0) -> has_integral M N (fun x:set => f (fun k :e idx M => m k * x k)) (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (abs_SNo (finprod (idx M) m))) i) {(fun k :e idx M => recip_SNo (m k) * x k) | x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k l :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f k s /\ has_integral M N g l s -> has_integral M N (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) (vector_sub N k l) s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SUBSET_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall i j :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, s c= t /\ (has_integral M N f i s /\ (has_integral M N f j t /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> 0 <= f x k))))) -> i k <= j k

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SUBSET_DROP_LE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall i j :e R :^: idx 1, s c= t /\ (has_integral M 1 f i s /\ (has_integral M 1 f j t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> 0 <= drop (f x)))) -> drop i <= drop j

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_SUBSTITUTION_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx 1, forall k c= R :^: idx 1, countable k /\ (integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 1 g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ({g x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} c= closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: k -> has_vector_derivative 1 g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (g x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)))) /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ (drop c <= drop d /\ drop (g a) <= drop (g b))))))) -> has_integral 1 N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop (g' x)) (f (g x))) (integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (g a,g b) seq_nil)) f) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, has_integral M N (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x)) i s <-> has_integral M N f i {vector_add M a x | x :e s}

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_TWIDDLE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, h x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall r :e R, forall i :e R :^: idx P, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, 0 < r /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, h (g x) = x) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (h x) = x) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) g (at M x)) /\ ((forall u v :e R :^: idx M, exists w z :e R :^: idx N, {g x | x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)} = closed_interval N (seq_cons (w,z) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall u v :e R :^: idx N, exists w z :e R :^: idx M, {h x | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)} = closed_interval M (seq_cons (w,z) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall u v :e R :^: idx M, content N {g x | x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)} = r * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil))) /\ has_integral N P f i (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))))))) -> has_integral M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) (vector_mul P (recip_SNo r) i) {h x | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_TWIDDLE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, h x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall r :e R, forall i :e R :^: idx P, forall s c= R :^: idx N, 0 < r /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, h (g x) = x) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (h x) = x) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) g (at M x)) /\ ((forall b :e R, 0 < b -> exists b' :e R, 0 < b' /\ ball N (vec N 0,b) c= {g x | x :e ball M (vec M 0,b')}) /\ ((forall u v :e R :^: idx M, exists w z :e R :^: idx N, {g x | x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)} = closed_interval N (seq_cons (w,z) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall u v :e R :^: idx N, exists w z :e R :^: idx M, {h x | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)} = closed_interval M (seq_cons (w,z) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall u v :e R :^: idx M, content N {g x | x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)} = r * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil))) /\ has_integral N P f i s))))))) -> has_integral M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) (vector_mul P (recip_SNo r) i) {h x | x :e s}

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_TWIZZLE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx P, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> dimindex M = dimindex N /\ (permutes omega p (idx N) /\ has_integral N P f y {(fun i :e idx N => x (p i)) | x :e s}) -> has_integral M P (fun x:set => f (fun i :e idx N => x (p i))) y s

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_TWIZZLE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx P, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> dimindex M = dimindex N /\ permutes omega p (idx N) -> (has_integral N P f y {(fun i :e idx N => x (p i)) | x :e s} <-> has_integral M P (fun x:set => f (fun i :e idx N => x (p i))) y s)

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_TWIZZLE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall y :e R :^: idx P, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, has_integral N P f y (closed_interval N (seq_cons (fun i :e idx N => a (p i),fun i :e idx N => b (p i)) seq_nil)) /\ (dimindex M = dimindex N /\ permutes omega p (idx N)) -> has_integral M P (fun x:set => f (fun i :e idx N => x (p i))) y (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_UNION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i j :e R :^: idx N, forall s t c= R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f i s /\ (has_integral M N f j t /\ negligible M (s :/\: t)) -> has_integral M N f (vector_add N i j) (s :\/: t)

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_UNIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), i x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t c= Power (R :^: idx M), finite t /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx M, s :e t -> has_integral M N f (i s) s) /\ (forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, s :e t /\ (s' :e t /\ ~ s = s') -> negligible M (s :/\: s'))) -> has_integral M N f (vsum (Power (R :^: idx M)) N t i) (Union t)

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e Power (R :^: idx M) :^: A, forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e A, i x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t c= A, finite t /\ ((forall s :e A, s :e t -> has_integral M N f (i s) (k s)) /\ (forall x y :e t, x <> y -> negligible M (k x :/\: k y))) -> has_integral M N f (vsum A N t i) (Union {k x | x :e t})

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i c= R :^: idx M, forall k1 k2 :e R :^: idx N, has_integral M N f k1 i /\ has_integral M N f k2 i -> k1 = k2

items.name: HAS_INTEGRAL_VSUM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e A, i x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= A, finite t /\ (forall a :e A, a :e t -> has_integral M N (f a) (i a) s) -> has_integral M N (fun x:set => vsum A N t (fun a:set => f a x)) (vsum A N t i) s

items.name: HAS_MEASURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, has_measure N s m <-> has_integral N 1 (fun x:set => if x :e s then vec 1 1 else vec 1 0) (lift m) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, has_measure N s 0 <-> negligible N s

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R, has_measure N s y -> has_measure N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} (abs_SNo m ^ dimindex N * y)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_ALMOST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s s' t c= R :^: idx A, forall m :e R, has_measure A s m /\ (negligible A t /\ s :\/: t = s' :\/: t) -> has_measure A s' m

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_ALMOST_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall s s' t c= R :^: idx A, negligible A t /\ s :\/: t = s' :\/: t -> (has_measure A s m <-> has_measure A s' m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_COUNTABLE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall B :e R, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (s n)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, ~ m = n -> negligible N (s m :/\: s n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => measure N (s k)) <= B)) -> measurable N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}) /\ sums 1 (fun n:set => lift (measure N (s n))) (lift (measure N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))) (from 0)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_COUNTABLE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNIONS_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (s n)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, ~ m = n -> negligible N (s m :/\: s n)) /\ bounded_hl N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega})) -> measurable N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}) /\ sums 1 (fun n:set => lift (measure N (s n))) (lift (measure N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))) (from 0)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> (has_measure N {f x | x :e s} m <-> has_integral N 1 (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x))))) (lift m) s)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_DIFF_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, has_measure N s m /\ negligible N t -> has_measure N (s :\: t) m

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_DIFF_NEGLIGIBLE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, negligible N t -> (has_measure N (s :\: t) m <-> has_measure N s m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_DIFF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s1 s2 c= R :^: idx A, forall m1 m2 :e R, has_measure A s1 m1 /\ (has_measure A s2 m2 /\ s2 c= s1) -> has_measure A (s1 :\: s2) (m1 + - m2)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s1 s2 c= R :^: idx A, forall m1 m2 :e R, has_measure A s1 m1 /\ (has_measure A s2 m2 /\ s1 :/\: s2 = Empty) -> has_measure A (s1 :\/: s2) (m1 + m2)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_DISJOINT_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), m x :e R) -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> has_measure N s (m s)) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ (t :e f /\ ~ s = t) -> s :/\: t = Empty)) -> has_measure N (Union f) (finsum f m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_DISJOINT_UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> measurable N (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> f x :/\: f y = Empty)) -> has_measure N (Union {f x | x :e s}) (finsum s (fun x:set => measure N (f x)))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_DISJOINT_UNIONS_IMAGE_STRONG
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = Empty} /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> measurable N (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> f x :/\: f y = Empty)) -> has_measure N (Union {f x | x :e s}) (finsum s (fun x:set => measure N (f x)))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_ELEMENTARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, division_of A d s -> has_measure A s (finsum d (fun x:set => content A x))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> has_measure A Empty 0

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_IMAGE_STD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> permutes omega p (idx N) -> has_measure N {x :e R :^: idx N | 0 <= x (p 1) /\ (x (p (dimindex N)) <= 1 /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i < dimindex N -> x (p i) <= x (p (i + 1)))} (measure N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} (vec N 0))))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_IMP_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall m :e R, has_measure A s m -> measurable A s

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_INNER_OUTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, has_measure N s m <-> (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (measurable N t /\ m + - e0 < measure N t)) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, s c= u /\ (measurable N u /\ measure N u < m + e0)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_INNER_OUTER_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, has_measure N s m <-> (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (measurable N t /\ m + - e0 <= measure N t)) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, s c= u /\ (measurable N u /\ measure N u <= m + e0)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, has_measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, has_measure N (open_interval N (a,b)) (content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_ISOMETRY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall m :e R, dimindex M = dimindex N /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x)) -> (has_measure N {f x | x :e s} m <-> has_measure M s m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx A, has_measure A s m <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx A, ball A (vec A 0,B) c= closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> exists z :e R, has_measure A (s :/\: closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) z /\ abs_SNo (z + - m) < e0

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ measurable N s -> has_measure N {f x | x :e s} (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N f)) * measure N s)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_LINEAR_IMAGE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, linear N N f /\ has_measure N s m -> has_measure N {f x | x :e s} (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N f)) * m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_LINEAR_IMAGE_SAME
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, linear A A f /\ (measurable A s /\ abs_SNo (det A (matrix A A f)) = 1) -> has_measure A {f x | x :e s} (measure A s)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_LINEAR_SUFFICIENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m :e R, linear N N f /\ (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, has_measure N {f x | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} (m * measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s -> has_measure N {f x | x :e s} (m * measure N s)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_MEASURABLE_MEASURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall m :e R, has_measure A s m <-> measurable A s /\ measure A s = m

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_MEASURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s <-> has_measure A s (measure A s)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_SYMDIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, has_measure N s m /\ negligible N ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> has_measure N t m

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s1 s2 c= R :^: idx N, forall m1 m2 :e R, has_measure N s1 m1 /\ (has_measure N s2 m2 /\ negligible N (s1 :/\: s2)) -> has_measure N (s1 :\/: s2) (m1 + m2)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), m x :e R) -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> has_measure N s (m s)) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ (t :e f /\ ~ s = t) -> negligible N (s :/\: t))) -> has_measure N (Union f) (finsum f m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> measurable N (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> negligible N (f x :/\: f y))) -> has_measure N (Union {f x | x :e s}) (finsum s (fun x:set => measure N (f x)))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNIONS_IMAGE_STRONG
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = Empty} /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> measurable N (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> negligible N (f x :/\: f y))) -> has_measure N (Union {f x | x :e s}) (finsum s (fun x:set => measure N (f x)))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_NESTED_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (s n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, s (ordsucc n) c= s n) -> measurable N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (measure N (s n))) (lift (measure N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y})) sequentially

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_NESTED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall B :e R, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (s n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, measure N (s n) <= B) /\ (forall n :e omega, s n c= s (ordsucc n))) -> measurable N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}) /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (measure N (s n))) (lift (measure N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))) sequentially

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_ORTHOGONAL_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, orthogonal_transformation N f /\ has_measure N s m -> has_measure N {f x | x :e s} m

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_ORTHOGONAL_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, orthogonal_transformation N f -> (has_measure N {f x | x :e s} m <-> has_measure N s m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R, has_measure M s a /\ has_measure N t b -> has_measure (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (a * b)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_POS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, has_measure N s m -> 0 <= m

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m c :e R, has_measure N s m -> has_measure N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} (abs_SNo c ^ dimindex N * m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m c :e R, ~ c = 0 -> (has_measure N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} (abs_SNo c ^ dimindex N * m) <-> has_measure N s m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_SHEAR_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall m n :e omega, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ (~ m = n /\ (~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ 0 <= a n))))) -> has_measure N {(fun i :e idx N => if i = m then x m + x n else x i) | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} (measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall l :e finseq (R :^: idx N), seq_len l = dimindex N -> has_measure N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (seq_set (seq_cons a l))) (abs_SNo (det N (vector (R :^: idx N) N (seq_map (fun x:set => vector_sub N x a) l))) :/: factorial (dimindex N))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_SIMPLEX_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq (R :^: idx N), seq_len l = dimindex N -> has_measure N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin (seq_set l) (vec N 0))) (abs_SNo (det N (vector (R :^: idx N) N l)) :/: factorial (dimindex N))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_STD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> has_measure N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} (vec N 0))) (recip_SNo (factorial (dimindex N)))

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_STRETCH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, m x :e R) -> forall y :e R, has_measure N s y -> has_measure N {(fun k :e idx N => m k * x k) | x :e s} (abs_SNo (finprod (idx N) m) * y)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s1 s2 c= R :^: idx N, forall m1 m2 :e R, has_measure N s1 m1 /\ (has_measure N s2 m2 /\ s1 c= s2) -> m1 <= m2

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall a :e R :^: idx N, has_measure N s m -> has_measure N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} m

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, has_measure N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} m <-> has_measure N s m

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx_n 2, has_measure (idx_n 2) (hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | convex (idx_n 2) x} {a,b,c}) (abs_SNo ((b 1 + - a 1) * (c 2 + - a 2) + - (b 2 + - a 2) * (c 1 + - a 1)) :/: 2)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_UNION_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, has_measure N s m /\ negligible N t -> has_measure N (s :\/: t) m

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_UNION_NEGLIGIBLE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, negligible N t -> (has_measure N (s :\/: t) m <-> has_measure N s m)

items.name: HAS_MEASURE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall m1 m2 :e R, has_measure A s m1 /\ has_measure A s m2 -> m1 = m2

items.name: HAS_SIZE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s n <-> finite s /\ finite_cardinality s = n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, equip s 0 <-> s = Empty

items.name: HAS_SIZE_1
items.statement: equip 1 1

items.name: HAS_SIZE_1_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, equip s 1 <-> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> y = x

items.name: HAS_SIZE_2
items.statement: equip (idx_n 2) 2

items.name: HAS_SIZE_3
items.statement: equip (idx_n 3) 3

items.name: HAS_SIZE_4
items.statement: equip (idx_n 4) 4

items.name: HAS_SIZE_BOOL
items.statement: equip 2 2

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s n -> finite_cardinality s = n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CART
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, m x :e omega) -> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> equip {x :e A | P i x} (m i)) -> equip {v :e A :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (v i)} (finprod (idx N) m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CART_UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e omega, equip A m -> equip (A :^: idx N) (m ^ dimindex N)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (equip s 0 <-> s = Empty) /\ (equip s (ordsucc n) <-> exists a :e A, exists t c= A, equip t n /\ (~ a :e t /\ s = SetAdjoin t a))

items.name: HAS_SIZE_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ equip t n -> equip (s :*: t) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ (equip t n /\ t c= s) -> equip (s :\: t) (minus_nat m n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_EQ_COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, (closed N s /\ closed N t \/ bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t) /\ homeomorphic N N s t -> (equip (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) n <-> equip (components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t)) n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_FACES_OF_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx N, simplex N n s -> equip {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N f s} (2 ^ if n + 1 :e omega then n + 1 else 0)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_FINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> equip (idx A) (dimindex A)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e B, forall n :e omega, forall t c= B, forall m :e omega, forall s c= A, equip s m /\ equip t n -> equip {f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = d} (n ^ m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_FUNSPACE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m n :e omega, equip A m /\ equip B n -> equip (B :^: A) (n ^ m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ equip s n -> equip {f x | x :e s} n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> (equip {f x | x :e s} n <-> equip s n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ equip {x :e A | x :e s /\ P (f x)} n)))) -> equip {x :e B | x :e t /\ P x} n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_INDEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s n -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall m :e omega, m < n -> f m :e s) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists m :e omega, m < n /\ f m = x /\ forall y :e omega, y < n /\ f y = x -> y = m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_INTER_SPHERE_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, equip (sphere N (a,r) :/\: sphere N (b,s)) 1 <-> 0 <= r /\ (0 <= s /\ ((a = b -> r = 0 /\ s = 0) /\ (distance N (a,b) = r + s \/ distance N (a,b) = abs_SNo (r + - s))))

items.name: HAS_SIZE_INTSEG_INT
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a :e int /\ b :e int -> equip {x :e R | x :e int /\ (a <= x /\ x <= b)} (if b < a then 0 else if (if (b + - a) + 1 :e int then (b + - a) + 1 else 0) :e omega then if (b + - a) + 1 :e int then (b + - a) + 1 else 0 else 0)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_INTSEG_NUM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, equip {x :e R | x :e int /\ (m <= x /\ x <= n)} (minus_nat (n + 1) m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_LEFT_RIGHT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e omega, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> (equip {left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} n <-> equip {right_coset_hl A G h x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_MULTIVECTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip (multivector N) (2 ^ dimindex N)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, equip {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (minus_nat (n + 1) m)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, equip (idx_n n) n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, equip {m :e omega | m <= n} (n + 1)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, equip {m :e omega | m < n} n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ equip t n -> equip (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_PERMUTATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s n -> equip {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s} (factorial n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_POWERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s n -> equip {t :e Power A | t c= s} (2 ^ n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e omega, forall t c= B, forall n :e omega, equip s m /\ equip t n -> equip (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t}) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_PRODUCT_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e omega, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall n :e omega, equip s m /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> equip (t x) n) -> equip (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, x :e s /\ y :e t x}) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_SET_OF_LIST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, equip (seq_set l) (seq_len l) <-> seq_pairwise (fun x:set => fun y:set => ~ x = y) l

items.name: HAS_SIZE_SPHERE_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, equip (sphere N (a,r)) 1 <-> r = 0

items.name: HAS_SIZE_SPHERE_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, equip (sphere N (a,r)) 2 <-> dimindex N = 1 /\ 0 < r

items.name: HAS_SIZE_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> equip {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} (dimindex N)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_SUC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, equip s (ordsucc n) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ forall a :e A, a :e s -> equip (s :\: {a}) n

items.name: HAS_SIZE_TYBIT0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (2 * dimindex A)) (2 * dimindex A)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_TYBIT1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> equip (idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1)) (2 * dimindex A + 1)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_UNBOUNDED_COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> equip {c :e Power (R :^: idx N) | c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ ~ bounded_hl N c} (if s = Empty \/ 2 <= dimindex N then 1 else 2)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_UNBOUNDED_COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENT_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, bounded_hl 1 s /\ ~ s = Empty -> equip {c :e Power (R :^: idx 1) | c :e components 1 ((R :^: idx 1) :\: s) /\ ~ bounded_hl 1 c} 2

items.name: HAS_SIZE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ (equip t n /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> equip (s :\/: t) (m + n)

items.name: HAS_SIZE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall m n :e omega, equip s m /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> equip (t x) n) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> t x :/\: t y = Empty)) -> equip (Union {t x | x :e A, x :e s}) (m * n)

items.name: HAS_SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l :e R, is_lub s l <-> ~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= l) /\ forall c :e R, c < l -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ c < x)

items.name: HAS_SUP_APPROACH
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l c :e R, is_lub s l /\ c < l -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ c < x

items.name: HAS_SUP_LE
items.statement: forall s t c= R, forall l m :e R, is_lub s l /\ (is_lub t m /\ (forall y :e R, y :e t -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ y <= x)) -> m <= l

items.name: HAS_SUP_SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l :e R, is_lub s l <-> ~ s = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ sup s = l)

items.name: HAS_SUP_UBOUND
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b x :e R, is_lub s b /\ x :e s -> x <= b

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g' :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), has_vector_derivative A f f' net0 /\ has_vector_derivative A g g' net0 -> has_vector_derivative A (fun x:set => vector_add A (f x) (g x)) (vector_add A f' g') net0

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_AT_1D
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative N f f' (at 1 x) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun y:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (drop (vector_sub 1 y x))) (vector_sub N (f y) (f x))) f' (at 1 x)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_AT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative A f f' (at 1 x) -> has_vector_derivative A f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_BILINEAR_AT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx M, forall g' :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative M f f' (at 1 x) /\ (has_vector_derivative N g g' (at 1 x) /\ bilinear N P M h) -> has_vector_derivative P (fun x0:set => h (f x0) (g x0)) (vector_add P (h (f x) g') (h f' (g x))) (at 1 x)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_BILINEAR_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx M, forall g' :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative M f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) /\ (has_vector_derivative N g g' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) /\ bilinear N P M h) -> has_vector_derivative P (fun x0:set => h (f x0) (g x0)) (vector_add P (h (f x) g') (h f' (g x))) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), forall c :e R, has_vector_derivative A f f' net0 -> has_vector_derivative A (fun x:set => vector_mul A c (f x)) (vector_mul A c f') net0

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_CMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), forall c :e R, ~ c = 0 -> (has_vector_derivative A (fun x:set => vector_mul A c (f x)) (vector_mul A c f') net0 <-> has_vector_derivative A f f' net0)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_COMPONENTWISE_AT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative N f f' (at 1 a) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) (lift (f' i)) (at 1 a)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_COMPONENTWISE_WITHIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative N f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) s) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) (lift (f' i)) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) s)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), has_vector_derivative A (fun x:set => c) (vec A 0) net0

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_ID
items.statement: forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => x) (vec 1 1) net0

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_IMP_DIFFERENTIABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), has_vector_derivative A f f' net0 -> differentiable A 1 f net0

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists k c= R :^: idx 1, negligible 1 k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: k -> has_vector_derivative N (fun x0:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x0) seq_nil)) f) (f x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_LIFT_COMPONENT_AT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall i :e omega, has_vector_derivative N f f' (at 1 a) /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) (lift (f' i)) (at 1 a)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_LIFT_COMPONENT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall i :e omega, has_vector_derivative N f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) s) /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> has_vector_derivative 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) (lift (f' i)) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) s)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), has_vector_derivative A f f' net0 -> has_vector_derivative A (fun x:set => vector_neg A (f x)) (vector_neg A f') net0

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), has_vector_derivative A (fun x:set => vector_neg A (f x)) (vector_neg A f') net0 <-> has_vector_derivative A f f' net0

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g' :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), has_vector_derivative A f f' net0 /\ has_vector_derivative A g g' net0 -> has_vector_derivative A (fun x:set => vector_sub A (f x) (g x)) (vector_sub A f' g') net0

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_TRANSFORM_AT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall d :e R, 0 < d /\ ((forall x' :e R :^: idx 1, distance 1 (x',x) < d -> f x' = g x') /\ has_vector_derivative A f f' (at 1 x)) -> has_vector_derivative A g f' (at 1 x)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_TRANSFORM_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall d :e R, 0 < d /\ (x :e s /\ ((forall x' :e R :^: idx 1, x' :e s /\ distance 1 (x',x) < d -> f x' = g x') /\ has_vector_derivative A f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s))) -> has_vector_derivative A g f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_TRANSFORM_WITHIN_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, open 1 s /\ (x :e s /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx 1, y :e s -> f y = g y) /\ has_vector_derivative A f f' (at 1 x))) -> has_vector_derivative A g f' (at 1 x)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_WITHIN_1D
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative N f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun y:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (drop (vector_sub 1 y x))) (vector_sub N (f y) (f x))) f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)

items.name: HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_WITHIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative A f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) /\ t c= s -> has_vector_derivative A f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> hausdist N (s,t) = sup {abs_SNo (setdist N ({x},s) + - setdist N ({x},t)) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e R :^: idx N}

items.name: HAUSDIST_BALLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, hausdist N (ball N (a,r),ball N (b,s)) = if r <= 0 \/ s <= 0 then 0 else distance N (a,b) + abs_SNo (r + - s)) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, hausdist N (ball N (a,r),cball N (b,s)) = if r <= 0 \/ s < 0 then 0 else distance N (a,b) + abs_SNo (r + - s)) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, hausdist N (cball N (a,r),ball N (b,s)) = if r < 0 \/ s <= 0 then 0 else distance N (a,b) + abs_SNo (r + - s)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, hausdist N (cball N (a,r),cball N (b,s)) = if r < 0 \/ s < 0 then 0 else distance N (a,b) + abs_SNo (r + - s)))

items.name: HAUSDIST_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hausdist N (closure N s,t) = hausdist N (s,t)) /\ forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hausdist N (s,closure N t) = hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_COMPACT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (compact N t /\ ~ t = Empty) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ distance N (x,y) <= hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_COMPACT_INTERS_LIMIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact N (s n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, s (ordsucc n) c= s n) -> tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (hausdist N (s n,{x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s i | i :e omega, i :e omega}, x :e Y}))) (vec 1 0) sequentially

items.name: HAUSDIST_COMPACT_NONTRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (compact N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> hausdist N (s,t) = inf {e0 :e R | 0 <= e0 /\ (s c= (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ vector_norm N y <= e0}) /\ t c= \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ vector_norm N y <= e0})}

items.name: HAUSDIST_COMPACT_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (compact N t /\ ~ t = Empty) -> s c= \/_ y :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N y z | z :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ z :e cball N (vec N 0,hausdist N (s,t))}

items.name: HAUSDIST_COMPLEMENTS_CONVEX_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (~ x :e s /\ hausdist N (s,t) < d)))) -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, ~ y :e t /\ distance N (x,y) < d

items.name: HAUSDIST_COMPLEMENTS_CONVEX_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty)))) -> hausdist N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s,(R :^: idx N) :\: t) <= hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_CONVEX_HULLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t -> hausdist N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s,hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t) <= hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall t c= R :^: idx N, hausdist N (Empty,t) = 0) /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, hausdist N (s,Empty) = 0

items.name: HAUSDIST_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall s' t' c= R :^: idx N, (forall b :e R, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> setdist M ({x},t) <= b) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e t -> setdist M ({y},s) <= b) <-> (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s' -> setdist N ({x},t') <= b) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t' -> setdist N ({y},s') <= b) -> hausdist M (s,t) = hausdist N (s',t')

items.name: HAUSDIST_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t -> (hausdist N (s,t) = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ closure N s = closure N t))

items.name: HAUSDIST_FRONTIERS_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t)) -> hausdist N (frontier N s,frontier N t) = hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_INSERT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> hausdist N (SetAdjoin s a,SetAdjoin t a) <= hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x) -> hausdist N ({f x | x :e s},{f x | x :e t}) = hausdist M (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_NONTRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> hausdist N (s,t) = sup ({setdist N ({x},t) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} :\/: {setdist N ({y},s) | y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t})

items.name: HAUSDIST_NONTRIVIAL_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> hausdist N (s,t) = if sup {setdist N ({x},t) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} <= sup {setdist N ({y},s) | y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t} then sup {setdist N ({y},s) | y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t} else sup {setdist N ({x},t) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}

items.name: HAUSDIST_POS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, 0 <= hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_POS_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, 0 < hausdist N (s,t) <-> ~ hausdist N (s,t) = 0

items.name: HAUSDIST_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hausdist N (s,s) = 0

items.name: HAUSDIST_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s -> hausdist A (relative_interior A s,t) = hausdist A (s,t)) /\ forall s t c= R :^: idx B, convex B t -> hausdist B (s,relative_interior B t) = hausdist B (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hausdist N ({vector_mul N a x | x :e s},{vector_mul N a x | x :e t}) = abs_SNo a * hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_SETDIST_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, ~ t = Empty /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t) -> setdist N (s,u) <= hausdist N (s,t) + setdist N (t,u)

items.name: HAUSDIST_SINGS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, hausdist N ({x},{y}) = distance N (x,y)

items.name: HAUSDIST_STILL_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,t) < setdist N ({x},(R :^: idx N) :\: s))))) -> x :e t

items.name: HAUSDIST_STILL_INSIDE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,t) < setdist N ({x},(R :^: idx N) :\: s))))) -> x :e interior N t

items.name: HAUSDIST_STILL_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N s /\ ~ interior N s = Empty) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall s' c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s' /\ (convex N s' /\ (~ s' = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,s') < e0)) -> ~ interior N s' = Empty

items.name: HAUSDIST_STILL_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ hausdist N (s,t) < setdist N ({x},s)) -> ~ x :e t

items.name: HAUSDIST_STILL_SAME_PLACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,t) < setdist N ({x},frontier N s))))) -> (x :e t <-> x :e s)

items.name: HAUSDIST_STILL_SAME_PLACE_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (~ vec N 0 :e closure N s /\ ~ x :e frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x0} s)))) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall s' c= R :^: idx N, convex N s' /\ (bounded_hl N s' /\ (~ s' = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,s') < e0)) -> (x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x0} s' <-> x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x0} s)

items.name: HAUSDIST_STILL_SAME_PLACE_CONIC_HULL_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (~ vec N 0 :e closure N s /\ (~ x = vec N 0 /\ ~ x :e frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x0} s))))) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall s' c= R :^: idx N, convex N s' /\ (bounded_hl N s' /\ (~ s' = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,s') < e0)) -> ~ x :e frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x0} s') /\ (x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x0} s' <-> x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x0} s)

items.name: HAUSDIST_STILL_SAME_PLACE_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,t) < setdist N ({x},frontier N s))))) -> ~ x :e frontier N s /\ (~ x :e frontier N t /\ (x :e t <-> x :e s))

items.name: HAUSDIST_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (bounded_hl N u /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ ~ u = Empty)))))) -> hausdist N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x e0 | e0 :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ e0 :e u},\/_ y :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N y e0 | e0 :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ e0 :e u}) = hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_SUMS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u v c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (bounded_hl N u /\ bounded_hl N v)) -> hausdist N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t},\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e u /\ y :e v}) <= hausdist N (s,u) + hausdist N (t,v)

items.name: HAUSDIST_SUMS_LE_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ bounded_hl N u) -> hausdist N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t},\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e u}) <= hausdist N (t,u)

items.name: HAUSDIST_SUMS_LE_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ bounded_hl N u) -> hausdist N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e u},\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ y :e u}) <= hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_SYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hausdist N (s,t) = hausdist N (t,s)

items.name: HAUSDIST_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, hausdist N ({vector_add N a x | x :e s},{vector_add N a x | x :e t}) = hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: HAUSDIST_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (bounded_hl N u /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> hausdist N (s,u) <= hausdist N (s,t) + hausdist N (t,u)

items.name: HAUSDIST_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t t' c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (t' c= s /\ (bounded_hl M t /\ (bounded_hl M t' /\ hausdist M (t',t) < d))) -> hausdist N ({f x | x :e t'},{f x | x :e t}) < e0

items.name: HAUSDIST_UNION_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (bounded_hl N u /\ (~ t = Empty /\ ~ u = Empty))) -> hausdist N (s :\/: t,s :\/: u) <= hausdist N (t,u)

items.name: HAUSDORFF_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE

items.name: HAUSDORFF_IMP_KC_SPACE

items.name: HAUSDORFF_IMP_T0_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top -> t0_space A top

items.name: HAUSDORFF_IMP_T1_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top -> t1_space A top

items.name: HAUSDORFF_NORMAL_SPACE_CLOSED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> normal_space A top /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ t1_space B top'))) -> hausdorff_space B top'

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) <-> hausdorff_space A top /\ locally_compact_space A top

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION_ASYMMETRIC_PROD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) <-> kc_space ((A :+: 1) :*: A) (prod_topology (A :+: 1) A (alexandroff_compactification A top) top) /\ k_space ((A :+: 1) :*: A) (prod_topology (A :+: 1) A (alexandroff_compactification A top) top)

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_CANTOR_SPACE
