items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_CLOSED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top'))) -> hausdorff_space B top'

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_CLOSED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')) -> (closed_map A B (top,top') f <-> hausdorff_space B top')

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_CLOSED_IN_DIAGONAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top <-> closed_in (A :*: A) (prod_topology A A top top) {(x,x) | x :e A, x :e topspace A top}

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_CLOSED_NEIGHBOURHOOD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists u c c= A, u :e top /\ (closed_in A top c /\ (hausdorff_space A (subtopology A top c) /\ (x :e u /\ u c= c)))

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_COMPACT_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (compact_in A top s /\ (compact_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty)) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_COMPACT_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, compact_in A top s /\ (compact_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (kc_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top'))) -> hausdorff_space B top'

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')) -> (hausdorff_space B top' <-> kc_space B top')

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_DISCRETE_COMPACT_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top -> (s :/\: derived_set_of A top s = Empty /\ compact_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ finite s)

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, hausdorff_space A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> hausdorff_space (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A)

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: hausdorff_space R euclideanreal

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_EXPANSIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, topspace A top' = topspace A top /\ (forall u c= A, u :e top -> u :e top') -> hausdorff_space A top -> hausdorff_space A top'

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_FINITE_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top -> (derived_set_of A top (topspace A top) = Empty /\ compact_space A top <-> finite (topspace A top))

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_INJECTIVE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ hausdorff_space B top') -> hausdorff_space A top

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, hausdorff_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_ONE_POINT_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, compact_space A top /\ (topspace A top :\: {a} :e top /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) k /\ closed_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) k -> closed_in A top k)) -> (hausdorff_space A top <-> hausdorff_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) /\ locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})))

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_ONE_POINT_COMPACTIFICATION_ASYMMETRIC_PROD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, compact_space A top -> (hausdorff_space A top <-> kc_space (A :*: A) (prod_topology A A top (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a}))) /\ k_space (A :*: A) (prod_topology A A top (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a}))))

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> hausdorff_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> hausdorff_space B top'

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, hausdorff_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> hausdorff_space A (tops i)

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, hausdorff_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ hausdorff_space A top1 /\ hausdorff_space B top2

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_PROPER_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> hausdorff_space A top /\ (proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> hausdorff_space B top'

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ hausdorff_space A top -> hausdorff_space B top'

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_SING_INTERS_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> {x0 :e A | forall Y :e {u :e Power A | closed_in A top u /\ x :e interior_of A top u}, x0 :e Y} = {x}

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_SING_INTERS_OPENS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, hausdorff_space A top /\ a :e topspace A top -> {x :e A | forall Y :e {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ a :e u}, x :e Y} = {a}

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top -> hausdorff_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: HAUSDORFF_SPACE_TOPSPACE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> hausdorff_space A top

items.name: HD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_hd (seq_cons h t) = h

items.name: HD_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_hd (seq_append l m) = if l = seq_nil then seq_hd m else seq_hd l

items.name: HD_REVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> seq_hd (seq_rev l) = seq_last l

items.name: HEINE_BOREL_IMP_BOLZANO_WEIERSTRASS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> open N t) /\ s c= Union f -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ (finite f' /\ s c= Union f')) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, infinite t /\ t c= s -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ limit_point_of N x t

items.name: HEINE_BOREL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), s c= Union t /\ (forall b c= R :^: idx N, b :e t -> open N b) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, b :e t /\ ball N (x,e0) c= b

items.name: HELLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (dimindex N + 1 <= finite_cardinality f /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex N s) /\ (forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), t c= f /\ finite_cardinality t = dimindex N + 1 -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e t, x :e Y} = Empty))) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: HELLY_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex N s) /\ (forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), t c= f /\ finite_cardinality t <= dimindex N + 1 -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e t, x :e Y} = Empty)) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: HELLY_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (finite f -> dimindex N + 1 <= finite_cardinality f) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex N s /\ closed N s) /\ ((exists s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ bounded_hl N s) /\ (forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), t c= f /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t = dimindex N + 1) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e t, x :e Y} = Empty))) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: HELLY_CLOSED_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex N s /\ closed N s) /\ ((exists s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ bounded_hl N s) /\ (forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), t c= f /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t <= dimindex N + 1) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e t, x :e Y} = Empty)) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: HELLY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (finite f -> dimindex N + 1 <= finite_cardinality f) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex N s /\ compact N s) /\ (forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), t c= f /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t = dimindex N + 1) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e t, x :e Y} = Empty)) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: HELLY_COMPACT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex N s /\ compact N s) /\ (forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), t c= f /\ (finite t /\ finite_cardinality t <= dimindex N + 1) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e t, x :e Y} = Empty) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: HELLY_INDUCT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), equip f n /\ (dimindex N + 1 <= n /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> convex N s) /\ (forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), t c= f /\ finite_cardinality t = dimindex N + 1 -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e t, x :e Y} = Empty))) -> ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: HELLY_SELECTION_INCREASING
items.statement: forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx 1, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall k :e R, is_interval 1 s /\ ((forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> vector_norm 1 (f n x) <= k) /\ (forall n :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f n x) <= drop (f n y))) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => f (r n) x) (g x) sequentially) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> vector_norm 1 (g x) <= k) /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (g x) <= drop (g y))))

items.name: HELLY_SELECTION_THEOREM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx 1, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall c d :e R, is_interval 1 s /\ ((forall n :e omega, has_bounded_variation_on N (f n) s) /\ ((forall n :e omega, vector_variation N s (f n) <= c) /\ (forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f n x) <= d))) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f (r n) x) (g x) sequentially) /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N g s /\ vector_variation N s g <= c)))

items.name: HENSTOCK_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d:set -> set -> prop, gauge M d /\ forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_partial_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p -> finsum p (fun p0:set => vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0))) (integral N M (p0 1) f))) < e0

items.name: HENSTOCK_LEMMA_PART1
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall d:set -> set -> prop, forall e0 :e R, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (0 < e0 /\ (gauge M d /\ (forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0)))) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f)) < e0))) -> forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_partial_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p -> vector_norm N (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_sub N (vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0))) (integral N M (p0 1) f))) <= e0

items.name: HENSTOCK_LEMMA_PART2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall d:set -> set -> prop, forall e0 :e R, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (0 < e0 /\ (gauge M d /\ (forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0)))) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f)) < e0))) -> forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_partial_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p -> finsum p (fun p0:set => vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0))) (integral N M (p0 1) f))) <= 2 * dimindex N * e0

items.name: HEREDITARILY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= topology A, forall top :e topology A, hereditarily A P top <-> forall s c= A, subtopology A top s :e P

items.name: HEREDITARILY_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall P c= topology A, hereditarily A P top -> top :e P

items.name: HEREDITARILY_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall t :e topology A, forall P c= topology A, forall Q:set -> prop, (forall top :e topology A, top :e P -> Q t) -> forall top :e topology A, hereditarily A P top -> hereditarily A P top

items.name: HEREDITARILY_NORMAL_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top <-> forall s t c= A, separated_in A top s t -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: HEREDITARILY_NORMAL_SEPARATION_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top <-> forall u c= Power A, finite u /\ ((forall s c= A, s :e u -> s c= topspace A top) /\ (forall x y :e u, x <> y -> separated_in A top x y)) -> exists f :e Power A :^: Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e u -> f s :e top /\ s c= f s) /\ forall x y :e u, x <> y -> f x :/\: f y = Empty

items.name: HEREDITARILY_NORMAL_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top <-> forall u c= A, u :e top -> normal_space A (subtopology A top u)

items.name: HEREDITARILY_NORMAL_SPACE_CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top)) -> hereditarily B {x :e topology B | normal_space B x} top'

items.name: HEREDITARILY_NORMAL_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> hereditarily B {x :e topology B | normal_space B x} top'

items.name: HEREDITARILY_NORMAL_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top -> hereditarily B {x :e topology B | normal_space B x} top'

items.name: HEREDITARILY_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= topology A, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hereditarily A P top -> hereditarily A P (subtopology A top s)

items.name: HEREDITARY_IMP_RETRACTIVE_PROPERTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, P top -> P (subtopology A top s)) /\ (forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (P top <-> Q top')) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ P top -> Q top'

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_AFFINE_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, affine N s -> (homeomorphic_space (R :^: idx N) (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (euclidean_space n) <-> aff_dim N s = n)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_AFFINE_SETS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, affine M s /\ (affine N t /\ aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t) -> homeomorphic N M s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_AFFINE_SETS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, affine M s /\ affine N t -> (homeomorphic N M s t <-> aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, ~ c = 0 -> homeomorphic N N s {vector_add N (vector_mul N c x) a | x :e s}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_ANALYTICITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> (analytic M s <-> analytic N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_ANRNESS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> (ANR M s <-> ANR N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_ARC_IMAGES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc M g /\ arc N h -> homeomorphic N M (path_image M g) (path_image N h)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_ARC_IMAGE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, arc N g /\ drop a < drop b -> homeomorphic 1 N (path_image N g) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_ARC_IMAGE_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, arc N g /\ ~ a = b -> homeomorphic M N (path_image N g) (closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_ARC_IMAGE_SEGMENT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ~ a = b -> (homeomorphic M N s (closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N g /\ path_image N g = s))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_ARNESS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> (AR M s <-> AR N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_BAIRE_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, homeomorphic N M s t /\ 1 <= k -> ((fun x :e R :^: idx M => indicator M s x) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M) <-> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => indicator N t x) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_BALLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall d e0 :e R, 0 < d /\ 0 < e0 -> homeomorphic N N (ball N (a,d)) (ball N (b,e0))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_BALLS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, homeomorphic N M (ball M (a,r)) (ball N (b,s)) <-> r <= 0 /\ s <= 0 \/ 0 < r /\ (0 < s /\ dimindex M = dimindex N)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_BALL_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 0 < r -> homeomorphic N N (ball N (a,r)) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_BORELNESS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> (borel M s <-> borel N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CARD_EQ_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> equip (components M s) (components N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CARD_EQ_PATH_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> equip {{x0 :e R :^: idx M | path_component M s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s} {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N t x x0} | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CBALLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall d e0 :e R, 0 < d /\ 0 < e0 -> homeomorphic N N (cball N (a,d)) (cball N (b,e0))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CBALLS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, homeomorphic N M (cball M (a,r)) (cball N (b,s)) <-> r < 0 /\ s < 0 \/ (r = 0 /\ s = 0 \/ 0 < r /\ (0 < s /\ dimindex M = dimindex N))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CLOSED_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty /\ ~ open_interval N (c,d) = Empty -> homeomorphic N N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CLOSED_IN_CONVEX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, aff_dim M s < dimindex N -> exists u t c= R :^: idx N, convex N u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ homeomorphic N M s t))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall t c= R :^: idx B, compact A s /\ (continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))) -> homeomorphic B A s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_COMPACTNESS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx B, homeomorphic B A s t -> (compact A s <-> compact B t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_COMPACT_ARNESS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall s' c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s s' -> (compact M s /\ retract_of M s (R :^: idx M) <-> compact N s' /\ retract_of N s' (R :^: idx N))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_COMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (compact_space A top <-> compact_space B top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_COMPLETELY_METRIZABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (completely_metrizable_space A top <-> completely_metrizable_space B top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_COMPLETELY_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (completely_regular_space A top <-> completely_regular_space B top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONNECTEDNESS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx B, homeomorphic B A s t -> (connected A s <-> connected B t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (connected_space A top <-> connected_space B top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t /\ contractible M s -> contractible N t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONTRACTIBLE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> (contractible M s <-> contractible N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ (~ interior N s = Empty /\ (convex N t /\ (compact N t /\ ~ interior N t = Empty)))) -> homeomorphic N N s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_COMPACT_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ (~ interior N s = Empty /\ 0 < e0)) -> homeomorphic N N s (cball N (b,e0))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_COMPACT_SETS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex M s /\ (compact M s /\ (convex N t /\ (compact N t /\ aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t))) -> homeomorphic N M s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_COMPACT_SETS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex M s /\ (compact M s /\ (convex N t /\ compact N t)) -> (homeomorphic N M s t <-> aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_OPEN_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (open N s /\ (convex N t /\ (open N t /\ (s = Empty <-> t = Empty)))) -> homeomorphic N N s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_SETS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex M s /\ (convex N t /\ homeomorphic N M s t) -> aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_COUNTABILITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> (countable s <-> countable t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_BAIRE_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, homeomorphic N M s t /\ 1 <= k -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_BAIRE_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, homeomorphic N M s t /\ 1 <= k -> ((exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx M => indicator M x x00) :e baire M 1 k (R :^: idx M)) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, (fun x00 :e R :^: idx N => indicator N x x00) :e baire N 1 k (R :^: idx N)) /\ Union u = t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> dimension M s = dimension N t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_DISCRETE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (discrete_space A top <-> discrete_space B top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_DISCRETE_SPACES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, discrete_space A top /\ discrete_space B top' -> (homeomorphic_space A B top top' <-> equip (topspace A top) (topspace B top'))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_EMPTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic M N s Empty <-> s = Empty) /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M Empty s <-> s = Empty

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_EMPTY_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (topspace A top = Empty <-> topspace B top' = Empty)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_EMPTY_SPACE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, topspace A top = Empty -> (homeomorphic_space A B top top' <-> topspace B top' = Empty)) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, topspace B top' = Empty -> (homeomorphic_space A B top top' <-> topspace A top = Empty)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_ENRNESS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> (ENR M s <-> ENR N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_EQ_EVERYTHING_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (open_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)))))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_EQ_INJECTIVE_PERFECT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f <-> perfect_map A B (top,top') f /\ forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall n :e omega, homeomorphic_space (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) (product_topology R omega (idx_n n) (fun i:set => euclideanreal))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_FINITE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ finite t -> (homeomorphic N M s t <-> finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_FINITENESS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_FINITE_STRONG

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_FIXPOINT_PROPERTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx B, homeomorphic B A s t -> ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> continuous_on_hl A A f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= s -> exists x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ f x = x) <-> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> continuous_on_hl B B g t /\ {g x | x :e t} c= t -> exists y :e R :^: idx B, y :e t /\ g y = y)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_FRONTIERS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_FRONTIERS_SAME_DIMENSION

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_FSIGMANESS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_GDELTANESS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_GRAPH

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_HAS_SIZE

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_HYPERPLANES

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_HYPERPLANES_EQ

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_IMP_HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE_LEFT_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx A, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (homeomorphic A N {f x | x :e s} t <-> homeomorphic A M s t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_INTERVALS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) <-> aff_dim M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = aff_dim N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (open_interval N (c,d)) <-> closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ open_interval N (c,d) = Empty) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M (open_interval M (a,b)) (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) <-> open_interval M (a,b) = Empty /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M (open_interval M (a,b)) (open_interval N (c,d)) <-> open_interval M (a,b) = Empty /\ open_interval N (c,d) = Empty \/ ~ open_interval M (a,b) = Empty /\ (~ open_interval N (c,d) = Empty /\ dimindex M = dimindex N)))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAPS_COMPOSE

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAPS_SUBTOPOLOGIES_ALT

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAPS_SWAP

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAPS_SYM

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_CLOSEDNESS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_CLOSEDNESS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall u c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f -> (closed_in A top u <-> u c= topspace A top /\ closed_in B top' {f x | x :e u})

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ s c= topspace A top -> closure_of B top' {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e closure_of A top s}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_COMPACTNESS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_COMPACTNESS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall u c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f -> (compact_in A top u <-> u c= topspace A top /\ compact_in B top' {f x | x :e u})

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ homeomorphic_map B C (top',top'') g -> homeomorphic_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_CONNECTEDNESS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall u c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ u c= topspace A top -> (connected_in B top' {f x | x :e u} <-> connected_in A top u)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_CONNECTEDNESS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall u c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f -> (connected_in A top u <-> u c= topspace A top /\ connected_in B top' {f x | x :e u})

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f -> connected_components_of B top' = {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e connected_components_of A top}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall x :e A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ x :e topspace A top -> forall x0 :e B, connected_component_of B top' (f x) x0 <-> x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e {x1 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x1}}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_DERIVED_SET_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ s c= topspace A top -> derived_set_of B top' {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e derived_set_of A top s}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) /\ homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f -> homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ s c= topspace A top -> frontier_of B top' {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e frontier_of A top s}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_FSIGMANESS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_GDELTANESS

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall u c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f -> (u :e gdelta_in A top <-> u c= topspace A top /\ {f x | x :e u} :e gdelta_in B top')

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f :e B :^: A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) -> group_isomorphism_hl (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top),homology_group B (p,top')) (fun x:set => hom_induced A B p (top,Empty) (top',Empty) f x)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_IMP_HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_INVOLUTION

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_MAPS

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f -> path_components_of B top' = {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e path_components_of A top}

items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall x :e A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ x :e topspace A top -> forall x0 :e B, path_component_of B top' (f x) x0 <-> x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e {x1 :e A | path_component_of A top x x1}}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_PATH_CONNECTEDNESS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall u c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f -> (path_connected_in A top u <-> u c= topspace A top /\ path_connected_in B top' {f x | x :e u})

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_QUASI_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall x :e A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ x :e topspace A top -> forall x0 :e B, quasi_component_of B top' (f x) x0 <-> x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e {x1 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x1}}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_ISOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f :e B :^: A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ {f x | x :e s} = t) -> group_isomorphism_hl (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)),relative_homology_group B (p,(top',t))) (fun x:set => hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) f x)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s t c= A, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ t c= topspace A top) -> (separated_in B top' {f x | x :e s} {f x | x :e t} <-> separated_in A top s t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_SUBTOPOLOGIES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top :/\: s} = topspace B top' :/\: t -> homeomorphic_map A B (subtopology A top s,subtopology B top' t) f

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP_SWAP

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_METRIZABLE_SPACE

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx B, homeomorphic B A s t <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> f x :e t /\ g (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y) /\ (continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ continuous_on_hl B A g t)))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_MONOTONE_IMAGE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, connected 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ f x = y}) /\ ~ f (vec 1 1) = f (vec 1 0)) -> homeomorphic 1 N {f x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)} (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_OPEN_INTERVAL_UNIV

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall s' c= R :^: idx P, forall t' c= R :^: idx Q, homeomorphic P M s s' /\ homeomorphic Q N t t' -> homeomorphic (idx_n (dimindex P + dimindex Q)) (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart P Q x y | y :e t'})

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_PCROSS_ASSOC
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, homeomorphic (idx_n ((dimindex M + dimindex N) + dimindex P)) (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N + dimindex P)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) x y | y :e \/_ x :e t, {pastecart N P x y | y :e u}}) (\/_ x :e (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}), {pastecart (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) P x y | y :e u})

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_PCROSS_SING

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_PUNCTURED_AFFINE_SPHERE_AFFINE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall p c= R :^: idx M, 0 < r /\ (b :e sphere N (a,r) /\ (affine N t /\ (a :e t /\ (b :e t /\ (affine M p /\ aff_dim N t = aff_dim M p + 1))))) -> homeomorphic M N (sphere N (a,r) :/\: t :\: {b}) p

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_PUNCTURED_SPHERE_AFFINE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, 0 < r /\ (b :e sphere N (a,r) /\ (affine M t /\ aff_dim M t + 1 = dimindex N)) -> homeomorphic M N (sphere N (a,r) :\: {b}) t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_PUNCTURED_SPHERE_AFFINE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (a :e relative_frontier N s /\ (affine M t /\ aff_dim N s = aff_dim M t + 1))) -> homeomorphic M N (relative_frontier N s :\: {a}) t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_PUNCTURED_SPHERE_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall b c :e R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, 0 < r /\ (b :e sphere N (a,r) /\ ~ c = vec N 0) -> homeomorphic N N (sphere N (a,r) :\: {b}) {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N c x = d}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_PUNCTURED_SPHERE_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall b :e R :^: idx N, 0 < r /\ (b :e sphere N (a,r) /\ dimindex N = dimindex M + 1) -> homeomorphic M N (sphere N (a,r) :\: {b}) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N N s s

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (regular_space A top <-> regular_space B top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_RELATIVELY_OPEN_CONVEX_SETS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex M s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (hull (R :^: idx M) {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | affine M x} s) /\ (convex N t /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t) /\ aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t))) -> homeomorphic N M s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_RELATIVE_BOUNDARIES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t /\ (relative_interior M s = Empty <-> relative_interior N t = Empty) -> homeomorphic N M (s :\: relative_interior M s) (t :\: relative_interior N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_RELATIVE_BOUNDARIES_SAME_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t /\ homeomorphic N M s t -> homeomorphic N M (s :\: relative_interior M s) (t :\: relative_interior N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_RELATIVE_FRONTIERS_CONVEX_BOUNDED_SETS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex M s /\ (bounded_hl M s /\ (convex N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t))) -> homeomorphic N M (relative_frontier M s) (relative_frontier N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_RELATIVE_INTERIORS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t /\ (relative_interior M s = Empty <-> relative_interior N t = Empty) -> homeomorphic N M (relative_interior M s) (relative_interior N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_RELATIVE_INTERIORS_CONVEX_COMPACT_SETS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex M s /\ (compact M s /\ (convex N t /\ (compact N t /\ aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t))) -> homeomorphic N M (relative_interior M s) (relative_interior N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_RELATIVE_INTERIORS_SAME_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t /\ homeomorphic N M s t -> homeomorphic N M (relative_interior M s) (relative_interior N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, ~ c = 0 -> homeomorphic N N s {vector_mul N c x | x :e s}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SCALING_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall c :e R, 0 < c -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall t c= R :^: idx A, homeomorphic A B {vector_mul B c x | x :e s} t <-> homeomorphic A B s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SCALING_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall c :e R, 0 < c -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx B, homeomorphic B A s {vector_mul B c x | x :e t} <-> homeomorphic B A s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SEGMENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M (closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (closed_segment N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) <-> (a = b <-> c = d)) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ homeomorphic N M (closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (open_segment N (c,d))) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ homeomorphic N M (open_segment M (a,b)) (closed_segment N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M (open_segment M (a,b)) (open_segment N (c,d)) <-> (a = b <-> c = d)))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SELF_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g) /\ u c= s -> homeomorphic M N {f x | x :e u} u

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SEPARABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (separable_space A top <-> separable_space B top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ homeomorphic N N s t) -> (connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) <-> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SEPARATION_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, s c= sphere N (a,r) /\ (t c= sphere N (a,r) /\ homeomorphic N N s t) -> (connected N (sphere N (a,r) :\: s) <-> connected N (sphere N (a,r) :\: t))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SEPARATION_SPHERE_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, s c= sphere N (a,r) /\ (t c= sphere N (a,r) /\ (closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ homeomorphic N N s t))) -> equip (components N (sphere N (a,r) :\: s)) (components N (sphere N (a,r) :\: t))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SEPARATION_SPHERE_HAS_SIZE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall n :e omega, s c= sphere N (a,r) /\ (t c= sphere N (a,r) /\ homeomorphic N N s t) -> (equip (components N (sphere N (a,r) :\: s)) n <-> equip (components N (sphere N (a,r) :\: t)) n)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SIMPLE_PATH_ARC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc M g /\ (simple_path N h /\ homeomorphic N M (path_image M g) (path_image N h)) -> arc N h

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SIMPLE_PATH_ARC_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path M g /\ (simple_path N h /\ homeomorphic N M (path_image M g) (path_image N h)) -> (arc M g <-> arc N h)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path M g /\ (pathfinish M g = pathstart M g /\ (simple_path N h /\ pathfinish N h = pathstart N h)) -> homeomorphic N M (path_image M g) (path_image N h)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE_CIRCLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx_n 2, forall r :e R, simple_path N g /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N g /\ 0 < r) -> homeomorphic (idx_n 2) N (path_image N g) (sphere (idx_n 2) (a,r))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE_CIRCLE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx_n 2, forall r :e R, 0 < r -> (homeomorphic (idx_n 2) N s (sphere (idx_n 2) (a,r)) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (simple_path N g /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N g /\ path_image N g = s)))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SIMPLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t /\ simply_connected M s -> simply_connected N t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SIMPLY_CONNECTED_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M s t -> (simply_connected M s <-> simply_connected N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N M {a} {b}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_CONTRACTIBILITY

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_COUNTABILITY

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_DIMENSION_LE

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic_space (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) <-> homeomorphic N M s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_IMP_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> equip (topspace A top) (topspace B top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_IMP_ISOMORPHIC_HOMOLOGY_GROUPS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> isomorphic_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top)) (homology_group B (p,top'))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_IMP_ISOMORPHIC_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUPS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> isomorphic_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group A (p,top)) (reduced_homology_group B (p,top'))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_INFINITENESS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top1' :e topology B, forall top2 :e topology C, forall top2' :e topology D, homeomorphic_space A B top1 top1' /\ homeomorphic_space C D top2 top2' -> homeomorphic_space (A :*: C) (B :*: D) (prod_topology A C top1 top2) (prod_topology B D top1' top2')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall b :e B, b :e topspace B top' -> homeomorphic_space A (A :*: B) top (prod_topology A B top (subtopology B top' {b}))) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall a :e A, a :e topspace A top -> homeomorphic_space B (A :*: B) top' (prod_topology A B (subtopology A top {a}) top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space (A :*: B) (B :*: A) (prod_topology A B top top') (prod_topology B A top' top)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_REFL

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_SECOND_COUNTABILITY

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_SINGLETON_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k :e K, homeomorphic_space (A :^: K) A (product_topology A K {k} tops) (tops k)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_SYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' <-> homeomorphic_space B A top' top

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_TRANS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SPHERES

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_STANDARD_HYPERPLANE_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, forall k :e omega, forall c :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> homeomorphic N N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = c} {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SUBSPACES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace M s /\ (subspace N t /\ dim M s = dim N t) -> homeomorphic N M s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SUBSPACES_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace M s /\ subspace N t -> (homeomorphic N M s t <-> dim M s = dim N t)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SUBSPACE_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, subspace N s -> (homeomorphic_space (R :^: idx N) (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (euclidean_space n) <-> dim N s = n)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SUBSPACE_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> homeomorphic_space (R :^: idx N) (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (euclidean_space (dim N s))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_SYM

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_T0_SPACE

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (t1_space A top <-> t1_space B top')

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_TRANS

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N N s {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_TRANSLATION_LEFT_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx A, homeomorphic A N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} t <-> homeomorphic A N s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_TRANSLATION_RIGHT_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N A s {vector_add N a x | x :e t} <-> homeomorphic N A s t

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_TRANSLATION_SELF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphic N N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} s

items.name: HOMEOMORPHIC_UNIV_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (homeomorphic N M (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) <-> dimindex M = dimindex N)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g) <-> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M (fun x:set => g x) t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> f (g y) = y))))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHISM_1D_IMP_MONOTONIC
items.statement: forall f g :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx 1), forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, homeomorphism 1 1 (s,t) (f,g) /\ is_interval 1 s -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (drop (f x) < drop (f y) <-> drop x < drop y)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (drop (g x) < drop (g y) <-> drop x < drop y)) \/ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (drop (f x) < drop (f y) <-> drop y < drop x)) /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e t /\ y :e t -> (drop (g x) < drop (g y) <-> drop y < drop x)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHISM_ANRNESS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= R :^: idx M, homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g) /\ k c= s -> (ANR N {f x | x :e k} <-> ANR M k)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHISM_ARC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx 1), arc N (fun x:set => g x) -> exists h :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism 1 N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil),path_image N (fun x:set => g x)) (g,h)

items.name: HOMEOMORPHISM_ARC_IMAGES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc M g /\ arc N h -> exists f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), exists f' :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (path_image M g,path_image N h) (f,f') /\ (f (pathstart M g) = pathstart N h /\ (f (pathfinish M g) = pathfinish N h /\ (f' (pathstart N h) = pathstart M g /\ f' (pathfinish N h) = pathfinish M g)))

items.name: HOMEOMORPHISM_FROM_COMPOSITION_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N P (fun x:set => g x) t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ g x = g y) -> x = y) /\ (exists h :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx P), homeomorphism M P (s,u) (fun x :e R :^: idx M => g (f x),h)))))) -> (exists f' :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,f')) /\ exists g' :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx P), homeomorphism N P (t,u) (g,g')

items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s \/ compact M s /\ ANR N t -> (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f g <-> continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ ({g x | x :e s} c= t /\ forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e components M s -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f g))))

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_ON_NEIGHBOURHOOD_INTO_ANR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall v c= R :^: idx N, ANR N v /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= v /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ ({g x | x :e s} c= v /\ (t c= s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> f x = g x)))))) -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (t c= u /\ homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> h x = f x} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) v) f g)

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> orthogonal_transformation N f /\ orthogonal_transformation N g -> (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (vec N 0,1)),subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (vec N 0,1))) f g <-> det N (matrix N N f) = det N (matrix N N g))

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> (homotopic_paths N s p q <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n 2, h x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl (idx_n 2) N h (\/_ x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil), {pastecart 1 1 x y | y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)}) /\ ({h x | x :e \/_ x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil), {pastecart 1 1 x y | y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)}} c= s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> h (pastecart 1 1 (vec 1 0) x) = p x) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> h (pastecart 1 1 (vec 1 1) x) = q x) /\ forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> pathstart N (fun x:set => h (pastecart 1 1 t x)) = pathstart N p /\ pathfinish N (fun x:set => h (pastecart 1 1 t x)) = pathfinish N p)))))

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p /\ (path_image N p c= s /\ (path N q /\ (path_image N q c= s /\ (path N r /\ (path_image N r c= s /\ (pathfinish N p = pathstart N q /\ pathfinish N q = pathstart N r)))))) -> homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) q r x0) x) (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p q x0) r x)

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_EQ

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_IMP_PATHFINISH

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_JOIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q' x :e R :^: idx N) -> homotopic_paths N s p p' /\ (homotopic_paths N s q q' /\ pathfinish N p = pathstart N q) -> homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p q x) (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p' q' x)

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p q x) (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p r x) /\ (pathstart N q = pathfinish N p /\ pathstart N r = pathfinish N p) -> homotopic_paths N s q r

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_LCANCEL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, pathstart N q = pathfinish N p /\ pathstart N r = pathfinish N p -> (homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p q x) (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p r x) <-> path N p /\ (path_image N p c= s /\ homotopic_paths N s q r))

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_LID
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p /\ path_image N p c= s -> homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) (fun x0:set => linepath N (pathstart N p,pathstart N p) x0) p x) p

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_LINEAR
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N g /\ (path N h /\ (pathstart N h = pathstart N g /\ (pathfinish N h = pathfinish N g /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, forall x :e A, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> closed_segment N (seq_cons (g t,h t) seq_nil) c= s)))) -> homotopic_paths N s g h

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_LINV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p /\ path_image N p c= s -> homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) (fun x0:set => reversepath N p x0) p x) (fun x:set => linepath N (pathfinish N p,pathfinish N p) x)

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_LOOP_PARTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_loops N s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p (fun x0:set => reversepath N q x0) x) (fun x:set => linepath N (a,a) x) /\ path N q -> homotopic_paths N s p q

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_NEARBY_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N g /\ (path N h /\ (pathstart N h = pathstart N g /\ (pathfinish N h = pathfinish N g /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, forall x :e R :^: idx N, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ ~ x :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (h t) (g t)) < vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g t) x))))) -> homotopic_paths N s g h

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p r x) (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) q r x) /\ (pathfinish N p = pathstart N r /\ pathfinish N q = pathstart N r) -> homotopic_paths N s p q

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_RCANCEL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, pathfinish N p = pathstart N r /\ pathfinish N q = pathstart N r -> (homotopic_paths N s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p r x) (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) q r x) <-> homotopic_paths N s p q /\ (path N r /\ path_image N r c= s))

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> (homotopic_paths A s p p <-> path A p /\ path_image A p c= s)

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_REPARAMETRIZE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p /\ (path_image N p c= s /\ (exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) /\ ({f x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)} c= closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (f (vec 1 0) = vec 1 0 /\ (f (vec 1 1) = vec 1 1 /\ forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> q t = p (f t))))))) -> homotopic_paths N s p q

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_RID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> path A p /\ path_image A p c= s -> homotopic_paths A s (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) p (fun x0:set => linepath A (pathfinish A p,pathfinish A p) x0) x) p

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx A) -> (homotopic_paths A s p q <-> homotopic_paths A s q p)

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_PATHS_TRANS

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_THROUGH_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g1 x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g2 x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl M N f1 s /\ ({f1 x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g1 t /\ ({g1 x | x :e t} c= u /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f2 s /\ ({f2 x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g2 t /\ ({g2 x | x :e t} c= u /\ (contractible N t /\ path_connected P u)))))))) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx P) (R :^: idx M) {h :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u) (fun x:set => g1 (f1 x)) (fun x:set => g2 (f2 x))

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_THROUGH_CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE

items.name: HOMOTOPIC_WITH_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY

items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, homotopy_equivalent M N s t -> ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl P M f u /\ {f x | x :e u} c= s -> exists c :e R :^: idx M, homotopic_with (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx P) {x :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx P) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u,subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) f (fun x:set => c)) <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx P, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl P N f u /\ {f x | x :e u} c= t -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx P) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx P) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => c))

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE_LEFT_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx A, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (homotopy_equivalent N A {f x | x :e s} t <-> homotopy_equivalent M A s t)

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE_RIGHT_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (homotopy_equivalent A N s {f x | x :e t} <-> homotopy_equivalent A M s t)

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE_SELF
