items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_PATH_CONNECTEDNESS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homotopy_equivalent M N s t -> (path_connected M s <-> path_connected N t)

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall s' c= R :^: idx P, forall t' c= R :^: idx Q, homotopy_equivalent M P s s' /\ homotopy_equivalent N Q t t' -> homotopy_equivalent (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (idx_n (dimindex P + dimindex Q)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart P Q x y | y :e t'})

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_PUNCTURED_UNIV_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 0 < r -> homotopy_equivalent N N ((R :^: idx N) :\: {c}) (sphere N (a,r))

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, homotopy_equivalent N N s s

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_PUNCTURED_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ a :e relative_interior N s) -> homotopy_equivalent N N (relative_frontier N s) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :\: {a})

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_PUNCTURED_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (a :e relative_interior N s /\ (convex N t /\ (relative_frontier N s c= t /\ t c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s)))) -> homotopy_equivalent N N (relative_frontier N s) (t :\: {a})

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, homotopy_equivalent M N s {a} <-> ~ s = Empty /\ contractible M s

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SPACE_CONTRACTIBILITY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homotopy_equivalent_space A B top top' -> (contractible_space A top <-> contractible_space B top')

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homotopy_equivalent_space (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) <-> homotopy_equivalent M N s t

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SPACE_IMP_ISOMORPHIC_HOMOLOGY_GROUPS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homotopy_equivalent_space A B top top' -> isomorphic_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top)) (homology_group B (p,top'))

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SPACE_IMP_ISOMORPHIC_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUPS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homotopy_equivalent_space A B top top' -> isomorphic_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group A (p,top)) (reduced_homology_group B (p,top'))

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SPACE_IMP_ISOMORPHIC_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUPS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_map B A (top',top) g /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= s /\ (homotopic_with A A {h :e A :^: A | {h x | x :e s} c= s} (top,top) (fun x:set => g (f x)) (fun x:set => x) /\ homotopic_with B B {k :e B :^: B | {k x | x :e t} c= t} (top',top') (fun x:set => f (g x)) (fun x:set => x))))) -> isomorphic_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s))) (relative_homology_group B (p,(top',t)))

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SPACE_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, homotopy_equivalent_space A A top top

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SPACE_SYM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homotopy_equivalent_space A B top top' <-> homotopy_equivalent_space B A top' top

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SPACE_TRANS

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_SYM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homotopy_equivalent M N s t <-> homotopy_equivalent N M t s

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_TRANS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, homotopy_equivalent M N s t /\ homotopy_equivalent N P t u -> homotopy_equivalent M P s u

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_TRANSLATION_LEFT_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx A, homotopy_equivalent N A {vector_add N a x | x :e s} t <-> homotopy_equivalent N A s t

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_TRANSLATION_RIGHT_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homotopy_equivalent A N s {vector_add N a x | x :e t} <-> homotopy_equivalent A N s t

items.name: HOMOTOPY_EQUIVALENT_TRANSLATION_SELF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, homotopy_equivalent N N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} s

items.name: HOMOTOPY_INVARIANT_CARD_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= s /\ homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) (fun x:set => f (g x)) (fun x:set => x)))) -> atleastp (components N t) (components M s)

items.name: HOMOTOPY_INVARIANT_CARD_PATH_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= s /\ homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) (fun x:set => f (g x)) (fun x:set => x)))) -> atleastp {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N t x x0} | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t} {{x0 :e R :^: idx M | path_component M s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s}

items.name: HOMOTOPY_INVARIANT_CONNECTEDNESS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= s /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) (fun x:set => f (g x)) (fun x:set => x) /\ connected M s)))) -> connected N t

items.name: HOMOTOPY_INVARIANT_PATH_CONNECTEDNESS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= s /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) (fun x:set => f (g x)) (fun x:set => x) /\ path_connected M s)))) -> path_connected N t

items.name: HOM_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall c c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), hom_boundary A p (top,s) c :e group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p + - 1,subtopology A top s))

items.name: HOM_BOUNDARY_CHAIN_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) c /\ 1 <= p -> forall x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), x :e hom_boundary A p (top,s) {x0 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | homologous_rel A (p,(top,s)) c x0} <-> homologous_rel A (minus_nat p 1,(subtopology A top s,Empty)) (chain_boundary A p c) x

items.name: HOM_BOUNDARY_DEFAULT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall c c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), ~ c :e group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s))) -> hom_boundary A p (top,s) c = group_id (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p + - 1,subtopology A top s))

items.name: HOM_BOUNDARY_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hom_boundary A p (top,s) = hom_boundary A p (top,topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: HOM_BOUNDARY_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, p <= 0 -> forall q :e topology A :*: Power A, forall r c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), hom_boundary A p q r = choose_in (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (fun x:set => True)

items.name: HOM_INDUCED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall t c= B, forall c c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) f c :e group_carrier (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group B (p,(top',t)))

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_CHAIN_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall t c= B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) c) -> forall x :e frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)), x :e hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) f {x0 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | homologous_rel A (p,(top,s)) c x0} <-> homologous_rel B (p,(top',t)) (chain_map A B p (fun x0:set => f x0) c) x

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_CHAIN_MAP_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall t c= B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top :/\: s} c= t /\ singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) c) -> forall x :e frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)), x :e hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) f {x0 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | homologous_rel A (p,(top,s)) c x0} <-> homologous_rel B (p,(top',t)) (chain_map A B p (fun x0:set => f x0) c) x

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall t c= B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall u c= C, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_map B C (top',top'') (fun x:set => g x) /\ {g x | x :e t} c= u)) -> forall x c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall x0 :e frag (C :^: (R :^: omega)), x0 :e hom_induced A C p (top,s) (top'',u) (fun x1 :e A => g (f x1)) x <-> hom_induced B C p (top',t) (top'',u) g (hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) f x) x0

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_COMPOSE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ continuous_map B C (top',top'') (fun x:set => g x) -> forall x c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall x0 :e frag (C :^: (R :^: omega)), x0 :e hom_induced A C p (top,Empty) (top'',Empty) (fun x1 :e A => g (f x1)) x <-> hom_induced B C p (top',Empty) (top'',Empty) g (hom_induced A B p (top,Empty) (top',Empty) f x) x0

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_DEFAULT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall t c= B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall c c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), ~ (continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top :/\: s} c= t /\ c :e group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s))))) -> hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) f c = group_id (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group B (p,(top',t)))

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall t c= B, forall f g :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) -> hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) f = hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) g

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall c c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), c :e group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s))) -> hom_induced A A p (top,s) (top,s) (fun x :e A => x) c = c

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_ID_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall f :e A :^: A, forall s c= A, forall c c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), continuous_map A A (top,top) (fun x:set => f x) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = x) /\ c :e group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)))) -> hom_induced A A p (top,s) (top,s) f c = c

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_REDUCED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall c c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), c :e group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group A (p,top)) -> hom_induced A B p (top,Empty) (top',Empty) f c :e group_carrier (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group B (p,top'))

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall t c= B, hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) = hom_induced A B p (top,topspace A top :/\: s) (top',topspace B top' :/\: t)

items.name: HOM_INDUCED_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, p < 0 -> forall q :e topology A :*: Power A, forall r :e topology B :*: Power B, forall s :e B :^: A, forall t c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), hom_induced A B p q r s t = choose_in (Power (frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)))) (fun x:set => True)

items.name: HOM_RELBOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall c c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), {x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | hom_relboundary A p (top,(s,t)) c x} :e group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p + - 1,(subtopology A top s,t)))

items.name: HOM_RELBOUNDARY_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall x0 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), hom_relboundary A p (top,(s,Empty)) x x0 <-> x0 :e hom_boundary A p (top,s) x

items.name: HP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> exists P c= A, chain_on A l P /\ forall Q c= A, chain_on A l Q /\ P c= Q -> Q = P

items.name: HULLS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, (forall f c= Power A, (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e f -> s0 :e P) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e P) /\ (s c= hull A P t /\ t c= hull A P s) -> hull A P s = hull A P t

items.name: HULL_ANTIMONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q c= Power A, forall s c= A, P c= Q -> hull A Q s c= hull A P s

items.name: HULL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall f c= Power A, (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e f -> s0 :e P) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e P) -> (hull A P s = s <-> s :e P)

items.name: HULL_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, hull A P (hull A P s) = hull A P s

items.name: HULL_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall s0 c= A, hull A P s0 :e P) /\ ((forall s0 c= A, {f x | x :e s0} :e P <-> s0 :e P) /\ ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e A, exists x :e A, f x = y))) -> hull A P {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e hull A P s}

items.name: HULL_IMAGE_GALOIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall s0 c= A, hull A P s0 :e P) /\ ((forall s0 c= A, s0 :e P -> {f x | x :e s0} :e P) /\ ((forall s0 c= A, s0 :e P -> {g x | x :e s0} :e P) /\ (forall s0 t c= A, s0 c= {g x | x :e t} <-> {f x | x :e s0} c= t))) -> hull A P {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e hull A P s}

items.name: HULL_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall s c= A, hull A P s :e P /\ (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e P -> {f x | x :e s0} :e P) -> hull A P {f x | x :e s} c= {f x | x :e hull A P s}

items.name: HULL_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s -> x :e hull A P s

items.name: HULL_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall p:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x) /\ {x :e A | p x} :e P -> forall x :e A, x :e hull A P s -> p x

items.name: HULL_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, hull A P (SetAdjoin s a) = hull A P (SetAdjoin (hull A P s) a)

items.name: HULL_INTERS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P f c= Power A, hull A P {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} c= {x :e A | forall Y :e {hull A P s | s :e Power A, s :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: HULL_INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, hull A P (s :/\: t) c= hull A P s :/\: hull A P t

items.name: HULL_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t :e P -> hull A P s c= t

items.name: HULL_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, s c= t -> hull A P s c= hull A P t

items.name: HULL_P
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, s :e P -> hull A P s = s

items.name: HULL_P_AND_Q
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P Q c= Power A, (forall f c= Power A, (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e f -> s0 :e P) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e P) /\ ((forall f c= Power A, (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e f -> s0 :e Q) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e Q) /\ (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e Q -> hull A P s0 :e Q)) -> hull A {x :e Power A | x :e P /\ x :e Q} s = hull A P (hull A Q s)

items.name: HULL_REDUNDANT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, a :e hull A P s -> hull A P (SetAdjoin s a) = hull A P s

items.name: HULL_REDUNDANT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, a :e hull A P s <-> hull A P (SetAdjoin s a) = hull A P s

items.name: HULL_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, s c= hull A P s

items.name: HULL_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, hull A P (s :\/: t) = hull A P (hull A P s :\/: hull A P t)

items.name: HULL_UNIONS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P f c= Power A, Union {hull A P s | s :e Power A, s :e f} c= hull A P (Union f)

items.name: HULL_UNION_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, hull A P (s :\/: t) = hull A P (hull A P s :\/: t)

items.name: HULL_UNION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, hull A P (s :\/: t) = hull A P (s :\/: hull A P t)

items.name: HULL_UNION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, hull A P s :\/: hull A P t c= hull A P (s :\/: t)

items.name: HULL_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ (t :e P /\ (forall t' c= A, s c= t' /\ t' :e P -> t c= t')) -> hull A P s = t

items.name: HULL_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, hull A P A = A

items.name: HYPERPLANE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} = Empty <-> a = vec N 0 /\ ~ b = 0

items.name: HYPERPLANE_EQ_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} = R :^: idx N <-> a = vec N 0 /\ b = 0

items.name: HYPERPLANE_FACET_OF_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 -> facet_of N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x}

items.name: HYPERPLANE_FACET_OF_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 -> facet_of N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b}

items.name: HYPERPLANE_FACE_OF_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, face_of N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x}

items.name: HYPERPLANE_FACE_OF_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, face_of N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b} {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b}
