items.name: IDEMPOTENT_IMP_RETRACTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f (f x) = f x)) -> retraction N (s,{f x | x :e s}) f

items.name: IDEMPOTENT_MATRIX_MUL_LINV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul N N N (matrix_mul N M N (matrix_inv N M A) A) (matrix_mul N M N (matrix_inv N M A) A) = matrix_mul N M N (matrix_inv N M A) A

items.name: IDEMPOTENT_MATRIX_MUL_RINV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul M M M (matrix_mul M N M A (matrix_inv N M A)) (matrix_mul M N M A (matrix_inv N M A)) = matrix_mul M N M A (matrix_inv N M A)

items.name: IDEMPOTENT_MATRIX_TRACE_EQ_RANK
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A A = A -> trace N A = rank N N A

items.name: IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> {f x | x :e s} = {y :e B | exists x :e A, x :e s /\ y = f x}

items.name: IMAGE_AFFINITY_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall c a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e ball N (a,r)} = if ~ m = 0 then ball N (vector_add N (vector_mul N m a) c,abs_SNo m * r) else if r <= 0 then Empty else {c}

items.name: IMAGE_AFFINITY_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall c a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e cball N (a,r)} = if 0 <= r \/ ~ m = 0 then cball N (vector_add N (vector_mul N m a) c,abs_SNo m * r) else Empty

items.name: IMAGE_AFFINITY_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = if closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty then Empty else if 0 <= m then closed_interval N (seq_cons (vector_add N (vector_mul N m a) c,vector_add N (vector_mul N m b) c) seq_nil) else closed_interval N (seq_cons (vector_add N (vector_mul N m b) c,vector_add N (vector_mul N m a) c) seq_nil)

items.name: IMAGE_AFFINITY_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall c a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e sphere N (a,r)} = if 0 <= r \/ ~ m = 0 then sphere N (vector_add N (vector_mul N m a) c,abs_SNo m * r) else Empty

items.name: IMAGE_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, f x0 :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall s c= A, {f x | x :e Empty} = Empty /\ {f x0 | x0 :e SetAdjoin s x} = SetAdjoin {f x | x :e s} (f x)

items.name: IMAGE_CLOSURE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl N M f (closure N s) /\ (closed M t /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t) -> {f x | x :e closure N s} c= t

items.name: IMAGE_COMPACT_IN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, compact_in A top s /\ continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> compact_in B top' {f x | x :e s}

items.name: IMAGE_COMPOSE_PERMUTATIONS_L
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> permutes A q s -> {(fun x :e A => q (p x)) | p :e A :^: A, permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s} = {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s}

items.name: IMAGE_COMPOSE_PERMUTATIONS_R
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> permutes A q s -> {(fun x :e A => p (q x)) | p :e A :^: A, permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s} = {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s}

items.name: IMAGE_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall c :e B, {c | x :e s} = if s = Empty then Empty else {c}

items.name: IMAGE_DELETE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = f a -> x = a) -> {f x | x :e s :\: {a}} = {f x | x :e s} :\: {f a}

items.name: IMAGE_DELETE_INJ_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ a :e s -> {f x | x :e s :\: {a}} = {f x | x :e s} :\: {f a}

items.name: IMAGE_DIFF_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> {f x | x :e s :\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_DIFF_INJ_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ t c= s -> {f x | x :e s :\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_DROPOUT_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> {dropout N M k x | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = if a k <= b k then closed_interval M (seq_cons (dropout N M k a,dropout N M k b) seq_nil) else Empty

items.name: IMAGE_DROP_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, {drop x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_real_interval (seq_cons (drop a,drop b) seq_nil) /\ {drop x | x :e open_interval 1 (a,b)} = open_real_interval (drop a,drop b)

items.name: IMAGE_DROP_UNIV
items.statement: {drop x | x :e R :^: idx 1} = R

items.name: IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> {f x | x :e s} = {g x | x :e s}

items.name: IMAGE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {f x | x :e s} = Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: IMAGE_FSTCART_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {fstcart M x | x :e \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}} = if t = Empty then Empty else s

items.name: IMAGE_FST_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {x 0 | x :e s :*: t} = if t = Empty then Empty else s

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e s} = group_setmul A G {a} (group_setmul A G s {group_inv A G a})

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION_BY_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= group_carrier A G -> {group_conjugation A G (group_id A G) x | x :e s} = s

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION_BY_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, forall s t c= A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ (s c= group_carrier A G /\ t c= group_carrier A G) -> ({group_conjugation A G (group_inv A G a) x | x :e s} = t <-> {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e t} = s)

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION_BY_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall a b :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ (b :e group_carrier A G /\ s c= group_carrier A G) -> {group_conjugation A G (group_mul A G a b) x | x :e s} = {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e {group_conjugation A G b x | x :e s}}

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, forall s t c= A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ (s c= group_carrier A G /\ t c= group_carrier A G) -> ({group_conjugation A G a x | x :e s} = t <-> group_setmul A G {a} s = group_setmul A G t {a})

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION_EQ_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, forall s t c= A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ (s c= group_carrier A G /\ t c= group_carrier A G) -> ({group_conjugation A G a x | x :e s} = t <-> {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ group_conjugation A G a x :e t} = s)

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION_EQ_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, forall s t c= A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ (s c= group_carrier A G /\ (t c= group_carrier A G /\ {group_conjugation A G (group_inv A G a) x | x :e s} = t)) -> {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e t} = s

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ a :e h -> {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e h} = h

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ s c= group_carrier A G -> {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e s} c= group_carrier A G

items.name: IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION_TORSION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G -> {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ P (group_element_order_hl A G x)}} = {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ P (group_element_order_hl A G x)}

items.name: IMAGE_I
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s = s

items.name: IMAGE_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s = s

items.name: IMAGE_IMP_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} = s -> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: IMAGE_IMP_INJECTIVE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> finite s /\ (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t /\ {f x | x :e s} = t) -> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: IMAGE_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, exists t c= A, t c= s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t} /\ forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: IMAGE_INTERS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= Power A, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e Union s /\ (y :e Union s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> {f x | x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y}} = {x :e B | forall Y :e {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: IMAGE_INTERS_SATURATED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g c= Power A, forall s c= A, ~ g = Empty /\ (forall t c= A, t :e g :\: {s} -> {x :e A | f x :e {f x | x :e t}} c= t) -> {f x | x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}} = {x :e B | forall Y :e {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e g}, x :e Y}

items.name: IMAGE_INTERS_SATURATED_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g c= Power A, forall s u c= A, ~ g = Empty /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e g -> t c= u) /\ (forall t c= A, t :e g :\: {s} -> {x :e A | x :e u /\ f x :e {f x | x :e t}} c= t)) -> {f x | x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}} = {x :e B | forall Y :e {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e g}, x :e Y}

items.name: IMAGE_INTERS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g c= Power A, {f x | x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}} c= {x :e B | forall Y :e {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e g}, x :e Y}

items.name: IMAGE_INTER_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) -> {f x | x :e s :/\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :/\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_INTER_SATURATED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, {x :e A | f x :e {f x | x :e s}} c= s \/ {x :e A | f x :e {f x | x :e t}} c= t -> {f x | x :e s :/\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :/\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_INTER_SATURATED_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t u c= A, {x :e A | x :e u /\ f x :e {f x | x :e s}} c= s /\ t c= u \/ {x :e A | x :e u /\ f x :e {f x | x :e t}} c= t /\ s c= u -> {f x | x :e s :/\: t} = {f x | x :e s} :/\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, {f x | x :e s :/\: t} c= {f x | x :e s} :/\: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_INVERSE_PERMUTATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, {(fun x :e A => inverse A A (fun x0:set => p x0) x) | p :e A :^: A, permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s} = {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s}

items.name: IMAGE_LEFT_COSET_SWITCH
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> {group_mul A G (group_div A G y x) a | a :e left_coset_hl A G x h} = left_coset_hl A G y h

items.name: IMAGE_LIFT_DROP
items.statement: (forall s c= R :^: idx 1, {lift (drop x) | x :e s} = s) /\ forall s c= R, {drop (lift x) | x :e s} = s

items.name: IMAGE_LIFT_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b :e R, {lift x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (lift a,lift b) seq_nil) /\ {lift x | x :e open_real_interval (a,b)} = open_interval 1 (lift a,lift b)

items.name: IMAGE_LIFT_UNIV
items.statement: {lift x | x :e R} = R :^: idx 1

items.name: IMAGE_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, {matrix_vector_mul M N (matrix_inv M N A) x | x :e R :^: idx N} = {matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M A) x | x :e R :^: idx N}

items.name: IMAGE_PAIRED_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, B <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e C, g x :e D) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= C, {(f (p 0),g (p 1)) | p :e s :*: t} = {f x | x :e s} :*: {g x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_PRODUCT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {(fun x0 :e K => if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) | x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}} = {f0 :e B :^: K | (forall i :e k, f0 i :e {x0 :e B | x0 :e {f i x1 | x1 :e s i}}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f0 i = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: IMAGE_PROJECTION_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall i :e K, {x i | x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}} = if {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty then Empty else if i :e k then s i else {choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}

items.name: IMAGE_REAL_OF_INT_UNIV
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int <-> x :e int

items.name: IMAGE_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, s c= t -> {(if x :e t then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) | x :e s} = {f x | x :e s}

items.name: IMAGE_RIGHT_COSET_SWITCH
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> {group_mul A G a (group_mul A G (group_inv A G x) y) | a :e right_coset_hl A G h x} = right_coset_hl A G h y

items.name: IMAGE_SNDCART_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {sndcart M N x | x :e \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}} = if s = Empty then Empty else t

items.name: IMAGE_SND_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {x 1 | x :e s :*: t} = if s = Empty then Empty else t

items.name: IMAGE_STRETCH_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, m x :e R) -> {(fun k :e idx N => m k * x k) | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = if closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty then Empty else closed_interval N (seq_cons (fun k :e idx N => if m k * a k <= m k * b k then m k * a k else m k * b k,fun k :e idx N => if m k * a k <= m k * b k then m k * b k else m k * a k) seq_nil)

items.name: IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, s c= t -> {f x | x :e s} c= {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_TWIZZLE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, dimindex M = dimindex N /\ permutes omega p (idx N) -> {(fun i :e idx N => x (p i)) | x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval N (seq_cons (fun i :e idx N => a (p i),fun i :e idx N => b (p i)) seq_nil)

items.name: IMAGE_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, {f x | x :e s :\/: t} = {f x | x :e s} :\/: {f x | x :e t}

items.name: IMAGE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= Power A, {f x | x :e Union s} = Union {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e s}

items.name: IMAGE_o
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {f (g x) | x :e s} = {f x | x :e {g x | x :e s}}

items.name: IMP_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall t:prop, (True -> t <-> t) /\ ((t -> True <-> True) /\ ((False -> t <-> True) /\ ((t -> t <-> True) /\ (t -> False <-> ~ t))))

items.name: IMP_CONJ
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, p /\ q -> r <-> p -> q -> r

items.name: IMP_CONJ_ALT
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, p /\ q -> r <-> q -> p -> r

items.name: IMP_DEF
items.statement: forall p q:prop, p -> q <-> (p /\ q <-> p)

items.name: IMP_IMP
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, p -> q -> r <-> p /\ q -> r

items.name: IN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= A, forall x :e A, x :e P <-> x :e P

items.name: INCREASING_BOUNDED_VARIATION
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INCREASING_BOUNDED_VARIATION_GEN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, bounded_hl 1 {f x | x :e s} /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s

items.name: INCREASING_COUNTABLE_DISCONTINUITIES
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> countable {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ continuous 1 (R :^: idx 1) f (at 1 x)}

items.name: INCREASING_EXTENDS_FROM_DENSE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, closure 1 s = R :^: idx 1 /\ (closure 1 {f x | x :e s} = R :^: idx 1 /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x < drop y) -> drop (f x) < drop (f y))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop (g x) < drop (g y) <-> drop x < drop y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> g x = f x) /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 1 g (R :^: idx 1) /\ {g x | x :e R :^: idx 1} = R :^: idx 1)))

items.name: INCREASING_FTC_AE_IMP_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative 1 f (f' x) (at 1 x)) /\ integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f' = vector_sub 1 (f b) (f a))) -> absolutely_continuous_on 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INCREASING_IMP_BAIRE1
items.statement: forall f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx 1), forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> f :e baire 1 1 1 s

items.name: INCREASING_LEFT_LIMIT_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) /\ c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)))

items.name: INCREASING_LEFT_LIMIT_1_GEN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall B :e R, is_interval 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> drop (f x) <= B) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y))) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= drop a})

items.name: INCREASING_RIGHT_LIMIT_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) /\ c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: INCREASING_RIGHT_LIMIT_1_GEN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall B :e R, is_interval 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> B <= drop (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y))) -> exists l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop a <= drop x})

items.name: INCREASING_VECTOR_VARIATION
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> vector_variation 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = drop (f b) + - drop (f a)

items.name: INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (c :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (d :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ 0 < e0)) -> exists k :e R, 0 < k /\ forall c' d' :e R :^: idx M, c' :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (d' :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (vector_norm M (vector_sub M c' c) <= k /\ vector_norm M (vector_sub M d' d) <= k)) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c',d') seq_nil)) f) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) f)) < e0

items.name: INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_CONTINUOUS_LEFT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (x,b) seq_nil)) f) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_CONTINUOUS_RIGHT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex M)) N (fun y:set => integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (fstcart M y,sndcart M M y) seq_nil)) f) (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex M)) (seq_cons (pastecart M M a a,pastecart M M b b) seq_nil))

items.name: INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ 0 < e0 -> exists k :e R, 0 < k /\ forall c d c' d' :e R :^: idx M, c :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (d :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (c' :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (d' :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (vector_norm M (vector_sub M c' c) <= k /\ vector_norm M (vector_sub M d' d) <= k)))) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c',d') seq_nil)) f) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) f)) < e0

items.name: INDEPENDENT_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R, independent N {a,b} /\ ~ a = b -> (vector_add N (vector_mul N x a) (vector_mul N y b) = vec N 0 <-> x = 0 /\ y = 0)

items.name: INDEPENDENT_3
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, forall x y z :e R, independent N {a,b,c} /\ (~ a = b /\ (~ a = c /\ ~ b = c)) -> (vector_add N (vector_mul N x a) (vector_add N (vector_mul N y b) (vector_mul N z c)) = vec N 0 <-> x = 0 /\ (y = 0 /\ z = 0))

items.name: INDEPENDENT_BASIS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k c= omega, independent N {basis N x | x :e k} <-> k c= idx N

items.name: INDEPENDENT_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, independent N s -> finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N

items.name: INDEPENDENT_BOUND_GENERAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, independent N s -> finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= dim N s

items.name: INDEPENDENT_CARD_LE_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx N, b c= v /\ independent N b -> finite b /\ finite_cardinality b <= dim N v

items.name: INDEPENDENT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> independent A Empty

items.name: INDEPENDENT_EQ_DIM_EQ_CARD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, independent N s <-> finite s /\ dim N s = finite_cardinality s

items.name: INDEPENDENT_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, independent N b <-> finite b /\ forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> vsum (R :^: idx N) N b (fun v:set => vector_mul N (c v) v) = vec N 0 -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> c v = 0

items.name: INDEPENDENT_IMP_AFFINE_DEPENDENT_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, independent A s -> ~ affine_dependent A (SetAdjoin s (vec A 0))

items.name: INDEPENDENT_IMP_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, independent N s -> finite s

items.name: INDEPENDENT_INJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, independent M s /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y)) -> independent N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: INDEPENDENT_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, independent M s /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e span M s /\ (y :e span M s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> independent N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: INDEPENDENT_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, independent N (SetAdjoin s a) <-> (a :e s -> independent N s) /\ (~ a :e s -> independent N s /\ ~ a :e span N s)

items.name: INDEPENDENT_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (independent N {f x | x :e s} <-> independent M s)

items.name: INDEPENDENT_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, independent A t /\ s c= t -> independent A s

items.name: INDEPENDENT_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, independent A s -> ~ vec A 0 :e s

items.name: INDEPENDENT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, independent A {x} <-> ~ x = vec A 0

items.name: INDEPENDENT_SPAN_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, finite t /\ (independent A s /\ s c= span A t) -> finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= finite_cardinality t

items.name: INDEPENDENT_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> independent N {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N}

items.name: INDEPENDENT_SUBSPACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ subspace N t -> (s :/\: t c= {vec N 0} <-> forall x y x' y' :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (x' :e s /\ (y :e t /\ (y' :e t /\ vector_add N x y = vector_add N x' y'))) -> x = x' /\ y = y')

items.name: INDEPENDENT_SUBSPACES_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ subspace N t -> (s :/\: t c= {vec N 0} <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ vector_add N x y = vec N 0) -> x = vec N 0 /\ y = vec N 0)

items.name: INDEPENDENT_SUBSPACES_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ subspace N t -> (s :/\: t c= {vec N 0} <-> s :/\: t = {vec N 0})

items.name: INDEPENDENT_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, independent N s /\ (independent N t /\ span N s :/\: span N t c= {vec N 0}) -> independent N (s :\/: t)

items.name: INDEX_0
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_index p 0 = 0

items.name: INDEX_1
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_index p 1 = 0

items.name: INDEX_ADD
items.statement: forall p n m :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ (~ m = 0 -> prime_index p n < prime_index p m) -> prime_index p (m + n) = prime_index p n

items.name: INDEX_ADD_MIN
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, (if prime_index p m <= prime_index p n then prime_index p m else prime_index p n) <= prime_index p (m + n)

items.name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, exists m :e omega, p ^ prime_index p n * m = n /\ (n = 0 \/ (p = 1 \/ ~ divides_nat p m))

items.name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_LE
items.statement: forall p e1 m1 e2 m2 :e omega, p ^ e1 * m1 = p ^ e2 * m2 /\ (~ p = 0 /\ ~ divides_nat p m2) -> e1 <= e2

items.name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_PRIME
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> exists m :e omega, p ^ prime_index p n * m = n /\ (n = 0 \/ gcd_int p m = 1)

items.name: INDEX_DECOMPOSITION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall p e1 m1 e2 m2 :e omega, p ^ e1 * m1 = p ^ e2 * m2 /\ (~ p = 0 /\ (~ divides_nat p m1 /\ ~ divides_nat p m2)) -> e1 = e2

items.name: INDEX_EQ_0
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_index p n = 0 <-> n = 0 \/ (p = 1 \/ ~ divides_nat p n)

items.name: INDEX_EXP
items.statement: forall p n k :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (n ^ k) = k * prime_index p n

items.name: INDEX_FACT
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (factorial n) = finsum (idx_n n) (fun m:set => prime_index p m)

items.name: INDEX_FACT_ALT
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (factorial n) = finsum {j :e omega | 1 <= j /\ p ^ j <= n} (fun j:set => div_nat n (p ^ j))

items.name: INDEX_FACT_PRIME_MULT
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (factorial (p * n)) = n + prime_index p (factorial n)

items.name: INDEX_FACT_UNBOUNDED
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (factorial n) = finsum {j :e omega | 1 <= j} (fun j:set => div_nat n (p ^ j))

items.name: INDEX_GCD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (gcd_int m n) = if m = 0 then prime_index p n else if n = 0 then prime_index p m else if prime_index p m <= prime_index p n then prime_index p m else prime_index p n

items.name: INDEX_LCM
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p (lcm_int m n) = if m = 0 \/ n = 0 then 0 else if prime_index p m <= prime_index p n then prime_index p n else prime_index p m

items.name: INDEX_LT
items.statement: forall n p k :e omega, (~ n = 0 \/ ~ k = 0) /\ n < p ^ k -> prime_index p n < k

items.name: INDEX_MUL
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ m = 0 /\ ~ n = 0) -> prime_index p (m * n) = prime_index p m + prime_index p n

items.name: INDEX_MULT_ADD
items.statement: (forall p m n k :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ prime_index p n < k -> prime_index p (p ^ k * m + n) = prime_index p n) /\ ((forall p m n k :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ prime_index p n < k -> prime_index p (m * p ^ k + n) = prime_index p n) /\ ((forall p m n k :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ prime_index p n < k -> prime_index p (n + m * p ^ k) = prime_index p n) /\ forall p m n k :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ prime_index p n < k -> prime_index p (n + p ^ k * m) = prime_index p n))

items.name: INDEX_MULT_BASE
items.statement: (forall p n :e omega, prime_index p (p * n) = if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else prime_index p n + 1) /\ forall p n :e omega, prime_index p (n * p) = if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else prime_index p n + 1

items.name: INDEX_MULT_EXP
items.statement: (forall p n k :e omega, prime_index p (p ^ k * n) = if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else k + prime_index p n) /\ forall p n k :e omega, prime_index p (n * p ^ k) = if n = 0 \/ p <= 1 then 0 else prime_index p n + k

items.name: INDEX_NSUM_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall p n :e omega, forall k c= A, finite k /\ (~ k = Empty /\ (forall a :e A, a :e k -> n <= prime_index p (f a))) -> n <= prime_index p (finsum k f)

items.name: INDEX_POW
items.statement: forall p n k :e omega, prime_index (p ^ k) n = div_nat (prime_index p n) k

items.name: INDEX_PRIME
items.statement: forall p a :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index a p = if p = a then 1 else 0

items.name: INDEX_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, prime_index n n = if n <= 1 then 0 else 1

items.name: INDEX_SUB_MIN
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, n < m -> (if prime_index p m <= prime_index p n then prime_index p m else prime_index p n) <= prime_index p (minus_nat m n)

items.name: INDEX_TRIVIAL_BOUND
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_index p n <= n

items.name: INDEX_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall p m n e0 :e omega, p ^ e0 * m = n /\ ((p = 0 -> e0 = 0) /\ ~ divides_nat p m) -> prime_index p n = e0

items.name: INDEX_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall n p k :e omega, prime_index p n = k <-> (p = 1 \/ n = 0 -> k = 0) /\ (~ (p = 1 \/ n = 0) -> divides_nat (p ^ k) n /\ ~ divides_nat (p ^ (k + 1)) n)

items.name: INDEX_UNIQUE_EQ
items.statement: forall n p k :e omega, prime_index p n = k <-> (p = 1 \/ n = 0 -> k = 0) /\ (~ (p = 1 \/ n = 0) -> forall j :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ j) n <-> j <= k)

items.name: INDEX_ZERO
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, ~ divides_nat p n -> prime_index p n = 0

items.name: INDICATOR_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, indicator N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x = vector_sub 1 (vec 1 1) (indicator N s x)

items.name: INDUCT_COPRIME
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall a b :e omega, 1 < a /\ (1 < b /\ (gcd_int a b = 1 /\ (P a /\ P b))) -> P (a * b)) /\ (forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> P (p ^ k)) -> forall n :e omega, 1 < n -> P n

items.name: INDUCT_COPRIME_ALT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ ((forall a b :e omega, 1 < a /\ (1 < b /\ (gcd_int a b = 1 /\ (P a /\ P b))) -> P (a * b)) /\ (forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> P (p ^ k))) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: INDUCT_COPRIME_STRONG
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall a b :e omega, 1 < a /\ (1 < b /\ (gcd_int a b = 1 /\ (P a /\ P b))) -> P (a * b)) /\ (forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p /\ ~ k = 0 -> P (p ^ k)) -> forall n :e omega, 1 < n -> P n

items.name: INDUCT_LINEAR_ELEMENTARY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall f g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), linear N N (fun x:set => f x) /\ (linear N N (fun x:set => g x) /\ (P f /\ P g)) -> P (fun x :e R :^: idx N => f (g x))) /\ ((forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall i :e omega, linear N N (fun x:set => f x) /\ (1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x i = 0))) -> P f) /\ ((forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R) -> P (fun x :e R :^: idx N => fun i :e idx N => c i * x i)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ ~ m = n))) -> P (fun x :e R :^: idx N => fun i :e idx N => x (swap omega (m,n) i))) /\ (forall m n :e omega, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ ~ m = n))) -> P (fun x :e R :^: idx N => fun i :e idx N => if i = m then x m + x n else x i))))) -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), linear N N (fun x:set => f x) -> P f

items.name: INDUCT_MATRIX_ELEMENTARY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, P A /\ P B -> P (matrix_mul N N N A B)) /\ ((forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ row N N i A = vec N 0) -> P A) /\ ((forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ i = j))) -> A i j = 0) -> P A) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ ~ m = n))) -> P (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => mat N N 1 i (swap omega (m,n) j))) /\ (forall m n :e omega, forall c :e R, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ ~ m = n))) -> P (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => if i = m /\ j = n then c else if i = j then 1 else 0))))) -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, P A

items.name: INDUCT_MATRIX_ELEMENTARY_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, P A /\ P B -> P (matrix_mul N N N A B)) /\ ((forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ row N N i A = vec N 0) -> P A) /\ ((forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ i = j))) -> A i j = 0) -> P A) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ ~ m = n))) -> P (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => mat N N 1 i (swap omega (m,n) j))) /\ (forall m n :e omega, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ ~ m = n))) -> P (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => if i = m /\ j = n \/ i = j then 1 else 0))))) -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, P A

items.name: INDUCT_MATRIX_ROW_OPERATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ row N N i A = vec N 0) -> P A) /\ ((forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ i = j))) -> A i j = 0) -> P A) /\ ((forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall m n :e omega, P A /\ (1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ ~ m = n)))) -> P (fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => A i (swap omega (m,n) j))) /\ (forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall m n :e omega, forall c :e R, P A /\ (1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ ~ m = n)))) -> P (fun i :e idx N => if i = m then vector_add N (row N N m A) (vector_mul N c (row N N n A)) else row N N i A)))) -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, P A

items.name: INESSENTIAL_ON_CLOPEN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= Power (R :^: idx M), path_connected N t /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx M, s :e u -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (Union u)) s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (Union u) /\ exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => a))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (Union u),subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => a)

items.name: INESSENTIAL_ON_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s /\ (path_connected N t /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e components M s -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => a))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => a)

items.name: INESSENTIAL_ON_COMPONENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s \/ compact M s /\ ANR N t) /\ path_connected N t -> ((exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => a)) <-> continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ forall c c= R :^: idx M, c :e components M s -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => a)))

items.name: INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) -> (forall x :e R, x :e s -> inf s <= x) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) -> b <= inf s

items.name: INFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s <-> ~ finite s

items.name: INFINITE_ARC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> arc A g -> infinite (path_image A g)

items.name: INFINITE_CARD_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s <-> atleastp omega s

items.name: INFINITE_CROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, infinite (s :*: t) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ infinite t \/ infinite s /\ ~ t = Empty

items.name: INFINITE_CROSS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (infinite (A :*: B) <-> infinite A \/ infinite B)

items.name: INFINITE_CYCLIC_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (infinite (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x})) <-> forall m n :e omega, group_pow A G x m = group_pow A G x n -> m = n)

items.name: INFINITE_CYCLIC_SUBGROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (infinite (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x})) <-> forall m n :e int, group_zpow A G x m = group_zpow A G x n -> m = n)

items.name: INFINITE_CYCLIC_SUBGROUP_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> (infinite (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {x})) <-> group_element_order_hl A G x = 0)

items.name: INFINITE_DIFF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ finite t -> infinite (s :\: t)

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ {r x | x :e omega} = s)

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_EQ
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s <-> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ {r x | x :e omega} = s)

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s <-> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ forall n :e omega, r n :e s)

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e omega, f x :e s) /\ forall x y :e omega, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: INFINITE_ENUMERATE_WEAK
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ forall n :e omega, r n :e s)

items.name: INFINITE_FROM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, infinite (from n)

items.name: INFINITE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, infinite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> infinite {f x | x :e s}

items.name: INFINITE_IMAGE_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> infinite {f x | x :e s}

items.name: INFINITE_INTEGER
items.statement: infinite {x :e R | x :e int}

items.name: INFINITE_INTEGER_GROUP
items.statement: infinite (group_carrier int integer_group)

items.name: INFINITE_IRRATIONAL_IN_RANGE
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a < b -> infinite {q :e R | ~ q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)}

items.name: INFINITE_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, infinite s -> ~ s = Empty

items.name: INFINITE_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ limit_point_of N x u) -> infinite s

items.name: INFINITE_PERFECT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (s c= derived_set_of A top s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> infinite s

items.name: INFINITE_PERFECT_SET_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, t1_space A top /\ (s c= derived_set_of A top s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> infinite s

items.name: INFINITE_RATIONAL
items.statement: infinite {x :e R | x :e rational}

items.name: INFINITE_RATIONAL_IN_RANGE
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a < b -> infinite {q :e R | q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)}

items.name: INFINITE_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> simple_path A g -> infinite (path_image A g)

items.name: INFINITE_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, infinite s /\ s c= t -> infinite t

items.name: INFINITE_UNIV_PAIR
items.statement: forall A:set, infinite (A :*: A) <-> infinite A

items.name: INFNORM_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> infnorm A (vec A 0) = 0

items.name: INFNORM_2
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx_n 2, infnorm (idx_n 2) x = if abs_SNo (x 1) <= abs_SNo (x 2) then abs_SNo (x 2) else abs_SNo (x 1)

items.name: INFNORM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, infnorm A x = 0 <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: INFNORM_EQ_1_2
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx_n 2, infnorm (idx_n 2) x = 1 <-> abs_SNo (x 1) <= 1 /\ (abs_SNo (x 2) <= 1 /\ (x 1 = - 1 \/ (x 1 = 1 \/ (x 2 = - 1 \/ x 2 = 1))))

items.name: INFNORM_EQ_1_IMP
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx_n 2, infnorm (idx_n 2) x = 1 -> abs_SNo (x 1) <= 1 /\ abs_SNo (x 2) <= 1

items.name: INFNORM_LE_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, infnorm A x <= vector_norm A x

items.name: INFNORM_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, infnorm N (vector_mul N a x) = abs_SNo a * infnorm N x

items.name: INFNORM_MUL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, infnorm A (vector_mul A a x) <= abs_SNo a * infnorm A x

items.name: INFNORM_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, infnorm A (vector_neg A x) = infnorm A x

items.name: INFNORM_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 <= infnorm A x

items.name: INFNORM_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 < infnorm A x <-> ~ x = vec A 0

items.name: INFNORM_SET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, {abs_SNo (x i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} = {abs_SNo (x i) | i :e idx N}

items.name: INFNORM_SET_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, finite {abs_SNo (x i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} /\ ~ {abs_SNo (x i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} = Empty

items.name: INFNORM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, infnorm A (vector_sub A x y) = infnorm A (vector_sub A y x)

items.name: INFNORM_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, infnorm A (vector_add A x y) <= infnorm A x + infnorm A y

items.name: INFSUM_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, infsum A s (fun i:set => vec A 0) = vec A 0

items.name: INFSUM_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, summable A s x /\ summable A s y -> infsum A s (fun i:set => vector_add A (x i) (y i)) = vector_add A (infsum A s x) (infsum A s y)

items.name: INFSUM_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c :e R, summable A s x -> infsum A s (fun n:set => vector_mul A c (x n)) = vector_mul A c (infsum A s x)

items.name: INFSUM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall k c= omega, summable A k f /\ (summable A k g /\ (forall x :e omega, x :e k -> f x = g x)) -> infsum A k f = infsum A k g

items.name: INFSUM_EVEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, infsum N (from n) f = infsum N (from (2 * n)) (fun i:set => if even_nat i then f (div_nat i 2) else vec N 0)

items.name: INFSUM_LINEAR
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, h x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, summable B s f /\ linear B A h -> infsum A s (fun n:set => h (f n)) = h (infsum B s f)

items.name: INFSUM_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> summable A s x -> infsum A s (fun n:set => vector_neg A (x n)) = vector_neg A (infsum A s x)

items.name: INFSUM_ODD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, infsum N (from n) f = infsum N (from (2 * n + 1)) (fun i:set => if odd_nat i then f (div_nat i 2) else vec N 0)

items.name: INFSUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k c= omega, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> infsum N omega (fun n:set => if n :e k then a n else vec N 0) = infsum N k a

items.name: INFSUM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, summable A s x /\ summable A s y -> infsum A s (fun i:set => vector_sub A (x i) (y i)) = vector_sub A (infsum A s x) (infsum A s y)

items.name: INFSUM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= omega, sums N f l s -> infsum N s f = l

items.name: INF_APPROACH
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall c :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ inf s < c) -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ x < c

items.name: INF_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, inf {drop x | x :e closure 1 s} = inf {drop x | x :e s}

items.name: INF_EQ
items.statement: forall s t c= R, (forall a :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> a <= x) <-> forall x :e R, x :e t -> a <= x) -> inf s = inf t

items.name: INF_EXISTS
items.statement: forall s c= R, (exists l :e R, is_glb s l) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x

items.name: INF_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> inf s :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> inf s <= x

items.name: INF_FINITE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists b :e R, b :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x

items.name: INF_INSERT
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall s c= R, bounded_hl 1 {lift x0 | x0 :e s} -> inf (SetAdjoin s x) = if s = Empty then x else if x <= inf s then x else inf s

items.name: INF_INSERT_FINITE
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall s c= R, finite s -> inf (SetAdjoin s x) = if s = Empty then x else if x <= inf s then x else inf s

items.name: INF_INSERT_INSERT
items.statement: forall a b :e R, forall s c= R, inf (SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s a) b) = inf (SetAdjoin s (if a <= b then a else b))

items.name: INF_LE_ELEMENT
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ a :e s -> inf s <= a

items.name: INF_SING
items.statement: forall a :e R, inf {a} = a

items.name: INF_UNION
items.statement: forall s t c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) /\ (exists c :e R, forall x :e R, x :e t -> c <= x))) -> inf (s :\/: t) = if inf s <= inf t then inf s else inf t

items.name: INF_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, (forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> c <= x) <-> c <= b) -> inf s = b

items.name: INF_UNIQUE_FINITE
items.statement: forall a :e R, forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (inf s = a <-> a :e s /\ forall y :e R, y :e s -> a <= y)

items.name: INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (inj s t f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.error: internal constant INJA (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: INJECTIVE_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y <-> x = y)

items.name: INJECTIVE_CLOSED_IMP_EMBEDDING_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: INJECTIVE_EQ_MONOTONE_MAP
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R, is_realinterval s /\ continuous_map R R (subtopology R euclideanreal s,euclideanreal) f -> ((forall x y :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> (forall x y :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ x < y) -> f x < f y) \/ forall x y :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ x < y) -> f y < f x)

items.name: INJECTIVE_EQ_REAL_OPEN_MAP_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R, is_realinterval s /\ continuous_map R R (subtopology R euclideanreal s,euclideanreal) f -> ((forall x y :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> forall u c= R, real_open u /\ u c= s -> real_open {f x | x :e u})

items.name: INJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall s t c= A, {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t} -> s = t) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: INJECTIVE_IMP_ISOMETRIC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, closed M s /\ (subspace M s /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ f x = vec N 0 -> x = vec M 0))) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> e0 * vector_norm M x <= vector_norm N (f x)

items.name: INJECTIVE_IMP_MONOTONE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> monotone_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: INJECTIVE_IMP_PROPER_EQ_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> (proper_map A B (top,top') f <-> closed_map A B (top,top') f)

items.name: INJECTIVE_INTO_1D_EQ_HOMEOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => f x) s /\ path_connected N s -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx 1), homeomorphism N 1 (s,{f x | x :e s}) (f,g))

items.name: INJECTIVE_INTO_1D_IMP_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 f s /\ (path_connected N s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s)) -> {f x | x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx 1) (euclidean 1) {f x | x :e s}

items.name: INJECTIVE_INTO_1D_IMP_OPEN_MAP_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 f s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ (open N t /\ t c= s)) -> open 1 {f x | x :e t}

items.name: INJECTIVE_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> ((forall x x' :e B, f x = f x' -> x = x') <-> forall x :e B, inverse A B f (f x) = x)

items.name: INJECTIVE_INVERSE_o
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> ((forall x x' :e B, f x = f x' -> x = x') <-> forall x :e B, inverse A B f (f x) = x)

items.name: INJECTIVE_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall x :e A, g (f x) = x)

items.name: INJECTIVE_LEFT_INVERSE_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall t c= A, (exists x :e B, x :e s) -> ((forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ ((forall y :e A, y :e t -> g y :e s) /\ forall x :e B, x :e s -> g (f x) = x))

items.name: INJECTIVE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall l m :e finseq A, seq_map f l = seq_map f m -> l = m) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: INJECTIVE_MAP_OPEN_IFF_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e u})

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, P x /\ (P y /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, P x /\ P y -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, (forall s t c= A, s c= u /\ (t c= u /\ {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e t}) -> s = t) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e u /\ (y :e u /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g (f x) = x

items.name: INJECTIVE_ON_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall u c= B, (forall t t' c= B, t c= u /\ (t' c= u /\ {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t'}) -> t = t') <-> u c= {f x | x :e s}

items.name: INJECTIVE_OPEN_IMP_EMBEDDING_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (open_map A B (top,top') f /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))) -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: INJECTIVE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall t t' c= B, {x :e A | f x :e t} = {x :e A | f x :e t'} -> t = t') <-> {f x | x :e A} = B)

items.name: INJECTIVE_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)) -> (quotient_map A B (top,top') f <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (open_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')))

items.name: INJECTIVE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_mul N c x = vector_mul N c y -> x = y) <-> ~ c = 0

items.name: INJ_INVERSE2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y :e C) -> (forall x1 :e A, forall y1 :e B, forall x2 :e A, forall y2 :e B, P x1 y1 = P x2 y2 <-> x1 = x2 /\ y1 = y2) -> exists X:set -> set, (forall x :e C, X x :e A) /\ exists Y:set -> set, (forall x :e C, Y x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, forall y :e B, X (P x y) = x /\ Y (P x y) = y

items.name: INNER_LADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector A), inner A (vector_add (multivector A) x y) z = vector_add (multivector A) (inner A x z) (inner A y z)

items.name: INNER_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), inner A (vector_mul (multivector A) c x) y = vector_mul (multivector A) c (inner A x y)

items.name: INNER_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), inner A (vector_neg (multivector A) x) y = vector_neg (multivector A) (inner A x y)

items.name: INNER_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), inner A (vec (multivector A) 0) x = vec (multivector A) 0

items.name: INNER_RADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector A), inner A x (vector_add (multivector A) y z) = vector_add (multivector A) (inner A x y) (inner A x z)

items.name: INNER_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), inner A x (vector_mul (multivector A) c y) = vector_mul (multivector A) c (inner A x y)

items.name: INNER_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), inner A x (vector_neg (multivector A) y) = vector_neg (multivector A) (inner A x y)

items.name: INNER_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), inner A x (vec (multivector A) 0) = vec (multivector A) 0

items.name: INSEG_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l m /\ inseg_on A m l -> forall x x0 :e A, l x x0 <-> m x x0

items.name: INSEG_FLD_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l m -> fld_on A l c= fld_on A m

items.name: INSEG_LINSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l -> (inseg_on A m l <-> (forall x x0 :e A, m x x0 <-> l x x0) \/ exists a :e A, a :e fld_on A l /\ forall x x0 :e A, m x x0 <-> linseg_rel l a x x0)

items.name: INSEG_ORDINAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l /\ ordinal_on A l -> ordinal_on A m

items.name: INSEG_PROPER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l /\ ~ (forall x x0 :e A, l x x0 <-> m x x0) -> exists x y :e A, l x y /\ ~ m x y

items.name: INSEG_PROPER_SUBSET_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l /\ ~ (forall x x0 :e A, l x x0 <-> m x x0) -> exists a :e A, a :e fld_on A l /\ ~ a :e fld_on A m

items.name: INSEG_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l l

items.name: INSEG_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l -> forall x y :e A, m x y -> l x y

items.name: INSEG_SUBSET_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A m -> x :e fld_on A l

items.name: INSEG_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m n:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l m /\ inseg_on A m n -> inseg_on A l n

items.name: INSEG_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A m l /\ woset_on A l -> woset_on A m

items.name: INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin s x = {y :e A | y :e s \/ y = x}

items.name: INSERT_AC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s y) x = SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s x) y /\ SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s x) x = SetAdjoin s x

items.name: INSERT_COMM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s y) x = SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s x) y

items.name: INSERT_DEF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, y :e SetAdjoin s x <-> y :e s \/ y = x

items.name: INSERT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, x :e s -> SetAdjoin (s :\: {x}) x = s

items.name: INSERT_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, SetAdjoin s x :\: t = if x :e t then s :\: t else SetAdjoin (s :\: t) x

items.name: INSERT_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s x) x = SetAdjoin s x

items.name: INSERT_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x :/\: t = if x :e t then SetAdjoin (s :/\: t) x else s :/\: t

items.name: INSERT_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, {x :e A | x :e SetAdjoin s a /\ P x} = if P a then SetAdjoin {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} a else {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x}

items.name: INSERT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x c= t <-> x :e t /\ s c= t

items.name: INSERT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x :\/: t = if x :e t then s :\/: t else SetAdjoin (s :\/: t) x

items.name: INSERT_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, SetAdjoin s x :\/: t = SetAdjoin (s :\/: t) x

items.name: INSERT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, SetAdjoin A x = A

items.name: INSIDE_ARC_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc N p -> inside N (path_image N p) = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_BOUNDED_COMPLEMENT_CONNECTED_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ bounded_hl N s -> inside N s = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_COMPLEMENT_UNBOUNDED_CONNECTED_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ ~ bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> inside N s = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ bounded_hl N s -> inside N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | ~ x :e s /\ forall B :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, B <= vector_norm N y /\ ~ connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x y}

items.name: INSIDE_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ bounded_hl N s -> inside N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | ~ x :e s /\ forall B :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, B < vector_norm N y /\ ~ connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x y}

items.name: INSIDE_CONVEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s -> inside A s = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> inside A Empty = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_EMPTY_EQ_NO_BOUNDED_COMPONENT_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N s = Empty <-> forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> ~ bounded_hl N c

items.name: INSIDE_EQ_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N s = outside N s <-> s = R :^: idx N

items.name: INSIDE_FRONTIER_EQ_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ convex N s -> inside N (frontier N s) = interior N s

items.name: INSIDE_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= inside N t -> inside N s :\: t c= inside N t

items.name: INSIDE_INSIDE_COMPACT_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (compact N t /\ (s c= inside N t /\ connected N t)) -> inside N s c= inside N t

items.name: INSIDE_INSIDE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ connected N s -> inside N (inside N s) = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_INSIDE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N (inside N s) c= s

items.name: INSIDE_INTER_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, inside A s :/\: outside A s = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_IN_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N s :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) <-> connected N (inside N s) /\ ~ inside N s = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx A, exists x :e R :^: idx B, f x = y)) -> inside A {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e inside B s}

items.name: INSIDE_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s c= t -> inside A s :\: t c= inside A t

items.name: INSIDE_MONO_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t -> inside N s c= t :\/: inside N t

items.name: INSIDE_NO_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, inside A s :/\: s = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_OF_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx_n 2, inside (idx_n 2) (closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: (closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil) :\/: closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (c,a) seq_nil))) = interior (idx_n 2) (hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | convex (idx_n 2) x} {a,b,c})

items.name: INSIDE_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N s = (R :^: idx N) :\: s :\/: outside N s

items.name: INSIDE_OUTSIDE_COMPACT_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (compact N t /\ (s c= inside N t /\ connected N t)) -> t c= outside N s

items.name: INSIDE_OUTSIDE_INTERSECT_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N t /\ (~ inside N s :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ outside N s :/\: t = Empty) -> ~ s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: INSIDE_OUTSIDE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, connected N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (connected N u /\ (~ bounded_hl N u /\ (~ connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ t :\/: u = (R :^: idx N) :\: s)))) -> inside N s = t /\ outside N s = u

items.name: INSIDE_SAME_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x y /\ x :e inside N s -> y :e inside N s

items.name: INSIDE_SELF_OUTSIDE_COMPACT_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (compact N t /\ (s c= inside N t /\ connected N t)) -> t :\/: outside N t c= outside N s

items.name: INSIDE_SELF_OUTSIDE_EVERSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :\/: inside N s c= inside N t <-> t :\/: outside N t c= outside N s

items.name: INSIDE_SIMPLE_CURVE_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, simple_path N g /\ x :e inside N (path_image N g) -> pathfinish N g = pathstart N g

items.name: INSIDE_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, inside N (sphere N (a,r)) = ball N (a,r)

items.name: INSIDE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, connected N u /\ (~ bounded_hl N u /\ t :\/: u = (R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> inside N s c= t

items.name: INSIDE_SUBSET_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, convex N c /\ s c= c -> inside N s c= c

items.name: INSIDE_SUBSET_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s

items.name: INSIDE_SUBSET_INTERIOR_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, convex N c /\ s c= c -> inside N s c= interior N c

items.name: INSIDE_SUBSET_INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N s c= interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: INSIDE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, inside A {vector_add A a x | x :e s} = {vector_add A a x | x :e inside A s}

items.name: INSIDE_UNION_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N s :\/: outside N s = (R :^: idx N) :\: s

items.name: INSIDE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, connected N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ (connected N u /\ (~ bounded_hl N u /\ (~ connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ t :\/: u = (R :^: idx N) :\: s)))) -> inside N s = t
