items.name: INSIDE_WITH_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N (s :\/: inside N s) = Empty

items.name: INTEGER_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x :e int <-> x :e int

items.name: INTEGER_ABS_MUL_EQ_1
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> (abs_SNo (x * y) = 1 <-> abs_SNo x = 1 /\ abs_SNo y = 1)

items.name: INTEGER_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x + y :e int

items.name: INTEGER_ADD_EQ
items.statement: (forall x y :e R, x :e int -> (x + y :e int <-> y :e int)) /\ forall x y :e R, y :e int -> (x + y :e int <-> x :e int)

items.name: INTEGER_CASES
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int <-> (exists n :e omega, x = n) \/ exists n :e omega, x = - n

items.name: INTEGER_CLOSED
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, n :e int) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x + y :e int) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x + - y :e int) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x * y :e int) /\ ((forall x :e R, forall r :e omega, x :e int -> x ^ r :e int) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e int -> - x :e int) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e int -> abs_SNo x :e int) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> (if x <= y then y else x) :e int) /\ forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> (if x <= y then x else y) :e int)))))))

items.name: INTEGER_DET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall M :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> M i j :e int) -> det N M :e int

items.name: INTEGER_DIV
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m :/: n :e int <-> n = 0 \/ divides_nat n m

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + 1 <= y -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x <= n /\ n < y)

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_ABS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 1 <= abs_SNo (x + - y) -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x <= n /\ n < y \/ y <= n /\ n < x)

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_ABS_LT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 1 < abs_SNo (x + - y) -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x < n /\ n < y \/ y < n /\ n < x)

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_ALT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + 1 <= y -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x < n /\ n <= y)

items.name: INTEGER_EXISTS_BETWEEN_LT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + 1 < y -> exists n :e R, n :e int /\ (x < n /\ n < y)

items.name: INTEGER_GROUP
items.statement: group_carrier int integer_group = int /\ (group_id int integer_group = 0 /\ ((forall x :e int, group_inv int integer_group x = - x) /\ forall x x0 :e int, group_mul int integer_group x x0 = x + x0))

items.name: INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: group_carrier int (integer_mod_group 0) = int /\ ((forall n :e omega, 0 < n -> group_carrier int (integer_mod_group n) = {m :e int | 0 <= m /\ m < n}) /\ ((forall n :e omega, group_id int (integer_mod_group n) = 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, forall a :e int, group_inv int (integer_mod_group n) a = rem_int (- a) n) /\ forall n :e omega, forall a b :e int, group_mul int (integer_mod_group n) a b = rem_int (a + b) n)))

items.name: INTEGER_MOD_GROUP_0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 :e group_carrier int (integer_mod_group n)

items.name: INTEGER_MOD_GROUP_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 1 :e group_carrier int (integer_mod_group n) <-> ~ n = 1

items.name: INTEGER_MOD_GROUP_1R
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall x :e int, rem_int x n :e group_carrier int (integer_mod_group n)

items.name: INTEGER_MOD_GROUP_TRIVIAL
items.statement: integer_mod_group 0 = integer_group

items.name: INTEGER_MOD_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_BY_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, subgroup_generated int (integer_mod_group n) {1} = integer_mod_group n

items.name: INTEGER_MOD_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_BY_1R
items.statement: forall n :e omega, subgroup_generated int (integer_mod_group n) {rem_int 1 n} = integer_mod_group n

items.name: INTEGER_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x * y :e int

items.name: INTEGER_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, - x :e int <-> x :e int

items.name: INTEGER_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> (x :e int <-> exists n :e omega, x = n)

items.name: INTEGER_POW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, x :e int -> x ^ n :e int

items.name: INTEGER_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e int) -> finprod s f :e int

items.name: INTEGER_REAL_OF_INT
items.statement: forall x :e int, x :e int

items.name: INTEGER_ROUND
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e R, n :e int /\ abs_SNo (x + - n) <= 1 :/: 2

items.name: INTEGER_SIGN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> sign A p :e int

items.name: INTEGER_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e int /\ y :e int -> x + - y :e int

items.name: INTEGER_SUB_EQ
items.statement: (forall x y :e R, x :e int -> (x + - y :e int <-> y :e int)) /\ forall x y :e R, y :e int -> (x + - y :e int <-> x :e int)

items.name: INTEGER_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e int) -> finsum s f :e int

items.name: INTEGRABLE_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, integrable_on B A (fun x:set => vec B 0) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ integrable_on N M g s -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ ~ m = 0 -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => f (vector_add M (vector_mul M m x) c)) {vector_add M (vector_mul M (recip_SNo m) x) (vector_neg M (vector_mul M (recip_SNo m) c)) | x :e s}

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s <-> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall a b c d :e R :^: idx M, ball M (vec M 0,B) c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ ball M (vec M 0,B) c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0)) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0))) < e0

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ALT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s <-> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall a b c d :e R :^: idx M, ball M (vec M 0,B) c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0)) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0))) < e0

items.name: INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_VARIATION_BILINEAR_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, op x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, bilinear N P M op /\ (integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on M g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> integrable_on P 1 (fun x:set => op (g x) (f x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_VARIATION_BILINEAR_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, op x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, bilinear N P M op /\ (integrable_on M 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> integrable_on P 1 (fun x:set => op (f x) (g x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_VARIATION_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on 1 g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> integrable_on N 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop (g x)) (f x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_BOUNDED_VARIATION_PRODUCT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> integrable_on N 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul N (g x) (f x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_BY_PARTS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall c c= R :^: idx 1, bilinear N P M bop /\ (countable c /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 P (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) :\: c -> has_vector_derivative M f (f' x) (at 1 x) /\ has_vector_derivative N g (g' x) (at 1 x)) /\ integrable_on P 1 (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g' x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))))) -> integrable_on P 1 (fun x:set => bop (f' x) (g x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_BY_PARTS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall c c= R :^: idx 1, bilinear N P M bop /\ (countable c /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 P (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) :\: c -> has_vector_derivative M f (f' x) (at 1 x) /\ has_vector_derivative N g (g' x) (at 1 x)))) -> (integrable_on P 1 (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g' x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> integrable_on P 1 (fun x:set => bop (f' x) (g x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_CASES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ P x} /\ integrable_on N M g {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ~ P x} -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_CAUCHY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d:set -> set -> prop, gauge M d /\ forall p1 p2 c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_division_of M p1 (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p1 /\ (tagged_division_of M p2 (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p2)) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p1 (fun p:set => vector_mul N (content M (p 1)) (f (p 0)))) (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p2 (fun p:set => vector_mul N (content M (p 1)) (f (p 0))))) < e0

items.name: INTEGRABLE_CCONTINUOUS_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, negligible M k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, ~ x :e k /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall h :e R, 0 < h /\ h < d -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (x,vector_add M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1))) seq_nil)))) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (x,vector_add M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1))) seq_nil)) f)) (f x)) < e0

items.name: INTEGRABLE_CCONTINUOUS_EXPLICIT_SYMMETRIC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, negligible M k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, ~ x :e k /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall h :e R, 0 < h /\ h < d -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (vector_sub M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1)),vector_add M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1))) seq_nil)))) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (vector_sub M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1)),vector_add M x (vector_mul M h (vec M 1))) seq_nil)) f)) (f x)) < e0

items.name: INTEGRABLE_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_CMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s <-> c = 0 \/ integrable_on N M f s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_COMBINE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop c /\ (drop c <= drop b /\ (integrable_on A 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) /\ integrable_on A 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)))) -> integrable_on A 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_COMBINE_DIVISION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, division_of A d s /\ (forall i c= R :^: idx A, i :e d -> integrable_on B A f i) -> integrable_on B A f s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_CONST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx N, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => c) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_CONVOLUTION_SYM
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on Q M (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y)) (R :^: idx M) <-> integrable_on Q M (fun y:set => bop (f y) (g (vector_sub M x y))) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_DECREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, forall i :e omega, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (drop x <= drop y /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N))) -> f y i <= f x i) -> integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_DECREASING_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) -> integrable_on 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_DECREASING_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> g y <= g x) -> integrable_on N 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul N (g x) (f x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_DECREASING_PRODUCT_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall B :e R, integrable_on N 1 f (R :^: idx 1) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop x <= drop y -> g y <= g x) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, abs_SNo (g x) <= B)) -> integrable_on N 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul N (g x) (f x)) (R :^: idx 1)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_DIFF
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on N M f t /\ t c= s) -> integrable_on N M f (s :\: t)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ integrable_on N M f s -> integrable_on N M g s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_IFF_MEASURABLE_UNDER_CURVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= drop (f x)) -> (integrable_on 1 N f (R :^: idx N) <-> measurable (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {pastecart N 1 x y | y :e R :^: idx 1, y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,f x) seq_nil)}))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_IMP_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s -> measurable_on M N f s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_INCREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, forall i :e omega, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (drop x <= drop y /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N))) -> f x i <= f y i) -> integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_INCREASING_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> integrable_on 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_INCREASING_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> g x <= g y) -> integrable_on N 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul N (g x) (f x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_INCREASING_PRODUCT_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall B :e R, integrable_on N 1 f (R :^: idx 1) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop x <= drop y -> g x <= g y) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, abs_SNo (g x) <= B)) -> integrable_on N 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul N (g x) (f x)) (R :^: idx 1)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall i c= R :^: idx A, integrable_on B A f i -> has_integral A B f (integral B A i f) i

items.name: INTEGRABLE_LIFT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, h x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, integrable_on A B f s /\ linear A C h -> integrable_on C B (fun x:set => h (f x)) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_MIN_CONST_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t :e R, 0 <= t /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) /\ integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s) -> integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => lift (if f x <= t then f x else t)) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) s <-> integrable_on N M f s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_ALL_INTERVALS_INTEGRABLE_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= drop (g x)) /\ integrable_on 1 M g s) -> integrable_on N M f s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_CONST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx N, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => c) s <-> c = vec N 0 \/ measurable M s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> integrable_on A B f Empty

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => indicator N s x) t <-> measurable N (s :/\: t)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_LITTLE_SUBINTERVALS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall u v :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) /\ (closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) c= ball M (x,d) /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil))) -> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, negligible M s -> integrable_on N M f s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_NULL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx B, content B (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> integrable_on A B f (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx B, integrable_on A B f (open_interval B (a,b)) <-> integrable_on A B f (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_REFL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a :e R :^: idx B, integrable_on A B f (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,a) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_SUBDIVISION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall i c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d i /\ (integrable_on N M f s /\ i c= s) -> integrable_on N M f i

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_SUBINTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_SUBINTERVAL_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, integrable_on N 1 f s /\ (t c= s /\ is_interval 1 t) -> integrable_on N 1 f t

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, integrable_on N 1 f s /\ (t c= s /\ finite (components 1 t)) -> integrable_on N 1 f t

items.name: INTEGRABLE_ON_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx B, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, ~ x :e s -> f x = vec A 0) /\ (s c= t /\ integrable_on A B f s) -> integrable_on A B f t

items.name: INTEGRABLE_PASTECART_SYM
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) (fun z:set => f (pastecart M N (sndcart N M z) (fstcart N z))) {pastecart N M (sndcart M N z) (fstcart M z) | z :e s} <-> integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_PASTECART_SYM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s :e A, forall y :e B, integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) (fun z:set => f (pastecart M N (sndcart N M z) (fstcart N z))) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) <-> integrable_on P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_REFLECT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => f (vector_neg M x)) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (vector_neg M b,vector_neg M a) seq_nil)) <-> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_REFLECT_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => f (vector_neg M x)) s <-> integrable_on N M f {vector_neg M x | x :e s}

items.name: INTEGRABLE_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, s c= t -> (integrable_on N M (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) t <-> integrable_on N M f s)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_RESTRICT_INTER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) t <-> integrable_on N M f (s :/\: t)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_RESTRICT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A M:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on A M (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec A 0) (R :^: idx M) <-> integrable_on A M f s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SPIKE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t :\: s -> g x = f x) -> integrable_on N M f t -> integrable_on N M g t

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SPIKE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t :\: s -> g x = f x) -> (integrable_on N M f t <-> integrable_on N M g t)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SPIKE_FINITE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, finite s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t :\: s -> g x = f x) -> integrable_on N M f t -> integrable_on N M g t

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SPIKE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e open_interval M (a,b) -> g x = f x) -> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> integrable_on N M g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SPIKE_SET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> integrable_on N M f s -> integrable_on N M f t

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SPIKE_SET_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> (integrable_on N M f s <-> integrable_on N M f t)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SPLIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex M) -> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx M | x k <= c}) /\ integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx M | c <= x k})

items.name: INTEGRABLE_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, h x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists i j :e R :^: idx 1, has_integral N 1 g i s /\ (has_integral N 1 h j s /\ (vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 i j) < e0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> drop (g x) <= drop (f x) /\ drop (f x) <= drop (h x)))) -> integrable_on 1 N f s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_STRADDLE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, h x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ exists i j :e R :^: idx 1, has_integral N 1 g i (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (has_integral N 1 h j (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 i j) < e0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> drop (g x) <= drop (f x) /\ drop (f x) <= drop (h x)))) -> integrable_on 1 N f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_STRETCH
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, m x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex M -> ~ m k = 0) -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => f (fun k :e idx M => m k * x k)) {(fun k :e idx M => recip_SNo (m k) * x k) | x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ integrable_on N M g s -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SUBINTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_SUBINTERVALS_IMP_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x)) s <-> integrable_on N M f {vector_add M a x | x :e s}

items.name: INTEGRABLE_TWIZZLE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> dimindex M = dimindex N /\ permutes omega p (idx N) -> (integrable_on P N f {(fun i :e idx N => x (p i)) | x :e s} <-> integrable_on P M (fun x:set => f (fun i :e idx N => x (p i))) s)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_UNIFORM_LIMIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) <= e0) /\ integrable_on N M g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_UNION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on N M f t /\ negligible M (s :/\: t)) -> integrable_on N M f (s :\/: t)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u c= Power (R :^: idx M), finite u /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx M, s :e u -> integrable_on N M f s) /\ (forall x y :e u, x <> y -> negligible M (x :/\: y))) -> integrable_on N M f (Union u)

items.name: INTEGRABLE_UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e Power (R :^: idx M) :^: A, forall t c= A, finite t /\ ((forall s :e A, s :e t -> integrable_on N M f (k s)) /\ (forall x y :e t, x <> y -> negligible M (k x :/\: k y))) -> integrable_on N M f (Union {k x | x :e t})

items.name: INTEGRABLE_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ integrable_on N M f t -> (integrable_on N M f (s :\/: t) <-> integrable_on N M f (s :/\: t))

items.name: INTEGRABLE_VSUM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= A, finite t /\ (forall a :e A, a :e t -> integrable_on N M (f a) s) -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vsum A N t (fun a:set => f a x)) s

items.name: INTEGRAL_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, integral B A s (fun x:set => vec B 0) = vec B 0

items.name: INTEGRAL_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ integrable_on N M g s -> integral N M s (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) = vector_add N (integral N M s f) (integral N M s g)

items.name: INTEGRAL_CHANGE_OF_VARIABLES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, g' x y :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative M M g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ g x = g y) -> x = y) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f {g x | x :e s} \/ absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M (g' x)))) (f (g x))) s))) -> integral N M {g x | x :e s} f = integral N M s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M (g' x)))) (f (g x)))

items.name: INTEGRAL_CHANGE_OF_VARIABLES_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M M g /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M f {g x | x :e s} \/ absolutely_integrable_on N M (fun x:set => f (g x)) s) -> integral N M {g x | x :e s} f = vector_mul N (abs_SNo (det M (matrix M M g))) (integral N M s (fun x:set => f (g x)))

items.name: INTEGRAL_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s -> integral N M s (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) = vector_mul N c (integral N M s f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop c /\ (drop c <= drop b /\ integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> vector_add N (integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f) (integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f) = integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMBINE_DIVISION_BOTTOMUP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d s /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e d -> integrable_on N M f k) -> integral N M s f = vsum (Power (R :^: idx M)) N d (fun i:set => integral N M i f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMBINE_DIVISION_TOPDOWN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ division_of M d s -> integral N M s f = vsum (Power (R :^: idx M)) N d (fun i:set => integral N M i f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMBINE_TAGGED_DIVISION_BOTTOMUP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall k c= R :^: idx M, (x,k) :e p -> integrable_on N M f k) -> integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => integral N M (p0 1) f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMBINE_TAGGED_DIVISION_TOPDOWN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => integral N M (p0 1) f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> integrable_on N M f s -> integral N M s f k = drop (integral 1 M s (fun x:set => lift (f x k)))

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_LBOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall B :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> B <= f x k))) -> B * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <= integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f k

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on N M g s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x k <= g x k)))) -> integral N M s f k <= integral N M s g k

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_LE_AE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, forall t c= R :^: idx M, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (negligible M t /\ (integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on N M g s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> f x k <= g x k))))) -> integral N M s f k <= integral N M s g k

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_POS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (integrable_on N M f s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> 0 <= f x k))) -> 0 <= integral N M s f k

items.name: INTEGRAL_COMPONENT_UBOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall B :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> f x k <= B))) -> integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f k <= B * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRAL_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx B, forall c :e R :^: idx A, integral A B (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => c) = vector_mul A (content B (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) c

items.name: INTEGRAL_CONST_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx N, measurable M s -> integral N M s (fun x:set => c) = vector_mul N (measure M s) c

items.name: INTEGRAL_CONVOLUTION_SYM
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, integral Q M (R :^: idx M) (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y)) = integral Q M (R :^: idx M) (fun y:set => bop (f y) (g (vector_sub M x y)))

items.name: INTEGRAL_COUNTABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, integrable_on N M f (s n)) /\ ((forall x y :e omega, x <> y -> negligible M (s x :/\: s y)) /\ absolutely_integrable_on N M f (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega})) -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => vsum omega N {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => integral N M (s i) f)) (integral N M (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}) f) sequentially

items.name: INTEGRAL_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, absolutely_integrable_on N M f (Union {s m | m :e omega, m :e omega}) /\ (forall m :e omega, lebesgue_measurable M (s m)) -> (forall n :e omega, absolutely_integrable_on N M f (Union {s m | m :e omega, m :e {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}})) /\ tendsto N omega (fun n:set => integral N M (Union {s m | m :e omega, m :e {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}}) f) (integral N M (Union {s m | m :e omega, m :e omega}) f) sequentially

items.name: INTEGRAL_DIFF
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on N M f t /\ negligible M (t :\: s)) -> integral N M (s :\: t) f = vector_sub N (integral N M s f) (integral N M t f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_DROP_LE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on 1 M f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M g s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> drop (f x) <= drop (g x))) -> drop (integral 1 M s f) <= drop (integral 1 M s g)

items.name: INTEGRAL_DROP_LE_AE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on 1 M f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M g s /\ (negligible M t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> drop (f x) <= drop (g x)))) -> drop (integral 1 M s f) <= drop (integral 1 M s g)

items.name: INTEGRAL_DROP_LE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on N 1 f s /\ (integrable_on 1 N g s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= drop (f x) /\ drop (f x) <= drop (g x))) -> drop (integral 1 N s f) <= drop (integral 1 N s g)

items.name: INTEGRAL_DROP_POS
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on 1 M f s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> 0 <= drop (f x)) -> 0 <= drop (integral 1 M s f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_DROP_POS_AE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on 1 M f s /\ (negligible M t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> 0 <= drop (f x))) -> 0 <= drop (integral 1 M s f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> integral B A Empty f = vec B 0

items.name: INTEGRAL_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> integral N M s f = integral N M s g

items.name: INTEGRAL_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = vec N 0) -> integral N M s f = vec N 0

items.name: INTEGRAL_EQ_HAS_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y :e R :^: idx A, integrable_on A B f s -> (integral A B s f = y <-> has_integral B A f y s)

items.name: INTEGRAL_HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_vector_derivative N (fun u:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,u) seq_nil)) f) (f x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: INTEGRAL_HAS_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx 1, integrable_on N 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> has_vector_derivative N (fun u:set => integral N 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,u) seq_nil)) f) (f x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: INTEGRAL_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, measurable M (s :/\: t) -> integral 1 M t (fun x:set => indicator M s x) = lift (measure M (s :/\: t))

items.name: INTEGRAL_INTERVALS_DIFF_INCLUSION_EXCLUSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (c :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ d :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> vector_sub N (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,d) seq_nil)) f) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f) = vsum (Power omega) N {s :e Power omega | ~ s = Empty /\ s c= idx M} (fun s:set => vector_mul N ((- 1) ^ finite_cardinality {i :e omega | i :e s /\ d i < c i}) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (fun i :e idx M => if i :e s then if c i <= d i then c i else d i else a i,fun i :e idx M => if i :e s then if c i <= d i then d i else c i else c i) seq_nil)) f))

items.name: INTEGRAL_INTERVALS_INCLUSION_EXCLUSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (c :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ d :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,d) seq_nil)) f = vsum (Power omega) N {s :e Power omega | s c= idx M} (fun s:set => vector_mul N ((- 1) ^ finite_cardinality {i :e omega | i :e s /\ d i < c i}) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (fun i :e idx M => if i :e s then if c i <= d i then c i else d i else a i,fun i :e idx M => if i :e s then if c i <= d i then d i else c i else c i) seq_nil)) f))

items.name: INTEGRAL_INTERVALS_INCLUSION_EXCLUSION_LEFT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ c :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f = vsum (Power omega) N {s :e Power omega | s c= idx M} (fun s:set => vector_mul N ((- 1) ^ finite_cardinality s) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,fun i :e idx M => if i :e s then c i else b i) seq_nil)) f))

items.name: INTEGRAL_INTERVALS_INCLUSION_EXCLUSION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ c :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f = vsum (Power omega) N {s :e Power omega | s c= idx M} (fun s:set => vector_mul N ((- 1) ^ finite_cardinality s) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (fun i :e idx M => if i :e s then c i else a i,b) seq_nil)) f))

items.name: INTEGRAL_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, h x :e R :^: idx P) -> integrable_on N M f s /\ linear N P h -> integral P M s (fun x:set => h (f x)) = h (integral N M s f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_MEASURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s -> integral 1 A s (fun x:set => vec 1 1) = lift (measure A s)

items.name: INTEGRAL_MEASURE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s -> integral 1 A (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => if x :e s then vec 1 1 else vec 1 0) = lift (measure A s)

items.name: INTEGRAL_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s -> integral N M s (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) = vector_neg N (integral N M s f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_NORM_BOUND_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M g s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= drop (g x))) -> vector_norm N (integral N M s f) <= drop (integral 1 M s g)

items.name: INTEGRAL_NORM_BOUND_INTEGRAL_AE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M g s /\ (negligible M t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> vector_norm N (f x) <= drop (g x)))) -> vector_norm N (integral N M s f) <= drop (integral 1 M s g)

items.name: INTEGRAL_NORM_BOUND_INTEGRAL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex P /\ (integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on P M g s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= g x k)))) -> vector_norm N (integral N M s f) <= integral P M s g k

items.name: INTEGRAL_NULL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx B, content B (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> integral A B (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = vec A 0

items.name: INTEGRAL_ON_IMAGE_DROP_UBOUND_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, g' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= drop (f (g x))) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => vector_mul 1 (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (g' x)))) (f (g x))) s /\ drop (integral 1 N s (fun x:set => vector_mul 1 (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (g' x)))) (f (g x)))) <= b)) -> drop (integral 1 N {g x | x :e s} f) <= b

items.name: INTEGRAL_ON_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, negligible M s -> integral N M s f = vec N 0

items.name: INTEGRAL_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx B, integral A B (open_interval B (a,b)) f = integral A B (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: INTEGRAL_PASTECART_CONST
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e R :^: idx P, integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => k) = integral P M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => integral P N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) (fun y:set => k))

items.name: INTEGRAL_PASTECART_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) P f (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)) -> integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)) f = integral P M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => integral P N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) (fun y:set => f (pastecart M N x y)))

items.name: INTEGRAL_PASTECART_SYM
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), integral P (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) {pastecart N M (sndcart M N z) (fstcart M z) | z :e s} (fun z:set => f (pastecart M N (sndcart N M z) (fstcart N z))) = integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s f

items.name: INTEGRAL_PASTECART_SYM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s :e A, forall y :e B, integral P (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) (fun z:set => f (pastecart M N (sndcart N M z) (fstcart N z))) = integral P (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) f

items.name: INTEGRAL_REFL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a :e R :^: idx B, integral A B (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,a) seq_nil)) f = vec A 0

items.name: INTEGRAL_REFLECT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (vector_neg M b,vector_neg M a) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => f (vector_neg M x)) = integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: INTEGRAL_REFLECT_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integral N M s (fun x:set => f (vector_neg M x)) = integral N M {vector_neg M x | x :e s} f

items.name: INTEGRAL_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, s c= t -> integral N M t (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) = integral N M s f

items.name: INTEGRAL_RESTRICT_INTER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integral N M t (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) = integral N M (s :/\: t) f

items.name: INTEGRAL_RESTRICT_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integral N M (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) = integral N M s f

items.name: INTEGRAL_SPIKE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t :\: s -> g x = f x) -> integral N M t f = integral N M t g

items.name: INTEGRAL_SPIKE_SET
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g :e A, forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> integral N M s f = integral N M t f

items.name: INTEGRAL_SPLIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall t :e R, forall k :e omega, integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex M) -> integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = vector_add N (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,fun i :e idx M => if i = k then if b k <= t then b k else t else b i) seq_nil)) f) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (fun i :e idx M => if i = k then if a k <= t then t else a k else a i,b) seq_nil)) f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_SPLIT_SIGNED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall t :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex M /\ (a k <= t /\ (a k <= b k /\ integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,fun i :e idx M => if i = k then if b k <= t then t else b k else b i) seq_nil))))) -> integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = vector_add N (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,fun i :e idx M => if i = k then t else b i) seq_nil)) f) (vector_mul N (if b k < t then - 1 else 1) (integral N M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (fun i :e idx M => if i = k then if b k <= t then b k else t else a i,fun i :e idx M => if i = k then if b k <= t then t else b k else b i) seq_nil)) f))

items.name: INTEGRAL_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ integrable_on N M g s -> integral N M s (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) = vector_sub N (integral N M s f) (integral N M s g)

items.name: INTEGRAL_SUBSET_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, s c= t /\ (integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on N M f t /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> 0 <= f x k))))) -> integral N M s f k <= integral N M t f k

items.name: INTEGRAL_SUBSET_DROP_LE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, s c= t /\ (integrable_on 1 M f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M f t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t -> 0 <= drop (f x)))) -> drop (integral 1 M s f) <= drop (integral 1 M t f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_SUBSET_DROP_LE_AE
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx M, s c= t /\ (integrable_on 1 M f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M f t /\ (negligible M u /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t :\: u -> 0 <= drop (f x))))) -> drop (integral 1 M s f) <= drop (integral 1 M t f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_SWAP_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) P (fun z:set => f (fstcart M z) (sndcart M N z)) (closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)) -> integral P M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => integral P N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) (f x)) = integral P N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) (fun y:set => integral P M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => f x y))

items.name: INTEGRAL_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, integral N M s (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x)) = integral N M {vector_add M a x | x :e s} f

items.name: INTEGRAL_TWIZZLE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> dimindex M = dimindex N /\ permutes omega p (idx N) -> integral P N {(fun i :e idx N => x (p i)) | x :e s} f = integral P M s (fun x:set => f (fun i :e idx N => x (p i)))

items.name: INTEGRAL_UNION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, integrable_on N M f s /\ (integrable_on N M f t /\ negligible M (s :/\: t)) -> integral N M (s :\/: t) f = vector_add N (integral N M s f) (integral N M t f)

items.name: INTEGRAL_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y :e R :^: idx A, forall k c= R :^: idx B, has_integral B A f y k -> integral A B k f = y

items.name: INTEGRAL_VSUM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= A, finite t /\ (forall a :e A, a :e t -> integrable_on N M (f a) s) -> integral N M s (fun x:set => vsum A N t (fun a:set => f a x)) = vsum A N t (fun a:set => integral N M s (f a))

items.name: INTEGRAL_ZERO_ON_SUBINTERVALS_IMP_ZERO_AE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_integral M N f (vec N 0) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil))) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ ~ f x = vec N 0}

items.name: INTEGRAL_ZERO_ON_SUBINTERVALS_IMP_ZERO_AE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, has_integral M N f (vec N 0) (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | ~ f x = vec N 0}

items.name: INTEGRATION_BY_PARTS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall c c= R :^: idx 1, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bilinear N P M bop /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ (countable c /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 P (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g x)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) :\: c -> has_vector_derivative M f (f' x) (at 1 x) /\ has_vector_derivative N g (g' x) (at 1 x)) /\ has_integral 1 P (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g' x)) (vector_sub P (vector_sub P (bop (f b) (g b)) (bop (f a) (g a))) y) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))))) -> has_integral 1 P (fun x:set => bop (f' x) (g x)) y (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTEGRATION_BY_PARTS_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bilinear N P M bop /\ (drop a <= drop b /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_vector_derivative M f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ has_vector_derivative N g (g' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) /\ has_integral 1 P (fun x:set => bop (f x) (g' x)) (vector_sub P (vector_sub P (bop (f b) (g b)) (bop (f a) (g a))) y) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> has_integral 1 P (fun x:set => bop (f' x) (g x)) y (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = {x :e A | x :e s /\ x :e t}

items.name: INTERIOR_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, interior N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} = if m = 0 then Empty else {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e interior N s}

items.name: INTERIOR_ARC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> 2 <= dimindex N /\ arc N g -> interior N (path_image N g) = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, interior A (ball A (a,r)) = ball A (a,r)

items.name: INTERIOR_BIJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> interior N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e interior M s}

items.name: INTERIOR_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, interior N (cball N (x,e0)) = ball N (x,e0)

items.name: INTERIOR_CLOSED_EQ_EMPTY_AS_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ interior N s = Empty <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ s = frontier N t

items.name: INTERIOR_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, interior N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = open_interval N (a,b)

items.name: INTERIOR_CLOSED_UNION_EMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ interior N t = Empty -> interior N (s :\/: t) = interior N s

items.name: INTERIOR_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N s = (R :^: idx N) :\: closure N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: INTERIOR_CLOSURE_IDEMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N (closure N (interior N (closure N s))) = interior N (closure N s)

items.name: INTERIOR_CLOSURE_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ open N t -> interior N (closure N (s :/\: t)) = interior N (closure N s) :/\: interior N (closure N t)

items.name: INTERIOR_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) = (R :^: idx N) :\: closure N s

items.name: INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL_3
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx_n 2, ~ collinear (idx_n 2) {a,b,c} -> interior (idx_n 2) (hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | convex (idx_n 2) x} {a,b,c}) = {v :e R :^: idx_n 2 | exists x y z :e R, 0 < x /\ (x < 1 /\ (0 < y /\ (y < 1 /\ (0 < z /\ (z < 1 /\ (x + y + z = 1 /\ vector_add (idx_n 2) (vector_mul (idx_n 2) x a) (vector_add (idx_n 2) (vector_mul (idx_n 2) y b) (vector_mul (idx_n 2) z c)) = v))))))}

items.name: INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL_3_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx_n 2, ~ collinear (idx_n 2) {a,b,c} -> interior (idx_n 2) (hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | convex (idx_n 2) x} {a,b,c}) = {v :e R :^: idx_n 2 | exists x y z :e R, 0 < x /\ (0 < y /\ (0 < z /\ (x + y + z = 1 /\ vector_add (idx_n 2) (vector_mul (idx_n 2) x a) (vector_add (idx_n 2) (vector_mul (idx_n 2) y b) (vector_mul (idx_n 2) z c)) = v)))}

items.name: INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, equip s (dimindex N + 1) -> (interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = Empty <-> affine_dependent N s)

items.name: INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = if finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N then Empty else {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 < u x /\ u x < 1) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))}
