items.name: INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL_EXPLICIT_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = if finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N then Empty else {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 < u x) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))}

items.name: INTERIOR_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, interior A (s :\: t) = interior A s :\: closure A t

items.name: INTERIOR_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> interior A Empty = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, interior A s = s <-> open A s

items.name: INTERIOR_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N s = Empty <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ t c= s -> t = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_EQ_EMPTY_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N s = Empty <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ ~ t = Empty -> ~ t :\: s = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_EQ_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N s = R :^: idx N <-> s = R :^: idx N

items.name: INTERIOR_FINITE_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite s -> interior N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e interior N x} | x :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERIOR_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N (frontier N s) = interior N (closure N s) :\: closure N (interior N s)

items.name: INTERIOR_FRONTIER_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s \/ closed N s -> interior N (frontier N s) = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, interior N {x :e R :^: idx N | a <= x k} = {x :e R :^: idx N | a < x k}

items.name: INTERIOR_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, interior N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= a} = {x :e R :^: idx N | x k < a}

items.name: INTERIOR_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 -> interior N {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x} = {x :e R :^: idx N | b < dot N a x}

items.name: INTERIOR_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 -> interior N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x < b}

items.name: INTERIOR_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, ~ a = vec A 0 -> interior A {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x = b} = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> interior N {f x | x :e s} c= {f x | x :e interior M s}

items.name: INTERIOR_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> interior N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e interior N s}

items.name: INTERIOR_INSIDE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> interior N s c= inside N (frontier N s)

items.name: INTERIOR_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, interior N (s :/\: t) = interior N s :/\: interior N t

items.name: INTERIOR_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, interior A (interior A s) = interior A s

items.name: INTERIOR_INTERS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), interior A {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} c= {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e interior A x} | x :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERIOR_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, interior A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = open_interval A (a,b)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx B, interior B (open_interval B (a,b)) = open_interval B (a,b)

items.name: INTERIOR_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, finite k -> interior_of (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e interior_of A (tops i) (s i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: INTERIOR_LIMIT_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e interior N s -> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: INTERIOR_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, t c= s /\ open A t -> t c= interior A s

items.name: INTERIOR_MAXIMAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> (s c= interior N t <-> s c= t)

items.name: INTERIOR_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, interior A {vector_neg A x | x :e s} = {vector_neg A x | x :e interior A s}

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_CLOSED_IN_UNION_EMPTY_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ interior_of A top t = Empty -> interior_of A top (s :\/: t) = interior_of A top s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s = topspace A top :\: closure_of A top (topspace A top :\: s)

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_CLOSURE_OF_IDEMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (closure_of A top (interior_of A top (closure_of A top s))) = interior_of A top (closure_of A top s)

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_CLOSURE_OF_REALINTERVAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, is_realinterval s -> interior_of R euclideanreal (closure_of R euclideanreal s) = interior_of R euclideanreal s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (topspace A top :\: s) = topspace A top :\: closure_of A top s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, interior_of (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (s :*: t) = interior_of A top1 s :*: interior_of B top2 t

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, interior_of A top Empty = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s = s <-> s :e top

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s = Empty <-> forall t c= A, t :e top /\ t c= s -> t = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_EQ_EMPTY_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s = Empty <-> forall t c= A, t :e top /\ ~ t = Empty -> ~ t :\: s = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_EQ_EMPTY_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s = Empty <-> closure_of A top (topspace A top :\: s) = topspace A top

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (frontier_of A top s) = interior_of A top (closure_of A top s) :\: closure_of A top (interior_of A top s)

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_FRONTIER_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top \/ closed_in A top s -> interior_of A top (frontier_of A top s) = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e u}) {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e interior_of (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s}

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, interior_of A top (s :/\: t) = interior_of A top s :/\: interior_of A top t

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (interior_of A top s) = interior_of A top s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_INTERS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, interior_of A top {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} c= {x :e A | forall Y :e {interior_of A top s | s :e Power A, s :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SUBSPACE_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c c= A, locally_connected_space A top /\ c :e connected_components_of A (subtopology A top s) -> interior_of A top c = c :/\: interior_of A top s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, t c= s /\ t :e top -> t c= interior_of A top s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_MAXIMAL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, t :e top -> (t c= interior_of A top s <-> t c= s)

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= t -> interior_of A top s c= interior_of A top t

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall a:set, a <> Empty -> forall top :e topology a, forall s c= a, s :e top -> interior_of a top s = s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b :e R, interior_of R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = open_real_interval (a,b)

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s = interior_of A top (topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s c= s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_SUBSET_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s c= closure_of A top s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_SUBSET_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, interior_of A (subtopology A top s) t c= s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s c= topspace A top

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ t c= u -> interior_of A (subtopology A top u) s c= interior_of A (subtopology A top t) s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, u :e top -> interior_of A (subtopology A top u) s = u :/\: interior_of A top s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s u c= A, u :/\: interior_of A top s c= interior_of A (subtopology A top u) s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, t c= u -> t :/\: interior_of A (subtopology A top u) s c= interior_of A (subtopology A top t) s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, interior_of A top (topspace A top) = topspace A top

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall u s c= R :^: idx N, interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {vector_add N a x | x :e u}) {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s}

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx_n 2, interior (idx_n 2) (hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | convex (idx_n 2) x} {a,b,c}) = hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | convex (idx_n 2) x} {a,b,c} :\: closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: (closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil) :\/: closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (c,a) seq_nil))

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_UNIONS_OPEN_IN_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, Union {t :e Power A | t :e top /\ t c= s} = interior_of A top s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_UNION_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s \/ closed_in A top t -> (interior_of A top (s :\/: t) = Empty <-> interior_of A top s = Empty /\ interior_of A top t = Empty)

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_UNION_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s :\/: frontier_of A top s = closure_of A top s

items.name: INTERIOR_OF_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, t c= s /\ (t :e top /\ (forall t' c= A, t' c= s /\ t' :e top -> t' c= t)) -> interior_of A top s = t

items.name: INTERIOR_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s -> interior A s = s

items.name: INTERIOR_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, interior (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e interior M s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e interior N t}

items.name: INTERIOR_RECTIFIABLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> 2 <= dimindex N /\ rectifiable_path N g -> interior N (path_image N g) = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, interior N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} = if c = 0 then Empty else {vector_mul N c x | x :e interior N s}

items.name: INTERIOR_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, interior N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if 2 <= dimindex N then Empty else open_segment N (a,b)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, interior N (open_segment N (a,b)) = if 2 <= dimindex N then Empty else open_segment N (a,b)

items.name: INTERIOR_SIMPLEX_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, independent N s /\ equip s (dimindex N) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, a :e interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s (vec N 0)))

items.name: INTERIOR_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> 2 <= dimindex N /\ simple_path N g -> interior N (path_image N g) = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, interior N {a} = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, interior N (sphere N (a,r)) = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_STANDARD_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a :e R, interior N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = a} = Empty

items.name: INTERIOR_STD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} (vec N 0))) = {x :e R :^: idx N | (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 < x i) /\ finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => x i) < 1}

items.name: INTERIOR_STRIP_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, interior N {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) <= a} = {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) < a}

items.name: INTERIOR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, interior A s c= s

items.name: INTERIOR_SUBSET_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, interior A s c= relative_interior A s

items.name: INTERIOR_SUBSET_UNION_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s i j c= R :^: idx N, (exists a b :e R :^: idx N, i = closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((exists c d :e R :^: idx N, j = closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) /\ (~ interior N j = Empty /\ (i c= j :\/: s /\ interior N i :/\: interior N j = Empty))) -> interior N i c= interior N s

items.name: INTERIOR_SURJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = y) -> interior N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e interior N s}

items.name: INTERIOR_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e interior N s}

items.name: INTERIOR_UNIONS_OPEN_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, Union {t :e Power (R :^: idx N) | open N t /\ t c= s} = interior N s

items.name: INTERIOR_UNION_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s \/ closed N t -> (interior N (s :\/: t) = Empty <-> interior N s = Empty /\ interior N t = Empty)

items.name: INTERIOR_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, t c= s /\ (open A t /\ (forall t' c= R :^: idx A, t' c= s /\ open A t' -> t' c= t)) -> interior A s = t

items.name: INTERIOR_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> interior N (R :^: idx N) = R :^: idx N

items.name: INTERMEDIATE_CONTINUUM_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c u c= A, connected_space A top /\ (locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (compact_in A top c /\ (connected_in A top c /\ (~ c = Empty /\ (~ c = topspace A top /\ (u :e top /\ c c= u))))))) -> exists d c= A, compact_in A top d /\ (connected_in A top d /\ (c c= d /\ c <> d /\ (d c= u /\ d <> u)))

items.name: INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall u c= A, u :e s -> x :e u}

items.name: INTERSECTION_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e u -> Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s)

items.name: INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, P Empty -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = A

items.name: INTERSECTION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P {s} /\ Q s -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: INTERSECTION_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q Q':set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s) /\ (forall x c= A, Q x -> Q' x) -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q' c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: INTERS_0
items.statement: forall A:set, {x :e A | forall Y :e Empty, x :e Y} = A

items.name: INTERS_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, {x :e A | forall Y :e {s}, x :e Y} = s

items.name: INTERS_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, {x :e A | forall Y :e {s,t}, x :e Y} = s :/\: t

items.name: INTERS_ANTIMONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f g c= Power A, g c= f -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} c= {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERS_ANTIMONO_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= Power A, (forall y c= A, y :e t -> exists x c= A, x :e s /\ x c= y) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} c= {x :e A | forall Y :e t, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERS_EQ_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = A <-> forall s c= A, s :e f -> s = A

items.name: INTERS_FACES_FINITE_ALTBOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e f -> face_of N c s) -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f' /\ (f' c= f /\ (finite_cardinality f' <= dimindex N + 2 /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}))

items.name: INTERS_FACES_FINITE_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), convex N s /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e f -> face_of N c s) -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f' /\ (f' c= f /\ (finite_cardinality f' <= dimindex N + 1 /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}))

items.name: INTERS_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall P:set -> prop, forall f :e Power B :^: A, {x :e B | forall Y :e {f x | x :e A, P x}, x :e Y} = {a :e B | forall x :e A, P x -> a :e f x}) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall f :e Power C :^: B :^: A, {x :e C | forall Y :e (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, P x y}), x :e Y} = {a :e C | forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y -> a :e f x y}) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall f :e Power D :^: C :^: B :^: A, {x :e D | forall Y :e (\/_ x :e A, \/_ y :e B, {f x y z | z :e C, P x y z}), x :e Y} = {a :e D | forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, P x y z -> a :e f x y z})

items.name: INTERS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e Power B :^: A, forall s c= A, {x :e B | forall Y :e {f x | x :e s}, x :e Y} = {y :e B | forall x :e A, x :e s -> y :e f x}

items.name: INTERS_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall u c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e SetAdjoin u s, x :e Y} = s :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERS_IN_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, finite f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s)) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e f

items.name: INTERS_OVER_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (Power B) :^: A, forall s c= A, {x :e B | forall Y :e {Union (f x) | x :e A, x :e s}, x :e Y} = Union {{x :e B | forall Y :e {g x | x :e A, x :e s}, x :e Y} | g :e Power B :^: A, forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x :e f x}

items.name: INTERS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= Power A, forall s c= A, ~ u = Empty /\ (forall t c= A, t :e u -> t c= s) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} c= s

items.name: INTERS_SUBSET_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= Power A, forall s c= A, (exists t c= A, t :e u /\ t c= s) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} c= s

items.name: INTERS_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e s :\/: t, x :e Y} = {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e t, x :e Y}

items.name: INTERS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= Power A, {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} = A :\: Union {A :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}

items.name: INTERVAL_1
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = if drop a <= drop b then cball 1 (midpoint 1 (a,b),distance 1 (a,b) :/: 2) else Empty) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, open_interval 1 (a,b) = if drop a < drop b then ball 1 (midpoint 1 (a,b),distance 1 (a,b) :/: 2) else Empty

items.name: INTERVAL_BIJ_AFFINE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b u v x :e R :^: idx A, interval_bij A (a,b) (u,v) x = vector_add A (fun i :e idx A => (v i + - u i) :/: (b i + - a i) * x i) (fun i :e idx A => u i + - (v i + - u i) :/: (b i + - a i) * a i)

items.name: INTERVAL_BIJ_BIJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b u v x :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < b i /\ u i < v i) -> interval_bij N (a,b) (u,v) (interval_bij N (u,v) (a,b) x) = x

items.name: INTERVAL_BISECTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, P s /\ (P t /\ interior N s :/\: interior N t = Empty) -> P (s :\/: t)) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ P (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c d :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) /\ (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= ball N (x,e0) /\ (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ ~ P (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))))

items.name: INTERVAL_BISECTION_STEP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, P s /\ (P t /\ interior N s :/\: interior N t = Empty) -> P (s :\/: t)) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ P (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ P (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= c i /\ (c i <= d i /\ (d i <= b i /\ 2 * (d i + - c i) <= b i + - a i))

items.name: INTERVAL_BOUNDS_EMPTY_1
items.statement: interval_upperbound 1 Empty = interval_lowerbound 1 Empty

items.name: INTERVAL_BOUNDS_NULL_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, content 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> interval_upperbound 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = interval_lowerbound 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTERVAL_CASES_1
items.statement: forall a b x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) \/ (x = a \/ x = b)

items.name: INTERVAL_CONTAINS_COMPACT_NEIGHBOURHOOD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, is_interval N s /\ x :e s -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ (x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s /\ ball N (x,d) :/\: s c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: INTERVAL_DOUBLESPLIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall c e0 :e R, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k + - c) <= e0} = closed_interval N (seq_cons (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then if a k <= c + - e0 then c + - e0 else a k else a i,fun i :e idx N => if i = k then if b k <= c + e0 then b k else c + e0 else b i) seq_nil)

items.name: INTERVAL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty <-> (exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ b i < a i))) /\ (open_interval N (a,b) = Empty <-> exists i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ b i <= a i))

items.name: INTERVAL_EQ_EMPTY_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty <-> drop b < drop a) /\ (open_interval 1 (a,b) = Empty <-> drop b <= drop a)

items.name: INTERVAL_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {x} <-> a = x /\ b = x) /\ forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (a,b) = {x}

items.name: INTERVAL_IMAGE_AFFINITY_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx A, exists u v :e R :^: idx A, {vector_add A (vector_mul A m x) c | x :e closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval A (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)

items.name: INTERVAL_IMAGE_STRETCH_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, m x :e R) -> exists u v :e R :^: idx N, {(fun k :e idx N => m k * x k) | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)

items.name: INTERVAL_LOWERBOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= b i) -> interval_lowerbound N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = a

items.name: INTERVAL_LOWERBOUND_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b -> interval_lowerbound 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = a

items.name: INTERVAL_LOWERBOUND_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty -> interval_lowerbound N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = a

items.name: INTERVAL_NE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty <-> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= b i)) /\ (~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < b i)

items.name: INTERVAL_NE_EMPTY_1
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty <-> drop a <= drop b) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ open_interval 1 (a,b) = Empty <-> drop a < drop b

items.name: INTERVAL_OPEN_SUBSET_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, open_interval A (a,b) c= closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: INTERVAL_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {lift x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (drop a,drop b) seq_nil)} /\ open_interval 1 (a,b) = {lift x | x :e open_real_interval (drop a,drop b)}

items.name: INTERVAL_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,a) seq_nil) = {a} /\ open_interval A (a,a) = Empty

items.name: INTERVAL_SPLIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} = closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,fun i :e idx N => if i = k then if b k <= c then b k else c else b i) seq_nil) /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} = closed_interval N (seq_cons (fun i :e idx N => if i = k then if a k <= c then c else a k else a i,b) seq_nil)

items.name: INTERVAL_SUBDIVISION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, c :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> division_of N {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (fun i :e idx N => if i :e x then c i else a i,fun i :e idx N => if i :e x then b i else c i) seq_nil)} | x :e {s :e Power omega | s c= idx N}} (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: INTERVAL_SUBSET_IS_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, is_interval N s -> (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s <-> closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty \/ a :e s /\ b :e s)

items.name: INTERVAL_SUBSET_SEGMENT_1
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, open_interval 1 (a,b) c= open_segment 1 (a,b)

items.name: INTERVAL_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall c a b :e R :^: idx A, closed_interval A (seq_cons (vector_add A c a,vector_add A c b) seq_nil) = {vector_add A c x | x :e closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}) /\ forall c a b :e R :^: idx B, open_interval B (vector_add B c a,vector_add B c b) = {vector_add B c x | x :e open_interval B (a,b)}

items.name: INTERVAL_UPPERBOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= b i) -> interval_upperbound N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = b

items.name: INTERVAL_UPPERBOUND_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b -> interval_upperbound 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = b

items.name: INTERVAL_UPPERBOUND_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty -> interval_upperbound N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = b

items.name: INTER_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :/\: t :/\: u = s :/\: (t :/\: u)

items.name: INTER_BALLS_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, ball N (a,r) :/\: ball N (b,s) = Empty <-> r <= 0 \/ (s <= 0 \/ r + s <= distance N (a,b))) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, ball N (a,r) :/\: cball N (b,s) = Empty <-> r <= 0 \/ (s < 0 \/ r + s <= distance N (a,b))) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, cball N (a,r) :/\: ball N (b,s) = Empty <-> r < 0 \/ (s <= 0 \/ r + s <= distance N (a,b))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, cball N (a,r) :/\: cball N (b,s) = Empty <-> r < 0 \/ (s < 0 \/ r + s < distance N (a,b))))

items.name: INTER_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} :/\: {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e s i :/\: t i}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: INTER_COMM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = t :/\: s

items.name: INTER_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (s :\/: t) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} t = if s = Empty \/ t = Empty then Empty else if s :/\: t = Empty then {vec N 0} else hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (s :/\: t)

items.name: INTER_CONIC_HULL_SUBSETS_CONVEX_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, convex N u /\ (vec N 0 :e relative_interior N u /\ s :\/: t c= relative_frontier N u) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} t = if s = Empty \/ t = Empty then Empty else if s :/\: t = Empty then {vec N 0} else hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (s :/\: t)

items.name: INTER_CONVEX_HULL_INSERT_RELATIVE_EXTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c t s c= R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx N, convex N c /\ (t c= c /\ (z :e relative_interior N c /\ s :/\: relative_interior N c = Empty)) -> s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin t z) = s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t

items.name: INTER_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s s' c= A, forall t t' c= B, (s :*: t) :/\: (s' :*: t') = s :/\: s' :*: t :/\: t'

items.name: INTER_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} :/\: {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e s (p 0) :/\: t (p 0)}}

items.name: INTER_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, Empty :/\: s = Empty) /\ forall s c= A, s :/\: Empty = Empty

items.name: INTER_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :/\: s = s

items.name: INTER_INTERIOR_UNIONS_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (open N s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, t = closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> s :/\: interior N t = Empty))) -> s :/\: interior N (Union f) = Empty

items.name: INTER_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, s :/\: {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = if f = Empty then s else {x :e A | forall Y :e {s :/\: t | t :e Power A, t :e f}, x :e Y}) /\ forall f c= Power A, forall s c= A, {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :/\: s = if f = Empty then s else {x :e A | forall Y :e {t :/\: s | t :e Power A, t :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: INTER_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx A, closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: closed_interval A (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = closed_interval A (seq_cons (fun i :e idx A => if a i <= c i then c i else a i,fun i :e idx A => if b i <= d i then b i else d i) seq_nil)

items.name: INTER_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall a b c d :e R :^: idx 1, closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (lift (if drop a <= drop c then drop c else drop a),lift (if drop b <= drop d then drop b else drop d)) seq_nil)

items.name: INTER_INTERVAL_MIXED_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (c,d) = Empty -> (open_interval N (a,b) :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty <-> open_interval N (a,b) :/\: open_interval N (c,d) = Empty)

items.name: INTER_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} :/\: {i :e omega | p <= i /\ i <= q} = {i :e omega | (if m <= p then p else m) <= i /\ i <= if n <= q then n else q}

items.name: INTER_OVER_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :\/: t :/\: u = (s :\/: t) :/\: (s :\/: u)

items.name: INTER_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t t' c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :/\: (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) = \/_ x :e s :/\: s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :/\: t'}

items.name: INTER_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b c d :e R, closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: closed_real_interval (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = closed_real_interval (seq_cons (if a <= c then c else a,if b <= d then b else d) seq_nil)

items.name: INTER_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s /\ t c= relative_frontier N s) -> t = relative_frontier N s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} t

items.name: INTER_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ convex N t -> relative_interior N s :/\: relative_interior N t c= relative_interior N (s :/\: t)

items.name: INTER_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, {x :e A | x :e s :/\: t /\ P x} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} :/\: {x :e A | x :e t /\ P x}

items.name: INTER_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, b :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil) \/ ~ collinear N {a,b,c} -> closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: closed_segment N (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil) = {b}

items.name: INTER_SPHERE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, sphere N (a,r) :/\: sphere N (b,s) = Empty <-> (dimindex N = 1 -> r < 0 \/ (s < 0 \/ ~ distance N (a,b) = abs_SNo (r + - s) /\ ~ distance N (a,b) = r + s)) /\ (~ dimindex N = 1 -> r < 0 \/ (s < 0 \/ (distance N (a,b) < abs_SNo (r + - s) \/ r + s < distance N (a,b))))

items.name: INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s t c= A, s :/\: t c= s) /\ forall s t c= A, t :/\: s c= s

items.name: INTER_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall s c= Power A, forall t c= A, Union s :/\: t = Union {x :/\: t | x :e Power A, x :e s}) /\ forall s c= Power A, forall t c= A, t :/\: Union s = Union {t :/\: x | x :e Power A, x :e s}

items.name: INTER_UNIONS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= Power A, (forall x y :e s :\/: t, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) -> Union s :/\: Union t = Union (s :/\: t)

items.name: INTER_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, A :/\: s = s) /\ forall s c= A, s :/\: A = s

items.name: INT_2_DIVIDES_ADD
items.statement: forall m n :e int, divides_int 2 (m + n) <-> (divides_int 2 m <-> divides_int 2 n)

items.name: INT_2_DIVIDES_MUL
items.statement: forall m n :e int, divides_int 2 (m * n) <-> divides_int 2 m \/ divides_int 2 n

items.name: INT_2_DIVIDES_POW
items.statement: forall n :e int, forall k :e omega, divides_int 2 (n ^ k) <-> divides_int 2 n /\ ~ k = 0

items.name: INT_2_DIVIDES_SUB
items.statement: forall m n :e int, divides_int 2 (m + - n) <-> (divides_int 2 m <-> divides_int 2 n)

items.name: INT_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo x = if 0 <= x then x else - x

items.name: INT_ABS_0
items.statement: abs_SNo 0 = 0

items.name: INT_ABS_1
items.statement: abs_SNo 1 = 1

items.name: INT_ABS_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_ABS_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall x y d :e int, 0 < d /\ (x + - d < y /\ y < x + d) <-> abs_SNo (y + - x) < d

items.name: INT_ABS_BETWEEN1
items.statement: forall x y z :e int, x < z /\ abs_SNo (y + - x) < z + - x -> y < z

items.name: INT_ABS_BETWEEN2
items.statement: forall x0 x y0 y :e int, x0 < y0 /\ (2 * abs_SNo (x + - x0) < y0 + - x0 /\ 2 * abs_SNo (y + - y0) < y0 + - x0) -> x < y

items.name: INT_ABS_BOUND
items.statement: forall x y d :e int, abs_SNo (x + - y) < d -> y < x + d

items.name: INT_ABS_BOUNDS
items.statement: forall x k :e int, abs_SNo x <= k <-> - k <= x /\ x <= k

items.name: INT_ABS_CASES
items.statement: forall x :e int, x = 0 \/ 0 < abs_SNo x

items.name: INT_ABS_CIRCLE
