items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (a :e s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N (fun x0:set => f x0) (f' x) (at N x)) /\ (~ det N (matrix N N (f' a)) = 0 /\ (forall h :e R :^: idx N, continuous N (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => f' x h) (at N a))))) -> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), exists g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, g' x y :e R :^: idx N) /\ (open N t /\ (a :e t /\ (t c= s /\ (open N u /\ (f a :e u /\ (homeomorphism N N (t,u) (f,g) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> has_derivative N N (fun x0:set => f x0) (f' x) (at N x) /\ ((forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f' x (g' (f x) x0) = x0) /\ forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, g' (f x) (f' x x0) = x0)) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e u -> has_derivative N N (fun x:set => g x) (g' y) (at N y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' (g y) (g' y x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, g' y (f' (g y) x) = x)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ (forall h :e R :^: idx N, continuous N (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => f' y h) (at N x)) -> forall h :e R :^: idx N, continuous N (R :^: idx N) (fun z:set => g' z h) (at N (f x))))))))))

items.name: INVERSE_FUNCTION_THEOREM_GLOBAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (simply_connected N t /\ ((s = Empty -> t = Empty) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e c}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N (fun x0:set => f x0) (f' x) (at N x) /\ ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0))))) -> exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), exists g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, g' x y :e R :^: idx N) /\ (homeomorphism N N (s,t) (f,g) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> has_derivative N N (fun x:set => g x) (g' y) (at N y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' (g y) (g' y x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, g' y (f' (g y) x) = x)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f' x (g' (f x) x0) = x0) /\ forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, g' (f x) (f' x x0) = x0))

items.name: INVERSE_FUNCTION_THEOREM_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s p c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, subspace N p /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) p /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= p /\ (a :e s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N (fun x0:set => f x0) (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) p) /\ {f' x x0 | x0 :e p} = p)))) -> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), exists g':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, g' x y :e R :^: idx N) /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) p /\ (a :e t /\ (t c= s /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) p /\ (f a :e u /\ (homeomorphism N N (t,u) (f,g) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> has_derivative N N (fun x0:set => f x0) (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) p) /\ forall h :e R :^: idx N, h :e p -> f' x (g' (f x) h) = h /\ g' (f x) (f' x h) = h) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e u -> has_derivative N N (fun x:set => g x) (g' y) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N y) p) /\ forall h :e R :^: idx N, h :e p -> f' (g y) (g' y h) = h /\ g' y (f' (g y) h) = h)))))))

items.name: INVERSE_I
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, inverse A A (fun x:set => x) x = x

items.name: INVERSE_LIPSCHITZ_CONVEX_SPHERICAL_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s) -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e relative_frontier N s /\ y :e relative_frontier N s -> B * distance N (x,y) <= distance N (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N x)) x,vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N y)) y)

items.name: INVERSE_LIPSCHITZ_CONVEX_SPHERICAL_PROJECTION_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r R0 :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (0 < r /\ (vec N 0 :e s /\ (ball N (vec N 0,r) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s c= relative_interior N s /\ (s c= cball N (vec N 0,R0) /\ (x :e relative_frontier N s /\ y :e relative_frontier N s))))) -> r :/: R0 ^ 2 * distance N (x,y) <= distance N (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N x)) x,vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N y)) y)

items.name: INVERSE_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b x :e A, inverse A A (fun x0:set => swap A (a,b) x0) x = swap A (a,b) x

items.name: INVERSE_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, f (g x) = x) /\ (forall x :e A, g (f x) = x) -> forall x :e A, inverse A A f x = g x

items.name: INVERSE_UNIQUE_o
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, f (g x) = x) /\ (forall x :e B, g (f x) = x) -> forall x :e A, inverse A B f x = g x

items.name: INVERTIBLE_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall c :e R, invertible M N (matrix_cmul M N c A) <-> ~ c = 0 /\ invertible M N A

items.name: INVERTIBLE_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N (cofactor N A) <-> dimindex N = 1 \/ invertible N N A

items.name: INVERTIBLE_COVARIANCE_RANK
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, invertible N N (matrix_mul N M N (transp M N A) A) <-> rank N M A = dimindex N

items.name: INVERTIBLE_DET_NZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A <-> ~ det N A = 0

items.name: INVERTIBLE_DIAGONAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall D :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N D -> (invertible N N D <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> ~ D i i = 0)

items.name: INVERTIBLE_EIGENVALUES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A <-> forall c :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v /\ ~ v = vec N 0 -> ~ c = 0

items.name: INVERTIBLE_EQ_INJECTIVE_AND_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, invertible N M m <-> (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M m x = matrix_vector_mul N M m y -> x = y) /\ {matrix_vector_mul N M m x | x :e R :^: idx M} = R :^: idx N

items.name: INVERTIBLE_FIXPOINT_PROPERTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, i x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl N M i t /\ ({i x | x :e t} c= s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N r s /\ ({r x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> r (i y) = y)))) -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl M M f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= s -> exists x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ f x = x) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl N N g t /\ {g x | x :e t} c= t -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ g y = y

items.name: INVERTIBLE_I
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> invertible N N (mat N N 1)

items.name: INVERTIBLE_IMP_SQUARE_MATRIX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, invertible M N A -> dimindex M = dimindex N

items.name: INVERTIBLE_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A <-> exists B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N B A = mat N N 1

items.name: INVERTIBLE_MAT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e omega, invertible N N (mat N N a) <-> ~ a = 0

items.name: INVERTIBLE_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, invertible M N (matrix_inv M N A) <-> invertible N M A

items.name: INVERTIBLE_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N (matrix_mul N N N A B) <-> invertible N N A /\ invertible N N B

items.name: INVERTIBLE_NEARBY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_sub N N B A) x) < e0 -> invertible N N B

items.name: INVERTIBLE_NEARBY_ONORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A /\ onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_sub N N B A) x) < recip_SNo (onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_inv N N A) x)) -> invertible N N B

items.name: INVERTIBLE_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, invertible M N (matrix_neg M N A) <-> invertible M N A

items.name: INVERTIBLE_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A <-> exists B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A B = mat N N 1

items.name: INVERTIBLE_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, invertible N M (transp M N A) <-> invertible M N A

items.name: INVOLUTION_EVEN_FIXPOINTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e s /\ f (f x) = x) -> (even_nat (finite_cardinality {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = x}) <-> even_nat (finite_cardinality s))

items.name: INVOLUTION_EVEN_NOFIXPOINTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e s /\ (~ f x = x /\ f (f x) = x)) -> even_nat (finite_cardinality s)

items.name: INVOLUTION_IMP_HOMEOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N N (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f (f x) = x)) -> homeomorphism N N (s,s) (f,f)

items.name: INVOLUTION_IMP_HOMEOMORPHISM_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall u s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N N (fun x:set => f x) u /\ (s :\/: {f x | x :e s} c= u /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f (f x) = x)) -> homeomorphism N N (s,{f x | x :e s}) (f,f)

items.name: INVOLUTION_MOVES_2_IS_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p (p x) = x) /\ finite_cardinality {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ p x = x} = 2)) -> exists a b :e A, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (~ a = b /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x = swap A (a,b) x))

items.name: INVOLUTION_SIZE_2_IS_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p (p x) = x) /\ equip {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ p x = x} 2) -> exists a b :e A, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (~ a = b /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x = swap A (a,b) x))

items.name: IN_AFFINE_ADD_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, affine N s /\ (a :e s /\ vector_add N a x :e s) -> vector_add N a (vector_mul N d x) :e s

items.name: IN_AFFINE_ADD_MUL_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ z :e s)) -> vector_add N x (vector_mul N a (vector_sub N y z)) :e s

items.name: IN_AFFINE_HULL_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx M) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx M) | affine M x0} s -> f x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: IN_AFFINE_MUL_DIFF_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ z :e s)) -> vector_add N (vector_mul N a (vector_sub N x y)) z :e s

items.name: IN_AFFINE_SUB_MUL_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ z :e s)) -> vector_sub N x (vector_mul N a (vector_sub N y z)) :e s

items.name: IN_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, y :e ball A (x,e0) <-> distance A (x,y) < e0

items.name: IN_BALL_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, x :e ball A (vec A 0,e0) <-> vector_norm A x < e0

items.name: IN_CARD_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, Inj0 x :e s :+: t <-> x :e s) /\ forall y :e B, Inj1 y :e s :+: t <-> y :e t

items.name: IN_CARD_MUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, (x,y) :e s :*: t <-> x :e s /\ y :e t

items.name: IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall x :e A :^: K, x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> (forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e k -> x x0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> x i :e s i

items.name: IN_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, y :e cball A (x,e0) <-> distance A (x,y) <= e0

items.name: IN_CBALL_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, x :e cball A (vec A 0,e0) <-> vector_norm A x <= e0

items.name: IN_CLOSURE_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ open N s -> (x :e closure N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s y x0} <-> x :e {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s y x0})

items.name: IN_CLOSURE_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closure N (s :\: {x}) <-> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: IN_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e closure_of A top s <-> x :e topspace A top /\ forall t c= A, x :e t /\ t :e top -> exists y :e A, y :e s /\ y :e t

items.name: IN_CLOSURE_OF_IMP_SUBSET_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall t c= A, x :e mspace A m /\ (mbounded A m t /\ x :e closure_of A (mtopology A m) t) -> t c= mcball A m (x,mdiameter A m t)

items.name: IN_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, s :e components N u <-> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u /\ forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, x0 :e s <-> connected_component N u x x0

items.name: IN_COMPONENTS_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx A, c :e components A s -> connected A c

items.name: IN_COMPONENTS_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s <-> ~ c = Empty /\ (c c= s /\ (connected N c /\ forall c' c= R :^: idx N, ~ c' = Empty /\ (c c= c' /\ (c' c= s /\ connected N c')) -> c' = c))

items.name: IN_COMPONENTS_MAXIMAL_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s <-> ~ c = Empty /\ (c c= s /\ (connected N c /\ forall c' c= R :^: idx N, ~ c :/\: c' = Empty /\ (c' c= s /\ connected N c') -> c' c= c))

items.name: IN_COMPONENTS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx A, c :e components A s -> ~ c = Empty

items.name: IN_COMPONENTS_SELF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e components N s <-> connected N s /\ ~ s = Empty

items.name: IN_COMPONENTS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx A, c :e components A s -> c c= s

items.name: IN_COMPONENTS_UNIONS_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N s -> s :\: c = Union (components N s :\: {c})

items.name: IN_CONVEX_HULL_EXCHANGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s -> exists b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} (SetAdjoin (s :\: {b}) a)

items.name: IN_CONVEX_HULL_EXCHANGE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t t' c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ (a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ (t c= s /\ (t' c= s /\ (x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} (SetAdjoin t a) /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} (SetAdjoin t' a))))) -> x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} (SetAdjoin (t :/\: t') a)

items.name: IN_CONVEX_HULL_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e hull (R :^: idx 1) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx 1) | convex 1 x0} s <-> exists a b :e R :^: idx 1, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: IN_CONVEX_HULL_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ x :e hull (R :^: idx M) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx M) | convex M x0} s -> f x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: IN_CONVEX_HULL_SEGMENT_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e hull (R :^: idx 1) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx 1) | convex 1 x0} s <-> exists a b :e R :^: idx 1, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ x :e closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: IN_CONVEX_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a b :e R :^: idx A, forall u :e R, convex A s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (0 <= u /\ u <= 1))) -> vector_add A (vector_mul A (1 + - u) a) (vector_mul A u b) :e s

items.name: IN_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (x,y) :e s :*: t <-> x :e s /\ y :e t

items.name: IN_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, x :e s :\: {y} <-> x :e s /\ ~ x = y

items.name: IN_DELETE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall x x' :e A, (x :e s <-> x' :e s) <-> (x :e s :\: {x'} <-> x' :e s :\: {x})

items.name: IN_DERIVED_SET_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e derived_set_of A top s <-> x :e topspace A top /\ forall t c= A, x :e t /\ t :e top -> exists y :e A, ~ y = x /\ (y :e s /\ y :e t)

items.name: IN_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s :\: t <-> x :e s /\ ~ x :e t

items.name: IN_DIMINDEX_SWAP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m n j :e omega, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)))) -> 1 <= swap omega (m,n) j /\ swap omega (m,n) j <= dimindex N

items.name: IN_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :/\: t = Empty <-> ~ exists x :e A, x :e s /\ x :e t

items.name: IN_ELIM_PAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, (a,b) :e (\/_ x :e A, {(x,y) | y :e B, P x y}) <-> P a b

items.name: IN_ELIM_PASTECART_THM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A :^: idx M, forall b :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N a b :e (\/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N, P x y}) <-> P a b

items.name: IN_ELIM_QUAD_THM
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, (forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, forall d :e D, (a,(b,(c,d))) :e (\/_ w :e A, \/_ x :e B, \/_ y :e C, {(w,(x,(y,z))) | z :e D, P w x y z}) <-> P a b c d) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, forall d :e D, ((a,b),(c,d)) :e (\/_ w :e A, \/_ x :e B, \/_ y :e C, {((w,x),(y,z)) | z :e D, P w x y z}) <-> P a b c d) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, forall d :e D, (((a,b),c),d) :e (\/_ w :e A, \/_ x :e B, \/_ y :e C, {(((w,x),y),z) | z :e D, P w x y z}) <-> P a b c d)

items.name: IN_ELIM_TRIPLE_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, (forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, (a,(b,c)) :e (\/_ x :e A, \/_ y :e B, {(x,(y,z)) | z :e C, P x y z}) <-> P a b c) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall c :e C, ((a,b),c) :e (\/_ x :e A, \/_ y :e B, {((x,y),z) | z :e C, P x y z}) <-> P a b c

items.name: IN_EPIGRAPH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R, pastecart A 1 x (lift y) :e epigraph A s f <-> x :e s /\ f x <= y

items.name: IN_EXTENSIONAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f :e B :^: A, f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} <-> forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: IN_EXTENSIONAL_UNDEFINED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, f :e {x0 :e B :^: A | forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> x0 x = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: IN_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> exists y :e A, l x y \/ l y x

items.name: IN_FROM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m :e from n <-> n <= m

items.name: IN_FRONTIER_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N + 1 /\ x :e s) -> x :e frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s)

items.name: IN_GROUP_CENTRALIZER_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_id A G :e group_centralizer A G s

items.name: IN_GROUP_NORMALIZER_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_id A G :e group_normalizer A G s

items.name: IN_GROUP_ORBIT
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, y :e {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} <-> x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ exists g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G /\ a g x = y)

items.name: IN_GROUP_ORBIT_SELF
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s -> x :e {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0}

items.name: IN_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, {x :e A | x :e s} = s

items.name: IN_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall y :e B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (y :e {f x | x :e s} <-> exists x :e A, y = f x /\ x :e s)

items.name: IN_IMAGE_DROPOUT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> (x :e {dropout N M k x0 | x0 :e s} <-> exists t :e R, pushin N R M k t x :e s)

items.name: IN_IMAGE_GROUP_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ s c= group_carrier A G) -> (x :e {group_conjugation A G y x0 | x0 :e s} <-> group_conjugation A G (group_inv A G y) x :e s)

items.name: IN_IMAGE_LIFT_DROP
items.statement: (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R, x :e {lift x0 | x0 :e s} <-> drop x :e s) /\ forall x :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, x :e {drop x0 | x0 :e s} <-> lift x :e s

items.name: IN_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, x :e SetAdjoin s y <-> x = y \/ x :e s

items.name: IN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t <-> x :e s /\ x :e t

items.name: IN_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e interior A s <-> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ ball A (x,e0) c= s

items.name: IN_INTERIOR_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e interior A s <-> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ cball A (x,e0) c= s

items.name: IN_INTERIOR_CLOSURE_CONVEX_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e interior N s /\ b :e closure N s) -> open_segment N (a,b) c= interior N s

items.name: IN_INTERIOR_CLOSURE_CONVEX_SHRINK
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, forall x c :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (c :e interior N s /\ (x :e closure N s /\ (0 < e0 /\ e0 <= 1))) -> vector_sub N x (vector_mul N e0 (vector_sub N x c)) :e interior N s

items.name: IN_INTERIOR_CONVEX_SHRINK
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, forall x c :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (c :e interior N s /\ (x :e s /\ (0 < e0 /\ e0 <= 1))) -> vector_sub N x (vector_mul N e0 (vector_sub N x c)) :e interior N s

items.name: IN_INTERIOR_EVENTUALLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e interior N s <-> a :e s /\ eventually (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s} (at N a)

items.name: IN_INTERIOR_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (linear N M g /\ ((forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f (g x0) = x0) /\ x :e interior M s)) -> f x :e interior N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: IN_INTERIOR_OF_MBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e interior_of A (mtopology A m) s <-> x :e mspace A m /\ exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ mball A m (x,e0) c= s

items.name: IN_INTERIOR_OF_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e interior_of A (mtopology A m) s <-> x :e mspace A m /\ exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ mcball A m (x,e0) c= s

items.name: IN_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= Power A, forall x :e A, x :e {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} <-> forall t c= A, t :e s -> x :e t

items.name: IN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e open_interval N (a,b) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < x i /\ x i < b i) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= x i /\ x i <= b i

items.name: IN_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall a b x :e R :^: idx 1, (x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> drop a <= drop x /\ drop x <= drop b) /\ (x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) <-> drop a < drop x /\ drop x < drop b)

items.name: IN_INTERVAL_INTERVAL_BIJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b u v x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) = Empty -> interval_bij N (a,b) (u,v) x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)

items.name: IN_INTERVAL_REFLECT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a b x :e R :^: idx A, vector_neg A x :e closed_interval A (seq_cons (vector_neg A b,vector_neg A a) seq_nil) <-> x :e closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b x :e R :^: idx B, vector_neg B x :e open_interval B (vector_neg B b,vector_neg B a) <-> x :e open_interval B (a,b)

items.name: IN_LEFT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x a :e A, h c= group_carrier A G /\ (a :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e group_carrier A G) -> (x :e left_coset_hl A G a h <-> group_mul A G (group_inv A G a) x :e h)

items.name: IN_LEFT_COSET_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, h c= group_carrier A G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> (x :e left_coset_hl A G (group_inv A G y) h <-> group_mul A G y x :e h)

items.name: IN_LEFT_COSET_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> x :e left_coset_hl A G x h

items.name: IN_MBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, forall r :e R, y :e mball A m (x,r) <-> x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) < r)

items.name: IN_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, forall y :e A, y :e mcball A m (x,r) <-> x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) <= r)

items.name: IN_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, p :e {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} <-> m <= p /\ p <= n

items.name: IN_NUMSEG_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m :e {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} <-> m <= n

items.name: IN_OPEN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, x :e open_segment N (a,b) <-> x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (~ x = a /\ ~ x = b)

items.name: IN_OPEN_SEGMENT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, x :e open_segment N (a,b) <-> x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (~ x = a /\ (~ x = b /\ ~ a = b))

items.name: IN_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s c= A :^: K, forall k c= K, forall z :e A :^: K, z :e closure_of (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) s -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> z i :e closure_of A (tops i) {x i | x :e s}

items.name: IN_PROD_TOPOLOGY_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall s c= A :*: B, forall z :e A :*: B, z :e closure_of (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) s -> z 0 :e closure_of A top1 {x 0 | x :e s} /\ z 1 :e closure_of B top2 {x 1 | x :e s}

items.name: IN_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b x :e R, (x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> a <= x /\ x <= b) /\ (x :e open_real_interval (a,b) <-> a < x /\ x < b)

items.name: IN_REAL_INTERVAL_REFLECT
items.statement: (forall a b x :e R, - x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (- b,- a) seq_nil) <-> x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b x :e R, - x :e open_real_interval (- b,- a) <-> x :e open_real_interval (a,b)

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, x :e relative_interior N s <-> x :e s /\ exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ ball N (x,e0) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s c= s

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, x :e relative_interior N s <-> x :e s /\ exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ cball N (x,e0) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s c= s

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CLOSURE_CONVEX_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e relative_interior N s /\ b :e closure N s) -> open_segment N (a,b) c= relative_interior N s

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CLOSURE_CONVEX_SHRINK
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, forall x c :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (c :e relative_interior N s /\ (x :e closure N s /\ (0 < e0 /\ e0 <= 1))) -> vector_sub N x (vector_mul N e0 (vector_sub N x c)) :e relative_interior N s

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONVEX_SHRINK
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, forall x c :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (c :e relative_interior N s /\ (x :e s /\ (0 < e0 /\ e0 <= 1))) -> vector_sub N x (vector_mul N e0 (vector_sub N x c)) :e relative_interior N s

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_IN_OPEN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (x :e relative_interior N s /\ (a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s /\ ~ x = a)) -> exists b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s /\ x :e open_segment N (a,b)

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_IN_OPEN_SEGMENT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (x :e relative_interior N s <-> ~ s = Empty /\ forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ ~ a = x -> exists b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s /\ x :e open_segment N (a,b))

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_IN_OPEN_SEGMENT_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (x :e relative_interior N s /\ (a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s /\ ~ x = a)) -> exists b :e R :^: idx N, b :e relative_interior N s /\ x :e open_segment N (a,b)

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_OF_FACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ x :e s -> exists f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ x :e relative_interior N f

items.name: IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR_OF_UNIQUE_FACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ x :e s -> exists f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ x :e relative_interior N f /\ forall y c= R :^: idx N, face_of N y s /\ x :e relative_interior N y -> y = f

items.name: IN_REST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, x :e s :\: {choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)} <-> x :e s /\ ~ x = choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)

items.name: IN_RIGHT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x a :e A, h c= group_carrier A G /\ (a :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e group_carrier A G) -> (x :e right_coset_hl A G h a <-> group_mul A G x (group_inv A G a) :e h)

items.name: IN_RIGHT_COSET_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, h c= group_carrier A G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> (x :e right_coset_hl A G h (group_inv A G y) <-> group_mul A G x y :e h)

items.name: IN_RIGHT_COSET_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> x :e right_coset_hl A G h x

items.name: IN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, (x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> (exists u :e R, 0 <= u /\ (u <= 1 /\ x = vector_add N (vector_mul N (1 + - u) a) (vector_mul N u b)))) /\ (x :e open_segment N (a,b) <-> ~ a = b /\ exists u :e R, 0 < u /\ (u < 1 /\ x = vector_add N (vector_mul N (1 + - u) a) (vector_mul N u b)))

items.name: IN_SEGMENT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> (if a i <= b i then a i else b i) <= x i /\ x i <= if a i <= b i then b i else a i

items.name: IN_SET_OF_LIST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, x :e seq_set l <-> seq_mem x l

items.name: IN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, x :e {y} <-> x = y

items.name: IN_SPAN_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, a :e span A s /\ ~ a :e span A (s :\: {b}) -> b :e span A (SetAdjoin (s :\: {b}) a)

items.name: IN_SPAN_IMAGE_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= omega, x :e span N {basis N x0 | x0 :e s} <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ ~ i :e s) -> x i = 0

items.name: IN_SPAN_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, a :e span N (SetAdjoin s b) /\ ~ a :e span N s -> b :e span N (SetAdjoin s a)

items.name: IN_SPHERE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, y :e sphere A (x,e0) <-> distance A (x,y) = e0

items.name: IN_SPHERE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, x :e sphere A (vec A 0,e0) <-> vector_norm A x = e0

items.name: IN_SUBGROUP_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a x :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (a :e h /\ x :e h) -> group_conjugation A G a x :e h

items.name: IN_SUBGROUP_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e h /\ y :e h) -> group_div A G x y :e h

items.name: IN_SUBGROUP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> group_id A G :e h

items.name: IN_SUBGROUP_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ x :e h -> group_inv A G x :e h

items.name: IN_SUBGROUP_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e h /\ y :e h) -> group_mul A G x y :e h

items.name: IN_SUBGROUP_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, subgroup_of A h G /\ x :e h -> group_pow A G x n :e h

items.name: IN_SUBGROUP_ZPOW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, forall n :e int, subgroup_of A h G /\ x :e h -> group_zpow A G x n :e h

items.name: IN_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall s c= A, x :e {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} <-> x :e s /\ ~ f x = neutral_of B op

items.name: IN_TRANSLATION_GALOIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, b :e {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> vector_sub N b a :e s

items.name: IN_TRANSLATION_GALOIS_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N a b :e s <-> b :e {vector_add N (vector_neg N a) x | x :e s}

items.name: IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s :\/: t <-> x :e s \/ x :e t

items.name: IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= Power A, forall x :e A, x :e Union s <-> exists t c= A, t :e s /\ x :e t

items.name: IN_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x :e A

items.name: IPRODUCT_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x)) = abs_SNo (finprod s f)

items.name: IPRODUCT_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> finprod Empty f = 1) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e int) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finprod (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finprod s f else f x * finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m * finprod {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> (forall m :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 1) /\ forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * f (ordsucc n) else finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f * f n

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, P 1 /\ ((forall x y :e int, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: IPRODUCT_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e int, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: IPRODUCT_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e int, forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => c) = c ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: IPRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c :e int, forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => c) = c ^ minus_nat (n + 1) m

items.name: IPRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall c :e int, forall n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun x:set => c) = c ^ n

items.name: IPRODUCT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> f a * finprod (s :\: {a}) f = finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e int, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finprod s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 1) = if a :e s then b else 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finprod s f = finprod s g

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finprod s f = 0 <-> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = 0)

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 <-> exists x :e omega, m <= x /\ (x <= n /\ f x = 0)

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 1) -> finprod s f = 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_1_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 1) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: IPRODUCT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= B, (forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finprod {f x | x :e s} g = finprod s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: IPRODUCT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finprod s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x /\ f x <= g x) -> finprod s f <= finprod s g

items.name: IPRODUCT_LE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x /\ f x <= 1) -> finprod s f <= 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> 0 <= f i /\ f i <= g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: IPRODUCT_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: IPRODUCT_MUL_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 1} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 1} -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: IPRODUCT_MUL_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: IPRODUCT_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ finite_cardinality s * finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ minus_nat (n + 1) m * finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ n * finprod (idx_n n) f

items.name: IPRODUCT_OFFSET
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m p :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: IPRODUCT_ONE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finprod s (fun n:set => 1) = 1

items.name: IPRODUCT_PAIR
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (2 * i) * f (2 * i + 1))

items.name: IPRODUCT_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_POS_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_POS_LT_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: IPRODUCT_REFLECT
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e int) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then 1 else finprod {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: IPRODUCT_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, R0 1 1 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e int, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: IPRODUCT_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e int) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e int, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: IPRODUCT_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun i:set => if i :e s then f i else 1) = finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> finprod {i :e A | i :e s /\ P i} f = finprod s (fun i:set => if P i then f i else 1)

items.name: IPRODUCT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall x :e A, finprod {x} f = f x

items.name: IPRODUCT_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e int) -> forall n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: IPRODUCT_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 1) -> finprod v f = finprod u f

items.name: IPRODUCT_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, finprod {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} f = finprod s f

items.name: IPRODUCT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finprod (s :\/: t) f = finprod s f * finprod t f

items.name: IPRODUCT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e int) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} c= s -> finprod s f = finprod A f

items.name: IRRATIONAL_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists y :e R, ~ y :e rational /\ abs_SNo (y + - x) < e0

items.name: IRRATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_ABOVE
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists q :e R, ~ q :e rational /\ (x < q /\ q < x + e0)

items.name: IRRATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_BELOW
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists q :e R, ~ q :e rational /\ (x + - e0 < q /\ q < x)

items.name: IRRATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists a b :e R, ~ a :e rational /\ (~ b :e rational /\ (a < x /\ (x < b /\ abs_SNo (b + - a) < e0)))

items.name: IRRATIONAL_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a < b -> exists q :e R, ~ q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)

items.name: IRRATIONAL_BETWEEN_EQ
items.statement: forall a b :e R, (exists q :e R, ~ q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)) <-> a < b

items.name: ISO
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x :e B, f (g x) = x) /\ (forall y :e A, g (f y) = y) <-> (forall x :e B, f (g x) = x) /\ forall y :e A, g (f y) = y)

items.name: ISOMETRIC_HOMEOMORPHISM_AFFINE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, affine M s /\ (affine N t /\ aff_dim M s = aff_dim N t) -> exists f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ y :e t -> distance M (g x,g y) = distance N (x,y))

items.name: ISOMETRIES_SUBSPACES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace M s /\ (subspace N t /\ dim M s = dim N t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear M N f /\ (linear N M g /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ({g x | x :e t} = s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> vector_norm M (g y) = vector_norm N y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> f (g y) = y)))))))

items.name: ISOMETRY_IMP_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) -> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear M N h /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x = vector_add N (f (vec M 0)) (h x))

items.name: ISOMETRY_IMP_EMBEDDING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) -> exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g)

items.name: ISOMETRY_IMP_EMBEDDING_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m' :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> {f x | x :e mspace A m} c= mspace B m' /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> mdist B m' (f x,f y) = mdist A m (x,y)) -> embedding_map A B (mtopology A m,mtopology B m') f

items.name: ISOMETRY_IMP_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m' :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> {f x | x :e mspace A m} = mspace B m' /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> mdist B m' (f x,f y) = mdist A m (x,y)) -> homeomorphic_map A B (mtopology A m,mtopology B m') f

items.name: ISOMETRY_IMP_HOMEOMORPHISM_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (f x,f y) = distance N (x,y))) -> exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism N N (s,s) (f,g)

items.name: ISOMETRY_IMP_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) /\ u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t

items.name: ISOMETRY_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> f (vec M 0) = vec N 0 /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) -> linear M N f

items.name: ISOMETRY_ON_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: ISOMETRY_SPHERE_EXTEND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x = 1 -> vector_norm N (f x) = 1) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x = 1 /\ vector_norm N y = 1 -> distance N (f x,f y) = distance N (x,y)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x = 1 -> g x = f x)

items.name: ISOMETRY_SUBSET_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, subspace M s /\ (subspace N t /\ dim M s <= dim N t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear M N f /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x))

items.name: ISOMETRY_SUBSPACES

items.name: ISOMETRY_UNIV_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ dimindex M = dim N s -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear M N f /\ ({f x | x :e R :^: idx M} = s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x))

items.name: ISOMETRY_UNIV_SUPERSET_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (dim N s <= dimindex M /\ dimindex M <= dimindex N) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear M N f /\ (s c= {f x | x :e R :^: idx M} /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x))

items.name: ISOMORPHIC_ABELIAN_SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h :e Power A :^: K, abelian_group_hl A G /\ ((forall i :e K, i :e k -> subgroup_of A (h i) G) /\ (subgroup_generated A G (Union {h i | i :e K, i :e k}) = G /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> h i :/\: group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G (Union {h j | j :e K, j :e k :\: {i}})) = {group_id A G}))) -> isomorphic_group (A :^: K) A (sum_group A K k (fun i:set => subgroup_generated A G (h i))) G

items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h :e Power A :^: K, (forall i :e K, i :e k -> subgroup_of A (h i) G) /\ ((forall x y :e k, x <> y -> forall x0 y0 :e A, x0 :e h x /\ y0 :e h y -> group_mul A G x0 y0 = group_mul A G y0 x0) /\ (subgroup_generated A G (Union {h i | i :e K, i :e k}) = G /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> h i :/\: group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G (Union {h j | j :e K, j :e k :\: {i}})) = {group_id A G}))) -> isomorphic_group (A :^: K) A (sum_group A K k (fun i:set => subgroup_generated A G (h i))) G

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = neutral_of B op) -> iterate_op B op s f = neutral_of B op

items.name: ITERATE_EXPAND_CASES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, iterate_op B op s f = if finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} then iterate_op B op {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} f else neutral_of B op

items.name: ITERATE_GCD_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall K:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall i :e K, finite k /\ i :e k -> divides_nat (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f) (f i)

items.name: ITERATE_GCD_DIVIDES_EQ
items.statement: forall K:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall i :e K, i :e k -> (divides_nat (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f) (f i) <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 0} \/ f i = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_GCD_EQ_0
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> finite k -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f = 0 <-> forall j :e K, j :e k -> f j = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_GCD_EQ_0_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) k f = 0 <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 0} -> forall j :e K, j :e k -> f j = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> iterate_op C op {f x | x :e s} g = iterate_op C op s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: ITERATE_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> iterate_op C op s g = iterate_op C op {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => iterate_op C op {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)

items.name: ITERATE_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ f x = f y)) -> g (f x) = neutral_of C op) -> iterate_op C op {f x | x :e s} g = iterate_op C op s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: ITERATE_INCL_EXCL
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> finite s /\ finite t -> op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op t f) = op (iterate_op B op (s :\/: t) f) (iterate_op B op (s :/\: t) f)

items.name: ITERATE_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = iterate_op B op s f

items.name: ITERATE_ITERATE_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x x y :e C) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> finite (t i)) -> iterate_op C op s (fun i:set => iterate_op C op (t i) (x i)) = iterate_op C op (\/_ i :e A, {(i,j) | j :e B, i :e s /\ j :e t i}) (fun p:set => x (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall n :e omega, finite k -> (divides_nat (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) n <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> divides_nat (f i) n)

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_DIVIDES_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall n :e omega, divides_nat (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) n <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> divides_nat (f i) n

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> finite k -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f = 0 <-> exists j :e K, j :e k /\ f j = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_0_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f = 0 <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} /\ exists j :e K, j :e k /\ f j = 0)

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_1
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> finite k -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f = 1 <-> forall j :e K, j :e k -> f j = 1)

items.name: ITERATE_LCM_EQ_1_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f = 1 <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} -> forall j :e K, j :e k -> f j = 1)

items.name: ITERATE_NONZERO_IMAGE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> forall a :e A, (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) /\ (finite s /\ (g a = neutral_of C op /\ (forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (f x = f y /\ ~ x = y)) -> g (f x) = neutral_of C op))) -> iterate_op C op {f x | x :e B, x :e s /\ ~ f x = a} g = iterate_op C op s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: ITERATE_OP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => op (f x) (g x)) = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_OP_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} /\ finite {x :e s | g x <> neutral_of B op} -> iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => op (f x) (g x)) = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_PAIR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall m n :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => op (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1)))

items.name: ITERATE_PERMUTE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> iterate_op B op s f = iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: ITERATE_REFLECT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> forall m n :e omega, iterate_op A op {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then neutral_of A op else iterate_op A op {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: ITERATE_RELATED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, R0 (neutral_of B op) (neutral_of B op) /\ (forall x1 y1 x2 y2 :e B, R0 x1 x2 /\ R0 y1 y2 -> R0 (op x1 y1) (op x2 y2)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)) -> R0 (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x1 y1 x2 y2 :e B, R0 x1 x2 /\ R0 y1 y2 -> R0 (op x1 y1) (op x2 y2)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x))) -> R0 (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op s g)

items.name: ITERATE_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> iterate_op B op {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f = iterate_op B op s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else neutral_of B op)

items.name: ITERATE_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, iterate_op B op {x} f = f x

items.name: ITERATE_SOME
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op :e B :^: B :^: B, (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B (fun a:set => fun b:set => op a b)) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> iterate_op (1 :+: B) (fun a:set => fun b:set => lifted B B op a b) s (fun x:set => Inj1 (f x)) = Inj1 (iterate_op B (fun a:set => fun b:set => op a b) s f)

items.name: ITERATE_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = neutral_of B op) -> iterate_op B op v f = iterate_op B op u f

items.name: ITERATE_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, iterate_op B op {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} f = iterate_op B op s f

items.name: ITERATE_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall x y :e C, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e C, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e C, op (neutral_of C op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> iterate_op C op s (fun i:set => iterate_op C op t (f i)) = iterate_op C op t (fun j:set => iterate_op C op s (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: ITERATE_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> iterate_op B op (s :\/: t) f = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op t f)

items.name: ITERATE_UNION_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} /\ (finite {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of B op} /\ {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} :/\: {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of B op} = Empty) -> iterate_op B op (s :\/: t) f = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op t f)

items.name: ITERATE_UNION_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t -> f x = neutral_of B op)) -> iterate_op B op (s :\/: t) f = op (iterate_op B op s f) (iterate_op B op t f)

items.name: ITERATE_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> (forall x y :e B, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e B, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e B, op (neutral_of B op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of B op} c= s -> iterate_op B op s f = iterate_op B op A f
