items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_foldr f seq_nil b = b /\ seq_foldr f (seq_cons h t) b = f h (seq_foldr f t b)

items.name: ITLIST2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, f x y z :e C) -> forall b :e C, forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, forall h2 :e B, forall t2 :e finseq B, seq_foldr2 f seq_nil seq_nil b = b /\ seq_foldr2 f (seq_cons h1 t1) (seq_cons h2 t2) b = f h1 h2 (seq_foldr2 f t1 t2 b)

items.name: ITLIST2_DEF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, f x y z :e C) -> forall l2 :e finseq B, forall b :e C, forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, seq_foldr2 f seq_nil l2 b = b /\ seq_foldr2 f (seq_cons h1 t1) l2 b = f h1 (seq_hd l2) (seq_foldr2 f t1 (seq_tl l2) b)

items.name: ITLIST_APPEND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall a :e B, forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_foldr f (seq_append l1 l2) a = seq_foldr f l1 (seq_foldr f l2 a)

items.name: ITLIST_EXTRA
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_foldr f (seq_append l (seq_cons a seq_nil)) b = seq_foldr f l (f a b)

items.name: ITSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, g x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> forall x0 :e B, f x x0 = g x x0) /\ ((forall x y :e A, forall s0 :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s0) = f y (f x s0)) /\ (forall x y :e A, forall s0 :e B, ~ x = y -> g x (g y s0) = g y (g x s0)))) -> set_foldr f s b = set_foldr g s b

items.name: IVT_DECREASING_COMPONENT_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall y :e R, forall k :e omega, drop a <= drop b /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (at 1 x)) /\ (f b k <= y /\ y <= f a k)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ f x k = y

items.name: IVT_DECREASING_COMPONENT_ON_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall y :e R, forall k :e omega, drop a <= drop b /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (f b k <= y /\ y <= f a k)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ f x k = y

items.name: IVT_INCREASING_COMPONENT_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall y :e R, forall k :e omega, drop a <= drop b /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (at 1 x)) /\ (f a k <= y /\ y <= f b k)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ f x k = y

items.name: IVT_INCREASING_COMPONENT_ON_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall y :e R, forall k :e omega, drop a <= drop b /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (f a k <= y /\ y <= f b k)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ f x k = y

items.name: I_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x = x

items.name: JACOBIAN_SIGN_INVARIANCE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (at N x) /\ ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0)) -> (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 < det N (matrix N N (f' x))) \/ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> det N (matrix N N (f' x)) < 0

items.name: JACOBIAN_WORKS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx A), differentiable B A f net0 <-> has_derivative B A f (fun h:set => matrix_vector_mul B A (jacobian A B f net0) h) net0

items.name: JOINABLE_COMPONENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c1 c2 c= R :^: idx A, connected A t /\ (t c= s /\ (c1 :e components A s /\ (c2 :e components A s /\ (~ c1 :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ c2 :/\: t = Empty)))) -> c1 = c2

items.name: JOINABLE_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, connected N t /\ (t c= s /\ (~ {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0} :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s y x0} :/\: t = Empty)) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N s x x0 <-> connected_component N s y x0

items.name: JOINPATHS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A g1 = pathstart A g2 -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, poly_add (R :^: idx A) g1 g2 x = if drop x < 1 :/: 2 then g1 (vector_mul 1 2 x) else g2 (vector_sub 1 (vector_mul 1 2 x) (vec 1 1))

items.name: JOINPATHS_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx A) -> linear A B f -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, poly_add (R :^: idx B) (fun x:set => f (g1 x)) (fun x:set => f (g2 x)) x = f (poly_add (R :^: idx A) g1 g2 x)

items.name: JOINPATHS_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, poly_add (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => vector_add N a (g1 x)) (fun x:set => vector_add N a (g2 x)) x = vector_add N a (poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x)

items.name: JOIN_PATHS_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> p t = p' t) /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> q t = q' t) -> forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> poly_add (R :^: idx N) p q t = poly_add (R :^: idx N) p' q' t

items.name: JOIN_SUBPATHS_MIDDLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, poly_add (R :^: idx N) (fun x0:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) (lift (1 :/: 2)) p x0) (fun x0:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (lift (1 :/: 2)) (vec 1 1) p x0) x = p x

items.name: JORDAN_BROUWER_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (homeomorphic N N s (sphere N (a,r)) /\ t :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) -> frontier N t = s

items.name: JORDAN_BROUWER_NONSEPARATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (homeomorphic N N s (sphere N (a,r)) /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s)) -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t)

items.name: JORDAN_BROUWER_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 0 < r /\ homeomorphic N N s (sphere N (a,r)) -> ~ connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: JORDAN_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> simple_path (idx_n 2) g /\ pathfinish (idx_n 2) g = pathstart (idx_n 2) g -> components (idx_n 2) ((R :^: idx_n 2) :\: path_image (idx_n 2) g) = {inside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) g),outside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) g)}

items.name: JORDAN_CURVE_THEOREM
items.statement: forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, c x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> simple_path (idx_n 2) c /\ pathfinish (idx_n 2) c = pathstart (idx_n 2) c -> exists ins out c= R :^: idx_n 2, ~ ins = Empty /\ (open (idx_n 2) ins /\ (connected (idx_n 2) ins /\ (~ out = Empty /\ (open (idx_n 2) out /\ (connected (idx_n 2) out /\ (bounded_hl (idx_n 2) ins /\ (~ bounded_hl (idx_n 2) out /\ (ins :/\: out = Empty /\ (ins :\/: out = (R :^: idx_n 2) :\: path_image (idx_n 2) c /\ (frontier (idx_n 2) ins = path_image (idx_n 2) c /\ frontier (idx_n 2) out = path_image (idx_n 2) c))))))))))

items.name: JORDAN_CURVE_THEOREM_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ homeomorphic N N s (sphere N (vec N 0,1)) -> exists ins out c= R :^: idx N, ~ ins = Empty /\ (open N ins /\ (connected N ins /\ (~ out = Empty /\ (open N out /\ (connected N out /\ (bounded_hl N ins /\ (~ bounded_hl N out /\ (ins :/\: out = Empty /\ (ins :\/: out = (R :^: idx N) :\: s /\ (frontier N ins = s /\ frontier N out = s))))))))))

items.name: JORDAN_DISCONNECTED
items.statement: forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, c x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> simple_path (idx_n 2) c /\ pathfinish (idx_n 2) c = pathstart (idx_n 2) c -> ~ connected (idx_n 2) ((R :^: idx_n 2) :\: path_image (idx_n 2) c)

items.name: JORDAN_INSIDE_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, c x :e R :^: idx_n 2) -> simple_path (idx_n 2) c /\ pathfinish (idx_n 2) c = pathstart (idx_n 2) c -> ~ inside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c) = Empty /\ (open (idx_n 2) (inside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c)) /\ (connected (idx_n 2) (inside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c)) /\ (~ outside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c) = Empty /\ (open (idx_n 2) (outside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c)) /\ (connected (idx_n 2) (outside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c)) /\ (bounded_hl (idx_n 2) (inside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c)) /\ (~ bounded_hl (idx_n 2) (outside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c)) /\ (inside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c) :/\: outside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c) = Empty /\ (inside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c) :\/: outside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c) = (R :^: idx_n 2) :\: path_image (idx_n 2) c /\ (frontier (idx_n 2) (inside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c)) = path_image (idx_n 2) c /\ frontier (idx_n 2) (outside (idx_n 2) (path_image (idx_n 2) c)) = path_image (idx_n 2) c))))))))))

items.name: JORDAN_INSIDE_OUTSIDE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ homeomorphic N N s (sphere N (vec N 0,1)) -> ~ inside N s = Empty /\ (open N (inside N s) /\ (connected N (inside N s) /\ (~ outside N s = Empty /\ (open N (outside N s) /\ (connected N (outside N s) /\ (bounded_hl N (inside N s) /\ (~ bounded_hl N (outside N s) /\ (inside N s :/\: outside N s = Empty /\ (inside N s :\/: outside N s = (R :^: idx N) :\: s /\ (frontier N (inside N s) = s /\ frontier N (outside N s) = s))))))))))

items.name: JUNG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (if 0 <= dimindex N :/: (2 * dimindex N + 2) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (dimindex N :/: (2 * dimindex N + 2)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- dimindex N :/: (2 * dimindex N + 2))) * diameter N s <= r -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, s c= cball N (a,r)

items.name: KC_SPACE_AS_COMPACTIFICATION_UNIQUE

items.name: KC_SPACE_AS_COMPACTIFICATION_UNIQUE_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, kc_space A top /\ compact_space A top -> forall u c= A, u :e top <-> (a :e u -> u c= topspace A top /\ (compact_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) (topspace A top :\: u) /\ closed_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) (topspace A top :\: u))) /\ (~ a :e u -> u :e subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a}))

items.name: KC_SPACE_CLOSED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> kc_space A top /\ (compact_space A top /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top'))) -> kc_space B top'

items.name: KC_SPACE_CLOSED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> kc_space A top /\ (compact_space A top /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')) -> (closed_map A B (top,top') f <-> kc_space B top')

items.name: KC_SPACE_COMPACT_PROD_TOPOLOGY

items.name: KC_SPACE_COMPACT_SUBTOPOLOGIES

items.name: KC_SPACE_CONTINUOUS_INJECTIVE_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ kc_space B top') -> kc_space A top

items.name: KC_SPACE_ONE_POINT_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, compact_space A top /\ (topspace A top :\: {a} :e top /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) k /\ closed_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) k -> closed_in A top k)) -> (kc_space A top <-> k_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) /\ kc_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})))

items.name: KC_SPACE_ONE_POINT_COMPACTIFICATION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, compact_space A top -> (kc_space A top <-> topspace A top :\: {a} :e top /\ ((forall k c= A, compact_in A top k /\ ~ a :e k -> closed_in A top k) /\ (k_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) /\ kc_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})))))

items.name: KC_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE

items.name: KC_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY_ALT

items.name: KC_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, kc_space A top /\ (kc_space B top' /\ ((forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> hausdorff_space A (subtopology A top k)) \/ (forall l c= B, compact_in B top' l -> hausdorff_space B (subtopology B top' l)))) -> kc_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top')

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ kc_space A top -> kc_space B top'

items.name: KC_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, kc_space A top -> kc_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: KERNEL_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | matrix_vector_mul M N (matrix_inv M N A) x = vec M 0} = {x :e R :^: idx N | matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M A) x = vec M 0}

items.name: KIFICATION_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, kification A top = top <-> k_space A top

items.name: KIFICATION_KIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, kification A (kification A top) = kification A top

items.name: KIRCHBERGER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (compact N t /\ (forall s' t' c= R :^: idx N, s' c= s /\ (t' c= t /\ (finite s' /\ (finite t' /\ finite_cardinality s' + finite_cardinality t' <= dimindex N + 2))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s' -> dot N a x < b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t' -> b < dot N a x)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x < b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> b < dot N a x)

items.name: KIRSZBRAUN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, 0 <= B /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g x) (g y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: KL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall C c= A, chain_on A l C -> exists P c= A, chain_on A l P /\ C c= P /\ forall R0 c= A, chain_on A l R0 /\ P c= R0 -> R0 = P

items.name: KL_POSET_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= A, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on (Power A) (fun c1:set => fun c2:set => C c= c1 /\ (c1 c= c2 /\ chain_on A l c2))

items.name: KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (t0_space B top' /\ x :e topspace A top) -> f (kolmogorov_quotient A top x) = f x

items.name: KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, kolmogorov_quotient A top x = kolmogorov_quotient A top y <-> forall u c= A, u :e top -> (x :e u <-> y :e u)

items.name: KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, kolmogorov_quotient A top x = kolmogorov_quotient A top y <-> forall u c= A, closed_in A top u -> (x :e u <-> y :e u)

items.name: KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, t0_space A top /\ x :e topspace A top -> kolmogorov_quotient A top x = x

items.name: KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_IDEMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, kolmogorov_quotient A top (kolmogorov_quotient A top x) = kolmogorov_quotient A top x

items.name: KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_IN_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, forall x :e A, closed_in A top c -> (kolmogorov_quotient A top x :e c <-> x :e c)

items.name: KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_IN_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, forall x :e A, u :e top -> (kolmogorov_quotient A top x :e u <-> x :e u)

items.name: KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, kolmogorov_quotient A top x :e topspace A top <-> x :e topspace A top

items.name: KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_LIFT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ (t0_space B top' /\ continuous_map A B (subtopology A top s,top') f) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e s},top') g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g (kolmogorov_quotient A top x) = f x)

items.name: KREIN_MILMAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ compact N s -> s = closure N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s})

items.name: KREIN_MILMAN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s e0 c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ convex N s -> (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} e0 = s <-> e0 c= s /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s} c= e0)

items.name: KREIN_MILMAN_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ compact N s -> s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (frontier N s)

items.name: KREIN_MILMAN_MINKOWSKI
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ compact N s -> s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s}

items.name: KREIN_MILMAN_POLYTOPE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s -> hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} {x :e R :^: idx A | extreme_point_of A x (hull (R :^: idx A) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x0} s)}

items.name: KREIN_MILMAN_RELATIVE_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a})) -> s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\: relative_interior N s)

items.name: KREIN_MILMAN_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a})) -> s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: KURATOWSKI_COMPONENT_NUMBER_INVARIANCE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (locally_connected_space A top /\ hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top)) -> ((forall s t c= A, forall n :e omega, closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ homeomorphic_space A A (subtopology A top s) (subtopology A top t)) -> (equip (connected_components_of A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: s))) n <-> equip (connected_components_of A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: t))) n)) <-> forall s t c= A, forall n :e omega, homeomorphic_space A A (subtopology A top s) (subtopology A top t) -> (equip (connected_components_of A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: s))) n <-> equip (connected_components_of A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: t))) n))

items.name: K_KC_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, k_space A top /\ (kc_space A top /\ (s :e top \/ closed_in A top s)) -> k_space A (subtopology A top s) /\ kc_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: K_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, k_space A top <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> closed_in A (subtopology A top k) (k :/\: s)) -> closed_in A top s

items.name: K_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, k_space A top <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (s :e top <-> forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> k :/\: s :e subtopology A top k)

items.name: K_SPACE_AS_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, k_space A top <-> exists q:set -> set, (forall x :e Power A :*: A, q x :e A) /\ exists top' :e topology (Power A :*: A), locally_compact_space (Power A :*: A) top' /\ quotient_map (Power A :*: A) A (top',top) q

items.name: K_SPACE_AS_QUOTIENT_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, k_space A top <-> quotient_map (Power A :*: A) A (sum_topology A (Power A) {k :e Power A | compact_in A top k} (fun x:set => subtopology A top x),top) (fun x:set => x 1)

items.name: K_SPACE_CLOSED_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, k_space A top /\ closed_in A top s -> k_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: K_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, k_space A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: K_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> k_space (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N)

items.name: K_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: k_space R euclideanreal

items.name: K_SPACE_KIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, k_space A (kification A top)

items.name: K_SPACE_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, k_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: K_SPACE_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, k_space A top <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> k :/\: s :e subtopology A top k) -> s :e top

items.name: K_SPACE_OPEN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, (kc_space A top \/ (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top)) /\ (k_space A top /\ s :e top) -> k_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: K_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> k_space B top'

items.name: K_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> hausdorff_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> (k_space A top <-> k_space B top')

items.name: K_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, locally_compact_space A top /\ ((hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) /\ k_space B top') -> k_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top')

items.name: K_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, k_space A top /\ (locally_compact_space B top' /\ (hausdorff_space B top' \/ regular_space B top')) -> k_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top')

items.name: K_SPACE_QUOTIENT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') q /\ k_space A top -> k_space B top'

items.name: K_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ k_space A top -> k_space B top'

items.name: K_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, (forall t c= A, t c= topspace A top /\ (t c= s /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> closed_in A (subtopology A top (k :/\: s)) (k :/\: t))) -> closed_in A (subtopology A top s) t) /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> k_space A (subtopology A top (k :/\: s))) -> k_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: K_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, (forall t c= A, t c= topspace A top /\ (t c= s /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> k :/\: t :e subtopology A top (k :/\: s))) -> t :e subtopology A top s) /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> k_space A (subtopology A top (k :/\: s))) -> k_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: L1_LE_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => abs_SNo (x i)) <= (if 0 <= dimindex N then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (dimindex N) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- dimindex N)) * vector_norm N x

items.name: LAGRANGE_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ subgroup_of A h G -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality h) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: LAGRANGE_THEOREM_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ subgroup_of A h G -> finite_cardinality {left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} * finite_cardinality h = finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)

items.name: LAGRANGE_THEOREM_LEFT_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ subgroup_of A h G -> finite_cardinality {left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} = div_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) (finite_cardinality h)

items.name: LAGRANGE_THEOREM_LEFT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> equip ({left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} :*: h) (group_carrier A G)

items.name: LAGRANGE_THEOREM_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ subgroup_of A h G -> finite_cardinality {right_coset_hl A G h x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} * finite_cardinality h = finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)

items.name: LAGRANGE_THEOREM_RIGHT_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ subgroup_of A h G -> finite_cardinality {right_coset_hl A G h x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} = div_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) (finite_cardinality h)

items.name: LAGRANGE_THEOREM_RIGHT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> equip ({right_coset_hl A G h x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} :*: h) (group_carrier A G)

items.name: LAMBDA_ADD_GALOIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m n :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ (n <= dimindex N /\ ~ m = n))) -> (x = (fun i :e idx N => if i = m then y m + y n else y i) <-> (fun i :e idx N => if i = m then x m + - x n else x i) = y)

items.name: LAMBDA_BETA
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex B -> (fun i :e idx B => g i) i = g i

items.name: LAMBDA_BETA_PERM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> forall i :e omega, permutes omega p (idx N) /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> (fun i :e idx N => g i) (p i) = g (p i)

items.name: LAMBDA_ETA
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall g :e A :^: idx B, (fun i :e idx B => g i) = g

items.name: LAMBDA_PAIR
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall p :e A :*: B, f (p 0) (p 1) = f (p 0) (p 1)

items.name: LAMBDA_PAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, t x :e C) -> forall p :e A :*: B, t p = t (p 0,p 1)

items.name: LAMBDA_SKOLEM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> exists x :e A, P i x) <-> exists x :e A :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (x i)

items.name: LAMBDA_SWAP_GALOIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m n :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, 1 <= m /\ (m <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= n /\ n <= dimindex N)) -> (x = (fun i :e idx N => y (swap omega (m,n) i)) <-> (fun i :e idx N => x (swap omega (m,n) i)) = y)

items.name: LAMBDA_TRIPLE
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, forall f:set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall z :e C, f x y z :e D) -> forall t :e A :*: (B :*: C), f (t 0) (t 1 0) (t 1 1) = f (t 0) (t 1 0) (t 1 1)

items.name: LAMBDA_TRIPLE_THM
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, D <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f x :e D) -> forall t :e A :*: (B :*: C), f t = f (t 0,(t 1 0,t 1 1))

items.name: LAMBDA_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f :e A :^: idx B, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) -> ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex B -> f i = g i) <-> (fun i :e idx B => g i) = f)

items.name: LARGE_INDUCTIVE_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> (s = Empty -> - 1 <= n) /\ (~ s = Empty -> forall c d c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) c /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) d /\ c :/\: d = Empty) -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) b /\ (dimension N b <= n + - 1 /\ exists u v c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (u :/\: v = Empty /\ (u :\/: v = s :\: b /\ (c c= u /\ d c= v))))))

items.name: LAST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_last (seq_cons h t) = if t = seq_nil then h else seq_last t

items.name: LAST_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p q :e finseq A, seq_last (seq_append p q) = if q = seq_nil then seq_last p else seq_last q

items.name: LAST_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h k :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_last (seq_cons h seq_nil) = h /\ seq_last (seq_cons h (seq_cons k t)) = seq_last (seq_cons k t)

items.name: LAST_EL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> seq_last l = seq_nth l (minus_nat (seq_len l) 1)

items.name: LAST_REVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> seq_last (seq_rev l) = seq_hd l

items.name: LAVRENTIEV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ gdelta N t) -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (gdelta M u /\ (s c= u /\ (u c= closure M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ ({g x | x :e u} c= t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)))))

items.name: LAVRENTIEV_BOREL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ borel N t) -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (borel M u /\ (s c= u /\ (u c= closure M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ ({g x | x :e u} c= t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)))))

items.name: LAVRENTIEV_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> s c= topspace A top /\ ((metrizable_space A top \/ topspace A top c= closure_of A top s) /\ (completely_metrizable_space B top' /\ continuous_map A B (subtopology A top s,top') f)) -> exists u c= A, exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (u :e gdelta_in A top /\ (s c= u /\ (u c= closure_of A top s /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top u,top') g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x))))

items.name: LAVRENTIEV_EXTENSION_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> s c= topspace A top /\ (completely_metrizable_space B top' /\ continuous_map A B (subtopology A top s,top') f) -> exists u c= A, exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (u :e gdelta_in A top /\ (s c= u /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (closure_of A top s :/\: u),top') g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)))

items.name: LAVRENTIEV_HOMEOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall f' :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall s' c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphism M N (s,s') (f,f') -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, exists u' c= R :^: idx N, exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), exists g' :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), gdelta M u /\ (s c= u /\ (u c= closure M s /\ (gdelta N u' /\ (s' c= u' /\ (u' c= closure N s' /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s' -> g' x = f' x) /\ homeomorphism M N (u,u') (g,g'))))))))

items.name: LAVRENTIEV_HOMEOMORPHISM_SELF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f f' :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphism N N (s,s) (f,f') -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, exists g g' :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), gdelta N u /\ (s c= u /\ (u c= closure N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> g x = f x /\ g' x = f' x) /\ homeomorphism N N (u,u) (g,g'))))

items.name: LCM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m (lcm_int m n) /\ (divides_nat n (lcm_int m n) /\ forall d :e omega, divides_nat m d /\ divides_nat n d -> divides_nat (lcm_int m n) d)

items.name: LCM_0
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, lcm_int 0 n = 0) /\ forall n :e omega, lcm_int n 0 = 0

items.name: LCM_1
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, lcm_int 1 n = n) /\ forall n :e omega, lcm_int n 1 = n

items.name: LCM_ASSOC
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, lcm_int m (lcm_int n p) = lcm_int (lcm_int m n) p

items.name: LCM_COPRIME_DECOMP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, exists m' n' :e omega, divides_nat m' m /\ (divides_nat n' n /\ (gcd_int m' n' = 1 /\ m' * n' = lcm_int m n))

items.name: LCM_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall m n d :e omega, divides_nat (lcm_int m n) d <-> divides_nat m d /\ divides_nat n d

items.name: LCM_DIVIDES_MUL
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat (lcm_int m n) (m * n)

items.name: LCM_EQ
items.statement: forall x y u v :e omega, (forall d :e omega, divides_nat x d /\ divides_nat y d <-> divides_nat u d /\ divides_nat v d) -> lcm_int x y = lcm_int u v

items.name: LCM_EQ_1
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, lcm_int m n = 1 <-> m = 1 /\ n = 1

items.name: LCM_EQ_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, lcm_int m n = m * n <-> m = 0 \/ (n = 0 \/ gcd_int m n = 1)

items.name: LCM_EXP
items.statement: forall n a b :e omega, lcm_int (a ^ n) (b ^ n) = lcm_int a b ^ n

items.name: LCM_GCD_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, lcm_int a (gcd_int b c) = gcd_int (lcm_int a b) (lcm_int a c)

items.name: LCM_LE_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, lcm_int m n <= m * n

items.name: LCM_LMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, lcm_int (c * a) (c * b) = c * lcm_int a b

items.name: LCM_MULTIPLE
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, lcm_int b (a * b) = a * b

items.name: LCM_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, lcm_int n n = n

items.name: LCM_RMUL
items.statement: forall a b c :e omega, lcm_int (a * c) (b * c) = c * lcm_int a b

items.name: LCM_SYM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, lcm_int m n = lcm_int n m

items.name: LCM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall d m n :e omega, divides_nat m d /\ (divides_nat n d /\ (forall e0 :e omega, divides_nat m e0 /\ divides_nat n e0 -> divides_nat d e0)) <-> d = lcm_int m n

items.name: LCM_ZERO
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, lcm_int m n = 0 <-> m = 0 \/ n = 0

items.name: LDIV_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ a = 0 -> (n < div_nat b a <-> a * (n + 1) <= b)

items.name: LE
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, m <= 0 <-> m = 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, m <= ordsucc n <-> m = ordsucc n \/ m <= n

items.name: LEBESGUE_COVERING_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall c c= Power A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ (~ c = Empty /\ (s c= Union c /\ (forall b c= A, b :e c -> b :e mtopology A m))) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= A, t c= s /\ mdiameter A m t <= d -> exists b c= A, b :e c /\ t c= b

items.name: LEBESGUE_COVERING_LEMMA_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall u s c= A, forall c c= Power A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ (~ c = Empty /\ (s c= Union c /\ (forall b c= A, b :e c -> b :e subtopology A (mtopology A m) u))) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= A, t c= s /\ mdiameter A m t <= d -> exists b c= A, b :e c /\ t c= b

items.name: LEBESGUE_DENSITY_THEOREM_INTEGRAL_BALL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f (s :/\: closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, negligible M k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x :e k -> tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun e0:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (measure M (ball M (x,drop e0)))) (integral N M (s :/\: ball M (x,drop e0)) f)) (if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (vec 1 0)) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 < drop t})

items.name: LEBESGUE_DENSITY_THEOREM_INTEGRAL_CBALL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f (s :/\: closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, negligible M k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x :e k -> tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) (fun e0:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (measure M (cball M (x,drop e0)))) (integral N M (s :/\: cball M (x,drop e0)) f)) (if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (vec 1 0)) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 < drop t})

items.name: LEBESGUE_DENSITY_THEOREM_INTEGRAL_NORM_BALL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, negligible M k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x :e k -> tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun e0:set => vector_mul 1 (recip_SNo (measure M (ball M (x,drop e0)))) (integral 1 M (ball M (x,drop e0)) (fun y:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)))))) (vec 1 0) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (vec 1 0)) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 < drop t})

items.name: LEBESGUE_DENSITY_THEOREM_INTEGRAL_NORM_CBALL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, absolutely_integrable_on N M f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, negligible M k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x :e k -> tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun e0:set => vector_mul 1 (recip_SNo (measure M (cball M (x,drop e0)))) (integral 1 M (cball M (x,drop e0)) (fun y:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)))))) (vec 1 0) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (vec 1 0)) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 < drop t})

items.name: LEBESGUE_DENSITY_THEOREM_LIFT_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x :e k -> tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun e0:set => lift (measure N (s :/\: ball N (x,drop e0)) :/: measure N (ball N (x,drop e0)))) (if x :e s then vec 1 1 else vec 1 0) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (vec 1 0)) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 < drop t})

items.name: LEBESGUE_DENSITY_THEOREM_LIFT_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x :e k -> tendsto 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun e0:set => lift (measure N (s :/\: cball N (x,drop e0)) :/: measure N (cball N (x,drop e0)))) (if x :e s then vec 1 1 else vec 1 0) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (vec 1 0)) {t :e R :^: idx 1 | 0 < drop t})

items.name: LEBESGUE_DIFFERENTIATION_THEOREM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable N 1 f (at 1 x)}

items.name: LEBESGUE_DIFFERENTIATION_THEOREM_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> exists t c= R :^: idx 1, t c= s /\ (negligible 1 t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s :\: t -> differentiable N 1 f (at 1 x))

items.name: LEBESGUE_DIFFERENTIATION_THEOREM_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ ~ differentiable N 1 f (at 1 x)}

items.name: LEBESGUE_DIFFERENTIATION_THEOREM_DECREASING
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) -> negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable 1 1 f (at 1 x)}

items.name: LEBESGUE_DIFFERENTIATION_THEOREM_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, countable (components 1 s) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable N 1 f (at 1 x)}

items.name: LEBESGUE_DIFFERENTIATION_THEOREM_INCREASING
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> negligible 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable 1 1 f (at 1 x)}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ (lebesgue_measurable 1 t /\ t c= s)) -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_ALMOST_FSIGMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s -> exists c t c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N c /\ (negligible N t /\ (c :\/: t = s /\ c :/\: t = Empty))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_ALMOST_GDELTA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s -> exists c t c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N c /\ (negligible N t /\ (s :\/: t = c /\ t :/\: s = Empty))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, lebesgue_measurable N (ball N (a,r))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, lebesgue_measurable N (cball N (a,r))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t /\ lebesgue_measurable N s -> lebesgue_measurable N t

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_COMPL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) <-> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M t /\ t c= s -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_COUNTABLE_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> lebesgue_measurable N s) -> lebesgue_measurable N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_COUNTABLE_INTERS_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, lebesgue_measurable N (s n)) -> lebesgue_measurable N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> lebesgue_measurable N s) -> lebesgue_measurable N (Union f)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, lebesgue_measurable N (s n)) -> lebesgue_measurable N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega})

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N (s :\: {a}) <-> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ lebesgue_measurable N t -> lebesgue_measurable N (s :\: t)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (differentiable_on_hl N M f s /\ lebesgue_measurable M s) -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_DOMAIN_OF_INJECTIVITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M t /\ (t c= s /\ ({f x | x :e t} = {f x | x :e s} /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> lebesgue_measurable A Empty

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_FUNCTION_ORDINATE_SET_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) -> lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e R :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, y k <= f x k})

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_FUNCTION_ORDINATE_SET_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) <-> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e R :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, y k <= f x k}))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_FUNCTION_ORDINATE_SET_LT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) -> lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e R :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, y k < f x k})

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_FUNCTION_ORDINATE_SET_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) <-> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e R :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, y k < f x k}))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_FUNCTION_ORTHANT_SET_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) <-> lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e R :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> y k <= f x k}))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_FUNCTION_ORTHANT_SET_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) <-> lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e R :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> y k < f x k}))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_IFF_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> (lebesgue_measurable N s <-> measurable N s)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_INNER_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, closed N t /\ (t c= s /\ (measurable N (s :\: t) /\ measure N (s :\: t) < e0))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_INNER_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ~ negligible N s -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ (compact N k /\ 0 < measure N k)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N (SetAdjoin s a) <-> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ lebesgue_measurable N t -> lebesgue_measurable N (s :/\: t)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> lebesgue_measurable N s) -> lebesgue_measurable N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N (open_interval N (a,b))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_JORDAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N (frontier N s) -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ analytic N t) -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_BOREL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ borel N t) -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ closed N t) -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ open N t) -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e s} <-> lebesgue_measurable N s)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M = dimindex N /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y)) -> (lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e s} <-> lebesgue_measurable M s)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LINEAR_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ dimindex M <= dimindex N) -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y))) -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, exists b :e R, open M t /\ (x :e t /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s :/\: t -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)) <= b * vector_norm M (vector_sub M y x)))) -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_MEASURABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_MEASURABLE_INTER_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N t -> measurable N (s :/\: t)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_MEASURABLE_ON_COUNTABLE_SUBINTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s <-> forall n :e omega, measurable N (s :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (vector_neg N (vec N n),vec N n) seq_nil))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_MEASURABLE_ON_SUBINTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, measurable N (s :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_NEGLIGIBLE_SYMDIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ negligible N ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> lebesgue_measurable N t

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_NEGLIGIBLE_SYMDIFF_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> (lebesgue_measurable N s <-> lebesgue_measurable N t)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_ON_SUBINTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N (s :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ lebesgue_measurable N s -> lebesgue_measurable N t

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_OUTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ (s c= t /\ (measurable N (t :\: s) /\ measure N (t :\: s) < e0))

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> negligible M s \/ (negligible N t \/ lebesgue_measurable M s /\ lebesgue_measurable N t)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_POINTS_OF_CONVERGENCE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M P (fun x:set => f x y) s) /\ continuous_on_hl M N g s) -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ exists l :e R :^: idx P, tendsto P (R :^: idx N) (f x) l (at N (g x))}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_POINTS_OF_DIFFERENTIABILITY_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | differentiable N M f (at M x)}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_POINTS_OF_DIFFERENTIABILITY_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ differentiable N M f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ analytic N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_BOREL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ borel N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_CARD_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t})) -> lebesgue_measurable N {y :e R :^: idx N | finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} /\ finite_cardinality {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} <= n}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ closed N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_FINITE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t})) -> lebesgue_measurable N {y :e R :^: idx N | finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_HAS_SIZE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t})) -> lebesgue_measurable N {y :e R :^: idx N | equip {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} n}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_INFINITE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t})) -> lebesgue_measurable N {y :e R :^: idx N | infinite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ open N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e t}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_REGULAR_INNER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, exists c :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, negligible N k /\ ((forall n :e omega, compact N (c n)) /\ s = Union {c n | n :e omega, n :e omega} :\/: k)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_REGULAR_OUTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, exists c :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, negligible N k /\ ((forall n :e omega, open N (c n)) /\ s = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {c n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} :\: k)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N {a}

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_SMALL_IMP_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ (atleastp s R /\ ~ equip s R) -> negligible N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ lebesgue_measurable N t -> lebesgue_measurable N (s :\/: t)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e f -> lebesgue_measurable A s) -> lebesgue_measurable A (Union f)

items.name: LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> lebesgue_measurable N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: LEBESGUE_NUMBER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall U c= Power A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ ((forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e mtopology A m) /\ s c= Union U) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists u c= A, u :e U /\ mball A m (x,e0) c= u

items.name: LEFT_ADD_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * (n + p) = m * n + m * p

items.name: LEFT_AND_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x) /\ Q <-> exists x :e A, P x /\ Q

items.name: LEFT_AND_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x) /\ Q <-> forall x :e A, P x /\ Q

items.name: LEFT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ h c= group_carrier A G -> left_coset_hl A G x h c= group_carrier A G

items.name: LEFT_COSETS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> (left_coset_hl A G x h = left_coset_hl A G y h <-> ~ left_coset_hl A G x h :/\: left_coset_hl A G y h = Empty)

items.name: LEFT_COSET_AS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall h c= A, left_coset_hl A G x h = {group_mul A G x x0 | x0 :e h}

items.name: LEFT_COSET_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> left_coset_hl A G x (group_carrier A G) = group_carrier A G

items.name: LEFT_COSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> (left_coset_hl A G x h = left_coset_hl A G y h <-> group_mul A G (group_inv A G x) y :e h)

items.name: LEFT_COSET_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, left_coset_hl A G x h = Empty <-> h = Empty

items.name: LEFT_COSET_EQ_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> (left_coset_hl A G x h = h <-> x :e h)

items.name: LEFT_COSET_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, h c= group_carrier A G -> left_coset_hl A G (group_id A G) h = h

items.name: LEFT_COSET_LEFT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, forall h c= A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ h c= group_carrier A G) -> left_coset_hl A G x (left_coset_hl A G y h) = left_coset_hl A G (group_mul A G x y) h

items.name: LEFT_COSET_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, subgroup_of A h G -> ~ left_coset_hl A G x h = Empty

items.name: LEFT_COSET_OPPOSITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, left_coset_hl A G x h = right_coset_hl A (opposite_group A G) h x

items.name: LEFT_COSET_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall h :e Power A :^: K, forall x :e A :^: K, forall k c= K, left_coset_hl (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) x {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e h i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | x1 :e left_coset_hl A (G i) (x i) (h i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: LEFT_COSET_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall G1 :e group_hl A, forall G2 :e group_hl B, forall h1 c= A, forall h2 c= B, forall x1 :e A, forall x2 :e B, left_coset_hl (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G1 G2) (x1,x2) (h1 :*: h2) = left_coset_hl A G1 x1 h1 :*: left_coset_hl B G2 x2 h2

items.name: LEFT_COSET_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h k c= A, forall x :e A, left_coset_hl A (subgroup_generated A G h) x k = left_coset_hl A G x k

items.name: LEFT_COSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> left_coset_hl A G x {group_id A G} = {x}

items.name: LEFT_EXISTS_AND_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x /\ Q) <-> (exists x :e A, P x) /\ Q

items.name: LEFT_EXISTS_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x -> Q) <-> (forall x :e A, P x) -> Q

items.name: LEFT_FORALL_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> Q) <-> (exists x :e A, P x) -> Q

items.name: LEFT_FORALL_OR_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x \/ Q) <-> (forall x :e A, P x) \/ Q

items.name: LEFT_IMP_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x) -> Q <-> forall x :e A, P x -> Q

items.name: LEFT_IMP_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x) -> Q <-> exists x :e A, P x -> Q

items.name: LEFT_INVERSE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (f x) = x) -> linear N N g

items.name: LEFT_INVERTIBLE_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul M N M B (transp M N A) = mat M M 1) <-> exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N M A B = mat M M 1

items.name: LEFT_LIMIT_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto A (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x <= drop a}) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x < drop a})

items.name: LEFT_LIMIT_WITHIN_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto A (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= drop a}) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x < drop a})

items.name: LEFT_OR_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, p /\ (q \/ r) <-> p /\ q \/ p /\ r

items.name: LEFT_OR_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P x) \/ Q <-> exists x :e A, P x \/ Q

items.name: LEFT_OR_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P x) \/ Q <-> forall x :e A, P x \/ Q

items.name: LEFT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, exists U P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N P /\ matrix_mul N N N P U = A)

items.name: LEFT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION_INVERTIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A <-> exists U P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_definite N P /\ matrix_mul N N N P U = A)

items.name: LEFT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION_INVERTIBLE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A U V P S :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A /\ (orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N P /\ (orthogonal_matrix_hl N V /\ (positive_semidefinite N S /\ (matrix_mul N N N P U = A /\ matrix_mul N N N S V = A))))) -> P = S /\ U = V

items.name: LEFT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, exists P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (exists U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N P /\ matrix_mul N N N P U = A)) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (exists U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N y /\ matrix_mul N N N y U = A)) -> y = P

items.name: LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e A) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, f (g x) = x) /\ (forall x :e A, g (h x) = x) -> forall x :e A, f x = h x

items.name: LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N M f /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (f x) = x) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f (g x) = x)) -> linear M N g

items.name: LEFT_SUB_DISTRIB

items.name: LENGTH
items.statement: forall A:set, seq_len seq_nil = 0 /\ forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_len (seq_cons h t) = ordsucc (seq_len t)

items.name: LENGTH_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_len (seq_append l m) = seq_len l + seq_len m

items.name: LENGTH_EQ_CONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, seq_len l = ordsucc n <-> exists h :e A, exists t :e finseq A, l = seq_cons h t /\ seq_len t = n

items.name: LENGTH_EQ_LIST_OF_SEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, seq_len l = n <-> l = seq_mk n (fun i:set => seq_nth l i)

items.name: LENGTH_EQ_NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_len l = 0 <-> l = seq_nil

items.name: LENGTH_FILTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, seq_len (seq_filter P l) <= seq_len l

items.name: LENGTH_LIST_OF_SEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> forall n :e omega, seq_len (seq_mk n s) = n

items.name: LENGTH_LIST_OF_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> seq_len (choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)) = finite_cardinality s

items.name: LENGTH_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> seq_len (seq_map f l) = seq_len l

items.name: LENGTH_MAP2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall l :e finseq A, forall m :e finseq B, seq_len l = seq_len m -> seq_len (seq_map2 f l m) = seq_len m

items.name: LENGTH_REPLICATE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, seq_len (seq_replicate n x) = n

items.name: LENGTH_REVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_len (seq_rev l) = seq_len l

items.name: LENGTH_TL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, ~ l = seq_nil -> seq_len (seq_tl l) = minus_nat (seq_len l) 1

items.name: LENGTH_ZIP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall l1 :e finseq A, forall l2 :e finseq B, seq_len l1 = seq_len l2 -> seq_len (seq_zip l1 l2) = seq_len l2

items.name: LET_ADD2

items.name: LET_ANTISYM

items.name: LET_CASES

items.name: LET_END_DEF

items.name: LET_TRANS

items.name: LE_0

items.name: LE_1
