items.name: LE_ADD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= m + n

items.name: LE_ADD2
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, m <= p /\ n <= q -> m + n <= p + q

items.name: LE_ADDR

items.name: LE_ADD_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m + n <= m + p <-> n <= p

items.name: LE_ADD_RCANCEL

items.name: LE_ANTISYM

items.name: LE_C
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, atleastp s t <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ forall x :e B, x :e s -> exists y :e A, y :e t /\ g y = x

items.name: LE_CASES
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n \/ n <= m

items.name: LE_C_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t <-> s = Empty \/ exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) /\ {f x | x :e t} = s

items.name: LE_C_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, atleastp s t <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) /\ s c= {f x | x :e t}

items.name: LE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n <-> exists d :e omega, n = m + d

items.name: LE_EXP
items.statement: forall x m n :e omega, x ^ m <= x ^ n <-> (x = 0 -> m = 0 -> n = 0) /\ (~ x = 0 -> x = 1 \/ m <= n)

items.name: LE_INDEX
items.statement: forall n p k :e omega, k <= prime_index p n <-> (n = 0 \/ p = 1 -> k = 0) /\ divides_nat (p ^ k) n

items.name: LE_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall m :e omega, P m m) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n /\ P m n -> P m (ordsucc n)) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> P m n

items.name: LE_LCM
items.statement: (forall m n :e omega, m <= lcm_int m n <-> n = 0 -> m = 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, n <= lcm_int m n <-> m = 0 -> n = 0

items.name: LE_LDIV
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ a = 0 /\ b <= a * n -> div_nat b a <= n

items.name: LE_LDIV_EQ
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ a = 0 -> (div_nat b a <= n <-> b < a * (n + 1))

items.name: LE_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n <-> m < n \/ m = n

items.name: LE_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, (exists r :e omega, P r) -> (n <= choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) <-> forall i :e omega, P i -> n <= i)

items.name: LE_MULT2

items.name: LE_MULT_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * n <= m * p <-> m = 0 \/ n <= p

items.name: LE_MULT_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * p <= n * p <-> m <= n \/ p = 0

items.name: LE_RDIV_EQ
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ a = 0 -> (n <= div_nat b a <-> a * n <= b)

items.name: LE_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n <= n

items.name: LE_SQUARE_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n <= n * n

items.name: LE_SUC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m <= ordsucc n <-> m <= n

items.name: LE_SUC_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m <= n <-> m < n

items.name: LE_TRANS
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m <= n /\ n <= p -> m <= p

items.name: LF_CLOSED_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall W c= Power A, perfect_map A B (top,top') f /\ (locally_finite_in A top W /\ (forall w c= A, w :e W -> closed_in A top w)) -> locally_finite_in B top' {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e W} /\ forall v c= B, v :e {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e W} -> closed_in B top' v

items.name: LF_COVERING_IMP_LF_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ (forall B c= Power A, (forall b c= A, b :e B -> b :e top) /\ Union B = topspace A top -> exists C c= Power A, Union C = topspace A top /\ (locally_finite_in A top C /\ forall c c= A, c :e C -> exists b c= A, b :e B /\ c c= b)) -> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top -> exists W c= Power A, Union W = topspace A top /\ (locally_finite_in A top W /\ ((forall w c= A, w :e W -> closed_in A top w) /\ forall w c= A, w :e W -> exists u c= A, u :e U /\ w c= u))

items.name: LF_COVERING_IMP_LF_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ (forall B c= Power A, (forall b c= A, b :e B -> b :e top) /\ Union B = topspace A top -> exists C c= Power A, Union C = topspace A top /\ (locally_finite_in A top C /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e C -> closed_in A top c) /\ forall c c= A, c :e C -> exists b c= A, b :e B /\ c c= b))) -> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top -> exists W c= Power A, Union W = topspace A top /\ (locally_finite_in A top W /\ ((forall w c= A, w :e W -> w :e top) /\ forall w c= A, w :e W -> exists u c= A, u :e U /\ w c= u))

items.name: LIEB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, (forall n :e omega, absolutely_integrable_on N M (f n) s) /\ (absolutely_integrable_on N M g s /\ (negligible M t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially))) -> tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => vector_sub 1 (integral 1 M s (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f n x) (g x))))) (vector_sub 1 (integral 1 M s (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f n x)))) (integral 1 M s (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (g x)))))) (vec 1 0) sequentially

items.name: LIFT_ADD

items.name: LIFT_COMPONENT

items.name: LIFT_DROP
items.statement: (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, lift (drop x) = x) /\ forall x :e R, drop (lift x) = x

items.name: LIFT_EQ

items.name: LIFT_EQ_CMUL

items.name: LIFT_INTEGRAL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> integrable_on N M f s -> lift (integral N M s f k) = integral 1 M s (fun x:set => lift (f x k))

items.name: LIFT_IN_IMAGE_LIFT

items.name: LIFT_IN_INTERVAL

items.name: LIFT_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, lift (- x) = vector_neg 1 (lift x)

items.name: LIFT_NUM

items.name: LIFT_SUM

items.name: LIFT_TO_QUOTIENT_SPACE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u:set -> prop, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall v c= R :^: idx N, v c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) /\ (continuous_on_hl M P h s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx P, x :e {h x | x :e s} <-> u x) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> h x = h y)))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g t /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx P, x :e {g x | x :e t} <-> u x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> h x = g (f x)))

items.name: LIFT_TO_QUOTIENT_SPACE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ ({g x | x :e s} = u /\ ((forall v c= R :^: idx N, v c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) /\ ((forall v c= R :^: idx P, v c= u -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ g x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (f x = f y <-> g x = g y))))) -> homeomorphic P N t u

items.name: LIMIT_ATPOINTOF
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, limit A B top' f y (atpointof A top x) <-> y :e topspace B top' /\ (x :e topspace A top -> forall v c= B, v :e top' /\ y :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (x :e u /\ {f x0 | x0 :e u :\: {x}} c= v))

items.name: LIMIT_ATPOINTOF_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m :e metric A, forall top :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, limit A B top f y (atpointof A (mtopology A m) x) <-> y :e topspace B top /\ (x :e mspace A m -> forall v c= B, v :e top /\ y :e v -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e A, x' :e mspace A m /\ (0 < mdist A m (x',x) /\ mdist A m (x',x) < d) -> f x' :e v)

items.name: LIMIT_ATPOINTOF_SELF
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, limit A B top2 f (f a) (atpointof A top1 a) <-> f a :e topspace B top2 /\ (a :e topspace A top1 -> forall v c= B, v :e top2 /\ f a :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e top1 /\ (a :e u /\ {f x | x :e u} c= v))

items.name: LIMIT_ATPOINTOF_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, forall l :e B, limit A B (mtopology B m2) f l (atpointof A (mtopology A m1) a) <-> l :e mspace B m2 /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A m1 :\: {a}) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m1) x a sequentially -> limit omega B (mtopology B m2) (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_ATPOINTOF_SEQUENTIALLY_DECREASING
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, forall l :e B, limit A B (mtopology B m2) f l (atpointof A (mtopology A m1) a) <-> l :e mspace B m2 /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A m1 :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> mdist A m1 (x n,a) < mdist A m1 (x m,a)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m1) x a sequentially)) -> limit omega B (mtopology B m2) (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_ATPOINTOF_SEQUENTIALLY_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, forall l :e B, limit A B (mtopology B m2) f l (atpointof A (mtopology A m1) a) <-> l :e mspace B m2 /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A m1 :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m1) x a sequentially) -> limit omega B (mtopology B m2) (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_ATPOINTOF_SEQUENTIALLY_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, forall l :e B, limit A B (mtopology B m2) f l (within A (atpointof A (mtopology A m1) a) s) <-> l :e mspace B m2 /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :/\: mspace A m1 :\: {a}) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m1) x a sequentially -> limit omega B (mtopology B m2) (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_ATPOINTOF_SEQUENTIALLY_WITHIN_DECREASING
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, forall l :e B, limit A B (mtopology B m2) f l (within A (atpointof A (mtopology A m1) a) s) <-> l :e mspace B m2 /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :/\: mspace A m1 :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> mdist A m1 (x n,a) < mdist A m1 (x m,a)) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m1) x a sequentially)) -> limit omega B (mtopology B m2) (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_ATPOINTOF_SEQUENTIALLY_WITHIN_INJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, forall l :e B, limit A B (mtopology B m2) f l (within A (atpointof A (mtopology A m1) a) s) <-> l :e mspace B m2 /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :/\: mspace A m1 :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m1) x a sequentially) -> limit omega B (mtopology B m2) (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall A C K:set, A <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net C, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall t c= K, forall f :e A :^: K :^: C, forall l :e A :^: K, limit C (A :^: K) (product_topology A K t tops) (fun x:set => f x) l net0 <-> (forall x :e K, ~ x :e t -> l x = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ (eventually C {a :e C | f a :e topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K t tops)} net0 /\ forall k :e K, k :e t -> limit C A (tops k) (fun c:set => f c k) (l k) net0)

items.name: LIMIT_COMPONENTWISE_REAL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, limit A (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) f l net0 <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x i) (l i) net0

items.name: LIMIT_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology B, forall net0 :e net A, forall l :e B, limit A B top (fun a:set => l) l net0 <-> l :e topspace B top

items.name: LIMIT_CONST_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, K <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net K, forall top :e topology A, forall a l :e A, t1_space A top /\ ~ trivial_limit K net0 -> (limit K A top (fun k:set => a) l net0 <-> l :e topspace A top /\ a = l)

items.name: LIMIT_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, forall b :e B, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (a :e topspace A top /\ f a = b) -> limit A B top' f b (atpointof A top a)

items.name: LIMIT_CONTINUOUS_MAP_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, forall b :e B, continuous_map A B (subtopology A top s,top') f /\ (a :e s /\ (a :e topspace A top /\ f a = b)) -> limit A B top' f b (within A (atpointof A top a) s)

items.name: LIMIT_EQ_DROP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall l :e R :^: idx 1, limit A (R :^: idx 1) (euclidean 1) f l net0 <-> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => drop (f x)) (drop l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_EQ_LIFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 <-> limit A (R :^: idx 1) (euclidean 1) (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (lift l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall net0 :e net A, limit A (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) f x net0 <-> tendsto N A f x net0

items.name: LIMIT_EVENTUALLY
items.statement: forall A K:set, K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall net0 :e net K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e A) -> forall l :e A, l :e topspace A top /\ eventually K {x :e K | f x = l} net0 -> limit K A top f l net0

items.name: LIMIT_HAUSDORFF_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall top :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l1 l2 :e B, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (hausdorff_space B top /\ (limit A B top f l1 net0 /\ limit A B top f l2 net0)) -> l1 = l2

items.name: LIMIT_IMP_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall top :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e B, forall s c= A, limit A B top f l net0 -> limit A B top f l (within A net0 s)

items.name: LIMIT_INF
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e K, f x y :e R) -> forall l:set -> set, (forall x :e K, l x :e R) -> forall k c= K, finite k /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x i) (l i) net0) -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => inf {f x i | i :e K, i :e k}) (inf {l i | i :e K, i :e k}) net0

items.name: LIMIT_IN_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall top :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e B, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (limit A B top f l net0 /\ (closed_in B top s /\ eventually A {x :e A | f x :e s} net0)) -> l :e s

items.name: LIMIT_IN_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall m :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e B, limit A B (mtopology B m) f l net0 -> l :e mspace B m

items.name: LIMIT_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall top :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e B, limit A B top f l net0 -> l :e topspace B top

items.name: LIMIT_KC_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall l1 l2 :e A, kc_space A top /\ (limit omega A top f l1 sequentially /\ limit omega A top f l2 sequentially) -> l1 = l2

items.name: LIMIT_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e B, forall net0 :e net A, limit A B (mtopology B m) f l net0 <-> l :e mspace B m /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | f x :e mspace B m /\ mdist B m (f x,l) < e0} net0

items.name: LIMIT_METRIC_DIST_NULL
items.statement: forall A K:set, K <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net K, forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e A) -> forall l :e A, limit K A (mtopology A m) f l net0 <-> l :e mspace A m /\ (eventually K {x :e K | f x :e mspace A m} net0 /\ limit K R euclideanreal (fun x:set => mdist A m (f x,l)) 0 net0)

items.name: LIMIT_METRIC_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall l :e A, limit omega A (mtopology A m) f l sequentially <-> l :e mspace A m /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n -> f n :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (f n,l) < e0

items.name: LIMIT_METRIC_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall m :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l1 l2 :e B, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (limit A B (mtopology B m) f l1 net0 /\ limit A B (mtopology B m) f l2 net0) -> l1 = l2

items.name: LIMIT_NULL_REAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (limit A R euclideanreal f 0 net0 <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {a :e A | abs_SNo (f a) < e0} net0)

items.name: LIMIT_NULL_REAL_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (limit A R euclideanreal (fun a:set => abs_SNo (f a)) 0 net0 <-> limit A R euclideanreal f 0 net0)

items.name: LIMIT_NULL_REAL_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> limit A R euclideanreal f 0 net0 /\ eventually A {a :e A | abs_SNo (g a) <= abs_SNo (f a)} net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal g 0 net0

items.name: LIMIT_NULL_REAL_HARMONIC_OFFSET
items.statement: forall a :e R, limit omega R euclideanreal (fun n:set => recip_SNo (n + a)) 0 sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net C, forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e C, f x :e A :*: B) -> forall l :e A :*: B, limit C (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) f l net0 <-> limit C A top1 (fun x:set => f x 0) (l 0) net0 /\ limit C B top2 (fun x:set => f x 1) (l 1) net0

items.name: LIMIT_PAIR_DROP_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net1 :e net A, forall net2 :e net B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall l m :e R :^: idx 1, ~ trivial_limit A net1 /\ (~ trivial_limit B net2 /\ (tendsto 1 A f l net1 /\ (tendsto 1 B g m net2 /\ eventually A {x :e A | eventually B {y :e B | drop (f x) <= drop (g y)} net2} net1))) -> drop l <= drop m

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, finite s -> ~ limit_point_of A a s

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_IN_DERIVED_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x s <-> x :e derived_set_of (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_OF_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, limit_point_of M x s /\ (continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ (forall x0 y :e R :^: idx M, x0 :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x0 = f y) -> x0 = y)) -> limit_point_of N (f x) {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_OF_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s u c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, limit_point_of M x s /\ (continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ (open M u /\ (x :e u /\ finite {z :e R :^: idx M | z :e s :/\: u /\ f z = f x}))) -> limit_point_of N (f x) {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_OF_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> ~ a = b /\ x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x (open_interval N (a,b)) <-> ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty /\ x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_OF_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, s c= u /\ x :e u -> (limit_point_of N x s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, ~ y = x /\ (y :e s /\ y :e t))

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_OF_LOCAL_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, s c= u /\ (limit_point_of N x s /\ (x :e t /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u)) -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, ~ y = x /\ (y :e s /\ y :e t)

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_OF_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x (sphere N (a,r)) <-> 0 < r /\ (2 <= dimindex N /\ x :e sphere N (a,r))

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x (s :\/: t) <-> limit_point_of N x s \/ limit_point_of N x t

items.name: LIMIT_POINT_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall x :e R :^: idx N, finite f -> (limit_point_of N x (Union f) <-> exists s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ limit_point_of N x s)

items.name: LIMIT_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e K, f x y :e R) -> forall l:set -> set, (forall x :e K, l x :e R) -> forall k c= K, finite k /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x i) (l i) net0) -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => finprod k (f x)) (finprod k l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x)) (abs_SNo l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall l m :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 /\ limit A R euclideanreal g m net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x + g x) (l + m) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal (fun a:set => l) l net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall l m :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 /\ (limit A R euclideanreal g m net0 /\ ~ m = 0) -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x :/: g x) (l :/: m) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 /\ ~ l = 0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => recip_SNo (f x)) (recip_SNo l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => c * f x) (c * l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_LMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => c * f x) (c * l) net0 <-> c = 0 \/ limit A R euclideanreal f l net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall l m :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 /\ limit A R euclideanreal g m net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => if f x <= g x then g x else f x) (if l <= m then m else l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall l m :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 /\ limit A R euclideanreal g m net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => if f x <= g x then f x else g x) (if l <= m then l else m) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall l m :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 /\ limit A R euclideanreal g m net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x * g x) (l * m) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => - f x) (- l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => - f x) l net0 <-> limit A R euclideanreal f (- l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall c l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x * c) (l * c) net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_RMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall c l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x * c) (l * c) net0 <-> c = 0 \/ limit A R euclideanreal f l net0

items.name: LIMIT_REAL_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall l m :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 /\ limit A R euclideanreal g m net0 -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x + - g x) (l + - m) net0

items.name: LIMIT_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> forall l :e A, limit omega A top s l sequentially <-> l :e topspace A top /\ forall u c= A, u :e top /\ l :e u -> exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n -> s n :e u

items.name: LIMIT_SEQUENTIALLY_OFFSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall l :e A, forall k :e omega, limit omega A top f l sequentially -> limit omega A top (fun i:set => f (i + k)) l sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_SEQUENTIALLY_OFFSET_REV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall l :e A, forall k :e omega, limit omega A top (fun i:set => f (i + k)) l sequentially -> limit omega A top f l sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_SUBMETRIC_IFF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall m :e metric B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e B, limit A B (mtopology B (submetric B m s)) f l net0 <-> l :e s /\ (eventually A {x :e A | f x :e s} net0 /\ limit A B (mtopology B m) f l net0)

items.name: LIMIT_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall l :e A, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) -> (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ limit omega A top f l sequentially -> limit omega A top (fun x:set => f (r x)) l sequentially

items.name: LIMIT_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall top :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall l :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (limit A B (subtopology B top s) f l net0 <-> l :e s /\ (eventually A {a :e A | f a :e s} net0 /\ limit A B top f l net0))

items.name: LIMIT_SUM
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e K, f x y :e R) -> forall l:set -> set, (forall x :e K, l x :e R) -> forall k c= K, finite k /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x i) (l i) net0) -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => finsum k (f x)) (finsum k l) net0

items.name: LIMIT_SUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e K, f x y :e R) -> forall l:set -> set, (forall x :e K, l x :e R) -> forall k c= K, finite k /\ (forall i :e K, i :e k -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x i) (l i) net0) -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => sup {f x i | i :e K, i :e k}) (sup {l i | i :e K, i :e k}) net0

items.name: LIMIT_TRANSFORM_EVENTUALLY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall top :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall l :e B, eventually A {x :e A | f x = g x} net0 /\ limit A B top f l net0 -> limit A B top g l net0

items.name: LIMIT_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology B, forall y :e B, trivial_limit A net0 /\ y :e topspace B top -> limit A B top f y net0

items.name: LIMIT_WITHIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall net0 :e net A, forall top :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e B, forall s t c= A, limit A B top f l (within A net0 s) /\ t c= s -> limit A B top f l (within A net0 t)

items.name: LIMPT_APPROACHABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, limit_point_of A x s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists x' :e R :^: idx A, x' :e s /\ (~ x' = x /\ distance A (x',x) < e0)

items.name: LIMPT_APPROACHABLE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, limit_point_of A x s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists x' :e R :^: idx A, x' :e s /\ (~ x' = x /\ distance A (x',x) <= e0)

items.name: LIMPT_APPROACHABLE_LIFT
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall s c= R, limit_point_of 1 (lift x) {lift x0 | x0 :e s} <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists x' :e R, x' :e s /\ (~ x' = x /\ abs_SNo (x' + - x) < e0)

items.name: LIMPT_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, limit_point_of N y (ball N (x,e0)) <-> 0 < e0 /\ y :e cball N (x,e0)

items.name: LIMPT_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x (s :\: {a}) <-> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: LIMPT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, ~ limit_point_of A x Empty

items.name: LIMPT_INFINITE_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> infinite (s :/\: ball N (x,e0))

items.name: LIMPT_INFINITE_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> infinite (s :/\: cball N (x,e0))

items.name: LIMPT_INFINITE_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ open N t -> infinite (s :/\: t)

items.name: LIMPT_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, f x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x0 y :e R :^: idx M, f x0 = f y -> x0 = y) -> (limit_point_of N (f x) {f x | x :e s} <-> limit_point_of M x s)

items.name: LIMPT_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x (SetAdjoin s y) <-> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: LIMPT_OF_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x (closure N s) <-> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: LIMPT_OF_CONDENSATION_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x {y :e R :^: idx N | condensation_point_of N y s} <-> condensation_point_of N x s

items.name: LIMPT_OF_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ x :e s -> (limit_point_of N x s <-> ~ s = {x})

items.name: LIMPT_OF_LIMPTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x {y :e R :^: idx N | limit_point_of N y s} -> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: LIMPT_OF_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, open N s /\ x :e s -> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: LIMPT_OF_OPEN_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, open N s /\ x :e closure N s -> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: LIMPT_OF_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (limit_point_of N x s /\ x :e t) -> limit_point_of N x t

items.name: LIMPT_OF_SEQUENCE_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N l {f x | x :e omega} -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto N omega (fun x:set => f (r x)) l sequentially)

items.name: LIMPT_OF_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x (R :^: idx N)

items.name: LIMPT_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, limit_point_of M x s /\ limit_point_of N y t -> limit_point_of (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x y) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: LIMPT_SEQUENTIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :\: {x}) /\ tendsto N omega f x sequentially)

items.name: LIMPT_SEQUENTIAL_DECREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :\: {x}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> distance N (f n,x) < distance N (f m,x)) /\ tendsto N omega f x sequentially))

items.name: LIMPT_SEQUENTIAL_INJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, limit_point_of N x s <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n :e s :\: {x}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, f m = f n <-> m = n) /\ tendsto N omega f x sequentially))

items.name: LIMPT_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, ~ limit_point_of N x {y}

items.name: LIMPT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s t c= R :^: idx A, limit_point_of A x s /\ s c= t -> limit_point_of A x t

items.name: LIMPT_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, limit_point_of A (vector_add A a x) {vector_add A a y | y :e s} <-> limit_point_of A x s

items.name: LIM_ABS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A f l net0 -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => abs_SNo (f x i)) (fun i :e idx N => abs_SNo (l i)) net0

items.name: LIM_ADD
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l m :e R :^: idx B, tendsto B A f l net0 /\ tendsto B A g m net0 -> tendsto B A (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) (vector_add B l m) net0

items.name: LIM_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (at M a) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, 0 < distance M (x,a) /\ distance M (x,a) < d -> distance N (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_AT_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => x) a (at A a)

items.name: LIM_AT_INFINITY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (at_infinity B) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx B, b <= vector_norm B x -> distance A (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_AT_INFINITY_POS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (at_infinity B) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists b :e R, 0 < b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx B, b <= vector_norm B x -> distance A (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_AT_INFINITY_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at_infinity M) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ b <= vector_norm M x -> distance N (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_AT_INFINITY_WITHIN_POS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at_infinity M) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists b :e R, 0 < b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ b <= vector_norm M x -> distance N (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_AT_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx B, tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (at B a) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx B, 0 < distance B (x,a) /\ distance B (x,a) <= d -> distance A (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_AT_NEGINFINITY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A R f l at_neginfinity <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x <= b -> distance A (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_AT_POSINFINITY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A R f l at_posinfinity <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists b :e R, forall x :e R, b <= x -> distance A (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_AT_REFLECT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (vector_neg M x)) l (at M (vector_neg M a)) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (at M a)

items.name: LIM_AT_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (at M a) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> (forall n :e omega, ~ x n = a) /\ tendsto M omega x a sequentially -> tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIM_AT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= R :^: idx B, tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (at B a) -> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) s)

items.name: LIM_AT_ZERO
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (at M a) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x)) l (at M (vec M 0))

items.name: LIM_BILINEAR
items.statement: forall A M N P:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx M, forall m :e R :^: idx N, tendsto M A f l net0 /\ (tendsto N A g m net0 /\ bilinear N P M h) -> tendsto P A (fun x:set => h (f x) (g x)) (h l m) net0

items.name: LIM_BILINEAR_CONVOLUTION
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m :e omega, forall k :e R, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, bilinear N P M bop /\ (tendsto M omega x a sequentially /\ tendsto N omega y b sequentially) -> tendsto P omega (fun n:set => vector_mul P (recip_SNo (n + k)) (vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => bop (x i) (y (minus_nat n i))))) (bop a b) sequentially

items.name: LIM_CASES_COFINITE_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, finite {n :e omega | ~ P n} -> (tendsto A omega (fun n:set => if P n then f n else g n) l sequentially <-> tendsto A omega f l sequentially)

items.name: LIM_CASES_FINITE_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, finite {n :e omega | P n} -> (tendsto A omega (fun n:set => if P n then f n else g n) l sequentially <-> tendsto A omega g l sequentially)

items.name: LIM_CASES_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall m :e omega, (tendsto A omega (fun n:set => if m <= n then f n else g n) l sequentially <-> tendsto A omega f l sequentially) /\ ((tendsto A omega (fun n:set => if m < n then f n else g n) l sequentially <-> tendsto A omega f l sequentially) /\ ((tendsto A omega (fun n:set => if n <= m then f n else g n) l sequentially <-> tendsto A omega g l sequentially) /\ (tendsto A omega (fun n:set => if n < m then f n else g n) l sequentially <-> tendsto A omega g l sequentially)))

items.name: LIM_CESARO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall m :e omega, forall k :e R, tendsto N omega a l sequentially -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (n + k)) (vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} a)) l sequentially

items.name: LIM_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx B, forall c :e R, tendsto B A f l net0 -> tendsto B A (fun x:set => vector_mul B c (f x)) (vector_mul B c l) net0

items.name: LIM_CMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx B, forall c :e R, ~ c = 0 -> (tendsto B A (fun x:set => vector_mul B c (f x)) (vector_mul B c l) net0 <-> tendsto B A f l net0)

items.name: LIM_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N) -> forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (A0 a) x) (matrix_vector_mul N N B x) net0) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (cofactor N (A0 a)) x) (matrix_vector_mul N N (cofactor N B) x) net0

items.name: LIM_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e omega, forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A f l net0 -> tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (f a i)) (lift (l i)) net0

items.name: LIM_COMPONENTWISE_LIFT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (tendsto N A f l net0 <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) (lift (l i)) net0)

items.name: LIM_COMPONENTWISE_REAL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A f l net0 <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => f x i) (l i) net0

items.name: LIM_COMPONENT_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e omega, forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, tendsto N A f l net0 /\ (1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ eventually A {x :e A | f x i = b} net0))) -> l i = b

items.name: LIM_COMPONENT_LBOUND
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, forall k :e omega, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (tendsto N A f l net0 /\ (eventually A {x :e A | b <= f x k} net0 /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N))) -> b <= l k

items.name: LIM_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, forall l m :e R :^: idx N, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (tendsto N A f l net0 /\ (tendsto N A g m net0 /\ (eventually A {x :e A | f x k <= g x k} net0 /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N)))) -> l k <= m k

items.name: LIM_COMPONENT_UBOUND
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, forall k :e omega, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (tendsto N A f l net0 /\ (eventually A {x :e A | f x k <= b} net0 /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N))) -> l k <= b

items.name: LIM_COMPOSE_AT
items.statement: forall A N P:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx P, tendsto N A f y net0 /\ (eventually A {w :e A | f w = y -> g y = z} net0 /\ tendsto P (R :^: idx N) g z (at N y)) -> tendsto P A (fun x:set => g (f x)) z net0

items.name: LIM_COMPOSE_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A N P:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx P, tendsto N A f y net0 /\ (eventually A {w :e A | f w :e s /\ (f w = y -> g y = z)} net0 /\ tendsto P (R :^: idx N) g z (within (R :^: idx N) (at N y) s)) -> tendsto P A (fun x:set => g (f x)) z net0

items.name: LIM_CONG_AT

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, ~ x = a -> f x = g x) -> (tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (at B a) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) g l (at B a))
