var_views.f: metafun(R :^: idx B -> R :^: idx A)
var_views.g: metafun(R :^: idx B -> R :^: idx A)

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s /\ ~ x = a -> f x = g x) -> (tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) s) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) g l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) s))

items.name: LIM_CONST
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall a :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A (fun x:set => a) a net0

items.name: LIM_CONST_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A (fun x:set => c) d net0 <-> trivial_limit A net0 \/ c = d

items.name: LIM_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, continuous N A f net0 /\ f (netlimit A net0) = l -> tendsto N A f l net0

items.name: LIM_CONTINUOUS_FUNCTION
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall net0 :e net C, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e C, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx B, continuous A (R :^: idx B) f (at B l) /\ tendsto B C g l net0 -> tendsto A C (fun x:set => f (g x)) (f l) net0

items.name: LIM_CONTINUOUS_FUNCTION_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall l :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M l) s) /\ (tendsto M A g l net0 /\ eventually A {a :e A | g a :e s} net0) -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => f (g x)) (f l) net0

items.name: LIM_CONTINUOUS_SELF_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M x) /\ f x = y -> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f y (at M x)

items.name: LIM_CONTINUOUS_SELF_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ f x = y -> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f y (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: LIM_DROP_LBOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall l :e R :^: idx 1, forall b :e R, tendsto 1 A f l net0 /\ (~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ eventually A {x :e A | b <= drop (f x)} net0) -> b <= drop l

items.name: LIM_DROP_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall l m :e R :^: idx 1, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (tendsto 1 A f l net0 /\ (tendsto 1 A g m net0 /\ eventually A {x :e A | drop (f x) <= drop (g x)} net0)) -> drop l <= drop m

items.name: LIM_DROP_UBOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall l :e R :^: idx 1, forall b :e R, tendsto 1 A f l net0 /\ (~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ eventually A {x :e A | drop (f x) <= b} net0) -> drop l <= b

items.name: LIM_EQ_DROP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall l :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto 1 A f l net0 <-> limit A R euclideanreal (fun x:set => drop (f x)) (drop l) net0

items.name: LIM_EQ_LIFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, limit A R euclideanreal f l net0 <-> tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (lift l) net0

items.name: LIM_EVENTUALLY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx B, eventually A {x :e A | f x = l} net0 -> tendsto B A f l net0

items.name: LIM_EVENTUALLY_IN_OPEN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (tendsto N A f l net0 /\ l :e s) -> eventually A {x :e A | f x :e s} net0

items.name: LIM_EVENTUALLY_IN_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall u s c= R :^: idx N, l :e s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (eventually A {x :e A | f x :e u} net0 /\ tendsto N A f l net0)) -> eventually A {x :e A | f x :e s} net0

items.name: LIM_INFINITY_POSINFINITY_LIFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (at_infinity 1) -> tendsto N R (fun x:set => f (lift x)) l at_posinfinity

items.name: LIM_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (lift l) net0 /\ ~ l = 0 -> tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (recip_SNo (f x))) (lift (recip_SNo l)) net0

items.name: LIM_IN_CLOSED_SET
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall l :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (eventually A {x :e A | f x :e s} net0 /\ (~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ tendsto N A f l net0)) -> l :e s

items.name: LIM_LIFT_ABS_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, tendsto N A f l net0 -> tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (f x k))) (lift (abs_SNo (l k))) net0

items.name: LIM_LIFT_DET
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N) -> forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall net0 :e net A, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (A0 x i j)) (lift (B i j)) net0) -> tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (det N (A0 x))) (lift (det N B)) net0

items.name: LIM_LIFT_DOT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx M), forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l net0 -> tendsto 1 (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => lift (dot N a (f x))) (lift (dot N a l)) net0

items.name: LIM_LIFT_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, forall n :e omega, tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (f a)) (lift l) net0 -> tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (f a ^ n)) (lift (l ^ n)) net0

items.name: LIM_LIFT_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall t c= B, finite t /\ (forall i :e B, i :e t -> tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) (lift (g i)) net0) -> tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (finprod t (f x))) (lift (finprod t g)) net0

items.name: LIM_LINEAR
items.statement: forall B C A:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, h x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx B, tendsto B A f l net0 /\ linear B C h -> tendsto C A (fun x:set => h (f x)) (h l) net0

items.name: LIM_MATRIX_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N) -> forall B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N M (A0 a) x) (matrix_vector_mul N M B x) net0) <-> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex M)) -> tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (A0 a i j)) (lift (B i j)) net0

items.name: LIM_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N) -> forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (A0 a) x) (matrix_vector_mul N N B x) net0) /\ ~ det N B = 0 -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_inv N N (A0 a)) x) (matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_inv N N B) x) net0

items.name: LIM_MATRIX_TRANSP
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N) -> forall B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, tendsto M A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M (A0 a)) x) (matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M B) x) net0) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N M (A0 a) x) (matrix_vector_mul N M B x) net0

items.name: LIM_MATRIX_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N) -> forall B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N M (A0 a) x) (matrix_vector_mul N M B x) net0) <-> tendsto (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex M)) A (fun a:set => vectorize R N M (A0 a)) (vectorize R N M B) net0

items.name: LIM_MAX
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l m :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A f l net0 /\ tendsto N A g m net0 -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => if f x i <= g x i then g x i else f x i) (fun i :e idx N => if l i <= m i then m i else l i) net0

items.name: LIM_MIN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l m :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A f l net0 /\ tendsto N A g m net0 -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => fun i :e idx N => if f x i <= g x i then f x i else g x i) (fun i :e idx N => if l i <= m i then l i else m i) net0

items.name: LIM_MUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e A, c x :e R) -> forall d :e R, tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (c x)) (lift d) net0 /\ tendsto N A f l net0 -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_mul N (c x) (f x)) (vector_mul N d l) net0

items.name: LIM_MUL_NORM_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= R :^: idx B, tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f (vec A 0) (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) s) -> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) (fun x:set => vector_mul A (vector_norm B (vector_sub B x a)) (f x)) (vec A 0) (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) s)

items.name: LIM_NEG
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A f l net0 -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) (vector_neg N l) net0

items.name: LIM_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) (vector_neg N l) net0 <-> tendsto N A f l net0

items.name: LIM_NORM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A f l net0 -> tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x))) (lift (vector_norm N l)) net0

items.name: LIM_NORM_LBOUND
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (tendsto N A f l net0 /\ eventually A {x :e A | b <= vector_norm N (f x)} net0) -> b <= vector_norm N l

items.name: LIM_NORM_UBOUND
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (tendsto N A f l net0 /\ eventually A {x :e A | vector_norm N (f x) <= b} net0) -> vector_norm N l <= b

items.name: LIM_NULL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx B, tendsto B A f l net0 <-> tendsto B A (fun x:set => vector_sub B (f x) l) (vec B 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_ADD
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> tendsto N A f (vec N 0) net0 /\ tendsto N A g (vec N 0) net0 -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) (vec N 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall c :e R, tendsto B A f (vec B 0) net0 -> tendsto B A (fun x:set => vector_mul B c (f x)) (vec B 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_CMUL_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall B :e R, eventually A {a :e A | g a = vec N 0 \/ abs_SNo (f a) <= B} net0 /\ tendsto N A g (vec N 0) net0 -> tendsto N A (fun n:set => vector_mul N (f n) (g n)) (vec N 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_CMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) (vec N 0) net0 <-> c = 0 \/ tendsto N A f (vec N 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> eventually A {x :e A | vector_norm B (f x) <= g x} net0 /\ tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (g x)) (vec 1 0) net0 -> tendsto B A f (vec B 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_MATRIX_ONORM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N) -> (tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (onorm M N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N M (A0 a) x))) (vec 1 0) net0 <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N A (fun a:set => matrix_vector_mul N M (A0 a) x) (vec N 0) net0)

items.name: LIM_NULL_MATRIX_ONORM_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N) -> (tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (onorm M N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N M (A0 a) x))) (vec 1 0) net0 <-> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex M)) -> tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (A0 a i j)) (vec 1 0) net0)

items.name: LIM_NULL_NEG
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) (vec N 0) net0 <-> tendsto N A f (vec N 0) net0)

items.name: LIM_NULL_NORM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> (tendsto A B f (vec A 0) net0 <-> tendsto 1 B (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm A (f x))) (vec 1 0) net0)

items.name: LIM_NULL_ONORM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall a :e A, linear M N (f a)) /\ (linear M N g /\ tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (onorm M N (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f a x) (g x)))) (vec 1 0) net0) -> tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (onorm M N (f a))) (lift (onorm M N g)) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_ONORM_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall a :e A, linear M N (f a)) -> (tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (onorm M N (f a))) (vec 1 0) net0 <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> tendsto N A (fun a:set => f a (basis M i)) (vec N 0) net0)

items.name: LIM_NULL_SUB
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> tendsto N A f (vec N 0) net0 /\ tendsto N A g (vec N 0) net0 -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) (vec N 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_VMUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e A, c x :e R) -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (c x)) (vec 1 0) net0 -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_mul N (c x) v) (vec N 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_VMUL_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall B :e R, tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (vec 1 0) net0 /\ eventually A {a :e A | f a = 0 \/ vector_norm N (g a) <= B} net0 -> tendsto N A (fun n:set => vector_mul N (f n) (g n)) (vec N 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_VMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e A, c x :e R) -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_mul N (c x) v) (vec N 0) net0 <-> v = vec N 0 \/ tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (c x)) (vec 1 0) net0

items.name: LIM_NULL_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= B, finite s /\ (forall a :e B, a :e s -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => f x a) (vec N 0) net0) -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => vsum B N s (f x)) (vec N 0) net0

items.name: LIM_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> tendsto M A f a net0 /\ tendsto N A g b net0 -> tendsto (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) A (fun x:set => pastecart M N (f x) (g x)) (pastecart M N a b) net0

items.name: LIM_PASTECART_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (tendsto (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) A (fun x:set => pastecart M N (f x) (g x)) (pastecart M N a b) net0 <-> tendsto M A f a net0 /\ tendsto N A g b net0)

items.name: LIM_POSINFINITY_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A R f l at_posinfinity -> tendsto A omega f l sequentially

items.name: LIM_SELF_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f (f a) (at M a) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, distance M (x,a) < d -> distance N (f x,f a) < e0

items.name: LIM_SELF_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f (f a) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ distance M (x,a) < d -> distance N (f x,f a) < e0

items.name: LIM_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, tendsto A omega s l sequentially <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n -> distance A (s n,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_SUB
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l m :e R :^: idx B, tendsto B A f l net0 /\ tendsto B A g m net0 -> tendsto B A (fun x:set => vector_sub B (f x) (g x)) (vector_sub B l m) net0

items.name: LIM_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto A omega s l sequentially -> tendsto A omega (fun x:set => s (r x)) l sequentially

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx B, tendsto B A (fun x:set => vector_sub B (f x) (g x)) (vec B 0) net0 /\ tendsto B A f l net0 -> tendsto B A g l net0

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_AT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall d :e R, 0 < d /\ ((forall x' :e R :^: idx B, 0 < distance B (x',x) /\ distance B (x',x) < d -> f x' = g x') /\ tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (at B x)) -> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) g l (at B x)

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_AWAY_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ~ a = b /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x = a /\ ~ x = b -> f x = g x) /\ tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (at M a)) -> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) g l (at M a)

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_AWAY_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, ~ a = b /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (~ x = a /\ ~ x = b) -> f x = g x) /\ tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s)) -> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) g l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s)

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_BOUND
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> eventually A {n :e A | vector_norm C (f n) <= vector_norm B (g n)} net0 /\ tendsto B A g (vec B 0) net0 -> tendsto C A f (vec C 0) net0

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_EQ
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) (vec N 0) net0 -> (tendsto N A f l net0 <-> tendsto N A g l net0)

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_EVENTUALLY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx B, eventually A {x :e A | f x = g x} net0 /\ tendsto B A f l net0 -> tendsto B A g l net0

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall d :e R, 0 < d /\ ((forall x' :e R :^: idx B, x' :e s /\ (0 < distance B (x',x) /\ distance B (x',x) < d) -> f x' = g x') /\ tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s)) -> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) g l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s)

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_WITHIN_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall l :e R :^: idx N, open M s /\ (a :e s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ ~ x = a -> f x = g x) /\ tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (at M a))) -> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) g l (at M a)

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_WITHIN_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall l :e R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) t /\ (a :e s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ ~ x = a -> f x = g x) /\ tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) t))) -> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) g l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) t)

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_WITHIN_SET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall s t c= R :^: idx B, eventually (R :^: idx B) {x :e R :^: idx B | x :e s <-> x :e t} (at B a) -> (tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) s) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) t))

items.name: LIM_TRANSFORM_WITHIN_SET_IMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall s t c= R :^: idx B, eventually (R :^: idx B) {x :e R :^: idx B | x :e t -> x :e s} (at B a) /\ tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) s) -> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) t)

items.name: LIM_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, trivial_limit A net0 -> tendsto N A f l net0

items.name: LIM_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall s t c= R :^: idx B, tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s) /\ tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) t) -> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) (s :\/: t))

items.name: LIM_UNION_UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, tendsto A (R :^: idx N) f l (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s) /\ (tendsto A (R :^: idx N) f l (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) t) /\ s :\/: t = R :^: idx N) -> tendsto A (R :^: idx N) f l (at N x)

items.name: LIM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l l' :e R :^: idx N, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (tendsto N A f l net0 /\ tendsto N A f l' net0) -> l = l'

items.name: LIM_VECTORIZE_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall A0:set -> set, (forall x :e A, A0 x :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M) -> forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, tendsto (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) A (fun a:set => vectorize R M N (A0 a)) (vectorize R M N B) net0 <-> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> tendsto 1 A (fun a:set => lift (A0 a i j)) (lift (B i j)) net0

items.name: LIM_VMUL
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e A, c x :e R) -> forall d :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, tendsto 1 A (fun x:set => lift (c x)) (lift d) net0 -> tendsto N A (fun x:set => vector_mul N (c x) v) (vector_mul N d v) net0

items.name: LIM_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l:set -> set, (forall x :e A, l x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> tendsto N B (f i) (l i) net0) -> tendsto N B (fun x:set => vsum A N s (fun i:set => f i x)) (vsum A N s l) net0

items.name: LIM_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (0 < distance M (x,a) /\ distance M (x,a) < d) -> distance N (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_CLOSED_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, closed A s /\ ~ a :e s -> trivial_limit (R :^: idx A) (within (R :^: idx A) (at A a) s)

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_DELETE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) (s :\: {a})) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s)

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx B, tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) Empty)

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, tendsto A (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => x) a (within (R :^: idx A) (at A a) s)

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e interior B s -> (tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (at B x))

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_INTERIOR_INTER
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e interior B s -> (tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) (s :/\: t)) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) t))

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (0 < distance M (x,a) /\ distance M (x,a) <= d) -> distance N (f x,l) < e0

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_OPEN
items.statement: forall A M:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, a :e s /\ open M s -> (tendsto A (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx M) f l (at M a))

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall s t c= R :^: idx M, a :e t /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> (tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) t) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s))

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_REFLECT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (vector_neg M x)) l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M (vector_neg M a)) {vector_neg M x | x :e s}) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s)

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :\: {a}) /\ tendsto M omega x a sequentially -> tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY_DECREASING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> distance M (x n,a) < distance M (x m,a)) /\ tendsto M omega x a sequentially) -> tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_SEQUENTIALLY_INJ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s :\: {a}) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, x m = x n <-> m = n) /\ tendsto M omega x a sequentially) -> tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) l sequentially

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= R :^: idx B, tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) s) /\ t c= s -> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B a) t)

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_UNION

var_views.f: metafun(R :^: idx B -> R :^: idx A)

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx B, f x0 :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall s t c= R :^: idx B, tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) (s :\/: t)) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s) /\ tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f l (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) t)

items.name: LIM_WITHIN_ZERO
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N (R :^: idx M) f l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M a) s) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x)) l (within (R :^: idx M) (at M (vec M 0)) {vector_sub M x a | x :e s})

items.name: LINDELOF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> open N s) -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ (countable f' /\ Union f' = Union f)

items.name: LINDELOF_HAUSDORFF_REGULAR_EQ_PARACOMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, lindelof_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top -> (regular_space A top <-> paracompact_space A top)

items.name: LINDELOF_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall u c= R :^: idx N, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ (countable f' /\ Union f' = Union f)

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, lindelof_space A top <-> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ topspace A top c= Union U -> exists V c= Power A, countable V /\ (V c= U /\ topspace A top c= Union V)

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, lindelof_space A top /\ closed_in A top s -> lindelof_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> lindelof_space A top /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> lindelof_space B top'

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> lindelof_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> lindelof_space B top'

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> (lindelof_space A top <-> lindelof_space B top')

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_PROPER_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ lindelof_space B top' -> lindelof_space A top

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_QUOTIENT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') q /\ lindelof_space A top -> lindelof_space B top'

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ lindelof_space A top -> lindelof_space B top'

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, lindelof_space A (subtopology A top s) <-> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ topspace A top :/\: s c= Union U -> exists V c= Power A, countable V /\ (V c= U /\ topspace A top :/\: s c= Union V)

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (lindelof_space A (subtopology A top s) <-> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ s c= Union U -> exists V c= Power A, countable V /\ (V c= U /\ s c= Union V))

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_TOPSPACE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> lindelof_space A top

items.name: LINDELOF_SPACE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall U c= Power A, countable U /\ (forall c c= A, c :e U -> lindelof_space A (subtopology A top c)) -> lindelof_space A (subtopology A top (Union U))

items.name: LINEAR_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f -> f (vec A 0) = vec B 0

items.name: LINEAR_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (linear 1 1 f <-> exists c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x = vector_mul 1 c x)

items.name: LINEAR_1_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> dimindex N = 1 -> (linear N N f <-> exists c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = vector_mul N c x)

items.name: LINEAR_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, linear A B f -> f (vector_add A x y) = vector_add B (f x) (f y)

items.name: LINEAR_BIJECTIVE_DIMINDEX_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> dimindex M = dimindex N

items.name: LINEAR_BIJECTIVE_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, f (g y) = y))

items.name: LINEAR_BIJECTIVE_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x)))

items.name: LINEAR_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> exists B :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= B * vector_norm M x

items.name: LINEAR_BOUNDED_POS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= B * vector_norm M x

items.name: LINEAR_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> linear N N (fun x:set => closest_point N s x)

items.name: LINEAR_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, linear A B f -> f (vector_mul A c x) = vector_mul B c (f x)

items.name: LINEAR_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (linear M N f <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> linear M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)))

items.name: LINEAR_COMPONENTWISE_EXPANSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall j :e omega, 1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N -> f x j = finsum (idx M) (fun i:set => x i * f (basis M i) j)

items.name: LINEAR_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> linear A B f /\ linear B C g -> linear A C (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f /\ linear A B g -> linear A B (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x))

items.name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c :e R, linear B A f -> linear B A (fun x:set => vector_mul A c (f x))

items.name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_NEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f -> linear A B (fun x:set => vector_neg B (f x))

items.name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (linear M N (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) <-> linear M N f)

items.name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_SUB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f /\ linear A B g -> linear A B (fun x:set => vector_sub B (f x) (g x))

items.name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e C, forall y :e R :^: idx B, f x y :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= C, finite s /\ (forall a :e C, a :e s -> linear B A (f a)) -> linear B A (fun x:set => vsum C A s (fun a:set => f a x))

items.name: LINEAR_CONTINUOUS_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (at M a)

items.name: LINEAR_CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A N P:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> continuous N A f net0 /\ linear N P g -> continuous P A (fun x:set => g (f x)) net0

items.name: LINEAR_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: LINEAR_CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ linear N P g -> continuous_on_hl M P (fun x:set => g (f x)) s

items.name: LINEAR_CONTINUOUS_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> continuous N (R :^: idx M) f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: LINEAR_CONVEX_ON_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (linear N 1 f <-> f (vec N 0) = vec 1 0 /\ (convex_on N (fun x:set => drop (f x)) (R :^: idx N) /\ convex_on N (fun x:set => - drop (f x)) (R :^: idx N)))

items.name: LINEAR_DROPOUT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, linear N M (fun x:set => dropout N M k x)

items.name: LINEAR_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall b s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (linear B A g /\ (s c= span B b /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e b -> f x = g x))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> f x = g x

items.name: LINEAR_EQUATIONS_1_EQ
items.statement: forall a b :e R, (exists x :e R, a * x = b) <-> a = 0 -> b = 0

items.name: LINEAR_EQUATIONS_2_EQ
items.statement: forall a b c d u v :e R, (exists x y :e R, a * x + b * y = u /\ c * x + d * y = v) <-> (a * d = b * c -> d * u = b * v /\ c * u = a * v) /\ (a = 0 /\ (b = 0 /\ (c = 0 /\ d = 0)) -> u = 0 /\ v = 0)

items.name: LINEAR_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall b s c= R :^: idx A, linear A B f /\ (s c= span A b /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e b -> f x = vec B 0)) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> f x = vec B 0

items.name: LINEAR_EQ_0_SPAN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e b -> f x = vec N 0) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e span M b -> f x = vec N 0

items.name: LINEAR_EQ_MATRIX
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f /\ (linear A B g /\ matrix A B f = matrix A B g) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x = g x

items.name: LINEAR_EQ_MBASIS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector M), g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s :e A, linear (multivector M) N f /\ (linear (multivector M) N g /\ (forall s0 c= omega, s0 c= idx M -> f (mbasis M s0) = g (mbasis M s0))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector M), f x = g x

items.name: LINEAR_EQ_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (linear M N g /\ (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> f (basis M i) = g (basis M i))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x = g x

items.name: LINEAR_FRECHET_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx B), differentiable A B f net0 -> linear B A (frechet_derivative A B f net0)

items.name: LINEAR_FROM_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (linear 1 N f <-> exists c :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x = vector_mul N (drop x) c)

items.name: LINEAR_FROM_REALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear 1 N f -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x = vector_mul N (drop x) (column N 1 1 (matrix 1 N f))

items.name: LINEAR_FSTCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> linear (idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A)) B (fun x:set => fstcart B x)

items.name: LINEAR_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> linear A A (fun x:set => x)

items.name: LINEAR_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> linear A A (fun x:set => x)

items.name: LINEAR_IMAGE_SUBSET_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y) -> {f x | x :e interior M s} c= interior N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LINEAR_IMP_CONVEX_ON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) -> convex_on N f s

items.name: LINEAR_IMP_HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear 1 N f /\ bounded_hl 1 s -> has_bounded_variation_on N f s

items.name: LINEAR_IMP_HOMEOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, linear M N (fun x:set => f x) /\ (linear N M (fun x:set => g x) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x) /\ {f x | x :e s} = t)) -> homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g)

items.name: LINEAR_IMP_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)

items.name: LINEAR_INDEPENDENT_EXTEND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b c= R :^: idx M, independent M b -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear M N g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e b -> g x = f x)

items.name: LINEAR_INDEPENDENT_EXTEND_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b c= R :^: idx M, finite b -> independent M b -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e span M b /\ y :e span M b -> g (vector_add M x y) = vector_add N (g x) (g y)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, x :e span M b -> g (vector_mul M c x) = vector_mul N c (g x)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e b -> g x = f x))

items.name: LINEAR_INDEP_IMAGE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (finite b /\ (independent N {f x | x :e b} /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e b /\ (y :e b /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e span M b -> f x = vec N 0 -> x = vec M 0

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> linear B A f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x = vec A 0 -> x = vec B 0)

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_0_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ subspace M s -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ f x = vec N 0 -> x = vec M 0)

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_BOUNDED_BELOW_POS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm M x * B <= vector_norm N (f x)

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_DIMINDEX_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> dimindex M <= dimindex N

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IFF_DIM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> dim N {f x | x :e R :^: idx M} = dimindex M)

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IMP_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = y

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IMP_SURJECTIVE_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, linear M N f /\ (subspace M s /\ (subspace N t /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (dim N t <= dim M s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y))))) -> {f x | x :e s} = t

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_ISOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear N N f' /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' (f x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (f' x) = x))

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x)

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_LEFT_INVERSE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x))

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear N N g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (f x) = x)))

items.name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_ON_IFF_DIM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ subspace M s -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> dim N {f x | x :e s} = dim M s)

items.name: LINEAR_INTERIOR_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> interior N {f x | x :e s} c= {f x | x :e interior M s}

items.name: LINEAR_INVERSE_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ linear N N f' -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (f' x) = x) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' (f x) = x)

items.name: LINEAR_INVERTIBLE_BOUNDED_BELOW
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> linear M N f /\ (linear N M g /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x)) -> exists B :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, B * vector_norm M x <= vector_norm N (f x)

items.name: LINEAR_INVERTIBLE_BOUNDED_BELOW_POS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> linear M N f /\ (linear N M g /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x)) -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, B * vector_norm M x <= vector_norm N (f x)

items.name: LINEAR_LIFT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, linear N 1 (fun x:set => lift (x k))

items.name: LINEAR_LIFT_DOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, linear A 1 (fun x:set => lift (dot A a x))

items.name: LINEAR_LIMIT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ (eventually A {i :e A | linear M N (f i)} net0 /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N A (fun i:set => f i x) (g x) net0)) -> linear M N g

items.name: LINEAR_LIM_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> linear B A f -> tendsto A (R :^: idx B) f (vec A 0) (at B (vec B 0))

items.name: LINEAR_MATRIX_EXISTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (linear M N f <-> exists A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x = matrix_vector_mul N M A x)

items.name: LINEAR_NEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, linear A B f -> f (vector_neg A x) = vector_neg B (f x)

items.name: LINEAR_NEGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> linear A A (fun x:set => vector_neg A x)

items.name: LINEAR_OPEN_MAPPING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> linear M N f /\ (linear N M g /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x)) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, open M s -> open N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LINEAR_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> linear M N f /\ linear M P g -> linear M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x))

items.name: LINEAR_PASTECART_EQ
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> (linear M (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) (fun x:set => pastecart N P (f x) (g x)) <-> linear M N f /\ linear M P g)

items.name: LINEAR_PROPERTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P (vec B 0) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, P x /\ P y -> P (vector_add B x y)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> P (f i)) -> P (vsum A B s f)

items.name: LINEAR_PUSHIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, linear A B (fun x:set => pushin B R A k 0 x)

items.name: LINEAR_REFLECT_ALONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, linear N N (fun x:set => reflect_along N v x)

items.name: LINEAR_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, linear N N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c x)

items.name: LINEAR_SEQUENTIAL_LIMIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> eventually omega {n :e omega | linear M N (f n)} sequentially /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially) -> linear M N g

items.name: LINEAR_SINGULAR_IMAGE_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ ~ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = 0}

items.name: LINEAR_SINGULAR_INTO_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> (~ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, dot N a (f x) = 0)

items.name: LINEAR_SNDCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> linear (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) B (fun x:set => sndcart A B x)

items.name: LINEAR_SUB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, linear A B f -> f (vector_sub A x y) = vector_sub B (f x) (f y)

items.name: LINEAR_SUBSPACE_GRAPH
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (linear M N f <-> subspace (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {pastecart M N x (f x) | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e R :^: idx M})

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_DIMINDEX_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y) -> dimindex N <= dimindex M

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_IFF_DIM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y) <-> dim N {f x | x :e R :^: idx M} = dimindex N)

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = y) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> dimindex M = dimindex N /\ linear M N f -> ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, linear M N f /\ (subspace M s /\ (subspace N t /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ dim M s = dim N t))) -> ({f x | x :e s} = t <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_IMP_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = y) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_ISOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = y) -> exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear N N f' /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f' (f x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (f' x) = x))

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear N N g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (f x) = x)))

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_ON_IFF_DIM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, linear M N f /\ (subspace M s /\ (subspace N t /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t)) -> ({f x | x :e s} = t <-> dim N {f x | x :e s} = dim N t)

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x)

items.name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_RIGHT_INVERSE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x))

items.name: LINEAR_TO_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (linear N 1 f <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = lift (dot N a x))

items.name: LINEAR_TO_REALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> linear N 1 f -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = lift (dot N (row 1 N 1 (matrix N 1 f)) x)

items.name: LINEAR_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> linear (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex M)) (fun x:set => vectorize R N M (transp M N (matrify R M N x)))

items.name: LINEAR_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: LINEAR_VMUL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall v :e R :^: idx A, forall k :e omega, linear M N f /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> linear M A (fun x:set => vector_mul A (f x k) v)

items.name: LINEAR_VMUL_DROP

items.name: LINEAR_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e C, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= C, linear A B f /\ finite s -> f (vsum C A s g) = vsum C B s (fun x:set => f (g x))

items.name: LINEAR_VSUM_MUL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= C, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e C, c x :e R) -> forall v:set -> set, (forall x :e C, v x :e R :^: idx A) -> linear A B f /\ finite s -> f (vsum C A s (fun i:set => vector_mul A (c i) (v i))) = vsum C B s (fun i:set => vector_mul B (c i) (f (v i)))

items.name: LINEAR_ZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> linear A B (fun x:set => vec B 0)

items.name: LINEPATH_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> linear B A f -> forall b c :e R :^: idx B, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, linepath A (f b,f c) x = f (linepath B (b,c) x)

items.name: LINEPATH_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, linepath A (a,a) x = a

items.name: LINEPATH_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, linepath A (vector_add A a b,vector_add A a c) x = vector_add A a (linepath A (b,c) x)

items.name: LINSEG_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a x :e A, woset_on A l -> (x :e fld_on A (linseg_rel l a) <-> properly_rel l x a)

items.name: LINSEG_INSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, woset_on A l -> inseg_on A (linseg_rel l a) l

items.name: LINSEG_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a :e A, woset_on A l -> woset_on A (linseg_rel l a)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_COEFFICIENT_POS
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m' :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall k :e R, (forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m -> f x :e mspace B m') /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> mdist B m' (f x,f y) <= k * mdist A m (x,y)) /\ (exists x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ ~ f x = f y))) -> 0 < k

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_IMP_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f -> continuous_map A B (mtopology A m1,mtopology B m2) f

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_CART_PROJECTIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> lipschitz_continuous_map (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean_metric (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)),euclidean_metric M) (fun x:set => fstcart M x) /\ lipschitz_continuous_map (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean_metric (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)),euclidean_metric N) (fun x:set => sndcart M N x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall m3 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f /\ lipschitz_continuous_map C B (m2,m3) g -> lipschitz_continuous_map C A (m1,m3) (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall c :e B, lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) (fun x:set => c) <-> mspace A m1 = Empty \/ c :e mspace B m2

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e B, x :e mspace B m1 -> f x = g x) /\ lipschitz_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f -> lipschitz_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) g

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENDS_TO_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, mcomplete B m2 /\ lipschitz_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 s,m2) f -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (lipschitz_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 (closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s),m2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENDS_TO_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, mcomplete B m2 /\ (lipschitz_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 s,m2) f /\ t c= closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (lipschitz_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 t,m2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f -> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 s,m2) f

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_SUBMETRIC_MONO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall s t c= B, lipschitz_continuous_map A B (submetric B m1 t,m2) f /\ s c= t -> lipschitz_continuous_map A B (submetric B m1 s,m2) f

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> lipschitz_continuous_map (B :*: C) A (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) f -> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m,m1) (fun x:set => f x 0)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, lipschitz_continuous_map A A (m1,m1) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,submetric B m2 s) f <-> {f x | x :e mspace A m1} c= s /\ lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_MDIST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m' :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m,m') f /\ lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m,m') g -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => mdist B m' (f x,g x))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, lipschitz_continuous_map R (A :*: A) (prod_metric A A m m,real_euclidean_metric) (mdist A m)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE
