items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ (t c= closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A (mtopology A m1) t,mtopology B m2) f /\ lipschitz_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 s,m2) f)) -> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 t,m2) f

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PAIRED
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> (lipschitz_continuous_map (B :*: C) A (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) (fun x:set => (f x,g x)) <-> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m,m1) f /\ lipschitz_continuous_map C A (m,m2) g)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> (lipschitz_continuous_map (B :*: C) A (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) f <-> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m,m1) (fun x:set => f x 0) /\ lipschitz_continuous_map C A (m,m2) (fun x:set => f x 1))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PASTED
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (lipschitz_continuous_map (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) A (m,euclidean_metric (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (fun x:set => pastecart M N (f x) (g x)) <-> lipschitz_continuous_map (R :^: idx M) A (m,euclidean_metric M) f /\ lipschitz_continuous_map (R :^: idx N) A (m,euclidean_metric N) g)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PASTEWISE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> (lipschitz_continuous_map (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) A (m,euclidean_metric (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) f <-> lipschitz_continuous_map (R :^: idx M) A (m,euclidean_metric M) (fun x:set => fstcart M (f x)) /\ lipschitz_continuous_map (R :^: idx N) A (m,euclidean_metric N) (fun x:set => sndcart M N (f x)))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PASTING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> lipschitz_continuous_map (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (R :^: idx M :*: R :^: idx N) (prod_metric (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric M) (euclidean_metric N),euclidean_metric (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (fun p:set => pastecart M N (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_POS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f <-> {f x | x :e mspace A m1} c= mspace B m2 /\ exists B0 :e R, 0 < B0 /\ forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m1 /\ y :e mspace A m1 -> mdist B m2 (f x,f y) <= B0 * mdist A m1 (x,y))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PROJECTIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, lipschitz_continuous_map A (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2,m1) (fun x:set => x 0)) /\ forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, lipschitz_continuous_map B (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2,m2) (fun x:set => x 1)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_ABSOLUTE_VALUE
items.statement: lipschitz_continuous_map R R (real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => abs_SNo x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x + g x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_ADDITION
items.statement: lipschitz_continuous_map R (R :*: R) (prod_metric R R real_euclidean_metric real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun p:set => p 0 + p 1)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ (lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g /\ (real_bounded {f x | x :e mspace A m} /\ ~ 0 :e closure_of R euclideanreal {g x | x :e mspace A m})) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x :/: g x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ ~ 0 :e closure_of R euclideanreal {f x | x :e mspace A m} -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => recip_SNo (f x))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_LEFT_MULTIPLICATION
items.statement: forall c :e R, lipschitz_continuous_map R R (real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => c * x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => c * f x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => if f x <= g x then g x else f x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MAXIMUM
items.statement: lipschitz_continuous_map R (R :*: R) (prod_metric R R real_euclidean_metric real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun p:set => if p 0 <= p 1 then p 1 else p 0)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => if f x <= g x then f x else g x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MINIMUM
items.statement: lipschitz_continuous_map R (R :*: R) (prod_metric R R real_euclidean_metric real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun p:set => if p 0 <= p 1 then p 0 else p 1)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ (lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g /\ (real_bounded {f x | x :e mspace A m} /\ real_bounded {g x | x :e mspace A m})) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x * g x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => - f x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_NEGATION
items.statement: lipschitz_continuous_map R R (real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => - x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_RIGHT_MULTIPLICATION
items.statement: forall c :e R, lipschitz_continuous_map R R (real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => x * c)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x * c)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> lipschitz_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x + - g x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_SUBTRACTION
items.statement: lipschitz_continuous_map R (R :*: R) (prod_metric R R real_euclidean_metric real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun p:set => p 0 + - p 1)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SND
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> lipschitz_continuous_map (B :*: C) A (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) f -> lipschitz_continuous_map C A (m,m2) (fun x:set => f x 1)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SUM
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall m :e metric K, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e R) -> forall k c= A, finite k /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> lipschitz_continuous_map R K (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x i)) -> lipschitz_continuous_map R K (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => finsum k (f x))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONVEX_SPHERICAL_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s -> exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e relative_frontier N s /\ y :e relative_frontier N s -> distance N (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N x)) x,vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N y)) y) <= B * distance N (x,y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_CONVEX_SPHERICAL_PROJECTION_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (0 < r /\ (vec N 0 :e s /\ (ball N (vec N 0,r) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s c= relative_interior N s /\ (x :e relative_frontier N s /\ y :e relative_frontier N s)))) -> distance N (vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N x)) x,vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm N y)) y) <= recip_SNo r * distance N (x,y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_EXTENSION_EXISTS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g x) (g y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_IMP_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall B :e R, bounded_hl 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)) -> absolutely_continuous_on N f s

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_IMP_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_IMP_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_IMP_HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall B :e R, bounded_hl 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)) -> has_bounded_variation_on N f s

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_IMP_RECTIFIABLE_PATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g x) (g y)) <= b * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)) -> rectifiable_path N g

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_IMP_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_IMP_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_LIM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall b :e R, (forall n :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f n x) (f n y)) <= b * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g x) (g y)) <= b * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_ON_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, forall l :e R, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= l * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= l * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= l * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_ON_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> abs_SNo (f x i + - f y i) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_ON_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) /\ ((exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ y :e t -> vector_norm P (vector_sub P (g x) (g y)) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)) /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t) -> exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm P (vector_sub P (g (f x)) (g (f y))) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_ON_INF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall B :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, 0 <= B /\ ((forall f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), P f -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists C :e R, forall f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), P f -> C <= drop (f x))) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 (lift (inf {drop (f x) | f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), P f})) (lift (inf {drop (f y) | f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), P f}))) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_ON_POS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) <-> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_ON_SUP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall B :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, 0 <= B /\ ((forall f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), P f -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists C :e R, forall f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), P f -> drop (f x) <= C)) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 (lift (sup {drop (f x) | f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), P f})) (lift (sup {drop (f y) | f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx N), P f}))) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_ON_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, forall l :e R, is_interval 1 s /\ (is_interval 1 t /\ (~ s :/\: t = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= l * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e t /\ y :e t -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= l * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y))))) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s :\/: t /\ y :e s :\/: t -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= l * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_POS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> ((exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) <-> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y))

items.name: LIPSCHITZ_VECTOR_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall B :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> abs_SNo (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f + - vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,y) seq_nil)) f) <= B * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y))

items.name: LIST_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, l1 = l2 <-> seq_len l1 = seq_len l2 /\ forall n :e omega, n < seq_len l2 -> seq_nth l1 n = seq_nth l2 n

items.name: LIST_OF_SEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> seq_mk 0 f = seq_nil) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall n :e omega, seq_mk (ordsucc n) f = seq_cons (f 0) (seq_mk n (fun x:set => f (ordsucc x)))

items.name: LIST_OF_SEQ_EQ_NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> forall n :e omega, seq_mk n s = seq_nil <-> n = 0

items.name: LIST_OF_SEQ_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_mk (seq_len l) (fun i:set => seq_nth l i) = l

items.name: LIST_OF_SET_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = Empty /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality Empty) = seq_nil

items.name: LIST_OF_SET_PROPERTIES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> seq_set (choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)) = s /\ seq_len (choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)) = finite_cardinality s

items.name: LIST_OF_SET_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = {a} /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality {a}) = seq_cons a seq_nil

items.name: LOCALLY_AND_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ P u} s <-> forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (P u /\ (x :e u /\ u c= v))

items.name: LOCALLY_AND_OPEN_IN_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ locally N {v :e Power (R :^: idx N) | v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ P v} u} s <-> locally N {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ P u} s

items.name: LOCALLY_AND_SMALL_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, locally N P x <-> locally N {s :e Power (R :^: idx N) | s :e P /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ diameter N s <= e0)} x

items.name: LOCALLY_AND_SMALL_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, locally N P x <-> locally N {s :e Power (R :^: idx N) | s :e P /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ diameter N s < e0)} x

items.name: LOCALLY_AND_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N P s <-> locally N {t :e Power (R :^: idx N) | t c= s /\ t :e P} s

items.name: LOCALLY_ANR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | ANR N x} s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, x :e v /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ ANR N v)

items.name: LOCALLY_ANR_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | ANR N x} s <-> forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (ANR N u /\ (x :e u /\ u c= v))

items.name: LOCALLY_BAIRE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, locally M {u :e Power (R :^: idx M) | f :e baire M N k u} s <-> f :e baire M N k s

items.name: LOCALLY_BAIRE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, f :e baire M N k s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u v c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ f :e baire M N k v))

items.name: LOCALLY_BAIRE_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k :e omega, f :e baire M N k s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (x :e u /\ f :e baire M N k u)

items.name: LOCALLY_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall e0 :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> 0 < e0 /\ (forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m1 -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (submetric A m1 (mball A m1 (x,e0)),m2) f) -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f

items.name: LOCALLY_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | closed N x} s <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_CLOSED_IN_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s v c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e v /\ v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, a :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (u c= v /\ closure_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) u c= v))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (v c= s /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ compact N v)))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (compact N (closure N u) /\ closure N u c= s))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_CLOSED_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, closed N t /\ (closed N u /\ t :\: u = s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} t

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_CLOSED_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, closed N t /\ (open N u /\ s = t :/\: u)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_CLOSED_IN_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_CLOSED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} t /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t)) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} (s :\/: t)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_CLOSURE_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> closed N (closure N s :\: s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ compact N k -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, k c= u /\ (u c= v /\ (v c= s /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ compact N v)))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_COMPACT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ compact N k -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, k c= u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (compact N (closure N u) /\ closure N u c= s))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_COMPACT_SUBOPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> forall k t c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ (compact N k /\ (open N t /\ k c= t)) -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, k c= u /\ (u c= v /\ (u c= t /\ (v c= s /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ compact N v))))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s /\ connected N s) -> path_connected N s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (connected N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) -> path_connected N s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, locally_compact_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) /\ (connected_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s)) -> path_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} (s :\: {a})

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, locally_compact_space (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_HAUSDORFF_IMP_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_compact_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top -> regular_space A top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_HAUSDORFF_OR_REGULAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) <-> locally_compact_space A top /\ regular_space A top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_HOMEOMORPHIC_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s /\ dimindex M < dimindex N -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, closed N t /\ homeomorphic N M s t

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_HOMEOMORPHISM_PROJECTION_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s -> exists t c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), exists f :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) :^: (R :^: idx M), closed (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) t /\ homeomorphism M (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (s,t) (f,fun x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) => fstcart M x)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_IMP_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> analytic N s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_IMP_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> borel N s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_IMP_COMPLETELY_METRIZABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top /\ locally_compact_space A top -> completely_metrizable_space A top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_IMP_KC_EQ_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, neighbourhood_base_of A {x :e Power A | compact_in A top x} top -> (kc_space A top <-> hausdorff_space A top)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_IMP_K_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_compact_space A top -> k_space A top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} t -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} (s :/\: t)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_INTER_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ closed N (cball N (x,e0) :/\: s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_INTER_CBALLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall d :e R, d <= e0 -> closed N (cball N (x,d) :/\: s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_KC_IMP_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, neighbourhood_base_of A {x :e Power A | compact_in A top x} top /\ kc_space A top -> regular_space A top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_KC_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, neighbourhood_base_of A {x :e Power A | compact_in A top x} top /\ kc_space A top <-> locally_compact_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_KC_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, neighbourhood_base_of A {x :e Power A | compact_in A top x} top /\ kc_space A top <-> locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ regular_space A top)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} {f x | x :e s} <-> locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, locally_compact_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) /\ locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) -> locally_path_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, locally_compact_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) -> (locally_path_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) <-> locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} t

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_OPEN_INTER_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ s = t :/\: closure N s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_OPEN_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} t /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u)) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} (s :\/: t)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_OPEN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall u c= R :^: idx N, (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e f -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} c) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e f -> c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} (Union f)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> (path_connected N s <-> connected N s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} t -> locally (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) | compact (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x} (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, locally (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) | compact (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x} (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} t)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_PROPER_CONTINUOUS_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} c /\ c c= t))) -> locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e c}

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_PROPER_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= {f x | x :e s} /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) /\ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_PROPER_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= {f x | x :e s} /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) -> (locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} {f x | x :e s})

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_REGULAR_IMP_COMPLETELY_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) -> completely_regular_space A top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_REGULAR_SPACE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_compact_space A top /\ regular_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {c :e Power A | compact_in A top c /\ closed_in A top c} top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_CLOSED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, locally_compact_space A top /\ closed_in A top s -> locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_COMPACT_CLOSED_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top -> (locally_compact_space A top <-> forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> exists u l c= A, u :e top /\ (compact_in A top l /\ (closed_in A top l /\ (k c= u /\ u c= l))))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_COMPACT_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top -> (locally_compact_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists u k c= A, u :e top /\ (compact_in A top k /\ (closed_in A top k /\ (x :e u /\ u c= k))))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_COMPACT_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top -> (locally_compact_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (compact_in A top (closure_of A top u) /\ x :e u))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_CONTINUOUS_OPEN_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (open_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ locally_compact_space A top)) -> locally_compact_space B top'

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, locally_compact_space A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: locally_compact_space R euclideanreal

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_IMP_GDELTA_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, metrizable_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top s)) -> s :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top -> (locally_compact_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {x :e Power A | compact_in A top x} top)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top -> (locally_compact_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {c :e Power A | compact_in A top c /\ closed_in A top c} top)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top -> (locally_compact_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {t :e Power A | compact_in A top (closure_of A top t)} top)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OPEN_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top -> (locally_compact_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ compact_in A top (closure_of A top u)} top)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_OPEN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) /\ (locally_compact_space A top /\ s :e top) -> locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) /\ (locally_compact_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f) -> locally_compact_space B top'

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> (locally_compact_space A top <-> locally_compact_space B top')

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> locally_compact_space B top' /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> locally_compact_space A top

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, locally_compact_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ compact_space A (tops i)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> locally_compact_space A (tops i)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, locally_compact_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ locally_compact_space A top1 /\ locally_compact_space B top2

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ locally_compact_space A top -> locally_compact_space B top'

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally_compact_space (R :^: idx N) (mtopology (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s)) <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally_compact_space (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_SUM_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> (locally_compact_space (K :*: A) (sum_topology A K k top) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> locally_compact_space A (top i))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SUBSPACE_CLOSED_INTER_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top s)) -> exists c u c= A, closed_in A top c /\ (u :e top /\ c :/\: u = s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SUBSPACE_CLOSED_INTER_OPEN_IN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ locally_compact_space A top -> ((exists c u c= A, closed_in A top c /\ (u :e top /\ c :/\: u = s)) <-> s c= topspace A top /\ locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top s))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SUBSPACE_OPEN_IN_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top s)) -> s :e subtopology A top (closure_of A top s)

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_SUBSPACE_OPEN_IN_CLOSURE_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ locally_compact_space A top -> (s :e subtopology A top (closure_of A top s) <-> s c= topspace A top /\ locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top s))

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_COMPACT_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} (R :^: idx N)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s <-> forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (connected N u /\ (x :e u /\ u c= v))

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CLOSED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} t /\ (closed N s /\ closed N t)) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (s :\/: t)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CLOSED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> closed N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (Union f)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CLOSED_UNION_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} t)) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (s :\/: t)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CLOSURE_FROM_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (frontier N s) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (closure N s)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s /\ c :e components N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} c

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x0} s -> locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x0} {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0}

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE_COMPACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s /\ (compact M s /\ continuous_on_hl M N f s) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CONTINUUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {c :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N c /\ (connected N c /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} c)} s <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CONTINUUM_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, neighbourhood_base_of A {c :e Power A | compact_in A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) c /\ (connected_in A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) c /\ locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) c))} (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) <-> locally_compact_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) /\ locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, locally_connected_space (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_FROM_UNION_AND_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (s :\/: t) /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (s :/\: t))) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_FROM_UNION_AND_INTER_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (s :\/: t) /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (s :/\: t))) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IM_KLEINEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s <-> forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e u -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, connected N c /\ (c c= v /\ (x :e c /\ y :e c))))

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IS_REALINTERVAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, is_realinterval s -> locally_connected_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal s)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_LEFT_INVERTIBLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g {f x | x :e s} /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s)) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} {f x | x :e s} <-> locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_NOT_COUNTABLE_CLOSED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, ~ topspace A top = Empty /\ (connected_space A top /\ (locally_connected_space A top /\ ((completely_metrizable_space A top \/ locally_compact_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top) /\ (countable u /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e u -> closed_in A top c /\ ~ c = Empty) /\ Union u = topspace A top)))))) -> u = {topspace A top}

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_OPEN_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s <-> forall t c c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ c :e components N t -> c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_OPEN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e t -> {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N t x x0} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (path_image N p)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} t -> locally (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) | connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x} (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, locally (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) | connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x} (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} t)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_QUOTIENT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s})) /\ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, locally_connected_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) /\ forall a b :e R, locally_connected_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal (open_real_interval (a,b)))

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g {f x | x :e s} /\ ({g x | x :e {f x | x :e s}} c= s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e {f x | x :e s} -> f (g x) = x) /\ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | connected M x} s))) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_connected_space A top <-> forall v c= A, forall x :e A, v :e top /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (connected_in A top u /\ (x :e u /\ u c= v))

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_connected_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ connected_in A top u} top

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, locally_connected_space A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_EQ_OPEN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_connected_space A top <-> forall u c= A, forall x :e A, u :e top /\ x :e u -> {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A (subtopology A top u) x x0} :e top

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: locally_connected_space R euclideanreal

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_IM_KLEINEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_connected_space A top <-> forall v c= A, forall x :e A, v :e top /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ forall y :e A, y :e u -> exists c c= A, connected_in A top c /\ (c c= v /\ (x :e c /\ y :e c))))

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_OPEN_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_connected_space A top <-> forall u c c= A, u :e top /\ c :e connected_components_of A (subtopology A top u) -> c :e top

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_OPEN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, locally_connected_space A top /\ s :e top -> locally_connected_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, locally_connected_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ connected_space A (tops i)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> locally_connected_space A (tops i)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, locally_connected_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ locally_connected_space A top1 /\ locally_connected_space B top2

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_QUOTIENT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f /\ locally_connected_space A top -> locally_connected_space B top'

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ locally_connected_space A top -> locally_connected_space B top'

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally_connected_space (R :^: idx N) (mtopology (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s)) <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally_connected_space (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE_SUM_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> (locally_connected_space (K :*: A) (sum_topology A K k top) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> locally_connected_space A (top i))

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (sphere N (a,r))

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPHERE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ convex N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SUBREGION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s /\ (t c= s /\ (connected N c /\ c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) -> exists c' c= R :^: idx N, connected N c' /\ (c' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ c = t :/\: c')

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_CONNECTED_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (R :^: idx N)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s -> (locally N {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | exists c :e A, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u -> f x = c} s <-> exists c :e A, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x = c)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONSTANT_IMP_CONSTANT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (x :e u /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx N, x' :e u -> f x' = f x)) -> exists c :e A, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x = c

items.name: LOCALLY_CONSTANT_REFINEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall h :e Power A :^: Power omega, forall e0 :e R, compact_space A (mtopology A m) /\ (0 < e0 /\ ((forall x c= omega, closed_in A (mtopology A m) (h x)) /\ ((forall x c= omega, ~ h x = Empty) /\ ((forall x c= omega, h x c= mspace A m) /\ ((forall x c= omega, exists u c= Power omega, u :e cantor_space /\ (x :e u /\ forall y c= omega, y :e u -> h y = h x)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e mspace A m -> exists x c= omega, a :e h x)))))) -> exists h' :e Power A :^: Power omega, (forall x c= omega, closed_in A (mtopology A m) (h' x)) /\ ((forall x c= omega, ~ h' x = Empty) /\ ((forall x c= omega, h' x c= mspace A m) /\ ((forall x c= omega, mdiameter A m (h' x) < e0) /\ ((forall x c= omega, h' x c= h x) /\ ((forall x c= omega, exists u c= Power omega, u :e cantor_space /\ (x :e u /\ forall y c= omega, y :e u -> h' y = h' x)) /\ forall a :e A, a :e mspace A m -> exists x c= omega, a :e h' x)))))

items.name: LOCALLY_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, locally M {u :e Power (R :^: idx M) | continuous_on_hl M N f u} s <-> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: LOCALLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u v c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ continuous_on_hl M N f v))

items.name: LOCALLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (x :e u /\ continuous_on_hl M N f u)

items.name: LOCALLY_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (v c= s /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ convex N v)))

items.name: LOCALLY_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | countable x} s <-> countable s

items.name: LOCALLY_DIFF_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s t c= R :^: idx N, locally N P s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t -> locally N P (s :\: t)

items.name: LOCALLY_DIMENSION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, ~ s = Empty /\ locally N {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | dimension N u = n} s -> dimension N s = n

items.name: LOCALLY_DIMENSION_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> - 1 <= n /\ locally N {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | dimension N u <= n} s

items.name: LOCALLY_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx A), locally A P Empty

items.name: LOCALLY_ENR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | ENR N x} s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, x :e v /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ ENR N v)

items.name: LOCALLY_ENR_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | ENR N x} s <-> forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (ENR N u /\ (x :e u /\ u c= v))

items.name: LOCALLY_EQ_COMPACTLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall t u c= R :^: idx N, t c= u /\ (u c= s /\ u :e P) -> t :e P) /\ ((forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> t :e P /\ t c= s) -> Union f :e P) /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s) -> (locally N P s <-> forall c c= R :^: idx N, compact N c /\ c c= s -> c :e P)

items.name: LOCALLY_FCCOVERABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite c /\ (Union c = s /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e c -> connected N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ diameter N t <= e0))) /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ a :e u) -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (connected N v /\ (a :e v /\ (v c= u /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite c /\ (Union c = v /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e c -> connected N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ diameter N t <= e0)))))

items.name: LOCALLY_FCCOVERABLE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ a :e u)) -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (connected N v /\ (a :e v /\ (v c= u /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite c /\ (Union c = v /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e c -> connected N t /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ diameter N t <= e0)))))

items.name: LOCALLY_FCCOVERABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s u c= A, forall a :e A, locally_compact_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) /\ (locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) /\ (u :e subtopology A (mtopology A m) s /\ a :e u)) -> exists v c= A, v :e subtopology A (mtopology A m) s /\ (connected_in A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) v /\ (a :e v /\ (v c= u /\ fccoverable_in A m v)))

items.name: LOCALLY_FCCOVERABLE_SPACE_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s u c= A, forall a :e A, forall r :e R, s c= mspace A m /\ (a :e s /\ (a :e mspace A m /\ (0 < r /\ (s :/\: mcball A m (a,2 * r) c= u /\ (locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power A, finite c /\ ((forall w c= A, w :e c -> w c= s /\ (connected_in A (mtopology A m) w /\ (mbounded A m w /\ mdiameter A m w <= e0))) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s /\ x :e mball A m (a,2 * r) -> exists w c= A, w :e c /\ x :e w))))))) -> exists v c= A, v :e subtopology A (mtopology A m) s /\ (connected_in A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) v /\ (a :e v /\ (v c= u /\ fccoverable_in A m v)))

items.name: LOCALLY_FINE_COVERING_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, compact N s /\ (locally N P s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (Union f = s /\ forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e f -> c :e P /\ (bounded_hl N c /\ diameter N c <= e0))

items.name: LOCALLY_FINITE_COVER_OF_COMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, compact_space A top /\ (topspace A top c= Union u /\ locally_finite_in A top u) -> finite u

items.name: LOCALLY_FINITE_COVER_OF_LINDELOF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, lindelof_space A top /\ (topspace A top c= Union u /\ locally_finite_in A top u) -> countable u

items.name: LOCALLY_FINITE_IN_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f c= Power A, locally_finite_in A top f -> locally_finite_in A top {closure_of A top s | s :e Power A, s :e f}

items.name: LOCALLY_FINITE_IN_HOMEOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e A :^: B, forall V c= Power A, homeomorphic_maps A B (top,top') (f,g) /\ locally_finite_in A top V -> locally_finite_in B top' {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e V}

items.name: LOCALLY_FINITE_IN_REFINEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, forall f :e Power A :^: Power A, locally_finite_in A top u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> f s c= s) -> locally_finite_in A top {f s | s :e Power A, s :e u}

items.name: LOCALLY_FINITE_IN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u v c= Power A, locally_finite_in A top u /\ v c= u -> locally_finite_in A top v

items.name: LOCALLY_FINITE_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall u c= Power A, locally_finite_in A top u /\ (forall t c= A, t :e u -> t c= s) -> locally_finite_in A (subtopology A top s) u

items.name: LOCALLY_FINITE_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall u c= Power A, closed_in A top s -> (locally_finite_in A (subtopology A top s) u <-> locally_finite_in A top u /\ forall t c= A, t :e u -> t c= s)

items.name: LOCALLY_FINITE_PRODUCT_TUBES
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall W c= Power A, forall U c= Power (A :*: B), forall Ux :e Power (Power (A :*: B)) :^: A, forall xw:set -> set, (forall x :e Power A, xw x :e A) -> locally_finite_in A top W /\ ((forall w c= A, w :e W -> finite (Ux (xw w))) /\ ((forall w c= A, w :e W -> Ux (xw w) c= U) /\ (forall u c= A :*: B, u :e U -> u :e prod_topology A B top top'))) -> locally_finite_in (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top') (\/_ w :e Power A, {(w :*: topspace B top') :/\: u | u :e Power (A :*: B), w :e W /\ u :e Ux (xw w)})

items.name: LOCALLY_IMP_COUNTABLE_UNION_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N P s -> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, x :e P) /\ Union u = s

items.name: LOCALLY_IMP_FINITE_UNION_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N P s -> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite u /\ (forall x :e u, x :e P) /\ Union u = s

items.name: LOCALLY_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall Q c= Power (R :^: idx M), (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> ({f x | x :e s} :e P <-> s :e Q)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (locally N P {f x | x :e s} <-> locally M Q s)

items.name: LOCALLY_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e P /\ t :e P -> s :/\: t :e P) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, locally N P s /\ locally N P t -> locally N P (s :/\: t)

items.name: LOCALLY_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, locally N P s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) -> locally N P (s :/\: t)

items.name: LOCALLY_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | lebesgue_measurable N x} s <-> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: LOCALLY_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (x :e u /\ lebesgue_measurable N u)

items.name: LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall b :e R, convex M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> eventually (R :^: idx M) {y :e R :^: idx M | vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)) <= b * vector_norm M (vector_sub M y x)} (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= b * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)

items.name: LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_INVERSION
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ 0 :e closure_of R euclideanreal s -> lipschitz_continuous_map R R (submetric R real_euclidean_metric s,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => recip_SNo x)

items.name: LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MULTIPLICATION
items.statement: forall s c= R :*: R, mbounded (R :*: R) (prod_metric R R real_euclidean_metric real_euclidean_metric) s -> lipschitz_continuous_map R (R :*: R) (submetric (R :*: R) (prod_metric R R real_euclidean_metric real_euclidean_metric) s,real_euclidean_metric) (fun p:set => p 0 * p 1)

items.name: LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall b :e R, convex M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, x :e s /\ b < c -> eventually (R :^: idx M) {y :e R :^: idx M | vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)) <= c * vector_norm M (vector_sub M y x)} (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= b * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)

items.name: LOCALLY_LOCALLY
