items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall x c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | locally N P x0} x <-> locally N P x

items.name: LOCALLY_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, (forall t c= R :^: idx A, t :e P -> t :e Q) /\ locally A P s -> locally A Q s

items.name: LOCALLY_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | negligible N x} s <-> negligible N s

items.name: LOCALLY_NEGLIGIBLE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (x :e u /\ negligible N u)

items.name: LOCALLY_ON_NBDS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N P s <-> forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (a :e u /\ (u c= v /\ (v c= s /\ locally N P v)))

items.name: LOCALLY_ON_OPEN_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N P s <-> forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (a :e v /\ locally N P v)

items.name: LOCALLY_OPEN_AND_DIMENSION_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall n :e int, dimension A s <= n <-> - 1 <= n /\ locally A {u :e Power (R :^: idx A) | u :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s /\ dimension A u <= n} s

items.name: LOCALLY_OPEN_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ P u} s <-> exists b c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable b /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e b -> ~ c = Empty /\ (c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ P c)) /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s -> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), u c= b /\ t = Union u)

items.name: LOCALLY_OPEN_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, locally N P t /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) -> locally N P (s :/\: t)

items.name: LOCALLY_OPEN_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall Q c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s}) /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ t :e P -> {f x | x :e t} :e Q) /\ locally M P s)) -> locally N Q {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_OPEN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s t c= R :^: idx N, locally N P s /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s -> locally N P t

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s <-> forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (path_connected N u /\ (x :e u /\ u c= v))

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_CLOSURE_FROM_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} (frontier N s) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} (closure N s)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s /\ c :e components N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} c

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x0} s -> locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x0} {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0}

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE_COMPACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | path_connected M x} s /\ (compact M s /\ continuous_on_hl M N f s) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, locally_path_connected_space (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_FROM_UNION_AND_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} (s :\/: t) /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} (s :/\: t))) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_FROM_UNION_AND_INTER_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} (s :\/: t) /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} (s :/\: t))) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_IMP_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_IMP_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_AT
items.statement: forall a:set, forall top :e topology a, forall x :e a, locally_path_connected_at a x top -> locally_connected_at a x top

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_IMP_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_space A top -> locally_connected_space A top

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_IM_KLEINEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s <-> forall v c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e u -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx 1, p x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (path N p /\ (path_image N p c= v /\ (pathstart N p = x /\ pathfinish N p = y)))))

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_IS_REALINTERVAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, is_realinterval s -> locally_path_connected_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal s)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_LEFT_INVERTIBLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g {f x | x :e s} /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | path_connected M x} s)) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} {f x | x :e s} <-> locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | path_connected M x} s)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_OPEN_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e t -> {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N t x x0} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x0} s -> locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x0} {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0}

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} (path_image N p)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | path_connected M x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} t -> locally (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) | path_connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x} (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, locally (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) | path_connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) x} (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | path_connected M x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} t)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_QUOTIENT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s})) /\ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | path_connected M x} s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, locally_path_connected_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) /\ forall a b :e R, locally_path_connected_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal (open_real_interval (a,b)))

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g {f x | x :e s} /\ ({g x | x :e {f x | x :e s}} c= s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e {f x | x :e s} -> f (g x) = x) /\ locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | path_connected M x} s))) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_space A top <-> forall v c= A, forall x :e A, v :e top /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (path_connected_in A top u /\ (x :e u /\ u c= v))

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ path_connected_in A top u} top

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, locally_path_connected_space A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_EQ_OPEN_PATH_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_space A top <-> forall u c= A, forall x :e A, u :e top /\ x :e u -> {x0 :e A | path_component_of A (subtopology A top u) x x0} :e top

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: locally_path_connected_space R euclideanreal

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_IM_KLEINEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_space A top <-> forall v c= A, forall x :e A, v :e top /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ forall y :e A, y :e u -> exists c c= A, path_connected_in A top c /\ (c c= v /\ (x :e c /\ y :e c))))

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_OPEN_PATH_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_space A top <-> forall u c c= A, u :e top /\ c :e path_components_of A (subtopology A top u) -> c :e top

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_OPEN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, locally_path_connected_space A top /\ s :e top -> locally_path_connected_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, locally_path_connected_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ path_connected_space A (tops i)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> locally_path_connected_space A (tops i)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, locally_path_connected_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ locally_path_connected_space A top1 /\ locally_path_connected_space B top2

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_QUOTIENT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f /\ locally_path_connected_space A top -> locally_path_connected_space B top'

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ locally_path_connected_space A top -> locally_path_connected_space B top'

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally_path_connected_space (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_SUM_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> (locally_path_connected_space (K :*: A) (sum_topology A K k top) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> locally_path_connected_space A (top i))

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} (sphere N (a,r))

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPHERE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ convex N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SUBREGION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s /\ (t c= s /\ (path_connected N c /\ c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) -> exists c' c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N c' /\ (c' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ c = t :/\: c')

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} (R :^: idx N)

items.name: LOCALLY_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall Q c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall R0 c= Power (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)), (forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, s :e P /\ t :e Q -> (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :e R0) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, locally M P s /\ locally N Q t -> locally (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) R0 (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: LOCALLY_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall a :e R :^: idx A, locally A P {a} <-> {a} :e P

items.name: LOCALLY_TO_COMPACTLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c c= R :^: idx N, (forall t u c= R :^: idx N, t c= u /\ (u c= s /\ u :e P) -> t :e P) /\ ((forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> t :e P /\ t c= s) -> Union f :e P) /\ (locally N P s /\ (compact N c /\ c c= s))) -> c :e P

items.name: LOCALLY_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, {vector_add N a x | x :e s} :e P <-> s :e P) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N P {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> locally N P s

items.name: LOCAL_HOMEOMORPHISM_IMP_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, exists v c= R :^: idx N, exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ homeomorphism M N (u,v) (f,g)))) -> forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t

items.name: LOEWNER_ORDER_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N (matrix_sub N N A B) /\ positive_semidefinite N (matrix_sub N N B A) <-> A = B

items.name: LOWDIM_EQ_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s = minus_nat (dimindex N) 1 -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ span N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = 0}

items.name: LOWDIM_EQ_INTER_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ (t c= s /\ dim N t + 1 = dim N s)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = 0} :/\: s = t

items.name: LOWDIM_EXPAND_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, dim N s <= n /\ n <= dimindex N -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, equip b n /\ (independent N b /\ span N s c= span N b)

items.name: LOWDIM_EXPAND_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, dim N s <= n /\ n <= dimindex N -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, dim N t = n /\ span N s c= span N t

items.name: LOWDIM_SUBSET_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s < dimindex N -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ span N s c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = 0}

items.name: LOWER_BOUND_FINITE_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> exists a :e omega, forall x :e A, x :e s -> a <= f x

items.name: LOWER_BOUND_FINITE_SET_REAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> exists a :e R, forall x :e A, x :e s -> a <= f x

items.name: LOWER_HEMICONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x c= t) -> ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x c= u}) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ~ f x :/\: u = Empty} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s)

items.name: LPC_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_ANR_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (ANR N s /\ ((R :^: idx N) :\: s c= t /\ t :/\: interior N s = Empty)) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} t

items.name: LPC_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_ANR_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (ANR N s /\ (c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ (c c= t /\ t c= closure N c))) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} t

items.name: LPC_OPEN_SIMPLE_PATH_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N g -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} ((R :^: idx N) :\: (path_image N g :\: {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g}))

items.name: LPC_SUPERSET_COMPLEMENT_SIMPLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (simple_path N g /\ (R :^: idx N) :\: path_image N g c= s) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: LT
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, m < 0 <-> False) /\ forall m n :e omega, m < ordsucc n <-> m = n \/ m < n

items.name: LTE_ADD2
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, m < p /\ n <= q -> m + n < p + q

items.name: LTE_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ (m < n /\ n <= m)

items.name: LTE_CASES
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n \/ n <= m

items.name: LTE_TRANS
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m < n /\ n <= p -> m < p

items.name: LT_0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 < ordsucc n

items.name: LT_ADD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < m + n <-> 0 < n

items.name: LT_ADD2
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, m < p /\ n < q -> m + n < p + q

items.name: LT_ADDR
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, n < m + n <-> 0 < m

items.name: LT_ADD_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m + n < m + p <-> n < p

items.name: LT_ADD_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m + p < n + p <-> m < n

items.name: LT_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ (m < n /\ n < m)

items.name: LT_CASES
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n \/ (n < m \/ m = n)

items.name: LT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n <-> exists d :e omega, n = m + ordsucc d

items.name: LT_EXP
items.statement: forall x m n :e omega, x ^ m < x ^ n <-> 2 <= x /\ m < n \/ x = 0 /\ (~ m = 0 /\ n = 0)

items.name: LT_IMP_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n -> m <= n

items.name: LT_IMP_NE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n -> ~ m = n

items.name: LT_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n <-> m <= n /\ ~ m = n

items.name: LT_LMULT
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ m = 0 /\ n < p -> m * n < m * p

items.name: LT_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, 0 < m * n <-> 0 < m /\ 0 < n

items.name: LT_MULT2
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, m < n /\ p < q -> m * p < n * q

items.name: LT_MULT_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * n < m * p <-> ~ m = 0 /\ n < p

items.name: LT_MULT_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * p < n * p <-> m < n /\ ~ p = 0

items.name: LT_NZ
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 0 < n <-> ~ n = 0

items.name: LT_POW2_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n < 2 ^ n

items.name: LT_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n < n

items.name: LT_SUC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m < ordsucc n <-> m < n

items.name: LT_SUC_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < ordsucc n <-> m <= n

items.name: LT_TRANS
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m < n /\ n < p -> m < p

items.name: LUZIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, measurable M s /\ (measurable_on M N f s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, compact M k /\ (k c= s /\ (measure M (s :\: k) < e0 /\ continuous_on_hl M N f k))

items.name: LUZIN_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, compact M k /\ (k c= s /\ (measure M (s :\: k) < e0 /\ continuous_on_hl M N f k)))

items.name: LUZIN_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists k c= R :^: idx M, exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (compact M k /\ (k c= s /\ (measure M (s :\: k) < e0 /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (R :^: idx M) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e k -> g x = f x)))))

items.name: LUZIN_NPROPERTY_IMP_COUNTABLE_PREIMAGES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (measurable_on M N f s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t})) -> negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | ~ countable {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: LUZIN_SIGMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ measurable_on M N f s -> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable u /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e u -> compact M k /\ (k c= s /\ continuous_on_hl M N f k)) /\ negligible M (s :\: Union u)))

items.name: LUZIN_SIGMA_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ measurable_on M N f s -> exists k :e Power (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact M (k n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, k n c= s) /\ ((forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N f (k n)) /\ ((forall x y :e omega, x <> y -> k x :/\: k y = Empty) /\ negligible M (s :\: Union {k n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))))

items.name: LUZIN_SIGMA_NESTED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ measurable_on M N f s -> exists k :e Power (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact M (k n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, k n c= s) /\ ((forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N f (k n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, k n c= k (ordsucc n)) /\ negligible M (s :\: Union {k n | n :e omega, n :e omega}))))

items.name: MANHATTAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> mspace (R :^: idx N) (manhattan N) = R :^: idx N /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, mdist (R :^: idx N) (manhattan N) (x,y) = finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => abs_SNo (x i + - y i))

items.name: MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> seq_map f seq_nil = seq_nil) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_map f (seq_cons h t) = seq_cons (f h) (seq_map f t)

items.name: MAP2
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, forall h2 :e B, forall t2 :e finseq B, seq_map2 f seq_nil seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_map2 f (seq_cons h1 t1) (seq_cons h2 t2) = seq_cons (f h1 h2) (seq_map2 f t1 t2)

items.name: MAP2_DEF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall l :e finseq B, forall h1 :e A, forall t1 :e finseq A, seq_map2 f seq_nil l = seq_nil /\ seq_map2 f (seq_cons h1 t1) l = seq_cons (f h1 (seq_hd l)) (seq_map2 f t1 (seq_tl l))

items.name: MAPPING_CONNECTED_ONTO_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected M s /\ ~ (exists a0 :e R :^: idx M, s c= {a0}) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: MAP_APPEND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_map f (seq_append l1 l2) = seq_append (seq_map f l1) (seq_map f l2)

items.name: MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_all (fun x:set => f x = g x) l -> seq_map f l = seq_map g l

items.name: MAP_EQ_ALL2
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_all2 (fun x:set => fun y:set => f x = f y) l m -> seq_map f l = seq_map f m

items.name: MAP_EQ_DEGEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> seq_all (fun x:set => f x = x) l -> seq_map f l = l

items.name: MAP_EQ_NIL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_map f l = seq_nil <-> l = seq_nil

items.name: MAP_FST_ZIP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall l1 :e finseq A, forall l2 :e finseq B, seq_len l1 = seq_len l2 -> seq_map (fun x:set => x 0) (seq_zip l1 l2) = l1

items.name: MAP_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e finseq A, seq_map (fun x:set => x) x = x

items.name: MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_map (fun x:set => x) l = l

items.name: MAP_LIST_OF_SEQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall n :e omega, seq_map g (seq_mk n f) = seq_mk n (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: MAP_REVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev (seq_map f l) = seq_map f (seq_rev l)

items.name: MAP_SND_ZIP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall l1 :e finseq A, forall l2 :e finseq B, seq_len l1 = seq_len l2 -> seq_map (fun x:set => x 1) (seq_zip l1 l2) = l2

items.name: MAP_o
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_map (fun x:set => g (f x)) l = seq_map g (seq_map f l)

items.name: MATCH_SEQPATTERN
items.error: internal constant _MATCH (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: MATRIFY_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> matrify R B A (vec (idx_n (dimindex B * dimindex A)) 0) = mat B A 0

items.name: MATRIFY_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), matrify R M N (vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) x y) = matrix_add M N (matrify R M N x) (matrify R M N y)

items.name: MATRIFY_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), matrify R M N (vector_mul (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) c x) = matrix_cmul M N c (matrify R M N x)

items.name: MATRIFY_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall v :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> matrify A M N v i j = v (minus_nat i 1 * dimindex N + j)

items.name: MATRIFY_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m1 m2 :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), matrify R M N m1 = matrify R M N m2 <-> m1 = m2

items.name: MATRIFY_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), matrify R M N m = mat M N 0 <-> m = vec (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) 0

items.name: MATRIFY_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), matrify R M N (vector_sub (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) x y) = matrix_sub M N (matrify R M N x) (matrify R M N y)

items.name: MATRIFY_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e A :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrify A M N (vectorize A M N m) = m

items.name: MATRIX_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> matrix M N (fun x:set => vec N 0) = mat N M 0

items.name: MATRIX_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ linear M N g -> matrix M N (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) = matrix_add N M (matrix M N f) (matrix M N g)

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_AC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B C :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_add M N A B = matrix_add M N B A /\ (matrix_add M N (matrix_add M N A B) C = matrix_add M N A (matrix_add M N B C) /\ matrix_add M N A (matrix_add M N B C) = matrix_add M N B (matrix_add M N A C))

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B C :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_add M N A (matrix_add M N B C) = matrix_add M N (matrix_add M N A B) C

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i j :e omega, matrix_add M N A B i j = A i j + B i j

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B C :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N P A (matrix_add N P B C) = matrix_add M P (matrix_mul M N P A B) (matrix_mul M N P A C)

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_LID
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx B, matrix_add B A (mat B A 0) A0 = A0

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_LNEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx B, matrix_add B A (matrix_neg B A A0) A0 = mat B A 0

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall C :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N P (matrix_add M N A B) C = matrix_add M P (matrix_mul M N P A C) (matrix_mul M N P B C)

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_RID
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx B, matrix_add B A A0 (mat B A 0) = A0

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_RNEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx B, matrix_add B A A0 (matrix_neg B A A0) = mat B A 0

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_ROW
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall X Y :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, matrix_add N M X Y i = vector_add M (X i) (Y i)

items.name: MATRIX_ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_add M N A B = matrix_add M N B A

items.name: MATRIX_ADJOINT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f -> matrix B A (adjoint A B f) = transp B A (matrix A B f)

items.name: MATRIX_AUGMENTED_LINEAR_EQUATIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, (exists x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M (transp M N A) x = y) <-> rank N (idx_n (dimindex M + 1)) (pastecart M 1 A (rowvector N y)) = rank N M A

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, linear M N f -> matrix M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) = matrix_cmul N M c (matrix M N f)

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_ADD_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall c :e R, matrix_cmul M N c (matrix_add M N A B) = matrix_add M N (matrix_cmul M N c A) (matrix_cmul M N c B)

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_ADD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall b c :e R, matrix_cmul M N (b + c) A = matrix_add M N (matrix_cmul M N b A) (matrix_cmul M N c A)

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_ASSOC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall X :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_cmul N M a (matrix_cmul N M b X) = matrix_cmul N M (a * b) X

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall j :e omega, forall c :e R, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, matrix_cmul M N c A i j = c * A i j

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall c :e R, matrix_cmul N M c A = mat N M 0 <-> c = 0 \/ A = mat N M 0

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_LID
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall X :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_cmul N M 1 X = X

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_LZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx B, matrix_cmul B A 0 A0 = mat B A 0

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_ROW
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall X :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, matrix_cmul N M c X i = vector_mul M c (X i)

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_RZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall c :e R, matrix_cmul B A c (mat B A 0) = mat B A 0

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_SUB_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall c :e R, matrix_cmul M N c (matrix_sub M N A B) = matrix_sub M N (matrix_cmul M N c A) (matrix_cmul M N c B)

items.name: MATRIX_CMUL_SUB_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall b c :e R, matrix_cmul M N (b + - c) A = matrix_sub M N (matrix_cmul M N b A) (matrix_cmul M N c A)

items.name: MATRIX_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex M -> matrix M N f i j = f (basis M j) i

items.name: MATRIX_COMPONENT_LE_ONORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i j :e omega, abs_SNo (A i j) <= onorm N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x)

items.name: MATRIX_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> linear B A f /\ linear A C g -> matrix B C (fun x:set => g (f x)) = matrix_mul C A B (matrix A C g) (matrix B A f)

items.name: MATRIX_DIAGONALIZABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, exists P D Q :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P /\ (diagonal_matrix_hl N N D /\ (orthogonal_matrix_hl N Q /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 <= D i i) /\ A = matrix_mul N N N P (matrix_mul N N N D Q))))

items.name: MATRIX_ENTIRE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> (forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, invertible M N A -> (matrix_mul M N P A B = mat M P 0 <-> B = mat N P 0)) /\ forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, invertible N P B -> (matrix_mul M N P A B = mat M P 0 <-> A = mat M N 0)

items.name: MATRIX_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, A = B <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = matrix_vector_mul M N B x

items.name: MATRIX_EQUAL_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, A = B <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> column M N i A = column M N i B

items.name: MATRIX_EQUAL_ROWS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, A = B <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> row M N i A = row M N i B

items.name: MATRIX_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, A = mat N N 0 <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul N N A x = vec N 0

items.name: MATRIX_FULL_LINEAR_EQUATIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall b :e R :^: idx N, rank M N A = dimindex N -> exists x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x = b

items.name: MATRIX_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> matrix A A (fun x:set => x) = mat A A 1

items.name: MATRIX_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> matrix A A (fun x:set => x) = mat A A 1

items.name: MATRIX_INJECTIVE_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M m x = matrix_vector_mul N M m y -> x = y) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M m x = vec N 0 -> x = vec M 0

items.name: MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, invertible M N A -> matrix_mul M N M A (matrix_inv N M A) = mat M M 1 /\ matrix_mul N M N (matrix_inv N M A) A = mat N N 1

items.name: MATRIX_INVERTIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> (invertible N M (matrix M N f) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x)))

items.name: MATRIX_INVERTIBLE_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> (invertible N N (matrix N N f) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear N N g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (f x) = x))

items.name: MATRIX_INVERTIBLE_LEFT_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ dimindex N <= dimindex M -> (invertible N M (matrix M N f) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x))

items.name: MATRIX_INVERTIBLE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> (invertible N N (matrix N N f) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (linear N N g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x))

items.name: MATRIX_INVERTIBLE_RIGHT_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ dimindex M <= dimindex N -> (invertible N M (matrix M N f) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x))

items.name: MATRIX_INV_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> matrix_inv M N (mat N M 0) = mat M N 0

items.name: MATRIX_INV_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv M N (matrix_cmul N M c A) = matrix_cmul M N (recip_SNo c) (matrix_inv M N A)

items.name: MATRIX_INV_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx A, ~ det A A0 = 0 -> matrix_inv A A A0 = matrix_cmul A A (recip_SNo (det A A0)) (transp A A (cofactor A A0))

items.name: MATRIX_INV_COVARIANCE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) = matrix_mul M N M (matrix_inv M N A) (transp M N (matrix_inv M N A))

items.name: MATRIX_INV_COVARIANCE_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N N (transp N M A) (matrix_inv N N (matrix_mul N M N A (transp N M A))) = matrix_inv M N A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_COVARIANCE_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M M N (matrix_inv M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A)) (transp N M A) = matrix_inv M N A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv M N A = matrix_inv M N B <-> A = B

items.name: MATRIX_INV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv M N A = mat M N 0 <-> A = mat N M 0

items.name: MATRIX_INV_I
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> matrix_inv N N (mat N N 1) = mat N N 1

items.name: MATRIX_INV_IDEMPOTENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ matrix_mul N N N A A = A -> matrix_inv N N A = A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv N M (matrix_inv M N A) = A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N (matrix_inv N N A) A = mat N N 1 <-> invertible N N A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A /\ invertible N N B -> matrix_inv N N (matrix_mul N N N A B) = matrix_mul N N N (matrix_inv N N B) (matrix_inv N N A)

items.name: MATRIX_INV_MULTIPLE_TRANP_LEFT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv M N A = matrix_mul M N N (transp N M A) (matrix_mul N M N (transp M N (matrix_inv M N A)) (matrix_inv M N A))

items.name: MATRIX_INV_MULTIPLE_TRANP_RIGHT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv M N A = matrix_mul M N N (matrix_inv M N A) (matrix_mul N M N (transp M N (matrix_inv M N A)) (transp N M A))

items.name: MATRIX_INV_MUL_INNER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M M A (matrix_mul M N M (matrix_inv M N A) A) = A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_MUL_LINV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_inv N N (matrix_mul N M N (matrix_inv N M A) A) = matrix_mul N M N (matrix_inv N M A) A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_MUL_OUTER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N N (matrix_inv M N A) (matrix_mul N M N A (matrix_inv M N A)) = matrix_inv M N A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_MUL_RINV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_inv M M (matrix_mul M N M A (matrix_inv N M A)) = matrix_mul M N M A (matrix_inv N M A)

items.name: MATRIX_INV_ORTHOGONAL_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U -> matrix_inv M N (matrix_mul N N M U A) = matrix_mul M N N (matrix_inv M N A) (matrix_inv N N U)

items.name: MATRIX_INV_ORTHOGONAL_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall U :e R :^: idx M :^: idx M, forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl M U -> matrix_inv M N (matrix_mul N M M A U) = matrix_mul M M N (matrix_inv M M U) (matrix_inv M N A)

items.name: MATRIX_INV_PROJECTION_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M N A (matrix_inv M N A) = matrix N N (fun x:set => closest_point N {matrix_vector_mul N M A x0 | x0 :e R :^: idx M} x)

items.name: MATRIX_INV_PROJECTION_IMAGE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N M N A (matrix_inv M N A)) x = closest_point N {matrix_vector_mul N M A x0 | x0 :e R :^: idx M} x

items.name: MATRIX_INV_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A (matrix_inv N N A) = mat N N 1 <-> invertible N N A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv N M (transp N M A) = transp M N (matrix_inv M N A)

items.name: MATRIX_INV_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N M A B = mat M M 1 /\ matrix_mul N M N B A = mat N N 1 -> matrix_inv N M A = B

items.name: MATRIX_INV_UNIQUE_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A B = mat N N 1 -> matrix_inv N N B = A

items.name: MATRIX_INV_UNIQUE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A B = mat N N 1 -> matrix_inv N N A = B

items.name: MATRIX_INV_UNIQUE_STRONG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall X :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul N M M A (matrix_mul M N M X A) = A /\ (matrix_mul M N N X (matrix_mul N M N A X) = X /\ (symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_mul N M N A X) /\ symmetric_matrix_hl M (matrix_mul M N M X A))) -> matrix_inv M N A = X

items.name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERSE_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A A' :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A' A = mat N N 1 <-> ~ det N A = 0 /\ A' = matrix_cmul N N (recip_SNo (det N A)) (transp N N (cofactor N A))

items.name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERTIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> ((exists B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul M N M B (matrix M N f) = mat M M 1) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, g (f x) = x))

items.name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERTIBLE_INDEPENDENT_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M N B A = mat N N 1) <-> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R) -> vsum omega M (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_mul M (c i) (column M N i A)) = vec M 0 -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> c i = 0

items.name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERTIBLE_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M N B A = mat N N 1) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = matrix_vector_mul M N A y -> x = y

items.name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERTIBLE_KER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M N B A = mat N N 1) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = vec M 0 -> x = vec N 0

items.name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERTIBLE_SPAN_ROWS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M N B A = mat N N 1) <-> span N (rows M N A) = R :^: idx N

items.name: MATRIX_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A A' :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A A' = mat N N 1 <-> matrix_mul N N N A' A = mat N N 1

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_ASSOC
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, forall C :e R :^: idx Q :^: idx P, matrix_mul M N Q A (matrix_mul N P Q B C) = matrix_mul M P Q (matrix_mul M N P A B) C

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx P, forall B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex P -> matrix_mul P N M A B i = matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M B) (A i)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_COVARIANCE_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx P, forall B C :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N M (matrix_mul N P N (transp P N A) A) B = matrix_mul N N M (matrix_mul N P N (transp P N A) A) C <-> matrix_mul P N M A B = matrix_mul P N M A C

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_COVARIANCE_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, forall B C :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul M N N B (matrix_mul N P N A (transp N P A)) = matrix_mul M N N C (matrix_mul N P N A (transp N P A)) <-> matrix_mul M N P B A = matrix_mul M N P C A

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_DIAGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A /\ diagonal_matrix_hl N N B -> matrix_mul N N N A B = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => A i j * B i j

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_DOT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = fun i :e idx M => dot N (A i) x

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_INV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul P N M (matrix_inv P N A) (matrix_inv N M B) = mat P M 0 <-> matrix_mul M N P B A = mat M P 0

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall B C :e R :^: idx P :^: idx M, invertible N M A -> (matrix_mul N M P A B = matrix_mul N M P A C <-> B = C)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_LEFT_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N (transp N N (cofactor N A)) A = matrix_cmul N N (det N A) (mat N N 1)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_LID
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul M M N (mat M M 1) A = A

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_LINV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, ~ det N A = 0 -> matrix_mul N N N (matrix_inv N N A) A = mat N N 1

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, forall c :e R, matrix_mul M N P (matrix_cmul M N c A) B = matrix_cmul M P c (matrix_mul M N P A B)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_LNEG
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N P (matrix_neg M N A) B = matrix_neg M P (matrix_mul M N P A B)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_LTRANSP_DOT_COLUMN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul N M N (transp M N A) A = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => dot M (column M N i A) (column M N j A)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_LZERO
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N P (mat M N 0) A = mat M P 0

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall C :e R :^: idx P :^: idx M, invertible M P C -> (matrix_mul N M P A C = matrix_mul N M P B C <-> A = B)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_RID
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul M N N A (mat N N 1) = A

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_RIGHT_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A (transp N N (cofactor N A)) = matrix_cmul N N (det N A) (mat N N 1)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_RINV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, ~ det N A = 0 -> matrix_mul N N N A (matrix_inv N N A) = mat N N 1

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, forall c :e R, matrix_mul M N P A (matrix_cmul N P c B) = matrix_cmul M P c (matrix_mul M N P A B)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_RNEG
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N P A (matrix_neg N P B) = matrix_neg M P (matrix_mul M N P A B)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_RTRANSP_DOT_ROW
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul M N M A (transp M N A) = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx M => dot N (row M N i A) (row M N j A)

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_RZERO
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul M N P A (mat N P 0) = mat M P 0

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_VSUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = vsum omega M (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_mul M (x i) (column M N i A))

items.name: MATRIX_MUL_VSUM_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A B = fun i :e idx N => vsum omega N (idx N) (fun k:set => vector_mul N (A i k) (B k))

items.name: MATRIX_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> matrix M N (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) = matrix_neg N M (matrix M N f)

items.name: MATRIX_NEG_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> matrix_neg B A (mat B A 0) = mat B A 0

items.name: MATRIX_NEG_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_neg M N (matrix_add M N A B) = matrix_add M N (matrix_neg M N A) (matrix_neg M N B)

items.name: MATRIX_NEG_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i j :e omega, matrix_neg M N A i j = - A i j

items.name: MATRIX_NEG_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_neg M N A = mat M N 0 <-> A = mat M N 0

items.name: MATRIX_NEG_MINUS1
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_neg M N A = matrix_cmul M N (- 1) A

items.name: MATRIX_NEG_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_neg M N (matrix_neg M N A) = A

items.name: MATRIX_NEG_ROW
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall X :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, matrix_neg N M X i = vector_neg M (X i)

items.name: MATRIX_NEG_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_neg M N (matrix_sub M N A B) = matrix_sub M N B A

items.name: MATRIX_NONFULL_LINEAR_EQUATIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, ~ rank M N A = dimindex M -> exists x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x = vec M 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vec N 0

items.name: MATRIX_NONFULL_LINEAR_EQUATIONS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, (exists x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x = vec M 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vec N 0) <-> ~ rank M N A = dimindex M

items.name: MATRIX_OF_MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x) = A

items.name: MATRIX_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> B i j :e rational) /\ onorm N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N (matrix_sub M N A B) x) < e0

items.name: MATRIX_REFLECT_ALONG_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> matrix N N (fun x:set => reflect_along N (basis N k) x) = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => if i = k /\ j = k then - 1 else if i = j then 1 else 0

items.name: MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERSE_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A A' :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, matrix_mul N N N A A' = mat N N 1 <-> ~ det N A = 0 /\ A' = matrix_cmul N N (recip_SNo (det N A)) (transp N N (cofactor N A))

items.name: MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> ((exists B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul N M N (matrix M N f) B = mat N N 1) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (linear N M g /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x))

items.name: MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_INDEPENDENT_ROWS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N M A B = mat M M 1) <-> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R) -> vsum omega N (idx M) (fun i:set => vector_mul N (c i) (row M N i A)) = vec N 0 -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> c i = 0

items.name: MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_SPAN_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N M A B = mat M M 1) <-> span M (columns M N A) = R :^: idx M

items.name: MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N M A B = mat M M 1) <-> forall y :e R :^: idx M, exists x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = y

items.name: MATRIX_SELF_ADJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> linear A A f -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx A, adjoint A A f x = f x) <-> symmetric_matrix_hl A (matrix A A f))

items.name: MATRIX_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_sub M N A B = matrix_add M N A (matrix_neg M N B)

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_add M N (matrix_sub M N A B) B = A

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_ADD2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_add M N A (matrix_sub M N B A) = B

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i j :e omega, matrix_sub M N A B i j = A i j + - B i j

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_sub M N A B = mat M N 0 <-> A = B

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B C :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N P A (matrix_sub N P B C) = matrix_sub M P (matrix_mul M N P A B) (matrix_mul M N P A C)

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_LZERO
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_sub M N (mat M N 0) A = matrix_neg M N A

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall C :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N P (matrix_sub M N A B) C = matrix_sub M P (matrix_mul M N P A C) (matrix_mul M N P B C)

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_REFL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx B, matrix_sub B A A0 A0 = mat B A 0

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_ROW
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall X Y :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, matrix_sub N M X Y i = vector_sub M (X i) (Y i)

items.name: MATRIX_SUB_RZERO
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_sub M N A (mat M N 0) = A

items.name: MATRIX_TRANSP_MUL
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx B, forall B0 :e R :^: idx C :^: idx A, transp B C (matrix_mul B A C A0 B0) = matrix_mul C A B (transp A C B0) (transp B A A0)

items.name: MATRIX_TRANSP_MULTIPLE_INV_LEFT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, transp N M A = matrix_mul M N N (matrix_inv M N A) (matrix_mul N M N A (transp N M A))

items.name: MATRIX_TRANSP_MULTIPLE_INV_RIGHT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, transp N M A = matrix_mul M N N (transp N M A) (matrix_mul N M N A (matrix_inv M N A))

items.name: MATRIX_TRIVIAL_LINEAR_EQUATIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, dimindex N < dimindex M -> exists x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x = vec M 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vec N 0

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_COLUMN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = vsum omega M (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_mul M (x i) (transp M N A i))

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M (matrix_cmul N M c A) x = vector_mul N c (matrix_vector_mul N M A x)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x = matrix_vector_mul N M (matrix M N f) x

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_ADD_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A (vector_add M x y) = vector_add N (matrix_vector_mul N M A x) (matrix_vector_mul N M A y)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_ADD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M (matrix_add N M A B) x = vector_add N (matrix_vector_mul N M A x) (matrix_vector_mul N M B x)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_ASSOC
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx P, matrix_vector_mul M N A (matrix_vector_mul N P B x) = matrix_vector_mul M P (matrix_mul M N P A B) x

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_BASIS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex M -> matrix_vector_mul N M A (basis M k) = column N M k A

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex M -> matrix_vector_mul M N A x k = dot N (A k) x

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_COVARIANCE_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) x = vec M 0 <-> matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vec N 0

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_INJECTIVE_ON_ROWSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e span M (rows N M A) /\ (y :e span M (rows N M A) /\ matrix_vector_mul N M A x = matrix_vector_mul N M A y) -> x = y

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_INV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N (matrix_inv M N A) x = vec M 0 <-> matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M A) x = vec M 0

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_IN_COLUMNSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x :e span N (columns N M A)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_LID
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul N N (mat N N 1) x = x

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, linear N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_LNEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M (matrix_neg N M A) x = vector_neg N (matrix_vector_mul N M A x)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_LZERO
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul A N (mat A N 0) x = vec A 0

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, matrix_vector_mul N M A (vector_mul M c x) = vector_mul N c (matrix_vector_mul N M A x)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_RNEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A (vector_neg M x) = vector_neg N (matrix_vector_mul N M A x)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_RZERO
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul N M A (vec M 0) = vec N 0

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_SUB_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A (vector_sub M x y) = vector_sub N (matrix_vector_mul N M A x) (matrix_vector_mul N M A y)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_SUB_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M (matrix_sub N M A B) x = vector_sub N (matrix_vector_mul N M A x) (matrix_vector_mul N M B x)

items.name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vector_matrix_mul M N x (transp N M A)

items.name: MATRIX_WLOG_INVERTIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A -> P A) /\ (forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ closed 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e cball 1 (vec 1 0,d) /\ P (matrix_add N N A (matrix_cmul N N (drop x) (mat N N 1)))}) -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, P A

items.name: MATRIX_WORKS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M (matrix M N f) x = f x

items.name: MATROID_BASES_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_basis A m s /\ matroid_basis A m t -> equip s t

items.name: MATROID_BASES_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_basis A m s /\ matroid_basis A m t -> (finite s <-> finite t)

items.name: MATROID_BASES_SIZE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, forall n :e omega, matroid_basis A m s /\ matroid_basis A m t -> (equip s n <-> equip t n)

items.name: MATROID_BASIS_EQ_MAXIMAL_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_basis A m s <-> matroid_independent A m s /\ forall s' c= A, s c= s' /\ s <> s' -> ~ matroid_independent A m s'

items.name: MATROID_BASIS_EQ_MINIMAL_SPANNING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_basis A m s <-> matroid_spanning A m s /\ forall s' c= A, s' c= s /\ s' <> s -> ~ matroid_spanning A m s'

items.name: MATROID_BASIS_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, exists b c= A, matroid_basis A m b

items.name: MATROID_BASIS_EXISTS_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ exists b c= A, equip b (matroid_dim A m s) /\ (b c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> matroid_span A m s x))

items.name: MATROID_BASIS_EXISTS_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A <-> exists b c= A, equip b (matroid_dimension A m) /\ matroid_basis A m b

items.name: MATROID_BASIS_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_basis A m s -> s c= matroid_set A m

items.name: MATROID_BASIS_SUBMATROID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> (matroid_basis A (submatroid A m s) b <-> b c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> matroid_span A m s x))

items.name: MATROID_CHOOSE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (s :e matroid_finite_dim A m -> n <= matroid_dim A m s) -> exists t c= A, t c= s /\ (matroid_independent A m t /\ equip t n)

items.name: MATROID_CHOOSE_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (s :e matroid_finite_dim A m -> n <= matroid_dim A m s) -> exists t c= A, matroid_subspace A m t /\ (t c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} /\ (t :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ matroid_dim A m t = n))

items.name: MATROID_CONTAINS_BASIS_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ exists b c= A, equip b (matroid_dim A m s) /\ (b c= s /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> matroid_span A m s x))

items.name: MATROID_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_dependent A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ exists x :e A, x :e s /\ x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m (s :\: {x}) x0}

items.name: MATROID_DEPENDENT_FINITARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_dependent A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ t :e matroid_dependent A m)

items.name: MATROID_DEPENDENT_FINITARY_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_dependent A m -> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ (t :e matroid_dependent A m /\ forall t' c= A, t' c= t /\ t' <> t -> matroid_independent A m t'))

items.name: MATROID_DEPENDENT_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_dependent A m -> s c= matroid_set A m

items.name: MATROID_DIMENSION_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_dimension A m = choose_in omega (fun n:set => exists b c= A, matroid_basis A m b /\ equip b n)

items.name: MATROID_DIMENSION_EQ_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall b c= A, matroid_basis A m b /\ finite b -> matroid_dimension A m = finite_cardinality b

items.name: MATROID_DIMENSION_FINITE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall b c= A, forall n :e omega, b c= matroid_set A m /\ (matroid_set A m c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x} /\ (finite b /\ finite_cardinality b <= n)) -> m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A /\ matroid_dimension A m <= n

items.name: MATROID_DIMENSION_GE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall b c= A, forall n :e omega, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ n <= finite_cardinality b) -> n <= matroid_dimension A m

items.name: MATROID_DIMENSION_GE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall b c= A, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A /\ matroid_independent A m b -> finite_cardinality b <= matroid_dimension A m

items.name: MATROID_DIMENSION_GE_FINITE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall b c= A, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A /\ matroid_independent A m b -> finite b /\ finite_cardinality b <= matroid_dimension A m

items.name: MATROID_DIMENSION_LE
