items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall b c= A, forall n :e omega, b c= matroid_set A m /\ (matroid_set A m c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x} /\ (finite b /\ finite_cardinality b <= n)) -> matroid_dimension A m <= n

items.name: MATROID_DIMENSION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall b c= A, forall n :e omega, matroid_basis A m b /\ equip b n -> matroid_dimension A m = n

items.name: MATROID_DIM_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> matroid_dim A m s = choose_in omega (fun n:set => exists b c= A, b c= s /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ (s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x} /\ equip b n)))

items.name: MATROID_DIM_BASIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> matroid_dim A m s = choose_in omega (fun n:set => exists b c= A, b c= s /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ ((forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> matroid_span A m s x) /\ equip b n)))

items.name: MATROID_DIM_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_dim A m Empty = 0

items.name: MATROID_DIM_EQ_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall b c= A, finite b /\ matroid_independent A m b -> matroid_dim A m b = finite_cardinality b

items.name: MATROID_DIM_EQ_CARD_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, b c= s /\ (finite b /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x})) -> matroid_dim A m s = finite_cardinality b

items.name: MATROID_DIM_EQ_FINITE_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (finite s /\ matroid_dim A m s = finite_cardinality s) <-> s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ matroid_independent A m s

items.name: MATROID_DIM_EQ_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, t :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ (s c= t /\ matroid_dim A m t <= matroid_dim A m s) -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x

items.name: MATROID_DIM_FINITE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, forall n :e omega, finite b /\ (finite_cardinality b <= n /\ (b c= matroid_set A m /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x})) -> s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ matroid_dim A m s <= n

items.name: MATROID_DIM_GE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, forall n :e omega, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ (b c= s /\ n <= finite_cardinality b)) -> n <= matroid_dim A m s

items.name: MATROID_DIM_GE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ matroid_independent A m s -> finite_cardinality s <= matroid_dim A m s

items.name: MATROID_DIM_GE_CARD_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ b c= s) -> finite_cardinality b <= matroid_dim A m s

items.name: MATROID_DIM_GE_FINITE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ b c= s) -> finite b /\ finite_cardinality b <= matroid_dim A m s

items.name: MATROID_DIM_GE_FINITE_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= matroid_dim A m s) <-> s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ matroid_independent A m s

items.name: MATROID_DIM_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ x :e matroid_set A m -> matroid_dim A m (SetAdjoin s x) = if x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} then matroid_dim A m s else matroid_dim A m s + 1

items.name: MATROID_DIM_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, forall n :e omega, finite b /\ (finite_cardinality b <= n /\ (b c= matroid_set A m /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x})) -> matroid_dim A m s <= n

items.name: MATROID_DIM_LE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ s c= matroid_set A m -> matroid_dim A m s <= finite_cardinality s

items.name: MATROID_DIM_LE_CARD_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, finite b /\ (b c= matroid_set A m /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x}) -> matroid_dim A m s <= finite_cardinality b

items.name: MATROID_DIM_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_dim A m (matroid_set A m) = matroid_dimension A m

items.name: MATROID_DIM_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> matroid_dim A m {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} = matroid_dim A m s

items.name: MATROID_DIM_SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (t :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ ({x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} /\ matroid_dim A m s = matroid_dim A m t)) -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x

items.name: MATROID_DIM_SPAN_EQ_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (t :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ ({x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} /\ matroid_dim A m t <= matroid_dim A m s)) -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x

items.name: MATROID_DIM_SPAN_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ ({x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} /\ {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} <> {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} /\ t :e matroid_finite_dim A m) -> matroid_dim A m s < matroid_dim A m t

items.name: MATROID_DIM_SPAN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ ({x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} /\ t :e matroid_finite_dim A m) -> matroid_dim A m s <= matroid_dim A m t

items.name: MATROID_DIM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t :e matroid_finite_dim A m -> matroid_dim A m s <= matroid_dim A m t

items.name: MATROID_DIM_SUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} /\ t :e matroid_finite_dim A m -> matroid_dim A m s <= matroid_dim A m t

items.name: MATROID_DIM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, forall n :e omega, b c= s /\ (equip b n /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x})) -> matroid_dim A m s = n

items.name: MATROID_DIM_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, forall n :e omega, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (b c= matroid_set A m /\ (equip b n /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ (forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> matroid_span A m s x)))) -> matroid_dim A m s = n

items.name: MATROID_EQ_SPANS_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_independent A m s /\ (matroid_independent A m t /\ (forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x)) -> equip s t

items.name: MATROID_EQ_SPANS_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_independent A m s /\ (matroid_independent A m t /\ (forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x)) -> (finite s <-> finite t)

items.name: MATROID_EQ_SPANS_SIZE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, forall n :e omega, matroid_independent A m s /\ (matroid_independent A m t /\ (forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x)) -> (equip s n <-> equip t n)

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> exists b c= A, finite b /\ (b c= matroid_set A m /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x})

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIMENSIONAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A <-> exists b c= A, finite b /\ (b c= matroid_set A m /\ matroid_set A m c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x})

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIMENSIONAL_ANY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall b c= A, matroid_basis A m b -> (m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A <-> finite b)

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIMENSIONAL_BASIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A <-> exists b c= A, finite b /\ matroid_basis A m b

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIMENSIONAL_CONTAINS_BASIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A /\ matroid_spanning A m s -> exists b c= A, finite b /\ (b c= s /\ matroid_basis A m b)

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIMENSIONAL_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A /\ s c= matroid_set A m -> s :e matroid_finite_dim A m

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_BASIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ exists b c= A, finite b /\ (b c= s /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> matroid_span A m s x))

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, Empty :e matroid_finite_dim A m

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, finite s -> (s :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m)

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m -> s c= matroid_set A m

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, SetAdjoin s x :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> x :e matroid_set A m /\ s :e matroid_finite_dim A m

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, t :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ s c= t -> s :e matroid_finite_dim A m

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_set A m :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> ({x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s :e matroid_finite_dim A m)

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} :e matroid_finite_dim A m

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ exists b c= A, finite b /\ (b c= s /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x})

items.name: MATROID_FINITE_DIM_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ t :e matroid_finite_dim A m

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_independent A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ ~ s :e matroid_dependent A m

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_CARD_LE_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, t c= matroid_set A m /\ (matroid_independent A m s /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x}) -> atleastp s t

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_CARD_LE_SPANNING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_independent A m s /\ matroid_spanning A m t -> atleastp s t

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_CARD_LE_SPAN_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= matroid_set A m /\ (matroid_independent A m s /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x})) -> finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= finite_cardinality t

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall c c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e c -> matroid_independent A m s) /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e c /\ t :e c -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> matroid_independent A m (Union c)

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_independent A m Empty

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_EXTENDS_TO_BASIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_independent A m s -> exists b c= A, s c= b /\ matroid_basis A m b

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_FINITARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_independent A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ forall t c= A, finite t /\ t c= s -> matroid_independent A m t

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_IMP_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ matroid_independent A m s -> finite s

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_independent A m s -> s c= matroid_set A m

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, matroid_independent A m (SetAdjoin s a) <-> (a :e s -> matroid_independent A m s) /\ (~ a :e s -> a :e matroid_set A m /\ (matroid_independent A m s /\ ~ a :e {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x}))

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_independent A m t /\ s c= t -> matroid_independent A m s

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_SPANNING_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_independent A m s /\ (matroid_spanning A m t /\ finite t) -> finite s

items.name: MATROID_INDEPENDENT_SUBMATROID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> (matroid_independent A (submatroid A m s) b <-> b c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} /\ matroid_independent A m b)

items.name: MATROID_INTERMEDIATE_BASIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_independent A m s /\ matroid_spanning A m t -> exists b c= A, s c= b /\ (b c= s :\/: t /\ matroid_basis A m b)

items.name: MATROID_INTERMEDIATE_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_independent A m s /\ (t c= matroid_set A m /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x}) -> exists b c= A, s c= b /\ (b c= s :\/: t /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> matroid_span A m t x))

items.name: MATROID_LOWDIM_EXPAND_BASIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ (matroid_dim A m s <= n /\ (m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A -> n <= matroid_dimension A m)) -> exists b c= A, equip b n /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x})

items.name: MATROID_LOWDIM_EXPAND_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ (matroid_dim A m s <= n /\ (m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A -> n <= matroid_dimension A m)) -> exists t c= A, t :e matroid_finite_dim A m /\ (matroid_dim A m t = n /\ {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x})

items.name: MATROID_MAXIMAL_INDEPENDENT_SUBSET_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ (t c= matroid_set A m /\ (matroid_independent A m s /\ (forall s' c= A, s c= s' /\ s <> s' /\ s' c= t -> ~ matroid_independent A m s'))) -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x

items.name: MATROID_MINIMALLY_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, (forall t c= A, t c= s /\ t <> s -> matroid_independent A m t) -> (s :e matroid_dependent A m <-> ~ s = Empty /\ (s c= matroid_set A m /\ forall a :e A, a :e s -> a :e {x :e A | matroid_span A m (s :\: {a}) x}))

items.name: MATROID_MINIMALLY_DEPENDENT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_dependent A m -> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ (t :e matroid_dependent A m /\ (~ t = Empty /\ forall a :e A, a :e t -> a :e {x :e A | matroid_span A m (t :\: {a}) x})))

items.name: MATROID_SPANNING_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_spanning A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ matroid_set A m c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x}

items.name: MATROID_SPANNING_CONTAINS_BASIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_spanning A m s -> exists b c= A, b c= s /\ matroid_basis A m b

items.name: MATROID_SPANNING_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_spanning A m s -> s c= matroid_set A m

items.name: MATROID_SPANNING_PSUBSET_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, ~ (s c= t /\ s <> t /\ (matroid_spanning A m s /\ matroid_independent A m t))

items.name: MATROID_SPANNING_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_spanning A m (matroid_set A m)

items.name: MATROID_SPANNING_SUBMATROID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> (matroid_spanning A (submatroid A m s) b <-> b c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> matroid_span A m s x)

items.name: MATROID_SPANNING_SUBMATROID_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> matroid_spanning A (submatroid A m s) s

items.name: MATROID_SPANNING_SUBSET_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, t c= s /\ (matroid_independent A m s /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x}) -> s = t

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall c c= Power A, ~ c = Empty /\ ((forall s c= A, s :e c -> s c= matroid_set A m) /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e c /\ t :e c -> s c= t \/ t c= s)) -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m (Union c) x <-> x :e Union {{x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} | s :e Power A, s :e c}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_DELETE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e s /\ s c= matroid_set A m -> ((forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A m (s :\: {x}) x0 <-> matroid_span A m s x0) <-> x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m (s :\: {x}) x0})

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_DEPENDENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e matroid_set A m /\ s c= matroid_set A m -> (x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} <-> x :e s \/ exists t c= A, t c= s /\ (matroid_independent A m t /\ SetAdjoin t x :e matroid_dependent A m))

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_DIM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (t c= matroid_set A m /\ (forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x)) -> matroid_dim A m s = matroid_dim A m t

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> ((forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x) <-> s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} /\ t c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x})

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> ((forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> x :e s) <-> matroid_subspace A m s)

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_EQ_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> ((forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> x :e matroid_set A m) <-> matroid_set A m c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x})

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_EXCHANGE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (x :e matroid_set A m /\ (y :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m (SetAdjoin s x) x0} /\ ~ y :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0})) -> x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m (SetAdjoin s y) x0}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_EXCHANGE_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall a b :e A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (b :e matroid_set A m /\ (a :e {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} /\ ~ a :e {x :e A | matroid_span A m (s :\: {b}) x})) -> b :e {x :e A | matroid_span A m (SetAdjoin (s :\: {b}) a) x}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_FINITARY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} -> exists s' c= A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s' x0})

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_FINITARY_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s k c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (finite k /\ k c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x}) -> exists s' c= A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ k c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s' x})

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_FINITARY_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} -> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ (x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m t x0} /\ forall t' c= A, t' c= t /\ t' <> t -> ~ x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m t' x0}))

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ x :e s -> x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_INSERT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ x :e matroid_set A m -> ((forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A m (SetAdjoin s x) x0 <-> matroid_span A m s x0) <-> x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0})

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_INSERT_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} -> forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A m (SetAdjoin s x) x0 <-> matroid_span A m s x0

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_INTER_SPANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m ({x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m t x0}) x <-> x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m t x0}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> {x :e A | matroid_span A m (s :/\: t) x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} :/\: {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, t c= matroid_set A m /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} -> {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_OF_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_subspace A m s -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> x :e s

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_PSUBSET_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t /\ matroid_independent A m t -> exists a :e A, a :e t /\ ~ a :e {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_PSUBSET_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t /\ matroid_independent A m t -> {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} /\ {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} <> {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall x :e A, matroid_span A m (matroid_set A m) x <-> x :e matroid_set A m

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} x <-> matroid_span A m s x

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= matroid_set A m

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> ((forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> matroid_span A m t x) <-> t c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x})

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_SUBSET_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ matroid_subspace A m t -> {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= t

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s b c= A, b c= s /\ (s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m b x} /\ matroid_subspace A m s) -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> x :e s

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall x y :e A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ (x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} /\ y :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m (SetAdjoin s x) x0}) -> y :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0}

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m (s :\/: t) x <-> matroid_span A m ({x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} :\/: {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m t x0}) x

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> ((forall x :e A, matroid_span A m (s :\/: t) x <-> matroid_span A m t x) <-> s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x})

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_UNION_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m (s :\/: t) x <-> matroid_span A m ({x0 :e A | matroid_span A m s x0} :\/: t) x

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_UNION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> forall x :e A, matroid_span A m (s :\/: t) x <-> matroid_span A m (s :\/: {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m t x0}) x

items.name: MATROID_SPAN_UNION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, s c= matroid_set A m /\ t c= matroid_set A m -> {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} :\/: {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x} c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m (s :\/: t) x}

items.name: MATROID_STEINITZ_EXCHANGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, t c= matroid_set A m /\ (finite s /\ (matroid_independent A m s /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x})) -> exists t' c= A, t' c= t /\ (equip t' (finite_cardinality s) /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m ((t :\: t') :\/: s) x <-> matroid_span A m t x)

items.name: MATROID_STEINITZ_EXCHANGE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= matroid_set A m /\ (matroid_independent A m s /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x})) -> exists t' c= A, t' c= t /\ (finite_cardinality t' + finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m (s :\/: t') x <-> matroid_span A m t x)

items.name: MATROID_STEINITZ_EXCHANGE_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= matroid_set A m /\ (matroid_independent A m s /\ s c= {x :e A | matroid_span A m t x})) -> exists t' c= A, equip t' (finite_cardinality t) /\ (s c= t' /\ (t' c= s :\/: t /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m t' x <-> matroid_span A m t x))

items.name: MATROID_SUBSET_CONTAINS_BASIS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> exists b c= A, b c= s /\ (matroid_independent A m b /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m b x <-> matroid_span A m s x)

items.name: MATROID_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_subspace A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} c= s

items.name: MATROID_SUBSPACE_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall c c= Power A, ~ c = Empty /\ ((forall s c= A, s :e c -> matroid_subspace A m s) /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e c /\ t :e c -> s c= t \/ t c= s)) -> matroid_subspace A m (Union c)

items.name: MATROID_SUBSPACE_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_subspace A m s -> s c= matroid_set A m

items.name: MATROID_SUBSPACE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s t c= A, matroid_subspace A m s /\ matroid_subspace A m t -> matroid_subspace A m (s :/\: t)

items.name: MATROID_SUBSPACE_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall f c= Power A, ~ f = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e f -> matroid_subspace A m s) -> matroid_subspace A m {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: MATROID_SUBSPACE_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_subspace A m (matroid_set A m)

items.name: MATROID_SUBSPACE_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> matroid_subspace A m {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x}

items.name: MAT_0_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, mat M N 0 i j = 0

items.name: MAT_0_ROW
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, mat N M 0 i = vec M 0

items.name: MAT_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall a :e omega, mat B A a = matrix_cmul B A a (mat B A 1)

items.name: MAT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall n i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> mat M N n i j = if i = j then n else 0

items.name: MAT_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m n :e omega, mat B A m = mat B A n <-> m = n

items.name: MAX
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (if m <= n then n else m) = if m <= n then n else m

items.name: MAXIMAL_AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s b c= R :^: idx N, b c= s /\ (~ affine_dependent N b /\ (forall b' c= R :^: idx N, b c= b' /\ (b' c= s /\ ~ affine_dependent N b') -> b' = b)) -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} b

items.name: MAXIMAL_AFFINE_INDEPENDENT_SUBSET_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s b c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (b c= s /\ (~ affine_dependent N b /\ (forall b' c= R :^: idx N, b c= b' /\ (b' c= s /\ ~ affine_dependent N b') -> b' = b))) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} b = s

items.name: MAXIMAL_INDEPENDENT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx N, exists b c= R :^: idx N, b c= v /\ (independent N b /\ v c= span N b)

items.name: MAXIMAL_INDEPENDENT_SUBSET_EXTEND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s v c= R :^: idx N, s c= v /\ independent N s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, s c= b /\ (b c= v /\ (independent N b /\ v c= span N b))

items.name: MAXIMAL_NORMAL_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> ((forall h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G /\ (n c= h /\ n <> h) -> h = group_carrier A G) <-> forall k c= Power A, normal_subgroup_of (Power A) k (quotient_group A G n) -> k = {group_id (Power A) (quotient_group A G n)} \/ k = group_carrier (Power A) (quotient_group A G n))

items.name: MAXIMAL_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finitely_generated_group_hl A G /\ ~ trivial_group A G -> exists h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G /\ (~ h = group_carrier A G /\ forall h' c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h' G /\ (h c= h' /\ h <> h') -> h' = group_carrier A G)

items.name: MAXIMAL_PROPER_SUBGROUP_PRIME_INDEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ ~ n = group_carrier A G -> ((forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (n c= h /\ n <> h) -> h = group_carrier A G) <-> finite {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} /\ prime_nat (finite_cardinality {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}))

items.name: MAXIMAL_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> ((forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (n c= h /\ n <> h) -> h = group_carrier A G) <-> forall k c= Power A, subgroup_of (Power A) k (quotient_group A G n) -> k = {group_id (Power A) (quotient_group A G n)} \/ k = group_carrier (Power A) (quotient_group A G n))

items.name: MAXIMAL_SUBGROUP_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finitely_generated_group_hl A G /\ ~ trivial_group A G -> exists h c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (~ h = group_carrier A G /\ forall h' c= A, subgroup_of A h' G /\ (h c= h' /\ h <> h') -> h' = group_carrier A G)

items.name: MAXIMAL_SUBGROUP_PRIME_INDEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> ((forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (n c= h /\ n <> h) -> h = group_carrier A G) <-> finite {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} /\ (finite_cardinality {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} = 1 \/ prime_nat (finite_cardinality {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G})))

items.name: MAX_LE_LCM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (m = 0 <-> n = 0) -> (if m <= n then n else m) <= lcm_int m n

items.name: MAX_LE_LCM_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (if m <= n then n else m) <= lcm_int m n <-> (m = 0 <-> n = 0)

items.name: MBALL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, r <= 0 -> mball A m (x,r) = Empty

items.name: MBALL_EMPTY_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, ~ x :e mspace A m -> mball A m (x,r) = Empty

items.name: MBALL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, mball A m (x,r) = Empty <-> ~ x :e mspace A m \/ r <= 0

items.name: MBALL_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, mball (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) (x,r) = ball N (x,r)

items.name: MBALL_INTER_DSEPARATED_SINGLETON
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, forall d :e R, forall x y :e A, t c= s /\ (s c= mspace A m /\ (0 < d /\ ((forall a b :e A, a :e t /\ (b :e t /\ ~ a = b) -> d <= mdist A m (a,b)) /\ (x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mball A m (x,d :/: 2) :/\: t)))) -> mball A m (x,d :/: 2) :/\: t = {y}

items.name: MBALL_PROD_METRIC_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall r :e R, mball (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) ((x,y),r) c= mball A m1 (x,r) :*: mball B m2 (y,r)

items.name: MBALL_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall x r :e R, mball R real_euclidean_metric (x,r) = open_real_interval (x + - r,x + r)

items.name: MBALL_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, x :e s -> mball A (submetric A m s) (x,r) = mball A m (x,r) :/\: s

items.name: MBALL_SUBMETRIC_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, forall r :e R, mball A (submetric A m s) (a,r) = if a :e s then s :/\: mball A m (a,r) else Empty

items.name: MBALL_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, forall a b :e R, y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) + a <= b -> mball A m (x,a) c= mball A m (y,b)

items.name: MBALL_SUBSET_CONCENTRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r1 r2 :e R, r1 <= r2 -> mball A m (x,r1) c= mball A m (x,r2)

items.name: MBALL_SUBSET_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, mball A m (x,r) c= mcball A m (x,r)

items.name: MBALL_SUBSET_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, mball A m (x,r) c= mspace A m

items.name: MBALL_SUBSET_PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall r r' :e R, mball A m1 (x,r) :*: mball B m2 (y,r') c= mball (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) ((x,y),r + r')

items.name: MBASIS_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= omega, s c= idx N -> multivector_index N (mbasis N t) s = if s = t then 1 else 0

items.name: MBASIS_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, mbasis N s = vec (multivector N) 0 <-> ~ s c= idx N

items.name: MBASIS_EXPANSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector N), vsum (Power omega) (multivector N) {s :e Power omega | s c= idx N} (fun s:set => vector_mul (multivector N) (multivector_index N x s) (mbasis N s)) = x

items.name: MBASIS_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> P (mbasis N s)) /\ ((forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector N), P x -> P (vector_mul (multivector N) c x)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), P x /\ P y -> P (vector_add (multivector N) x y))) -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector N), P x

items.name: MBASIS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> ~ mbasis N s = vec (multivector N) 0

items.name: MBASIS_SPLIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e omega, forall s c= omega, (forall x :e omega, x :e s -> a < x) -> mbasis A (SetAdjoin s a) = outer A (mbasis A {a}) (mbasis A s)

items.name: MBOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s <-> s = Empty \/ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> x :e mspace A m) /\ exists c :e A, exists b :e R, c :e mspace A m /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> mdist A m (c,x) <= b

items.name: MBOUNDED_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s <-> s c= mspace A m /\ exists b :e R, forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> mdist A m (x,y) <= b

items.name: MBOUNDED_ALT_POS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s <-> s c= mspace A m /\ exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> mdist A m (x,y) <= B

items.name: MBOUNDED_AND_MDIAMETER_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall r :e R, s c= mspace A m -> (mbounded A m s /\ mdiameter A m s <= r <-> 0 <= r /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> mdist A m (x,y) <= r)

items.name: MBOUNDED_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s -> mbounded A m (closure_of A (mtopology A m) s)

items.name: MBOUNDED_CLOSURE_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, s c= mspace A m -> (mbounded A m (closure_of A (mtopology A m) s) <-> mbounded A m s)

items.name: MBOUNDED_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, mbounded (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ mbounded A m1 s /\ mbounded B m2 t)

items.name: MBOUNDED_DISCRETE_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, mbounded A (discrete_metric A u) s <-> s c= u

items.name: MBOUNDED_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mbounded A m Empty

items.name: MBOUNDED_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, mbounded (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s <-> bounded_hl N s

items.name: MBOUNDED_IMP_IN_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, mbounded A m s /\ x :e s -> x :e mspace A m

items.name: MBOUNDED_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m (SetAdjoin s a) <-> a :e mspace A m /\ mbounded A m s

items.name: MBOUNDED_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, mbounded A m s /\ mbounded A m t -> mbounded A m (s :/\: t)

items.name: MBOUNDED_LIPSCHITZ_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, lipschitz_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f /\ mbounded A m1 s -> mbounded B m2 {f x | x :e s}

items.name: MBOUNDED_MBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall c :e A, forall b :e R, mbounded A m (mball A m (c,b))

items.name: MBOUNDED_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall c :e A, forall b :e R, mbounded A m (mcball A m (c,b))

items.name: MBOUNDED_POS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s <-> exists c :e A, exists b :e R, 0 < b /\ s c= mcball A m (c,b)

items.name: MBOUNDED_PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall u c= A :*: B, mbounded (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) u <-> mbounded A m1 {x 0 | x :e u} /\ mbounded B m2 {x 1 | x :e u}

items.name: MBOUNDED_REAL_EUCLIDEAN_METRIC
items.statement: forall x c= R, mbounded R real_euclidean_metric x <-> real_bounded x

items.name: MBOUNDED_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t c= A, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A (submetric A m s) t <-> mbounded A m (s :/\: t) /\ t c= s

items.name: MBOUNDED_SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s -> (mbounded (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) t <-> bounded_hl N t)

items.name: MBOUNDED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, mbounded A m t /\ s c= t -> mbounded A m s

items.name: MBOUNDED_SUBSET_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s -> s c= mspace A m

items.name: MBOUNDED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, mbounded A m (s :\/: t) <-> mbounded A m s /\ mbounded A m t

items.name: MBOUNDED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f c= Power A, finite f /\ (forall s c= A, s :e f -> mbounded A m s) -> mbounded A m (Union f)

items.name: MCBALL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, r < 0 -> mcball A m (x,r) = Empty

items.name: MCBALL_EMPTY_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, ~ x :e mspace A m -> mcball A m (x,r) = Empty

items.name: MCBALL_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, mcball A m (x,r) = Empty <-> ~ x :e mspace A m \/ r < 0

items.name: MCBALL_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, mcball (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) (x,r) = cball N (x,r)

items.name: MCBALL_PROD_METRIC_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall r :e R, mcball (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) ((x,y),r) c= mcball A m1 (x,r) :*: mcball B m2 (y,r)

items.name: MCBALL_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall x r :e R, mcball R real_euclidean_metric (x,r) = closed_real_interval (seq_cons (x + - r,x + r) seq_nil)

items.name: MCBALL_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, x :e s -> mcball A (submetric A m s) (x,r) = mcball A m (x,r) :/\: s

items.name: MCBALL_SUBMETRIC_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, forall r :e R, mcball A (submetric A m s) (a,r) = if a :e s then s :/\: mcball A m (a,r) else Empty

items.name: MCBALL_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, forall a b :e R, y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) + a <= b -> mcball A m (x,a) c= mcball A m (y,b)

items.name: MCBALL_SUBSET_CONCENTRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall a b :e R, a <= b -> mcball A m (x,a) c= mcball A m (x,b)

items.name: MCBALL_SUBSET_MBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, forall a b :e R, y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) + a < b -> mcball A m (x,a) c= mball A m (y,b)

items.name: MCBALL_SUBSET_MBALL_CONCENTRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall a b :e R, a < b -> mcball A m (x,a) c= mball A m (x,b)

items.name: MCBALL_SUBSET_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, mcball A m (x,r) c= mspace A m

items.name: MCBALL_SUBSET_PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall r r' :e R, mcball A m1 (x,r) :*: mcball B m2 (y,r') c= mcball (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) ((x,y),r + r')

items.name: MCOMPLETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m <-> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> eventually omega {n :e omega | s n :e mspace A m} sequentially /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall n n' :e omega, N <= n /\ N <= n' -> mdist A m (s n,s n') < e0) -> exists x :e A, limit omega A (mtopology A m) s x sequentially

items.name: MCOMPLETE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m <-> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> (cauchy_in A m s <-> (forall n :e omega, s n :e mspace A m) /\ exists x :e A, limit omega A (mtopology A m) s x sequentially)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_CAPPED_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e R, forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A (capped_metric A d m) <-> mcomplete A m

items.name: MCOMPLETE_CFUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, mcomplete B m -> mcomplete (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_CONNECTED_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m /\ (connected_space A (mtopology A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m)) -> path_connected_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_CONNECTED_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, mcomplete (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) /\ (connected N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) -> path_connected N s

items.name: MCOMPLETE_CONNECTED_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mcomplete A (submetric A m s) /\ (connected_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s)) -> path_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_DISCRETE_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, mcomplete A (discrete_metric A s)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_DYADIC_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall a b :e A, mcomplete A m /\ (connected_space A (mtopology A m) /\ (locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) /\ (a :e mspace A m /\ b :e mspace A m))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e A) /\ (f 0 = a /\ (f 1 = b /\ ((forall m' n :e omega, m' <= 2 ^ n -> f (m' :/: 2 ^ n) :e mspace A m) /\ forall j :e omega, exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall n m1 m2 :e omega, m1 <= 2 ^ n /\ (m2 <= 2 ^ n /\ abs_SNo (m1 :/: 2 ^ n + - m2 :/: 2 ^ n) < d) -> mdist A m (f (m1 :/: 2 ^ n),f (m2 :/: 2 ^ n)) < recip_SNo (2 ^ j))))

items.name: MCOMPLETE_EMPTY_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mspace A m = Empty -> mcomplete A m

items.name: MCOMPLETE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> mcomplete (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_FIP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m <-> forall f c= Power A, (forall c c= A, c :e f -> closed_in A (mtopology A m) c) /\ ((forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= A, exists a :e A, c :e f /\ c c= mcball A m (a,e0)) /\ (forall f' c= Power A, finite f' /\ f' c= f -> ~ {x :e A | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = Empty)) -> ~ {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: MCOMPLETE_FIP_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m <-> forall f c= Power A, (forall c c= A, c :e f -> closed_in A (mtopology A m) c) /\ ((forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= A, exists a :e A, c :e f /\ c c= mcball A m (a,e0)) /\ (forall f' c= Power A, finite f' /\ f' c= f -> ~ {x :e A | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = Empty)) -> exists l :e A, l :e mspace A m /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = {l}

items.name: MCOMPLETE_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric B, mcomplete B m -> mcomplete (B :^: A) (funspace A B s m)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_IMBEDDING_IN_LC_CONTINUUM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall a b :e A, mcomplete A m /\ (connected_space A (mtopology A m) /\ (locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) /\ (a :e mspace A m /\ b :e mspace A m))) -> exists K c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) K /\ (connected_in A (mtopology A m) K /\ (locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) K) /\ (a :e K /\ b :e K)))

items.name: MCOMPLETE_IMBEDDING_IN_LC_CONTINUUM_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall a b :e A, mcomplete A (submetric A m s) /\ (connected_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ (locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s) /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s))) -> exists K c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) K /\ (connected_in A (mtopology A m) K /\ (locally_connected_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) K) /\ (K c= s /\ (a :e K /\ b :e K))))

items.name: MCOMPLETE_IMP_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mcomplete A (submetric A m s) /\ s c= mspace A m -> closed_in A (mtopology A m) s

items.name: MCOMPLETE_IMP_LOCALLY_COMPACT_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, mcomplete (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s

items.name: MCOMPLETE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, mcomplete A (submetric A m s) /\ mcomplete A (submetric A m t) -> mcomplete A (submetric A m (s :/\: t))

items.name: MCOMPLETE_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall t c= A, t :e s -> mcomplete A (submetric A m t))) -> mcomplete A (submetric A m {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y})

items.name: MCOMPLETE_IN_LOCALLY_COMPACT_IMP_LOCALLY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, locally_compact_space A (mtopology A m) /\ (mcomplete A (submetric A m s) /\ s c= mspace A m) -> locally_compact_space A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) s)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) -> locally_path_connected_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, mcomplete (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: MCOMPLETE_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m -> (locally_path_connected_space A (mtopology A m) <-> locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m))

items.name: MCOMPLETE_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, mcomplete (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) -> (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s <-> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_NEST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m <-> forall c :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, closed_in A (mtopology A m) (c n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ c n = Empty) /\ ((forall m0 n :e omega, m0 <= n -> c n c= c m0) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists n :e omega, exists a :e A, c n c= mcball A m (a,e0)))) -> ~ {x :e A | forall Y :e {c n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} = Empty

items.name: MCOMPLETE_NEST_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m <-> forall c :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, closed_in A (mtopology A m) (c n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ c n = Empty) /\ ((forall m0 n :e omega, m0 <= n -> c n c= c m0) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists n :e omega, exists a :e A, c n c= mcball A m (a,e0)))) -> exists l :e A, l :e mspace A m /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e {c n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} = {l}

items.name: MCOMPLETE_PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, mcomplete (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) <-> mspace A m1 = Empty \/ (mspace B m2 = Empty \/ mcomplete A m1 /\ mcomplete B m2)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_REAL_EUCLIDEAN_METRIC
items.statement: mcomplete R real_euclidean_metric

items.name: MCOMPLETE_SUBMETRIC_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A (submetric A m Empty)

items.name: MCOMPLETE_SUBMETRIC_REAL_EUCLIDEAN_METRIC
items.statement: forall s c= R, mcomplete R (submetric R real_euclidean_metric s) <-> closed_in R euclideanreal s

items.name: MCOMPLETE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, mcomplete A (submetric A m s) /\ mcomplete A (submetric A m t) -> mcomplete A (submetric A m (s :\/: t))

items.name: MCOMPLETE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ (forall t c= A, t :e s -> mcomplete A (submetric A m t)) -> mcomplete A (submetric A m (Union s))

items.name: MDIAMETER_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s -> (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> mdist A m (x,y) <= mdiameter A m s) /\ forall d :e R, 0 <= d /\ d < mdiameter A m s -> exists x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ d < mdist A m (x,y))

items.name: MDIAMETER_BOUNDED_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, mbounded A m s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> mdist A m (x,y) <= mdiameter A m s

items.name: MDIAMETER_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s -> mdiameter A m (closure_of A (mtopology A m) s) = mdiameter A m s

items.name: MDIAMETER_COMPACT_ATTAINED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ mdist A m (x,y) = mdiameter A m s)

items.name: MDIAMETER_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mdiameter A m Empty = 0

items.name: MDIAMETER_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s -> (mdiameter A m s = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ exists a :e A, s = {a})

items.name: MDIAMETER_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, mdiameter (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) x = diameter N x

items.name: MDIAMETER_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall d :e R, s c= mspace A m /\ ((~ s = Empty \/ 0 <= d) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> mdist A m (x,y) <= d)) -> mdiameter A m s <= d

items.name: MDIAMETER_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s -> 0 <= mdiameter A m s

items.name: MDIAMETER_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m -> mdiameter A m {x} = 0

items.name: MDIAMETER_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, mdiameter A (submetric A m s) t = mdiameter A m t

items.name: MDIAMETER_SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s -> mdiameter (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) t = diameter N t

items.name: MDIAMETER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ mbounded A m t -> mdiameter A m s <= mdiameter A m t

items.name: MDIAMETER_SUBSET_MBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, forall t c= A, x :e mspace A m /\ (0 < r /\ t c= mball A m (x,r)) -> mdiameter A m t <= 2 * r

items.name: MDIAMETER_SUBSET_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s -> exists z :e A, s c= mcball A m (z,mdiameter A m s)

items.name: MDIAMETER_SUBSET_MCBALL_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mbounded A m s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists z :e A, z :e s /\ s c= mcball A m (z,mdiameter A m s)

items.name: MDIAMETER_UNION_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, mbounded A m s /\ (mbounded A m t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> mdiameter A m (s :\/: t) <= mdiameter A m s + mdiameter A m t

items.name: MDIST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall d :e R :^: (A :*: A), is_metric_space A (s,d) -> forall x :e A :*: A, mdist A (s,d) x = d x

items.name: MDIST_0
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> (mdist A m (x,y) = 0 <-> x = y)

items.name: MDIST_CAPPED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall d :e R, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, 0 < d -> mdist A (capped_metric A d m) (x,y) <= d

items.name: MDIST_CFUNSPACE_EQ_MDIST_FUNSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall f g :e B :^: A, mdist (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) (f,g) = mdist (B :^: A) (funspace A B (topspace A top) m) (f,g)

items.name: MDIST_CFUNSPACE_IMP_MDIST_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall f g :e B :^: A, forall a :e R, forall x :e A, f :e mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) /\ (g :e mspace (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) /\ (mdist (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) (f,g) <= a /\ x :e topspace A top)) -> mdist B m (f x,g x) <= a

items.name: MDIST_CFUNSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, forall B0 :e R, forall f g :e B :^: A, 0 <= B0 /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> mdist B m (f x,g x) <= B0) -> mdist (B :^: A) (cfunspace A B top m) (f,g) <= B0

items.name: MDIST_POS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> (0 < mdist A m (x,y) <-> ~ x = y)

items.name: MDIST_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> 0 <= mdist A m (x,y)

items.name: MDIST_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ ~ x = y) -> 0 < mdist A m (x,y)

items.name: MDIST_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m -> mdist A m (x,x) = 0

items.name: MDIST_REVERSE_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y z :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ z :e mspace A m) -> abs_SNo (mdist A m (x,y) + - mdist A m (y,z)) <= mdist A m (x,z)

items.name: MDIST_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> mdist A m (x,y) = mdist A m (y,x)

items.name: MDIST_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y z :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ z :e mspace A m) -> mdist A m (x,z) <= mdist A m (x,y) + mdist A m (y,z)

items.name: MDIST_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y z :e A, forall a b :e R, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ (z :e mspace A m /\ (mdist A m (x,y) < a /\ mdist A m (y,z) < b))) -> mdist A m (x,z) < a + b

items.name: MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s <-> integrable_on 1 A (fun x:set => vec 1 1) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ (measurable 1 t /\ t c= s)) -> measurable N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: MEASURABLE_ADDITIVE_IMP_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f (vector_add M x y) = vector_add N (f x) (f y)) -> linear M N f

items.name: MEASURABLE_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, measurable N s -> measurable N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, measurable N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ALMOST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s s' t c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s /\ (negligible A t /\ s :\/: t = s' :\/: t) -> measurable A s'

items.name: MEASURABLE_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, measurable A (ball A (a,r))

items.name: MEASURABLE_BOUNDED_AE_BY_INTEGRABLE_IMP_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s k c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M g s /\ (negligible M k /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: k -> vector_norm N (f x) <= drop (g x)))) -> integrable_on N M f s

items.name: MEASURABLE_BOUNDED_BY_INTEGRABLE_IMP_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M g s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= drop (g x))) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f s

items.name: MEASURABLE_BOUNDED_BY_INTEGRABLE_IMP_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_AE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M g s /\ (negligible M t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: t -> vector_norm N (f x) <= drop (g x)))) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f s

items.name: MEASURABLE_BOUNDED_BY_INTEGRABLE_IMP_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M g s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= drop (g x))) -> integrable_on N M f s

items.name: MEASURABLE_BOUNDED_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, measurable N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s) /\ abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x))) <= B) -> measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, measurable A (cball A (a,r))

items.name: MEASURABLE_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t /\ measurable N s -> measurable N t

items.name: MEASURABLE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s -> measurable A (closure A s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> measurable_on N P f (R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (R :^: idx M) /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | g x :e k})) -> measurable_on M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: MEASURABLE_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ bounded_hl N s -> measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_CONVEX_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (measurable N s <-> bounded_hl N s \/ interior N s = Empty)

items.name: MEASURABLE_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s -> measurable A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_COUNTABLE_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (s n)) -> measurable N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}

items.name: MEASURABLE_COUNTABLE_INTERS_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall D c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable D /\ (~ D = Empty /\ (forall d c= R :^: idx N, d :e D -> measurable N d)) -> measurable N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e D, x :e Y}

items.name: MEASURABLE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall B :e R, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (s n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => measure N (s k)) <= B) -> measurable N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega})

items.name: MEASURABLE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (s n)) /\ bounded_hl N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}) -> measurable N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega})

items.name: MEASURABLE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall B :e R, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (s n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, measure N (Union {s k | k :e omega, k <= n}) <= B) -> measurable N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega})

items.name: MEASURABLE_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N (s :\: {x}) <-> measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ measurable N t -> measurable N (s :\: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x))))) s) -> measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> (measurable N {f x | x :e s} <-> absolutely_integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x))))) s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> (measurable N {f x | x :e s} <-> integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x))))) s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ELEMENTARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, division_of A d s -> measurable A s

items.name: MEASURABLE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> measurable A Empty

items.name: MEASURABLE_EQ_ALMOST_BAIRE1
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), measurable_on M N (fun x:set => f x) (R :^: idx M) <-> exists s c= R :^: idx M, negligible M ((R :^: idx M) :\: s) /\ f :e baire M N 1 s

items.name: MEASURABLE_EQ_ALMOST_BAIRE2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) <-> exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), g :e baire M N 2 (R :^: idx M) /\ negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | ~ g x = f x})

items.name: MEASURABLE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> measurable N (frontier N s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_IFF_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_UNDER_CURVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= drop (f x)) -> (measurable_on N 1 f (R :^: idx N) <-> lebesgue_measurable (idx_n (dimindex N + 1)) (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {pastecart N 1 x y | y :e R :^: idx 1, y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,f x) seq_nil)}))

items.name: MEASURABLE_IMP_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_INNER_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, measurable N s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, compact N t /\ (t c= s /\ (measurable N t /\ measure N s < measure N t + e0))

items.name: MEASURABLE_INNER_OUTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (s c= u /\ (measurable N t /\ (measurable N u /\ abs_SNo (measure N t + - measure N u) < e0)))

items.name: MEASURABLE_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N (SetAdjoin s x) <-> measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s -> measurable N (inside N s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s <-> integrable_on 1 A (fun x:set => if x :e s then vec 1 1 else vec 1 0) (R :^: idx A)

items.name: MEASURABLE_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ measurable N t -> measurable N (s :/\: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, bounded_hl A s -> measurable A (interior A s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, measurable N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, measurable N (open_interval N (a,b))

items.name: MEASURABLE_INTER_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, forall i :e omega, measurable N s -> measurable N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | a <= x i})

items.name: MEASURABLE_INTER_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, forall i :e omega, measurable N s -> measurable N (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x i <= a})

items.name: MEASURABLE_INTER_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, measurable N s -> measurable N (s :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: MEASURABLE_JORDAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ negligible N (frontier N s) -> measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_INTER_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ measurable N t -> measurable N (s :/\: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ (measurable N t /\ s c= t) -> measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ measurable N s -> measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (measurable N {f x | x :e s} <-> measurable N s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M = dimindex N /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y)) -> (measurable N {f x | x :e s} <-> measurable M s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_LINEAR_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (measurable M s /\ dimindex M <= dimindex N) -> measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_LINEAR_IMAGE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx B, linear B A f -> measurable A {f x | x :e closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: MEASURABLE_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (measurable M s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y))) -> measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (measurable M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, open M t /\ (x :e t /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s :/\: t -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M y x)))) -> measurable N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_MEASURABLE_DIFF_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s /\ lebesgue_measurable A t -> measurable A (s :\: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_MEASURABLE_INTER_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ lebesgue_measurable N t -> measurable N (s :/\: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f s /\ (measurable M s /\ closed N t) -> measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: MEASURABLE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f s /\ (measurable M s /\ open N t) -> measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: MEASURABLE_MEASURE_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s -> (measure A s = 0 <-> negligible A s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_MEASURE_POS_LT
