items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s -> (0 < measure A s <-> ~ negligible A s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_MIDPOINT_CONVEX_IMP_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ (open N s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f (midpoint N (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2)) -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_MIDPOINT_CONVEX_IMP_CONVEX_1D
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, measurable_on 1 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ (convex 1 s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f (midpoint 1 (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2)) -> convex_on 1 f s

items.name: MEASURABLE_MIDPOINT_CONVEX_IMP_CONVEX_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) (cball N (a,r)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e cball N (a,r) /\ y :e cball N (a,r) -> f (midpoint N (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2) -> convex_on N f (cball N (a,r))

items.name: MEASURABLE_MIDPOINT_CONVEX_IMP_CONVEX_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ (convex N s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f (midpoint N (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2)) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall u v :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ (u + v = 1 /\ (closed_segment N (seq_cons (x,y) seq_nil) c= frontier N s -> x = y))))) -> f (vector_add N (vector_mul N u x) (vector_mul N v y)) <= u * f x + v * f y

items.name: MEASURABLE_MIDPOINT_CONVEX_IMP_CONVEX_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ (convex N s /\ (open N s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f (midpoint N (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2))) -> convex_on N f s

items.name: MEASURABLE_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N {vector_neg N x | x :e s} <-> measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_NEGLIGIBLE_SYMDIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ negligible N ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> measurable N t

items.name: MEASURABLE_NEGLIGIBLE_SYMDIFF_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> (measurable N s <-> measurable N t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_NESTED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall B :e R, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (s n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, measure N (s n) <= B) /\ (forall n :e omega, s n c= s (ordsucc n))) -> measurable N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega})

items.name: MEASURABLE_NONNEGLIGIBLE_IMP_LARGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ 0 < measure N s -> equip s R

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable_on A B (fun x:set => vec B 0) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ measurable_on M N g s -> measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_BANACH_INDICATRIX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx 1, measurable_on M N f s /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t})) -> measurable_on N 1 (fun y:set => if finite {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} then lift (finite_cardinality {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) else c) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_BILINEAR
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, op x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, bilinear P Q N op /\ (measurable_on M N f s /\ measurable_on M P g s) -> measurable_on M Q (fun x:set => op (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_CASES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | P x} /\ (measurable_on M N f s /\ measurable_on M N g s) -> measurable_on M N (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s -> measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_CMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) s <-> c = 0 \/ measurable_on M N f s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMBINE
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, h x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (measurable_on M P g s /\ (continuous_on_hl (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) Q (fun x:set => h (fstcart N x) (sndcart N P x)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex P)) /\ h (vec N 0) (vec P 0) = vec Q 0)) -> measurable_on M Q (fun x:set => h (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s <-> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> measurable_on M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (lebesgue_measurable N t /\ ({g x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ k c= t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ g x :e k}) /\ (measurable_on M N g s /\ measurable_on N P f t)))) -> measurable_on M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ continuous_on_hl N P g (R :^: idx N) -> measurable_on M P (fun x:set => g (f x)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_CONTINUOUS_0
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g (R :^: idx N) /\ g (vec N 0) = vec P 0) -> measurable_on M P (fun x:set => g (f x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_SET
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e s) /\ continuous_on_hl N P g s)) -> measurable_on M P (fun x:set => g (f x)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_SET_0
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, closed N s /\ (measurable_on M N f t /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e s) /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g s /\ (vec N 0 :e s /\ g (vec N 0) = vec P 0)))) -> measurable_on M P (fun x:set => g (f x)) t

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_CONTINUOUS_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e open_interval N (a,b)) /\ continuous_on_hl N P g (open_interval N (a,b))) -> measurable_on M P (fun x:set => g (f x)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_FSTCART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> measurable_on M P f (R :^: idx M) -> measurable_on (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) P (fun z:set => f (fstcart M z)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N t /\ ({g x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N k /\ k c= t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ g x :e k}) /\ measurable_on N P f t)) -> measurable_on M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_REV
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ ({g x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M k /\ k c= s -> lebesgue_measurable N {g x | x :e k}) /\ measurable_on M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) s)) -> measurable_on N P f t

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_SNDCART
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> measurable_on N P f (R :^: idx N) -> measurable_on (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) P (fun z:set => f (sndcart M N z)) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COMPOSE_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) -> measurable_on (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex M)) N (fun z:set => f (vector_sub M (fstcart M z) (sndcart M M z))) (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex M))

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_CONST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N (fun x:set => k) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_CONST_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R :^: idx N, measurable_on M N (fun x:set => c) s <-> c = vec N 0 \/ lebesgue_measurable M s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (lebesgue_measurable N t /\ ({g x | x :e s} c= t /\ (measurable_on N P f t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, negligible N k /\ k c= t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ g x :e k}))))) -> measurable_on M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_CONTINUOUS_COMPOSE_REV
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable M s /\ ({g x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, negligible M k /\ k c= s -> lebesgue_measurable N {g x | x :e k}) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ measurable_on M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) s))) -> measurable_on N P f t

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_CONVOLUTION
items.statement: forall M N P Q:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> Q <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx P, bop x y :e R :^: idx Q) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, bilinear P Q N bop /\ (measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) /\ measurable_on M P g (R :^: idx M)) -> measurable_on M Q (fun y:set => bop (f (vector_sub M x y)) (g y)) (R :^: idx M)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_COUNTABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= Power (R :^: idx M), countable k /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx M, s :e k -> measurable_on M N f s) -> measurable_on M N f (Union k)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_DET_JACOBIAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) -> measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (det N (matrix N N (f' x)))) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_DIFF
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ measurable_on M N f t -> measurable_on M N f (s :\: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (lebesgue_measurable M s /\ (differentiable_on_hl N M g s /\ measurable_on M P (fun x:set => f (g x)) s)) -> measurable_on N P f {g x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_DROP_MUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M 1 f s /\ measurable_on M N g s -> measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (drop (f x)) (g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> measurable_on M N f Empty

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ measurable_on M N f s -> measurable_on M N g s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_INDICATOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, measurable_on A 1 (fun x:set => indicator A t x) s <-> lebesgue_measurable A (s :/\: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_INDICATOR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s -> (measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => indicator N t x) s <-> lebesgue_measurable N t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_INTER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ measurable_on M N f t -> measurable_on M N f (s :/\: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_INVERSE_FUNCTION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x)) -> measurable_on N M g {f x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, analytic N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_ANALYTIC_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ lebesgue_measurable M s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, analytic N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_BOREL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, borel N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_BOREL_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ lebesgue_measurable M s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, borel N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_CLOSED_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ lebesgue_measurable M s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ a <= f x k})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ a < f x k})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x k <= a})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x k < a})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, open N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_OPEN_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ lebesgue_measurable M s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, open N t -> lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_PREIMAGE_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e open_interval N (a,b)})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx B, s c= t /\ (measurable_on B A f t /\ lebesgue_measurable B s) -> measurable_on B A f s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LEFT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ measurable_on N M g {f x | x :e s})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LIFT_ABS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (f x))) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LIFT_DIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ (measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) s /\ negligible N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ g x = 0}) -> measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x :/: g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LIFT_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ negligible N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = 0} -> measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (recip_SNo (f x))) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LIFT_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable_on A 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ measurable_on A 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) s -> measurable_on A 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x * g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LIFT_POW
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e omega, measurable_on M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ (n = 0 -> lebesgue_measurable M s) -> measurable_on M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x ^ n)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LIFT_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= A, finite t /\ ((t = Empty -> lebesgue_measurable N s) /\ (forall i :e A, i :e t -> measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f i x)) s)) -> measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => lift (finprod t (fun i:set => f i x))) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LIMIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s k c= R :^: idx M, (forall n :e omega, measurable_on M N (f n) s) /\ (negligible M k /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s :\: k -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially)) -> measurable_on M N g s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall N P:set, N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, h x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (measurable_on N P (fun x:set => h (f x)) s <-> measurable_on N P h {f x | x :e s})

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ_GEN
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, h x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M = dimindex N /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y)) -> (measurable_on M P (fun x:set => h (f x)) s <-> measurable_on N P h {f x | x :e s})

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (measurable_on N 1 f (R :^: idx N) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= drop (f x)) <-> exists g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, g x y :e R :^: idx 1) /\ ((forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= drop (g n x) /\ drop (g n x) <= drop (f x)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, drop (g n x) <= drop (g (ordsucc n) x)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, measurable_on N 1 (g n) (R :^: idx N)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, finite {g n x | x :e R :^: idx N}) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => g n x) (f x) sequentially)))))

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_SPIKE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e t :\: s -> g x = f x) -> measurable_on M N f t -> measurable_on M N g t

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_SPIKE_SET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> measurable_on M N f s -> measurable_on M N f t

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_SPIKE_SET_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> measurable_on M N f t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ measurable_on M N g s -> measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f {vector_add M a x | x :e s} -> measurable_on M N (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N (fun x:set => f (vector_add M a x)) s <-> measurable_on M N f {vector_add M a x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_UNION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ measurable_on M N f t -> measurable_on M N f (s :\/: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_UNIONS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= Power (R :^: idx M), finite k /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx M, s :e k -> measurable_on M N f s) -> measurable_on M N f (Union k)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_UNIV

var_views.f: metafun(R :^: idx M -> R :^: idx A)

items.statement: forall A M:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> (measurable_on M A (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec A 0) (R :^: idx M) <-> measurable_on M A f s)

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s k c= R :^: idx 1, negligible 1 k /\ (lebesgue_measurable 1 s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s :\: k -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (at 1 x))) -> measurable_on 1 N f' s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, lebesgue_measurable 1 s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)) -> measurable_on 1 N f' s

items.name: MEASURABLE_ON_VSUM
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= A, finite t /\ (forall i :e A, i :e t -> measurable_on M N (f i) s) -> measurable_on M N (fun x:set => vsum A N t (fun i:set => f i x)) s

items.name: MEASURABLE_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ open N s -> measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ measurable N s -> measurable N t

items.name: MEASURABLE_OUTER_CLOSED_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, measurable N s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable d /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e d -> ~ k = Empty /\ exists a b :e R :^: idx N, k = closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall k l c= R :^: idx N, k :e d /\ (l :e d /\ ~ k = l) -> interior N k :/\: interior N l = Empty) /\ (s c= Union d /\ (measurable N (Union d) /\ measure N (Union d) <= measure N s + e0))))

items.name: MEASURABLE_OUTER_INTERVALS_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, measurable N s /\ (s c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ 0 < e0) -> exists d c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable d /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e d -> k c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (~ k = Empty /\ exists c d0 :e R :^: idx N, k = closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d0) seq_nil))) /\ ((forall k1 k2 c= R :^: idx N, k1 :e d /\ (k2 :e d /\ ~ k1 = k2) -> interior N k1 :/\: interior N k2 = Empty) /\ ((forall u v :e R :^: idx N, closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) :e d -> exists n :e omega, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> v i + - u i = (b i + - a i) :/: 2 ^ n) /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e d /\ ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty -> ~ interior N k = Empty) /\ (s c= Union d /\ (measurable N (Union d) /\ measure N (Union d) <= measure N s + e0))))))

items.name: MEASURABLE_OUTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, measurable N s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ (s c= t /\ (measurable N t /\ measure N t < measure N s + e0))

items.name: MEASURABLE_OUTER_OPEN_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, measurable N s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable d /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e d -> ~ k = Empty /\ exists a b :e R :^: idx N, k = open_interval N (a,b)) /\ (s c= Union d /\ (measurable N (Union d) /\ measure N (Union d) <= measure N s + e0)))

items.name: MEASURABLE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> negligible M s \/ (negligible N t \/ measurable M s /\ measurable N t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, measurable N s -> measurable N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, measurable N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, measurable N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, measurable N (open_segment N (a,b))

items.name: MEASURABLE_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq (R :^: idx A), measurable A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} (seq_set l))

items.name: MEASURABLE_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, measurable N {a}

items.name: MEASURABLE_SMALL_IMP_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ (atleastp s R /\ ~ equip s R) -> negligible N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_TETRAHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, measurable N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {a,b,c,d})

items.name: MEASURABLE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, measurable N s -> measurable N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: MEASURABLE_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> measurable N s

items.name: MEASURABLE_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, measurable N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {a,b,c})

items.name: MEASURABLE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ measurable N t -> measurable N (s :\/: t)

items.name: MEASURABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> measurable N s) -> measurable N (Union f)

items.name: MEASURE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e omega) -> forall x y :e A, m x < m y <-> m x < m y

items.name: MEASURE_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, measurable N s -> measure N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} = abs_SNo m ^ dimindex N * measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_BALL_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, 0 <= d -> measure N (ball N (x,d)) <= (2 * d) ^ dimindex N

items.name: MEASURE_BALL_POS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < measure N (ball N (x,e0)) <-> 0 < e0

items.name: MEASURE_BALL_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall c r :e R, 0 <= c -> measure N (ball N (a,c * r)) = c ^ dimindex N * measure N (ball N (a,r))

items.name: MEASURE_BOUNDED_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, measurable N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s) /\ abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x))) <= B) -> measure N {f x | x :e s} <= B * measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_CBALL_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, 0 <= d -> measure N (cball N (x,d)) <= (2 * d) ^ dimindex N

items.name: MEASURE_CBALL_POS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < measure N (cball N (x,e0)) <-> 0 < e0

items.name: MEASURE_CBALL_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall c r :e R, 0 <= c -> measure N (cball N (a,c * r)) = c ^ dimindex N * measure N (cball N (a,r))

items.name: MEASURE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ negligible N (frontier N s) -> measure N (closure N s) = measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_CONTINUOUS_WITH_HAUSDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ 0 < e0)) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N t /\ (convex N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ hausdist N (s,t) < d)) -> abs_SNo (measure N t + - measure N s) < e0

items.name: MEASURE_CONTINUOUS_WITH_HAUSDIST_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, convex N t /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ distance N (x,y) < d) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ distance N (x,y) < d)) -> abs_SNo (measure N t + - measure N s) < e0

items.name: MEASURE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_APPROACHABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall D c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall B e0 :e R, countable D /\ ((forall d c= R :^: idx N, d :e D -> measurable N d) /\ ((forall D' c= Power (R :^: idx N), D' c= D /\ finite D' -> measure N (Union D') <= B) /\ 0 < e0)) -> exists D' c= Power (R :^: idx N), D' c= D /\ (finite D' /\ measure N (Union D) + - e0 < measure N (Union D'))

items.name: MEASURE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall B :e R, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (d n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => measure N (d k)) <= B) -> measurable N (Union {d n | n :e omega, n :e omega}) /\ measure N (Union {d n | n :e omega, n :e omega}) <= B

items.name: MEASURE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_LE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall D c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall B :e R, countable D /\ ((forall d c= R :^: idx N, d :e D -> measurable N d) /\ (forall D' c= Power (R :^: idx N), D' c= D /\ finite D' -> finsum D' (fun d:set => measure N d) <= B)) -> measurable N (Union D) /\ measure N (Union D) <= B

items.name: MEASURE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_LE_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall B :e R, (forall n :e omega, measurable N (d n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, measure N (Union {d k | k :e omega, k <= n}) <= B) -> measurable N (Union {d n | n :e omega, n :e omega}) /\ measure N (Union {d n | n :e omega, n :e omega}) <= B

items.name: MEASURE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_LE_STRONG_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall D c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall B :e R, countable D /\ ((forall d c= R :^: idx N, d :e D -> measurable N d) /\ (forall D' c= Power (R :^: idx N), D' c= D /\ finite D' -> measure N (Union D') <= B)) -> measurable N (Union D) /\ measure N (Union D) <= B

items.name: MEASURE_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, measure N (s :\: {x}) = measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ (integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x))))) s /\ drop (integral 1 N s (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x)))))) <= b)) -> measure N {f x | x :e s} <= b

items.name: MEASURE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE_APPROX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall a :e R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (a :e s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (at N x) /\ ~ det N (matrix N N (f' x)) = 0) /\ (tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (diameter N (c n))) (vec 1 0) sequentially /\ ((forall n :e omega, a :e closure N (c n)) /\ (exists A c= R :^: idx N, convex N A /\ (bounded_hl N A /\ (~ interior N A = Empty /\ forall n :e omega, exists t :e R, exists z :e R :^: idx N, 0 < t /\ {vector_add N (vector_mul N t x) z | x :e A} = c n))))))) -> eventually omega {n :e omega | measurable N {f x | x :e c n}} sequentially /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (measure N {f x | x :e c n} :/: measure N (c n))) (lift (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' a))))) sequentially

items.name: MEASURE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE_APPROX_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall a :e R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (differentiable_on_hl N N f s /\ ((forall v c= R :^: idx N, v c= s /\ open N v -> open N {f x | x :e v}) /\ (a :e s /\ (~ det N (jacobian N N f (at N a)) = 0 /\ (tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (diameter N (c n))) (vec 1 0) sequentially /\ ((forall n :e omega, a :e closure N (c n)) /\ (exists A c= R :^: idx N, convex N A /\ (bounded_hl N A /\ (~ interior N A = Empty /\ forall n :e omega, exists t :e R, exists z :e R :^: idx N, 0 < t /\ {vector_add N (vector_mul N t x) z | x :e A} = c n))))))))) -> eventually omega {n :e omega | measurable N {f x | x :e c n}} sequentially /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (measure N {f x | x :e c n} :/: measure N (c n))) (lift (abs_SNo (det N (jacobian N N f (at N a))))) sequentially

items.name: MEASURE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> has_derivative N N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ integrable_on 1 N (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x))))) s)) -> measure N {f x | x :e s} = drop (integral 1 N s (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N (f' x))))))

items.name: MEASURE_DIFF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s /\ (measurable A t /\ t c= s) -> measure A (s :\: t) = measure A s + - measure A t

items.name: MEASURE_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s /\ (measurable A t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> measure A (s :\/: t) = measure A s + measure A t

items.name: MEASURE_DISJOINT_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), m x :e R) -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> has_measure N s (m s)) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ (t :e f /\ ~ s = t) -> s :/\: t = Empty)) -> measure N (Union f) = finsum f m

items.name: MEASURE_DISJOINT_UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> measurable N (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> f x :/\: f y = Empty)) -> measure N (Union {f x | x :e s}) = finsum s (fun x:set => measure N (f x))

items.name: MEASURE_DISJOINT_UNIONS_IMAGE_STRONG
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = Empty} /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> measurable N (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> f x :/\: f y = Empty)) -> measure N (Union {f x | x :e s}) = finsum s (fun x:set => measure N (f x))

items.name: MEASURE_DISJOINT_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s /\ (measurable A t /\ (s :\/: t = u /\ s :/\: t = Empty)) -> measure A s + measure A t = measure A u

items.name: MEASURE_ELEMENTARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, division_of A d s -> measure A s = finsum d (fun x:set => content A x)

items.name: MEASURE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> measure A Empty = 0

items.name: MEASURE_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, negligible A s -> measure A s = 0

items.name: MEASURE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> measure N (frontier N s) = measure N (closure N s) + - measure N (interior N s)

items.name: MEASURE_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, measure N (SetAdjoin s x) = measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s -> measure A s = drop (integral 1 A s (fun x:set => vec 1 1))

items.name: MEASURE_INTEGRAL_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s -> measure A s = drop (integral 1 A (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => if x :e s then vec 1 1 else vec 1 0))

items.name: MEASURE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ negligible N (frontier N s) -> measure N (interior N s) = measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, measure N (open_interval N (a,b)) = content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: MEASURE_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, measure 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if drop a <= drop b then drop b + - drop a else 0) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, measure 1 (open_interval 1 (a,b)) = if drop a <= drop b then drop b + - drop a else 0

items.name: MEASURE_INTERVAL_1_ALT
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, measure 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if drop a < drop b then drop b + - drop a else 0) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, measure 1 (open_interval 1 (a,b)) = if drop a < drop b then drop b + - drop a else 0

items.name: MEASURE_INTERVAL_2
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, measure (idx_n 2) (closed_interval (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if a 1 <= b 1 /\ a 2 <= b 2 then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) else 0) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, measure (idx_n 2) (open_interval (idx_n 2) (a,b)) = if a 1 <= b 1 /\ a 2 <= b 2 then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) else 0

items.name: MEASURE_INTERVAL_2_ALT
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, measure (idx_n 2) (closed_interval (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if a 1 < b 1 /\ a 2 < b 2 then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) else 0) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, measure (idx_n 2) (open_interval (idx_n 2) (a,b)) = if a 1 < b 1 /\ a 2 < b 2 then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) else 0

items.name: MEASURE_INTERVAL_3
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 3, measure (idx_n 3) (closed_interval (idx_n 3) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if a 1 <= b 1 /\ (a 2 <= b 2 /\ a 3 <= b 3) then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) * (b 3 + - a 3) else 0) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 3, measure (idx_n 3) (open_interval (idx_n 3) (a,b)) = if a 1 <= b 1 /\ (a 2 <= b 2 /\ a 3 <= b 3) then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) * (b 3 + - a 3) else 0

items.name: MEASURE_INTERVAL_3_ALT
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 3, measure (idx_n 3) (closed_interval (idx_n 3) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if a 1 < b 1 /\ (a 2 < b 2 /\ a 3 < b 3) then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) * (b 3 + - a 3) else 0) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 3, measure (idx_n 3) (open_interval (idx_n 3) (a,b)) = if a 1 < b 1 /\ (a 2 < b 2 /\ a 3 < b 3) then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) * (b 3 + - a 3) else 0

items.name: MEASURE_INTERVAL_4
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 4, measure (idx_n 4) (closed_interval (idx_n 4) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if a 1 <= b 1 /\ (a 2 <= b 2 /\ (a 3 <= b 3 /\ a 4 <= b 4)) then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) * (b 3 + - a 3) * (b 4 + - a 4) else 0) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 4, measure (idx_n 4) (open_interval (idx_n 4) (a,b)) = if a 1 <= b 1 /\ (a 2 <= b 2 /\ (a 3 <= b 3 /\ a 4 <= b 4)) then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) * (b 3 + - a 3) * (b 4 + - a 4) else 0

items.name: MEASURE_INTERVAL_4_ALT
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 4, measure (idx_n 4) (closed_interval (idx_n 4) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if a 1 < b 1 /\ (a 2 < b 2 /\ (a 3 < b 3 /\ a 4 < b 4)) then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) * (b 3 + - a 3) * (b 4 + - a 4) else 0) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 4, measure (idx_n 4) (open_interval (idx_n 4) (a,b)) = if a 1 < b 1 /\ (a 2 < b 2 /\ (a 3 < b 3 /\ a 4 < b 4)) then (b 1 + - a 1) * (b 2 + - a 2) * (b 3 + - a 3) * (b 4 + - a 4) else 0

items.name: MEASURE_ISOMETRY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M = dimindex N /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x)) -> measure N {f x | x :e s} = measure M s

items.name: MEASURE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e omega) -> ((forall y :e A, m y < m a -> m y < m b) <-> m a <= m b)

items.name: MEASURE_LIMIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, measurable N s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ball N (vec N 0,B) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> abs_SNo (measure N (s :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) + - measure N s) < e0

items.name: MEASURE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ measurable N s -> measure N {f x | x :e s} = abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N f)) * measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_LINEAR_IMAGE_SAME
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (measurable N s /\ abs_SNo (det N (matrix N N f)) = 1) -> measure N {f x | x :e s} = measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (measurable M s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y))) -> measure N {f x | x :e s} <= B ^ dimindex N * measure M s

items.name: MEASURE_LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (measurable M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, open M t /\ (x :e t /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s :/\: t -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M y x)))) -> measure N {f x | x :e s} <= B ^ dimindex N * measure M s

items.name: MEASURE_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measure N {vector_neg N x | x :e s} = measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_SYMDIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> measure N s = measure N t

items.name: MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s /\ (measurable A t /\ negligible A (s :/\: t)) -> measure A (s :\/: t) = measure A s + measure A t

items.name: MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), m x :e R) -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> has_measure N s (m s)) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ (t :e f /\ ~ s = t) -> negligible N (s :/\: t))) -> measure N (Union f) = finsum f m

items.name: MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> measurable N (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> negligible N (f x :/\: f y))) -> measure N (Union {f x | x :e s}) = finsum s (fun x:set => measure N (f x))

items.name: MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNIONS_IMAGE_STRONG
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = Empty} /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> measurable N (f x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> negligible N (f x :/\: f y))) -> measure N (Union {f x | x :e s}) = finsum s (fun x:set => measure N (f x))

items.name: MEASURE_NEGLIGIBLE_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s /\ (measurable A t /\ (s :\/: t = u /\ negligible A (s :/\: t))) -> measure A s + measure A t = measure A u

items.name: MEASURE_OPEN_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s /\ (bounded_hl A s /\ ~ s = Empty) -> 0 < measure A s

items.name: MEASURE_OPEN_POS_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s /\ bounded_hl A s -> (0 < measure A s <-> ~ s = Empty)

items.name: MEASURE_ORTHOGONAL_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, orthogonal_transformation N f -> measure N {f x | x :e s} = measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, measurable M s /\ measurable N t -> measure (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = measure M s * measure N t

items.name: MEASURE_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s -> 0 <= measure A s

items.name: MEASURE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, measurable N s -> measure N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} = abs_SNo c ^ dimindex N * measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_SEGMENT_1
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, measure 1 (closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 b a)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, measure 1 (open_segment 1 (a,b)) = vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 b a)

items.name: MEASURE_SEMICONTINUOUS_WITH_HAUSDIST_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx N, forall r e0 :e R, forall a :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (convex N s /\ (ball N (a,r) c= s /\ (0 < r /\ (bounded_hl N s' /\ (measurable N s' /\ (hausdist N (s,s') <= e0 * r /\ 0 < e0)))))) -> measure N s' <= measure N s * (1 + e0) ^ dimindex N

items.name: MEASURE_SEMICONTINUOUS_WITH_HAUSDIST_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ (negligible N (frontier N s) /\ 0 < e0) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall s' c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s' /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s' -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ distance N (x,y) < d) -> measure N s' < measure N s + e0

items.name: MEASURE_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall l :e finseq (R :^: idx N), seq_len l = dimindex N -> measure N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (seq_set (seq_cons a l))) = abs_SNo (det N (vector (R :^: idx N) N (seq_map (fun x:set => vector_sub N x a) l))) :/: factorial (dimindex N)

items.name: MEASURE_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, measure N {a} = 0

items.name: MEASURE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s /\ (measurable A t /\ s c= t) -> measure A s <= measure A t

items.name: MEASURE_SUB_LE_MEASURE_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ measurable N t -> measure N s + - measure N t <= measure N (s :\: t)

items.name: MEASURE_SUB_LE_MEASURE_SYMDIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ measurable N t -> abs_SNo (measure N s + - measure N t) <= measure N ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s))

items.name: MEASURE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, measure N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = measure N s

items.name: MEASURE_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx_n 2, measure (idx_n 2) (hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | convex (idx_n 2) x} {a,b,c}) = abs_SNo ((b 1 + - a 1) * (c 2 + - a 2) + - (b 2 + - a 2) * (c 1 + - a 1)) :/: 2

items.name: MEASURE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ measurable N t -> measure N (s :\/: t) = measure N s + measure N t + - measure N (s :/\: t)

items.name: MEASURE_UNIONS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> measurable N s) -> measure N (Union f) <= finsum f (fun s:set => measure N s)

items.name: MEASURE_UNIONS_LE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f c= A, forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: A, finite f /\ (forall a :e A, a :e f -> measurable N (s a)) -> measure N (Union {s x | x :e f}) <= finsum f (fun a:set => measure N (s a))

items.name: MEASURE_UNION_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ measurable N t -> measure N (s :\/: t) <= measure N s + measure N t

items.name: MEASURE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall m :e R, has_measure A s m -> measure A s = m

items.name: MEM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_mem x seq_nil <-> False) /\ (seq_mem x (seq_cons h t) <-> x = h \/ seq_mem x t)

items.name: MEMBER_NOT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, (exists x :e A, x :e s) <-> ~ s = Empty

items.name: MEM_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_mem x (seq_append l1 l2) <-> seq_mem x l1 \/ seq_mem x l2

items.name: MEM_APPEND_DECOMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, seq_mem x l <-> exists l1 l2 :e finseq A, l = seq_append l1 (seq_cons x l2)

items.name: MEM_APPEND_DECOMPOSE_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, seq_mem x l <-> exists l1 l2 :e finseq A, ~ seq_mem x l1 /\ l = seq_append l1 (seq_cons x l2)

items.name: MEM_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq (A :*: B), forall x :e A, seq_mem (x,seq_assoc x l) l <-> seq_mem x (seq_map (fun x0:set => x0 0) l)

items.name: MEM_EL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, forall n :e omega, n < seq_len l -> seq_mem (seq_nth l n) l

items.name: MEM_EXISTS_EL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l :e finseq A, forall x :e A, seq_mem x l <-> exists i :e omega, i < seq_len l /\ x = seq_nth l i

items.name: MEM_FILTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, forall x :e A, seq_mem x (seq_filter P l) <-> P x /\ seq_mem x l

items.name: MEM_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall l :e finseq (R :^: idx M), linear M N f /\ (forall x0 y :e R :^: idx M, f x0 = f y -> x0 = y) -> (seq_mem (f x) (seq_map f l) <-> seq_mem x l)

items.name: MEM_LIST_OF_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, finite s -> forall x :e A, seq_mem x (choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)) <-> x :e s

items.name: MEM_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall y :e B, forall l :e finseq A, seq_mem y (seq_map f l) <-> exists x :e A, seq_mem x l /\ y = f x

items.name: MEM_REPLICATE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e omega, forall x y :e A, seq_mem x (seq_replicate n y) <-> x = y /\ ~ n = 0

items.name: MEM_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx N, forall l :e finseq (R :^: idx N), seq_mem (vector_add N a x) (seq_map (fun x0:set => vector_add N a x0) l) <-> seq_mem x l

items.name: METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall d :e R :^: (A :*: A), is_metric_space A (s,d) -> mspace A (s,d) = s /\ forall x :e A :*: A, mdist A (s,d) x = d x

items.name: METRIC_BAIRE_CATEGORY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall g c= Power A, mcomplete A m /\ (countable g /\ (forall t c= A, t :e g -> t :e mtopology A m /\ closure_of A (mtopology A m) t = mspace A m)) -> closure_of A (mtopology A m) {x :e A | forall Y :e g, x :e Y} = mspace A m

items.name: METRIC_BAIRE_CATEGORY_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall g c= Power A, mcomplete A m /\ (countable g /\ (forall t c= A, t :e g -> closed_in A (mtopology A m) t /\ interior_of A (mtopology A m) t = Empty)) -> interior_of A (mtopology A m) (Union g) = Empty

items.name: METRIC_CLOSED_IN_IFF_SEQUENTIALLY_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, closed_in A (mtopology A m) s <-> s c= mspace A m /\ forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e A) -> forall l :e A, (forall n :e omega, a n :e s) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m) a l sequentially -> l :e s

items.name: METRIC_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, closure_of A (mtopology A m) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ forall r :e R, 0 < r -> exists y :e A, y :e s /\ y :e mball A m (x,r)}

items.name: METRIC_CLOSURE_OF_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, closure_of A (mtopology A m) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ forall r :e R, 0 < r -> exists y :e A, y :e s /\ y :e mcball A m (x,r)}

items.name: METRIC_COMPLETION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, exists m' :e metric (R :^: A), exists f :e R :^: A :^: A, mcomplete (R :^: A) m' /\ ({f x | x :e mspace A m} c= mspace (R :^: A) m' /\ (closure_of (R :^: A) (mtopology (R :^: A) m') {f x | x :e mspace A m} = mspace (R :^: A) m' /\ forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> mdist (R :^: A) m' (f x,f y) = mdist A m (x,y)))

items.name: METRIC_COMPLETION_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, exists s c= R :^: A, exists f :e R :^: A :^: A, s c= mspace (R :^: A) (funspace A R (mspace A m) real_euclidean_metric) /\ (mcomplete (R :^: A) (submetric (R :^: A) (funspace A R (mspace A m) real_euclidean_metric) s) /\ ({f x | x :e mspace A m} c= s /\ (closure_of (R :^: A) (mtopology (R :^: A) (funspace A R (mspace A m) real_euclidean_metric)) {f x | x :e mspace A m} = s /\ forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> mdist (R :^: A) (funspace A R (mspace A m) real_euclidean_metric) (f x,f y) = mdist A m (x,y))))

items.name: METRIC_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m' :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (mtopology A m,mtopology B m') f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m -> f x :e mspace B m') /\ forall a :e A, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ a :e mspace A m -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (a,x) < d -> mdist B m' (f a,f x) < e0)

items.name: METRIC_COVER_SIGMA_LOCALLY_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e mtopology A m) /\ Union U = mspace A m -> exists V c= Power A, (forall v c= A, v :e V -> v :e mtopology A m) /\ (Union V = mspace A m /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e V -> exists u c= A, u :e U /\ v c= u) /\ sigma_locally_finite_in A (mtopology A m) V))

items.name: METRIC_DERIVED_SET_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A (mtopology A m) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ forall r :e R, 0 < r -> exists y :e A, ~ y = x /\ (y :e s /\ y :e mball A m (x,r))}

items.name: METRIC_INJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall m :e metric B, forall s c= A, {f x | x :e s} c= mspace B m /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> mspace A (s,fun p :e A :*: A => mdist B m (f (p 0),f (p 1))) = s /\ forall x :e A :*: A, mdist A (s,fun p :e A :*: A => mdist B m (f (p 0),f (p 1))) x = mdist B m (f (x 0),f (x 1))

items.name: METRIC_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, interior_of A (mtopology A m) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ mball A m (x,e0) c= s}

items.name: METRIC_INTERIOR_OF_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, interior_of A (mtopology A m) s = {x :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ mcball A m (x,e0) c= s}

items.name: METRIZABLE_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, metrizable_space (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n)

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_COMPLETELY_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> completely_regular_space A top

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_FIRST_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> first_countable A top

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> hausdorff_space A top

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_HEREDITARILY_NORMAL_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_KC_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> kc_space A top

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_K_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> k_space A top

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_NORMAL_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> normal_space A top

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_PARACOMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> paracompact_space A top

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> regular_space A top

items.name: METRIZABLE_IMP_T1_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> t1_space A top

items.name: METRIZABLE_PRODUCT_EUCLIDEANREAL_NUM
items.statement: metrizable_space (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun n:set => euclideanreal))

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_CANTOR_SPACE
items.statement: metrizable_space (Power omega) cantor_space

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_COMPLETION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top -> exists top' :e topology (R :^: A), exists f :e R :^: A :^: A, completely_metrizable_space (R :^: A) top' /\ (embedding_map A (R :^: A) (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ closure_of (R :^: A) top' {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace (R :^: A) top')

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, metrizable_space A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> metrizable_space (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A)

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: metrizable_space R euclideanreal

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, metrizable_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, metrizable_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ countable {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ exists a :e A, topspace A (tops i) c= {a}} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> metrizable_space A (tops i)

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, metrizable_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ metrizable_space A top1 /\ metrizable_space B top2

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ metrizable_space A top -> metrizable_space B top'

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, metrizable_space A top /\ separated_in A top s t -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, metrizable_space A top -> metrizable_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: MICHAEL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top -> (forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top -> exists V c= Power A, (forall v c= A, v :e V -> v :e top) /\ (Union V = topspace A top /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e V -> exists u c= A, u :e U /\ v c= u) /\ sigma_locally_finite_in A top V))) -> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top -> exists V c= Power A, (forall v c= A, v :e V -> v :e top) /\ (Union V = topspace A top /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e V -> exists u c= A, u :e U /\ v c= u) /\ locally_finite_in A top V))

items.name: MIDPOINTS_IN_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall y x :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s -> midpoint N (x,y) :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s

items.name: MIDPOINT_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, b = midpoint N (a,c) <-> between N b (a,c) /\ distance N (a,b) = distance N (b,c)

items.name: MIDPOINT_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = c -> (b = midpoint N (a,c) <-> collinear N {a,b,c} /\ distance N (a,b) = distance N (b,c))

items.name: MIDPOINT_CONVEX_DYADIC_RATIONALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> midpoint N (x,y) :e s /\ f (midpoint N (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2) -> forall n m p :e omega, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ m + p = 2 ^ n) -> vector_add N (vector_mul N (m :/: 2 ^ n) x) (vector_mul N (p :/: 2 ^ n) y) :e s /\ f (vector_add N (vector_mul N (m :/: 2 ^ n) x) (vector_mul N (p :/: 2 ^ n) y)) <= m :/: 2 ^ n * f x + p :/: 2 ^ n * f y

items.name: MIDPOINT_CONVEX_IMP_CONTINUOUS_OSTROWSKI
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, convex N s /\ (open N s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f (midpoint N (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2) /\ (t c= s /\ (lebesgue_measurable N t /\ (~ negligible N t /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> f x <= B)))))) -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s

items.name: MIDPOINT_CONVEX_IMP_CONVEX_OSTROWSKI
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, convex N s /\ (open N s /\ (t c= s /\ (lebesgue_measurable N t /\ (~ negligible N t /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s -> f (midpoint N (x,y)) <= (f x + f y) :/: 2) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> f x <= B)))))) -> convex_on N f s

items.name: MIDPOINT_CONVEX_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s \/ closed N s -> (convex N s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e s -> midpoint N (a,b) :e s)

items.name: MIDPOINT_EQ_ENDPOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, (midpoint A (a,b) = a <-> a = b) /\ ((midpoint A (a,b) = b <-> a = b) /\ ((a = midpoint A (a,b) <-> a = b) /\ (b = midpoint A (a,b) <-> a = b)))

items.name: MIDPOINT_IN_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s) -> midpoint N (x,y) :e s

items.name: MIDPOINT_IN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, midpoint N (a,b) :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, midpoint N (a,b) :e open_segment N (a,b) <-> ~ a = b

items.name: MIDPOINT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx B, linear B A f -> midpoint A (f a,f b) = f (midpoint B (a,b))

items.name: MIDPOINT_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, midpoint A (x,x) = x

items.name: MIDPOINT_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, midpoint A (a,b) = midpoint A (b,a)

items.name: MIN
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (if m <= n then m else n) = if m <= n then m else n

items.name: MINIMAL
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists n :e omega, P n) <-> P (choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m)) /\ forall m :e omega, m < choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) -> ~ P m

items.name: MINIMAL_BAD_SEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall bad:set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) /\ ((forall x :e A :^: omega, ~ bad x -> exists n :e omega, forall y :e A :^: omega, (forall k :e omega, k < n -> y k = x k) -> ~ bad y) /\ (exists x :e A :^: omega, bad x)) -> exists y :e A :^: omega, bad y /\ forall z :e A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, bad z /\ (forall k :e omega, k < n -> z k = y k) -> ~ lt (z n) (y n)

items.name: MINIMAL_CONTINUUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t s c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (compact N s /\ connected N s) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, t c= u /\ (u c= s /\ (compact N u /\ (connected N u /\ forall v c= R :^: idx N, v c= u /\ (t c= v /\ (compact N v /\ connected N v)) -> v = u)))

items.name: MINIMAL_IN_INSERT
items.statement: forall s c= omega, forall i :e omega, (forall j :e omega, j :e s -> i < j) -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => n :e SetAdjoin s i /\ forall m :e omega, m :e SetAdjoin s i -> n <= m) = i

items.name: MINIMAL_LBOUND
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, (exists r :e omega, P r) /\ (forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m) -> n <= choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m)

items.name: MINIMAL_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, (exists r :e omega, P r) -> (choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) <= n <-> exists i :e omega, i <= n /\ P i)

items.name: MINIMAL_MONO
