items.statement: forall P Q:set -> prop, (exists n :e omega, P n) /\ (forall n :e omega, P n -> Q n) -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => Q n /\ forall m :e omega, Q m -> n <= m) <= choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m)

items.name: MINIMAL_SEPARATING_COMMON_COMPONENT_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ t <> s /\ (~ s = R :^: idx N /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> frontier N c = s)) -> connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t)

items.name: MINIMAL_SEPARATING_COMMON_COMPONENT_FRONTIER_ELEMENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx N, c1 :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ (c2 :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ (a :e c1 /\ (b :e c2 /\ (frontier N c1 = s /\ (frontier N c2 = s /\ (t c= s /\ t <> s)))))) -> connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t) a b

items.name: MINIMAL_TOPOLOGY_BASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= A, P s -> s :e top) /\ (forall s t c= A, P s /\ P t -> P (s :/\: t)) -> forall s c= A, s :e {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x} -> s :e top

items.name: MINIMAL_TOPOLOGY_SUBBASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= A, P s -> s :e top) /\ u :e top -> forall s c= A, s :e {x :e Power A | exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A {x01 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} u) /\ Union u0 = x} -> s :e top

items.name: MINIMAL_UBOUND
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P n -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) <= n

items.name: MINIMAL_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P n /\ (forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m) -> choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) = n

items.name: MK_REC_INJ
items.error: internal constant ZRECSPACE (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: MOD_0
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat 0 n = 0

items.name: MOD_1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat n 1 = 0

items.name: MOD_2_CASES
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat n 2 = if even_nat n then 0 else 1

items.name: MOD_ADD_CASES
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m < p /\ n < p -> mod_nat (m + n) p = if m + n < p then m + n else minus_nat (m + n) p

items.name: MOD_ADD_EQ
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n -> mod_nat (x + y) n = mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n

items.name: MOD_ADD_EQ_EQ
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, mod_nat (x + y) n = mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n <-> n = 0 \/ mod_nat x n + mod_nat y n < n

items.name: MOD_ADD_MOD
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat a n + mod_nat b n) n = mod_nat (a + b) n

items.name: MOD_CASES
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, n < 2 * p -> mod_nat n p = if n < p then n else minus_nat n p

items.name: MOD_DIV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> div_nat (mod_nat m n) n = 0

items.name: MOD_EQ
items.statement: forall m n p q :e omega, m = n + q * p -> mod_nat m p = mod_nat n p

items.name: MOD_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n = 0 <-> exists q :e omega, m = q * n

items.name: MOD_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n = m <-> n = 0 \/ m < n

items.name: MOD_EVEN_2
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat n -> mod_nat (mod_nat m n) 2 = mod_nat m 2

items.name: MOD_EXISTS
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, (exists q :e omega, m = n * q) <-> (n = 0 -> m = 0) /\ (~ n = 0 -> mod_nat m n = 0)

items.name: MOD_EXP
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ m = 0 -> mod_nat (m ^ n) (m ^ p) = if p <= n \/ m = 1 then 0 else m ^ n

items.name: MOD_EXP_MOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n ^ p) n = mod_nat (m ^ p) n

items.name: MOD_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n <= m

items.name: MOD_LE_TWICE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, 0 < m /\ m <= n -> 2 * mod_nat n m <= n

items.name: MOD_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m < n -> mod_nat m n = m

items.name: MOD_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n < n <-> ~ n = 0

items.name: MOD_LT_EQ_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat m n < n <-> 0 < n

items.name: MOD_MOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m (n * p)) n = mod_nat m n

items.name: MOD_MOD_EXP_MIN
items.statement: forall x p m n :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat x (p ^ m)) (p ^ n) = mod_nat x (p ^ if m <= n then m else n)

items.name: MOD_MOD_LE
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ n <= p -> mod_nat (mod_nat m n) p = mod_nat m n

items.name: MOD_MOD_REFL
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n) n = mod_nat m n

items.name: MOD_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, mod_nat (m * n) m = 0

items.name: MOD_MULT2
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (m * n) (m * p) = m * mod_nat n p

items.name: MOD_MULT_ADD
items.statement: (forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (m * n + p) n = mod_nat p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (n * m + p) n = mod_nat p n) /\ ((forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (p + m * n) n = mod_nat p n) /\ forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (p + n * m) n = mod_nat p n))

items.name: MOD_MULT_LMOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n * p) n = mod_nat (m * p) n

items.name: MOD_MULT_MOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat m (n * p) = n * mod_nat (div_nat m n) p + mod_nat m n

items.name: MOD_MULT_MOD2
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (mod_nat m n * mod_nat p n) n = mod_nat (m * p) n

items.name: MOD_MULT_RMOD
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, mod_nat (m * mod_nat p n) n = mod_nat (m * p) n

items.name: MOD_NSUM_MOD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> mod_nat (finsum s f) n = mod_nat (finsum s (fun i:set => mod_nat (f i) n)) n

items.name: MOD_NSUM_MOD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall a b n :e omega, mod_nat (finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} f) n = mod_nat (finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => mod_nat (f i) n)) n

items.name: MOD_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat n n = 0

items.name: MOD_SUBSET_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c1 c2 d1 d2 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), mod_subset A (p,top) c1 c2 /\ mod_subset A (p,top) d1 d2 -> mod_subset A (p,top) (frag_add (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c1 d1) (frag_add (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c2 d2)

items.name: MOD_SUBSET_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e int, forall c1 c2 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), mod_subset A (p,top) c1 c2 -> mod_subset A (p,top) (frag_cmul (A :^: (R :^: omega)) a c1) (frag_cmul (A :^: (R :^: omega)) a c2)

items.name: MOD_SUBSET_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c1 c2 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), mod_subset A (p,subtopology A top Empty) c1 c2 <-> c1 = c2

items.name: MOD_SUBSET_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), mod_subset A (p,top) c c

items.name: MOD_UNIQ
items.statement: forall m n q r :e omega, m = q * n + r /\ r < n -> mod_nat m n = r

items.name: MOD_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e omega, mod_nat n 0 = n

items.name: MONOIDAL_AC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> (forall a :e A, op (neutral_of A op) a = a) /\ ((forall a :e A, op a (neutral_of A op) = a) /\ ((forall a b :e A, op a b = op b a) /\ ((forall a b c :e A, op (op a b) c = op a (op b c)) /\ forall a b c :e A, op a (op b c) = op b (op a c))))

items.name: MONOIDAL_ADD
items.statement: (forall x y :e omega, x + y = y + x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, x + y + z = (x + y) + z) /\ forall x :e omega, neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) + x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_FRAG_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall x y :e frag A, frag_add A x y = frag_add A y x) /\ (forall x y z :e frag A, frag_add A x (frag_add A y z) = frag_add A (frag_add A x y) z) /\ forall x :e frag A, frag_add A (neutral_of (frag A) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add A a b)) x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_GCD
items.statement: (forall x y :e omega, gcd_int x y = gcd_int y x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, gcd_int x (gcd_int y z) = gcd_int (gcd_int x y) z) /\ forall x :e omega, gcd_int (neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b)) x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_GROUP_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, (forall x y :e A, group_add A G x y = group_add A G y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, group_add A G x (group_add A G y z) = group_add A G (group_add A G x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, group_add A G (neutral_of A (fun a:set => fun b:set => group_add A G a b)) x = x) <-> abelian_group_hl A G

items.name: MONOIDAL_INT_ADD
items.statement: (forall x y :e int, x + y = y + x) /\ (forall x y z :e int, x + y + z = (x + y) + z) /\ forall x :e int, neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) + x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_INT_MUL
items.statement: (forall x y :e int, x * y = y * x) /\ (forall x y z :e int, x * y * z = (x * y) * z) /\ forall x :e int, neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) * x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_LCM
items.statement: (forall x y :e omega, lcm_int x y = lcm_int y x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, lcm_int x (lcm_int y z) = lcm_int (lcm_int x y) z) /\ forall x :e omega, lcm_int (neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b)) x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_LIFTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op :e A :^: A :^: A, (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A (fun a:set => fun b:set => op a b)) x = x) -> (forall x y :e 1 :+: A, lifted A A op x y = lifted A A op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e 1 :+: A, lifted A A op x (lifted A A op y z) = lifted A A op (lifted A A op x y) z) /\ forall x :e 1 :+: A, lifted A A op (neutral_of (1 :+: A) (fun a:set => fun b:set => lifted A A op a b)) x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_MUL
items.statement: (forall x y :e omega, x * y = y * x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, x * y * z = (x * y) * z) /\ forall x :e omega, neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) * x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_REAL_ADD
items.statement: (forall x y :e R, x + y = y + x) /\ (forall x y z :e R, x + y + z = (x + y) + z) /\ forall x :e R, neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) + x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_REAL_MUL
items.statement: (forall x y :e R, x * y = y * x) /\ (forall x y z :e R, x * y * z = (x * y) * z) /\ forall x :e R, neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) * x = x

items.name: MONOIDAL_VECTOR_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N x y = vector_add N y x) /\ (forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N x (vector_add N y z) = vector_add N (vector_add N x y) z) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N (neutral_of (R :^: idx N) (fun a:set => fun b:set => vector_add N a b)) x = x

items.name: MONOTONE_BIGGER
items.statement: forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) -> (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) -> forall n :e omega, n <= r n

items.name: MONOTONE_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> (monotone_map A B (top,top') f <-> forall c c= B, connected_in B top' c -> connected_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e c})

items.name: MONOTONE_CONNECTED_PREIMAGES_IMP_PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ (locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c c= t /\ connected N c -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e c}))))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: MONOTONE_CONNECTED_PREIMAGES_IMP_PROPER_MAP_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ (locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} t /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ compact M c -> compact N {f x | x :e c}) /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx N, c c= t /\ connected N c -> connected M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e c}))))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_DECREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> drop (f (ordsucc k) x) <= drop (f k x)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega})) -> integrable_on 1 N g s /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => integral 1 N s (f k)) (integral 1 N s g) sequentially

items.name: MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_DECREASING_AE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ (negligible N t /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: t -> drop (f (ordsucc k) x) <= drop (f k x)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: t -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega}))) -> integrable_on 1 N g s /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => integral 1 N s (f k)) (integral 1 N s g) sequentially

items.name: MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_INCREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> drop (f k x) <= drop (f (ordsucc k) x)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega})) -> integrable_on 1 N g s /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => integral 1 N s (f k)) (integral 1 N s g) sequentially

items.name: MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_INCREASING_AE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) s) /\ (negligible N t /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: t -> drop (f k x) <= drop (f (ordsucc k) x)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s :\: t -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N s (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega}))) -> integrable_on 1 N g s /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => integral 1 N s (f k)) (integral 1 N s g) sequentially

items.name: MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (forall k :e omega, integrable_on 1 N (f k) (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ ((forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> drop (f k x) <= drop (f (ordsucc k) x)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => f k x) (g x) sequentially) /\ bounded_hl 1 {integral 1 N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (f k) | k :e omega, k :e omega})) -> integrable_on 1 N g (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun k:set => integral 1 N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (f k)) (integral 1 N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) g) sequentially

items.name: MONOTONE_IMP_HOMEOMORPHISM_1D
items.statement: forall f :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx 1), forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (is_interval 1 t /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x < drop y) -> drop (f x) < drop (f y)) \/ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x < drop y) -> drop (f x) < drop (f y))))) -> exists g :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx 1), homeomorphism 1 1 (s,t) (f,g)

items.name: MONOTONE_INTO_1D_IMP_PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx 1, connected N s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (continuous_on_hl N 1 f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx 1, compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx 1, connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}))))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx 1, k c= t /\ compact 1 k -> compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: MONOTONE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (monotone_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall y :e B, connected_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y})

items.name: MONOTONE_MAP_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R, is_realinterval s /\ continuous_map R R (subtopology R euclideanreal s,euclideanreal) f -> (monotone_map R R (subtopology R euclideanreal s,euclideanreal) f <-> (forall x y :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ x <= y) -> f x <= f y) \/ forall x y :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ x <= y) -> f y <= f x)

items.name: MONOTONE_MAP_EUCLIDEANREAL_ALT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R, (forall c c= R, is_realinterval c -> is_realinterval {x :e R | x :e s /\ f x :e c}) <-> is_realinterval s /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ x <= y) -> f x <= f y) \/ forall x y :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ x <= y) -> f y <= f x)

items.name: MONOTONE_MAP_FROM_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> monotone_map A B (top,top') f /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ (x :e s /\ f x = f y)) -> y :e s) -> monotone_map A B (subtopology A top s,top') f

items.name: MONOTONE_MAP_INTO_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> connected_space A top /\ continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f -> (monotone_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f <-> forall k c= R, is_realinterval k -> connected_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k})

items.name: MONOTONE_MAP_INTO_EUCLIDEANREAL_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f -> ((forall k c= R, is_realinterval k -> connected_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k}) <-> connected_space A top /\ monotone_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f)

items.name: MONOTONE_MAP_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (monotone_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f <-> monotone_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= s)

items.name: MONOTONE_MAP_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, forall v c= B, monotone_map A B (top,top') f /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e v} = u -> monotone_map A B (subtopology A top u,subtopology B top' v) f

items.name: MONOTONE_OPEN_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (open_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> (monotone_map A B (top,top') f <-> forall c c= B, connected_in B top' c -> connected_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e c})

items.name: MONOTONE_SUBSEQUENCE
items.statement: forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s (r m) <= s (r n)) \/ forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> s (r n) <= s (r m)))

items.name: MONOTONE_TOPOLOGICALLY
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) \/ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) <-> forall c c= R :^: idx 1, connected 1 c -> connected 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ f x :e c})

items.name: MONOTONE_TOPOLOGICALLY_EQ
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall c c= R :^: idx 1, connected 1 c -> connected 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ f x :e c}) <-> is_interval 1 s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) \/ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x))

items.name: MONOTONE_TOPOLOGICALLY_IMP
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall c c= R :^: idx 1, connected 1 c -> connected 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ f x :e c}) -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) \/ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)

items.name: MONOTONE_TOPOLOGICALLY_INTO_1D
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (continuous_on_hl N 1 f s /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx 1, connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y})) -> forall k c= R :^: idx 1, connected 1 k -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: MONOTONE_TOPOLOGICALLY_INTO_1D_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 f s -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx 1, connected 1 k -> connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) <-> connected N s /\ forall y :e R :^: idx 1, connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y})

items.name: MONOTONE_TOPOLOGICALLY_POINTS
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ continuous_on_hl 1 1 f s -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) \/ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) <-> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, connected 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ f x = a})

items.name: MONOTONE_TOPOLOGICALLY_POINTS_IMP
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, continuous_on_hl 1 1 f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx 1, connected 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ f x = y})) -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) \/ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)

items.name: MONO_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x :e A, P x -> Q x) -> seq_all P l -> seq_all Q l

items.name: MONO_ALL2
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, forall l' :e finseq B, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y -> Q x y) -> seq_all2 P l l' -> seq_all2 Q l l'

items.name: MONO_AND
items.statement: forall A B C D:prop, (A -> B) /\ (C -> D) -> A /\ C -> B /\ D

items.name: MONO_COND
items.statement: forall A B C D b:prop, (A -> B) /\ (C -> D) -> (b -> A) /\ (~ b -> C) -> (b -> B) /\ (~ b -> D)

items.name: MONO_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> Q x) -> (exists x :e A, P x) -> exists x :e A, Q x

items.name: MONO_FORALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P x -> Q x) -> (forall x :e A, P x) -> forall x :e A, Q x

items.name: MONO_IMP
items.statement: forall B A C D:prop, (B -> A) /\ (C -> D) -> (A -> C) -> B -> D

items.name: MONO_NOT
items.statement: forall B A:prop, (B -> A) -> ~ A -> ~ B

items.name: MONO_OR
items.statement: forall A B C D:prop, (A -> B) /\ (C -> D) -> A \/ C -> B \/ D

items.name: MOORE_PENROSE_PSEUDOINVERSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx N, (forall w :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A w = vec N 0 -> orthogonal M (matrix_vector_mul M N (matrix_inv M N A) y) w) /\ forall z :e R :^: idx M, orthogonal N (vector_sub N y (matrix_vector_mul N M A (matrix_vector_mul M N (matrix_inv M N A) y))) (matrix_vector_mul N M A z)

items.name: MOORE_PENROSE_PSEUDOINVERSE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, (forall w :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A w = vec N 0 -> orthogonal M x w) /\ (forall z :e R :^: idx M, orthogonal N (vector_sub N y (matrix_vector_mul N M A x)) (matrix_vector_mul N M A z)) -> matrix_vector_mul M N (matrix_inv M N A) y = x

items.name: MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall d :e R :^: (A :*: A), is_metric_space A (s,d) -> mspace A (s,d) = s

items.name: MTOPOLOGY_BASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mtopology A m = {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e \/_ x01 :e A, {mball A m (x01,r) | r :e R, x01 :e mspace A m /\ 0 < r}) /\ Union u = x}

items.name: MTOPOLOGY_CAPPED_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e R, forall m :e metric A, mtopology A (capped_metric A d m) = mtopology A m

items.name: MTOPOLOGY_DISCRETE_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, mtopology A (discrete_metric A s) = discrete_topology A s

items.name: MTOPOLOGY_EUCLIDEAN_METRIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> mtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) = euclidean N

items.name: MTOPOLOGY_PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, mtopology (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) = prod_topology A B (mtopology A m1) (mtopology B m2)

items.name: MTOPOLOGY_REAL_EUCLIDEAN_METRIC
items.statement: mtopology R real_euclidean_metric = euclideanreal

items.name: MTOPOLOGY_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mtopology A (submetric A m s) = subtopology A (mtopology A m) s

items.name: MTOPOLOGY_SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, mtopology (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) = subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: MULT
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, 0 * n = 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m * n = m * n + n

items.name: MULTIPART_MEASURES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, measurable N s /\ ~ n = 0 -> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (finite_cardinality f <= n /\ ((forall x y :e f, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ (Union f = s /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> t c= s /\ (measurable N t /\ measure N t = measure N s :/: n))))

items.name: MULTIPLES_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m = n <-> forall d :e omega, divides_nat m d <-> divides_nat n d

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_ADD_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> multivector_index N (vector_add (multivector N) x y) s = multivector_index N x s + multivector_index N y s

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_BETA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power omega, g x :e R) -> forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> multivector_index N (lambdas N g) s = g s

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), x = y <-> forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> multivector_index N x s = multivector_index N y s

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_ETA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx (multivector A), lambdas A (fun s:set => multivector_index A m s) = m

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_GRADE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), multivector_hl A k (grade A k x)

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> multivector N = {s :e Power omega | s c= idx N}

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_MUL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector N), forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> multivector_index N (vector_mul (multivector N) c x) s = c * multivector_index N x s

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx (multivector N), forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power omega, g x :e R) -> (forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> multivector_index N m s = g s) -> lambdas N g = m

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_VEC_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> multivector_index N (vec (multivector N) k) s = k

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx (multivector A)) -> vsum B (multivector A) t f = lambdas A (fun s:set => finsum t (fun x:set => multivector_index A (f x) s))

items.name: MULTIVECTOR_VSUM_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx (multivector N)) -> forall t c= A, forall s c= omega, s c= idx N -> multivector_index N (vsum A (multivector N) t f) s = finsum t (fun x:set => multivector_index N (f x) s)

items.name: MULT_0
items.statement: forall m :e omega, m * 0 = 0

items.name: MULT_2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 * n = n + n

items.name: MULT_AC
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * n = n * m /\ ((m * n) * p = m * n * p /\ m * n * p = n * m * p)

items.name: MULT_ASSOC
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * n * p = (m * n) * p

items.name: MULT_CLAUSES
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, 0 * n = 0) /\ ((forall m :e omega, m * 0 = 0) /\ ((forall n :e omega, 1 * n = n) /\ ((forall m :e omega, m * 1 = m) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m * n = m * n + n) /\ forall m n :e omega, m * ordsucc n = m + m * n))))

items.name: MULT_DIV
items.statement: (forall m n p :e omega, divides_nat p m -> div_nat (m * n) p = div_nat m p * n) /\ forall m n p :e omega, divides_nat p n -> div_nat (m * n) p = m * div_nat n p

items.name: MULT_DIV_LE
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m * div_nat n p <= div_nat (m * n) p

items.name: MULT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m * n = 0 <-> m = 0 \/ n = 0

items.name: MULT_EQ_1
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m * n = 1 <-> m = 1 /\ n = 1

items.name: MULT_EXP
items.statement: forall p m n :e omega, (m * n) ^ p = m ^ p * n ^ p

items.name: MULT_GCD_LCM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, gcd_int m n * lcm_int m n = m * n

items.name: MULT_LCM_GCD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, lcm_int m n * gcd_int m n = m * n

items.name: MULT_SUC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m * ordsucc n = m + m * n

items.name: MULT_SYM
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m * n = n * m

items.name: MUL_C_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, A :*: B = A :*: B

items.name: MUMFORD_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | compact M x} s /\ (y :e t /\ compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y}))) -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, exists v c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} c= u /\ (y :e v /\ ({f x | x :e u} c= v /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= v /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e u /\ f x :e k}))))

items.name: MVT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, f' x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a < drop b /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) -> has_derivative 1 1 f (f' x) (at 1 x))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) /\ vector_sub 1 (f b) (f a) = f' x (vector_sub 1 b a)

items.name: MVT_GENERAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a < drop b /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) -> has_derivative N 1 f (f' x) (at 1 x))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f b) (f a)) <= vector_norm N (f' x (vector_sub 1 b a))

items.name: MVT_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b /\ (continuous_on_hl N 1 f (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e open_segment N (a,b) -> has_derivative 1 N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) (open_segment N (a,b))))) -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, c :e open_segment N (a,b) /\ vector_sub 1 (f b) (f a) = f' c (vector_sub N b a)

items.name: MVT_SEGMENT_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f' x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_derivative 1 N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) (open_segment N (a,b)))) -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, c :e open_segment N (a,b) /\ vector_sub 1 (f b) (f a) = f' c (vector_sub N b a)

items.name: MVT_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, f' x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a < drop b /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_derivative 1 1 f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) /\ vector_sub 1 (f b) (f a) = f' x (vector_sub 1 b a)

items.name: MVT_VERY_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, f' x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> has_derivative 1 1 f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ vector_sub 1 (f b) (f a) = f' x (vector_sub 1 b a)

items.name: NATURALITY_HOM_INDUCED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall t c= B, forall f :e B :^: A, continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> forall x c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall x0 :e frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)), hom_boundary B p (top',t) (hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',t) f x) x0 <-> hom_induced A B (p + - 1) (subtopology A top s,Empty) (subtopology B top' t,Empty) f (hom_boundary A p (top,s) x) x0

items.name: NATURALITY_HOM_INDUCED_RELBOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall top' :e topology B, forall u v c= B, forall f :e B :^: A, continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= u /\ {f x | x :e t} c= v) -> forall x c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall x0 :e frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)), {x2 :e frag (B :^: (R :^: omega)) | hom_relboundary B p (top',(u,v)) (hom_induced A B p (top,s) (top',u) f x) x2} x0 <-> hom_induced A B (p + - 1) (subtopology A top s,t) (subtopology B top' u,v) f {x2 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | hom_relboundary A p (top,(s,t)) x x2} x0

items.name: NATURALITY_SIMPLICIAL_SUBDIVISION
items.statement: forall p q :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall g :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), forall c :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_chain (p,standard_simplex q) c /\ simplicial_simplex (q,s) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => g x x0) -> simplicial_subdivision p (chain_map (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) p (fun x:set => g x) c) = chain_map (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) p (fun x:set => g x) (simplicial_subdivision p c)

items.name: NATURALITY_SINGULAR_SUBDIVISION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall s :e topology A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,s) c -> singular_subdivision B p (chain_map A B p g c) = chain_map A B p g (singular_subdivision A p c)

items.name: NEARBY_INVERTIBLE_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x :e R, ~ x = 0 /\ abs_SNo x < e0 -> invertible N N (matrix_add N N A (matrix_cmul N N x (mat N N 1)))

items.name: NEARBY_INVERTIBLE_MATRIX_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N B -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x :e R, ~ x = 0 /\ abs_SNo x < e0 -> invertible N N (matrix_add N N A (matrix_cmul N N x B))

items.name: NEARBY_POSITIVE_DEFINITE_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall x :e R, positive_semidefinite N A /\ 0 < x -> positive_definite N (matrix_add N N A (matrix_cmul N N x (mat N N 1)))

items.name: NEARBY_POSITIVE_DEFINITE_MATRIX_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall x :e R, positive_semidefinite N A /\ (positive_definite N B /\ 0 < x) -> positive_definite N (matrix_add N N A (matrix_cmul N N x B))

items.name: NEGATIONS_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, {vector_neg N x | x :e ball N (vec N 0,r)} = ball N (vec N 0,r)

items.name: NEGATIONS_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, {vector_neg N x | x :e cball N (vec N 0,r)} = cball N (vec N 0,r)

items.name: NEGATIONS_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, {vector_neg N x | x :e sphere N (vec N 0,r)} = sphere N (vec N 0,r)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, has_integral N 1 (fun x:set => indicator N s x) (vec 1 0) t

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ (negligible 1 t /\ t c= s)) -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_ABSOLUTELY_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (absolutely_continuous_on N f s /\ is_interval 1 s) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N -> negligible N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_AFFINE_HULL_1
items.statement: forall a :e R :^: idx 1, negligible 1 (hull (R :^: idx 1) {x :e Power (R :^: idx 1) | affine 1 x} {a})

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_AFFINE_HULL_2
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, negligible (idx_n 2) (hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | affine (idx_n 2) x} {a,b})

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_AFFINE_HULL_3
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx_n 3, negligible (idx_n 3) (hull (R :^: idx_n 3) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 3) | affine (idx_n 3) x} {a,b,c})

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, negligible N s -> negligible N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, negligible N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ negligible N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_BOUNDED_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N t /\ t c= s -> negligible N t

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_CONVEX_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> negligible N (frontier N s)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N -> negligible N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_CONVEX_HULL_1
items.statement: forall a :e R :^: idx 1, negligible 1 (hull (R :^: idx 1) {x :e Power (R :^: idx 1) | convex 1 x} {a})

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_CONVEX_HULL_2
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx_n 2, negligible (idx_n 2) (hull (R :^: idx_n 2) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 2) | convex (idx_n 2) x} {a,b})

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_CONVEX_HULL_3
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx_n 3, negligible (idx_n 3) (hull (R :^: idx_n 3) {x :e Power (R :^: idx_n 3) | convex (idx_n 3) x} {a,b,c})

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_CONVEX_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (negligible N s <-> interior N s = Empty)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, countable s -> negligible N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, negligible N (s n)) -> negligible N (Union {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega})

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> negligible N s) -> negligible N (Union f)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, negligible N (s :\: {a}) <-> negligible N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s -> negligible N (s :\: t)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M < dimindex N /\ differentiable_on_hl N M f s -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_DIFFERENTIABLE_IMAGE_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (negligible M s /\ differentiable_on_hl N M f s) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_DIFFERENTIABLE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f' x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, dimindex M = dimindex N /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> has_derivative N M f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ rank M N (matrix M N (f' x)) = dimindex N) /\ negligible N t) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_DISJOINT_TRANSLATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s k c= R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ (limit_point_of N z k /\ (forall x y :e k, x <> y -> {vector_add N x x0 | x0 :e s} :/\: {vector_add N y x0 | x0 :e s} = Empty)) -> negligible N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> negligible A Empty

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_EMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s -> interior N s = Empty

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_EQ_MEASURE_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> measurable N s /\ measure N s = 0

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_EQ_ZERO_DENSITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall r e0 :e R, x :e s /\ (0 < e0 /\ 0 < r) -> exists d :e R, exists u c= R :^: idx N, 0 < d /\ (d <= r /\ (s :/\: ball N (x,d) c= u /\ (measurable N u /\ measure N u < e0 * measure N (ball N (x,d)))))

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_EQ_ZERO_DENSITY_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, x :e s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, exists u c= R :^: idx N, 0 < d /\ (d <= e0 /\ (s :/\: ball N (x,d) c= u /\ (measurable N u /\ measure N u < e0 * measure N (ball N (x,d)))))

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s -> negligible A s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_FRONTIER_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, negligible N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: open_interval N (a,b))

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, ~ (a = vec N 0 /\ b = 0) -> negligible N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_IFF_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s -> lebesgue_measurable N t

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_IFF_MEASURABLE_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s -> measurable N t

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_IMAGE_BOUNDED_VARIATION_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ is_interval 1 s) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_IMAGE_INDEFINITE_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, integrable_on 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ s c= closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> negligible 1 {integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f | c :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_IMP_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s -> lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_IMP_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s -> measurable N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_INFINITE_PREIMAGES_DIFFERENTIABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ differentiable_on_hl N N f s -> negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | infinite {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_INFINITE_PREIMAGES_MOSTLY_DIFFERENTIABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ (compact N s /\ negligible N {f x | x :e {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable N N f (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)}}) -> negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | infinite {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_INFINITE_PREIMAGES_MOSTLY_DIFFERENTIABLE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall y :e R :^: idx N, compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}) /\ negligible N {f x | x :e {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable N N f (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s)}} -> negligible N {y :e R :^: idx N | infinite {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ f x = y}}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N (SetAdjoin s a) <-> negligible N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, negligible A s \/ negligible A t -> negligible A (s :/\: t)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, negligible A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> open_interval A (a,b) = Empty) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx B, negligible B (open_interval B (a,b)) <-> open_interval B (a,b) = Empty

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ negligible N s -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (negligible N {f x | x :e s} <-> negligible N s)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_LINEAR_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (negligible M s /\ dimindex M <= dimindex N) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_LINEAR_SINGULAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ ~ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall B :e R, negligible N s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M <= dimindex N /\ (negligible M s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, exists b :e R, open M t /\ (x :e t /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s :/\: t -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)) <= b * vector_norm M (vector_sub M y x)))) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_LOCALLY_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, dimindex M < dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, exists b :e R, open M t /\ (x :e t /\ forall y :e R :^: idx M, y :e s :/\: t -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)) <= b * vector_norm M (vector_sub M y x))) -> negligible N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s < dimindex N -> negligible N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_MEASURABLE_FUNCTION_GRAPH
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> measurable_on M N f (R :^: idx M) -> negligible (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e R :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, f x = y})

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_ON_COUNTABLE_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall n :e omega, negligible N (s :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (vector_neg N (vec N n),vec N n) seq_nil))

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_ON_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, negligible N (s :/\: closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_ON_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> has_integral N 1 (fun x:set => indicator N s x) (vec 1 0) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_OUTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (measurable N t /\ measure N t < e0)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_OUTER_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (measurable N t /\ measure N t <= e0)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, negligible (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> negligible M s \/ negligible N t

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_POINTS_OF_AMBIGUOUS_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ exists y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, y x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists z:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, z x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (has_derivative N M f y (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ (has_derivative N M f z (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) /\ ~ forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, y x0 = z x0))}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_RECTIFIABLE_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> 2 <= dimindex N /\ rectifiable_path N g -> negligible N (path_image N g)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, negligible N s -> negligible N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, negligible N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ negligible N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, negligible N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> 2 <= dimindex N \/ a = b) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, negligible N (open_segment N (a,b)) <-> 2 <= dimindex N \/ a = b

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, negligible N {a}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, negligible N (sphere N (a,r))

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_STANDARD_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall k :e omega, negligible N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = c}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s /\ t c= s -> negligible N t

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_SYMDIFF_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> (negligible N s <-> negligible N t)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, negligible N s -> negligible N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, negligible N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> negligible N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_TRANSLATION_REV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, negligible N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} -> negligible N s

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N s /\ negligible N t -> negligible N (s :\/: t)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx A), finite s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx A, t :e s -> negligible A t) -> negligible A (Union s)

items.name: NEGLIGIBLE_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N (s :\/: t) <-> negligible N s /\ negligible N t

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_AT_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall u c= A, forall x :e A, neighbourhood_base_at A x P (discrete_topology A u) <-> x :e u -> {x} :e P

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_AT_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall P Q c= Power A, forall x :e A, (forall s c= A, s :e P /\ x :e s -> s :e Q) /\ neighbourhood_base_at A x P top -> neighbourhood_base_at A x Q top

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_AT_TOPOLOGY_BASE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall top :e topology A, forall b c= Power A, forall x :e A, (forall x0 c= A, x0 :e top <-> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e b) /\ Union u = x0) -> (neighbourhood_base_at A x P top <-> forall w c= A, w :e b /\ x :e w -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e P /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ v c= w))))

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_AT_UNLOCALIZED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall P c= Power A, forall x :e A, (forall s t c= A, s :e P /\ (t :e top /\ (x :e t /\ t c= s)) -> t :e P) -> (neighbourhood_base_at A x P top <-> x :e topspace A top -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e P /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ v c= topspace A top))))

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_AT_WITH_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, forall x :e A, u :e top /\ x :e u -> (neighbourhood_base_at A x P top <-> neighbourhood_base_at A x {t :e Power A | t c= u /\ t :e P} top)

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_IMP_LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, neighbourhood_base_of A {x :e Power A | compact_in A top x} top -> locally_compact_space A top

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall P c= Power A, neighbourhood_base_of A P top <-> forall w c= A, forall x :e A, w :e top /\ x :e w -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e P /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ v c= w)))

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_CLOSED_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {c :e Power A | closed_in A top c /\ hausdorff_space A (subtopology A top c)} top

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, neighbourhood_base_of A {x :e Power A | closed_in A top x} top <-> regular_space A top

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u c= A, neighbourhood_base_of A P (discrete_topology A u) <-> forall x :e A, x :e u -> {x} :e P

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, neighbourhood_base_of (R :^: idx N) P (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> locally N P s

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall P Q c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e P -> s :e Q) /\ neighbourhood_base_of A P top -> neighbourhood_base_of A Q top

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_OPEN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, neighbourhood_base_of A P top /\ s :e top -> neighbourhood_base_of A P (subtopology A top s)

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_TOPOLOGY_BASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall top :e topology A, forall b c= Power A, (forall x c= A, x :e top <-> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e b) /\ Union u = x) -> (neighbourhood_base_of A P top <-> forall w c= A, forall x :e A, w :e b /\ x :e w -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e P /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ v c= w))))

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_UNLOCALIZED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall P c= Power A, (forall s t c= A, s :e P /\ (t :e top /\ (~ t = Empty /\ t c= s)) -> t :e P) -> (neighbourhood_base_of A P top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e P /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ v c= topspace A top))))

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF_WITH_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall top :e topology A, neighbourhood_base_of A P top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {t :e Power A | t c= topspace A top /\ t :e P} top

items.name: NEIGHBOURHOOD_EXTENSION_INTO_ANR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (ANR N t /\ closed M s)) -> exists v c= R :^: idx M, exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (s c= v /\ (open M v /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g v /\ ({g x | x :e v} c= t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x))))

items.name: NESTED_COMPACT_APPROX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s :e Power A :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (s n)) /\ (forall n :e omega, s (ordsucc n) c= s n) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall x :e A, x :e s N -> exists y :e A, y :e {x :e A | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} /\ mdist A m (x,y) < e0

items.name: NET
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall n :e net C, forall s :e A, forall t :e B, forall s0 t0 c= C, s0 :e netfilter C n /\ t0 :e netfilter C n -> s0 :/\: t0 :e netfilter C n

items.name: NETLIMITS_ATPOINTOF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, netlimits A (atpointof A top a) = {a}

items.name: NETLIMITS_AT_INFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> netlimits (R :^: idx N) (at_infinity N) = Empty

items.name: NETLIMITS_AT_NEGINFINITY
items.statement: netlimits R at_neginfinity = Empty

items.name: NETLIMITS_AT_POSINFINITY
items.statement: netlimits R at_posinfinity = Empty

items.name: NETLIMITS_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: netlimits omega sequentially = Empty

items.name: NETLIMITS_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e net A, forall s c= A, netlimits A (within A n s) = netlimits A n

items.name: NETLIMIT_AT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, netlimit (R :^: idx A) (at A a) = a

items.name: NETLIMIT_ATPOINTOF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, netlimit A (atpointof A top a) = a

items.name: NETLIMIT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, netlimit (R :^: idx N) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s) = a

items.name: NET_WITHIN_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, within A net0 A = net0

items.name: NEUTRAL_ADD
items.statement: neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) = 0

items.name: NEUTRAL_FRAG_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> neutral_of (frag A) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add A a b) = frag_0 A

items.name: NEUTRAL_GCD
items.statement: neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => gcd_int a b) = 0

items.name: NEUTRAL_GROUP_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, neutral_of A (fun a:set => fun b:set => group_add A G a b) = group_id A G

items.name: NEUTRAL_INT_ADD
items.statement: neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) = 0

items.name: NEUTRAL_INT_MUL
items.statement: neutral_of int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) = 1

items.name: NEUTRAL_LCM
items.statement: neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) = 1

items.name: NEUTRAL_LIFTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op :e A :^: A :^: A, (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A (fun a:set => fun b:set => op a b)) x = x) -> neutral_of (1 :+: A) (fun a:set => fun b:set => lifted A A op a b) = Inj1 (neutral_of A (fun a:set => fun b:set => op a b))

items.name: NEUTRAL_MUL
items.statement: neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) = 1

items.name: NEUTRAL_OUTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> neutral_of (R :^: idx (multivector A)) (fun a:set => fun b:set => outer A a b) = mbasis A Empty

items.name: NEUTRAL_REAL_ADD
items.statement: neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) = 0

items.name: NEUTRAL_REAL_MUL
items.statement: neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) = 1

items.name: NEUTRAL_VECTOR_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> neutral_of (R :^: idx N) (fun a:set => fun b:set => vector_add N a b) = vec N 0

items.name: NONDECREASING_EXTENDS_FROM_DENSE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, closure 1 s = R :^: idx 1 /\ (closure 1 {f x | x :e s} = R :^: idx 1 /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, drop x <= drop y -> drop (g x) <= drop (g y)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> g x = f x) /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 1 g (R :^: idx 1) /\ {g x | x :e R :^: idx 1} = R :^: idx 1)))

items.name: NONDECREASING_EXTENDS_TO_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e hull (R :^: idx 1) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx 1) | convex 1 x0} s /\ (y :e hull (R :^: idx 1) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx 1) | convex 1 x0} s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (g x) <= drop (g y)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: NONEMPTY_AFFINE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall a :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= n /\ n <= dimindex N -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (a :e s /\ aff_dim N s = n)

items.name: NONEMPTY_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e connected_components_of A top -> ~ c = Empty

items.name: NONEMPTY_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) = Empty

items.name: NONEMPTY_NSPHERE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ topspace (R :^: omega) (nsphere n) = Empty

items.name: NONEMPTY_PATH_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e path_components_of A top -> ~ c = Empty

items.name: NONEMPTY_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> ~ c = Empty

items.name: NONEMPTY_SIMPLE_PATH_ENDLESS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, c x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N c -> ~ path_image N c :\: {pathstart N c,pathfinish N c} = Empty

items.name: NONEMPTY_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ span N s = Empty

items.name: NONEMPTY_STANDARD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, ~ standard_simplex p = Empty

items.name: NONEMPTY_TOPSPACE_CANTOR_SPACE
items.statement: ~ topspace (Power omega) cantor_space = Empty

items.name: NONNEGATIVE_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, x :e s /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> 0 <= f x i) /\ integrable_on N M f s -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f s

items.name: NONNEGATIVE_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_AE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, x :e s :\: t /\ (1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N) -> 0 <= f x i) /\ integrable_on N M f s) -> absolutely_integrable_on N M f s

items.name: NONNEGATIVE_INTEGER
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int /\ 0 <= x <-> exists n :e omega, x = n

items.name: NONPOSITIVE_INTEGER
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int /\ x <= 0 <-> exists n :e omega, x = - n

items.name: NONPOSITIVE_INTEGER_ALT
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int /\ x <= 0 <-> exists n :e omega, x + n = 0

items.name: NONSEPARATED_CLOSED_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c c= R :^: idx N, (compact N u \/ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} u) /\ (connected N u /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ c :e components N (u :\: s)))) -> ~ s :/\: closure N c = Empty

items.name: NONSEPARATED_CLOSED_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= Power (R :^: idx N), connected N u /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} u /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (c c= components N (u :\: s) /\ ~ c = Empty)))) -> ~ s :/\: closure N (Union c) = Empty

items.name: NONTRIVIAL_LIMIT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall s c= A, trivial_limit A net0 -> trivial_limit A (within A net0 s)

items.name: NONTRIVIAL_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)) = quotient_group (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (relcycle_group A (p,(top,s))) {x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) x}

items.name: NON_CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE_NSPHERE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ contractible_space (R :^: omega) (nsphere n)

items.name: NON_MEASURABLE_SET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, ~ lebesgue_measurable N s

items.name: NON_TRIVIAL_INTEGER_GROUP
items.statement: ~ trivial_group int integer_group

items.name: NON_TRIVIAL_LIMIT_LEFT
items.statement: forall a :e R :^: idx 1, ~ trivial_limit (R :^: idx 1) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x <= drop a})

items.name: NON_TRIVIAL_LIMIT_RIGHT
items.statement: forall a :e R :^: idx 1, ~ trivial_limit (R :^: idx 1) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop a <= drop x})

items.name: NORMAL_BIPOLAR_DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A <-> exists U P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N P /\ (matrix_mul N N N U P = A /\ matrix_mul N N N P U = A))

items.name: NORMAL_HAUSDORFF_SPACE_CLOSED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> normal_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top'))) -> normal_space B top' /\ hausdorff_space B top'

items.name: NORMAL_IMP_COMPLETELY_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) -> completely_regular_space A top

items.name: NORMAL_IMP_COMPLETELY_REGULAR_SPACE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top /\ (t1_space A top \/ (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top)) -> completely_regular_space A top

items.name: NORMAL_LEFT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A U P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N P /\ matrix_mul N N N P U = A) -> (normal_matrix_hl N A <-> matrix_mul N N N P U = matrix_mul N N N U P)

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_IFF_SAME_DOT_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N (matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x) (matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) y) = dot N (matrix_vector_mul N N A x) (matrix_vector_mul N N A y)

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_IFF_SAME_NORM_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N (matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x) = vector_norm N (matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N (matrix_inv N N A) <-> normal_matrix_hl N A

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_KERNEL_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A -> {x :e R :^: idx N | matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x = vec N 0} = {x :e R :^: idx N | matrix_vector_mul N N A x = vec N 0}

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_KERNEL_TRANSP_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A -> (matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x = vec N 0 <-> matrix_vector_mul N N A x = vec N 0)

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_SAME_EIGENPAIRS_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A -> forall c :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) v = vector_mul N c v <-> matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_SAME_EIGENVECTORS_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, (exists c :e R, matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) v = vector_mul N c v) <-> exists c :e R, matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_SIMILAR_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A <-> exists U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ matrix_mul N N N U (transp N N A) = A

items.name: NORMAL_MATRIX_SIMILAR_TRANSP_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A <-> exists U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) U = A

items.name: NORMAL_RIGHT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A U P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N P /\ matrix_mul N N N U P = A) -> (normal_matrix_hl N A <-> matrix_mul N N N P U = matrix_mul N N N U P)

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (s c= u /\ t :/\: closure_of A top u = Empty)

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall s u c= A, closed_in A top s /\ (u :e top /\ s c= u) -> exists v c= A, v :e top /\ (s c= v /\ closure_of A top v c= u)

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_CLOSED_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, normal_space A top /\ closed_in A top s -> normal_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_CLOSURES
