items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ (t c= topspace A top /\ closure_of A top s :/\: closure_of A top t = Empty) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_CONTINUOUS_CLOSED_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ normal_space A top)) -> normal_space B top'

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, normal_space A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_DISJOINT_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ closure_of A top u :/\: closure_of A top v = Empty)))

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_DUAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ u :\/: v = topspace A top) -> exists s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ s :\/: t = topspace A top)))

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_EQ_TIETZE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, closed_in A top s /\ continuous_map A R (subtopology A top s,euclideanreal) f -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_EQ_URYSOHN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil))) f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0) /\ forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = 1))

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_EQ_URYSOHN_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0) /\ forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = 1))

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_EQ_URYSOHN_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall a b :e R, a < b -> (normal_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = a) /\ forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = b)))

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_EQ_URYSOHN_GEN_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall a b :e R, ~ a = b -> (normal_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = a) /\ forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = b)))

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_FSIGMAS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, s :e fsigma_in A top /\ (t :e fsigma_in A top /\ separated_in A top s t) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_FSIGMA_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, normal_space A top /\ s :e fsigma_in A top -> normal_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, normal_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> normal_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> normal_space B top'

items.name: NORMAL_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ normal_space A top -> normal_space B top'

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_ACTION_KERNEL
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> group_action_hl A X G s a -> normal_subgroup_of A {g :e A | g :e group_carrier A G /\ forall x :e X, x :e s -> a g x = x} G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CENTRALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> normal_subgroup_of A (group_centralizer A G n) G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CENTRALIZER_NORMALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A (group_centralizer A G h) (subgroup_generated A G (group_normalizer A G h))

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CONJUGATE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G /\ forall n' c= A, group_conjugate A G n n' -> n' = n

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CONJUGATE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G /\ forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_setmul A G {group_inv A G x} (group_setmul A G n {x}) = n

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CONJUGATE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n n' c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G \/ normal_subgroup_of A n' G -> (group_conjugate A G n n' <-> n = n')

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CONJUGATE_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G /\ forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_setmul A G {group_inv A G x} (group_setmul A G n {x}) c= n

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G <-> subgroup_of A h G /\ forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G -> {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e h} c= h

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CONJUGATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G <-> subgroup_of A h G /\ forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G -> {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e h} = h

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CONJUGATION_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G <-> subgroup_of A h G /\ forall a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G -> h c= {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e h}

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_GROUP_KERNEL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f -> normal_subgroup_of A (group_kernel A B (G,G') f) G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_IMP_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> subgroup_of A n G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_LEFT_EQ_RIGHT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G /\ {left_coset_hl A G x n | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} = {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_LEFT_SUBSET_RIGHT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G /\ {left_coset_hl A G x n | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} c= {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_MUL_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G <-> subgroup_of A h G /\ forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> (group_mul A G x y :e h <-> group_mul A G y x :e h)

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_NORMALIZER_CONTAINS_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G /\ group_carrier A G c= group_normalizer A G n

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_NORMALIZER_EQ_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G /\ group_normalizer A G n = group_carrier A G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall n c= A, group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ normal_subgroup_of A n G -> normal_subgroup_of B {f x | x :e n} H

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_EPIMORPHIC_PREIMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall j c= A, forall k c= B, group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ (subgroup_of B k H /\ {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ f x :e k} = j) -> (normal_subgroup_of A j G <-> normal_subgroup_of B k H)

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_HOMOMORPHIC_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall j c= B, group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ normal_subgroup_of B j H -> normal_subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ f x :e j} G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> n c= group_carrier A G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A g G /\ normal_subgroup_of A h G -> normal_subgroup_of A (g :/\: h) G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall gs c= Power A, (forall g c= A, g :e gs -> normal_subgroup_of A g G) /\ ~ gs = Empty -> normal_subgroup_of A {x :e A | forall Y :e gs, x :e Y} G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_ISOMORPHIC_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall j c= A, group_isomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ j c= group_carrier A G -> (normal_subgroup_of B {f x | x :e j} H <-> normal_subgroup_of A j G)

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_NORMALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h (subgroup_generated A G (group_normalizer A G h)) <-> subgroup_of A h G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_OPPOSITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n (opposite_group A G) <-> normal_subgroup_of A n G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G /\ h c= s -> normal_subgroup_of A h (subgroup_generated A G s)

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G /\ h c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) -> normal_subgroup_of A h (subgroup_generated A G s)

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_TORSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, normal_subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0} G <-> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0} G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_TORSION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall G :e group_hl A, normal_subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ P (group_element_order_hl A G x)} G <-> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ P (group_element_order_hl A G x)} G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall u c= Power A, ~ u = Empty /\ ((forall h c= A, h :e u -> normal_subgroup_of A h G) /\ (forall g h c= A, g :e u /\ h :e u -> g c= h \/ h c= g)) -> normal_subgroup_of A (Union u) G

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_RIGHT_SUBSET_LEFT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G /\ {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} c= {left_coset_hl A G x n | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}

items.name: NORMAL_SUBGROUP_SINGULAR_RELBOUNDARY_RELCYCLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, normal_subgroup_of (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) {x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) x} (relcycle_group A (p,(top,s)))

items.name: NORMAL_T1_EQ_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top -> (t1_space A top <-> hausdorff_space A top)

items.name: NORMAL_T1_IMP_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top /\ t1_space A top -> hausdorff_space A top

items.name: NORMAL_T1_IMP_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top /\ t1_space A top -> regular_space A top

items.name: NORM_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> vector_norm A (vec A 0) = 0

items.name: NORM_1
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, vector_norm 1 x = abs_SNo (drop x)

items.name: NORM_1_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, 0 <= drop x -> vector_norm 1 x = drop x

items.name: NORM_ADD_PYTHAGOREAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N a b -> vector_norm N (vector_add N a b) ^ 2 = vector_norm N a ^ 2 + vector_norm N b ^ 2

items.name: NORM_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (basis N k) = 1

items.name: NORM_BASIS_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> vector_norm A (basis A 1) = 1

items.name: NORM_BOUND_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, vector_norm N x <= e0 -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) <= e0

items.name: NORM_BOUND_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, vector_norm N x < e0 -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) < e0

items.name: NORM_BOUND_GENERALIZE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, linear M N f -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm M x = 1 -> vector_norm N (f x) <= b) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= b * vector_norm M x)

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y <= vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_ABS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (dot N x y) <= vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_ABS_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (dot N x y) = vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y <-> vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y = vector_mul N (vector_norm N y) x \/ vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y = vector_mul N (- vector_norm N y) x

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_DIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (dot N x y :/: (vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y)) <= 1

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y = vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y <-> vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y = vector_mul N (vector_norm N y) x

items.name: NORM_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_EQUAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (dot N x y) = vector_norm N x * vector_norm N y <-> collinear N {vec N 0,x,y}

items.name: NORM_COLUMN_LE_ONORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, vector_norm M (column M N i A) <= onorm N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x)

items.name: NORM_CROSS_MULTIPLY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_mul N a x = vector_mul N b y /\ (0 < a /\ 0 < b) -> vector_mul N (vector_norm N y) x = vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y

items.name: NORM_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm A x = vector_norm B y <-> dot A x x = dot B y y

items.name: NORM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = 0 <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: NORM_EQ_0_DOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = 0 <-> dot A x x = 0

items.name: NORM_EQ_0_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = 0 -> x = vec A 0

items.name: NORM_EQ_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = 1 <-> dot A x x = 1

items.name: NORM_EQ_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) = abs_SNo (y i)) -> vector_norm N x = vector_norm N y

items.name: NORM_EQ_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x = a <-> 0 <= a /\ dot N x x = a ^ 2

items.name: NORM_FSTCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A), vector_norm B (fstcart B x) <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex B + dimindex A)) x

items.name: NORM_GE_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, a <= vector_norm N x <-> a <= 0 \/ a ^ 2 <= dot N x x

items.name: NORM_GT_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, a < vector_norm N x <-> a < 0 \/ a ^ 2 < dot N x x

items.name: NORM_INCREASES_ONLINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a d :e R :^: idx N, ~ d = vec N 0 -> vector_norm N a < vector_norm N (vector_add N a d) \/ vector_norm N a < vector_norm N (vector_sub N a d)

items.name: NORM_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm A x <= vector_norm B y <-> dot A x x <= dot B y y

items.name: NORM_LE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x <= 0 <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: NORM_LE_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> abs_SNo (x i) <= abs_SNo (y i)) -> vector_norm N x <= vector_norm N y

items.name: NORM_LE_INFNORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x <= (if 0 <= dimindex N then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (dimindex N) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- dimindex N)) * infnorm N x

items.name: NORM_LE_L1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x <= finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => abs_SNo (x i))

items.name: NORM_LE_MAX_EIGENVECTOR_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall l :e R, linear N N f /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, x0 :e b -> f x0 = vector_mul N (c x0) x0 /\ abs_SNo (c x0) <= l) /\ x :e span N b)) -> vector_norm N (f x) <= l * vector_norm N x

items.name: NORM_LE_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm M x <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x y) /\ vector_norm N y <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x y)

items.name: NORM_LE_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x <= a <-> 0 <= a /\ dot N x x <= a ^ 2

items.name: NORM_LIFT
items.statement: forall x :e R, vector_norm 1 (lift x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: NORM_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm A x < vector_norm B y <-> dot A x x < dot B y y

items.name: NORM_LT_SQUARE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x < a <-> 0 < a /\ dot N x x < a ^ 2

items.name: NORM_LT_SQUARE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x < a <-> 0 <= a /\ dot N x x < a ^ 2

items.name: NORM_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (vector_mul A a x) = abs_SNo a * vector_norm A x

items.name: NORM_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (vector_neg A x) = vector_norm A x

items.name: NORM_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x y) = if 0 <= vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm B y ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm B y ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- (vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm B y ^ 2))

items.name: NORM_PASTECART_0
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x (vec B 0)) = vector_norm A x) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx C, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex D + dimindex C)) (pastecart D C (vec D 0) y) = vector_norm C y

items.name: NORM_PASTECART_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x y) <= vector_norm A x + vector_norm B y

items.name: NORM_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 <= vector_norm A x

items.name: NORM_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, 0 < vector_norm A x <-> ~ x = vec A 0

items.name: NORM_POW_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x ^ 2 = dot A x x

items.name: NORM_REAL
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, vector_norm 1 x = abs_SNo (x 1)

items.name: NORM_REFLECT_ALONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N (reflect_along N v x) = vector_norm N x

items.name: NORM_SEGMENT_LOWERBOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, forall r d :e R, 0 < r /\ (vector_norm N a = r /\ (vector_norm N b = r /\ (x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ dot N a b = d * r ^ 2))) -> (if 0 <= (1 + - abs_SNo d) :/: 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg ((1 + - abs_SNo d) :/: 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- (1 + - abs_SNo d) :/: 2)) * r <= vector_norm N x

items.name: NORM_SEGMENT_ORTHOGONAL_LOWERBOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, r <= vector_norm N a /\ (r <= vector_norm N b /\ (orthogonal N a b /\ x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> r :/: 2 <= vector_norm N x

items.name: NORM_SNDCART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B), vector_norm B (sndcart A B x) <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) x

items.name: NORM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y) = vector_norm A (vector_sub A y x)

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (vector_add A x y) <= vector_norm A x + vector_norm A y

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N (vector_add N x y) = vector_norm N x + vector_norm N y <-> vector_mul N (vector_norm N x) y = vector_mul N (vector_norm N y) x

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x + vector_norm A y <= e0 -> vector_norm A (vector_add A x y) <= e0

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x + vector_norm A y < e0 -> vector_norm A (vector_add A x y) < e0

items.name: NORM_TRIANGLE_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x <= vector_norm N y + vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y)

items.name: NORM_VECTORIZE_HADAMARD_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N (fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => A i j * B i j)) <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N A) * vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N B)

items.name: NORM_VECTORIZE_MUL_LE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx P, forall B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex P * dimindex M)) (vectorize R P M (matrix_mul P N M A B)) <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex P * dimindex N)) (vectorize R P N A) * vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex M)) (vectorize R N M B)

items.name: NORM_VECTORIZE_ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_LMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P -> vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex N)) (vectorize R N N (matrix_mul N N N P A)) = vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex N)) (vectorize R N N A)

items.name: NORM_VECTORIZE_ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_RMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P -> vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex N)) (vectorize R N N (matrix_mul N N N A P)) = vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex N)) (vectorize R N N A)

items.name: NORM_VECTORIZE_POW_2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N A) ^ 2 = finsum (idx M) (fun i:set => vector_norm N (A i) ^ 2)

items.name: NORM_VECTORIZE_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex M)) (vectorize R N M (transp M N A)) = vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N A)

items.name: NORM_VECTOR_DERIVATIVES_LE_AT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx M, forall g' :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative M f f' (at 1 x) /\ (has_vector_derivative N g g' (at 1 x) /\ eventually (R :^: idx 1) {y :e R :^: idx 1 | vector_norm M (vector_sub M (f y) (f x)) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g y) (g x))} (at 1 x)) -> vector_norm M f' <= vector_norm N g'

items.name: NORM_VECTOR_DERIVATIVES_LE_WITHIN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx M, forall g' :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, limit_point_of 1 x s /\ (has_vector_derivative M f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) /\ (has_vector_derivative N g g' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) /\ eventually (R :^: idx 1) {y :e R :^: idx 1 | vector_norm M (vector_sub M (f y) (f x)) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g y) (g x))} (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s))) -> vector_norm M f' <= vector_norm N g'

items.name: NORM_VSUM_PYTHAGOREAN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k c= A, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite k /\ (forall x y :e k, x <> y -> orthogonal N (u x) (u y)) -> vector_norm N (vsum A N k u) ^ 2 = finsum k (fun i:set => vector_norm N (u i) ^ 2)

items.name: NORM_VSUM_TRIVIAL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall s c= omega, forall m n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> (P -> vector_norm A (vsum omega A (s :/\: {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}) f) < e0 <-> P -> n < m \/ vector_norm A (vsum omega A (s :/\: {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}) f) < e0)

items.name: NOT_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT_COBOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ retract_of N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) (R :^: idx N) -> s = Empty

items.name: NOT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, ~ seq_all P l <-> seq_ex (fun x:set => ~ P x) l

items.name: NOT_AR_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> ~ AR N Empty

items.name: NOT_BOUNDED_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> ~ bounded_hl N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: NOT_CLAUSES
items.statement: (forall t:prop, ~ ~ t <-> t) /\ ((~ True <-> False) /\ (~ False <-> True))

items.name: NOT_CLAUSES_WEAK
items.statement: (~ True <-> False) /\ (~ False <-> True)

items.name: NOT_COMPACT_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: ~ compact_space R euclideanreal

items.name: NOT_COMPACT_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> ~ compact N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: NOT_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, s :/\: closure N t = Empty /\ (t :/\: closure N s = Empty /\ (x :e s /\ y :e t)) -> ~ connected_component N (s :\/: t) x y

items.name: NOT_CONS_NIL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, ~ seq_cons h t = seq_nil

items.name: NOT_DEF
items.statement: forall p:prop, ~ p <-> p -> False

items.name: NOT_EMPTY_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ Empty = SetAdjoin s x

items.name: NOT_EQUAL_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, ~ s = t <-> exists x :e A, x :e t <-> ~ x :e s

items.name: NOT_EVEN
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ even_nat n <-> odd_nat n

items.name: NOT_EVENTUALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall p c= A, (forall x :e A, ~ x :e p) /\ ~ trivial_limit A net0 -> ~ eventually A p net0

items.name: NOT_EX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, ~ seq_ex P l <-> seq_all (fun x:set => ~ P x) l

items.name: NOT_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, ~ (exists x :e A, P x) <-> forall x :e A, ~ P x

items.name: NOT_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, ~ (forall x :e A, P x) <-> exists x :e A, ~ P x

items.name: NOT_GDELTA_DENSE_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, countable s /\ closure N s = R :^: idx N -> ~ gdelta N s

items.name: NOT_IMP
items.statement: forall t1 t2:prop, ~ (t1 -> t2) <-> t1 /\ ~ t2

items.name: NOT_INSERT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, ~ SetAdjoin s x = Empty

items.name: NOT_INTERVAL_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = R :^: idx N) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (a,b) = R :^: idx N

items.name: NOT_INT_REM_2
items.statement: (forall n :e int, ~ rem_int n 2 = 0 <-> rem_int n 2 = 1) /\ forall n :e int, ~ rem_int n 2 = 1 <-> rem_int n 2 = 0

items.name: NOT_IN_AFFINE_HULL_SURFACE_TRIANGULATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx N, convex N u /\ (bounded_hl N u /\ (z :e interior N u /\ (triangulation N t /\ Union t c= frontier N u))) -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e t -> ~ z :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} c

items.name: NOT_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, ~ x :e Empty

items.name: NOT_IN_INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (finite_cardinality s <= dimindex N + 1 /\ x :e s) -> ~ x :e interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s)

items.name: NOT_IN_PATH_IMAGE_JOIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, ~ x :e path_image A g1 /\ ~ x :e path_image A g2 -> ~ x :e path_image A (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) g1 g2 x0)

items.name: NOT_LE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m <= n <-> n < m

items.name: NOT_LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_IRRATIONAL
items.statement: ~ locally_compact_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal {z :e R | ~ z :e rational})

items.name: NOT_LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_IRRATIONAL_GEN
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ interior_of R euclideanreal s = Empty -> ~ locally_compact_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal {q :e R | q :e s /\ ~ q :e rational})

items.name: NOT_LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_RATIONAL
items.statement: ~ locally_compact_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal {x :e R | x :e rational})

items.name: NOT_LOCALLY_COMPACT_SPACE_RATIONAL_GEN
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ interior_of R euclideanreal s = Empty -> ~ locally_compact_space R (subtopology R euclideanreal {q :e R | q :e s /\ q :e rational})

items.name: NOT_LT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ~ m < n <-> n <= m

items.name: NOT_MEASURABLE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> ~ measurable N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: NOT_NEGLIGIBLE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> ~ negligible N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: NOT_ODD
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ odd_nat n <-> even_nat n

items.name: NOT_ON_PATH_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall z :e R :^: idx N, path N g /\ ~ z :e path_image N g -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ ball N (z,e0) :/\: path_image N g = Empty

items.name: NOT_ON_PATH_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall z :e R :^: idx N, path N g /\ ~ z :e path_image N g -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ cball N (z,e0) :/\: path_image N g = Empty

items.name: NOT_OPEN_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, ~ open N {a}

items.name: NOT_OUTSIDE_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ bounded_hl N s -> (R :^: idx N) :\: outside N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall B :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, B <= vector_norm N y /\ ~ connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x y}

items.name: NOT_OUTSIDE_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ bounded_hl N s -> (R :^: idx N) :\: outside N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall B :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, B < vector_norm N y /\ ~ connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x y}

items.name: NOT_PSUBSET_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, ~ (s c= Empty /\ s <> Empty)

items.name: NOT_REAL_BOUNDED_UNIV
items.statement: ~ real_bounded R

items.name: NOT_REAL_COMPACT_UNIV
items.statement: ~ real_compact R

items.name: NOT_SUC
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ ordsucc n = 0

items.name: NOT_UNIV_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, ~ (A c= s /\ A <> s)

items.name: NOWHERE_DENSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N (closure N s) = Empty <-> forall t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ ~ t = Empty -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ (~ u = Empty /\ (u c= t /\ u :/\: s = Empty))

items.name: NOWHERE_DENSE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable g /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e g -> interior N (closure N s) = Empty) -> interior N (Union g) = Empty

items.name: NOWHERE_DENSE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable g /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e g -> closed N s /\ interior N s = Empty) -> interior N (Union g) = Empty

items.name: NOWHERE_DENSE_COUNTABLE_UNIONS_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall g c= Power (R :^: idx N), locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} u /\ (countable g /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e g -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s = Empty)) -> interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) (Union g) = Empty

items.name: NOWHERE_DENSE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, interior N (closure N (s :\/: t)) = Empty <-> interior N (closure N s) = Empty /\ interior N (closure N t) = Empty

items.name: NO_EMBEDDING_SPHERE_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall r :e R, 0 < r /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f (sphere M (a,r)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e sphere M (a,r) /\ (y :e sphere M (a,r) /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> dimindex M <= dimindex N

items.name: NO_LIMIT_POINT_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ~ (exists x :e R :^: idx A, limit_point_of A x s) -> closed A s

items.name: NO_PROPER_SUBGROUPS_EQ_CYCLIC_PRIME_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, (forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> h = {group_id A G} \/ h = group_carrier A G) <-> cyclic_group_hl A G /\ (finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G) = 1 \/ prime_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))))

items.name: NO_PROPER_SUBGROUPS_IMP_CYCLIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, (forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> h c= {group_id A G} \/ h = group_carrier A G) -> cyclic_group_hl A G

items.name: NO_PROPER_SUBGROUP_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f -> ((forall k c= B, subgroup_of B k H -> k = {group_id B H} \/ k = group_carrier B H) <-> forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (group_kernel A B (G,H) f c= h /\ group_kernel A B (G,H) f <> h) -> h = group_carrier A G)

items.name: NO_RETRACTION_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> ~ retract_of N (sphere N (a,e0)) (cball N (a,e0))

items.name: NO_RETRACTION_FRONTIER_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ ~ interior N s = Empty -> ~ retract_of N (frontier N s) s

items.name: NPRODUCT_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: NPRODUCT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finprod Empty f = 1) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e omega) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finprod (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finprod s f else f x * finprod s f

items.name: NPRODUCT_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m * finprod {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: NPRODUCT_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> (forall m :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 1) /\ forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * f (ordsucc n) else finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: NPRODUCT_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f * f n

items.name: NPRODUCT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, P 1 /\ ((forall x y :e omega, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: NPRODUCT_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e omega, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: NPRODUCT_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => c) = c ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: NPRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => c) = c ^ minus_nat (n + 1) m

items.name: NPRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall c n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun x:set => c) = c ^ n

items.name: NPRODUCT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> f a * finprod (s :\: {a}) f = finprod s f

items.name: NPRODUCT_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e omega, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finprod s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 1) = if a :e s then b else 1

items.name: NPRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finprod s f = finprod s g

items.name: NPRODUCT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finprod s f = 0 <-> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = 0)

items.name: NPRODUCT_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 <-> exists x :e omega, m <= x /\ (x <= n /\ f x = 0)

items.name: NPRODUCT_EQ_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 1) -> finprod s f = 1

items.name: NPRODUCT_EQ_1_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 1) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 1

items.name: NPRODUCT_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: NPRODUCT_FACT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun m:set => m) = factorial n

items.name: NPRODUCT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= B, (forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finprod {f x | x :e s} g = finprod s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: NPRODUCT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finprod s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finprod s f

items.name: NPRODUCT_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) -> finprod s f <= finprod s g

items.name: NPRODUCT_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e omega) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i <= g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: NPRODUCT_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: NPRODUCT_MUL_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 1} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 1} -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: NPRODUCT_MUL_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: NPRODUCT_OFFSET
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m p :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: NPRODUCT_ONE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finprod s (fun n:set => 1) = 1

items.name: NPRODUCT_PAIR
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (2 * i) * f (2 * i + 1))

items.name: NPRODUCT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod s f

items.name: NPRODUCT_POS_LT_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: NPRODUCT_REFLECT
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then 1 else finprod {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: NPRODUCT_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, R0 1 1 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e omega, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: NPRODUCT_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e omega, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: NPRODUCT_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun i:set => if i :e s then f i else 1) = finprod s f

items.name: NPRODUCT_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finprod {i :e A | i :e s /\ P i} f = finprod s (fun i:set => if P i then f i else 1)

items.name: NPRODUCT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall x :e A, finprod {x} f = f x

items.name: NPRODUCT_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: NPRODUCT_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 1) -> finprod v f = finprod u f

items.name: NPRODUCT_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finprod {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} f = finprod s f

items.name: NPRODUCT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finprod (s :\/: t) f = finprod s f * finprod t f

items.name: NPRODUCT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} c= s -> finprod s f = finprod A f

items.name: NSPHERE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, nsphere n = subtopology (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) {x :e R :^: omega | finsum (idx_n (n + 1)) (fun i:set => x i ^ 2) = 1 /\ forall i :e omega, ~ i :e idx_n (n + 1) -> x i = 0}

items.name: NSUM_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finsum s (fun n:set => 0) = 0

items.name: NSUM_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + g x) = finsum s f + finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_ADD_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 0} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 0} -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + g x) = finsum s f + finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_ADD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f i + g i) = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: NSUM_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: NSUM_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ p y0 = y -> y0 = x) -> finsum s f = finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: NSUM_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) -> finsum s f <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: NSUM_BOUND_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= div_nat b (finite_cardinality s))) -> finsum s f <= b

items.name: NSUM_BOUND_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: NSUM_BOUND_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: NSUM_BOUND_LT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < div_nat b (finite_cardinality s))) -> finsum s f < b

items.name: NSUM_CARD_GROUP_ORBITS
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> group_action_hl A X G s a /\ finite s -> finsum {{x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} | x :e X, x :e s} (fun x:set => finite_cardinality x) = finite_cardinality s

items.name: NSUM_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) = finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f + finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ P x} g

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finsum Empty f = 0) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e omega) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finsum (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finsum s f else f x + finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m + finsum {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> (forall m :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + f (ordsucc n) else finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> finsum {i :e omega | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\ forall k :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | i <= ordsucc k} f = finsum {i :e omega | i <= k} f + f (ordsucc k)

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> finsum {i :e omega | i < 0} f = 0 /\ forall k :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | i < ordsucc k} f = finsum {i :e omega | i < k} f + f k

items.name: NSUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f + f n

items.name: NSUM_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, P 0 /\ ((forall x y :e omega, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: NSUM_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e omega, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: NSUM_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun n:set => c) = finite_cardinality s * c

items.name: NSUM_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun n0:set => c) = minus_nat (n + 1) m * c

items.name: NSUM_DEGENERATE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, ~ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 0} -> finsum s f = 0

items.name: NSUM_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> f a + finsum (s :\: {a}) f = finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e omega, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finsum s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 0) = if a :e s then b else 0

items.name: NSUM_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> finsum (s :\: t) f = minus_nat (finsum s f) (finsum t f)

items.name: NSUM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finsum s f = finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0) -> finsum s f = 0

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0_IFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finsum s f = 0 <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0)

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0_IFF_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 <-> forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 0

items.name: NSUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 0) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: NSUM_EQ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e omega) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ h x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ h y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ g (h x) = f x) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: NSUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e omega) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e A) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> k y :e s /\ h (k y) = y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ (k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: NSUM_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: NSUM_EQ_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = g x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ x :e t -> f x = 0))) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: NSUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g) = finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_GROUP_RELATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 x y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 x y0 -> y0 = y) -> finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} g) = finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finsum {f x | x :e s} g = finsum s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: NSUM_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s g = finsum {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)

items.name: NSUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e B, d x :e omega) -> forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e A, i x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ i x = i y)) -> d (i x) = 0) -> finsum {i x | x :e s} d = finsum s (fun x:set => d (i x))

items.name: NSUM_INCL_EXCL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum (s :\/: t) f + finsum (s :/\: t) f

items.name: NSUM_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) -> finsum s f <= finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_LE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 0} -> finsum s f <= finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i <= g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: NSUM_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall c :e omega, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => c * f x) = c * finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: NSUM_MULTICOUNT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k :e omega, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = k * finite_cardinality t

items.name: NSUM_MULTICOUNT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e omega) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k j)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = finsum t k

items.name: NSUM_MUL_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e omega) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e A, b x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun i:set => a i * b i) <= finsum s a * finsum s b

items.name: NSUM_NSUM_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x x y :e omega) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> finite (t i)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum (t i) (x i)) = finsum (\/_ i :e A, {(i,j) | j :e B, i :e s /\ j :e t i}) (fun p:set => x (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: NSUM_NSUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun x:set => finsum {y :e B | y :e t /\ R0 x y} (f x)) = finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} (fun x:set => f x y))

items.name: NSUM_OFFSET
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: NSUM_OFFSET_0
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => f (i + m))

items.name: NSUM_PAIR
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (2 * i) + f (2 * i + 1))

items.name: NSUM_PERMUTE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> finsum s f = finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: NSUM_PERMUTE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, permutes omega p {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: NSUM_POS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall b :e omega, forall s c= A, finite s /\ finsum s f <= b -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b

items.name: NSUM_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ 0 < f x) -> 0 < finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_POS_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> 0 < f i)) -> 0 < finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_REFLECT
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then 0 else finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: NSUM_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, R0 0 0 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e omega, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: NSUM_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e omega, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: NSUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else 0) = finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f = finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else 0)

items.name: NSUM_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall c :e omega, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => f x * c) = finsum s f * c

items.name: NSUM_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall x :e A, finsum {x} f = f x

items.name: NSUM_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: NSUM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finite u /\ (finite v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e u :\: v -> f x = 0)) -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: NSUM_SUBSET_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> finite v /\ u c= v -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: NSUM_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum v f = finsum u f

items.name: NSUM_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finsum {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} f = finsum s f

items.name: NSUM_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e omega) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum t (f i)) = finsum t (fun j:set => finsum s (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: NSUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, f x y :e omega) -> finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (f i)) = finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (fun j:set => finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: NSUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, n < m -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: NSUM_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: NSUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t) /\ (forall t1 t2 c= A, forall x :e A, t1 :e s /\ (t2 :e s /\ (~ t1 = t2 /\ (x :e t1 /\ x :e t2))) -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (Union s) f = finsum s (fun t:set => finsum t f)

items.name: NSUM_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t u c= A, finite u /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ s :\/: t = u) -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum u f

items.name: NSUM_UNION_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall u v c= A, finite v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e u /\ ~ x :e v -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum v f

items.name: NSUM_UNION_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: NSUM_UNION_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall u v c= A, finite u /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum u f

items.name: NSUM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} c= s -> finsum s f = finsum A f

items.name: NULL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_len seq_nil = 0 <-> True) /\ (seq_len (seq_cons h t) = 0 <-> False)

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_FROM_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ contractible M s) -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => c)

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_FROM_CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, continuous_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ contractible_space A top1 -> exists c :e B, homotopic_with B A {h :e B :^: A | True} (top1,top2) f (fun x:set => c)

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_FROM_SPHERE_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall r :e R, (exists c :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) (sphere M (a,r)),subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) f (fun x:set => c)) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (cball M (a,r)) /\ ({g x | x :e cball M (a,r)} c= s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e sphere M (a,r) -> g x = f x))

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_INTO_ANR_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ANR N t))) -> ((exists c :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => c)) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (R :^: idx M) /\ ({g x | x :e R :^: idx M} c= t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)))

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_INTO_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ contractible N t) -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => c)

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_INTO_CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, continuous_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ contractible_space B top2 -> exists c :e B, homotopic_with B A {h :e B :^: A | True} (top1,top2) f (fun x:set => c)

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_INTO_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, closed M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= relative_frontier N t /\ (convex N t /\ bounded_hl N t)))) -> ((exists c :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (relative_frontier N t)) f (fun x:set => c)) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (R :^: idx M) /\ ({g x | x :e R :^: idx M} c= relative_frontier N t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)))

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_INTO_SPHERE_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, closed M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ {f x | x :e s} c= sphere N (a,r))) -> ((exists c :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (sphere N (a,r))) f (fun x:set => c)) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g (R :^: idx M) /\ ({g x | x :e R :^: idx M} c= sphere N (a,r) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)))

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_NONSURJECTIVE_SPHERE_MAP
