items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), continuous_map (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) (nsphere p,nsphere p) (fun x:set => f x) /\ ~ {f x | x :e topspace (R :^: omega) (nsphere p)} = topspace (R :^: omega) (nsphere p) -> exists a :e R :^: omega, homotopic_with (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) {x :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega) | True} (nsphere p,nsphere p) (fun x:set => f x) (fun x:set => fun x0 :e omega => a x0)

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_NONSURJECTIVE_SPHERE_MAP_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f (relative_frontier N s) /\ ({f x | x :e relative_frontier N s} c= relative_frontier N s /\ {f x | x :e relative_frontier N s} <> relative_frontier N s))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (relative_frontier N s),subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (relative_frontier N s)) f (fun x:set => a)

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_THROUGH_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ contractible N t))) -> exists c :e R :^: idx P, homotopic_with (R :^: idx P) (R :^: idx M) {h :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u) (fun x:set => g (f x)) (fun x:set => c)

items.name: NULLHOMOTOPIC_THROUGH_CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top3 :e topology C, continuous_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ (continuous_map B C (top2,top3) g /\ contractible_space B top2) -> exists c :e C, homotopic_with C A {h :e C :^: A | True} (top1,top3) (fun x:set => g (f x)) (fun x:set => c)

items.name: NULLSPACE_INTER_ROWSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vec N 0 /\ x :e span M (rows N M A) <-> x = vec M 0

items.name: NUMSEG_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} :\/: {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p}

items.name: NUMSEG_CARD_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, atleastp (idx_n n) s <-> finite s -> n <= finite_cardinality s

items.name: NUMSEG_CLAUSES
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} = if m = 0 then {0} else Empty) /\ forall m n :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} = if m <= ordsucc n then SetAdjoin {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (ordsucc n) else {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_CLAUSES_LE
items.statement: {i :e omega | i <= 0} = {0} /\ forall k :e omega, {i :e omega | i <= ordsucc k} = SetAdjoin {i :e omega | i <= k} (ordsucc k)

items.name: NUMSEG_CLAUSES_LT
items.statement: {i :e omega | i < 0} = Empty /\ forall k :e omega, {i :e omega | i < ordsucc k} = SetAdjoin {i :e omega | i < k} k

items.name: NUMSEG_COMBINE_L
items.statement: forall m p n :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n + 1 -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat p 1} :\/: {i :e omega | p <= i /\ i <= n} = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_COMBINE_R
items.statement: forall m p n :e omega, m <= p + 1 /\ p <= n -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} :\/: {i :e omega | p + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_DIMINDEX_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> exists i :e omega, i :e idx N

items.name: NUMSEG_EMPTY
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = Empty <-> n < m

items.name: NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, {x :e omega | x <= n} = {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_LREC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> SetAdjoin {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} m = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, {x :e omega | x < n} = if n = 0 then Empty else {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1}

items.name: NUMSEG_LT_DIMINDEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> {i :e omega | i < dimindex N} = {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat (dimindex N) 1}

items.name: NUMSEG_OFFSET_IMAGE
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} = {i + p | i :e {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}}

items.name: NUMSEG_REC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= ordsucc n -> {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} = SetAdjoin {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (ordsucc n)

items.name: NUMSEG_RREC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> SetAdjoin {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} n = {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}

items.name: NUMSEG_SING
items.statement: forall n :e omega, {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} = {n}

items.name: NUM_CASES_BINARY
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall n :e omega, P n) <-> (forall n :e omega, P (2 * n)) /\ forall n :e omega, P (2 * n + 1)

items.name: NUM_COUNTABLE
items.statement: countable omega

items.name: NUM_GCD
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = gcd_int a b

items.name: NUM_LCM
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, lcm_int a b = lcm_int a b

items.name: NUM_OF_INT
items.statement: forall x :e int, 0 <= x <-> (if x :e omega then x else 0) = x

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y -> (if x + y :e omega then x + y else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) + if y :e omega then y else 0

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e int, 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y -> (if x * y :e omega then x * y else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) * if y :e omega then y else 0

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_OF_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, (if n :e omega then n else 0) = n

items.name: NUM_OF_INT_POW
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, 0 <= x -> (if x ^ n :e omega then x ^ n else 0) = (if x :e omega then x else 0) ^ n

items.name: ODD
items.statement: (odd_nat 0 <-> False) /\ forall n :e omega, odd_nat (ordsucc n) <-> ~ odd_nat n

items.name: ODD_ADD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m + n) <-> ~ (odd_nat m <-> odd_nat n)

items.name: ODD_DOUBLE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat (ordsucc (2 * n))

items.name: ODD_EXISTS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> exists m :e omega, n = ordsucc (2 * m)

items.name: ODD_EXP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m ^ n) <-> odd_nat m \/ n = 0

items.name: ODD_MOD
items.statement: forall n :e omega, odd_nat n <-> mod_nat n 2 = 1

items.name: ODD_MOD_EVEN
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, even_nat n -> (odd_nat (mod_nat m n) <-> odd_nat m)

items.name: ODD_MULT
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (m * n) <-> odd_nat m /\ odd_nat n

items.name: ODD_PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> (odd_nat p <-> 3 <= p)

items.name: ODD_SUB
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, odd_nat (minus_nat m n) <-> n < m /\ ~ (odd_nat m <-> odd_nat n)

items.name: OEP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A p -> exists t:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A t /\ (fld_on A t = fld_on A p /\ forall x y :e A, p x y -> t x y)

items.name: ONE_ONE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y) <-> forall x1 x2 :e A, f x1 = f x2 -> x1 = x2)

items.name: ONE_OR_PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, p = 1 \/ prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, divides_nat n p -> n = 1 \/ n = p

items.name: ONE_OR_PRIME_DIVIDES_OR_COPRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, p = 1 \/ prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, divides_nat p n \/ gcd_int p n = 1

items.name: ONE_POINT_COMPACTIFICATION_DENSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, compact_space A top /\ ~ compact_in A top (topspace A top :\: {a}) -> closure_of A top (topspace A top :\: {a}) = topspace A top

items.name: ONE_POINT_COMPACTIFICATION_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, compact_space A top /\ ~ compact_in A top (topspace A top :\: {a}) -> interior_of A top {a} = Empty

items.name: ONORM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= onorm M N f * vector_norm M x) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= b * vector_norm M x) -> onorm M N f <= b

items.name: ONORM_ADJOINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> onorm N N (adjoint N N f) = onorm N N f

items.name: ONORM_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, linear M N f -> onorm M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) = abs_SNo c * onorm M N f

items.name: ONORM_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx C, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> linear C A f /\ linear B C g -> onorm B A (fun x:set => f (g x)) <= onorm C A f * onorm B C g

items.name: ONORM_COMPOSE_ADJOINT_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> onorm N N (fun x:set => adjoint N N f (f x)) = onorm N N f ^ 2

items.name: ONORM_COMPOSE_ADJOINT_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> onorm N N (fun x:set => f (adjoint N N f x)) = onorm N N f ^ 2

items.name: ONORM_COMPOSE_ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> orthogonal_transformation B f -> onorm A B (fun x:set => f (g x)) = onorm A B g

items.name: ONORM_COMPOSE_ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> orthogonal_transformation A g -> onorm A B (fun x:set => f (g x)) = onorm A B f

items.name: ONORM_CONST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, onorm M N (fun x:set => y) = vector_norm N y

items.name: ONORM_COVARIANCE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) A) x) = onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) ^ 2

items.name: ONORM_COVARIANCE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N N N A (transp N N A)) x) = onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) ^ 2

items.name: ONORM_DERIVATIVES_LE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g' x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (at M x) /\ (has_derivative P M g g' (at M x) /\ eventually (R :^: idx M) {y :e R :^: idx M | vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f y) (f x)) <= vector_norm P (vector_sub P (g y) (g x))} (at M x)) -> onorm M N f' <= onorm M P g'

items.name: ONORM_DIAGONALIZED_COVARIANCE_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A D P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P /\ (diagonal_matrix_hl N N D /\ matrix_mul N N N (transp N N P) (matrix_mul N N N D P) = matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) A) -> onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) = if 0 <= sup {abs_SNo (D i i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (sup {abs_SNo (D i i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N}) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- sup {abs_SNo (D i i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N})

items.name: ONORM_DIAGONALIZED_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A D P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P /\ (diagonal_matrix_hl N N D /\ matrix_mul N N N (transp N N P) (matrix_mul N N N D P) = A) -> onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) = sup {abs_SNo (D i i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N}

items.name: ONORM_DIAGONAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A -> onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) = sup {abs_SNo (A i i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N}

items.name: ONORM_DOT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> onorm M N f = sup (\/_ x :e R :^: idx M, {dot N (f x) y | y :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm M x = 1 /\ vector_norm N y = 1})

items.name: ONORM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f -> (onorm M N f = 0 <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x = vec N 0)

items.name: ONORM_EQ_MAX_EIGENVECTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> linear N N f /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ (span N b = R :^: idx N /\ (~ vec N 0 :e b /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e b -> f x = vector_mul N (c x) x)))) -> onorm N N f = sup {abs_SNo (c x) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e b}

items.name: ONORM_I
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> onorm N N (fun x:set => x) = 1

items.name: ONORM_ID
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> onorm N N (fun x:set => x) = 1

items.name: ONORM_INVERSE_DET_LE_ONORM_POW
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A -> onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_inv N N A) x) * det N A <= onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) ^ minus_nat (dimindex N) 1

items.name: ONORM_INVERSE_DET_LE_ONORM_POW_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (linear N N g /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x)) -> onorm N N f * det N (matrix N N g) <= onorm N N g ^ minus_nat (dimindex N) 1

items.name: ONORM_INVERSE_FUNCTION_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N M f /\ (linear M N g /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f (g x) = x)) -> 1 <= onorm N M f * onorm M N g

items.name: ONORM_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, linear M N f -> (onorm M N f <= b <-> forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) <= b * vector_norm M x)

items.name: ONORM_LE_EQ_2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, linear M N f -> (onorm M N f <= b <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx M, dot N x (f y) <= b * vector_norm N x * vector_norm M y)

items.name: ONORM_LE_EQ_2_ABS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, linear M N f -> (onorm M N f <= b <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx M, abs_SNo (dot N x (f y)) <= b * vector_norm N x * vector_norm M y)

items.name: ONORM_LE_EVENTUALLY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, linear M N f -> (onorm M N f <= b <-> eventually (R :^: idx M) {y :e R :^: idx M | vector_norm N (f y) <= b * vector_norm M y} (at M (vec M 0)))

items.name: ONORM_LE_MATRIX_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> abs_SNo (A i j) <= B) -> onorm N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x) <= dimindex M * dimindex N * B

items.name: ONORM_LE_MATRIX_COMPONENT_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, onorm N M (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul M N A x) <= finsum (idx M) (fun i:set => finsum (idx N) (fun j:set => abs_SNo (A i j)))

items.name: ONORM_LE_NORM_VECTORIZE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, onorm M N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N M A x) <= vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex N * dimindex M)) (vectorize R N M A)

items.name: ONORM_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> onorm M N (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) = onorm M N f

items.name: ONORM_ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A -> onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x) = 1

items.name: ONORM_ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_MUL_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P -> onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N N N P A) x) = onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: ONORM_ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_MUL_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P -> onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N N N A P) x) = onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: ONORM_ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> orthogonal_transformation N f -> onorm N N f = 1

items.name: ONORM_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f -> 0 <= onorm A B f

items.name: ONORM_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f -> (0 < onorm A B f <-> ~ forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x = vec B 0)

items.name: ONORM_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) x) = onorm N N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: ONORM_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ linear M N g -> onorm M N (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) <= onorm M N f + onorm M N g

items.name: ONORM_TRIANGLE_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f /\ (linear A B g /\ onorm A B f + onorm A B g <= e0) -> onorm A B (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) <= e0

items.name: ONORM_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear A B f /\ (linear A B g /\ onorm A B f + onorm A B g < e0) -> onorm A B (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) < e0

items.name: ONTO
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall y :e B, exists x :e A, y = f x)

items.name: OPEN_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (m = 0 -> s = Empty) -> open N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: OPEN_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, open N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> (m = 0 -> s = Empty) /\ open N s

items.name: OPEN_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, open A (ball A (x,e0))

items.name: OPEN_BIJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> (open N {f x | x :e s} <-> open M s)

items.name: OPEN_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s <-> closed N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: OPEN_CLOSED_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, open_interval 1 (a,b) = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: {a,b}

items.name: OPEN_CLOSED_INTERVAL_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x y :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, x :e open_interval N (a,b) /\ (y :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (0 < e0 /\ e0 <= 1)) -> vector_add N (vector_mul N e0 x) (vector_mul N (1 + - e0) y) :e open_interval N (a,b)

items.name: OPEN_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ s :e components N u -> open N s

items.name: OPEN_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s :\: {vec N 0})

items.name: OPEN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0}

items.name: OPEN_CONNECTED_FINE_COVER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall u c= A, forall e0 :e R, locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) /\ (u :e mtopology A m /\ 0 < e0) -> forall x :e A, x :e u -> exists v c= A, v :e mtopology A m /\ (connected_in A (mtopology A m) v /\ (x :e v /\ (v c= u /\ (closure_of A (mtopology A m) v c= u /\ forall y z :e A, y :e v /\ z :e v -> mdist A m (y,z) < e0))))

items.name: OPEN_CONTAINS_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ ball A (x,e0) c= s

items.name: OPEN_CONTAINS_BALL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s <-> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ ball A (x,e0) c= s

items.name: OPEN_CONTAINS_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ cball A (x,e0) c= s

items.name: OPEN_CONTAINS_CBALL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s <-> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ cball A (x,e0) c= s

items.name: OPEN_CONTAINS_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, x :e open_interval N (a,b) /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s

items.name: OPEN_CONTAINS_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, x :e open_interval N (a,b) /\ open_interval N (a,b) c= s

items.name: OPEN_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s)

items.name: OPEN_COUNTABLE_LIMIT_ELEMENTARY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> exists f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, exists d c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N d (f n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n c= f (ordsucc n)) /\ Union {f n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = s)

items.name: OPEN_COUNTABLE_UNION_CLOSED_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> exists D c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable D /\ ((forall i c= R :^: idx N, i :e D -> i c= s /\ exists a b :e R :^: idx N, i = closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ Union D = s)

items.name: OPEN_COUNTABLE_UNION_OPEN_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> exists D c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable D /\ ((forall i c= R :^: idx N, i :e D -> i c= s /\ exists a b :e R :^: idx N, i = open_interval N (a,b)) /\ Union D = s)

items.name: OPEN_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, open A s -> open A (s :\: {x})

items.name: OPEN_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, open A s /\ closed A t -> open A (s :\: t)

items.name: OPEN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> open A Empty

items.name: OPEN_EQ_CONTINUOUS_INVERSE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e topspace B top' /\ g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> g y :e topspace A top /\ f (g y) = y) -> (open_map A B (top,top') f <-> continuous_map B A (top',top) g)

items.name: OPEN_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall Q:set -> set -> prop, (forall a :e A, open N {x :e R :^: idx N | Q a x}) -> open N {x :e R :^: idx N | exists a :e A, Q a x}

items.name: OPEN_EXISTS_IN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall Q:set -> set -> prop, (forall a :e A, P a -> open N {x :e R :^: idx N | Q a x}) -> open N {x :e R :^: idx N | exists a :e A, P a /\ Q a x}

items.name: OPEN_GENERAL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: (R :^: idx N) :^: Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, y :e c s x -> x :e s /\ y :e s) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, y :e c s x -> x :e c s y) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, y :e c s x /\ z :e c s y -> z :e c s x) /\ ((forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ y :e c s x -> y :e c t x) /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, y :e ball N (x,e0) /\ ball N (x,e0) c= s -> y :e c (ball N (x,e0)) x)))) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N (c s x)

items.name: OPEN_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, open N {x :e R :^: idx N | a < x k}

items.name: OPEN_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, open N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k < a}

items.name: OPEN_HALFSPACE_GT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, open A {x :e R :^: idx A | b < dot A a x}

items.name: OPEN_HALFSPACE_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall b :e R, open A {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x < b}

items.name: OPEN_HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_CLOSED_IN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, metrizable_space A top /\ s :e top -> exists t c= A :*: R, closed_in (A :*: R) (prod_topology A R top euclideanreal) t /\ homeomorphic_space A (A :*: R) (subtopology A top s) (subtopology (A :*: R) (prod_topology A R top euclideanreal) t)

items.name: OPEN_IMP_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> analytic N s

items.name: OPEN_IMP_ANR

items.name: OPEN_IMP_BAIRE1_INDICATOR

items.name: OPEN_IMP_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> borel N s

items.name: OPEN_IMP_BOREL_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top -> borel_in A top s

items.name: OPEN_IMP_ENR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> ENR N s

items.name: OPEN_IMP_FSIGMA

items.name: OPEN_IMP_FSIGMA_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, metrizable_space A top /\ s :e top -> s :e fsigma_in A top

items.name: OPEN_IMP_GDELTA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> gdelta N s

items.name: OPEN_IMP_GDELTA_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top -> s :e gdelta_in A top

items.name: OPEN_IMP_INFINITE

items.name: OPEN_IMP_LOCALLY_COMPACT

items.name: OPEN_IMP_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: OPEN_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED

items.name: OPEN_IN

items.name: OPEN_INSIDE

items.name: OPEN_INTER

items.name: OPEN_INTERIOR

items.name: OPEN_INTERS

items.name: OPEN_INTERVAL

items.name: OPEN_INTERVAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) <-> closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open N (open_interval N (a,b))

items.name: OPEN_INTERVAL_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b :e R :^: idx N, open N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i < b i}

items.name: OPEN_INTERVAL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall a b x :e R, a < x /\ x < b -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R, abs_SNo (x' + - x) < d -> a < x' /\ x' < b

items.name: OPEN_INTERVAL_MIDPOINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty -> vector_mul N (recip_SNo 2) (vector_add N a b) :e open_interval N (a,b)

items.name: OPEN_INTERVAL_RIGHT

items.name: OPEN_INTER_CLOSURE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> s :/\: closure N t = s :/\: closure N (s :/\: t)

items.name: OPEN_INTER_CLOSURE_EQ_EMPTY

items.name: OPEN_INTER_OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top -> s :/\: t :e subtopology A top t

items.name: OPEN_INVERTIBLE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (invertible N M (matrix M N f) /\ open M s) -> open N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: OPEN_IN_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall v c= A :+: 1, v :e alexandroff_compactification A top <-> (exists u c= A, u :e top /\ v = {Inj0 x | x :e u}) \/ exists c c= A, compact_in A top c /\ (closed_in A top c /\ v = SetAdjoin {Inj0 x | x :e topspace A top :\: c} (Inj1 0))

items.name: OPEN_IN_ANALYTIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ analytic N t -> analytic N s

items.name: OPEN_IN_BOREL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ borel N t -> borel N s

items.name: OPEN_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, finite k -> ({f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} :e product_topology A K k tops <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i :e tops i)

items.name: OPEN_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT_GEN
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} :e product_topology A K k tops <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ s i = topspace A (tops i)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i :e tops i

items.name: OPEN_IN_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, Empty :e top /\ ((forall s t c= A, s :e top /\ t :e top -> s :/\: t :e top) /\ forall k c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e k -> s :e top) -> Union k :e top)

items.name: OPEN_IN_CLOSED_IN

items.name: OPEN_IN_CLOSED_IN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ closed_in A top (topspace A top :\: s)

items.name: OPEN_IN_COMPONENTS_LOCALLY_CONNECTED

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} u) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s :\: {vec N 0} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} u))

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, finite {{x1 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x0 x1} | x0 :e R :^: idx N, x0 :e s} -> {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, finite (components N s) /\ c :e components N s -> c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, locally_connected_space A top /\ c :e connected_components_of A top -> c :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x0} s -> {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, locally_connected_space A top -> {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0} :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONTAINS_CBALL

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PREIMAGE

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PREIMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall u c= A, forall v c= B, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (u :e top /\ v :e top') -> {x :e A | x :e u /\ f x :e v} :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_CONVEX_MEETS_RELATIVE_INTERIOR

items.name: OPEN_IN_CROSS

items.name: OPEN_IN_DELETE

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, s :e discrete_topology A u <-> s c= u

items.name: OPEN_IN_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall u :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e u (p 0)} :e sum_topology A K k top <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> u i :e top i

items.name: OPEN_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, Empty :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx A, x :e euclidean A <-> open A x

items.name: OPEN_IN_EUCLIDEAN_METRIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, x :e mtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) <-> open N x

items.name: OPEN_IN_FINITE_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, finite (connected_components_of A top) /\ c :e connected_components_of A top -> c :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_FINITE_QUASI_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, finite (quasi_components_of A top) /\ c :e quasi_components_of A top -> c :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_FSIGMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ fsigma N t -> fsigma N s

items.name: OPEN_IN_GDELTA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ gdelta N t -> gdelta N s

items.name: OPEN_IN_HAUSDORFF_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, hausdorff_space A top /\ s :e top -> s :\: {x} :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_IMP_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: OPEN_IN_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, t :e subtopology A top s -> t c= s

items.name: OPEN_IN_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> ({f x | x :e s} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e t} <-> s :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) t)

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top /\ t :e top -> s :/\: t :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall t c= A, t :e s -> t :e top)) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e s, x :e Y} :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTER_CLOSURE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ t c= u -> (s :/\: closure N t = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTER_CLOSURE_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top -> s :/\: closure_of A top t = s :/\: closure_of A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTER_CLOSURE_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top -> (s :/\: closure_of A top t = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTER_CLOSURE_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top -> s :/\: closure_of A top t c= closure_of A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTER_DERIVED_SET_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top -> s :/\: derived_set_of A top t = s :/\: derived_set_of A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTER_DERIVED_SET_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top -> s :/\: derived_set_of A top t c= derived_set_of A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: OPEN_IN_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ open N t -> s :/\: t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u

items.name: OPEN_IN_KIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, u :e kification A top <-> u c= topspace A top /\ forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> k :/\: u :e subtopology A top k

items.name: OPEN_IN_KIFICATION_FINER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top -> s :e kification A top

items.name: OPEN_IN_LOCALLY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s <-> t c= s /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, compact N k /\ k c= s -> k :/\: t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) k)

items.name: OPEN_IN_MBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, mball A m (x,r) :e mtopology A m

items.name: OPEN_IN_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mspace A m :e mtopology A m

items.name: OPEN_IN_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall u c= A, u :e mtopology A m <-> u c= mspace A m /\ forall x :e A, x :e u -> exists r :e R, 0 < r /\ mball A m (x,r) c= u

items.name: OPEN_IN_MTOPOLOGY_MCBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall u c= A, u :e mtopology A m <-> u c= mspace A m /\ forall x :e A, x :e u -> exists r :e R, 0 < r /\ mcball A m (x,r) c= u

items.name: OPEN_IN_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, open N t /\ s = u :/\: t

items.name: OPEN_IN_OPEN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, open A s -> (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s <-> open A t /\ t c= s)

items.name: OPEN_IN_OPEN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx A, open A s -> u :/\: s :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) u

items.name: OPEN_IN_OPEN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top -> (t :e subtopology A top s <-> t :e top /\ t c= s)

items.name: OPEN_IN_OPEN_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) t /\ open A t -> open A s

items.name: OPEN_IN_PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, locally_path_connected_space A top /\ c :e path_components_of A top -> c :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_PATH_COMPONENT_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x0} s -> {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: OPEN_IN_PATH_COMPONENT_OF_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, locally_path_connected_space A top -> {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, s' :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ t' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t -> (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) :e subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: OPEN_IN_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) :e subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s' = Empty \/ (t' = Empty \/ s' :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ t' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)

items.name: OPEN_IN_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall t c= K, forall x c= A :^: K, x :e product_topology A K t tops <-> exists u c= Power (A :^: K), True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e relative_to (A :^: K) {x01 :e Power (A :^: K) | exists u c= Power (A :^: K), finite u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e \/_ k :e K, {{x11 :e A :^: K | x11 k :e u} | u :e Power A, k :e t /\ u :e tops k}) /\ {x :e A :^: K | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} (topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K t tops))) /\ Union u = x

items.name: OPEN_IN_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_ALT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s c= A :^: K, s :e product_topology A K k tops <-> forall x :e A :^: K, x :e s -> exists u :e Power A :^: K, finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ u i = topspace A (tops i)} /\ ((forall i :e K, i :e k -> u i :e tops i) /\ (x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e u i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e u i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} c= s))

items.name: OPEN_IN_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_ALT_EXPAND
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s c= A :^: K, s :e product_topology A K k tops <-> s c= topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) /\ forall x :e A :^: K, x :e s -> exists u :e Power A :^: K, finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ u i = topspace A (tops i)} /\ ((forall i :e K, i :e k -> u i :e tops i /\ x i :e u i) /\ {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e u i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} c= s)

items.name: OPEN_IN_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s c= A :^: K, s :e product_topology A K Empty tops <-> s :e {Empty,{fun k :e K => choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}}

items.name: OPEN_IN_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall x c= A :*: B, x :e prod_topology A B top1 top2 <-> exists u c= Power (A :*: B), True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e \/_ s :e Power A, {s :*: t | t :e Power B, s :e top1 /\ t :e top2}) /\ Union u = x

items.name: OPEN_IN_PROD_TOPOLOGY_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall s c= A :*: B, s :e prod_topology A B top1 top2 <-> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, (x,y) :e s -> exists u c= A, exists v c= B, u :e top1 /\ (v :e top2 /\ (x :e u /\ (y :e v /\ u :*: v c= s)))

items.name: OPEN_IN_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, locally_connected_space A top /\ c :e quasi_components_of A top -> c :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, locally_connected_space A top -> {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0} :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: OPEN_IN_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_INTERIOR_FACET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s f c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ facet_of N f s -> relative_interior N f :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: OPEN_IN_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, relative_interior A s :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s)

items.name: OPEN_IN_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, relative_to A top s = subtopology A top s

items.name: OPEN_IN_SAME_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, conic N u /\ s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s :\: {vec N 0} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u

items.name: OPEN_IN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open_segment N (a,b) c= s /\ s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (open_segment N (a,b)) -> open_segment N (a,b) :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: OPEN_IN_SEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, 0 < setdist N (s,t) -> s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t) /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)

items.name: OPEN_IN_SET_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_interior N s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: OPEN_IN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, {a} :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s <-> a :e s /\ ~ limit_point_of A a s

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBBASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall B:set -> prop, forall u s c= A, s :e {x :e Power A | exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A {x01 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, B c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} u) /\ Union u0 = x} <-> exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall x :e u0, x :e relative_to A {x1 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, B c) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x1} u) /\ Union u0 = s

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBOPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists t c= A, t :e top /\ (x :e t /\ t c= s)

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top -> s c= topspace A top

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBSET_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} t) -> (s c= relative_interior A t <-> s c= t)

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top /\ s c= t -> s :e subtopology A top t

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBSET_TOPSPACE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, s :/\: frontier_of A top u = Empty -> (s :e subtopology A top u <-> s :e top /\ s c= u)

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, s :e subtopology A top u /\ (s c= t /\ t c= u) -> s :e subtopology A top t

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, s :e subtopology A top u <-> exists t c= A, t :e top /\ s = t :/\: u

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s c= A, s :e subtopology A top u <-> s :e {u :/\: t | t :e Power A, t :e top}

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_BOREL_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall t s c= A, s :e subtopology A top t /\ borel_in A top t -> borel_in A top s

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_DIFF_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ closed_in A top t -> s :\: t :e subtopology A top s

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e subtopology A top Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, t :e top -> s :/\: t :e subtopology A top s

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_INTER_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, s :e subtopology A top u /\ t :e top -> s :/\: t :e subtopology A top u

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_INTER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s u v c= A, u :/\: s :e subtopology A top u /\ v c= u -> v :/\: s :e subtopology A top v

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, u :e subtopology A top u <-> u c= topspace A top

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, s :e subtopology A top t /\ s :e subtopology A top u -> s :e subtopology A top (t :\/: u)

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUM_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall u c= K :*: A, u :e sum_topology A K k top <-> u c= {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e {x0 :e A | {x0 :e A | x0 :e topspace A (top (p 0))} x0}} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> {x :e A | (i,x) :e u} :e top i

items.name: OPEN_IN_SUM_TOPOLOGY_ALT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall u c= K :*: A, u :e sum_topology A K k top <-> exists t :e Power A :^: K, u = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> t i :e top i

items.name: OPEN_IN_TOPOLOGY_BASE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall B c= Power A, (forall x c= A, x :e top <-> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e B) /\ Union u = x) <-> (forall v c= A, v :e B -> v :e top) /\ forall u c= A, forall x :e A, u :e top /\ x :e u -> exists v c= A, v :e B /\ (x :e v /\ v c= u)

items.name: OPEN_IN_TOPOLOGY_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall b c= Power A, (forall x c= A, x :e top <-> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e b) /\ Union u = x) <-> (forall u c= A, u :e b -> u :e top) /\ neighbourhood_base_of A b top

items.name: OPEN_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_TOPSPACE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, topspace A top = Empty -> (s :e top <-> s = Empty)

items.name: OPEN_IN_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, s :e subtopology A top t /\ t :e subtopology A top u -> s :e subtopology A top u

items.name: OPEN_IN_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s t c= R :^: idx A, {vector_add A a x | x :e s} :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) {vector_add A a x | x :e t} <-> s :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) t

items.name: OPEN_IN_TRANS_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t -> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: OPEN_IN_TRANS_FULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s u c= A, s :e subtopology A top u /\ u :e top -> s :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top /\ t :e top -> s :\/: t :e top

items.name: OPEN_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e k -> s :e top) -> Union k :e top

items.name: OPEN_LIFT
items.statement: forall s c= R, open 1 {lift x | x :e s} <-> forall x :e R, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x' :e R, abs_SNo (x' + - x) < e0 -> x' :e s

items.name: OPEN_MAP_CLOSED_SUPERSET_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, forall w c= R :^: idx N, (forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e k} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u /\ (w c= t /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e w} c= u)) -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) v /\ (w c= v /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} c= u)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_CLOSED_SUPERSET_PREIMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e k} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx M, forall w c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u /\ (w c= t /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e w} c= u) -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) v /\ (w c= v /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} c= u))

items.name: OPEN_MAP_COMPONENT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> open_map A (K :*: A) (top i,sum_topology A K k top) (fun x:set => (i,x))

items.name: OPEN_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> open_map A B (top,top') f /\ open_map B C (top',top'') g -> open_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: OPEN_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) /\ open_map A B (top,top') f -> open_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: OPEN_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g t /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ g x = g y) -> x = y) /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {g (f x) | x :e k} :e subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u)))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e k} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t

items.name: OPEN_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> open_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> open_map B C (top',top'') g

items.name: OPEN_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> open_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ (continuous_map B C (top',top'') g /\ (forall x y :e B, x :e topspace B top' /\ (y :e topspace B top' /\ g x = g y) -> x = y))) -> open_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: OPEN_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {g (f x) | x :e k} :e subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t -> {g x | x :e k} :e subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u

items.name: OPEN_MAP_FROM_OPEN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> s :e top' /\ open_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f -> open_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: OPEN_MAP_FROM_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, open_map A B (top,top') f /\ u :e top -> open_map A B (subtopology A top u,top') f

items.name: OPEN_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, open_map (A :*: B) A (prod_topology A B top1 top2,top1) (fun x:set => x 0)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_FSTCART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), open (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s -> open M {fstcart M x | x :e s}

items.name: OPEN_MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, open_map A A (top,top) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_IFF_CLOSED_MAP_BIJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) <-> forall c c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) c -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e c})

items.name: OPEN_MAP_IFF_LOWER_HEMICONTINUOUS_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {y :e R :^: idx N | y :e t /\ {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = y} c= u})

items.name: OPEN_MAP_IMP_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e {f x | x :e u}})) -> forall u c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e u}

items.name: OPEN_MAP_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx M, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s}) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= {f x | x :e s} -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) {f x | x :e s})

items.name: OPEN_MAP_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, open_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ s c= topspace A top1 -> {f x | x :e s} c= topspace B top2

items.name: OPEN_MAP_IMP_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> open_map A B (top1,top2) f -> {f x | x :e topspace A top1} c= topspace B top2

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INCLUSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top -> open_map A A (subtopology A top s,top) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INCLUSION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, open_map A A (subtopology A top s,top) (fun x:set => x) <-> topspace A top :/\: s :e top

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, open_map A (A :+: 1) (top,alexandroff_compactification A top) (fun x:set => Inj0 x)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INTERIORS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> ((forall s c= R :^: idx M, open M s -> open N {f x | x :e s}) <-> forall s c= R :^: idx M, {f x | x :e interior M s} c= interior N {f x | x :e s})

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INTERIOR_OF_IMAGE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (open_map A B (top,top') f <-> forall s c= A, {f x | x :e interior_of A top s} c= interior_of B top' {f x | x :e s})

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INTERIOR_OF_IMAGE_SUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (open_map A B (top,top') f <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> {f x | x :e interior_of A top s} c= interior_of B top' {f x | x :e s})

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INTERIOR_OF_IMAGE_SUBSET_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (open_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall s c= A, {f x | x :e interior_of A top s} c= interior_of B top' {f x | x :e s})

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INTO_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= B, open_map A B (top,discrete_topology B u) f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= u

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INTO_K_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ (forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> open_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k},subtopology B top' k) f)) -> open_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INTO_K_SPACE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' -> (open_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> open_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k},subtopology B top' k) f)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_INTO_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= B, open_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= s -> open_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f

items.name: OPEN_MAP_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> s :e top' -> (open_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f <-> open_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= s)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, open_map A A (top,subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e topspace A top}) (fun x:set => kolmogorov_quotient A top x)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, u :e top -> {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e u} = {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e topspace A top} :/\: u

items.name: OPEN_MAP_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, open_map A A (subtopology A top s,subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e s}) (fun x:set => kolmogorov_quotient A top x)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> topspace A top = Empty -> open_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: OPEN_MAP_PREIMAGE_NEIGHBOURHOOD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (open_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall u c= A, forall t c= B, closed_in A top u /\ (t c= topspace B top' /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e t} c= u) -> exists v c= B, closed_in B top' v /\ (t c= v /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e v} c= u))

items.name: OPEN_MAP_PROD
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top1' :e topology C, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top2' :e topology D, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e D) -> (open_map (A :*: B) (C :*: D) (prod_topology A B top1 top2,prod_topology C D top1' top2') (fun p:set => (f (p 0),g (p 1))) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ open_map A C (top1,top1') f /\ open_map B D (top2,top2') g)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall top':set -> set, (forall x :e K, top' x :e topology B) -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> (open_map (A :^: K) (B :^: K) (product_topology A K k top,product_topology B K k top') (fun x:set => fun x0 :e K => if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k top) = Empty \/ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ({f i x | x :e topspace A (top i)} c= topspace B (top' i) /\ {f i x | x :e topspace A (top i)} <> topspace B (top' i))} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> open_map A B (top i,top' i) (f i))

items.name: OPEN_MAP_PRODUCT_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall t c= K, forall k :e K, k :e t -> open_map (A :^: K) A (product_topology A K t tops,tops k) (fun x:set => x k)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, (forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) /\ t' c= t -> forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e t'} -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t'

items.name: OPEN_MAP_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, forall v c= B, open_map A B (top,top') f /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e v} = u -> open_map A B (subtopology A top u,subtopology B top' v) f

items.name: OPEN_MAP_SND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, open_map (A :*: B) B (prod_topology A B top1 top2,top2) (fun x:set => x 1)

items.name: OPEN_MAP_SNDCART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), open (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) s -> open N {sndcart M N x | x :e s}

items.name: OPEN_MEASURABLE_INNER_DIVISION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, open N s /\ (measurable N s /\ 0 < e0) -> exists D c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N D (Union D) /\ (Union D c= s /\ measure N s < measure N (Union D) + e0)

items.name: OPEN_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N {vector_neg N x | x :e s}

items.name: OPEN_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_AT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall P c= Power A, forall x :e A, (forall s c= A, s :e P /\ x :e s -> s :e top) -> (neighbourhood_base_at A x P top <-> forall w c= A, w :e top /\ x :e w -> exists u c= A, u :e P /\ (x :e u /\ u c= w))

items.name: OPEN_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall P c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e P -> s :e top) -> (neighbourhood_base_of A P top <-> forall w c= A, forall x :e A, w :e top /\ x :e w -> exists u c= A, u :e P /\ (x :e u /\ u c= w))

items.name: OPEN_NON_GENERAL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: (R :^: idx N) :^: Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, y :e c s x -> x :e s /\ y :e s) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, y :e c s x -> x :e c s y) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, y :e c s x /\ z :e c s y -> z :e c s x) /\ ((forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ y :e c s x -> y :e c t x) /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, y :e ball N (x,e0) /\ ball N (x,e0) c= s -> y :e c (ball N (x,e0)) x)))) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N (s :\: c s x)

items.name: OPEN_NON_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N (s :\: {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0})

items.name: OPEN_NOT_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> ~ negligible N s

items.name: OPEN_OPEN_IN_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, open A s /\ (open A t /\ t c= s) -> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s

items.name: OPEN_OPEN_LEFT_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), open M s /\ open (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) t -> open M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ exists y :e R :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y :e t}

items.name: OPEN_OPEN_RIGHT_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), open N s /\ open (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) t -> open N {y :e R :^: idx N | y :e s /\ exists x :e R :^: idx M, pastecart M N x y :e t}

items.name: OPEN_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> open N (outside N s)

items.name: OPEN_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0}

items.name: OPEN_PATH_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, open N s -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s x x0 <-> connected_component N s x x0

items.name: OPEN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, open M s /\ open N t -> open (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: OPEN_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, open (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ open M s /\ open N t)

items.name: OPEN_POSITIVE_MULTIPLES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N (\/_ c :e R, {vector_mul N c x | x :e R :^: idx N, 0 < c /\ x :e s})

items.name: OPEN_POSITIVE_ORTHANT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> open N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 < x i}

items.name: OPEN_QUASI_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e top -> (c :e quasi_components_of A top <-> c :e connected_components_of A top)

items.name: OPEN_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t :e relative_to (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | open N x} s <-> t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s

items.name: OPEN_SCALING
