items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, ~ c = 0 /\ open N s -> open N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s}

items.name: OPEN_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, open N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> (c = 0 -> s = Empty) /\ open N s

items.name: OPEN_SEGMENT_1
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, open 1 (open_segment 1 (a,b))

items.name: OPEN_SEGMENT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> open_segment N (a,b) = {vector_add N (vector_mul N (1 + - u) a) (vector_mul N u b) | u :e R, 0 < u /\ u < 1}

items.name: OPEN_SEGMENT_DESCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R, forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, 0 < a /\ (0 <= b /\ (0 < c /\ (vector_mul N b y :e open_segment N (vector_mul N a x,vector_mul N c z) /\ (~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} {x,y,z} /\ ~ (x = y /\ z = y))))) -> y :e open_segment N (x,z)

items.name: OPEN_SEGMENT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> open_segment N (f a,f b) = {f x | x :e open_segment M (a,b)}

items.name: OPEN_SEGMENT_SUBSET_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall u v :e R :^: idx N, u :e cball N (a,r) /\ v :e cball N (a,r) -> open_segment N (u,v) c= ball N (a,r)

items.name: OPEN_SET_COCOUNTABLE_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> countable (R :\: {x :e R | P i x})) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (x i)

items.name: OPEN_SET_COSMALL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> atleastp (R :\: {x :e R | P i x}) R /\ ~ equip (R :\: {x :e R | P i x}) R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> P i (x i)

items.name: OPEN_SET_IRRATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> ~ x i :e rational

items.name: OPEN_SET_RATIONAL_COORDINATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i :e rational

items.name: OPEN_STRIP_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, open N {x :e R :^: idx N | abs_SNo (x k) < a}

items.name: OPEN_SUBOPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx A, open A t /\ (x :e t /\ t c= s)

items.name: OPEN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ open N s -> s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t

items.name: OPEN_SUBSET_CLOSURE_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ convex N s -> (u c= closure N s <-> u c= interior N s)

items.name: OPEN_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, open N s \/ open N t -> open N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: OPEN_SURJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, open M s -> open N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: OPEN_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, open N s -> open N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: OPEN_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> open N s

items.name: OPEN_TRANSLATION_SUBSET_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ open N t -> open N {a :e R :^: idx N | {vector_add N a x | x :e s} c= t}

items.name: OPEN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, open A s /\ open A t -> open A (s :\/: t)

items.name: OPEN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx A), (forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e f -> open A s) -> open A (Union f)

items.name: OPEN_UNION_COMPACT_SUBSETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> exists f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, compact N (f n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n c= s) /\ ((forall n :e omega, f n c= interior N (f (n + 1))) /\ (Union {f n | n :e omega, n :e omega} = s /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, compact N k /\ k c= s -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, N0 <= n -> k c= f n)))

items.name: OPEN_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> open N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: OPERATIVE_1_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx 1), f x :e A) -> (operative A 1 op f <-> (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop b <= drop a -> f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = neutral_of A op) /\ forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop c /\ drop c <= drop b -> op (f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil))) (f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil))) = f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: OPERATIVE_1_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx 1), f x :e A) -> (operative A 1 op f <-> (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop b <= drop a -> f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = neutral_of A op) /\ forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, drop a < drop c /\ drop c < drop b -> op (f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil))) (f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil))) = f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: OPERATIVE_CONTENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> operative R A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x + x0) (fun x:set => content A x)

items.name: OPERATIVE_DIVISION
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), f x :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) /\ (operative A N op f /\ division_of N d (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> iterate_op A op d f = f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: OPERATIVE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), f x :e A) -> operative A N op f -> f Empty = neutral_of A op

items.name: OPERATIVE_FUNCTION_ENDPOINT_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> operative (R :^: idx N) 1 (fun x:set => fun x0:set => vector_add N x x0) (fun k:set => vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 k)) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 k)))

items.name: OPERATIVE_INTEGRAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> operative (1 :+: R :^: idx N) M (fun x:set => fun x0:set => lifted (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) (fun x :e R :^: idx N => fun x0 :e R :^: idx N => vector_add N x x0) x x0) (fun i:set => if integrable_on N M f i then Inj1 (integral N M i f) else Inj0 0)

items.name: OPERATIVE_LIFTED_SETVARIATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> operative (R :^: idx N) M (fun x:set => fun x0:set => vector_add N x x0) f -> operative (1 :+: R) M (fun x:set => fun x0:set => lifted R R (fun x :e R => fun x0 :e R => x + x0) x x0) (fun i:set => if has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f i then Inj1 (set_variation M N i f) else Inj0 0)

items.name: OPERATIVE_LIFTED_VECTOR_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> operative (1 :+: R) 1 (fun x:set => fun x0:set => lifted R R (fun x :e R => fun x0 :e R => x + x0) x x0) (fun i:set => if has_bounded_variation_on N f i then Inj1 (vector_variation N i f) else Inj0 0)

items.name: OPERATIVE_REAL_FUNCTION_ENDPOINT_DIFF
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> operative R 1 (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x + x0) (fun k:set => f (interval_upperbound 1 k) + - f (interval_lowerbound 1 k))

items.name: OPERATIVE_TAGGED_DIVISION
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> forall d c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), f x :e A) -> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) /\ (operative A N op f /\ tagged_division_of N d (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> iterate_op A op d (fun p:set => f (p 1)) = f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: OPERATIVE_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx B), f x :e A) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx B, operative A B op f /\ content B (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> f (closed_interval B (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = neutral_of A op

items.name: OPPOSITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, group_carrier A (opposite_group A G) = group_carrier A G /\ (group_id A (opposite_group A G) = group_id A G /\ ((forall x :e A, group_inv A (opposite_group A G) x = group_inv A G x) /\ forall x y :e A, group_mul A (opposite_group A G) x y = group_mul A G y x))

items.name: OPPOSITE_GROUP_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, group_inv A (opposite_group A G) x = group_inv A G x

items.name: OPPOSITE_GROUP_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, group_mul A (opposite_group A G) x y = group_mul A G y x

items.name: OPPOSITE_GROUP_SETINV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_setinv A (opposite_group A G) s = group_setinv A G s

items.name: OPPOSITE_GROUP_SETMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_setmul A (opposite_group A G) s t = group_setmul A G t s

items.name: OPPOSITE_OPPOSITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, opposite_group A (opposite_group A G) = G

items.name: OPPOSITE_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall k c= K, opposite_group (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) = product_group A K k (fun i:set => opposite_group A (G i))

items.name: OPPOSITE_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G1 :e group_hl A, forall G2 :e group_hl B, opposite_group (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G1 G2) = prod_group A B (opposite_group A G1) (opposite_group B G2)

items.name: OPPOSITE_SINGLETON_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, opposite_group A (singleton_group A a) = singleton_group A a

items.name: ORBIT_STABILIZER
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s) -> finite_cardinality {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} = finite_cardinality {left_coset_hl A G g (group_stabilizer A X G a x) | g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G}

items.name: ORBIT_STABILIZER_GEN
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s -> equip {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} {left_coset_hl A G g (group_stabilizer A X G a x) | g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G}

items.name: ORBIT_STABILIZER_MUL
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s) -> finite_cardinality {x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} * finite_cardinality (group_stabilizer A X G a x) = finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)

items.name: ORBIT_STABILIZER_MUL_GEN
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s -> equip ({x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} :*: group_stabilizer A X G a x) (group_carrier A G)

items.name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_CARD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 :e Power A :^: A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall z :e A, forall k :e omega, finite {R0 (iter_fun n f z) | n :e omega, n :e omega} /\ (finite_cardinality {R0 (iter_fun n f z) | n :e omega, n :e omega} <= k /\ (z :e R0 z /\ ((forall x y :e A, y :e R0 x -> x :e R0 y) /\ ((forall x y z0 :e A, y :e R0 x /\ z0 :e R0 y -> z0 :e R0 x) /\ (forall x y :e A, f y :e R0 (f x) <-> y :e R0 x))))) -> exists d :e omega, 0 < d /\ (d <= k /\ forall n :e omega, z :e R0 (iter_fun n f z) <-> divides_nat d n)

items.name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 :e Power A :^: A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall z :e A, finite {R0 (iter_fun n f z) | n :e omega, n :e omega} /\ (z :e R0 z /\ ((forall x y :e A, y :e R0 x -> x :e R0 y) /\ ((forall x y z0 :e A, y :e R0 x /\ z0 :e R0 y -> z0 :e R0 x) /\ (forall x y :e A, f y :e R0 (f x) <-> y :e R0 x)))) -> exists d :e omega, 0 < d /\ forall n :e omega, z :e R0 (iter_fun n f z) <-> divides_nat d n

items.name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> P (f 0) /\ (forall m n :e omega, P (f m) /\ ~ m = 0 -> (P (f (m + n)) <-> P (f n))) -> exists d :e omega, forall n :e omega, P (f n) <-> divides_nat d n

items.name: ORDER_EXISTENCE_ITER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall z :e A, R0 z z /\ ((forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> R0 y x) /\ ((forall x y z0 :e A, R0 x y /\ R0 y z0 -> R0 x z0) /\ (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> R0 (f x) (f y)))) -> exists d :e omega, forall n :e omega, R0 (iter_fun n f z) z <-> divides_nat d n

items.name: ORDER_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> finite_cardinality (group_carrier int (integer_mod_group n)) = n

items.name: ORDINAL_CHAINED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ ordinal_on A m -> inseg_on A m l \/ inseg_on A l m

items.name: ORDINAL_CHAINED_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall k l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ ordinal_on A m -> inseg_on A k l /\ inseg_on A k m -> (forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> l x x0) \/ ((forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> m x x0) \/ exists a :e A, a :e fld_on A l /\ (a :e fld_on A m /\ ((forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> linseg_rel l a x x0) /\ forall x x0 :e A, k x x0 <-> linseg_rel m a x x0)))

items.name: ORDINAL_FLD_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ (ordinal_on A m /\ fld_on A l c= fld_on A m) -> inseg_on A l m

items.name: ORDINAL_FLD_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ ordinal_on A m -> (fld_on A l c= fld_on A m <-> inseg_on A l m)

items.name: ORDINAL_FLD_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l m:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ (ordinal_on A m /\ fld_on A l = fld_on A m) -> forall x x0 :e A, l x x0 <-> m x x0

items.name: ORDINAL_IMP_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l -> woset_on A l

items.name: ORDINAL_SUC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l /\ (exists x :e A, ~ x :e fld_on A l) -> ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => l x y \/ y = choose_in A (fun y0:set => ~ y0 :e fld_on A l) /\ (x :e fld_on A l \/ x = choose_in A (fun y0:set => ~ y0 :e fld_on A l)))

items.name: ORDINAL_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall l :e Power A :^: A, P l -> ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e l x)) -> ordinal_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => exists l :e Power A :^: A, P l /\ y :e l x)

items.name: ORDINAL_UNION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, ordinal_on A l -> x :e fld_on A l -> x :e fld_on A (fun a:set => fun b:set => exists l0:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l0 /\ l0 a b)

items.name: ORDINAL_UP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l -> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l) \/ exists m:set -> set -> prop, exists x :e A, ordinal_on A m /\ (x :e fld_on A m /\ ~ x :e fld_on A l)

items.name: ORIENTED_SIMPLEX_EQ
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall l:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, l x y :e R) -> forall l':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, l' x y :e R) -> ((forall x :e R :^: omega, forall x0 :e omega, oriented_simplex p l x x0 = oriented_simplex p l' x x0) <-> forall i :e omega, i <= p -> forall x :e omega, l i x = l' i x)

items.name: ORTHOGONALITY_PRESERVING_EQ_SIMILARITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N x y -> orthogonal N (f x) (f y)) <-> exists c :e R, exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N g /\ forall z :e R :^: idx N, f z = vector_mul N c (g z)))

items.name: ORTHOGONALITY_PRESERVING_EQ_SIMILARITY_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N x y -> orthogonal N (f x) (f y)) <-> exists c :e R, exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (0 <= c /\ (orthogonal_transformation N g /\ forall z :e R :^: idx N, f z = vector_mul N c (g z))))

items.name: ORTHOGONALITY_PRESERVING_IMP_SCALING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, orthogonal M x y -> orthogonal N (f x) (f y)) -> exists c :e R, 0 <= c /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = c * vector_norm M x

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A (vec A 0) x /\ orthogonal A x (vec A 0)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_AND_COLLINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N x y /\ collinear N {vec N 0,x,y} <-> x = vec N 0 \/ y = vec N 0

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_ANY_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> orthogonal N (vector_sub N x b) (vector_sub N a b)) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> distance N (a,b) <= distance N (a,x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> (orthogonal N (basis N i) x <-> x i = 0)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_BASIS_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> (orthogonal N (basis N i) (basis N j) <-> ~ i = j)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_BASIS_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx N, exists b c= R :^: idx N, independent N b /\ (b c= span N v /\ (v c= span N b /\ (equip b (dim N v) /\ forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y)))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_BASIS_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, ~ vec N 0 :e b /\ (b c= s /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ (independent N b /\ (equip b (dim N s) /\ span N b = s))))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C D E F G H I J:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> F <> Empty -> G <> Empty -> H <> Empty -> I <> Empty -> J <> Empty -> (forall a :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A a (vec A 0)) /\ ((forall a x :e R :^: idx B, forall c :e R, orthogonal B a x -> orthogonal B a (vector_mul B c x)) /\ ((forall a x :e R :^: idx E, orthogonal E a x -> orthogonal E a (vector_neg E x)) /\ ((forall a x y :e R :^: idx F, orthogonal F a x /\ orthogonal F a y -> orthogonal F a (vector_add F x y)) /\ ((forall a x y :e R :^: idx G, orthogonal G a x /\ orthogonal G a y -> orthogonal G a (vector_sub G x y)) /\ ((forall a :e R :^: idx C, orthogonal C (vec C 0) a) /\ ((forall a x :e R :^: idx D, forall c :e R, orthogonal D x a -> orthogonal D (vector_mul D c x) a) /\ ((forall a x :e R :^: idx H, orthogonal H x a -> orthogonal H (vector_neg H x) a) /\ ((forall a x y :e R :^: idx I, orthogonal I x a /\ orthogonal I y a -> orthogonal I (vector_add I x y) a) /\ forall a x y :e R :^: idx J, orthogonal J x a /\ orthogonal J y a -> orthogonal J (vector_sub J x y) a))))))))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s :\/: u, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ span N (s :\/: u) = span N (s :\/: t)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_EXTENSION_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :/\: SetAdjoin s (vec N 0) = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e s :\/: u, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ span N (s :\/: u) = span N (s :\/: t))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_IMP_INDEPENDENT_SUBSPACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e t -> orthogonal N a b) -> s :/\: t c= {vec N 0}

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm M x0) -> (orthogonal N (f x) (f y) <-> orthogonal M x y)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A (vector_neg A x) y <-> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_LVSUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, forall y :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> orthogonal N (f x) y) -> orthogonal N (vsum A N s f) y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall Q :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N Q <-> matrix_mul N N N (transp N N Q) Q = mat N N 1

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 -> (orthogonal_matrix_hl N m <-> m = mat N N 1 \/ m = matrix_neg N N (mat N N 1))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_2
items.statement: forall A :e R :^: idx_n 2 :^: idx_n 2, orthogonal_matrix_hl (idx_n 2) A <-> A 1 1 ^ 2 + A 2 1 ^ 2 = 1 /\ (A 1 2 ^ 2 + A 2 2 ^ 2 = 1 /\ A 1 1 * A 1 2 + A 2 1 * A 2 2 = 0)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_2_ALT
items.statement: forall A :e R :^: idx_n 2 :^: idx_n 2, orthogonal_matrix_hl (idx_n 2) A <-> A 1 1 ^ 2 + A 2 1 ^ 2 = 1 /\ (A 1 1 = A 2 2 /\ A 1 2 = - A 2 1 \/ A 1 1 = - A 2 2 /\ A 1 2 = A 2 1)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> matrix_mul N N N A (transp N N A) = mat N N 1

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_EXISTS_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N a = 1 -> exists A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A /\ matrix_vector_mul N N A (basis N 1) = a

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> orthogonal_matrix_hl A (mat A A 1)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_IMP_INVERTIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A -> invertible N N A

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A -> matrix_inv N N A = transp N N A

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_INV_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N (matrix_inv N N A) <-> orthogonal_matrix_hl N A

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> orthogonal_transformation N f -> orthogonal_matrix_hl N (matrix N N f)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall A0 B :e R :^: idx A :^: idx A, orthogonal_matrix_hl A A0 /\ orthogonal_matrix_hl A B -> orthogonal_matrix_hl A (matrix_mul A A A A0 B)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A -> vector_norm N (matrix_vector_mul N N A x) = vector_norm N x

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_NORM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx A, orthogonal_matrix_hl A A0 <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (matrix_vector_mul A A A0 x) = vector_norm A x

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ORTHOGONAL_EIGENVECTORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall v w :e R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A /\ (matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N a v /\ (matrix_vector_mul N N A w = vector_mul N b w /\ ~ a = b)) -> orthogonal N v w

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ORTHONORMAL_COLUMNS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (column N N i A) = 1) /\ forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ i = j))) -> orthogonal N (column N N i A) (column N N j A)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ORTHONORMAL_COLUMNS_INDEXED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (column N N i A) = 1) /\ forall x y :e idx N, x <> y -> orthogonal N (column N N x A) (column N N y A)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ORTHONORMAL_COLUMNS_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> finite_cardinality (columns N N A) = dimindex N /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (column N N i A) = 1) /\ forall x y :e columns N N A, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ORTHONORMAL_COLUMNS_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> span N (columns N N A) = R :^: idx N /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (column N N i A) = 1) /\ forall x y :e columns N N A, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ORTHONORMAL_ROWS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (row N N i A) = 1) /\ forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ i = j))) -> orthogonal N (row N N i A) (row N N j A)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ORTHONORMAL_ROWS_INDEXED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (row N N i A) = 1) /\ forall x y :e idx N, x <> y -> orthogonal N (row N N x A) (row N N y A)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ORTHONORMAL_ROWS_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> finite_cardinality (rows N N A) = dimindex N /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (row N N i A) = 1) /\ forall x y :e rows N N A, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_ORTHONORMAL_ROWS_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> span N (rows N N A) = R :^: idx N /\ ((forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> vector_norm N (row N N i A) = 1) /\ forall x y :e rows N N A, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_TRANSFORMATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N A <-> orthogonal_transformation N (fun x:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N (transp N N A) <-> orthogonal_matrix_hl N A

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_TRANSP_LMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P -> matrix_mul N N N (transp N N P) P = mat N N 1

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MATRIX_TRANSP_RMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P -> matrix_mul N N N P (transp N N P) = mat N N 1

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N (vector_mul N a x) y <-> a = 0 \/ orthogonal N x y) /\ forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N x (vector_mul N a y) <-> a = 0 \/ orthogonal N x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_NULLSPACE_ROWSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vec N 0 /\ y :e span M (rows N M A) -> orthogonal M x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal_transformation N f -> (orthogonal N (f x) (f y) <-> orthogonal N x y)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_PROJECTION_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N (vector_sub N (f x) x) (vector_sub N (f x) (f y))) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N (vector_sub N (f x) x) (f y))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_PROJECTION_EQ_SELF_ADJOINT_IDEMPOTENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f -> ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N (vector_sub N (f x) x) (vector_sub N (f x) (f y))) <-> (forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (f x) = f x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A x x <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A x (vector_neg A y) <-> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_ROTATION_OR_ROTOINVERSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall Q :e R :^: idx A :^: idx A, orthogonal_matrix_hl A Q <-> rotation_matrix A Q \/ rotoinversion_matrix A Q

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_RVSUM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> orthogonal N x (f y)) -> orthogonal N x (vsum A N s f)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SPANNINGSET_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, b c= s /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ span N b = s)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SUBSPACE_DECOMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, exists x0 :e R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N, x0 0 :e span N s /\ (x0 1 :e {z :e R :^: idx N | forall x1 :e R :^: idx N, x1 :e span N s -> orthogonal N z x1} /\ x = vector_add N (x0 0) (x0 1)) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N, y 0 :e span N s /\ (y 1 :e {z :e R :^: idx N | forall x1 :e R :^: idx N, x1 :e span N s -> orthogonal N z x1} /\ x = vector_add N (y 0) (y 1)) -> y = x0

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SUBSPACE_DECOMP_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, exists y z :e R :^: idx N, y :e span N s /\ ((forall w :e R :^: idx N, w :e span N s -> orthogonal N z w) /\ x = vector_add N y z)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SUBSPACE_DECOMP_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x y x' y' :e R :^: idx N, (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e t -> orthogonal N a b) /\ (x :e span N s /\ (x' :e span N s /\ (y :e span N t /\ (y' :e span N t /\ vector_add N x y = vector_add N x' y')))) -> x = x' /\ y = y'

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A x y <-> orthogonal A y x

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_ORTHOGONAL_2D
items.statement: forall x y z :e R :^: idx_n 2, ~ x = vec (idx_n 2) 0 /\ (orthogonal (idx_n 2) x y /\ orthogonal (idx_n 2) x z) -> collinear (idx_n 2) {vec (idx_n 2) 0,y,z}

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, (forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e s -> orthogonal A x y) -> forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e span A s -> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SPANS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, (forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e span A s /\ y :e span A t -> orthogonal A x y) <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e t -> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, (forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e span A s -> orthogonal A x y) <-> forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e s -> orthogonal A x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SUBSPACE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s < dimindex N -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x = vec N 0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> orthogonal N x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_SUBSPACE_EXISTS_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, span N s c= span N t /\ span N s <> span N t -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x = vec N 0 /\ (x :e span N t /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e span N s -> orthogonal N x y)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TO_VECTOR_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, ~ y = vec N 0 /\ orthogonal N x y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> (orthogonal_transformation A f <-> linear A A f /\ forall v :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A (f v) = vector_norm A v)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_1_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> dimindex N = 1 -> (orthogonal_transformation N f <-> (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = x) \/ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = vector_neg N x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_ADJOINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> orthogonal_transformation N f -> orthogonal_transformation N (adjoint N N f)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r :e R, orthogonal_transformation N f -> {f x | x :e ball N (vec N 0,r)} = ball N (vec N 0,r)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_BETWEEN_ORTHOGONAL_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, v x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall w:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, w x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= omega, (forall x y :e k, x <> y -> orthogonal N (v x) (v y)) /\ ((forall x y :e k, x <> y -> orthogonal N (w x) (w y)) /\ (forall i :e omega, i :e k -> vector_norm N (v i) = vector_norm N (w i))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ forall i :e omega, i :e k -> f (v i) = w i)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r :e R, orthogonal_transformation N f -> {f x | x :e cball N (vec N 0,r)} = cball N (vec N 0,r)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> orthogonal_transformation A f /\ orthogonal_transformation A g -> orthogonal_transformation A (fun x:set => f (g x))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_EQ_ADJOINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (orthogonal_transformation N f <-> linear N N f /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f (f x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (adjoint N N f x) = x))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_EQ_ADJOINT_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (orthogonal_transformation N f <-> linear N N f /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f (f x) = x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_EQ_ADJOINT_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (orthogonal_transformation N f <-> linear N N f /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (adjoint N N f x) = x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N a = vector_norm N b -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ f a = b)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_EXISTS_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N a = 1 /\ vector_norm N b = 1 -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ f a = b)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_EXISTS_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ vector_norm N a = vector_norm N b)) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ ({f x | x :e s} = s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N a x /\ orthogonal N b x -> f x = x) /\ (f a = b /\ f b = a))))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_GENERATED_BY_REFLECTIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, orthogonal_transformation N f /\ dimindex N <= dim N {x :e R :^: idx N | f x = x} + n -> exists l :e finseq (R :^: idx N), seq_len l <= n /\ (seq_all (fun v:set => ~ v = vec N 0) l /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = seq_foldr (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => fun x2 :e R :^: idx N => reflect_along N x0 (x1 x2)) l (fun x0 :e R :^: idx N => x0) x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> orthogonal_transformation A (fun x:set => x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> orthogonal_transformation A (fun x:set => x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_IMP_HOMEOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s t c= R :^: idx N, orthogonal_transformation N (fun x:set => f x) /\ {f x | x :e s} = t -> exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), orthogonal_transformation N (fun x:set => g x) /\ homeomorphism N N (s,t) (f,g)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> orthogonal_transformation N f -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_INTO_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ dim N s <= dim N t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_INVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> orthogonal_transformation N f -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, f (g y) = y))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_INVERSE_o
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> orthogonal_transformation N f -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, g (f x) = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_ISOMETRY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (orthogonal_transformation N f <-> f (vec N 0) = vec N 0 /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, distance N (f x,f y) = distance N (x,y))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_LINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> orthogonal_transformation N f -> linear N N f

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_LOWDIM_HORIZONTAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s < dimindex N -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ {f x | x :e s} c= {z :e R :^: idx N | z (dimindex N) = 0})

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (orthogonal_transformation N f <-> linear N N f /\ orthogonal_matrix_hl N (matrix N N f))

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (orthogonal_transformation N (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) <-> orthogonal_transformation N f)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_NEGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> orthogonal_transformation A (fun x:set => vector_neg A x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_ONTO_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ dim N s = dim N t) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ {f x | x :e s} = t)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_ORTHOGONAL_EIGENVECTORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall v w :e R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R, orthogonal_transformation N f /\ (f v = vector_mul N a v /\ (f w = vector_mul N b w /\ ~ a = b)) -> orthogonal N v w

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_REFLECT_ALONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal_transformation N (fun x:set => reflect_along N v x)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_REFLECT_INDUCT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P (fun x :e R :^: idx N => x) /\ (forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall a :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal_transformation N (fun x:set => f x) /\ (~ a = vec N 0 /\ P f) -> P (fun x :e R :^: idx N => reflect_along N a (f x))) -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), orthogonal_transformation N (fun x:set => f x) -> P f

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r :e R, orthogonal_transformation N f -> {f x | x :e sphere N (vec N 0,r)} = sphere N (vec N 0,r)

items.name: ORTHOGONAL_TRANSFORMATION_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> orthogonal_transformation N f -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = y

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_BASIS_EXPAND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> vector_norm N v = 1) /\ x :e span N b) -> vsum (R :^: idx N) N b (fun v:set => vector_mul N (dot N v x) v) = x

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_BASIS_EXPAND_DOT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> vector_norm N v = 1) /\ (x :e span N b \/ y :e span N b)) -> finsum b (fun v:set => dot N v x * dot N v y) = dot N x y

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_BASIS_EXPAND_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> vector_norm N v = 1) /\ x :e span N b) -> finsum b (fun v:set => dot N v x ^ 2) = vector_norm N x ^ 2

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_BASIS_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, b c= s /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e b -> vector_norm N x = 1) /\ (independent N b /\ (equip b (dim N s) /\ span N b = s))))

items.name: ORTHONORMAL_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_norm N x = 1) -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :/\: s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e s :\/: u, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u -> vector_norm N x = 1) /\ span N (s :\/: u) = span N (s :\/: t)))

items.name: OR_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall t:prop, (True \/ t <-> True) /\ ((t \/ True <-> True) /\ ((False \/ t <-> t) /\ ((t \/ False <-> t) /\ (t \/ t <-> t))))

items.name: OR_DEF
items.statement: forall p q:prop, p \/ q <-> forall r:prop, (p -> r) -> (q -> r) -> r

items.name: OR_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) \/ (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P x \/ Q x

items.name: OSTROWSKI_THEOREM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall B :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f (vector_add M x y) = vector_add N (f x) (f y)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= B) /\ (measurable M s /\ 0 < measure M s)) -> linear M N f

items.name: OUTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), outer N x y = Product N (fun s:set => fun t:set => if ~ s :/\: t = Empty then 0 else (- 1) ^ finite_cardinality (\/_ i :e omega, {(i,j) | j :e omega, i :e idx N /\ (j :e idx N /\ (i :e s /\ (j :e t /\ j < i)))})) (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => fun x2:set => x2 :e x0 :\/: x1) x y

items.name: OUTERMORPHISM_MBASIS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, s c= idx M -> outermorphism M N f (mbasis M s) = seqiterate (R :^: idx (multivector N)) (fun x :e R :^: idx (multivector N) => fun x0 :e R :^: idx (multivector N) => outer N x x0) s (fun x :e omega => multivec N (f (basis M x)))

items.name: OUTERMORPHISM_MBASIS_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> outermorphism A B f (mbasis A Empty) = mbasis B Empty

items.name: OUTER_ACI
items.statement: forall A B C D E F G:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> F <> Empty -> G <> Empty -> (forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A (outer A x y) z = outer A x (outer A y z)) /\ ((forall i j :e omega, j < i -> outer B (mbasis B {i}) (mbasis B {j}) = vector_mul (multivector B) (- 1) (outer B (mbasis B {j}) (mbasis B {i}))) /\ ((forall i j :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector C), j < i -> outer C (mbasis C {i}) (outer C (mbasis C {j}) x) = vector_mul (multivector C) (- 1) (outer C (mbasis C {j}) (outer C (mbasis C {i}) x))) /\ ((forall i :e omega, outer D (mbasis D {i}) (mbasis D {i}) = vec (multivector D) 0) /\ ((forall i :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector E), outer E (mbasis E {i}) (outer E (mbasis E {i}) x) = vec (multivector E) 0) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector F), outer F (mbasis F Empty) x = x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector G), outer G x (mbasis G Empty) = x)))))

items.name: OUTER_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector N), outer N x (outer N y z) = outer N (outer N x y) z

items.name: OUTER_LADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A (vector_add (multivector A) x y) z = vector_add (multivector A) (outer A x z) (outer A y z)

items.name: OUTER_LEBESGUE_MEASURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, exists t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (lebesgue_measurable N t /\ forall t' c= R :^: idx N, s c= t' /\ lebesgue_measurable N t' -> negligible N (t :\: t'))

items.name: OUTER_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A (vector_mul (multivector A) c x) y = vector_mul (multivector A) c (outer A x y)

items.name: OUTER_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A (vector_neg (multivector A) x) y = vector_neg (multivector A) (outer A x y)

items.name: OUTER_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A (vec (multivector A) 0) x = vec (multivector A) 0

items.name: OUTER_MBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= omega, outer N (mbasis N s) (mbasis N t) = if s c= idx N /\ (t c= idx N /\ s :/\: t = Empty) then vector_mul (multivector N) ((- 1) ^ finite_cardinality (\/_ i :e omega, {(i,j) | j :e omega, i :e s /\ (j :e t /\ j < i)})) (mbasis N (s :\/: t)) else vec (multivector N) 0

items.name: OUTER_MBASIS_LSCALAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A (mbasis A Empty) x = x

items.name: OUTER_MBASIS_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, outer A (mbasis A {i}) (mbasis A {i}) = vec (multivector A) 0

items.name: OUTER_MBASIS_RSCALAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A x (mbasis A Empty) = x

items.name: OUTER_MBASIS_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, outer N (mbasis N {i}) (mbasis N {j}) = if i :e idx N /\ (j :e idx N /\ ~ i = j) then if i < j then mbasis N {i,j} else vector_neg (multivector N) (mbasis N {i,j}) else vec (multivector N) 0

items.name: OUTER_MBASIS_SKEWSYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, outer A (mbasis A {i}) (mbasis A {j}) = vector_neg (multivector A) (outer A (mbasis A {j}) (mbasis A {i}))

items.name: OUTER_MEASURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (measurable N t /\ forall t' c= R :^: idx N, s c= t' /\ measurable N t' -> negligible N (t :\: t'))

items.name: OUTER_MEASURE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (exists t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ measurable N t) <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (measurable N t /\ forall t' c= R :^: idx N, s c= t' /\ lebesgue_measurable N t' -> negligible N (t :\: t'))

items.name: OUTER_MEASURE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s u c= R :^: idx N, s c= u /\ measurable N u -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ (measurable N t /\ forall t' c= R :^: idx N, s c= t' /\ lebesgue_measurable N t' -> negligible N (t :\: t'))

items.name: OUTER_RADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A x (vector_add (multivector A) y z) = vector_add (multivector A) (outer A x y) (outer A x z)

items.name: OUTER_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A x (vector_mul (multivector A) c y) = vector_mul (multivector A) c (outer A x y)

items.name: OUTER_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A x (vector_neg (multivector A) y) = vector_neg (multivector A) (outer A x y)

items.name: OUTER_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), outer A x (vec (multivector A) 0) = vec (multivector A) 0

items.name: OUTL_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall x :e A, OUTL A B (Inj0 x) = x

items.name: OUTR_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall y :e B, OUTR A B (Inj1 y) = y

items.name: OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, outside N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | ~ bounded_hl N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x x0}}

items.name: OUTSIDE_BOUNDED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> ~ outside N s = Empty

items.name: OUTSIDE_COMPACT_IN_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (open N t /\ (s c= t /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> ~ outside N s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: OUTSIDE_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, outside N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall B :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, B <= vector_norm N y /\ connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x y}

items.name: OUTSIDE_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, outside N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall B :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, B < vector_norm N y /\ connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x y}

items.name: OUTSIDE_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> outside N s = (R :^: idx N) :\: s

items.name: OUTSIDE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> outside N Empty = R :^: idx N

items.name: OUTSIDE_EMPTY_EQ_NO_BOUNDED_COMPONENT_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, outside N s = Empty <-> forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> bounded_hl N c

items.name: OUTSIDE_FRONTIER_EQ_COMPLEMENT_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ convex N s -> outside N (frontier N s) = (R :^: idx N) :\: closure N s

items.name: OUTSIDE_FRONTIER_MISSES_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> outside N (frontier N s) c= (R :^: idx N) :\: closure N s

items.name: OUTSIDE_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, outside N s = (R :^: idx N) :\: s :\/: inside N s

items.name: OUTSIDE_IN_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, outside N s :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) <-> connected N (outside N s) /\ ~ outside N s = Empty

items.name: OUTSIDE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx A, exists x :e R :^: idx B, f x = y)) -> outside A {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e outside B s}

items.name: OUTSIDE_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s c= t -> outside A t c= outside A s

items.name: OUTSIDE_NO_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, outside A s :/\: s = Empty

items.name: OUTSIDE_SAME_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x y /\ x :e outside N s -> y :e outside N s

items.name: OUTSIDE_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, outside N (sphere N (a,r)) = (R :^: idx N) :\: cball N (a,r)

items.name: OUTSIDE_SUBSET_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N t /\ s c= t -> (R :^: idx N) :\: t c= outside N s

items.name: OUTSIDE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, outside A {vector_add A a x | x :e s} = {vector_add A a x | x :e outside A s}

items.name: OUTSIDE_UNION_OUTSIDE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, c :/\: outside N (c1 :\/: c2) = Empty -> outside N (c1 :\/: c2) c= outside N (c1 :\/: c)

items.name: OUTSIDE_WITH_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, outside N (s :\/: outside N s) = Empty

items.name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall p x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ 1 < p -> exists n :e omega, exists q r :e R, q :e int /\ (r :e int /\ (q :/: p ^ n < x /\ (x < r :/: p ^ n /\ abs_SNo (q :/: p ^ n + - r :/: p ^ n) < e0)))

items.name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE_POS
items.statement: forall p x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (1 < p /\ 0 < x) -> exists n q r :e omega, q :/: p ^ n < x /\ (x < r :/: p ^ n /\ abs_SNo (q :/: p ^ n + - r :/: p ^ n) < e0)

items.name: PADIC_RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE_POS_LE
items.statement: forall p x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ (1 < p /\ 0 <= x) -> exists n q r :e omega, q :/: p ^ n <= x /\ (x < r :/: p ^ n /\ abs_SNo (q :/: p ^ n + - r :/: p ^ n) < e0)

items.name: PAIR
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A :*: B, (x 0,x 1) = x

items.name: PAIRED_ETA_THM
items.statement: forall A B C D E:set, C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A :*: B, f (x 0,x 1) = f x) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f x :e D) -> forall x :e A :*: (B :*: C), f (x 0,(x 1 0,x 1 1)) = f x) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D)), f x :e E) -> forall x :e A :*: (B :*: (C :*: D)), f (x 0,(x 1 0,(x 1 1 0,x 1 1 1))) = f x)

items.name: PAIRED_EXT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, l x y :e C) -> forall m:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, m x y :e C) -> ((forall x :e A, forall y :e B, l x y = m x y) <-> forall x :e A, forall x0 :e B, l x x0 = m x x0)

items.name: PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, (seq_pairwise r seq_nil <-> True) /\ (seq_pairwise r (seq_cons h t) <-> seq_all (r h) t /\ seq_pairwise r t)

items.name: PAIRWISE_AND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 R':set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R' x y) <-> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y /\ R' x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall l m :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 (seq_append l m) <-> seq_pairwise R0 l /\ (seq_pairwise R0 m /\ forall x y :e A, seq_mem x l /\ seq_mem y m -> R0 x y)

items.name: PAIRWISE_CHAIN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall c c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e c -> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e c /\ t :e c -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> forall x y :e Union c, x <> y -> R0 x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_DISJOINT_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e components N u, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty

items.name: PAIRWISE_DISJOINT_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e connected_components_of A top, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty

items.name: PAIRWISE_DISJOINT_GROUP_ORBITS
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> group_action_hl A X G s a -> forall x y :e {{x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} | x :e X, x :e s}, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty

items.name: PAIRWISE_DISJOINT_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_IMP_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall x y :e f, x <> y -> negligible N (x :/\: y)) /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ~ negligible N s) -> countable f

items.name: PAIRWISE_DISJOINT_LEFT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> forall x y :e {left_coset_hl A G a h | a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G}, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty

items.name: PAIRWISE_DISJOINT_PATH_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e path_components_of A top, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty

items.name: PAIRWISE_DISJOINT_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e quasi_components_of A top, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty

items.name: PAIRWISE_DISJOINT_RIGHT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> forall x y :e {right_coset_hl A G h a | a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G}, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty

items.name: PAIRWISE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e Empty, x <> y -> r x y) <-> True

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x y :e {f x | x :e s}, x <> y -> r x y) <-> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> ~ f x = f y -> r (f x) (f y))

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> P x y) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (P x y /\ ~ x = y)) -> Q x y) -> forall x y :e s, x <> y -> Q x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_IMPLIES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0 R':set -> set -> prop, forall l :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 l /\ (forall x y :e A, seq_mem x l /\ (seq_mem y l /\ R0 x y) -> R' x y) -> seq_pairwise R' l

items.name: PAIRWISE_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (forall x0 y :e SetAdjoin s x, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> (forall y :e A, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> r x y /\ r y x) /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_INSERT_SYMMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, forall s c= A, (forall y :e A, y :e s -> (r x y <-> r y x)) -> ((forall x0 y :e SetAdjoin s x, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> (forall y :e A, y :e s /\ ~ y = x -> r x y) /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y)

items.name: PAIRWISE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_pairwise R0 (seq_map f l) <-> seq_pairwise (fun x:set => fun y:set => R0 (f x) (f y)) l

items.name: PAIRWISE_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y) /\ t c= s -> forall x y :e t, x <> y -> r x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_ORTHOGONAL_IMP_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) -> finite s

items.name: PAIRWISE_ORTHOGONAL_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ~ vec N 0 :e s -> independent N s

items.name: PAIRWISE_SEPARATED_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e components N s, x <> y -> separated_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_SEPARATED_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e connected_components_of A top, x <> y -> separated_in A top x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_SEPARATED_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e quasi_components_of A top, x <> y -> separated_in A top x y

items.name: PAIRWISE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall r:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, (forall x0 y :e {x}, x0 <> y -> r x0 y) <-> True

items.name: PAIRWISE_TRANSITIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, forall l :e finseq A, (forall x0 y0 z :e A, R0 x0 y0 /\ R0 y0 z -> R0 x0 z) -> (seq_pairwise R0 (seq_cons x (seq_cons y l)) <-> R0 x y /\ seq_pairwise R0 (seq_cons y l))

items.name: PAIRWISE_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s t c= A, (forall x y :e s :\/: t, x <> y -> R0 x y) <-> (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ ((forall x y :e t, x <> y -> R0 x y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s :\: t /\ y :e t :\: s -> R0 x y /\ R0 y x)

items.name: PAIR_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall a :e A, forall b :e B, (x,y) = (a,b) <-> x = a /\ y = b

items.name: PAIR_EXISTS_THM
items.error: internal constant mk_pair (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: PAIR_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall p :e A :*: B, exists x :e A, exists y :e B, p = (x,y)

items.name: PARACOMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e c -> open N t) /\ s c= Union c -> exists c' c= Power (R :^: idx N), s c= Union c' /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e c' -> open N u /\ exists t c= R :^: idx N, t :e c /\ u c= t) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, open N v /\ (x :e v /\ finite {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | u :e c' /\ ~ u :/\: v = Empty}))

items.name: PARACOMPACT_HAUSDORFF_CLOSURE_REFINEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall U c= Power A, paracompact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ ((forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top)) -> exists V c= Power A, exists r :e Power A :^: Power A, (forall v c= A, v :e V -> v :e top) /\ (Union V = topspace A top /\ (locally_finite_in A top V /\ forall v c= A, v :e V -> r v :e U /\ closure_of A top v c= r v))

items.name: PARACOMPACT_HAUSDORFF_EXPANSION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall B c= Power A, paracompact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ ((forall b c= A, b :e B -> b c= topspace A top) /\ locally_finite_in A top B)) -> exists f :e Power A :^: Power A, (forall b c= A, b :e B -> f b :e top) /\ ((forall b c= A, b :e B -> b c= f b) /\ locally_finite_in A top {f b | b :e Power A, b :e B})

items.name: PARACOMPACT_HAUSDORFF_IMP_NORMAL_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, paracompact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) -> normal_space A top

items.name: PARACOMPACT_HAUSDORFF_IMP_REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, paracompact_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top -> regular_space A top

items.name: PARACOMPACT_HAUSDORFF_INDEXED_SHRINKING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall U c= Power A, paracompact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ ((forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top)) -> exists v :e Power A :^: Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> v u :e top /\ closure_of A top (v u) c= u) /\ (Union {v x | x :e U} = topspace A top /\ forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists N c= A, N :e top /\ (x :e N /\ finite {u :e Power A | u :e U /\ ~ v u :/\: N = Empty}))

items.name: PARACOMPACT_PARTITION_OF_UNITY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall U c= Power A, paracompact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ ((forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top)) -> exists phi:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e Power A, forall y :e A, phi x y :e R) /\ ((forall u c= A, u :e U -> continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) (phi u) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> 0 <= phi u x) /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ ~ phi u x = 0} c= u)) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists N c= A, N :e top /\ (x :e N /\ finite {u :e Power A | u :e U /\ ~ N :/\: {y :e A | y :e topspace A top /\ ~ phi u y = 0} = Empty})) /\ forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> finsum U (fun u:set => phi u x) = 1))

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_CLOSED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, paracompact_space A top /\ closed_in A top s -> paracompact_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, paracompact_space A (discrete_topology A u)

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_EQ_CLOSED_REFINEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top -> (paracompact_space A top <-> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top -> exists V c= Power A, (forall v c= A, v :e V -> closed_in A top v) /\ (Union V = topspace A top /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e V -> exists u c= A, u :e U /\ v c= u) /\ locally_finite_in A top V)))

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_EQ_LOCALLY_FINITE_REFINEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top -> (paracompact_space A top <-> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top -> exists V c= Power A, Union V = topspace A top /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e V -> exists u c= A, u :e U /\ v c= u) /\ locally_finite_in A top V))

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> paracompact_space (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N)

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, paracompact_space (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s)

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_FSIGMA_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, paracompact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ s :e fsigma_in A top) -> paracompact_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, paracompact_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> paracompact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f) -> paracompact_space B top'

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f /\ paracompact_space B top' -> paracompact_space A top

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_PRODUCT_COMPACT_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, paracompact_space A top /\ compact_space B top' -> paracompact_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top')

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_PRODUCT_COMPACT_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, compact_space A top /\ paracompact_space B top' -> paracompact_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top')

items.name: PARACOMPACT_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ paracompact_space A top -> paracompact_space B top'

items.name: PARTIAL_DIVISION_EXTEND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p q c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s t c= R :^: idx N, division_of N p s /\ (division_of N q t /\ s c= t) -> exists r c= Power (R :^: idx N), p c= r /\ division_of N r t

items.name: PARTIAL_DIVISION_EXTEND_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty -> exists p c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_of N p (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) :e p

items.name: PARTIAL_DIVISION_EXTEND_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, division_of N p (Union p) /\ Union p c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> exists q c= Power (R :^: idx N), p c= q /\ division_of N q (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: PARTIAL_DIVISION_OF_TAGGED_DIVISION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, tagged_partial_division_of A s i -> division_of A {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e x 1} | x :e s} (Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e x 1} | x :e s})

items.name: PARTIAL_SUMS_COMPONENT_LE_INFSUM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall k n :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ ((forall i :e omega, i :e s -> 0 <= f i k) /\ summable N s f)) -> vsum omega N (s :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) f k <= infsum N s f k

items.name: PARTIAL_SUMS_DROP_LE_INFSUM
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= omega, forall n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, i :e s -> 0 <= drop (f i)) /\ summable 1 s f -> drop (vsum omega 1 (s :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) f) <= drop (infsum 1 s f)

items.name: PART_MEASURES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, measurable N s /\ (0 <= m /\ m <= measure N s) -> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, t :/\: u = Empty /\ (t :\/: u = s /\ (measurable N t /\ (measure N t = m /\ (measurable N u /\ measure N u = measure N s + - m))))

items.name: PASTECART_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx M, forall y1 :e R :^: idx N, forall x2 :e R :^: idx M, forall y2 :e R :^: idx N, vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x1 y1) (pastecart M N x2 y2) = pastecart M N (vector_add M x1 x2) (vector_add N y1 y2)

items.name: PASTECART_AS_ORTHOGONAL_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y = vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x (vec N 0)) (pastecart M N (vec M 0) y)

items.name: PASTECART_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall y1 :e R :^: idx B, forall c :e R, pastecart A B (vector_mul A c x1) (vector_mul B c y1) = vector_mul (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) c (pastecart A B x1 y1)

items.name: PASTECART_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall u :e A :^: idx M, forall v :e A :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> pastecart M N u v i = u i) /\ forall u :e A :^: idx M, forall v :e A :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, dimindex M + 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M + dimindex N -> pastecart M N u v i = v (minus_nat i (dimindex M))

items.name: PASTECART_EQ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x y :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), x = y <-> fstcart M x = fstcart M y /\ sndcart M N x = sndcart M N y

items.name: PASTECART_EQ_VEC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, forall n :e omega, pastecart A B x y = vec (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) n <-> x = vec A n /\ y = vec B n

items.name: PASTECART_FST_SND
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall z :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), pastecart M N (fstcart M z) (sndcart M N z) = z

items.name: PASTECART_INJ
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, forall w :e A :^: idx M, forall z :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y = pastecart M N w z <-> x = w /\ y = z

items.name: PASTECART_IN_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y :e u /\ open (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) u -> exists v c= R :^: idx M, exists w c= R :^: idx N, open M v /\ (x :e v /\ (open N w /\ (y :e w /\ (\/_ x :e v, {pastecart M N x y | y :e w}) c= u)))

items.name: PASTECART_IN_INTERIOR_SUBTOPOLOGY
