items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y :e u /\ u :e subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) -> exists v c= R :^: idx M, exists w c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (x :e v /\ (w :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ (y :e w /\ (\/_ x :e v, {pastecart M N x y | y :e w}) c= u)))

items.name: PASTECART_IN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N x y :e (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> x :e s /\ y :e t

items.name: PASTECART_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, pastecart M N (vector_neg M x) (vector_neg N y) = vector_neg (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x y)

items.name: PASTECART_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x1 :e R :^: idx M, forall y1 :e R :^: idx N, forall x2 :e R :^: idx M, forall y2 :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (pastecart M N x1 y1) (pastecart M N x2 y2) = pastecart M N (vector_sub M x1 x2) (vector_sub N y1 y2)

items.name: PASTECART_VEC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, pastecart A B (vec A n) (vec B n) = vec (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) n

items.name: PASTECART_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall k c= C, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e C, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e C, y x0 :e R :^: idx B) -> finite k -> pastecart A B (vsum C A k x) (vsum C B k y) = vsum C (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) k (fun i:set => pastecart A B (x i) (y i))

items.name: PASTING_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall t :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, (forall i :e K, i :e k -> t i :e top /\ continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (t i),top') (f i)) /\ ((forall i j :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ (j :e k /\ x :e topspace A top :/\: (t i :/\: t j)) -> f i x = f j x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists j :e K, j :e k /\ (x :e t j /\ g x = f j x))) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: PASTING_LEMMA_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall t :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, finite k /\ ((forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_in A top (t i) /\ continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (t i),top') (f i)) /\ ((forall i j :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ (j :e k /\ x :e topspace A top :/\: (t i :/\: t j)) -> f i x = f j x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists j :e K, j :e k /\ (x :e t j /\ g x = f j x)))) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: PASTING_LEMMA_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall t :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, topspace A top c= Union {t i | i :e K, i :e k} /\ ((forall i :e K, i :e k -> t i :e top /\ continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (t i),top') (f i)) /\ (forall i j :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ (j :e k /\ x :e topspace A top :/\: (t i :/\: t j)) -> f i x = f j x)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') g /\ forall x :e A, forall i :e K, i :e k /\ x :e topspace A top :/\: t i -> g x = f i x)

items.name: PASTING_LEMMA_EXISTS_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall t :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, finite k /\ (topspace A top c= Union {t i | i :e K, i :e k} /\ ((forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_in A top (t i) /\ continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (t i),top') (f i)) /\ (forall i j :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ (j :e k /\ x :e topspace A top :/\: (t i :/\: t j)) -> f i x = f j x))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') g /\ forall x :e A, forall i :e K, i :e k /\ x :e topspace A top :/\: t i -> g x = f i x)

items.name: PASTING_LEMMA_EXISTS_LOCALLY_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall t :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists v c= A, v :e top /\ (x :e v /\ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ t i :/\: v = Empty})) /\ (topspace A top c= Union {t i | i :e K, i :e k} /\ ((forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_in A top (t i) /\ continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (t i),top') (f i)) /\ (forall i j :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ (j :e k /\ x :e topspace A top :/\: (t i :/\: t j)) -> f i x = f j x))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') g /\ forall x :e A, forall i :e K, i :e k /\ x :e topspace A top :/\: t i -> g x = f i x)

items.name: PASTING_LEMMA_LOCALLY_FINITE
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall t :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists v c= A, v :e top /\ (x :e v /\ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ t i :/\: v = Empty})) /\ ((forall i :e K, i :e k -> closed_in A top (t i) /\ continuous_map A B (subtopology A top (t i),top') (f i)) /\ ((forall i j :e K, forall x :e A, i :e k /\ (j :e k /\ x :e topspace A top :/\: (t i :/\: t j)) -> f i x = f j x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists j :e K, j :e k /\ (x :e t j /\ g x = f j x)))) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: PATHFINISH_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx B) -> pathfinish A (fun x:set => f (p x)) = f (pathfinish B p)

items.name: PATHFINISH_IN_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A g :e path_image A g

items.name: PATHFINISH_JOIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) g1 g2 x) = pathfinish A g2

items.name: PATHFINISH_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear B A f -> pathfinish A (fun x:set => f (g x)) = f (pathfinish B g)

items.name: PATHFINISH_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, pathfinish A (fun x:set => linepath A (a,b) x) = b

items.name: PATHFINISH_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A (fun x:set => reversepath A g x) = pathstart A g

items.name: PATHFINISH_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> 0 <= drop a /\ pathfinish A g = pathstart A g -> pathfinish A (fun x:set => shiftpath A a g x) = g a

items.name: PATHFINISH_SUBPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) u v g x) = g v

items.name: PATHFINISH_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A (fun x:set => vector_add A a (g x)) = vector_add A a (pathfinish A g)

items.name: PATHSTART_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx B) -> pathstart A (fun x:set => f (p x)) = f (pathstart B p)

items.name: PATHSTART_IN_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathstart A g :e path_image A g

items.name: PATHSTART_JOIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathstart A (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) g1 g2 x) = pathstart A g1

items.name: PATHSTART_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear B A f -> pathstart A (fun x:set => f (g x)) = f (pathstart B g)

items.name: PATHSTART_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, pathstart A (fun x:set => linepath A (a,b) x) = a

items.name: PATHSTART_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathstart A (fun x:set => reversepath A g x) = pathfinish A g

items.name: PATHSTART_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> drop a <= 1 -> pathstart A (fun x:set => shiftpath A a g x) = g a

items.name: PATHSTART_SUBPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathstart N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) u v g x) = g u

items.name: PATHSTART_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathstart A (fun x:set => vector_add A a (g x)) = vector_add A a (pathstart A g)

items.name: PATH_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N p = pathstart N q /\ pathfinish N q = pathstart N r -> (path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) q r x0) x) <-> path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p q x0) r x))

items.name: PATH_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> (path N g <-> path N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) u g x) /\ path N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) u (vec 1 1) g x))

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s x y <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N t /\ (t c= s /\ (x :e t /\ y :e t))

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_space A top -> path_components_of A top = connected_components_of A top

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, path_components_of A (discrete_topology A u) = {{x} | x :e A, x :e u}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c' c= A, c :e path_components_of A top /\ c' :e path_components_of A top -> (c :/\: c' = Empty <-> ~ c = c')

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_EMPTY_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> path_components_of A top = Empty

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_components_of A top = Empty <-> topspace A top = Empty

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, path_components_of A top = {s} <-> path_connected_space A top /\ (~ topspace A top = Empty /\ s = topspace A top)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_components_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) = path_components N s

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c c= A, c :e path_components_of A top /\ (path_connected_in A top s /\ ~ c :/\: s = Empty) -> s c= c

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c' c= A, c :e path_components_of A top /\ c' :e path_components_of A top -> (~ c :/\: c' = Empty <-> c = c')

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top -> path_components_of A top = if topspace A top = Empty then Empty else {topspace A top}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> path_components_of (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = {{f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e c i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} | c :e Power A :^: K, forall i :e K, i :e k -> c i :e path_components_of A (tops i)}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, path_components_of (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = \/_ c1 :e Power A, {c1 :*: c2 | c2 :e Power B, c1 :e path_components_of A top1 /\ c2 :e path_components_of B top2}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e path_components_of A top -> c c= topspace A top

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_SUBSET_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, path_components_of A top c= {s} <-> path_connected_space A top /\ (topspace A top = Empty \/ topspace A top = s)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENTS_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c c= A, c :e path_components_of A top /\ c c= u -> c :e path_components_of A (subtopology A top u)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a b :e R :^: idx A, {x :e R :^: idx A | path_component A s a x} :/\: {x :e R :^: idx A | path_component A s b x} = Empty <-> ~ a :e {x :e R :^: idx A | path_component A s b x}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x x0 :e R :^: idx A, path_component A Empty x x0 <-> x0 :e Empty

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, y :e {x0 :e R :^: idx A | path_component A s x x0} -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, path_component A s y x0 <-> path_component A s x x0

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, locally N {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x0} s -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s x x0 <-> connected_component N s x x0

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, locally_path_connected_space A top -> forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top x x0

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, path_component A s x x0 <-> x0 :e Empty) <-> ~ x :e s

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_EQ_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s x x0 <-> path_component N s y x0) <-> ~ x :e s /\ ~ y :e s \/ x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ path_component N s x y)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_IMP_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s a b -> connected_component N s a b

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_IMP_HOMOTOPIC_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s a b -> homotopic_loops N s (fun x:set => linepath N (a,a) x) (fun x:set => linepath N (b,b) x)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, path_component A s x y -> x :e s /\ y :e s

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_INTERMEDIATE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t u c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, {x :e R :^: idx N | path_component N u a x} c= t /\ t c= u -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, path_component N t a x <-> path_component N u a x

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_IN_PATH_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, {x :e A | path_component_of A top a x} :e path_components_of A top <-> a :e topspace A top

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, path_component_of A top x y -> x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall x :e R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ ((forall x0 y :e R :^: idx B, f x0 = f y -> x0 = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx A, exists x0 :e R :^: idx B, f x0 = y)) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, path_component A {f x | x :e s} (f x) x0 <-> x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e {x1 :e R :^: idx B | path_component B s x x1}}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e t /\ (path_connected A t /\ t c= s) -> t c= {x0 :e R :^: idx A | path_component A s x x0}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, s c= t -> {x0 :e R :^: idx A | path_component A s x x0} c= {x0 :e R :^: idx A | path_component A t x x0}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, path_component_of A top x y <-> exists t c= A, path_connected_in A top t /\ (x :e t /\ y :e t)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x y :e A, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ path_component_of A top x y -> path_component_of B top' (f x) (f y)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= A, forall x x0 :e A, path_component_of A (discrete_topology A u) x x0 <-> (x :e u -> x0 :e SetAdjoin Empty x) /\ (~ x :e u -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top y x0} = Empty <-> ~ path_component_of A top x y

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, (forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> path_component_of A top y x0) <-> ~ x :e topspace A top /\ ~ y :e topspace A top \/ x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ path_component_of A top x y)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_EQUIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, path_component_of A top x y <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> path_component_of A top y x0)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, (forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e Empty) <-> ~ x :e topspace A top

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_EQ_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, (forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> path_component_of A top y x0) <-> ~ x :e topspace A top /\ ~ y :e topspace A top \/ ~ {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top y x0} = Empty

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x x0 :e R :^: idx N, path_component_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) x x0 <-> path_component N s x x0

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, path_connected_in A top s /\ x :e s -> s c= {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall x y :e A, path_component_of A (subtopology A top s) x y /\ s c= t -> path_component_of A (subtopology A top t) x y

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_NONOVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top y x0} = Empty <-> ~ x :e topspace A top \/ (~ y :e topspace A top \/ ~ forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> path_component_of A top y x0)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, ~ {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top y x0} = Empty <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> path_component_of A top y x0)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_PAIR
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, forall x0 :e A :*: B, path_component_of (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (x,y) x0 <-> x0 :e {x1 :e A | path_component_of A top1 x x1} :*: {x1 :e B | path_component_of B top2 y x1}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall x x0 :e A :^: K, path_component_of (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) x x0 <-> ((forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e k -> x x0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) -> x0 :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x2 :e A | path_component_of A (tops i) (x i) x2}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}) /\ (~ (forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e k -> x x0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, path_component_of A top x x <-> x :e topspace A top

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e {y :e A | exists g:set -> set, (forall x1 :e R, g x1 :e A) /\ (path_in A top g /\ (g 0 = x /\ g 1 = y))}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_SET_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e {y :e A | exists t c= A, path_connected_in A top t /\ (x :e t /\ y :e t)}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall y :e R :^: idx A, forall s t c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, s c= t /\ path_component A s x y -> path_component A t x y

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} c= topspace A top

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, path_component_of A (subtopology A top s) x y -> path_component_of A top x y

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, forall x :e A, (forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A (subtopology A top u) x x0 <-> path_component_of A top x x0) <-> {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} c= u

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, path_component_of A top x y <-> path_component_of A top y x

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y z :e A, path_component_of A top x y /\ path_component_of A top y z -> path_component_of A top x z

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_OF_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, forall x :e A, x :e c /\ (path_connected_in A top c /\ (forall c' c= A, x :e c' /\ path_connected_in A top c' -> c' c= c)) -> forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e c

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x x0 :e R :^: idx N, path_component N {x1 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x1} x x0 <-> path_component N s x x0

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_PATH_IMAGE_PATHSTART
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, path N p /\ x :e path_image N p -> path_component N (path_image N p) (pathstart N p) x

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), path_component (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (pastecart M N a b) x <-> x :e \/_ x :e {x0 :e R :^: idx M | path_component M s a x0}, {pastecart M N x y | y :e {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N t b x0}}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> path_component N s x x

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s x x <-> x :e s

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x x0 :e R :^: idx A, path_component A s x x0 <-> x0 :e {y :e R :^: idx A | exists g:set -> set, (forall x1 :e R :^: idx 1, g x1 :e R :^: idx A) /\ (path A g /\ (path_image A g c= s /\ (pathstart A g = x /\ pathfinish A g = y)))}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, {x0 :e R :^: idx A | path_component A s x x0} c= s

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_SUBSET_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0} c= {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_SUBSET_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} c= {x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_SUBSET_QUASI_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} c= {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_SYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s x y -> path_component N s y x

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_SYM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, path_component A s x y <-> path_component A s y x

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall z :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s x y /\ path_component N s y z -> path_component N s x z

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x x0 :e R :^: idx A, path_component A {vector_add A a x1 | x1 :e s} (vector_add A a x) x0 <-> x0 :e {vector_add A a x1 | x1 :e {x1 :e R :^: idx A | path_component A s x x1}}

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ (c c= s /\ (path_connected N c /\ (forall c' c= R :^: idx N, x :e c' /\ (c' c= s /\ path_connected N c') -> c' c= c))) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, path_component N s x x0 <-> x0 :e c

items.name: PATH_COMPONENT_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x x0 :e R :^: idx N, path_component N (R :^: idx N) x x0 <-> x0 :e R :^: idx N

items.name: PATH_COMPOSE_JOIN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f (poly_add A p q x) = poly_add B (fun x:set => f (p x)) (fun x:set => f (q x)) x

items.name: PATH_COMPOSE_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f (reversepath A p x) = reversepath B (fun x:set => f (p x)) x

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N s -> path_connected N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ path_connected N s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_ANNULUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r1 r2 :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> path_connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | r1 < vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) < r2}) /\ ((forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r1 r2 :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> path_connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | r1 < vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) <= r2}) /\ ((forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r1 r2 :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> path_connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | r1 <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) < r2}) /\ forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r1 r2 :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> path_connected N {x :e R :^: idx N | r1 <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) < r2}))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_ARCWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx 1, g x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N g /\ (path_image N g c= s /\ (pathstart N g = x /\ pathfinish N g = y)))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_ARC_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> 2 <= dimindex N /\ arc N p -> path_connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: path_image N p)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_CLOSURE_FROM_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N (frontier N s) -> path_connected N (closure N s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (compact N s /\ AR N s) -> path_connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_BOUNDED_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ convex N s) -> path_connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (atleastp s R /\ ~ equip s R) -> path_connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_COMPLEMENT_HOMEOMORPHIC_CONVEX_COMPACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx M, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (homeomorphic M N s t /\ (convex M t /\ compact M t)) -> path_connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, path_connected A s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, path_component A s x x0 <-> x0 :e s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_CONNECTED_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s c= closure N (s :\: t) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ path_connected N (u :\: t)))) -> path_connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ path_connected M s -> path_connected N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_CONVEX_DIFF_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, convex N u /\ (~ collinear N u /\ (atleastp s R /\ ~ equip s R)) -> path_connected N (u :\: s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_CONVEX_DIFF_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx A, convex A u /\ (~ collinear A u /\ countable s) -> path_connected A (u :\: s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_CONVEX_DIFF_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ aff_dim N t + 2 <= aff_dim N s -> path_connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_DELETE_INTERIOR_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (path_connected N s /\ a :e interior N s) -> path_connected N (s :\: {a})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_DIFF_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (path_connected N s /\ cball N (a,r) c= s) -> path_connected N (s :\: ball N (a,r))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> path_connected A Empty

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s -> (path_connected A s <-> connected A s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_CONNECTED_LPC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, locally A {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | path_connected A x} s -> (path_connected A s <-> connected A s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_space A top -> (path_connected_space A top <-> connected_space A top)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_EQ_HOMOTOPIC_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e s -> homotopic_loops N s (fun x:set => linepath N (a,a) x) (fun x:set => linepath N (b,b) x)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, path_connected_space (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_FROM_CLOSED_UNION_AND_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ (path_connected N (s :\/: t) /\ path_connected N (s :/\: t))) -> path_connected N s /\ path_connected N t

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_FROM_CLOSED_UNION_AND_INTER_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ (path_connected N (s :\/: t) /\ path_connected N (s :/\: t))) -> path_connected N s /\ path_connected N t

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_FROM_OPEN_UNION_AND_INTER_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (path_connected N (s :\/: t) /\ path_connected N (s :/\: t))) -> path_connected N s /\ path_connected N t

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IFF_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, path_connected A s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> path_component A s x y

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IMP_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N s -> connected N s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IMP_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top -> connected_space A top

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N s /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s) -> path_component N s a b

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, path_connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R, g x0 :e A) /\ (path_in A top g /\ ({g x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)} c= s /\ (g 0 = x /\ g 1 = y)))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_ANR_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (ANR N s /\ (c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) /\ (c c= t /\ t c= closure N c))) -> path_connected N t

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N (open_interval N (a,b))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_ABSOLUTE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, path_connected_in A (subtopology A top s) s <-> path_connected_in A top s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, path_connected_in (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> path_connected_in A (tops i) (s i)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ path_connected_in A top s -> path_connected_in B top' {f x | x :e s}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, path_connected_in (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ path_connected_in A top1 s /\ path_connected_in B top2 t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, path_connected_in A (discrete_topology A u) s <-> s c= u /\ exists a :e A, s c= {a}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_in A top Empty

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_connected_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s <-> path_connected N s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, path_connected_in R euclideanreal s <-> is_realinterval s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_EUCLIDEANREAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, path_connected_in R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R, path_connected_in R euclideanreal (open_real_interval (a,b))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_EUCLIDEAN_COMPLEMENTS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall s t c= R :^: omega, closed_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) t /\ homeomorphic_space (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) s) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) t)) -> (path_connected_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) (topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) :\: s) <-> path_connected_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) (topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) :\: t))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_IMP_CONNECTED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, path_connected_in A top s -> connected_in A top s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_PATH_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e path_components_of A top -> path_connected_in A top c

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_PATH_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, path_connected_in A top {x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e A) -> path_in A top g -> path_connected_in A top {g x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, path_connected_in A top {a} <-> a :e topspace A top

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_STANDARD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, path_connected_in (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) (standard_simplex p)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, path_connected_in A top s -> s c= topspace A top

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, path_connected_in A (subtopology A top s) t <-> path_connected_in A top t /\ t c= s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_in A top (topspace A top) <-> path_connected_space A top

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, path_connected_in A top s /\ (path_connected_in A top t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> path_connected_in A top (s :\/: t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, (forall s c= A, s :e u -> path_connected_in A top s) /\ ~ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = Empty -> path_connected_in A top (Union u)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, path_connected M s /\ linear M N f -> path_connected N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (path_connected A {f x | x :e s} <-> path_connected B s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> path_component N s a b

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N s -> path_connected N {vector_neg N x | x :e s}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_OPEN_ARC_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> 2 <= dimindex N /\ arc N g -> path_connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: (path_image N g :\: {pathstart N g,pathfinish N g}))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_OPEN_DELETE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (open N s /\ connected N s) -> path_connected N (s :\: {a})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_OPEN_DIFF_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (atleastp t R /\ ~ equip t R))) -> path_connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_OPEN_DIFF_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (open N s /\ (connected N s /\ countable t)) -> path_connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_OPEN_IN_DIFF_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ (~ collinear N s /\ (atleastp t R /\ ~ equip t R))) -> path_connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_OPEN_IN_DIFF_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ aff_dim N t + 2 <= aff_dim N s) -> path_connected N (s :\: t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_OPEN_IN_DIFF_UNIONS_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), connected N s /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ (finite f /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> closed N t /\ aff_dim N t + 2 <= aff_dim N s))) -> path_connected N (s :\: Union f)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_PATH_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p -> path_connected N (path_image N p)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, path_connected M s /\ path_connected N t -> path_connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, path_connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ path_connected M s /\ path_connected N t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_PUNCTURED_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> path_connected N (ball N (a,r) :\: {a})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_PUNCTURED_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> path_connected N (cball N (a,r) :\: {a})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_PUNCTURED_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ aff_dim N s = 1 -> path_connected N (s :\: {a})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_PUNCTURED_UNIVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N -> path_connected N ((R :^: idx N) :\: {a})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, path_connected N s -> path_connected N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, path_connected N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ path_connected N s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, path_connected A (closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx B, path_connected B (open_segment B (a,b))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SEMIOPEN_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: {a})) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: {b})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SIMPLE_PATH_ENDLESS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, c x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N c -> path_connected N (path_image N c :\: {pathstart N c,pathfinish N c})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N {a}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, path_connected_space A (discrete_topology A u) <-> exists a :e A, u c= {a}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_connected_space (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> path_connected N s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_IFF_COMPONENTS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top <-> forall c c' c= A, c :e path_components_of A top /\ c' :e path_components_of A top -> c = c'

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_IFF_COMPONENTS_SUBSET_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top <-> exists a c= A, path_components_of A top c= {a}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_IFF_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> path_component_of A top x y

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_CARD_GE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ ~ (exists a :e A, topspace A top c= {a})) -> atleastp R (topspace A top)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_PATH_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a b :e A, path_connected_space A top /\ (a :e topspace A top /\ b :e topspace A top) -> path_component_of A top a b

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_IMP_UNCOUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top /\ (t1_space A top /\ ~ (exists a :e A, topspace A top c= {a})) -> ~ countable (topspace A top)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_PATH_COMPONENT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> forall x0 :e A, path_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e topspace A top

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, path_connected_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> path_connected_space A (tops i)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, path_connected_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ path_connected_space A top1 /\ path_connected_space B top2

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_QUOTIENT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') q /\ path_connected_space A top -> path_connected_space B top'

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ path_connected_space A top -> path_connected_space B top'

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_SUBCONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> exists s c= A, path_connected_in A top s /\ (x :e s /\ y :e s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPACE_TOPSPACE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> path_connected_space A top

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPHERE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 2 <= dimindex N -> path_connected N (sphere N (a,r))

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPHERE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, path_connected N (sphere N (a,r)) <-> 2 <= dimindex N \/ r <= 0

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SPHERE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ ~ aff_dim N s = 1) -> path_connected N (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N s /\ path_connected N t -> path_connected N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_SUPERSET_COMPLEMENT_ARC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (arc N g /\ (R :^: idx N) :\: path_image N g c= s) -> path_connected N s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N s -> path_connected N {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> path_connected N s

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, path_connected A s /\ (path_connected A t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> path_connected A (s :\/: t)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> path_connected N s) /\ ~ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = Empty -> path_connected N (Union f)

items.name: PATH_CONNECTED_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> path_connected N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: PATH_CONTAINS_ARC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path N p /\ (pathstart N p = a /\ (pathfinish N p = b /\ ~ a = b)) -> exists q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (arc N q /\ (path_image N q c= path_image N p /\ (pathstart N q = a /\ pathfinish N q = b)))

items.name: PATH_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> path M g /\ continuous_on_hl M N f (path_image M g) -> path N (fun x:set => f (g x))

items.name: PATH_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx A) -> (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> p t = q t) /\ path A p -> path A q

items.name: PATH_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (path N g /\ path_image N g c= s <-> path_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (fun x:set => g (lift x)))

items.name: PATH_FINISH_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e A) -> path_in A top g -> g 1 :e topspace A top

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx B) -> path_image A (fun x:set => f (p x)) = {f x | x :e path_image B p}

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_CONST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, path_image N (fun x:set => a) = {a}

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_JOIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A g1 = pathstart A g2 -> path_image A (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) g1 g2 x) = path_image A g1 :\/: path_image A g2

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_JOIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> path_image N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) c= path_image N g1 :\/: path_image N g2

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear B A f -> path_image A (fun x:set => f (g x)) = {f x | x :e path_image B g}

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, path_image A (fun x:set => linepath A (a,b) x) = closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> ~ path_image A g = Empty

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> path_image N (fun x:set => reversepath N g x) = path_image N g

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ pathfinish N g = pathstart N g -> path_image N (fun x:set => shiftpath N a g x) = path_image N g

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_SUBPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> drop u <= drop v -> path_image N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) u v g x) = {g x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)}

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_SUBPATH_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u :e R :^: idx 1, path N g /\ u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> path_image N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) u g x) :\/: path_image N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) u (vec 1 1) g x) = path_image N g

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_SUBPATH_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> path_image N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) u v g x) = {g x | x :e closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)}

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_SUBPATH_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N g /\ (u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ v :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> path_image N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) u v g x) c= path_image N g

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e A) -> path_in A top g -> {g x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)} c= topspace A top

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A p = pathstart A q /\ pathfinish A q = pathstart A p -> path_image A (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) p q x) = path_image A (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) q p x)

items.name: PATH_IMAGE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> path_image A (fun x:set => vector_add A a (g x)) = {vector_add A a x | x :e path_image A g}

items.name: PATH_IMP_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, path_component_of A top x y -> connected_component_of A top x y

items.name: PATH_IMP_QUASI_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, path_component_of A top x y -> quasi_component_of A top x y

items.name: PATH_IN_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e A) -> path_in A top g /\ continuous_map A B (top,top') f -> path_in B top' (fun x:set => f (g x))

items.name: PATH_IN_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, path_in A top (fun x:set => a) <-> a :e topspace A top

items.name: PATH_IN_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (path_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) g <-> path N (fun x:set => g (drop x)) /\ path_image N (fun x:set => g (drop x)) c= s)

items.name: PATH_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e A) -> (path_in A (subtopology A top s) g <-> path_in A top g /\ forall x :e R, x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil) -> g x :e s)

items.name: PATH_JOIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 -> (path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) <-> path N g1 /\ path N g2)

items.name: PATH_JOIN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N g1 /\ path N g2 -> (path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) <-> pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2)

items.name: PATH_JOIN_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N g1 /\ (path N g2 /\ pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2) -> path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x)

items.name: PATH_JOIN_PATH_ENDS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N g2 /\ path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) -> pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t :e R :^: idx 1, rectifiable_path N g /\ t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> path_length N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) t g x) + path_length N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) t (vec 1 1) g x) = path_length N g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_DIFFERENTIABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, countable s /\ (rectifiable_path N g /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) :\: s -> differentiable N 1 g (at 1 t))) -> path_length N g = drop (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) (fun t:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_derivative N g (at 1 t)))))

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> p t = q t) -> path_length N p = path_length N q

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g -> (path_length N g = 0 <-> exists c :e R :^: idx N, forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> g t = c)

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_EQ_LINE_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g /\ path_length N g = distance N (pathstart N g,pathfinish N g) -> path_image N g = closed_segment N (seq_cons (pathstart N g,pathfinish N g) seq_nil)

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_ISOMETRIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) -> path_length N (fun x:set => f (g x)) = path_length M g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_JOIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g1 /\ (rectifiable_path N g2 /\ pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2) -> path_length N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) = path_length N g1 + path_length N g2

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x) -> path_length N (fun x:set => f (g x)) = path_length M g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_length N (fun x:set => linepath N (a,b) x) = distance N (a,b)

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b :e R, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g x) (g y)) <= b * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)) -> path_length N g <= b

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_POS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g -> 0 <= path_length N g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_REPARAMETRIZATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h h' :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx 1), rectifiable_path N g /\ homeomorphism 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil),closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) (h,h') -> path_length N (fun x:set => g (h x)) = path_length N g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> path_length N (fun x:set => reversepath N g x) = path_length N g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, rectifiable_path N g -> path_length N (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (g x)) = abs_SNo c * path_length N g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, rectifiable_path N g /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N g /\ a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> path_length N (fun x:set => shiftpath N a g x) = path_length N g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_SUBPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t :e R :^: idx 1, path_length N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) s t g x) = vector_variation N (closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (s,t) seq_nil)) g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_SUBPATH_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t :e R :^: idx 1, rectifiable_path N g /\ (s :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> path_length N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) s t g x) <= path_length N g

items.name: PATH_LENGTH_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> path_length N (fun x:set => vector_add N a (g x)) = path_length N g

items.name: PATH_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (path N (fun x:set => f (g x)) <-> path M g)

items.name: PATH_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, path A (fun x:set => linepath A (a,b) x)

items.name: PATH_PATH_IN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (path N g <-> path_in (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (fun x:set => g (lift x)))

items.name: PATH_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (path N (fun x:set => reversepath N g x) <-> path N g)

items.name: PATH_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, path N g /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N g /\ a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> path N (fun x:set => shiftpath N a g x)

items.name: PATH_START_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e A) -> path_in A top g -> g 0 :e topspace A top

items.name: PATH_SUBPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N g /\ (u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ v :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> path N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) u v g x)

items.name: PATH_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A p = pathstart A q /\ pathfinish A q = pathstart A p -> (path A (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) p q x) <-> path A (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) q p x))

items.name: PATH_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (path N (fun x:set => vector_add N a (g x)) <-> path N g)

items.name: PCROSS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}

items.name: PCROSS_AS_ORTHOGONAL_SUM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ u :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), {vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) u v | v :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), u :e {pastecart M N x (vec N 0) | x :e s} /\ v :e {pastecart M N (vec M 0) y | y :e t}}

items.name: PCROSS_DIFF
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :\: u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :\: \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) /\ forall s t c= A :^: idx M, forall u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s :\: t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) :\: \/_ x :e t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}

items.name: PCROSS_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e Empty}) = Empty) /\ forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e Empty, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = Empty

items.name: PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) <-> (s = Empty \/ t = Empty) /\ (s' = Empty \/ t' = Empty) \/ s = s' /\ t = t'

items.name: PCROSS_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = Empty <-> s = Empty \/ t = Empty

items.name: PCROSS_INTER
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :/\: u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :/\: \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) /\ forall s t c= A :^: idx M, forall u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s :/\: t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) :/\: \/_ x :e t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}

items.name: PCROSS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall f c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e {x :e A :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}}) = if f = Empty then \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N} else {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), t :e f}, x :e Y}) /\ forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e {x :e A :^: idx M | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = if f = Empty then \/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t} else {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | s :e Power (A :^: idx M), s :e f}, x :e Y}

items.name: PCROSS_INTERS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall g c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e {x :e A :^: idx M | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}, {pastecart M N x y | y :e {x :e A :^: idx N | forall Y :e g, x :e Y}}) = if f = Empty then {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), t :e g}, x :e Y} else if g = Empty then {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N}) | s :e Power (A :^: idx M), s :e f}, x :e Y} else {x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | forall Y :e (\/_ s :e Power (A :^: idx M), {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), s :e f /\ t :e g}), x :e Y}

items.name: PCROSS_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall c d :e R :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil), {pastecart M N x y | y :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)}) = closed_interval (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (seq_cons (pastecart M N a c,pastecart M N b d) seq_nil)

items.name: PCROSS_MONO
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t c= A :^: idx N, forall s' c= A :^: idx M, forall t' c= A :^: idx N, s c= s' /\ t c= t' -> (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) c= \/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}

items.name: PCROSS_SING
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx M, forall y :e A :^: idx N, (\/_ x0 :e {x}, {pastecart M N x0 y0 | y0 :e {y}}) = {pastecart M N x y}

items.name: PCROSS_UNION
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall t u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t :\/: u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) :\/: \/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) /\ forall s t c= A :^: idx M, forall u c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e s :\/: t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) = (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}) :\/: \/_ x :e t, {pastecart M N x y | y :e u}

items.name: PCROSS_UNIONS
