items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall s c= A :^: idx M, forall f c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e Union f}) = Union {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), t :e f}) /\ forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall t c= A :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e Union f, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = Union {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | s :e Power (A :^: idx M), s :e f}

items.name: PCROSS_UNIONS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (A :^: idx M), forall g c= Power (A :^: idx N), (\/_ x :e Union f, {pastecart M N x y | y :e Union g}) = Union (\/_ s :e Power (A :^: idx M), {(\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) | t :e Power (A :^: idx N), s :e f /\ t :e g})

items.name: PEANO_GAP_FILLING_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e A) -> forall C c= R, compact_space A top /\ (metrizable_space A top /\ (connected_space A top /\ (locally_connected_space A top /\ (~ topspace A top = Empty /\ (C c= closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil) /\ (closed_in R (subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil))) C /\ (continuous_map R A (subtopology R euclideanreal C,top) f /\ {f x | x :e C} = topspace A top))))))) -> exists F:set -> set, (forall x :e R, F x :e A) /\ (continuous_map R A (subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)),top) F /\ {F x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)} = topspace A top)

items.name: PERFECT_CANTOR_SPACE
items.statement: forall x c= omega, x :e topspace (Power omega) cantor_space -> x :e derived_set_of (Power omega) cantor_space (topspace (Power omega) cantor_space)

items.name: PERFECT_CANTOR_SPACE_EQ
items.statement: derived_set_of (Power omega) cantor_space (topspace (Power omega) cantor_space) = topspace (Power omega) cantor_space

items.name: PERFECT_FROM_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closure N s -> limit_point_of N x (closure N s)) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> limit_point_of N x s

items.name: PERFECT_IMP_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PERFECT_IMP_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PERFECT_IMP_PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PERFECT_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PERFECT_IMP_SURJECTIVE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top'

items.name: PERFECT_INJECTIVE_EQ_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (perfect_map A B (top,top') f /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) <-> homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f)

items.name: PERFECT_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f /\ perfect_map B C (top',top'') g -> perfect_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: PERFECT_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> perfect_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map B C (top',top'') g /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')) -> perfect_map B C (top',top'') g

items.name: PERFECT_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> hausdorff_space B top' /\ (perfect_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map B C (top',top'') g /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top'))) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PERFECT_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_RIGHT_INJ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> perfect_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map B C (top',top'') g /\ (forall x y :e B, x :e topspace B top' /\ (y :e topspace B top' /\ g x = g y) -> x = y)))) -> perfect_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PERFECT_MAP_FROM_KIFICATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> perfect_map A B (kification A top,top') f

items.name: PERFECT_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, perfect_map (A :*: B) A (prod_topology A B top top',top) (fun x:set => x 0) <-> (topspace A top = Empty \/ compact_space B top') /\ (topspace B top' = Empty -> topspace A top = Empty)

items.name: PERFECT_MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, perfect_map A A (top,top) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: PERFECT_MAP_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, forall v c= B, perfect_map A B (top,top') f /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e v} = u -> perfect_map A B (subtopology A top u,subtopology B top' v) f

items.name: PERFECT_MAP_SND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, perfect_map (A :*: B) B (prod_topology A B top top',top') (fun x:set => x 1) <-> (topspace B top' = Empty \/ compact_space A top) /\ (topspace A top = Empty -> topspace B top' = Empty)

items.name: PERMUTATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> (permutation A p <-> (forall y :e A, exists x :e A, p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, p y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ finite {x :e A | ~ p x = x})

items.name: PERMUTATION_BIJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> permutation A p -> forall y :e A, exists x :e A, p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, p y0 = y -> y0 = x

items.name: PERMUTATION_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> permutation A p /\ permutation A q -> permutation A (fun x:set => p (q x))

items.name: PERMUTATION_COMPOSE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> permutation A p -> (permutation A (fun x:set => p (q x)) <-> permutation A q)) /\ forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> permutation A q -> (permutation A (fun x:set => p (q x)) <-> permutation A p)

items.name: PERMUTATION_COMPOSE_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall a b :e A, permutation A (fun x:set => swap A (a,b) (p x)) <-> permutation A p) /\ forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall a b :e A, permutation A (fun x:set => p (swap A (a,b) x)) <-> permutation A p

items.name: PERMUTATION_CYCLIC
items.statement: forall n :e omega, permutation omega (fun i:set => if i < n then mod_nat (i + 1) n else i)

items.name: PERMUTATION_CYCLIC_N
items.statement: forall n k :e omega, permutation omega (fun i:set => if i < n then mod_nat (i + k) n else i)

items.name: PERMUTATION_FINITE_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> permutation A p -> finite {x :e A | ~ p x = x}

items.name: PERMUTATION_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> permutation A (fun x:set => x)

items.name: PERMUTATION_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> permutation A p -> permutation A (fun x:set => inverse A A p x)

items.name: PERMUTATION_INVERSE_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> permutation A p /\ permutation A q -> forall x :e A, inverse A A (fun x:set => p (q x)) x = inverse A A q (inverse A A p x)

items.name: PERMUTATION_INVERSE_WORKS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> permutation A p -> (forall x :e A, inverse A A p (p x) = x) /\ forall x :e A, p (inverse A A p x) = x

items.name: PERMUTATION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> finite s /\ ((forall y :e A, exists x :e A, p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, p y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> p x = x)) -> permutation A p

items.name: PERMUTATION_PERMUTES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> (permutation A p <-> exists s c= A, finite s /\ permutes A p s)

items.name: PERMUTATION_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall Q:set -> prop, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> permutation A p /\ (forall x :e A, Q (p x) <-> Q x) -> permutation A (fun i:set => if Q i then p i else i)

items.name: PERMUTATION_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, permutation A (fun x:set => swap A (a,b) x)

items.name: PERMUTES_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s <-> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ ((forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> p x = x) /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ p y0 = y -> y0 = x)

items.name: PERMUTES_BIJECTIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ ((forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> p x = x) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> q x :e s) /\ ((forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> q x = x) /\ ((forall x :e A, p (q x) = x) /\ (forall x :e A, q (p x) = x))))) -> permutes A p s

items.name: PERMUTES_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e B, q x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, permutes A p s /\ permutes B q t -> permutes (A :*: B) (fun p0:set => if p0 0 :e s /\ p0 1 :e t then (p (p0 0),q (p0 1)) else (p0 0,p0 1)) (s :*: t)

items.name: PERMUTES_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s /\ permutes A q s -> permutes A (fun x:set => q (p x)) s

items.name: PERMUTES_CYCLIC
items.statement: forall n :e omega, permutes omega (fun i:set => if i < n then mod_nat (i + 1) n else i) {i :e omega | i < n}

items.name: PERMUTES_CYCLIC_N
items.statement: forall n k :e omega, permutes omega (fun i:set => if i < n then mod_nat (i + k) n else i) {i :e omega | i < n}

items.name: PERMUTES_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> (permutes A p Empty <-> forall x :e A, p x = x)

items.name: PERMUTES_FINITE_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> finite s -> (permutes A p s <-> (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> p x = x) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y))

items.name: PERMUTES_FINITE_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> finite s -> (permutes A p s <-> (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> p x = x) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y))

items.name: PERMUTES_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, permutes A (fun x:set => x) s

items.name: PERMUTES_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, permutes A (fun x:set => x) s

items.name: PERMUTES_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> {p x | x :e s} = s

items.name: PERMUTES_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, finite s /\ (P (fun x :e A => x) /\ (forall a b :e A, forall p :e A :^: A, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (P p /\ permutation A (fun x:set => p x))) -> P (fun x :e A => swap A (a,b) (p x)))) -> forall p :e A :^: A, permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s -> P p

items.name: PERMUTES_INDUCT_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, finite s /\ (P (fun x :e A => x) /\ (forall a b :e A, forall p :e A :^: A, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (~ a = b /\ (P p /\ permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s))) -> P (fun x :e A => swap A (a,b) (p x)))) -> forall p :e A :^: A, permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s -> P p

items.name: PERMUTES_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> forall x y :e A, p x = p y <-> x = y

items.name: PERMUTES_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, forall s c= A, {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) (SetAdjoin s a)} = {(fun x0 :e A => swap A (a,x 0) (x 1 x0)) | x :e \/_ b :e A, {(b,p) | p :e A :^: A, b :e SetAdjoin s a /\ p :e {p0 :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p0 x) s}}}

items.name: PERMUTES_INSERT_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall a :e A, forall s c= A, permutes A p (SetAdjoin s a) -> permutes A (fun x:set => swap A (a,p a) (p x)) s

items.name: PERMUTES_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> permutes A (fun x:set => inverse A A p x) s

items.name: PERMUTES_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> (forall x :e A, p (inverse A A p x) = x) /\ forall x :e A, inverse A A p (p x) = x

items.name: PERMUTES_INVERSES_o
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> (forall x :e A, p (inverse A A p x) = x) /\ forall x :e A, inverse A A p (p x) = x

items.name: PERMUTES_INVERSE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> forall x y :e A, inverse A A p y = x <-> p x = y

items.name: PERMUTES_INVERSE_FUNCTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> (permutes A p s <-> exists q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) /\ ((forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> p x = x) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> p (q x) = x /\ q (p x) = x)))

items.name: PERMUTES_INVERSE_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> permutes A p s -> forall x :e A, inverse A A (fun x0:set => inverse A A p x0) x = p x

items.name: PERMUTES_INVOLUTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, p (p x) = x) /\ (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> p x = x) -> permutes A p s

items.name: PERMUTES_IN_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e A, permutes A p s -> (p x :e s <-> x :e s)

items.name: PERMUTES_IN_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> forall n i :e omega, permutes omega p (idx_n n) /\ i :e idx_n n -> 1 <= p i /\ p i <= n

items.name: PERMUTES_NUMSET_GE
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> forall s c= omega, permutes omega p s /\ (forall i :e omega, i :e s -> i <= p i) -> forall x :e omega, p x = x

items.name: PERMUTES_NUMSET_LE
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> forall s c= omega, permutes omega p s /\ (forall i :e omega, i :e s -> p i <= i) -> forall x :e omega, p x = x

items.name: PERMUTES_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall Q:set -> prop, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> (Q (p x) <-> Q x)) -> permutes A (fun i:set => if Q i then p i else i) s

items.name: PERMUTES_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall Q:set -> prop, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> (Q (p x) <-> Q x)) -> permutes A (fun i:set => if Q i then p i else i) {x :e A | x :e s /\ Q x}

items.name: PERMUTES_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall a :e A, permutes A p {a} <-> forall x :e A, p x = x

items.name: PERMUTES_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s t c= A, permutes A p s /\ s c= t -> permutes A p t

items.name: PERMUTES_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s t c= A, permutes A p s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :\: t -> p x = x) -> permutes A p t

items.name: PERMUTES_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> forall y :e A, exists x :e A, p x = y

items.name: PERMUTES_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, forall s c= A, a :e s /\ b :e s -> permutes A (fun x:set => swap A (a,b) x) s

items.name: PERMUTES_THREE_CYCLE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall a b c :e A, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (c :e s /\ (~ a = b /\ (~ b = c /\ ~ a = c)))) -> permutes A (fun x:set => three_cycle A a b c x) s

items.name: PERMUTES_TRANSFER
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e B, q x :e B) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> q (f x) = f (p x)) /\ (forall y :e B, ~ y :e {f x | x :e s} -> q y = y))) -> permutes B q {f x | x :e s}

items.name: PERMUTES_TRANSFER_BIJECTIONS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e B, f' x :e A) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e B, p x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall x :e A, f' (f x) = x) /\ ((forall y :e B, f (f' y) = y) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e t -> f' y :e s))) -> (permutes A (fun x:set => f' (p (f x))) s <-> permutes B p t)

items.name: PERMUTES_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> (permutes A p A <-> forall y :e A, exists x :e A, p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, p y0 = y -> y0 = x)

items.name: PERRON_FROBENIUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> 0 <= A i j) -> exists v :e R :^: idx N, exists c :e R, vector_norm N v = 1 /\ (0 <= c /\ matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v)

items.name: PGROUP_ACTION_FIXPOINT
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall p :e omega, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (prime_nat p /\ (finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (pgroup A {p} G /\ (finite s /\ ~ divides_nat p (finite_cardinality s))))) -> exists x :e X, x :e s /\ forall g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G -> a g x = x

items.name: PGROUP_ACTION_FIXPOINTS
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall p :e omega, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (finite s /\ (prime_nat p /\ (finite (group_carrier A G) /\ pgroup A {p} G))) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, finite_cardinality {x :e X | x :e s /\ forall g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G -> a g x = x} + p * q1 = finite_cardinality s + p * q2

items.name: PGROUP_DIVIDES_NORMALIZER_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ (finite_cardinality h = p ^ k /\ divides_nat p (div_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) (finite_cardinality h))))) -> divides_nat p (div_nat (finite_cardinality (group_normalizer A G h)) (finite_cardinality h))

items.name: PGROUP_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, pgroup A Empty G <-> trivial_group A G

items.name: PGROUP_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= omega, group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ pgroup A s G -> pgroup B s H

items.name: PGROUP_FRATTINI
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h j c= A, prime_nat p /\ (finite j /\ (normal_subgroup_of A j G /\ (h c= j /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ (prime_index p (finite_cardinality j) = k /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k))))) -> group_setmul A G (group_normalizer A G h) j = group_carrier A G

items.name: PGROUP_MAXIMAL_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, forall h c= A, prime_nat p /\ (finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (pgroup A {p} G /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ (forall h' c= A, subgroup_of A h' G /\ (h c= h' /\ h <> h') -> h' = group_carrier A G)))) -> normal_subgroup_of A h G

items.name: PGROUP_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= omega, pgroup A s G /\ s c= t -> pgroup A t G

items.name: PGROUP_MONOMORPHIC_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= omega, group_monomorphism A B (G,H) f /\ pgroup B s H -> pgroup A s G

items.name: PGROUP_NONTRIVIAL_CENTRE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ k = 0 /\ equip (group_carrier A G) (p ^ k)) -> {group_id A G} c= group_centralizer A G (group_carrier A G) /\ {group_id A G} <> group_centralizer A G (group_carrier A G)

items.name: PGROUP_NONTRIVIAL_CENTRE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (pgroup A {p} G /\ (normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ ~ n = {group_id A G}))) -> {group_id A G} c= group_centralizer A G (group_carrier A G) :/\: n /\ {group_id A G} <> group_centralizer A G (group_carrier A G) :/\: n

items.name: PGROUP_NORMALIZER_NORMALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k))) -> group_normalizer A G (group_normalizer A G h) = group_normalizer A G h

items.name: PGROUP_PRIME_TORSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G /\ prime_nat p -> pgroup A {p} (subgroup_generated A G {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k})

items.name: PGROUP_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G H :e group_hl A, forall s c= omega, pgroup (A :*: A) s (prod_group A A G H) <-> pgroup A s G /\ pgroup A s H

items.name: PGROUP_QUOTIENT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall s c= omega, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ pgroup A s G -> pgroup (Power A) s (quotient_group A G n)

items.name: PGROUP_SELF_NORMALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall s h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k /\ (subgroup_of A s G /\ (finite_cardinality s = p ^ k /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ group_normalizer A G s c= h))))) -> group_normalizer A G h = h

items.name: PGROUP_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> (pgroup A {p} G <-> forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k)

items.name: PGROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= omega, forall h c= A, pgroup A s G -> pgroup A s (subgroup_generated A G h)

items.name: PGROUP_SUBGROUP_PSUBSET_NORMALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, forall h c= A, prime_nat p /\ (finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (pgroup A {p} G /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ ~ h = group_carrier A G))) -> h c= group_normalizer A G h /\ h <> group_normalizer A G h

items.name: PGROUP_SUBSET_PRIME_TORSION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, forall s c= A, prime_nat p /\ (s c= group_carrier A G /\ pgroup A {p} (subgroup_generated A G s)) -> s c= {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k}

items.name: PGROUP_SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall s c= omega, pgroup (A :^: K) s (sum_group A K k G) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> pgroup A s (G i)

items.name: PICARD_LINDELOF_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx_n (1 + dimindex N), forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx_n (1 + dimindex N), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t0 :e R :^: idx 1, forall u0 :e R :^: idx N, forall r0 r1 B c :e R, open (idx_n (1 + dimindex N)) s /\ (continuous_on_hl (idx_n (1 + dimindex N)) N f s /\ (0 < r0 /\ (0 < r1 /\ (B * r0 < r1 /\ (c * r0 < 1 /\ ((\/_ x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (t0,vector_add 1 t0 (lift r0)) seq_nil), {pastecart 1 N x y | y :e cball N (u0,r1)}) c= s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx_n (1 + dimindex N), x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= B) /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, forall v w :e R :^: idx N, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (t0,vector_add 1 t0 (lift r0)) seq_nil) /\ (v :e cball N (u0,r1) /\ w :e cball N (u0,r1)) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f (pastecart 1 N t v)) (f (pastecart 1 N t w))) <= c * vector_norm N (vector_sub N v w))))))))) -> exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, u x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (u t0 = u0 /\ ((forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (t0,vector_add 1 t0 (lift r0)) seq_nil) -> has_vector_derivative N u (f (pastecart 1 N t (u t))) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 t) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (t0,vector_add 1 t0 (lift r0)) seq_nil)))) /\ forall v:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, v x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (t0,vector_add 1 t0 (lift r0)) seq_nil) -> pastecart 1 N t (v t) :e s) /\ (v t0 = u0 /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (t0,vector_add 1 t0 (lift r0)) seq_nil) -> has_vector_derivative N v (f (pastecart 1 N t (v t))) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 t) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (t0,vector_add 1 t0 (lift r0)) seq_nil))))) -> forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (t0,vector_add 1 t0 (lift r0)) seq_nil) -> v t = u t))

items.name: POLAR_DUAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polar_dual N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {{x :e R :^: idx N | - 1 <= dot N u x} | u :e R :^: idx N, u :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, vec N 0 :e polar_dual N s

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_ANTIMONO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t -> polar_dual N t c= polar_dual N s

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, 0 < r -> polar_dual N (cball N (vec N 0,r)) = cball N (vec N 0,recip_SNo r)

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> polar_dual N Empty = R :^: idx N

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_POLAR_DUAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (convex N s /\ vec N 0 :e s) -> polar_dual N (polar_dual N s) = s

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_POLAR_DUAL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polar_dual N (polar_dual N s) = s <-> closed N s /\ (convex N s /\ vec N 0 :e s)

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_POLAR_DUAL_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polar_dual N (polar_dual N s) = closure N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s (vec N 0)))

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ a = 0 -> polar_dual N {vector_mul N a x | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} = {vector_mul N (recip_SNo a) x | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e polar_dual N s}

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> polar_dual N {vec N 0} = R :^: idx N

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, polar_dual N (s :\/: t) = polar_dual N s :/\: polar_dual N t

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_UNIT_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> polar_dual N (cball N (vec N 0,1)) = cball N (vec N 0,1)

items.name: POLAR_DUAL_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> polar_dual N (R :^: idx N) = {vec N 0}

items.name: POLYHEDRAL_CONVEX_CONE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ convex_cone N s <-> exists k c= R :^: idx N, finite k /\ s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} k

items.name: POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s <-> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = s /\ ((forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ f' <> f -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} /\ s <> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y}) /\ forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b}))

items.name: POLYHEDRON_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, polyhedron A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s)

items.name: POLYHEDRON_AS_CONE_PLUS_CONV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s <-> exists t u c= R :^: idx N, finite t /\ (finite u /\ s = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x0} t /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} u})

items.name: POLYHEDRON_CONIC_HULL_POLYTOPE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s -> polyhedron N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s)

items.name: POLYHEDRON_CONVEX_CONE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> polyhedron N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} s)

items.name: POLYHEDRON_CONVEX_CONE_HULL_POLYTOPE

items.name: POLYHEDRON_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s -> polyhedron A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s)

items.name: POLYHEDRON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> polyhedron N Empty

items.name: POLYHEDRON_EQ_FINITE_EXPOSED_FACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s <-> closed N s /\ (convex N s /\ finite {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | exposed_face_of N f s})

items.name: POLYHEDRON_EQ_FINITE_FACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s <-> closed N s /\ (convex N s /\ finite {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N f s})

items.name: POLYHEDRON_HALFSPACE_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, polyhedron N {x :e R :^: idx N | b <= dot N a x}

items.name: POLYHEDRON_HALFSPACE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, polyhedron N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b}

items.name: POLYHEDRON_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, polyhedron N {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = b}

items.name: POLYHEDRON_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> closed N s

items.name: POLYHEDRON_IMP_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> convex N s

items.name: POLYHEDRON_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ polyhedron N t -> polyhedron N (s :/\: t)

items.name: POLYHEDRON_INTERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> polyhedron N s) -> polyhedron N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y}

items.name: POLYHEDRON_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, polyhedron A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: POLYHEDRON_INTER_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s <-> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b})

items.name: POLYHEDRON_INTER_AFFINE_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s <-> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ ((forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b}) /\ forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ f' <> f -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} /\ s <> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y}))

items.name: POLYHEDRON_INTER_AFFINE_PARALLEL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s <-> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ (h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s -> vector_add N x a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s))

items.name: POLYHEDRON_INTER_AFFINE_PARALLEL_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s <-> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ ((forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ (h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x <= b} /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s -> vector_add N x a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s)) /\ forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ f' <> f -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} /\ s <> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y}))

items.name: POLYHEDRON_INTER_POLYTOPE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ polytope N t -> polytope N (s :/\: t)

items.name: POLYHEDRON_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ polyhedron M s -> polyhedron N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: POLYHEDRON_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> (polyhedron N {f x | x :e s} <-> polyhedron M s)

items.name: POLYHEDRON_LINEAR_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear M N f /\ polyhedron N s -> polyhedron M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e s}

items.name: POLYHEDRON_MINIMAL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite f /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} = s -> exists f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f' /\ (f' c= f /\ (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} = s /\ forall f'' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f'' c= f' /\ f'' <> f' -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f'', x :e Y} /\ s <> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f'', x :e Y}))

items.name: POLYHEDRON_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> polyhedron N {vector_neg N x | x :e s}

items.name: POLYHEDRON_POLYTOPE_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ polytope N t -> polyhedron N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: POLYHEDRON_POSITIVE_ORTHANT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> polyhedron N {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 <= x i}

items.name: POLYHEDRON_RIDGE_TWO_FACETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p r c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N p /\ (face_of N r p /\ (~ r = Empty /\ aff_dim N r = aff_dim N p + - 2)) -> exists f1 f2 c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f1 p /\ (aff_dim N f1 = aff_dim N p + - 1 /\ (face_of N f2 p /\ (aff_dim N f2 = aff_dim N p + - 1 /\ (~ f1 = f2 /\ (r c= f1 /\ (r c= f2 /\ (f1 :/\: f2 = r /\ forall f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f p /\ (aff_dim N f = aff_dim N p + - 1 /\ r c= f) -> f = f1 \/ f = f2)))))))

items.name: POLYHEDRON_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ polyhedron N t -> polyhedron N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: POLYHEDRON_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> polyhedron N s

items.name: POLYHEDRON_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> polyhedron N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_ADD
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x + q x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_CONST
items.statement: forall c :e R, polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => c)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_FINITE_ROOTS
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall a :e R, polynomial_function_R p -> (finite {x :e R | p x = a} <-> ~ forall x :e R, p x = a)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_I
items.statement: polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_ID
items.statement: polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P (fun x :e R => x) /\ ((forall c :e R, P (fun x :e R => c)) /\ ((forall p q :e R :^: R, P p /\ P q -> P (fun x :e R => p x + q x)) /\ (forall p q :e R :^: R, P p /\ P q -> P (fun x :e R => p x * q x)))) -> forall p :e R :^: R, polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x) -> P p

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_LMUL
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall c :e R, polynomial_function_R p -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => c * p x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_MUL
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x * q x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_NEG
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> (polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => - p x) <-> polynomial_function_R p)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_POW
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, polynomial_function_R p -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x ^ n)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R, forall y :e A, p x y :e R) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x i)) -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => finprod s (p x))

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_RMUL
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall c :e R, polynomial_function_R p -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x * c)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_SUB
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x + - q x)

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R, forall y :e A, p x y :e R) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p x i)) -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => finsum s (p x))

items.name: POLYNOMIAL_FUNCTION_o
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R, q x :e R) -> polynomial_function_R p /\ polynomial_function_R q -> polynomial_function_R (fun x:set => p (q x))

items.name: POLYTOPE_1
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, polytope 1 s <-> exists a b :e R :^: idx 1, s = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: POLYTOPE_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, polytope N s -> polytope N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s}

items.name: POLYTOPE_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx N, polytope N {vector_add N (vector_mul N m x) c | x :e s} <-> m = 0 \/ polytope N s

items.name: POLYTOPE_AFF_DIM_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, polytope N p /\ aff_dim N p = 1 <-> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b /\ p = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: POLYTOPE_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, finite s -> polytope A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} s)

items.name: POLYTOPE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> polytope A Empty

items.name: POLYTOPE_EQ_BOUNDED_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s <-> polyhedron N s /\ bounded_hl N s

items.name: POLYTOPE_FACET_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, polytope N p /\ 0 < aff_dim N p -> exists f c= R :^: idx N, facet_of N f p

items.name: POLYTOPE_FACET_LOWER_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, polytope N p /\ ~ aff_dim N p = 0 -> aff_dim N p + 1 <= finite_cardinality {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | facet_of N f p}

items.name: POLYTOPE_IMP_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, polytope A s -> bounded_hl A s

items.name: POLYTOPE_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, polytope A s -> closed A s

items.name: POLYTOPE_IMP_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, polytope A s -> compact A s

items.name: POLYTOPE_IMP_CONVEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, polytope A s -> convex A s

items.name: POLYTOPE_IMP_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A, polytope A p -> polyhedron A p

items.name: POLYTOPE_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, polytope A s /\ polytope A t -> polytope A (s :/\: t)

items.name: POLYTOPE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, polytope A (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: POLYTOPE_INTER_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s /\ polyhedron N t -> polytope N (s :/\: t)

items.name: POLYTOPE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ polytope M p -> polytope N {f x | x :e p}

items.name: POLYTOPE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> (polytope N {f x | x :e s} <-> polytope M s)

items.name: POLYTOPE_LOWDIM_IMP_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, polytope N p /\ aff_dim N p <= 1 -> exists n :e int, simplex N n p

items.name: POLYTOPE_NEGATIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s -> polytope N {vector_neg N x | x :e s}

items.name: POLYTOPE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, polytope M s /\ polytope N t -> polytope (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: POLYTOPE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, polytope (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ polytope M s /\ polytope N t)

items.name: POLYTOPE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s -> polytope N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s}

items.name: POLYTOPE_SCALING_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, polytope N {vector_mul N c x | x :e s} <-> c = 0 \/ polytope N s

items.name: POLYTOPE_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, polytope N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: POLYTOPE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, polytope A {a}

items.name: POLYTOPE_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, polytope N s /\ polytope N t -> polytope N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: POLYTOPE_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, polytope N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> polytope N s

items.name: POLYTOPE_UNION_CONVEX_HULL_FACETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s p c= R :^: idx N, polytope N p /\ (0 < aff_dim N p /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= p)) -> p = Union {hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\/: f) | f :e Power (R :^: idx N), facet_of N f p}

items.name: POLYTOPE_VERTEX_LOWER_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, polytope N p -> aff_dim N p + 1 <= finite_cardinality {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v p}

items.name: POSET_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y

items.name: POSET_FLDEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> l x x

items.name: POSET_IMP_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> qoset_on A l

items.name: POSET_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, poset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ properly_rel l a x

items.name: POSET_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, poset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ properly_rel l x a

items.name: POSET_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l <-> qoset_on A l /\ forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y

items.name: POSET_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x

items.name: POSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, poset_on A l -> poset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: POSET_RESTRICTED_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, poset_on (Power A) (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ x c= y))

items.name: POSET_TRANS

items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> (if 0 <= x ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x ^ 2)) = x

items.name: POW_2_SQRT_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x ^ 2)) = abs_SNo x

items.name: PRE
items.statement: nat_pred 0 = 0 /\ forall n :e omega, nat_pred (ordsucc n) = n

items.name: PRESERVES_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_IFF_PRESERVES_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M t /\ t c= s -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e t}) <-> forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t})

items.name: PRESERVES_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_IFF_PRESERVES_NEGLIGIBLE_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s -> ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M t /\ t c= s -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e t}) <-> forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e t})

items.name: PRESERVES_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_IFF_PRESERVES_NEGLIGIBLE_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s -> ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M t /\ t c= s -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e t}) <-> forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t})

items.name: PRESERVES_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE_IMP_PRESERVES_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N t /\ t c= s -> lebesgue_measurable A {f x | x :e t}) -> forall t c= R :^: idx N, negligible N t /\ t c= s -> negligible A {f x | x :e t}

items.name: PRESERVES_NEGLIGIBLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) <-> forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t /\ t c= s -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: PRESERVES_NEGLIGIBLE_IMAGE_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> ((forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t -> negligible N {f x | x :e t}) <-> forall t c= R :^: idx M, negligible M t -> lebesgue_measurable N {f x | x :e t})

items.name: PRESERVES_NORM_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y

items.name: PRESERVES_NORM_PRESERVES_DOT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm M x0) -> dot N (f x) (f y) = dot M x y

items.name: PRESEVES_NORM_PRESERVES_DIST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)

items.name: PRE_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P (nat_pred n) <-> forall m :e omega, n = ordsucc m \/ m = 0 /\ n = 0 -> P m

items.name: PRE_ELIM_THM'
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, P (nat_pred n) <-> exists m :e omega, (n = ordsucc m \/ m = 0 /\ n = 0) /\ P m

items.name: PRIME
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> ~ p = 0 /\ (~ p = 1 /\ forall m :e omega, 0 < m /\ m < p -> gcd_int p m = 1)

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_FACT
items.statement: forall p n k :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ k) (factorial n) <-> k <= finsum {j :e omega | 1 <= j /\ p ^ j <= n} (fun j:set => div_nat n (p ^ j)))

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_INDEX
items.statement: forall n p k :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ k) n <-> n = 0 \/ (p = 1 \/ k <= prime_index p n)

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall p m :e omega, finite k /\ prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ m) (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) <-> m = 0 \/ exists i :e K, i :e k /\ divides_nat (p ^ m) (f i))

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall p m :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ m) (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) <-> m = 0 \/ finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} /\ exists i :e K, i :e k /\ divides_nat (p ^ m) (f i))

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_LCM
items.statement: forall m n p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ k) (lcm_int m n) <-> divides_nat (p ^ k) m \/ divides_nat (p ^ k) n)

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVIDES_PROD
items.statement: forall p k m n :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat (p ^ k) (m * n) -> exists i j :e omega, divides_nat (p ^ i) m /\ (divides_nat (p ^ j) n /\ k = i + j)

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVISORS_DIVIDES
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n <-> forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat (p ^ k) m -> divides_nat (p ^ k) n

items.name: PRIMEPOW_DIVISORS_EQ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, m = n <-> forall p k :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat (p ^ k) m <-> divides_nat (p ^ k) n)

items.name: PRIMEPOW_FACTOR
items.statement: forall n :e omega, 2 <= n -> exists p k m :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (1 <= k /\ (gcd_int p m = 1 /\ n = p ^ k * m))

items.name: PRIMES_INFINITE
items.statement: infinite {p :e omega | prime_nat p}

items.name: PRIME_0
items.statement: ~ prime_nat 0

items.name: PRIME_1
items.statement: ~ prime_nat 1

items.name: PRIME_2
items.statement: prime_nat 2

items.name: PRIME_ALT
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> ~ p = 0 /\ (~ p = 1 /\ forall n :e omega, 1 < n /\ n < p -> ~ divides_nat n p)

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> n = 1 \/ (divides_nat p n \/ gcd_int p n = 1)

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_CASES
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ gcd_int a b = 1 -> gcd_int p a = 1 \/ gcd_int p b = 1

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_EQ
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p -> (gcd_int p n = 1 <-> ~ divides_nat p n)

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_EQ_NONDIVISIBLE
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> forall n :e omega, gcd_int p n = 1 <-> ~ divides_nat p n

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_LT
items.statement: forall x p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (0 < x /\ x < p) -> gcd_int x p = 1

items.name: PRIME_COPRIME_STRONG
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> divides_nat p n \/ gcd_int p n = 1

items.name: PRIME_DIVEXP
items.statement: forall n p x :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (x ^ n) -> divides_nat p x

items.name: PRIME_DIVEXP_EQ
items.statement: forall n p x :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (x ^ n) <-> divides_nat p x /\ ~ n = 0)

items.name: PRIME_DIVEXP_N
items.statement: forall n p x :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (x ^ n) -> divides_nat (p ^ n) (x ^ n)

items.name: PRIME_DIVIDES_GROUP_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ prime_nat p -> ((exists x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ divides_nat p (group_element_order_hl A G x)) <-> divides_nat p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)))

items.name: PRIME_DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall p :e omega, finite k /\ prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) <-> exists i :e K, i :e k /\ divides_nat p (f i))

items.name: PRIME_DIVIDES_ITERATE_LCM_GEN
items.statement: forall K:set, K <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e omega) -> forall k c= K, forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => lcm_int a b) k f) <-> finite {j :e K | j :e k /\ ~ f j = 1} /\ exists i :e K, i :e k /\ divides_nat p (f i))

items.name: PRIME_DIVIDES_LCM
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (lcm_int m n) <-> divides_nat p m \/ divides_nat p n)

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (a * b) -> divides_nat p a \/ divides_nat p b

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_EQ
items.statement: forall p a b :e omega, prime_nat p -> (divides_nat p (a * b) <-> divides_nat p a \/ divides_nat p b)

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_POW
items.statement: forall n p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (gcd_int a b = 1 /\ divides_nat (p ^ n) (a * b)) -> divides_nat (p ^ n) a \/ divides_nat (p ^ n) b

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_POW_EQ
items.statement: forall n p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ gcd_int a b = 1 -> (divides_nat (p ^ n) (a * b) <-> divides_nat (p ^ n) a \/ divides_nat (p ^ n) b)

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_POW_GEN
items.statement: forall n p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ divides_nat p (gcd_int a b) /\ divides_nat (p ^ n) (a * b)) -> divides_nat (p ^ n) a \/ divides_nat (p ^ n) b

items.name: PRIME_DIVPROD_POW_GEN_EQ
items.statement: forall n p a b :e omega, prime_nat p /\ ~ divides_nat p (gcd_int a b) -> (divides_nat (p ^ n) (a * b) <-> divides_nat (p ^ n) a \/ divides_nat (p ^ n) b)

items.name: PRIME_EXP
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_nat (p ^ n) <-> prime_nat p /\ n = 1

items.name: PRIME_FACTOR
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 1 -> exists p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n

items.name: PRIME_FACTORIZATION
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> finprod {p :e omega | prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n} (fun p:set => p ^ prime_index p n) = n

items.name: PRIME_FACTORIZATION_ALT
items.statement: forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> finprod {p :e omega | prime_nat p} (fun p:set => p ^ prime_index p n) = n

items.name: PRIME_FACTORIZATION_INDEX
items.statement: forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k x :e omega) -> finite {p :e omega | prime_nat p /\ ~ k p = 0} -> exists n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> prime_index p n = k p

items.name: PRIME_FACTOR_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ (P 1 /\ (forall p n :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ n = 0 /\ P n) -> P (p * n))) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: PRIME_FACTOR_LT
items.statement: forall n m p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ n = 0 /\ n = p * m) -> m < n

items.name: PRIME_FACTOR_PARTITION
items.statement: forall Q:set -> prop, forall n :e omega, ~ n = 0 -> exists n1 n2 :e omega, n1 * n2 = n /\ ((forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n1 -> Q p) /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n2 -> ~ Q p)

items.name: PRIME_GE_2
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> 2 <= p

items.name: PRIME_IMP_NZ
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> ~ p = 0

items.name: PRIME_INDEX_MAXIMAL_PROPER_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> (finite {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} /\ prime_nat (finite_cardinality {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}) <-> ~ n = group_carrier A G /\ forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (n c= h /\ n <> h) -> h = group_carrier A G)

items.name: PRIME_INT_DIVPROD_EQ
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall a b :e int, prime_nat p -> (divides_int p (a * b) <-> divides_int p a \/ divides_int p b)

items.name: PRIME_IRREDUCIBLE
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> 1 < p /\ forall a b :e omega, divides_nat p (a * b) -> divides_nat p a \/ divides_nat p b

items.name: PRIME_ODD
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> p = 2 \/ odd_nat p

items.name: PRIME_ORDER_EQ_NO_PROPER_SUBGROUPS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G) = 1 \/ prime_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))) <-> forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> h = {group_id A G} \/ h = group_carrier A G

items.name: PRIME_ORDER_IMP_CYCLIC_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G) = 1 \/ prime_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))) -> cyclic_group_hl A G

items.name: PRIME_ORDER_IMP_NO_PROPER_SUBGROUPS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, equip (group_carrier A G) p /\ (p = 1 \/ prime_nat p) -> forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> h = {group_id A G} \/ h = group_carrier A G

items.name: PRIME_POWER_EXISTS
items.statement: forall n q :e omega, prime_nat q -> ((exists i :e omega, n = q ^ i) <-> forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n -> p = q)

items.name: PRIME_POWER_EXISTS_ALT
items.statement: forall n p :e omega, prime_nat p -> ((exists i :e omega, n = p ^ i) <-> forall d :e omega, divides_nat d n -> d = 1 \/ divides_nat p d)

items.name: PRIME_POWER_EXP
items.statement: forall n x p k :e omega, prime_nat p /\ (~ n = 0 /\ x ^ n = p ^ k) -> exists i :e omega, x = p ^ i

items.name: PRIME_POWER_MULT
items.statement: forall k x y p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ x * y = p ^ k -> exists i j :e omega, x = p ^ i /\ y = p ^ j

items.name: PRIME_PRIME_FACTOR
items.statement: forall n :e omega, prime_nat n <-> ~ n = 1 /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p n -> p = n

items.name: PRODUCT_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> finprod (idx_n 1) f = f 1

items.name: PRODUCT_2
items.statement: forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R) -> finprod (idx_n 2) t = t 1 * t 2

items.name: PRODUCT_3
items.statement: forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R) -> finprod (idx_n 3) t = t 1 * t 2 * t 3

items.name: PRODUCT_4
items.statement: forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R) -> finprod (idx_n 4) t = t 1 * t 2 * t 3 * t 4

items.name: PRODUCT_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x)) = abs_SNo (finprod s f)

items.name: PRODUCT_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: PRODUCT_ASSOCIATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall op :e Power omega :^: Power omega :^: Power omega, forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> (forall s t c= omega, s c= idx N /\ t c= idx N -> op s t c= idx N) /\ ((forall s t u c= omega, op s (op t u) = op (op s t) u) /\ (forall s t u c= omega, mult t u * mult s (op t u) = mult s t * mult (op s t) u)) -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector N), Product N mult (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => fun x2:set => x2 :e op x0 x1) x (Product N mult (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => fun x2:set => x2 :e op x0 x1) y z) = Product N mult (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => fun x2:set => x2 :e op x0 x1) (Product N mult (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => fun x2:set => x2 :e op x0 x1) x y) z

items.name: PRODUCT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finprod Empty f = 1) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e R) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finprod (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finprod s f else f x * finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m * finprod {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> (forall m :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 1) /\ forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * f (ordsucc n) else finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f * f n

items.name: PRODUCT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, P 1 /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: PRODUCT_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ P y -> P (x * y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finprod s f)

items.name: PRODUCT_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => c) = c ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: PRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c :e R, forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => c) = c ^ minus_nat (n + 1) m

items.name: PRODUCT_CONST_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall c :e R, forall n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun x:set => c) = c ^ n

items.name: PRODUCT_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> f a * finprod (s :\: {a}) f = finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e R, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finprod s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 1) = if a :e s then b else 1

items.name: PRODUCT_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x :/: g x) = finprod s f :/: finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_DIV_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f x :/: g x) = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f :/: finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finprod s f = finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> (finprod s f = 0 <-> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = 0)

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 <-> exists x :e omega, m <= x /\ (x <= n /\ f x = 0)

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 1) -> finprod s f = 1

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_1_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 1) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 1

items.name: PRODUCT_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> (forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> group_carrier (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e group_carrier A (G i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}) /\ ((forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall x :e K, group_id (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) x = if x :e k then group_id A (G x) else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ ((forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall x :e A :^: K, forall x0 :e K, group_inv (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) x x0 = if x0 :e k then group_inv A (G x0) (x x0) else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall x y :e A :^: K, forall x0 :e K, group_mul (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) x y x0 = if x0 :e k then group_mul A (G x0) (x x0) (y x0) else choose_in A (fun y0:set => True)))

items.name: PRODUCT_GROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall h :e Power A :^: K, (forall i :e K, i :e k -> subgroup_of A (h i) (G i)) -> product_group A K k (fun i:set => subgroup_generated A (G i) (h i)) = subgroup_generated (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e h i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: PRODUCT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= B, (forall x y :e B, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finprod {f x | x :e s} g = finprod s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: PRODUCT_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finprod s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => recip_SNo (f x)) = recip_SNo (finprod s f)

items.name: PRODUCT_LADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector A), Product A mult op (vector_add (multivector A) x y) z = vector_add (multivector A) (Product A mult op x z) (Product A mult op y z)

items.name: PRODUCT_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x /\ f x <= g x) -> finprod s f <= finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_LE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x /\ f x <= 1) -> finprod s f <= 1

items.name: PRODUCT_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> 0 <= f i /\ f i <= g i) -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: PRODUCT_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), Product A mult op (vector_mul (multivector A) c x) y = vector_mul (multivector A) c (Product A mult op x y)

items.name: PRODUCT_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), Product A mult op (vector_neg (multivector A) x) y = vector_neg (multivector A) (Product A mult op x y)

items.name: PRODUCT_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), Product A mult op (vec (multivector A) 0) x = vec (multivector A) 0

items.name: PRODUCT_MAP_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B K:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall k c= K, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e K, x x :e A) -> forall x0 :e K, (if x0 :e k then f x0 ((fun x1 :e K => if x1 :e k then x x1 else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: PRODUCT_MBASIS

var_views.op: set(Power omega :^: Power omega :^: Power omega)

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op :e Power omega :^: Power omega :^: Power omega, forall s t c= omega, Product N mult (fun x:set => fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e op x x0) (mbasis N s) (mbasis N t) = if s c= idx N /\ t c= idx N then vector_mul (multivector N) (mult s t) (mbasis N (op s t)) else vec (multivector N) 0

items.name: PRODUCT_MBASIS_SING

var_views.op: set(Power omega :^: Power omega :^: Power omega)

items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op :e Power omega :^: Power omega :^: Power omega, forall i j :e omega, Product N mult (fun x:set => fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e op x x0) (mbasis N {i}) (mbasis N {j}) = if i :e idx N /\ j :e idx N then vector_mul (multivector N) (mult {i} {j}) (mbasis N (op {i} {j})) else vec (multivector N) 0

items.name: PRODUCT_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_MUL_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 1} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 1} -> finprod s (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod s f * finprod s g

items.name: PRODUCT_MUL_NUMSEG
