items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f x * g x) = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f * finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: PRODUCT_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ finite_cardinality s * finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ minus_nat (n + 1) m * finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_NEG_NUMSEG_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, finprod (idx_n n) (fun i:set => - f i) = (- 1) ^ n * finprod (idx_n n) f

items.name: PRODUCT_OFFSET
items.statement: forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m p :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: PRODUCT_ONE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finprod s (fun n:set => 1) = 1

items.name: PRODUCT_PAIR
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (2 * i) * f (2 * i + 1))

items.name: PRODUCT_PERMUTE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> finprod s f = finprod s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: PRODUCT_PERMUTE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, permutes omega p {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} -> finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: PRODUCT_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_POS_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_POS_LT_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> 0 < f x) -> 0 < finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: PRODUCT_RADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall x y z :e R :^: idx (multivector A), Product A mult op x (vector_add (multivector A) y z) = vector_add (multivector A) (Product A mult op x y) (Product A mult op x z)

items.name: PRODUCT_REFLECT
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then 1 else finprod {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: PRODUCT_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, R0 1 1 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e R, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: PRODUCT_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e R, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m * m') (n * n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> R0 (f i) (g i)))) -> R0 (finprod s f) (finprod s g)

items.name: PRODUCT_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finprod s (fun i:set => if i :e s then f i else 1) = finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finprod {i :e A | i :e s /\ P i} f = finprod s (fun i:set => if P i then f i else 1)

items.name: PRODUCT_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), Product A mult op x (vector_mul (multivector A) c y) = vector_mul (multivector A) c (Product A mult op x y)

items.name: PRODUCT_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector A), Product A mult op x (vector_neg (multivector A) y) = vector_neg (multivector A) (Product A mult op x y)

items.name: PRODUCT_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e Power omega, mult x y :e R) -> forall op:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector A), Product A mult op x (vec (multivector A) 0) = vec (multivector A) 0

items.name: PRODUCT_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall x :e A, finprod {x} f = f x

items.name: PRODUCT_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, finprod {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: PRODUCT_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 1) -> finprod v f = finprod u f

items.name: PRODUCT_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finprod {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} f = finprod s f

items.name: PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_BASE_ALT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, relative_to (A :^: K) {x :e Power (A :^: K) | exists u c= Power (A :^: K), finite u /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e \/_ i :e K, {{x01 :e A :^: K | x01 i :e u} | u :e Power A, i :e k /\ u :e tops i}) /\ {x0 :e A :^: K | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} (topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops)) = {{f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e u i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} | u :e Power A :^: K, finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ u i = topspace A (tops i)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> u i :e tops i}

items.name: PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> product_topology A K Empty tops = {Empty,{fun k :e K => choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}}

items.name: PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_EMPTY_DISCRETE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> product_topology A K Empty tops = discrete_topology (A :^: K) {fun x :e K => choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}

items.name: PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_EQ
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall top':set -> set, (forall x :e K, top' x :e topology A) -> (product_topology A K k top = product_topology A K k top' <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k top) = Empty /\ topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k top') = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> top i = top' i)

items.name: PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_HOMEOMORPHIC_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, forall i :e K, i :e k /\ (forall j :e K, j :e k /\ ~ j = i -> exists a :e A, topspace A (tops j) = {a}) -> homeomorphic_space (A :^: K) A (product_topology A K k tops) (tops i)

items.name: PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_SUBBASE_ALT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall t c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> relative_to (A :^: K) {x :e Power (A :^: K) | exists u c= Power (A :^: K), finite u /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e \/_ k :e K, {{x01 :e A :^: K | x01 k :e u} | u :e Power A, k :e t /\ u :e tops k}) /\ {x0 :e A :^: K | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} (topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K t tops)) = relative_to (A :^: K) {x :e Power (A :^: K) | exists u c= Power (A :^: K), finite u /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e \/_ k :e K, {{x01 :e A :^: K | x01 k :e u} | u :e Power A, k :e t /\ (u :e tops k /\ (u c= topspace A (tops k) /\ u <> topspace A (tops k)))}) /\ {x0 :e A :^: K | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} (topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K t tops))

items.name: PRODUCT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finprod (s :\/: t) f = finprod s f * finprod t f

items.name: PRODUCT_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b)} c= s -> finprod s f = finprod A f

items.name: PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, group_carrier (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G G') = group_carrier A G :*: group_carrier B G') /\ ((forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, group_id (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G G') = (group_id A G,group_id B G')) /\ ((forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall x :e A :*: B, group_inv (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G G') x = (group_inv A G (x 0),group_inv B G' (x 1))) /\ forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall x x0 :e A :*: B, group_mul (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G G') x x0 = (group_mul A G (x 0) (x0 0),group_mul B G' (x 1) (x0 1))))

items.name: PROD_GROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G1 :e group_hl A, forall G2 :e group_hl B, forall h1 c= A, forall h2 c= B, subgroup_of A h1 G1 /\ subgroup_of B h2 G2 -> prod_group A B (subgroup_generated A G1 h1) (subgroup_generated B G2 h2) = subgroup_generated (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G1 G2) (h1 :*: h2)

items.name: PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, mspace (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) = mspace A m1 :*: mspace B m2) /\ forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall x :e A :*: B :*: (A :*: B), mdist (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) x = if 0 <= mdist A m1 (x 0 0,x 1 0) ^ 2 + mdist B m2 (x 0 1,x 1 1) ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (mdist A m1 (x 0 0,x 1 0) ^ 2 + mdist B m2 (x 0 1,x 1 1) ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- (mdist A m1 (x 0 0,x 1 0) ^ 2 + mdist B m2 (x 0 1,x 1 1) ^ 2))

items.name: PROD_METRIC_LE_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall x1 :e A, forall y1 :e B, forall x2 :e A, forall y2 :e B, x1 :e mspace A m1 /\ (x2 :e mspace A m1 /\ (y1 :e mspace B m2 /\ y2 :e mspace B m2)) -> mdist (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) ((x1,y1),(x2,y2)) <= mdist A m1 (x1,x2) + mdist B m2 (y1,y2)

items.name: PROD_TOPOLOGY_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, prod_topology A B (discrete_topology A s) (discrete_topology B t) = discrete_topology (A :*: B) (s :*: t)

items.name: PROD_TOPOLOGY_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top1' :e topology A, forall top2' :e topology B, prod_topology A B top1 top2 = prod_topology A B top1' top2' <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty /\ topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1' top2') = Empty \/ top1 = top1' /\ top2 = top2'

items.name: PROD_TOPOLOGY_HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall b :e B, topspace B top' = {b} -> homeomorphic_space (A :*: B) A (prod_topology A B top top') top

items.name: PROD_TOPOLOGY_HOMEOMORPHIC_SPACE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall a :e A, topspace A top = {a} -> homeomorphic_space (A :*: B) B (prod_topology A B top top') top'

items.name: PROD_TOPOLOGY_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, prod_topology A B (subtopology A top s) top' = subtopology (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top') (s :*: topspace B top')) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall t c= B, prod_topology A B top (subtopology B top' t) = subtopology (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top top') (topspace A top :*: t)

items.name: PROPERLY_DIVIDES_LE_IMP
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, divides_nat m n /\ (~ n = 0 /\ ~ m = n) -> 2 * m <= n

items.name: PROPERLY_EQ_STRICTLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x x0 :e A, properly_rel l x x0 <-> strictly_rel l x x0

items.name: PROPERLY_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0 S:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, R0 x y -> S x y) -> forall x y :e A, properly_rel R0 x y -> properly_rel S x y

items.name: PROPERLY_PROPERLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, properly_rel (properly_rel R0) x x0 <-> properly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: PROPERLY_STRICTLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, properly_rel (strictly_rel R0) x x0 <-> strictly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: PROPERTY_EMPTY_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> P (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> P Empty

items.name: PROPER_EQ_COMPACT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' /\ (kc_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f \/ kc_space A top)) -> (proper_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> compact_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k})

items.name: PROPER_IMP_CLOSED_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f -> closed_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PROPER_IMP_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> kc_space A top /\ (compact_space B top' /\ proper_map A B (top,top') f) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PROPER_LOCALLY_INJECTIVE_OPEN_IMP_COVERING_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => p x) c /\ ({p x | x :e c} = s /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x :e k}) /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c -> {p x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e c -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, x :e t /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c /\ forall y z :e R :^: idx M, y :e t /\ (z :e t /\ p y = p z) -> y = z))))) -> covering_space M N (c,p) s

items.name: PROPER_LOCALLY_INJECTIVE_OPEN_IMP_COVERING_MAP_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => p x) c /\ ({p x | x :e c} = s /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x :e k}) /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x :e {p x0 | x0 :e u}} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e c -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, x :e t /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c /\ forall y z :e R :^: idx M, y :e t /\ (z :e t /\ p y = p z) -> y = z))))) -> covering_space M N (c,p) s

items.name: PROPER_LOCALLY_INJECTIVE_OPEN_IMP_HOMEOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, path_connected M s /\ (simply_connected N t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ forall y z :e R :^: idx M, y :e u /\ (z :e u /\ f y = f z) -> y = z))))))) -> exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g)

items.name: PROPER_LOCALLY_INJECTIVE_OPEN_IMP_HOMEOMORPHISM_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, path_connected M s /\ (simply_connected N t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e {f x0 | x0 :e u}} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ forall y z :e R :^: idx M, y :e u /\ (z :e u /\ f y = f z) -> y = z))))))) -> exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g)

items.name: PROPER_LOCAL_HOMEOMORPHISM_GLOBAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, path_connected M s /\ (simply_connected N t /\ ((s = Empty -> t = Empty) /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> exists u c= R :^: idx M, exists v c= R :^: idx N, exists q :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), x :e u /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ homeomorphism M N (u,v) (f,q))))))) -> exists g :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (s,t) (f,g)

items.name: PROPER_LOCAL_HOMEOMORPHISM_IMP_COVERING_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx N, {p x | x :e c} = s /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e c /\ p x :e k}) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e c -> exists t c= R :^: idx M, exists u c= R :^: idx N, exists q :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), x :e t /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ homeomorphism M N (t,u) (p,q))))) -> covering_space M N (c,p) s

items.name: PROPER_MAP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) <-> (forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e k}) /\ forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e t -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = a})

items.name: PROPER_MAP_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (proper_map A B (top,top') f <-> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> compact_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k})

items.name: PROPER_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ proper_map B C (top',top'') g -> proper_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: PROPER_MAP_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall c :e B, proper_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => c) <-> compact_space A top /\ (topspace A top = Empty \/ closed_in B top' {c})

items.name: PROPER_MAP_DIAG_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, proper_map A (A :*: A) (top,prod_topology A A top top) (fun x:set => (x,x)) <-> hausdorff_space A top

items.name: PROPER_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) <-> (forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e k}) /\ forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e t -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x = a}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_ESCAPES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ compact M c -> finite {n :e omega | x n :e c}) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> finite {n :e omega | f (x n) :e k})

items.name: PROPER_MAP_ESCAPES_FROM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x0 :e R :^: idx M | x0 :e s /\ f x0 :e k}) /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ (~ a :e s /\ (tendsto M omega x a sequentially /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x (r x0))) b sequentially))))) -> ~ b :e {f x | x :e s}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_ESCAPES_IMP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x0 :e R :^: idx M | x0 :e s /\ f x0 :e k}) /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ (forall c c= R :^: idx M, c c= s /\ compact M c -> finite {n :e omega | x n :e c}))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> finite {n :e omega | f (x n) :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, proper_map (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f <-> {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_EUCLIDEAN_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx P, k c= u /\ compact P k -> compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e t /\ g x :e k})) -> forall k c= R :^: idx P, k c= u /\ compact P k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ g (f x) :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_EUCLIDEAN_FROM_COMPOSITION_LEFT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx P, k c= u /\ compact P k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ g (f x) :e k})))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx P, k c= u /\ compact P k -> compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e t /\ g x :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_EUCLIDEAN_FROM_COMPOSITION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx P, k c= u /\ compact P k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ g (f x) :e k})))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FROM_CLOSED_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_in B top' s /\ proper_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FROM_COMPACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (compact M s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) k)) -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FROM_COMPACT_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, compact M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> proper_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> proper_map B C (top',top'') g

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> hausdorff_space B top' /\ (proper_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ continuous_map B C (top',top'') g)) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_RIGHT_INJ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> proper_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ (continuous_map B C (top',top'') g /\ (forall x y :e B, x :e topspace B top' /\ (y :e topspace B top' /\ g x = g y) -> x = y))) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FROM_KIFICATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' -> (proper_map A B (kification A top,top') f <-> proper_map A B (top,top') f)

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FROM_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall c c= A, proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ closed_in A top c -> proper_map A B (subtopology A top c,top') f

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, proper_map (A :*: B) A (prod_topology A B top top',top) (fun x:set => x 0) <-> topspace A top = Empty \/ compact_space B top'

items.name: PROPER_MAP_FSTCART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall k c= R :^: idx M, compact N t /\ (k c= s /\ compact M k) -> compact (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {z :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | z :e (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) /\ fstcart M z :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, proper_map A A (top,top) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: PROPER_MAP_IMP_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f -> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top'

items.name: PROPER_MAP_INCLUSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (proper_map A A (subtopology A top s,top) (fun x:set => x) <-> closed_in A top s /\ forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> compact_in A top (s :/\: k))

items.name: PROPER_MAP_INTO_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, continuous_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) f \/ kc_space A top -> (proper_map A (R :^: idx N) (top,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= s /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ compact N k -> compact_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k})

items.name: PROPER_MAP_INTO_K_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ (forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> proper_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k},subtopology B top' k) f)) -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PROPER_MAP_INTO_K_SPACE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' -> (proper_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> proper_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k},subtopology B top' k) f)

items.name: PROPER_MAP_INTO_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall c c= B, proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= c -> proper_map A B (top,subtopology B top' c) f

items.name: PROPER_MAP_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_in B top' s -> (proper_map A B (top,subtopology B top' s) f <-> proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= s)

items.name: PROPER_MAP_NORM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx 1, closed N s -> forall k c= R :^: idx 1, k c= t /\ compact 1 k -> compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ lift (vector_norm N x) :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_NORM_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k c= R :^: idx 1, compact 1 k -> compact N {x :e R :^: idx N | lift (vector_norm N x) :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> topspace A top = Empty -> proper_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: PROPER_MAP_PAIRED
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top1 :e topology B, forall top2 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> hausdorff_space A top /\ (proper_map A B (top,top1) f /\ proper_map A C (top,top2) g) \/ (hausdorff_space B top1 /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top1) f /\ proper_map A C (top,top2) g) \/ hausdorff_space C top2 /\ (proper_map A B (top,top1) f /\ continuous_map A C (top,top2) g)) -> proper_map A (B :*: C) (top,prod_topology B C top1 top2) (fun x:set => (f x,g x))

items.name: PROPER_MAP_PAIRED_CLOSED_MAP_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y}) /\ regular_space A top) -> proper_map A (B :*: A) (top,prod_topology B A top' top) (fun x:set => (f x,x))

items.name: PROPER_MAP_PAIRED_CLOSED_MAP_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y}) /\ regular_space A top) -> proper_map A (A :*: B) (top,prod_topology A B top top') (fun x:set => (x,f x))

items.name: PROPER_MAP_PAIRED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ hausdorff_space B top' -> proper_map A (B :*: A) (top,prod_topology B A top' top) (fun x:set => (f x,x))

items.name: PROPER_MAP_PAIRED_CONTINUOUS_MAP_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ hausdorff_space B top' -> proper_map A (A :*: B) (top,prod_topology A B top top') (fun x:set => (x,f x))

items.name: PROPER_MAP_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top1 :e topology B, forall top2 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> hausdorff_space A top /\ (proper_map A B (top,top1) (fun x:set => f x 0) /\ proper_map A C (top,top2) (fun x:set => f x 1)) \/ (hausdorff_space B top1 /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top1) (fun x:set => f x 0) /\ proper_map A C (top,top2) (fun x:set => f x 1)) \/ hausdorff_space C top2 /\ (proper_map A B (top,top1) (fun x:set => f x 0) /\ continuous_map A C (top,top2) (fun x:set => f x 1))) -> proper_map A (B :*: C) (top,prod_topology B C top1 top2) f

items.name: PROPER_MAP_PROD
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top1' :e topology C, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top2' :e topology D, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e D) -> (proper_map (A :*: B) (C :*: D) (prod_topology A B top1 top2,prod_topology C D top1' top2') (fun p:set => (f (p 0),g (p 1))) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ proper_map A C (top1,top1') f /\ proper_map B D (top2,top2') g)

items.name: PROPER_MAP_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, forall v c= B, proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e v} = u -> proper_map A B (subtopology A top u,subtopology B top' v) f

items.name: PROPER_MAP_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ (y :e t /\ tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) y sequentially) -> exists z :e R :^: idx M, exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ (z :e s /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto M omega (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) z sequentially)))

items.name: PROPER_MAP_SEQUENTIALLY_IMP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x0 :e R :^: idx M | x0 :e s /\ f x0 :e k}) /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ (y :e t /\ tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) y sequentially))) -> exists z :e R :^: idx M, exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ (z :e s /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto M omega (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) z sequentially))

items.name: PROPER_MAP_SEQUENTIALLY_REV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y :e R :^: idx N, (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ (y :e t /\ tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => f (x x0)) y sequentially) -> exists z :e R :^: idx M, exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ (z :e s /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto M omega (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) z sequentially))) -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_SND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, proper_map (A :*: B) B (prod_topology A B top top',top') (fun x:set => x 1) <-> compact_space A top \/ topspace B top' = Empty

items.name: PROPER_MAP_SNDCART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t k c= R :^: idx N, compact M s /\ (k c= t /\ compact N k) -> compact (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) {z :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) | z :e (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) /\ sndcart M N z :e k}

items.name: PROPER_MAP_TO_COMPACT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, (forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= t /\ compact N k -> compact M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e k}) /\ (compact N t /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t <-> s c= t /\ ~ s = t

items.name: PSUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t <-> s c= t /\ exists a :e A, a :e t /\ ~ a :e s

items.name: PSUBSET_INSERT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t <-> exists x :e A, ~ x :e s /\ SetAdjoin s x c= t

items.name: PSUBSET_IRREFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, ~ (s c= s /\ s <> s)

items.name: PSUBSET_SUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t /\ t c= u -> s c= u /\ s <> u

items.name: PSUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= A, s c= t /\ s <> t /\ (t c= u /\ t <> u) -> s c= u /\ s <> u

items.name: PSUBSET_UNIONS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= Power A, (forall x y :e v, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ (u c= v :\: {Empty} /\ u <> v :\: {Empty}) -> Union u c= Union v /\ Union u <> Union v

items.name: PSUBSET_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, s c= A /\ s <> A <-> exists x :e A, ~ x :e s

items.name: PUSHIN_DROPOUT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, dimindex M + 1 = dimindex N /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> pushin N R M k (x k) (dropout N M k x) = x

items.name: P_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall f c= Power A, (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e f -> s0 :e P) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e P) -> hull A P s :e P

items.name: Product_DEF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), forall mult:set -> set -> set, (forall x0 y0 :e Power omega, mult x0 y0 :e R) -> forall op :e Power omega :^: Power omega :^: Power omega, Product N mult (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => fun x2:set => x2 :e op x0 x1) x y = vsum (Power omega) (multivector N) {s :e Power omega | s c= idx N} (fun s:set => vsum (Power omega) (multivector N) {s0 :e Power omega | s0 c= idx N} (fun t:set => vector_mul (multivector N) (multivector_index N x s * multivector_index N y t * mult s t) (mbasis N (op s t))))

items.name: QOSET_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> fld_on A l = {x :e A | l x x}

items.name: QOSET_FLDEQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l <-> l x x

items.name: QOSET_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, qoset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ strictly_rel l a x

items.name: QOSET_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, qoset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ strictly_rel l x a

items.name: QOSET_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= K, qoset_on (A :^: K) (fun x:set => fun y:set => forall i :e K, i :e s -> l (x i) (y i)) <-> s = Empty \/ qoset_on A l

items.name: QOSET_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x

items.name: QOSET_REFL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, qoset_on A l -> (l x x <-> x :e fld_on A l)

items.name: QOSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> qoset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: QOSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l -> forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z

items.name: QOSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> qoset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False)

items.name: QOSET_num
items.statement: qoset_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0)

items.name: QUANTIFY_SURJECTION_HIGHER_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) -> (forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e B, P x) <-> forall x :e A, P (f x)) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e B, P x) <-> exists x :e A, P (f x)) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (forall s c= B, Q s) <-> forall s c= A, Q {f x | x :e s}) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (exists s c= B, Q s) <-> exists s c= A, Q {f x | x :e s}) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (forall s c= Power B, Q s) <-> forall s c= Power A, Q {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e s}) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (exists s c= Power B, Q s) <-> exists s c= Power A, Q {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e s}) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (forall g :e B :^: (R :^: idx 1), P g) <-> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e A) -> P (fun x :e R :^: idx 1 => f (g x))) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (exists g :e B :^: (R :^: idx 1), P g) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e A) /\ P (fun x :e R :^: idx 1 => f (g x))) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (forall g :e B :^: omega, P g) <-> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) -> P (fun x :e omega => f (g x))) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (exists g :e B :^: omega, P g) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) /\ P (fun x :e omega => f (g x))) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (forall l :e finseq B, Q l) <-> forall l :e finseq A, Q (seq_map f l)) /\ (forall Q:set -> prop, (exists l :e finseq B, Q l) <-> exists l :e finseq A, Q (seq_map f l)))))))))))) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, {x :e B | P x} = {f x | x :e {x :e A | P (f x)}}) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, {s :e Power B | Q s} = {{x0 :e B | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e {s :e Power A | Q {f x | x :e s}}}) /\ forall R0:set -> prop, {l :e finseq B | R0 l} = {seq_map f x | x :e {l :e finseq A | R0 (seq_map f l)}}))

items.name: QUANTIFY_SURJECTION_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) -> (forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e B, P x) <-> forall x :e A, P (f x)) /\ ((forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e B, P x) <-> exists x :e A, P (f x)) /\ ((forall Q:set -> prop, (forall s c= B, Q s) <-> forall s c= A, Q {f x | x :e s}) /\ (forall Q:set -> prop, (exists s c= B, Q s) <-> exists s c= A, Q {f x | x :e s}))) /\ forall P:set -> prop, {x :e B | P x} = {f x | x :e {x :e A | P (f x)}}

items.name: QUASICOMPACT_OPEN_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_AS_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> exists t c= Power A, t c= connected_components_of A top /\ Union t = c

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top -> quasi_components_of A top = if topspace A top = Empty then Empty else {topspace A top}

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, quasi_components_of A (discrete_topology A u) = {{x} | x :e A, x :e u}

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c' c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top /\ c' :e quasi_components_of A top -> (c :/\: c' = Empty <-> ~ c = c')

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_EMPTY_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> quasi_components_of A top = Empty

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, quasi_components_of A top = Empty <-> topspace A top = Empty

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, quasi_components_of A top = {s} <-> connected_space A top /\ (~ topspace A top = Empty /\ s = topspace A top)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c' c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top /\ c' :e quasi_components_of A top -> (~ c :/\: c' = Empty <-> c = c')

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> {x :e A | forall Y :e {t :e Power A | closed_in A top t /\ (t :e top /\ c c= t)}, x :e Y} = c

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> c c= topspace A top

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF_SUBSET_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, quasi_components_of A top c= {s} <-> connected_space A top /\ (topspace A top = Empty \/ topspace A top = s)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_AS_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e Union {{x1 :e A | connected_component_of A top y x1} | y :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y}

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_IN_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, {x :e A | quasi_component_of A top a x} :e quasi_components_of A top <-> a :e topspace A top

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_IN_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y -> x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_NONSEPARATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ separated_between A top {x} {y})

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ forall t c= A, x :e t /\ (closed_in A top t /\ t :e top) -> y :e t)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (u :\/: v = topspace A top /\ (u :/\: v = Empty /\ (x :e u /\ y :e v)))))

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_CLOPEN_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c t c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top /\ (closed_in A top t /\ t :e top) -> c c= t \/ c :/\: t = Empty

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x y :e A, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ quasi_component_of A top x y -> quasi_component_of B top' (f x) (f y)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u c= A, forall x x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A (discrete_topology A u) x x0 <-> (x :e u -> x0 :e SetAdjoin Empty x) /\ (~ x :e u -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top y x0} = Empty <-> ~ quasi_component_of A top x y

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, (forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> quasi_component_of A top y x0) <-> ~ x :e topspace A top /\ ~ y :e topspace A top \/ x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ quasi_component_of A top x y)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_EQUIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> quasi_component_of A top y x0)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, (forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> x0 :e Empty) <-> ~ x :e topspace A top

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_EQ_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, (forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> quasi_component_of A top y x0) <-> ~ x :e topspace A top /\ ~ y :e topspace A top \/ ~ {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top y x0} = Empty

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A (subtopology A top s) x y /\ s c= t -> quasi_component_of A (subtopology A top t) x y

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_NONOVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top y x0} = Empty <-> ~ x :e topspace A top \/ (~ y :e topspace A top \/ ~ forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> quasi_component_of A top y x0)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_OVERLAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, ~ {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0} :/\: {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top y x0} = Empty <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> quasi_component_of A top y x0)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x <-> x :e topspace A top

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_SEPARATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ exists u v c= A, separated_in A top u v /\ (u :\/: v = topspace A top /\ (x :e u /\ y :e v)))

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> (x :e topspace A top -> x0 :e {x0 :e A | forall Y :e {t :e Power A | closed_in A top t /\ (t :e top /\ x :e t)}, x0 :e Y}) /\ (~ x :e topspace A top -> x0 :e Empty)

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_SUBSET_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0} c= topspace A top

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A (subtopology A top s) x y -> quasi_component_of A top x y

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y <-> quasi_component_of A top y x

items.name: QUASI_COMPONENT_OF_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y z :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y /\ quasi_component_of A top y z -> quasi_component_of A top x z

items.name: QUASI_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, finite (connected_components_of A top) \/ (finite (quasi_components_of A top) \/ (locally_connected_space A top \/ compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top \/ (regular_space A top \/ normal_space A top)))) -> quasi_components_of A top = connected_components_of A top

items.name: QUASI_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, quasi_components_of A top = connected_components_of A top <-> forall c c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> connected_in A top c

items.name: QUASI_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_INCLUSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, quasi_components_of A top = connected_components_of A top <-> connected_components_of A top c= quasi_components_of A top \/ quasi_components_of A top c= connected_components_of A top

items.name: QUASI_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, quasi_components_of A top = connected_components_of A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top x x0

items.name: QUASI_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_POINTWISE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, quasi_components_of A top = connected_components_of A top <-> forall x x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top x x0

items.name: QUASI_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, finite (connected_components_of A top) \/ (finite (quasi_components_of A top) \/ (locally_connected_space A top \/ compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top \/ (regular_space A top \/ normal_space A top)))) -> forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top x x0

items.name: QUASI_EQ_CONNECTED_COMPONENT_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, (forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top x x0) <-> connected_in A top {x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0}

items.name: QUASI_SUBSET_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, quasi_components_of A top c= connected_components_of A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> forall x0 :e A, quasi_component_of A top x x0 <-> connected_component_of A top x x0

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> group_carrier (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) = {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}) /\ ((forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> group_id (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) = n) /\ ((forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> forall x c= A, forall x0 :e A, group_inv (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) x x0 <-> x0 :e group_setinv A G x) /\ forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> forall x x0 c= A, forall x1 :e A, group_mul (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) x x0 x1 <-> x1 :e group_setmul A G x x0))

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall a b :e A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (a :e group_carrier A G /\ b :e group_carrier A G) -> group_div (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) (right_coset_hl A G n a) (right_coset_hl A G n b) = right_coset_hl A G n (group_div A G a b)

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> group_id (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) = n

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall a :e A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> forall x :e A, group_inv (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) (right_coset_hl A G n a) x <-> x :e right_coset_hl A G n (group_inv A G a)

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall a b :e A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (a :e group_carrier A G /\ b :e group_carrier A G) -> forall x :e A, group_mul (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) (right_coset_hl A G n a) (right_coset_hl A G n b) x <-> x :e right_coset_hl A G n (group_mul A G a b)

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_POW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall a :e A, forall k :e omega, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> group_pow (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) (right_coset_hl A G n a) k = right_coset_hl A G n (group_pow A G a k)

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_POW_EQ_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall x :e A, forall k :e omega, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> (group_pow (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) (right_coset_hl A G n x) k = group_id (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) <-> group_pow A G x k :e n)

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ n c= h) -> quotient_group A (subgroup_generated A G h) n = subgroup_generated (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e h}

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, isomorphic_group (Power A) A (quotient_group A G {group_id A G}) G

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_UNIVERSAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall n c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f /\ (normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ n c= group_kernel A B (G,G') f) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power A, g x :e B) /\ (group_homomorphism_hl (Power A) B (quotient_group A G n,G') g /\ forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> g (right_coset_hl A G n x) = f x)

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_UNIVERSAL_EPIMORPHISM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall n c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,G') f /\ (normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ n c= group_kernel A B (G,G') f) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power A, g x :e B) /\ (group_epimorphism (Power A) B (quotient_group A G n,G') g /\ forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> g (right_coset_hl A G n x) = f x)

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_UNIVERSAL_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall n c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f /\ (normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ right_coset_hl A G n x = right_coset_hl A G n y) -> f x = f y)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power A, g x :e B) /\ (group_homomorphism_hl (Power A) B (quotient_group A G n,G') g /\ forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> g (right_coset_hl A G n x) = f x)

items.name: QUOTIENT_GROUP_ZPOW
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall a :e A, forall k :e int, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> group_zpow (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) (right_coset_hl A G n a) k = right_coset_hl A G n (group_zpow A G a k)

items.name: QUOTIENT_IMP_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: QUOTIENT_IMP_SURJECTIVE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f -> {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top'

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (quotient_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ forall u c= B, u c= topspace B top' -> (closed_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e u} <-> closed_in B top' u))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_CLOSED_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) {f x | x :e k}) <-> forall k c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) k -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e {f x | x :e k}})

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f /\ quotient_map B C (top',top'') g -> quotient_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_COMPOSE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f -> (quotient_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x)) <-> quotient_map B C (top',top'') g)

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_COMPOSE_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall v c= R :^: idx N, v c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) /\ (forall v c= R :^: idx P, v c= u -> ({x :e R :^: idx N | x :e t /\ g x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u))) -> forall v c= R :^: idx P, v c= u -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ g (f x) :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u)

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) /\ quotient_map A B (top,top') f -> quotient_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map B C (top',top'') g /\ quotient_map A C (top,top'') (fun x:set => g (f x))) -> quotient_map B C (top',top'') g

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_FROM_COMPOSITION_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx P, continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N P g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ (forall v c= R :^: idx P, v c= u -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ g (f x) :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u))))) -> forall v c= R :^: idx P, v c= u -> ({x :e R :^: idx N | x :e t /\ g x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx P) (euclidean P) u)

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_FROM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall u c= R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl M N f t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= u /\ (s c= t /\ ({f x | x :e s} = u /\ (forall v c= R :^: idx N, v c= u -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u))))) -> forall v c= R :^: idx N, v c= u -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e t /\ f x :e v} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) t <-> v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u)

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, quotient_map (A :*: B) A (prod_topology A B top top',top) (fun x:set => x 0) <-> topspace B top' = Empty -> topspace A top = Empty

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_IMP_CONTINUOUS_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} <-> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u)) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_IMP_CONTINUOUS_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) -> continuous_on_hl M N f s

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_INTO_K_SPACE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ (forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> quotient_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k},subtopology B top' k) f))) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_INTO_K_SPACE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> k_space B top' /\ kc_space B top' -> (quotient_map A B (top,top') f <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ forall k c= B, compact_in B top' k -> quotient_map A B (subtopology A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e k},subtopology B top' k) f))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, quotient_map A A (top,subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e topspace A top}) (fun x:set => kolmogorov_quotient A top x)

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, quotient_map A A (subtopology A top s,subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e s}) (fun x:set => kolmogorov_quotient A top x)

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_LIFT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall top'' :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e C) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map A C (top,top'') h /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ f x = f y) -> h x = h y)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) /\ (continuous_map B C (top',top'') g /\ ({g x | x :e topspace B top'} = {h x | x :e topspace A top} /\ forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> g (f x) = h x))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_ONTO_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ (forall u c= B, u c= topspace B top' -> ({x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e u} :e top <-> u :e top')) -> quotient_map A B (top,subtopology B top' {f x | x :e topspace A top}) f

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_OPEN_CLOSED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} <-> closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_OPEN_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {f x | x :e k} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) <-> forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e {f x | x :e k}} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s)

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_PROD
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology C, forall top1' :e topology B, forall top2' :e topology D, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e C, g x :e D) -> (locally_compact_space A top1 /\ ((hausdorff_space A top1 \/ regular_space A top1) /\ (locally_compact_space D top2' /\ (hausdorff_space D top2' \/ regular_space D top2'))) \/ locally_compact_space B top1' /\ ((hausdorff_space B top1' \/ regular_space B top1') /\ (locally_compact_space C top2 /\ (hausdorff_space C top2 \/ regular_space C top2)))) /\ (quotient_map A B (top1,top1') f /\ quotient_map C D (top2,top2') g) -> quotient_map (A :*: C) (B :*: D) (prod_topology A C top1 top2,prod_topology B D top1' top2') (fun p:set => (f (p 0),g (p 1)))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_PRODUCT_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, forall i :e K, i :e k -> (quotient_map (A :^: K) A (product_topology A K k tops,tops i) (fun x:set => x i) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty -> topspace A (tops i) = Empty)

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_PROD_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> locally_compact_space C top /\ ((hausdorff_space C top \/ regular_space C top) /\ quotient_map A B (top1,top2) f) -> quotient_map (A :*: C) (B :*: C) (prod_topology A C top1 top,prod_topology B C top2 top) (fun p:set => (f (p 0),p 1))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_PROD_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top1 :e topology B, forall top2 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e C) -> locally_compact_space A top /\ ((hausdorff_space A top \/ regular_space A top) /\ quotient_map B C (top1,top2) f) -> quotient_map (A :*: B) (A :*: C) (prod_topology A B top top1,prod_topology A C top top2) (fun p:set => (p 0,f (p 1)))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c c= R :^: idx N, {f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)) /\ (c :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t \/ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) c)) -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= c -> ({x :e R :^: idx M | x :e {x0 :e R :^: idx M | x0 :e s /\ f x0 :e c} /\ f x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x :e c} <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) c)

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, forall v c= B, quotient_map A B (top,top') f /\ ((v :e top' \/ closed_in B top' v) /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e v} = u) -> quotient_map A B (subtopology A top u,subtopology B top' v) f

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_SATURATED_CLOSED
