items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (quotient_map A B (top,top') f <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ forall u c= A, closed_in A top u /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e {f x | x :e u}} c= u -> closed_in B top' {f x | x :e u}))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_SATURATED_OPEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (quotient_map A B (top,top') f <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ forall u c= A, u :e top /\ {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e {f x | x :e u}} c= u -> {f x | x :e u} :e top'))

items.name: QUOTIENT_MAP_SND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, quotient_map (A :*: B) B (prod_topology A B top top',top') (fun x:set => x 1) <-> topspace A top = Empty -> topspace B top' = Empty

items.name: QUOTIENT_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_CORRESPONDENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall j c= A, forall k c= Power A, normal_subgroup_of A j G -> (normal_subgroup_of (Power A) k (quotient_group A G j) <-> exists i c= A, normal_subgroup_of A i G /\ (j c= i /\ ({x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ right_coset_hl A G j x :e k} = i /\ {{x0 :e A | x0 :e right_coset_hl A G j x} | x :e i} = k)))

items.name: QUOTIENT_SUBGROUP_CORRESPONDENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall j c= A, forall k c= Power A, normal_subgroup_of A j G -> (subgroup_of (Power A) k (quotient_group A G j) <-> exists i c= A, subgroup_of A i G /\ (j c= i /\ ({x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ right_coset_hl A G j x :e k} = i /\ {{x0 :e A | x0 :e right_coset_hl A G j x} | x :e i} = k)))

items.name: RADEMACHER
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable N M f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)}

items.name: RADEMACHER_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, negligible M (frontier M s) /\ (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable N M f (at M x)}

items.name: RADEMACHER_OPEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, open M s /\ (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ~ differentiable N M f (at M x)}

items.name: RADEMACHER_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | ~ differentiable N M f (at M x)}

items.name: RADON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, affine_dependent N c -> exists m p c= R :^: idx N, m c= c /\ (p c= c /\ (m :/\: p = Empty /\ ~ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} m :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} p = Empty))

items.name: RADON_EX_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, finite c /\ affine_dependent N c -> exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finsum c u = 0 /\ ((exists v :e R :^: idx N, v :e c /\ ~ u v = 0) /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N c (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = vec N 0))

items.name: RADON_PARTITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, finite c /\ affine_dependent N c -> exists m p c= R :^: idx N, m :/\: p = Empty /\ (m :\/: p = c /\ ~ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} m :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} p = Empty)

items.name: RADON_S_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finite s /\ finsum s f = 0 -> finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ 0 < f x} f = - finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x < 0} f

items.name: RADON_V_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> finite s /\ (vsum A N s f = vec N 0 /\ (forall x :e A, g x = 0 -> f x = vec N 0)) -> vsum A N {x :e A | x :e s /\ 0 < g x} f = vector_neg N (vsum A N {x :e A | x :e s /\ g x < 0} f)

items.name: RANK_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> rank A B (mat B A 0) = 0

items.name: RANK_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A <= if dimindex M <= dimindex N then dimindex M else dimindex N

items.name: RANK_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall c :e R, rank N M (matrix_cmul M N c A) = if c = 0 then 0 else rank N M A

items.name: RANK_COFACTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, rank N N (cofactor N A) = if rank N N A = dimindex N then dimindex N else if rank N N A = minus_nat (dimindex N) 1 then 1 else 0

items.name: RANK_COFACTOR_EQ_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, rank N N (cofactor N A) = 1 <-> dimindex N = 1 \/ rank N N A = minus_nat (dimindex N) 1

items.name: RANK_COFACTOR_EQ_FULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, rank N N (cofactor N A) = dimindex N <-> dimindex N = 1 \/ rank N N A = dimindex N

items.name: RANK_DIAGONAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A -> rank N N A = finite_cardinality {i :e omega | i :e idx N /\ ~ A i i = 0}

items.name: RANK_DIM_IM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = dim N {matrix_vector_mul N M A x | x :e R :^: idx M}

items.name: RANK_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = 0 <-> A = mat N M 0

items.name: RANK_EQ_FULL_DET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, rank N N A = dimindex N <-> ~ det N A = 0

items.name: RANK_GRAM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_I
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> rank N N (mat N N 1) = dimindex N

items.name: RANK_INVERTIBLE_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx M, invertible N M A -> rank P N (matrix_mul N M P A B) = rank P M B

items.name: RANK_INVERTIBLE_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx M, invertible M P B -> rank P N (matrix_mul N M P A B) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank N M (matrix_inv M N A) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_MATRIX_INV_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M M (matrix_mul M N M (matrix_inv M N A) A) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_MATRIX_INV_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank N N (matrix_mul N M N A (matrix_inv M N A)) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_MUL_LE_LEFT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, rank P M (matrix_mul M N P A B) <= rank N M A

items.name: RANK_MUL_LE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, rank P M (matrix_mul M N P A B) <= rank P N B

items.name: RANK_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, rank N M (matrix_neg M N A) = rank N M A

items.name: RANK_NULLSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A + dim M {x :e R :^: idx M | matrix_vector_mul N M A x = vec N 0} = dimindex M

items.name: RANK_ROW
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = dim M (rows N M A)

items.name: RANK_SIMILAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall U :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, invertible N M U -> rank M M (matrix_mul M N M (matrix_inv M N U) (matrix_mul N N M A U)) = rank N N A

items.name: RANK_SYLVESTER
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, rank N M A + rank P N B <= rank P M (matrix_mul M N P A B) + dimindex N

items.name: RANK_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank N M (transp N M A) = rank M N A

items.name: RANK_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N (matrix_add N M A B) <= rank M N A + rank M N B

items.name: RATIONAL_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational -> abs_SNo x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_ABS_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x :e rational <-> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_ADD
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_ALT
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational <-> exists p q :e omega, ~ q = 0 /\ abs_SNo x = p :/: q

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists r :e R, r :e rational /\ abs_SNo (r + - x) < e0

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_ABOVE
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (x < q /\ q < x + e0)

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_BELOW
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (x + - e0 < q /\ q < x)

items.name: RATIONAL_APPROXIMATION_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall x e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists a b :e R, a :e rational /\ (b :e rational /\ (a < x /\ (x < b /\ abs_SNo (b + - a) < e0)))

items.name: RATIONAL_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall a b :e R, a < b -> exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)

items.name: RATIONAL_BETWEEN_EQ
items.statement: forall a b :e R, (exists q :e R, q :e rational /\ (a < q /\ q < b)) <-> a < b

items.name: RATIONAL_CLOSED
items.statement: (forall n :e omega, n :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e int -> x :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + y :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + - y :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x * y :e rational) /\ ((forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x :/: y :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, forall r :e omega, x :e rational -> x ^ r :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e rational -> - x :e rational) /\ ((forall x :e R, x :e rational -> recip_SNo x :e rational) /\ forall x :e R, x :e rational -> abs_SNo x :e rational))))))))

items.name: RATIONAL_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x :/: y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_INTEGER
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int -> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational -> recip_SNo x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_INV_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, recip_SNo x :e rational <-> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x * y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational -> - x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall x :e R, - x :e rational <-> x :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_POW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, x :e rational -> x ^ n :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :e rational /\ y :e rational -> x + - y :e rational

items.name: RATIONAL_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R) -> (forall i :e A, i :e s -> x i :e rational) -> finsum s x :e rational

items.name: RAT_LEMMA1
items.statement: forall y1 y2 x1 x2 :e R, ~ y1 = 0 /\ ~ y2 = 0 -> x1 :/: y1 + x2 :/: y2 = (x1 * y2 + x2 * y1) * recip_SNo y1 * recip_SNo y2

items.name: RAT_LEMMA2
items.statement: forall y1 y2 x1 x2 :e R, 0 < y1 /\ 0 < y2 -> x1 :/: y1 + x2 :/: y2 = (x1 * y2 + x2 * y1) * recip_SNo y1 * recip_SNo y2

items.name: RAT_LEMMA3
items.statement: forall y1 y2 x1 x2 :e R, 0 < y1 /\ 0 < y2 -> x1 :/: y1 + - x2 :/: y2 = (x1 * y2 + - x2 * y1) * recip_SNo y1 * recip_SNo y2

items.name: RAY_TO_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a l :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (a :e interior N s /\ ~ l = vec N 0) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ (vector_add N a (vector_mul N d l) :e frontier N s /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 <= e0 /\ e0 < d -> vector_add N a (vector_mul N e0 l) :e interior N s)

items.name: RAY_TO_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a l :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (a :e relative_interior N s /\ (vector_add N a l :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ ~ l = vec N 0)) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ (vector_add N a (vector_mul N d l) :e relative_frontier N s /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 <= e0 /\ e0 < d -> vector_add N a (vector_mul N e0 l) :e relative_interior N s)

items.name: RDIV_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall a b n :e omega, ~ a = 0 -> (div_nat b a < n <-> b < a * n)

items.name: REALLIM_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall a :e R, tendsto_real A (fun x:set => a) a net0

items.name: REALLIM_LBOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l b :e R, tendsto_real A f l net0 /\ (~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ eventually A {x :e A | b <= f x} net0) -> b <= l

items.name: REALLIM_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall l m :e R, tendsto_real A f l net0 /\ (tendsto_real A g m net0 /\ (~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ eventually A {x :e A | f x <= g x} net0)) -> l <= m

items.name: REALLIM_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, tendsto_real omega f l sequentially <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n -> abs_SNo (f n + - l) < e0

items.name: REALLIM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall l m :e R, tendsto_real A f l net0 /\ tendsto_real A g m net0 -> tendsto_real A (fun x:set => f x + - g x) (l + - m) net0

items.name: REALLIM_UBOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l b :e R, tendsto_real A f l net0 /\ (~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ eventually A {x :e A | f x <= b} net0) -> l <= b

items.name: REAL_ABS_0

items.name: REAL_ABS_1
items.statement: abs_SNo 1 = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_ABS
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall x y d :e R, 0 < d /\ (x + - d < y /\ y < x + d) <-> abs_SNo (y + - x) < d

items.name: REAL_ABS_BETWEEN1
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, x < z /\ abs_SNo (y + - x) < z + - x -> y < z

items.name: REAL_ABS_BETWEEN2
items.statement: forall x0 x y0 y :e R, x0 < y0 /\ (2 * abs_SNo (x + - x0) < y0 + - x0 /\ 2 * abs_SNo (y + - y0) < y0 + - x0) -> x < y

items.name: REAL_ABS_BOUND
items.statement: forall x y d :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < d -> y < x + d

items.name: REAL_ABS_BOUNDS
items.statement: forall x k :e R, abs_SNo x <= k <-> - k <= x /\ x <= k

items.name: REAL_ABS_CASES
items.statement: forall x :e R, x = 0 \/ 0 < abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_CIRCLE
items.statement: forall x y h :e R, abs_SNo h < abs_SNo y + - abs_SNo x -> abs_SNo (x + h) < abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_DIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (distance N (x,y)) = distance N (x,y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x :/: y) = abs_SNo x :/: abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_HAUSDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (hausdist N (s,t)) = hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: REAL_ABS_INFNORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (infnorm A x) = infnorm A x

items.name: REAL_ABS_INF_LE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= a) -> abs_SNo (inf s) <= a

items.name: REAL_ABS_INTEGER_LEMMA
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int /\ ~ x = 0 -> 1 <= abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (recip_SNo x) = recip_SNo (abs_SNo x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, x <= abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_LE_SQRT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo ((if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) + - if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <= if 0 <= 2 * abs_SNo (x + - y) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (2 * abs_SNo (x + - y)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- 2 * abs_SNo (x + - y))

items.name: REAL_ABS_LE_SQRT_POS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y -> abs_SNo ((if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) + - if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <= if 0 <= abs_SNo (x + - y) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (abs_SNo (x + - y)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- abs_SNo (x + - y))

items.name: REAL_ABS_MDIST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ y :e mspace A m -> abs_SNo (mdist A m (x,y)) = mdist A m (x,y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x * y) = abs_SNo x * abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (- x) = abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (vector_norm A x) = vector_norm A x

items.name: REAL_ABS_NUM
items.statement: forall n :e omega, abs_SNo n = n

items.name: REAL_ABS_NZ
items.statement: forall x :e R, ~ x = 0 <-> 0 < abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= abs_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ABS_POW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, abs_SNo (x ^ n) = abs_SNo x ^ n

items.name: REAL_ABS_REFL
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x = x <-> 0 <= x

items.name: REAL_ABS_SGN
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < abs_SNo x then 1 else if abs_SNo x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_SIGN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> abs_SNo (sign A p) = 1

items.name: REAL_ABS_SIGN2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < - y -> x < 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_SQRT
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = if 0 <= abs_SNo x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (abs_SNo x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- abs_SNo x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_STILLNZ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) < abs_SNo y -> ~ x = 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + - y) = abs_SNo (y + - x)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB_ABS
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (abs_SNo x + - abs_SNo y) <= abs_SNo (x + - y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB_INFNORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (infnorm A x + - infnorm A y) <= infnorm A (vector_sub A x y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUB_NORM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, abs_SNo (vector_norm A x + - vector_norm A y) <= vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y)

items.name: REAL_ABS_SUP_LE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= a) -> abs_SNo (sup s) <= a

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall x y :e R, abs_SNo (x + y) <= abs_SNo x + abs_SNo y

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE_LE
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, abs_SNo x + abs_SNo (y + - x) <= z -> abs_SNo y <= z

items.name: REAL_ABS_TRIANGLE_LT
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, abs_SNo x + abs_SNo (y + - x) < z -> abs_SNo y < z

items.name: REAL_ABS_ZERO
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x = 0 <-> x = 0

items.name: REAL_ABS_ZPOW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, abs_SNo (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = if 0 <= n then abs_SNo x ^ n else recip_SNo (abs_SNo x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ADD2_SUB2
items.statement: forall a b c d :e R, (a + b) + - (c + d) = (a + - c) + b + - d

items.name: REAL_ADD_AC
items.statement: forall m n p :e R, m + n = n + m /\ ((m + n) + p = m + n + p /\ m + n + p = n + m + p)

items.name: REAL_ADD_ASSOC

items.name: REAL_ADD_LDISTRIB

items.name: REAL_ADD_LINV

items.name: REAL_ADD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, (x + y) * z = x * z + y * z

items.name: REAL_ADD_RID
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + 0 = x

items.name: REAL_ADD_RINV
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - x = 0

items.name: REAL_ADD_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (x + y) + - x = y

items.name: REAL_ADD_SUB2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - (x + y) = - y

items.name: REAL_ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + y = y + x

items.name: REAL_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall m c x y :e R, ~ m = 0 -> (m * x + c = y <-> x = recip_SNo m * y + - c :/: m)

items.name: REAL_AFFINITY_LE

items.name: REAL_AFFINITY_LT

items.name: REAL_ARCH

items.name: REAL_ARCH_INV

items.name: REAL_ARCH_LT
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x < n

items.name: REAL_ARCH_POW
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 1 < x -> exists n :e omega, y < x ^ n

items.name: REAL_ARCH_POW2
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x < 2 ^ n

items.name: REAL_ARCH_POW_INV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 < y /\ x < 1 -> exists n :e omega, x ^ n < y

items.name: REAL_ARCH_RDIV_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x c :e R, 0 <= x /\ (0 <= c /\ (forall m :e omega, 0 < m -> m * x <= c)) -> x = 0

items.name: REAL_ARCH_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n :e omega, x <= n

items.name: REAL_BOUNDED_POS
items.statement: forall s c= R, real_bounded s <-> exists B :e R, 0 < B /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= B

items.name: REAL_BOUNDED_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, real_bounded (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R, real_bounded (open_real_interval (a,b))

items.name: REAL_BOUNDED_SHRINK

items.name: REAL_BOUNDS_LE

items.name: REAL_BOUNDS_LT

items.name: REAL_CARD_INTSEG_INT

items.name: REAL_CLOSED_CONTAINS_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, real_closed s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x)) -> inf s :e s

items.name: REAL_CLOSED_CONTAINS_SUP

items.name: REAL_CLOSED_HALFSPACE_LE

items.statement: forall a b :e R, a <= b -> closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = open_real_interval (a,b) :\/: {a,b}

items.name: REAL_CLOSED_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall a b :e R, real_closed (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: REAL_CLOSED_SING

items.statement: forall s t c= R, real_closed s /\ real_closed t -> real_closed (s :\/: t)

items.name: REAL_CLOSED_UNIV

items.name: REAL_COMPACT_ATTAINS_INF

items.statement: forall s c= R, real_compact s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ forall y :e R, y :e s -> y <= x

items.name: REAL_COMPACT_CONTAINS_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, real_compact s /\ ~ s = Empty -> inf s :e s

items.name: REAL_COMPACT_CONTAINS_SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, real_compact s /\ ~ s = Empty -> sup s :e s

items.statement: forall a b :e R, real_compact (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: REAL_COMPACT_IS_REALINTERVAL
items.statement: forall s c= R, real_compact s /\ is_realinterval s <-> exists a b :e R, s = closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: REAL_COMPACT_UNION
items.statement: forall s t c= R, real_compact s /\ real_compact t -> real_compact (s :\/: t)

items.name: REAL_COMPLETE
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e R, P x) /\ (exists M :e R, forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) -> exists M :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M) /\ forall M' :e R, (forall x :e R, P x -> x <= M') -> M <= M'

items.name: REAL_COMPLETE_SOMEPOS

items.statement: forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R) -> forall x y :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * x ^ i) + - finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * y ^ i) = (x + - y) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun j:set => finsum {i :e omega | j + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * y ^ minus_nat (minus_nat i j) 1) * x ^ j)

items.name: REAL_SUB_POLYFUN_ALT
items.statement: forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R) -> forall x y :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * x ^ i) + - finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => a i * y ^ i) = (x + - y) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun j:set => finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat (minus_nat n j) 1} (fun k:set => a (j + k + 1) * y ^ k) * x ^ j)

items.name: REAL_SUB_POW
items.statement: forall x y :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> x ^ n + - y ^ n = (x + - y) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun i:set => x ^ i * y ^ minus_nat (minus_nat n 1) i)

items.name: REAL_SUB_POW_L1
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> 1 + - x ^ n = (1 + - x) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun i:set => x ^ i)

items.name: REAL_SUB_POW_R1
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, 1 <= n -> x ^ n + - 1 = (x + - 1) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} (fun i:set => x ^ i)

items.name: REAL_SUB_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall x y z :e R, (x + - y) * z = x * z + - y * z

items.name: REAL_SUB_REFL
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - x = 0

items.name: REAL_SUB_RNEG
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - - y = x + y

items.name: REAL_SUB_RZERO
items.statement: forall x :e R, x + - 0 = x

items.name: REAL_SUB_SUB
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (x + - y) + - x = - y

items.name: REAL_SUB_SUB2
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - (x + - y) = y

items.name: REAL_SUB_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall a b c :e R, (a + - b) + b + - c = a + - c

items.name: REAL_SUMMABLE_CAUCHY
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall s c= omega, real_summable s f <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall m n :e omega, N <= m -> abs_SNo (finsum (s :/\: {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}) f) < e0

items.name: REAL_SUMMABLE_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall s c= omega, real_summable s g /\ (exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n /\ n :e s -> abs_SNo (f n) <= g n) -> real_summable s f

items.name: REAL_SUMS_INFSUM
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall s c= omega, real_sums f (real_infsum s f) s <-> real_summable s f

items.name: REAL_SUMS_SUMMABLE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, forall s c= omega, real_sums f l s -> real_summable s f

items.name: REAL_SUP_ASCLOSE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall l e0 :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo (x + - l) <= e0) -> abs_SNo (sup s + - l) <= e0

items.name: REAL_SUP_BOUNDS
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a b :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> a <= x /\ x <= b) -> a <= sup s /\ sup s <= b

items.name: REAL_SUP_EQ_INF
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (exists B :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= B) -> (sup s = inf s <-> exists a :e R, s = {a})

items.name: REAL_SUP_LE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> sup s <= b

items.name: REAL_SUP_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall y :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> (sup s <= y <-> forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= y)

items.name: REAL_SUP_LE_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (sup s <= a <-> forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= a)

items.name: REAL_SUP_LE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall s t c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (s c= t /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e t -> x <= b)) -> sup s <= sup t

items.name: REAL_SUP_LT_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall a :e R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (sup s < a <-> forall x :e R, x :e s -> x < a)

items.name: REAL_SUP_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ (forall b' :e R, b' < b -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ b' < x) -> sup s = b

items.name: REAL_TRUNCATE
items.statement: forall x :e R, exists n r :e R, n :e int /\ (0 <= r /\ (r < 1 /\ x = n + r))

items.name: REAL_TRUNCATE_POS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> exists n :e omega, exists r :e R, 0 <= r /\ (r < 1 /\ x = n + r)

items.name: REAL_WLOG_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e R, P x y <-> P y x) /\ (forall x y :e R, x <= y -> P x y) -> forall x y :e R, P x y

items.name: REAL_WLOG_LE_3
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e R, P x y z -> P y x z /\ P x z y) /\ (forall x y z :e R, x <= y /\ y <= z -> P x y z) -> forall x y z :e R, P x y z

items.name: REAL_WLOG_LT
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e R, P x x) /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x y <-> P y x) /\ (forall x y :e R, x < y -> P x y)) -> forall x y :e R, P x y

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= 0 then x ^ 0 else recip_SNo (x ^ (- 0))) = 1

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_1
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= 1 then x ^ 1 else recip_SNo (x ^ (- 1))) = x

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_2
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= 2 then x ^ 2 else recip_SNo (x ^ (- 2))) = x * x

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_ADD
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e int, ~ x = 0 -> (if 0 <= m + n then x ^ (m + n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- (m + n)))) = (if 0 <= m then x ^ m else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m))) * if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then (x :/: y) ^ n else recip_SNo ((x :/: y) ^ (- n))) = (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) :/: if 0 <= n then y ^ n else recip_SNo (y ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = 0 <-> x = 0 /\ ~ n = 0

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then recip_SNo x ^ n else recip_SNo (recip_SNo x ^ (- n))) = recip_SNo (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n)))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, 0 <= x -> 0 <= if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_LT
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, 0 < x -> 0 < if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_MINUS1
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= - 1 then x ^ (- 1) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- - 1))) = recip_SNo x

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then (x * y) ^ n else recip_SNo ((x * y) ^ (- n))) = (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) * if 0 <= n then y ^ n else recip_SNo (y ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e int, (if 0 <= - n then x ^ (- n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- - n))) = recip_SNo (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n)))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_NUM
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = x ^ n

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_ONE
items.statement: forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then 1 ^ n else recip_SNo (1 ^ (- n))) = 1

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_POW
items.statement: (forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, (if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))) = x ^ n) /\ forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, (if 0 <= - n then x ^ (- n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- - n))) = recip_SNo (x ^ n)

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_SUB
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e int, ~ x = 0 -> (if 0 <= m + - n then x ^ (m + - n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- (m + - n)))) = (if 0 <= m then x ^ m else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m))) :/: if 0 <= n then x ^ n else recip_SNo (x ^ (- n))

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_ZERO
items.statement: forall n :e int, (if 0 <= n then 0 ^ n else recip_SNo (0 ^ (- n))) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

items.name: REAL_ZPOW_ZPOW
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e int, (if 0 <= n then (if 0 <= m then x ^ m else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m))) ^ n else recip_SNo ((if 0 <= m then x ^ m else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m))) ^ (- n))) = if 0 <= m * n then x ^ (m * n) else recip_SNo (x ^ (- m * n))

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> (rectifiable_path N g <-> rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) t g x) /\ rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) t (vec 1 1) g x))

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_DIFFERENTIABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, countable s /\ (path N g /\ (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) :\: s -> differentiable N 1 g (at 1 t))) -> (rectifiable_path N g <-> absolutely_integrable_on N 1 (fun t:set => vector_derivative N g (at 1 t)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)))

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall t :e R :^: idx 1, t :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> p t = q t) /\ rectifiable_path N p -> rectifiable_path N q

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_IMAGE_SUBSET_CBALL

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_IMP_PATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g -> path N g

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_JOIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 -> (rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) <-> rectifiable_path N g1 /\ rectifiable_path N g2)

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_JOIN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g1 /\ rectifiable_path N g2 -> (rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) <-> pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2)

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_JOIN_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g1 /\ (rectifiable_path N g2 /\ pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2) -> rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x)

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => f (g x)) <-> rectifiable_path M g)

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => linepath N (a,b) x)

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_LIPSCHITZ_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> rectifiable_path M g /\ (exists B :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx M, x :e path_image M g /\ y :e path_image M g -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y)) -> rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => f (g x))

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_REPARAMETRIZATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h h' :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx 1), rectifiable_path N g /\ homeomorphism 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil),closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) (h,h') -> rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => g (h x))

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => reversepath N g x) <-> rectifiable_path N g)

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, rectifiable_path N g /\ (pathfinish N g = pathstart N g /\ a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => shiftpath N a g x)

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_SUBPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g /\ (u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ v :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) u v g x)

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_SUBPATH_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t :e R :^: idx 1, rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) s t g x) <-> path N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) s t g x) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g (closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (s,t) seq_nil))

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_SYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N p = pathstart N q /\ pathfinish N q = pathstart N p -> (rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p q x) <-> rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) q p x))

items.name: RECTIFIABLE_PATH_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (rectifiable_path N (fun x:set => vector_add N a (g x)) <-> rectifiable_path N g)

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v (vec N 0) = vec N 0

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_1D
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v x :e R :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 -> reflect_along N v x = if v = vec N 0 then x else vector_neg N x

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v x y :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v (vector_add N x y) = vector_add N (reflect_along N v x) (reflect_along N v y)

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> reflect_along N (basis N k) x = vector_sub N x (vector_mul N (2 * x k) (basis N k))

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_BASIS_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> reflect_along N (basis N i) x j = if j = i then - x j else x j

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v x y :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v x = reflect_along N v y <-> x = y

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v x :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v x = vec N 0 <-> x = vec N 0

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v x :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v x = x <-> orthogonal N v x

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_GALOIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v p q :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v p = q <-> p = reflect_along N v q

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_INVOLUTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v x :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v (reflect_along N v x) = x

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall v x :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm M x0) -> reflect_along N (f v) (f x) = f (reflect_along M v x)

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v (vector_mul N a x) = vector_mul N a (reflect_along N v x)

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v x :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v (vector_neg N x) = vector_neg N (reflect_along N v x)

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_NEGATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v x :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N (vector_neg N v) x = reflect_along N v x

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v v = vector_neg N v

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_SCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall v x :e R :^: idx N, ~ c = 0 -> reflect_along N (vector_mul N c v) x = reflect_along N v x

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v x = y

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_SWITCH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N a = vector_norm N b /\ ~ a = b -> reflect_along N (vector_sub N b a) a = b /\ reflect_along N (vector_sub N b a) b = a

items.name: REFLECT_ALONG_ZERO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N (vec N 0) x = x

items.name: REFLECT_BASIS_ALONG_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (1 <= j /\ j <= dimindex N)) -> reflect_along N (basis N i) (basis N j) = if i = j then vector_neg N (basis N j) else basis N j

items.name: REFLECT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, {vector_neg N x | x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval N (seq_cons (vector_neg N b,vector_neg N a) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, {vector_neg N x | x :e open_interval N (a,b)} = open_interval N (vector_neg N b,vector_neg N a)

items.name: REFLECT_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: (forall a b :e R, {- x | x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_real_interval (seq_cons (- b,- a) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R, {- x | x :e open_real_interval (a,b)} = open_real_interval (- b,- a)

items.name: REFLECT_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> {vector_neg N x | x :e R :^: idx N} = R :^: idx N

items.name: REFL_CLAUSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x = x <-> True

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closure N (interior N s) = s <-> closed N s /\ s c= closure N (interior N s)

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top (interior_of A top s) = s <-> closed_in A top s /\ s c= closure_of A top (interior_of A top s)

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closure N (interior N s) = s /\ closure N (interior N t) = t -> closure N (interior N (s :\/: t)) = s :\/: t

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> closure N (interior N t) = t) -> closure N (interior N (Union f)) = Union f

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSED_UNIONS_FAT_CELLS_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall u c= R :^: idx N, closure N (interior N u) = u /\ (finite s /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e s -> closed N c /\ convex N c) /\ Union s = u)) -> Union {c :e Power (R :^: idx N) | c :e s /\ ~ interior N c = Empty} = u

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSURE_IMP_THIN_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s c= closure N (interior N s) -> interior N (frontier N s) = Empty

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSURE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s c= closure N (interior N s) <-> closure N (interior N s) = closure N s

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSURE_OF_IMP_THIN_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= closure_of A top (interior_of A top s) -> interior_of A top (frontier_of A top s) = Empty

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSURE_OF_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= closure_of A top (interior_of A top s) <-> s c= topspace A top /\ closure_of A top (interior_of A top s) = closure_of A top s

items.name: REGULAR_CLOSURE_REFINEMENT_COVERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall U c= Power A, regular_space A top /\ ((forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top) -> Union {b :e Power A | b :e top /\ exists u c= A, u :e U /\ closure_of A top b c= u} = topspace A top

items.name: REGULAR_INTERIOR_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N (closure N s) c= s <-> interior N (closure N s) = interior N s

items.name: REGULAR_INTERIOR_IMP_THIN_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N (closure N s) c= s -> interior N (frontier N s) = Empty

items.name: REGULAR_INTERIOR_OF_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (closure_of A top s) c= s <-> interior_of A top (closure_of A top s) = interior_of A top s

items.name: REGULAR_INTERIOR_OF_IMP_THIN_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (closure_of A top s) c= s -> interior_of A top (frontier_of A top s) = Empty

items.name: REGULAR_LINDELOF_IMP_NORMAL_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ lindelof_space A top -> normal_space A top

items.name: REGULAR_LINDELOF_IMP_PARACOMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ lindelof_space A top -> paracompact_space A top

items.name: REGULAR_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N (closure N s) = s <-> open N s /\ interior N (closure N s) c= s

items.name: REGULAR_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (closure_of A top s) = s <-> s :e top /\ interior_of A top (closure_of A top s) c= s

items.name: REGULAR_OPEN_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, interior N (closure N s) = s /\ interior N (closure N t) = t -> interior N (closure N (s :/\: t)) = s :/\: t

items.name: REGULAR_POLYTOPE_DIST_BARYCENTRE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, forall r :e R, equip s n /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> distance N (x,y) = r) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> distance N (barycentre N s,x) = (if 0 <= (n + - 1) :/: (2 * n) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg ((n + - 1) :/: (2 * n)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- (n + - 1) :/: (2 * n))) * r

items.name: REGULAR_POLYTOPE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, n <= aff_dim N s + 1 /\ 0 < r -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, equip k n /\ (~ affine_dependent N k /\ (k c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e k /\ (y :e k /\ ~ x = y) -> distance N (x,y) = r))

items.name: REGULAR_POLYTOPE_WITH_BARYCENTRE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, n <= aff_dim N s + 1 /\ (0 < r /\ (a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ 1 < n)) -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, equip k n /\ (~ affine_dependent N k /\ (k c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ (barycentre N k = a /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e k -> distance N (a,x) = r) /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e k /\ (y :e k /\ ~ x = y) -> distance N (x,y) = (if 0 <= (2 * n) :/: (n + - 1) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg ((2 * n) :/: (n + - 1)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- (2 * n) :/: (n + - 1))) * r))))

items.name: REGULAR_POLYTOPE_WITH_BARYCENTRE_EXISTS_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, n <= aff_dim N s + 1 /\ (0 < r /\ (a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ ~ n = 0)) -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, equip k n /\ (~ affine_dependent N k /\ (k c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s /\ (barycentre N k = a /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e k /\ (y :e k /\ ~ x = y) -> distance N (x,y) = r) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e k -> distance N (a,x) = (if 0 <= (n + - 1) :/: (2 * n) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg ((n + - 1) :/: (2 * n)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- (n + - 1) :/: (2 * n))) * r))))

items.name: REGULAR_SECOND_COUNTABLE_HAUSDORFF_IMP_NORMAL_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ (second_countable A top /\ hausdorff_space A top) -> normal_space A top

items.name: REGULAR_SECOND_COUNTABLE_IMP_HEREDITARILY_NORMAL_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ second_countable A top -> hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top <-> forall c c= A, forall a :e A, closed_in A top c /\ a :e topspace A top :\: c -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (a :e u /\ c :/\: closure_of A top u = Empty)

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) <-> regular_space A top /\ locally_compact_space A top

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_COMPACT_CLOSED_SEPARATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, regular_space A top /\ (compact_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty)) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_COMPACT_CLOSED_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, compact_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_CONTINUOUS_PROPER_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> regular_space A top /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')) -> regular_space B top'

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, regular_space A (discrete_topology A s)

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> regular_space (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A)

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: regular_space R euclideanreal

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, regular_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_ONE_POINT_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, compact_space A top /\ (topspace A top :\: {a} :e top /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) k /\ closed_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) k -> closed_in A top k)) -> (regular_space A top <-> regular_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) /\ locally_compact_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})))

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> regular_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> regular_space B top'

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> hausdorff_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> (regular_space A top <-> regular_space B top')

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, regular_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> regular_space A (tops i)

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, regular_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ regular_space A top1 /\ regular_space B top2

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ regular_space A top -> regular_space B top'

items.name: REGULAR_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, regular_space A top -> regular_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: REGULAR_T0_EQ_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top -> (t0_space A top <-> hausdorff_space A top)

items.name: REGULAR_T0_IMP_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ t0_space A top -> hausdorff_space A top

items.name: REGULAR_T1_EQ_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top -> (t1_space A top <-> hausdorff_space A top)

items.name: REGULAR_T1_IMP_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ t1_space A top -> hausdorff_space A top

items.name: RELATIVE_BOUNDARY_OF_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s :\: relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = Union {hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\: {a}) | a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s}

items.name: RELATIVE_BOUNDARY_OF_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> s :\: relative_interior N s = Union {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | facet_of N f s}

items.name: RELATIVE_BOUNDARY_OF_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, ~ collinear N {a,b,c} -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {a,b,c} :\: relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {a,b,c}) = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: (closed_segment N (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil) :\/: closed_segment N (seq_cons (c,a) seq_nil))

items.name: RELATIVE_BOUNDARY_POINT_IN_EXPOSED_FACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (x :e s /\ ~ x :e relative_interior N s) -> exists f c= R :^: idx N, exposed_face_of N f s /\ (~ f = s /\ x :e f)

items.name: RELATIVE_BOUNDARY_POINT_IN_PROPER_FACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (x :e s /\ ~ x :e relative_interior N s) -> exists f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ (~ f = s /\ x :e f)

items.name: RELATIVE_BOUNDARY_RETRACT_OF_PUNCTURED_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ a :e relative_interior N s) -> retract_of N (s :\: relative_interior N s) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :\: {a})

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, relative_frontier N (ball N (a,r)) = if r = 0 then Empty else sphere N (a,r)

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CBALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, relative_frontier N (cball N (a,r)) = if r = 0 then Empty else sphere N (a,r)

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CBALL_INTER_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, affine N s /\ (a :e s /\ ~ r = 0) -> relative_frontier N (cball N (a,r) :/\: s) = sphere N (a,r) :/\: s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s -> relative_frontier A (closure A s) = relative_frontier A s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> relative_frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) = if exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a} then {vec N 0} else hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CONVEX_HULL_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> relative_frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ ((exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ u x = 0) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y)))}

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CONVEX_INTER_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (affine N t /\ ~ interior N s :/\: t = Empty) -> relative_frontier N (s :/\: t) = frontier N s :/\: t

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_PUNCTURED_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (a :e relative_interior N s /\ (relative_frontier N s c= t /\ t c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s)))) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (t :\: {a}),subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (t :\: {a})) (fun x:set => x) r /\ (retraction N (t :\: {a},relative_frontier N s) r /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, exists c :e R, 0 < c /\ vector_sub N (r x) a = vector_mul N c (vector_sub N x a)))

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> relative_frontier A Empty = Empty

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_frontier N s = Empty <-> affine N s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_FACIAL_PARTITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ closed N s -> Union {relative_interior N f | f :e Power (R :^: idx N), face_of N f s /\ aff_dim N f < aff_dim N s} = relative_frontier N s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_FACIAL_PARTITION_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ closed N s -> Union {relative_interior N f | f :e Power (R :^: idx N), face_of N f s /\ ~ f = s} = relative_frontier N s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N -> relative_frontier N s = frontier N s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_frontier N s = frontier_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s)) s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> relative_frontier N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e relative_frontier M s}

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ~ interior A s = Empty -> relative_frontier A s = frontier A s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_NOT_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> ~ relative_frontier N s = {a}

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_OF_CONVEX_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ closed N s -> relative_frontier N s = Union {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N f s /\ ~ f = s}

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_OF_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> relative_frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = Union {hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (s :\: {a}) | a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s}

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_OF_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> relative_frontier N s = Union {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | facet_of N f s}

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_OF_POLYHEDRON_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> relative_frontier N s = Union {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N f s /\ ~ f = s}

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_OF_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, ~ collinear N {a,b,c} -> relative_frontier N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {a,b,c}) = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: (closed_segment N (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil) :\/: closed_segment N (seq_cons (c,a) seq_nil))

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> relative_frontier N s = frontier N s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> relative_frontier N (relative_interior N s) = relative_frontier N s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_RETRACT_OF_PUNCTURED_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ a :e relative_interior N s) -> retract_of N (relative_frontier N s) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :\: {a})

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, relative_frontier N {a} = Empty

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s -> relative_frontier N s c= s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_SUBSET_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_frontier N s c= s <-> closed N s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_SUBSET_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_frontier N s c= frontier N s

items.name: RELATIVE_FRONTIER_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_frontier N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e relative_frontier N s}

items.name: RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, group_carrier (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s))) = {{x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | homologous_rel A (p,(top,s)) c x} | c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) c}) /\ ((forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), x :e group_id (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s))) <-> singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) x) /\ ((forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall r c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), group_inv (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s))) r x <-> x :e {frag_neg (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c | c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), c :e r}) /\ forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall r1 r2 c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), group_mul (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s))) r1 r2 x <-> x :e \/_ c1 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), {frag_add (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c1 c2 | c2 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), c1 :e r1 /\ c2 :e r2}))

items.name: RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_EUCLIDEAN_COMPLEMENT_STEP
items.statement: forall p :e int, forall n k :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, closed_in (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) s -> isomorphic_group (Power (frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group (R :^: omega) (p,(euclidean_space n,topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) :\: s))) (relative_homology_group (R :^: omega) (p + k,(euclidean_space (n + k),topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space (n + k)) :\: s)))

items.name: RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)) = relative_homology_group A (p,(top,topspace A top :/\: s))

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, relative_interior A s = {x :e R :^: idx A | x :e s /\ exists t c= R :^: idx A, open A t /\ (x :e t /\ t :/\: hull (R :^: idx A) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x0} s c= s)}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, affine N s -> relative_interior N s = s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, relative_interior A (ball A (a,r)) = ball A (a,r)

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, relative_interior A (cball A (a,r)) = if r = 0 then {a} else ball A (a,r)

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CBALL_INTER_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, affine N s /\ (a :e s /\ ~ r = 0) -> relative_interior N (cball N (a,r) :/\: s) = ball N (a,r) :/\: s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CLOSURE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, relative_interior A s c= relative_interior A (closure A s)

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} (relative_interior N s) :\: {vec N 0}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONIC_HULL_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (vec N 0 :e relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) <-> vec N 0 :e relative_interior N s)

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONVEX_CONTAINS_SAME_RAY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b l :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (b :e relative_interior N s /\ (forall t :e R, 0 <= t -> vector_add N a (vector_mul N t l) :e relative_interior N s)) -> forall t :e R, 0 <= t -> vector_add N b (vector_mul N t l) :e relative_interior N s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONVEX_HULL_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s -> relative_interior N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 < u x) /\ (finsum s u = 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONVEX_INTER_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (affine N t /\ ~ interior N s :/\: t = Empty) -> relative_interior N (s :/\: t) = interior N s :/\: t

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONVEX_INTER_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (open N t /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty) -> relative_interior N (s :/\: t) = relative_interior N s :/\: t

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_CONVEX_PROLONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> relative_interior N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> exists t :e R, 1 < t /\ vector_add N y (vector_mul N t (vector_sub N x y)) :e s}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> relative_interior A Empty = Empty

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, relative_interior A s = s <-> s :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s)

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_EQ_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_interior N s = closure N s <-> affine N s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s -> (relative_interior N s = Empty <-> s = Empty)

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> relative_interior N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e relative_interior M s}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ ~ relative_interior N s :/\: relative_interior N t = Empty) -> relative_interior N (s :/\: t) = relative_interior N s :/\: relative_interior N t

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s = R :^: idx N -> relative_interior N s = interior N s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_INTERIOR_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_interior N s = interior_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s)) s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_LINEAR_IMAGE_CONVEX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ convex M s -> relative_interior N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e relative_interior M s}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_LINEAR_PREIMAGE_CONVEX
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear M N f /\ (convex N s /\ ~ {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e relative_interior N s} = Empty) -> relative_interior M {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e s} = {x :e R :^: idx M | f x :e relative_interior N s}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_MAXIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, t c= s /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s) -> t c= relative_interior A s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ~ interior A s = Empty -> relative_interior A s = interior A s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_OF_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s -> relative_interior N s = s :\: Union {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | facet_of N f s}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> relative_interior N s = s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s) -> relative_interior A s = s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, relative_interior (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e relative_interior M s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e relative_interior N t}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_POLYHEDRON_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), b x :e R) -> finite f /\ (s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ ((forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> ~ a h = vec N 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N (a h) x <= b h}) /\ (forall f' c= Power (R :^: idx N), f' c= f /\ f' <> f -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y} /\ s <> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e f', x :e Y}))) -> relative_interior N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ forall h c= R :^: idx N, h :e f -> dot N (a h) x < b h}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_PROLONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e relative_interior N s /\ y :e s -> exists t :e R, 1 < t /\ vector_add N y (vector_mul N t (vector_sub N x y)) :e s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_interior N (relative_interior N s) = relative_interior N s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, relative_interior N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = if a = b then {a} else open_segment N (a,b)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, relative_interior N (open_segment N (a,b)) = open_segment N (a,b)

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, relative_interior A {a} = {a}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, relative_interior A s c= s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_SUBSET_OF_PROPER_FACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (t c= s /\ ~ relative_interior N t :\: relative_interior N s = Empty) -> exists f c= R :^: idx N, face_of N f s /\ (~ f = s /\ t c= f)

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ convex N t -> relative_interior N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e relative_interior N s /\ y :e relative_interior N t}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, relative_interior N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} = {vector_add N a x | x :e relative_interior N s}

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_UNBOUNDED_CONVEX_CONTAINS_RAY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ bounded_hl N s /\ a :e relative_interior N s) -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, ~ l = vec N 0 /\ forall t :e R, 0 <= t -> vector_add N a (vector_mul N t l) :e relative_interior N s

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_UNBOUNDED_CONVEX_CONTAINS_RAYS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ bounded_hl N s -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, ~ l = vec N 0 /\ forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall t :e R, a :e relative_interior N s /\ 0 <= t -> vector_add N a (vector_mul N t l) :e relative_interior N s
