items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, t c= s /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s) /\ (forall t' c= R :^: idx A, t' c= s /\ t' :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s) -> t' c= t)) -> relative_interior A s = t

items.name: RELATIVE_INTERIOR_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, relative_interior A (hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s) = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} s

items.name: RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u c= A, relative_to A P u = {u :/\: s | s :e Power A, s :e P}

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_COMPL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u s c= A, s c= u -> (u :\: s :e relative_to A P u <-> s :e relative_to A {c :e Power A | A :\: c :e P} u)

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, t :e relative_to A P s -> t c= s

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u s c= A, s :e P -> u :/\: s :e relative_to A P u

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall c d c= A, c :e P /\ d :e P -> c :/\: d :e P) -> forall c d c= A, c :e relative_to A P s /\ d :e relative_to A P s -> c :/\: d :e relative_to A P s

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P Q c= Power A, (forall s0 c= A, s0 :e P -> s0 :e Q) -> forall u c= A, s :e relative_to A P u -> s :e relative_to A Q u

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_RELATIVE_TO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, relative_to A (relative_to A P s) t = relative_to A P (s :/\: t)

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ s :e P -> s :e relative_to A P t

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall u s c= A, s c= u /\ s :e P -> s :e relative_to A P u

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall u s t c= A, s :e relative_to A P u /\ (s c= t /\ t c= u) -> s :e relative_to A P t

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall c d c= A, c :e P /\ d :e P -> c :\/: d :e P) -> forall c d c= A, c :e relative_to A P s /\ d :e relative_to A P s -> c :\/: d :e relative_to A P s

items.name: RELATIVE_TO_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, s :e relative_to A P A <-> s :e P

items.name: RELCYCLE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), x :e group_carrier (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (relcycle_group A (p,(top,s))) <-> singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) x) /\ ((forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, group_id (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (relcycle_group A (p,(top,s))) = frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega))) /\ ((forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), group_inv (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (relcycle_group A (p,(top,s))) x = frag_neg (A :^: (R :^: omega)) x) /\ forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x x0 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), group_mul (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (relcycle_group A (p,(top,s))) x x0 = frag_add (A :^: (R :^: omega)) x x0))

items.name: RELCYCLE_GROUP_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, relcycle_group A (p,(top,s)) = relcycle_group A (p,(top,topspace A top :/\: s))

items.name: REPLICATE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, seq_replicate 0 x = seq_nil /\ seq_replicate (ordsucc n) x = seq_cons x (seq_replicate n x)

items.name: REP_ABS_PAIR
items.error: internal constant mk_pair (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: REST
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\: {choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)} = s :\: {choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e s)}

items.name: RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) :e t then g (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f x | x :e s} c= t -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if f x :e t then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, forall x :e A, (if x :e s then g (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then g (f x) else choose_in C (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, topspace A top c= s -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') f)

items.name: RESTRICTION_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> s c= t -> (continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => if x :e t then f x else choose_in (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => True)) s <-> continuous_on_hl M N f s)

items.name: RESTRICTION_DEFINED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = f x

items.name: RESTRICTION_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x :e s /\ f x = y -> (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = y

items.name: RESTRICTION_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then g x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)

items.name: RESTRICTION_FIXPOINT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = f x) <-> f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: RESTRICTION_HAS_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> (has_vector_derivative N (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else choose_in (R :^: idx N) (fun y:set => True)) f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) <-> has_vector_derivative N f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s))

items.name: RESTRICTION_IDEMP
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_IN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e K, f x :e A) -> ((fun x :e K => if x :e k then f x else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> f i :e s i)

items.name: RESTRICTION_IN_EXTENSIONAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (fun x :e A => if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: RESTRICTION_RESTRICTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> s c= t -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then if x :e t then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNDEFINED
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = choose_in B (fun x:set => True)

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, (if x :e s then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = g x) <-> (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> g x = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> ((forall x :e A, f x = if x :e s then g x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) <-> (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> f x = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x)

items.name: RESTRICTION_UNIV
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e A then f x else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = f x

items.name: RESTRICT_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e A) -> t c= s /\ (permutes A f s /\ (permutes A g s /\ ({f x | x :e t} = t /\ {g x | x :e t} = t))) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e t then f (g x) else x) = if (if x :e t then g x else x) :e t then f (if x :e t then g x else x) else if x :e t then g x else x

items.name: RESTRICT_I
items.statement: forall A:set, forall t c= A, forall x :e A, (if x :e t then x else x) = x

items.name: RESTRICT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> finite t /\ (t c= s /\ (permutes A f s /\ {f x | x :e t} = t)) -> forall x :e A, (if x :e t then inverse A A f x else x) = inverse A A (fun x0:set => if x0 :e t then f x0 else x0) x

items.name: RESTRICT_PERMUTES_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> finite t /\ (t c= s /\ (permutes A f s /\ {f x | x :e t} = t)) -> permutes A (fun x:set => if x :e t then f x else x) t

items.name: RESTRICT_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall a b :e A, a :e s /\ b :e s -> forall x :e A, (if x :e s then swap A (a,b) x else x) = swap A (a,b) x

items.name: RETRACTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, r x :e R :^: idx A) -> (retraction A (s,t) r <-> t c= s /\ (continuous_on_hl A A r s /\ ({r x | x :e s} = t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e t -> r x = x)))

items.name: RETRACTION_ARC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc N p -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f (R :^: idx N) /\ ({f x | x :e R :^: idx N} c= path_image N p /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e path_image N p -> f x = x))

items.name: RETRACTION_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N t /\ (closed N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ t c= s)) -> retraction N (s,t) (fun x:set => closest_point N t x)

items.name: RETRACTION_IDEMPOTENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, r x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, retraction A (s,t) r -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> r (r x) = r x

items.name: RETRACTION_IMP_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') f -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: RETRACTION_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') f -> quotient_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: RETRACTION_IMP_QUOTIENT_MAP_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, retraction N (s,t) r -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u c= t -> ({x :e R :^: idx N | x :e s /\ r x :e u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s <-> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t)

items.name: RETRACTION_IMP_SURJECTIVE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') f -> {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top'

items.name: RETRACTION_MAPS_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top3 :e topology C, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall f' :e A :^: B, forall g' :e B :^: C, retraction_maps A B (top1,top2) (f,f') /\ retraction_maps B C (top2,top3) (g,g') -> retraction_maps A C (top1,top3) (fun x :e A => g (f x),fun x :e C => f' (g' x))

items.name: RETRACTION_MAPS_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f f' :e B :^: A, forall g g' :e A :^: B, (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = f' x) /\ ((forall x :e B, x :e topspace B top' -> g x = g' x) /\ retraction_maps A B (top,top') (f,g)) -> retraction_maps A B (top,top') (f',g')

items.name: RETRACTION_MAPS_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall r :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s t c= R :^: idx N, retraction_maps (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) (r,fun x :e R :^: idx N => x) <-> retraction N (s,t) (fun x:set => r x)

items.name: RETRACTION_MAPS_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, retraction_maps A A (top,subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e topspace A top}) (fun x :e A => kolmogorov_quotient A top x,fun x :e A => x)

items.name: RETRACTION_MAPS_SECTION_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r :e B :^: A, forall s :e A :^: B, retraction_maps A B (top,top') (r,s) -> retract_of_space A {s x | x :e topspace B top'} top /\ homeomorphic_space A B (subtopology A top {s x | x :e topspace B top'}) top'

items.name: RETRACTION_MAPS_SUBTOPOLOGIES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall r :e B :^: A, forall r' :e A :^: B, retraction_maps A B (top,top') (r,r') /\ ({r x | x :e s} c= t /\ {r' x | x :e t} c= s) -> retraction_maps A B (subtopology A top s,subtopology B top' t) (r,r')

items.name: RETRACTION_MAPS_TO_RETRACT_MAPS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r :e B :^: A, forall s :e A :^: B, retraction_maps A B (top,top') (r,s) -> retraction_maps A A (top,subtopology A top {s x | x :e topspace B top'}) (fun x :e A => s (r x),fun x :e A => x)

items.name: RETRACTION_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top3 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> retraction_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ retraction_map B C (top2,top3) g -> retraction_map A C (top1,top3) (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: RETRACTION_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) /\ retraction_map A B (top,top') f -> retraction_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: RETRACTION_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, retraction_map (A :*: B) A (prod_topology A B top1 top2,top1) (fun x:set => x 0) <-> topspace B top2 = Empty -> topspace A top1 = Empty

items.name: RETRACTION_MAP_INTO_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall t c= B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ {r x | x :e topspace A top} c= t -> retraction_map A B (top,subtopology B top' t) r

items.name: RETRACTION_MAP_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, retraction_map A A (top,subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e topspace A top}) (fun x:set => kolmogorov_quotient A top x)

items.name: RETRACTION_MAP_PRODUCT_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> (retraction_map (A :^: K) A (product_topology A K k tops,tops i) (fun x:set => x i) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty -> topspace A (tops i) = Empty)

items.name: RETRACTION_MAP_SND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, retraction_map (A :*: B) B (prod_topology A B top1 top2,top2) (fun x:set => x 1) <-> topspace A top1 = Empty -> topspace B top2 = Empty

items.name: RETRACTION_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, retraction A (s,s) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: RETRACTION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, r x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s s' t c= R :^: idx A, retraction A (s,t) r /\ (t c= s' /\ s' c= s) -> retraction A (s',t) r

items.name: RETRACTION_o
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, retraction N (s,t) f /\ retraction N (t,u) g -> retraction N (s,u) (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: RETRACT_FIXPOINT_PROPERTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N t s /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= s -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl N N g t /\ {g x | x :e t} c= t -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ g y = y

items.name: RETRACT_FROM_UNION_AND_INTER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) t /\ (retract_of N (s :\/: t) u /\ retract_of N (s :/\: t) t)) -> retract_of N s u

items.name: RETRACT_OF_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, closed A t /\ retract_of A s t -> closed A s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_CLOSED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) t /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ (s = Empty -> t = Empty))) -> retract_of N s (s :\/: t)

items.name: RETRACT_OF_COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, retract_of N t s /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl N M f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= u /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g s /\ {g x | x :e s} c= u)) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) f g) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl N M f t /\ ({f x | x :e t} c= u /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g t /\ {g x | x :e t} c= u)) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) f g

items.name: RETRACT_OF_COHOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_NULL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, retract_of N t s /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl N M f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= u -> exists c :e R :^: idx M, homotopic_with (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) f (fun x:set => c)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl N M f t /\ {f x | x :e t} c= u -> exists c :e R :^: idx M, homotopic_with (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) f (fun x:set => c)

items.name: RETRACT_OF_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N t /\ retract_of N s t -> compact N s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, connected N t /\ retract_of N s t -> connected N s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, contractible N t /\ retract_of N s t -> contractible N s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall s c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N Empty s <-> s = Empty) /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N s Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: RETRACT_OF_HOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, retract_of N t s /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f u /\ ({f x | x :e u} c= s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ {g x | x :e u} c= s)) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) f g) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f u /\ ({f x | x :e u} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ {g x | x :e u} c= t)) -> homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f g

items.name: RETRACT_OF_HOMOTOPICALLY_TRIVIAL_NULL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx M, retract_of N t s /\ (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f u /\ {f x | x :e u} c= s -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) f (fun x:set => c)) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N f u /\ {f x | x :e u} c= t -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) f (fun x:set => c)

items.name: RETRACT_OF_IMP_EXTENSIBLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, forall s t c= R :^: idx M, retract_of M s t /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= u) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x))

items.name: RETRACT_OF_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, retract_of A s t -> s c= t

items.name: RETRACT_OF_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ retract_of M t s) -> retract_of N {f x | x :e t} {f x | x :e s}

items.name: RETRACT_OF_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> (retract_of N {f x | x :e t} {f x | x :e s} <-> retract_of M t s)

items.name: RETRACT_OF_LOCALLY_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ retract_of N t s -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} t

items.name: RETRACT_OF_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N s t /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} t -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N s t /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} t -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | path_connected N x} s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_OPEN_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t) /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t) /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ (s = Empty -> t = Empty))) -> retract_of N s (s :\/: t)

items.name: RETRACT_OF_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, path_connected N t /\ retract_of N s t -> path_connected N s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, retract_of M s s' /\ retract_of N t t' -> retract_of (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'})

items.name: RETRACT_OF_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s s' c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, retract_of (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) (\/_ x :e s', {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'}) <-> (s = Empty \/ t = Empty) /\ (s' = Empty \/ t' = Empty) \/ retract_of M s s' /\ retract_of N t t'

items.name: RETRACT_OF_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, retract_of A s s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SEPARATED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :/\: closure N t = Empty /\ (t :/\: closure N s = Empty /\ (s = Empty -> t = Empty)) -> retract_of N s (s :\/: t)

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SIMPLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N t /\ retract_of N s t -> simply_connected N s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, retract_of N {x} s <-> x :e s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_CLOPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :e top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (s = Empty -> topspace A top = Empty)) -> retract_of_space A s top

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top /\ (t :e top /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ (s :\/: t = topspace A top /\ (s = Empty -> topspace A top = Empty)))) -> retract_of_space A s top

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, retract_of_space A Empty top <-> topspace A top = Empty

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, retract_of_space (R :^: idx N) t (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) <-> retract_of N t s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_IMP_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hausdorff_space A top /\ retract_of_space A s top -> closed_in A top s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_IMP_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, retract_of_space A s top /\ ~ topspace A top = Empty -> ~ s = Empty

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, retract_of_space A s top -> s c= topspace A top

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, retract_of_space A {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e topspace A top} top

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAPS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, retract_of_space A s top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ exists r :e A :^: A, retraction_maps A A (top,subtopology A top s) (r,fun x :e A => x)

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_SECTION_MAP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, retract_of_space A s top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ section_map A A (subtopology A top s,top) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, retract_of_space A {a} top <-> a :e topspace A top

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s u c= A, retract_of_space A s top /\ s c= u -> retract_of_space A s (subtopology A top u)

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, retract_of_space A (topspace A top) top

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SPACE_TRANS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, retract_of_space A s top /\ retract_of_space A t (subtopology A top s) -> retract_of_space A t top

items.name: RETRACT_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s s' t c= R :^: idx A, retract_of A t s /\ (t c= s' /\ s' c= s) -> retract_of A t s'

items.name: RETRACT_OF_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N s t /\ retract_of N t u -> retract_of N s u

items.name: RETRACT_OF_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall t s c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N t s -> retract_of N {vector_add N a x | x :e t} {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: RETRACT_OF_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall t s c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N {vector_add N a x | x :e t} {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> retract_of N t s

items.name: RETRACT_OF_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, retract_of N s (R :^: idx N) <-> AR N s /\ closed N s

items.name: REVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev seq_nil = seq_nil /\ seq_rev (seq_cons x l) = seq_append (seq_rev l) (seq_cons x seq_nil)

items.name: REVERSEPATH_JOINPATHS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A g1 = pathstart A g2 -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, reversepath A (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) g1 g2 x0) x = poly_add (R :^: idx A) (fun x0:set => reversepath A g2 x0) (fun x0:set => reversepath A g1 x0) x

items.name: REVERSEPATH_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear B A f -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, reversepath A (fun x:set => f (g x)) x = f (reversepath B g x)

items.name: REVERSEPATH_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, reversepath A (fun x0:set => linepath A (a,b) x0) x = linepath A (b,a) x

items.name: REVERSEPATH_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, reversepath N (fun x0:set => reversepath N g x0) x = g x

items.name: REVERSEPATH_SUBPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall u v x :e R :^: idx 1, reversepath A (fun x0:set => subpath (R :^: idx A) u v g x0) x = subpath (R :^: idx A) v u g x

items.name: REVERSEPATH_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, reversepath A (fun x:set => vector_add A a (g x)) x = vector_add A a (reversepath A g x)

items.name: REVERSE_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l m :e finseq A, seq_rev (seq_append l m) = seq_append (seq_rev m) (seq_rev l)

items.name: REVERSE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev l = seq_nil <-> l = seq_nil

items.name: REVERSE_REVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_rev (seq_rev l) = l

items.name: RIGHT_ADD_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, (m + n) * p = m * p + n * p

items.name: RIGHT_AND_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P /\ (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P /\ Q x

items.name: RIGHT_AND_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P /\ (forall x :e A, Q x) <-> forall x :e A, P /\ Q x

items.name: RIGHT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ h c= group_carrier A G -> right_coset_hl A G h x c= group_carrier A G

items.name: RIGHT_COSETS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> (right_coset_hl A G h x = right_coset_hl A G h y <-> ~ right_coset_hl A G h x :/\: right_coset_hl A G h y = Empty)

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> right_coset_hl A G (group_carrier A G) x = group_carrier A G

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x y :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> (right_coset_hl A G h x = right_coset_hl A G h y <-> group_div A G x y :e h)

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, right_coset_hl A G h x = Empty <-> h = Empty

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_EQ_SUBGROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> (right_coset_hl A G h x = h <-> x :e h)

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_GROUP_CONJUGATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ h c= group_carrier A G -> right_coset_hl A G {group_conjugation A G x x0 | x0 :e h} x = left_coset_hl A G x h

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, h c= group_carrier A G -> right_coset_hl A G h (group_id A G) = h

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, subgroup_of A h G -> ~ right_coset_hl A G h x = Empty

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_OPPOSITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, right_coset_hl A G h x = left_coset_hl A (opposite_group A G) x h

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall h :e Power A :^: K, forall x :e A :^: K, forall k c= K, right_coset_hl (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e h i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} x = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | x1 :e right_coset_hl A (G i) (h i) (x i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall G1 :e group_hl A, forall G2 :e group_hl B, forall h1 c= A, forall h2 c= B, forall x1 :e A, forall x2 :e B, right_coset_hl (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G1 G2) (h1 :*: h2) (x1,x2) = right_coset_hl A G1 h1 x1 :*: right_coset_hl B G2 h2 x2

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_RIGHT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x y :e A, forall h c= A, h c= group_carrier A G /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G) -> right_coset_hl A G (right_coset_hl A G h x) y = right_coset_hl A G h (group_mul A G x y)

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_SINGULAR_RELBOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x x0 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), x0 :e right_coset_hl (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (relcycle_group A (p,(top,s))) {x1 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) x1} x <-> homologous_rel A (p,(top,s)) x x0

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h k c= A, forall x :e A, right_coset_hl A (subgroup_generated A G h) k x = right_coset_hl A G k x

items.name: RIGHT_COSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> right_coset_hl A G {group_id A G} x = {x}

items.name: RIGHT_EXISTS_AND_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P /\ Q x) <-> P /\ exists x :e A, Q x

items.name: RIGHT_EXISTS_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P -> Q x) <-> P -> exists x :e A, Q x

items.name: RIGHT_FORALL_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P -> Q x) <-> P -> forall x :e A, Q x

items.name: RIGHT_FORALL_OR_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P \/ Q x) <-> P \/ forall x :e A, Q x

items.name: RIGHT_IMP_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P -> (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P -> Q x

items.name: RIGHT_IMP_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P -> (forall x :e A, Q x) <-> forall x :e A, P -> Q x

items.name: RIGHT_INVERSE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = x) -> linear N N g

items.name: RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, (exists B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_mul N M N (transp M N A) B = mat N N 1) <-> exists B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul N M N B A = mat N N 1

items.name: RIGHT_LIMIT_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto A (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop a <= drop x}) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop a < drop x})

items.name: RIGHT_LIMIT_WITHIN_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, tendsto A (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop a <= drop x}) <-> tendsto A (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop a < drop x})

items.name: RIGHT_OR_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall p q r:prop, (p \/ q) /\ r <-> p /\ r \/ q /\ r

items.name: RIGHT_OR_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P \/ (exists x :e A, Q x) <-> exists x :e A, P \/ Q x

items.name: RIGHT_OR_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:prop, forall Q:set -> prop, P \/ (forall x :e A, Q x) <-> forall x :e A, P \/ Q x

items.name: RIGHT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, exists U P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N P /\ matrix_mul N N N U P = A)

items.name: RIGHT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION_INVERTIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A <-> exists U P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_definite N P /\ matrix_mul N N N U P = A)

items.name: RIGHT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION_INVERTIBLE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A U V P S :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N A /\ (orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N P /\ (orthogonal_matrix_hl N V /\ (positive_semidefinite N S /\ (matrix_mul N N N U P = A /\ matrix_mul N N N V S = A))))) -> P = S /\ U = V

items.name: RIGHT_POLAR_DECOMPOSITION_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, exists P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (exists U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N P /\ matrix_mul N N N U P = A)) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, (exists U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N U /\ (positive_semidefinite N y /\ matrix_mul N N N U y = A)) -> y = P

items.name: RIGHT_SUB_DISTRIB
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, minus_nat m n * p = minus_nat (m * p) (n * p)

items.name: RIGID_TRANSFORMATION_BETWEEN_2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b a' b' :e R :^: idx N, distance N (a,b) = distance N (a',b') -> exists k :e R :^: idx N, exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ (a' = vector_add N k (f a) /\ b' = vector_add N k (f b)))

items.name: RIGID_TRANSFORMATION_BETWEEN_3
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c a' b' c' :e R :^: idx N, distance N (a,b) = distance N (a',b') /\ (distance N (b,c) = distance N (b',c') /\ distance N (c,a) = distance N (c',a')) -> exists k :e R :^: idx N, exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ (a' = vector_add N k (f a) /\ (b' = vector_add N k (f b) /\ c' = vector_add N k (f c))))

items.name: RIGID_TRANSFORMATION_BETWEEN_CONGRUENT_SETS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, y x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, (forall i j :e A, i :e s /\ j :e s -> distance N (x i,x j) = distance N (y i,y j)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ forall i :e A, i :e s -> y i = vector_add N a (f (x i)))

items.name: RIGID_TRANSFORMATION_BETWEEN_CONGRUENT_SETS_STRONG
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e A, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, y x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= A, t c= s /\ (hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} {y x | x :e t} = hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} {y x | x :e s} /\ (forall i j :e A, i :e s /\ j :e t -> distance N (x i,x j) = distance N (y i,y j))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f x0 :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ forall i :e A, i :e s -> y i = vector_add N a (f (x i)))

items.name: ROLLE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f':set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, f' x y :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a < drop b /\ (f a = f b /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) -> has_derivative 1 1 f (f' x) (at 1 x)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) /\ forall v :e R :^: idx 1, f' x v = vec 1 0

items.name: ROTATION_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ vector_norm N a = vector_norm N b -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ (det N (matrix N N f) = 1 /\ f a = b))

items.name: ROTATION_EXISTS_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ (vector_norm N a = 1 /\ vector_norm N b = 1) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ (det N (matrix N N f) = 1 /\ f a = b))

items.name: ROTATION_LOWDIM_HORIZONTAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dim N s < dimindex N -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ (det N (matrix N N f) = 1 /\ {f x | x :e s} c= {z :e R :^: idx N | z (dimindex N) = 0}))

items.name: ROTATION_MATRIX_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 -> (rotation_matrix N m <-> m = mat N N 1)

items.name: ROTATION_MATRIX_2
items.statement: forall A :e R :^: idx_n 2 :^: idx_n 2, rotation_matrix (idx_n 2) A <-> A 1 1 ^ 2 + A 2 1 ^ 2 = 1 /\ (A 1 1 = A 2 2 /\ A 1 2 = - A 2 1)

items.name: ROTATION_MATRIX_EXISTS_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, 2 <= dimindex N /\ vector_norm N a = 1 -> exists A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, rotation_matrix N A /\ matrix_vector_mul N N A (basis N 1) = a

items.name: ROTATION_RIGHTWARD_LINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> exists b :e R, exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ ((2 <= dimindex N -> det N (matrix N N f) = 1) /\ (f (vector_mul N b (basis N k)) = a /\ 0 <= b)))

items.name: ROTATION_TO_GENERAL_POSITION_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, countable s -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ (det N (matrix N N f) = 1 /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> ~ f x i = f y i))

items.name: ROTATION_TO_GENERAL_POSITION_EXISTS_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= R :^: idx N, n <= dimindex N /\ (countable s /\ s c= span N {basis N x | x :e idx_n n}) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ (det N (matrix N N f) = 1 /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= n -> x i = 0) -> f x = x) /\ ({f x | x :e span N {basis N x | x :e idx_n n}} = span N {basis N x | x :e idx_n n} /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= n -> ~ f x i = f y i))))

items.name: ROTHE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ (bounded_hl N {f x | x :e s} /\ {f x | x :e frontier N s} c= s)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x

items.name: ROTOINVERSION_EXISTS_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (~ a = b /\ vector_norm N a = vector_norm N b))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (orthogonal_transformation N f /\ ({f x | x :e s} = s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, orthogonal N a x /\ orthogonal N b x -> f x = x) /\ (det N (matrix N N f) = - 1 /\ (f a = b /\ f b = a)))))

items.name: ROTOINVERSION_MATRIX_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, dimindex N = 1 -> (rotoinversion_matrix N m <-> m = matrix_neg N N (mat N N 1))

items.name: ROTOINVERSION_MATRIX_REFLECT_ALONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 -> rotoinversion_matrix N (matrix N N (fun x:set => reflect_along N v x))

items.name: ROWS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, ~ rows M N A = Empty

items.name: ROWS_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, rows N M (transp M N A) = columns M N A

items.name: ROW_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, row N N i (mat N N 0) = vec N 0

items.name: ROW_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M -> row M P i (matrix_mul M N P A B) = matrix_vector_mul P N (transp N P B) (row M N i A)

items.name: ROW_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> row N M i (transp M N A) = column M N i A

items.name: RSUM_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall e0 :e R, tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (f x) <= e0) -> vector_norm N (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0)))) <= e0 * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: RSUM_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall i :e omega, forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex N /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> f x i <= g x i))) -> vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0))) i <= vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (g (p0 0))) i

items.name: RSUM_DIFF_BOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (g x)) <= e0) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0)))) (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (g (p0 0))))) <= e0 * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SAME_DISTANCES_TO_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> distance N (x,a) = distance N (x,b)) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x0} s -> distance N (x,a) = distance N (x,b)

items.name: SAME_EIGENVALUES_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall c :e R, (exists v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N N N A B) v = vector_mul N c v) <-> exists v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N N N B A) v = vector_mul N c v

items.name: SAME_EIGENVALUES_SIMILAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall S A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall c :e R, invertible N N S -> ((exists v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_mul N N N (matrix_inv N N S) (matrix_mul N N N A S)) v = vector_mul N c v) <-> exists v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v)

items.name: SAME_EIGENVALUES_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall c :e R, (exists v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N (transp N N A) v = vector_mul N c v) <-> exists v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 /\ matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N c v

items.name: SAME_EIGENVECTORS_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A -> (matrix_vector_mul N N (matrix_inv N N A) v = vector_mul N c v <-> matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N (recip_SNo c) v)

items.name: SAME_NORM_SAME_DOT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (linear M P g /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm P (g x0))) -> dot N (f x) (f y) = dot P (g x) (g y)

items.name: SCALING_LINEAR
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall c :e R, f (vec M 0) = vec N 0 /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, distance N (f x,f y) = c * distance M (x,y)) -> linear M N f

items.name: SCHAUDER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (t c= s /\ (compact N t /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t)))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ f x = x

items.name: SCHAUDER_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, AR N s /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (t c= s /\ compact N t))) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ f x = x

items.name: SCHAUDER_PROJECTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, compact N s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (finite t /\ (t c= s /\ (continuous_on_hl N N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) x) < e0))))

items.name: SCHAUDER_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl N N f (R :^: idx N) /\ bounded_hl N {f x | x :e R :^: idx N} -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, f x = x

items.name: SCHREIER_TRANSVERSAL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h s t c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ (s c= group_carrier A G /\ (subgroup_generated A G s = G /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> group_inv A G x :e s) /\ (t c= group_carrier A G /\ (Union {right_coset_hl A G h x | x :e A, x :e t} = group_carrier A G /\ t :/\: h c= {group_id A G}))))) -> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G (h :/\: group_setmul A G t (group_setmul A G s (group_setinv A G t)))) = h

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top <-> exists b c= Power A, countable b /\ forall x c= A, x :e top <-> exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e b) /\ Union u = x

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_CLOSED_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e C) -> forall top :e topology B, forall top' :e topology C, continuous_map B C (top,top') f /\ (closed_map B C (top,top') f /\ (compact_space B top /\ (hausdorff_space C top' /\ ({f x | x :e topspace B top} = topspace C top' /\ second_countable B top)))) -> second_countable C top'

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, second_countable A (discrete_topology A u) <-> countable u

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_IMP_FIRST_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top -> first_countable A top

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_IMP_LINDELOF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top -> lindelof_space A top

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_IMP_SEPARABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top -> separable_space A top

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_LOCALLY_COMPACT_HAUSDORFF_IMP_PARACOMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top /\ (locally_compact_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top) -> paracompact_space A top

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top <-> exists b c= Power A, countable b /\ neighbourhood_base_of A b top

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_NEIGHBOURHOOD_BASE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top <-> exists b c= Power A, countable b /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e b -> v :e top) /\ neighbourhood_base_of A b top)

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_OPEN_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (open_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ second_countable A top)) -> second_countable B top'

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_REGULAR_IMP_PARACOMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top /\ regular_space A top -> paracompact_space A top

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ second_countable A top -> second_countable B top'

items.name: SECOND_COUNTABLE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, second_countable A top -> second_countable A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: SECOND_MEAN_VALUE_THEOREM
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (integrable_on 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> g x <= g y)) -> exists c :e R :^: idx 1, c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => vector_mul 1 (g x) (f x)) = vector_add 1 (vector_mul 1 (g a) (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f)) (vector_mul 1 (g b) (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f))

items.name: SECOND_MEAN_VALUE_THEOREM_BONNET
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (integrable_on 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> 0 <= g x) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> g x <= g y))) -> exists c :e R :^: idx 1, c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => vector_mul 1 (g x) (f x)) = vector_mul 1 (g b) (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f)

items.name: SECOND_MEAN_VALUE_THEOREM_BONNET_FULL
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (integrable_on 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> 0 <= g x) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> g x <= g y))) -> exists c :e R :^: idx 1, c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ has_integral 1 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul 1 (g x) (f x)) (vector_mul 1 (g b) (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f)) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SECOND_MEAN_VALUE_THEOREM_FULL
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (integrable_on 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> g x <= g y)) -> exists c :e R :^: idx 1, c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ has_integral 1 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul 1 (g x) (f x)) (vector_add 1 (vector_mul 1 (g a) (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f)) (vector_mul 1 (g b) (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f))) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SECOND_MEAN_VALUE_THEOREM_GEN
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall u v :e R, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (integrable_on 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) -> u <= g x /\ g x <= v) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> g x <= g y))) -> exists c :e R :^: idx 1, c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => vector_mul 1 (g x) (f x)) = vector_add 1 (vector_mul 1 u (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f)) (vector_mul 1 v (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f))

items.name: SECOND_MEAN_VALUE_THEOREM_GEN_FULL
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall u v :e R, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (integrable_on 1 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e open_interval 1 (a,b) -> u <= g x /\ g x <= v) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> g x <= g y))) -> exists c :e R :^: idx 1, c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ has_integral 1 1 (fun x:set => vector_mul 1 (g x) (f x)) (vector_add 1 (vector_mul 1 u (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f)) (vector_mul 1 v (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f))) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SECTION_AND_RETRACTION_EQ_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (section_map A B (top,top') f /\ retraction_map A B (top,top') f <-> homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f)

items.name: SECTION_IMP_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> section_map A B (top,top') f -> continuous_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: SECTION_IMP_EMBEDDING_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> section_map A B (top,top') f -> embedding_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: SECTION_IMP_INJECTIVE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> section_map A B (top,top') f -> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y)

items.name: SECTION_IMP_MONOTONE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> section_map A B (top,top') f -> monotone_map A B (top,top') f

items.name: SECTION_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall top3 :e topology C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> section_map A B (top1,top2) f /\ section_map B C (top2,top3) g -> section_map A C (top1,top3) (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: SECTION_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) /\ section_map A B (top,top') f -> section_map A B (top,top') g

items.name: SEGMENT_1
items.statement: (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = if drop a <= drop b then closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) else closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (b,a) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, open_segment 1 (a,b) = if drop a <= drop b then open_interval 1 (a,b) else open_interval 1 (b,a)

items.name: SEGMENT_AS_BALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} :/\: cball N (vector_mul N (recip_SNo 2) (vector_add N a b),vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a) :/: 2)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open_segment N (a,b) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b} :/\: ball N (vector_mul N (recip_SNo 2) (vector_add N a b),vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a) :/: 2)

items.name: SEGMENT_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a) /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x b) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N b a)

items.name: SEGMENT_CLOSED_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = open_segment A (a,b) :\/: {a,b}

items.name: SEGMENT_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} {a,b}

items.name: SEGMENT_EDGE_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, edge_of N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) s -> ~ a = b /\ (extreme_point_of N a s /\ extreme_point_of N b s)

items.name: SEGMENT_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = closed_segment N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) <-> {a,b} = {c,d}) /\ ((forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = open_segment N (c,d)) /\ ((forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_segment N (a,b) = closed_segment N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, open_segment N (a,b) = open_segment N (c,d) <-> a = b /\ c = d \/ {a,b} = {c,d}))

items.name: SEGMENT_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open_segment N (a,b) = Empty <-> a = b

items.name: SEGMENT_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {c} <-> a = c /\ b = c) /\ forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_segment N (a,b) = {c}

items.name: SEGMENT_FACE_OF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, face_of N (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) s -> extreme_point_of N a s /\ extreme_point_of N b s

items.name: SEGMENT_FURTHEST_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N y x) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N y a) \/ vector_norm N (vector_sub N y x) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N y b)

items.name: SEGMENT_HORIZONTAL
items.statement: forall a b x :e R :^: idx_n 2, a 2 = b 2 -> (x :e closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> x 2 = a 2 /\ (x 2 = b 2 /\ (a 1 <= x 1 /\ x 1 <= b 1 \/ b 1 <= x 1 /\ x 1 <= a 1)))

items.name: SEGMENT_IMAGE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {vector_add A (vector_mul A (1 + - drop u) a) (vector_mul A (drop u) b) | u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)}) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx B, ~ a = b -> open_segment B (a,b) = {vector_add B (vector_mul B (1 + - drop u) a) (vector_mul B (drop u) b) | u :e open_interval 1 (vec 1 0,vec 1 1)}

items.name: SEGMENT_OPEN_SUBSET_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, open_segment A (a,b) c= closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: SEGMENT_OUT_TO_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (b :e closure N s /\ ~ b = a) -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, ~ c = a /\ (c :e frontier N s /\ b :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil))

items.name: SEGMENT_REFL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a :e R :^: idx A, closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,a) seq_nil) = {a}) /\ forall a :e R :^: idx B, open_segment B (a,a) = Empty

items.name: SEGMENT_SCALAR_MULTIPLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, closed_segment N (seq_cons (vector_mul N a v,vector_mul N b v) seq_nil) = {vector_mul N x v | x :e R, a <= x /\ x <= b \/ b <= x /\ x <= a}) /\ forall a b :e R, forall v :e R :^: idx N, ~ v = vec N 0 -> open_segment N (vector_mul N a v,vector_mul N b v) = {vector_mul N x v | x :e R, a < x /\ x < b \/ b < x /\ x < a}

items.name: SEGMENT_SUBSET_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e s /\ b :e s) -> closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s

items.name: SEGMENT_SUBSET_LINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b}) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open_segment N (a,b) c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} {a,b}

items.name: SEGMENT_SUBSET_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (c :e open_segment N (a,b) /\ {a,b,c} c= relative_frontier N s) -> closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= relative_frontier N s

items.name: SEGMENT_SUBSET_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_CONVEX_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (collinear N {a,b,c} /\ (~ a = b /\ (~ a = c /\ (~ b = c /\ {a,b,c} c= relative_frontier N s)))) -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {a,b,c} c= relative_frontier N s

items.name: SEGMENT_SYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = closed_segment N (seq_cons (b,a) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open_segment N (a,b) = open_segment N (b,a)

items.name: SEGMENT_TO_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> open_segment N (a,closest_point N s a) :/\: s = Empty

items.name: SEGMENT_TO_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e interior N s /\ ~ b :e interior N s -> exists c :e R :^: idx N, c :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (~ c = a /\ (c :e frontier N s /\ open_segment N (a,c) c= interior N s))

items.name: SEGMENT_TO_FRONTIER_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ x :e s -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e frontier N s /\ (b :e frontier N s /\ x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SEGMENT_TO_POINT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists b :e R :^: idx N, b :e s /\ open_segment N (a,b) :/\: s = Empty

items.name: SEGMENT_TO_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (x :e relative_interior N s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ (x = y /\ s = {x})))) -> exists z :e R :^: idx N, z :e relative_frontier N s /\ (y :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (x,z) seq_nil) /\ open_segment N (x,z) c= relative_interior N s)

items.name: SEGMENT_TO_RELATIVE_FRONTIER_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (x :e s /\ ~ s = {x}) -> exists a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e relative_frontier N s /\ (b :e relative_frontier N s /\ x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SEGMENT_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall c a b :e R :^: idx A, closed_segment A (seq_cons (vector_add A c a,vector_add A c b) seq_nil) = {vector_add A c x | x :e closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}) /\ forall c a b :e R :^: idx B, open_segment B (vector_add B c a,vector_add B c b) = {vector_add B c x | x :e open_segment B (a,b)}

items.name: SEGMENT_VERTICAL
items.statement: forall a b x :e R :^: idx_n 2, a 1 = b 1 -> (x :e closed_segment (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) <-> x 1 = a 1 /\ (x 1 = b 1 /\ (a 2 <= x 2 /\ x 2 <= b 2 \/ b 2 <= x 2 /\ x 2 <= a 2)))

items.name: SELECT_AX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall x :e A, P x -> P (choose_in A P)

items.name: SELECT_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, choose_in A (fun y:set => y = x) = x

items.name: SELECT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall x :e A, (forall y :e A, P y <-> y = x) -> choose_in A P = x

items.name: SELF_ADJOINT_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N (fun x0:set => closest_point N s x0) x = closest_point N s x

items.name: SELF_ADJOINT_COMPOSE
