items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (linear N N g /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N g x = g x))) -> ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N (fun x:set => f (g x)) x = f (g x)) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, f (g x) = g (f x))

items.name: SELF_ADJOINT_HAS_EIGENVECTOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) -> exists v :e R :^: idx N, exists c :e R, vector_norm N v = 1 /\ f v = vector_mul N c v

items.name: SELF_ADJOINT_HAS_EIGENVECTOR_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, (forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e b -> vector_norm N x = 1 /\ exists c :e R, f x = vector_mul N c x) /\ (independent N b /\ (span N b = R :^: idx N /\ equip b (dimindex N))))

items.name: SELF_ADJOINT_HAS_EIGENVECTOR_BASIS_OF_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) /\ (subspace N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x :e s))) -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, b c= s /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e b -> vector_norm N x = 1 /\ exists c :e R, f x = vector_mul N c x) /\ (independent N b /\ (span N b = s /\ equip b (dim N s)))))

items.name: SELF_ADJOINT_HAS_EIGENVECTOR_IN_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, linear N N f /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) /\ (subspace N s /\ (~ s = {vec N 0} /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x :e s)))) -> exists v :e R :^: idx N, exists c :e R, v :e s /\ (vector_norm N v = 1 /\ f v = vector_mul N c v)

items.name: SELF_ADJOINT_ORTHOGONAL_EIGENVECTORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall v w :e R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R, linear N N f /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N f x = f x) /\ (f v = vector_mul N a v /\ (f w = vector_mul N b w /\ ~ a = b))) -> orthogonal N v w

items.name: SEMI_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ finite (components N (s :\: u))))

items.name: SEMI_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ finite (components N (s :\: u))))

items.name: SEMI_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_COMPACT_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m) -> forall x :e A, forall v c= A, v :e mtopology A m /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e mtopology A m /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ finite (connected_components_of A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m :\: u)))))

items.name: SEMI_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, connected_in A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m) /\ (locally_compact_space A (mtopology A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m)) -> forall x :e A, forall v c= A, v :e mtopology A m /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e mtopology A m /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ finite (connected_components_of A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m :\: u)))))

items.name: SEMI_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite (components N s) /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e v -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ finite (components N (s :\: u))))

items.name: SEMI_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_GEN_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, finite (connected_components_of A (mtopology A m)) /\ (locally_compact_space A (mtopology A m) /\ locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m)) -> forall x :e A, forall v c= A, v :e mtopology A m /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e mtopology A m /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ finite (connected_components_of A (subtopology A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m :\: u)))))

items.name: SEPARABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, exists t c= R :^: idx N, countable t /\ (t c= s /\ s c= closure N t)

items.name: SEPARABLE_METRIZABLE_IMP_SECOND_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, separable_space A top /\ metrizable_space A top -> second_countable A top

items.name: SEPARABLE_SPACE_CONTINUOUS_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> separable_space A top /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top') -> separable_space B top'

items.name: SEPARABLE_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, separable_space A (discrete_topology A u) <-> countable u

items.name: SEPARABLE_SPACE_OPEN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, separable_space A top /\ s :e top -> separable_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: SEPARABLE_SPACE_QUOTIENT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e B) -> quotient_map A B (top,top') q /\ separable_space A top -> separable_space B top'

items.name: SEPARABLE_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ separable_space A top -> separable_space B top'

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t <-> exists u c= A, closed_in A top u /\ (u :e top /\ (s c= u /\ t c= topspace A top :\: u))

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t <-> exists u v c= A, closed_in A top u /\ (closed_in A top v /\ (u :\/: v = topspace A top /\ (u :/\: v = Empty /\ (s c= u /\ t c= v))))

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (separated_between A top (closure_of A top s) t <-> separated_between A top s t)) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, t c= topspace A top -> (separated_between A top s (closure_of A top t) <-> separated_between A top s t)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_CLOSURE_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t <-> s c= topspace A top /\ separated_between A top (closure_of A top s) t) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t <-> t c= topspace A top /\ separated_between A top s (closure_of A top t)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_COMPACT_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c t c= A, locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (c :e connected_components_of A top /\ (compact_in A top c /\ (closed_in A top t /\ c :/\: t = Empty)))) -> separated_between A top c t

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_COMPACT_QUASI_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k c c= A, compact_in A top k /\ c :e quasi_components_of A top -> (separated_between A top k c <-> k :/\: c = Empty)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, separated_between A top Empty s <-> s c= topspace A top) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, separated_between A top s Empty <-> s c= topspace A top

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_EQ_SEPARATED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t = topspace A top -> (separated_between A top s t <-> separated_in A top s t)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_FROM_CLOSED_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c c= A, separated_between A (subtopology A top c) s (frontier_of A top c) /\ separated_between A (subtopology A top c) s t -> separated_between A top s t

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_FROM_CLOSED_SUBTOPOLOGY_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A (subtopology A top t) s (frontier_of A top t) -> separated_between A top s (frontier_of A top t)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_FROM_FRONTIER_OF_CLOSED_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A (subtopology A top t) s (frontier_of A top t) -> separated_between A top s (topspace A top :\: t)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_FRONTIER_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ s :/\: t = Empty -> (separated_between A top (frontier_of A top s) t <-> separated_between A top s t)) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, t c= topspace A top /\ s :/\: t = Empty -> (separated_between A top s (frontier_of A top t) <-> separated_between A top s t)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_FRONTIER_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t <-> s c= topspace A top /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ separated_between A top (frontier_of A top s) t)) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t <-> t c= topspace A top /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ separated_between A top s (frontier_of A top t))

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_FULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t = topspace A top -> (separated_between A top s t <-> s :/\: t = Empty /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (s :e top /\ (closed_in A top t /\ t :e top))))

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_IMP_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t -> s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_IMP_SEPARATED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t -> separated_in A top s t

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t -> s c= topspace A top /\ t c= topspace A top

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t s' t' c= A, separated_between A top s t /\ (s' c= s /\ t' c= t) -> separated_between A top s' t'

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_POINTWISE_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, compact_in A top s -> (separated_between A top s t <-> (s = Empty -> t c= topspace A top) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> separated_between A top {x} t)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_POINTWISE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, compact_in A top t -> (separated_between A top s t <-> (t = Empty -> s c= topspace A top) /\ forall y :e A, y :e t -> separated_between A top s {y})

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_POINT_QUASI_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, forall c c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> (separated_between A top {x} c <-> x :e topspace A top :\: c)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_QUASI_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c c' c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top /\ c' :e quasi_components_of A top -> (separated_between A top c c' <-> c :/\: c' = Empty)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_QUASI_COMPONENT_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c k c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top /\ compact_in A top k -> (separated_between A top c k <-> c :/\: k = Empty)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_QUASI_COMPONENT_POINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall c c= A, forall x :e A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> (separated_between A top c {x} <-> x :e topspace A top :\: c)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_QUASI_COMPONENT_POINTWISE_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c s c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> (separated_between A top c s <-> exists x :e A, x :e c /\ separated_between A top {x} s)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_QUASI_COMPONENT_POINTWISE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c c= A, c :e quasi_components_of A top -> (separated_between A top s c <-> exists x :e A, x :e c /\ separated_between A top s {x})

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, separated_between A top s s <-> s = Empty

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_SINGS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, separated_between A top {x} {y} <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ quasi_component_of A top x y)

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t <-> separated_between A top t s

items.name: SEPARATED_BETWEEN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, separated_between A top s (t :\/: u) <-> separated_between A top s t /\ separated_between A top s u) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, separated_between A top (s :\/: t) u <-> separated_between A top s u /\ separated_between A top t u

items.name: SEPARATED_EQ_DISTINGUISHABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, separated_in A top {x} {y} <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ((exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (x :e u /\ ~ y :e u)) /\ exists v c= A, v :e top /\ (y :e v /\ ~ x :e v)))

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_CLOSED_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ closed_in A top t -> (separated_in A top s t <-> s :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_COMPLEMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, separated_in A top s (topspace A top :\: s) <-> closed_in A top s /\ s :e top

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_DIFFS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top /\ t :e top \/ closed_in A top s /\ closed_in A top t -> separated_in A top (s :\: t) (t :\: s)

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s t c= A, separated_in A (discrete_topology A u) s t <-> s c= u /\ (t c= u /\ s :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, separated_in A top s Empty <-> s c= topspace A top) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, separated_in A top Empty s <-> s c= topspace A top

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_FULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t = topspace A top -> (separated_in A top s t <-> s :/\: t = Empty /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (s :e top /\ (closed_in A top t /\ t :e top))))

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_IMP_DISJOINT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_in A top s t -> s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t s' t' c= A, separated_in A top s t /\ (s' c= s /\ t' c= t) -> separated_in A top s' t'

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_OPEN_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, s :e top /\ t :e top -> (separated_in A top s t <-> s :/\: t = Empty)

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, separated_in A top s s <-> s = Empty

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, t1_space A top -> (separated_in A top {a} s <-> a :e topspace A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ ~ a :e closure_of A top s))) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, t1_space A top -> (separated_in A top s {a} <-> a :e topspace A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ ~ a :e closure_of A top s))

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u s t c= A, separated_in A (subtopology A top u) s t <-> s c= u /\ (t c= u /\ separated_in A top s t)

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_in A top s t <-> separated_in A top t s

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, separated_in A top s (t :\/: u) <-> separated_in A top s t /\ separated_in A top s u) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s t u c= A, separated_in A top (s :\/: t) u <-> separated_in A top s u /\ separated_in A top t u

items.name: SEPARATED_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall u c= Power A, finite u -> (separated_in A top s (Union u) <-> s c= topspace A top /\ forall t c= A, t :e u -> separated_in A top s t)) /\ forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall u c= Power A, finite u -> (separated_in A top (Union u) s <-> (forall t c= A, t :e u -> separated_in A top s t) /\ s c= topspace A top)

items.name: SEPARATE_CLOSED_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (compact N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> d <= distance N (x,y)

items.name: SEPARATE_CLOSED_CONES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c d c= R :^: idx N, conic N c /\ (closed N c /\ (conic N d /\ (closed N d /\ c :/\: d c= {vec N 0}))) -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ y :e d -> e0 * (if vector_norm N x <= vector_norm N y then vector_norm N y else vector_norm N x) <= distance N (x,y)

items.name: SEPARATE_COMPACT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (closed N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> d <= distance N (x,y)

items.name: SEPARATE_POINT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ a :e s -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> d <= distance N (a,x)

items.name: SEPARATING_FUNCTIONS_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall fs:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e A, fs x y :e R) -> forall x y :e A, hausdorff_space A top /\ ((forall x0 :e A, forall u c= A, u :e top /\ x0 :e u -> exists n :e omega, 0 < fs n x0 /\ forall x1 :e A, x1 :e topspace A top /\ ~ x1 :e u -> fs n x1 = 0) /\ (x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top)) -> ((forall n :e omega, fs n x = fs n y) <-> x = y)

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_AFFINE_AFFINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, affine N s /\ (affine N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ s :/\: t = Empty))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b c :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ (b < c /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x = b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> dot N a x = c))

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_AFFINE_HULLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} t = Empty) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b c :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ (b < c /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x = b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> dot N a x = c))

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_CLOSED_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e s) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ (0 < b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b < dot N a x)

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_CLOSED_0_INSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ vec N 0 :e s)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, a :e s /\ (~ a = vec N 0 /\ (0 < b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b < dot N a x))

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_CLOSED_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (convex N t /\ (compact N t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ s :/\: t = Empty)))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x < b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> b < dot N a x

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_CLOSED_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ ~ z :e s) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, dot N a z < b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b < dot N a x

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_CLOSED_POINT_INSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ z :e s)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, a :e s /\ (dot N (vector_sub N a z) z < b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b < dot N (vector_sub N a z) x)

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_COMPACT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (convex N t /\ (closed N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty)))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x < b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> b < dot N a x

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_COMPACT_CLOSED_NONZERO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (convex N t /\ (closed N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty)))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x < b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> b < dot N a x)

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_COMPACT_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ (convex N t /\ (compact N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x < b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> b < dot N a x)

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_POLYHEDRA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, polyhedron N s /\ (polyhedron N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ s :/\: t = Empty))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x < b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> b < dot N a x)

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_RELATIVE_INTERIORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (~ (s = Empty /\ t = R :^: idx N \/ s = R :^: idx N /\ t = Empty) /\ relative_interior N s :/\: relative_interior N t = Empty)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x <= b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> b <= dot N a x)

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_SETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (convex N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ s :/\: t = Empty))) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a x <= b) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> b <= dot N a x)

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_SET_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e s -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= dot N a x

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_SET_0_INSPAN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ vec N 0 :e s) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e A, a :e span N s /\ (~ a = vec N 0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= dot N a x)

items.name: SEPARATING_HYPERPLANE_SET_POINT_INAFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ z :e s) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, vector_add N z a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} (SetAdjoin s z) /\ (~ a = vec N 0 /\ (dot N a z <= b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b <= dot N a x))

items.name: SEPARATION_BY_CLOSED_INTERMEDIATES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, ~ connected N (u :\: s) -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ (t c= s /\ forall c c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) c /\ (t c= c /\ c c= s) -> ~ connected N (u :\: c))

items.name: SEPARATION_BY_CLOSED_INTERMEDIATES_COUNT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top /\ (exists u c= Power A, equip u n /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> separated_in A top x y) /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e u -> ~ t = Empty) /\ Union u = topspace A top :\: s))) -> exists c c= A, closed_in A top c /\ (c c= s /\ forall d c= A, closed_in A top d /\ (c c= d /\ d c= s) -> exists u c= Power A, equip u n /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> separated_in A top x y) /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e u -> ~ t = Empty) /\ Union u = topspace A top :\: d)))

items.name: SEPARATION_BY_CLOSED_INTERMEDIATES_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} u -> (~ connected N (u :\: s) <-> exists t c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ (t c= s /\ forall c c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) c /\ (t c= c /\ c c= s) -> ~ connected N (u :\: c)))

items.name: SEPARATION_BY_CLOSED_INTERMEDIATES_EQ_COUNT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall n :e omega, locally_connected_space A top /\ hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top -> ((exists u c= Power A, equip u n /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> separated_in A top x y) /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e u -> ~ t = Empty) /\ Union u = topspace A top :\: s))) <-> exists c c= A, closed_in A top c /\ (c c= s /\ forall d c= A, closed_in A top d /\ (c c= d /\ d c= s) -> exists u c= Power A, equip u n /\ ((forall x y :e u, x <> y -> separated_in A top x y) /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e u -> ~ t = Empty) /\ Union u = topspace A top :\: d))))

items.name: SEPARATION_BY_CLOSED_INTERMEDIATES_EQ_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, locally_connected_space A top /\ hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top -> (~ connected_in A top (topspace A top :\: s) <-> exists c c= A, closed_in A top c /\ (c c= s /\ forall d c= A, closed_in A top d /\ (c c= d /\ d c= s) -> ~ connected_in A top (topspace A top :\: d)))

items.name: SEPARATION_BY_CLOSED_INTERMEDIATES_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, hereditarily A {x :e topology A | normal_space A x} top /\ ~ connected_in A top (topspace A top :\: s) -> exists c c= A, closed_in A top c /\ (c c= s /\ forall d c= A, closed_in A top d /\ (c c= d /\ d c= s) -> ~ connected_in A top (topspace A top :\: d))

items.name: SEPARATION_CLOSED_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :/\: closure N t = Empty /\ t :/\: closure N s = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t)) t)

items.name: SEPARATION_CLOSED_IN_UNION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_in A top s t <-> s c= topspace A top /\ (t c= topspace A top /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ (closed_in A (subtopology A top (s :\/: t)) s /\ closed_in A (subtopology A top (s :\/: t)) t)))

items.name: SEPARATION_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :/\: closure N t = Empty /\ t :/\: closure N s = Empty -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, u :/\: v = Empty /\ (open N u /\ (open N v /\ (s c= u /\ t c= v)))

items.name: SEPARATION_HAUSDORFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, ~ x = y -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ (open N v /\ (x :e u /\ (y :e v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: SEPARATION_NORMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ (open N v /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: SEPARATION_NORMAL_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists s' t' c= R :^: idx N, open N s' /\ (open N t' /\ (s c= s' /\ (t c= t' /\ (s' :/\: t' = Empty /\ closure N s' :/\: closure N t' = Empty))))

items.name: SEPARATION_NORMAL_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (closed N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ (compact N (closure N u) /\ (open N v /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty))))

items.name: SEPARATION_NORMAL_LOCAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists s' t' c= R :^: idx N, s' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (t' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (s c= s' /\ (t c= t' /\ s' :/\: t' = Empty)))

items.name: SEPARATION_NORMAL_LOCAL_CLOSURES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists s' t' c= R :^: idx N, s' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (t' :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ (s c= s' /\ (t c= t' /\ (s' :/\: t' = Empty /\ closure_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s' :/\: closure_of (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t' = Empty))))

items.name: SEPARATION_OPEN_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :/\: closure N t = Empty /\ t :/\: closure N s = Empty <-> s :/\: t = Empty /\ (s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t) /\ t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t))

items.name: SEPARATION_OPEN_IN_UNION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_in A top s t <-> s c= topspace A top /\ (t c= topspace A top /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ (s :e subtopology A top (s :\/: t) /\ t :e subtopology A top (s :\/: t))))

items.name: SEPARATION_T0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, ~ x = y <-> exists u c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ ~ (x :e u <-> y :e u)

items.name: SEPARATION_T1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, ~ x = y <-> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ (open N v /\ (x :e u /\ (~ y :e u /\ (~ x :e v /\ y :e v))))

items.name: SEPARATION_T2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, ~ x = y <-> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, open N u /\ (open N v /\ (x :e u /\ (y :e v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: SEQITERATE_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> (forall op :e A :^: A :^: A, forall f :e A :^: omega, seqiterate A op Empty f = neutral_of A (fun a:set => fun b:set => op a b)) /\ ((forall op :e B :^: B :^: B, forall f :e B :^: omega, forall i :e omega, seqiterate B op {i} f = f i) /\ forall op :e C :^: C :^: C, forall f :e C :^: omega, forall i :e omega, forall s c= omega, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall j :e omega, j :e s -> i < j)) -> seqiterate C op (SetAdjoin s i) f = op (f i) (seqiterate C op s f))

items.name: SEQITERATE_ITERATE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall op :e A :^: A :^: A, forall f :e A :^: omega, forall s c= omega, (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A (fun a:set => fun b:set => op a b)) x = x) /\ finite s -> seqiterate A op s f = iterate_op A (fun a:set => fun b:set => op a b) s (fun x:set => f x)

items.name: SEQUENCE_CAUCHY_WLOG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall e0 :e R, forall P:set -> prop, forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx A) -> ((forall m n :e omega, P m /\ P n -> distance A (s m,s n) < e0) <-> forall m n :e omega, P m /\ (P n /\ m <= n) -> distance A (s m,s n) < e0)

items.name: SEQUENCE_ESCAPES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ compact N k -> finite {n :e omega | x n :e k}) <-> ~ exists y :e R :^: idx N, exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ (y :e s /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) y sequentially)))

items.name: SEQUENCE_ESCAPES_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k c= s /\ compact N k -> eventually omega {n :e omega | ~ x n :e k} sequentially) <-> ~ exists y :e R :^: idx N, exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ (y :e s /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto N omega (fun x0:set => x (r x0)) y sequentially)))

items.name: SEQUENCE_INFINITE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, (forall n :e omega, ~ f n = l) /\ tendsto N omega f l sequentially -> infinite {y :e R :^: idx N | exists n :e omega, y = f n}

items.name: SEQUENCE_UNIQUE_LIMPT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l l' :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega f l sequentially /\ limit_point_of N l' {y :e R :^: idx N | exists n :e omega, y = f n} -> l' = l

items.name: SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e A, netfilter omega sequentially = {from n0 | n0 :e omega, n0 :e omega}

items.name: SEQUENTIALLY_CLOSED_IN_MCOMPLETE_IMP_MCOMPLETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mcomplete A m /\ (forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> forall l :e A, (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ limit omega A (mtopology A m) x l sequentially -> l :e s) -> mcomplete A (submetric A m s)

items.name: SEQUENTIAL_LIMIT_URYSOHN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega s l sequentially <-> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) -> (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) -> exists q:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, q x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> q m < q n) /\ tendsto N omega (fun x:set => s (r (q x))) l sequentially)

items.name: SEQ_HARMONIC
items.statement: tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (recip_SNo n)) (vec 1 0) sequentially

items.name: SEQ_HARMONIC_OFFSET
items.statement: forall a :e R, tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (recip_SNo (n + a))) (vec 1 0) sequentially

items.name: SEQ_HARMONIC_RATIO
items.statement: forall a b :e R, tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift ((n + a) :/: (n + b))) (vec 1 1) sequentially

items.name: SEQ_MONO_LEMMA
items.statement: forall m :e omega, forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, d x :e R) -> forall e0:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, e0 x :e R) -> (forall n :e omega, m <= n -> d n < e0 n) /\ (forall n :e omega, m <= n -> e0 n <= e0 m) -> forall n :e omega, m <= n -> d n < e0 m

items.name: SEQ_OFFSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall k :e omega, tendsto A omega f l sequentially -> tendsto A omega (fun i:set => f (i + k)) l sequentially

items.name: SEQ_OFFSET_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N omega (fun i:set => f (i + k)) l sequentially <-> tendsto N omega f l sequentially

items.name: SEQ_OFFSET_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall k :e omega, tendsto A omega f l sequentially -> tendsto A omega (fun i:set => f (minus_nat i k)) l sequentially

items.name: SEQ_OFFSET_REV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall k :e omega, tendsto A omega (fun i:set => f (i + k)) l sequentially -> tendsto A omega f l sequentially

items.name: SERIES_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, sums A (fun n:set => vec A 0) (vec A 0) s

items.name: SERIES_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, forall y:set -> set, (forall x1 :e omega, y x1 :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y0 :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= omega, sums A x x0 s /\ sums A y y0 s -> sums A (fun n:set => vector_add A (x n) (y n)) (vector_add A x0 y0) s

items.name: SERIES_BILINEAR
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, bilinear N P M bop /\ (sums M x a (from 0) /\ (sums N y b (from 0) /\ (summable 1 (from 0) (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm M (x n))) \/ summable 1 (from 0) (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm N (y n)))))) -> sums P (fun n:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => bop (x i) (y (minus_nat n i)))) (bop a b) (from 0)

items.name: SERIES_BILINEAR_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R :^: idx P, bilinear N P M bop /\ (sums M x a (from 0) /\ (sums N y b (from 0) /\ sums P (fun n:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => bop (x i) (y (minus_nat n i)))) c (from 0))) -> bop a b = c

items.name: SERIES_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall s c= omega, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall b :e R, sums N f a s /\ (sums 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) (lift b) s /\ (forall i :e omega, i :e s -> vector_norm N (f i) <= g i)) -> vector_norm N a <= b

items.name: SERIES_CAUCHY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, (exists l :e R :^: idx A, sums A f l s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall m n :e omega, N <= m -> vector_norm A (vsum omega A (s :/\: {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}) f) < e0

items.name: SERIES_CAUCHY_UNIFORM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e omega, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= omega, (exists l:set -> set, (forall x :e A, l x :e R :^: idx N) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= n /\ P x -> distance N (vsum omega N (k :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) (f x),l x) < e0) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= m /\ P x -> vector_norm N (vsum omega N (k :/\: {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}) (f x)) < e0

items.name: SERIES_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, forall s c= omega, sums A x x0 s -> sums A (fun n:set => vector_mul A c (x n)) (vector_mul A c x0) s

items.name: SERIES_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall s c= omega, (exists l :e R :^: idx 1, sums 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) l s) /\ (exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, N0 <= n /\ n :e s -> vector_norm N (f n) <= g n) -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, sums N f l s

items.name: SERIES_COMPARISON_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= omega, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, sums 1 g a s /\ (forall i :e omega, i :e s -> vector_norm N (f i) <= drop (g i)) -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, sums N f l s /\ vector_norm N l <= drop a

items.name: SERIES_COMPARISON_UNIFORM
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e omega, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= omega, (exists l :e R :^: idx 1, sums 1 (fun x:set => lift (g x)) l s) /\ (exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= n /\ (n :e s /\ P x) -> vector_norm N (f x n) <= g n) -> exists l:set -> set, (forall x :e A, l x :e R :^: idx N) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= n /\ P x -> distance N (vsum omega N (s :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) (f x),l x) < e0

items.name: SERIES_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, sums N f l s /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> sums 1 (fun i:set => lift (f i k)) (lift (l k)) s

items.name: SERIES_DIFFS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, tendsto N omega f (vec N 0) sequentially -> sums N (fun n:set => vector_sub N (f n) (f (n + 1))) (f k) (from k)

items.name: SERIES_DIRICHLET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall N0 k m :e omega, bounded_hl N {vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f | n :e omega, n :e omega} /\ ((forall n :e omega, N0 <= n -> g (n + 1) <= g n) /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun x:set => lift (g x)) (vec 1 0) sequentially) -> summable N (from k) (fun n:set => vector_mul N (g n) (f n))

items.name: SERIES_DIRICHLET_BILINEAR
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall k m p :e omega, forall l :e R :^: idx P, bilinear N P M h /\ (bounded_hl N {vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f | n :e omega, n :e omega} /\ (summable 1 (from p) (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm M (vector_sub M (g (n + 1)) (g n)))) /\ tendsto P omega (fun n:set => h (g (n + 1)) (vsum omega N (idx_n n) f)) l sequentially)) -> summable P (from k) (fun n:set => h (g n) (f n))

items.name: SERIES_DROP_LE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= omega, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, sums 1 f a s /\ (sums 1 g b s /\ (forall x :e omega, x :e s -> drop (f x) <= drop (g x))) -> drop a <= drop b

items.name: SERIES_DROP_POS
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= omega, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, sums 1 f a s /\ (forall x :e omega, x :e s -> 0 <= drop (f x)) -> 0 <= drop a

items.name: SERIES_EVEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, sums N f l (from n) <-> sums N (fun i:set => if even_nat i then f (div_nat i 2) else vec N 0) l (from (2 * n))

items.name: SERIES_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, finite s -> sums A f (vsum omega A s f) s

items.name: SERIES_FINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall y :e R :^: idx N, finite s -> (sums N f y s <-> vsum omega N s f = y)

items.name: SERIES_FINITE_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s k c= omega, finite (s :/\: k) /\ (forall x :e omega, x :e k /\ ~ x :e s -> f x = vec N 0) -> sums N f (vsum omega N (s :/\: k) f) k

items.name: SERIES_FROM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall k :e omega, sums A f l (from k) <-> tendsto A omega (fun n:set => vsum omega A {i :e omega | k <= i /\ i <= n} f) l sequentially

items.name: SERIES_GOESTOZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> summable A s x -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually omega {n :e omega | n :e s -> vector_norm A (x n) < e0} sequentially

items.name: SERIES_INJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e omega) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, summable 1 {f x | x :e s} (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm N (x n))) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m :e s /\ (n :e s /\ f m = f n) -> m = n) -> (sums N (fun x0:set => x (f x0)) l s <-> sums N x l {f x | x :e s})

items.name: SERIES_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, f x0 :e omega) -> summable 1 {f x | x :e s} (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm N (x n))) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m :e s /\ (n :e s /\ f m = f n) -> m = n) -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => vector_sub N (vsum omega N ({f x | x :e s} :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) x) (vsum omega N (s :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) (fun x0:set => x (f x0)))) (vec N 0) sequentially

items.name: SERIES_LIFT_ABSCONV_IMP_CONV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= omega, summable 1 k (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm N (x n))) -> summable N k x

items.name: SERIES_LINEAR
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, h x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= omega, sums A f l s /\ linear A B h -> sums B (fun n:set => h (f n)) (h l) s

items.name: SERIES_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= omega, sums A x x0 s -> sums A (fun n:set => vector_neg A (x n)) (vector_neg A x0) s

items.name: SERIES_ODD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, sums N f l (from n) <-> sums N (fun i:set => if odd_nat i then f (div_nat i 2) else vec N 0) l (from (2 * n + 1))

items.name: SERIES_PASTECART
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f1:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f2:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f2 x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall l1 :e R :^: idx N, forall l2 :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= omega, sums (idx_n (dimindex N + dimindex M)) (fun x:set => pastecart N M (f1 x) (f2 x)) (pastecart N M l1 l2) s <-> sums N f1 l1 s /\ sums M f2 l2 s

items.name: SERIES_RATIO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall N0 :e omega, c < 1 /\ (forall n :e omega, N0 <= n -> vector_norm N (a (ordsucc n)) <= c * vector_norm N (a n)) -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, sums N a l s

items.name: SERIES_REARRANGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, p x0 :e omega) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, summable 1 s (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm N (x n))) /\ (permutes omega p s /\ sums N x l s) -> sums N (fun x0:set => x (p x0)) l s

items.name: SERIES_REARRANGE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, p x0 :e omega) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, summable 1 s (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm N (x n))) /\ permutes omega p s -> (sums N (fun x0:set => x (p x0)) l s <-> sums N x l s)

items.name: SERIES_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= omega, forall l :e R :^: idx N, sums N (fun n:set => if n :e k then f n else vec N 0) l omega <-> sums N f l k

items.name: SERIES_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x0 :e R :^: idx A, forall y:set -> set, (forall x1 :e omega, y x1 :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y0 :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= omega, sums A x x0 s /\ sums A y y0 s -> sums A (fun n:set => vector_sub A (x n) (y n)) (vector_sub A x0 y0) s

items.name: SERIES_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= omega, forall l :e R :^: idx A, s c= t /\ sums A (fun i:set => if i :e s then x i else vec A 0) l t -> sums A x l s

items.name: SERIES_TERMS_TOZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall n :e omega, sums A f l (from n) -> tendsto A omega f (vec A 0) sequentially

items.name: SERIES_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> sums A f (vec A 0) Empty

items.name: SERIES_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l l' :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= omega, sums N f l s /\ sums N f l' s -> l = l'

items.name: SERIES_VSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall k s c= omega, finite s /\ (s c= k /\ ((forall x :e omega, ~ x :e s -> f x = vec A 0) /\ vsum omega A s f = l)) -> sums A f l k

items.name: SETCODE_BOUNDS
items.statement: forall s c= omega, forall n :e omega, s c= idx_n n -> setcode s :e idx_n (2 ^ n)

items.name: SETDIST_BALLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, setdist N (ball N (a,r),ball N (b,s)) = if r <= 0 \/ s <= 0 then 0 else if 0 <= distance N (a,b) + - (r + s) then distance N (a,b) + - (r + s) else 0) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, setdist N (ball N (a,r),cball N (b,s)) = if r <= 0 \/ s < 0 then 0 else if 0 <= distance N (a,b) + - (r + s) then distance N (a,b) + - (r + s) else 0) /\ ((forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, setdist N (cball N (a,r),ball N (b,s)) = if r < 0 \/ s <= 0 then 0 else if 0 <= distance N (a,b) + - (r + s) then distance N (a,b) + - (r + s) else 0) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall r s :e R, setdist N (cball N (a,r),cball N (b,s)) = if r < 0 \/ s < 0 then 0 else if 0 <= distance N (a,b) + - (r + s) then distance N (a,b) + - (r + s) else 0))

items.name: SETDIST_CLOSED_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (compact N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> exists x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ distance N (x,y) = setdist N (s,t))

items.name: SETDIST_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> setdist N ({a},s) = distance N (a,closest_point N s a)

items.name: SETDIST_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, setdist N (closure N s,t) = setdist N (s,t)) /\ forall s t c= R :^: idx N, setdist N (s,closure N t) = setdist N (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_COMPACT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (closed N t /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ t = Empty)) -> exists x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e t /\ distance N (x,y) = setdist N (s,t))

items.name: SETDIST_DIFFERENCES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, setdist N (s,t) = setdist N ({vec N 0},\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_sub N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: SETDIST_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall t c= R :^: idx A, setdist A (Empty,t) = 0) /\ forall s c= R :^: idx B, setdist B (s,Empty) = 0

items.name: SETDIST_EQ_0_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s \/ bounded_hl N t -> (setdist N (s,t) = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ ~ closure N s :/\: closure N t = Empty))

items.name: SETDIST_EQ_0_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, closed A s -> (setdist A ({x},s) = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ x :e s)

items.name: SETDIST_EQ_0_CLOSED_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ compact N t -> (setdist N (s,t) = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ ~ s :/\: t = Empty))

items.name: SETDIST_EQ_0_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, closed_in (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) u) s /\ x :e u -> (setdist A ({x},s) = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ x :e s)

items.name: SETDIST_EQ_0_COMPACT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ closed N t -> (setdist N (s,t) = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ ~ s :/\: t = Empty))

items.name: SETDIST_EQ_0_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, setdist N ({x},s) = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ x :e closure N s) /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, setdist N (s,{x}) = 0 <-> s = Empty \/ x :e closure N s

items.name: SETDIST_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :/\: t = Empty -> setdist N (frontier N s,t) = setdist N (s,t)) /\ forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :/\: t = Empty -> setdist N (s,frontier N t) = setdist N (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_FRONTIERS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, setdist N (s,t) = if s :/\: t = Empty then setdist N (frontier N s,frontier N t) else 0

items.name: SETDIST_HAUSDIST_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, ~ t = Empty /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ bounded_hl N u) -> setdist N (s,u) <= setdist N (s,t) + hausdist N (t,u)

items.name: SETDIST_LE_DIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> setdist N (s,t) <= distance N (x,y)

items.name: SETDIST_LE_HAUSDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N t -> setdist N (s,t) <= hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_LE_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> setdist N (s,t) <= setdist N ({x},t)

items.name: SETDIST_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x) = vector_norm M x) -> setdist N ({f x | x :e s},{f x | x :e t}) = setdist M (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, 0 <= setdist A (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_POS_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, 0 < setdist N (s,t) <-> ~ setdist N (s,t) = 0

items.name: SETDIST_REFL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, setdist N (s,s) = 0

items.name: SETDIST_RELATIVE_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall s t c= R :^: idx A, convex A s -> setdist A (relative_interior A s,t) = setdist A (s,t)) /\ forall s t c= R :^: idx B, convex B t -> setdist B (s,relative_interior B t) = setdist B (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, setdist N ({vector_mul N a x | x :e s},{vector_mul N a x | x :e t}) = abs_SNo a * setdist N (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_SINGS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, setdist A ({x},{y}) = distance A (x,y)

items.name: SETDIST_SING_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x :e s -> setdist N ({x},frontier N s) = setdist N ({x},s)

items.name: SETDIST_SING_FRONTIER_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, setdist N ({x},s) = if x :e s then 0 else setdist N ({x},frontier N s)

items.name: SETDIST_SING_IN_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e s -> setdist A ({x},s) = 0

items.name: SETDIST_SING_LE_HAUSDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ (bounded_hl N t /\ x :e s) -> setdist N ({x},t) <= hausdist N (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_SING_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, abs_SNo (setdist N ({x},s) + - setdist N ({y},s)) <= distance N (x,y)

items.name: SETDIST_SUBSETS_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t s' t' c= R :^: idx N, s' c= s /\ (t' c= t /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> exists x' y' :e R :^: idx N, x' :e s' /\ (y' :e t' /\ distance N (x',y') <= distance N (x,y)))) -> setdist N (s',t') = setdist N (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_SUBSET_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ s c= t -> setdist N (t,u) <= setdist N (s,u)

items.name: SETDIST_SUBSET_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, ~ t = Empty /\ t c= u -> setdist N (s,u) <= setdist N (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, setdist A (s,t) = setdist A (t,s)

items.name: SETDIST_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, setdist N ({vector_add N a x | x :e s},{vector_add N a x | x :e t}) = setdist N (s,t)

items.name: SETDIST_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall t c= R :^: idx N, setdist N (s,t) <= setdist N (s,{a}) + setdist N ({a},t)

items.name: SETDIST_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t t' c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (t' c= s /\ setdist M (t',t) < d) -> setdist N ({f x | x :e t'},{f x | x :e t}) < e0

items.name: SETDIST_UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall t t' c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (t' c= s /\ (bounded_hl M t /\ (bounded_hl M t' /\ setdist M (t',t) < d))) -> setdist N ({f x | x :e t'},{f x | x :e t}) < e0

items.name: SETDIST_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, a :e s /\ (b :e t /\ (distance N (a,b) = d /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t -> distance N (a,b) <= distance N (x,y)))) -> setdist N (s,t) = d

items.name: SETDIST_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall s c= R :^: idx N, setdist N (s,R :^: idx N) = 0) /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, setdist N (R :^: idx N,t) = 0

items.name: SETDIST_ZERO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s :/\: t = Empty -> setdist N (s,t) = 0

items.name: SETDIST_ZERO_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ closure N s :/\: closure N t = Empty -> setdist N (s,t) = 0

items.name: SETSPEC
items.error: internal constant SETSPEC (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: SETVARIATION_EQUAL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall mf:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N :^: Power (R :^: idx M), forall y :e Power (R :^: idx M), mf x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall ms ms' :e Power (R :^: idx M) :^: Power (R :^: idx M), (forall s c= R :^: idx M, ms' (ms s) = s /\ ms (ms' s) = s) /\ ((forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty -> mf f (ms (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) = f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ exists a' b' :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a',b') seq_nil) = Empty /\ ms' (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = closed_interval M (seq_cons (a',b') seq_nil)) /\ ((forall t u c= R :^: idx M, t c= u -> ms t c= ms u /\ ms' t c= ms' u) /\ (forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d t -> division_of M {ms x | x :e d} (ms t) /\ division_of M {ms' x | x :e d} (ms' t)))) -> (forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: Power (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (mf f) (ms s) <-> has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (fun x:set => f x) s) /\ forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: Power (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, set_variation M N (ms s) (mf f) = set_variation M N s (fun x:set => f x)

items.name: SET_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, s x <-> x :e Empty) \/ exists x :e A, exists t c= A, (forall x0 :e A, s x0 <-> x0 :e SetAdjoin t x) /\ ~ x :e t

items.name: SET_DIFF_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :\: frontier N s = interior N s

items.name: SET_OF_LIST_APPEND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l1 l2 :e finseq A, seq_set (seq_append l1 l2) = seq_set l1 :\/: seq_set l2

items.name: SET_OF_LIST_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_set l = Empty <-> l = seq_nil

items.name: SET_OF_LIST_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall l :e finseq A, seq_set (seq_map f l) = {f x | x :e seq_set l}

items.name: SET_OF_LIST_OF_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> seq_set (choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)) = s

items.name: SET_PAIR_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, {p :e A :*: B | P p} = \/_ a :e A, {(a,b) | b :e B, P (a,b)}

items.name: SET_PROVE_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, P Empty /\ (forall a :e A, forall s c= A, ~ a :e s -> P (SetAdjoin s a)) -> forall s c= A, P s

items.name: SET_RECURSION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e B) -> forall b :e B, (forall x y :e A, forall s :e B, ~ x = y -> f x (f y s) = f y (f x s)) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power A, g x :e B) /\ (g Empty = b /\ forall x :e A, forall s c= A, finite s -> g (SetAdjoin s x) = if x :e s then g s else f x (g s))

items.name: SET_VARIATION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ (division_of M d t /\ t c= s) -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= set_variation M N s f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_0
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, set_variation N A s (fun x:set => vec A 0) = 0

items.name: SET_VARIATION_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s -> set_variation M N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) = abs_SNo c * set_variation M N s f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> vector_norm P (g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) <= vector_norm N (f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> set_variation M P s g <= set_variation M N s f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_DEGENERATES
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, ~ has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ ~ has_bounded_setvariation_on M A g s -> set_variation M N s f = set_variation M A s g

items.name: SET_VARIATION_ELEMENTARY_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall b :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists d c= Power (R :^: idx M), division_of M d s) -> ((forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d t /\ t c= s -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= b) <-> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), division_of M d s -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= b)

items.name: SET_VARIATION_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = g (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> set_variation M N s f = set_variation M N s g

items.name: SET_VARIATION_GE_FUNCTION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s /\ ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty) -> vector_norm N (f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) <= set_variation M N s f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_INTERVAL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c :e R, is_interval M s -> ((forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d t /\ t c= s -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= c) <-> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= c)

items.name: SET_VARIATION_LBOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ (exists d c= Power (R :^: idx M), exists t c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d t /\ (t c= s /\ B <= finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)))) -> B <= set_variation M N s f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_LBOUND_ON_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (exists d c= Power (R :^: idx M), division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ B <= finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k))) -> B <= set_variation M N (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_MONOTONE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ t c= s -> set_variation M N t f <= set_variation M N s f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_ON_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), operative (R :^: idx N) M (fun x:set => fun x0:set => vector_add N x x0) f /\ (division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> finsum d (fun k:set => set_variation M N k f) = set_variation M N (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_ON_ELEMENTARY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (exists d c= Power (R :^: idx M), division_of M d s) -> set_variation M N s f = sup {finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) | d :e Power (Power (R :^: idx M)), division_of M d s}

items.name: SET_VARIATION_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> set_variation M N Empty f = 0

items.name: SET_VARIATION_ON_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, set_variation M N (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = sup {finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) | d :e Power (Power (R :^: idx M)), division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))}

items.name: SET_VARIATION_ON_NULL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall a b :e R :^: idx M, content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = vec N 0) /\ (content M s = 0 /\ bounded_hl M s) -> set_variation M N s f = 0

items.name: SET_VARIATION_POS_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s -> 0 <= set_variation M N s f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_REFLECT2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, set_variation M N {vector_neg M x | x :e s} (fun k:set => f {vector_neg M x | x :e k}) = set_variation M N s f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_SUM_LE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall k c= A, finite k /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> has_bounded_setvariation_on M N (f i) s) -> set_variation M N s (fun x:set => vsum A N k (fun i:set => f i x)) <= finsum k (fun i:set => set_variation M N s (f i))

items.name: SET_VARIATION_TRANSLATION2
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, set_variation M N {vector_add M (vector_neg M a) x | x :e s} (fun k:set => f {vector_add M a x | x :e k}) = set_variation M N s f

items.name: SET_VARIATION_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ has_bounded_setvariation_on M N g s -> set_variation M N s (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) <= set_variation M N s f + set_variation M N s g

items.name: SET_VARIATION_UBOUND
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s /\ (forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d t /\ t c= s -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= B) -> set_variation M N s f <= B

items.name: SET_VARIATION_UBOUND_ON_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= B) -> set_variation M N (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f <= B

items.name: SET_VARIATION_WORKS_ON_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ division_of M d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= set_variation M N (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: SHIFTPATH_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall t :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> linear B A f -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, shiftpath A t (fun x:set => f (g x)) x = f (shiftpath B t g x)

items.name: SHIFTPATH_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a x :e R :^: idx 1, a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (pathfinish A g = pathstart A g /\ x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> shiftpath A (vector_sub 1 (vec 1 1) a) (fun x0:set => shiftpath A a g x0) x = g x

items.name: SHIFTPATH_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall t :e R :^: idx 1, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, shiftpath A t (fun x:set => vector_add A a (g x)) x = vector_add A a (shiftpath A t g x)

items.name: SHIFTPATH_TRIVIAL

items.name: SHORTEST_ARC_EXISTS
