items.name: SHORTEST_PATH_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s a b c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (compact N a /\ (compact N b /\ (exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (rectifiable_path N g /\ (path_image N g c= s /\ (pathstart N g :e a /\ pathfinish N g :e b)))))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (rectifiable_path N g /\ (path_image N g c= s /\ (pathstart N g :e a /\ (pathfinish N g :e b /\ forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N h /\ (path_image N h c= s /\ (pathstart N h :e a /\ pathfinish N h :e b)) -> path_length N g <= path_length N h))))

items.name: SHORTEST_PATH_EXISTS_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx 1, h x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall n :e omega, rectifiable_path N (h n) /\ P (path_image N (h n)) (pathstart N (h n)) (pathfinish N (h n))) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, N0 <= n /\ x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (h n x) (g x)) < e0) -> P (path_image N g) (pathstart N g) (pathfinish N g)) /\ ((exists t c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N t /\ forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g /\ P (path_image N g) (pathstart N g) (pathfinish N g) -> ~ t :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (path_image N g) = Empty) /\ (exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (rectifiable_path N g /\ P (path_image N g) (pathstart N g) (pathfinish N g)))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (rectifiable_path N g /\ (P (path_image N g) (pathstart N g) (pathfinish N g) /\ forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N h /\ P (path_image N h) (pathstart N h) (pathfinish N h) -> path_length N g <= path_length N h))

items.name: SHORTEST_PATH_EXISTS_STRADDLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t a b c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (compact N a /\ (compact N b /\ (exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (rectifiable_path N g /\ (t c= path_image N g /\ (path_image N g c= s /\ (pathstart N g :e a /\ pathfinish N g :e b))))))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (rectifiable_path N g /\ (t c= path_image N g /\ (path_image N g c= s /\ (pathstart N g :e a /\ (pathfinish N g :e b /\ forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N h /\ (t c= path_image N h /\ (path_image N h c= s /\ (pathstart N h :e a /\ pathfinish N h :e b))) -> path_length N g <= path_length N h)))))

items.name: SHORT_EXACT_SEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) <-> group_monomorphism A B (A0,B0) (fun x:set => f x) /\ (group_epimorphism B C (B0,C0) (fun x:set => g x) /\ group_image A B (A0,B0) (fun x:set => f x) = group_kernel B C (B0,C0) (fun x:set => g x))

items.name: SHORT_EXACT_SEQUENCE_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) -> isomorphic_group B A (subgroup_generated B B0 (group_image A B (A0,B0) (fun x:set => f x))) A0 /\ isomorphic_group (Power B) C (quotient_group B B0 (group_image A B (A0,B0) (fun x:set => f x))) C0

items.name: SHORT_EXACT_SEQUENCE_TRIVIAL_GROUPS
items.statement: forall A B C D E:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> forall g :e C :^: B, forall h :e D :^: C, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall D0 :e group_hl D, short_exact_sequence B C D (B0,(C0,D0)) (g,h) <-> exists f :e B :^: A, exists k :e E :^: D, exists A0 :e group_hl A, exists E0 :e group_hl E, trivial_group A A0 /\ (trivial_group E E0 /\ (group_exactness A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_exactness B C D (B0,(C0,D0)) (g,h) /\ group_exactness C D E (C0,(D0,E0)) (h,k))))

items.name: SHORT_FIVE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_ C C_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> C_ <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall f' :e B_ :^: A_, forall g' :e C_ :^: B_, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e A_) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e B, b x :e B_) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e C, c x :e C_) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall A' :e group_hl A_, forall B' :e group_hl B_, forall C' :e group_hl C_, group_isomorphism_hl A A_ (A0,A') a /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B B_ (B0,B') b /\ (group_isomorphism_hl C C_ (C0,C') c /\ (short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (short_exact_sequence A_ B_ C_ (A',(B',C')) (f',g') /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A A0 -> f' (a x) = b (f x)) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e group_carrier B B0 -> g' (b y) = c (g y))))))) -> group_isomorphism_hl B B_ (B0,B') b

items.name: SHORT_FIVE_LEMMA_EPI
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_ C C_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> C_ <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall f' :e B_ :^: A_, forall g' :e C_ :^: B_, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e A_) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e B, b x :e B_) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e C, c x :e C_) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall A' :e group_hl A_, forall B' :e group_hl B_, forall C' :e group_hl C_, group_epimorphism A A_ (A0,A') a /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B B_ (B0,B') b /\ (group_epimorphism C C_ (C0,C') c /\ (short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (short_exact_sequence A_ B_ C_ (A',(B',C')) (f',g') /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A A0 -> f' (a x) = b (f x)) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e group_carrier B B0 -> g' (b y) = c (g y))))))) -> group_epimorphism B B_ (B0,B') b

items.name: SHORT_FIVE_LEMMA_MONO
items.statement: forall A A_ B B_ C C_:set, A <> Empty -> A_ <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> B_ <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> C_ <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall f' :e B_ :^: A_, forall g' :e C_ :^: B_, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e A_) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e B, b x :e B_) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e C, c x :e C_) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall A' :e group_hl A_, forall B' :e group_hl B_, forall C' :e group_hl C_, group_monomorphism A A_ (A0,A') a /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B B_ (B0,B') b /\ (group_monomorphism C C_ (C0,C') c /\ (short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (short_exact_sequence A_ B_ C_ (A',(B',C')) (f',g') /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A A0 -> f' (a x) = b (f x)) /\ (forall y :e B, y :e group_carrier B B0 -> g' (b y) = c (g y))))))) -> group_monomorphism B B_ (B0,B') b

items.name: SIGMA_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable f /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e f -> compact N t) /\ Union f = s)

items.name: SIGMA_LOCALLY_FINITE_IMP_LOCALLY_FINITE_COVERING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall B c= Power A, (forall b c= A, b :e B -> b :e top) /\ (sigma_locally_finite_in A top B /\ Union B = topspace A top) -> exists C c= Power A, Union C = Union B /\ (locally_finite_in A top C /\ forall c c= A, c :e C -> exists b c= A, b :e B /\ c c= b)

items.name: SIGN_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e B, q x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (permutes A p s /\ permutes B q t)) -> sign (A :*: B) (fun p0:set => if p0 0 :e s /\ p0 1 :e t then (p (p0 0),q (p0 1)) else (p0 0,p0 1)) = sign A p ^ finite_cardinality t * sign B q ^ finite_cardinality s

items.name: SIGN_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> permutation A p /\ permutation A q -> sign A (fun x:set => p (q x)) = sign A p * sign A q

items.name: SIGN_CYCLIC
items.statement: forall n :e omega, sign omega (fun i:set => if i < n then mod_nat (i + 1) n else i) = (- 1) ^ minus_nat n 1

items.name: SIGN_CYCLIC_N
items.statement: forall n k :e omega, sign omega (fun i:set => if i < n then mod_nat (i + k) n else i) = (- 1) ^ (k * minus_nat n 1)

items.name: SIGN_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> sign A (fun x:set => x) = 1

items.name: SIGN_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> sign A (fun x:set => x) = 1

items.name: SIGN_IDEMPOTENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> sign A p * sign A p = 1

items.name: SIGN_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> permutation A p -> sign A (fun x:set => inverse A A p x) = sign A p

items.name: SIGN_INVOLUTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, p (p x) = x) /\ (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> p x = x)) -> sign A p = (- 1) ^ div_nat (finite_cardinality {x :e A | ~ p x = x}) 2

items.name: SIGN_NZ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> ~ sign A p = 0

items.name: SIGN_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, sign A (fun x:set => swap A (a,b) x) = if a = b then 1 else - 1

items.name: SIGN_TRANSFER
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e B, q x :e B) -> finite s /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) /\ (permutes A p s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> q (f x) = f (p x)) /\ (forall y :e B, ~ y :e {f x | x :e s} -> q y = y)))) -> sign B q = sign A p

items.name: SILVERMAN_STEINHAUSLIKE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s /\ (gdelta N t /\ (R :^: idx N c= closure N s /\ R :^: idx N c= closure N t)) -> (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = R :^: idx N

items.name: SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx A, simplex A n s <-> exists c c= R :^: idx A, finite c /\ (~ affine_dependent A c /\ (finite_cardinality c = n + 1 /\ s = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} c))

items.name: SIMPLEX_0_NOT_IN_AFFINE_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= R :^: idx N, simplex N (n + - 1) s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s <-> convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ (equip {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s} n /\ independent N {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s}))

items.name: SIMPLEX_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall i :e int, simplex N i s <-> convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ (finite {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s} /\ (finite_cardinality {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s} = i + 1 /\ ~ affine_dependent N {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s})))

items.name: SIMPLEX_ALT1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= R :^: idx N, simplex N (n + - 1) s <-> convex N s /\ (compact N s /\ (equip {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s} n /\ ~ affine_dependent N {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s}))

items.name: SIMPLEX_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, ~ affine_dependent N c /\ finite_cardinality c = n + 1 -> simplex N n (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} c)

items.name: SIMPLEX_DIM_GE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx A, simplex A n s -> - 1 <= n

items.name: SIMPLEX_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e int, simplex A n Empty <-> n = - 1

items.name: SIMPLEX_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ vec N 0 :e s -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s (vec N 0)) = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= u x) /\ (finsum s u <= 1 /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (u x) x) = y))}

items.name: SIMPLEX_EXTREMAL_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists u v :e R :^: idx N, u :e s /\ (v :e s /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N u v))

items.name: SIMPLEX_EXTREMAL_LE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, finite s /\ (x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s) -> exists u v :e R :^: idx N, u :e s /\ (v :e s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x y) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N u v))

items.name: SIMPLEX_EXTREME_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx N, simplex N n s -> finite {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s} /\ (~ affine_dependent N {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s} /\ (finite_cardinality {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s} = n + 1 /\ s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {v :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N v s}))

items.name: SIMPLEX_EXTREME_POINTS_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c c= R :^: idx A, simplex A (dimindex N + - 1) c -> ~ {v :e R :^: idx A | extreme_point_of A v c} = Empty

items.name: SIMPLEX_FACE_OF_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s f c= R :^: idx N, simplex N n s /\ face_of N f s -> exists m :e int, m <= n /\ simplex N m f

items.name: SIMPLEX_FURTHEST_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N y a)

items.name: SIMPLEX_FURTHEST_LE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) <= vector_norm N (vector_sub N y a)

items.name: SIMPLEX_FURTHEST_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ ~ x :e s -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) < vector_norm N (vector_sub N y a)

items.name: SIMPLEX_FURTHEST_LT_EXISTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x0} s /\ ~ x :e s -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ vector_norm N (vector_sub N x a) < vector_norm N (vector_sub N y a)

items.name: SIMPLEX_IMP_CLOSED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, simplex N n s -> closed N s

items.name: SIMPLEX_IMP_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, simplex N n s -> compact N s

items.name: SIMPLEX_IMP_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, simplex N n s -> convex N s

items.name: SIMPLEX_IMP_POLYHEDRON
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall n :e int, simplex A n s -> polyhedron A s

items.name: SIMPLEX_IMP_POLYTOPE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx A, simplex A n s -> polytope A s

items.name: SIMPLEX_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, (exists n :e int, simplex N n s) /\ ~ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> exists n :e int, simplex N n (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s a))

items.name: SIMPLEX_INSERT_DIMPLUS1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, simplex N n s /\ ~ a :e hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s -> simplex N (n + 1) (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin s a))

items.name: SIMPLEX_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall n :e int, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (simplex N n {f x | x :e s} <-> simplex M n s)

items.name: SIMPLEX_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e B, h x :e C) -> forall x :e A :^: (R :^: omega), forall x0 :e R :^: omega, simplex_map A C p (fun x:set => h (g x)) (fun x1:set => x x1) x0 = (fun x2 :e R :^: omega => simplex_map B C p h (fun x2:set => (fun x2 :e R :^: omega => simplex_map A B p g (fun x2:set => x x2) x2) x2) x2) x0

items.name: SIMPLEX_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, c x :e A) -> singular_simplex A (p,top) c /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = g x) -> forall x :e R :^: omega, simplex_map A B p f c x = simplex_map A B p g c x

items.name: SIMPLEX_MAP_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, x x :e A) -> forall x0 :e R :^: omega, simplex_map A A p (fun x:set => x) x x0 = if x0 :e standard_simplex p then x x0 else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)

items.name: SIMPLEX_MAP_ID_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> forall top :e topology A, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, c x :e A) -> singular_simplex A (p,top) c /\ (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x = x) -> forall x :e R :^: omega, simplex_map A A p f c x = c x

items.name: SIMPLEX_MAP_ORIENTED_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p q r :e omega, forall g :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), forall l :e R :^: omega :^: omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, simplicial_simplex (p,standard_simplex q) (oriented_simplex p (fun x:set => fun x0:set => l x x0)) /\ (simplicial_simplex (r,s) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => g x x0) /\ q <= r) -> forall x :e R :^: omega, forall x0 :e omega, simplex_map (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) p (fun x1:set => g x1) (fun x1:set => fun x2 :e omega => oriented_simplex p (fun x1:set => fun x2:set => l x1 x2) x1 x2) x x0 = oriented_simplex p (fun x:set => g (l x)) x x0

items.name: SIMPLEX_MINUS_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, simplex A (- 1) s <-> s = Empty

items.name: SIMPLEX_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, exists n :e int, simplex A n (closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SIMPLEX_SEGMENT_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, simplex N (if a = b then 0 else 1) (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SIMPLEX_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall a :e R :^: idx N, simplex N n {a} <-> n = 0

items.name: SIMPLEX_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, simplex N n {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> simplex N n s

items.name: SIMPLEX_VERTICES_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ affine_dependent N s /\ (~ affine_dependent N t /\ hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} t) -> s = t

items.name: SIMPLEX_ZERO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simplex N 0 s <-> exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a}

items.name: SIMPLE_GROUP_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f -> ((forall k c= B, normal_subgroup_of B k H -> k = {group_id B H} \/ k = group_carrier B H) <-> forall h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G /\ (group_kernel A B (G,H) f c= h /\ group_kernel A B (G,H) f <> h) -> h = group_carrier A G)

items.name: SIMPLE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {f x | x :e A, x :e s} = {f x | x :e s}

items.name: SIMPLE_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall P:set -> prop, {f x | x :e A, P x} = {f x | x :e {x :e A | P x}}

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N p = pathstart N q /\ pathfinish N q = pathstart N r -> (simple_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) q r x0) x) <-> simple_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) (fun x0:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) p q x0) r x))

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N g -> arc N g \/ pathfinish N g = pathstart N g

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> simple_path A g /\ (continuous_on_hl A B f (path_image A g) /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e path_image A g /\ (y :e path_image A g /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)) -> simple_path B (fun x:set => f (g x))

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_ENDLESS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, c x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N c -> path_image N c :\: {pathstart N c,pathfinish N c} = {c x | x :e open_interval 1 (vec 1 0,vec 1 1)}

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_EQ_ARC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> ~ pathstart A g = pathfinish A g -> (simple_path A g <-> arc A g)

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_IMP_ARC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N g /\ ~ pathfinish N g = pathstart N g -> arc N g

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_IMP_PATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> simple_path A g -> path A g

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_JOIN_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> simple_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) /\ pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 -> arc N g1 /\ (arc N g2 /\ path_image N g1 :/\: path_image N g2 c= {pathstart N g1,pathstart N g2})

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_JOIN_LOOP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> arc N g1 /\ (arc N g2 /\ (pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 /\ (pathfinish N g2 = pathstart N g1 /\ path_image N g1 :/\: path_image N g2 c= {pathstart N g1,pathstart N g2}))) -> simple_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x)

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_JOIN_LOOP_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N g2 = pathstart N g1 /\ pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 -> (simple_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) <-> arc N g1 /\ (arc N g2 /\ path_image N g1 :/\: path_image N g2 c= {pathstart N g1,pathstart N g2}))

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_JOIN_LOOP_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N g2 = pathstart N g1 /\ pathfinish N g1 = pathstart N g2 -> (simple_path N (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx N) g1 g2 x) <-> arc N g1 /\ (arc N g2 /\ path_image N g1 :/\: path_image N g2 = {pathstart N g1,pathstart N g2}))

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_LENGTH_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g /\ (simple_path N g /\ (rectifiable_path N h /\ path_image N g = path_image N h)) -> path_length N g <= path_length N h

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_LENGTH_POS_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g /\ simple_path N g -> 0 < path_length N g

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_LENGTH_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> rectifiable_path N g /\ (simple_path N g /\ (rectifiable_path N h /\ (simple_path N h /\ path_image N g = path_image N h))) -> path_length N g = path_length N h

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (simple_path N (fun x:set => f (g x)) <-> simple_path M g)

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_LINEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, ~ a = b -> simple_path A (fun x:set => linepath A (a,b) x)

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_LINEPATH_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, simple_path N (fun x:set => linepath N (a,b) x) <-> ~ a = b

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> simple_path A g -> simple_path A (fun x:set => reversepath A g x)

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_REVERSEPATH_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (simple_path N (fun x:set => reversepath N g x) <-> simple_path N g)

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_SHIFTPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, simple_path A g /\ (pathfinish A g = pathstart A g /\ a :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) -> simple_path A (fun x:set => shiftpath A a g x)

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_SUBPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, simple_path A g /\ (u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (v :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ ~ u = v)) -> simple_path A (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx A) u v g x)

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_SUBPATH_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, simple_path A (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx A) u v g x) <-> path A (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx A) u v g x) /\ (~ u = v /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) /\ g x = g y) -> x = y \/ (x = u /\ y = v \/ x = v /\ y = u))

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx A) -> pathfinish A p = pathstart A q /\ pathfinish A q = pathstart A p -> (simple_path A (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) p q x) <-> simple_path A (fun x:set => poly_add (R :^: idx A) q p x))

items.name: SIMPLE_PATH_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (simple_path N (fun x:set => vector_add N a (g x)) <-> simple_path N g)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_CHAIN_0
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, simplicial_chain (p,s) (frag_0 (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)))

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_CHAIN_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall c :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_chain (p,s) c -> simplicial_chain (minus_nat p 1,s) (chain_boundary (R :^: omega) p c)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_CHAIN_CHAIN_MAP
items.statement: forall p q :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), forall c :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_simplex (q,s) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0) /\ simplicial_chain (p,standard_simplex q) c -> simplicial_chain (p,s) (chain_map (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) p (fun x:set => f x) c)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_CHAIN_CMUL
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall a :e int, forall c :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_chain (p,s) c -> simplicial_chain (p,s) (frag_cmul (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) a c)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_CHAIN_OF
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall c :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), simplicial_chain (p,s) (frag_of (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) c) <-> simplicial_simplex (p,s) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => c x x0)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_CHAIN_SIMPLICIAL_CONE
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s t c= R :^: omega, forall v:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, v x :e R) -> forall c :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_chain (p,s) c /\ (forall x :e R :^: omega, forall u :e R, 0 <= u /\ (u <= 1 /\ x :e s) -> (fun i :e omega => (1 + - u) * v i + u * x i) :e t) -> simplicial_chain (p + 1,t) (simplicial_cone p v c)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_CHAIN_SIMPLICIAL_SUBDIVISION
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall c :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_chain (p,s) c -> simplicial_chain (p,s) (simplicial_subdivision p c)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_CHAIN_SUB
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall c1 c2 :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_chain (p,s) c1 /\ simplicial_chain (p,s) c2 -> simplicial_chain (p,s) (frag_sub (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) c1 c2)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_CHAIN_SUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega))) -> forall k c= A, (forall c :e A, c :e k -> simplicial_chain (p,s) (f c)) -> simplicial_chain (p,s) (iterate_op (frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega))) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) a b) k f)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_COMPLEX_DISJOINT_RELATIVE_INTERIORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall c d c= R :^: idx N, simplicial_complex N t /\ (c :e t /\ (d :e t /\ ~ c = d)) -> relative_interior N c :/\: relative_interior N d = Empty

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_COMPLEX_IMP_TRIANGULATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall tr c= Power (R :^: idx A), simplicial_complex A tr -> triangulation A tr

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_COMPLEX_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall tr c= Power (R :^: idx M), linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> (simplicial_complex N {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e tr} <-> simplicial_complex M tr)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_COMPLEX_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall tr c= Power (R :^: idx N), simplicial_complex N {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {vector_add N a x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e tr} <-> simplicial_complex N tr

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_FACE_IN_STANDARD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: omega, 1 <= p /\ (k <= p /\ x :e standard_simplex (minus_nat p 1)) -> (fun x0 :e omega => simplicial_face k (fun x1:set => x x1) x0) :e standard_simplex p

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_IMP_SINGULAR_CHAIN
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall c :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_chain (p,s) c -> singular_chain (R :^: omega) (p,subtopology (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) s) c

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_IMP_SINGULAR_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), simplicial_simplex (p,s) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0) -> singular_simplex (R :^: omega) (p,subtopology (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) s) (fun x:set => f x)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), simplicial_simplex (p,s) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0) <-> {f x | x :e standard_simplex p} c= s /\ exists l:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, l x y :e R) /\ forall x :e R :^: omega, forall x0 :e omega, f x x0 = oriented_simplex p l x x0

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SIMPLEX_EMPTY
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, forall y :e omega, f x y :e R) -> ~ simplicial_simplex (p,Empty) f

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SIMPLEX_I
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, simplicial_simplex (p,s) (fun x:set => if x :e standard_simplex p then fun x0 :e omega => x x0 else choose_in (R :^: omega) (fun y:set => True)) <-> standard_simplex p c= s

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SIMPLEX_ORIENTED_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall l:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, l x y :e R) -> (simplicial_simplex (p,s) (oriented_simplex p l) <-> {(fun x0 :e omega => finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= p} (fun j:set => l j x0 * x j)) | x :e standard_simplex p} c= s)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SIMPLEX_SIMPLEX_CONE
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s t c= R :^: omega, forall v :e R :^: omega, forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), simplicial_simplex (p,s) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0) /\ (forall x :e R :^: omega, forall u :e R, 0 <= u /\ (u <= 1 /\ x :e s) -> (fun i :e omega => (1 + - u) * v i + u * x i) :e t) -> simplicial_simplex (p + 1,t) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => simplex_cone p v f x x0)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SIMPLEX_SINGULAR_FACE
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, forall k :e omega, forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), simplicial_simplex (p,s) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0) /\ (1 <= p /\ k <= p) -> simplicial_simplex (minus_nat p 1,s) (singular_face (R :^: omega) p k (fun x:set => f x))

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SUBDIVISION_0
items.statement: forall p :e omega, simplicial_subdivision p (frag_0 (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega))) = frag_0 (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega))

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SUBDIVISION_OF
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), simplicial_subdivision p (frag_of (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) f) = if p = 0 then frag_of (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) f else simplicial_cone (minus_nat p 1) (fun i:set => finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= p} (fun j:set => simplicial_vertex j (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0) i) :/: (p + 1)) (simplicial_subdivision (minus_nat p 1) (chain_boundary (R :^: omega) p (frag_of (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) f)))

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SUBDIVISION_OF_CELL_COMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> polytope N c) /\ (forall c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, c1 :e m /\ c2 :e m -> face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c1 /\ face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c2)) -> exists t c= Power (R :^: idx N), simplicial_complex N t /\ (Union t = Union m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (f c= t /\ c = Union f)) /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m /\ k c= c))

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SUBDIVISION_OF_CELL_COMPLEX_LOWDIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall d :e int, finite m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> polytope N c) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> aff_dim N c <= d) /\ (forall c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, c1 :e m /\ c2 :e m -> face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c1 /\ face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c2))) -> exists t c= Power (R :^: idx N), simplicial_complex N t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> aff_dim N k <= d) /\ (Union t = Union m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (f c= t /\ c = Union f)) /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m /\ k c= c)))

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SUBDIVISION_SHRINKS
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: omega, forall k p :e omega, forall d :e R, forall c :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_chain (p,s) c /\ (forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), forall x y :e R :^: omega, f :e frag_support (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) c /\ (x :e standard_simplex p /\ y :e standard_simplex p) -> abs_SNo (f x k + - f y k) <= d) -> forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), forall x y :e R :^: omega, f :e frag_support (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) (simplicial_subdivision p c) /\ (x :e standard_simplex p /\ y :e standard_simplex p) -> abs_SNo (f x k + - f y k) <= p :/: (p + 1) * d

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_SUBDIVISION_SUB
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall c1 c2 :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_subdivision p (frag_sub (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) c1 c2) = frag_sub (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) (simplicial_subdivision p c1) (simplicial_subdivision p c2)

items.name: SIMPLICIAL_VERTEX_ORIENTED_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall i p :e omega, forall l:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, l x y :e R) -> forall x :e omega, simplicial_vertex i (oriented_simplex p l) x = if i <= p then l i x else choose_in (R :^: omega) (fun x:set => True) x

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> simply_connected A Empty

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_EQ_CONTRACTIBLE_LOOP_ALL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s <-> s = Empty \/ exists a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p /\ (path_image N p c= s /\ pathfinish N p = pathstart N p) -> homotopic_loops N s p (fun x:set => linepath N (a,a) x)

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_EQ_CONTRACTIBLE_LOOP_ANY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s <-> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, path N p /\ (path_image N p c= s /\ (pathfinish N p = pathstart N p /\ a :e s)) -> homotopic_loops N s p (fun x:set => linepath N (a,a) x)

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_EQ_CONTRACTIBLE_LOOP_SOME
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s <-> path_connected N s /\ forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p /\ (path_image N p c= s /\ pathfinish N p = pathstart N p) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ homotopic_loops N s p (fun x:set => linepath N (a,a) x)

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_EQ_CONTRACTIBLE_PATH
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s <-> path_connected N s /\ forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p /\ (path_image N p c= s /\ pathfinish N p = pathstart N p) -> homotopic_paths N s p (fun x:set => linepath N (pathstart N p,pathstart N p) x)

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_EQ_HOMOTOPIC_PATHS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s <-> path_connected N s /\ forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p /\ (path_image N p c= s /\ (path N q /\ (path_image N q c= s /\ (pathstart N q = pathstart N p /\ pathfinish N q = pathfinish N p)))) -> homotopic_paths N s p q

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_FUNDAMENTAL_GROUP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s <-> path_connected N s /\ forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s -> fundamental_group N (s,a) = {{x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx 1) | homotopic_paths N s (fun x0:set => linepath N (a,a) x0) (fun x0:set => x x0)}}

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_IMP_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s -> connected N s

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s -> path_connected N s

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_INJECTIVE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (simply_connected N {f x | x :e s} <-> simply_connected M s)

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_NESTED_UNIONS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f c= Power (R :^: idx N), (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e f -> open N s /\ simply_connected N s) /\ (forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s) -> simply_connected N (Union f)

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected M s /\ simply_connected N t -> simply_connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ simply_connected M s /\ simply_connected N t)

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_RETRACTION_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, k x :e R :^: idx M) -> continuous_on_hl M N h s /\ ({h x | x :e s} = t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M k t /\ ({k x | x :e t} c= s /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t -> h (k y) = y) /\ simply_connected M s)))) -> simply_connected N t

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, simply_connected N {a}

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> simply_connected N s

items.name: SIMPLY_CONNECTED_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t) /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) (s :\/: t) /\ (simply_connected N s /\ (simply_connected N t /\ (path_connected N (s :/\: t) /\ ~ s :/\: t = Empty)))) -> simply_connected N (s :\/: t)

items.name: SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, (exists x :e A, s = {x}) <-> exists x :e A, s = {x}

items.name: SINGLETON_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall a :e A, group_carrier A (singleton_group A a) = {a}) /\ ((forall a :e A, group_id A (singleton_group A a) = a) /\ ((forall a x :e A, group_inv A (singleton_group A a) x = a) /\ forall a x y :e A, group_mul A (singleton_group A a) x y = a))

items.name: SINGULAR_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_relboundary A (p,(top,Empty)) c <-> exists d :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p + 1,top) d /\ chain_boundary A (p + 1) d = c

items.name: SINGULAR_BOUNDARY_EQ_CYCLE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), topspace A top = {a} /\ 1 <= p -> (singular_relboundary A (p,(top,Empty)) c <-> singular_relcycle A (p,(top,Empty)) c)

items.name: SINGULAR_BOUNDARY_IMP_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_relboundary A (p,(top,Empty)) c -> singular_chain A (p,top) c

items.name: SINGULAR_BOUNDARY_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), t c= s /\ singular_relboundary A (p,(subtopology A top t,Empty)) c -> singular_relboundary A (p,(subtopology A top s,Empty)) c

items.name: SINGULAR_BOUNDARY_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), topspace A top = {a} -> (singular_relboundary A (p,(top,Empty)) c <-> singular_chain A (p,top) c /\ (odd_nat p \/ c = frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega))))

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, singular_chain A (p,top) (frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega)))

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c1 c2 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,top) c1 /\ singular_chain A (p,top) c2 -> singular_chain A (p,top) (frag_add (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c1 c2)

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,top) c -> singular_chain A (minus_nat p 1,top) (chain_boundary A p c)

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_BOUNDARY_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p + 1,top) c -> singular_chain A (p,top) (chain_boundary A (p + 1) c)

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_CHAIN_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,top) c /\ continuous_map A B (top,top') g -> singular_chain B (p,top') (chain_map A B p g c)

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e int, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,top) c -> singular_chain A (p,top) (frag_cmul (A :^: (R :^: omega)) a c)

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), topspace A top = Empty -> (singular_chain A (p,top) c <-> c = frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega)))

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_EXTEND
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: (R :^: omega), f x :e frag (B :^: (R :^: omega))) -> forall x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), (forall c :e A :^: (R :^: omega), c :e frag_support (A :^: (R :^: omega)) x -> singular_chain B (p,top) (f c)) -> singular_chain B (p,top) (frag_extend (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (B :^: (R :^: omega)) f x)

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_IMP_RELBOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,subtopology A top s) c -> singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) c

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), t c= s /\ singular_chain A (p,subtopology A top t) c -> singular_chain A (p,subtopology A top s) c

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,top) (frag_neg (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c) <-> singular_chain A (p,top) c

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c :e A :^: (R :^: omega), singular_chain A (p,top) (frag_of (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c) <-> singular_simplex A (p,top) (fun x:set => c x)

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), topspace A top = {a} -> (singular_chain A (p,top) c <-> exists b :e int, c = frag_cmul (A :^: (R :^: omega)) b (frag_of (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun x :e R :^: omega => if x :e standard_simplex p then a else choose_in A (fun y:set => True))))

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_SINGULAR_SUBDIVISION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall s :e topology A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,s) c -> singular_chain A (p,s) (singular_subdivision A p c)

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c1 c2 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,top) c1 /\ singular_chain A (p,top) c2 -> singular_chain A (p,top) (frag_sub (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c1 c2)

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p,subtopology A top s) c <-> singular_chain A (p,top) c /\ forall f :e A :^: (R :^: omega), f :e frag_support (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c -> {f x | x :e standard_simplex p} c= s

items.name: SINGULAR_CHAIN_SUM
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) -> forall k c= B, (forall c :e B, c :e k -> singular_chain A (p,top) (f c)) -> singular_chain A (p,top) (iterate_op (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add (A :^: (R :^: omega)) a b) k f)

items.name: SINGULAR_CYCLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_relcycle A (p,(top,Empty)) c <-> singular_chain A (p,top) c /\ chain_boundary A p c = frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega))

items.name: SINGULAR_CYCLE_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), t c= s /\ singular_relcycle A (p,(subtopology A top t,Empty)) c -> singular_relcycle A (p,(subtopology A top s,Empty)) c

items.name: SINGULAR_CYCLE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), topspace A top = {a} -> (singular_relcycle A (p,(top,Empty)) c <-> singular_chain A (p,top) c /\ (p = 0 \/ (odd_nat p \/ c = frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega)))))

items.name: SINGULAR_FACE_ORIENTED_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p k :e omega, forall l:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, l x y :e R) -> 1 <= p /\ k <= p -> forall x :e R :^: omega, forall x0 :e omega, singular_face (R :^: omega) p k (fun x1:set => fun x2 :e omega => oriented_simplex p l x1 x2) x x0 = oriented_simplex (minus_nat p 1) (fun j:set => fun x1:set => if j < k then l j x1 else l (j + 1) x1) x x0

items.name: SINGULAR_FACE_SIMPLEX_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p k :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, c x :e A) -> 1 <= p /\ k <= p -> forall x :e R :^: omega, singular_face B p k (simplex_map A B p f c) x = simplex_map A B (minus_nat p 1) f (fun x:set => c (fun x1 :e omega => simplicial_face k (fun x2:set => x x2) x1)) x

items.name: SINGULAR_RELBOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) c <-> exists d e0 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p + 1,top) d /\ (singular_chain A (p,subtopology A top s) e0 /\ frag_add (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (chain_boundary A (p + 1) d) e0 = c)

items.name: SINGULAR_RELBOUNDARY_0

items.name: SINGULAR_SIMPLEX_CHAIN_MAP_I
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall f :e A :^: (R :^: omega), singular_simplex A (p,top) (fun x:set => f x) -> chain_map (R :^: omega) A p (fun x:set => f x) (frag_of (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun x :e R :^: omega => fun x0 :e omega => (if x :e standard_simplex p then fun x0 :e omega => x x0 else choose_in (R :^: omega) (fun y:set => True)) x0)) = frag_of (A :^: (R :^: omega)) f

items.name: SINGULAR_SIMPLEX_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, f x :e A) -> t c= s /\ singular_simplex A (p,subtopology A top t) f -> singular_simplex A (p,subtopology A top s) f

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> singular_simplex A (p,top) f /\ continuous_map A B (top,top') g -> singular_simplex B (p,top') (simplex_map A B p g f)

items.name: SINGULAR_SIMPLEX_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, f x :e A) -> topspace A top = {a} -> (singular_simplex A (p,top) f <-> forall x :e R :^: omega, f x = if x :e standard_simplex p then a else choose_in A (fun y:set => True))

items.name: SINGULAR_SIMPLEX_SINGULAR_FACE

items.name: SINGULAR_SIMPLEX_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, f x :e A) -> (singular_simplex A (p,subtopology A top s) f <-> singular_simplex A (p,top) f /\ {f x | x :e standard_simplex p} c= s)

items.name: SINGULAR_SUBDIVISION_0

items.name: SINGULAR_SUBDIVISION_ADD

items.name: SINGULAR_SUBDIVISION_SUB

items.name: SINGULAR_SUBDIVISION_ZERO

items.name: SING_ALT

items.name: SING_STRONG_DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_AR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, AR N s /\ a :e s -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | h a = a} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (fun x:set => x) r /\ retraction N (s,{a}) r)

items.name: SKOLEM_THM

items.name: SMALL_HOMOLOGOUS_REL_RELCYCLE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall u c= Power A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), (forall v c= A, v :e u -> v :e top) /\ (topspace A top c= Union u /\ singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) c) -> exists c' :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) c' /\ (homologous_rel A (p,(top,s)) c c' /\ forall f :e A :^: (R :^: omega), f :e frag_support (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c' -> exists v c= A, v :e u /\ {f x | x :e standard_simplex p} c= v)

items.name: SMALL_IMP_DIMENSION_LE_0

items.name: SMALL_IMP_TOTALLY_DISCONNECTED

items.name: SMALL_INDUCTIVE_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, dimension N s <= n <-> - 1 <= n /\ forall c c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) c /\ ~ a :e c) -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) b /\ (dimension N b <= n + - 1 /\ exists u v c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (u :/\: v = Empty /\ (u :\/: v = s :\: b /\ (a :e u /\ c c= v)))))

items.name: SNDCART_COMPONENT

items.name: SNDCART_VSUM

items.name: SOLVABLE_GROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, solvable_group A G <-> exists k :e omega, exists c :e Power A :^: omega, c 0 = {group_id A G} /\ (c k = group_carrier A G /\ forall i :e omega, i < k -> normal_subgroup_of A (c i) (subgroup_generated A G (c (ordsucc i))) /\ abelian_group_hl (Power A) (quotient_group A (subgroup_generated A G (c (ordsucc i))) (c i)))

items.name: SOLVABLE_GROUP_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ solvable_group A G -> solvable_group B H

items.name: SOLVABLE_GROUP_MONOMORPHIC_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_monomorphism A B (G,H) f /\ solvable_group B H -> solvable_group A G

items.name: SOLVABLE_GROUP_NORMAL_EXTENSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ (abelian_group_hl (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) /\ solvable_group A (subgroup_generated A G n)) -> solvable_group A G

items.name: SOLVABLE_GROUP_QUOTIENT

items.name: SPANNING_SUBSET_INDEPENDENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (independent N s /\ s c= span N t) -> s = t

items.name: SPANNING_SURJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, R :^: idx M c= span M s /\ (linear M N f /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> R :^: idx N c= span N {f x | x :e s}

items.name: SPANS_IMAGE

items.name: SPAN_0

items.name: SPAN_2

items.name: SPAN_ADD

items.name: SPAN_AFFINE_HULL_INSERT

items.name: SPAN_BREAKDOWN

items.name: SPAN_BREAKDOWN_EQ
