items.name: SPAN_CARD_GE_DIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v b c= R :^: idx N, v c= span N b /\ finite b -> dim N v <= finite_cardinality b

items.name: SPAN_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, (forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s0 c= R :^: idx A, a :e s0 -> a :e span A s0) /\ (vec B 0 :e span B s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx D, forall s0 c= R :^: idx D, x :e span D s0 /\ y :e span D s0 -> vector_add D x y :e span D s0) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx C, forall c :e R, forall s0 c= R :^: idx C, x :e span C s0 -> vector_mul C c x :e span C s0))

items.name: SPAN_COLUMNSPACE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, span N (columns N M A) = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists x :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A x = y}

items.name: SPAN_CONIC_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, span N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | conic N x} s) = span N s

items.name: SPAN_CONVEX_CONE_ALLSIGNS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, span N s = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex_cone N x} (s :\/: {vector_neg N x | x :e s})

items.name: SPAN_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, span N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} s) = span N s

items.name: SPAN_DELETE_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, span N (s :\: {vec N 0}) = span N s

items.name: SPAN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> span A Empty = {vec A 0}

items.name: SPAN_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, span N s = span N t <-> s c= span N t /\ t c= span N s

items.name: SPAN_EQ_DIM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, span A s = span A t -> dim A s = dim A t

items.name: SPAN_EQ_INSERT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, span N (SetAdjoin s x) = span N s <-> x :e span N s

items.name: SPAN_EQ_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, span A s = s <-> subspace A s

items.name: SPAN_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N, span N p = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists s c= R :^: idx N, exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ (finite s /\ (s c= p /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y))}

items.name: SPAN_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> span N s = {y :e R :^: idx N | exists u:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, u x :e R) /\ vsum (R :^: idx N) N s (fun v:set => vector_mul N (u v) v) = y}

items.name: SPAN_IMAGE_SCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> ~ c x = 0) -> span N {vector_mul N (c x) x | x :e s} = span N s

items.name: SPAN_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, s c= span A s

items.name: SPAN_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s h c= R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> x :e h) /\ subspace A h -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e span A s -> x :e h

items.name: SPAN_INDUCT_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall h:set -> prop, h (vec N 0) /\ (forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ h y -> h (vector_add N (vector_mul N c x) y)) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e span N s -> h x

items.name: SPAN_INSERT_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, span A (SetAdjoin s (vec A 0)) = span A s

items.name: SPAN_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, linear M N f -> span N {f x | x :e s} = {f x | x :e span M s}

items.name: SPAN_MBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> span (multivector N) {mbasis N s | s :e Power omega, s c= idx N} = R :^: idx (multivector N)

items.name: SPAN_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s c= t -> span A s c= span A t

items.name: SPAN_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e span A s -> vector_mul A c x :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_MUL_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ c = 0 -> (vector_mul N c x :e span N s <-> x :e span N s)

items.name: SPAN_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e span A s -> vector_neg A x :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_NEG_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, vector_neg A x :e span A s <-> x :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_NOT_UNIV_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ span N s = R :^: idx N -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e span N s -> dot N a x = 0

items.name: SPAN_NOT_UNIV_SUBSET_HYPERPLANE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ span N s = R :^: idx N -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ span N s c= {x :e R :^: idx N | dot N a x = 0}

items.name: SPAN_OF_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> span N s = s

items.name: SPAN_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> span N s = R :^: idx N

items.name: SPAN_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (vec M 0 :e s \/ vec N 0 :e t)) -> span (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) = \/_ x :e span M s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e span N t}

items.name: SPAN_PCROSS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, span (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) c= \/_ x :e span M s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e span N t}

items.name: SPAN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, span A {a} = {vector_mul A u a | u :e R, u :e R}

items.name: SPAN_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, span A (span A s) = span A s

items.name: SPAN_SPECIAL_SCALE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, span N (SetAdjoin s (vector_mul N a x)) = if a = 0 then span N s else span N (SetAdjoin s x)

items.name: SPAN_STDBASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> span N {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} = R :^: idx N

items.name: SPAN_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, x :e span A s /\ y :e span A s -> vector_sub A x y :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_SUBSET_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, s c= t /\ subspace N t -> span N s c= t

items.name: SPAN_SUBSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall b s c= R :^: idx A, b c= s /\ (s c= span A b /\ subspace A s) -> span A b = s

items.name: SPAN_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ vec N 0 :e s :\/: t) -> span N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e span N s /\ y :e span N t}

items.name: SPAN_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> x :e span A s

items.name: SPAN_TRANS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, x :e span N s /\ y :e span N (SetAdjoin s x) -> y :e span N s

items.name: SPAN_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, span N (s :\/: t) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e span N s /\ y :e span N t}

items.name: SPAN_UNION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, span A s :\/: span A t c= span A (s :\/: t)

items.name: SPAN_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> span N (R :^: idx N) = R :^: idx N

items.name: SPAN_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall t c= A, finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x :e span B s) -> vsum A B t f :e span B s

items.name: SPECIAL_HYPERPLANE_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> {x :e R :^: idx N | x k = 0} = span N {basis N x | x :e idx N :\: {k}}

items.name: SPHERE_1
items.statement: forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall r :e R, sphere 1 (a,r) = if r < 0 then Empty else {vector_sub 1 a (lift r),vector_add 1 a (lift r)}

items.name: SPHERE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, r < 0 -> sphere N (a,r) = Empty

items.name: SPHERE_EQ_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, sphere N (a,r) = Empty <-> r < 0

items.name: SPHERE_EQ_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, sphere N (a,r) = {x} <-> x = a /\ r = 0

items.name: SPHERE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall r :e R, linear M N f /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x0 :e R :^: idx M, f x0 = y) /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm N (f x0) = vector_norm M x0)) -> sphere N (f x,r) = {f x0 | x0 :e sphere M (x,r)}

items.name: SPHERE_RETRACT_OF_PUNCTURED_UNIVERSE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, 0 < r -> retract_of N (sphere N (a,r)) ((R :^: idx N) :\: {a})

items.name: SPHERE_RETRACT_OF_PUNCTURED_UNIVERSE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, forall b :e R :^: idx N, b :e ball N (a,r) -> retract_of N (sphere N (a,r)) ((R :^: idx N) :\: {b})

items.name: SPHERE_SCALING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, 0 < c -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, sphere A (vector_mul A c x,c * r) = {vector_mul A c x0 | x0 :e sphere A (x,r)}

items.name: SPHERE_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, e0 = 0 -> sphere A (x,e0) = {x}

items.name: SPHERE_SUBSET_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, sphere A (x,e0) c= cball A (x,e0)

items.name: SPHERE_SUBSET_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall r :e R, convex N s -> (sphere N (a,r) c= s <-> cball N (a,r) c= s)

items.name: SPHERE_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a x :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, sphere A (vector_add A a x,r) = {vector_add A a y | y :e sphere A (x,r)}

items.name: SPHERE_UNION_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall r :e R, sphere A (a,r) :\/: ball A (a,r) = cball A (a,r)

items.name: SPLITTING_LEMMA_FREE_ABELIAN_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall s c= D, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (abelian_group_hl B B0 /\ isomorphic_group C (frag D) C0 (free_abelian_group D s)) -> isomorphic_group B (A :*: C) B0 (prod_group A C A0 C0)

items.name: SPLITTING_LEMMA_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e B, f' x :e A) -> forall g :e C :^: B, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B A (B0,A0) f' /\ (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A A0 -> f' (f x) = x)) -> exists h k c= B, normal_subgroup_of B h B0 /\ (normal_subgroup_of B k B0 /\ (h :/\: k c= {group_id B B0} /\ (group_setmul B B0 h k = group_carrier B B0 /\ (group_isomorphism_hl A B (A0,subgroup_generated B B0 h) (fun x:set => f x) /\ group_isomorphism_hl B C (subgroup_generated B B0 k,C0) (fun x:set => g x)))))

items.name: SPLITTING_LEMMA_LEFT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e B, f' x :e A) -> forall g :e C :^: B, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B A (B0,A0) f' /\ group_isomorphism_hl A A (A0,A0) (fun x:set => f' (f x))) -> exists h k c= B, normal_subgroup_of B h B0 /\ (normal_subgroup_of B k B0 /\ (h :/\: k c= {group_id B B0} /\ (group_setmul B B0 h k = group_carrier B B0 /\ (group_isomorphism_hl A B (A0,subgroup_generated B B0 h) (fun x:set => f x) /\ group_isomorphism_hl B C (subgroup_generated B B0 k,C0) (fun x:set => g x)))))

items.name: SPLITTING_LEMMA_LEFT_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e B, f' x :e A) -> forall g :e C :^: B, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (abelian_group_hl B B0 /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B A (B0,A0) f' /\ (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A A0 -> f' (f x) = x))) -> isomorphic_group B (A :*: C) B0 (prod_group A C A0 C0)

items.name: SPLITTING_LEMMA_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e C, g' x :e B) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_homomorphism_hl C B (C0,B0) g' /\ (forall z :e C, z :e group_carrier C C0 -> g (g' z) = z)) -> exists h k c= B, normal_subgroup_of B h B0 /\ (subgroup_of B k B0 /\ (h :/\: k c= {group_id B B0} /\ (group_setmul B B0 h k = group_carrier B B0 /\ (group_isomorphism_hl A B (A0,subgroup_generated B B0 h) (fun x:set => f x) /\ group_isomorphism_hl B C (subgroup_generated B B0 k,C0) (fun x:set => g x)))))

items.name: SPLITTING_LEMMA_RIGHT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e C, g' x :e B) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_homomorphism_hl C B (C0,B0) g' /\ group_isomorphism_hl C C (C0,C0) (fun x:set => g (g' x))) -> exists h k c= B, normal_subgroup_of B h B0 /\ (subgroup_of B k B0 /\ (h :/\: k c= {group_id B B0} /\ (group_setmul B B0 h k = group_carrier B B0 /\ (group_isomorphism_hl A B (A0,subgroup_generated B B0 h) (fun x:set => f x) /\ group_isomorphism_hl B C (subgroup_generated B B0 k,C0) (fun x:set => g x)))))

items.name: SPLITTING_LEMMA_RIGHT_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e C, g' x :e B) -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (abelian_group_hl B B0 /\ (group_homomorphism_hl C B (C0,B0) g' /\ (forall z :e C, z :e group_carrier C C0 -> g (g' z) = z))) -> isomorphic_group B (A :*: C) B0 (prod_group A C A0 C0)

items.name: SPLITTING_SUBLEMMA
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall h k c= B, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_image A B (A0,B0) (fun x:set => f x) = h /\ (subgroup_of B k B0 /\ (h :/\: k c= {group_id B B0} /\ group_setmul B B0 h k = group_carrier B B0))) -> group_isomorphism_hl A B (A0,subgroup_generated B B0 h) (fun x:set => f x) /\ group_isomorphism_hl B C (subgroup_generated B B0 k,C0) (fun x:set => g x)

items.name: SPLITTING_SUBLEMMA_GEN
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall h k c= B, group_exactness A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_image A B (A0,B0) (fun x:set => f x) = h /\ (subgroup_of B k B0 /\ (h :/\: k c= {group_id B B0} /\ group_setmul B B0 h k = group_carrier B B0))) -> group_isomorphism_hl B C (subgroup_generated B B0 k,subgroup_generated C C0 (group_image B C (B0,C0) (fun x:set => g x))) (fun x:set => g x)

items.name: SQNORM_LE_MAX_EIGENVECTOR_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, c x :e R) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall l :e R, linear N N f /\ ((forall x y :e b, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, x0 :e b -> f x0 = vector_mul N (c x0) x0 /\ c x0 ^ 2 <= l) /\ x :e span N b)) -> vector_norm N (f x) ^ 2 <= l * vector_norm N x ^ 2

items.name: SQNORM_PASTECART
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall y :e R :^: idx B, vector_norm (idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B)) (pastecart A B x y) ^ 2 = vector_norm A x ^ 2 + vector_norm B y ^ 2

items.name: SQRT_0
items.statement: (if 0 <= 0 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg 0 else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- 0)) = 0

items.name: SQRT_1
items.statement: (if 0 <= 1 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg 1 else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- 1)) = 1

items.name: SQRT_DIV
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x :/: y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x :/: y) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x :/: y)) = (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) :/: if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)

items.name: SQRT_EQ_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = 0 <-> x = 0

items.name: SQRT_EQ_1
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = 1 <-> x = 1

items.name: SQRT_EVEN_POW2
items.statement: forall n :e omega, even_nat n -> (if 0 <= 2 ^ n then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (2 ^ n) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- 2 ^ n)) = 2 ^ div_nat n 2

items.name: SQRT_INJ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = (if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <-> x = y

items.name: SQRT_INV
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= recip_SNo x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (recip_SNo x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- recip_SNo x)) = recip_SNo (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x))

items.name: SQRT_LE_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) <-> 0 <= x

items.name: SQRT_LT_0
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 < (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) <-> 0 < x

items.name: SQRT_MONO_LE
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x <= y -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) <= if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)

items.name: SQRT_MONO_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) <= (if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <-> x <= y

items.name: SQRT_MONO_LT
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x < y -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)

items.name: SQRT_MONO_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < (if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)) <-> x < y

items.name: SQRT_MUL
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 <= x * y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (x * y) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x * y)) = (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) * if 0 <= y then sqrt_SNo_nonneg y else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- y)

items.name: SQRT_NEG
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= - x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- - x)) = - if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)

items.name: SQRT_POS_LE
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> 0 <= if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)

items.name: SQRT_POS_LT
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 < x -> 0 < if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)

items.name: SQRT_POW2
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = x <-> 0 <= x

items.name: SQRT_POW_2
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = x

items.name: SQRT_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall x y :e R, 0 <= y /\ y ^ 2 = x -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = y

items.name: SQRT_UNIQUE_GEN
items.statement: forall x y :e R, (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) /\ y ^ 2 = abs_SNo x -> (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = y

items.name: SQRT_WORKS
items.statement: forall x :e R, 0 <= x -> 0 <= (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) /\ (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = x

items.name: SQRT_WORKS_GEN
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x) then 1 else if (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) /\ (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) ^ 2 = abs_SNo x

items.name: SQUARE_INTEGRAL_SQUARE_INTEGRABLE_PRODUCT_LE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx P) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, measurable_on M N f s /\ (integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x) ^ 2)) s /\ (measurable_on M P g s /\ integrable_on 1 M (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm P (g x) ^ 2)) s)) -> drop (integral 1 M s (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x) * vector_norm P (g x)))) ^ 2 <= drop (integral 1 M s (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f x) ^ 2))) * drop (integral 1 M s (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm P (g x) ^ 2)))

items.name: STANDARD_SIMPLEX_0
items.statement: standard_simplex 0 = {fun j :e omega => if j = 0 then 1 else 0}

items.name: STANDARD_SIMPLEX_MONO
items.statement: forall p q :e omega, p <= q -> standard_simplex p c= standard_simplex q

items.name: STARLIKE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, starlike N s -> starlike N (closure N s)

items.name: STARLIKE_COMPACT_PROJECTIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (a :e relative_interior N s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> open_segment N (a,x) c= relative_interior N s)) -> homeomorphic N N (s :\: relative_interior N s) (sphere N (a,1) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ (homeomorphic N N s (cball N (a,1) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s) /\ homeomorphic N N (relative_interior N s) (ball N (a,1) :/\: hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | affine N x} s))

items.name: STARLIKE_CONVEX_TWEAK_BOUNDARY_POINTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (relative_interior N s c= t /\ t c= closure N s)) -> starlike N t

items.name: STARLIKE_IMP_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, starlike N s -> connected N s

items.name: STARLIKE_IMP_CONTRACTIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, starlike N s -> contractible N s

items.name: STARLIKE_IMP_CONTRACTIBLE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall t :e R, a :e s /\ (0 <= t /\ t <= 1) -> (fun x :e R :^: idx N => vector_add N (vector_mul N (1 + - t) x) (vector_mul N t a)) :e P) /\ starlike N s -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) P (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (fun x:set => x) (fun x:set => a)

items.name: STARLIKE_IMP_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, starlike N s -> path_connected N s

items.name: STARLIKE_IMP_SIMPLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, starlike N s -> simply_connected N s

items.name: STARLIKE_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, starlike A s /\ linear A B f -> starlike B {f x | x :e s}

items.name: STARLIKE_LINEAR_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, linear B A f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx B, f x = f y -> x = y) -> (starlike A {f x | x :e s} <-> starlike B s)

items.name: STARLIKE_NEGLIGIBLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= c /\ (vector_add N a x :e s /\ vector_add N a (vector_mul N c x) :e s) -> c = 1) -> negligible N s

items.name: STARLIKE_NEGLIGIBLE_BOUNDED_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ (bounded_hl N s /\ (forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= c /\ (x :e s /\ vector_mul N c x :e s) -> c = 1)) -> negligible N s

items.name: STARLIKE_NEGLIGIBLE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= c /\ (x :e s /\ vector_mul N c x :e s) -> c = 1) -> negligible N s

items.name: STARLIKE_NEGLIGIBLE_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ (forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= c /\ (c < 1 /\ vector_add N a x :e s) -> ~ vector_add N a (vector_mul N c x) :e s) -> negligible N s

items.name: STARLIKE_PCROSS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, starlike M s /\ starlike N t -> starlike (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t})

items.name: STARLIKE_PCROSS_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, starlike (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) <-> starlike M s /\ starlike N t

items.name: STARLIKE_TRANSLATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, starlike A {vector_add A a x | x :e s} <-> starlike A s

items.name: STARLIKE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> starlike N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: STD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (SetAdjoin {basis N i | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N} (vec N 0)) = {x :e R :^: idx N | (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> 0 <= x i) /\ finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => x i) <= 1}

items.name: STEINHAUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, measurable N s /\ 0 < measure N s -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ ball N (vec N 0,d) c= \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_sub N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s}

items.name: STEINHAUS_DIFFS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ (~ negligible N s /\ (lebesgue_measurable N t /\ ~ negligible N t)) -> ~ interior N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_sub N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = Empty

items.name: STEINHAUS_LEBESGUE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ ~ negligible N s -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ ball N (vec N 0,d) c= \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_sub N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e s}

items.name: STEINHAUS_SUMS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s /\ (~ negligible N s /\ (lebesgue_measurable N t /\ ~ negligible N t)) -> ~ interior N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = Empty

items.name: STEPANOV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, open M s -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ((exists B :e R, eventually (R :^: idx M) {y :e R :^: idx M | vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) :/: vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y) <= B} (at M x)) /\ ~ differentiable N M f (at M x))}

items.name: STEPANOV_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, lebesgue_measurable M s -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ((exists B :e R, eventually (R :^: idx M) {y :e R :^: idx M | vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) :/: vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y) <= B} (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)) /\ ~ differentiable N M f (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s))}

items.name: STEPANOV_UNIV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> negligible M {x :e R :^: idx M | (exists B :e R, eventually (R :^: idx M) {y :e R :^: idx M | vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) :/: vector_norm M (vector_sub M x y) <= B} (at M x)) /\ ~ differentiable N M f (at M x)}

items.name: STRETCH_GALOIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall m:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, m x0 :e R) -> (forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> ~ m k = 0) -> (y = (fun k :e idx N => m k * x k) <-> (fun k :e idx N => recip_SNo (m k) * y k) = x)

items.name: STRICTLY_DECREASING_ALT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ x < y) -> f y < f x) <-> (forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ x <= y) -> f y <= f x) /\ forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: STRICTLY_EQ_PROPERLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l -> forall x x0 :e A, strictly_rel l x x0 <-> properly_rel l x x0

items.name: STRICTLY_IMP_PROPERLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, qoset_on A l /\ strictly_rel l x y -> properly_rel l x y

items.name: STRICTLY_INCREASING_ALT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e R) -> ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ x < y) -> f x < f y) <-> (forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ x <= y) -> f x <= f y) /\ forall x y :e R, P x /\ (P y /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: STRICTLY_PROPERLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, strictly_rel (properly_rel R0) x x0 <-> strictly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: STRICTLY_STRICTLY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x x0 :e A, strictly_rel (strictly_rel R0) x x0 <-> strictly_rel R0 x x0

items.name: STRONG_DEFORMATION_RETRACT_OF_AR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, AR N s /\ retract_of N t s -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {h :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> h x = x} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) (fun x:set => x) r /\ retraction N (s,t) r)

items.name: SUB
items.statement: (forall m :e omega, minus_nat m 0 = m) /\ forall m n :e omega, minus_nat m (ordsucc n) = nat_pred (minus_nat m n)

items.name: SUBADDITIVE_CONTENT_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, division_of M d s /\ s c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> finsum d (fun x:set => content M x) <= content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SUBBASE_SUBTOPOLOGY_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: forall u c= R, {x :e Power R | exists u0 c= Power R, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to R {x01 :e Power R | exists u c= Power R, finite u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e {{x11 :e R | a < x11} | a :e R, a :e R} :\/: {{x11 :e R | x11 < a} | a :e R, a :e R}) /\ {x :e R | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} u) /\ Union u0 = x} = subtopology R euclideanreal u

items.name: SUBGROUPS_GENERATED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t) /\ t c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) -> subgroup_generated A G s = subgroup_generated A G t

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) = {x :e A | forall Y :e {h :e Power A | subgroup_of A h G /\ group_carrier A G :/\: s c= h}, x :e Y}) /\ ((forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_id A (subgroup_generated A G s) = group_id A G) /\ ((forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, group_inv A (subgroup_generated A G s) x = group_inv A G x) /\ forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall x x0 :e A, group_mul A (subgroup_generated A G s) x x0 = group_mul A G x x0))

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_BY_EPIMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ (s c= group_carrier A G /\ subgroup_generated A G s = G) -> subgroup_generated B H {f x | x :e s} = H

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_BY_HOMOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ s c= group_carrier A G -> group_carrier B (subgroup_generated B H {f x | x :e s}) = {f x | x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)}

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_BY_HOMOMORPHIC_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ (s c= group_carrier A G /\ (t c= group_carrier A G /\ subgroup_generated A G s = subgroup_generated A G t)) -> subgroup_generated B H {f x | x :e s} = subgroup_generated B H {f x | x :e t}

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_BY_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_generated A G (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)) = subgroup_generated A G s

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_BY_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= t -> subgroup_generated A (subgroup_generated A G t) (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)) = subgroup_generated A G s

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_ELEMENT_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ a :e group_carrier A G -> (subgroup_generated A G {a} = G <-> group_element_order_hl A G a = finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_generated A G s = G <-> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) = group_carrier A G

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_GROUP_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, subgroup_generated A G (group_carrier A G) = G

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= t -> subgroup_generated A (subgroup_generated A G t) s = subgroup_generated A G s

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_IDEMPOT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t) -> subgroup_generated A (subgroup_generated A G t) s = subgroup_generated A G s

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s c= group_carrier A G /\ x :e s -> x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_INC_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s -> x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s -> P x) /\ (P (group_id A G) /\ ((forall x :e A, P x -> P (group_inv A G x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, P x /\ P y -> P (group_mul A G x y)))) -> forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) -> P x

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_INDUCT_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P (group_id A G) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s -> P x /\ P (group_inv A G x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ (P x /\ P y)) -> P (group_mul A G x y))) -> forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) -> P x

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_INDUCT_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P (group_id A G) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (x :e s /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ P y)) -> P (group_mul A G x y) /\ P (group_mul A G (group_inv A G x) y)) -> forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) -> P x

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_INDUCT_STRONG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s -> P x) /\ (P (group_id A G) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ P x -> P (group_inv A G x)) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ (P x /\ P y)) -> P (group_mul A G x y)))) -> forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) -> P x

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_INSERT_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_generated A G (SetAdjoin s (group_id A G)) = subgroup_generated A G s

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_MINIMAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h s c= A, s c= h /\ subgroup_of A h G -> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) c= h

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_MINIMAL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h s c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) c= h <-> group_carrier A G :/\: s c= h)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= t -> group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_carrier A G c= s -> subgroup_generated A G s = G

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_generated A G s = subgroup_generated A G (group_carrier A G :/\: s)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_SETMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> subgroup_generated A G (group_setmul A G g h) = subgroup_generated A G (g :\/: h)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_SUBSET_CARRIER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, group_carrier A G :/\: h c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G h)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_SUBSET_CARRIER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= group_carrier A G -> s c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_generated A G s = G <-> group_carrier A G c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, subgroup_generated A G (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) :\/: group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t)) = subgroup_generated A G (s :\/: t)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_UNIONS_PRIME_TORSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall P:set -> prop, subgroup_generated A G (Union {{x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k} | p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ P p}) = subgroup_generated A G {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ (~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0 /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (group_element_order_hl A G x) -> P p)}

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_UNIONS_PRIME_TORSION_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall P:set -> prop, finite {p :e omega | prime_nat p /\ P p} -> subgroup_generated A G (Union {{x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k} | p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ P p}) = subgroup_generated A G {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (group_element_order_hl A G x) -> P p}

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_UNIONS_PRIME_TORSION_FULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, subgroup_generated A G (Union {{x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k} | p :e omega, prime_nat p}) = subgroup_generated A G {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0}

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_UNION_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, subgroup_generated A G (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s) :\/: t) = subgroup_generated A G (s :\/: t)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GENERATED_UNION_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, subgroup_generated A G (s :\/: group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t)) = subgroup_generated A G (s :\/: t)

items.name: SUBGROUP_GROUP_CENTRALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of A (group_centralizer A G s) G

items.name: SUBGROUP_GROUP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f -> subgroup_of B (group_image A B (G,G') f) G'

items.name: SUBGROUP_GROUP_KERNEL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f -> subgroup_of A (group_kernel A B (G,G') f) G

items.name: SUBGROUP_GROUP_NORMALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of A (group_normalizer A G s) G

items.name: SUBGROUP_MONOMORPHISM_EPIMORPHISM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (group_monomorphism A B (G,G') f /\ group_epimorphism A B (G,subgroup_generated B G' s) f <-> group_isomorphism_hl A B (G,subgroup_generated B G' s) f)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_COMMUTING_ELEMENTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall z :e A, z :e group_carrier A G -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ group_mul A G x z = group_mul A G z x} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_COPRIME_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ gcd_int n (group_element_order_hl A G x) = 1} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_CYCLIC_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, cyclic_group_hl A G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> cyclic_group_hl A (subgroup_generated A G h)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_CYCLIC_GROUP_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ subgroup_of A h (subgroup_generated A G {x}) -> exists k :e omega, h = {group_zpow A G x (k * n) | n :e int, n :e int}

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_EPIMORPHIC_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall h c= B, group_epimorphism A B (G,H) f /\ subgroup_of B h H -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ f x :e h} G /\ {f x | x :e {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ f x :e h}} = h

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_FINITE_CYCLIC_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall a :e A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (a :e group_carrier A G /\ subgroup_generated A G {a} = G) -> (subgroup_of A h G <-> exists d :e omega, divides_nat d (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) /\ h = group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G {group_pow A G a d}))

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_GROUP_STABILIZER
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ x :e s -> subgroup_of A (group_stabilizer A X G a x) G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_HOMOMORPHIC_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall h c= A, forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f /\ subgroup_of A h G -> subgroup_of B {f x | x :e h} G'

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_HOMOMORPHIC_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall h c= B, group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ subgroup_of B h H -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ f x :e h} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_IMP_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of A s G -> ~ s = Empty

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of A s G -> s c= group_carrier A G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> subgroup_of A (g :/\: h) G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall gs c= Power A, (forall g c= A, g :e gs -> subgroup_of A g G) /\ ~ gs = Empty -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | forall Y :e gs, x :e Y} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_ISOMORPHIC_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall j c= A, group_isomorphism_hl A B (G,H) f /\ j c= group_carrier A G -> (subgroup_of B {f x | x :e j} H <-> subgroup_of A j G)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_LEFT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> (subgroup_of A (left_coset_hl A G x h) G <-> left_coset_hl A G x h = h)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_LOWER_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ divides_nat (group_element_order_hl A G x) n} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_LOWER_ORDER_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ group_pow A G x n = group_id A G} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_NONDIVISIBLE_ORDER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G /\ prime_nat p -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ divides_nat p (group_element_order_hl A G x)} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_OPPOSITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h (opposite_group A G) <-> subgroup_of A h G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_POWERS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> subgroup_of A {group_zpow A G x n | n :e int, n :e int} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_PRIMES_TORSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall Q:set -> prop, abelian_group_hl A G -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ forall p :e omega, prime_nat p /\ divides_nat p (group_element_order_hl A G x) -> Q p} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_PRIME_TORSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p :e omega, abelian_group_hl A G /\ prime_nat p -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_QUOTIENT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall h c= Power A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> (subgroup_of (Power A) h (quotient_group A G n) <-> exists k c= A, subgroup_of A k G /\ {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e k} = h)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_QUOTIENT_GROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall h c= Power A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> (subgroup_of (Power A) h (quotient_group A G n) <-> exists k c= A, subgroup_of A k G /\ (n c= k /\ {right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e k} = h))

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_QUOTIENT_GROUP_GENERATED_BY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, forall h c= Power A, normal_subgroup_of A n G /\ subgroup_of (Power A) h (quotient_group A G n) -> exists k c= A, subgroup_of A k G /\ (n c= k /\ quotient_group A (subgroup_generated A G k) n = subgroup_generated (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) h)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_RIGHT_COSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, subgroup_of A h G /\ x :e group_carrier A G -> (subgroup_of A (right_coset_hl A G h x) G <-> right_coset_hl A G h x = h)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_SETWISE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of A s G <-> s c= group_carrier A G /\ (group_id A G :e s /\ (group_setinv A G s c= s /\ group_setmul A G s s c= s))

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ g c= h -> subgroup_of A g (subgroup_generated A G h)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h k c= A, subgroup_of A h (subgroup_generated A G k) <-> subgroup_of A h G /\ h c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G k)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_REV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g (subgroup_generated A G h) -> subgroup_of A g G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_SUBGROUP_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h k c= A, subgroup_of A k G -> (subgroup_of A h (subgroup_generated A G k) <-> subgroup_of A h G /\ h c= k)

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_TORSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_TORSION_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G /\ (P 1 /\ (forall m n p :e omega, divides_nat p (m * n) /\ (P m /\ P n) -> P p)) -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ P (group_element_order_hl A G x)} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_TORSION_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G /\ (P 1 /\ (forall m n p :e omega, divides_nat p (lcm_int m n) /\ (P m /\ P n) -> P p)) -> subgroup_of A {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ P (group_element_order_hl A G x)} G

items.name: SUBGROUP_OF_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall u c= Power A, ~ u = Empty /\ ((forall h c= A, h :e u -> subgroup_of A h G) /\ (forall g h c= A, g :e u /\ h :e u -> g c= h \/ h c= g)) -> subgroup_of A (Union u) G

items.name: SUBGROUP_SETMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, abelian_group_hl A G /\ (subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G) -> subgroup_of A (group_setmul A G g h) G

items.name: SUBGROUP_SETMUL_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall g h c= A, subgroup_of A g G /\ subgroup_of A h G -> (subgroup_of A (group_setmul A G g h) G <-> group_setmul A G g h = group_setmul A G h g)

items.name: SUBGROUP_SINGULAR_RELBOUNDARY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) {x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) x} (chain_group A (p,top))

items.name: SUBGROUP_SINGULAR_RELBOUNDARY_RELCYCLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) {x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) x} (relcycle_group A (p,(top,s)))

items.name: SUBGROUP_SINGULAR_RELCYCLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) {x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) x} (chain_group A (p,top))

items.name: SUBGROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of A (group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G s)) G

items.name: SUBGROUP_SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> subgroup_of (A :^: K) {x :e A :^: K | x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | x1 :e group_carrier A (G i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ x i = group_id A (G i)}} (product_group A K k G)

items.name: SUBINTERVAL_MEAN_VALUE_THEOREM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (~ n = 0 /\ absolutely_integrable_on 1 N f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> exists c d :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N c (vector_mul N (recip_SNo n) (vector_sub N b a)) = d /\ (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ vector_mul 1 (measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) (integral 1 N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) f) = vector_mul 1 (measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))) (integral 1 N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f))

items.name: SUBINTERVAL_MEAN_VALUE_THEOREM_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ absolutely_integrable_on 1 N f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c d :e R :^: idx N, exists n :e omega, ~ n = 0 /\ (vector_add N c (vector_mul N (recip_SNo n) (vector_sub N b a)) = d /\ (x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) /\ (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (diameter N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) < e0 /\ vector_mul 1 (measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) (integral 1 N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) f) = vector_mul 1 (measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil))) (integral 1 N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f)))))

items.name: SUBINTERVAL_MEAN_VALUE_THEOREM_SEQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ absolutely_integrable_on 1 N f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> exists c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists d:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, d x :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall n :e omega, exists m :e omega, ~ m = 0 /\ vector_add N (c n) (vector_mul N (recip_SNo m) (vector_sub N b a)) = d n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (c n,d n) seq_nil) = Empty) /\ (tendsto N omega (fun n:set => vector_sub N (d n) (c n)) (vec N 0) sequentially /\ ((forall n :e omega, closed_interval N (seq_cons (c n,d n) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, closed_interval N (seq_cons (c (ordsucc n),d (ordsucc n)) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (c n,d n) seq_nil)) /\ forall n :e omega, vector_mul 1 (measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) (integral 1 N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c n,d n) seq_nil)) f) = vector_mul 1 (measure N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (c n,d n) seq_nil))) (integral 1 N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f))))))

items.name: SUBMATROID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_subspace A m s -> matroid_set A (submatroid A m s) = s) /\ forall m :e matroid A, forall s x c= A, forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A (submatroid A m s) x x0 <-> matroid_span A m x x0

items.name: SUBMATROID_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A, x :e matroid_set A (submatroid A m s) <-> matroid_span A m (matroid_set A m :/\: s) x) /\ forall m :e matroid A, forall s x c= A, forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A (submatroid A m s) x x0 <-> matroid_span A m x x0

items.name: SUBMATROID_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, submatroid A m (matroid_set A m) = m

items.name: SUBMATROID_SPAN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> submatroid A m {x :e A | matroid_span A m s x} = submatroid A m s

items.name: SUBMATROID_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s c= matroid_set A m -> forall x :e A, x :e matroid_set A (submatroid A m s) <-> matroid_span A m s x) /\ forall m :e matroid A, forall s x c= A, forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A (submatroid A m s) x x0 <-> matroid_span A m x x0

items.name: SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mspace A (submetric A m s) = s :/\: mspace A m) /\ forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall x :e A :*: A, mdist A (submetric A m s) x = mdist A m x

items.name: SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN_METRIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall s c= R :^: idx N, mspace (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) = s) /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N, mdist (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) x = distance N x

items.name: SUBMETRIC_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, submetric A m (mspace A m) = m

items.name: SUBMETRIC_PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, submetric (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) (s :*: t) = prod_metric A B (submetric A m1 s) (submetric B m2 t)

items.name: SUBMETRIC_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, submetric A m s = submetric A m (mspace A m :/\: s)

items.name: SUBMETRIC_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, submetric A (submetric A m s) t = submetric A m (s :/\: t)

items.name: SUBMETRIC_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, submetric A m A = m

items.name: SUBORDINATE_PARTITION_OF_UNITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, s c= Union c /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e c -> open N u) -> exists f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), forall y :e R :^: idx N, f x y :e R) /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e c -> continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f u x)) s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> 0 <= f u x) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e c /\ (x :e s /\ ~ x :e u) -> f u x = 0) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> finsum c (fun u:set => f u x) = 1) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists n c= R :^: idx N, open N n /\ (x :e n /\ finite {u :e Power (R :^: idx N) | u :e c /\ ~ forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, x0 :e n -> f u x0 = 0}))))

items.name: SUBPATH_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, linear M N f -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, subpath (R :^: idx N) u v (fun x:set => f (g x)) x = f (subpath (R :^: idx M) u v g x)

items.name: SUBPATH_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall a x :e R :^: idx 1, subpath (R :^: idx A) a a g x = linepath A (g a,g a) x

items.name: SUBPATH_REVERSEPATH
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, subpath (R :^: idx A) (vec 1 1) (vec 1 0) g x = reversepath A g x

items.name: SUBPATH_SCALING_LEMMA
items.statement: forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, {vector_add 1 u (vector_mul 1 (drop (vector_sub 1 v u)) x) | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)} = closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)

items.name: SUBPATH_TO_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path N g /\ (pathstart N g :e s /\ ~ pathfinish N g :e s) -> exists u :e R :^: idx 1, u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (pathfinish N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) u g x) :e frontier N s /\ path_image N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) u g x) :\: {pathfinish N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) u g x)} c= interior N s)

items.name: SUBPATH_TO_FRONTIER_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path N g /\ (pathstart N g :e s /\ ~ pathfinish N g :e s) -> exists u :e R :^: idx 1, u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, 0 <= drop x /\ drop x < drop u -> g x :e interior N s) /\ (~ g u :e interior N s /\ (u = vec 1 0 \/ g u :e closure N s)))

items.name: SUBPATH_TO_FRONTIER_STRONG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, path N g /\ (pathstart N g :e s /\ ~ pathfinish N g :e s) -> exists u :e R :^: idx 1, u :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (~ pathfinish N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) u g x) :e interior N s /\ (u = vec 1 0 \/ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ ~ x = vec 1 1 -> subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) u g x :e interior N s) /\ pathfinish N (fun x:set => subpath (R :^: idx N) (vec 1 0) u g x) :e closure N s))

items.name: SUBPATH_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u v x :e R :^: idx 1, subpath (R :^: idx N) u v (fun x:set => vector_add N a (g x)) x = vector_add N a (subpath (R :^: idx N) u v g x)

items.name: SUBPATH_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, subpath A (vec 1 0) (vec 1 1) g x = g x

items.name: SUBSEQUENCE_DIAGONALIZATION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall i :e omega, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e A) -> exists k:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> k m < k n) /\ P i (fun x :e omega => r (k x)))) /\ (forall i :e omega, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e A) -> forall k1:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k1 x :e omega) -> forall k2:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k2 x :e omega) -> forall N :e omega, P i (fun x :e omega => r (k1 x)) /\ (forall j :e omega, N <= j -> exists j' :e omega, j <= j' /\ k2 j = k1 j') -> P i (fun x :e omega => r (k2 x))) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e A) -> exists k:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, k x :e omega) /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> k m < k n) /\ forall i :e omega, P i (fun x :e omega => r (k x)))

items.name: SUBSEQUENCE_IMP_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) -> (forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) -> forall m n :e omega, r m = r n <-> m = n

items.name: SUBSEQUENCE_STEPWISE
items.statement: forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) -> ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) <-> forall n :e omega, r n < r (ordsucc n))

items.name: SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t <-> forall x :e A, x :e s -> x :e t

items.name: SUBSET_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= s -> s = t

items.name: SUBSET_ANTISYM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= s <-> s = t

items.name: SUBSET_BALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall d e0 :e R, d <= e0 -> ball A (x,d) c= ball A (x,e0)

items.name: SUBSET_BALLS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a a' :e R :^: idx N, forall r r' :e R, ball N (a,r) c= ball N (a',r') <-> distance N (a,a') + r <= r' \/ r <= 0) /\ ((forall a a' :e R :^: idx N, forall r r' :e R, ball N (a,r) c= cball N (a',r') <-> distance N (a,a') + r <= r' \/ r <= 0) /\ ((forall a a' :e R :^: idx N, forall r r' :e R, cball N (a,r) c= ball N (a',r') <-> distance N (a,a') + r < r' \/ r < 0) /\ forall a a' :e R :^: idx N, forall r r' :e R, cball N (a,r) c= cball N (a',r') <-> distance N (a,a') + r <= r' \/ r < 0))

items.name: SUBSET_CARD_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, finite t /\ s c= t -> (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t <-> s = t)

items.name: SUBSET_CARRIER_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, s c= group_carrier A G /\ s c= t -> s c= group_carrier A (subgroup_generated A G t)

items.name: SUBSET_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} c= {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e t i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} <-> {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i c= t i

items.name: SUBSET_CBALL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall d e0 :e R, d <= e0 -> cball A (x,d) c= cball A (x,e0)

items.name: SUBSET_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s c= t -> closure A s c= closure A t

items.name: SUBSET_COMPACT_HAUSDIST_LIMIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall n :e omega, t c= f n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, bounded_hl N (f n)) /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (hausdist N (f n,s))) (vec 1 0) sequentially))) -> t c= s

items.name: SUBSET_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE_SEGMENT_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, continuous_on_hl N 1 f (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (f a,f b) seq_nil) c= {f x | x :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}

items.name: SUBSET_CONVEX_HULL_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (frontier N s)

items.name: SUBSET_CONVEX_HULL_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s /\ ~ (exists a :e R :^: idx N, s = {a}) -> s c= hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} (relative_frontier N s)

items.name: SUBSET_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall s' c= A, forall t' c= B, s :*: t c= s' :*: t' <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ s c= s' /\ t c= t')

items.name: SUBSET_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall s t c= A, s c= t :\: {x} <-> ~ x :e s /\ s c= t

items.name: SUBSET_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\: t c= s

items.name: SUBSET_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} c= {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> s i c= t i

items.name: SUBSET_DISJOINT_UNION_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall u c= K :*: A, u c= {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} <-> exists t :e Power A :^: K, u = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> t i c= s i

items.name: SUBSET_DROP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, {drop x | x :e s} c= {drop x | x :e t} <-> s c= t

items.name: SUBSET_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s c= Empty <-> s = Empty

items.name: SUBSET_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space m) c= topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) <-> m <= n

items.name: SUBSET_FACE_OF_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, forall c c= R :^: idx N, simplex N n s /\ c c= {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x s} -> face_of N (hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} c) s

items.name: SUBSET_GROUP_ORBIT_CLOSED

items.name: SUBSET_GROUP_ORBIT_INVARIANT
