items.name: SUBSPACE_TRANSLATION_SELF_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, subspace N s -> ({vector_add N a x | x :e s} = s <-> a :e s)

items.name: SUBSPACE_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> subspace A {vec A 0}

items.name: SUBSPACE_UNION_CHAIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, subspace N s /\ (subspace N t /\ subspace N (s :\/: t)) -> s c= t \/ t c= s

items.name: SUBSPACE_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> subspace N (R :^: idx N)

items.name: SUBSPACE_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall t c= A, subspace B s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x :e s)) -> vsum A B t f :e s

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, forall k c= K, subtopology (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = product_topology A K k (fun i:set => subtopology A (tops i) (s i))

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, subtopology (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (s :*: t) = prod_topology A B (subtopology A top1 s) (subtopology B top2 t)

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, subtopology A (discrete_topology A u) s = discrete_topology A (u :/\: s)

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top /\ s :/\: derived_set_of A top s = Empty -> subtopology A top s = discrete_topology A s

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, top = discrete_topology A Empty <-> topspace A top = Empty

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, subtopology A top u = discrete_topology A u <-> u c= topspace A top /\ u :/\: derived_set_of A top u = Empty

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, t1_space A top /\ (s c= topspace A top /\ finite s) -> subtopology A top s = discrete_topology A s

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s :/\: derived_set_of A top s = Empty -> subtopology A top s = discrete_topology A (topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_GEN_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, t1_space A top /\ finite s -> subtopology A top s = discrete_topology A (topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_EQ_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, top = discrete_topology A {a} <-> topspace A top = {a}

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_EUCLIDEAN_EQ_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite s -> subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s = discrete_topology (R :^: idx N) s

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_KIFICATION_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> subtopology A (kification A top) k = subtopology A top k

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_KIFICATION_FINER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s u c= A, u :e subtopology A (kification A top) s -> u :e kification A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_MSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, subtopology A (mtopology A m) (mspace A m) = mtopology A m

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_NSPHERE_EQUATOR
items.statement: forall n :e omega, subtopology (R :^: omega) (nsphere (n + 1)) {x :e R :^: omega | x (n + 2) = 0} = nsphere n

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, subtopology A top s = subtopology A top (topspace A top :/\: s)

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, subtopology A (subtopology A top s) t = subtopology A top (s :/\: t)

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_SUM_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> forall s :e Power A :^: K, subtopology (K :*: A) (sum_topology A K k top) {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} = sum_topology A K k (fun i:set => subtopology A (top i) (s i))

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, topspace A top c= s -> subtopology A top s = top

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, subtopology A top (topspace A top) = top

items.name: SUBTOPOLOGY_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, subtopology A top A = top

items.name: SUBWOSET_ISO_INSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, woset_on A l /\ fld_on A l = A -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (l (f x) (f y) <-> l x y)) /\ forall x y :e A, y :e {f x | x :e s} /\ l x y -> x :e {f x | x :e s})

items.name: SUB_0
items.statement: forall m :e omega, minus_nat 0 m = 0 /\ minus_nat m 0 = m

items.name: SUB_ADD
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, n <= m -> minus_nat m n + n = m

items.name: SUB_ADD_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, minus_nat (m + n) (m + p) = minus_nat n p

items.name: SUB_ADD_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall m n p :e omega, minus_nat (m + p) (n + p) = minus_nat m n

items.name: SUB_ELIM_THM
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall a b :e omega, P (minus_nat a b) <-> forall d :e omega, a = b + d \/ a < b /\ d = 0 -> P d

items.name: SUB_ELIM_THM'
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall a b :e omega, P (minus_nat a b) <-> exists d :e omega, (a = b + d \/ a < b /\ d = 0) /\ P d

items.name: SUB_EQ_0
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, minus_nat m n = 0 <-> m <= n

items.name: SUB_PRESUC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, nat_pred (minus_nat (ordsucc m) n) = minus_nat m n

items.name: SUB_REFL
items.statement: forall n :e omega, minus_nat n n = 0

items.name: SUB_SUC
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, minus_nat (ordsucc m) (ordsucc n) = minus_nat m n

items.name: SUC_DEF
items.error: internal constant mk_num (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUC_INJ
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, ordsucc m = ordsucc n <-> m = n

items.name: SUC_SUB1
items.statement: forall n :e omega, minus_nat (ordsucc n) 1 = n

items.name: SUFFICIENT_ITERATED_SINGULAR_SUBDIVISION_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall u c= Power A, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), (forall v c= A, v :e u -> v :e top) /\ (topspace A top c= Union u /\ singular_chain A (p,top) c) -> exists n :e omega, forall m :e omega, forall f :e A :^: (R :^: omega), n <= m /\ f :e frag_support (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (iter_fun m (singular_subdivision A p) c) -> exists v c= A, v :e u /\ {f x | x :e standard_simplex p} c= v

items.name: SUMMABLE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, summable A s (fun n:set => vec A 0)

items.name: SUMMABLE_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, summable A s x /\ summable A s y -> summable A s (fun n:set => vector_add A (x n) (y n))

items.name: SUMMABLE_BILINEAR_LEFT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n p :e omega, bilinear N P M bop /\ (summable 1 (from m) (fun n0:set => lift (vector_norm M (x n0))) /\ summable N (from n) y) -> summable P (from p) (fun n0:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n0} (fun i:set => bop (x i) (y (minus_nat n0 i))))

items.name: SUMMABLE_BILINEAR_PARTIAL_PRE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall l :e R :^: idx P, forall k :e omega, bilinear N P M h /\ (tendsto P omega (fun n:set => h (f (n + 1)) (g n)) l sequentially /\ summable P (from k) (fun n:set => h (vector_sub M (f (n + 1)) (f n)) (g n))) -> summable P (from k) (fun n:set => h (f n) (vector_sub N (g n) (g (minus_nat n 1))))

items.name: SUMMABLE_BILINEAR_RIGHT
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n p :e omega, bilinear N P M bop /\ (summable M (from m) x /\ summable 1 (from n) (fun n0:set => lift (vector_norm N (y n0)))) -> summable P (from p) (fun n0:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n0} (fun i:set => bop (x i) (y (minus_nat n0 i))))

items.name: SUMMABLE_CAUCHY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, summable A s f <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall m n :e omega, N <= m -> vector_norm A (vsum omega A (s :/\: {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}) f) < e0

items.name: SUMMABLE_CMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c :e R, summable A s x -> summable A s (fun n:set => vector_mul A c (x n))

items.name: SUMMABLE_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall s c= omega, summable 1 s (fun x:set => lift (g x)) /\ (exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n /\ n :e s -> vector_norm A (f n) <= g n) -> summable A s f

items.name: SUMMABLE_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall k :e omega, summable N s f /\ (1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N) -> summable 1 s (fun i:set => lift (f i k))

items.name: SUMMABLE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall k c= omega, (forall x :e omega, x :e k -> f x = g x) /\ summable A k f -> summable A k g

items.name: SUMMABLE_EQ_COFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= omega, finite ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) /\ summable A s f -> summable A t f

items.name: SUMMABLE_EQ_EVENTUALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall k c= omega, (exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n /\ n :e k -> f n = g n) /\ summable A k f -> summable A k g

items.name: SUMMABLE_EVEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, summable N (from n) f <-> summable N (from (2 * n)) (fun i:set => if even_nat i then f (div_nat i 2) else vec N 0)

items.name: SUMMABLE_FINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k c= omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite k -> summable N k f

items.name: SUMMABLE_FROM_ELSEWHERE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, summable A (from m) f -> summable A (from n) f

items.name: SUMMABLE_FROM_ELSEWHERE_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n m :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (summable N (from m) f <-> summable N (from n) f)

items.name: SUMMABLE_IFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall k c= omega, (forall x :e omega, x :e k -> f x = g x) -> (summable A k f <-> summable A k g)

items.name: SUMMABLE_IFF_COFINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= omega, finite ((s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) -> (summable A s f <-> summable A t f)

items.name: SUMMABLE_IFF_EVENTUALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall k c= omega, (exists N :e omega, forall n :e omega, N <= n /\ n :e k -> f n = g n) -> (summable A k f <-> summable A k g)

items.name: SUMMABLE_IMP_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= omega, summable N k f -> bounded_hl N {f x | x :e k}

items.name: SUMMABLE_IMP_SUMS_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k :e omega, summable N (from k) f -> bounded_hl N {vsum omega N {i :e omega | k <= i /\ i <= n} f | n :e omega, n :e omega}

items.name: SUMMABLE_IMP_TOZERO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= omega, summable N k f -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => if n :e k then f n else vec N 0) (vec N 0) sequentially

items.name: SUMMABLE_LINEAR
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, h x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= omega, summable A s f /\ linear A B h -> summable B s (fun n:set => h (f n))

items.name: SUMMABLE_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, summable A s x -> summable A s (fun n:set => vector_neg A (x n))

items.name: SUMMABLE_ODD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, summable N (from n) f <-> summable N (from (2 * n + 1)) (fun i:set => if odd_nat i then f (div_nat i 2) else vec N 0)

items.name: SUMMABLE_RATIO
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, forall N0 :e omega, c < 1 /\ (forall n :e omega, N0 <= n -> vector_norm N (a (ordsucc n)) <= c * vector_norm N (a n)) -> summable N s a

items.name: SUMMABLE_REAL_GP
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall k c= omega, abs_SNo x < 1 -> summable 1 k (fun n:set => lift (x ^ n))

items.name: SUMMABLE_REARRANGE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, p x0 :e omega) -> summable 1 s (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm A (x n))) /\ permutes omega p s -> summable A s (fun x0:set => x (p x0))

items.name: SUMMABLE_REINDEX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall n :e omega, summable A (from n) (fun x:set => a (x + k)) <-> summable A (from (n + k)) a

items.name: SUMMABLE_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= omega, summable N omega (fun n:set => if n :e k then f n else vec N 0) <-> summable N k f

items.name: SUMMABLE_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, summable A s x /\ summable A s y -> summable A s (fun n:set => vector_sub A (x n) (y n))

items.name: SUMMABLE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= omega, s c= t /\ summable A t (fun i:set => if i :e s then x i else vec A 0) -> summable A s x

items.name: SUMMABLE_SUBSET_ABSCONV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= omega, summable 1 s (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm N (x n))) /\ t c= s -> summable 1 t (fun n:set => lift (vector_norm N (x n)))

items.name: SUMMABLE_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> summable N Empty f

items.name: SUMS_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, (forall n :e omega, n :e s -> f n = vec N 0) -> sums N f (vec N 0) s

items.name: SUMS_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ w :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N w z | z :e R :^: idx N, w :e (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) /\ z :e u}) = \/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x v | v :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ v :e \/_ y :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N y z | z :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ z :e u}}

items.name: SUMS_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall k c= omega, (forall x :e omega, x :e k -> f x = g x) /\ sums A f l k -> sums A g l k

items.name: SUMS_FINITE_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall t s c= omega, forall l :e R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ (finite t /\ sums N f l s) -> sums N f (vector_sub N l (vsum omega N t f)) (s :\: t)

items.name: SUMS_FINITE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= omega, forall l :e R :^: idx N, finite t /\ sums N f l s -> sums N f (vector_add N l (vsum omega N (t :\: s) f)) (s :\/: t)

items.name: SUMS_IFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall k c= omega, (forall x :e omega, x :e k -> f x = g x) -> (sums A f l k <-> sums A g l k)

items.name: SUMS_INFSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, sums A f (infsum A s f) s <-> summable A s f

items.name: SUMS_INTERVALS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty -> (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)}) = closed_interval N (seq_cons (vector_add N a c,vector_add N b d) seq_nil)) /\ forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty /\ ~ open_interval N (c,d) = Empty -> (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e open_interval N (a,b) /\ y :e open_interval N (c,d)}) = open_interval N (vector_add N a c,vector_add N b d)

items.name: SUMS_LIM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= omega, sums N f (lim N omega sequentially (fun n:set => vsum omega N (s :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) f)) s <-> summable N s f

items.name: SUMS_OFFSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall m n :e omega, sums N f l (from m) /\ (0 < n /\ m <= n) -> sums N f (vector_sub N l (vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f)) (from n)

items.name: SUMS_OFFSET_REV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall m n :e omega, sums N f l (from m) /\ (0 < m /\ n <= m) -> sums N f (vector_add N l (vsum omega N {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= minus_nat m 1} f)) (from n)

items.name: SUMS_REINDEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall n :e omega, sums N (fun x:set => a (x + k)) l (from n) <-> sums N a l (from (n + k))

items.name: SUMS_REINDEX_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= omega, sums N (fun x:set => a (x + k)) l s <-> sums N a l {i + k | i :e s}

items.name: SUMS_SUMMABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= omega, sums A f l s -> summable A s f

items.name: SUMS_SYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N x y | y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ y :e t}) = \/_ y :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N y x | x :e R :^: idx N, y :e t /\ x :e s}

items.name: SUM_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finsum s (fun n:set => 0) = 0

items.name: SUM_1
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> finsum (idx_n 1) f = f 1

items.name: SUM_2
items.statement: forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R) -> finsum (idx_n 2) t = t 1 + t 2

items.name: SUM_3
items.statement: forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R) -> finsum (idx_n 3) t = t 1 + t 2 + t 3

items.name: SUM_4
items.statement: forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R) -> finsum (idx_n 4) t = t 1 + t 2 + t 3 + t 4

items.name: SUM_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> abs_SNo (finsum s f) <= finsum s (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x))

items.name: SUM_ABS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> abs_SNo (f x) <= b) -> abs_SNo (finsum s f) <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: SUM_ABS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> abs_SNo (f x) <= g x) -> abs_SNo (finsum s f) <= finsum s g

items.name: SUM_ABS_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, abs_SNo (finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => abs_SNo (f i))

items.name: SUM_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + g x) = finsum s f + finsum s g

items.name: SUM_ADD_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 0} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = 0} -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + g x) = finsum s f + finsum s g

items.name: SUM_ADD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f i + g i) = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: SUM_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f

items.name: SUM_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ p y0 = y -> y0 = x) -> finsum s f = finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: SUM_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) -> finsum s f <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: SUM_BOUND_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b :/: finite_cardinality s)) -> finsum s f <= b

items.name: SUM_BOUND_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: SUM_BOUND_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < b)) -> finsum s f < finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: SUM_BOUND_LT_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < b :/: finite_cardinality s)) -> finsum s f < b

items.name: SUM_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) = finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f + finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ P x} g

items.name: SUM_CASES_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall y :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if x = a then y else f x) = finsum s f + y + - f a

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finsum Empty f = 0) /\ forall x :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e B, f x0 :e R) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> finsum (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then finsum s f else f x + finsum s f

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = f m + finsum {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> (forall m :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + f (ordsucc n) else finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> finsum {i :e omega | i <= 0} f = f 0 /\ forall k :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | i <= ordsucc k} f = finsum {i :e omega | i <= k} f + f (ordsucc k)

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG_LT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> finsum {i :e omega | i < 0} f = 0 /\ forall k :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | i < ordsucc k} f = finsum {i :e omega | i < k} f + f k

items.name: SUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f + f n

items.name: SUM_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, P 0 /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: SUM_CLOSED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ((forall x y :e R, P x /\ P y -> P (x + y)) /\ (forall a :e A, a :e s -> P (f a)))) -> P (finsum s f)

items.name: SUM_COMBINE_L
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n p :e omega, 0 < n /\ (m <= n /\ n <= p + 1) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f + finsum {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: SUM_COMBINE_R
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 /\ n <= p -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + finsum {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: SUM_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun n:set => c) = finite_cardinality s * c

items.name: SUM_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall c :e R, forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun n0:set => c) = minus_nat (n + 1) m * c

items.name: SUM_CONTENT_AREA_OVER_THIN_DIVISION
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, forall c :e R, division_of M d s /\ (s c= closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (a i <= c /\ (c <= b i /\ (forall k c= R :^: idx M, k :e d -> ~ k :/\: {x :e R :^: idx M | x i = c} = Empty)))))) -> (b i + - a i) * finsum d (fun k:set => content M k :/: (interval_upperbound M k i + - interval_lowerbound M k i)) <= 2 * content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: SUM_DEGENERATE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, ~ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = 0} -> finsum s f = 0

items.name: SUM_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> finsum (s :\: {a}) f = finsum s f + - f a

items.name: SUM_DELETE_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s -> finsum (s :\: {a}) f = if a :e s then finsum s f + - f a else finsum s f

items.name: SUM_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b :e R, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finsum s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else 0) = if a :e s then b else 0

items.name: SUM_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> finsum (s :\: t) f = finsum s f + - finsum t f

items.name: SUM_DIFFS
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f k + - f (k + 1)) = if m <= n then f m + - f (n + 1) else 0

items.name: SUM_DIFFS_ALT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f (k + 1) + - f k) = if m <= n then f (n + 1) + - f m else 0

items.name: SUM_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> finsum s f = finsum s g

items.name: SUM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0) -> finsum s f = 0

items.name: SUM_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = 0) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: SUM_EQ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ h x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ h y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ g (h x) = f x) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: SUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e A) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> k y :e s /\ h (k y) = y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ (k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: SUM_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i = g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: SUM_EQ_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = g x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ x :e t -> f x = 0))) -> finsum s f = finsum t g

items.name: SUM_GP
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => x ^ i) = if n < m then 0 else if x = 1 then minus_nat (n + 1) m else (x ^ m + - x ^ ordsucc n) :/: (1 + - x)

items.name: SUM_GP_BASIC
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall n :e omega, (1 + - x) * finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => x ^ i) = 1 + - x ^ ordsucc n

items.name: SUM_GP_MULTIPLIED
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> (1 + - x) * finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => x ^ i) = x ^ m + - x ^ ordsucc n

items.name: SUM_GP_OFFSET
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= m + n} (fun i:set => x ^ i) = if x = 1 then n + 1 else x ^ m * (1 + - x ^ ordsucc n) :/: (1 + - x)

items.name: SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g) = finsum s g

items.name: SUM_GROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> sum_group A K k G = subgroup_generated (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) {x :e A :^: K | finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ x i = group_id A (G i)}}

items.name: SUM_GROUP_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> (forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> group_carrier (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) = {x :e A :^: K | x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | x1 :e group_carrier A (G i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ x i = group_id A (G i)}}) /\ ((forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall x :e K, group_id (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) x = if x :e k then group_id A (G x) else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ ((forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall x :e A :^: K, forall x0 :e K, group_inv (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) x x0 = if x0 :e k then group_inv A (G x0) (x x0) else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall x y :e A :^: K, forall x0 :e K, group_mul (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) x y x0 = if x0 :e k then group_mul A (G x0) (x x0) (y x0) else choose_in A (fun y0:set => True)))

items.name: SUM_GROUP_EQ_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> finite k -> sum_group A K k G = product_group A K k G

items.name: SUM_GROUP_RELATION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 x y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 x y0 -> y0 = y) -> finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} g) = finsum s g

items.name: SUM_GROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> forall h :e Power A :^: K, (forall i :e K, i :e k -> subgroup_of A (h i) (G i)) -> sum_group A K k (fun i:set => subgroup_generated A (G i) (h i)) = subgroup_generated (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e h i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: SUM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> finsum {f x | x :e s} g = finsum s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: SUM_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s g = finsum {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)

items.name: SUM_IMAGE_LE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= g (f x)) -> finsum {f x | x :e s} g <= finsum s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: SUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e B, d x :e R) -> forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e A, i x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ i x = i y)) -> d (i x) = 0) -> finsum {i x | x :e s} d = finsum s (fun x:set => d (i x))

items.name: SUM_INCL_EXCL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum (s :\/: t) f + finsum (s :/\: t) f

items.name: SUM_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = finsum s f

items.name: SUM_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) -> finsum s f <= finsum s g

items.name: SUM_LE_INCLUDED
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e B, i x :e A) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> 0 <= g y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ (i y = x /\ f x <= g y)))) -> finsum s f <= finsum t g

items.name: SUM_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall i :e omega, m <= i /\ i <= n -> f i <= g i) -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: SUM_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => c * f x) = c * finsum s f

items.name: SUM_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= g x) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: SUM_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x < g x)) -> finsum s f < finsum s g

items.name: SUM_MULTICOUNT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k :e omega, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = k * finite_cardinality t

items.name: SUM_MULTICOUNT_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e omega) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall j :e B, j :e t -> finite_cardinality {i :e A | i :e s /\ R0 i j} = k j)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finite_cardinality {j :e B | j :e t /\ R0 i j}) = finsum t k

items.name: SUM_MUL_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R) -> forall b:set -> set, (forall x :e A, b x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> 0 <= a i /\ 0 <= b i) -> finsum s (fun i:set => a i * b i) <= finsum s a * finsum s b

items.name: SUM_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => - f x) = - finsum s f

items.name: SUM_OFFSET
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: SUM_OFFSET_0
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => f (i + m))

items.name: SUM_OVER_PERMUTATIONS_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: A, f x :e R) -> forall a :e A, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ~ a :e s -> finsum {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) (SetAdjoin s a)} f = finsum (SetAdjoin s a) (fun b:set => finsum {p :e A :^: A | permutes A (fun x:set => p x) s} (fun q:set => f (fun x :e A => swap A (a,b) (q x))))

items.name: SUM_OVER_PERMUTATIONS_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega :^: omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> finsum {p :e omega :^: omega | permutes omega (fun x:set => p x) {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => finsum {p :e omega :^: omega | permutes omega (fun x:set => p x) {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n}} (fun q:set => f (fun x :e omega => swap omega (m,i) (q x))))

items.name: SUM_OVER_TAGGED_DIVISION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), d x :e R) -> forall p c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall i c= R :^: idx N, tagged_division_of N p i /\ (forall u v :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) = Empty /\ content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) = 0 -> d (closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) = 0) -> finsum p (fun p0:set => d (p0 1)) = finsum {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e x 1} | x :e p} d

items.name: SUM_OVER_TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), d x :e R) -> forall p c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall i c= R :^: idx N, tagged_partial_division_of N p i /\ (forall u v :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) = Empty /\ content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) = 0 -> d (closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) = 0) -> finsum p (fun p0:set => d (p0 1)) = finsum {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e x 1} | x :e p} d

items.name: SUM_PAIR
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (2 * i) + f (2 * i + 1))

items.name: SUM_PARTIAL_PRE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f k * (g k + - g (minus_nat k 1))) = if m <= n then (f (n + 1) * g n + - f m * g (minus_nat m 1)) + - finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => g k * (f (k + 1) + - f k)) else 0

items.name: SUM_PARTIAL_SUC
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => f k * (g (k + 1) + - g k)) = if m <= n then (f (n + 1) * g (n + 1) + - f m * g m) + - finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => g (k + 1) * (f (k + 1) + - f k)) else 0

items.name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_COMPOSE_L
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega :^: omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, q x :e omega) -> permutes omega q {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} -> finsum {p :e omega :^: omega | permutes omega (fun x:set => p x) {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}} f = finsum {p :e omega :^: omega | permutes omega (fun x:set => p x) {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}} (fun p:set => f (fun x :e omega => q (p x)))

items.name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_COMPOSE_R
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega :^: omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, q x :e omega) -> permutes omega q {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} -> finsum {p :e omega :^: omega | permutes omega (fun x:set => p x) {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}} f = finsum {p :e omega :^: omega | permutes omega (fun x:set => p x) {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}} (fun p:set => f (fun x :e omega => p (q x)))

items.name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_INVERSE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega :^: omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {p :e omega :^: omega | permutes omega (fun x:set => p x) {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}} f = finsum {p :e omega :^: omega | permutes omega (fun x:set => p x) {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n}} (fun p:set => f (fun x :e omega => inverse omega omega (fun x0:set => p x0) x))

items.name: SUM_PERMUTE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, permutes A p s -> finsum s f = finsum s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: SUM_PERMUTE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, permutes omega p {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: SUM_POS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall b :e R, forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) /\ finsum s f <= b) -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= b

items.name: SUM_POS_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) /\ finsum s f = 0) -> forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = 0

items.name: SUM_POS_EQ_0_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall p :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n -> 0 <= f p) /\ finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0 -> forall p :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n -> f p = 0

items.name: SUM_POS_LE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) -> 0 <= finsum s f

items.name: SUM_POS_LE_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> (forall p :e omega, m <= p /\ p <= n -> 0 <= f p) -> 0 <= finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: SUM_POS_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> 0 <= f x) /\ (exists x :e A, x :e s /\ 0 < f x)) -> 0 < finsum s f

items.name: SUM_POS_LT_ALL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> 0 < f i)) -> 0 < finsum s f

items.name: SUM_REFLECT
items.statement: forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then 0 else finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: SUM_RELATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, R0 0 0 /\ ((forall m n m' n' :e R, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: SUM_RELATED_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, (forall m n m' n' :e R, R0 m n /\ R0 m' n' -> R0 (m + m') (n + n')) /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> R0 (f x) (g x)))) -> R0 (finsum s f) (finsum s g)

items.name: SUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else 0) = finsum s f

items.name: SUM_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f = finsum s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else 0)

items.name: SUM_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, finsum s (fun x:set => f x * c) = finsum s f * c

items.name: SUM_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall x :e A, finsum {x} f = f x

items.name: SUM_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: SUM_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> finsum s (fun x:set => f x + - g x) = finsum s f + - finsum s g

items.name: SUM_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finite u /\ (finite v /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e u :\: v -> f x <= 0) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v :\: u -> 0 <= f x))) -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: SUM_SUBSET_SIMPLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u v c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> finite v /\ (u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v :\: u -> 0 <= f x)) -> finsum u f <= finsum v f

items.name: SUM_SUB_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f i + - g i) = finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f + - finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: SUM_SUM_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x x y :e R) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> finite (t i)) -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum (t i) (x i)) = finsum (\/_ i :e A, {(i,j) | j :e B, i :e s /\ j :e t i}) (fun p:set => x (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: SUM_SUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun x:set => finsum {y :e B | y :e t /\ R0 x y} (f x)) = finsum t (fun y:set => finsum {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} (fun x:set => f x y))

items.name: SUM_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum v f = finsum u f

items.name: SUM_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finsum {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} f = finsum s f

items.name: SUM_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> finsum s (fun i:set => finsum t (f i)) = finsum t (fun j:set => finsum s (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: SUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall a b c d :e omega, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, f x y :e R) -> finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (f i)) = finsum {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (fun j:set => finsum {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: SUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall m n :e omega, n < m -> finsum {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = 0

items.name: SUM_TWOTHIRDS
items.statement: forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => 2 :/: 3 ^ (k + 1)) = 1 + - (1 :/: 3) ^ (n + 1)

items.name: SUM_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: SUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t) /\ (forall t1 t2 c= A, forall x :e A, t1 :e s /\ (t2 :e s /\ (~ t1 = t2 /\ (x :e t1 /\ x :e t2))) -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (Union s) f = finsum s (fun t:set => finsum t f)

items.name: SUM_UNION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t u c= A, finite u /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ s :\/: t = u) -> finsum s f + finsum t f = finsum u f

items.name: SUM_UNION_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall u v c= A, finite v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e u /\ ~ x :e v -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum v f

items.name: SUM_UNION_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t -> f x = 0)) -> finsum (s :\/: t) f = finsum s f + finsum t f

items.name: SUM_UNION_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall u v c= A, finite u /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = 0) -> finsum (u :\/: v) f = finsum u f

items.name: SUM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b)} c= s -> finsum s f = finsum A f

items.name: SUM_VSUM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finsum s f = drop (vsum A 1 s (fun x:set => lift (f x)))

items.name: SUM_ZERO_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall u:set -> set, (forall x :e A, u x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ finsum s u = 0 -> (forall i :e A, i :e s -> u i = 0) \/ exists j k :e A, j :e s /\ (u j < 0 /\ (k :e s /\ 0 < u k))

items.name: SUP
items.statement: forall s c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= sup s) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> sup s <= b

items.error: internal constant superadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_CLOSED_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (closed N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ z :e s)) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, dot N a z < b /\ (y :e s /\ (dot N a y = b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b <= dot N a x))

items.name: SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_COMPACT_POINT_INF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a c :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists b :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ (dot N a (vector_sub N y c) = b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> b <= dot N a (vector_sub N x c))

items.name: SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_COMPACT_POINT_SUP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a c :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists b :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s /\ (dot N a (vector_sub N y c) = b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> dot N a (vector_sub N x c) <= b)

items.name: SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ x :e frontier N s -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e closure N s -> dot N a x <= dot N a y

items.name: SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall z :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ~ z :e s) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, exists b :e R, exists y :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ (dot N a z <= b /\ (y :e closure N s /\ (dot N a y = b /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closure N s -> b <= dot N a x)))

items.name: SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_RELATIVE_BOUNDARY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (x :e s /\ ~ x :e relative_interior N s) -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e s -> dot N a x <= dot N a y) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e relative_interior N s -> dot N a x < dot N a y)

items.name: SUPPORTING_HYPERPLANE_RELATIVE_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ x :e relative_frontier N s -> exists a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e closure N s -> dot N a x <= dot N a y) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e relative_interior N s -> dot N a x < dot N a y)

items.name: SUPPORT_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e C, op x y :e C) -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> {x :e Empty | f x <> neutral_of C op} = Empty) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A, forall s c= A, {x0 :e SetAdjoin s x | f x0 <> neutral_of C op} = if f x = neutral_of C op then {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} else SetAdjoin {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} x) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall x :e A, forall s c= A, {x0 :e s :\: {x} | f x0 <> neutral_of C op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} :\: {x}) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall s t c= A, {x :e s :\/: t | f x <> neutral_of C op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} :\/: {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of C op}) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall s t c= A, {x :e s :/\: t | f x <> neutral_of C op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} :/\: {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of C op}) /\ ((forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e C) -> forall s t c= A, {x :e s :\: t | f x <> neutral_of C op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of C op} :\: {x :e t | f x <> neutral_of C op}) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall s c= A, {x :e {f x | x :e s} | g x <> neutral_of C op} = {f x | x :e {x :e s | g (f x) <> neutral_of C op}})))))

items.name: SUPPORT_DELTA
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall a :e A, {x :e s | (if x = a then f x else neutral_of B op) <> neutral_of B op} = if a :e s then {x :e {a} | f x <> neutral_of B op} else Empty

items.name: SUPPORT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = neutral_of B op) <-> {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} = Empty

items.name: SUPPORT_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} c= s

items.name: SUPPORT_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, {x :e {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} | f x <> neutral_of B op} = {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op}

items.name: SUP_APPROACH
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall c :e R, ~ s = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ c < sup s) -> exists x :e R, x :e s /\ c < x

items.name: SUP_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: idx 1, sup {drop x | x :e closure 1 s} = sup {drop x | x :e s}

items.name: SUP_EQ
items.statement: forall s t c= R, (forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) <-> forall x :e R, x :e t -> x <= b) -> sup s = sup t

items.name: SUP_EXISTS
items.statement: forall s c= R, (exists l :e R, is_lub s l) <-> ~ s = Empty /\ exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b

items.name: SUP_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> sup s :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= sup s

items.name: SUP_FINITE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists b :e R, b :e s /\ forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b

items.name: SUP_INSERT
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall s c= R, bounded_hl 1 {lift x0 | x0 :e s} -> sup (SetAdjoin s x) = if s = Empty then x else if x <= sup s then sup s else x

items.name: SUP_INSERT_FINITE
items.statement: forall x :e R, forall s c= R, finite s -> sup (SetAdjoin s x) = if s = Empty then x else if x <= sup s then sup s else x

items.name: SUP_INSERT_INSERT
items.statement: forall a b :e R, forall s c= R, sup (SetAdjoin (SetAdjoin s a) b) = sup (SetAdjoin s (if a <= b then b else a))

items.name: SUP_METRIC_CARTESIAN_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e K, m x :e metric A) -> forall m' :e metric (A :^: K), ({f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x0 :e A | {x0 :e A | x0 :e mspace A (m i)} x0}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)},fun p :e A :^: K :*: A :^: K => sup {mdist A (m i) (p 0 i,p 1 i) | i :e K, i :e k}) = m' /\ (~ k = Empty /\ (exists c :e R, forall i :e K, forall x y :e A, i :e k /\ (x :e mspace A (m i) /\ y :e mspace A (m i)) -> mdist A (m i) (x,y) <= c)) -> mspace (A :^: K) m' = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x0 :e A | {x0 :e A | x0 :e mspace A (m i)} x0}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ ((forall x :e A :^: K :*: A :^: K, mdist (A :^: K) m' x = sup {mdist A (m i) (x 0 i,x 1 i) | i :e K, i :e k}) /\ forall x y :e A :^: K, forall b :e R, x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | {x1 :e A | x1 :e mspace A (m i)} x1}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ y :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | {x1 :e A | x1 :e mspace A (m i)} x1}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} -> (mdist (A :^: K) m' (x,y) <= b <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> mdist A (m i) (x i,y i) <= b))

items.name: SUP_SING
items.statement: forall a :e R, sup {a} = a

items.name: SUP_UNION
items.statement: forall s t c= R, ~ s = Empty /\ (~ t = Empty /\ ((exists b :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) /\ (exists c :e R, forall x :e R, x :e t -> x <= c))) -> sup (s :\/: t) = if sup s <= sup t then sup t else sup s

items.name: SUP_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, (forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= c) <-> b <= c) -> sup s = b

items.name: SUP_UNIQUE_FINITE
items.statement: forall a :e R, forall s c= R, finite s /\ ~ s = Empty -> (sup s = a <-> a :e s /\ forall y :e R, y :e s -> y <= a)

items.name: SURA_BURA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (c :e components N s /\ compact N c) -> c = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {k :e Power (R :^: idx N) | c c= k /\ (compact N k /\ k :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s)}, x :e Y}

items.name: SURA_BURA_CLOPEN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c u c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (c :e components N s /\ (compact N c /\ (open N u /\ c c= u))) -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (compact N k /\ (c c= k /\ k c= u))

items.name: SURA_BURA_CLOPEN_SUBSET_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c u c= R :^: idx N, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s /\ (c :e components N s /\ (compact N c /\ (u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ c c= u))) -> exists k c= R :^: idx N, k :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (compact N k /\ (c c= k /\ k c= u))

items.name: SURA_BURA_COMPACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ c :e components N s -> c = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {t :e Power (R :^: idx N) | c c= t /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) t)}, x :e Y}

items.name: SURJ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall x :e s, f x :e t) /\ (forall y :e t, exists x :e s, f x = y) <-> (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x :e B, x :e t -> exists y :e A, y :e s /\ f y = x)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_EMBEDDING_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (embedding_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' <-> homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P (f x)) <-> exists y :e B, P y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, P (f x)) <-> forall y :e B, P y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= s -> ((forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> finite s /\ (finite t /\ (finite_cardinality s = finite_cardinality t /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t)) -> ((forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall t:set -> prop, exists s c= A, forall x :e B, x :e {f x | x :e s} <-> t x) <-> forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, f x = y) /\ (forall x :e A, f x :e t <-> x :e s) -> {f x | x :e s} = t

items.name: SURJECTIVE_IMAGE_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall P:set -> prop, {f x | x :e {x :e A | P (f x)}} = {x :e B | P x})

items.name: SURJECTIVE_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> ((forall y :e A, exists x :e B, f x = y) <-> forall y :e A, f (inverse A B f y) = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_INVERSE_o
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> forall x :e B, f (inverse B A f x) = x)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall m :e finseq B, exists l :e finseq A, seq_map f l = m) <-> forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_ON_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall u c= A, forall v c= B, (forall t c= B, t c= v -> exists s c= A, s c= u /\ {f x | x :e s} = t) <-> forall y :e B, y :e v -> exists x :e A, x :e u /\ f x = y

items.name: SURJECTIVE_ON_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall u c= B, (forall k c= A, k c= s -> exists t c= B, t c= u /\ {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x :e t} = k) <-> {f x | x :e s} c= u /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y

items.name: SURJECTIVE_ON_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall t c= B, (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> g y :e s /\ f (g y) = y

items.name: SURJECTIVE_PREIMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall k:set -> prop, exists t c= B, forall x :e A, x :e {x0 :e A | f x0 :e t} <-> k x) <-> forall x y :e A, f x = f y -> x = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_RETRACTION_OR_SECTION_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' -> (retraction_map A B (top,top') f \/ section_map A B (top,top') f <-> retraction_map A B (top,top') f)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_RIGHT_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> ((forall y :e B, exists x :e A, f x = y) <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ forall y :e B, f (g y) = y)

items.name: SURJECTIVE_SCALING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx N, vector_mul N c x = y) <-> ~ c = 0

items.name: SURJECTIVE_SECTION_EQ_HOMEOMORPHIC_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (section_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' <-> homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f)

items.name: SUSLIN_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, forall s c= A, s :e C -> s :e suslin A C

items.name: SUSLIN_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, forall s t c= A, s :e suslin A C /\ t :e suslin A C -> s :/\: t :e suslin A C

items.name: SUSLIN_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C f c= Power A, countable f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e f -> s :e suslin A C)) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} :e suslin A C

items.name: SUSLIN_LEBESGUE_MEASURABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x c= R :^: idx N, x :e suslin (R :^: idx N) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx N) | lebesgue_measurable N x0} <-> lebesgue_measurable N x

items.name: SUSLIN_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C D c= Power A, forall s c= A, (forall t c= A, t :e C -> t :e D) /\ s :e suslin A C -> s :e suslin A D

items.name: SUSLIN_REGULAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, (forall c c= Power A, finite c /\ (~ c = Empty /\ c c= u) -> {x :e A | forall Y :e c, x :e Y} :e u) -> suslin A u = {suslin_operation A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e f x) | f :e Power A :^: finseq omega, (forall l :e finseq omega, ~ l = seq_nil -> f l :e u) /\ forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e omega) -> forall m n :e omega, 1 <= m /\ m <= n -> f (seq_mk n s) c= f (seq_mk m s)}

items.name: SUSLIN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C D c= Power A, C c= D -> suslin A C c= suslin A D

items.name: SUSLIN_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, u c= suslin A u

items.name: SUSLIN_SUSLIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, suslin A (suslin A u) = suslin A u

items.name: SUSLIN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C c= Power A, forall s t c= A, s :e suslin A C /\ t :e suslin A C -> s :\/: t :e suslin A C

items.name: SUSLIN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall C f c= Power A, countable f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s c= A, s :e f -> s :e suslin A C)) -> Union f :e suslin A C

items.name: SUSSMANN_OPEN_MAPPING
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g' x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, open M s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (x :e s /\ (has_derivative N M f f' (at M x) /\ (linear N M g' /\ (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f' (g' x0) = x0))))) -> forall t c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ x :e interior M t -> f x :e interior N {f x | x :e t}

items.name: SWAPSEQ_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall m :e omega, forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) -> swapseq A n p /\ swapseq A m q -> swapseq A (n + m) (fun x:set => p (q x))

items.name: SWAPSEQ_ENDSWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall n :e omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall a b :e A, swapseq A n p /\ ~ a = b -> swapseq A (ordsucc n) (fun x:set => p (swap A (a,b) x))

items.name: SWAPSEQ_EVEN_EVEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m n :e omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> swapseq A m p /\ swapseq A n p -> (even_nat m <-> even_nat n)

items.name: SWAPSEQ_I
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> swapseq A 0 (fun x:set => x)

items.name: SWAPSEQ_IDENTITY_EVEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, swapseq A n (fun x:set => x) -> even_nat n

items.name: SWAPSEQ_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> swapseq A n p -> swapseq A n (fun x:set => inverse A A p x)

items.name: SWAPSEQ_INVERSE_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> swapseq A n p -> exists q:set -> set, (forall x :e A, q x :e A) /\ (swapseq A n q /\ ((forall x :e A, p (q x) = x) /\ forall x :e A, q (p x) = x))

items.name: SWAPSEQ_SWAP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, swapseq A (if a = b then 0 else 1) (fun x:set => swap A (a,b) x)

items.name: SWAP_COMMON
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c :e A, ~ a = c /\ ~ b = c -> forall x :e A, swap A (a,b) (swap A (a,c) x) = swap A (b,c) (swap A (a,b) x)

items.name: SWAP_COMMON'
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c :e A, ~ a = b /\ ~ a = c -> forall x :e A, swap A (a,c) (swap A (b,c) x) = swap A (b,c) (swap A (a,b) x)

items.name: SWAP_CONJUGATE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, forall a b :e A, permutes A p s -> forall x :e A, p (swap A (a,b) (inverse A A p x)) = swap A (p a,p b) x

items.name: SWAP_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y) <-> exists y :e B, exists x :e A, P x y

items.name: SWAP_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y) <-> forall y :e B, forall x :e A, P x y

items.name: SWAP_GALOIS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b x y :e A, x = swap A (a,b) y <-> y = swap A (a,b) x

items.name: SWAP_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c d :e A, ~ a = b /\ ~ c = d -> (forall x :e A, swap A (a,b) (swap A (c,d) x) = x) \/ exists x y z :e A, ~ x = a /\ (~ y = a /\ (~ z = a /\ (~ x = y /\ forall x0 :e A, swap A (a,b) (swap A (c,d) x0) = swap A (x,y) (swap A (a,z) x0))))

items.name: SWAP_IDEMPOTENT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b x :e A, swap A (a,b) (swap A (a,b) x) = x

items.name: SWAP_INDEPENDENT
