items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c d :e A, ~ a = c /\ (~ a = d /\ (~ b = c /\ ~ b = d)) -> forall x :e A, swap A (a,b) (swap A (c,d) x) = swap A (c,d) (swap A (a,b) x)

items.name: SWAP_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, swap A (a,b) a = b

items.name: SWAP_OTHER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b x :e A, ~ x = a /\ ~ x = b -> swap A (a,b) x = x

items.name: SWAP_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a x :e A, swap A (a,a) x = x

items.name: SWAP_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, swap A (a,b) b = a

items.name: SWAP_SYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b x :e A, swap A (a,b) x = swap A (b,a) x

items.name: SWAP_TRIPLE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c :e A, ~ a = b /\ (~ b = c /\ ~ a = c) -> forall x :e A, swap A (a,b) (swap A (b,c) (swap A (a,b) x)) = swap A (a,c) x

items.name: SWAP_TRIPLE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a x y :e A, ~ a = x /\ (~ a = y /\ ~ x = y) -> forall x0 :e A, swap A (a,x) (swap A (a,y) (swap A (a,x) x0)) = swap A (x,y) x0

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ divides_nat (p ^ k) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))) -> exists h c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_CONJUGATE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h h' c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ (finite_cardinality h = p ^ k /\ (subgroup_of A h' G /\ finite_cardinality h' = p ^ k))))) -> group_conjugate A G h h'

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_CONJUGATE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h h' c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (~ divides_nat (p ^ (k + 1)) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ (finite_cardinality h = p ^ k /\ (subgroup_of A h' G /\ finite_cardinality h' = p ^ k))))) -> group_conjugate A G h h'

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_CONJUGATE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h h' c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k))) -> (subgroup_of A h' G /\ finite_cardinality h' = p ^ k <-> group_conjugate A G h h')

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_CONJUGATE_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h j c= A, prime_nat p /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ (finite {left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} /\ (~ divides_nat p (finite_cardinality {left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G}) /\ (subgroup_of A j G /\ (finite j /\ finite_cardinality j = p ^ k))))) -> exists a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ j c= {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e h}

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_CONJUGATE_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k l :e omega, forall h j c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (~ divides_nat (p ^ (k + 1)) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ (finite_cardinality h = p ^ k /\ (subgroup_of A j G /\ finite_cardinality j = p ^ l))))) -> exists a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ j c= {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e h}

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_COUNT_DIVISOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k) -> divides_nat (finite_cardinality {h :e Power A | subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k}) (div_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) (p ^ k))

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_COUNT_MOD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ divides_nat (p ^ k) (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G))) -> exists q1 q2 :e omega, finite_cardinality {h :e Power A | subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k} + p * q1 = 1 + p * q2

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_COUNT_NORMALIZER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall p k :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k))) -> finite_cardinality {h0 :e Power A | subgroup_of A h0 G /\ finite_cardinality h0 = p ^ k} = div_nat (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) (finite_cardinality (group_normalizer A G h))

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_COUNT_NORMALIZER_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall p k :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k))) -> finite_cardinality {h0 :e Power A | subgroup_of A h0 G /\ finite_cardinality h0 = p ^ k} * finite_cardinality (group_normalizer A G h) = finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_NORMAL_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h h' c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k /\ (normal_subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k))) -> (subgroup_of A h' G /\ finite_cardinality h' = p ^ k <-> h' = h)

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_NORMAL_UNIQUE_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k))) -> ((forall h' c= A, subgroup_of A h' G /\ finite_cardinality h' = p ^ k <-> h' = h) <-> normal_subgroup_of A h G)

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_PGROUP_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, forall h c= A, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ (subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k)) -> exists h' c= A, subgroup_of A h' G /\ (h c= h' /\ finite_cardinality h' = p ^ prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)))

items.name: SYLOW_THEOREM_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall p k :e omega, finite (group_carrier A G) /\ (prime_nat p /\ prime_index p (finite_cardinality (group_carrier A G)) = k) -> ((exists h c= A, subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k /\ forall y c= A, subgroup_of A y G /\ finite_cardinality y = p ^ k -> y = h) <-> exists h c= A, normal_subgroup_of A h G /\ finite_cardinality h = p ^ k)

items.name: SYLVESTER_DETERMINANT_IDENTITY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, det M (matrix_add M M (mat M M 1) (matrix_mul M N M A B)) = det N (matrix_add N N (mat N N 1) (matrix_mul N M N B A))

items.name: SYMDIFF_PARITY_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t u c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s) = u) -> (even_nat (finite_cardinality u) <-> (even_nat (finite_cardinality s) <-> even_nat (finite_cardinality t)))

items.name: SYMMETRIC_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_neg N x :e s) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e closure N s -> vector_neg N x :e closure N s

items.name: SYMMETRIC_IMP_NORMAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A -> normal_matrix_hl N A

items.name: SYMMETRIC_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_neg N x :e s) -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e interior N s -> vector_neg N x :e interior N s

items.name: SYMMETRIC_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> vector_neg A x :e s) /\ linear A B f -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e {f x | x :e s} -> vector_neg B x :e {f x | x :e s}

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A <-> forall x :e R :^: idx N, adjoint N N (fun x0:set => matrix_vector_mul N N A x0) x = matrix_vector_mul N N A x

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ symmetric_matrix_hl N B -> symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_add N N A B)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_CMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A -> symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_cmul N N c A)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_COVARIANCE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_mul N M N (transp M N A) A)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_DIAGONALIZABLE_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A -> exists P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, exists d:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, d x :e R) /\ (orthogonal_matrix_hl N P /\ matrix_mul N N N (transp N N P) (matrix_mul N N N A P) = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => if i = j then d i else 0)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_EQ_DIAGONALIZABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A <-> exists P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P /\ diagonal_matrix_hl N N (matrix_mul N N N (transp N N P) (matrix_mul N N N A P))

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_EQ_DIAGONALIZABLE_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A <-> exists P D :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P /\ (diagonal_matrix_hl N N D /\ A = matrix_mul N N N (transp N N P) (matrix_mul N N N D P))

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_IMP_DIAGONALIZABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A -> exists P :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N P /\ diagonal_matrix_hl N N (matrix_mul N N N (transp N N P) (matrix_mul N N N A P))

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_inv N N A) <-> symmetric_matrix_hl N A

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_INV_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl M (matrix_mul M N M (matrix_inv M N A) A)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_INV_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_mul N M N A (matrix_inv M N A))

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_MAT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, symmetric_matrix_hl A (mat A A n)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_MUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ symmetric_matrix_hl N B -> (symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_mul N N N A B) <-> matrix_mul N N N A B = matrix_mul N N N B A)

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_neg N N A) <-> symmetric_matrix_hl N A

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_ORTHOGONAL_EIGENVECTORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, forall v w :e R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ (matrix_vector_mul N N A v = vector_mul N a v /\ (matrix_vector_mul N N A w = vector_mul N b w /\ ~ a = b)) -> orthogonal N v w

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_SIMILAR
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A0 :e R :^: idx A :^: idx N, forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N B -> symmetric_matrix_hl A (matrix_mul A N A (transp N A A0) (matrix_mul N N A B A0))

items.name: SYMMETRIC_MATRIX_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ symmetric_matrix_hl N B -> symmetric_matrix_hl N (matrix_sub N N A B)

items.name: SYMMETRY_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall a b c d :e A, P a b c d -> P a b d c) /\ (forall a b c d :e A, ~ a = b /\ (~ c = d /\ (a = c /\ b = d \/ (a = c /\ ~ b = d \/ (~ a = c /\ b = d \/ ~ a = c /\ (~ a = d /\ (~ b = c /\ ~ b = d)))))) -> P a b c d) -> forall a b c d :e A, ~ a = b /\ ~ c = d -> P a b c d

items.name: T0_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t0_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ x = y) -> exists c c= A, closed_in A top c /\ ~ (x :e c <-> y :e c)

items.name: T0_SPACE_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t0_space (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) <-> t0_space A top

items.name: T0_SPACE_CLOSURE_OF_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t0_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ closure_of A top {x} = closure_of A top {y}) -> x = y

items.name: T0_SPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, t0_space A (discrete_topology A s)

items.name: T0_SPACE_EXPANSIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, topspace A top' = topspace A top /\ (forall u c= A, u :e top -> u :e top') -> t0_space A top -> t0_space A top'

items.name: T0_SPACE_KOLMOGOROV_QUOTIENT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t0_space A (subtopology A top {kolmogorov_quotient A top x | x :e topspace A top})

items.name: T0_SPACE_ONE_POINT_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, compact_space A top /\ topspace A top :\: {a} :e top -> (t0_space A top <-> t0_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})))

items.name: T0_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, t0_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> t0_space A (tops i)

items.name: T0_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, t0_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ t0_space A top1 /\ t0_space B top2

items.name: T0_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ t0_space A top -> t0_space B top'

items.name: T0_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, t0_space A top -> t0_space A (subtopology A top u)

items.name: T1_EQ_SYMMETRIC_T0_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> t0_space A top /\ forall x y :e A, x :e closure_of A top {y} <-> y :e closure_of A top {x}

items.name: T1_EQ_SYMMETRIC_T0_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> t0_space A top /\ forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (x :e closure_of A top {y} <-> y :e closure_of A top {x})

items.name: T1_IMP_T0_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top -> t0_space A top

items.name: T1_OR_HAUSDORFF_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top \/ hausdorff_space A top <-> t1_space A top

items.name: T1_SPACE_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) <-> t1_space A top

items.name: T1_SPACE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ x = y) -> exists u c= A, closed_in A top u /\ (x :e u /\ ~ y :e u)

items.name: T1_SPACE_CLOSED_IN_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall s c= A, finite s /\ s c= topspace A top -> closed_in A top s

items.name: T1_SPACE_CLOSED_IN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> closed_in A top {x}

items.name: T1_SPACE_CLOSED_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ ({f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ t1_space A top) -> t1_space B top'

items.name: T1_SPACE_DERIVED_SET_OF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall s c= A, finite s -> derived_set_of A top s = Empty

items.name: T1_SPACE_DERIVED_SET_OF_INFINITE_OPEN_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall s c= A, derived_set_of A top s = {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ forall u c= A, x :e u /\ u :e top -> infinite (s :/\: u)}

items.name: T1_SPACE_DERIVED_SET_OF_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> derived_set_of A top {x} = Empty

items.name: T1_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> t1_space (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A)

items.name: T1_SPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: t1_space R euclideanreal

items.name: T1_SPACE_EXPANSIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, topspace A top' = topspace A top /\ (forall u c= A, u :e top -> u :e top') -> t1_space A top -> t1_space A top'

items.name: T1_SPACE_INTERS_OPEN_SUPERSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> {x :e A | forall Y :e {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ s c= u}, x :e Y} = s

items.name: T1_SPACE_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, t1_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: T1_SPACE_ONE_POINT_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, topspace A top :\: {a} :e top /\ (forall k c= A, compact_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) k /\ closed_in A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})) k -> closed_in A top k) -> (t1_space A top <-> t1_space A (subtopology A top (topspace A top :\: {a})))

items.name: T1_SPACE_OPEN_IN_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall u c= A, forall x :e A, u :e top /\ x :e u -> u :\: {x} :e top

items.name: T1_SPACE_OPEN_IN_DELETE_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall u c= A, forall x :e A, u :e top -> u :\: {x} :e top

items.name: T1_SPACE_PERFECT_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> t1_space A top /\ perfect_map A B (top,top') f -> t1_space B top'

items.name: T1_SPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, t1_space (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) <-> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> t1_space A (tops i)

items.name: T1_SPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, t1_space (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) <-> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ t1_space A top1 /\ t1_space B top2

items.name: T1_SPACE_RETRACTION_MAP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ t1_space A top -> t1_space B top'

items.name: T1_SPACE_SEPARATED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ x = y) -> separated_in A top {x} {y}

items.name: T1_SPACE_SING_INTERS_OPEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> {x0 :e A | forall Y :e {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ x :e u}, x0 :e Y} = {x}

items.name: T1_SPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, t1_space A top -> t1_space A (subtopology A top u)

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_FINER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall d :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: (R :^: idx N), tagged_division_of N p (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ gauge N (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e d x) -> exists q c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), tagged_division_of N q (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (fine (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e d x) q /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall k c= R :^: idx N, (x,k) :e p /\ k c= d x -> (x,k) :e q)

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF

var_views.s: subset(R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A))

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, tagged_division_of A s i <-> finite s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall k c= R :^: idx A, (x,k) :e s -> x :e k /\ (k c= i /\ exists a b :e R :^: idx A, k = closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ ((forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall k1 c= R :^: idx A, forall x2 :e R :^: idx A, forall k2 c= R :^: idx A, (x1,k1) :e s /\ ((x2,k2) :e s /\ ~ (x1,k1) = (x2,k2)) -> interior A k1 :/\: interior A k2 = Empty) /\ Union {k :e Power (R :^: idx A) | exists x :e R :^: idx A, (x,k) :e s} = i))

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, tagged_division_of A p s <-> tagged_partial_division_of A p s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> exists t :e R :^: idx A, exists k c= R :^: idx A, (t,k) :e p /\ x :e k

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF_ANOTHER
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall s s' c= R :^: idx A, tagged_partial_division_of A p s' /\ ((forall t :e R :^: idx A, forall k c= R :^: idx A, (t,k) :e p -> k c= s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> exists t :e R :^: idx A, exists k c= R :^: idx A, (t,k) :e p /\ x :e k)) -> tagged_division_of A p s

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> tagged_division_of A Empty Empty

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, tagged_division_of A s i -> finite s

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF_NONTRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall a b :e R :^: idx N, tagged_division_of N s (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ~ content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> tagged_division_of N (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {(x,k) | k :e Power (R :^: idx N), (x,k) :e s /\ ~ content N k = 0}) (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x a b :e R :^: idx A, x :e closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> tagged_division_of A {(x,closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))} (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), tagged_division_of A p Empty <-> p = Empty

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF_UNION_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, tagged_division_of A p s -> tagged_division_of A p (Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e x 1} | x :e p})

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_SPLIT_LEFT_INJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall i c= R :^: idx N, forall x1 :e R :^: idx N, forall k1 c= R :^: idx N, forall x2 :e R :^: idx N, forall k2 c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, forall c :e R, tagged_division_of N d i /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ ((x1,k1) :e d /\ ((x2,k2) :e d /\ (~ k1 = k2 /\ k1 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c} = k2 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}))))) -> content N (k1 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}) = 0

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_SPLIT_RIGHT_INJ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall d c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall i c= R :^: idx N, forall x1 :e R :^: idx N, forall k1 c= R :^: idx N, forall x2 :e R :^: idx N, forall k2 c= R :^: idx N, forall k :e omega, forall c :e R, tagged_division_of N d i /\ (1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ ((x1,k1) :e d /\ ((x2,k2) :e d /\ (~ k1 = k2 /\ k1 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k} = k2 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k}))))) -> content N (k1 :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k}) = 0

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s1 s2 c= R :^: idx N, forall p1 p2 c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), tagged_division_of N p1 s1 /\ (tagged_division_of N p2 s2 /\ interior N s1 :/\: interior N s2 = Empty) -> tagged_division_of N (p1 :\/: p2) (s1 :\/: s2)

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_UNIONS
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall iset c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall pfn :e Power (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) :^: Power (R :^: idx M), finite iset /\ ((forall i c= R :^: idx M, i :e iset -> tagged_division_of M (pfn i) i) /\ (forall i1 i2 c= R :^: idx M, i1 :e iset /\ (i2 :e iset /\ ~ i1 = i2) -> interior M i1 :/\: interior M i2 = Empty)) -> tagged_division_of M (Union {pfn x | x :e iset}) (Union iset)

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_UNIONS_EXISTS
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set -> prop, forall iset c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall i c= R :^: idx M, finite iset /\ ((forall i0 c= R :^: idx M, i0 :e iset -> exists p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_division_of M p i0 /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p) /\ ((forall i1 i2 c= R :^: idx M, i1 :e iset /\ (i2 :e iset /\ ~ i1 = i2) -> interior M i1 :/\: interior M i2 = Empty) /\ Union iset = i)) -> exists p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), tagged_division_of M p i /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_UNION_IMAGE_SND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, tagged_division_of A p s -> s = Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e x 1} | x :e p}

items.name: TAGGED_DIVISION_UNION_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall p1 p2 c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall c :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ (k <= dimindex N /\ (tagged_division_of N p1 (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c}) /\ tagged_division_of N p2 (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k}))) -> tagged_division_of N (p1 :\/: p2) (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION_COMMON_POINT_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall y :e R :^: idx N, tagged_partial_division_of N p s -> finite_cardinality (\/_ x :e R :^: idx N, {(x,k) | k :e Power (R :^: idx N), (x,k) :e p /\ (y :e k /\ ~ content N k = 0)}) <= 2 ^ dimindex N

items.name: TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION_COMMON_TAGS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx N :*: Power (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, tagged_partial_division_of N p s -> finite_cardinality {(x,k) | k :e Power (R :^: idx N), (x,k) :e p /\ ~ content N k = 0} <= 2 ^ dimindex N

items.name: TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall s t c= R :^: idx A, tagged_partial_division_of A p s /\ s c= t -> tagged_partial_division_of A p t

items.name: TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION_OF_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), tagged_partial_division_of A p Empty <-> p = Empty

items.name: TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION_OF_UNION_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, tagged_partial_division_of A p s -> tagged_division_of A p (Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | x0 :e x 1} | x :e p})

items.name: TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, tagged_partial_division_of A s i /\ t c= s -> tagged_partial_division_of A t i

items.name: TAG_IN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall i k c= R :^: idx A, tagged_division_of A p i /\ (x,k) :e p -> x :e i

items.name: TARSKI_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e Power A :^: Power A, (forall s t c= A, s c= t -> f s c= f t) -> exists s c= A, f s = s

items.name: TENDSTO_ALT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall net0 :e net A, tendsto N A f l net0 <-> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ l :e s -> eventually A {x :e A | f x :e s} net0

items.name: TENDSTO_ALT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx N, l :e u /\ eventually A {x :e A | f x :e u} net0 -> (tendsto N A f l net0 <-> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u /\ l :e s -> eventually A {x :e A | f x :e s} net0)

items.name: TENDSTO_LIM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall l :e R :^: idx B, ~ trivial_limit A net0 /\ tendsto B A f l net0 -> lim B A net0 f = l

items.name: TENDSTO_REAL_EPS_DELTA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, forall net0 :e net A, tendsto_real A f l net0 <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | abs_SNo (f x + - l) < e0} net0

items.name: THIN_FRONTIER_CIC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N (frontier N s) = Empty <-> closure N (interior N (closure N s)) = closure N (interior N s)

items.name: THIN_FRONTIER_ICI
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N (frontier N s) = Empty <-> interior N (closure N (interior N s)) = interior N (closure N s)

items.name: THIN_FRONTIER_OF_CIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (frontier_of A top s) = Empty <-> closure_of A top (interior_of A top (closure_of A top s)) = closure_of A top (interior_of A top s)

items.name: THIN_FRONTIER_OF_ICI
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (frontier_of A top s) = Empty <-> interior_of A top (closure_of A top (interior_of A top s)) = interior_of A top (closure_of A top s)

items.name: THIN_FRONTIER_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top (frontier_of A top s) = Empty <-> interior_of A top (closure_of A top s) c= closure_of A top (interior_of A top s)

items.name: THIN_FRONTIER_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, interior N (frontier N s) = Empty <-> interior N (closure N s) c= closure N (interior N s)

items.name: THREE_CYCLE_AS_COMMUTATOR
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c d e0 :e A, ~ a = b /\ (~ a = c /\ (~ a = d /\ (~ a = e0 /\ (~ b = c /\ (~ b = d /\ (~ b = e0 /\ (~ c = d /\ (~ c = e0 /\ ~ d = e0)))))))) -> forall x :e A, three_cycle A a b c x = three_cycle A d c a (three_cycle A c b e0 (three_cycle A d a c (three_cycle A c e0 b x)))

items.name: THREE_CYCLE_COMMUTATOR
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c d e0 :e A, ~ a = b /\ (~ a = c /\ (~ a = d /\ (~ a = e0 /\ (~ b = c /\ (~ b = d /\ (~ b = e0 /\ (~ c = d /\ (~ c = e0 /\ ~ d = e0)))))))) -> forall x :e A, three_cycle A a b c x = inverse A A (fun x1:set => three_cycle A d a c x1) (inverse A A (fun x1:set => three_cycle A c e0 b x1) (three_cycle A d a c (three_cycle A c e0 b x)))

items.name: THREE_CYCLE_COMPOSE_REVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c :e A, ~ a = b /\ (~ b = c /\ ~ a = c) -> (forall x :e A, three_cycle A a b c (three_cycle A a c b x) = x) /\ forall x :e A, three_cycle A a c b (three_cycle A a b c x) = x

items.name: THREE_CYCLE_INVERSE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c :e A, ~ a = b /\ (~ b = c /\ ~ a = c) -> forall x :e A, inverse A A (fun x0:set => three_cycle A a b c x0) x = three_cycle A a c b x

items.name: THREE_CYCLE_NOT_I
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b c :e A, ~ a = b /\ (~ b = c /\ ~ a = c) -> ~ forall x :e A, three_cycle A a b c x = x

items.name: TIETZE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx M, forall B :e R, 0 <= B /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= B))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e u -> vector_norm N (g x) <= B))

items.name: TIETZE_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx M, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e u -> g x :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: TIETZE_CLOSED_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop b /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (continuous_on_hl N 1 f s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ (continuous_on_hl N 1 g u /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> g x = f x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u -> g x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))

items.name: TIETZE_EXTENSION_CLOSED_REAL_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall a b :e R, normal_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (a <= b /\ (continuous_map A R (subtopology A top s,euclideanreal) f /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) g /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> g x :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x))

items.name: TIETZE_EXTENSION_COMPLETELY_REGULAR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= R, completely_regular_space A top /\ (compact_in A top s /\ (is_realinterval t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (continuous_map A R (subtopology A top s,euclideanreal) f /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t))))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) g /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> g x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x))

items.name: TIETZE_EXTENSION_REALINTERVAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= R, normal_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (is_realinterval t /\ (~ t = Empty /\ (continuous_map A R (subtopology A top s,euclideanreal) f /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t))))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) g /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> g x :e t) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x))

items.name: TIETZE_OPEN_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx M, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x :e open_interval N (a,b)))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e u -> g x :e open_interval N (a,b)))

items.name: TIETZE_OPEN_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a < drop b /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (continuous_on_hl N 1 f s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x :e open_interval 1 (a,b)))) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx 1) /\ (continuous_on_hl N 1 g u /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> g x = f x) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u -> g x :e open_interval 1 (a,b)))

items.name: TIETZE_UNBOUNDED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u s c= R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) u) s /\ continuous_on_hl M N f s -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N g u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: TINY_INDUCTIVE_DIMENSION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | compact N x} s -> (dimension N s <= n <-> (s = Empty -> - 1 <= n) /\ (~ s = Empty -> 0 <= n /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> exists b c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) b /\ (dimension N b <= n + - 1 /\ exists u v c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (u :/\: v = Empty /\ (u :\/: v = s :\: b /\ (x :e u /\ y :e v)))))))

items.name: TL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_tl (seq_cons h t) = t

items.name: TOEPLITZ_BILINEAR_SERIES
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, a x y :e R :^: idx M) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m r :e omega, forall l :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e R :^: idx M, forall b :e R, bilinear N P M bop /\ (tendsto N omega x l sequentially /\ ((forall p :e omega, tendsto M omega (fun n:set => a n p) (vec M 0) sequentially) /\ (tendsto M omega (fun n:set => vsum omega M {i :e omega | r <= i /\ i <= n} (a n)) i sequentially /\ (forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i0:set => vector_norm M (a n i0)) <= b)))) -> tendsto P omega (fun n:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i0:set => bop (a n i0) (x i0))) (bop i l) sequentially

items.name: TOEPLITZ_BILINEAR_SERIES_NULL
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall bop:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, bop x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, a x y :e R :^: idx M) -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m :e omega, forall b :e R, bilinear N P M bop /\ (tendsto N omega x (vec N 0) sequentially /\ ((forall p :e omega, tendsto M omega (fun n:set => a n p) (vec M 0) sequentially) /\ (forall n :e omega, finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => vector_norm M (a n i)) <= b))) -> tendsto P omega (fun n:set => vsum omega P {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => bop (a n i) (x i))) (vec P 0) sequentially

items.name: TOPCONTINUOUS_AT_ATPOINTOF
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, topcontinuous_at A B top top' f x <-> x :e topspace A top /\ ((forall x0 :e A, x0 :e topspace A top -> f x0 :e topspace B top') /\ limit A B top' f (f x) (atpointof A top x))

items.name: TOPOLOGICAL_PROPERTY_OF_PRODUCT_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, (forall z :e A :^: K, forall i :e K, z :e topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) /\ (P (product_topology A K k tops) /\ i :e k) -> P (subtopology (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) {f :e A :^: K | (forall i0 :e k, f i0 :e {x0 :e A | (i0 = i -> x0 :e topspace A (tops i)) /\ (~ i0 = i -> x0 :e {z i0})}) /\ forall i0 :e K, ~ i0 :e k -> f i0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)})) /\ (forall top :e topology (A :^: K), forall top' :e topology A, homeomorphic_space (A :^: K) A top top' -> (P top <-> Q top')) -> P (product_topology A K k tops) -> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K k tops) = Empty \/ forall i :e K, i :e k -> Q (tops i)

items.name: TOPOLOGICAL_PROPERTY_OF_PROD_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P Q R0:set -> prop, forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, (forall a :e A, a :e topspace A top1 /\ P (prod_topology A B top1 top2) -> P (subtopology (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) ({a} :*: topspace B top2))) /\ ((forall b :e B, b :e topspace B top2 /\ P (prod_topology A B top1 top2) -> P (subtopology (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) (topspace A top1 :*: {b}))) /\ ((forall top :e topology (A :*: B), forall top' :e topology A, homeomorphic_space (A :*: B) A top top' -> (P top <-> Q top')) /\ (forall top :e topology (A :*: B), forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space (A :*: B) B top top' -> (P top <-> R0 top')))) -> P (prod_topology A B top1 top2) -> topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = Empty \/ Q top1 /\ R0 top2

items.name: TOPOLOGICAL_PROPERTY_OF_SUM_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall k c= K, (forall top :e topology (K :*: A), forall s c= K :*: A, P top /\ (closed_in (K :*: A) top s /\ s :e top) -> P (subtopology (K :*: A) top s)) /\ (forall top :e topology (K :*: A), forall top' :e topology A, homeomorphic_space (K :*: A) A top top' -> (P top <-> Q top')) -> P (sum_topology A K k tops) -> forall i :e K, i :e k -> Q (tops i)

items.name: TOPOLOGICAL_SORT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, lt x y /\ lt y x -> x = y) /\ (forall x y z :e A, lt x y /\ lt y z -> lt x z) -> forall n :e omega, forall s c= A, equip s n -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) /\ (s = {f x | x :e idx_n n} /\ forall j k :e omega, j :e idx_n n /\ (k :e idx_n n /\ j < k) -> ~ lt (f k) (f j))

items.name: TOPOLOGY_BASES_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall u c= A, forall x :e A, P u /\ x :e u -> exists v c= A, Q v /\ (x :e v /\ v c= u)) /\ (forall v c= A, forall x :e A, Q v /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, P u /\ (x :e u /\ u c= v)) -> {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x} = {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = x}

items.name: TOPOLOGY_BASE_UNIQUE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall P:set -> prop, (forall s c= A, P s -> s :e top) /\ (forall u c= A, forall x :e A, u :e top /\ x :e u -> exists b c= A, P b /\ (x :e b /\ b c= u)) -> {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, True /\ (forall c :e u, P c) /\ Union u = x} = top

items.name: TOPOLOGY_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top1 top2 :e topology A, top1 = top2 <-> forall s c= A, s :e top1 <-> s :e top2

items.name: TOPOLOGY_EQ_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top1 top2 :e topology A, top1 = top2 <-> forall s c= A, closed_in A top1 s <-> closed_in A top2 s

items.name: TOPOLOGY_FINER_CLOSED_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, (forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> closed_in A top' s) <-> closed_map A A (top,top') (fun x:set => x)

items.name: TOPOLOGY_FINER_CLOSED_IN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, topspace A top' = topspace A top -> ((forall s c= A, s :e top -> s :e top') <-> forall s c= A, closed_in A top s -> closed_in A top' s)

items.name: TOPOLOGY_FINER_CONTINUOUS_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, topspace A top' = topspace A top -> ((forall s c= A, s :e top -> s :e top') <-> continuous_map A A (top',top) (fun x:set => x))

items.name: TOPOLOGY_FINER_OPEN_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, (forall s c= A, s :e top -> s :e top') <-> open_map A A (top,top') (fun x:set => x)

items.name: TOPOLOGY_FINER_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top top' :e topology A, forall u c= A, (forall s c= A, s :e top -> s :e top') -> forall s c= A, s :e subtopology A top u -> s :e subtopology A top' u

items.name: TOPSPACE_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) = SetAdjoin {Inj0 x | x :e topspace A top} (Inj1 0)

items.name: TOPSPACE_ALEXANDROFF_COMPACTIFICATION_DELETE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace (A :+: 1) (alexandroff_compactification A top) :\: {Inj1 0} = {Inj0 x | x :e topspace A top}

items.name: TOPSPACE_CANTOR_SPACE
items.statement: topspace (Power omega) cantor_space = Power omega

items.name: TOPSPACE_DISCRETE_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, topspace A (discrete_topology A u) = u

items.name: TOPSPACE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> topspace (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) = R :^: idx N

items.name: TOPSPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL
items.statement: topspace R euclideanreal = R

items.name: TOPSPACE_EUCLIDEANREAL_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall s c= R, topspace R (subtopology R euclideanreal s) = s

items.name: TOPSPACE_EUCLIDEAN_SPACE
items.statement: forall n :e omega, topspace (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space n) = {x :e R :^: omega | forall i :e omega, ~ i :e idx_n n -> x i = 0}

items.name: TOPSPACE_EUCLIDEAN_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, topspace (R :^: idx A) (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) = s

items.name: TOPSPACE_KIFICATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A (kification A top) = topspace A top

items.name: TOPSPACE_MTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, topspace A (mtopology A m) = mspace A m

items.name: TOPSPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall t c= K, topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K t tops) = {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e t, f i :e {x0 :e A | {x0 :e A | x0 :e topspace A (tops i)} x0}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e t -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)}

items.name: TOPSPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_ALT
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> forall t c= K, topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K t tops) = {x :e A :^: K | (forall x0 :e K, ~ x0 :e t -> x x0 = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall k :e K, k :e t -> x k :e topspace A (tops k)}

items.name: TOPSPACE_PRODUCT_TOPOLOGY_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> topspace (A :^: K) (product_topology A K Empty tops) = {fun k :e K => choose_in A (fun x:set => True)}

items.name: TOPSPACE_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, topspace (A :*: B) (prod_topology A B top1 top2) = topspace A top1 :*: topspace B top2

items.name: TOPSPACE_STANDARD_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall p :e omega, topspace (R :^: omega) (subtopology (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) (standard_simplex p)) = standard_simplex p

items.name: TOPSPACE_SUBBASE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall B:set -> prop, forall u c= A, topspace A {x :e Power A | exists u0 c= Power A, True /\ (forall x0 :e u0, x0 :e relative_to A {x01 :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, finite u /\ (forall c :e u, B c) /\ {x :e A | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} u) /\ Union u0 = x} = u

items.name: TOPSPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, topspace A (subtopology A top u) = topspace A top :/\: u

items.name: TOPSPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY_IS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, topspace A (subtopology A top s) c= s

items.name: TOPSPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> topspace A (subtopology A top s) = s

items.name: TOPSPACE_SUM_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> topspace (K :*: A) (sum_topology A K k top) = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e {x0 :e A | {x0 :e A | x0 :e topspace A (top (p 0))} x0}}

items.name: TORSION_ABELIAN_GROUP_AS_SUM_OF_PGROUPS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G -> ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0) <-> exists H:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, H x :e group_hl A) /\ ((forall p :e omega, prime_nat p -> pgroup A {p} (H p)) /\ isomorphic_group A (A :^: omega) G (sum_group A omega {p :e omega | prime_nat p} H)))

items.name: TORSION_ABELIAN_GROUP_STRUCTURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, abelian_group_hl A G /\ (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0) -> isomorphic_group A (A :^: omega) G (sum_group A omega {p :e omega | prime_nat p} (fun p:set => subgroup_generated A G {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ exists k :e omega, group_element_order_hl A G x = p ^ k}))

items.name: TORSION_FREE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_element_order_hl A G x <= 1) <-> forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ x = group_id A G -> group_element_order_hl A G x = 0

items.name: TORSION_FREE_GROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, (forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> group_element_order_hl A G x <= 1) <-> forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, x :e group_carrier A G /\ group_pow A G x n = group_id A G -> x = group_id A G \/ n = 0

items.name: TORSION_FREE_QUOTIENT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl (Power A), abelian_group_hl A G /\ quotient_group A G {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ ~ group_element_order_hl A G x = 0} = H -> forall x c= A, x :e group_carrier (Power A) H -> group_element_order_hl (Power A) H x <= 1

items.name: TOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l <-> (forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ ((forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x)

items.name: TOSET_COFINAL_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l -> exists w:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, w x y -> l x y) /\ (woset_on A w /\ forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> exists y :e A, y :e fld_on A w /\ l x y)

items.name: TOSET_IMP_POSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l -> poset_on A l

items.name: TOSET_IMP_QOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l -> qoset_on A l

items.name: TOSET_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, toset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> l x a

items.name: TOSET_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, toset_on A l /\ (finite s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ s c= fld_on A l)) -> exists a :e A, a :e s /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> l a x

items.name: TOSET_POSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l <-> poset_on A l /\ forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x

items.name: TOSET_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, toset_on A l -> toset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => P x /\ (P y /\ l x y))

items.name: TOSET_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> toset_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => False)

items.name: TOSET_num
items.statement: toset_on omega (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x <= x0)

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_HAUSDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, bounded_hl N s /\ 0 < e0 -> exists k c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite k /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e k -> ~ u = Empty /\ u c= s) /\ forall t c= R :^: idx N, t c= s /\ ~ t = Empty -> exists u c= R :^: idx N, u :e k /\ hausdist N (t,u) < e0)

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IMP_DISCRETE_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, forall d :e R, totally_bounded_in A m s /\ (t c= s /\ (0 < d /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e t /\ (y :e t /\ ~ x = y) -> d <= mdist A m (x,y)))) -> finite t

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_ABSOLUTE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, totally_bounded_in A (submetric A m s) s <-> totally_bounded_in A m s

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f /\ totally_bounded_in A m1 s -> totally_bounded_in B m2 {f x | x :e s}

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_CAUCHY_SEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> cauchy_in A m x -> totally_bounded_in A m {x x0 | x0 :e omega}

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, totally_bounded_in A m s -> totally_bounded_in A m (closure_of A (mtopology A m) s)

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_CLOSURE_OF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, s c= mspace A m -> (totally_bounded_in A m (closure_of A (mtopology A m) s) <-> totally_bounded_in A m s)

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_CROSS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= A, forall t c= B, totally_bounded_in (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) (s :*: t) <-> s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ totally_bounded_in A m1 s /\ totally_bounded_in B m2 t)

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_DISCRETE_METRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u s c= A, totally_bounded_in A (discrete_metric A u) s <-> finite s /\ s c= u

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, totally_bounded_in A m Empty

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_EQ_COMPACT_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, mcomplete A m -> (totally_bounded_in A m s <-> s c= mspace A m /\ compact_in A (mtopology A m) (closure_of A (mtopology A m) s))

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_IMP_MBOUNDED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, totally_bounded_in A m s -> mbounded A m s

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_IMP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, totally_bounded_in A m s -> s c= mspace A m

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_PROD_METRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall u c= A :*: B, totally_bounded_in (A :*: B) (prod_metric A B m1 m2) u <-> totally_bounded_in A m1 {x 0 | x :e u} /\ totally_bounded_in B m2 {x 1 | x :e u}

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, totally_bounded_in A m s <-> s c= mspace A m /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> exists r:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, r x0 :e omega) /\ ((forall m0 n :e omega, m0 < n -> r m0 < r n) /\ cauchy_in A m (fun x0:set => x (r x0)))

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_SING
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, totally_bounded_in A m {x} <-> x :e mspace A m

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, totally_bounded_in A m s /\ s c= t -> totally_bounded_in A (submetric A m t) s

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, totally_bounded_in A m s /\ t c= s -> totally_bounded_in A m t

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s t c= A, totally_bounded_in A m s /\ totally_bounded_in A m t -> totally_bounded_in A m (s :\/: t)

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_IN_UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f c= Power A, finite f /\ (forall s c= A, s :e f -> totally_bounded_in A m s) -> totally_bounded_in A m (Union f)

items.name: TOTALLY_BOUNDED_ULC_SPACE_IMP_FCCOVERABLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, totally_bounded_in A m (mspace A m) /\ ulc_space A m -> fccoverable_space A m

items.name: TRACE_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> trace A (mat A A 0) = 0

items.name: TRACE_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, trace N (matrix_add N N A B) = trace N A + trace N B

items.name: TRACE_CMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, trace N (matrix_cmul N N c A) = c * trace N A

items.name: TRACE_COVARIANCE_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) B) <= (if 0 <= trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A))) * if 0 <= trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M B) B) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M B) B)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M B) B))

items.name: TRACE_COVARIANCE_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_ABS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, abs_SNo (trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) B)) <= (if 0 <= trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A))) * if 0 <= trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M B) B) then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M B) B)) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M B) B))

items.name: TRACE_COVARIANCE_CAUCHY_SCHWARZ_SQUARE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) B) ^ 2 <= trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) * trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M B) B)

items.name: TRACE_COVARIANCE_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) = 0 <-> A = mat N M 0

items.name: TRACE_COVARIANCE_POSITIVE_SEMIDEFINITE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A -> trace N (matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) A) <= trace N A ^ 2

items.name: TRACE_COVARIANCE_POS_LE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, 0 <= trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A)

items.name: TRACE_COVARIANCE_POS_LT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, 0 < trace M (matrix_mul M N M (transp N M A) A) <-> ~ A = mat N M 0

items.name: TRACE_I
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> trace N (mat N N 1) = dimindex N

items.name: TRACE_LE_MUL_SQUARES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ symmetric_matrix_hl N B -> trace N (matrix_mul N N N (matrix_mul N N N A B) (matrix_mul N N N A B)) <= trace N (matrix_mul N N N (matrix_mul N N N A A) (matrix_mul N N N B B))

items.name: TRACE_MATRIX_INV_LMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, trace N (matrix_mul N M N (matrix_inv N M A) A) = rank N M A

items.name: TRACE_MATRIX_INV_RMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, trace M (matrix_mul M N M A (matrix_inv N M A)) = rank N M A

items.name: TRACE_MUL_CYCLIC
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx P :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx P, forall C :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, trace M (matrix_mul M P M A (matrix_mul P N M B C)) = trace P (matrix_mul P N P B (matrix_mul N M P C A))

items.name: TRACE_MUL_POSITIVE_DEFINITE_SEMIDEFINITE_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_definite N A /\ positive_semidefinite N B -> (trace N (matrix_mul N N N A B) = 0 <-> B = mat N N 0)

items.name: TRACE_MUL_POSITIVE_SEMIDEFINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A /\ positive_semidefinite N B -> 0 <= trace N (matrix_mul N N N A B)

items.name: TRACE_MUL_POSITIVE_SEMIDEFINITE_DEFINITE_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A /\ positive_definite N B -> (trace N (matrix_mul N N N A B) = 0 <-> A = mat N N 0)

items.name: TRACE_MUL_POSITIVE_SEMIDEFINITE_EQ_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A /\ positive_semidefinite N B -> (trace N (matrix_mul N N N A B) = 0 <-> matrix_mul N N N A B = mat N N 0)

items.name: TRACE_MUL_POSITIVE_SEMIDEFINITE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A /\ positive_semidefinite N B -> trace N (matrix_mul N N N A B) <= trace N A * trace N B

items.name: TRACE_MUL_SYM
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, trace N (matrix_mul N M N A B) = trace M (matrix_mul M N M B A)

items.name: TRACE_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, trace N (matrix_neg N N A) = - trace N A

items.name: TRACE_POSITIVE_DEFINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_definite N A -> 0 < trace N A

items.name: TRACE_POSITIVE_SEMIDEFINITE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A -> 0 <= trace N A

items.name: TRACE_SIMILAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A U :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, invertible N N U -> trace N (matrix_mul N N N (matrix_inv N N U) (matrix_mul N N N A U)) = trace N A

items.name: TRACE_SQUARE_POSITIVE_SEMIDEFINITE_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A -> trace N (matrix_mul N N N A A) <= trace N A ^ 2

items.name: TRACE_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, trace N (matrix_sub N N A B) = trace N A + - trace N B

items.name: TRACE_TRANSP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, trace N (transp N N A) = trace N A

items.name: TRANSITIVE_STEPWISE_LE
items.statement: forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e omega, R0 x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e omega, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ (forall n :e omega, R0 n (ordsucc n))) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> R0 m n

items.name: TRANSITIVE_STEPWISE_LE_EQ
items.statement: forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e omega, R0 x x) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) -> ((forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> R0 m n) <-> forall n :e omega, R0 n (ordsucc n))

items.name: TRANSITIVE_STEPWISE_LT
items.statement: forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e omega, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) /\ (forall n :e omega, R0 n (ordsucc n)) -> forall m n :e omega, m < n -> R0 m n

items.name: TRANSITIVE_STEPWISE_LT_EQ
items.statement: forall R0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e omega, R0 x y /\ R0 y z -> R0 x z) -> ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> R0 m n) <-> forall n :e omega, R0 n (ordsucc n))

items.name: TRANSLATION_DIFF
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s t c= R :^: idx N, {vector_add N a x | x :e s :\: t} = {vector_add N a x | x :e s} :\: {vector_add N a x | x :e t}

items.name: TRANSLATION_EQ_IMP
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, P {vector_add N a x | x :e s} <-> P s) <-> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, P s -> P {vector_add N a x | x :e s}

items.name: TRANSLATION_GALOIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, s = {vector_add N a x | x :e t} <-> t = {vector_add N (vector_neg N a) x | x :e s}

items.name: TRANSLATION_SUBSET_GALOIS_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N a x | x :e s} c= t <-> s c= {vector_add N (vector_neg N a) x | x :e t}

items.name: TRANSLATION_SUBSET_GALOIS_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, s c= {vector_add N a x | x :e t} <-> {vector_add N (vector_neg N a) x | x :e s} c= t

items.name: TRANSLATION_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, {vector_add N a x | x :e R :^: idx N} = R :^: idx N

items.name: TRANSP_COLUMNVECTOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx A, transp A 1 (columnvector A v) = rowvector A v

items.name: TRANSP_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i j :e omega, transp M N A i j = A j i

items.name: TRANSP_DIAGONAL_MATRIX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, diagonal_matrix_hl N N A -> transp N N A = A

items.name: TRANSP_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, transp N M A = transp N M B <-> A = B

items.name: TRANSP_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N A = mat N M 0 <-> A = mat M N 0

items.name: TRANSP_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M m) x = matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M m) y -> x = y) <-> {matrix_vector_mul N M m x | x :e R :^: idx M} = R :^: idx N

items.name: TRANSP_MAT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, transp A B (mat A B n) = mat B A n

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N (matrix_add M N A B) = matrix_add N M (transp M N A) (transp M N B)

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall c :e R, transp N M (matrix_cmul N M c A) = matrix_cmul M N c (transp N M A)

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_INV
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, transp M N (matrix_inv M N A) = matrix_inv N M (transp N M A)

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_NEG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N (matrix_neg M N A) = matrix_neg N M (transp M N A)

items.name: TRANSP_MATRIX_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N (matrix_sub M N A B) = matrix_sub N M (transp M N A) (transp M N B)

items.name: TRANSP_ROWVECTOR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx A, transp 1 A (rowvector A v) = columnvector A v

items.name: TRANSP_SURJECTIVE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, {matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M m) x | x :e R :^: idx N} = R :^: idx M <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M m x = matrix_vector_mul N M m y -> x = y

items.name: TRANSP_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp N M (transp M N A) = A

items.error: internal constant treal_eq (HOL Light internal construction)

items.error: internal constant treal_eq (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: TREAL_OF_NUM_LE
items.error: internal constant treal_le (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: TREAL_OF_NUM_MUL
items.error: internal constant treal_eq (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: TREAL_OF_NUM_WELLDEF
items.error: internal constant treal_eq (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: TRIANGULAR_SUBDIVISION_OF_CELL_COMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall d :e int, finite m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> polytope N c) /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> aff_dim N c = d) /\ (forall c1 c2 c= R :^: idx N, c1 :e m /\ c2 :e m -> face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c1 /\ face_of N (c1 :/\: c2) c2))) -> exists t c= Power (R :^: idx N), triangulation N t /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> aff_dim N k = d) /\ (Union t = Union m /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m -> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx N), finite f /\ (f c= t /\ c = Union f)) /\ forall k c= R :^: idx N, k :e t -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e m /\ k c= c)))

items.name: TRIANGULATION_DISJOINT_RELATIVE_INTERIORS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall c d c= R :^: idx N, triangulation N t /\ (c :e t /\ (d :e t /\ ~ c = d)) -> relative_interior N c :/\: relative_interior N d = Empty

items.name: TRIANGULATION_INTER_SIMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall tr c= Power (R :^: idx N), forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, triangulation N tr /\ (t :e tr /\ t' :e tr) -> t :/\: t' = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} ({x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x t} :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | extreme_point_of N x t'})

items.name: TRIANGULATION_LINEAR_IMAGE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall tr c= Power (R :^: idx M), linear M N f /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f x = f y -> x = y) /\ (forall y :e R :^: idx N, exists x :e R :^: idx M, f x = y)) -> (triangulation N {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {f x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e tr} <-> triangulation M tr)

items.name: TRIANGULATION_SIMPLEX_FACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n d :e int, simplex N n s -> triangulation N {c :e Power (R :^: idx N) | face_of N c s /\ aff_dim N c = d}

items.name: TRIANGULATION_SIMPLEX_FACETS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall n :e int, simplex N n s -> triangulation N {c :e Power (R :^: idx N) | facet_of N c s}

items.name: TRIANGULATION_SIMPLICIAL_COMPLEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall tr c= Power (R :^: idx N), triangulation N tr -> simplicial_complex N {f :e Power (R :^: idx N) | exists t c= R :^: idx N, t :e tr /\ face_of N f t}

items.name: TRIANGULATION_SUBFACES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall tr tr' c= Power (R :^: idx N), triangulation N tr /\ (forall c' c= R :^: idx N, c' :e tr' -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, c :e tr /\ face_of N c' c) -> triangulation N tr'

items.name: TRIANGULATION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall tr tr' c= Power (R :^: idx N), triangulation N tr /\ tr' c= tr -> triangulation N tr'

items.name: TRIANGULATION_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall tr c= Power (R :^: idx N), triangulation N {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e {vector_add N a x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e tr} <-> triangulation N tr

items.name: TRIANGULATION_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall tr1 tr2 c= Power (R :^: idx A), triangulation A (tr1 :\/: tr2) <-> triangulation A tr1 /\ (triangulation A tr2 /\ forall s t c= R :^: idx A, s :e tr1 /\ t :e tr2 -> face_of A (s :/\: t) s /\ face_of A (s :/\: t) t)

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G <-> exists a :e A, group_carrier A G = {a}

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUPS_IMP_SHORT_EXACT_SEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A B C D E:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> E <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall h :e D :^: C, forall k :e E :^: D, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall D0 :e group_hl D, forall E0 :e group_hl E, trivial_group A A0 /\ (trivial_group E E0 /\ (group_exactness A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_exactness B C D (B0,(C0,D0)) (g,h) /\ group_exactness C D E (C0,(D0,E0)) (h,k)))) -> short_exact_sequence B C D (B0,(C0,D0)) (g,h)

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G <-> exists a :e A, group_carrier A G c= {a}

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP_GENERATED_BY_ANYTHING
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, trivial_group A G -> subgroup_generated A G s = G

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP_HAS_SIZE_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G <-> equip (group_carrier A G) 1

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP_SINGLETON_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, trivial_group A (singleton_group A a)

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, trivial_group A G -> trivial_group A (subgroup_generated A G s)

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A (subgroup_generated A G Empty)

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, trivial_group A (subgroup_generated A G s) <-> group_carrier A G :/\: s c= {group_id A G}

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP_SUBGROUP_GENERATED_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, s c= {group_id A G} -> trivial_group A (subgroup_generated A G s)

items.name: TRIVIAL_GROUP_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G <-> group_carrier A G c= {group_id A G}

items.name: TRIVIAL_HOMOLOGY_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, p < 0 -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top))

items.name: TRIVIAL_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, contractible_space A top /\ ~ p = 0 -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top))

items.name: TRIVIAL_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top))

items.name: TRIVIAL_HOMOMORPHISM_GROUP_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, trivial_homomorphism A B (G,G') f <-> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f /\ group_image A B (G,G') f = {group_id B G'}

items.name: TRIVIAL_HOMOMORPHISM_GROUP_KERNEL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, trivial_homomorphism A B (G,G') f <-> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f /\ group_kernel A B (G,G') f = group_carrier A G
