items.name: TRIVIAL_HOMOMORPHISM_HOM_BOUNDARY_INCLUSION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, s = Empty \/ retract_of_space A s top -> trivial_homomorphism (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)),homology_group A (p + - 1,subtopology A top s)) (fun x:set => hom_boundary A p (top,s) x)

items.name: TRIVIAL_HOMOMORPHISM_HOM_INDUCED_RELATIVIZATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, (exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) /\ (homotopic_with A A {x :e A :^: A | True} (top,top) (fun x:set => x) f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= s)) -> trivial_homomorphism (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top),relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s))) (fun x:set => hom_induced A A p (top,Empty) (top,s) (fun x :e A => x) x)

items.name: TRIVIAL_HOMOMORPHISM_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl B, forall H :e group_hl A, trivial_homomorphism B A (G,H) (fun x:set => group_id A H)

items.name: TRIVIAL_IMP_ABELIAN_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G -> abelian_group_hl A G

items.name: TRIVIAL_IMP_CYCLIC_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G -> cyclic_group_hl A G

items.name: TRIVIAL_IMP_FINITELY_GENERATED_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G -> finitely_generated_group_hl A G

items.name: TRIVIAL_IMP_FINITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G -> finite (group_carrier A G)

items.name: TRIVIAL_IMP_SOLVABLE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G -> solvable_group A G

items.name: TRIVIAL_INTEGER_MOD_GROUP
items.statement: forall n :e omega, trivial_group int (integer_mod_group n) <-> n = 1

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_AT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, ~ trivial_limit (R :^: idx A) (at A a)

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_ATPOINTOF
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, trivial_limit A (atpointof A top a) <-> ~ a :e derived_set_of A top (topspace A top)

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_ATPOINTOF_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, trivial_limit A (within A (atpointof A top a) s) <-> ~ a :e derived_set_of A top s

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_AT_INFINITY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ~ trivial_limit (R :^: idx A) (at_infinity A)

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_AT_NEGINFINITY
items.statement: ~ trivial_limit R at_neginfinity

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_AT_POSINFINITY
items.statement: ~ trivial_limit R at_posinfinity

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: ~ trivial_limit omega sequentially

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_SEQUENTIALLY_WITHIN
items.statement: forall k c= omega, trivial_limit omega (within omega sequentially k) <-> finite k

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, trivial_limit (R :^: idx N) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N a) s) <-> ~ limit_point_of N a s

items.name: TRIVIAL_LIMIT_WITHIN_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ x :e s -> (trivial_limit (R :^: idx N) (within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) s) <-> s = {x})

items.name: TRIVIAL_NORMAL_SUBGROUP_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, normal_subgroup_of A {group_id A G} G

items.name: TRIVIAL_OPPOSITE_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A (opposite_group A G) <-> trivial_group A G

items.name: TRIVIAL_PRODUCT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> (trivial_group (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> trivial_group A (G i))

items.name: TRIVIAL_PROD_GROUP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall H :e group_hl B, trivial_group (A :*: B) (prod_group A B G H) <-> trivial_group A G /\ trivial_group B H

items.name: TRIVIAL_QUOTIENT_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, trivial_group A G /\ normal_subgroup_of A n G -> trivial_group (Power A) (quotient_group A G n)

items.name: TRIVIAL_QUOTIENT_GROUP_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G -> (trivial_group (Power A) (quotient_group A G n) <-> n = group_carrier A G)

items.name: TRIVIAL_QUOTIENT_GROUP_SELF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group (Power A) (quotient_group A G (group_carrier A G))

items.name: TRIVIAL_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, p < 0 -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group A (p,top))

items.name: TRIVIAL_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_CONTRACTIBLE_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, contractible_space A top -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group A (p,top))

items.name: TRIVIAL_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Empty -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group A (p,top))

items.name: TRIVIAL_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_NSPHERE
items.statement: forall p :e int, forall n :e omega, trivial_group (Power (frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group (R :^: omega) (p,nsphere n)) <-> ~ p = n

items.name: TRIVIAL_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, p < 0 -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)))

items.name: TRIVIAL_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> continuous_map A A (top,subtopology A top s) f /\ homotopic_with A A {k :e A :^: A | {k x | x :e s} c= s} (top,top) f (fun x:set => x) -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)))

items.name: TRIVIAL_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_CONTRACTIBLE_SPACES
items.statement: forall A:set, forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, contractible_space A top /\ (contractible_space A (subtopology A top s) /\ ~ topspace A top :/\: s = Empty) -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)))

items.name: TRIVIAL_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, topspace A top = Empty -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)))

items.name: TRIVIAL_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> continuous_map A A (top,subtopology A top s) f /\ (homotopic_with A A {h :e A :^: A | True} (subtopology A top s,subtopology A top s) f (fun x:set => x) /\ homotopic_with A A {k :e A :^: A | True} (top,top) f (fun x:set => x)) -> trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)))

items.name: TRIVIAL_RELATIVE_HOMOLOGY_GROUP_TOPSPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, trivial_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (relative_homology_group A (p,(top,topspace A top)))

items.name: TRIVIAL_SUBGROUP_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, subgroup_of A {group_id A G} G

items.name: TRIVIAL_SUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> (trivial_group (A :^: K) (sum_group A K k G) <-> forall i :e K, i :e k -> trivial_group A (G i))

items.name: TRIV_AND_EXISTS_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P) /\ (exists x :e A, Q) <-> exists x :e A, P /\ Q

items.name: TRIV_EXISTS_AND_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P /\ Q) <-> (exists x :e A, P) /\ exists x :e A, Q

items.name: TRIV_EXISTS_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (exists x :e A, P -> Q) <-> (forall x :e A, P) -> exists x :e A, Q

items.name: TRIV_FORALL_IMP_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P -> Q) <-> (exists x :e A, P) -> forall x :e A, Q

items.name: TRIV_FORALL_OR_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P \/ Q) <-> (forall x :e A, P) \/ forall x :e A, Q

items.name: TRIV_OR_FORALL_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P Q:prop, (forall x :e A, P) \/ (forall x :e A, Q) <-> forall x :e A, P \/ Q

items.name: TRUTH
items.statement: True

items.name: TUBE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), forall a :e R :^: idx N, compact M s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ ({pastecart M N x a | x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s} c= u /\ u :e subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}))) -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t /\ (a :e v /\ (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e v}) c= u)

items.name: TUBE_LEMMA_GEN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, forall u c= R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), compact M s /\ (~ s = Empty /\ (t c= t' /\ ((\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t}) c= u /\ u :e subtopology (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) (euclidean (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e t'})))) -> exists v c= R :^: idx N, v :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t' /\ (t c= v /\ (\/_ x :e s, {pastecart M N x y | y :e v}) c= u)

items.name: TUBE_LEMMA_LEFT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall k c= A, forall y :e B, forall w c= A :*: B, w :e prod_topology A B top top' /\ (compact_in A top k /\ (y :e topspace B top' /\ k :*: {y} c= w)) -> exists u c= A, exists v c= B, u :e top /\ (v :e top' /\ (k c= u /\ (y :e v /\ u :*: v c= w)))

items.name: TUBE_LEMMA_RIGHT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall x :e A, forall k c= B, forall w c= A :*: B, w :e prod_topology A B top top' /\ (compact_in B top' k /\ (x :e topspace A top /\ {x} :*: k c= w)) -> exists u c= A, exists v c= B, u :e top /\ (v :e top' /\ (x :e u /\ (k c= v /\ u :*: v c= w)))

items.name: TUKEY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, ~ s = Empty /\ (forall t c= A, (forall c c= A, finite c /\ c c= t -> c :e s) <-> t :e s) -> exists u c= A, u :e s /\ forall v c= A, v :e s /\ u c= v -> u = v

items.name: TWOTHIRDS_SUMS
items.statement: real_sums (fun k:set => 2 :/: 3 ^ (k + 1)) 1 (from 0)

items.name: TWO_SIDED_LIMIT_AT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (at 1 a) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x <= drop a}) /\ tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop a <= drop x})

items.name: TWO_SIDED_LIMIT_WITHIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall l :e R :^: idx N, tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) s) <-> tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop x <= drop a})) /\ tendsto N (R :^: idx 1) f l (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) (s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx 1 | drop a <= drop x}))

items.name: T_DEF
items.statement: True <-> forall p:prop, p <-> p

items.name: ULC_IMP_LOCALLY_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ distance N (x,y) < d) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ (y :e c /\ (c c= s /\ (connected N c /\ (bounded_hl N c /\ diameter N c <= e0))))) -> locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | connected N x} s

items.name: ULC_SPACE_IMP_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_SPACE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, ulc_space A m -> locally_connected_space A (mtopology A m)

items.name: ULC_SPACE_SUBMETRIC_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ulc_space (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ distance N (x,y) < d) -> exists c c= R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ (y :e c /\ (c c= s /\ (connected N c /\ (bounded_hl N c /\ diameter N c <= e0))))

items.name: UNBOUNDED_COMPLEMENT_COMPONENT_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) -> ~ bounded_hl N c

items.name: UNBOUNDED_COMPLEMENT_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c c= R :^: idx N, convex N c /\ ~ c = R :^: idx N -> ~ bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: c)

items.name: UNBOUNDED_COMPONENTS_COMPLEMENT_ABSOLUTE_RETRACT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, compact N s /\ (AR N s /\ c :e components N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) -> ~ bounded_hl N c

items.name: UNBOUNDED_COMPONENTS_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c c= R :^: idx N, c :e components N (outside N s) -> ~ bounded_hl N c

items.name: UNBOUNDED_CONVEX_CLOSED_CONTAINS_RAY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ bounded_hl N s /\ (closed N s /\ a :e s)) -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, ~ l = vec N 0 /\ forall t :e R, 0 <= t -> vector_add N a (vector_mul N t l) :e s

items.name: UNBOUNDED_CONVEX_CLOSED_CONTAINS_RAYS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (~ bounded_hl N s /\ closed N s) -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, ~ l = vec N 0 /\ forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall t :e R, a :e s /\ 0 <= t -> vector_add N a (vector_mul N t l) :e s

items.name: UNBOUNDED_DISJOINT_IN_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, connected N t /\ (~ bounded_hl N t /\ (x :e t /\ s :/\: t = Empty)) -> x :e outside N s

items.name: UNBOUNDED_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, ~ bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | a <= x k}

items.name: UNBOUNDED_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_GT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, ~ bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | a < x k}

items.name: UNBOUNDED_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, ~ bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= a}

items.name: UNBOUNDED_HALFSPACE_COMPONENT_LT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall k :e omega, ~ bounded_hl N {x :e R :^: idx N | x k < a}

items.name: UNBOUNDED_INTER_COBOUNDED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, ~ bounded_hl N s /\ bounded_hl N ((R :^: idx N) :\: t) -> ~ s :/\: t = Empty

items.name: UNBOUNDED_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s -> ~ bounded_hl N (outside N s)

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, connected N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ ~ a = b)) -> ~ countable s

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_CONTAINS_LIMIT_POINT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, ~ countable s -> exists x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ limit_point_of A x s

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_CONVEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, convex N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ ~ a = b)) -> ~ countable s

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> ~ countable (R :^: idx N)

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_HAS_CONDENSATION_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ countable s -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, condensation_point_of N x s

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx A, ~ open_interval A (a,b) = Empty -> ~ countable (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx B, ~ open_interval B (a,b) = Empty -> ~ countable (open_interval B (a,b))

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_NONEMPTY_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, ~ interior N s = Empty -> ~ countable s

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_OPEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> ~ countable s

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_PATH_CONNECTED
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, path_connected N s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ ~ a = b)) -> ~ countable s

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_REAL
items.statement: ~ countable R

items.name: UNCOUNTABLE_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> ~ countable (closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = b -> ~ countable (open_segment N (a,b))

items.name: UNCURRY_DEF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y :e C) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, f x y = f x y

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CAUCHY_IMP_UNIFORMLY_CONVERGENT
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e A, s x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l:set -> set, (forall x :e A, l x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= m /\ (N0 <= n /\ P x) -> distance N (s m x,s n x) < e0) /\ (forall x :e A, P x -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, N0 <= n -> distance N (s n x,l x) < e0) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= n /\ P x -> distance N (s n x,l x) < e0

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_EQ_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_BOUNDED
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, bounded_hl M s -> (uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> cauchy M x /\ (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => f (x x0)))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_EXTENDS_TO_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) /\ (uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N g (closure M s) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> g x = f x) /\ forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, h x :e R :^: idx N) -> continuous_on_hl M N h (closure M s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> h x = f x) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e closure M s -> h x = g x))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_HOMEOMORPHISM_UNIV_TRIVIAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx N, homeomorphism N N (s,R :^: idx N) (f,g) /\ uniformly_continuous_on_hl N N (fun x:set => f x) s -> s = R :^: idx N

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_IMP_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> cauchy M x /\ (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) -> cauchy N (fun x0:set => f (x x0))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_IMP_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A f s -> continuous_on_hl B A f s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_IMP_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f -> continuous_map A B (mtopology A m1,mtopology B m2) f

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m3 :e metric C, forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f /\ uniformly_continuous_map C B (m2,m3) g -> uniformly_continuous_map C A (m1,m3) (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall c :e B, uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) (fun x:set => c) <-> mspace A m1 = Empty \/ c :e mspace B m2

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_DROP
items.statement: uniformly_continuous_map R (R :^: idx 1) (euclidean_metric 1,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => drop x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_DROP_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R, f x :e A) -> (uniformly_continuous_map A R (real_euclidean_metric,m) f <-> uniformly_continuous_map A (R :^: idx 1) (euclidean_metric 1,m) (fun x:set => f (drop x)))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) -> (forall x :e B, x :e mspace B m1 -> f x = g x) /\ uniformly_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f -> uniformly_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) g

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_DROP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx 1) A (m,euclidean_metric 1) f <-> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => drop (f x)))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EQ_LIFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> (uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f <-> uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx 1) A (m,euclidean_metric 1) (fun x:set => lift (f x)))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx N) (submetric (R :^: idx N) (euclidean_metric N) s,euclidean_metric M) f <-> uniformly_continuous_on_hl N M f s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENDS_TO_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, mcomplete B m2 /\ uniformly_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 s,m2) f -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (uniformly_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 (closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s),m2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_EXTENDS_TO_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE_OF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, mcomplete B m2 /\ (uniformly_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 s,m2) f /\ t c= closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s) -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) /\ (uniformly_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 t,m2) g /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x = f x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 s,m2) f

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_FROM_SUBMETRIC_MONO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall s t c= B, uniformly_continuous_map A B (submetric B m1 t,m2) f /\ s c= t -> uniformly_continuous_map A B (submetric B m1 s,m2) f

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_FST
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> uniformly_continuous_map (B :*: C) A (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) f -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m,m1) (fun x:set => f x 0)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, uniformly_continuous_map A A (m1,m1) (fun x:set => x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_INTO_SUBMETRIC
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall s c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,submetric B m2 s) f <-> {f x | x :e mspace A m1} c= s /\ uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_LIFT
items.statement: uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx 1) R (real_euclidean_metric,euclidean_metric 1) (fun x:set => lift x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_LIFT_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e A) -> (uniformly_continuous_map A (R :^: idx 1) (euclidean_metric 1,m) f <-> uniformly_continuous_map A R (real_euclidean_metric,m) (fun x:set => f (lift x)))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_MDIST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m' :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m,m') f /\ uniformly_continuous_map B A (m,m') g -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => mdist B m' (f x,g x))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_ON_INTERMEDIATE_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ (t c= closure_of A (mtopology A m1) s /\ (continuous_map A B (subtopology A (mtopology A m1) t,mtopology B m2) f /\ uniformly_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 s,m2) f)) -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (submetric A m1 t,m2) f

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PAIRED
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e C) -> (uniformly_continuous_map (B :*: C) A (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) (fun x:set => (f x,g x)) <-> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m,m1) f /\ uniformly_continuous_map C A (m,m2) g)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PAIRWISE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> (uniformly_continuous_map (B :*: C) A (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) f <-> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m,m1) (fun x:set => f x 0) /\ uniformly_continuous_map C A (m,m2) (fun x:set => f x 1))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PASTED
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) A (m,euclidean_metric (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) (fun x:set => pastecart M N (f x) (g x)) <-> uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx M) A (m,euclidean_metric M) f /\ uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx N) A (m,euclidean_metric N) g)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_PASTEWISE
items.statement: forall A M N:set, A <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) -> (uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)) A (m,euclidean_metric (idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N))) f <-> uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx M) A (m,euclidean_metric M) (fun x:set => fstcart M (f x)) /\ uniformly_continuous_map (R :^: idx N) A (m,euclidean_metric N) (fun x:set => sndcart M N (f x)))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_ABS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => abs_SNo (f x))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_ADD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x + g x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_CONST
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall m :e metric A, uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => c)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_DIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ (uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g /\ (real_bounded {f x | x :e mspace A m} /\ ~ 0 :e closure_of R euclideanreal {g x | x :e mspace A m})) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x :/: g x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_INV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ ~ 0 :e closure_of R euclideanreal {f x | x :e mspace A m} -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => recip_SNo (f x))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_LMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => c * f x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MAX
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => if f x <= g x then g x else f x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => if f x <= g x then f x else g x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_MUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ (uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g /\ (real_bounded {f x | x :e mspace A m} /\ real_bounded {g x | x :e mspace A m})) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x * g x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_NEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => - f x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_RMUL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall c :e R, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x * c)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_REAL_SUB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f /\ uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) g -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x + - g x)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f <-> {f x | x :e mspace A m1} c= mspace B m2 /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A m1) /\ ((forall n :e omega, y n :e mspace A m1) /\ limit omega R euclideanreal (fun n:set => mdist A m1 (x n,y n)) 0 sequentially) -> limit omega R euclideanreal (fun n:set => mdist B m2 (f (x n),f (y n))) 0 sequentially)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SEQUENTIALLY_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f <-> {f x | x :e mspace A m1} c= mspace B m2 /\ forall e0 :e R, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e A) -> 0 < e0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e mspace A m1) /\ ((forall n :e omega, y n :e mspace A m1) /\ limit omega R euclideanreal (fun n:set => mdist A m1 (x n,y n)) 0 sequentially)) -> exists n :e omega, mdist B m2 (f (x n),f (y n)) < e0)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SND
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B :*: C) -> uniformly_continuous_map (B :*: C) A (m,prod_metric B C m1 m2) f -> uniformly_continuous_map C A (m,m2) (fun x:set => f x 1)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SQRT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) f -> uniformly_continuous_map R A (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => if 0 <= f x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (f x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- f x))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SQUARE_ROOT
items.statement: uniformly_continuous_map R R (real_euclidean_metric,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_MAP_SUM
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall m :e metric K, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e R) -> forall k c= A, finite k /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> uniformly_continuous_map R K (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => f x i)) -> uniformly_continuous_map R K (m,real_euclidean_metric) (fun x:set => finsum k (f x))

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, uniformly_continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ uniformly_continuous_on_hl A B g s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl A B (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s) -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_CMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx B, uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A f s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A (fun x:set => vector_mul A c (f x)) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A f s /\ uniformly_continuous_on_hl A C g {f x | x :e s} -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl B C (fun x:set => g (f x)) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall c :e R :^: idx A, uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A (fun x:set => c) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_DIST_CLOSEST_POINT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, closed N s /\ ~ s = Empty -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (distance N (x,closest_point N s x))) t

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> f x = g x) /\ uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A f s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A g s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_ID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, uniformly_continuous_on_hl A A (fun x:set => x) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_LIFT_SETDIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, uniformly_continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun y:set => lift (setdist N ({y},s))) t

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_MUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s /\ (uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N g s /\ (bounded_hl 1 {lift (f x) | x :e s} /\ bounded_hl N {g x | x :e s})) -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_NEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, uniformly_continuous_on_hl A B f s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl A B (fun x:set => vector_neg B (f x)) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> P x) -> (uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) s <-> uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SEQUENTIALLY
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx M) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ ((forall n :e omega, y n :e s) /\ tendsto M omega (fun n:set => vector_sub M (x n) (y n)) (vec M 0) sequentially) -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => vector_sub N (f (x n)) (f (y n))) (vec N 0) sequentially

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SEQUENTIALLY_ALT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall e0 :e R, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall y:set -> set, (forall x0 :e omega, y x0 :e R :^: idx M) -> 0 < e0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, x n :e s) /\ ((forall n :e omega, y n :e s) /\ tendsto M omega (fun n:set => vector_sub M (x n) (y n)) (vec M 0) sequentially)) -> exists n :e omega, distance N (f (x n),f (y n)) < e0

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SETDIST
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t t' c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ (t c= s /\ (t' c= s /\ setdist M (t,t') = 0)) -> setdist N ({f x | x :e t},{f x | x :e t'}) = 0

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SETDIST_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f s <-> forall t t' c= R :^: idx M, t c= s /\ (t' c= s /\ setdist M (t,t') = 0) -> setdist N ({f x | x :e t},{f x | x :e t'}) = 0

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SQRT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, uniformly_continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl N 1 (fun x:set => lift (if 0 <= f x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (f x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- f x))) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SUB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, uniformly_continuous_on_hl A B f s /\ uniformly_continuous_on_hl A B g s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl A B (fun x:set => vector_sub B (f x) (g x)) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx B, uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A f s /\ t c= s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A f t

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_UNION
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx M, bounded_hl M s /\ (bounded_hl M t /\ (uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f t /\ continuous_on_hl M N f (closure M s :\/: t))) -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N f (s :\/: t)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_VMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, c x :e R) -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, uniformly_continuous_on_hl M 1 (fun x:set => lift (c x)) s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => vector_mul N (c x) v) s

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONTINUOUS_ON_VSUM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall t c= R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e C, forall y :e R :^: idx B, f x y :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= C, finite s /\ (forall a :e C, a :e s -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A (f a) t) -> uniformly_continuous_on_hl B A (fun x:set => vsum C A s (fun a:set => f a x)) t

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONVERGENT_EQ_CAUCHY
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e A, s x y :e R :^: idx N) -> ((exists l:set -> set, (forall x :e A, l x :e R :^: idx N) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= n /\ P x -> distance N (s n x,l x) < e0) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= m /\ (N0 <= n /\ P x) -> distance N (s m x,s n x) < e0)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_CONVERGENT_EQ_CAUCHY_ALT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e A, s x y :e R :^: idx N) -> ((exists l:set -> set, (forall x :e A, l x :e R :^: idx N) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= n /\ P x -> distance N (s n x,l x) < e0) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, forall x :e A, N0 <= m /\ (N0 <= n /\ (m < n /\ P x)) -> distance N (s m x,s n x) < e0)

items.name: UNIFORMLY_IMP_CAUCHY_CONTINUOUS_MAP
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> uniformly_continuous_map B A (m1,m2) f -> cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f

items.name: UNIFORM_LIM_ADD
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, f x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, g x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall l:set -> set, (forall x :e B, l x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e B, m x :e R :^: idx C) -> (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P n -> vector_norm C (vector_sub C (f n x) (l n)) < e0} net0) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P n -> vector_norm C (vector_sub C (g n x) (m n)) < e0} net0) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P n -> vector_norm C (vector_sub C (vector_add C (f n x) (g n x)) (vector_add C (l n) (m n))) < e0} net0

items.name: UNIFORM_LIM_BILINEAR
items.statement: forall A B M N P:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall P0:set -> prop, forall h:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall y :e R :^: idx N, h x y :e R :^: idx P) -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, f x y :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, g x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall l:set -> set, (forall x :e B, l x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e B, m x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall b1 b2 :e R, bilinear N P M h /\ (eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P0 n -> vector_norm M (l n) <= b1} net0 /\ (eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P0 n -> vector_norm N (m n) <= b2} net0 /\ ((forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P0 n -> vector_norm M (vector_sub M (f n x) (l n)) < e0} net0) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P0 n -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (g n x) (m n)) < e0} net0)))) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P0 n -> vector_norm P (vector_sub P (h (f n x) (g n x)) (h (l n) (m n))) < e0} net0

items.name: UNIFORM_LIM_SUB
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, f x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B, forall y :e A, g x y :e R :^: idx C) -> forall l:set -> set, (forall x :e B, l x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e B, m x :e R :^: idx C) -> (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P n -> vector_norm C (vector_sub C (f n x) (l n)) < e0} net0) /\ (forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P n -> vector_norm C (vector_sub C (g n x) (m n)) < e0} net0) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually A {x :e A | forall n :e B, P n -> vector_norm C (vector_sub C (vector_sub C (f n x) (g n x)) (vector_sub C (l n) (m n))) < e0} net0

items.name: UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t = {x :e A | x :e s \/ x :e t}

items.name: UNIONS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union s = {x :e A | exists u c= A, u :e s /\ x :e u}

items.name: UNIONS_0
items.statement: forall A:set, Union Empty = Empty

items.name: UNIONS_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, Union {s} = s

items.name: UNIONS_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, Union {s,t} = s :\/: t

items.name: UNIONS_COMPONENTS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u c= R :^: idx N, u = Union (components N u)

items.name: UNIONS_CONNECTED_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} = s

items.name: UNIONS_CONNECTED_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, Union (connected_components_of A top) = topspace A top

items.name: UNIONS_DELETE_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union (s :\: {Empty}) = Union s

items.name: UNIONS_DIFF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, forall t c= A, Union s :\: t = Union {x :\: t | x :e Power A, x :e s}

items.name: UNIONS_EQ_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, Union f = {x :e A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} <-> exists s c= A, f = {s}

items.name: UNIONS_GROUP_ORBITS
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> group_action_hl A X G s a -> Union {{x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} | x :e X, x :e s} = s

items.name: UNIONS_GROUP_ORBITS_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall t c= X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (t c= s /\ (forall g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G -> {a g x | x :e t} c= t)) -> Union {{x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} | x :e X, x :e t} = t

items.name: UNIONS_GROUP_ORBITS_INVARIANT
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= X, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall t c= X, group_action_hl A X G s a /\ (t c= s /\ (forall g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G -> {a g x | x :e t} = t)) -> Union {{x0 :e X | group_orbit A X G s a x x0} | x :e X, x :e t} = t

items.name: UNIONS_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall P:set -> prop, forall f :e Power B :^: A, Union {f x | x :e A, P x} = {a :e B | exists x :e A, P x /\ a :e f x}) /\ ((forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall f :e Power C :^: B :^: A, Union (\/_ x :e A, {f x y | y :e B, P x y}) = {a :e C | exists x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y /\ a :e f x y}) /\ forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, forall f :e Power D :^: C :^: B :^: A, Union (\/_ x :e A, \/_ y :e B, {f x y z | z :e C, P x y z}) = {a :e D | exists x :e A, exists y :e B, exists z :e C, P x y z /\ a :e f x y z})

items.name: UNIONS_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f :e Power B :^: A, forall s c= A, Union {f x | x :e s} = {y :e B | exists x :e A, x :e s /\ y :e f x}

items.name: UNIONS_INSERT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall u c= Power A, Union (SetAdjoin u s) = s :\/: Union u

items.name: UNIONS_INSERT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union (SetAdjoin s Empty) = Union s

items.name: UNIONS_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power A, Union s = A :\: {x :e A | forall Y :e {A :\: t | t :e Power A, t :e s}, x :e Y}

items.name: UNIONS_IN_CHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, finite f /\ (~ f = Empty /\ (forall s t c= A, s :e f /\ t :e f -> s c= t \/ t c= s)) -> Union f :e f

items.name: UNIONS_LEFT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> Union {left_coset_hl A G x h | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} = group_carrier A G

items.name: UNIONS_MAXIMAL_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, finite f -> Union {t :e Power A | t :e f /\ forall u c= A, u :e f -> ~ (t c= u /\ t <> u)} = Union f

items.name: UNIONS_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= Power A, (forall x c= A, x :e s -> exists y c= A, y :e t /\ x c= y) -> Union s c= Union t

items.name: UNIONS_MONO_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f g :e Power B :^: A, forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x c= g x) -> Union {f x | x :e s} c= Union {g x | x :e s}

items.name: UNIONS_OVER_INTERS
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (Power B) :^: A, forall s c= A, Union {{x0 :e B | forall Y :e f x, x0 :e Y} | x :e A, x :e s} = {x :e B | forall Y :e {Union {g x | x :e A, x :e s} | g :e Power B :^: A, forall x :e A, x :e s -> g x :e f x}, x :e Y}

items.name: UNIONS_PATH_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | path_component N s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} = s

items.name: UNIONS_PATH_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, Union (path_components_of A top) = topspace A top

items.name: UNIONS_PRED
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P c= Power A, forall x :e A, x :e Union P <-> exists p c= A, p :e P /\ x :e p

items.name: UNIONS_QUASI_COMPONENTS_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, Union (quasi_components_of A top) = topspace A top

items.name: UNIONS_RIGHT_COSETS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, subgroup_of A h G -> Union {right_coset_hl A G h x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G} = group_carrier A G

items.name: UNIONS_SINGS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, Union {{x} | x :e A, x :e s} = s

items.name: UNIONS_SINGS_GEN
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, Union {{x} | x :e A, P x} = {x :e A | P x}

items.name: UNIONS_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f c= Power A, forall t c= A, Union f c= t <-> forall s c= A, s :e f -> s c= t

items.name: UNIONS_UNION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= Power A, Union (s :\/: t) = Union s :\/: Union t

items.name: UNIONS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> Union (Power A) = A

items.name: UNION_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :\/: t :\/: u = s :\/: (t :\/: u)

items.name: UNION_COMM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t c= A, s :\/: t = t :\/: s

items.name: UNION_DISJOINT_UNION
items.statement: forall A K:set, forall k c= K, forall s t :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} :\/: {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e t (p 0)} = {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e s (p 0) :\/: t (p 0)}}

items.name: UNION_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, Empty :\/: s = s) /\ forall s c= A, s :\/: Empty = s

items.name: UNION_FLD
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall P:set -> prop, x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun y:set => exists l :e Power A :^: A, P l /\ y :e l x0) <-> exists l :e Power A :^: A, P l /\ x :e fld_on A (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e l x0)

items.name: UNION_FRONTIER
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, frontier N s :\/: frontier N t = frontier N (s :\/: t) :\/: (frontier N (s :/\: t) :\/: frontier N s :/\: frontier N t)

items.name: UNION_IDEMPOT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, s :\/: s = s

items.name: UNION_INSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall l:set -> set -> prop, (forall m :e Power A :^: A, P m -> inseg_on A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e m x) l) -> inseg_on A (fun x:set => fun y:set => exists l0 :e Power A :^: A, P l0 /\ y :e l0 x) l

items.name: UNION_INTERIOR_OF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, interior_of A top s :\/: interior_of A top t c= interior_of A top (s :\/: t)

items.name: UNION_INTERIOR_SUBSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, interior N s :\/: interior N t c= interior N (s :\/: t)

items.name: UNION_INTERVAL_1
items.statement: forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil) :\/: closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil) = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)

items.name: UNION_INTERVAL_SUBSET_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b c d :e R :^: idx N, is_interval N s /\ (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= s) -> exists u v :e R :^: idx N, closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: closed_interval N (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) c= s

items.name: UNION_LE_ADD_C
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, atleastp (s :\/: t) (s :+: t)

items.name: UNION_OF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s) <-> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ ((forall c c= A, c :e u -> Q c) /\ Union u = s)

items.name: UNION_OF_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, P Empty -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = Empty

items.name: UNION_OF_INC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, forall s c= A, P {s} /\ Q s -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: UNION_OF_MONO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P Q Q':set -> prop, forall s c= A, (exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q c) /\ Union u = s) /\ (forall x c= A, Q x -> Q' x) -> exists u c= Power A, P u /\ (forall c :e u, Q' c) /\ Union u = s

items.name: UNION_OVER_INTER
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :/\: (t :\/: u) = s :/\: t :\/: s :/\: u

items.name: UNION_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall s t c= A, {x :e A | x :e s :\/: t /\ P x} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} :\/: {x :e A | x :e t /\ P x}

items.name: UNION_SEGMENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx N, b :e closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil) -> closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\/: closed_segment N (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil) = closed_segment N (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)

items.name: UNION_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s t u c= A, s :\/: t c= u <-> s c= u /\ t c= u

items.name: UNION_UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall s c= A, A :\/: s = A) /\ forall s c= A, s :\/: A = A

items.name: UNION_WITH_INSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :\/: inside N s = (R :^: idx N) :\: outside N s

items.name: UNION_WITH_OUTSIDE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :\/: outside N s = (R :^: idx N) :\: inside N s

items.name: UNIQUE_SKOLEM_ALT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y /\ forall y0 :e B, P x y0 -> y0 = y) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y <-> f x = y

items.name: UNIQUE_SKOLEM_THM
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, exists y :e B, P x y /\ forall y0 :e B, P x y0 -> y0 = y) <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ((forall x :e A, P x (f x)) /\ forall y:set -> set, (forall x :e A, y x :e B) -> (forall x :e A, P x (y x)) -> forall x :e A, y x = f x)

items.name: UNIT_INTERVAL_CONVEX_HULL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> closed_interval N (seq_cons (vec N 0,vec N 1) seq_nil) = hull (R :^: idx N) {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | convex N x} {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> x i = 0 \/ x i = 1}

items.name: UNIT_INTERVAL_NONEMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> ~ closed_interval N (seq_cons (vec N 0,vec N 1) seq_nil) = Empty /\ ~ open_interval N (vec N 0,vec N 1) = Empty

items.name: UNIV
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, x :e A <-> True

items.name: UNIVERSAL_COVERING_SPACE
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall p :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx M), forall c' c= R :^: idx N, forall p' :e R :^: idx P :^: (R :^: idx N), forall s c= R :^: idx P, covering_space M P (c,p) s /\ (covering_space N P (c',p') s /\ (locally M {x :e Power (R :^: idx M) | path_connected M x} c /\ (simply_connected M c /\ connected N c'))) -> exists q :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), covering_space M N (c,q) c' /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e c -> p' (q x) = p x

items.name: UNIV_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A:set, {x :e A | True} = A

items.name: UNIV_HAS_SIZE_DIMINDEX
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (equip N (dimindex N) <-> finite N)

items.name: UNIV_NOT_EMPTY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> ~ A = Empty

items.name: UNIV_PCROSS_UNIV
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (\/_ x :e A :^: idx M, {pastecart M N x y | y :e A :^: idx N}) = A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N)

items.name: UNIV_SECOND_COUNTABLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> exists b c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable b /\ ((forall c c= R :^: idx N, c :e b -> open N c) /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), u c= b /\ s = Union u)

items.name: UNIV_SECOND_COUNTABLE_SEQUENCE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> exists b :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, (forall m n :e omega, b m = b n <-> m = n) /\ ((forall n :e omega, open N (b n)) /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> exists k c= omega, s = Union {b n | n :e omega, n :e k})

items.name: UNIV_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, A c= s <-> s = A

items.name: UNWIND_THM1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, (exists x :e A, a = x /\ P x) <-> P a

items.name: UNWIND_THM2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall a :e A, (exists x :e A, x = a /\ P x) <-> P a

items.name: UN_REDUCED_HOMOLOGY_GROUP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, ~ p = 0 -> reduced_homology_group A (p,top) = homology_group A (p,top)

items.name: UPPER_BOUND_FINITE_SET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e omega) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> exists a :e omega, forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= a

items.name: UPPER_BOUND_FINITE_SET_REAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> exists a :e R, forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x <= a

items.name: UPPER_HEMICONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x c= t) -> ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x c= u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) <-> forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ ~ f x :/\: u = Empty})

items.name: UPPER_LOWER_HEMICONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x c= t) /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x c= u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x c= u})) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, x :e s /\ (0 < e0 /\ bounded_hl N (f x)) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx M, x' :e s /\ distance M (x,x') < d -> hausdist N (f x,f x') < e0

items.name: UPPER_LOWER_HEMICONTINUOUS_EXPLICIT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> f x c= t) /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t -> {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x c= u} :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) /\ (forall u c= R :^: idx N, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) u -> closed_in (R :^: idx M) (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) {x :e R :^: idx M | x :e s /\ f x c= u})) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall e0 :e R, x :e s /\ (0 < e0 /\ (bounded_hl N (f x) /\ ~ f x = Empty)) -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx M, x' :e s /\ distance M (x,x') < d -> (forall y :e R :^: idx N, y :e f x -> exists y' :e R :^: idx N, y' :e f x' /\ distance N (y,y') < e0) /\ forall y' :e R :^: idx N, y' :e f x' -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, y :e f x /\ distance N (y',y) < e0

items.name: URYSOHN
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (continuous_on_hl N M f (R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x = a) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> f x = b)))

items.name: URYSOHN_COMPLETELY_REGULAR_CLOSED_COMPACT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall a b :e R, a <= b /\ (completely_regular_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (compact_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = a) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = b))

items.name: URYSOHN_COMPLETELY_REGULAR_COMPACT_CLOSED
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall a b :e R, a <= b /\ (completely_regular_space A top /\ (compact_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = a) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = b))

items.name: URYSOHN_COMPLETELY_REGULAR_COMPACT_CLOSED_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall a b :e R, completely_regular_space A top /\ (compact_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty)) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = a) /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = b))

items.name: URYSOHN_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall a b :e R, a <= b /\ (normal_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty))) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = a) /\ forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = b))

items.name: URYSOHN_LEMMA_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, forall a b :e R, normal_space A top /\ (closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty)) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,euclideanreal) f /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = a) /\ forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = b))

items.name: URYSOHN_LOCAL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (continuous_on_hl N M f u /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u -> f x :e closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> f x = a) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> f x = b)))

items.name: URYSOHN_LOCAL_STRONG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t u c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) s /\ (closed_in (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u) t /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ a = b)) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (continuous_on_hl N M f u /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u -> f x :e closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u -> (f x = a <-> x :e s)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e u -> (f x = b <-> x :e t))))

items.name: URYSOHN_METRIZATION
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top /\ (second_countable A top /\ hausdorff_space A top) -> metrizable_space A top

items.name: URYSOHN_METRIZATION_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top -> (regular_space A top /\ hausdorff_space A top <-> metrizable_space A top)

items.name: URYSOHN_STRONG
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx M, closed N s /\ (closed N t /\ (s :/\: t = Empty /\ ~ a = b)) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (continuous_on_hl N M f (R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e closed_segment M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = a <-> x :e s) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x = b <-> x :e t)))

items.name: VARIATION_EQUAL_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall ms:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, ms x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall ms':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, ms' x :e R :^: idx 1) -> (forall s :e R :^: idx 1, ms' (ms s) = s /\ ms (ms' s) = s) /\ ((forall d c= Power (R :^: idx 1), forall t c= R :^: idx 1, division_of 1 d t -> division_of 1 {{x0 :e R :^: idx 1 | x0 :e {ms x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e d} {ms x | x :e t} /\ division_of 1 {{x0 :e R :^: idx 1 | x0 :e {ms' x0 | x0 :e x}} | x :e d} {ms' x | x :e t}) /\ (forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty -> {ms' x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (ms' a,ms' b) seq_nil) \/ {ms' x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)} = closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (ms' b,ms' a) seq_nil))) -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N (fun x:set => f (ms' x)) {ms x | x :e s} <-> has_bounded_variation_on N f s) /\ forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N {ms x | x :e s} (fun x:set => f (ms' x)) = vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTORIZE_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> vectorize R M N (mat M N 0) = vec (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) 0

items.name: VECTORIZE_ADD
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m1 m2 :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N (matrix_add M N m1 m2) = vector_add (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N m1) (vectorize R M N m2)

items.name: VECTORIZE_CMUL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall m :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N (matrix_cmul M N c m) = vector_mul (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) c (vectorize R M N m)

items.name: VECTORIZE_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e A :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M * dimindex N -> vectorize A M N m i = m (1 + div_nat (minus_nat i 1) (dimindex N)) (1 + mod_nat (minus_nat i 1) (dimindex N))

items.name: VECTORIZE_EQ
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m1 m2 :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N m1 = vectorize R M N m2 <-> m1 = m2

items.name: VECTORIZE_EQ_0
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N m = vec (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) 0 <-> m = mat M N 0

items.name: VECTORIZE_GSPEC
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, {vectorize A M N m | m :e A :^: idx N :^: idx M, P m} = {v :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N) | P (matrify A M N v)}

items.name: VECTORIZE_MATRIFY
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), vectorize A M N (matrify A M N a) = a

items.name: VECTORIZE_SUB
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall m1 m2 :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize R M N (matrix_sub M N m1 m2) = vector_sub (idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N)) (vectorize R M N m1) (vectorize R M N m2)

items.name: VECTOR_1
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, vector A 1 (seq_cons x seq_nil) 1 = x

items.name: VECTOR_2
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y :e A, vector A (idx_n 2) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y seq_nil)) 1 = x /\ vector A (idx_n 2) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y seq_nil)) 2 = y

items.name: VECTOR_3
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x y z :e A, vector A (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil))) 1 = x /\ (vector A (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil))) 2 = y /\ vector A (idx_n 3) (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil))) 3 = z)

items.name: VECTOR_4
items.statement: forall A:set, forall w x y z :e A, vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))) 1 = w /\ (vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))) 2 = x /\ (vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))) 3 = y /\ vector A (idx_n 4) (seq_cons w (seq_cons x (seq_cons y (seq_cons z seq_nil)))) 4 = z))

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_AC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m n p :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N m n = vector_add N n m /\ (vector_add N (vector_add N m n) p = vector_add N m (vector_add N n p) /\ vector_add N m (vector_add N n p) = vector_add N n (vector_add N m p))

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_ASSOC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y z :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N x (vector_add N y z) = vector_add N (vector_add N x y) z

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, vector_add N x y i = x i + y i

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A c (vector_add A x y) = vector_add A (vector_mul A c x) (vector_mul A c y)

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_LID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A (vec A 0) x = x

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_LINV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A (vector_neg A x) x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A (a + b) x = vector_add A (vector_mul A a x) (vector_mul A b x)

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_RID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A x (vec A 0) = x

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_RINV
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A x (vector_neg A x) = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub N (vector_add N x y) x = y

items.name: VECTOR_ADD_SYM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N x y = vector_add N y x

items.name: VECTOR_AFFINITY_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall c x y :e R :^: idx A, ~ m = 0 -> (vector_add A (vector_mul A m x) c = y <-> x = vector_add A (vector_mul A (recip_SNo m) y) (vector_neg A (vector_mul A (recip_SNo m) c)))

items.name: VECTOR_CHOOSE_DIST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, 0 <= e0 -> exists y :e R :^: idx N, distance N (x,y) = e0

items.name: VECTOR_CHOOSE_SIZE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, 0 <= c -> exists x :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N x = c

items.name: VECTOR_COMPONENTWISE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, x = fun j :e idx N => finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => x i * basis N i j)

items.name: VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_AT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative N f f' (at 1 x) -> vector_derivative N f (at 1 x) = f'

items.name: VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_CONST_AT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R :^: idx N, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, vector_derivative N (fun x:set => c) (at 1 a) = vec N 0

items.name: VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_INCREASING_WITHIN
