items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) /\ (a :e s /\ (limit_point_of 1 a s /\ has_vector_derivative 1 f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 a) s))) -> 0 <= drop f'

items.name: VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_UNIQUE_AT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall f' f'' :e R :^: idx N, has_vector_derivative N f f' (at 1 x) /\ has_vector_derivative N f f'' (at 1 x) -> f' = f''

items.name: VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_UNIQUE_WITHIN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall f' f'' :e R :^: idx N, ~ trivial_limit (R :^: idx 1) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) /\ (has_vector_derivative N f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) /\ has_vector_derivative N f f'' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)) -> f' = f''

items.name: VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_UNIQUE_WITHIN_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b x :e R :^: idx 1, forall f' f'' :e R :^: idx N, drop a < drop b /\ (x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (has_vector_derivative N f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ has_vector_derivative N f f'' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))))) -> f' = f''

items.name: VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_WITHIN_CLOSED_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx N, forall x a b :e R :^: idx 1, drop a < drop b /\ (x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ has_vector_derivative N f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> vector_derivative N f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) = f'

items.name: VECTOR_DERIVATIVE_WORKS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (differentiable N 1 f net0 <-> has_vector_derivative N f (vector_derivative N f net0) net0)

items.name: VECTOR_DIFFERENTIABLE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), differentiable A 1 f net0 <-> exists f' :e R :^: idx A, has_vector_derivative A f f' net0

items.name: VECTOR_DIFFERENTIABLE_BOUND
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall B :e R, convex 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f' x) <= B)) -> forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= B * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)

items.name: VECTOR_DIFF_CHAIN_AT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx 1, forall g' :e R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative 1 f f' (at 1 x) /\ has_vector_derivative A g g' (at 1 (f x)) -> has_vector_derivative A (fun x:set => g (f x)) (vector_mul A (drop f') g') (at 1 x)

items.name: VECTOR_DIFF_CHAIN_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx 1, forall g' :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, has_vector_derivative 1 f f' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s) /\ has_vector_derivative A g g' (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 (f x)) {f x | x :e s}) -> has_vector_derivative A (fun x:set => g (f x)) (vector_mul A (drop f') g') (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) s)

items.name: VECTOR_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x = y <-> dot A x x = dot A x y /\ dot A y y = dot A x x

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_ADDR
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_add A x y = x <-> y = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall c x y :e R :^: idx A, ~ m = 0 -> (y = vector_add A (vector_mul A m x) c <-> vector_add A (vector_mul A (recip_SNo m) y) (vector_neg A (vector_mul A (recip_SNo m) c)) = x)

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_DOT_SPAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b c= R :^: idx N, forall x y :e R :^: idx N, (forall v :e R :^: idx N, v :e b -> dot N v x = dot N v y) /\ (x :e span N b /\ y :e span N b) -> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_LDOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall y z :e R :^: idx A, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, dot A x y = dot A x z) <-> y = z

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_NEG2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_neg N x = vector_neg N y <-> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_EQ_RDOT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, (forall z :e R :^: idx A, dot A x z = dot A y z) <-> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_EXPAND_1
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x = vector R 1 (seq_cons (x 1) seq_nil)

items.name: VECTOR_EXPAND_2
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx_n 2, x = vector R (idx_n 2) (seq_cons (x 1) (seq_cons (x 2) seq_nil))

items.name: VECTOR_EXPAND_3
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx_n 3, x = vector R (idx_n 3) (seq_cons (x 1) (seq_cons (x 2) (seq_cons (x 3) seq_nil)))

items.name: VECTOR_EXPAND_4
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx_n 4, x = vector R (idx_n 4) (seq_cons (x 1) (seq_cons (x 2) (seq_cons (x 3) (seq_cons (x 4) seq_nil))))

items.name: VECTOR_IN_ORTHOGONAL_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, ~ a = vec N 0 -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (~ vec N 0 :e s /\ ((forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ (independent N s /\ (equip s (dimindex N) /\ span N s = R :^: idx N))))

items.name: VECTOR_IN_ORTHOGONAL_SPANNINGSET
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, exists s c= R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ ((forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ span N s = R :^: idx N)

items.name: VECTOR_IN_ORTHONORMAL_BASIS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, vector_norm N a = 1 -> exists s c= R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ ((forall x y :e s, x <> y -> orthogonal N x y) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_norm N x = 1) /\ (independent N s /\ (equip s (dimindex N) /\ span N s = R :^: idx N))))

items.name: VECTOR_MATRIX_MUL_TRANSP
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_matrix_mul N M x A = matrix_vector_mul M N (transp N M A) x

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A a (vector_mul A b x) = vector_mul A (a * b) x

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, vector_mul N c x i = c * x i

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A a x = vec A 0 <-> a = 0 \/ x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A a x = vector_mul A a y <-> a = 0 \/ x = y

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LCANCEL_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, ~ a = 0 /\ vector_mul A a x = vector_mul A a y -> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LID
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A 1 x = x

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A (- c) x = vector_neg A (vector_mul A c x)

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A 0 x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_RCANCEL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A a x = vector_mul A b x <-> a = b \/ x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_RCANCEL_IMP
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, ~ x = vec A 0 /\ vector_mul A a x = vector_mul A b x -> a = b

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_RNEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A c (vector_neg A x) = vector_neg A (vector_mul A c x)

items.name: VECTOR_MUL_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, vector_mul A c (vec A 0) = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> vector_neg A (vec A 0) = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, vector_neg N x i = - x i

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_EQ_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_neg A x = vec A 0 <-> x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_MINUS1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_neg A x = vector_mul A (- 1) x

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_neg N (vector_neg N x) = x

items.name: VECTOR_NEG_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_neg N (vector_sub N x y) = vector_sub N y x

items.name: VECTOR_ONE
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x = fun i :e idx 1 => x 1

items.name: VECTOR_SUB
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub N x y = vector_add N x (vector_neg N y)

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_ADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N (vector_sub N x y) y = x

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_ADD2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall y x :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N y (vector_sub N x y) = x

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, vector_sub N x y i = x i + - y i

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_sub A x y = vec A 0 <-> x = y

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_LDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A c (vector_sub A x y) = vector_sub A (vector_mul A c x) (vector_mul A c y)

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_LZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_sub A (vec A 0) x = vector_neg A x

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_PROJECT_ORTHOGONAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall b x :e R :^: idx N, dot N b (vector_sub N x (vector_mul N (dot N b x :/: dot N b b) b)) = 0

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_RADD
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub N x (vector_add N x y) = vector_neg N y

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_RDISTRIB
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_mul A (a + - b) x = vector_sub A (vector_mul A a x) (vector_mul A b x)

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_sub A x x = vec A 0

items.name: VECTOR_SUB_RZERO
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_sub A x (vec A 0) = x

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_AFFINITY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx 1, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N s (fun x:set => f (vector_add 1 (vector_mul 1 m x) c)) = if m = 0 then 0 else vector_variation N {vector_add 1 (vector_mul 1 m x) c | x :e s} f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_AFFINITY2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall c :e R :^: idx 1, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N {vector_add 1 (vector_mul 1 (recip_SNo m) x) (vector_neg 1 (vector_mul 1 (recip_SNo m) c)) | x :e s} (fun x:set => f (vector_add 1 (vector_mul 1 m x) c)) = if m = 0 then 0 else vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_CMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall c :e R, has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> vector_variation N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N c (f x)) = abs_SNo c * vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_COMBINE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, drop a <= drop c /\ (drop c <= drop b /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) -> vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f + vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil)) f = vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_COMPARISON
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on M f s /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x < drop y) -> distance N (g x,g y) <= distance M (f x,f y)) -> vector_variation N s g <= vector_variation M s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_COMPONENT_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall i :e omega, has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> vector_variation 1 s (fun x:set => lift (f x i)) <= vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_COMPOSE_DECREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f y) <= drop (f x)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (f b,f a) seq_nil)) -> vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => g (f x)) <= vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (f b,f a) seq_nil)) g

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_COMPOSE_HOMEOMORPHISM
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f f' :e R :^: idx 1 :^: (R :^: idx 1), forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (homeomorphism 1 1 (s,t) (f,f') /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g t) -> vector_variation N s (fun x:set => g (f x)) = vector_variation N t g

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_COMPOSE_INCREASING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (f a,f b) seq_nil)) -> vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => g (f x)) <= vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (f a,f b) seq_nil)) g

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_COMPOSE_INCREASING_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (is_interval 1 t /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ drop x <= drop y) -> drop (f x) <= drop (f y)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g t))) -> vector_variation N s (fun x:set => g (f x)) <= vector_variation N t g

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_CONST
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall c :e R :^: idx N, vector_variation N s (fun x:set => c) = 0

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_CONST_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> (vector_variation N s f = 0 <-> exists c :e R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> f x = c)

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_CONTINUOUS
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> (continuous 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun x:set => lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f)) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) <-> continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))))

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_CONTINUOUS_LEFT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> (continuous 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun x:set => lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f)) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil))) <-> continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil))))

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_CONTINUOUS_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ c :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> (continuous 1 (R :^: idx 1) (fun x:set => lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f)) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil))) <-> continuous N (R :^: idx 1) f (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 c) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,b) seq_nil))))

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_DEGENERATES
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, ~ has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ ~ has_bounded_variation_on A g s -> vector_variation N s f = vector_variation A s g

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_EQ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> vector_variation N s f = vector_variation N s g

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_GE_DROP_FUNCTION
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s /\ closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> drop (f b) + - drop (f a) <= vector_variation 1 s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_GE_NORM_FUNCTION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) c= s -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f b) (f a)) <= vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_ID
items.statement: forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, vector_variation 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => x) = if closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = Empty then 0 else drop b + - drop a

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_INTEGRAL_NORM_DERIVATIVE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, countable s /\ (continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> differentiable N 1 f (at 1 x)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) -> vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = drop (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (vector_derivative N f (at 1 x)))))

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_INTEGRAL_NORM_DERIVATIVE_GEN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))))) -> absolutely_integrable_on N 1 f' (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = drop (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f' x))))

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_INTEGRAL_NORM_DERIVATIVE_REV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (negligible 1 s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: s -> has_vector_derivative N f (f' x) (within (R :^: idx 1) (at 1 x) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)))) /\ vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = drop (integral 1 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => lift (vector_norm N (f' x)))))) -> absolutely_continuous_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_ISOMETRIC
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, distance A (f x,f y) = distance N (g x,g y)) -> vector_variation A s f = vector_variation N s g

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_ISOMETRIC_COMPOSE
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx M) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, distance N (f x,f y) = distance M (x,y)) -> vector_variation N s (fun x:set => f (g x)) = vector_variation M s g

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_LE_UNION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (s :\/: t) /\ interior 1 s :/\: interior 1 t = Empty -> vector_variation N s f + vector_variation N t f <= vector_variation N (s :\/: t) f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_LIFT_ABS
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> vector_variation 1 s (fun x:set => lift (abs_SNo (f x))) <= vector_variation 1 s (fun x:set => lift (f x))

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_LINEAR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, linear 1 N f /\ drop a <= drop b -> vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = distance N (f a,f b)

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_LIPSCHITZ
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall l :e R, drop a <= drop b /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (f y)) <= l * vector_norm 1 (vector_sub 1 x y)) -> vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f <= l * (drop b + - drop a)

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_MINUS_FUNCTION_MONOTONE
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b c d :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on 1 f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) c= closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) /\ ~ closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil) = Empty) -> vector_variation 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (c,d) seq_nil)) f + - drop (vector_sub 1 (f d) (f c)) <= vector_variation 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f + - drop (vector_sub 1 (f b) (f a))

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_MINUS_FUNCTION_MONOTONE_LEFT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ drop a <= drop b))) -> vector_variation 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= drop a} f + - drop (f a) <= vector_variation 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= drop b} f + - drop (f b)

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_MINUS_FUNCTION_MONOTONE_RIGHT
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on 1 f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ drop a <= drop b))) -> vector_variation 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop b <= drop x} f + - drop (f b) <= vector_variation 1 {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop a <= drop x} f + - drop (f a)

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_MONOTONE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on A f s /\ t c= s -> vector_variation A t f <= vector_variation A s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_NEG
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N s (fun x:set => vector_neg N (f x)) = vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_ON_CLOSURE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ continuous_on_hl 1 N f (closure 1 s)) -> vector_variation N (closure 1 s) f = vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_ON_DIVISION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx 1), division_of 1 d (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_variation N k f) = vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_ON_EMPTY
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> vector_variation N Empty f = 0

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_ON_INTERIOR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N f (interior 1 s) /\ continuous_on_hl 1 N f s) -> vector_variation N (interior 1 s) f = vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_ON_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f = sup {finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 k)) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 k)))) | d :e Power (Power (R :^: idx 1)), division_of 1 d (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))}

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_ON_NULL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, content 1 s = 0 /\ bounded_hl 1 s -> vector_variation A s f = 0

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_POS_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> 0 <= vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_REFLECT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N s (fun x:set => f (vector_neg 1 x)) = vector_variation N {vector_neg 1 x | x :e s} f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_REFLECT2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N {vector_neg 1 x | x :e s} (fun x:set => f (vector_neg 1 x)) = vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_REFLECT_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => f (vector_neg 1 x)) = vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_neg 1 v,vector_neg 1 u) seq_nil)) f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_SEGMENT_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a b c :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ (is_interval 1 s /\ (a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ c :e s))) -> vector_variation N (closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (a,c) seq_nil)) f <= vector_variation N (closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f + vector_variation N (closed_segment 1 (seq_cons (b,c) seq_nil)) f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_SING
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N {a} f = 0

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_SPLIT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R, is_interval 1 s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f s -> vector_variation N {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ drop x <= a} f + vector_variation N {x :e R :^: idx 1 | x :e s /\ a <= drop x} f = vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_SUM_LE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e R :^: idx 1, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall k c= A, finite k /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> has_bounded_variation_on N (f i) s) -> vector_variation N s (fun x:set => vsum A N k (fun i:set => f i x)) <= finsum k (fun i:set => vector_variation N s (f i))

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_TRANSLATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall a :e R :^: idx N, vector_variation N s (fun x:set => vector_add N a (f x)) = vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_TRANSLATION2
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N {vector_add 1 (vector_neg 1 a) x | x :e s} (fun x:set => f (vector_add 1 a x)) = vector_variation N s f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_TRANSLATION_ALT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N s (fun x:set => f (vector_add 1 a x)) = vector_variation N {vector_add 1 a x | x :e s} f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_TRANSLATION_INTERVAL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx 1, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u v :e R :^: idx 1, vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => f (vector_add 1 a x)) = vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vector_add 1 a u,vector_add 1 a v) seq_nil)) f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g s -> vector_variation N s (fun x:set => vector_add N (f x) (g x)) <= vector_variation N s f + vector_variation N s g

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_UNION_LE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s t c= R :^: idx 1, is_interval 1 s /\ (is_interval 1 t /\ ((s :/\: t = Empty -> s :/\: closure 1 t = Empty /\ t :/\: closure 1 s = Empty) /\ (has_bounded_variation_on N f s /\ has_bounded_variation_on N f t))) -> vector_variation N (s :\/: t) f <= vector_variation N s f + vector_variation N t f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_VECTOR_VARIATION
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> vector_variation 1 (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) (fun x:set => lift (vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil)) f)) = vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) f

items.name: VECTOR_VARIATION_VMUL
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall v :e R :^: idx N, has_bounded_variation_on 1 (fun x:set => lift (f x)) s -> vector_variation N s (fun x:set => vector_mul N (f x) v) = vector_norm N v * vector_variation 1 s (fun x:set => lift (f x))

items.name: VEC_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k i :e omega, vec N k i = k

items.name: VEC_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m n :e omega, vec A m = vec A n <-> m = n

items.name: VERY_SHORT_EXACT_SEQUENCE
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e C :^: B, forall h :e D :^: C, forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall D0 :e group_hl D, group_exactness A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ (group_exactness B C D (B0,(C0,D0)) (g,h) /\ (trivial_group A A0 /\ trivial_group D D0)) -> group_isomorphism_hl B C (B0,C0) (fun x:set => g x)

items.name: VITALI_COVERING_LEMMA_BALLS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e R) -> forall k c= A, forall B :e R, s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e ball N (a x,r x)} | x :e k} /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> 0 < r i /\ r i <= B) -> exists c c= A, countable c /\ (c c= k /\ ((forall x y :e c, x <> y -> ball N (a x,r x) :/\: ball N (a y,r y) = Empty) /\ s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e ball N (a x,5 * r x)} | x :e c}))

items.name: VITALI_COVERING_LEMMA_CBALLS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e R) -> forall k c= A, forall B :e R, s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e cball N (a x,r x)} | x :e k} /\ (forall i :e A, i :e k -> 0 < r i /\ r i <= B) -> exists c c= A, countable c /\ (c c= k /\ ((forall x y :e c, x <> y -> cball N (a x,r x) :/\: cball N (a y,r y) = Empty) /\ s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e cball N (a x,5 * r x)} | x :e c}))

items.name: VITALI_COVERING_LEMMA_CBALLS_BALLS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e R) -> forall k c= A, forall B :e R, (forall i :e A, i :e k -> 0 < r i /\ r i <= B) -> exists c c= A, countable c /\ (c c= k /\ ((forall x y :e c, x <> y -> cball N (a x,r x) :/\: cball N (a y,r y) = Empty) /\ forall i :e A, i :e k -> exists j :e A, j :e c /\ (~ cball N (a i,r i) :/\: cball N (a j,r j) = Empty /\ cball N (a i,r i) c= ball N (a j,5 * r j))))

items.name: VITALI_COVERING_THEOREM_BALLS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k c= A, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, x :e s /\ 0 < d -> exists i :e A, i :e k /\ (x :e ball N (a i,r i) /\ r i < d)) -> exists c c= A, countable c /\ (c c= k /\ ((forall x y :e c, x <> y -> ball N (a x,r x) :/\: ball N (a y,r y) = Empty) /\ negligible N (s :\: Union {ball N (a i,r i) | i :e A, i :e c})))

items.name: VITALI_COVERING_THEOREM_CBALLS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k c= A, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, (forall i :e A, i :e k -> 0 < r i) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx N, forall d :e R, x :e s /\ 0 < d -> exists i :e A, i :e k /\ (x :e cball N (a i,r i) /\ r i < d)) -> exists c c= A, countable c /\ (c c= k /\ ((forall x y :e c, x <> y -> cball N (a x,r x) :/\: cball N (a y,r y) = Empty) /\ negligible N (s :\: Union {cball N (a i,r i) | i :e A, i :e c})))

items.name: VSUM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B s f = iterate_op (R :^: idx B) (fun a:set => fun b:set => vector_add B a b) s f

items.name: VSUM_0
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => vec B 0) = vec B 0

items.name: VSUM_1
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A (idx_n 1) f = f 1

items.name: VSUM_2
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A (idx_n 2) t = vector_add A (t 1) (t 2)

items.name: VSUM_3
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A (idx_n 3) t = vector_add A (t 1) (vector_add A (t 2) (t 3))

items.name: VSUM_4
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, t x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A (idx_n 4) t = vector_add A (t 1) (vector_add A (t 2) (vector_add A (t 3) (t 4)))

items.name: VSUM_ADD
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B s g)

items.name: VSUM_ADD_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = vec B 0} /\ finite {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ g x = vec B 0} -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_add B (f x) (g x)) = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B s g)

items.name: VSUM_ADD_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => vector_add A (f i) (g i)) = vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g)

items.name: VSUM_ADD_SPLIT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= n + p} f)

items.name: VSUM_BIJECTION
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ p y0 = y -> y0 = x) -> vsum A N s f = vsum A N s (fun x:set => f (p x))

items.name: VSUM_CASES
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall P:set -> prop, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite s -> vsum A N s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else g x) = vector_add N (vsum A N {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f) (vsum A N {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ P x} g)

items.name: VSUM_CASES_1
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall y :e R :^: idx B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => if x = a then y else f x) = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vector_sub B y (f a))

items.name: VSUM_CLAUSES
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> D <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> vsum A B Empty f = vec B 0) /\ forall x :e C, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e C, f x0 :e R :^: idx D) -> forall s c= C, finite s -> vsum C D (SetAdjoin s x) f = if x :e s then vsum C D s f else vector_add D (f x) (vsum C D s f)

items.name: VSUM_CLAUSES_LEFT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vector_add A (f m) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n} f)

items.name: VSUM_CLAUSES_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> (forall m :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= 0} f = if m = 0 then f 0 else vec A 0) /\ forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= ordsucc n} f = if m <= ordsucc n then vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (f (ordsucc n)) else vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f

items.name: VSUM_CLAUSES_RIGHT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n :e omega, 0 < n /\ m <= n -> vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vector_add N (vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f) (f n)

items.name: VSUM_CMUL_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall c :e R, forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun x:set => vector_mul A c (f x)) = vector_mul A c (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f)

items.name: VSUM_COMBINE_L
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n p :e omega, 0 < n /\ (m <= n /\ n <= p + 1) -> vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n 1} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= p} f) = vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: VSUM_COMBINE_R
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n p :e omega, m <= n + 1 /\ n <= p -> vector_add A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | n + 1 <= i /\ i <= p} f) = vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= p} f

items.name: VSUM_COMPONENT
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i :e omega, vsum A N s f i = finsum s (fun x:set => f x i)

items.name: VSUM_CONST
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall c :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B s (fun n:set => c) = vector_mul B (finite_cardinality s) c

items.name: VSUM_CONST_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e R :^: idx A, forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun n0:set => c) = vector_mul A (minus_nat (n + 1) m) c

items.name: VSUM_CONTENT_NULL
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx M, forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 /\ tagged_division_of M p (closed_interval M (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0))) = vec N 0

items.name: VSUM_DELETE
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, forall a :e A, finite s /\ a :e s -> vsum A B (s :\: {a}) f = vector_sub B (vsum A B s f) (f a)

items.name: VSUM_DELETE_CASES
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> forall x :e A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, f x0 :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B (s :\: {x}) f = if x :e s then vector_sub B (vsum A B s f) (f x) else vsum A B s f

items.name: VSUM_DELTA
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall b :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= A, forall a :e A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => if x = a then b else vec B 0) = if a :e s then b else vec B 0

items.name: VSUM_DIFF
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ t c= s -> vsum A B (s :\: t) f = vector_sub B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B t f)

items.name: VSUM_DIFFS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_sub A (f k) (f (k + 1))) = if m <= n then vector_sub A (f m) (f (n + 1)) else vec A 0

items.name: VSUM_DIFFS_ALT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_sub A (f (k + 1)) (f k)) = if m <= n then vector_sub A (f (n + 1)) (f m) else vec A 0

items.name: VSUM_DIFF_LEMMA
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall k c= omega, forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> vector_sub N (vsum omega N (k :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) f) (vsum omega N (k :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m}) f) = vsum omega N (k :/\: {i :e omega | m + 1 <= i /\ i <= n}) f

items.name: VSUM_EQ
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = g x) -> vsum A B s f = vsum A B s g

items.name: VSUM_EQ_0
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x = vec B 0) -> vsum A B s f = vec B 0

items.name: VSUM_EQ_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ h x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ h y0 = y -> y0 = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ g (h x) = f x) -> vsum A N s f = vsum B N t g

items.name: VSUM_EQ_GENERAL_INVERSES
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall k:set -> set, (forall x :e B, k x :e A) -> (forall y :e B, y :e t -> k y :e s /\ h (k y) = y) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> h x :e t /\ (k (h x) = x /\ g (h x) = f x)) -> vsum A N s f = vsum B N t g

items.name: VSUM_EQ_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, (forall x :e omega, m <= x /\ x <= n -> f x = g x) -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g

items.name: VSUM_EQ_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e t -> f x = g x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ x :e t -> f x = vec B 0))) -> vsum A B s f = vsum A B t g

items.name: VSUM_GROUP
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ {f x | x :e s} c= t -> vsum B C t (fun y:set => vsum A C {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g) = vsum A C s g

items.name: VSUM_GROUP_RELATION
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> exists y :e B, y :e t /\ R0 x y /\ forall y0 :e B, y0 :e t /\ R0 x y0 -> y0 = y) -> vsum B C t (fun y:set => vsum A C {x :e A | x :e s /\ R0 x y} g) = vsum A C s g

items.name: VSUM_IMAGE
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e C, f x :e A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= C, finite s /\ (forall x y :e C, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y) -> vsum A B {f x | x :e s} g = vsum C B s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: VSUM_IMAGE_GEN
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx C) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A C s g = vsum B C {f x | x :e s} (fun y:set => vsum A C {x :e A | x :e s /\ f x = y} g)

items.name: VSUM_IMAGE_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e B, d x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall i:set -> set, (forall x :e A, i x :e B) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (~ x = y /\ i x = i y)) -> d (i x) = vec N 0) -> vsum B N {i x | x :e s} d = vsum A N s (fun x:set => d (i x))

items.name: VSUM_INCL_EXCL
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> finite s /\ finite t -> vector_add N (vsum A N s f) (vsum A N t f) = vector_add N (vsum A N (s :\/: t) f) (vsum A N (s :/\: t) f)

items.name: VSUM_INJECTION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall s c= A, finite s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> p x :e s) /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ p x = p y) -> x = y)) -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => f (p x)) = vsum A B s f

items.name: VSUM_LMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall c :e R, forall s c= A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_mul B c (f x)) = vector_mul B c (vsum A B s f)

items.name: VSUM_NEG
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_neg B (f x)) = vector_neg B (vsum A B s f)

items.name: VSUM_NONZERO_IMAGE_LEMMA
items.statement: forall A B N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a :e B, finite s /\ (g a = vec N 0 /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (f x = f y /\ ~ x = y)) -> g (f x) = vec N 0)) -> vsum B N {f x | x :e A, x :e s /\ ~ f x = a} g = vsum A N s (fun x:set => g (f x))

items.name: VSUM_NORM
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= B, finite s -> vector_norm A (vsum B A s f) <= finsum s (fun x:set => vector_norm A (f x))

items.name: VSUM_NORM_ALLSUBSETS_BOUND
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p c= A, forall e0 :e R, finite p /\ (forall q c= A, q c= p -> vector_norm N (vsum A N q f) <= e0) -> finsum p (fun x:set => vector_norm N (f x)) <= 2 * dimindex N * e0

items.name: VSUM_NORM_BOUND
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> vector_norm B (f x) <= b) -> vector_norm B (vsum A B s f) <= finite_cardinality s * b

items.name: VSUM_NORM_LE
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R) -> finite s /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s -> vector_norm N (f x) <= g x) -> vector_norm N (vsum A N s f) <= finsum s g

items.name: VSUM_NORM_TRIANGLE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall b :e R, finite s /\ finsum s (fun a:set => vector_norm B (f a)) <= b -> vector_norm B (vsum A B s f) <= b

items.name: VSUM_OFFSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m + p <= i /\ i <= n + p} f = vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => f (i + p))

items.name: VSUM_OFFSET_0
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vsum omega A {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => f (i + m))

items.name: VSUM_OVER_TAGGED_DIVISION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), d x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), forall i c= R :^: idx M, tagged_division_of M p i /\ (forall u v :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) = Empty /\ content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) = 0 -> d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) = vec N 0) -> vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => d (p0 1)) = vsum (Power (R :^: idx M)) N {{x0 :e R :^: idx M | x0 :e x 1} | x :e p} d

items.name: VSUM_OVER_TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION_LEMMA
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall d:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), d x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), forall i c= R :^: idx M, tagged_partial_division_of M p i /\ (forall u v :e R :^: idx M, ~ closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil) = Empty /\ content M (closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) = 0 -> d (closed_interval M (seq_cons (u,v) seq_nil)) = vec N 0) -> vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => d (p0 1)) = vsum (Power (R :^: idx M)) N {{x0 :e R :^: idx M | x0 :e x 1} | x :e p} d

items.name: VSUM_PAIR
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega N {i :e omega | 2 * m <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => vector_add N (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1)))

items.name: VSUM_PAIR_0
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, vsum omega N {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= 2 * n + 1} f = vsum omega N {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => vector_add N (f (2 * i)) (f (2 * i + 1)))

items.name: VSUM_PARTIAL_PRE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_mul N (f k) (vector_sub N (g k) (g (minus_nat k 1)))) = if m <= n then vector_sub N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N (f (n + 1)) (g n)) (vector_mul N (f m) (g (minus_nat m 1)))) (vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_mul N (f (k + 1) + - f k) (g k))) else vec N 0

items.name: VSUM_PARTIAL_SUC
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_mul N (f k) (vector_sub N (g (k + 1)) (g k))) = if m <= n then vector_sub N (vector_sub N (vector_mul N (f (n + 1)) (g (n + 1))) (vector_mul N (f m) (g m))) (vsum omega N {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun k:set => vector_mul N (f (k + 1) + - f k) (g (k + 1)))) else vec N 0

items.name: VSUM_REAL
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall s c= A, vsum A 1 s f = lift (finsum s (fun x:set => drop (f x)))

items.name: VSUM_REFLECT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} x = if n < m then vec A 0 else vsum omega A {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= minus_nat n m} (fun i:set => x (minus_nat n i))

items.name: VSUM_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, vsum A B s (fun x:set => if x :e s then f x else vec B 0) = vsum A B s f

items.name: VSUM_RESTRICT_SET
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> vsum A B {x :e A | x :e s /\ P x} f = vsum A B s (fun x:set => if P x then f x else vec B 0)

items.name: VSUM_RMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e A, c x :e R) -> forall s c= A, forall v :e R :^: idx B, vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_mul B (c x) v) = vector_mul B (finsum s c) v

items.name: VSUM_SING
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e B, vsum B A {x} f = f x

items.name: VSUM_SING_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= n} f = f n

items.name: VSUM_SUB
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= A, finite s -> vsum A B s (fun x:set => vector_sub B (f x) (g x)) = vector_sub B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B s g)

items.name: VSUM_SUB_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} (fun i:set => vector_sub A (f i) (g i)) = vector_sub A (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f) (vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} g)

items.name: VSUM_SUC
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, vsum omega A {i :e omega | ordsucc n <= i /\ i <= ordsucc m} f = vsum omega A {i :e omega | n <= i /\ i <= m} (fun x:set => f (ordsucc x))

items.name: VSUM_SUPERSET
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u v c= A, u c= v /\ (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = vec N 0) -> vsum A N v f = vsum A N u f

items.name: VSUM_SUPPORT
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, vsum A N {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = vec N 0} f = vsum A N s f

items.name: VSUM_SWAP
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e C, forall y :e B, f x y :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= C, forall t c= B, finite s /\ finite t -> vsum C A s (fun i:set => vsum B A t (f i)) = vsum B A t (fun j:set => vsum C A s (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: VSUM_SWAP_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b c d :e omega, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, f x y :e R :^: idx A) -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => vsum omega A {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (f i)) = vsum omega A {i :e omega | c <= i /\ i <= d} (fun j:set => vsum omega A {i :e omega | a <= i /\ i <= b} (fun i:set => f i j))

items.name: VSUM_TRIV_NUMSEG
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall m n :e omega, n < m -> vsum omega A {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} f = vec A 0

items.name: VSUM_UNION
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> vsum A B (s :\/: t) f = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B t f)

items.name: VSUM_UNIONS_NONZERO
items.statement: forall B A:set, B <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s c= Power A, finite s /\ ((forall t c= A, t :e s -> finite t) /\ (forall t1 t2 c= A, forall x :e A, t1 :e s /\ (t2 :e s /\ (~ t1 = t2 /\ (x :e t1 /\ x :e t2))) -> f x = vec B 0)) -> vsum A B (Union s) f = vsum (Power A) B s (fun t:set => vsum A B t f)

items.name: VSUM_UNION_LZERO
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u v c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e u /\ ~ x :e v -> f x = vec N 0) -> vsum A N (u :\/: v) f = vsum A N v f

items.name: VSUM_UNION_NONZERO
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall s t c= A, finite s /\ (finite t /\ (forall x :e A, x :e s :/\: t -> f x = vec B 0)) -> vsum A B (s :\/: t) f = vector_add B (vsum A B s f) (vsum A B t f)

items.name: VSUM_UNION_RZERO
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall u v c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e v /\ ~ x :e u -> f x = vec N 0) -> vsum A N (u :\/: v) f = vsum A N u f

items.name: VSUM_UNIV
items.statement: forall A N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, {x :e A | f x <> neutral_of (R :^: idx N) (fun a:set => fun b:set => vector_add N a b)} c= s -> vsum A N s f = vsum A N A f

items.name: VSUM_VMUL
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R) -> forall v :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= B, vector_mul A (finsum s f) v = vsum B A s (fun x:set => vector_mul A (f x) v)

items.name: VSUM_VSUM_PRODUCT
items.statement: forall C A B:set, C <> Empty -> A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t :e Power B :^: A, forall x:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, x x y :e R :^: idx C) -> finite s /\ (forall i :e A, i :e s -> finite (t i)) -> vsum A C s (fun i:set => vsum B C (t i) (x i)) = vsum (A :*: B) C (\/_ i :e A, {(i,j) | j :e B, i :e s /\ j :e t i}) (fun p:set => x (p 0) (p 1))

items.name: WALLACE_THEOREM_PROD_TOPOLOGY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall w c= A :*: B, forall k c= A, forall l c= B, compact_in A top k /\ (compact_in B top' l /\ (w :e prod_topology A B top top' /\ k :*: l c= w)) -> exists u c= A, exists v c= B, u :e top /\ (v :e top' /\ (k c= u /\ (l c= v /\ u :*: v c= w)))

items.name: WEAKLY_HEREDITARY_IMP_RETRACTIVE_PROPERTY
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P Q:set -> prop, (forall top :e topology A, P top -> hausdorff_space A top) /\ ((forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, P top /\ closed_in A top s -> P (subtopology A top s)) /\ (forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' -> (P top <-> Q top'))) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e B) -> retraction_map A B (top,top') r /\ P top -> Q top'

items.name: WEAKLY_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_AT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, weakly_locally_connected_at A x top <-> forall v c= A, v :e top /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ forall y :e A, y :e u -> exists c c= A, connected_in A top c /\ (c c= v /\ (x :e c /\ y :e c))))

items.name: WEAKLY_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_AT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, weakly_locally_path_connected_at A x top <-> forall v c= A, v :e top /\ x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ forall y :e A, y :e u -> exists c c= A, path_connected_in A top c /\ (c c= v /\ (x :e c /\ y :e c))))

items.name: WEAKLY_LOCALLY_PATH_CONNECTED_IMP_WEAKLY_LOCALLY_CONNECTED_AT
items.statement: forall a:set, forall top :e topology a, forall x :e a, weakly_locally_path_connected_at a x top -> weakly_locally_connected_at a x top

items.name: WEAK_LEBESGUE_POINTS_IMP_IVT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx 1) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s /\ (connected N s /\ (~ open_interval N (a,b) = Empty /\ (locally N {x :e Power (R :^: idx N) | absolutely_integrable_on 1 N f x} s /\ (forall c :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s /\ ((forall n :e omega, exists u :e R, exists v :e R :^: idx N, 0 < u /\ c n = {vector_add N (vector_mul N u x0) v | x0 :e closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)}) /\ (eventually omega {n :e omega | x :e c n} sequentially /\ tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => lift (diameter N (c n))) (vec 1 0) sequentially)) -> tendsto 1 omega (fun n:set => vector_mul 1 (recip_SNo (measure N (c n))) (integral 1 N (c n) f)) (f x) sequentially)))) -> connected 1 {f x | x :e s}

items.name: WELLCHAINED_ELEMENTS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall a b :e A, forall e0 :e R, (exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e A) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> mdist A m (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))) <-> a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ forall c c= A, c c= s /\ (a :e c /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e c /\ (y :e s /\ mdist A m (x,y) < e0) -> y :e c)) -> b :e c)

items.name: WELLCHAINED_ELEMENTS_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, (exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> distance N (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))) <-> a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ forall c c= R :^: idx N, c c= s /\ (a :e c /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ (y :e s /\ distance N (x,y) < e0) -> y :e c)) -> b :e c)

items.name: WELLCHAINED_INTERS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s :e Power A :^: omega, forall d e0 :e R, d < e0 /\ ((forall n :e omega, compact_in A (mtopology A m) (s n)) /\ ((forall n :e omega, s (ordsucc n) c= s n) /\ (forall n :e omega, forall a b :e A, a :e s n /\ b :e s n -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e A) /\ exists k :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p k = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= k -> p i :e s n) /\ forall i :e omega, i < k -> mdist A m (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < d))))) -> forall a b :e A, a :e {x :e A | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} /\ b :e {x :e A | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y} -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e A) /\ exists k :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p k = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= k -> p i :e {x :e A | forall Y :e {s n | n :e omega, n :e omega}, x :e Y}) /\ forall i :e omega, i < k -> mdist A m (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))

items.name: WELLCHAINED_INTERS_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s :e Power (R :^: idx N) :^: omega, forall d e0 :e R, d < e0 /\ ((forall m :e omega, compact N (s m)) /\ ((forall m :e omega, s (ordsucc m) c= s m) /\ (forall m :e omega, forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s m /\ b :e s m -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s m) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> distance N (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < d))))) -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s m | m :e omega, m :e omega}, x :e Y} /\ b :e {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s m | m :e omega, m :e omega}, x :e Y} -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e {s m | m :e omega, m :e omega}, x :e Y}) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> distance N (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))

items.name: WELLCHAINED_SETS
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall s c= A, forall e0 :e R, (forall a b :e A, a :e s /\ b :e s -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e A) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> mdist A m (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))) <-> forall c c= A, c c= s /\ (~ c = Empty /\ (forall x y :e A, x :e c /\ (y :e s /\ mdist A m (x,y) < e0) -> y :e c)) -> c = s

items.name: WELLCHAINED_SETS_EUCLIDEAN
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall e0 :e R, (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ b :e s -> exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, p x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists n :e omega, p 0 = a /\ (p n = b /\ ((forall i :e omega, i <= n -> p i :e s) /\ forall i :e omega, i < n -> distance N (p i,p (ordsucc i)) < e0))) <-> forall c c= R :^: idx N, c c= s /\ (~ c = Empty /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, x :e c /\ (y :e s /\ distance N (x,y) < e0) -> y :e c)) -> c = s

items.name: WF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) -> exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, lt y x -> ~ P y

items.name: WF_ANTISYM
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> ~ (lt x y /\ lt y x)

items.name: WF_CARD_LT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (atleastp y x /\ ~ equip y x)

items.name: WF_DCHAIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> ~ exists s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) /\ forall n :e omega, lt (s (ordsucc n)) (s n)

items.name: WF_DHAIN_TRANSITIVE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e A, lt x y /\ lt y z -> lt x z) -> ((forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> ~ exists s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) /\ forall i j :e omega, i < j -> lt (s j) (s i))

items.name: WF_EQ
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e A, P x) <-> exists x :e A, P x /\ forall y :e A, lt y x -> ~ P y

items.name: WF_EREC
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) -> exists f :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, f x = H f x) /\ forall y :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, y x = H y x) -> y = f

items.name: WF_FALSE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ False

items.name: WF_FINITE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall x :e A, ~ lt x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, lt x y /\ lt y z -> lt x z) /\ (forall x :e A, finite {y :e A | lt y x})) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x

items.name: WF_IND
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) <-> forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, (forall y :e A, lt y x -> P y) -> P x) -> forall x :e A, P x

items.name: WF_INSEG_WOSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A :^: A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (woset_on A (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e y x0) /\ (woset_on A (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e x x0) /\ (inseg_on A (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e y x0) (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x1 :e x x0) /\ ~ y = x)))

items.name: WF_INT_MEASURE
items.statement: forall A:set, forall P:set -> prop, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e int) -> (forall x :e A, 0 <= m x) /\ (forall x :e A, (forall y :e A, m y < m x -> P y) -> P x) -> forall x :e A, P x

items.name: WF_INT_MEASURE_2
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> set -> prop, forall m:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, m x y :e int) -> (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, 0 <= m x y) /\ (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, (forall x' :e A, forall y' :e B, m x' y' < m x y -> P x' y') -> P x y) -> forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P x y

items.name: WF_LEX
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall R0 S:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ R0 y x) /\ (forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ S y x) -> forall P c= A :*: B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (R0 (y 0) (x 0) \/ y 0 = x 0 /\ S (y 1) (x 1))

items.name: WF_LEX_DEPENDENT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall S:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ R0 y x) /\ (forall a :e A, forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ S a y x) -> forall P c= A :*: B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (R0 (y 0) (x 0) \/ y 0 = x 0 /\ S (y 0) (y 1) (x 1))

items.name: WF_MEASURE
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e omega) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ m y < m x

items.name: WF_MEASURE_GEN
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall m:set -> set, (forall x :e A, m x :e B) -> (forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt (m y) (m x)

items.name: WF_POINTWISE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall lt lt0:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) /\ (forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt0 y x) -> forall P c= A :*: B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (lt (y 0) (x 0) /\ lt0 (y 1) (x 1))

items.name: WF_PSUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, finite s -> forall P c= Power A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ (y c= x /\ y <> x /\ x c= s)

items.name: WF_REC
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) -> exists f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, f x = H f x

items.name: WF_REC_CASES
items.error: internal constant CASEWISE (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: WF_REC_CASES'
items.error: internal constant CASEWISE (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: WF_REC_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, forall y :e B, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> (P f x y <-> P g x y)) /\ (forall f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> P f z (f z)) -> exists y :e B, P f x y) -> exists f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, P f x (f x)

items.name: WF_REC_INVARIANT
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> forall S:set -> set -> prop, (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z /\ S z (f z)) -> H f x = H g x /\ S x (H f x)) -> exists f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, f x = H f x

items.name: WF_REC_TAIL
