items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e A) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ forall x :e A, f x = if P x then f (g x) else h x

items.name: WF_REC_TAIL_GENERAL
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt P:set -> set -> prop, forall G:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, G x y :e A) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) /\ ((forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> (P f x <-> P g x) /\ (G f x = G g x /\ H f x = H g x)) /\ ((forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) /\ (forall f :e B :^: A, forall x y :e A, P f x /\ lt y (G f x) -> lt y x))) -> exists f :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, f x = if P f x then f (G f x) else H f x

items.name: WF_REC_TAIL_GENERAL'
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt P:set -> set -> prop, forall G:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: B, forall y :e B, G x y :e B) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: B, forall y :e B, H x y :e A) -> forall H':set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: B, forall y :e B, H' x y :e A) -> (forall P c= B, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) /\ ((forall f g :e A :^: B, forall x :e B, (forall z :e B, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> (P f x <-> P g x) /\ (G f x = G g x /\ H' f x = H' g x)) /\ ((forall f :e A :^: B, forall x y :e B, P f x /\ lt y (G f x) -> lt y x) /\ (forall f :e A :^: B, forall x :e B, H f x = if P f x then f (G f x) else H' f x))) -> exists f :e A :^: B, forall x :e B, f x = H f x

items.name: WF_REC_WF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e omega) -> (forall f g :e omega :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) -> exists f :e omega :^: A, forall x :e A, f x = H f x) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x

items.name: WF_REC_num
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A :^: omega, forall y :e omega, H x y :e A) -> (forall f g :e A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, (forall m :e omega, m < n -> f m = g m) -> H f n = H g n) -> exists f :e A :^: omega, forall n :e omega, f n = H f n

items.name: WF_REFL
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall x :e A, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> ~ lt x x

items.name: WF_RESTRICT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt:set -> set -> prop, forall P:set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall P0 c= A, P0 <> Empty -> exists x :e P0, forall y :e P0, ~ (P y /\ (P x /\ lt y x))

items.name: WF_SUBSET
items.statement: forall A:set, forall lt lt0:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e A, lt x y -> lt0 x y) /\ (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt0 y x) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x

items.name: WF_UREC
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x) -> forall H:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e B :^: A, forall y :e A, H x y :e B) -> (forall f g :e B :^: A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> f z = g z) -> H f x = H g x) -> forall f g :e B :^: A, (forall x :e A, f x = H f x) /\ (forall x :e A, g x = H g x) -> f = g

items.name: WF_UREC_WF
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall lt:set -> set -> prop, (forall H:set -> set -> prop, (forall f g c= A, forall x :e A, (forall z :e A, lt z x -> (z :e f <-> z :e g)) -> (H f x <-> H g x)) -> forall f g c= A, (forall x :e A, x :e f <-> H f x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e g <-> H g x) -> f = g) -> forall P c= A, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ lt y x

items.name: WF_num
items.statement: forall P c= omega, P <> Empty -> exists x :e P, forall y :e P, ~ y < x

items.name: WIENER_COVERING_LEMMA_BALLS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k c= A, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite k /\ s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e ball N (a x,r x)} | x :e k} -> exists c c= A, c c= k /\ ((forall x y :e c, x <> y -> ball N (a x,r x) :/\: ball N (a y,r y) = Empty) /\ s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e ball N (a x,3 * r x)} | x :e c})

items.name: WIENER_COVERING_LEMMA_CBALLS
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k c= A, forall a:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e R) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, finite k /\ s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e cball N (a x,r x)} | x :e k} -> exists c c= A, c c= k /\ ((forall x y :e c, x <> y -> cball N (a x,r x) :/\: cball N (a y,r y) = Empty) /\ s c= Union {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | x0 :e cball N (a x,3 * r x)} | x :e c})

items.name: WILDER_LOCALLY_COMPACT_COMPONENT_THM
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall c w c= A, locally_compact_space A top /\ (hausdorff_space A top /\ (c :e connected_components_of A top /\ (compact_in A top c /\ (w :e top /\ c c= w)))) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (u :/\: v = Empty /\ (u :\/: v = topspace A top /\ (c c= u /\ u c= w))))

items.name: WITHIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e net A, forall s c= A, netfilter A (within A n s) = relative_to A (netfilter A n) s

items.name: WITHIN_UNIV
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, within (R :^: idx N) (at N x) (R :^: idx N) = at N x

items.name: WITHIN_WITHIN
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall s t c= A, within A (within A net0 s) t = within A net0 (s :/\: t)

items.name: WLOG_LE
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> prop, (forall m n :e omega, P m n <-> P n m) /\ (forall m n :e omega, m <= n -> P m n) -> forall m n :e omega, P m n

items.name: WLOG_LE_3
items.statement: forall P:set -> set -> set -> prop, (forall x y z :e omega, P x y z -> P y x z /\ P x z y) /\ (forall x y z :e omega, x <= y /\ y <= z -> P x y z) -> forall x y z :e omega, P x y z

items.name: WLOG_LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IMAGE
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, P s /\ linear N N f -> P {f x | x :e s}) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> linear N N f /\ (forall x y :e R :^: idx N, f x = f y -> x = y) -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, P {f x | x :e s} <-> P s

items.name: WLOG_LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_2

items.name: WOSET_FINITE_TOSET

items.name: WOSET_INSEG_ORDINAL

items.name: WOSET_POSET
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l <-> poset_on A l /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> l x y

items.name: WOSET_REFL

items.name: WOSET_RESTRICT

items.name: WOSET_TOSET

items.name: WOSET_WELL

items.name: WOSET_WELL_CONTRAPOS

items.name: WOSET_WF

items.name: WQOSET

items.name: WQOSET_ANTICHAIN

items.name: WQOSET_NOBAD
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l <-> qoset_on A l /\ forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> (forall n :e omega, x n :e fld_on A l) -> exists i j :e omega, i < j /\ l (x i) (x j)

items.name: WQOSET_NOBAD_SUBSEQ

items.name: WQOSET_POINTWISE

items.name: absolutely_continuous_on_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, absolutely_continuous_on N f s <-> absolutely_setcontinuous_on 1 N (fun k:set => vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 k)) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 k))) s

items.name: affine_thm

items.name: alexandroff_compactification_thm

items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall s c= A, antichain_on A l s <-> s c= fld_on A l /\ forall x y :e s, x <> y -> ~ l x y

items.name: arc_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (arc N g <-> path N g /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ g x = g y) -> x = y)

items.name: at_infinity_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> at_infinity A = ({{x :e R :^: idx A | b <= vector_norm A x} | b :e R, b :e R},Empty)

items.name: at_neginfinity_thm
items.statement: at_neginfinity = ({{x :e R | x <= a} | a :e R, a :e R},Empty)

items.name: at_posinfinity_thm
items.statement: at_posinfinity = ({{x :e R | a <= x} | a :e R, a :e R},Empty)

items.name: at_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx A, at A a = atpointof (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) a

items.name: atpointof_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall a :e A, atpointof A top a = ({u :e Power A | u :e top /\ a :e u},{a})

items.name: baire_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall n :e omega, (f :e baire M N 0 s <-> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => f x) s) /\ (f :e baire M N (ordsucc n) s <-> exists g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, (forall k :e omega, g k :e baire M N n s) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun k:set => g k x) (f x) sequentially)

items.name: ball_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, ball A (x,e0) = {y :e R :^: idx A | distance A (x,y) < e0}

items.name: barycentre_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, barycentre A s = if finite s then vsum (R :^: idx A) A s (fun x:set => vector_mul A (recip_SNo (finite_cardinality s)) x) else vec A 0

items.name: basis_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, basis A k = fun i :e idx A => if i = k then 1 else 0

items.name: between_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a x b :e R :^: idx A, between A x (a,b) <-> distance A (a,b) = distance A (a,x) + distance A (x,b)

items.name: bilinear_thm
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx C, forall y :e R :^: idx A, f x y :e R :^: idx B) -> (bilinear A B C f <-> (forall x :e R :^: idx C, linear A B (f x)) /\ forall y :e R :^: idx A, linear C B (fun x:set => f x y))

items.name: binarysum_thm
items.statement: forall s c= omega, binarysum s = finsum s (fun i:set => 2 ^ i)

items.name: bitset_thm
items.statement: forall n :e omega, bitset n = {i :e omega | odd_nat (div_nat n (2 ^ i))}

items.name: bool_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P (if False then 1 else 0) /\ P (if True then 1 else 0) -> forall x:prop, P (if x then 1 else 0)

items.name: bool_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e 2, f x :e A) /\ (f (if False then 1 else 0) = a /\ f (if True then 1 else 0) = b)

items.name: borel_CASES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a c= R :^: idx N, borel N a <-> open N a \/ ((exists s c= R :^: idx N, a = (R :^: idx N) :\: s /\ borel N s) \/ exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), a = Union u /\ (countable u /\ forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> borel N s))

items.name: borel_INDUCT
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall borel':set -> prop, (forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> borel' s) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, borel' s -> borel' ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) /\ (forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> borel' s) -> borel' (Union u))) -> forall a c= R :^: idx N, borel N a -> borel' a

items.name: borel_RULES
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall s c= R :^: idx N, open N s -> borel N s) /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx N, borel N s -> borel N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)) /\ forall u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall s c= R :^: idx N, s :e u -> borel N s) -> borel N (Union u))

items.name: borel_in_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall a c= A, borel_in A top a <-> a :e top \/ ((exists s c= A, a = topspace A top :\: s /\ borel_in A top s) \/ exists u c= Power A, a = Union u /\ (countable u /\ forall s c= A, s :e u -> borel_in A top s))

items.name: borel_in_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall borel_in':set -> prop, (forall s c= A, s :e top -> borel_in' s) /\ ((forall s c= A, borel_in' s -> borel_in' (topspace A top :\: s)) /\ (forall u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> borel_in' s) -> borel_in' (Union u))) -> forall a c= A, borel_in A top a -> borel_in' a

items.name: borel_in_RULES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, (forall s c= A, s :e top -> borel_in A top s) /\ ((forall s c= A, borel_in A top s -> borel_in A top (topspace A top :\: s)) /\ forall u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall s c= A, s :e u -> borel_in A top s) -> borel_in A top (Union u))

items.name: borel_measurable_CASES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall a0:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, a0 x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a1 c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N a0 a1 <-> continuous_on_hl M N a0 a1 \/ exists f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) /\ ((forall n :e omega, borel_measurable_on M N (f n) a1) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e a1 -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (a0 x) sequentially)

items.name: borel_measurable_INDUCT
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall borel_measurable_on':set -> set -> prop, (forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => f x) s -> borel_measurable_on' f s) /\ (forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M) :^: omega, forall g :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall n :e omega, borel_measurable_on' (f n) s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially) -> borel_measurable_on' g s) -> forall a0 :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall a1 c= R :^: idx M, borel_measurable_on M N (fun x:set => a0 x) a1 -> borel_measurable_on' a0 a1

items.name: borel_measurable_RULES
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> (forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, continuous_on_hl M N f s -> borel_measurable_on M N f s) /\ forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, f x y :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, (forall n :e omega, borel_measurable_on M N (f n) s) /\ (forall x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => f n x) (g x) sequentially) -> borel_measurable_on M N g s

items.name: borel_measurable_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top2 :e topology B, forall top1 :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (borel_measurable_map A B (top1,top2) f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top1 -> f x :e topspace B top2) /\ forall u c= B, borel_in B top2 u -> borel_in A top1 {x :e A | x :e topspace A top1 /\ f x :e u})

items.name: bounded_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, bounded_hl N s <-> exists a :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> vector_norm N x <= a

items.name: brouwer_degree1_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall n :e omega, brouwer_degree1 N n f = if 1 <= n /\ n <= dimindex N then brouwer_degree2 (minus_nat n 1) (fun x:set => fun x0 :e omega => if 1 <= x0 /\ x0 <= n then f (fun i :e idx N => if 1 <= i /\ i <= n then x i else 0) x0 else 0) else 1

items.name: brouwer_degree2_thm
items.statement: forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), forall p :e omega, brouwer_degree2 p (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0) = choose_in int (fun d:set => forall x c= frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), x :e group_carrier (Power (frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group (R :^: omega) (p,nsphere p)) -> hom_induced (R :^: omega) (R :^: omega) p (nsphere p,Empty) (nsphere p,Empty) f x = group_zpow (Power (frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)))) (reduced_homology_group (R :^: omega) (p,nsphere p)) x d)

items.name: brouwer_degree_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> brouwer_degree N f = brouwer_degree1 N (dimindex N) f

items.name: cantor_map_thm
items.statement: forall a c= omega, cantor_map a = real_infsum (from 0) (fun x:set => cantor_term a x)

items.name: cantor_set_thm
items.statement: cantor_set = {cantor_map x | x :e Power omega}

items.name: cantor_space_thm
items.statement: cantor_space = product_topology 2 omega omega (fun n:set => discrete_topology 2 2)

items.name: cantor_term_thm
items.statement: forall a c= omega, forall k :e omega, cantor_term a k = (if k :e a then 2 else 0) :/: 3 ^ (k + 1)

items.name: capped_metric_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e R, forall m :e metric A, capped_metric A d m = if d <= 0 then m else (mspace A m,fun p :e A :*: A => if d <= mdist A m (p 0,p 1) then d else mdist A m (p 0,p 1))

items.name: cart_tybij
items.statement: forall A B:set, (forall a :e A :^: idx B, a = a) /\ forall r :e A :^: idx B, True <-> r = r

items.name: cartesian_product
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e s i) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} = {f :e A :^: K | (forall x :e K, ~ x :e k -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> f i :e s i}

items.name: cauchy_continuous_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (cauchy_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f <-> forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e A) -> cauchy_in A m1 x -> cauchy_in B m2 (fun x0:set => f (x x0)))

items.name: cauchy_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> (cauchy_in A m s <-> (forall n :e omega, s n :e mspace A m) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N :e omega, forall n n' :e omega, N <= n /\ N <= n' -> mdist A m (s n,s n') < e0)

items.name: cauchy_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e R :^: idx N) -> (cauchy N s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists N0 :e omega, forall m n :e omega, N0 <= m /\ N0 <= n -> distance N (s m,s n) < e0)

items.name: cball_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, cball A (x,e0) = {y :e R :^: idx A | distance A (x,y) <= e0}

items.name: cfunspace_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall m :e metric B, cfunspace A B top m = submetric (B :^: A) (funspace A B (topspace A top) m) {f :e B :^: A | continuous_map A B (top,mtopology B m) (fun x:set => f x)}

items.name: chain
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall l:set -> set -> prop, chain_on A l s <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> l x y \/ l y x

items.name: chain_boundary_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), chain_boundary A p c = if p = 0 then frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega)) else frag_extend (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun f:set => iterate_op (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add (A :^: (R :^: omega)) a b) {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= p} (fun k:set => frag_cmul (A :^: (R :^: omega)) ((- 1) ^ k) (frag_of (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun x :e R :^: omega => singular_face A p k (fun x:set => f x) x)))) c

items.name: chain_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, chain_group A (p,top) = free_abelian_group (A :^: (R :^: omega)) {x :e A :^: (R :^: omega) | singular_simplex A (p,top) (fun x0:set => x x0)}

items.name: chain_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), chain_map A B p g c = frag_extend (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (B :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun x:set => frag_of (B :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun x0 :e R :^: omega => simplex_map A B p g (fun x0:set => x x0) x0)) c

items.name: char_INDUCT
items.error: no carrier mapping for type constructor char (in char)

items.name: char_RECURSION
items.error: no carrier mapping for type constructor char (in char)

items.name: closed_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closed_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ topspace A top :\: s :e top

items.name: closed_interval_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq (R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N), closed_interval N l = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> seq_hd l 0 i <= x i /\ x i <= seq_hd l 1 i}

items.name: closed_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (closed_map A B (top1,top2) f <-> forall u c= A, closed_in A top1 u -> closed_in B top2 {f x | x :e u})

items.name: closed_real_interval_thm
items.statement: forall a b :e R, closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {x :e R | a <= x /\ x <= b}

items.name: closed_segment_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {vector_add A (vector_mul A (1 + - u) a) (vector_mul A u b) | u :e R, 0 <= u /\ u <= 1}

items.name: closed_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, closed N s <-> open N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s)

items.name: closest_point_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall a :e R :^: idx A, closest_point A s a = choose_in (R :^: idx A) (fun x:set => x :e s /\ forall y :e R :^: idx A, y :e s -> distance A (a,x) <= distance A (a,y))

items.name: closure_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, closure_of A top s = {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ forall t c= A, x :e t /\ t :e top -> exists y :e A, y :e s /\ y :e t}

items.name: closure_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, closure A s = s :\/: {x :e R :^: idx A | limit_point_of A x s}

items.name: codeset_thm
items.statement: forall n :e omega, codeset n = {ordsucc x | x :e bitset (minus_nat n 1)}

items.name: cofactor_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, cofactor N A = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx N => det N (fun k :e idx N => fun l :e idx N => if k = i /\ l = j then 1 else if k = i \/ l = j then 0 else A k l)

items.name: collinear_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, collinear A s <-> exists u :e R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> exists c :e R, vector_sub A x y = vector_mul A c u

items.name: column_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall j :e omega, column M N j A = fun i :e idx M => A i j

items.name: columns_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, columns M N A = {column M N i A | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N}

items.name: columnvector_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, columnvector N v = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx 1 => v i

items.name: compact_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, compact_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ s c= Union U -> exists V c= Power A, finite V /\ (V c= U /\ s c= Union V)

items.name: compact_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, compact_space A top <-> compact_in A top (topspace A top)

items.name: compact_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, compact N s <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall n :e omega, f n :e s) -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, r x :e omega) /\ (l :e s /\ ((forall m n :e omega, m < n -> r m < r n) /\ tendsto N omega (fun x:set => f (r x)) l sequentially))

items.name: complete_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, complete N s <-> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (forall n :e omega, f n :e s) /\ cauchy N f -> exists l :e R :^: idx N, l :e s /\ tendsto N omega f l sequentially

items.name: completely_metrizable_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, completely_metrizable_space A top <-> exists m :e metric A, mcomplete A m /\ top = mtopology A m

items.name: completely_regular_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, completely_regular_space A top <-> forall s c= A, forall x :e A, closed_in A top s /\ x :e topspace A top :\: s -> exists f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, f x0 :e R) /\ (continuous_map A R (top,subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil))) f /\ (f x = 0 /\ forall x0 :e A, x0 :e s -> f x0 = 1))

items.name: components_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, components N s = {{x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s}

items.name: condensation_point_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, condensation_point_of A x s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx A, x :e t /\ open A t -> ~ countable (s :/\: t)

items.name: cong
items.statement: forall A:set, forall rel:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, rel x y <-> rel x y

items.name: conic_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, conic A s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall c :e R, x :e s /\ 0 <= c -> vector_mul A c x :e s

items.name: connected_component_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, connected_component_of A top x y <-> exists t c= A, connected_in A top t /\ (x :e t /\ y :e t)

items.name: connected_component_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, connected_component A s x y <-> exists t c= R :^: idx A, connected A t /\ (t c= s /\ (x :e t /\ y :e t))

items.name: connected_components_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_components_of A top = {{x0 :e A | connected_component_of A top x x0} | x :e A, x :e topspace A top}

items.name: connected_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ connected_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: connected_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, connected_space A top <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= A, e1 :e top /\ (e2 :e top /\ (topspace A top c= e1 :\/: e2 /\ (e1 :/\: e2 = Empty /\ (~ e1 = Empty /\ ~ e2 = Empty))))

items.name: connected_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, connected A s <-> ~ exists e1 e2 c= R :^: idx A, open A e1 /\ (open A e2 /\ (s c= e1 :\/: e2 /\ (e1 :/\: (e2 :/\: s) = Empty /\ (~ e1 :/\: s = Empty /\ ~ e2 :/\: s = Empty))))

items.name: content_thm
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, content M s = if s = Empty then 0 else finprod (idx M) (fun i:set => interval_upperbound M s i + - interval_lowerbound M s i)

items.name: continuous_at_thm

var_views.f: metafun(R :^: idx B -> R :^: idx A)

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx B, f x0 :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, continuous A (R :^: idx B) f (at B x) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx B, distance B (x',x) < d -> distance A (f x',f x) < e0

items.name: continuous_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (continuous_map A B (top,top') f <-> (forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> f x :e topspace B top') /\ forall u c= B, u :e top' -> {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e u} :e top)

items.name: continuous_on_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> (continuous_on_hl A B f s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx A, x' :e s /\ distance A (x',x) < d -> distance B (f x',f x) < e0)

items.name: continuous_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall net0 :e net B, continuous A B f net0 <-> tendsto A B f (f (netlimit B net0)) net0

items.name: continuous_within

var_views.f: metafun(R :^: idx B -> R :^: idx A)

items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx B, f x0 :e R :^: idx A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx B, forall s c= R :^: idx B, continuous A (R :^: idx B) f (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s) <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx B, x' :e s /\ distance B (x',x) < d -> distance A (f x',f x) < e0

items.name: contractible_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, contractible_space A top <-> exists a :e A, homotopic_with A A {x :e A :^: A | True} (top,top) (fun x:set => x) (fun x:set => a)

items.name: contractible_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, contractible A s <-> exists a :e R :^: idx A, homotopic_with (R :^: idx A) (R :^: idx A) {x :e R :^: idx A :^: (R :^: idx A) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s,subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) (fun x:set => x) (fun x:set => a)

items.name: convex_cone_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex_cone A s <-> ~ s = Empty /\ (convex A s /\ conic A s)

items.name: convex_on_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R) -> (convex_on A f s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall u v :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1))) -> f (vector_add A (vector_mul A u x) (vector_mul A v y)) <= u * f x + v * f y)

items.name: convex_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, convex A s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, forall u v :e R, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ (0 <= u /\ (0 <= v /\ u + v = 1))) -> vector_add A (vector_mul A u x) (vector_mul A v y) :e s

items.name: coplanar_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, coplanar A s <-> exists u v w :e R :^: idx A, s c= hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x} {u,v,w}

items.name: coprime
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 <-> forall d :e omega, divides_nat d a /\ divides_nat d b -> d = 1

items.name: covering_space_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall c c= R :^: idx M, forall p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), covering_space M N (c,p) s <-> continuous_on_hl M N (fun x:set => p x) c /\ ({p x | x :e c} = s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists t c= R :^: idx N, x :e t /\ (t :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ exists v c= Power (R :^: idx M), Union v = {x0 :e R :^: idx M | x0 :e c /\ p x0 :e t} /\ ((forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e v -> u :e subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) c) /\ ((forall x y :e v, x <> y -> x :/\: y = Empty) /\ forall u c= R :^: idx M, u :e v -> exists q :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx N), homeomorphism M N (u,t) (p,q)))))

items.name: cyclic_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, cyclic_group_hl A G <-> exists x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ subgroup_generated A G {x} = G

items.name: dependent_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, dependent A s <-> exists a :e R :^: idx A, a :e s /\ a :e span A (s :\: {a})

items.name: derived_set_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, derived_set_of A top s = {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ forall t c= A, x :e t /\ t :e top -> exists y :e A, ~ y = x /\ (y :e s /\ y :e t)}

items.name: dest_int_rep
items.statement: forall i :e int, exists n :e omega, i = n \/ i = - n

items.name: det_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, det N A = finsum {p :e omega :^: omega | permutes omega (fun x:set => p x) (idx N)} (fun p:set => sign omega (fun x:set => p x) * finprod (idx N) (fun i:set => A i (p i)))

items.name: diagonal_matrix_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, diagonal_matrix_hl M N A <-> forall i j :e omega, 1 <= i /\ (i <= dimindex M /\ (1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ ~ i = j))) -> A i j = 0

items.name: diameter_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, diameter A s = if s = Empty then 0 else sup (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y) | y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e s})

items.name: differentiable_on_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, differentiable_on_hl A B f s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx B, x :e s -> differentiable A B f (within (R :^: idx B) (at B x) s)

items.name: differentiable_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx B), differentiable A B f net0 <-> exists f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f' x :e R :^: idx A) /\ has_derivative A B f f' net0

items.name: dim_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v c= R :^: idx N, dim N v = choose_in omega (fun n:set => exists b c= R :^: idx N, b c= v /\ (independent N b /\ (v c= span N b /\ equip b n)))

items.name: dimension_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, dimension N s = if s = Empty then - 1 else choose_in omega (fun n:set => dimension_le (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) n /\ forall m :e omega, dimension_le (R :^: idx N) (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s) m -> n <= m)

items.name: dimindex_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> dimindex A = if finite A then finite_cardinality A else 1

items.name: discrete_metric_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, discrete_metric A s = (s,fun p :e A :*: A => if p 0 = p 1 then 0 else 1)

items.name: discrete_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, discrete_space A top <-> discrete_topology A (topspace A top) = top

items.name: discrete_topology_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= A, discrete_topology A u = {s :e Power A | s c= u}

items.name: disjoint_union
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall s :e Power A :^: K, {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e s (p 0)} = \/_ i :e K, {(i,x) | x :e A, i :e k /\ x :e s i}

items.name: dist
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x,y) = vector_norm A (vector_sub A x y)

items.name: divides
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, divides_nat a b <-> exists x :e omega, b = a * x

items.name: division_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, division_of A s i <-> finite s /\ ((forall k c= R :^: idx A, k :e s -> k c= i /\ (~ k = Empty /\ exists a b :e R :^: idx A, k = closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ ((forall k1 k2 c= R :^: idx A, k1 :e s /\ (k2 :e s /\ ~ k1 = k2) -> interior A k1 :/\: interior A k2 = Empty) /\ Union s = i))

items.name: division_points_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k c= R :^: idx N, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx N), division_points N k d = \/_ j :e omega, {(j,x) | x :e R, 1 <= j /\ (j <= dimindex N /\ (interval_lowerbound N k j < x /\ (x < interval_upperbound N k j /\ exists i c= R :^: idx N, i :e d /\ (interval_lowerbound N i j = x \/ interval_upperbound N i j = x))))}

items.name: dot_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, dot N x y = finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => x i * y i)

items.name: drop_thm
items.statement: forall x :e R :^: idx 1, drop x = x 1

items.name: dropout_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: idx M, dropout M N k x = fun i :e idx N => if i < k /\ i <= dimindex M then x i else if i + 1 <= dimindex M then x (i + 1) else 0

items.name: edge_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s e0 c= R :^: idx A, edge_of A e0 s <-> face_of A e0 s /\ aff_dim A e0 = 1

items.name: embedding_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top' :e topology B, forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (embedding_map A B (top,top') f <-> homeomorphic_map A B (top,subtopology B top' {f x | x :e topspace A top}) f)

items.name: epigraph_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R) -> epigraph N s f = {xy :e R :^: idx_n (dimindex N + 1) | fstcart N xy :e s /\ f (fstcart N xy) <= drop (sndcart N 1 xy)}

items.name: eq_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, equip s t <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall y :e B, y :e t -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ f x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, y0 :e s /\ f y0 = y -> y0 = x)

items.name: equiintegrable_on_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall fs c= R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall i c= R :^: idx M, equiintegrable_on M N fs i <-> (forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), f :e fs -> integrable_on N M (fun x:set => f x) i) /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d:set -> set -> prop, gauge M d /\ forall f :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx M), forall p c= R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M), f :e fs /\ (tagged_division_of M p i /\ fine (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) d p) -> vector_norm N (vector_sub N (vsum (R :^: idx M :*: Power (R :^: idx M)) N p (fun p0:set => vector_mul N (content M (p0 1)) (f (p0 0)))) (integral N M i (fun x:set => f x))) < e0

items.name: euclidean_matroid_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> euclidean_matroid N = (R :^: idx N,fun x :e Power (R :^: idx N) => span N x)

items.name: euclidean_metric_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> euclidean_metric N = (R :^: idx N,fun x :e R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N => distance N x)

items.name: euclidean_space_thm
items.statement: forall n :e omega, euclidean_space n = subtopology (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) {x :e R :^: omega | forall i :e omega, ~ i :e idx_n n -> x i = 0}

items.name: euclidean_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> euclidean A = {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | open A x}

items.name: euclideanreal_thm
items.statement: euclideanreal = {x :e Power R | real_open x}

items.name: evenperm_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> (evenperm A p <-> even_nat (choose_in omega (fun n:set => swapseq A n p)))

items.name: eventually_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, forall P c= A, eventually A P net0 <-> netfilter A net0 = Empty \/ exists u c= A, u :e netfilter A net0 /\ forall x :e A, x :e u :\: netlimits A net0 -> x :e P

items.name: exp_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall t c= B, {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e t, f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)} = {f :e A :^: B | (forall x :e B, x :e t -> f x :e s) /\ forall x :e B, ~ x :e t -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => False)}

items.name: exposed_face_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t s c= R :^: idx A, exposed_face_of A t s <-> face_of A t s /\ exists a :e R :^: idx A, exists b :e R, s c= {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x <= b} /\ t = s :/\: {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x = b}

items.name: extreme_point_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx A, extreme_point_of A x s <-> x :e s /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx A, a :e s /\ b :e s -> ~ x :e open_segment A (a,b)

items.name: face_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, face_of A t s <-> t c= s /\ (convex A t /\ forall a b x :e R :^: idx A, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (x :e t /\ x :e open_segment A (a,b))) -> a :e t /\ b :e t)

items.name: facet_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f s c= R :^: idx A, facet_of A f s <-> face_of A f s /\ (~ f = Empty /\ aff_dim A f = aff_dim A s + - 1)

items.name: fccoverable_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric A, fccoverable_in A m s <-> s c= mspace A m /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power A, finite c /\ (Union c = s /\ forall t c= A, t :e c -> connected_in A (mtopology A m) t /\ (mbounded A m t /\ mdiameter A m t <= e0))

items.name: fccoverable_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, fccoverable_space A m <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists c c= Power A, finite c /\ (Union c = mspace A m /\ forall t c= A, t :e c -> connected_in A (mtopology A m) t /\ (mbounded A m t /\ mdiameter A m t <= e0))

items.name: fine_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= B :*: Power A, forall d :e Power A :^: B, fine A B (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e d x) s <-> forall x :e B, forall k c= A, (x,k) :e s -> k c= d x

items.name: finite_diff_tybij
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a :e idx_n (if dimindex B < dimindex A then minus_nat (dimindex A) (dimindex B) else 1), a = a) /\ forall r :e omega, r :e idx_n (if dimindex B < dimindex A then minus_nat (dimindex A) (dimindex B) else 1) <-> r = r

items.name: finite_image_tybij
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall a :e idx A, a = a) /\ forall r :e omega, r :e idx A <-> r = r

items.name: finite_index
items.statement: forall A N:set, forall x :e A :^: idx N, forall i :e omega, x i = x i

items.name: finite_prod_tybij
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a :e idx_n (dimindex A * dimindex B), a = a) /\ forall r :e omega, r :e idx_n (dimindex A * dimindex B) <-> r = r

items.name: finite_sum_tybij
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B), a = a) /\ forall r :e omega, r :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex B) <-> r = r

items.name: finitely_generated_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, finitely_generated_group_hl A G <-> exists s c= A, finite s /\ subgroup_generated A G s = G

items.name: first_countable_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, first_countable A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists b c= Power A, countable b /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e b -> v :e top) /\ forall u c= A, u :e top /\ x :e u -> exists v c= A, v :e b /\ (x :e v /\ v c= u))

items.name: fld
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall R0:set -> set -> prop, fld_on A R0 = {x :e A | exists y :e A, R0 x y \/ R0 y x}

items.name: frag_0_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> frag_0 A = fun x :e A => 0

items.name: frag_add_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e frag A, frag_add A x y = fun a :e A => x a + y a

items.name: frag_cmul_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e int, forall x :e frag A, frag_cmul A c x = fun a :e A => c * x a

items.name: frag_extend_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e frag A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, f x0 :e frag B) -> frag_extend A B f x = iterate_op (frag B) (fun a:set => fun b:set => frag_add B a b) (frag_support A x) (fun a:set => frag_cmul B (x a) (f a))

items.name: frag_neg_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e frag A, frag_neg A x = fun a :e A => - x a

items.name: frag_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall c :e A, frag_of A c = fun a :e A => if a = c then 1 else 0

items.name: frag_sub_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e frag A, frag_sub A x y = fun a :e A => x a + - y a

items.name: frag_support_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e frag A, frag_support A x = {a :e A | ~ x a = 0}

items.name: frag_tybij
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall a :e frag A, a = a) /\ forall r :e int :^: A, finite {x :e A | ~ r x = 0} <-> r = r

items.name: free_abelian_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, free_abelian_group A s = ({c :e frag A | frag_support A c c= s},(frag_0 A,(fun x :e frag A => frag_neg A x,fun x :e frag A => fun x0 :e frag A => frag_add A x x0)))

items.name: from_thm
items.statement: forall n :e omega, from n = {m :e omega | n <= m}

items.name: frontier_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, frontier_of A top s = closure_of A top s :\: interior_of A top s

items.name: frontier_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, frontier A s = closure A s :\: interior A s

items.name: fsigma_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall x c= A, x :e fsigma_in A top <-> exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x0 :e u, closed_in A top x0) /\ Union u = x

items.name: fsigma_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, fsigma N s <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, closed N x) /\ Union u = s

items.name: fstcart_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), fstcart M f = fun i :e idx M => f i

items.name: fundamental_group_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a :e R :^: idx N, forall s c= R :^: idx N, fundamental_group N (s,a) = {{x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx 1) | homotopic_paths N s (fun x0:set => p x0) (fun x0:set => x x0)} | p :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx 1), path N (fun x:set => p x) /\ (path_image N (fun x:set => p x) c= s /\ (pathstart N (fun x:set => p x) = a /\ pathfinish N (fun x:set => p x) = a))}

items.name: funspace_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric B, funspace A B s m = ({f :e B :^: A | (forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e mspace B m) /\ (f :e {x :e B :^: A | forall x0 :e A, ~ x0 :e s -> x x0 = choose_in B (fun y:set => True)} /\ mbounded B m {f x | x :e s})},fun p :e B :^: A :*: B :^: A => if s = Empty then 0 else sup {mdist B m (p 0 x,p 1 x) | x :e A, x :e s})

items.name: gauge_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall d :e Power (R :^: idx A) :^: (R :^: idx A), gauge A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e d x) <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e d x /\ open A (d x)

items.name: gdelta_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, gdelta_in A top = relative_to A {x :e Power A | exists u c= Power A, countable u /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e top) /\ {x0 :e A | forall Y :e u, x0 :e Y} = x} (topspace A top)

items.name: gdelta_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, gdelta N s <-> exists u c= Power (R :^: idx N), countable u /\ (forall x :e u, open N x) /\ {x :e R :^: idx N | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = s

items.name: ge_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall t c= B, forall s c= A, atleastp t s <-> atleastp t s

items.name: geom_mul_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), geom_mul N x y = Product N (fun s:set => fun t:set => (- 1) ^ finite_cardinality (\/_ i :e omega, {(i,j) | j :e omega, i :e idx N /\ (j :e idx N /\ (i :e s /\ (j :e t /\ j < i)))})) (fun s:set => fun t:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e (s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) x y

items.name: grade_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall p :e R :^: idx (multivector N), grade N k p = lambdas N (fun s:set => if equip s k then multivector_index N p s else 0)

items.name: group_action_thm
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> X <> Empty -> forall s c= X, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> (group_action_hl A X G s a <-> (forall g :e A, forall x :e X, g :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s -> a g x :e s) /\ ((forall x :e X, x :e s -> a (group_id A G) x = x) /\ forall g h :e A, forall x :e X, g :e group_carrier A G /\ (h :e group_carrier A G /\ x :e s) -> a (group_mul A G g h) x = a g (a h x)))

items.name: group_add_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall y x :e A, forall G :e group_hl A, group_add A G x y = if x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G then group_mul A G x y else if x :e group_carrier A G then y else if y :e group_carrier A G then x else choose_in A (fun w:set => ~ w :e group_carrier A G)

items.name: group_automorphism_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> (group_automorphism_hl A G f <-> group_isomorphism_hl A A (G,G) f)

items.name: group_carrier_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g :e group_hl A, group_carrier A g = g 0

items.name: group_centralizer_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall G :e group_hl A, group_centralizer A G s = {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ forall y :e A, y :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e s -> group_mul A G x y = group_mul A G y x}

items.name: group_conjugate_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s t c= A, group_conjugate A G s t <-> s c= group_carrier A G /\ (t c= group_carrier A G /\ exists a :e A, a :e group_carrier A G /\ {group_conjugation A G a x | x :e s} = t)

items.name: group_conjugation_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a :e A, group_conjugation A G a x = group_mul A G a (group_mul A G x (group_inv A G a))

items.name: group_div_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall G :e group_hl A, forall y :e A, group_div A G x y = group_mul A G x (group_inv A G y)

items.name: group_element_order_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall G :e group_hl A, group_element_order_hl A G x = choose_in omega (fun d:set => forall n :e omega, group_pow A G x n = group_id A G <-> divides_nat d n)

items.name: group_endomorphism_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e A) -> (group_endomorphism A G f <-> group_homomorphism_hl A A (G,G) f)

items.name: group_epimorphism_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, group_epimorphism A B (G,G') f <-> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f /\ {f x | x :e group_carrier A G} = group_carrier B G'

items.name: group_exactness_thm
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall f :e B :^: A, forall H :e group_hl B, forall K :e group_hl C, forall g :e C :^: B, group_exactness A B C (G,(H,K)) (f,g) <-> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,H) (fun x:set => f x) /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B C (H,K) (fun x:set => g x) /\ group_image A B (G,H) (fun x:set => f x) = group_kernel B C (H,K) (fun x:set => g x))

items.name: group_homomorphism_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f <-> {f x | x :e group_carrier A G} c= group_carrier B G' /\ (f (group_id A G) = group_id B G' /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> f (group_inv A G x) = group_inv B G' (f x)) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ y :e group_carrier A G -> f (group_mul A G x y) = group_mul B G' (f x) (f y))))

items.name: group_id_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g :e group_hl A, group_id A g = g 1 0

items.name: group_image_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall G :e group_hl A, group_image A B (G,G') f = {f x | x :e group_carrier A G}

items.name: group_inv_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall g :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, group_inv A g x = g 1 1 0 x

items.name: group_isomorphism_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f :e B :^: A, group_isomorphism_hl A B (G,G') (fun x:set => f x) <-> exists g :e A :^: B, group_isomorphisms A B (G,G') (f,g)

items.name: group_isomorphisms_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e A :^: B, group_isomorphisms A B (G,G') (f,g) <-> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') (fun x:set => f x) /\ (group_homomorphism_hl B A (G',G) (fun x:set => g x) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e group_carrier B G' -> f (g y) = y))

items.name: group_kernel_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall G' :e group_hl B, group_kernel A B (G,G') f = {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ f x = group_id B G'}

items.name: group_monomorphism_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G' :e group_hl B, forall G :e group_hl A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (group_monomorphism A B (G,G') f <-> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f /\ forall x y :e A, x :e group_carrier A G /\ (y :e group_carrier A G /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: group_mul_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall g :e group_hl A, forall x x0 :e A, group_mul A g x x0 = g 1 1 1 x x0

items.name: group_neg_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, group_neg A G x = if x :e group_carrier A G then group_inv A G x else x

items.name: group_nmul_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, group_nmul A G 0 x = group_id A G /\ group_nmul A G (ordsucc n) x = group_add A G x (group_nmul A G n x)

items.name: group_normalizer_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, group_normalizer A G s = {x :e A | x :e group_carrier A G /\ group_setmul A G {x} (group_carrier A G :/\: s) = group_setmul A G (group_carrier A G :/\: s) {x}}

items.name: group_orbit_thm
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= X, forall G :e group_hl A, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x y :e X, group_orbit A X G s a x y <-> x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ exists g :e A, g :e group_carrier A G /\ a g x = y)

items.name: group_pow_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e omega, group_pow A G x 0 = group_id A G /\ group_pow A G x (ordsucc n) = group_mul A G x (group_pow A G x n)

items.name: group_setinv_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g c= A, forall G :e group_hl A, group_setinv A G g = {group_inv A G x | x :e A, x :e g}

items.name: group_setmul_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g h c= A, forall G :e group_hl A, group_setmul A G g h = \/_ x :e A, {group_mul A G x y | y :e A, x :e g /\ y :e h}

items.name: group_stabilizer_thm
items.statement: forall A X:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall a:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e X, a x y :e X) -> forall x :e X, group_stabilizer A X G a x = {g :e A | g :e group_carrier A G /\ a g x = x}

items.name: group_tybij
items.statement: forall A:set, (forall a :e group_hl A, a = a) /\ forall r :e Power A :*: (A :*: (A :^: A :*: A :^: A :^: A)), r 1 0 :e r 0 /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e r 0 -> r 1 1 0 x :e r 0) /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e r 0 /\ y :e r 0 -> r 1 1 1 x y :e r 0) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, x :e r 0 /\ (y :e r 0 /\ z :e r 0) -> r 1 1 1 x (r 1 1 1 y z) = r 1 1 1 (r 1 1 1 x y) z) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e r 0 -> r 1 1 1 (r 1 0) x = x /\ r 1 1 1 x (r 1 0) = x) /\ (forall x :e A, x :e r 0 -> r 1 1 1 (r 1 1 0 x) x = r 1 0 /\ r 1 1 1 x (r 1 1 0 x) = r 1 0))))) <-> r = r

items.name: group_zpow_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall n :e int, group_zpow A G x n = if 0 <= n then group_pow A G x (if n :e omega then n else 0) else group_inv A G (group_pow A G x (if - n :e omega then - n else 0))

items.name: gt_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall t c= B, forall s c= A, atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s <-> atleastp t s /\ ~ equip t s

items.name: has_bounded_setvariation_on_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (has_bounded_setvariation_on M N f s <-> exists B :e R, forall d c= Power (R :^: idx M), forall t c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d t /\ t c= s -> finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) <= B)

items.name: has_bounded_variation_on_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, has_bounded_variation_on N f s <-> has_bounded_setvariation_on 1 N (fun k:set => vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 k)) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 k))) s

items.name: has_derivative_at
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (at M x) <-> linear M N f' /\ tendsto N (R :^: idx M) (fun y:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm M (vector_sub M y x))) (vector_sub N (f y) (vector_add N (f x) (f' (vector_sub M y x))))) (vec N 0) (at M x)

items.name: has_derivative_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f' x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx B), has_derivative A B f f' net0 <-> linear B A f' /\ tendsto A (R :^: idx B) (fun y:set => vector_mul A (recip_SNo (vector_norm B (vector_sub B y (netlimit (R :^: idx B) net0)))) (vector_sub A (f y) (vector_add A (f (netlimit (R :^: idx B) net0)) (f' (vector_sub B y (netlimit (R :^: idx B) net0)))))) (vec A 0) net0

items.name: has_derivative_within
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall f':set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f' x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx M, forall s c= R :^: idx M, has_derivative N M f f' (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s) <-> linear M N f' /\ tendsto N (R :^: idx M) (fun y:set => vector_mul N (recip_SNo (vector_norm M (vector_sub M y x))) (vector_sub N (f y) (vector_add N (f x) (f' (vector_sub M y x))))) (vec N 0) (within (R :^: idx M) (at M x) s)

items.name: has_inf
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, is_glb s b <-> forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> c <= x) <-> c <= b

items.name: has_integral_compact_interval_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall i c= R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall y :e R :^: idx B, has_integral_compact_interval A B f y i <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d:set -> set -> prop, gauge A d /\ forall p c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), tagged_division_of A p i /\ fine (R :^: idx A) (R :^: idx A) d p -> vector_norm B (vector_sub B (vsum (R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A)) B p (fun p0:set => vector_mul B (content A (p0 1)) (f (p0 0)))) y) < e0

items.name: has_integral_def
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall i c= R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall y :e R :^: idx B, has_integral A B f y i <-> ((exists a b :e R :^: idx A, i = closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> has_integral_compact_interval A B f y i) /\ (~ (exists a b :e R :^: idx A, i = closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) -> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists B0 :e R, 0 < B0 /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx A, ball A (vec A 0,B0) c= closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) -> exists z :e R :^: idx B, has_integral_compact_interval A B (fun x:set => if x :e i then f x else vec B 0) z (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) /\ vector_norm B (vector_sub B z y) < e0)

items.name: has_measure_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e R, forall s c= R :^: idx A, has_measure A s m <-> has_integral A 1 (fun x:set => vec 1 1) (lift m) s

items.name: has_sup
items.statement: forall s c= R, forall b :e R, is_lub s b <-> forall c :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= c) <-> b <= c

items.name: has_vector_derivative_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall f' :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), has_vector_derivative A f f' net0 <-> has_derivative A 1 f (fun x:set => vector_mul A (drop x) f') net0

items.name: hausdist_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall t s c= R :^: idx N, hausdist N (s,t) = if ~ {setdist N ({x},t) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} :\/: {setdist N ({y},s) | y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t} = Empty /\ exists b :e R, forall d :e R, d :e {setdist N ({x},t) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} :\/: {setdist N ({y},s) | y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t} -> d <= b then sup ({setdist N ({x},t) | x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s} :\/: {setdist N ({y},s) | y :e R :^: idx N, y :e t}) else 0

items.name: hausdorff_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, hausdorff_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ x = y) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (x :e u /\ (y :e v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: hereditarily_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= topology A, forall top :e topology A, hereditarily A P top <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> subtopology A top s :e P

items.name: hom_relboundary_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t c= A, forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall x c= frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall x0 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), hom_relboundary A p (top,(s,t)) x x0 <-> hom_induced A A (p + - 1) (subtopology A top s,Empty) (subtopology A top s,t) (fun x1 :e A => x1) (hom_boundary A p (top,s) x) x0

items.name: homeomorphic_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top' :e topology B, forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (homeomorphic_map A B (top,top') f <-> quotient_map A B (top,top') f /\ forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> (f x = f y <-> x = y))

items.name: homeomorphic_maps_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e A :^: B, homeomorphic_maps A B (top,top') (f,g) <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ (continuous_map B A (top',top) (fun x:set => g x) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> g (f x) = x) /\ forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> f (g y) = y))

items.name: homeomorphic_space_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homeomorphic_space A B top top' <-> exists f :e B :^: A, exists g :e A :^: B, homeomorphic_maps A B (top,top') (f,g)

items.name: homeomorphic_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx B, forall t c= R :^: idx A, homeomorphic A B s t <-> exists f :e R :^: idx A :^: (R :^: idx B), exists g :e R :^: idx B :^: (R :^: idx A), homeomorphism B A (s,t) (f,g)

items.name: homeomorphism_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f :e R :^: idx B :^: (R :^: idx A), forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall g :e R :^: idx A :^: (R :^: idx B), forall t c= R :^: idx B, homeomorphism A B (s,t) (f,g) <-> (forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> g (f x) = x) /\ ({f x | x :e s} = t /\ (continuous_on_hl A B (fun x:set => f x) s /\ ((forall y :e R :^: idx B, y :e t -> f (g y) = y) /\ ({g x | x :e t} = s /\ continuous_on_hl B A (fun x:set => g x) t))))

items.name: homologous_rel_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, forall c1 c2 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), homologous_rel A (p,(top,s)) c1 c2 <-> singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) (frag_sub (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c1 c2)

items.name: homology_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, homology_group A (p,top) = relative_homology_group A (p,(top,Empty))

items.name: homotopic_loops_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx A) -> (homotopic_loops A s p q <-> homotopic_with (R :^: idx A) (R :^: idx 1) {r :e R :^: idx A :^: (R :^: idx 1) | pathfinish A (fun x:set => r x) = pathstart A (fun x:set => r x)} (subtopology (R :^: idx 1) (euclidean 1) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)),subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) p q)

items.name: homotopic_paths_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx A) -> (homotopic_paths A s p q <-> homotopic_with (R :^: idx A) (R :^: idx 1) {r :e R :^: idx A :^: (R :^: idx 1) | pathstart A (fun x:set => r x) = pathstart A p /\ pathfinish A (fun x:set => r x) = pathfinish A p} (subtopology (R :^: idx 1) (euclidean 1) (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)),subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) s) p q)

items.name: homotopic_with_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall X :e topology B, forall Y :e topology A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e B, p x :e A) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e B, q x :e A) -> forall P c= A :^: B, homotopic_with A B P (X,Y) p q <-> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e R :*: B, h x :e A) /\ (continuous_map (R :*: B) A (prod_topology R B (subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil))) X,Y) h /\ ((forall x :e B, h (0,x) = p x) /\ ((forall x :e B, h (1,x) = q x) /\ forall t :e R, t :e closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil) -> (fun x :e B => h (t,x)) :e P)))

items.name: homotopy_equivalent_space_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, homotopy_equivalent_space A B top top' <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e A) /\ (continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (continuous_map B A (top',top) g /\ (homotopic_with A A {x :e A :^: A | True} (top,top) (fun x:set => g (f x)) (fun x:set => x) /\ homotopic_with B B {x :e B :^: B | True} (top',top') (fun x:set => f (g x)) (fun x:set => x))))

items.name: homotopy_equivalent_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall t c= R :^: idx N, homotopy_equivalent M N s t <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) /\ exists g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, g x :e R :^: idx M) /\ (continuous_on_hl M N f s /\ ({f x | x :e s} c= t /\ (continuous_on_hl N M g t /\ ({g x | x :e t} c= s /\ (homotopic_with (R :^: idx M) (R :^: idx M) {x :e R :^: idx M :^: (R :^: idx M) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s,subtopology (R :^: idx M) (euclidean M) s) (fun x:set => g (f x)) (fun x:set => x) /\ homotopic_with (R :^: idx N) (R :^: idx N) {x :e R :^: idx N :^: (R :^: idx N) | True} (subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t,subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) t) (fun x:set => f (g x)) (fun x:set => x))))))

items.name: hull_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s c= A, hull A P s = {x :e A | forall Y :e {t :e Power A | t :e P /\ s c= t}, x :e Y}

items.name: in_direction_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a v :e R :^: idx A, in_direction A a v = within (R :^: idx A) (at A a) {b :e R :^: idx A | exists c :e R, 0 <= c /\ vector_sub A b a = vector_mul A c v}

items.name: independent_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, independent A s <-> ~ dependent A s

items.name: index_def
items.statement: forall p n :e omega, prime_index p n = if p <= 1 \/ n = 0 then 0 else finite_cardinality {j :e omega | 1 <= j /\ divides_nat (p ^ j) n}

items.name: indicator_thm
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, indicator M s x = if x :e s then vec 1 1 else vec 1 0

items.name: inf_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R, inf s = choose_in R (fun a:set => (forall x :e R, x :e s -> a <= x) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> b <= x) -> b <= a)

items.name: infnorm_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, infnorm N x = sup {abs_SNo (x i) | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N}

items.name: infsum_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, infsum A s f = choose_in (R :^: idx A) (fun l:set => sums A f l s)

items.name: inner_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), inner N x y = Product N (fun s:set => fun t:set => if s = Empty \/ (t = Empty \/ ~ (s :\: t = Empty /\ ~ t :\: s = Empty)) then 0 else (- 1) ^ finite_cardinality (\/_ i :e omega, {(i,j) | j :e omega, i :e idx N /\ (j :e idx N /\ (i :e s /\ (j :e t /\ j < i)))})) (fun s:set => fun t:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e (s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) x y

items.name: inseg
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m l:set -> set -> prop, inseg_on A l m <-> forall x y :e A, l x y <-> m x y /\ y :e fld_on A l

items.name: inside_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, inside N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | ~ x :e s /\ bounded_hl N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x x0}}

items.name: int_INFINITE
items.statement: infinite int

items.name: int_abs
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo x = if abs_SNo x :e int then abs_SNo x else 0

items.name: int_abs_th
items.statement: forall x :e int, abs_SNo x = abs_SNo x

items.name: int_abstr
items.statement: forall a :e int, (if a :e int then a else 0) = a

items.name: int_add
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + y = if x + y :e int then x + y else 0

items.name: int_add_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + y = x + y

items.name: int_congruent
items.statement: forall x y n :e int, divides_int n (x + - y) <-> exists d :e int, x + - y = n * d

items.name: int_coprime
items.statement: forall a b :e int, gcd_int a b = 1 <-> exists x y :e int, a * x + b * y = 1

items.name: int_divides
items.statement: forall b a :e int, divides_int a b <-> exists x :e int, b = a * x

items.name: int_eq
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x = y <-> x = y

items.name: int_gcd
items.statement: forall a b :e int, 0 <= gcd_int a b /\ (divides_int (gcd_int a b) a /\ (divides_int (gcd_int a b) b /\ exists x y :e int, gcd_int a b = a * x + b * y))

items.name: int_ge
items.statement: forall x y :e int, y <= x <-> y <= x

items.name: int_gt
items.statement: forall x y :e int, y < x <-> y < x

items.name: int_lcm
items.statement: forall m n :e int, lcm_int m n = if m * n = 0 then 0 else div_int (abs_SNo (m * n)) (gcd_int m n)

items.name: int_le
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x <= y <-> x <= y

items.name: int_lt
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x < y <-> x < y

items.name: int_max
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if x <= y then y else x) = if (if x <= y then y else x) :e int then if x <= y then y else x else 0

items.name: int_max_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if x <= y then y else x) = if x <= y then y else x

items.name: int_min
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if x <= y then x else y) = if (if x <= y then x else y) :e int then if x <= y then x else y else 0

items.name: int_min_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, (if x <= y then x else y) = if x <= y then x else y

items.name: int_mod
items.statement: forall n x y :e int, divides_int n (x + - y) <-> divides_int n (x + - y)

items.name: int_mul
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x * y = if x * y :e int then x * y else 0

items.name: int_mul_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x * y = x * y

items.name: int_neg
items.statement: forall i :e int, - i = if - i :e int then - i else 0

items.name: int_neg_th
items.statement: forall x :e int, - x = - x

items.name: int_of_num
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n = if n :e int then n else 0

items.name: int_of_num_th
items.statement: forall n :e omega, n = n

items.name: int_pow
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, x ^ n = if x ^ n :e int then x ^ n else 0

items.name: int_pow_th
items.statement: forall x :e int, forall n :e omega, x ^ n = x ^ n

items.name: int_rep
items.statement: forall r :e R, r :e int <-> (if r :e int then r else 0) = r

items.name: int_sgn
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) :e int then if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0 else 0

items.name: int_sgn_th
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: int_sub
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - y = if x + - y :e int then x + - y else 0

items.name: int_sub_th
items.statement: forall x y :e int, x + - y = x + - y

items.name: int_tybij
items.statement: (forall a :e int, (if a :e int then a else 0) = a) /\ forall r :e R, r :e int <-> (if r :e int then r else 0) = r

items.name: integer
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int <-> exists n :e omega, abs_SNo x = n

items.name: integer_group_thm
items.statement: integer_group = (int,(0,(fun x :e int => - x,fun x :e int => fun x0 :e int => x + x0)))

items.name: integer_mod_group_thm
items.statement: forall n :e omega, integer_mod_group n = if n = 0 then integer_group else ({m :e int | 0 <= m /\ m < n},(0,(fun a :e int => rem_int (- a) n,fun a :e int => fun b :e int => rem_int (a + b) n)))

items.name: integrable_on_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall i c= R :^: idx B, integrable_on A B f i <-> exists y :e R :^: idx A, has_integral B A f y i

items.name: integral_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall i c= R :^: idx B, integral A B i f = choose_in (R :^: idx A) (fun y:set => has_integral B A f y i)

items.name: interior_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, interior_of A top s = {x :e A | exists t c= A, t :e top /\ (x :e t /\ t c= s)}

items.name: interior_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, interior A s = {x :e R :^: idx A | exists t c= R :^: idx A, open A t /\ (x :e t /\ t c= s)}

items.name: interval
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open_interval N (a,b) = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < x i /\ x i < b i} /\ closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= x i /\ x i <= b i}

items.name: interval_bij_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x b a v u :e R :^: idx N, interval_bij N (a,b) (u,v) x = fun i :e idx N => u i + (x i + - a i) :/: (b i + - a i) * (v i + - u i)

items.name: interval_lowerbound_thm
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, interval_lowerbound M s = fun i :e idx M => inf {a :e R | exists x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ x i = a}

items.name: interval_upperbound_thm
items.statement: forall M:set, M <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, interval_upperbound M s = fun i :e idx M => sup {a :e R | exists x :e R :^: idx M, x :e s /\ x i = a}

items.name: inverse_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall y :e A, inverse A B f y = choose_in B (fun x:set => f x = y)

items.name: invertible_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, invertible M N A <-> exists A' :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N M A A' = mat M M 1 /\ matrix_mul N M N A' A = mat N N 1

items.name: iproduct
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e int) -> finprod x x0 = iterate_op int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) x x0

items.name: is_int
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e int <-> exists n :e omega, x = n \/ x = - n

items.name: is_interval_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, is_interval N s <-> forall a b x :e R :^: idx N, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i <= x i /\ x i <= b i \/ b i <= x i /\ x i <= a i)) -> x :e s

items.name: is_metric_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall d :e R :^: (A :*: A), is_metric_space A (s,d) <-> (forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> 0 <= d (x,y)) /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> (d (x,y) = 0 <-> x = y)) /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> d (x,y) = d (y,x)) /\ forall x y z :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ z :e s) -> d (x,z) <= d (x,y) + d (y,z)))
