items.name: is_nadd_0
items.error: internal constant is_nadd (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: is_realinterval_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R, is_realinterval s <-> forall a b c :e R, a :e s /\ (b :e s /\ (a <= c /\ c <= b)) -> c :e s

items.name: isomorphic_group_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, isomorphic_group A B G G' <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ group_isomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f

items.name: istopology_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall L c= Power A, istopology A L <-> Empty :e L /\ ((forall s t c= A, s :e L /\ t :e L -> s :/\: t :e L) /\ forall k c= Power A, k c= L -> Union k :e L)

items.name: isum
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e int) -> finsum x x0 = iterate_op int (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) x x0

items.name: iterate
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall s c= A, forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> iterate_op B op s f = if finite {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} then set_foldr (fun x:set => op (f x)) {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} (neutral_of B op) else neutral_of B op

items.name: iterato
items.error: internal constant iterato (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: jacobian_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx A), jacobian A B f net0 = matrix A B (frechet_derivative B A f net0)

items.name: joinpaths
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g1:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g1 x :e A) -> forall g2:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g2 x :e A) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, poly_add A g1 g2 x = if drop x <= 1 :/: 2 then g1 (vector_mul 1 2 x) else g2 (vector_sub 1 (vector_mul 1 2 x) (vec 1 1))

items.name: k_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, k_space A top <-> forall s c= A, s c= topspace A top -> (closed_in A top s <-> forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> closed_in A (subtopology A top k) (k :/\: s))

items.name: kc_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, kc_space A top <-> forall s c= A, compact_in A top s -> closed_in A top s

items.name: kification_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, kification A top = {s :e Power A | s c= topspace A top /\ forall k c= A, compact_in A top k -> k :/\: s :e subtopology A top k}

items.name: kolmogorov_quotient_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x :e A, kolmogorov_quotient A top x = choose_in A (fun y:set => forall u c= A, u :e top -> (y :e u <-> x :e u))

items.name: lambda
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, g x :e A) -> (fun i :e idx B => g i) = choose_in (A :^: idx B) (fun f:set => forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex B -> f i = g i)

items.name: lambdas_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e Power omega, g x :e R) -> lambdas N g = fun i :e idx (multivector N) => g (codeset i)

items.name: lcm
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, lcm_int m n = if m * n = 0 then 0 else div_nat (m * n) (gcd_int m n)

items.name: le_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, atleastp s t <-> exists f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> f x :e t) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ f x = f y) -> x = y)

items.name: lebesgue_measurable_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, lebesgue_measurable N s <-> measurable_on N 1 (fun x:set => indicator N s x) (R :^: idx N)

items.name: left_coset_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall x :e A, forall h c= A, left_coset_hl A G x h = group_setmul A G {x} h

items.name: lemma
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall s c= A, forall e0 :e R, finsum s (fun x:set => vector_norm N (vector_sub N (f x) (g x))) < e0 -> finite s -> abs_SNo (finsum s (fun x:set => vector_norm N (f x)) + - finsum s (fun x:set => vector_norm N (g x))) < e0

items.name: lift_thm
items.statement: forall x :e R, lift x = fun i :e idx 1 => x

items.name: lifted_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall op :e A :^: B :^: B, forall rel :e 1 :+: B, forall x y :e B, lifted A B op (Inj0 0) rel = Inj0 0 /\ (lifted A B op rel (Inj0 0) = Inj0 0 /\ lifted A B op (Inj1 x) (Inj1 y) = Inj1 (op x y))

items.name: lim_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall net0 :e net B, lim A B net0 f = choose_in (R :^: idx A) (fun l:set => tendsto A B f l net0)

items.name: limit_point_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A, limit_point_of A x s <-> forall t c= R :^: idx A, x :e t /\ open A t -> exists y :e R :^: idx A, ~ y = x /\ (y :e s /\ y :e t)

items.name: limit_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology B, forall l :e B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall net0 :e net A, limit A B top f l net0 <-> l :e topspace B top /\ forall u c= B, u :e top /\ l :e u -> eventually A {x :e A | f x :e u} net0

items.name: lindelof_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, lindelof_space A top <-> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top -> exists V c= Power A, countable V /\ (V c= U /\ Union V = topspace A top)

items.name: linear_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (linear M N f <-> (forall x y :e R :^: idx M, f (vector_add M x y) = vector_add N (f x) (f y)) /\ forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx M, f (vector_mul M c x) = vector_mul N c (f x))

items.name: linepath_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, forall x :e R :^: idx 1, linepath A (a,b) x = vector_add A (vector_mul A (1 + - drop x) a) (vector_mul A (drop x) b)

items.name: linseg
items.statement: forall A:set, forall l:set -> set -> prop, forall a x y :e A, linseg_rel l a x y <-> l x y /\ properly_rel l y a

items.name: lipschitz_continuous_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m2 :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> forall m1 :e metric B, lipschitz_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f <-> {f x | x :e mspace B m1} c= mspace A m2 /\ exists B0 :e R, forall x y :e B, x :e mspace B m1 /\ y :e mspace B m1 -> mdist A m2 (f x,f y) <= B0 * mdist B m1 (x,y)

items.name: list_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, l = seq_nil \/ exists h :e A, exists t :e finseq A, l = seq_cons h t

items.name: list_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P seq_nil /\ (forall a0 :e A, forall a1 :e finseq A, P a1 -> P (seq_cons a0 a1)) -> forall x :e finseq A, P x

items.name: list_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A Z:set, A <> Empty -> forall NIL' :e Z, forall CONS':set -> set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e finseq A, forall z :e Z, CONS' x y z :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e finseq A, fn x :e Z) /\ (fn seq_nil = NIL' /\ forall a0 :e A, forall a1 :e finseq A, fn (seq_cons a0 a1) = CONS' a0 a1 (fn a1))

items.name: list_of_seq
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> forall n :e omega, seq_mk 0 s = seq_nil /\ seq_mk (ordsucc n) s = seq_append (seq_mk n s) (seq_cons (s n) seq_nil)

items.name: list_of_set
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s) = choose_in (finseq A) (fun l:set => seq_set l = s /\ seq_len l = finite_cardinality s)

items.name: locally_compact_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_compact_space A top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists u k c= A, u :e top /\ (compact_in A top k /\ (x :e u /\ u c= k))

items.name: locally_connected_at_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall top :e topology A, locally_connected_at A x top <-> neighbourhood_base_at A x {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ connected_in A top u} top

items.name: locally_connected_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_connected_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {x :e Power A | connected_in A top x} top

items.name: locally_finite_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall U c= Power A, locally_finite_in A top U <-> (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u c= topspace A top) /\ forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> exists v c= A, v :e top /\ (x :e v /\ finite {u :e Power A | u :e U /\ ~ u :/\: v = Empty})

items.name: locally_path_connected_at_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_at A x top <-> neighbourhood_base_at A x {u :e Power A | u :e top /\ path_connected_in A top u} top

items.name: locally_path_connected_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, locally_path_connected_space A top <-> neighbourhood_base_of A {x :e Power A | path_connected_in A top x} top

items.name: locally_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, forall P c= Power (R :^: idx N), locally N P s <-> forall w c= R :^: idx N, forall x :e R :^: idx N, w :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ x :e w -> exists u v c= R :^: idx N, u :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) s /\ (v :e P /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ v c= w)))

items.name: lt_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall t c= B, forall s c= A, atleastp s t /\ ~ equip s t <-> atleastp s t /\ ~ atleastp t s

items.name: manhattan_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> manhattan N = (R :^: idx N,fun p :e R :^: idx N :*: R :^: idx N => finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => abs_SNo (p 0 i + - p 1 i)))

items.name: mat_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, mat M N k = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => if i = j then k else 0

items.name: matrify_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N), matrify A M N x = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => x (minus_nat i 1 * dimindex N + j)

items.name: matrix_add_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_add M N A B = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => A i j + B i j

items.name: matrix_cmul_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_cmul M N c A = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => c * A i j

items.name: matrix_inv_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, matrix_inv M N A = matrix N M (fun y:set => choose_in (R :^: idx M) (fun x:set => (forall w :e R :^: idx M, matrix_vector_mul N M A w = vec N 0 -> orthogonal M x w) /\ forall z :e R :^: idx M, orthogonal N (vector_sub N y (matrix_vector_mul N M A x)) (matrix_vector_mul N M A z)))

items.name: matrix_mul_thm
items.statement: forall M N P:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall B :e R :^: idx P :^: idx N, matrix_mul M N P A B = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx P => finsum (idx N) (fun k:set => A i k * B k j)

items.name: matrix_neg_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_neg M N A = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => - A i j

items.name: matrix_sub_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A B :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, matrix_sub M N A B = fun i :e idx M => fun j :e idx N => A i j + - B i j

items.name: matrix_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> matrix M N f = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx M => f (basis M j) i

items.name: matrix_vector_mul_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx N, matrix_vector_mul M N A x = fun i :e idx M => finsum (idx N) (fun j:set => A i j * x j)

items.name: matroid_basis_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_basis A m s <-> matroid_spanning A m s /\ matroid_independent A m s

items.name: matroid_dependent_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_dependent A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ ~ matroid_independent A m s

items.name: matroid_dim_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_dim A m s = matroid_dimension A (submatroid A m s)

items.name: matroid_dimension_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_dimension A m = choose_in omega (fun n:set => forall b c= A, matroid_basis A m b -> equip b n)

items.name: matroid_finite_dim_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, s :e matroid_finite_dim A m <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ submatroid A m s :e matroid_finite_dimensional A

items.name: matroid_finite_dimensional_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, m :e matroid_finite_dimensional A <-> exists b c= A, finite b /\ matroid_spanning A m b

items.name: matroid_independent_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_independent A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> ~ x :e {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m (s :\: {x}) x0}

items.name: matroid_set_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, matroid_set A m = m 0

items.name: matroid_span_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e matroid A, forall x c= A, forall x0 :e A, matroid_span A m x x0 <-> x0 :e m 1 x

items.name: matroid_spanning_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e matroid A, matroid_spanning A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> x :e matroid_set A m

items.name: matroid_subspace_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e matroid A, forall s c= A, matroid_subspace A m s <-> s c= matroid_set A m /\ forall x :e A, matroid_span A m s x <-> x :e s

items.name: matroid_tybij
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall a :e matroid A, a = a) /\ forall r :e Power A :*: Power A :^: Power A, (forall s c= A, s c= r 0 -> r 1 s c= r 0) /\ ((forall s c= A, s c= r 0 -> s c= r 1 s) /\ ((forall s t c= A, s c= t /\ t c= r 0 -> r 1 s c= r 1 t) /\ ((forall s c= A, s c= r 0 -> r 1 (r 1 s) = r 1 s) /\ ((forall s c= A, forall x :e A, s c= r 0 /\ x :e r 1 s -> exists s' c= A, finite s' /\ (s' c= s /\ x :e r 1 s')) /\ (forall s c= A, forall x y :e A, s c= r 0 /\ (x :e r 0 /\ (y :e r 1 (SetAdjoin s x) /\ ~ y :e r 1 s)) -> x :e r 1 (SetAdjoin s y)))))) <-> r = r

items.name: mball_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, mball A m (x,r) = {y :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) < r)}

items.name: mbasis_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall i c= omega, mbasis A i = lambdas A (fun s:set => if i = s then 1 else 0)

items.name: mbounded_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric A, mbounded A m s <-> exists c :e A, exists b :e R, s c= mcball A m (c,b)

items.name: mcball_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall r :e R, mcball A m (x,r) = {y :e A | x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) <= r)}

items.name: mcomplete_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mcomplete A m <-> forall s:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, s x :e A) -> cauchy_in A m s -> exists x :e A, limit omega A (mtopology A m) s x sequentially

items.name: mdiameter_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric A, mdiameter A m s = if s = Empty then 0 else sup (\/_ x :e A, {mdist A m (x,y) | y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s})

items.name: mdist_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A :*: A, mdist A m x = m 1 x

items.name: measurable_on_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (measurable_on M N f s <-> exists k c= R :^: idx M, exists g:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e omega, forall y :e R :^: idx M, g x y :e R :^: idx N) /\ (negligible M k /\ ((forall n :e omega, continuous_on_hl M N (g n) (R :^: idx M)) /\ forall x :e R :^: idx M, ~ x :e k -> tendsto N omega (fun n:set => g n x) (if x :e s then f x else vec N 0) sequentially)))

items.name: measurable_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measurable A s <-> exists m :e R, has_measure A s m

items.name: measure_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, measure A s = choose_in R (fun m:set => has_measure A s m)

items.name: metric_tybij
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall a :e metric A, a = a) /\ forall r :e Power A :*: R :^: (A :*: A), is_metric_space A r <-> r = r

items.name: metrizable_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, metrizable_space A top <-> exists m :e metric A, top = mtopology A m

items.name: midpoint_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, midpoint A (a,b) = vector_mul A (recip_SNo 2) (vector_add A a b)

items.name: minimal
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, P m -> n <= m) = choose_in omega (fun n:set => P n /\ forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m)

items.name: mk_pair_def
items.error: internal constant mk_pair (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: mod_subset_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall c1 c2 :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), mod_subset A (p,top) c1 c2 <-> singular_chain A (p,top) (frag_sub (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c1 c2)

items.name: monoidal
items.statement: forall A:set, forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> ((forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ (forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ (forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x) <-> (forall x y :e A, op x y = op y x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, op x (op y z) = op (op x y) z) /\ forall x :e A, op (neutral_of A op) x = x))

items.name: monotone_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top' :e topology B, forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (monotone_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} c= topspace B top' /\ forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> connected_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y})

items.name: mspace_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mspace A m = m 0

items.name: msphere_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall m :e metric A, forall x :e A, forall e0 :e R, msphere A m (x,e0) = {y :e A | mdist A m (x,y) = e0}

items.name: mtopology_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, mtopology A m = {u :e Power A | u c= mspace A m /\ forall x :e A, x :e u -> exists r :e R, 0 < r /\ mball A m (x,r) c= u}

items.name: mul_c
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= B, forall t c= A, s :*: t = \/_ x :e B, {(x,y) | y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e t}

items.name: multivec_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, multivec N x = vsum omega (multivector N) (idx N) (fun i:set => vector_mul (multivector N) (x i) (mbasis N {i}))

items.name: multivector_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall p :e R :^: idx (multivector N), forall k :e omega, multivector_hl N k p <-> forall s c= omega, s c= idx N /\ ~ multivector_index N p s = 0 -> equip s k

items.name: multivector_tybij
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> (forall a :e multivector N, a = a) /\ forall r c= omega, r c= idx N <-> r = r

items.name: multivector_tybij_th
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> exists s c= omega, s c= idx N

items.name: nadd_rep
items.error: internal constant dest_nadd (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: negligible_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, negligible A s <-> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, has_integral A 1 (fun x:set => indicator A s x) (vec 1 0) (closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))

items.name: neighbourhood_base_at_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall P c= Power A, forall x :e A, neighbourhood_base_at A x P top <-> forall w c= A, w :e top /\ x :e w -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e P /\ (x :e u /\ (u c= v /\ v c= w)))

items.name: neighbourhood_base_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall top :e topology A, neighbourhood_base_of A P top <-> forall x :e A, x :e topspace A top -> neighbourhood_base_at A x P top

items.name: net_tybij
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall a :e net A, a = a) /\ forall r :e Power (Power A) :*: Power A, (forall s t c= A, s :e r 0 /\ t :e r 0 -> s :/\: t :e r 0) <-> r = r

items.name: netfilter_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e net A, netfilter A n = n 0

items.name: netlimit_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e net A, netlimit A n = choose_in A (fun x:set => x :e netlimits A n)

items.name: netlimits_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e net A, netlimits A n = n 1

items.name: neutral
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> neutral_of A op = choose_in A (fun x:set => forall y :e A, op x y = y /\ op y x = y)

items.name: normal_matrix_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, normal_matrix_hl N A <-> matrix_mul N N N (transp N N A) A = matrix_mul N N N A (transp N N A)

items.name: normal_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, normal_space A top <-> forall s t c= A, closed_in A top s /\ (closed_in A top t /\ s :/\: t = Empty) -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (s c= u /\ (t c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: normal_subgroup_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall n c= A, normal_subgroup_of A n G <-> subgroup_of A n G /\ forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> left_coset_hl A G x n = right_coset_hl A G n x

items.name: nproduct
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e omega) -> finprod x x0 = iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) x x0

items.name: nsphere_thm
items.statement: forall n :e omega, nsphere n = subtopology (R :^: omega) (euclidean_space (n + 1)) {x :e R :^: omega | finsum (idx_n (n + 1)) (fun i:set => x i ^ 2) = 1}

items.name: nsum
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e omega) -> finsum x x0 = iterate_op omega (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) x x0

items.name: num_Axiom
items.statement: forall A:set, forall e0 :e A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e omega, f x y :e A) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, fn x :e A) /\ (fn 0 = e0 /\ (forall n :e omega, fn (ordsucc n) = f (fn n) n) /\ forall y:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, y x :e A) -> y 0 = e0 /\ (forall n :e omega, y (ordsucc n) = f (y n) n) -> forall x :e omega, y x = fn x)

items.name: num_CASES
items.statement: forall m :e omega, m = 0 \/ exists n :e omega, m = ordsucc n

items.name: num_FINITE
items.statement: forall s c= omega, finite s <-> exists a :e omega, forall x :e omega, x :e s -> x <= a

items.name: num_FINITE_AVOID
items.statement: forall s c= omega, finite s -> exists a :e omega, ~ a :e s

items.name: num_INDUCTION
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 /\ (forall n :e omega, P n -> P (ordsucc n)) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: num_INDUCTION_DOWN
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall m :e omega, (forall n :e omega, m <= n -> P n) /\ (forall n :e omega, n < m /\ P (n + 1) -> P n) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: num_INFINITE
items.statement: infinite omega

items.name: num_INFINITE_EQ
items.statement: forall s c= omega, infinite s <-> forall N :e omega, exists n :e omega, N <= n /\ n :e s

items.name: num_MAX
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists x :e omega, P x) /\ (exists M :e omega, forall x :e omega, P x -> x <= M) <-> exists m :e omega, P m /\ forall x :e omega, P x -> x <= m

items.name: num_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall e0 :e A, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e omega, f x y :e A) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, fn x :e A) /\ (fn 0 = e0 /\ forall n :e omega, fn (ordsucc n) = f (fn n) n)

items.name: num_WF
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (forall n :e omega, (forall m :e omega, m < n -> P m) -> P n) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: num_WF_DOWN
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, forall m :e omega, (forall n :e omega, m <= n -> P n) /\ (forall n :e omega, n < m /\ (forall p :e omega, n < p -> P p) -> P n) -> forall n :e omega, P n

items.name: num_WOP
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, (exists n :e omega, P n) <-> exists n :e omega, P n /\ forall m :e omega, m < n -> ~ P m

items.name: num_congruent
items.statement: forall x y n :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> divides_int n (x + - y)

items.name: num_coprime
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = 1 <-> gcd_int a b = 1

items.name: num_divides
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, divides_nat a b <-> divides_int a b

items.name: num_gcd
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, gcd_int a b = if gcd_int a b :e omega then gcd_int a b else 0

items.name: num_lcm
items.statement: forall a b :e omega, lcm_int a b = if lcm_int a b :e omega then lcm_int a b else 0

items.name: num_mod
items.statement: forall n x y :e omega, (exists q1 q2 :e omega, x + n * q1 = y + n * q2) <-> divides_int n (x + - y)

items.name: num_of_int
items.statement: forall x :e int, (if x :e omega then x else 0) = choose_in omega (fun n:set => n = x)

items.name: numseg
items.statement: forall m n :e omega, {i :e omega | m <= i /\ i <= n} = {x :e omega | m <= x /\ x <= n}

items.name: o_ASSOC
items.statement: forall A B C D:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e C, f x :e D) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e B, g x :e C) -> forall h:set -> set, (forall x :e A, h x :e B) -> forall x :e A, f (g (h x)) = f (g (h x))

items.name: o_DEF
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall x :e A, f (g x) = f (g x)

items.name: o_THM
items.statement: forall A B C:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e C) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall x :e A, f (g x) = f (g x)

items.name: one
items.statement: forall v :e 1, v = 0

items.name: one_Axiom
items.statement: forall A:set, forall e0 :e A, exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e 1, fn x :e A) /\ (fn 0 = e0 /\ forall y:set -> set, (forall x :e 1, y x :e A) -> y 0 = e0 -> forall x :e 1, y x = fn x)

items.name: one_DEF
items.statement: 0 = choose_in 1 (fun x:set => True)

items.name: one_INDUCT
items.statement: forall P:set -> prop, P 0 -> forall x :e 1, P x

items.name: one_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A:set, forall e0 :e A, exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e 1, fn x :e A) /\ fn 0 = e0

items.name: one_axiom
items.statement: forall A:set, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e 1) -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e 1) -> forall x :e A, f x = g x

items.name: onorm_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx M, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> onorm M N f = sup {vector_norm N (f x) | x :e R :^: idx M, vector_norm M x = 1}

items.name: open_def
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, open A s <-> forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx A, distance A (x',x) < e0 -> x' :e s

items.name: open_in
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall u s c= R :^: idx N, s :e subtopology (R :^: idx N) (euclidean N) u <-> s c= u /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x' :e R :^: idx N, x' :e u /\ distance N (x',x) < e0 -> x' :e s

items.name: open_interval_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx N, open_interval N (a,b) = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex N -> a i < x i /\ x i < b i}

items.name: open_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (open_map A B (top1,top2) f <-> forall u c= A, u :e top1 -> {f x | x :e u} :e top2)

items.name: open_real_interval_thm
items.statement: forall a b :e R, open_real_interval (a,b) = {x :e R | a < x /\ x < b}

items.name: open_segment_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, open_segment A (a,b) = closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: {a,b}

items.name: operative_thm
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx N), f x :e A) -> (operative A N op f <-> (forall a b :e R :^: idx N, content N (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = 0 -> f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = neutral_of A op) /\ forall a b :e R :^: idx N, forall c :e R, forall k :e omega, 1 <= k /\ k <= dimindex N -> f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil)) = op (f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | x k <= c})) (f (closed_interval N (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :/\: {x :e R :^: idx N | c <= x k})))

items.name: opposite_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, opposite_group A G = (group_carrier A G,(group_id A G,(fun x :e A => group_inv A G x,fun x :e A => fun y :e A => group_mul A G y x)))

items.name: option_DISTINCT
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, ~ Inj1 a = Inj0 0

items.name: option_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, P (Inj0 0) /\ (forall a :e A, P (Inj1 a)) -> forall x :e 1 :+: A, P x

items.name: option_INJ
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a b :e A, Inj1 a = Inj1 b <-> a = b

items.name: option_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A Z:set, A <> Empty -> forall NONE' :e Z, forall SOME':set -> set, (forall x :e A, SOME' x :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e 1 :+: A, fn x :e Z) /\ (fn (Inj0 0) = NONE' /\ forall a :e A, fn (Inj1 a) = SOME' a)

items.name: ordinal_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, ordinal_on A l <-> woset_on A l /\ forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> x = choose_in A (fun y:set => ~ properly_rel l y x)

items.name: oriented_simplex_thm
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall l:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, l x y :e R) -> forall x :e R :^: omega, forall x0 :e omega, oriented_simplex p l x x0 = (if x :e standard_simplex p then fun x2 :e omega => finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= p} (fun j:set => l j x2 * x j) else choose_in (R :^: omega) (fun y:set => True)) x0

items.name: orthogonal_matrix_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall Q :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, orthogonal_matrix_hl N Q <-> matrix_mul N N N (transp N N Q) Q = mat N N 1 /\ matrix_mul N N N Q (transp N N Q) = mat N N 1

items.name: orthogonal_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, orthogonal A x y <-> dot A x y = 0

items.name: orthogonal_transformation_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> (orthogonal_transformation N f <-> linear N N f /\ forall v w :e R :^: idx N, dot N (f v) (f w) = dot N v w)

items.name: outer_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx (multivector N), outer N x y = Product N (fun s:set => fun t:set => if ~ s :/\: t = Empty then 0 else (- 1) ^ finite_cardinality (\/_ i :e omega, {(i,j) | j :e omega, i :e idx N /\ (j :e idx N /\ (i :e s /\ (j :e t /\ j < i)))})) (fun s:set => fun t:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e (s :\: t) :\/: (t :\: s)) x y

items.name: outermorphism_thm
items.statement: forall N P:set, N <> Empty -> P <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector N), forall f:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx N, f x0 :e R :^: idx P) -> outermorphism N P f x = vsum (Power omega) (multivector P) {s :e Power omega | s c= idx N} (fun s:set => vector_mul (multivector P) (multivector_index N x s) (seqiterate (R :^: idx (multivector P)) (fun x0 :e R :^: idx (multivector P) => fun x1 :e R :^: idx (multivector P) => outer P x0 x1) s (fun x0 :e omega => multivec P (f (basis N x0)))))

items.name: outside_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, outside N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | ~ x :e s /\ ~ bounded_hl N {x0 :e R :^: idx N | connected_component N ((R :^: idx N) :\: s) x x0}}

items.name: pair_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall P:set -> prop, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, P (x,y)) -> forall p :e A :*: B, P p

items.name: pair_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A B C:set, C <> Empty -> forall PAIR':set -> set -> set, (forall x :e A, forall y :e B, PAIR' x y :e C) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e A :*: B, fn x :e C) /\ forall a0 :e A, forall a1 :e B, fn (a0,a1) = PAIR' a0 a1

items.name: pairwise
items.statement: forall A:set, forall s c= A, forall r:set -> set -> prop, (forall x y :e s, x <> y -> r x y) <-> forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ (y :e s /\ ~ x = y) -> r x y

items.name: paracompact_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, paracompact_space A top <-> forall U c= Power A, (forall u c= A, u :e U -> u :e top) /\ Union U = topspace A top -> exists V c= Power A, (forall v c= A, v :e V -> v :e top) /\ (Union V = topspace A top /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e V -> exists u c= A, u :e U /\ v c= u) /\ locally_finite_in A top V))

items.name: pastecart_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e A :^: idx M, forall g :e A :^: idx N, pastecart M N f g = fun i :e idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N) => if i <= dimindex M then f i else g (minus_nat i (dimindex M))

items.name: path_component_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, path_component_of A top x y <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R, g x0 :e A) /\ (path_in A top g /\ (g 0 = x /\ g 1 = y))

items.name: path_component_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall x y :e R :^: idx A, path_component A s x y <-> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx 1, g x0 :e R :^: idx A) /\ (path A g /\ (path_image A g c= s /\ (pathstart A g = x /\ pathfinish A g = y)))

items.name: path_components_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_components_of A top = {{x0 :e A | path_component_of A top x x0} | x :e A, x :e topspace A top}

items.name: path_components_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, path_components A s = {{x0 :e R :^: idx A | path_component A s x x0} | x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s}

items.name: path_connected_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, path_connected_in A top s <-> s c= topspace A top /\ path_connected_space A (subtopology A top s)

items.name: path_connected_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, path_connected_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ y :e topspace A top -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R, g x0 :e A) /\ (path_in A top g /\ (g 0 = x /\ g 1 = y))

items.name: path_connected_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, path_connected A s <-> forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> exists g:set -> set, (forall x0 :e R :^: idx 1, g x0 :e R :^: idx A) /\ (path A g /\ (path_image A g c= s /\ (pathstart A g = x /\ pathfinish A g = y)))

items.name: path_image_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> path_image N g = {g x | x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)}

items.name: path_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R, g x :e A) -> (path_in A top g <-> continuous_map R A (subtopology R euclideanreal (closed_real_interval (seq_cons (0,1) seq_nil)),top) g)

items.name: path_length_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> path_length N g = vector_variation N (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)) g

items.name: path_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (path N g <-> continuous_on_hl 1 N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)))

items.name: pathfinish_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathfinish N g = g (vec 1 1)

items.name: pathstart_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> pathstart N g = g (vec 1 0)

items.name: perfect_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, perfect_map A B (top,top') f <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') f /\ (proper_map A B (top,top') f /\ {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top')

items.name: permutation_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> (permutation A p <-> exists n :e omega, swapseq A n p)

items.name: permutes_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> (permutes A p s <-> (forall x :e A, ~ x :e s -> p x = x) /\ forall y :e A, exists x :e A, p x = y /\ forall y0 :e A, p y0 = y -> y0 = x)

items.name: pgroup_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= omega, pgroup A s G <-> forall p :e omega, forall x :e A, prime_nat p /\ (x :e group_carrier A G /\ divides_nat p (group_element_order_hl A G x)) -> p :e s

items.name: polar_dual_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, polar_dual N s = {x :e R :^: idx N | forall u :e R :^: idx N, u :e s -> - 1 <= dot N u x}

items.name: polyhedron_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, polyhedron A s <-> exists f c= Power (R :^: idx A), finite f /\ (s = {x :e R :^: idx A | forall Y :e f, x :e Y} /\ forall h c= R :^: idx A, h :e f -> exists a :e R :^: idx A, exists b :e R, ~ a = vec A 0 /\ h = {x :e R :^: idx A | dot A a x <= b})

items.name: polynomial_function_thm
items.statement: forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R, p x :e R) -> (polynomial_function_R p <-> exists m :e omega, exists c:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, c x :e R) /\ forall x :e R, p x = finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= m} (fun i:set => c i * x ^ i))

items.name: polytope_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, polytope A s <-> exists v c= R :^: idx A, finite v /\ s = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} v

items.name: poset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, poset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y)

items.name: positive_definite_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_definite N A <-> symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, ~ x = vec N 0 -> 0 < dot N x (matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: positive_semidefinite_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, positive_semidefinite N A <-> symmetric_matrix_hl N A /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, 0 <= dot N x (matrix_vector_mul N N A x)

items.name: prime
items.statement: forall p :e omega, prime_nat p <-> ~ p = 1 /\ forall x :e omega, divides_nat x p -> x = 1 \/ x = p

items.name: prod_group_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall G' :e group_hl B, prod_group A B G G' = (group_carrier A G :*: group_carrier B G',((group_id A G,group_id B G'),(fun p :e A :*: B => (group_inv A G (p 0),group_inv B G' (p 1)),fun p :e A :*: B => fun p0 :e A :*: B => (group_mul A G (p 0) (p0 0),group_mul B G' (p 1) (p0 1)))))

items.name: prod_metric_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric A, forall m2 :e metric B, prod_metric A B m1 m2 = (mspace A m1 :*: mspace B m2,fun p :e A :*: B :*: (A :*: B) => if 0 <= mdist A m1 (p 0 0,p 1 0) ^ 2 + mdist B m2 (p 0 1,p 1 1) ^ 2 then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (mdist A m1 (p 0 0,p 1 0) ^ 2 + mdist B m2 (p 0 1,p 1 1) ^ 2) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- (mdist A m1 (p 0 0,p 1 0) ^ 2 + mdist B m2 (p 0 1,p 1 1) ^ 2)))

items.name: prod_topology_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top1 :e topology A, forall top2 :e topology B, prod_topology A B top1 top2 = {x :e Power (A :*: B) | exists u c= Power (A :*: B), True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e \/_ s :e Power A, {s :*: t | t :e Power B, s :e top1 /\ t :e top2}) /\ Union u = x}

items.name: prod_tybij
items.error: internal constant REP_prod (HOL Light internal construction)

items.name: product
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e R) -> finprod x x0 = iterate_op R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a * b) x x0

items.name: product_group_thm
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> product_group A K k G = ({f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x0 :e A | x0 :e group_carrier A (G i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)},(fun x :e K => if x :e k then group_id A (G x) else choose_in A (fun y:set => True),(fun x :e A :^: K => fun x0 :e K => if x0 :e k then group_inv A (G x0) (x x0) else choose_in A (fun y:set => True),fun x :e A :^: K => fun y :e A :^: K => fun x0 :e K => if x0 :e k then group_mul A (G x0) (x x0) (y x0) else choose_in A (fun y0:set => True))))

items.name: product_map
items.statement: forall A B K:set, forall k c= K, forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e K, forall y :e A, f x y :e B) -> forall x :e A :^: K, forall x0 :e K, (if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)) = if x0 :e k then f x0 (x x0) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: product_topology_thm
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall t c= K, forall tops:set -> set, (forall x :e K, tops x :e topology A) -> product_topology A K t tops = {x :e Power (A :^: K) | exists u c= Power (A :^: K), True /\ (forall x0 :e u, x0 :e relative_to (A :^: K) {x01 :e Power (A :^: K) | exists u c= Power (A :^: K), finite u /\ (forall x1 :e u, x1 :e \/_ k :e K, {{x11 :e A :^: K | x11 k :e u} | u :e Power A, k :e t /\ u :e tops k}) /\ {x :e A :^: K | forall Y :e u, x :e Y} = x01} {x01 :e A :^: K | (forall x :e K, ~ x :e t -> x01 x = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)) /\ forall k :e K, k :e t -> x01 k :e topspace A (tops k)}) /\ Union u = x}

items.name: proper_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top' :e topology B, forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> (proper_map A B (top,top') f <-> closed_map A B (top,top') f /\ forall y :e B, y :e topspace B top' -> compact_in A top {x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x = y})

items.name: properly
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, properly_rel R0 x y <-> R0 x y /\ ~ x = y

items.name: pushin_thm
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall k :e omega, forall t :e B, forall x :e B :^: idx C, pushin A B C k t x = fun i :e idx A => if i < k then x i else if i = k then t else x (minus_nat i 1)

items.name: qoset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, qoset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z

items.name: quasi_component_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall top :e topology A, forall x y :e A, quasi_component_of A top x y <-> x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ forall t c= A, closed_in A top t /\ t :e top -> (x :e t <-> y :e t))

items.name: quasi_components_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, quasi_components_of A top = {{x0 :e A | quasi_component_of A top x x0} | x :e A, x :e topspace A top}

items.name: quotient_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n c= A, forall G :e group_hl A, quotient_group A G n = ({right_coset_hl A G n x | x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G},(n,(fun x :e Power A => group_setinv A G x,fun x :e Power A => fun x0 :e Power A => group_setmul A G x x0)))

items.name: quotient_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall top' :e topology B, quotient_map A B (top,top') f <-> {f x | x :e topspace A top} = topspace B top' /\ forall u c= B, u c= topspace B top' -> ({x :e A | x :e topspace A top /\ f x :e u} :e top <-> u :e top')

items.name: rank_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx M :^: idx N, rank M N A = dim N (columns N M A)

items.name: rational_thm
items.statement: forall x :e R, x :e rational <-> exists m n :e R, m :e int /\ (n :e int /\ (~ n = 0 /\ x = m :/: n))

items.name: real_INFINITE
items.statement: infinite R

items.name: real_abs
items.statement: forall x :e R, abs_SNo x = if 0 <= x then x else - x

items.name: real_add
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_bounded_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R, real_bounded s <-> exists B :e R, forall x :e R, x :e s -> abs_SNo x <= B

items.name: real_closed_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R, real_closed s <-> real_open (R :\: s)

items.name: real_compact_def
items.statement: forall s c= R, real_compact s <-> compact_in R euclideanreal s

items.name: real_div
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x :/: y = x * recip_SNo y

items.name: real_euclidean_metric_thm
items.statement: real_euclidean_metric = (R,fun p :e R :*: R => abs_SNo (p 1 + - p 0))

items.name: real_ge
items.statement: forall y x :e R, y <= x <-> y <= x

items.name: real_gt
items.statement: forall y x :e R, y < x <-> y < x

items.name: real_infsum_thm
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall s c= omega, real_infsum s f = choose_in R (fun l:set => real_sums f l s)

items.name: real_interval
items.statement: forall a b :e R, open_real_interval (a,b) = {x :e R | a < x /\ x < b} /\ closed_real_interval (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {x :e R | a <= x /\ x <= b}

items.name: real_inv
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_lt
items.statement: forall y x :e R, x < y <-> ~ y <= x

items.name: real_max
items.statement: forall n m :e R, (if m <= n then n else m) = if m <= n then n else m

items.name: real_min
items.statement: forall m n :e R, (if m <= n then m else n) = if m <= n then m else n

items.name: real_mod_thm
items.statement: forall x y n :e R, real_mod n x y <-> exists q :e R, q :e int /\ x + - y = q * n

items.name: real_mul
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_neg
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_of_num
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_of_num_th
items.error: internal constant mk_real (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: real_open_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R, real_open s <-> forall x :e R, x :e s -> exists e0 :e R, 0 < e0 /\ forall x' :e R, abs_SNo (x' + - x) < e0 -> x' :e s

items.name: real_pow
items.statement: forall x :e R, x ^ 0 = 1 /\ forall n :e omega, x ^ ordsucc n = x * x ^ n

items.name: real_sgn
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) = if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0

items.name: real_sub
items.statement: forall x y :e R, x + - y = x + - y

items.name: real_summable_thm
items.statement: forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall s c= omega, real_summable s f <-> exists l :e R, real_sums f l s

items.name: real_sums_thm
items.statement: forall s c= omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, real_sums f l s <-> tendsto_real omega (fun n:set => finsum (s :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) f) l sequentially

items.name: real_zpow
items.statement: forall z :e R, forall i :e int, (if 0 <= i then z ^ i else recip_SNo (z ^ (- i))) = if 0 <= i then z ^ if i :e omega then i else 0 else recip_SNo (z ^ if - i :e omega then - i else 0)

items.name: reallim_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall net0 :e net A, reallim A net0 f = choose_in R (fun l:set => tendsto_real A f l net0)

items.name: rectifiable_path_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (rectifiable_path N g <-> path N g /\ has_bounded_variation_on N g (closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil)))

items.name: reduced_homology_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, reduced_homology_group A (p,top) = subgroup_generated (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top)) (group_kernel (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (Power (frag (1 :^: (R :^: omega)))) (homology_group A (p,top),homology_group 1 (p,discrete_topology 1 {0})) (fun x:set => hom_induced A 1 p (top,Empty) (discrete_topology 1 {0},Empty) (fun x :e A => 0) x))

items.name: reflect_along_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x v :e R :^: idx N, reflect_along N v x = vector_sub N x (vector_mul N (2 * dot N x v :/: dot N v v) v)

items.name: regular_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, regular_space A top <-> forall c c= A, forall a :e A, closed_in A top c /\ a :e topspace A top :\: c -> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (a :e u /\ (c c= v /\ u :/\: v = Empty)))

items.name: relative_frontier_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, relative_frontier A s = closure A s :\: relative_interior A s

items.name: relative_homology_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e int, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, relative_homology_group A (p,(top,s)) = if p < 0 then singleton_group (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (choose_in (Power (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)))) (fun x:set => True)) else quotient_group (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (relcycle_group A (if p :e omega then p else 0,(top,s))) {x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | singular_relboundary A (if p :e omega then p else 0,(top,s)) x}

items.name: relative_interior_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, relative_interior A s = {x :e R :^: idx A | exists t c= R :^: idx A, t :e subtopology (R :^: idx A) (euclidean A) (hull (R :^: idx A) {x0 :e Power (R :^: idx A) | affine A x0} s) /\ (x :e t /\ t c= s)}

items.name: relative_to_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P c= Power A, forall s t c= A, t :e relative_to A P s <-> exists u c= A, u :e P /\ s :/\: u = t

items.name: relcycle_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, relcycle_group A (p,(top,s)) = subgroup_generated (frag (A :^: (R :^: omega))) (chain_group A (p,top)) {x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)) | singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) x}

items.name: retract_of_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, retract_of_space A s top <-> s c= topspace A top /\ exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e A, r x :e A) /\ (continuous_map A A (top,subtopology A top s) r /\ forall x :e A, x :e s -> r x = x)

items.name: retract_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, retract_of A t s <-> exists r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, r x :e R :^: idx A) /\ retraction A (s,t) r

items.name: retraction_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f :e B :^: A, retraction_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) <-> exists g :e A :^: B, retraction_maps A B (top,top') (f,g)

items.name: retraction_maps_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f :e B :^: A, forall g :e A :^: B, retraction_maps A B (top,top') (f,g) <-> continuous_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) /\ (continuous_map B A (top',top) (fun x:set => g x) /\ forall x :e B, x :e topspace B top' -> f (g x) = x)

items.name: retraction_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx N, forall r:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx N, r x :e R :^: idx N) -> (retraction N (s,t) r <-> t c= s /\ (continuous_on_hl N N r s /\ ({r x | x :e s} c= t /\ forall x :e R :^: idx N, x :e t -> r x = x)))

items.name: reversepath_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall x :e R :^: idx 1, reversepath N g x = g (vector_sub 1 (vec 1 1) x)

items.name: reversion_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector N), reversion N x = lambdas N (fun s:set => (- 1) ^ div_nat (finite_cardinality s * minus_nat (finite_cardinality s) 1) 2 * multivector_index N x s)

items.name: right_coset_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall G :e group_hl A, forall h c= A, forall x :e A, right_coset_hl A G h x = group_setmul A G h {x}

items.name: rotation_matrix_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall Q :e R :^: idx A :^: idx A, rotation_matrix A Q <-> orthogonal_matrix_hl A Q /\ det A Q = 1

items.name: rotoinversion_matrix_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall Q :e R :^: idx A :^: idx A, rotoinversion_matrix A Q <-> orthogonal_matrix_hl A Q /\ det A Q = - 1

items.name: row_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall i :e omega, row M N i A = fun j :e idx N => A i j

items.name: rows_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, rows M N A = {row M N i A | i :e omega, 1 <= i /\ i <= dimindex M}

items.name: rowvector_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall v :e R :^: idx N, rowvector N v = fun i :e idx 1 => fun j :e idx N => v j

items.name: second_countable_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, second_countable A top <-> exists b c= Power A, countable b /\ ((forall v c= A, v :e b -> v :e top) /\ forall u c= A, forall x :e A, u :e top /\ x :e u -> exists v c= A, v :e b /\ (x :e v /\ v c= u))

items.name: section_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall top' :e topology B, forall top :e topology A, forall f :e B :^: A, section_map A B (top,top') (fun x:set => f x) <-> exists g :e A :^: B, retraction_maps B A (top',top) (g,f)

items.name: segment
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a b :e R :^: idx A, closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) = {vector_add A (vector_mul A (1 + - u) a) (vector_mul A u b) | u :e R, 0 <= u /\ u <= 1} /\ open_segment A (a,b) = closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil) :\: {a,b}

items.name: separable_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, separable_space A top <-> exists c c= A, countable c /\ (c c= topspace A top /\ closure_of A top c = topspace A top)

items.name: separated_between_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall s t c= A, separated_between A top s t <-> exists u v c= A, u :e top /\ (v :e top /\ (u :\/: v = topspace A top /\ (u :/\: v = Empty /\ (s c= u /\ t c= v))))

items.name: separated_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall t c= A, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, separated_in A top s t <-> s c= topspace A top /\ (t c= topspace A top /\ (s :/\: closure_of A top t = Empty /\ t :/\: closure_of A top s = Empty))

items.name: seqiterate_EXISTS
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e A, op x y :e A) -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e A) -> exists h:set -> set, (forall x :e Power omega, h x :e A) /\ forall s c= omega, h s = if infinite s \/ s = Empty then neutral_of A op else if s = {choose_in omega (fun n:set => n :e s /\ forall m :e omega, m :e s -> n <= m)} then f (choose_in omega (fun n:set => n :e s /\ forall m :e omega, m :e s -> n <= m)) else op (f (choose_in omega (fun n:set => n :e s /\ forall m :e omega, m :e s -> n <= m))) (h (s :\: {choose_in omega (fun n:set => n :e s /\ forall m :e omega, m :e s -> n <= m)}))

items.name: seqiterate_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall op :e A :^: A :^: A, forall f :e A :^: omega, forall s c= omega, seqiterate A op s f = if infinite s \/ s = Empty then neutral_of A (fun a:set => fun b:set => op a b) else if s = {choose_in omega (fun n:set => n :e s /\ forall m :e omega, m :e s -> n <= m)} then f (choose_in omega (fun n:set => n :e s /\ forall m :e omega, m :e s -> n <= m)) else op (f (choose_in omega (fun n:set => n :e s /\ forall m :e omega, m :e s -> n <= m))) (seqiterate A op (s :\: {choose_in omega (fun n:set => n :e s /\ forall m :e omega, m :e s -> n <= m)}) f)

items.name: sequentially_thm
items.statement: sequentially = ({from n | n :e omega, n :e omega},Empty)

items.name: set_of_list
items.statement: forall A:set, forall h :e A, forall t :e finseq A, seq_set seq_nil = Empty /\ seq_set (seq_cons h t) = SetAdjoin (seq_set t) h

items.name: set_variation_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx M, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e Power (R :^: idx M), f x :e R :^: idx N) -> set_variation M N s f = sup {finsum d (fun k:set => vector_norm N (f k)) | d :e Power (Power (R :^: idx M)), exists t c= R :^: idx M, division_of M d t /\ t c= s}

items.name: setcode_thm
items.statement: forall s c= omega, setcode s = 1 + binarysum {nat_pred x | x :e s}

items.name: setdist_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s t c= R :^: idx A, setdist A (s,t) = if s = Empty \/ t = Empty then 0 else inf (\/_ x :e R :^: idx A, {distance A (x,y) | y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e t})

items.name: shiftpath_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall a x :e R :^: idx 1, shiftpath N a f x = if drop (vector_add 1 a x) <= 1 then f (vector_add 1 a x) else f (vector_add 1 a (vector_sub 1 x (vec 1 1)))

items.name: short_exact_sequence_thm
items.statement: forall A B C:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> C <> Empty -> forall A0 :e group_hl A, forall f :e B :^: A, forall B0 :e group_hl B, forall C0 :e group_hl C, forall g :e C :^: B, short_exact_sequence A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) <-> group_monomorphism A B (A0,B0) (fun x:set => f x) /\ (group_exactness A B C (A0,(B0,C0)) (f,g) /\ group_epimorphism B C (B0,C0) (fun x:set => g x))

items.name: sigma_locally_finite_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall U c= Power A, sigma_locally_finite_in A top U <-> exists f :e Power (Power A) :^: omega, (forall n :e omega, locally_finite_in A top (f n)) /\ U = Union {f n | n :e omega, n :e omega}

items.name: sign_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> sign A p = if evenperm A p then 1 else - 1

items.name: simple_path_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e R :^: idx N) -> (simple_path N g <-> path N g /\ forall x y :e R :^: idx 1, x :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ (y :e closed_interval 1 (seq_cons (vec 1 0,vec 1 1) seq_nil) /\ g x = g y) -> x = y \/ (x = vec 1 0 /\ y = vec 1 1 \/ x = vec 1 1 /\ y = vec 1 0))

items.name: simplex_cone_thm
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall v :e R :^: omega, forall l:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, l x y :e R) -> forall x :e R :^: omega, forall x0 :e omega, simplex_cone p v (fun x1 :e R :^: omega => fun x2 :e omega => oriented_simplex p l x1 x2) x x0 = oriented_simplex (p + 1) (fun i:set => fun x1:set => if i = 0 then v x1 else l (minus_nat i 1) x1) x x0

items.name: simplex_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e A, g x :e B) -> forall c:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, c x :e A) -> forall x :e R :^: omega, simplex_map A B p g c x = if x :e standard_simplex p then g (c x) else choose_in B (fun y:set => True)

items.name: simplex_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall n :e int, forall s c= R :^: idx A, simplex A n s <-> exists c c= R :^: idx A, ~ affine_dependent A c /\ (finite_cardinality c = n + 1 /\ s = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | convex A x} c)

items.name: simplicial_chain_thm
items.statement: forall c :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), forall p :e omega, forall s c= R :^: omega, simplicial_chain (p,s) c <-> frag_support (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) c c= {x :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega) | simplicial_simplex (p,s) (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => x x0 x1)}

items.name: simplicial_complex_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c c= Power (R :^: idx A), simplicial_complex A c <-> finite c /\ ((forall s c= R :^: idx A, s :e c -> exists n :e int, simplex A n s) /\ ((forall f s c= R :^: idx A, s :e c /\ face_of A f s -> f :e c) /\ forall s s' c= R :^: idx A, s :e c /\ s' :e c -> face_of A (s :/\: s') s /\ face_of A (s :/\: s') s'))

items.name: simplicial_cone_thm
items.statement: forall p :e omega, forall v :e R :^: omega, forall x :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_cone p (fun x0:set => v x0) x = frag_extend (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun x:set => frag_of (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) (simplex_cone p v x)) x

items.name: simplicial_face_thm
items.statement: forall k :e omega, forall x:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, x x :e R) -> forall i :e omega, simplicial_face k x i = if i < k then x i else if i = k then 0 else x (minus_nat i 1)

items.name: simplicial_simplex_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R :^: omega, forall f :e R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega), forall p :e omega, simplicial_simplex (p,s) (fun x:set => fun x0:set => f x x0) <-> singular_simplex (R :^: omega) (p,subtopology (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) s) (fun x:set => f x) /\ exists l:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e omega, l x y :e R) /\ forall x :e R :^: omega, forall x0 :e omega, f x x0 = oriented_simplex p l x x0

items.name: simplicial_subdivision_thm
items.statement: forall p :e omega, (forall x :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_subdivision 0 x = x) /\ forall x :e frag (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)), simplicial_subdivision (ordsucc p) x = frag_extend (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun f:set => simplicial_cone p (fun i:set => finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= ordsucc p} (fun j:set => simplicial_vertex j (fun x0:set => fun x1:set => f x0 x1) i) :/: (p + 2)) (simplicial_subdivision p (chain_boundary (R :^: omega) (ordsucc p) (frag_of (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) f)))) x

items.name: simplicial_vertex_thm
items.statement: forall f:set -> set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, forall y :e omega, f x y :e R) -> forall i x :e omega, simplicial_vertex i f x = f (fun j :e omega => if j = i then 1 else 0) x

items.name: simply_connected_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx N, simply_connected N s <-> forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, p x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall q:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, q x :e R :^: idx N) -> path N p /\ (pathfinish N p = pathstart N p /\ (path_image N p c= s /\ (path N q /\ (pathfinish N q = pathstart N q /\ path_image N q c= s)))) -> homotopic_loops N s p q

items.name: sindex
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx (multivector N), forall s c= omega, multivector_index N x s = x (setcode s)

items.name: singleton_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall a :e A, singleton_group A a = ({a},(a,(fun x :e A => a,fun x :e A => fun y :e A => a)))

items.name: singular_chain_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, singular_chain A (p,top) c <-> frag_support (A :^: (R :^: omega)) c c= {x :e A :^: (R :^: omega) | singular_simplex A (p,top) (fun x0:set => x x0)}

items.name: singular_face_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, f x :e A) -> forall k :e omega, forall x :e R :^: omega, singular_face A p k f x = if x :e standard_simplex (minus_nat p 1) then f (fun x1 :e omega => simplicial_face k (fun x2:set => x x2) x1) else choose_in A (fun y:set => True)

items.name: singular_relboundary_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, singular_relboundary A (p,(top,s)) c <-> exists d :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_chain A (p + 1,top) d /\ mod_subset A (p,subtopology A top s) (chain_boundary A (p + 1) d) c

items.name: singular_relcycle_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall c :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), forall p :e omega, forall top :e topology A, forall s c= A, singular_relcycle A (p,(top,s)) c <-> singular_chain A (p,top) c /\ mod_subset A (minus_nat p 1,subtopology A top s) (chain_boundary A p c) (frag_0 (A :^: (R :^: omega)))

items.name: singular_simplex_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall p :e omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: omega, f x :e A) -> (singular_simplex A (p,top) f <-> continuous_map (R :^: omega) A (subtopology (R :^: omega) (product_topology R omega omega (fun i:set => euclideanreal)) (standard_simplex p),top) f /\ forall x :e R :^: omega, ~ x :e standard_simplex p -> f x = choose_in A (fun y:set => True))

items.name: singular_subdivision_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall p :e omega, forall x :e frag (A :^: (R :^: omega)), singular_subdivision A p x = frag_extend (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (A :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun f:set => chain_map (R :^: omega) A p (fun x0:set => f x0) (simplicial_subdivision p (frag_of (R :^: omega :^: (R :^: omega)) (fun x0 :e R :^: omega => fun x1 :e omega => (if x0 :e standard_simplex p then fun x1 :e omega => x0 x1 else choose_in (R :^: omega) (fun y:set => True)) x1)))) x

items.name: sndcart_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall f :e A :^: idx_n (dimindex M + dimindex N), sndcart M N f = fun i :e idx N => f (i + dimindex M)

items.name: solvable_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, solvable_group A G <-> exists k :e omega, exists c :e Power A :^: omega, c 0 = group_carrier A G /\ (c k = {group_id A G} /\ forall i :e omega, i < k -> normal_subgroup_of A (c (ordsucc i)) (subgroup_generated A G (c i)) /\ abelian_group_hl (Power A) (quotient_group A (subgroup_generated A G (c i)) (c (ordsucc i))))

items.name: span_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, span A s = hull (R :^: idx A) {x :e Power (R :^: idx A) | subspace A x} s

items.name: sphere_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall e0 :e R, sphere A (x,e0) = {y :e R :^: idx A | distance A (x,y) = e0}

items.name: sqrt
items.statement: forall x :e R, (if 0 <= x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg x else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- x)) = choose_in R (fun y:set => (if 0 < y then 1 else if y < 0 then - 1 else 0) = (if 0 < x then 1 else if x < 0 then - 1 else 0) /\ y ^ 2 = abs_SNo x)

items.name: standard_simplex_thm
items.statement: forall p :e omega, standard_simplex p = {x :e R :^: omega | (forall i :e omega, 0 <= x i /\ x i <= 1) /\ ((forall i :e omega, p < i -> x i = 0) /\ finsum {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= p} (fun x0:set => x x0) = 1)}

items.name: starlike_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, starlike A s <-> exists a :e R :^: idx A, a :e s /\ forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> closed_segment A (seq_cons (a,x) seq_nil) c= s

items.name: strictly
items.statement: forall A:set, forall R0:set -> set -> prop, forall x y :e A, strictly_rel R0 x y <-> R0 x y /\ ~ R0 y x

items.name: string_INFINITE
items.error: no carrier mapping for type constructor char (in char)

items.name: subgroup_generated_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall G :e group_hl A, subgroup_generated A G s = ({x :e A | forall Y :e {h :e Power A | subgroup_of A h G /\ group_carrier A G :/\: s c= h}, x :e Y},(group_id A G,(fun x :e A => group_inv A G x,fun x :e A => fun x0 :e A => group_mul A G x x0)))

items.name: subgroup_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall s c= A, subgroup_of A s G <-> s c= group_carrier A G /\ (group_id A G :e s /\ ((forall x :e A, x :e s -> group_inv A G x :e s) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> group_mul A G x y :e s))

items.name: submatroid_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e matroid A, submatroid A m s = ({x :e A | matroid_span A m (matroid_set A m :/\: s) x},fun x :e Power A => {x0 :e A | matroid_span A m x x0})

items.name: submetric_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric A, submetric A m s = (s :/\: mspace A m,fun x :e A :*: A => mdist A m x)

items.name: subpath_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall g:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, g x :e A) -> forall v u x :e R :^: idx 1, subpath A u v g x = g (vector_add 1 u (vector_mul 1 (drop (vector_sub 1 v u)) x))

items.name: subspace_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, subspace A s <-> vec A 0 :e s /\ ((forall x y :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ y :e s -> vector_add A x y :e s) /\ forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx A, x :e s -> vector_mul A c x :e s)

items.name: subtopology_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall u c= A, subtopology A top u = {s :/\: u | s :e Power A, s :e top}

items.name: sum
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x c= A, forall x0:set -> set, (forall x0 :e A, x0 x0 :e R) -> finsum x x0 = iterate_op R (fun a:set => fun b:set => a + b) x x0

items.name: sum_CASES
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall x :e A :+: B, (exists a :e A, x = Inj0 a) \/ exists a :e B, x = Inj1 a

items.name: sum_DISTINCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, forall a :e A, forall a' :e B, ~ Inj0 a = Inj1 a'

items.name: sum_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall a :e A, P (Inj0 a)) /\ (forall a :e B, P (Inj1 a)) -> forall x :e A :+: B, P x

items.name: sum_INJECTIVE
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> (forall a a' :e A, Inj0 a = Inj0 a' <-> a = a') /\ forall a a' :e B, Inj1 a = Inj1 a' <-> a = a'

items.name: sum_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A B Z:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> Z <> Empty -> forall INL':set -> set, (forall x :e A, INL' x :e Z) -> forall INR':set -> set, (forall x :e B, INR' x :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e A :+: B, fn x :e Z) /\ ((forall a :e A, fn (Inj0 a) = INL' a) /\ forall a :e B, fn (Inj1 a) = INR' a)

items.name: sum_group_thm
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall G:set -> set, (forall x :e K, G x :e group_hl A) -> sum_group A K k G = subgroup_generated (A :^: K) (product_group A K k G) {x :e A :^: K | x :e {f :e A :^: K | (forall i :e k, f i :e {x1 :e A | x1 :e group_carrier A (G i)}) /\ forall i :e K, ~ i :e k -> f i = choose_in A (fun y:set => True)} /\ finite {i :e K | i :e k /\ ~ x i = group_id A (G i)}}

items.name: sum_topology_thm
items.statement: forall A K:set, A <> Empty -> K <> Empty -> forall k c= K, forall top:set -> set, (forall x :e K, top x :e topology A) -> sum_topology A K k top = {u :e Power (K :*: A) | u c= {p :e K :*: A | p 0 :e k /\ p 1 :e {x0 :e A | {x0 :e A | x0 :e topspace A (top (p 0))} x0}} /\ forall i :e K, i :e k -> {x :e A | (i,x) :e u} :e top i}

items.name: summable_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall s c= omega, summable A s f <-> exists l :e R :^: idx A, sums A f l s

items.name: sums_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= omega, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e omega, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, sums A f l s <-> tendsto A omega (fun n:set => vsum omega A (s :/\: {i :e omega | 0 <= i /\ i <= n}) f) l sequentially

items.name: sup_thm
items.statement: forall s c= R, sup s = choose_in R (fun a:set => (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= a) /\ forall b :e R, (forall x :e R, x :e s -> x <= b) -> a <= b)

items.name: superadmissible
items.error: internal constant tailadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: support
items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall op:set -> set -> set, (forall x y :e B, op x y :e B) -> {x :e s | f x <> neutral_of B op} = {x :e A | x :e s /\ ~ f x = neutral_of B op}

items.name: suslin_operation_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f :e Power A :^: finseq omega, suslin_operation A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e f x) = Union {{x :e A | forall Y :e {f (seq_mk n (fun x:set => s x)) | n :e omega, 1 <= n}, x :e Y} | s :e omega :^: omega, s :e omega :^: omega}

items.name: suslin_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall u c= Power A, suslin A u = {suslin_operation A (fun x:set => fun x0:set => x0 :e f x) | f :e Power A :^: finseq omega, forall l :e finseq omega, ~ l = seq_nil -> f l :e u}

items.name: swap_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall j i k :e A, swap A (i,j) k = if k = i then j else if k = j then i else k

items.name: swapseq_CASES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall a0 :e omega, forall a1:set -> set, (forall x :e A, a1 x :e A) -> (swapseq A a0 a1 <-> a0 = 0 /\ (forall x :e A, a1 x = x) \/ exists a b :e A, exists p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) /\ exists n :e omega, a0 = ordsucc n /\ ((forall x :e A, a1 x = swap A (a,b) (p x)) /\ (swapseq A n p /\ ~ a = b)))

items.name: swapseq_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall swapseq':set -> set -> prop, swapseq' 0 (fun x :e A => x) /\ (forall a b :e A, forall p :e A :^: A, forall n :e omega, swapseq' n p /\ ~ a = b -> swapseq' (ordsucc n) (fun x :e A => swap A (a,b) (p x))) -> forall a0 :e omega, forall a1 :e A :^: A, swapseq A a0 (fun x:set => a1 x) -> swapseq' a0 a1

items.name: swapseq_RULES
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> swapseq A 0 (fun x:set => x) /\ forall a b :e A, forall p:set -> set, (forall x :e A, p x :e A) -> forall n :e omega, swapseq A n p /\ ~ a = b -> swapseq A (ordsucc n) (fun x:set => swap A (a,b) (p x))

items.name: symmetric_matrix_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, symmetric_matrix_hl N A <-> transp N N A = A

items.name: t0_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t0_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ x = y) -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ ~ (x :e u <-> y :e u)

items.name: t1_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, t1_space A top <-> forall x y :e A, x :e topspace A top /\ (y :e topspace A top /\ ~ x = y) -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (x :e u /\ ~ y :e u)

items.name: tagged_division_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), forall i c= R :^: idx A, tagged_division_of A s i <-> tagged_partial_division_of A s i /\ Union {k :e Power (R :^: idx A) | exists x :e R :^: idx A, (x,k) :e s} = i

items.name: tagged_partial_division_of_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall i c= R :^: idx A, forall s c= R :^: idx A :*: Power (R :^: idx A), tagged_partial_division_of A s i <-> finite s /\ ((forall x :e R :^: idx A, forall k c= R :^: idx A, (x,k) :e s -> x :e k /\ (k c= i /\ exists a b :e R :^: idx A, k = closed_interval A (seq_cons (a,b) seq_nil))) /\ forall x1 :e R :^: idx A, forall k1 c= R :^: idx A, forall x2 :e R :^: idx A, forall k2 c= R :^: idx A, (x1,k1) :e s /\ ((x2,k2) :e s /\ ~ (x1,k1) = (x2,k2)) -> interior A k1 :/\: interior A k2 = Empty)

items.name: tailadmissible
items.error: internal constant tailadmissible (HOL Light internal definition/datatype machinery)

items.name: tendsto_real_def
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R) -> forall l :e R, forall net0 :e net A, tendsto_real A f l net0 <-> limit A R euclideanreal f l net0

items.name: tendsto_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e R :^: idx A) -> forall l :e R :^: idx A, forall net0 :e net B, tendsto A B f l net0 <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> eventually B {x :e B | distance A (f x,l) < e0} net0

items.name: three_cycle_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall b c a x :e A, three_cycle A a b c x = if x = a then b else if x = b then c else if x = c then a else x

items.name: topcontinuous_at_thm
