items.statement: forall A B:set, B <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, forall top' :e topology B, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall x :e A, topcontinuous_at A B top top' f x <-> x :e topspace A top /\ ((forall x0 :e A, x0 :e topspace A top -> f x0 :e topspace B top') /\ forall v c= B, v :e top' /\ f x :e v -> exists u c= A, u :e top /\ (x :e u /\ forall y :e A, y :e u -> f y :e v))

items.name: topology_tybij
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> (forall a :e topology A, a = a) /\ forall r c= Power A, istopology A r <-> r = r

items.name: topology_tybij_th
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> exists t c= Power A, istopology A t

items.name: topspace_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall top :e topology A, topspace A top = Union {s :e Power A | s :e top}

items.name: toset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, toset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ ((forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y) /\ forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x))

items.name: totally_bounded_in_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall m :e metric A, totally_bounded_in A m s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists k c= A, finite k /\ (k c= s /\ s c= Union {mball A m (x,e0) | x :e A, x :e k})

items.name: trace_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx N, trace N A = finsum (idx N) (fun i:set => A i i)

items.name: transp_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, transp M N A = fun i :e idx N => fun j :e idx M => A j i

items.name: triangulation_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall tr c= Power (R :^: idx N), triangulation N tr <-> finite tr /\ ((forall t c= R :^: idx N, t :e tr -> exists n :e int, simplex N n t) /\ forall t t' c= R :^: idx N, t :e tr /\ t' :e tr -> face_of N (t :/\: t') t /\ face_of N (t :/\: t') t')

items.name: trivial_group_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, trivial_group A G <-> group_carrier A G = {group_id A G}

items.name: trivial_homomorphism_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall G :e group_hl A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e B) -> forall G' :e group_hl B, trivial_homomorphism A B (G,G') f <-> group_homomorphism_hl A B (G,G') f /\ forall x :e A, x :e group_carrier A G -> f x = group_id B G'

items.name: trivial_limit_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall net0 :e net A, trivial_limit A net0 <-> eventually A {x :e A | False} net0

items.name: tybit0_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall a :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex A), P a) -> forall x :e idx_n (2 * dimindex A), P x

items.name: tybit0_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A Z:set, A <> Empty -> Z <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex A), f x :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e idx_n (2 * dimindex A), fn x :e Z) /\ forall a :e idx_n (dimindex A + dimindex A), fn a = f a

items.name: tybit1_INDUCT
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall P:set -> prop, (forall a :e idx_n ((dimindex A + dimindex A) + 1), P a) -> forall x :e idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1), P x

items.name: tybit1_RECURSION
items.statement: forall A Z:set, A <> Empty -> Z <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e idx_n ((dimindex A + dimindex A) + 1), f x :e Z) -> exists fn:set -> set, (forall x :e idx_n (2 * dimindex A + 1), fn x :e Z) /\ forall a :e idx_n ((dimindex A + dimindex A) + 1), fn a = f a

items.name: ulc_space_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall m :e metric A, ulc_space A m <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x y :e A, x :e mspace A m /\ (y :e mspace A m /\ mdist A m (x,y) < d) -> exists c c= A, x :e c /\ (y :e c /\ (c c= mspace A m /\ (connected_in A (mtopology A m) c /\ (mbounded A m c /\ mdiameter A m c <= e0))))

items.name: uniformly_continuous_map_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall m1 :e metric B, forall m2 :e metric A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e B, f x :e A) -> (uniformly_continuous_map A B (m1,m2) f <-> {f x | x :e mspace B m1} c= mspace A m2 /\ forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x x' :e B, x :e mspace B m1 /\ (x' :e mspace B m1 /\ mdist B m1 (x',x) < d) -> mdist A m2 (f x',f x) < e0)

items.name: uniformly_continuous_on_thm
items.statement: forall A B:set, A <> Empty -> B <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx A, f x :e R :^: idx B) -> (uniformly_continuous_on_hl A B f s <-> forall e0 :e R, 0 < e0 -> exists d :e R, 0 < d /\ forall x x' :e R :^: idx A, x :e s /\ (x' :e s /\ distance A (x',x) < d) -> distance B (f x',f x) < e0)

items.name: vec_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall n :e omega, vec N n = fun i :e idx N => n

items.name: vector_add_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_add N x y = fun i :e idx N => x i + y i

items.name: vector_derivative_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> forall net0 :e net (R :^: idx 1), vector_derivative N f net0 = choose_in (R :^: idx N) (fun f':set => has_vector_derivative N f f' net0)

items.name: vector_matrix_mul_thm
items.statement: forall M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall A :e R :^: idx N :^: idx M, forall x :e R :^: idx M, vector_matrix_mul M N x A = fun j :e idx N => finsum (idx M) (fun i:set => A i j * x i)

items.name: vector_mul_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall c :e R, forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_mul N c x = fun i :e idx N => c * x i

items.name: vector_neg_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx N, vector_neg N x = fun i :e idx N => - x i

items.name: vector_norm_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall x :e R :^: idx A, vector_norm A x = if 0 <= dot A x x then sqrt_SNo_nonneg (dot A x x) else - sqrt_SNo_nonneg (- dot A x x)

items.name: vector_sub_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall x y :e R :^: idx N, vector_sub N x y = fun i :e idx N => x i + - y i

items.name: vector_thm
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall l :e finseq A, vector A N l = fun i :e idx N => seq_nth l (minus_nat i 1)

items.name: vector_variation_thm
items.statement: forall N:set, N <> Empty -> forall s c= R :^: idx 1, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e R :^: idx 1, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> vector_variation N s f = set_variation 1 N s (fun k:set => vector_sub N (f (interval_upperbound 1 k)) (f (interval_lowerbound 1 k)))

items.name: vectorize_thm
items.statement: forall A M N:set, M <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall x :e A :^: idx N :^: idx M, vectorize A M N x = fun i :e idx_n (dimindex M * dimindex N) => x (1 + div_nat (minus_nat i 1) (dimindex N)) (1 + mod_nat (minus_nat i 1) (dimindex N))

items.name: vsum_thm
items.statement: forall A N:set, A <> Empty -> N <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall f:set -> set, (forall x :e A, f x :e R :^: idx N) -> vsum A N s f = fun i :e idx N => finsum s (fun x:set => f x i)

items.name: weakly_locally_connected_at_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall top :e topology A, weakly_locally_connected_at A x top <-> neighbourhood_base_at A x {x0 :e Power A | connected_in A top x0} top

items.name: weakly_locally_path_connected_at_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, forall x :e A, forall top :e topology A, weakly_locally_path_connected_at A x top <-> neighbourhood_base_at A x {x0 :e Power A | path_connected_in A top x0} top

items.name: within_thm
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall s c= A, forall net0 :e net A, within A net0 s = (relative_to A (netfilter A net0) s,netlimits A net0)

items.name: woset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, woset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ ((forall x y :e A, l x y /\ l y x -> x = y) /\ ((forall x y :e A, x :e fld_on A l /\ y :e fld_on A l -> l x y \/ l y x) /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l /\ ~ s = Empty -> exists x :e A, x :e s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> l x y)))

items.name: wqoset
items.statement: forall A:set, A <> Empty -> forall l:set -> set -> prop, wqoset_on A l <-> (forall x :e A, x :e fld_on A l -> l x x) /\ ((forall x y z :e A, l x y /\ l y z -> l x z) /\ forall s c= A, s c= fld_on A l -> exists t c= A, finite t /\ (t c= s /\ forall y :e A, y :e s -> exists x :e A, x :e t /\ l x y))
